en.p:
One continuous shot drifting above a city skyline at night as the sky begins to fracture.

The camera slowly moves forward as reality distorts — stars appear through cracks in the sky.

At the 2-second mark a lightning god strikes downward while a void entity tears open a dimensional rift.

The camera accelerates into the collapsing space between them.

Buildings stretch and bend as gravity shifts.

The shot never cuts — it passes through a building as it phases between dimensions, emerging into a warped version of the city.

Lightning arcs across multiple layers of reality.

The camera spirals upward into the rift, then drops back down through a collapsing gravitational field.

Debris floats, reverses, and collapses simultaneously.

Escalation builds until both entities collide at the center of the rift.

Final moment: the camera is pulled directly into the singularity as the city collapses inward.

One-take reality collapse, time + space + energy interaction, continuous dimensional distortion, 4K.

zh.p: 一个连续的长镜头，在夜晚的城市天际线上方飘移，天空开始碎裂。镜头缓缓前推，现实随之扭曲——星辰从天空的裂缝中显现。第2秒时，一位雷电之神向下劈击，同时一个虚空实体撕裂出一道次元裂隙。镜头加速冲入两者之间正在坍缩的空间。建筑在重力偏移中拉伸、扭曲。镜头从未中断——它穿过一栋建筑，建筑在维度间切换，浮现于一个扭曲版本的城市中。闪电在多重现实层间交错。镜头螺旋上升进入裂隙，随后穿过一个坍缩的引力场向下坠落。碎片同时漂浮、倒流并坍缩。紧张感不断升级，直至两个实体在裂隙中心相撞。最终时刻：镜头被直接吸入奇点，城市向内坍缩。一镜到底的现实崩塌，时间、空间与能量的交互，持续的维度扭曲，4K画质。

The red energy dissipates against his chest. He doesn’t even blink. SFX: High-energy HISS followed by a heavy metallic THUD. 0:03-0:07 ACTION: Superman hits a burst of speed, leaving a vapor cone behind him. He reaches the mercenary in a blur, grabs the cannon barrel, and effortlessly peels the metal back like a banana peel. SFX: Sharp SONIC BOOM followed by the SCREECH of tearing steel. 0:07-0:12 ACTION: Superman delivers a controlled, single-inch punch to the mercenary’s armor. The force sends the villain flying backward, crashing through a massive "LexCorp" holographic billboard. SFX: Deep, bass-boosted CRUNCH and the ZAP of short-circuiting electronics. 0:12-0:15 ACTION: Superman hovers perfectly still. He floats through the dissipating smoke, adjusts his cape, and gives a sharp, heroic nod toward the ground. SFX: The wind whistles softly; a heroic brass fanfare swells and cuts to black.

en.p: A continuous dolly-in glides along a surreal wooden sound sculpture perched on a stone overlook above the sea, bathed in golden-hour light. The instrument twists upward in intersecting curves and blocky voids—planks of varying size, density, and color are embedded at odd angles across its looping form. Some beams curve like ribs, others jut out like cantilevers, each tuned to a specific pitch. A shallow depth of field holds focus tight on the textured wood and warm grain, while the beach and bay blur dreamily in the background. Two performers move around the structure with wooden mallets, striking low, thick planks for resonant thumps, making a consistent beat. The rhythm is musical and melodic, yet deeply grounded—like structured improvisation. Sunlight catches the edges of the sculpture’s curves, while a soft crowd gathers just out of focus. At 7.9 s, the performers land a final high-low accent, the wood ringing into the coastal air as the camera lingers on a glowing void in the sculpture’s core.

zh.p: 一个连续的推轨镜头沿着一个超现实的木质声音雕塑滑行，这座雕塑栖息在海边一处石质观景台上，沐浴在黄金时刻的光线中。乐器以交错的曲线和块状空隙向上扭曲——大小、密度和颜色各异的木板以奇特的角度嵌入其环状形态中。有些木梁弯曲如肋骨，另一些则像悬臂般突出，每一块都调谐至特定音高。浅景深将焦点紧紧锁定在纹理清晰的木材和温暖的木纹上，而海滩与海湾则在背景中梦幻般地模糊。两位表演者手持木槌围绕结构移动，敲击低音厚木板，发出共鸣的闷响，形成稳定的节拍。节奏富有音乐性和旋律感，却又深深扎根于大地——如同结构化的即兴演奏。阳光捕捉到雕塑曲线的边缘，而一群观众在虚化中聚集。在第7.9秒时，表演者奏出最后一个高低音重音，木头的余音在海岸空气中回荡，镜头停留在雕塑核心处一个发光的空隙上。

en.p: The scene opens from a first-person POV at a polished wooden dining table inside the kitchen, capturing local ceramic dishware and copper-rimmed serving bowls under warm amber and white light. The chef sits across the table, dressed in a white chef's coat, enjoying a spread of regional dishes. The mood is relaxed, ambient kitchen sounds fill the air. At 0s, Chef, smiling and satisfied, cuts into a fragrant dish. By 2s, the viewer's hands enter the frame, loading a fork with food dipped in Carolina Reaper-infused oil, a vivid dark red condiment. The fork extends towards the Chef, who grins and takes the bite at 5s, enjoying the flavor, but at 7s his expression shifts as realization dawns. By 8s, his face flushes and he begins fanning his mouth, reaching for water as the heat intensifies. At 10s, he slams a palm onto the table, grabs rice desperately, and at 12s laughter erupts from behind the camera, shaking it violently. The Chef stares into the camera at 13s, eyes watering, pointing an accusatory finger, before he angrily throws the ramekin off at 14s, maintaining a fierce glare at the camera. The single continuous shot highlights his escalating reaction, capturing the authenticity of the moment with natural kitchen noises like sizzling and clinking throughout. The camera remains steady until 12s when it shakes from laughter, stabilizing during the Chef's furious gaze. zh.p: 镜头以第一人称视角切入，画面中是一张抛光木制餐桌，位于厨房内，暖白灯光下摆放着当地陶瓷餐具和铜边碗。厨师身着白色厨师服，坐在餐桌对面，正享用着一桌地方菜肴。气氛轻松，厨房里回荡着环境音。第0秒，厨师面带满足的微笑，切开一盘香气四溢的菜肴。第2秒，镜头前出现观众的手，用叉子叉起一块蘸了卡罗莱纳死神辣椒油的食物，那是一种鲜艳的深红色调味料。叉子伸向厨师，他咧嘴一笑，在第5秒吃下这一口，起初享受着味道，但第7秒时，他的表情开始变化，意识到不对劲。第8秒，他脸颊泛红，开始用手扇风，伸手去拿水，辣味愈发强烈。第10秒，他一掌拍在桌上，抓起米饭狼吞虎咽，第12秒，镜头后爆发出笑声，画面剧烈晃动。第13秒，厨师盯着镜头，泪眼汪汪，伸手指责，随后在第14秒愤怒地扔出小碗，仍狠狠瞪着镜头。整个连续镜头凸显了他逐渐升级的反应，厨房里自然的滋滋声和碗碟碰撞声贯穿始终，捕捉了这一刻的真实感。镜头一直保持稳定，直到第12秒因笑声而晃动，在厨师怒视时恢复平稳。场景采用自然灯光和原声，无任何人工特效，以厨师愤怒的凝视收尾，厨房环境音未被干扰——一位主厨显然被整蛊了。

[0:00-0:02] Pre-fight: An anthropomorphic monkey warrior in full traditional chinese armour is surrounded by an army of soldiers wearing metallic armor of gold and white. The warrior is laughing, finding his situation both exciting and halarious. The enemy soldiers are closing in all around him. He spins his staff playfully at his right side, twirling it behind his back and switching hand so the staff arrives on his left side still twirling. He plant the staff at his side to take a heroic and confident pose, ready for the battle that is about to begin. Camera does a fast 360 orbits around him while he twirls the staff to show he is surrounded by thousands of enemy soldiers before coming to a brief low angle quarter turned shot for his pose.   

 [0:02-0:04] Fight begins: Cut to an ECU of his eyes as they narrow and turn serious, then tilt down to an ECU of his mouth curving up into a smirk. In the same shot, the warrior leans back slightly just as a sword glides right in front of the camera in slowmotion to block the entire frame for 0.5 second.   

[0:04-0:15] Camera rapidly pulls back to a medium shot as time speeds up again. The warrior rapidly dart from one enemy to the next at extreme speeds, defeating 7 soldiers in a blink of an eye. He continues performing dynamic wushu style combos and attacks with his staff. One hit one kill, over the top depiction of power, acrobatic aerial maneuvers, end with the warrior dodging multiple swords simultaneously swinging down at him by jumping high into the air, coiling his body as the staff expands into a humongous size, then dramatically swinging the staff back down to the ground in a powerful finishing attack. The staff hits the earth, causing a massive explosion that expands and forms a crater upon impact and decimates hundreds of soldiers all at once.  Anime arc effect, shockwave effect, sparks on hit, air burst effect. Godly overpowered warrior dominates an army by himself vibe. Heroic anime music.

[0:00-0:02] 战前：一只身穿全套中国传统铠甲的拟人化猴子武士，被一支身着金白金属铠甲的士兵军团团团围住。武士放声大笑，觉得眼前的处境既刺激又滑稽。敌军从四面八方步步逼近。他右手轻快地旋转着长棍，将棍子绕到背后换手，长棍随即在左手边继续旋转。他将长棍往身旁一顿，摆出一个英勇自信的姿势，准备迎接即将开始的战斗。镜头快速环绕他旋转360度，展示他被数千敌军包围的场景，最后以一个短暂的低角度四分之三侧面镜头定格在他的姿势上。

[0:02-0:04] 战斗开始：切至他双眼的特写，双眼眯起，神情变得严肃，随后镜头下移至他嘴角的特写，嘴角上扬，露出一丝得意的笑。同一镜头中，武士微微向后一仰，与此同时，一把剑以慢动作从镜头前划过，将整个画面遮挡了0.5秒。

[0:04-0:15] 镜头迅速拉远至中景，时间流速恢复正常。武士以极快的速度在敌人之间穿梭，眨眼间便击倒了七名士兵。他继续施展充满动感的武术套路，用长棍发动连击。一击必杀，展现出压倒性的力量，配合杂技般的空中动作。最后，武士面对多把同时劈下的利剑，高高跃起躲避，身体蜷缩，同时长棍瞬间变得巨大无比，然后他猛地将长棍挥向地面，发动一记威力惊人的终结一击。长棍击中大地，引发巨大爆炸，冲击波扩散开来，在地面形成一个弹坑，瞬间消灭了数百名士兵。画面呈现动漫式的弧线特效、冲击波效果、击中时的火花以及空气爆裂效果。整体氛围宛如一位神级无敌的武士以一己之力碾压整支军队。背景响起激昂的英雄式动漫音乐。

en.p: A calm, modern hospital room. A patient is lying on a bed while a professional, kind doctor stands beside him, gently checking his pulse and speaking softly. The camera slowly tracks from the side in a single continuous motion for the full 15 seconds. As the doctor leans slightly closer to examine the patient, the patient looks at the doctor and becomes emotionally captivated. His facial expression gradually shifts from weak and tired to calm, slightly smiling, and lost in admiration. To visually show his feelings (without unrealistic exaggeration), the background subtly transforms: the hospital environment softly blurs, and a warm, dreamy glow appears around the doctor. Light particles and soft-focus bokeh gently emerge, symbolizing the patient drifting into his thoughts. The patient is no longer focused on his illness instead, he is quietly staring at the doctor, completely absorbed in the moment. His breathing becomes calm, and his expression shows peace and affection. The doctor remains professional and unaware, continuing the check-up naturally. Final seconds: The camera continues its smooth motion as the dreamy overlay slightly fades, leaving a subtle emotional contrast a patient who has momentarily forgotten his pain, lost in thought. Important Direction (to avoid mistakes): The patient remains lying on the bed (not standing or moving unrealistically); The doctor behaves professionally (no exaggerated or inappropriate actions); The emotional effect is shown through lighting, focus, and atmosphere not unrealistic physical actions; No reversed roles or unnatural expressions; Keep the tone soft, respectful, and cinematic (not comedic or exaggerated)

zh.p: 一间宁静、现代化的病房。一名患者躺在病床上，一位专业而亲切的医生站在他身旁，正轻柔地为他诊脉，并低声说着话。镜头从侧面缓缓推进，以单一连续的运动持续整整15秒。当医生微微俯身检查患者时，患者望向医生，内心被深深触动。他的表情逐渐从虚弱疲惫转为平静，嘴角浮现一丝微笑，眼神中流露出倾慕。为了在视觉上展现他的情感（避免不切实际的夸张），背景悄然变化：医院环境柔和地虚化，医生周围泛起温暖梦幻的光晕。光斑与柔焦的散景轻轻浮现，象征患者陷入自己的思绪。他不再关注自己的病痛，只是静静凝视着医生，完全沉浸在这一刻。他的呼吸变得平稳，神情中透出安宁与爱意。医生依然保持专业，浑然不觉，继续自然地完成检查。最后几秒：镜头保持流畅的运动，梦幻的光晕微微淡去，留下微妙的情感反差——一个暂时忘却痛苦、陷入沉思的患者。重要指导（避免错误）：患者始终躺在病床上（不会站立或做出不切实际的动作）；医生行为专业（无夸张或不当举动）；情感效果通过光线、焦点和氛围展现，而非不自然的肢体动作；无角色颠倒或生硬表情；保持柔和、尊重、电影感的基调（不滑稽或夸张）。

raw_p: A calm, modern hospital room. A patient is lying on a bed while a professional, kind doctor stands beside him, gently checking his pulse and speaking softly. As the doctor leans slightly closer to examine the patient, the patient looks at the doctor and becomes emotionally captivated. His facial expression gradually shifts from weak and tired to calm, slightly smiling, and lost in admiration. To visually show his feelings (without unrealistic exaggeration), the background subtly transforms: the hospital environment softly blurs, and a warm, dreamy glow appears around the doctor. Light particles and soft-focus bokeh gently emerge, symbolizing the patient drifting into his thoughts. The patient is no longer focused on his illness instead, he is quietly staring at the doctor, completely absorbed in the moment. His breathing becomes calm, and his expression shows peace and affection. The doctor remains professional and unaware, continuing the check-up naturally. Final seconds: The camera continues its smooth motion as the dreamy overlay slightly fades, leaving a subtle emotional contrast a patient who has momentarily forgotten his pain, lost in thought. en.p: Environment: A colossal glacial canyon under pale blue twilight. Massive ice walls tower above a frozen river while snowstorms sweep through the valley. The environment glows faintly with reflected moonlight from crystalline ice formations. Action: 15.0s sequence. A gigantic glacier tiger made of solid ice and glowing frost veins prowls across the frozen river. Opposing it is a towering frost serpent emerging from beneath the ice surface. The tiger launches into powerful leaps across fractured ice sheets while the serpent coils upward, shattering the frozen terrain. Velocity Ramp choreography: the tiger’s claws strike the serpent mid-air as time slows, showing ice shards and snow particles suspended before snapping back to real-time as the impact explodes through the frozen canyon. Camera: Smooth ground-level tracking across the frozen river surface before a rapid upward tilt as the tiger leaps between ice pillars. Style & Constraints: Photorealistic ice fracturing, volumetric snow particles, ray-traced crystal reflections, cinematic cold blue lighting, 8K.

zh.p: 环境：一座巨大的冰川峡谷，笼罩在淡蓝色的暮光之下。高耸的冰壁环绕着一条冰封的河流，暴风雪席卷整个山谷。水晶般的冰层反射着月光，让整个环境散发出微弱的光芒。动作：15.0秒的连续镜头。一只由坚冰构成、遍布发光霜纹的巨型冰川虎，在冰封的河面上巡行。它的对手是一条从冰层下崛起的巍峨霜蛇。老虎在碎裂的冰面上奋力跃起，而巨蛇则盘绕升腾，将冻结的地形震得四分五裂。速度渐变编排：老虎的利爪在半空中击中巨蛇，时间随之放缓，冰屑与雪粒悬浮在空中，随后瞬间恢复实时速度，冲击波在冰封的峡谷中炸裂开来。镜头：平滑的地面跟踪，掠过冰封的河面，随后在老虎跃起于冰柱之间时，镜头急速向上倾斜。风格与限制：照片级真实的冰裂效果、体积感雪粒、光线追踪的水晶反射、电影般的冷蓝色调光影、8K分辨率。

en.p: Epic wide-angle shot of a vast ancient battlefield at golden hour, thousands of warriors clashing with swords and shields under a hazy amber sky thick with smoke and ash. A lone archer in weathered bronze armor, face streaked with dirt, draws a longbow with deliberate tension. The arrow releases with a sharp twang. Camera immediately snaps behind the arrow, tracking it in extreme slow motion as it cuts through drifting smoke and falling embers. Shallow depth of field keeps the arrow razor-sharp while the chaotic battlefield blurs behind. The camera pushes closer, tighter, until the wooden shaft fills the frame — revealing intricate carved runes and weathered grain. Seamless transition to macro scale: the arrow's surface becomes a landscape. A microscopic civilization of tiny warriors the size of splinters wages war across the fletching. Miniature catapults hurl fragments of dust. Warriors scale the carved runes like canyon walls. Torches flicker. Banners wave.

zh.p: 史诗级广角镜头：金色黄昏下，广袤的古战场硝烟弥漫，数千名战士挥舞刀剑与盾牌激烈厮杀，琥珀色的天空笼罩着浓烟与灰烬。一名身着锈蚀青铜铠甲的孤胆弓手，满面尘垢，正蓄力拉开长弓，弓弦绷紧的瞬间发出尖锐的颤音。镜头瞬间切至箭矢后方，以极致慢动作追踪其轨迹，箭矢穿透飘散的烟雾与坠落的火星。浅景深令箭矢锐利如锋，而混乱的战场在背景中化作模糊虚影。镜头不断推进、收紧，直至木质箭杆填满画面——其上镌刻的繁复符文与岁月侵蚀的纹理纤毫毕现。无缝切换至微观尺度：箭矢表面化为一片大地。一群细如木屑的微型战士在箭羽间展开战争。微型投石机抛掷尘埃碎屑，战士们攀爬符文如攀越峡谷绝壁。火把明灭，旌旗翻卷。

raw_p: Epic wide-angle shot of a vast ancient battlefield at golden hour, thousands of warriors clashing with swords and shields under a hazy amber sky thick with smoke and ash. A lone archer in weathered bronze armor, face streaked with dirt, draws a longbow with deliberate tension. The arrow releases with a sharp twang. Camera immediately snaps behind the arrow, tracking it in extreme slow motion as it cuts through drifting smoke and falling embers. Shallow depth of field keeps the arrow razor-sharp while the chaotic battlefield blurs behind. The camera pushes closer, tighter, until the wooden shaft fills the frame — revealing intricate carved runes and weathered grain. Seamless transition to macro scale: the arrow's surface becomes a landscape. A microscopic civilization of tiny warriors the size of splinters wages war across the fletching. Miniature catapults hurl fragments of dust. Warriors scale the carved runes like canyon walls. Torches flicker. Banners wave.

en.p: One fearless female explorer in beige crop top, jungle shorts, rope belt, muddy skin, long dark hair loose. Swinging from giant vines above ancient forest. Main frame from rear. Small rectangular inset top-right shows front face and torso. SCENE: Camera locked behind her as she is already mid-swing at high speed over massive jungle canyon. No cuts. Maintain one fluid take. Rear frame shows legs kicking, hair whipping, vine tension stretching realistically. Trees thousands of feet tall, waterfalls pouring through branches. Inset shows laughter, shock, intense focus, wind slamming cheeks. Route progression: giant swing over canyon → releases to next vine midair → swings through temple ruins → ducks under broken bridge → near miss with flock of giant birds → slides through waterfall curtain → lands onto moving tree branch rail → branch bends and launches her to another vine → final swing returns toward first canyon. Same momentum and shakes in both feeds. MOOD: Freedom, primal thrill, discovery. STYLE: Epic jungle realism.

zh.p: 一位无畏的女探险家，身穿米色露脐上衣、丛林短裤、系绳腰带，皮肤沾满泥土，深色长发披散。她正从古老森林上方的巨型藤蔓上荡过。主画面从背后拍摄。右上角有一个小矩形插画，展示她的正面脸庞和躯干。场景：镜头锁定在她身后，她已在高速荡过巨大的丛林峡谷。无剪辑，保持一个流畅的镜头。背后画面中，她双腿踢动，长发飞舞，藤蔓的张力真实地拉伸着。树木高耸入云，瀑布从枝干间倾泻而下。插画中，她时而大笑，时而震惊，时而极度专注，狂风拍打着脸颊。路线推进：荡过巨型峡谷 → 在半空中松开藤蔓，抓住下一根 → 荡过寺庙废墟 → 低头躲过断桥 → 与一群巨鸟擦肩而过 → 滑过瀑布水帘 → 降落在移动的树枝轨道上 → 树枝弯曲，将她弹向另一根藤蔓 → 最后一荡，返回最初的峡谷。两个画面中，动感和摇晃保持一致。氛围：自由、原始的刺激、发现。风格：史诗般的丛林现实主义。

en.p: A war-torn street with destroyed buildings and smoke in the background. A small child sits alone holding a damaged toy, dust on face, eyes filled with fear and confusion. Slow camera zoom, muted colors, cinematic lighting, emotional atmosphere, realistic style.

zh.p: 一条饱受战火摧残的街道，背景是残垣断壁与弥漫的硝烟。一个年幼的孩子独自坐着，怀里抱着一件破损的玩具，脸上沾满灰尘，眼神中充满恐惧与茫然。镜头缓慢推进，色彩低沉，光影如电影般富有质感，氛围悲怆，风格写实。

en.p: Image1 character as the subject a male, black oversized hoodie, black oversized baggy jeans, black sneakers. Radiation-enhanced superhuman speed and strength, awakened orange-yellow glowing pupils, veins bulging. intense aura. Scene: Abandoned Chicago high-rise ruins, exposed rebar, cracked concrete, suspended derelict vehicles, rusted steel walkways, mutant vines, broken glass shards, dim moonlight, glitching neon flicker, thick fog, extreme high-altitude tension. One-take continuous shot, 15 seconds, cinematic, 120fps high frame rate, ultra-realistic dark American post-apocalyptic sci-fi thriller, desaturated cold gray palette with orange-yellow accent. 0-3s: Low angle wide shot character stands at edge of cracked floor slab, panting after clearing small enemies. orange-vellow pupils coldly scanning ruins. Building violently shakes. Upgraded Giant Tracker bursts through fog, slams floor with massive claws, concrete explodes. Handheld slight tremor, wide angle oppressive framing. 3-6s: Giant Tracker sweeps massive claw character side-dashes at extreme speed with strong motion blur afterimage. Claw shatters steel column, dust blast. Monster strikes repeatedly, character serpentine-sprints through debris gaps at high speed. Ground-level chase track shot, full motion blur. 6-8s: Character kicks off suspended vehicle in mid-air, rotates at high speed, launches spinning kick at monster's head. Monster roars, snapping jaw barely grazes his sneaker. Hitchcock spiral orbit shot, high-altitude danger. 8-10s: Character lands and explodes forward -three rapid heavy punches to monster's chest and jaw, each blow forcing it back, bone-crushing thuds. Low sweep kick destabilizes monster's footing. Medium close-up tracking, 120fps slow-motion captures fist impact force. 10-13s: Character grabs monster arm, reverse-twists exoskeleton cracks and bursts. Leaps onto monster's back, legs lock around throat, both arms pry apart neck armor. Monster thrashes violently, character holds firm. Back overhead shot with fast lateral cuts, strong motion blur afterimage. 13-15s: Character vaults off, charges full-force punch into monster's split skull jaw kinetic force detonates through the head, monster collapses, shockwave shatters surrounding vines and glass. Final freeze frame: character stands atop monster corpse, orange-yellow

zh.p: 画面以一名男性角色为主体，他身穿黑色超大号连帽衫、黑色超大号宽松牛仔裤和黑色运动鞋。拥有辐射增强的超人速度和力量，觉醒的橙黄色发光瞳孔，青筋暴起。散发出强烈的气场。场景设定在废弃的芝加哥高楼废墟中，裸露的钢筋、开裂的混凝土、悬空的废弃车辆、生锈的钢制走道、变异藤蔓、破碎的玻璃碎片、昏暗的月光、闪烁的霓虹灯、浓雾以及极端高空的紧张感。采用一镜到底的连续拍摄，时长15秒，电影质感，120fps高帧率，超写实的黑暗美国后末日科幻惊悚风格，以去饱和的冷灰色调为主，辅以橙黄色点缀。0-3秒：低角度广角镜头，角色站在开裂楼板的边缘，在清理完小敌人后喘息着。橙黄色的瞳孔冷冷地扫视着废墟。建筑剧烈摇晃。升级版的巨型追踪者冲破浓雾出现，用巨大的爪子猛击楼板，混凝土爆炸飞溅。手持摄影轻微抖动，广角镜头营造压迫感。3-6秒：巨型追踪者挥动巨大的爪子，角色以极快的速度侧向闪避，带有强烈的动态模糊残影。爪子击碎钢柱，尘土飞扬。怪物连续攻击，角色以蛇形路线高速穿梭于废墟缝隙之间。地面追踪镜头跟拍，全程动态模糊。6-8秒：角色蹬踏悬空的车辆腾空而起，高速旋转，向怪物的头部发动回旋踢。怪物咆哮着，咬合的巨颚几乎擦过他的运动鞋。采用希区柯克式螺旋轨道镜头，展现高空危险感。8-10秒：角色落地后爆发前冲，连续三记重拳击中怪物的胸部和下颌，每一拳都迫使它后退，伴随着骨裂般的闷响。一记低扫踢破坏怪物的重心。中近景跟拍，120fps慢动作捕捉拳头冲击的力度。10-13秒：角色抓住怪物的手臂，反向扭动，外骨骼碎裂爆开。他跃上怪物的背部，双腿锁住其喉咙，双臂撬开颈部的护甲。怪物剧烈挣扎，角色牢牢固定。采用背面俯拍镜头，配合快速横向切换，强烈的动态模糊残影。13-15秒：角色纵身跃下，蓄力一记重拳砸入怪物裂开的头骨下颌，动能贯穿头部，怪物轰然倒下，冲击波震碎周围的藤蔓和玻璃。最终定格画面：角色站在怪物尸体之上，橙黄色的光芒闪耀。

en.p: Split screen: STYLE: High-end stylized 3D animated character, cinematic lighting, expressive faces, polished materials, exaggerated but believable motion, comedic visual storytelling with split-screen sequences. WARDROBE: Man Image2 — oversized graphic tee and jogger pants entire film, never changes. Woman Image1 — western casuals shots 1–6, sharp blazer trousers and heels shots 7–13, nighty shots 14–15. Daughter — school uniform shots 4–6. ENVIRONMENT: Shared bedroom, kitchen, building gate, metro station, footwear design studio, conference room, home living room, bedroom at night. MOOD: Chaotic, rushed, comedic exhaustion, blissful obliviousness, ending in tender defeat. SHOT 1: ECU, 85mm push-in / Alarm on bedside table, screen shows 6:00. Her hand shoots out and kills it. His hand pulls the blanket up tighter. SHOT 2: MCU, handheld 50mm / She sits up, looks at him buried under the blanket, says: "Get up." He says: "Two minutes." He will not get up. SHOT 3: MS, 35mm slide / She is in the kitchen, eggs on the pan, tiffin box open, phone wedged between ear and shoulder, all three burning simultaneously. SHOT 4: Top-down detail shot, 35mm / She ties the daughter's hair with one hand while checking the tiffin with the other. The daughter squirms. The eggs go cold. SHOT 5: MCU, 50mm / SPLIT SCREEN begins. Left: she stuffs the daughter into school shoes, zips the tiny backpack, grabs her own bag, pushes them both toward the door. Right: he rolls over, opens laptop in bed, starts typing a prompt, face glowing, completely serene. SHOT 6: WS, 24mm / She walks the daughter down to the building gate in casuals, waits for the school van, waves it off, turns around and sprints back upstairs to get ready. No time. SHOT 7: MS, 50mm snap push / SPLIT SCREEN. Left: she squeezes into the metro fully dressed in blazer and heels, crushed between strangers, tablet open, reviewing shoe sketches with her thumb. Right: he sits at his desk, cracks his knuckles slowly, says to himself: "Let's create." SHOT 8: MCU, 50mm / SPLIT SCREEN. Left: conference room, her foreign boss holds up a heel and says in a clipped accent: "The toe box. It needs to breathe more." Her pen taps the sketchbook. Right: his AI video finishes rendering. He leans back, crosses arms, watches the view counter. Nods. Types: "Not bad." SHOT 9: MS, 35mm / SPLIT SCREEN. Left: she presents a mood board, points at materials, answers three questions at once, measuring tape around her neck. Right: he enrolls in a new AI course, credit card in hand, eyes lit up like a child at Christmas, says: "This is the one." SHOT 10: WS, 35mm / SPLIT SCREEN. Left: she is last to leave the studio, turns off the light herself, bag heavy, heels off in her hand, phone shows 8:47 PM. Right: he wraps up a video call about AI, stretches big, says to the room: "Productive day." SHOT 11: MCU, handheld 50mm / She walks in the front door still in her blazer. He looks up warmly and says

zh.p: 分屏画面：风格为高端风格化3D动画角色，电影级布光，表情丰富，材质精致，动作夸张但可信，通过分屏序列进行喜剧化视觉叙事。服装：男性角色2——整部影片始终穿着超大图案T恤和慢跑裤，从不更换。女性角色1——第1至6个镜头穿西部休闲装，第7至13个镜头穿利落西装外套、长裤和高跟鞋，第14至15个镜头穿睡衣。女儿——第4至6个镜头穿校服。环境：共用卧室、厨房、建筑大门、地铁站、鞋履设计工作室、会议室、家中客厅、夜晚的卧室。情绪：混乱、匆忙、喜剧性的疲惫、幸福的 obliviousness，最终以温柔的挫败感收尾。镜头1：极端特写，85毫米镜头推进 / 床头柜上的闹钟，屏幕显示6:00。她的手猛地伸出按掉闹钟。他的手把被子拉得更紧。镜头2：中近景，手持50毫米镜头 / 她坐起来，看着他埋在被子下，说：“起床。”他说：“再两分钟。”他不会起床。镜头3：中景，35毫米镜头滑动 / 她在厨房，平底锅里有鸡蛋，便当盒打开，手机夹在耳朵和肩膀之间，三样东西同时烧焦。镜头4：俯拍细节镜头，35毫米镜头 / 她一只手给女儿扎头发，另一只手检查便当盒。女儿扭来扭去。鸡蛋变凉了。镜头5：中近景，50毫米镜头 / 分屏开始。左侧：她把女儿塞进校鞋，拉上小背包的拉链，抓起自己的包，把两人推向门口。右侧：他翻身，在床上打开笔记本电脑，开始输入提示词，脸上发光，完全平静。镜头6：全景，24毫米镜头 / 她穿着休闲装送女儿到建筑大门，等校车，挥手告别，转身跑回楼上准备自己。没时间了。镜头7：中景，50毫米镜头快速推进 / 分屏。左侧：她穿着西装外套和高跟鞋挤进地铁，被陌生人压扁，平板电脑打开，用拇指查看鞋类草图。右侧：他坐在办公桌前，慢慢掰响指关节，对自己说：“开始创作吧。”镜头8：中近景，50毫米镜头 / 分屏。左侧：会议室里，她的外国老板举起一只高跟鞋，用尖刻的口音说：“鞋头盒。它需要更透气。”她的笔在速写本上轻敲。右侧：他的AI视频渲染完成。他向后靠，交叉双臂，观看计数器。点头。打字：“还不错。”镜头9：中景，35毫米镜头 / 分屏。左侧：她展示情绪板，指着材料，同时回答三个问题，脖子上挂着测量尺。右侧：他报名参加新的AI课程，手里拿着信用卡，眼睛像圣诞节的孩子一样发亮，说：“就是这个了。”镜头10：全景，35毫米镜头 / 分屏。左侧：她是最后一个离开工作室的人，自己关灯，包很重，高跟鞋拿在手里，手机显示晚上8:47。右侧：他结束一个关于AI的视频通话，大大地伸了个懒腰，对房间说：“高效的一天。”镜头11：中近景，手持50毫米镜头 / 她穿着西装外套走进前门。他温暖地抬头看着她，说……

en.p: Hyperrealistic cinematic shot, 35mm anamorphic lens, heavy film grain, aggressive handheld camera with visible sway. Teal and amber palette with violet-purple accents. No zoom. Snowstorm atmosphere, volumetric fog, breath vapor visible [0s-3s] Low-angle shot from ground level. Vast frozen tundra, dark overcast sky, heavy snow falling. @ShadowMonarch walks forward through knee-deep snow, silhouette emerging from blizzard fog. Molten dagger blade melts nearby snowflakes, casting faint orange light. Camera tracks with handheld drift. Desolate, silent atmosphere. [3s-5s] Medium shot, chest height, slight Dutch angle. @ShadowMonarch stops. His right eye ignites with blue flame, casting cyan light across his face and snow. Confident smirk. He extends the dagger outward to his side. Red blade pulses brighter. Wind picks up violently. [5s-7s] Close-up to medium shot, below eye level. @ShadowMonarch barely tilts his chin up, eyes half-closed with cold arrogance, and commands "ÁLZATE" through a slight smirk - not shouting, almost whispering it, as if the word itself is beneath him but the world must obey anyway. Massive shockwave of violet-purple necromantic energy explodes outward across the snow. Ground cracks in fractal patterns, ice shatters, snowflakes freeze mid-air. Coat and hair blow back violently. Blue eye flame flares. Frame shakes with energy burst. [7s-9s] Wide shot pulling back. Three enormous columns of black smoke and purple lightning erupt from cracked ground behind @ShadowMonarch in triangular formation, spiraling upward 15 feet, crackling with energy. Snow melts and refreezes into black ice around each column. @ShadowMonarch stands still, dagger lowered, watching forward - not looking back. Camera drifts right. [9s-11s] Medium-wide shot. @Commander1 materializes from the left column, stepping forward, each footstep cracking the ground. @Commander2 emerges from the center column, shadow smoke pouring outward. Both advance toward @ShadowMonarch's flanks [11s-13s] @Commander3 descends from the right column, floating downward from above, casting enormous shadows across the snowfield. All three commanders now stand in formation behind @ShadowMonarch, combined supernatural energy illuminating the snowfield. [13s-15s] Final wide shot, low angle. @ShadowMonarch foreground, dagger glowing, blue eye flame steady. @Commander1, @Commander2, @Commander3 in V-formation behind him. Snow swirls violently. Volumetric purple-blue-cyan light cuts through fog. Camera holds with subtle handheld micro-movements. Heroic tableau. Heavy 35mm film grain, photorealistic textures. Final frame.

zh.p: 超写实电影级镜头，35毫米变形宽银幕镜头，厚重胶片颗粒，手持摄影机剧烈晃动，可见明显摇摆。青橙色调搭配紫罗兰色点缀。无变焦。暴风雪氛围，体积雾效果，可见呼吸白气[0-3秒]。低角度地面仰拍。广阔冰封苔原，阴沉密布的天空，大雪纷飞。@ShadowMonarch 在齐膝深的积雪中前行，身影从暴风雪雾中浮现。熔岩匕首熔化附近雪花，投射出微弱的橙色光芒。镜头以手持漂移方式跟拍。荒凉寂静的氛围。[3-5秒] 中景，胸部高度，轻微荷兰角。@ShadowMonarch 停下。他的右眼燃起蓝色火焰，在脸上和雪地上投出青色光芒。自信的冷笑。他将匕首向外侧伸出。红色刀身脉动更亮。狂风骤起。[5-7秒] 从特写到中景，低于视线水平。@ShadowMonarch 微微抬起下巴，半闭双眼带着冷酷的傲慢，通过一丝冷笑命令道“ÁLZATE”——并非呼喊，几乎是低语，仿佛这个词本身不值得他费力，但世界必须服从。巨大的紫罗兰色死灵能量冲击波在雪地上向外爆炸。地面裂开分形图案，冰层碎裂，雪花在半空中冻结。外套和头发被猛烈向后吹起。蓝色眼焰闪烁。画面因能量爆发而震动。[7-9秒] 广角镜头向后拉远。三根巨大的黑烟与紫色闪电柱从@ShadowMonarch 身后裂开的地面中喷涌而出，呈三角排列，螺旋上升至15英尺高，能量噼啪作响。每根柱子周围的雪融化后又重新凝结成黑冰。@ShadowMonarch 静立不动，匕首放低，目视前方——没有回头。镜头向右漂移。[9-11秒] 中全景。@Commander1 从左侧柱子中现身，踏步向前，每一步都踩裂地面。@Commander2 从中央柱子中浮现，阴影烟雾向外涌出。两人向@ShadowMonarch 的两翼推进。[11-13秒] @Commander3 从右侧柱子中降下，从上方飘落，在雪原上投下巨大阴影。三位指挥官现在以阵型立于@ShadowMonarch 身后，联合的超自然能量照亮雪原。[13-15秒] 最终广角镜头，低角度。@ShadowMonarch 在前景，匕首发光，蓝色眼焰稳定。@Commander1、@Commander2、@Commander3 在他身后呈V字阵型。雪花猛烈旋转。体积感紫蓝青色光芒穿透雾气。镜头以细微的手持微动保持稳定。英雄式构图。厚重35毫米胶片颗粒，照片级真实纹理。最终画面。

zh.p: 一位绝美的美国女性，长着一头浓密、富有活力的深橙色长发，优雅地散落在四周；她拥有惊艳完美的对称面容、无瑕的瓷白肌肤、迷人的双眸、高颧骨以及饱满的红唇，正安详地仰卧在一张由盛开的纯白玫瑰铺成的巨大花床中央。她身穿一套洁净、细节精致的白色宇航服，配有金属装饰、手套和靴子。双眼轻阖，神情宁静而梦幻，仿佛在花丛中小憩或沉睡。整个场景被大量柔软、纯白的玫瑰环绕，部分花朵轻覆于她的身体之上。柔和的自然阳光透过其间，洒下轻柔的高光，营造出浪漫而空灵的氛围。白色宇航服、瓷白肌肤与白色玫瑰海洋共同构成明亮的主色调，与她鲜艳的橙色长发形成鲜明对比；光线柔和漫射，对焦极为锐利，细节丰富，氛围清新洁净，无复古滤镜效果。

[Visual Concept] A girl enveloped in stardust sheds tears for someone she longs for over 10 seconds. Three whispered lines in Japanese. Deep purple and silver. Particles synchronize with emotions.

[Character] Silver-haired girl. Flowing silver hair, ethereal gown. Stillness → earnestness → tears.

[Background] Night sky. Infinite stars and stardust. Deep purple × silver. Particles rotate and fall.

[Shot 1 (0-3 sec)] Camera: Slow zoom. The girl stands wrapped in stardust. Girl: "Kirei..." (Beautiful...) Particles: Gently drifting.

[Shot 2 (3-6 sec)] Camera: Close-up on face. Girl: "Demo, hontou wa anata to kono keshiki o mitakatta." (But honestly, I wanted to see this view with you.) Particles: Swirling intensely. Tears glisten.

[Shot 3 (6-10 sec)] Camera: Pull back to full body. Girl: "Aitai... Aitai yo..." (I miss you... I miss you so much...) Tears fall down her cheeks. Particles: Gently rotating.

[Prohibited] Abrupt color changes. Intense movement. Character movement.

zh.p:
【映像コンセプト】星屑に包まれた少女が、誰かを想って涙する10秒。ウィスパーボイス（日本語）で呟く3つのセリフ。深紫と銀色。粒子は心情に同期。

【キャラクター】銀髪の少女。流れるシルバーヘア、エーテルガウン。静寂→切実さ→涙へ。
【背景】夜空。無限の星々とスターダスト。深紫×銀色。粒子が回転・落下。

【Shot 1（0-3秒）】カメラ：ゆっくりズーム。少女が星屑に包まれ立つ。少女：「きれい…」粒子：緩やかに舞う。
【Shot 2（3-6秒）】カメラ：顔に寄る。少女：「でも、本当はあなたとこの景色を見たかった」粒子：激しく渦巻く。涙が輝く。
【Shot 3（6-10秒）】カメラ：引いて全身。少女：「会いたい…会いたいよ…」涙が頬を落ちる。粒子：穏やかに回転。
【禁止】急激な色変化。激しい動き。キャラ移動。

zh.p:
【16秒超电影感野生动物竖屏预告片】

【0-4秒】
画面：非洲草原的黎明，金色阳光穿透薄雾，一头非洲象的剪影缓缓从地平线升起，长鼻卷起，扬起细碎的金色尘埃。
音效：低沉的象鸣声，伴随着缓慢而有力的心跳声。
字幕（白色粗体，居中）：
“大地之上”

【4-8秒】
画面：瞬间切换至高速慢镜头——一只猎豹在金色草原上全速冲刺，肌肉线条在阳光下如雕塑般分明，尘土在它脚下炸开，眼神锐利如刀。
音效：急促的呼吸声，风声，猎豹爪击地面的重音。
字幕（白色粗体，居中）：
“速度”

【8-12秒】
画面：镜头转入浓密雨林，光线从树冠缝隙中洒下，一只银背大猩猩缓缓转身，胸膛起伏，目光深邃而充满力量，它用拳头轻击地面，震动感透过屏幕传来。
音效：低沉的喉音，树叶沙沙声，一拳击地的低沉轰鸣。
字幕（白色粗体，居中）：
“力量”

【12-16秒】
画面：三个画面快速闪切——大象的长鼻、猎豹的眼睛、大猩猩的拳头——最终定格在一片广袤的星空下，三只动物的剪影并排站立，背景是燃烧的晚霞。
音效：交响乐高潮，鼓点与弦乐齐鸣，最后一声悠长的号角。
字幕（白色粗体，居中）：
“野性不朽”

【结尾】
画面：黑屏，白色品牌Logo缓缓浮现。
字幕（细体，居中）：
“即将震撼上映”

en.p: A clumsy yet secretly skilled kung fu master waitress dressed in a traditional Chinese cheongsam. While rapidly wrapping xiaolongbao skins in the kitchen, she accidentally spills a large amount of flour. From within the white cloud of dust, dozens of xiaolongbao rise into the air, forming a line like a dragon.

zh.p: 穿着传统旗袍、冒冒失失但实际上是功夫高手的看板娘。在厨房里飞快地包着小笼包时，不小心打翻了一大堆面粉。白色的烟雾中，几十个小笼包像龙一样排成队列，悬浮在空中。

raw_p: ACTION: 伝統的なチャイナドレスを着た、ドジだけど実はカンフーの達人である看板娘。厨房で小籠包の皮を高速で包んでいると、誤って大量の小麦粉をぶち撒けてしまう。白い煙の中から、何十個もの小籠包が、まるで龍のように列をなして空中に浮かび上がる。

en.p:
Gigantic orbital ring around an alien planet, structural failure propagating at high velocity, entire sections tearing apart while traffic is still moving across it.
Wide shot: the ring mid-rotation, a fracture suddenly racing along its surface faster than expected.
Hard tracking: camera locked to the crack as it splits structural layers, tearing through habitats and transit lines.
Close pass: maintenance ships accelerating along the ring, barely outrunning the collapsing structure behind them.
Near-failure: a ship misjudges speed, the surface drops away beneath it, forced to boost last-second to avoid being pulled into open space.
Chain reaction: rotating segments begin desyncing, colliding edges grinding and breaking apart.
Interior shot: corridor violently shifting, gravity flickering, people and debris slamming into walls as atmosphere vents.
Exterior whip: a massive section snaps free, rotating unpredictably, narrowly missing a fleeing ship.
Precision escape: pilot threads through a collapsing lattice of beams and cables, gaps closing in real time.
Shockwave: structural failure releases energy, pushing debris outward, ships struggling to maintain trajectory.
Final moment: a huge arc of the ring tears loose, drifting away, still populated with lights flickering across its surface.
Relentless structural collapse, no pauses, constant repositioning, cascading failures, grounded physics, massive scale with intimate danger.

en.p:
Japanese anime style with the exhilarating feel of a competitive fighting game. Set in a boxing ring, 15 seconds, 30fps, no subtitles. High-contrast cinematic lighting, volumetric light, atmospheric particles and smoke, with a strong audience presence. The overall pacing is clean and sharp, with decisive and powerful camera movement, no dragging. High dynamic range with realistic physical feedback.

[Entrance 0–5s]
Low-angle fast tracking shot with a steady push-in. A tall blonde, blue-eyed ballet dancer descends dramatically from above in a “Black Swan” form—more flamboyant and oppressive in presence. As she spins and lands, her movement carries clear aggression; the impact is heavier, sharper, with precise yet tension-filled body control. Feathers scatter through the air like black blades.
Lighting shifts to a cold, high-contrast tone, with sharp highlights outlining her silhouette, creating a dangerous atmosphere. The crowd erupts in cheers mixed with gasps.
Cut—
A towering boxer stands at the center of the ring (red shorts, red gloves, beast-style mouthguard), radiating pressure. Like a gorilla, he pounds his chest, laughing arrogantly with disdain and provocation.

[Fight 5–15s]
Extreme close-up of the boxing bell as it rings sharply. Hard cut back to the ring.
The boxer throws a heavy punch—the Black Swan dodges with an extreme backbend, then immediately unleashes a counterattack:
A rapid upward high kick, followed by consecutive spinning kicks and slicing leg techniques. Her movements are sharper, more aggressive, with accelerated pacing and continuous, relentless attacks. Her motion is both elegant and feral.
The boxer is completely overwhelmed, forced into a defensive state, retreating step by step as his movements grow disordered.
Final move—after a high-speed spin, the Black Swan delivers a powerful horizontal whip kick (with strong kinetic force and air-tearing impact), launching the boxer high into the air before crashing heavily to the ground.
K.O.
The crowd erupts in thunderous cheers. The Black Swan slowly settles her stance, standing at the center of the spotlight. She gracefully bows like a noble black swan.
en.t: Black Swan vs Boxer Anime Fight

zh.p:
日本动画风格，带有竞技格斗游戏的爽快感。场景设定在拳击擂台上，时长15秒，30帧/秒，无字幕。高对比度电影级布光，体积光，大气粒子与烟雾效果，观众存在感强烈。整体节奏干净利落，镜头运动果断有力，毫不拖沓。高动态范围，物理反馈真实。

【入场 0-5秒】
低角度快速跟拍镜头稳步推进。一位高挑的金发蓝眼芭蕾舞者以“黑天鹅”姿态从上方戏剧性降落——姿态更张扬、更具压迫感。旋转落地时动作带有明显攻击性，冲击更重、更锐利，身体控制精准而充满张力。羽毛如黑色利刃般四散飘落。
灯光转为冷色调高对比度，锐利的高光勾勒出她的轮廓，营造危险氛围。观众爆发出夹杂惊呼的喝彩。
切——
一位高大拳击手立于擂台中央（红色短裤、红色拳套、野兽式牙套），散发压迫感。如大猩猩般捶打胸口，以轻蔑挑衅的姿态狂妄大笑。

【战斗 5-15秒】
拳击铃铛的特写镜头，铃声尖锐响起。硬切回擂台。
拳击手挥出重拳——黑天鹅以极限后仰闪避，随即立即发动反击：
一记迅猛的高位回旋踢，接续连续旋转踢击与劈挂腿法。动作更锐利、更具攻击性，节奏加快，攻势连绵不绝。她的身姿既优雅又狂野。
拳击手完全被压制，被迫转入防守，步步后退，动作逐渐混乱。
终结技——高速旋转后，黑天鹅一记势大力沉的横鞭腿（附带强烈动能与撕裂空气的冲击力），将拳击手高高踢飞，重重砸落地面。
K.O.
观众爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼。黑天鹅缓缓收势，立于聚光灯中央。如高贵黑天鹅般优雅行礼。

en.p:
A massive man in his late 30s with volcanic ash streaking his skin, shaved head and ember-orange eyes, wearing a heavy basalt-plated mantle embedded with molten fissures glowing beneath the armor — hook at second two: he slams both fists into a city plaza and the molten fissures ignite, sending seismic shockwaves through the ground.

The pavement splits open instantly.

Magma veins burst upward through subway tunnels and sewer systems.

The fight becomes geological and explosive: lava fountains erupt through streets mid-battle, basalt pillars burst through skyscraper foundations, and asphalt liquefies under intense geothermal pressure.

Each of his strikes triggers tectonic fractures beneath the city.

Entire blocks begin sinking into molten fissures.

The gauntlet advances through an industrial district collapsing under volcanic pressure: factory floor → highway overpass melting under lava flows → refinery towers igniting in chain explosions.

Chase-cam across collapsing concrete bridges while lava rivers carve new channels through the city.

Velocity ramp when a dormant volcanic chamber beneath the city detonates and the entire district erupts upward.

Cut to aerial: a new volcanic caldera has formed where the city once stood.

He stands at the edge of the crater as lava flows reshape the landscape.

Diegetic orange magma emissive lighting interacting with ash clouds and molten rock particles, cinematic fire glow and geological destruction physics, 4K.

zh.p:
一名年近四十的魁梧男子，皮肤上沾着火山灰的条纹，剃着光头，双眼呈余烬般的橙色，身披厚重的玄武岩板甲，铠甲下镶嵌着熔岩裂隙，发出炽热的光芒——在第二秒时，他双拳猛击城市广场，熔岩裂隙瞬间点燃，将地震冲击波传入地下。

路面当场裂开。

岩浆脉动从地铁隧道和下水道系统中喷涌而出。

战斗变得如同地质灾难般猛烈：战斗中，熔岩喷泉从街道中迸发，玄武岩柱从摩天大楼的地基中刺出，沥青在强烈的地热压力下液化。

他的每一次攻击都会在城市下方引发构造断裂。

整个街区开始沉入熔岩裂隙中。

这名重甲战士穿过一个在火山压力下崩塌的工业区：工厂地面→在熔岩流下融化的高速公路立交桥→在连环爆炸中起火的炼油塔。

追拍镜头穿过正在坍塌的混凝土桥梁，而熔岩河流在城市中冲刷出新的河道。

当城市下方一个休眠的火山腔室爆炸，整个区域向上喷发时，速度骤然提升。

切换到航拍镜头：城市原址上形成了一个新的火山口。

他站在火山口的边缘，熔岩流重塑着地貌。

橙色的岩浆发光与灰烬云和熔岩颗粒产生互动，营造出电影般的火焰光芒和地质破坏物理效果，4K分辨率。

en.p:
15-second, no-dialogue, fully immersive high-speed brutal fight short film.

Two characters @ image1 and @ image2 . 
Live-action realistic style. Close-quarters, high-speed chaotic melee combat with no rules, fully out-of-control brawling. No flashy choreography—pure raw. Continuous exchange of punches, kicks, blocks, body checks, throws, and grappling entanglements. Ultra-realistic impact. Exaggerated yet physically grounded motion speed. Entire sequence in 120 FPS with no slow motion. Rapid dashes, evasions, and high-speed limb swings. Extreme motion blur and speed trails amplify intensity while preserving realistic weight and physics.

Master-level cinematic camera movement:

A professional film camera stays tightly locked to the action, flying dynamically with the fighters—high-speed dives, sudden stops, whip pans, and full 360° orbital tracking. The camera moves in sync with punches, kicks, and evasions, with responsive shake and displacement. One continuous take, no cuts. Sharp push-pull tracking, sudden directional shifts, fully integrated into the fight for a face-to-face immersive combat perspective. Smooth, zero-latency motion.

Master-level precision editing:

0–3 seconds: ultra-fast cuts to enter combat.

3–10 seconds: seamless action continuity with zero stutter or breaks.

10–15 seconds: dense, violent rapid-cut climax.

Editing rhythm escalates with combat intensity. Fast intercutting enhances chaos. Precise beat timing, no redundant shots. Constant suffocating high-speed pacing.

Environment Setting

Modern open-plan office with desks, computers, cabinets, printers, and swivel chairs; realistic layout with cool overhead lighting and side backlight for strong contrast. Slightly cramped space for added tension; no glass-breaking.

Environmental Interaction & Constraints:

Combat affects the space only through natural, physically justified collisions—papers scatter from air movement (not attacks), chairs slide or topple on impact, desks shift slightly without deliberate damage, and screens remain intact with minor vibration. No unnecessary or intentional destruction of equipment.

Body-driven combat: grappling, pinning, counter-throws, and realistic slams with subtle impact cracks/vibrations. Natural airflow—light paper/dust movement only, no exaggeration.

Final Action Design

Final 2–3s: both throw simultaneous close-range punches, freezing inches before impact—fully tensed, heavy breathing, locked in perfect deadlock.

zh.p:
一部15秒、无对白、完全沉浸式的高速残酷打斗短片。

两个角色，分别对应图片1和图片2。
采用真人实拍写实风格。近距离、高速混乱的近身肉搏，毫无规则，完全失控的斗殴。没有花哨的编排——纯粹原始。连续不断的拳击、踢击、格挡、身体冲撞、摔投和纠缠扭打。超真实的冲击感。动作速度夸张但符合物理基础。整段以120帧每秒拍摄，无慢动作。快速冲刺、闪避和高速肢体摆动。极致的运动模糊和速度拖尾增强紧张感，同时保留真实的重量感和物理效果。

大师级电影镜头运动：
专业电影摄影机紧密锁定动作，与打斗者一起动态飞行——高速俯冲、急停、甩镜和完整的360度环绕跟拍。镜头与拳击、踢击和闪避同步移动，带有响应性的抖动和位移。一镜到底，无剪辑。锐利的推拉跟拍，突然的方向变化，完全融入打斗，营造面对面沉浸式战斗视角。流畅、零延迟的运动。

大师级精准剪辑：
0-3秒：超快切入战斗。
3-10秒：无缝动作连贯，无卡顿或中断。
10-15秒：密集、暴力的快速剪辑高潮。
剪辑节奏随战斗强度升级。快速交叉剪辑增强混乱感。精准节拍把控，无冗余镜头。持续令人窒息的快节奏。

环境设定：
现代开放式办公室，配备办公桌、电脑、文件柜、打印机和转椅；布局真实，顶部冷光照明和侧面背光形成强烈对比。空间略显局促以增加紧张感；无玻璃破碎。

环境互动与限制：
战斗仅通过自然、物理上合理的碰撞影响空间——纸张因空气流动（而非攻击）散落，椅子在撞击下滑动或翻倒，桌子轻微移动而无故意破坏，屏幕保持完好仅有轻微震动。无不必要的或蓄意的设备损坏。

身体驱动的战斗：扭打、压制、反摔和真实的撞击，带有微妙的冲击裂纹/震动。自然气流——仅轻微纸张/灰尘移动，无夸张效果。

最终动作设计：
最后2-3秒：双方同时打出近距离拳击，在击中前瞬间定格——全身紧绷，沉重呼吸，陷入完美的僵持状态。

en.p: A hyper-realistic video shot in a modern Western-style bedroom in the morning. An American couple is sleeping peacefully in bed with soft, natural daylight coming through the window. A tabby orange cat is running through the bedroom doorway, holding its own food bowl in its mouth. The cat jumps onto the bed and runs between the two sleeping figures. First, it places the bowl down gently on the pillow between them and taps on it once to make a soft clinking sound. The woman, without opening her eyes, merely groans and rolls over onto her other side. Next, the cat uses both its front paws to lift the entire bowl and drops it deliberately onto the sleeping man's head, making a loud metallic thud. He does not wake up. Finally, the cat extends its paw and begins repeatedly batting the man in the face to wake him up.

zh.p: 清晨，一间现代西式风格的卧室里，柔和自然的日光透过窗户洒入。一对美国夫妇正安静地躺在床上熟睡。一只虎斑橘猫叼着自己的食碗，从卧室门口跑进来。它跳上床，在两人之间穿行。首先，它轻轻将碗放在两人之间的枕头上，用爪子敲了一下碗，发出清脆的叮当声。女人没有睁眼，只是咕哝了一声，翻身转向另一侧。接着，猫用两只前爪托起整个碗，故意将碗扣在熟睡男人的头上，发出一声沉闷的金属撞击声。他依然没有醒来。最后，猫伸出爪子，开始反复拍打男人的脸，试图叫醒他。

en.p: A meticulously detailed fantasy flower field landscape drawn with colored pencils, an expanse of colorful blossoms (from small to large flowers blooming densely), each petal and leaf carefully rendered. A clear blue sky with soft clouds slowly drifting, a deep blue gradient, the texture of the sky expressed through characteristic colored pencil strokes. Multi-layered color overlays, delicate cross-hatching, intricate shading, a faint hint of paper texture, natural gradations from varying pencil pressure, warm color development. Light pours down onto the flower field, petals softly glowing, natural movement swaying in the wind, a composition with depth (foreground, midground, and background clearly separated). An analog hand-drawn feel, extremely high-density detailing, a level of completion akin to an artwork, where tranquility and vitality coexist, a beautiful and lyrical landscape. The reference image serves as the end frame. The scene begins with a white canvas. Initially, it is completely blank paper. Gradually, delicate colored pencil lines appear, slowly tracing the outlines of the flower field. Starting with faint gray sketch lines, colors are gradually layered. Red, yellow, pink, and purple flowers are carefully colored with fine, characteristic colored pencil strokes. Each line remains visible, emphasizing the hand-drawn texture. With each layer, the colors gain depth and dimensionality. At certain points, the view zooms in partially, making the paper texture and colored pencil touches (roughness, overlays, differences in pressure) realistically visible. The background sky spreads from a pale blue gradient, with soft clouds lightly added. Finally, a vibrant and lively illustration of a flower field is completed. Just before completion, highlights and shadows are added, tightening the overall composition. The light is soft and natural, with a warm atmosphere. Overall, it is a video showing the creation process of 'an artwork carefully crafted with colored pencils.' High definition, ultra-precise details, delicate shading unique to colored pencils, paper texture, artwork, a pleasant creation process, ASMR-like depiction. 'Strokes appear automatically (hands are not shown).' 'A time-lapse style that conveys the passage of time.'
en.t: Fantasy Flower Field Colored Pencil Art

en.p:
STORY FORMAT: 15s / 152 BPM / ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT / 3D adventure-comedy / stylized ancient-tomb fantasy  

TONE: tense survival → frantic ingenuity → claustrophobic horror → absurd cosmic twist 

SUBJECTS: Orange cat explorer in rugged fedora-style hat, brown leather outfit, holding a torch, axe strapped at waist; Ancient sarcophagi; Swarm of black scarab beetles; Green-skinned alien in black suit with large dark eyes 

PROPS: Torch, stone lever switch, sarcophagus lids, improvised wooden ladder, crawling tunnel, glowing exit, pyramid peak, green banknote ENVIRONMENT: Dark pyramid chamber filled with sarcophagi → narrow ceiling tunnel → pyramid summit → surreal zoom-out into currency world 

COLOR: Deep shadow gold and ember torchlight → dusty brown claustrophobic tones → bright desert sunlight → flat green currency palette 

CAMERA: Single continuous 24mm tracking shot, tight interior movement, rapid whip pans, vertical climb transitions, seamless macro-to-wide transformation, no cuts  1 (0–2s) TRAPPED CHAMBER Camera circles tightly around the orange cat explorer in a dim pyramid room filled with sarcophagi. He slams a stone switch repeatedly. Instead of opening, the stone door grinds downward, sealing completely. 

DIALOGUE (Cat): “Oh come on—wrong button?!”  2 (2–3.5s) QUICK SCAN He spins, torchlight flickering across walls. Camera tilts up with his gaze—revealing a small hole in the ceiling. His eyes widen. DIALOGUE (Cat): “Okay… plan B.”  3 (3.5–6s) BUILD IN SECONDS He rushes to the sarcophagi—rips off multiple lids, wood cracking. With rapid axe strikes, he chops and reshapes pieces mid-motion. Camera orbits as he snaps them together into a rough ladder with absurd speed.  4 (6–7.5s) CLIMB AND LAUNCH He climbs fast, ladder wobbling. At the top, he forcefully kicks off—launching himself upward into the small ceiling hole, barely squeezing through.  5 (7.5–9s) CLAUSTROPHOBIC CRAWL Camera follows tightly behind as he crawls through a narrow, dark tunnel. Torchlight dims. Ahead, a faint glowing exit flickers. DIALOGUE (Cat, strained): “Yeah… definitely haunted.”  6 (9–11s) HORROR CHASE Behind him, a swarm of black scarab beetles floods into the tunnel—rapid clicking echoes. He panics and speeds up, scrambling forward. DIALOGUE (Cat): “NOPE nope nope nope—!”  7 (11–12s) ESCAPE BURST He bursts out of the tunnel into blinding sunlight—rolling forward onto the peak of a massive pyramid. Desert wind howls.  8 (12–13s) REVEAL HEIGHT He stands, catching breath—then looks down. Camera begins pulling rapidly upward, revealing impossible scale. His expression shifts to shock.  9 (13–14s) REALITY TWIST The pyramid morphs seamlessly into a printed symbol—the entire scene flattening into a green banknote design. The cat’s shocked face becomes a stylized portrait above the pyramid with “100 USD” markings.  

10 (14–15s) FINAL PUNCHLINE Camera pulls back fu

zh.p: （0-2秒）被困密室 镜头紧密环绕一只橙色猫咪探险家，它身处昏暗的金字塔密室，四周摆满石棺。它反复拍打一个石制拉杆开关。石门非但未开，反而向下碾动，彻底封死。 猫咪（台词）：“搞什么——按错了？！” （2-3.5秒）快速扫视 它转身，火把光影在墙壁上摇曳。镜头随它的视线向上倾斜——露出天花板上的一个小洞。它双眼圆睁。 猫咪（台词）：“行吧……B计划。” （3.5-6秒）争分夺秒搭建 它冲向石棺——掀开多个棺盖，木料碎裂声响起。它挥斧快速劈砍，边移动边重塑木料。镜头环绕拍摄，它以惊人的速度将木料拼成一把简陋的梯子。 （6-7.5秒）攀爬与跃起 它快速攀爬，梯子摇摇晃晃。爬到顶端，它用力蹬离——纵身跃入天花板上的小洞，勉强挤了进去。 （7.5-9秒）幽闭爬行 镜头紧随其后，拍摄它在狭窄黑暗的通道中爬行。火把光芒渐暗。前方，一个微弱的发光出口忽明忽暗。 猫咪（台词，吃力地）：“嗯……绝对闹鬼了。” （9-11秒）恐怖追逐 它身后，一大群黑色圣甲虫涌入通道——急促的咔嗒声回荡。它惊慌失措，加速向前爬去。 猫咪（台词）：“不要不要不要不要——！” （11-12秒）逃生冲出 它冲出通道，刺眼阳光扑面而来——它翻滚到一座巨大金字塔的顶端。沙漠风声呼啸。 （12-13秒）揭示高度 它站起身，喘着粗气——然后向下望去。镜头开始快速向上拉远，揭示出不可思议的尺度。它的表情转为震惊。 （13-14秒）现实扭曲 金字塔无缝变形为一个印刷符号——整个场景扁平化，化作绿色钞票图案。猫咪震惊的脸变成钞票上风格化的肖像，上方印有“100美元”字样。 （14-15秒）最终笑点 镜头继续拉远。

en.p:
## Phase C (0.20s): Lantern Activation · Explosion · Full View Presentation

(0.07s) Instant cut to blackout. Fixed camera. Only a human silhouette is visible in the darkness (silence before the special move is unleashed). A floral emblem (5 petals, red + gray, 40% width) appears in the center of the screen, and golden explosion light radiates in 8 directions from the center. A vertical golden energy beam extends downward from the lower part of the emblem. The energy begins to diffuse upward.

(0.13s) Fixed camera (low-angle tilt-up). The full image of a lantern-shaped object is displayed in the center of the screen (a vertically elongated hexagonal lantern type, with a red body, a white 5-petal floral emblem, and a stone base). A red beam of light extends from behind it into the sky. Yellow and turquoise star particles float around. Pink to magenta clouds occupy the lower 30% of the screen. A slight zoom-in of about 2% over 3 frames.

---

## Phase D (0.17s): Tilt Down · Character Reveal

(0.17s) Tilt down (downward pan at approximately 60–80 px/f). Over 5 frames, the camera moves from a high angle of the lantern to a medium close-up of the characters' faces. As the lantern recedes to the upper part of the screen, the 3-person unit hidden beneath it appears sequentially (waist → upper body → face). The red glow of the lantern fades upward. A mist effect lingers near the characters' waists. No zoom change (pure tilt down).

---

## Phase E (0.73s): 3-Person Unit Introduction · Charge Effect

(0.27s) Fixed low-angle tilt-up. Gradual zoom-in (1–2 px/f). Predominantly cool colors (navy blue base). The three characters face forward in an introductory pose. Each character makes small movements with their arms, hands, and necks (pose changes such as raising a hand or tilting the head). The golden shield-shaped pedestal at the bottom of the screen gradually moves out of frame.

(0.20s) Zoom-in continues. Color transition shifts to a mix of navy and purple. Yellow lightning effects snake along the edge of the pedestal (increasing from 3 to 6 streaks). The expressions of the three characters gradually become more combative (eyes widen, corners of the lips lift).

(0.26s) Rapid color transition from purple → orange → red (visualization of "charge → critical point"). Close-up where the faces of the three characters occupy 70% of the frame. The central character adopts a shouting expression, while the left and right characters shift into attack-ready poses. The color tone almost completely shifts to red/orange, preparing for the instant cut in the next shot.

---

## Phase F (0.44s): Descending Attack · Landing Impact

(0.24s) Instant cut to a distant view. Ultra-high-speed zoom-in (approximately 10x magnification over 8 frames). The characters appear small in the upper center of the screen, enveloped in a golden energy ring (2–3 concentric circles). Radial red speed lines streak across the entire screen. The orb of light rapidly approaches. The bottom of the lantern, accompanied by vertical motion blur, covers 60% of the screen, and golden flames begin to erupt from the base (expanding from 300px to 500px in width). Extreme close-up of the floral emblem on the lantern's base, covering 80% of the screen width. Just before landing, a massive flame fills the lower 40% of the screen, and an iridescent lens flare appears.

(0.20s) Landing impact. Fixed camera (slight vibration of 5–10 px due to impact). Golden flames occupy the lower 50% of the screen, with iridescent lens flare and chromatic aberration (RGB separation). The flames expand to 70%. Over 90% whiteout (golden-toned warm white, lasting 1 frame). A pillar of fire (width 200→150 px) vertically pierces the center of the screen, and the background begins to transition to purple and indigo.

---

## Phase G (0.56s): Light Pillar Ascension · Cloud Sea Breakthrough · Reaching Space

(0.16s) Tilt up + slight zoom-out. A pillar of light (width 100→60 px) vertically traversing the center of the screen narrows and rises, with rainbow stripes appearing on both sides. Pink to magenta cloud seas spread across the lower 30–40% of the screen. The light pillar transforms into a rainbow trail (arc-shaped trajectory, rainbow gradient, thicker at the bottom and thinner at the top). The entire screen fades to purple, transitioning the scene.

(0.10s) Fixed camera. The purple fade resolves, and a dark purple cosmic space stabilizes. Pink to magenta cloud seas (volumetric representation) occupy the lower part of the screen. The rainbow trail clearly appears, extending in an arc from the lower center upward, with a white to yellow orb of light (diameter 40px) at its tip.

(0.30s) Tilt up + slight zoom-out. The orb of light at the tip of the rainbow trail ascends to the upper part of the screen (cloud sea → space). Short radial light rays (30px) emanate from the orb in all directions. Formation of a light cross (cross flare) begins (horizontal 100px, vertical 80px). The light cross fully forms. It reaches its maximum size (horizontal 300px, vertical 200px), with a pure white light core (slightly elliptical) at its center. 4–5 golden star particles float around it.

---

## Phase H (0.50s): Space Flight · Planetary Collision

(0.27s) Instant cut to a wide shot of space. Fixed camera. 10–15 stars are scattered in the dark purple to navy space. A large red planet (with atmospheric rim light) is in the lower left of the screen, and a small blue planet is in the lower right. A sun-like large flare (red horizontal light rays extending 500px left and right) is slightly left of center. The flare shrinks. A comet shape (white to yellow light core + orange to red fiery tail) accelerates toward the red planet (fiery tail extends from 100px to 200px, movement speed 30–60 px/f).

(0.23s) Slight zoom-in. A human silhouette of the character (height 30px) is visible within the light core. The comet approaches the atmosphere of the red planet. A checkmark UI appears inside a turquoise hexagonal frame (with a glitch-style chromatic aberration effect). It contacts the planet's rim light, and orange flares begin to radiate outward (6–8 streaks) from the point of contact.

zh.p:
## Phase C (0.20s): 灯籠起動・爆発・全景提示

(0.07s) 瞬時カットで暗転へ。固定カメラ。人型シルエットのみ見える暗転（必殺技発動前の静寂）。画面中央に花形紋章（5弁、赤+灰色、幅40%）が出現し、中心から黄金色の爆発光が8方向に放射。紋章下部から縦の黄金エネルギービームが下方に伸びる。エネルギーが上方に拡散し始める。

(0.13s) 固定カメラ（煽りローアングル）。灯籠型オブジェクトの全体像が画面中央に表示（縦長六角形の提灯型、赤い本体に白い5弁花紋章、石造り台座付き）。背後から赤い光柱が天空へ伸びる。黄色・ターコイズの星パーティクルが浮遊。画面下部30%にピンク〜マゼンタの雲。3フレームで約2%の微ズームイン。

---

## Phase D (0.17s): ティルトダウン・キャラクター顕現

(0.17s) ティルトダウン（約60–80px/fの下方向パン）。5フレームで灯籠の上部アングルからキャラクター顔のミディアムクローズアップまで移動。灯籠が画面上方に退くにつれ、その下に隠れていた3人ユニットが順次画面に現れる（腰部→上半身→顔の順に顕現）。灯籠の赤い発光が上方に退いていく。霧エフェクトがキャラクター腰付近に漂う。ズーム変化なし（純粋なティルトダウン）。

---

## Phase E (0.73s): 3人ユニット紹介・溜め演出

(0.27s) 固定煽りローアングル。緩やかなズームイン（1–2px/f）。冷色主体（紺色ベース）。3人が正面を向いた紹介ポーズ。各キャラが腕・手・首などを小さく動かし（手を上げる・傾ける等のポーズ変化）、画面下部の金色盾型台座が徐々に画面外へ退く。

(0.20s) ズームイン継続。紺+紫混合へ色調遷移。台座縁に沿って黄色い電撃エフェクトが蛇行（3→6本に増加）。3人の表情が徐々に戦闘的に変化（目を見開く・唇の端が上がる）。

(0.26s) 紫→オレンジ→赤へ急速な色調遷移（「溜め→臨界」の視覚化）。3人の顔がフレームの70%を占めるクローズアップ. 中央キャラが叫ぶような表情に、左右キャラが攻撃準備ポーズへ。色調がほぼ赤/オレンジに転換完了し、次カットの瞬時カットに備える。

---

## Phase F (0.44s): 降下攻撃・着地インパクト

(0.24s) 瞬時カットで遠景に切り替わり。超高速ズームイン（8フレームで約10倍の拡大）。キャラクターが黄金色のエネルギーリング（2–3重の同心円）に包まれた状態で画面中央上部に小さく見える。放射状の赤いスピードラインが画面全体に走る。光球が急速に接近。灯籠底面が縦方向モーションブラーと共に画面の60%を覆い、黄金色の炎が底部から噴出開始（幅300px→500pxへ拡大）。灯籠底面の花紋章が画面幅80%の超接写に。着地直前、巨大な炎が画面下部40%を埋め、虹色レンズフレアが出現。

(0.20s) 着地インパクト。固定カメラ（衝撃による5–10pxの微振動）。黄金色の炎が画面下部50%を占め、虹色レンズフレアと色収差（RGB分離）が発生。炎が70%に拡大。90%以上のホワイトアウト（黄金色系ウォームホワイト、1フレーム持続）。炎柱（幅200→150px）が画面中央を縦貫し、背景が紫〜藍色へ転換し始める。

---

## Phase G (0.56s): 光柱上昇・雲海突破・宇宙到達

(0.10s) 固定カメラ。紫フェードが解消し、暗紫色の宇宙的空間が安定。画面下部にピンク〜マゼンタの雲海（立体的なボリューメトリック表現）。虹色トレイルが明確に出現し、先端に白〜黄色の光球（直径40px）を伴いながら下部中央から上方へ弧状に伸びる。

(0.30s) ティルトアップ＋微ズームアウト。虹色トレイルの先端光球が画面上部へ上昇（雲海→宇宙）。光球から短い放射光条（30px）が四方に出現。光十字（クロスフレア）の形成開始（水平100px・垂直80px）。光十字が完全形成。最大サイズ（水平300px・垂直200px）に到達し、中心に純白の光核（略楕円形）。黄金色の星パーティクルが周囲に4–5個浮遊。

---

(0.27s) 瞬時カットで宇宙空間のワイドショットへ. 固定カメラ。暗紫〜紺色の宇宙空間に恒星が10–15個散在。画面左下に赤い巨大惑星（大気のリム光あり）、画面右下に青い小惑星。画面中央やや左に太陽状の大フレア（赤い水平光条が左右500px）。フレアが縮小。彗星形状（白〜黄色の光核＋オレンジ〜赤の炎尾）が赤い惑星方向へ加速移動（炎尾100px→200pxへ伸長、移動速度30–60px/f）。

(0.23s) 微ズームイン。光核の中にキャラクターの人型シルエットが確認可能（高さ30px）。彗星が赤い惑星の大気圏に接近。ターコイズ色の六角形フレーム内にチェックマークUIが出現（グリッチ風色収差エフェクト付き）。惑星リム光に接触し、接触点からオレンジ色のフレアが放射状（6–8本）に広がり始める。

en.p: A barista in a small Tokyo café pours steamed milk into a dark espresso from 15cm height in one continuous motion. Milk stream hitting crema, creating a rosetta pattern, steam rising and curling in cold morning air, condensation on the ceramic cup, the barista's hand steady with visible tendons, apron fabric shifting, reflection of neon sign in the glass counter behind. Shallow focus pulls from the pour to the barista's concentrated eyes. Shot on Sony Venice, anamorphic lens, 4K, natural window light mixed with warm tungsten. Hyperrealistic, every droplet physically accurate.

zh.p: 东京一家小咖啡馆里，咖啡师将蒸奶从15厘米高处一次性连续注入深色浓缩咖啡中。奶流撞击咖啡油脂，形成罗塞塔图案，蒸汽在寒冷的晨空中升腾卷曲，陶瓷杯壁上凝结着水珠，咖啡师的手稳如磐石，青筋隐现，围裙布料随动作微动，身后玻璃柜台映出霓虹招牌的倒影。浅景深从注奶过程拉近到咖啡师专注的双眼。使用索尼威尼斯摄影机、变形镜头拍摄，4K画质，自然窗光与暖色钨丝灯混合。超写实风格，每一滴液体都精确符合物理规律。

en.p: Cinematic timelapse sequence, 16:9, 15 seconds. Opens with a wide aerial shot looking down at a completely empty flat plot of land — dirt, nothing around it, golden morning light. Time begins accelerating. Foundation crews arrive, concrete is poured, steel frames rise from the ground. Roads begin forming outward in every direction. Buildings grow upward at timelapse speed — first small structures, then mid-rise, then massive gleaming skyscrapers shooting upward around the original plot. Construction cranes everywhere, scaffolding appearing and disappearing. The city fills in — roads packed with traffic, bridges appearing over rivers, neighborhoods expanding to the horizon. Day and night cycle rapidly — golden days, vivid blue skies, then nights with thousands of city lights glowing, neon signs flickering on, headlights streaming through streets like rivers of light. Seasons shift — summer heat haze, autumn colors, winter snow dusting the rooftops, spring green returning. Final shot pulls back wide revealing a full glittering megacity stretching to every horizon, lights blazing, alive. Camera locked on the original empty plot the entire time — now buried deep in the heart of the city. Photorealistic, IMAX cinematic quality, ultra sharp, vivid colors throughout, dramatic lighting at every stage, epic scale, smooth continuous timelapse motion from first frame to last.

zh.p: 电影延时摄影序列，16:9画幅，时长15秒。开场以高空俯瞰广角镜头俯拍一片完全空旷的平坦地块——泥土裸露，四周空无一物，沐浴在金色的晨光中。时间开始加速。地基施工队抵达，混凝土浇筑，钢架从地面升起。道路向四面八方延伸成型。建筑以延时摄影的速度向上生长——先是低矮结构，接着是中层建筑，随后是宏伟闪亮的摩天大楼围绕原始地块拔地而起。建筑塔吊随处可见，脚手架出现又消失。城市逐渐填充——道路车水马龙，桥梁横跨河流，社区向地平线扩展。昼夜快速交替——金色白昼、湛蓝晴空，接着是夜晚成千上万的城市灯光闪烁，霓虹招牌逐一亮起，车灯如光河般在街道上流淌。四季更迭——夏季热浪蒸腾，秋日色彩斑斓，冬雪轻覆屋顶，春绿再度回归。最终镜头向后拉远，展现一座璀璨的巨型都市延伸至每个地平线，灯火辉煌，生机勃勃。镜头始终锁定最初的那片空旷地块——如今已深埋于城市心脏。照片级真实感，IMAX电影画质，超清晰，全程色彩鲜艳，每个阶段光影戏剧化，史诗级规模，从第一帧到最后一帧流畅连续的延时运动。

en.p: A sleepy orange cat in a crisp white taekwondo uniform dozes off in the middle of a disciplined dojo within the first two seconds, while rows of other cats practice punches with perfect focus, instantly creating a humorous hook, and the scene snaps into motion as a stern black cat master in a gray Taoist robe storms in and scolds him before grabbing a fly swatter and charging forward, turning the cartoon into a fast, one-take action-comedy chase that never cuts, flowing seamlessly from the dojo as the orange cat jolts awake and bolts toward the window, leaping out in panic as the en.p: A 15-second cinematic action sequence that starts instantly with an epic ultra-wide shot of a gigantic stone colossus striding through a storm-covered desert while tiny riders race across the dunes below at full speed. The camera is already moving fast from the first frame, sweeping low and aggressive past shattered pillars and exploding sand. At 7 seconds enter dramatic slow motion as one rider launches off a dune and rides vertically across the colossus arm while pieces of ancient armor crack open and golden fire spills out from inside. Then snap back to full speed as the camera dives toward the monster’s face, where its eyes open to reveal an entire glowing city hidden within its skull.

en.p: [CINEMATIC SETUP]  Film Style: Photorealistic 8K, 65mm IMAX. One continuous forward dolly — no cuts. The camera glides steadily forward at chest height, as if walking through time, while the coastal landscape and city evolve dramatically around it over 10,000 years.  Lens: 24mm wide-angle, shallow horizon line with subtle sea mist and horizon glow.  Color Grade: Soft dawn blues to warm earth tones to fiery sunset oranges to cool neon cyans to sterile white-silver, each era bleeding smoothly into the next.  Lighting: Natural daylight shifting to torchlight, gaslight, electric grids, holographic glow, and finally starlight — the illumination evolves with human progress.  Camera: Constant slow forward dolly movement. No lateral pans, no tilts. Seamless transitions through shared elements: shoreline becomes harbor becomes docks becomes launch platforms.  [TIMELINE — CONTINUOUS FORWARD DOLLY]  0-2s: PREHISTORIC SETTLEMENT. Glide forward along a wild rocky coastline at dawn. Simple thatched huts and stone circles assemble from scattered boulders and driftwood. Small fishing boats carve from logs on the beach. Early humans tend fires as smoke rises; shellfish mounds grow beside the path.  2-4s: ANCIENT PORT. The shoreline hardens into wooden piers. Mud huts transform into whitewashed stone buildings with red-tiled roofs. A bustling ancient harbor forms with wooden sailing ships docking. Marble columns rise on both sides. Olive groves and vineyards bloom rapidly along the advancing path.  4-6s: MEDIEVAL TRADE CITY. Stone walls and wooden structures give way to fortified castles and Gothic cathedrals. Cobblestone streets lay themselves underfoot. Markets assemble with colorful tents and horse-drawn carts. A grand harbor expands with larger galleons; cranes hoist cargo as the camera passes through sea spray and lantern light.  6-8s: INDUSTRIAL HARBOR. Cobblestones become paved roads. Brick factories and iron bridges replace medieval spires. Steamships and early railways emerge along the waterfront. Smokestacks rise, billowing dark plumes that fade into the next era. Warehouses and cranes multiply on both sides.  8-10s: MODERN METROPOLIS. Industrial grit transforms into sleek concrete and steel. Skyscrapers shoot upward in glass and chrome. Multi-lane highways and suspension bridges span the harbor. Cars and trains streak by with motion blur. Neon signs and digital billboards ignite sequentially as the city pulses with energy.  10-13s: NEAR-FUTURE MEGACITY. Glass towers evolve into towering arcologies with vertical gardens and glowing energy shields. Flying vehicles and maglev pods weave overhead. Holographic advertisements float in the air. The harbor fills with autonomous ships and floating platforms. Bioluminescent lights and drone swarms illuminate the scene.  13-15s: SPACE COLONY LAUNCH. The dense cityscape parts to reveal vast launch complexes on reclaimed land. Massive orbital elevators and starships stand ready.

zh.p: [电影设定] 影片风格：照片级8K画质，65毫米IMAX格式。采用连续向前推镜——无任何剪辑。摄像机以胸部高度稳定向前滑行，仿佛穿越时空，而沿海景观与城市在周围历经万年剧烈演变。镜头：24毫米广角，浅地平线，伴有微薄海雾与地平线辉光。色彩调校：柔和的黎明蓝过渡到温暖大地色，再转为炽热日落橙，继而变为冷艳霓虹青，最终呈现无菌白银色——每个时代无缝交融。光线：自然日光逐渐转变为火炬光、煤气灯光、电网灯光、全息光晕，最后是星光——照明随人类进步而演变。摄像机：持续缓慢向前推镜。无横向摇摄，无俯仰。通过共享元素实现无缝过渡：海岸线变为港口，再变为码头，最终成为发射平台。[时间线——连续向前推镜] 0-2秒：史前定居点。黎明时分，沿荒芜岩石海岸线向前滑行。简陋的茅草屋和石圈从散落的巨石与浮木中拼凑而成。海滩上，小型渔船由原木凿出。早期人类生火，烟雾升腾；贝丘沿路堆积。2-4秒：古代港口。海岸线硬化成木制码头。泥屋转变为粉刷洁白的石砌建筑，配以红瓦屋顶。繁华的古代港口形成，木制帆船停靠。两侧升起大理石柱。沿前进路径，橄榄园和葡萄园迅速繁茂。4-6秒：中世纪贸易城市。石墙与木结构让位于防御城堡和哥特式大教堂。鹅卵石街道在脚下铺展。市场形成，彩色帐篷与马车林立。宏伟港口扩展，容纳更大帆船；起重机吊运货物，摄像机穿过海雾与灯笼光。6-8秒：工业港口。鹅卵石变为铺砌道路。砖砌工厂和铁桥取代中世纪尖塔。汽船与早期铁路沿水岸出现。烟囱升起，浓烟滚滚，融入下一时代。两侧仓库与起重机倍增。8-10秒：现代大都市。工业粗粝转变为光滑混凝土与钢铁。摩天大楼以玻璃和铬合金拔地而起。多车道高速公路和悬索桥横跨港口。汽车与火车飞驰，呈现运动模糊。霓虹灯与数字广告牌依次点亮，城市脉动能量。10-13秒：近未来巨型城市。玻璃塔演变为高耸的生态建筑，配有垂直花园和发光能量护盾。飞行器与磁浮舱在上方穿梭。全息广告悬浮空中。港口布满自主船舶与浮动平台。生物发光灯与无人机群照亮场景。13-15秒：太空殖民地发射。密集城市景观让位于填海土地上的庞大发射综合体。巨型轨道电梯与星际飞船整装待发。

zh.p: 在《聊斋》的幽暗世界里，有一幅九格画卷，从左至右、自上而下展开。第一格，月下荒山，孤坟野草间，一白衣书生执伞而行，身后影影绰绰。第二格，古庙破门半掩，书生推门而入，烛火摇曳，映出壁上斑驳壁画。第三格，画中女子眉眼含愁，指尖轻触窗棂，似欲语还休。第四格，书生夜读，忽闻窗外低泣，推窗见一素衣女子，泪痕未干。第五格，女子自称邻家亡女，因情债未了，魂魄难散。第六格，书生燃香祭拜，女子渐现笑颜，二人对坐，共话前尘。第七格，夜半风起，烛灭，女子身影忽淡，书生急唤，却见窗外月华如水。第八格，晨光熹微，书生再寻古庙，壁画依旧，女子已无踪迹。第九格，书生归途，回首荒山，唯见孤坟新土，似有青烟一缕，袅袅升空。此乃邵氏片场风格，光影交错，情仇缠绵，如《倩女幽魂》之遗韵，凄美而妖异。

en.p:
Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic 14-second aerial adventure video in 4K, shot on RED camera with anamorphic lenses, vibrant color grading, golden sunlight, and crystal-clear turquoise water. Style: mix of National Geographic documentary and Hollywood action (think Top Gun meets Maldives travel film). Dynamic drone-style camera movement, motion blur on fast passes, lens flares, and sparkling water reflections. Location: pristine tropical island with vibrant coral reefs, white sand beaches, rocky outcrops, lush green jungle coastline, and distant mountains under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.
0-2 seconds: Sweeping high-angle aerial shot over a stunning turquoise lagoon. A bright yellow vintage seaplane (classic yellow biplane with floats) enters from the top right, flying low and steady just above the water. Camera tracks alongside it revealing intricate coral reef patterns below in shades of emerald, turquoise, and deep blue. Gentle waves lapping on sandy beaches and rocky shores.
2-4 seconds: The yellow seaplane banks smoothly and descends lower. Camera follows from above as it flies directly over shallow coral heads. It skims extremely close to the water, starting to kick up a thin white water spray trail from its floats. Sunlight glinting off the wings and fuselage.
4-6 seconds: Intense low-level pass. The seaplane touches the water surface at high speed, creating a massive explosive rooster tail of white spray and foam behind it. Camera dives closer, dynamic tracking shot from slightly behind and above, capturing the powerful water displacement and the plane’s reflection in the clear water. Motion blur on the spinning propeller.
6-8 seconds: Close dramatic tracking shot from behind and slightly below the plane as it continues skimming and bouncing lightly on the water. Huge billowing white wake and spray arcs high into the air. The plane’s bright yellow color pops against the turquoise sea. Camera moves fluidly with the action, showing the intricate coral reef visible beneath the surface.
8-10 seconds: The seaplane flies even lower, directly over a large school of black manta rays and stingrays gliding gracefully just below the surface. It continues carving a dramatic curving white water trail. Camera circles dynamically to show both the plane above and the rays below in the same frame. Intense speed and energy, water spray catching the sunlight.
10-12 seconds: Wider epic shot as the seaplane pulls into a sweeping turn, still skimming the lagoon. Massive curving white wake trails behind it like a signature in the water. Camera pulls back to reveal more of the coastline — white sand beaches, black volcanic rocks, and dense green jungle. Multiple water splashes and spray explosions from the floats.
12-14 seconds: Final majestic pull-back and climb shot. The yellow seaplane rises slightly while still low, flying parallel to the beautiful tropical islan

zh.p:
打造一段超写实、电影感的14秒航拍冒险视频，4K分辨率，使用RED摄影机搭配变形镜头拍摄，色彩分级鲜艳，沐浴金色阳光，海水清澈碧蓝。风格融合《国家地理》纪录片与好莱坞动作片（想象《壮志凌云》遇上马尔代夫旅游宣传片）。动态无人机式镜头运动，快速掠过时带运动模糊，镜头光晕，水面波光粼粼。拍摄地点：原始热带岛屿，拥有 vibrant 珊瑚礁、白色沙滩、岩石岬角、郁郁葱葱的丛林海岸线，远处山脉在蓝天白云下清晰可见。
0-2秒：俯拍广角镜头，扫过 stunning 的碧蓝泻湖。一架亮黄色复古水上飞机（经典黄色双翼浮筒飞机）从右上角进入画面，低空平稳飞行，紧贴水面。镜头平行追踪，展现下方 intricate 的珊瑚礁图案，色调涵盖翡翠绿、碧蓝和深蓝。轻柔海浪拍打沙滩和岩石海岸。
2-4秒：黄色水上飞机平稳倾斜，降低高度。镜头从上方跟随，飞机直接飞过浅水珊瑚礁头。它极低地掠过水面，浮筒开始激起一层薄薄的白水花尾迹。阳光在机翼和机身上闪烁。
4-6秒：激烈的低空通场。水上飞机高速接触水面，在身后激起巨大爆炸般的白色水花和泡沫尾迹（rooster tail）。镜头俯冲靠近，从略后方和上方动态追踪，捕捉强大的水体排开效果以及飞机在清澈水面上的倒影。旋转的螺旋桨带运动模糊。
6-8秒：从飞机后方略下方近距离戏剧性追踪拍摄，飞机继续贴水滑行并轻微弹跳。巨大翻涌的白色尾流和水花高高溅入空中。飞机亮黄色与碧蓝大海形成鲜明对比。镜头流畅跟随动作，显示水面下清晰可见的 intricate 珊瑚礁。
8-10秒：水上飞机飞得更低，直接掠过一大群在浅水区优雅滑行的黑色蝠鲼和鳐鱼。它继续划出戏剧性的弯曲白色水痕。镜头动态环绕，在同一画面中同时展现上方的飞机和下方的鳐鱼。强烈的速度和能量感，水花在阳光下闪耀。
10-12秒：更宏大的史诗镜头，水上飞机拉出一个大弧度转弯，仍在泻湖上贴水飞行。巨大的弯曲白色尾流像水中的签名一样拖在身后。镜头拉远，展现更多海岸线——白色沙滩、黑色火山岩和茂密绿色丛林。浮筒激起多处水花和水雾爆炸。
12-14秒：最后庄严的拉远爬升镜头。黄色水上飞机略微抬升但仍保持低空，平行飞过美丽的热带岛屿。

en.p:
Cinematic short film, photorealistic VFX. 15-second desert hunt at high noon. Blinding light, zero shade, heat shimmer on everything.

[0–2s] Overhead drone — red desert canyon system. Sandstone towers, wind-carved arches, dry riverbeds. One figure: a woman on a sand-skiff — a flat wooden board with a triangular sail, gliding across compacted sand on bone runners. She wears wrapped linen armor, copper goggles, a weighted net coiled at her waist. She watches the sand.

[2–4s] ECU the sand surface — it's BREATHING. Rippling outward from a point 200 yards ahead. The sand rises like a slow dome. The sail-woman cuts the skiff hard right. The dome ERUPTS — a sandworm. 40 feet, segmented, chitinous plates the color of rust. Its mouth is a vertical iris lined with grinding teeth like a rock crusher. Sand cascades off its body. It roars — the sound is DEEP, below human hearing, but you feel it shake the frame.

[4–7s] Chase through the canyon — the skiff banks between sandstone pillars. The worm follows UNDERGROUND — you see its path as a moving ridge of sand, smashing through the earth, pillars cracking as it passes beneath their foundations. She throws the weighted net — it wraps around a sandstone tower, rope trailing to her skiff.

[7–10s] The worm surfaces directly in the skiff's path. She leans the board, catches wind, and the skiff JUMPS — airborne over the worm's back. In mid-air she drives a barbed stake into the top of its head plate. Lands the skiff on the other side. Rope connects stake to the sandstone tower.

[10–13s] The worm charges away — the rope goes taut against the tower. The tower HOLDS. The worm's momentum whiplashes it sideways. It crashes into a canyon wall. Sandstone debris cascades. Dust cloud erupts like a bomb. Silence inside the cloud.

[13–15s] Dust settles. The worm lies against the canyon wall, breathing but pinned. She brings the skiff alongside, pulls her goggles up. Beneath the goggles — calm, focused eyes. She draws a curved knife and begins cutting a single iridescent scale from the worm's flank — the harvest. That's all she came for. One scale. The worm hisses but doesn't fight. She pats its flank once, takes the scale, pushes off. The skiff catches wind. She vanishes between the sandstone towers. Cut to black. Ultra-realistic.

zh.p:
电影级短片，照片级视觉特效。正午沙漠追猎，时长15秒。刺目强光，毫无遮蔽，热浪扭曲一切。

[0-2秒] 无人机俯拍——红色沙漠峡谷地貌。砂岩塔林、风蚀拱门、干涸河床。一人立于沙舟之上——一块扁平木板配三角帆，靠骨制滑橇在压实沙面上滑行。她身裹亚麻甲胄，戴铜制护目镜，腰间盘绕一捆配重网。她凝视着沙面。

[2-4秒] 极特写沙面——它在呼吸。波纹自前方200码处向外扩散。沙粒缓缓隆起如穹顶。沙舟女郎猛向右转舵。穹顶炸裂——沙虫现身。40英尺长，节状身躯，锈色几丁质甲壳。口器如竖瞳，内嵌碎石机般的研磨齿。沙粒从它身上倾泻而下。它发出咆哮——声音低沉，低于人耳可闻，但你能感到画面在震颤。

[4-7秒] 峡谷追逐——沙舟在砂岩柱间急转。沙虫在地下尾随——可见其路径如移动的沙脊，破土穿行，柱基被它经过时震裂。她掷出配重网——网缠住一座砂岩塔，绳索连向她的沙舟。

[7-10秒] 沙虫径直在沙舟前方破沙而出。她侧倾木板，借风发力，沙舟腾跃——飞越沙虫背部。半空中，她将一枚倒刺钉扎入虫头顶甲。沙舟在另一侧落地。绳索连接着倒刺钉与砂岩塔。

[10-13秒] 沙虫猛冲而去——绳索在塔身绷紧。塔柱撑住了。沙虫的冲力将其甩向一侧。它撞上峡谷岩壁。砂岩碎片倾泻而下。尘云如炸弹般爆开。尘云内一片死寂。

[13-15秒] 尘埃落定。沙虫倚靠岩壁，仍在呼吸却被钉住。她驾舟靠近，推起护目镜。镜片之下——平静而专注的双眸。她拔出弯刀，开始从虫身侧翼切割一枚虹彩鳞片——这便是收获。她此行只为这一枚鳞片。沙虫嘶鸣，却未挣扎。她轻拍虫身侧翼一次，取走鳞片，撑篙离岸。沙舟乘风而行。她消失在砂岩塔林之间。渐黑。极致真实。

en.p: Cinematographic video, 8 seconds. Picking up from the swirling vortex of glowing blue morpho butterflies. The massive cloud of butterflies rapidly converges into a dark, foggy void. In a flash of ethereal light, the swarm materializes a stunning woman wearing an elegant deep-blue evening gown embroidered with shimmering butterflies. She possesses massive, majestic, glowing blue morpho wings. As she materializes, she begins a fluid, expressive contemporary dance. Her movements are graceful and emotive, with long, sweeping arm gestures that mimic the flow of the butterflies. The camera performs a slow, orbit around her, capturing the swirling fabric of her dress and the iridescent light from her wings. She performs a slow, elegant pirouette, her wings softly beating in sync with her dance. Just as the dance reaches its peak, she gracefully sweeps her wings forward, and her entire form instantly shatters back into a massive vortex of thousands of glowing blue butterflies that explode directly toward the camera lens, filling the entire screen. The final frame of the video is identical to the first frame, creating a perfect, seamless looping effect. Surreal masterpiece, hyper-realistic physics, 8k. RULES: THE WOMAN'S BODY MUST REMAIN A SOLID, STABLE 3D STRUCTURE. THERE MUST BE NO UNNATURAL DISTORTION OR DEFORMATION OF HER TORSO RELATIVE TO HER WINGS DURING THE CAMERA ORBIT.

en.p:
Style: hyper-comedic, dramatic soap-opera parody, fast cuts, exaggerated reactions, anime-realism hybrid, vibrant lighting, TikTok UI overlays, chaotic energy
Scene 1 (0–1s)
Interior, messy bedroom. A white tiger in loose pajamas slurps instant noodles at a cluttered desk, eyes glued to a glowing monitor.
SFX: slurp slurp
White Tiger (muttering): “Let’s see what this stream is about...”
Scene 2 (1–2s)
Screen view: A beautiful white cat high school girl with a pink bob wig and sailor uniform dances energetically to upbeat J-pop style music. Floating comments and donations flood the screen.
Chat overlay: “SO CUTE!!!” “1000 YEN!!!” “Marry me!!!”
Scene 3 (2–3s)
Close-up: Donation pops up “¥1000”. The white cat’s eyes sparkle, she jumps higher, dancing more enthusiastically.
White Cat (cheerful): “Thank you for the donation~!!”
Scene 4 (3–4s)
She spins wildly, accidentally knocks the phone.
SFX: THUD
Filter glitches. Screen flickers.
Scene 5 (4–5s)
The filter abruptly turns off. The “cute white cat girl” is revealed as a tired old gray cat with stubble, still wearing the wig and uniform. Dead silence.
Scene 6 (5–6.5s)
Close-up: Old gray cat freezes, sweating.
Old Gray Cat (panicking): “Wait! This is—uh—an old-age filter! Yeah! Just a filter!”
Scene 7 (6.5–8s)
Cut to white tiger. Noodles shoot out of his mouth in slow motion.
SFX: SPPPPT!!!
White Tiger (shocked): “WHAT THE—?!”
Scene 8 (8–10s)
The tiger stands up in rage, fist trembling, then smashes the monitor.
SFX: CRASH!!!
White Tiger (furious): “I DONATED FOR THIS?!”
Scene 9 (10–12s)
Back to stream POV. Viewer count rapidly drops: 3000 → 1200 → 200 → 20 → 3
Chat overlay: “UNSUB.” “SCAM???” “BRO…”
Scene 10 (12–15s)
Close-up: Old gray cat staring at the screen. His expression shifts from shock to defeated sigh.
Old Gray Cat (quiet, exhausted): “...It was going so well.”
End Frame
Frozen frame on “3 followers” with dramatic soap-opera zoom-in and echo effect

zh.p:
风格：超搞笑、戏剧化肥皂剧恶搞、快速切换、夸张反应、动漫写实混合、鲜艳灯光、TikTok界面覆盖、混乱能量

场景1（0-1秒）
室内，凌乱的卧室。一只穿着宽松睡衣的白虎在堆满杂物的桌前吸溜着方便面，眼睛紧盯着发光的显示器。
音效：吸溜吸溜
白虎（喃喃自语）：“让我看看这直播在搞什么……”

场景2（1-2秒）
屏幕画面：一只戴着粉色波波头假发、穿着水手服的漂亮白猫女高中生，正活力四射地跳着欢快的日式流行音乐舞蹈。浮动评论和打赏刷屏。
聊天界面覆盖：“太可爱了！！！” “1000日元！！！” “嫁给我！！！”

场景3（2-3秒）
特写：打赏弹出“¥1000”。白猫眼睛一亮，跳得更高，舞得更起劲。
白猫（欢快）：“谢谢打赏~！！”

场景4（3-4秒）
她疯狂旋转，不小心撞到手机。
音效：砰
滤镜出现故障。屏幕闪烁。

场景5（4-5秒）
滤镜突然关闭。“可爱的白猫女高中生”露出真容——一只疲惫的老灰猫，留着胡茬，还戴着假发穿着水手服。死一般的寂静。

场景6（5-6.5秒）
特写：老灰猫僵住，冷汗直流。
老灰猫（慌张）：“等等！这是——呃——老年滤镜！对！只是个滤镜！”

场景7（6.5-8秒）
切回白虎。面条从他嘴里慢动作喷出。
音效：噗！！！
白虎（震惊）：“这什么鬼——？！”

场景8（8-10秒）
老虎愤怒站起，拳头颤抖，然后砸向显示器。
音效：哐当！！！
白虎（暴怒）：“我打赏就为了这个？！”

场景9（10-12秒）
切回直播视角。观众数急剧下降：3000 → 1200 → 200 → 20 → 3
聊天界面覆盖：“取关。” “骗局？？？” “兄弟……”

场景10（12-15秒）
特写：老灰猫盯着屏幕。表情从震惊转为无奈的叹息。
老灰猫（轻声，疲惫）：“……本来挺顺利的。”

结束画面
定格在“3个粉丝”上，伴随戏剧化肥皂剧式镜头拉近和回声效果

Ultra-realistic cinematic shot with film-grade fog and particle effects, 15 seconds, 30fps, no background music, no subtitles. Refer to Image 1 and maintain consistent character appearance. The shot begins with an extreme close-up from a low angle, featuring dynamic cinematic camera movement with a rapid push-in and slight handheld shake. The character’s body subtly twists, left shoulder forward, right shoulder pulled back, center of gravity lowered. Several talismans (ofuda) float around the body as purple-black spiritual energy gathers around the torso, forming a rotating energy vortex. The talismans ignite one by one, their flames forming the Sanskrit character “मनस्” from the Heart Sutra, gently flickering with a blend of gold and purple light.

Countless foxfire streams converge from all directions, trailing golden and purple flames as they rapidly flow into the character’s palm, forming a highly compressed energy sphere. Inside, the energy churns violently, revealing a flowing structure resembling the silhouette of a white tiger. The camera quickly pushes into a close-up of the hand as the energy sphere’s brightness intensifies dramatically, causing spatial distortion.

The protagonist forms a hand seal with the left hand while holding the energy core in the right, softly chanting “zenmetsu.” The talismans and hand seal activate instantly; the energy core compresses to its absolute limit in an instant before erupting. From the نقطة of explosion, a colossal white tiger composed purely of spiritual energy is born—massive like a mountain, formed of white and gold light. Its body continuously collapses and reconstructs along the edges, radiating overwhelming destructive pressure as it charges directly toward the camera. The shot is engulfed by the oncoming torrent of energy, accompanied by a blinding light burst and explosive particle dispersion.

en.p: A young pearl diver kid with glowing coral armor, fluid hair drifting in water, and a shell-powered jet pack rockets into frame in the first two seconds, spiraling through a reef tunnel as a massive coral mech leviathan crashes through the ocean floor behind him, instantly creating the hook. The chase unfolds through a breathtaking underwater kingdom— swimming through glowing reefs, weaving between ancient submerged temples, diving into abyss trenches, and bursting through schools of bioluminescent fish. He fights back using: – pressure pulse blasts – spinning shell shields – ink decoys that distort vision – coral spike projectiles The leviathan constantly escalates—its विशाल body reshaping, tentacles splitting into mechanical arms, crushing ruins, and generating whirlpool currents that drag everything inward. Visual style: dreamlike aquatic fantasy—neon blues, glowing coral pinks, drifting particles, slow-motion water physics, cinematic light rays. Final moment: inside a sacred sunken pearl shrine, he launches a final charged strike— The leviathan fractures. zh.p: 前两秒，一名年轻的珍珠采集少年身披荧光珊瑚铠甲，发丝在水中飘逸，背着贝壳动力喷射背包，旋转着冲入画面，穿过珊瑚礁隧道，身后一头巨大的珊瑚机械巨兽撞破海床破土而出，瞬间抓住观众眼球。追逐戏在令人叹为观止的海底王国中展开——他穿梭于发光的珊瑚礁间，绕过古老的水下庙宇，潜入深渊海沟，冲破成群的生物发光鱼群。他反击时使用：——压力脉冲冲击波——旋转贝壳护盾——扭曲视线的墨汁诱饵——珊瑚尖刺投射物。巨兽不断升级——其庞大的身躯不断重塑，触手分裂成机械臂，碾碎废墟，制造出将一切向内拖拽的漩涡暗流。视觉风格：梦幻般的水中仙境——霓虹蓝、荧光珊瑚粉、飘浮的微粒、慢动作的水体物理、电影级的光线。最终时刻：在一座神圣的沉没珍珠神殿内，他释放出最后一记蓄力攻击——巨兽碎裂。内部……露出一只小小的失落海兽，被珊瑚电路缠绕，微微发光，惊恐不已。

raw_p: A young pearl diver kid with glowing coral armor, fluid hair drifting in water, and a shell-powered jet pack rockets into frame in the first two seconds, spiraling through a reef tunnel as a massive coral mech leviathan crashes through the ocean floor behind him, instantly creating the hook. The chase unfolds through a breathtaking underwater kingdom— swimming through glowing reefs, weaving between ancient submerged temples, diving into abyss trenches, and bursting through schools of bioluminescent fish. He fights back using: – pressure pulse blasts – spinning shell shields – ink decoys that distort vision – coral spike projectiles The leviathan constantly escalates—its विशाल body reshaping, tentacles splitting into mechanical arms, crushing ruins, and generating whirlpool currents that drag everything inward. Visual style: dreamlike aquatic fantasy—neon blues, glowing coral pinks, drifting particles, slow-motion water physics, cinematic light rays. Final moment: inside a sacred sunken pearl shrine, he launches a final charged strike— The leviathan fractures. Inside… a tiny lost sea creature is revealed, tangled in coral circuitry, glowing softly, frightened.

en.p: A majestic griffin weaves an impossibly perfect nest of golden feathers, ancient runes and glowing crystals in the fork of an enchanted oak in a sun-drenched fantasy forest, every strand placed with architectural intention. The camera orbits slowly like a nature documentary — golden backlit feathers glowing like cathedral glass, dramatic close-ups of each delicate connection point. Soft orchestral music swells. The griffin finishes, hovers at the center, and spreads its wings proudly to admire its creation. A single tiny goblin drifts in and lands delicately on the nest. Tense pause. The goblin looks around, looks at the camera, pulls out an impossibly small phone, takes a selfie with flash — then gently lifts off and flies away completely unharmed. The griffin stares. Long silence. Style: Pixar-inspired 3D animation, warm enchanted forest lighting, hyper-detailed textures, nature documentary pacing with comedic payoff.
