en.p:
VISUAL STYLE: Use live-action feature film realism with crisp action-camera sharpness and prehistoric atmospheric haze. Subtle motion blur from vibration, micro-jitters from suspension stress.

CHARACTERS: Define a strict POV with mud-slick gloved hands gripping a dirt bike handlebar. Right hand aggressively feathering a sticking throttle, left hand riding a loose clutch lever. Boots locked onto vibrating foot pegs. Multiple massive prehistoric predators crossing and reacting to the path.

STAGE: A vast prehistoric canyon descending into dense fern canopy, a narrow river corridor, and a churned mud clearing under harsh daylight haze.

EMOTIONAL TARGET: Escalate from adrenaline control → mechanical failure → irreversible hunted panic.

COLOR LOGIC: Naturalistic Film Print Emulation with dust diffusion and sun-baked highlights.

⏱️ TIMELINE

00:00.0
Open on a hard POV at the canyon edge. Ultra-wide 14mm action lens. Engine already screaming too high — throttle is partially stuck. The bike lurches forward violently without full control. Hands fight the bar as the front wheel drops over the edge into a steep descent.
 SFX: Engine over-revving, chain rattle, gravel spray, wind blast.
00:03.2
Maintain uninterrupted POV. Bomb through dense treetop gaps and uneven terrain. A massive long-neck herbivore crosses ahead — the rider jerks the bar, barely missing its swinging neck. Throttle spikes unpredictably mid-turn.
 SFX: Engine surge spikes, deep animal bellow, branches snapping.
00:06.5
Dive into a narrow river corridor. Wet rock and mud reduce traction — rear tire fishtails violently. A flock of pterosaurs erupts across the path. The rider slips the clutch desperately to regain control, but revs surge again.
 SFX: Tire slipping, water spray, frantic wingbeats, engine scream.

00:09.8
Blast out of the river bend into thick mud. The throttle sticks wide open. The rider tries braking — response is weak. Speed becomes uncontrollable. The bike bucks hard, suspension slamming.
 SFX: Engine maxed out, brake squeal fading, mud tearing under tire.
00:12.4
Lose stability — partial wipeout. The bike skids sideways, camera dips violently but stays POV. Boots slam into mud, hands still gripping as momentum drags forward.
00:13.6
At ground level, stagger forward two steps after release. Breathing heavy. Look up—

A charging Spinosaurus bursts through river mist, jaws wide, closing distance instantly until teeth fill the frame.
SFX: Ground-shaking impacts, guttural roar, snapping jaws, abrupt cut.
🚫 EXCLUDE

Avoid third-person cuts, clean/stable riding, perfect control, teleporting terrain, frozen creatures, modern polished bike aesthetics, impossible recovery from skids, unrealistic suspension behavior.

zh.p: 视觉风格：采用真人实景电影质感，搭配凌厉的动作镜头锐度与史前氛围雾气。细微的震动模糊、悬挂系统受压产生的微颤。角色：严格限定第一人称视角——泥泞的戴手套双手紧握越野摩托车把手。右手粗暴地操控卡滞的油门，左手搭在松弛的离合器杆上。靴子锁定在震动的脚踏板上。多只巨型史前掠食者横穿路径并作出反应。场景：广袤的史前峡谷向下延伸至茂密的蕨类树冠层，狭窄的河道走廊，以及烈日雾霭下泥泞翻腾的空地。情感目标：从肾上腺素控制的紧张感→机械故障→不可逆转的猎物恐慌升级。色彩逻辑：自然主义胶片模拟，融入尘埃漫射与烈日曝晒的高光。⏱️时间轴 00:00.0 以峡谷边缘的硬核第一人称视角开场。超广角14mm动作镜头。引擎已过度嘶吼——油门部分卡死。摩托车失控般剧烈前冲。前轮坠入陡峭下坡时双手与车把搏斗。音效：引擎超转、链条咔嗒、碎石飞溅、狂风呼啸。00:03.2 保持不间断第一人称视角。穿越密集树冠间隙与崎岖地形。一头巨型长颈食草动物横穿前方——骑手猛转车把，险险避开其摆动的脖颈。转弯中油门意外飙升。音效：引擎爆鸣、巨兽低吼、树枝断裂。00:06.5 冲入狭窄河道走廊。湿滑岩石与泥泞降低抓地力——后轮剧烈甩尾。一群翼龙惊起横穿路径。骑手绝望地滑动离合器试图恢复控制，但转速再次飙升。音效：轮胎打滑、水花四溅、翅膀狂拍、引擎嘶鸣。00:09.8 冲出河湾进入厚泥区。油门卡死全开。骑手尝试刹车——反应微弱。速度失控。摩托车剧烈颠簸，悬挂系统猛撞。音效：引擎极限运转、刹车尖啸渐弱、轮胎撕裂泥浆。00:12.4 失去稳定性——部分翻车。摩托车侧滑，镜头剧烈下坠但保持第一人称视角。靴子陷入泥浆，双手仍紧握车把，被惯性拖拽向前。00:13.6 地面视角，脱手后踉跄两步。粗重喘息。抬头——一头狂奔的棘龙冲破河雾，血盆大口张开，瞬间逼近直至利齿填满画面。音效：地动山摇的撞击、喉音咆哮、利齿咬合、戛然而止。🚫排除项：避免第三人称切换、平稳/完美操控、绝对控制、地形瞬移、静止生物、现代抛光摩托车美学、滑行后不可能恢复、不现实的悬挂表现。

raw_p:
VISUAL STYLE: Use live-action feature film realism with crisp action-camera sharpness and prehistoric atmospheric haze. Subtle motion blur from vibration, micro-jitters from suspension stress.

CHARACTERS: Define a strict POV with mud-slick gloved hands gripping a dirt bike handlebar. Right hand aggressively feathering a sticking throttle, left hand riding a loose clutch lever. Boots locked onto vibrating foot pegs. Multiple massive prehistoric predators crossing and reacting to the path.

STAGE: A vast prehistoric canyon descending into dense fern canopy, a narrow river corridor, and a churned mud clearing under harsh daylight haze.

EMOTIONAL TARGET: Escalate from adrenaline control → mechanical failure → irreversible hunted panic.

COLOR LOGIC: Naturalistic Film Print Emulation with dust diffusion and sun-baked highlights.

⏱️ TIMELINE

00:00.0
Open on a hard POV at the canyon edge. Ultra-wide 14mm action lens. Engine already screaming too high — throttle is partially stuck. The bike lurches forward violently without full control. Hands fight the bar as the front wheel drops over the edge into a steep descent.
 SFX: Engine over-revving, chain rattle, gravel spray, wind blast.
00:03.2
Maintain uninterrupted POV. Bomb through dense treetop gaps and uneven terrain. A massive long-neck herbivore crosses ahead — the rider jerks the bar, barely missing its swinging neck. Throttle spikes unpredictably mid-turn.
 SFX: Engine surge spikes, deep animal bellow, branches snapping.
00:06.5
Dive into a narrow river corridor. Wet rock and mud reduce traction — rear tire fishtails violently. A flock of pterosaurs erupts across the path. The rider slips the clutch desperately to regain control, but revs surge again.
 SFX: Tire slipping, water spray, frantic wingbeats, engine scream.

00:09.8
Blast out of the river bend into thick mud. The throttle sticks wide open. The rider tries braking — response is weak. Speed becomes uncontrollable. The bike bucks hard, suspension slamming.
 SFX: Engine maxed out, brake squeal fading, mud tearing under tire.
00:12.4
Lose stability — partial wipeout. The bike skids sideways, camera dips violently but stays POV. Boots slam into mud, hands still gripping as momentum drags forward.
00:13.6
At ground level, stagger forward two steps after release. Breathing heavy. Look up—

A charging Spinosaurus bursts through river mist, jaws wide, closing distance instantly until teeth fill the frame.
SFX: Ground-shaking impacts, guttural roar, snapping jaws, abrupt cut.

A highly trained female operative in a sleek black tactical suit, calm, focused, controlled breathing, sharp eyes scanning constantly.
Dual pistols in hand, precise and efficient.

0-3s
Camera starts inside a luxury bank.
Slow push through a tense standoff—security guards aiming, civilians frozen.
She stands in the center, perfectly still.

3-5s
Without warning—everything explodes into motion.
She steps forward. Rapid precise shots—each movement minimal, controlled, no wasted motion.

Camera locks close to her, orbiting as she moves through guards.
She uses environment—pillars, desks—flowing movement, never stopping.

7-9s
Transition through glass reflections.
She slides across polished floor, firing mid-motion, bullets impacting surfaces around her.

9-11s
Tight corridor sequence.
Close-quarters engagement, ultra fast reactions, micro head turns, instant targeting.

11-13s
Massive push forward into main hall.
Camera pulls wide—chaos everywhere.
She moves through it like it’s slowed down.

13-15s
Final moment.
She exits through shattered glass doors into daylight.
Doesn’t look back.
Behind her—delayed impacts, everything collapses.
Camera freezes on her walking away.

en.p: Ultra-realistic cinematic disaster epic, single continuous shot, no cuts, no montage, no multiple-camera language, documentary-style realism, IMAX-scale clarity, natural film grain, high dynamic range, physically accurate daylight, realistic atmospheric perspective, authentic reflections, volumetric dust and smoke, true-to-life city lighting and environmental behavior. A real modern Chinese megacity in daytime: high-rise towers, elevated roads, broad avenues, plaza spaces, parked and moving cars, street signs, glass facades, all with the look of genuine live-action footage. The shot begins with chaos already underway: a colossal ancient giant python, far larger and more terrifying than a realistic anaconda, is violently rampaging through the city. Its thick muscular body whips between streets and buildings with horrifying speed and weight, crushing cars, smashing roadside structures, wrapping around building facades, lunging at fleeing crowds. People run in panic, vehicles collide, glass shards, concrete dust, torn billboards and debris fill the air. Everything feels like a real catastrophic emergency captured in one uninterrupted shot. Then the sky suddenly shifts. Clouds are torn apart at high speed and a gigantic Chinese dragon dives down from the heavens. This is not a cartoon dragon and has no wings. It is a believable colossal Eastern dragon, a mysterious real biological creature of the natural world, long serpentine body, no wings, powerful limbs, realistic muscles, bones, scale overlap, weathered reflective scales, layered shadows, natural skin tension, believable mass and inertia. As it moves, its body undulates through the air with convincing aerodynamic resistance, whiskers and mane trailing in turbulent airflow, subtle cloud vapor and disturbed mist forming around it. The dragon descends like a guardian over the city, precisely targeting the giant python below. In one continuous shot, the two beasts engage in a brutal close-range fight among skyscrapers and over shattered streets. The python coils, strikes, and thrashes between buildings; the Chinese dragon tears away constriction with its claws, coils around the serpent to overpower it, and finally bites hard into the python's upper body and neck. With overwhelming force, the dragon drags the struggling serpent up from the city ruins and lifts it into the sky. In the final moments, the wingless Chinese dragon powers upward by driving its long body through the air, carrying the still-writhing python away into the distant sky. Below, terrified citizens stop running and stare upward in stunned awe. zh.p: 超写实电影级灾难史诗，一镜到底，无剪辑、无蒙太奇、无多机位语言，纪录片式真实感，IMAX级清晰度，自然胶片颗粒，高动态范围，物理精确的日光，真实的大气透视，逼真的反射，体积感尘土与烟雾，真实的城市照明与环境行为。一座真实的当代中国特大城市在白天：高层塔楼、高架道路、宽阔大道、广场空间、停靠与行驶的汽车、路牌、玻璃幕墙，一切都呈现真实实拍画面的质感。镜头开始时，混乱已然上演：一条体型远超真实森蚺、更为庞大恐怖的远古巨蟒，正在城市中狂暴肆虐。它粗壮的肌肉身躯以骇人的速度和重量在街道与楼宇间甩动，碾碎汽车，撞毁路边设施，缠绕建筑外墙，扑向奔逃的人群。人们惊恐奔逃，车辆相撞，玻璃碎片、混凝土粉尘、撕裂的广告牌和残骸充斥空中。一切仿佛一场真实灾难紧急事件被一镜捕捉。随后天空骤变。云层高速撕裂，一条巨大的中国龙自天穹俯冲而下。这不是卡通龙，也没有翅膀。它是一条可信的巨型东方龙，是自然界中神秘的真实生物：长蛇般的身躯，无翼，强健的四肢，真实的肌肉、骨骼、鳞片重叠、风化反光的鳞甲、层叠阴影、自然的皮肤张力、可信的质量与惯性。移动时，它的身体在空中起伏，带着令人信服的空气阻力，龙须与鬃毛在湍流中飘曳，周围形成细微的云气与扰动雾霭。龙如守护者般降临城市上空，精准锁定下方巨蟒。在一镜到底中，两只巨兽在摩天楼间与破碎街道上展开残酷近身搏斗。蟒蛇在楼宇间盘绕、突袭、猛甩；中国龙用利爪撕开缠绕，以身躯盘绕压制巨蟒，最终狠狠咬住蟒蛇的上身与脖颈。凭借压倒性力量，龙将挣扎的巨蟒从城市废墟中拖起，升入天空。最后时刻，无翼的中国龙以长躯在空中奋力攀升，将仍在扭动的蟒蛇带向远方天际。下方，惊恐的市民停下奔逃，目瞪口呆地仰望。废墟城市中烟雾弥漫、残骸遍地，阳光穿透雾霭，构成一幅神龙拯救人类的终极史诗画面。全片保持现实物理法则、真实破坏、可信尺度、骇人重量、克制镜头语言、沉浸式实拍灾难真实感。

raw_p: Ultra-realistic cinematic disaster epic, single continuous shot, no cuts, no montage, no multiple-camera language, documentary-style realism, IMAX-scale clarity, natural film grain, high dynamic range, physically accurate daylight, realistic atmospheric perspective, authentic reflections, volumetric dust and smoke, true-to-life city lighting and environmental behavior. A real modern Chinese megacity in daytime: high-rise towers, elevated roads, broad avenues, plaza spaces, parked and moving cars, street signs, glass facades, all with the look of genuine live-action footage. The shot begins with chaos already underway: a colossal ancient giant python, far larger and more terrifying than a realistic anaconda, is violently rampaging through the city. Its thick muscular body whips between streets and buildings with horrifying speed and weight, crushing cars, smashing roadside structures, wrapping around building facades, lunging at fleeing crowds. People run in panic, vehicles collide, glass shards, concrete dust, torn billboards and debris fill the air. Everything feels like a real catastrophic emergency captured in one uninterrupted shot. Then the sky suddenly shifts. Clouds are torn apart at high speed and a gigantic Chinese dragon dives down from the heavens. This is not a cartoon dragon and has no wings. It is a believable colossal Eastern dragon, a mysterious real biological creature of the natural world, long serpentine body, no wings, powerful limbs, realistic muscles, bones, scale overlap, weathered reflective scales, layered shadows, natural skin tension, believable mass and inertia. As it moves, its body undulates through the air with convincing aerodynamic resistance, whiskers and mane trailing in turbulent airflow, subtle cloud vapor and disturbed mist forming around it. The dragon descends like a guardian over the city, precisely targeting the giant python below. In one continuous shot, the two beasts engage in a brutal close-range fight among skyscrapers and over shattered streets. The python coils, strikes, and thrashes between buildings; the Chinese dragon tears away constriction with its claws, coils around the serpent to overpower it, and finally bites hard into the python's upper body and neck. With overwhelming force, the dragon drags the struggling serpent up from the city ruins and lifts it into the sky. In the final moments, the wingless Chinese dragon powers upward by driving its long body through the air, carrying the still-writhing python away into the distant sky. Below, terrified citizens stop running and stare upward in stunned awe. The ruined city remains filled with smoke, debris, and sunlight cutting through haze, creating a final epic image of a divine dragon saving humanity. en.p:
Ultra-refined motion design sequence. Absolute black background.
Monochrome white visual language with subtle accents of negative space.
Single continuous shot — no cuts, no camera movement.
All transformation emerges from the center.
Self-illuminated geometry, razor-sharp edges, no noise, no gradients.
0–1s [GENESIS]
A thin vertical white beam fades into existence at center frame.
It hums subtly, then splits into two parallel lines — perfectly symmetrical — before snapping back into one.
1–2s [FRACTURE]
The line fractures into multiple short segments, evenly spaced.
Each segment drifts slightly apart horizontally, creating a rhythmic broken-line pattern.
2–4s [WAVEFIELD]
The segments begin oscillating vertically in a sine-wave motion.
The wave propagates outward from center, forming a smooth, synchronized waveform across the frame.
4–6s [RIBBON → TORUS]
The waveform thickens into a continuous flowing ribbon.
It twists in 3D space, curling inward and seamlessly connecting into a rotating torus (donut shape), perfectly centered.
6–8s [TORUS → DATA RINGS]
The torus splits into multiple concentric rotating rings.
Each ring carries small evenly spaced white nodes, like data points orbiting in precise synchronization.
8–10s [NETWORK]
Thin lines connect the orbiting nodes across rings, forming a dynamic geometric network.
Connections appear and disappear algorithmically, suggesting intelligence and computation.
10–11.5s [COMPRESSION]
The entire network contracts inward.
Lines retract, nodes accelerate toward center, forming a dense glowing cluster.
11.5–13s [ENERGY CORE]
The cluster stabilizes into a pulsating polyhedral core — a clean geometric solid made of interconnected edges.
It rotates subtly, emitting faint rhythmic pulses.
13–14s [DISASSEMBLY]
The core disintegrates into perfectly straight radial lines shooting outward briefly — then reversing direction, snapping back inward.
14–15s [IDENTITY REVEAL]
All lines converge into a single horizontal baseline.
From this line, minimal white typography rises upward — forming the brand logo in a clean sans-serif.
A soft, brief glow radiates from below, then fades to pure black.
Style: futuristic minimalism, Swiss design precision, computational elegance
Mood: intelligent, controlled, inevitable, high-end tech brand identity

zh.p: 极致精密的动态设计序列。纯黑背景。单色白视觉语言，辅以负空间的微妙点缀。单一连续镜头——无剪辑，无镜头移动。所有变化自画面中心涌现。自发光几何体，锐利边缘，无噪点，无渐变。0-1秒【诞生】画面中央浮现一道纤细的白色竖线光束。它微微颤动，随即分裂为两条平行线——完美对称——再骤然合二为一。1-2秒【断裂】线条断裂成多个等距短线段。各段水平方向轻微离散，形成富有韵律的断线图案。2-4秒【波场】线段开始以正弦波运动垂直振荡。波从中心向外传播，形成贯穿画面的平滑同步波形。4-6秒【缎带→环面】波形增厚为连续流动的缎带。它在三维空间中扭转，向内卷曲并无缝衔接为旋转的环面（甜甜圈形状），完美居中。6-8秒【环面→数据环】环面分裂为多个同心旋转环。每个环上承载等距分布的白色节点，如精确同步轨道运行的数据点。8-10秒【网络】纤细线条连接各环轨道节点，形成动态几何网络。连接线按算法逻辑出现与消失，暗示智能与计算。10-11.5秒【压缩】整个网络向内收缩。线条回缩，节点加速聚向中心，形成致密发光簇。11.5-13秒【能量核心】簇状结构稳定为脉动多面体核心——由互联边缘构成的纯净几何实体。它轻微旋转，发出规律性微弱脉冲。13-14秒【解构】核心崩解为笔直径向线条向外短暂迸射——随即逆转方向，猛然回缩。14-15秒【身份揭示】所有线条汇聚为单一水平基线。从这条线上，极简白色字体向上浮现——构成干净无衬线品牌标识。底部泛起柔和短暂光芒，随后渐隐至纯黑。风格：未来极简主义，瑞士设计精度，计算优雅气质：智能，掌控，必然，高端科技品牌调性

[Cinematic Location VFX: 15 seconds] [0-3 seconds]: In POV (first-person perspective), the old underground door shown in @image1 slowly opens. From the gap in the door, a warm and vivid "neon gold" light spills out, contrasting sharply with the cold concrete texture. [3-7 seconds]: As the camera passes through the door, the surrounding walls shatter into pieces with a cracking sound, like in video [[1000010059.mp4]]. As the fragments transform into particles of light, the view suddenly opens up, revealing a vast cavern (super shelter) extending hundreds of meters underground. [7-12 seconds]: As if the camera is thrown into the air, it dynamically glides over the underground city. There is a multi-layered city where thousands of people live, with real forests and rivers flowing inside a massive geodesic dome, and countless personal drones flying through the air. The entire city is fantastically illuminated by "futuristic neon" and "bioluminescent plants." [12-15 seconds]: At the edge of the screen, data appears in a stylish UI: "ARC CITY: SECTOR 7 - POPULATION 50,000." As the camera captures the full view of the city, the words "START YOUR NEW LIFE" emerge in the center, ending with a dazzling whiteout. zh.p:
【电影级场景VFX：15秒】
[0-3秒]：以第一人称视角（POV），@image1中那扇陈旧的铁门缓缓打开。门缝中涌出温暖而耀眼的“霓虹金色”光芒，与冰冷的混凝土质感形成鲜明对比。
[3-7秒]：当镜头穿过大门时，就像视频[[1000010059.mp4]]中那样，周围的墙壁如玻璃般“咔嚓”作响，碎裂成粉末。碎片化作光粒子，视野豁然开朗，展现出延伸至地下数百米的巨大空洞（超级避难所）。
[7-12秒]：镜头仿佛被抛向空中，在城市上空进行动态滑翔。这里是一座容纳数千人的多层结构城市，巨大的穹顶之下流淌着真实的森林与河流，无数个人无人机在空中穿梭。整座城市被“未来感霓虹”与“生物发光植物”的光芒笼罩，充满奇幻色彩。
[12-15秒]：画面边缘以时尚UI显示“ARC CITY: SECTOR 7 - POPULATION 50,000”的数据。当镜头捕捉到城市全景时，中央浮现出“START YOUR NEW LIFE”字样，最终以炫目的白屏结束。
设定细节：8K分辨率、照片级真实感、体积渲染、电影级动态模糊、动态运镜。

[0-3秒]:
POV（主観視点）で、@image1にある古びた地下扉 がゆっくりと開く。
扉の隙間から、冷たいコンクリートの質感とは正反対の、温かく鮮やかな「ネオンゴールド」の光が溢れ出す。

[3-7秒]:
カメラが扉をくぐり抜ける瞬間、動画 [[1000010059.mp4]] のように、周囲の壁がガラスのように「バキバキ」と音を立てて粉々に砕け散る。
砕けた破片が光の粒子に変わる中、視界が一気に開け、地下数百メートルまで続く広大な空洞（スーパー・シェルター）が現れる。

[7-12秒]:
カメラが空中に放り出されたかのように、地下都市の上空をダイナミックに滑空する。
そこには数千人が暮らす多層構造の街があり、巨大なジオデシック・ドームの中には本物の森や川が流れ、空中を無数の個人用ドローンが飛び交っている。
街全体が「未来的なネオン」と「発光植物（Bioluminescent plants）」の光で幻想的に彩られている。

[12-15秒]:
画面端にスタイリッシュなUIで「ARC CITY: SECTOR 7 - POPULATION 50,000」とデータが表示される。
カメラが街の全景を捉える中、中央に「START YOUR NEW LIFE」の文字が浮かび上がり、まばゆいホワイトアウトで終了。

en.p:
Setting: Dark fortress interior with towering metal structures. Teal/cyan illumination leaks through gaps between massive pillars. Metallic reflective floor.

Character: White-haired girl with red eyes. Mechanical angel in white armor plating. Wings on her back emit blue energy.

[1: HIGH-SPEED FLIGHT WITH BOOST TRAILS]

Extreme top-down angle. A tiny white light point zigzags across the fortress trailing blue energy lines. Concentric sonic-boom rings expand at each turning point. Wind-pressure particles scatter off the metal floor below.

[2: CHARACTER CLOSE-UP → WEAPON AIM → FIRE → EXTREME FACE CLOSE-UP]

Hard cut to low-angle close-up — the angel with wings spread, energy blades aimed forward in firing stance. She fires. Then the camera begins an agonizingly slow, deliberate zoom toward her face. It continues until only her glowing red eyes fill the entire frame. Pure intimidation.

[3: BOOSTER ADJUSTMENT → CHARGE → ENERGY MAX → BOOST]

From the red-eye extreme close-up, blue energy vents intensify in stages — blue → bright white. The entire screen whites out. An explosive flash of energy release.

[4: HIGH-SPEED FLIGHT WITH BOOST TRAILS]

Immediately after whiteout she streaks across the fortress at extreme speed. Blue beam trails cut diagonally across the frame. A targeting reticle flickers for an instant.

[5: KICK TOWARD CAMERA]

She dives from above and drives a kick straight at the camera — extreme low-angle POV from the target's perspective. Her armored leg fills the frame. Wing jets fire for added impact.

[6: SAME KICK FROM DIFFERENT ANGLE → EXPLOSION]

The same kick replayed from a different camera angle. On contact: cyan/white explosion → thick energy dust cloud → the dust lights up from inside as a secondary blast erupts.

[7: CLOSE-UP → WEAPON AIM → AUTO-TARGETING → FULL BARRAGE]

Dust clears to reveal the angel with all wings fully deployed. Each blue energy blade independently auto-adjusts its aim — blue/purple electrical arcs crackle as targeting locks on. Then every blade fires at once — continuous rapid-fire barrage, the entire screen consumed by cyan/white explosions.

[8: BOOSTER ADJUSTMENT → CHARGE → MAX BOOST → HIGH-SPEED FLIGHT]

Energy vents charge up again in stages. Blue → white → whiteout → explosive jet blast. She rockets away trailing blue energy across the fortress.

[9: WEAPON READY POSE]

Against the teal fortress backdrop she holds a static pose, energy blades aimed forward, wings fully spread. A faint blue aura shimmers around her.

zh.p: 场景设定：黑暗堡垒内部，高耸的金属结构林立。青绿色光芒从巨大立柱的缝隙间透出。金属反光地板。角色：白发红眼少女。身着白色装甲的机械天使。背后的翅膀散发出蓝色能量。[1：高速飞行伴随推进尾迹] 极致的俯拍视角。一个微小的白色光点在堡垒中曲折穿梭，拖曳着蓝色能量轨迹。每个转折点都扩散出同心圆状的音爆环。风压粒子从下方的金属地板上四散飞溅。[2：角色特写→武器瞄准→开火→极致面部特写] 硬切至低角度特写——天使展开双翼，能量刃向前瞄准，摆出射击姿态。她开火了。随后镜头开始以令人窒息的缓慢速度，刻意地向她的脸部推进。持续到只有她发光的红色双眼填满整个画面。纯粹的威慑力。[3：推进器调整→充能→能量满溢→推进] 从红色双眼的极致特写开始，蓝色能量排气口逐步增强——从蓝色变为亮白色。整个屏幕白化。一次爆炸性的能量释放闪光。[4：高速飞行伴随推进尾迹] 白化之后，她立即以极速掠过堡垒。蓝色光束轨迹斜向划过画面。一个瞄准准星闪烁了一瞬。[5：向镜头踢击] 她从上方俯冲而下，一记直踢向镜头——来自目标视角的极致低角度主观镜头。她装甲覆盖的腿填满画面。翅膀的喷射口点火以增加冲击力。[6：同一踢击的不同角度→爆炸] 同一记踢击从不同摄像机角度重放。接触瞬间：青白色爆炸→浓厚的能量尘云→尘云内部亮起，第二次爆炸爆发。[7：特写→武器瞄准→自动锁定→全弹齐射] 尘埃散去，天使所有翅膀完全展开。每片蓝色能量刃独立自动调整瞄准——蓝紫色电弧噼啪作响，锁定目标。随后所有能量刃同时开火——连续速射弹幕，整个屏幕被青白色爆炸吞噬。[8：推进器调整→充能→最大推进→高速飞行] 能量排气口再次逐步充能。蓝色→白色→白化→爆炸性喷射。她火箭般飞离，在堡垒中拖曳着蓝色能量。[9：武器待机姿态] 以青绿色堡垒为背景，她摆出静态姿势，能量刃向前瞄准，双翼完全展开。一层微弱的蓝色光晕在她周围闪烁。

en.p:
Core Concept: A continuous free-fall illusion where an iPhone 17 Pro Max "drops" facing upwards, and the character leaps after it. As they fall together, rapid match-cut background and wardrobe changes simulate passing through multiple dimensions.  

THE "UNREACHABLE" RULE: During the entire flight sequence (Scenes 2-5), the woman is strictly unable to catch the iPhone. She must be reaching out desperately with empty hands, but the camera (the phone) remains just inches out of her grasp, maintaining the tension of the chase.  

CRITICAL CAMERA ANGLE & PROP RULE: The falling scenes MUST be shot from an extreme low-angle / worm's-eye view. The camera lens IS the falling iPhone. Therefore, the woman’s hands must be completely EMPTY during the fall. Do NOT show her holding the phone.  

Universal Rule: A young woman with red hair must appear in all scenes for perfect visual continuity. Strictly use "The same Character" lock.  
Total Duration: 10.0 seconds.  

Timeline & Scene-by-Scene Breakdown:  
Scene 1: The Pigeon & The Vault (00:00 - 00:01.5 | Duration: 1.5 sec)  
Location: High-end hotel balcony, sunny day.  
Action: The same Character (casual chic attire, red hair loose) is leaning on the balcony railing, holding her iPhone 17 Pro Max. A pigeon flies aggressively close to her face. Startled, she drops the phone.  

Camera Sequence: 
1. Medium shot of the drop. 
2. Tracking the phone tumbling (showing back glass and screen clearly). 
3. Close-up of her shock. 
4. She vaults the railing like a parkour athlete, diving after it.  

Scene 2: The City Fall (00:01.5 - 00:03.0 | Duration: 1.5 sec)  
Location: Sunny blue sky/glass skyscrapers.  
Camera Angle: Worm's-eye view, looking UP at her.  
Action: The same Character is freefalling toward the camera. She reaches down with EMPTY hands, but the phone/camera stays just out of reach. Wind blows her red hair upward.  Transition: Hard match-cut.  

Scene 3: The Ocean Dive (00:03.0 - 00:04.5 | Duration: 1.5 sec)  Location: Underwater environment.  
Action: Maintaining the same pose. Hands reaching but failing to grab the camera. Tiny bubbles rush upward past her.  
Wardrobe Change: Sleek, high-tech WHITE aquatic wetsuit.  Transition: Hard match-cut.  

Scene 4: The Neon Night Fall (00:04.5 - 00:06.0 | Duration: 1.5 sec)  
Location: Neon-lit cyberpunk city.  
Action: Continuous downward reach with EMPTY hands. The phone remains uncaptured.  
Wardrobe Change: Glowing neon streetwear.  
Transition: Hard match-cut.  

Scene 5: The Deep Space Fall (00:06.0 - 00:07.5 | Duration: 1.5 sec)  
Location: Infinite starfield/nebula.  
Action: Slow-motion zero-gravity hair float. She is still reaching, hands open and EMPTY, unable to close her grip on the camera.  
Wardrobe Change: Sleek, PINK metallic spacesuit.  Transition: Hard match-cut.  

Scene 6: The Grav

zh.p: 核心概念：一种持续的自由落体错觉，iPhone 17 Pro Max 屏幕朝上‘坠落’，角色紧随其后跃下。两人一同下落时，通过快速匹配剪辑的背景与服装变化，模拟穿越多重维度的效果。‘无法触及’规则：在整个飞行序列（场景2-5）中，女性角色严格无法抓住iPhone。她必须徒劳地伸出双手，但摄像头（即手机）始终离她的手指差之毫厘，维持追逐的紧张感。关键拍摄角度与道具规则：坠落场景必须采用极端低角度/虫眼视角拍摄。摄像头镜头即代表坠落的iPhone。因此，女性角色在下落过程中双手必须完全空无一物。切勿展示她手持手机。通用规则：所有场景中必须出现一位红发年轻女性，以确保完美的视觉连贯性。严格锁定‘同一角色’。总时长：10.0秒。时间线与场景分解：场景1：鸽子与翻越（00:00 - 00:01.5 | 时长：1.5秒）地点：高端酒店阳台，晴天。动作：同一角色（休闲时尚装扮，红发披散）倚靠阳台栏杆，手持iPhone 17 Pro Max。一只鸽子凶猛飞近她的脸。她受惊之下，手机脱手。镜头序列：1. 手机掉落的中景。2. 追踪手机翻滚（清晰展示背面玻璃与屏幕）。3. 她震惊的特写。4. 她像跑酷运动员一样翻越栏杆，纵身跃下追逐。场景2：城市坠落（00:01.5 - 00:03.0 | 时长：1.5秒）地点：晴朗蓝天/玻璃摩天大楼。拍摄角度：虫眼视角，向上仰视她。动作：同一角色朝镜头自由落体。她伸出空无一物的双手，但手机/摄像头始终差一点够到。风将她的红发向上吹起。转场：硬匹配剪辑。场景3：海洋潜坠（00:03.0 - 00:04.5 | 时长：1.5秒）地点：水下环境。动作：保持相同姿势。双手伸出但未能抓住摄像头。细小的气泡从她身旁向上涌起。服装变化：流线型高科技白色潜水服。转场：硬匹配剪辑。场景4：霓虹夜坠（00:04.5 - 00:06.0 | 时长：1.5秒）地点：霓虹灯照亮的赛博朋克城市。动作：持续向下伸出空无一物的双手。手机仍未捕获。服装变化：发光的霓虹街头服饰。转场：硬匹配剪辑。场景5：深空坠落（00:06.0 - 00:07.5 | 时长：1.5秒）地点：无限星空/星云。动作：慢动作零重力发丝飘浮。她仍在伸手，双手张开且空无一物，无法合拢抓住摄像头。服装变化：流线型粉色金属太空服。转场：硬匹配剪辑。场景6：引力

en.p: 15s / 180 BPM / ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT / 360 POV downhill longboard run, viral energy, max chaos. SUBJECTS: First-person downhill longboard rider, front foot, deck nose, and flickering trucks appearing low in frame during drops, slides, and stair gaps. Flower pots, café chairs, scooters, cats, delivery bikes, tourists, and laundry erupt around the rider as sudden obstacles. ENVIRONMENT: Dense Mediterranean cliffside town, whitewashed stair alleys, blue shutters, tiled landings, sea-glow at the horizon, hanging laundry, tangled wires, sun-faded murals, narrow terraces, umbrellas, puddles, warm late afternoon light, deep stone shadows, layered rooftops dropping toward the coast below. MOOD: Adrenaline, max chaos, nonstop downhill street speed. COLOR LOGIC: Hyperreal Pop Look with sun-bleached whites, cobalt accents, coral signage, golden flare. CAMERA DETAILS: 360 action-cam POV, horizon-stable but brutal, nonstop forward drive, minimal roll, heavy stair vibration, sharp side and rear parallax, full-sphere chaos, no release. 0:00–0:03: POV freefalls into a steep stone stairwell, board nose rattling low in frame as the rider lands into brutal vibrating descent. A café server yanks a tray away from the line while walls, balconies, plants, and faces whip past inches away. SFX: sea wind, wheel chatter, stair hits, breath, distant crowd. 0:03–0:05: POV slashes left across a tiny tiled landing, clips past stacked flower pots, then snaps into another stair drop as hanging laundry lashes across the front hemisphere and tourists recoil. SFX: cloth slap, ceramic clink, wheel scrape, crowd gasp. 0:05–0:08: POV hammers the next staircase as a cat darts center frame and pigeons burst upward from a side ledge. The rider speed-check slides, then threads between a parked scooter and iron handrail with almost no clearance. SFX: tire chirp, wings flapping, metal rattle, stair thuds. 0:08–0:10: POV blasts over a short cobblestone gap between stair sections, trucks clacking, then drops straight into the next descending run as delivery bikes streak through the side wrap. SFX: wheel buzz, curb thump, distant horn, crowd echo. 0:10–0:13: POV attacks two tight landings and another steep stepped lane, every hit jolting the sphere as rooftops, awnings, church bells, alley mouths, and flashes of sea curl around the viewer. SFX: air rush, heavy thump, stair chatter, wind buffeting. 0:13–0:15: POV rips to a cliff overlook and throws into a savage stand-up slide, dust and tiny pebbles spraying across the lower frame while the glowing sea-town skyline blooms around the full sphere. SFX: wheel screech, gravel spray, crowd roar. Hyperreal, continuous-shot chaos, no text, no logos.

en.p:
A woman in her mid-30s with dark braided hair entwined with living vines, wearing layered organic armor of bark and woven leaves, skin traced with glowing emerald root veins — opening frame is a medium close-up of her standing barefoot in the center of an abandoned concrete megacity plaza, completely still as small plants begin sprouting through cracks in the pavement.

At second two she presses both palms downward — roots explode outward beneath the ground, instantly splitting asphalt and concrete as vegetation accelerates beyond natural growth speed.

The city becomes a living organism: trees burst through buildings mid-rise, vines consume steel beams, and entire structures collapse under rapid organic expansion.

She moves minimally — each gesture redirects the growth patterns: right hand sends explosive root pillars upward, left hand spreads creeping vine networks that engulf entire streets.

Camera orbits tightly as green growth overtakes grey infrastructure, snap zooming into root eruptions and cutting to building collapses.

Color logic: vivid bioluminescent green dominates new growth, contrasting against cold desaturated urban decay.

Escalation builds as entire blocks are overtaken — skyscrapers crack and fall under root pressure.

Final beat: hard POV shift — camera becomes the root network surging underground, racing through soil and concrete before bursting upward beneath a final collapsing tower.

Particle detail on soil displacement, bark texture, and debris fragmentation; diegetic green glow illuminates dust clouds.

Epic nature-reclaiming urban collapse, cinematic organic physics, 4K ultra-detail.

zh.p: 一位三十多岁的女性，深色辫发中缠绕着活生生的藤蔓，身披由树皮和编织树叶构成的多层有机铠甲，皮肤上浮现出发光的翠绿色根脉纹路。开场镜头是中近景：她赤足伫立于废弃混凝土巨型城市广场中央，纹丝不动，而细小植物开始从路面裂缝中萌芽。第二秒时，她双掌向下按压——根系在地下向外爆裂扩张，瞬间撕裂沥青与混凝土，植被以超越自然生长的速度加速蔓延。城市化为活体有机组织：树木冲破建筑中层，藤蔓吞噬钢梁，整座结构在急速有机扩张中崩塌。她动作幅度极小——每个手势都重新引导生长形态：右手向上喷涌出根柱，左手铺展缠绕的藤蔓网络吞没整条街道。镜头紧密环绕，绿色生机吞没灰色基础设施，急推聚焦根系爆发，切换至建筑倒塌画面。色彩逻辑：鲜艳的生物荧光绿主导新生植被，与冰冷去饱和的城市衰败形成对比。随着整个街区被吞噬，冲突升级——摩天大楼在根系压力下开裂倒塌。最终节拍：硬切主观视角——镜头化为地下奔涌的根系网络，在土壤与混凝土中疾驰，最终从最后一座倒塌的高塔下方爆裂冲出。粒子细节呈现土壤位移、树皮质感与碎片飞散；叙事性绿光照亮尘雾。史诗级自然收复城市崩塌，电影级有机物理效果，4K超高清细节。

en.p: "A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white blouse, a flowing burgundy skirt, and white sneakers, stands on the edge of a high rooftop at night, looking out over a glowing modern city. A shadowy figure suddenly rushes in from behind and violently pushes her off the edge. Her expression turns from confusion to shock as she begins to fall. The camera follows her in a dramatic wide-angle frontal tracking shot as she drops between towering neon skyscrapers, with intense motion blur, spinning perspective, and cinematic speed. As she keeps falling, the real city seamlessly transforms into a surreal dreamlike dimension: a tunnel of colossal stone faces and metallic sculptures, floating cathedrals and shattered monuments in the clouds, giant marble statues, swirling red fabric, a deep blue vortex of water and feathers, enormous carnival masks and theatrical faces, abstract glowing ribbons and floating orbs, and a mystical geometric tunnel made of glowing runes, sigils, and burning celestial spheres. At the climax, fiery golden rings and massive spinning artifacts surround her as she reaches out in panic. Suddenly she crashes back into reality on a crowded daytime city street, stumbling forward, breathing hard, and staring directly into the camera in disbelief. surreal urban fantasy, cinematic CGI, seamless transitions, strong emotional storytelling, Hollywood trailer energy, intense falling sequence, epic atmosphere, ultra detailed, volumetric lighting, 8k cinematic"

zh.p: 一位年轻女性，长发深色，身着白色衬衫、飘逸的酒红色长裙和白色运动鞋，夜晚站在高楼屋顶边缘，俯瞰着灯火辉煌的现代都市。一个黑影突然从身后冲来，粗暴地将她推下边缘。她的表情从困惑转为惊恐，开始坠落。镜头以戏剧性的广角正面跟拍，捕捉她在霓虹摩天楼间下坠的画面，伴随强烈的动态模糊、旋转视角和电影般的速度感。在她持续坠落时，真实的城市无缝转化为超现实的梦境维度：一条由巨大石像和金属雕塑构成的隧道，云层中漂浮的教堂与破碎的纪念碑，巨型大理石雕像，旋转的红色织物，由水与羽毛组成的深蓝漩涡，巨大的狂欢节面具与戏剧面孔，抽象的发光缎带与漂浮球体，以及由发光符文、印记和燃烧的天体构成的玄妙几何隧道。高潮处，炽热的金色圆环与巨大的旋转器物环绕着她，她惊恐地伸手挣扎。突然，她坠回现实，跌落在白天拥挤的城市街道上，踉跄前行，喘息不止，难以置信地直视镜头。超现实都市奇幻，电影级CGI，无缝转场，强烈情感叙事，好莱坞预告片能量，激烈坠落序列，史诗氛围，极致细节，体积光效，8K电影质感。

zh.p: 极致电影感的15秒奢华香水广告，基于#Image1分镜脚本，以流畅连续的镜头序列无缝衔接每个瞬间，优雅而感性的节奏。电影般的平滑运镜：微距推轨+柔和环绕+轻柔推进，通过花瓣、景深虚化和运动连续性实现无缝转场，无硬切，所有画面自然流动。（0-2秒）微距镜头展现立于柔粉花丛中的香水瓶，浅景深，花瓣轻盈飘落。（2-4秒）镜头缓缓推进，一只纤手入画，优雅触碰瓶身，柔光映照玻璃反光。（4-6秒）手平稳托起香水瓶，镜头跟随向上运动，花瓣环绕飘舞。（6-8秒）过渡至中景，女子手持香水瓶，浅笑嫣然，自然之美，头部轻动。（8-10秒）更近的特写镜头，她将香水靠近，双眸半阖，情感交融，柔光轻抚面庞。（10-12秒）慢动作喷雾瞬间，香水雾气弥漫空中，微粒捕捉光线，花瓣飘过画面。（12-14秒）梦幻美人镜头，女子被飘落花瓣环绕，神情宁静，柔光笼罩。（14-15秒）最终主角镜头，产品干净独立，花瓣环绕，极简背景下的优雅构图。柔粉花卉环境，从微距花田渐变至洁净奢华背景，统一柔和色调。超写实，高端香水广告，柔光电影质感，镜面反光，柔和调色板，优雅慢动作，体积感雾气，高级美感美学，无畸变，无拉伸。

en.p: Visual Style: Chinese-style anime 3D CG, IMAX cinematic quality. Atmosphere: Contrasting violent aesthetics, combining demonic, sinister, elegant, and cruel elements. Color Palette: Primarily ink green, dark gold, amber, and emerald green, with high contrast and strong spatial depth. Character Design: A young female cult leader. She has a stunningly cold and beautiful face with sharp features, her long ink-green hair tied up high. She wears an ink-green battle dress-style robe with floating dark gold water patterns. Key Prop: A floating Nine-Dragon Purple Clay Divine Cauldron (antique deep purple with flowing dark gold patterns, containing ultra-high-temperature spirit tea). General Sound Effects: Throughout, a low wind pressure, distant army rumbling, armor friction, and fluttering war flags. 0-3 seconds Shot Type: Extreme close-up macro -> Ultra-macro tracking -> Rapid subjective dive. Visual Content: The camera locks onto the protagonist's right eye. Her deep tea-colored eyes carry a dark gold shimmer, clearly reflecting the dark, oppressive army of 100,000 outside the city and the battlefield fires. Her eyes are filled with amusement and contempt. The camera shifts slightly; the corner of her mouth curls up into a faint, cold smile. The Nine-Dragon Purple Clay Divine Cauldron, held aloft with one hand, floats in the air. Spirit tea churns at the cauldron's mouth, the heat waves distorting the air. She extends two slender fingers and, with extreme elegance and eeriness, slowly picks a piece of emerald green tea leaf from the rolling steam. The camera zooms in on the leaf. As the leaf leaves her hand, time seems to slow down. The tea leaf begins to spin at high speed, its sharp edge cutting through the air, creating dense sonic boom clouds and sparks around it. The camera switches to the tea leaf's subjective perspective (or follows it closely), diving rapidly towards the center of the battlefield under the high sky, creating a strong sense of weightlessness. Sound Effects Enhanced: The roaring sound of boiling water in the cauldron, the low growl of steam, the sharp sound of the tea leaf breaking through the air and tearing it apart. 3-6 seconds Shot Type: Rapid descent -> Extreme wide-angle panoramic shot -> High-altitude overhead shot. Visual Content: The camera follows the tea leaf as it violently descends. At the moment before it touches the ground, it suddenly pulls back into an extreme wide-angle panoramic shot. The seemingly light tea leaf lands. Visual Spectacle Generation: With the landing point as the center, the entire ground surface instantly liquefies. Soil, rocks, war chariots, iron armor, and banners are all engulfed by the high-temperature amber spirit tea. The ancient battlefield suddenly transforms into a boundless, rolling, and boiling sea of tea. The high-temperature tea waves, carrying a destructive aura, spread wildly, and enemy soldiers fall into the tea sea in droves. Iron armor quickly turns red-hot, softens, and melts. Large clouds of white steam surge into the sky, obscuring it. The camera rises to a high-altitude overhead shot. Under dark clouds pressing down on the city, the entire battlefield has become a boiling cauldron of purgatory tea soup. Beneath the warm amber color lies extreme cruelty. Sound Effects Enhanced: The dull sound of the ground instantly liquefying, the boiling sound of the tea sea, the creaking sound of armor melting, the miserable screams of enemy soldiers, and the explosive sound of steam. 6-10 seconds Shot Type: Low-altitude rapid sweep -> Rapid forward push (frontal) -> Following upward lift -> Weaving through the storm -> Dive and cut back. Visual Content: The camera skims low over the surface of the boiling tea sea, with rolling tea liquid on both sides and steam rushing towards it. The camera rapidly pushes in on the protagonist from the front. She stands on a high place, untouched by dust, her ink-green long hair and ink-green battle robe wildly dancing in the hot wind caused by the massacre. Her eyes suddenly narrow, and her killing intent pierces out like a tangible force. She gently moves her fingertips. The initial tea leaf in mid-air silently splits, then crazily multiplies. Quantity Surge: Tens of billions of emerald-like sharp tea leaves burst forth, covering the sky. The camera sharply rises along with the leaf swarm. Countless tea leaves intertwine, converging into several green tornado storms connecting heaven and earth, piercing through the tea sea, the army formation, and the dark clouds. The storms sweep up countless enemy soldiers and warhorses, repeatedly cutting, crushing, and pulverizing them amidst the dense leaf blades. Finally, all people and objects turn into golden-green glowing tea dust. The camera first weaves through the interior of the storm, showcasing the extreme details of the cutting, then follows the most ferocious tornado as it dives and cuts back to the battlefield. The scene is magnificent, eerie, and cleanly executed. Sound Effects Enhanced: The hissing sound of countless tea leaves cutting at high speed (similar to a high-pressure water jet), the howling of the storm, the collective sound of weapons breaking, and the sound of flesh and bones being crushed. 10-15 seconds Shot Type: Low-angle long shot -> Slowly tilting down -> Medium close-up of the face, freeze frame. Visual Content: The storm stops abruptly without warning. The world instantly falls silent. The camera slowly tilts down from a low-angle long shot. The dark clouds in the sky are torn open, letting through cold light. The tea sea and the 100,000-strong army dissipate together. The ground transforms into a boundless mirror-like glass plain, reflecting the protagonist's solitary figure. Countless golden-green fluorescent tea dust particles slowly drift down in the silent air like ghost fires. The protagonist's expression returns to one of laziness. She casually puts away the Nine-Dragon Purple Clay Divine Cauldron. An elegant tea table and a cup of clear tea materialize in the void. She picks up the tea cup, looking down at the tea's surface. In the rippling tea soup, the bloody scene of the massacre of 100,000 soldiers is faintly reflected. A faint, sinister smile appears at the corner of her mouth, then she gently blows away the hot steam. The camera slowly pushes in to a medium close-up of her face, freeze frame. Wreaths of hot mist brush past her coldly beautiful profile. Her tea-colored golden eyes are calm and eerie. Tea dust falls all over the sky. The scene presents an extreme demonic nature and killing intent wrapped in a shell of Zen-like elegance. Sound Effects Enhanced: The sound suddenly returns to silence (creating a strong contrast), leaving only the soft sound of a gentle breeze, the rustling of falling tea dust, the light clinking of porcelain cups, and the sound of blowing on the hot tea.

zh.p:
视觉风格： 国风动漫3D CG，IMAX电影级画质。
氛围基调： 反差暴力美学，魔性、邪气、优雅、残忍并存。
色调： 墨青、暗金、琥珀、翠绿为主，高对比度，空间纵深感强。
人物设定： 年轻女性教主。面容绝美冷艳，五官锋利，墨绿色长发高束。身着墨青色战裙式战袍，浮动暗金水纹。
关键道具： 悬浮九龙紫砂神鼎（古朴深紫，暗金纹流转，内盛超高温灵茶）。
通用音效： 全程贯穿低沉风压、远处军阵轰鸣、甲胄摩擦、战旗猎猎声。

0-3秒
景别： 微距极近特写->超微距跟拍-> 极速主观俯冲。

画面内容：
镜头锁定主角右眼。深邃茶色眼眸带暗金流光，清晰倒映出城外黑压压的十万大军与战场火光。眼底尽是玩味与轻蔑。
镜头微移，她唇角微勾，露出一抹轻轻的冷笑。
单手托举的九龙紫砂神鼎悬浮于空，鼎口灵茶翻滚，热浪扭曲空气。
她伸出两根纤长手指，动作极其优雅诡异，从翻腾的热蒸汽中慢条斯理地捻起一片翠绿嫩叶。
镜头贴近茶叶。嫩叶脱手飞出的瞬间，时间仿佛放缓。
茶叶开始高速自旋，锋利的边缘切裂空气，周围炸开细密的音爆云与火花。
镜头切换至茶叶主观视角（或紧跟茶叶），极速向高空下的战场中心俯冲，失重感强烈。

音效强化： 鼎内滚水轰鸣声、蒸汽低吼声、茶叶破空与空气被极致撕裂的尖锐声。

3-6秒
景别： 极速下坠 ->极致广角全景-> 高空俯拍。

画面内容：
镜头跟随茶叶狂暴下坠，在触地前的一瞬间，猛然拉成极致广角全景。
那片轻飘飘的茶叶落地。
视觉奇观生成： 以落点为中心，整片地表瞬间液化。土石、战车、铁甲、旌旗全部被高温的琥珀色灵茶吞没。
古战场轰然化作无边无际、翻滚沸腾的茶海。
高温茶浪裹挟着毁灭气息疯狂扩散，敌军成片跌入茶海。铁制铠甲迅速烧红、软化、熔毁，大片白色蒸汽冲天而起，遮蔽天空。
镜头升至高空俯拍，黑云压城下，整片战场变成了一锅沸腾的炼狱茶汤。温润的琥珀色下是极致的残酷。

音效强化： 地表瞬间液化的沉闷声、茶海沸腾声、铠甲熔毁的吱嘎声、敌军凄厉惨叫与蒸汽爆响声。

6-10秒
景别： 低空疾掠 -> 极速推进（正面） -> 跟随抬升 ->穿梭风暴-> 俯冲切回。

画面内容：
镜头贴着沸腾的茶海表面低空疾掠，两侧是翻卷的茶液，蒸汽扑面而来。
镜头极速推近主角正面。她立于高处，不染尘埃，墨绿长发与墨青战袍在屠杀造成的热风中狂舞。
眼神骤然收紧，杀意如实质般刺出。
她轻轻动了动指尖。半空中那片最初的茶叶无声裂开，随即疯狂裂变。
数量激增： 百亿片翡翠般锋利的茶叶暴涨而出，遮蔽天幕。
镜头顺着叶群猛然抬升。无数茶叶交织，汇聚成数道接天连地的绿色龙卷风暴，贯穿茶海、军阵与乌云。
风暴卷起无数敌军与战马，他们在密密麻麻的叶刃中被反复切割、碾碎、粉化。
最终，所有人和物全部化作金绿色的发光茶尘。
镜头先是在风暴内部穿梭，展现极致的切割细节，随后跟随一股最凶狠的龙卷俯冲切回战场。画面华丽、妖异、干净利落。

音效强化： 无数茶叶高速切割的嘶嘶声（类似高压水枪）、风暴狂啸声、兵器集体断裂声、肉体与骨骼被粉碎的声音。

10-15秒
景别： 仰拍大远景 ->缓缓下压-> 脸部中近景定格。

画面内容：
风暴毫无预兆地骤然停止。
世界瞬间归于寂静。
镜头从仰拍大远景缓缓下压。天空黑云被撕开，透出冷光。
茶海与十万大军一同消散，地面化为一片无边无际的镜面琉璃平原，倒映着主角孤高的身影。
无数金绿荧光茶尘如鬼火般在静谧的空中缓缓飘落。
主角神情重新恢复慵懒。她随手收起九龙紫砂神鼎，虚空中浮现出一张古雅茶几与一盏清茶。
她端起茶盏，垂眸看着茶面。荡漾的茶汤中，隐约倒映出刚才屠尽十万大军的血腥画面。
唇角浮起若有若无的邪笑，随后轻轻吹开热气。
镜头缓慢推进到脸部中近景定格。袅袅热雾拂过她冷艳的侧脸，茶色金瞳平静而妖异。
满天茶尘飘落，画面呈现出一种被禅意教外壳包裹的极端魔性与杀意。

音效强化： 声音骤然归静（形成强烈反差），只剩轻风微拂声、茶尘飘落的沙沙声、瓷盏轻碰声与吹茶的热气声。

镜头极速推近主角正面。她立于高处，不染尘埃，墨绿长发与墨青战袍在屠杀造成的热风中狂舞。
眼神骤然收紧，杀意如实质般刺出。
她轻轻动了动指尖。半空中那片最初的茶叶无声裂开，随即疯狂裂变。
数量激增： 百亿片翡翠般锋利的茶叶暴涨而出，遮蔽天幕。
镜头顺着叶群猛然抬升。无数茶叶交织，汇聚成数道接天连地的绿色龙卷风暴，贯穿茶海、军阵与乌云。
风暴卷起无数敌军与战马，他们在密密麻麻的叶刃中被反复切割、碾碎、粉化。
最终，所有人和物全部化作金绿色的发光茶尘。
镜头先是在风暴内部穿梭，展现极致的切割细节，随后跟随一股最凶狠的龙卷俯冲切回战场。画面华丽、妖异、干净利落。

音效强化： 无数茶叶高速切割的嘶嘶声（类似高压水枪）、风暴狂啸声、兵器集体断裂声、肉体与骨骼被粉碎的声音。

10-15秒
景别： 仰拍大远景 ->缓缓下压-> 脸部中近景定格。

画面内容：
风暴毫无预兆地骤然停止。
世界瞬间归于寂静。
镜头从仰拍大远景缓缓下压。天空黑云被撕开，透出冷光。
茶海与十万大军一同消散，地面化为一片无边无际的镜面琉璃平原，倒映着主角孤高的身影。
无数金绿荧光茶尘如鬼火般在静谧的空中缓缓飘落。
主角神情重新恢复慵懒。她随手收起九龙紫砂神鼎，虚空中浮现出一张古雅茶几与一盏清茶。
她端起茶盏，垂眸看着茶面。荡漾的茶汤中，隐约倒映出刚才屠尽十万大军的血腥画面。
唇角浮起若有若无的邪笑，随后轻轻吹开热气。
镜头缓慢推进到脸部中近景定格。袅袅热雾拂过她冷艳的侧脸，茶色金瞳平静而妖异。
满天茶尘飘落，画面呈现出一种被禅意教外壳包裹的极端魔性与杀意。

音效强化： 声音骤然归静（形成强烈反差），只剩轻风微拂声、茶尘飘落的沙沙声、瓷盏轻碰声与吹茶的热气声。

en.p:
Shot on ALEXA 65mm anamorphic lens. Photorealistic cinematic quality. Aspect ratio 2.39:1 widescreen. Teal shadows, warm amber highlights. Film grain. Rain-soaked New York street at night. Neon signs, streetlights reflecting on wet asphalt. Steam rising from manholes. Lens flares, motion blur. Dolby Vision HDR.

0.0s–2.5s:
Extreme low-angle tracking shot — a lone female fighter strides down a narrow NYC street, rain pouring heavily. Leather jacket soaked, hair slicked back and dripping. Heels echo faintly on wet pavement. Camera tracks backward with subtle shake. Yellow taxi lights streak across puddles. Figures step out from alleyways and fire escapes, slowly surrounding her. She tilts her head, cracks her knuckles — calm, fearless expression.

2.6s–5.0s:
Whip-pan — first attacker lunges. TIME REMAP: slow-motion as she pivots smoothly, dodging and delivering a sharp elbow strike. Water sprays on impact. Her jacket snaps with the motion. Another attacker crashes into a stack of trash bags and metal bins. Sparks flicker from a flickering streetlight overhead.

5.1s–7.5s:
Drone shot — overhead view as she moves fluidly through multiple opponents. SLOW MOTION: precise kicks and spins land cleanly, bodies sliding across rain-slick asphalt. Steam swirls under golden streetlights. One attacker swings a bat — she catches it mid-swing, twists, and disarms them effortlessly.

7.6s–10.0s:
360° orbital shot — she leaps into a spinning kick, taking down two attackers at once. Camera circles her as another rushes from behind. Without turning, she blocks and counters instantly. Breath visible in the cold night air. Each strike hits in sync with a rising cinematic score.

10.1s–13.0s:
First-person POV — the final opponent charges. SMASH CUT: rapid, close-range exchange in slow motion. Her final punch lands clean. Silence falls. Rain continues to pour.

Slow push-in — she stands alone in the empty street, adjusts her jacket sleeve, exhales steadily.

Low-angle shot. Eyes locked forward. Unshaken.

zh.p: 使用ALEXA 65毫米变形镜头拍摄。具有照片级真实感的电影画质。宽银幕比例2.39:1。青蓝色阴影，暖琥珀色高光。胶片颗粒感。雨夜中的纽约街道。霓虹灯与街灯在湿漉漉的柏油路上映出倒影。井盖升腾起蒸汽。镜头光晕与动态模糊。杜比视界HDR。0.0-2.5秒：极低角度跟拍镜头——一名孤身女战士大步走在狭窄的纽约街道上，暴雨倾盆。皮夹克湿透，头发向后紧贴滴着水。高跟鞋在湿路面上发出微弱回响。摄像机向后跟拍，带有细微晃动。黄色出租车灯光在水洼中拖曳出轨迹。小巷和防火梯中走出人影，逐渐将她包围。她歪了歪头，活动指关节——神情平静无畏。2.6-5.0秒：快速摇镜——第一个攻击者猛扑过来。时间重映射：慢动作中她流畅转身，闪避并精准一记肘击。撞击时水花四溅。夹克随动作甩动。另一名攻击者撞上一堆垃圾袋和金属垃圾桶。头顶忽明忽暗的路灯迸出火花。5.1-7.5秒：无人机俯拍——她如流水般穿梭于多名对手之间。慢动作：精准的踢击与旋转干净利落，对手们在雨水浸湿的柏油路上滑倒。金色街灯下蒸汽缭绕。一名攻击者挥棒袭来——她凌空接住球棒，扭转手腕，轻松缴械。7.6-10.0秒：360度环绕镜头——她跃起旋踢，同时击倒两名对手。摄像机环绕她旋转，另一人从背后冲来。她头也不回，瞬间格挡反击。寒夜中呼出白气。每次打击与渐强的电影配乐同步。10.1-13.0秒：第一人称视角——最后一名对手猛冲过来。快速切换：慢动作中近距离快速交锋。最后一拳干净利落击中。万籁俱寂。雨仍在下。缓慢推进——她独自站在空荡街道上，整理夹克袖口，平稳呼气。低角度镜头。目光坚定向前。毫不动摇。

en.p:
INFINITE FALL — Beer Catch

[image1] Guy: lean young man, wavy blonde hair, thin glasses, black short-sleeve open shirt, dark grey pinstripe wide-leg trousers, large silver belt buckle, brown leather loafers, arm tattoos, silver bracelets. Expression: not panicked — annoyed at the bottle, nothing more.
IMAX 65mm aggressive handheld — camera itself in freefall with him, shaking slightly with air resistance, never still. Fast orbital cuts, whip pans between angles, camera sometimes rushing past him at speed. Everything blown violently upward: hair, jacket, trouser legs, shirt — continuous strong upward wind throughout. The visual grammar of terminal velocity. Sound FX: constant roaring wind, fabric snapping, bottle tumbling, liquid sloshing.
Environment: pure white infinite void — no ground, no ceiling, no horizon. Just white in all directions.
A brown glass beer bottle tumbling slowly in freefall beside him, liquid sloshing inside, just out of reach.
negative: no ground, no slow camera, no calm floating — this is a violent fall
The entire sequence is one continuous fall at full speed. Camera whips around him — bug's eye from directly below looking up at him shrinking then rushing toward camera, overhead looking straight down at him, 10mm close pass inches from his face with the wind tearing at his hair and glasses, Dutch angle tracking his full body as he reaches. The bottle tumbles just past his fingers — he repositions fast, body rotating in the fall, reaching again. His glasses nearly torn off by the wind, he pushes them back with one hand without stopping reaching with the other. The fall feels violent and fast — not peaceful zero gravity, not serene floating. The roaring wind is constant and loud. His clothes are being destroyed by the air resistance — shirt billowing completely open, trouser legs flattened against his legs then snapping outward.
He finally grabs the bottle in one hard grip — fingers closing around the neck. He pulls it against the wind to his lips. Takes a long defiant sip. Wind still roaring. Hair still destroyed. Glasses still crooked. Camera does one final fast orbit around him — close, aggressive, whipping past. He lowers the bottle. Looks directly into the camera lens from centimeters away. Completely unbothered. Wind roar continues. Cut to black.
IMAX/anamorphic, violent freefall camera, aggressive orbital handheld, constant roaring wind, infinite white void, 4K

Music: Flex It - MPH, y3kfae

zh.p: 无限坠落——啤酒接瓶 [图片1] 男子：清瘦青年，波浪金发，细框眼镜，黑色短袖开襟衬衫，深灰细条纹阔腿裤，大号银色皮带扣，棕色皮革乐福鞋，手臂纹身，银色手链。表情：毫无惊慌——只是对酒瓶有些恼火，仅此而已。IMAX 65毫米激进手持摄影——摄影机与他一同自由落体，因空气阻力微微颤动，永不停歇。快速轨道切换，角度间甩镜，摄影机有时高速掠过他身边。一切被猛烈向上吹起：头发、外套、裤腿、衬衫——全程持续强上升气流。这是终端速度的视觉语法。音效：持续呼啸风声，布料拍打声，酒瓶翻滚声，液体晃动声。环境：纯白无限虚空——无地面，无天花板，无地平线。四面八方皆是白色。一只棕色玻璃啤酒瓶在他身旁缓缓翻滚自由下落，内部液体晃动，恰好触不可及。负面：无地面，无慢速摄影，无平静漂浮——这是暴烈的坠落。整个序列是持续全速坠落。摄影机绕他甩动——虫眼视角从正下方仰拍他缩小后冲向镜头，俯拍正下方直击他，10毫米近距掠过他面庞，风撕扯着他的头发与眼镜，荷兰角跟拍他伸手的全身动作。酒瓶恰好滚过指尖——他迅速调整姿势，身体在坠落中旋转，再次伸手。眼镜险些被风扯落，他单手推回眼镜，另一只手不停继续探抓。坠落感暴烈而迅猛——绝非宁静失重，绝非安详漂浮。呼啸风声持续震耳。他的衣物正被空气阻力撕裂——衬衫完全鼓胀敞开，裤腿紧贴双腿后又猛然外翻。他终于一把抓住酒瓶——手指紧扣瓶颈。他逆风将酒瓶举到唇边。挑衅般长饮一口。风声依旧呼啸。头发依旧凌乱。眼镜依旧歪斜。摄影机最后一次快速绕他环拍——贴近、激进、甩掠而过。他放下酒瓶。从数厘米外直视镜头。全然不为所动。风声持续。切至黑屏。IMAX/变形宽银幕，暴烈自由落体摄影，激进轨道手持，持续呼啸风声，无限白色虚空，4K 音乐：Flex It - MPH, y3kfae

en.p: Imitating the style of Shaw Brothers films, set in a desolate snowy mountain with cold tones, high-contrast lighting, and thick film grain. The orange cat protagonist (wearing a coarse cloth woodcutter's outfit, carrying a woodcutter's knife on his back) trudges through the snow as the wind howls. He crouches down, gently placing a gray mouse beside a dying white cat on the snow, and says in a deep voice in English: 'This gray mouse is for you… I hope you can survive this winter.' The white cat is barely breathing, snowflakes landing on its slightly trembling whiskers. The scene shifts—suddenly turning to warm tones, a farmyard with firewood crackling. The orange cat is chopping wood, looking relaxed. The courtyard door opens, and a black cat (wearing a red diamond-studded gown, moving gracefully with a strong presence) steps in slowly. The orange cat freezes, showing a surprised expression, and says in English: 'Are you… that white cat?' The black cat stops, tilts its head slightly, and the atmosphere instantly freezes. The next second, she suddenly pulls out an exaggerated Gatling gun from behind, its barrel reflecting cold light, glaring at the orange cat, and says coldly in English: 'I am that gray mouse.' Immediately following—exaggerated martial arts-style slow motion with explosive sound effects, the Gatling gun fires wildly, flames and bullet casings pouring like rain, the orange cat dodging in panic, the entire courtyard splintering with wood chips and dust flying everywhere, the scene freezing in ultimate chaos and absurdity.
en.t: Snowy Revenge of the Gray Mouse

zh.p:
模仿邵氏電影風格，在荒野的雪山里，冷色調高對比光影與濃厚膠片顆粒。橘貓主角（穿粗布樵夫衣、肩背柴刀）踏雪而行，風雪呼嘯。牠蹲下身，將一隻灰老鼠輕輕放到雪地上一隻瀕死的白貓身旁，低頭用英文沉聲說：
“This gray mouse is for you… I hope you can survive this winter.”
白貓氣若游絲，雪花落在牠微微顫動的鬍鬚上。

鏡頭一轉——暖色調突變，農家院落，柴火劈啪作響。橘貓正在劈柴，神情輕鬆。院門被推開，一隻黑貓（穿紅色鑲鑽禮服，步伐優雅、氣場強烈）緩步走入。橘貓一愣，露出驚喜神情，用英文說：
“Are you… that white cat?”

黑貓停步，微微側頭，氣氛瞬間凝固。下一秒，她猛地從身後掏出一把誇張的加特林，槍管反射出冷光，怒視橘貓，用英文冷聲道：
“I am that gray mouse.”

緊接著——誇張武俠式慢動作＋爆裂音效，加特林瘋狂掃射，火光與子彈殼如雨傾瀉，橘貓驚慌閃避，整個院落被打得木屑飛濺、塵土四起，畫面在極致混亂與荒誕中定格。

白貓氣若游絲，雪花落在牠微微顫動的鬍鬚上。

鏡頭一轉——暖色調突變，農家院落，柴火劈啪作響。橘貓正在劈柴，神情輕鬆。院門被推開，一隻黑貓（穿紅色鑲鑽禮服，步伐優雅、氣場強烈）緩步走入。橘貓一愣，露出驚喜神情，用英文說：
“Are you… that white cat?”

黑貓停步，微微側頭，氣氛瞬間凝固。下一秒，她猛地從身後掏出一把誇張的加特林，槍管反射出冷光，怒視橘貓，用英文冷聲道：
“I am that gray mouse.”

緊接著——誇張武俠式慢動作＋爆裂音效，加特林瘋狂掃射，火光與子彈殼如雨傾瀉，橘貓驚慌閃避，整個院落被打得木屑飛濺、塵土四起，畫面在極致混亂與荒誕中定格。

zh.p: 高节奏暗黑奇幻动作预告片，所有角色和标志均使用图像呈现。[0-2秒]超低空无人机镜头掠过破败的奇幻堡垒，风暴中闪电照亮城墙，低音弦乐拨奏开始；[2-4秒]英雄双眼从黑暗中浮现的极端特写，缓慢而沉稳地拔剑；[4-5秒]低角度镜头——英雄举剑用日语高喊‘行くぞ！’，剑刃闪光，铜管乐器爆鸣；[5-9秒]四个硬切镜头各一秒——（a）法师引爆巨型魔法伴随爆发音效，（b）狼人挥斧将敌人击飞伴随沉重撞击声，（c）弓箭手连射利箭伴随尖锐连续命中声，（d）英雄慢动作挥剑留下光痕；[9-11秒]广角镜头——四位英雄并肩而立面对巨大敌人剪影，法师用日语说‘一緒に戦います’；[11-13.5秒]四人同时冲锋，剑光闪耀，光柱冲天，屏幕充满爆炸；[13.5-15秒]切至黑屏，标题标志伴随金色光芒爆发，深沉低音鼓点，回荡的铜管强音，随后寂静。

en.p:
The camera rockets up from below, tearing past jagged cliff walls, then whips into a downward tilt to reveal the ocean below in full violent eruption, waves detonating against black rock. On the cliff edge stands a warrior woman, utterly fearless, gazing into the maelstrom as if daring it to rise higher. 

She steps forward without hesitation and leaps off the edge, arms spread wide, plummeting through howling wind and salt spray. The camera dives alongside her in freefall, her hair and cloak thrashing upward as the black rocks and churning sea rush closer. 

Then a massive shadow tears through the mist below — a dragon surges upward with wings unfurling like storm sails, scales gleaming wet with ocean spray. It swoops beneath her mid-fall, and she lands on its back with practiced grace, fingers gripping the ridges along its neck. The dragon banks hard, climbing in a spiraling arc back up past the cliff face. 

The camera keeps pace, circling tight, then pulls ahead into a final close, frontal reveal: she rides the beast skyward, wind-whipped, calm, and burning with determination, the raging ocean now small and powerless far below.

zh.p: 镜头从下方急速升起，掠过犬牙交错的悬崖峭壁，随即猛然下倾，展现出下方海面正剧烈喷涌，巨浪撞击着黑色礁石。悬崖边缘站着一位毫无惧色的女战士，她凝视着风暴中心，仿佛在挑衅它再升高些。她毫不犹豫地迈步向前，纵身跃下，双臂张开，在呼啸的狂风与飞溅的浪花中急速坠落。镜头与她一同自由落体，她的头发与斗篷向上翻飞，黑色礁石与翻涌的海面越来越近。这时，一道巨大的阴影撕裂下方的雾气——一条巨龙冲天而起，双翼如风暴之帆般展开，鳞片上海水闪闪发光。它在她坠落途中俯冲至其下方，她以娴熟的优雅姿态落在龙背上，手指紧握龙颈上的脊突。巨龙猛然侧转，沿着螺旋弧线攀升，重新掠过悬崖峭壁。镜头紧随其后，紧密环绕，随即向前推进，最终定格于正面特写：她乘龙升空，风拂发丝，神情平静而燃烧着决心，下方狂暴的海洋此刻显得渺小无力。

en.p:
### CORE CONCEPT: Ultimate Tropical Escape ###
1. Scene Composition & Action (Scene & Action)
Opening: The perspective is a third-person tracking shot following behind a cute 20-year-old Japanese woman with brown hair. She wears a sophisticated resort style, pairing a tropical crop top camisole with tight denim hot pants, and effortlessly pulls a pink Rimowa-style aluminum carry-on suitcase. Her skin is slightly tanned. The location is a wooden pier (wood deck) floating over an emerald-green sea.
Unable to contain her excitement, she starts running forward with considerable momentum from the very beginning. Her strides are long, her steps are very light, and the wheels of the suitcase glide crisply in sync with her speed. Her hair and the hem of her top flutter in the wind, conveying a sense of exhilaration and eagerness to arrive from her entire body.
Middle (Room Tour): As she opens the wooden door of a modern overwater villa, a vast ocean view spreads out before her. The camera synchronizes with her movements, flowing seamlessly and rapidly through the living room, a circular hallway, and into the bathroom. Even after entering the room, she barely slows down, dashing through with a bouncing gait. Her movements are filled with anticipation, as if she is being drawn straight toward her destination. Midway through the room, she naturally and swiftly releases the handle of the carry-on suitcase with the momentum of her run, and the suitcase glides inertially toward the wall, coming to a quiet stop. Without a moment's hesitation, she accelerates further toward the terrace.
Climax: She bursts out onto the villa's terrace, dashes down the stairs with almost no deceleration, and dives without hesitation into the turquoise-blue sea. At this moment, she is already empty-handed, jumping with both arms freely spread. The momentum of her run carries through into the air, resulting in a bold, expansive leap. She spreads her limbs wide in the air, capturing the moment when the splash rises beautifully.
2. Visual & Technical Details (Visual & Technical Details)
Camera Work: Hyper-dynamic follow shot: Maintaining a constant distance from the subject, with minimal shake as if using a gimbal, but with overwhelming speed in the tracking. One-cut style: Seamless transitions as if shot in a single take. The camera closely follows her running speed, maximizing the sense of speed, immersion, and exhilaration. The moment she releases the suitcase is smoothly connected, emphasizing a natural flow that maintains the continuity of the action.
Lighting & Color: Crystal clear tropical daylight: A cloudless, clear sky. Sunlight pours down from directly overhead, and the sea surface sparkles like diamonds. Color Palette: Gradations of "cyan," "turquoise," and "cobalt blue" for the sea; "sky blue" for the sky; "natural wood" and "white" for the villa; "pure white" for her outfit; and "light brown" for her hair. These are set with high saturation to maximize visual satisfaction.
Texture & Detail: Water: Extremely high transparency, allowing the sandy patterns on the bottom to be visible. When she dives in, each droplet of the splash is finely rendered like crystals. Architecture: The villa's exterior features a modern design with white vertical lattice. The wooden deck floor has detailed textures conveying the feel of sun-dried wood. Wardrobe & Hair: Her brown hair flows naturally in the strong tropical wind, and the white crop top camisole and hot pants emphasize an open, healthy summer vibe.

zh.p:
【核心概念：终极热带逃离】
1. 场景构成与动作 (Scene & Action)
开头：视角为第三人称跟踪镜头，跟随一位20岁日本可爱女性的背影。她身着南国风格的露脐吊带衫和紧身牛仔热裤，搭配精致的度假装扮，轻松地拖着一只粉色日默瓦风格铝合金行李箱。肌肤略带晒痕。地点是漂浮在碧绿海面上的木质栈桥。她似乎按捺不住期待，从一开始就充满活力地向前奔跑。步伐很大，脚步非常轻快，行李箱的轮子也随着速度轻快地滑动。头发和上衣下摆随风飘动，全身散发出迫不及待的兴奋感。
中段（房间参观）：她推开现代水上别墅的木门，眼前是开阔的海景。镜头与她的动作同步，不间断地快速流畅移动，穿过客厅、圆形走廊，直至浴室。进入室内后，她几乎未减速，以轻快的步伐奔跑。动作充满期待，仿佛被直线吸向目的地。途中，她借着奔跑的势头，自然地从行李箱手柄上迅速松手，箱子凭借惯性滑向墙边，静静停下。她毫无犹豫，继续加速冲向露台。
高潮：她从别墅露台冲出，几乎未减速地跑下楼梯，毫不犹豫地跳入碧蓝的海水中。此时她已空手，张开双臂自由跳跃。助跑的势头直接转化为空中的动作，大胆而舒展。她在空中伸展四肢，捕捉水花优美飞溅的瞬间。
2. 视觉与技术细节 (Visual & Technical Details)
运镜：超动态跟随镜头：保持与主体的恒定距离，类似使用稳定器，晃动极少，但具有压倒性的速度感。一镜到底风格：仿佛用单次拍摄完成的无缝转场。镜头紧密跟随她的奔跑速度，最大程度强调疾驰感、沉浸感和爽快感。松开行李箱的瞬间也平滑衔接，注重动作连续性的自然引导。
光线与色彩：清澈透明的热带日光：万里无云。阳光从正上方洒下，海面如钻石般闪闪发光。色彩搭配：海洋的“青色”“碧绿”“钴蓝”渐变，天空的“天蓝”，别墅的“天然木色”“白色”，她服装的“纯白”，发色的“浅棕色”。这些色彩以高饱和度设定，最大化视觉满足感。
纹理与质感：水：透明度极高，可见底部沙纹。跳入时溅起的水花，每一滴都如水晶般细腻描绘。建筑：别墅外墙为白色纵向格栅的现代设计。地板木质栈桥的细节传达出阳光晒干的木材质感。服装与头发：浅棕色头发在热带强风中自然飘动，白色露脐吊带衫和热裤强调开放健康的夏日气息。

raw_p:
【コア・コンセプト：Ultimate Tropical Escape】

1. シーン構成とアクション (Scene & Action)
冒頭:

視点は、茶髪の日本人の20歳のかわいい女性の背後を追う三人称視点のトラッキングショット。
彼女は南国風のへそ出しキャミソールと、タイトなジーンズのホットパンツを合わせた洗練されたリゾートスタイルを着用し、ピンクのリモワ風アルミキャリーバッグを軽快に引いている。少し焼けた肌。
場所は、エメラルドグリーンの海の上に浮かぶ木製の桟橋（ウッドデッキ）。
彼女は期待を抑えきれないように、最初からかなり勢いよく前のめりに走り出す。
歩幅は大きく、足運びは非常に軽快で、キャリーバッグの車輪もスピードに合わせて小気味よく滑る。
髪とトップスの裾が風を受けてなびき、到着を待ちきれない高揚感が全身から伝わる。

中盤（ルームツアー）:

彼女がモダンな水上ヴィラの木製の扉を開けると、そこには広大なオーシャンビューが広がる。
カメラは彼女の動きに同期し、リビング、円形の通路、そしてバスルームへと途切れず高速で流れるように移動する。
彼女は室内に入ってからもスピードをほとんど落とさず、弾むような足取りで駆け抜ける。
まるで目的地へ一直線に吸い込まれていくような、期待感に満ちた動き。
部屋の途中で、彼女は走る勢いのままキャリーバッグのハンドルから自然にサッと手を離し、バッグは慣性で壁際へ滑るように流れ、静かに止まる。彼女は一切ためらわず、そのままさらに加速してテラスへ向かう。

クライマックス:

彼女はヴィラのテラスから外へ飛び出し、そのままほとんど減速せずに階段を駆け下り、迷うことなくターコイズブルーの海へとダイブする。
この時、彼女はすでに手ぶらで、両手を自由に広げながらジャンプする。
助走の勢いがそのまま空中へ抜けるような、大胆で伸びのあるジャンプ。
空中で手足を大きく広げ、水しぶき（スプラッシュ）が美しく舞い上がる瞬間を捉える。

2. 視覚的・技術的ディテール (Visual & Technical Details)
カメラワーク:
Hyper-dynamic follow shot: 被写体との距離を一定に保ちながら、ジンバルを使用したような揺れの少ない、しかし圧倒的なスピード感のあるトラッキング。
One-cut style: まるでワンカットで撮影されたかのようなシームレスなトランジション。
カメラは彼女のランニングスピードにぴったり追従し、疾走感・没入感・爽快感を最大限に強調する。
キャリーバッグを手放す瞬間も滑らかにつなぎ、アクションの連続性が崩れない自然な導線を重視する。
ライティングと色彩:
Crystal clear tropical daylight: 雲ひとつない快晴。太陽光は真上から降り注ぎ、海面はキラキラとダイヤモンドのように反射している。
Color Palette:
海の「シアン」「ターコイズ」「コバルトブルー」のグラデーション
空の「スカイブルー」
ヴィラの「ナチュラルウッド」「ホワイト」
彼女の衣装の「ピュアホワイト」
髪色の「ライトブラウン」
これらが彩度高めに設定され、視覚的な満足度を最大化する。
テクスチャと質感:
Water: 水は極めて透明度が高く、底の砂紋が見えるほど。飛び込んだ際の水しぶきは、一粒一粒がクリスタルのように細かく描写される。
Architecture: ヴィラの外壁は白い縦格子のモダンなデザイン。床のウッドデッキは、日光で乾燥した木の質感が伝わるようなディテール。
Wardrobe & Hair: 茶髪は南国の風を強く受けて自然になびき、白いへそ出しキャミソールとホットパンツは、開放的でヘルシーな夏らしさを強調する。

en.p: cinematic horror. Jakarta KRL Commuter Line station at night, Sudirman station platform, harsh yellow-white fluorescent overhead lighting, worn dirty tiled floor, blue KRL train car parked at platform, Indonesian signage on walls. A young woman in [reference outfit] poses next to the train car taking a selfie, smiling. On the train wall behind her, a large advertisement poster shows a beautiful woman's face. The poster surface begins to ripple and crack. Long black wet hair pushes through the glossy paper. A pale hand with black fingernails tears through. A kuntilanak in torn white kebaya crawls out of the poster completely, feet never touching the ground, long hair covering her face, head tilted at an unnatural angle. Bystanders on the platform scream and scatter. The woman drops her phone and runs. POV handheld tracking shot, she sprints through the platform, quick glance back, the kuntilanak glides at impossible speed closing the distance, hair flowing, white kebaya tattered. Emergency lights flicker red. Train doors slam shut. Dead end. Wide shot  the woman presses her back against the closed train doors, nowhere to go. The kuntilanak stops. Slowly raises her head. Two hollow black eyes beneath the hair. Shaky handheld cam, motion blur, high contrast shadows, horror aesthetic, cinematic.

zh.p: 电影级恐怖场景。雅加达KRL通勤线夜间车站，苏迪曼站月台，刺眼的黄白色荧光顶灯，破旧肮脏的瓷砖地面，蓝色KRL列车停靠在月台旁，墙上挂着印尼语标识。一名身着[参考服装]的年轻女子在列车旁摆姿势自拍，面带微笑。她身后的列车墙上，一张大型广告海报上印着美丽女子的面孔。海报表面开始泛起波纹并裂开。湿漉漉的黑色长发从光面纸中挤出。一只涂着黑色指甲的苍白手掌撕裂纸张。一只穿着破烂白色可巴雅的昆蒂拉纳克完全从海报中爬出，双脚始终未触地，长发遮面，头部以不自然的角度歪斜。月台上的路人尖叫四散。女子丢下手机奔逃。手持跟拍镜头，她在月台上狂奔，快速回头一瞥，昆蒂拉纳克以不可思议的速度滑行逼近，长发飘动，白色可巴雅破烂不堪。应急灯闪烁红光。列车门砰然关闭。死路一条。广角镜头中，女子背靠紧闭的列车门，无路可逃。昆蒂拉纳克停下。缓缓抬起头。发丝下露出两只空洞的黑眼。手持镜头摇晃，动态模糊，高对比阴影，恐怖美学，电影质感。

raw_p: cinematic horror. Jakarta KRL Commuter Line station at night, Sudirman station platform, harsh yellow-white fluorescent overhead lighting, worn dirty tiled floor, blue KRL train car parked at platform, Indonesian signage on walls. A young woman in [reference outfit] poses next to the train car taking a selfie, smiling. On the train wall behind her, a large advertisement poster shows a beautiful woman's face. The poster surface begins to ripple and crack. Long black wet hair pushes through the glossy paper. A pale hand with black fingernails tears through. A kuntilanak in torn white kebaya crawls out of the poster completely, feet never touching the ground, long hair covering her face, head tilted at an unnatural angle. Bystanders on the platform scream and scatter. The woman drops her phone and runs. POV handheld tracking shot, she sprints through the platform, quick glance back, the kuntilanak glides at impossible speed closing the distance, hair flowing, white kebaya tattered. Emergency lights flicker red. Train doors slam shut. Dead end. Wide shot  the woman presses her back against the closed train doors, nowhere to go. The kuntilanak stops. Slowly raises her head. Two hollow black eyes beneath the hair. Shaky handheld cam, motion blur, high contrast shadows, horror aesthetic, cinematic.

en.p:
Hyper-realistic first-person POV inside a dense cyberpunk megacity at night, the camera represents the character’s eyes, both hands frequently entering frame with subtle finger motion, slight tremble from adrenaline.

Action sequence: the POV character sprints through a narrow neon-lit alley, heavy breathing driving camera rhythm, rapid head turns scanning surroundings. Flickering holographic signs and glowing advertisements streak past, creating intense motion blur and color trails.

Distant mechanical drones descend into view, scanning aggressively. The POV character reacts instantly, turning sharply and accelerating, feet pounding against wet pavement with visible splashes and reflections.

The character vaults over obstacles, one hand slamming onto surfaces for support, then slides under a low barrier, camera dipping close to the ground before rising back up into a sprint. Hands remain visible, grounding every movement.

Camera behavior: aggressive handheld POV, constant micro jitter, body sway, fast whip pans during direction changes, forward push-in momentum, head bob synced with running cadence, dynamic focus shifts (f/0.4).

Environment: dense cyberpunk city with layered neon signage, holograms, steam vents, reflective rain-soaked streets, volumetric fog catching colored light, deep depth from foreground hands to distant skyline.

Lighting: high-contrast neon (cyan, magenta, electric blue), reflections on wet surfaces, glowing atmosphere, strong backlight silhouettes.

Style: ultra-cinematic realism, Blade Runner-inspired tone, documentary action intensity, motion blur streaks, no HUD, no overlays, no text, stable anatomy, normal proportions without stretch.

zh.p: 超写实第一人称视角，身处夜晚密集的赛博朋克大都市，镜头代表角色的眼睛，双手频繁进入画面，手指有细微动作，因肾上腺素而轻微颤抖。动作场景：视角角色穿过一条霓虹闪烁的狭窄小巷，急促的呼吸带动镜头节奏，快速转头扫视四周。闪烁的全息招牌和发光的广告牌飞速掠过，形成强烈的动态模糊和色彩拖尾。远处的机械无人机俯冲入视野，进行猛烈扫描。视角角色立即反应，急转弯并加速，双脚踩在湿漉漉的路面上，溅起水花并映出倒影。角色翻越障碍物，一只手猛拍表面以支撑，然后滑过低矮的屏障，镜头贴近地面，随后再次起身冲刺。双手始终可见，让每个动作都显得真实。镜头表现：激烈的手持视角，持续微抖动，身体晃动，方向变化时快速甩镜，向前推进的冲劲，头部随跑步节奏上下摆动，动态焦点切换（f/0.4）。环境：密集的赛博朋克城市，层层叠叠的霓虹招牌、全息影像、蒸汽排气口、反光的雨水浸湿街道、捕捉彩色光线的体积雾，从前景的手到远处的天际线形成深邃的景深。光照：高对比度霓虹光（青色、洋红、电光蓝），湿滑表面的反射，发光氛围，强烈的逆光剪影。风格：超电影化写实，受《银翼杀手》启发的色调，纪录片式的动作强度，动态模糊拖尾，无HUD，无叠加元素，无文字，解剖结构稳定，比例正常无拉伸。

en.p: Cinematic 10-second epic fantasy battle sequence in the style of Lord of the Rings, opening with a sweeping aerial crane shot pulling back over a massive ruined battlefield where thousands of armored Norse warriors charge through ash and smoke toward three colossal stone giants crackling with blue lightning, then cutting to a low ground-level tracking shot racing between the boots of sprinting soldiers as a giant's massive stone foot slams into the earth sending warriors flying in slow motion through dust and embers, then cutting to a medium dutch angle shot of a purple-robed female mage and a male sorcerer unleashing violet and blue arc lightning into the giants faces lit dramatically from below, then a whip pan over-the-shoulder shot from the giant's perspective as his enormous clawed hand sweeps across the battlefield scattering warriors like leaves with fire exploding to the right, finally ending on an extreme slow-motion close-up of a blood-soaked Norse warrior's determined face raising his sword and charging directly at the camera before the frame freezes in a blinding white lightning flash and smashes to black, desaturated steel blue and volcanic orange color grade, photorealistic, 8K, cinematic motion blur, epic orchestral atmosphere
en.t: Epic Norse Battle Against Stone Giants

zh.p: 电影级10秒史诗奇幻战斗场景，风格致敬《指环王》。开场采用航拍镜头，从高空向后拉远，展现一片被毁的巨型战场——数千名身披铠甲的北欧战士在灰烬与硝烟中冲锋，迎向三座缠绕着蓝色闪电的巨石巨人。随后镜头切换至低角度地面跟拍，在奔跑士兵的靴子间穿梭，巨人的石足猛然踏地，士兵们被震飞，在慢镜头中掠过尘埃与火星。接着转为中景荷兰角镜头：一位紫袍女法师与男巫师释放出紫蓝交织的弧形闪电，击中巨人面部，下方光线戏剧性照亮他们的脸庞。随后一个快速摇镜，越过巨人肩头视角，其巨爪横扫战场，战士如落叶般四散，右侧爆炸火焰冲天。最终以极致慢镜特写收尾：一名浑身血污的北欧战士神情坚毅，高举长剑直冲镜头，画面在刺目白光闪电中定格，随即碎裂为黑屏。整体色调为低饱和钢蓝与火山橙，照片级真实感，8K分辨率，电影级动态模糊，配以史诗管弦乐氛围。

en.p:
Cinematic realistic animation, static locked wide camera. Cozy kitchen, morning light through window. Orange tabby cat in striped apron stands upright at wooden counter, flour dust on fur, all ingredients visible: milk bottle, flour bowl, fresh eggs carton, vanilla extract, sugar, whisk, mixing bowl, chocolate chips, blueberries, butter, stack of finished pancakes already visible on right side of counter. Pancake cooking on stovetop pan in background.

Cat grabs egg carton with both paws, cracks egg firmly on bowl edge — yolk drops in, shell tossed aside casually. Scoops flour with small paw into bowl — white dust cloud puffs up, coats cat's nose, cat blinks. Pours milk from bottle — steady glug. Drops vanilla extract carefully. Both paws grip whisk, beats batter vigorously in bowl — rhythmic clinking, batter splashes slightly, cat's whole body moves with effort. Cat peers into bowl, satisfied. Ladle scoops batter, carries it to stovetop pan — pours perfect circle, gentle sizzle. Cat watches bubbles form on surface, spatula ready in paw. Confident flip — golden underside revealed, fresh sizzle. Pancake added to growing stack. Handful of blueberries and chocolate chips scattered on top. Butter slice placed — melts slowly. Maple syrup poured in thick amber stream.

Cat picks up finished plate with both paws, turns to face camera directly, extends plate forward toward lens — single clear "MEOW." Whiskers twitch. Static camera throughout, never moves. Ambient kitchen sounds only: whisking, sizzling, butter melting. 15 seconds.

zh.p: 电影级写实动画，固定机位广角镜头。温馨厨房，晨光透过窗户。一只穿条纹围裙的橘猫直立站在木质台面前，皮毛沾着面粉，所有食材清晰可见：牛奶瓶、面粉碗、新鲜鸡蛋盒、香草精、糖、打蛋器、搅拌碗、巧克力豆、蓝莓、黄油，台面右侧已摞好煎好的松饼。背景中炉灶上的平底锅正煎着松饼。猫咪双爪抓起鸡蛋盒，利落地在碗沿磕开鸡蛋——蛋黄落入碗中，蛋壳随手丢到一旁。小爪舀起面粉倒入碗中——白色粉尘腾起，糊了猫咪一鼻子，它眨了眨眼。从瓶中倒出牛奶——咕嘟咕嘟稳稳流淌。小心滴入香草精。双爪握住打蛋器，在碗中用力搅打面糊——发出有节奏的叮当声，面糊微微飞溅，猫咪整个身体随着动作晃动。它探头看看碗里，露出满意的神情。用勺子舀起面糊，走到炉灶前倒入平底锅——完美圆形摊开，发出轻柔的滋滋声。猫咪观察着表面冒起的气泡，爪中握着锅铲。自信地一翻——金黄色的底面露出来，又是一阵新鲜的滋滋声。松饼被加到逐渐增高的饼堆上。撒上一把蓝莓和巧克力豆。放上一片黄油——缓缓融化。枫糖浆如琥珀色细流般浇下。猫咪双爪端起装好的盘子，转身直面镜头，将盘子向前递到镜头前——发出一声清晰的
