en.p:
FORMAT: 15s / 182 BPM / 7 CUTS / minimalist 2D stick-fight animation, pure white background, ultra-fast readability 
SUBJECTS: Two 2D stick fighters drawn in solid black lines on a blank white field. One is lean, evasive, and elastic. The other is wider, heavier, and constantly presses forward with crushing force. 
ENVIRONMENT: Empty white void, no props. Only black speed lines, impact rings, smear frames, skid marks, and sharp red blood accents. Clean negative space keeps every move instantly readable. 
MOOD: Brutal, explosive, relentless, stylish, unfinished. COLOR LOGIC: Monochromatic Grading TIMELINE: 0:00-0:01 - Wide shot, extreme negative space. The lean fighter stands centered and still. The heavy fighter drops from above already throwing a downward strike. Sudden hard push-in. 24mm wide feel. SFX: air drop, hard land, cutting whoosh. 0:01-0:03 - CUT ON ACTION. Side wide shot. Heavy fighter unleashes jab, hook, knee. Lean fighter slips, guards, absorbs the knee, then fires back with calf kick, straight punch, spinning back kick. A sharp red blood arc snaps off the final hit. Short truck move. 35mm feel. SFX: swishes, dry thuds, foot taps, impact ticks. 0:03-0:05 - SMASH CUT. Medium wide side view. Heavy fighter answers with body hook, elbow, backfist, stomp kick, then drives through with a rushing shoulder check, forcing the lean fighter across frame. Quick red flecks burst near the impact rings. Fast lateral move with slight undercrank feel. SFX: impact cracks, whip swishes, stomp hit, air bursts. 0:05-0:07 - CUT ON ACTION. Side wide shot. Lean fighter ducks the next swing, steps inside, lands a rib shot, slicing elbow to the chin, then a rising kick to the chest. A brief red spray snaps off the last connection. Short truck move. 35mm film feel. SFX: duck swish, body thud, elbow crack, kick crack, skid scrape. 0:07-0:10 - WHIP PAN TRANSITION. Side wide shot. Both crash back together and trade a savage twelve-hit chain: punch, block, elbow, knee, duck, backfist, kick, catch, shove, hook, spinning elbow, straight cross. Red flicks burst only on the hardest impacts. Fast truck move with momentum-based cutting. Thick black impact circles on the heaviest blows. SFX: rapid hit flurry, hard swishes, bass ticks, breath bursts. 0:10-0:12 - CUT ON ACTION. Worm's-eye wide shot. Heavy fighter surges forward again. Lean fighter eats two hits, slips the third, steps off the planted thigh, vaults upward, and hammers down. Both collide midair in a tight X-shaped silhouette that splits apart instantly. Quick arc move around the clash. 24mm wide feel. SFX: rising whoosh, hit flurry, double crack, burst hiss, bass slam. 0:12-0:15 - HARD CUT. Monumental wide shot. Both land already in motion, skid a step, rebound, and charge back to center without pause, dissolving into black strike smears and red flecks as the exchange continues. Tiny push-in. End mid-fight, unresolved. 50mm standard feel. SFX: skid scrape, hard

zh.p:
格式：15秒 / 182拍每分钟 / 7个剪辑 / 极简二维火柴人打斗动画，纯白背景，超快可读性
主体：两个二维火柴人在空白白色场地上用纯黑线条绘制。一个瘦削、灵活、善于闪避。另一个更宽、更重，不断以压倒性力量向前推进。
环境：空白的白色虚空，无道具。只有黑色速度线、冲击环、拖影帧、滑痕和尖锐的红色血迹点缀。干净的负空间让每个动作瞬间可读。
氛围：残酷、爆炸性、无情、风格化、未完成。
色彩逻辑：单色分级
时间线：
0:00-0:01 - 广角镜头，极端负空间。瘦削斗士静止站立在中央。重型斗士从上方落下，已挥出下劈攻击。突然硬推近。24mm广角感。音效：空降、硬着陆、切割呼啸声。
0:01-0:03 - 动作剪辑。侧面广角镜头。重型斗士释放刺拳、勾拳、膝击。瘦削斗士闪避、格挡、承受膝击，然后回以小腿踢、直拳、转身后旋踢。一道尖锐的红色血弧在最后一击中迸发。短距平移。35mm感。音效：嗖嗖声、干闷撞击声、脚步轻点声、冲击滴答声。
0:03-0:05 - 猛切剪辑。中广角侧视图。重型斗士以身体勾拳、肘击、反手拳、踩踏踢回应，然后通过冲刺肩撞强行推进，迫使瘦削斗士横穿画面。快速红色斑点靠近冲击环爆发。快速横向移动，略带低速曲柄感。音效：冲击破裂声、鞭子嗖嗖声、踩踏撞击声、空气爆裂声。
0:05-0:07 - 动作剪辑。侧面广角镜头。瘦削斗士躲过下一击，迈步内切，击中肋骨，用肘部削向下巴，然后一记上升踢击中胸部。短暂的红色喷溅在最后一次连接中迸发。短距平移。35mm胶片感。音效：闪避嗖嗖声、身体闷响、肘击破裂声、踢击破裂声、滑擦声。
0:07-0:10 - 甩镜过渡。侧面广角镜头。两人再次碰撞，展开一轮凶猛的十二连击：拳击、格挡、肘击、膝击、下蹲、反手拳、踢击、接招、推搡、勾拳、旋转肘击、直拳交叉。红色斑点仅在最强冲击时爆发。基于动量的快速平移剪辑。最重打击时出现粗黑冲击圈。音效：快速连击、硬嗖嗖声、低音滴答声、呼吸爆发声。
0:10-0:12 - 动作剪辑。虫眼广角镜头。重型斗士再次向前猛冲。瘦削斗士承受两击，躲过第三击，从对方大腿上借力，跃起向上，然后猛砸而下。两人在半空中碰撞，形成紧密的X形剪影，瞬间分开。围绕冲突的快速弧线移动。24mm广角感。音效：上升呼啸声、连击声、双重破裂声、爆裂嘶嘶声、低音重击声。
0:12-0:15 - 硬切剪辑。宏大广角镜头。两人落地时已在运动中，滑步一步，反弹，不停歇地冲回中央，在交锋继续中消散成黑色打击拖影和红色斑点。轻微推近。50mm标准感。音效：滑擦声、硬

ヒロイン：17歳、腰までの栗色ストレートロングヘア、前髪ぱっつん、琥珀色の大きな瞳、白セーラー服に紺スカーフとプリーツスカート、色白、頬にうっすら紅。全カットで顔と衣装の一貫性を維持。

[0-4s] 春の朝、満開の桜並木の高校校門。柔らかい朝陽、花びらがゆっくり舞う。画面奥からヒロインが歩いてくる。画面下部にテキストウィンドウ「4月——新しい季節が始まる」。淡いゴッドレイ。Camera: slow dolly in, smooth gimbal, wide to medium.

[4-8s] 午後の教室、窓から斜めに陽光。ヒロインが窓際でゆっくり振り返り、首をかしげてはにかんだ笑顔。画面下部にダイアログボックス、名前欄「藤宮 ひなた」。柔らかいディフューズドライティング。Camera: static medium shot, eye level, fixed framing.

[8-12s] 放課後の屋上、夕焼けのオレンジ空。ヒロインがフェンス越しに夕陽を見つめ、夕風が髪を揺らす。ゆっくり振り向き頬を赤らめる。ダイアログ「……来てくれたんだ」。golden hour逆光、髪にリムライト。Camera: slow dolly in, waist to bust, low angle.

[12-15s] 校庭の大きな桜の樹の下、magic hourの金色の光。ヒロインが胸の前で手を重ねうつむき、ゆっくり顔を上げて潤んだ瞳で微笑む。画面下部にゲーム選択肢ウィンドウ2つ。桜が舞う。金色レンズフレア、淡いボケ。Camera: slow dolly in to close-up, eye level, gentle smooth.

4K, Ultra HD, no deformation, natural smooth movements, stable picture, no flickering, no ghosting, sharp details. Generate video without subtitles.

en.p: A continuous, cinematic tracking shot of a sleek, midnight black sports car with glowing neon cyan trim speeding down a wet, neon-lit futuristic city highway at night. Mid-drift, the car initiates a complex, seamless transformation: the hood splits, wheels rotate inward, and intricate mechanical armor panels dynamically unfold while maintaining rapid forward momentum with sparks flying. Intense cyan energy glows from within the shifting gears as the vehicle rapidly reconfigures into a sleek, agile humanoid robot. The robot completes the momentum by landing powerfully on two legs, skidding to a dramatic halt on the wet asphalt, steam rising from its mechanical joints, its glowing cyan eyes locking directly onto the camera. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, Unreal Engine 5 style render, high-octane sci-fi action, cinematic lighting, intense motion blur on the background.

en.p: Overall style: Japanese urban street photography, fast-paced fragmented editing. BGM and sound effects: Upbeat and brisk Japanese pop-rock with clear drum beats, emotionally charged vocals, strict synchronization of scene transitions with the music beat. Looking at a snow-covered village outside the window, dark inside and bright outside. [0:03-0:04] Sunny day. en.p: A contrast video with seamless transitions. First scene: First-person handheld everyday camera movement. A bright office corridor with white walls and a grid ceiling, with even and realistic lighting. An Asian woman wearing black-rimmed glasses and a pink hair clip, dressed in a loose black hoodie with white letters and black pants. She shows a spade Ace playing card with a skull pattern to the camera, then throws the card toward the lens. The card covers the screen, completing the transition. Second scene: After the transition, it becomes a dark, vintage Gothic room with a black velvet backdrop and an ornate golden carved mirror frame. The camera movement shifts to a slightly low-angle, steady close-up with high-contrast cinematic lighting. The woman transforms into a look with waist-length hair, a black pointed headpiece, a tight red sleeveless high-neck mini dress, and red stockings, with a cold and seductive makeup style. She extends one hand toward the camera, her hair flowing in the wind, while multiple large heart and spade playing cards dynamically float and fall around her in the space. The overall atmosphere instantly shifts from realistic everyday life to magnificent fantasy.

en.p:
Scene (0–5s):
A stormy suburban American street at night, rain pouring, streetlights flickering. Close-up of a 7-year-old blond boy (soaked, cheeks flushed) crouching down, gently picking up a shivering stray orange cat. The cat meows weakly, clinging to his chest. Smash cut — the front door bursts open as the boy rushes into a warm yet tense living room. His mother (wearing a home knit sweater, stern expression) stands at the staircase, her face darkening.
Dialogue 1 (Mom, furious and sharp):
Are you kidding me?! You brought a dirty stray into MY house?!

Scene (6–10s):
The boy clutches the cat tightly, eyes tearing up, trying to explain. The cat suddenly stops shaking, slowly lifting its head, pupils shrinking unnaturally. In an instant — the orange cat LEAPS straight onto the mother’s face.
Slow motion: claws latch onto her face, she lets out a suffocating scream, stumbling backward, knocking over furniture.
The boy rushes forward in panic, desperately pulling at the cat.
Dialogue 2 (Boy, breaking down):
Stop! Stop! Let her go!! PLEASE!!

Scene (11–15s):
Extreme close-up — the boy finally yanks the cat off.
Silence.
The mother’s “face” peels off completely, along with her blonde hair, sliding down.
Revealing — a green-skinned, large black-eyed alien face, wet and cold, staring directly forward.

The boy’s pupils shake violently. The “face” drops from his hands onto the floor.
The orange cat lands and slowly turns its head, eerily calm.
The alien tilts its head slightly, mouth stretching into an unnatural smile.
Dialogue 3 (Alien, low and eerie):
…You weren’t supposed to see that.

Sound Design:
Heavy rain and distant thunder at the start, door slam impact; mid-section tearing/claw impact, furniture crashing, suffocating screams; final section sudden silence → wet peeling sound → rising low-frequency horror tone, final line with subtle echo.

Duration:
Exactly 15 seconds (high-intensity American micro drama, dense shock beats, extreme twist payoff)
en.t: The Cat That Peeled Mom's Face

zh.p: 场景（0-5秒）：美国郊区暴风雨夜，大雨倾盆，路灯忽明忽暗。特写镜头——一个7岁的金发男孩（浑身湿透，脸颊泛红）蹲下身，轻轻捡起一只瑟瑟发抖的流浪橘猫。猫咪虚弱地喵喵叫，紧紧贴在他胸口。画面骤切——男孩冲进家门，前门砰地撞开，客厅里温暖却气氛紧张。母亲（穿着手织毛衣，表情严厉）站在楼梯口，脸色阴沉。对话1（母亲，愤怒尖锐）：你开什么玩笑？！把一只脏兮兮的流浪猫带进我的房子？！场景（6-10秒）：男孩紧紧抱着猫，眼眶含泪，试图解释。猫咪突然停止颤抖，缓缓抬起头，瞳孔不自然地收缩。瞬间——橘猫直扑母亲的脸。慢动作：爪子钩住她的脸，她发出窒息般的尖叫，踉跄后退，撞翻家具。男孩惊慌冲上前，拼命拉扯猫咪。对话2（男孩，崩溃）：住手！住手！放开她！！求你了！！场景（11-15秒）：极端特写——男孩终于把猫拽开。一片寂静。母亲的“脸”连同金发整张脱落，滑落下来。露出——一张绿色皮肤、黑色大眼的外星人脸，湿冷僵硬，直直盯着前方。男孩瞳孔剧烈震动。“脸”从他手中掉到地上。橘猫落地，缓缓转头，诡异平静。外星人微微歪头，嘴角扯出不自然的笑容。对话3（外星人，低沉阴森）：……你不该看到的。音效设计：开头暴雨声和远处雷声，门撞击声；中段撕裂/爪击声，家具碰撞声，窒息尖叫；结尾突然寂静→湿漉漉的剥落声→低频恐怖音调渐强，最后一句带细微回声。时长：精确15秒（高强度美国微剧，密集惊悚节奏，极致反转冲击）

The boy clutches the cat tightly, eyes tearing up, trying to explain. The cat suddenly stops shaking, slowly lifting its head, pupils shrinking unnaturally. In an instant — the orange cat LEAPS straight onto the mother’s face.
Slow motion: claws latch onto her face, she lets out a suffocating scream, stumbling backward, knocking over furniture.
The boy rushes forward in panic, desperately pulling at the cat.
Dialogue 2 (Boy, breaking down):
Stop! Stop! Let her go!! PLEASE!!

Scene (11–15s):
Extreme close-up — the boy finally yanks the cat off.
Silence.
The mother’s “face” peels off completely, along with her blonde hair, sliding down.
Revealing — a green-skinned, large black-eyed alien face, wet and cold, staring directly forward.

The boy’s pupils shake violently. The “face” drops from his hands onto the floor.
The orange cat lands and slowly turns its head, eerily calm.
The alien tilts its head slightly, mouth stretching into an unnatural smile.
Dialogue 3 (Alien, low and eerie):
…You weren’t supposed to see that.

Sound Design:
Heavy rain and distant thunder at the start, door slam impact; mid-section tearing/claw impact, furniture crashing, suffocating screams; final section sudden silence → wet peeling sound → rising low-frequency horror tone, final line with subtle echo.

Duration:
Exactly 15 seconds (high-intensity American micro drama, dense shock beats, extreme twist payoff)

en.p:
Dark navy background. A few small objects drift along a wide circular orbit — the rotation center sits in the upper right of the frame, the camera watches from the outer edge. A decorated box, a striped ball, and a couple of carnival items arc past one by one, curving leftward across the view. Sparse confetti strips and gold coins float through the air.

Three cream-colored rectangular talismans appear on the same orbital path, each bearing a different painted emblem. They approach one at a time, sweeping across the camera in a wide arc.

A glowing golden-framed card carrying a character illustration enters along the orbit. It drifts to center screen and the camera pushes in. The golden frame swells beyond the screen edges and vanishes — only the character remains. Gold sparkles and cross-shaped flares surround the reveal.

Red talismans orbit the character in irregular circular paths. Flame-colored ribbons weave through the hair. A fireball ignites near the outstretched hand, swelling until it fills nearly half the screen with white-hot light. The fireball contracts back toward the hands. Energy converts — flames dissolve into crackling purple arcs. The talismans transform into large glowing red rectangles covered in flame-crest patterns, fanning out in formation.

The character spins with the talismans fanning wider. Camera drives in — golden light ignites in both eyes, a held beat of charge. Pull back to full body. White-gold explosion erupts outward. The talismans launch toward the camera — one large talisman surges forward, dark surface swirling with magenta crests, growing until it covers the entire frame. Black.

New scene. No character visible. Red glowing rectangles streak across dark space in a wide circular arc, trailing fire. They converge on a single point at center screen. On impact, red flash fills the screen — hot pink wash expands, then fades.

Red-orange glowing core at the center with spiral energy arcs rotating around it. More red rectangles converge from all sides onto the central energy sphere. Everything compresses to a single bright point — total whiteout.

Fireball detonates outward with radial god rays. It expands to half the screen, then disperses. Red rectangle debris drifts through the flames. The color shifts — red bleeds to magenta, magenta to purple. In one frame, cold blue-purple replaces everything. New scene.

zh.p: 深海军蓝背景。几个小物体沿着宽阔的环形轨道飘移——旋转中心位于画面右上角，镜头从外缘观看。一个装饰盒、一个条纹球和几件嘉年华物品依次划出弧线，向左弯曲穿过视野。稀疏的彩纸屑和金币在空中漂浮。三个奶油色的长方形符咒出现在同一轨道上，每个都绘有不同的图案。它们逐一靠近，以宽阔的弧线扫过镜头。一张带有角色插图的发光金框卡片沿着轨道进入。它飘到画面中央，镜头推进。金框膨胀超出屏幕边缘并消失——只剩下角色。金色闪光和十字形光芒环绕着揭示过程。红色符咒以不规则的圆形轨道环绕角色。火焰色的丝带编织在头发中。一个火球在伸出的手附近点燃，膨胀到几乎填满半个屏幕，发出白炽光芒。火球向双手收缩。能量转化——火焰消散成噼啪作响的紫色电弧。符咒变成巨大的发光红色矩形，覆盖着火焰纹章图案，呈扇形展开。角色旋转，符咒扇面扩大。镜头推进——双眼燃起金色光芒，蓄力片刻。拉回至全身。白金色爆炸向外迸发。符咒向镜头发射——一个巨大的符咒猛冲向前，暗色表面旋转着洋红色纹章，不断增大直至覆盖整个画面。黑色。新场景。角色不可见。红色发光矩形在黑暗空间中沿宽阔的圆弧轨迹飞驰，拖着火焰。它们汇聚到画面中央的一个点。撞击时，红色闪光充满屏幕——热粉色扩散开来，然后消退。中心是红橙色发光核心，螺旋能量弧绕其旋转。更多红色矩形从四面八方汇聚到中央能量球上。一切压缩成一个明亮的点——完全白屏。火球向外引爆，放射出径向神光。它膨胀到半个屏幕，然后消散。红色矩形碎片在火焰中飘移。颜色转变——红色褪成洋红色，洋红色变成紫色。在一帧内，冷蓝紫色取代了一切。新场景。

en.p: 【Opening Shot Sequence · Total Duration 15 Seconds · 7 Transition Shots】 ■ Shot 1 (0:00–0:02) Drone Ultra-Wide · Full View of Space Colony Starting with an ultra-wide drone shot from the outer shell of the space colony. The massive ring-shaped colony interior gradually unfolds—morning light penetrates the curved transparent dome, slanting into the near-future city within. The city skyline appears faintly in the golden morning mist, with floating building clusters and glowing tracks interwoven. The camera slowly pushes inward at a very slow pace, creating a grand epic opening. Color palette: cool blue as the main tone, with golden morning light as accents. ■ Shot 2 (0:02–0:04) Overhead Vertical Descent · Full Body of Woman on Platform The camera captures a full-body shot of a woman standing at the edge of a platform from directly above. She wears a white and red mecha combat suit, with broad shoulder armor featuring aggressive lines, and a skirt composed of multiple layers of blade-like armor plates. Her long black hair gently sways in the high-altitude wind. The camera slowly descends vertically (crane down) to approach her; the white mecha reflects dazzling metallic luster in the morning light, with red circuit patterns faintly glowing. Below the platform lies a deep futuristic city canyon, with hovering vehicles darting like specks of light. ■ Shot 3 (0:04–0:06) Extreme Low Angle · Foot Close-Up The camera switches to an extreme low-angle shot near the ground, focusing on the toe tip of her white high-heeled mecha boot, precisely poised at the platform's edge. The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the red glowing line patterns on the boot and the white armor plates on the lower leg. Beneath the boot tip lies the endless city depth, with blurred neon lights and building contours creating a strong sense of height and tension. Wind sounds and low-frequency city hum serve as the audio layer. ■ Shot 4 (0:06–0:09) Side Horizontal Tracking · Waist to Shoulder Starting from her waist side, the camera smoothly moves upward in a fluid tracking shot. It passes over the details of the multi-layered blade-like armor skirt—each armor edge sharp and glossy; moving up along the waist, red energy patterns蜿蜒 extend on the white armor; reaching the broad shoulder armor with angular protruding structures at the top. Throughout the tracking, the background is a blurred city skyline, with shallow depth of field highlighting the mecha's texture. The camera movement speed matches a slow electronic beat, smooth and full of tension. ■ Shot 5 (0:09–0:11) Extreme Hand Close-Up · Cybernetic Mechanical Hand Switch to a hand close-up. One of her hands (a cybernetic mechanical prosthetic) rests on the metal railing of the platform. The camera is extremely close, capturing the intricate structure of the mechanical joints—white framework, red glowing joint points, and subtle sensor patterns at the fingertips. Red light points flicker slowly in a pulse rhythm, like a heartbeat. Reflected light from the city below flows over the mechanical hand's surface, creating shifting shadows. Sound effects: faint electric hum mixed with city wind. ■ Shot 6 (0:11–0:13) Extreme Side Profile Close-Up · Morning Light Rim Light Switch to an extreme close-up of her side profile. The white mask, seen from the side, has smooth and aggressive edge lines; her long black hair falls along the shoulder armor, gently swaying in the breeze. Morning light comes from the right side of the frame, precisely outlining the mask's edge and hair strands, forming a golden rim light. The side of the mask faintly reveals the outline of eyes, gazing at the distant city. The expression is unreadable, full of mystery and power. The background is extremely blurred into an orange-gold morning light halo. ■ Shot 7 (0:13–0:15) Drone Backward Ascending · Full City View Ending The camera pulls back and ascends like a drone, with the woman's silhouette gradually shrinking in the center of the frame—from full body to half body to a silhouette, finally becoming a tiny black silhouette against the colony city skyline. Morning light renders the entire scene in golden-orange tones. The camera continues ascending to a full view of the colony interior, fully presenting the city's grand scale, ending the opening sequence. The overall ending pace slows down, building momentum for the subsequent musical climax. 【Global Visual Settings】 Color Palette: Strong contrast between cool blue and golden orange; mecha primarily white with red as the energy accent color. Lighting: Slanted morning light, metallic reflections, red energy glow. Image Quality: 8K cinematic grade, ultra-high detail, rich depth of field layers, film grain texture. Atmosphere: Epic, mysterious, powerful, lonely futurism.

【开场镜头序列·总时长15秒·共7个切换镜头】
■ 镜头1（0:00–0:02）无人机超广角·宇宙殖民地全景
以超广角无人机镜头从宇宙殖民地外壳切入。巨大的环形殖民地内部徐徐展现——晨光穿透弧形透明穹顶，斜射进入殖民地内部的近未来都市。城市天际线在金色晨雾中若隐若现，悬浮建筑群与发光轨道交错排列。镜头以极慢速度向内推进，营造出宏大的史诗感开场。画面色调：冷蓝主调，金色晨光为点缀。
■ 镜头2（0:02–0:04）俯瞰垂直下降·高台上的女性全身
镜头从正上方俯视，捕捉站在高台边缘的女性全身。她身着白色与红色机甲战衣，肩部装甲宽大且具攻击性线条，裙摆由多层刀状装甲板构成。黑色长发在高处的风中轻轻飘动。镜头以缓慢的垂直下降（crane down）方式靠近，白色机甲在晨光下反射出耀眼的金属光泽，红色回路纹路隐约发出微弱的光芒。高台下方是深邃的未来城市峡谷，悬浮车辆如星点般穿梭。
■ 镜头3（0:04–0:06）极近地面·足部特写
镜头切换至极近地面的低角度仰拍，聚焦于她白色高跟机甲靴的靴尖，精准立于高台边缘。镜头缓缓向后拉开，露出靴身的红色发光线条纹路与小腿部位的白色装甲片。靴尖之下是无尽的城市深处，模糊的霓虹光与建筑轮廓形成强烈的高度感与紧张感。风声与城市低频嗡鸣作为音效层。
■ 镜头4（0:06–0:09）侧面横向追踪·腰部至肩部
镜头从她的腰侧开始，以流畅的横向追踪（tracking shot）缓缓向上移动。经过多层刀状装甲裙摆的细节——每片装甲边缘锋利、有光泽；沿着腰部向上，红色能量纹路在白色装甲上蜿蜒延伸；到达宽大的肩甲，顶端有棱角分明的突起结构。整个追踪过程背景为虚化的城市天际线，浅景深突出机甲质感。镜头运动速度配合慢拍电子节奏，流畅而充满张力。
■ 镜头5（0:09–0:11）手部极致特写·赛博机械手
切换至手部特写。她的一只手（赛博机械义手）搭放于高台金属栏杆之上。镜头极近，捕捉机械关节的精密结构——白色骨架、红色发光关节点、指尖处细微的传感器纹路。红色光点以脉冲节奏缓慢闪烁，仿佛心跳。栏杆下方城市的反射光在机械手表面形成流动的光影。音效：微弱的电流嗡鸣声与城市风声交叠。
■ 镜头6（0:11–0:13）侧颜极近特写·晨光轮廓光
镜头切换为极近侧颜特写。白色面具从侧面看，边缘线条流畅且具攻击性；黑色长发顺着肩甲垂落，在微风中轻柔摆动。晨光从画面右侧打来，精准地勾勒出面具边缘与发丝轮廓，形成金色的逆光轮廓（rim light）。面具侧面隐约可见一双眼睛的轮廓，凝视远方的城市。表情无法判读，充满神秘感与力量感。背景极度虚化为橙金色的晨光光晕。
■ 镜头7（0:13–0:15）无人机后退上升·都市全景收尾
镜头以无人机方式向后拉升，女性的轮廓在画面中央逐渐缩小——从全身到半身到剪影，最终成为殖民地城市天际线前的一个微小黑色剪影。晨光将整个画面渲染成金橙色调。镜头继续上升至殖民地内部全景，都市的宏大规模完整呈现，以此结束开场序列。整体结尾节奏放缓，为后续音乐高潮蓄力。
【全局视觉设定】
色调：冷蓝与金橙的强烈对比，机甲以白色为主色调，红色为能量强调色。
光线：晨光斜射、金属反射光、红色能量发光。
画质：8K电影级，超高细节，景深层次丰富，胶片颗粒质感。
氛围：史诗、神秘、力量感、孤独的未来主义。

zh.p:
ハイエンドなRPGのボスバトル実機プレイ映像、フォトリアルな8kグラフィックス。15秒のダイナミックなアクションシーケンス。

[0-3秒]: 巨大なボス [@ image3] が、画面全体を破壊するような真っ赤な衝撃波を放つ究極奥義を発動。画面が激しく揺れる。ゲームのHUD（UI）が表示され、画面端にある4人のHPバーが急激に減少し、残り10%で止まって赤く点滅し「LOW HP」の警告が出る。

[3-12秒]: 怒涛の反撃が開始。プレイ画面と各キャラクターのクローズアップしたカットインが、高速で交互に切り替わる：

- **カットイン1 (3-7秒):** @ image1 の顔のアップが斜めにカットイン、セリフ「一閃！天を穿て！」が表示。プレイ画面に戻り、ボスを垂直に駆け上がり、光るエネルギーブレードでド派手な斬撃を繰り出す。

- **カットイン2 (7-10秒):** @ image2 の横顔がスタイリッシュにカットイン、セリフ「そこだ…塵に還れ」が表示。プレイ画面に戻り、バレットタイム（スローモーション）でボスの背後にテレポートし、赤いネオンのビーム魔法を連続して当てるド派手な魔法を複数の空中魔法陣を召喚して撃ち込む

- **カットイン3 (10-13秒):** @ image1と@ image2 が2人同時にカッコいいカットイン、セリフ「合わせろ!」が表示。プレイ画面に戻り、@が極大な炎魔法を@ image1に向かって放つそれを@ image1のキャラクターが刀に全て吸い込む
@ image1のキャラクターが@ image3のボスにド派手に撃ち込む（このときはダメージが限界突破して999999と表示される）

UIには洗練されたミニマルなアイコン。攻撃の衝撃に合わせて「9999」や「CRITICAL」といったスタイリッシュなランダムなダメージ数字が飛び散る。最後は巨大な衝撃波とともに画面に「MAX CHAIN COMBO」の文字が表示される。4k、60fps、圧倒的なゲーム体験の雰囲気。各攻撃シーンはシームレスかつダイナミックなカメラワーク

en.p:
**Environment:**

A frozen glacial valley under pale arctic twilight. Deep cobalt shadows across the ice field with cold blue ambient light reflecting from massive glacier walls. Snow particles drifting through the air. Frozen lake surfaces acting as natural mirrors for diegetic reflections.

**Action:**

15.0s sequence. A towering figure composed of crystalline ice and refracting light engages a magma-armored titan whose body glows through volcanic fissures beneath black stone plating. They clash in rapid close-range combat across the frozen lake. Each strike fractures the ice beneath them, sending radial cracks spreading outward. The magma titan’s punches melt sections of the glacier while the ice giant counters with explosive frost bursts that instantly freeze the molten rock.

Velocity Ramp choreography: rapid exchanges freeze into ultra-slow motion when fists collide, showing ice crystals shattering and lava droplets vaporizing before snapping back to full speed as both titans slide across the ice surface.

**Camera:**

Low tracking shot sliding across the frozen lake surface, reflections capturing both combatants. A sudden upward crane move follows the moment the magma titan is thrown into a glacier wall, ice exploding outward.

**Style & Constraints:**

8K resolution, photorealistic volumetric snow, ray-traced reflections on ice surfaces, cinematic cold lighting, 35mm film grain, stable geometry, no flicker.

zh.p: 环境：一片冰封的冰川谷地，笼罩在苍白的极地暮光之下。深钴蓝色的阴影横亘冰原，冷冽的蓝光从巨大的冰川壁上反射而出。雪花在空中飘舞。冰封的湖面如同天然的镜面，映照出场景内的倒影。动作：15秒的连续镜头。一个由水晶冰体构成、折射着光芒的 towering 巨人，与一个身披岩浆铠甲的泰坦展开激战——后者黑色的石质甲壳下，火山裂隙中透出炽热的光芒。他们在冰封的湖面上进行高速的近身缠斗。每一次撞击都震裂脚下的冰层，放射状的裂纹向四周扩散。岩浆泰坦的拳头熔化了大片冰川，而冰巨人则以爆裂的霜冻反击，瞬间冻结熔岩。速度变化编排：当拳头相撞时，快速的攻防瞬间凝固成超慢动作，展现冰晶碎裂、熔岩液滴汽化的细节，随后又猛然恢复全速，两位泰坦在冰面上滑行。镜头：低角度跟踪镜头，在冰封的湖面上滑行，倒影中同时捕捉两位战斗者。当岩浆泰坦被掷向冰川壁时，镜头突然向上摇臂，冰屑向外爆裂。风格与限制：8K分辨率，照片级真实感的体积雪花，冰面上的光线追踪反射，电影感的冷色调照明，35毫米胶片颗粒感，稳定的几何结构，无闪烁。

en.p:
Cinematic hyper-dynamic fast-paced multi-shot sequence, epic mythological battlefield, IMAX film simulation, 35mm Panavision lens, f/4, heavy cinematic color grading, dramatic contrast between dark necrotic tones and radiant golden divine light.

Shot 1: Extreme close-up on Sun Wukong’s face, covered in dirt and blood, golden eyes flickering with exhaustion yet defiance. His fur is matted, his breathing heavy. He kneels in the center of a ruined battlefield, his golden staff cracked and planted into the ground for support. Around him, countless skeletal warriors slowly close in, their hollow eyes glowing with eerie green fire.

Shot 2: Rapid shaky handheld shot circling Wukong. The skeletal army tightens its formation, bones clattering, rusted weapons scraping. Wukong struggles to stand, gripping his staff, as the undead swarm prepares to strike from all directions.

Shot 3: Low-angle shot from behind Wukong. Just as the skeletons lunge forward, a faint golden glow begins to emerge behind him, cutting through the darkness like dawn breaking through a storm.

Shot 4: Sudden explosive bloom of radiant golden light. A towering Buddha manifestation appears behind Wukong, विशाल and serene, radiating infinite divine energy. The battlefield is instantly bathed in warm, overwhelming golden luminosity.

Shot 5: Fast upward tilt. Rows upon rows of celestial soldiers materialize in the sky and on the ground behind the Buddha—heavenly generals clad in ornate golden armor, divine banners flowing, weapons shining with sacred light.

Shot 6: Whip-pan across the battlefield. The skeletons freeze mid-attack, their bodies trembling under the pressure of the divine aura. Golden light surges outward like a tidal wave.

Shot 7: Ultra-fast sequence of disintegration shots. The skeletal army is instantly reduced to ash—bones crack, dissolve, and scatter into glowing dust, evaporating into nothingness under the overwhelming holy radiance.

Shot 8: Wide epic drone pull-back. Wukong stands silhouetted in front of the colossal golden Buddha and the vast heavenly army. The battlefield, once dark and corrupted, is now purified, glowing with divine light. Golden particles drift through the air like sacred snow.

Final frame: Freeze in epic tension—Wukong gripping his staff, head slightly bowed, while behind him the Buddha and celestial army radiate infinite power, dominating the horizon.

zh.p: 电影级超动态快节奏多镜头序列，史诗神话战场，IMAX电影模拟，35毫米潘那维申镜头，f/4光圈，厚重电影调色，黑暗腐朽色调与璀璨金色神光形成戏剧性对比。镜头1：孙悟空面部极端特写，满脸血污泥泞，金色眼眸闪烁着疲惫与不屈。毛发结块，呼吸沉重。他跪在废墟战场中央，金箍棒已开裂，插入地面支撑身体。周围无数骷髅战士缓缓逼近，空洞眼眶中燃烧着诡异的绿火。镜头2：快速手持摇晃镜头环绕悟空。骷髅军团收紧阵型，骨骼咔嗒作响，锈蚀武器相互摩擦。悟空挣扎起身，紧握金箍棒，亡灵大军从四面八方准备发动攻击。镜头3：从悟空身后低角度拍摄。就在骷髅们猛扑之际，他身后开始浮现微弱的金色光芒，如同黎明冲破暴风雨般划破黑暗。镜头4：璀璨金光骤然爆发。一尊巨大的佛陀化身出现在悟空身后，庄严宏伟，散发无限神力。战场瞬间沐浴在温暖而压倒性的金色光辉中。镜头5：快速仰拍。佛陀身后，天空与地面浮现层层天兵天将——身披华丽金甲的天神将领，神幡飘扬，武器闪耀圣光。镜头6：横扫战场。骷髅们僵在半空，身体在神威压迫下颤抖。金光如潮水般向外奔涌。镜头7：超快速瓦解序列。骷髅军团瞬间化为灰烬——骨骼碎裂、消散成发光尘埃，在神圣光辉中蒸发殆尽。镜头8：史诗级无人机广角拉远。悟空以剪影姿态立于巨大金佛与浩瀚天军之前。曾经黑暗腐朽的战场已被净化，闪耀着神性光芒。金色粒子如圣雪般飘散空中。最终定格：史诗张力凝固——悟空紧握金箍棒，微微低头，身后佛陀与天军放射无穷力量，主宰天际线。

en.p: 【Style】Y2K Pool Party, MiniDV Camcorder Footage, overexposed warm yellow, Film Grain, VHS interference lines, fast-paced beat cuts 【Duration】15 seconds 【Scene】2000s American backyard pool party, scorching sun, blinding light spots on the water, folding lounge chairs, silver CD player, rainbow inflatable float, plastic whale 【Characters】A group of Y2K-styled girls: low-rise bikinis, belly chains, colorful plastic sunglasses, butterfly clips, glitter lip gloss [00:00-00:01.5] Shot 1: Bursting out of the water (Close-up / Pullback) DV startup blue screen flashes with a red REC dot. Extreme close-up—a girl in colorful plastic sunglasses bursts out from underwater, wet hair whipping a water arc (Slow-mo), water droplets splashing the lens, laughing at the DV, sunlight overexposed to pure white. [00:01.5-00:03] Shot 2: Poolside stroll (Low Angle / Right Pan) Low-angle waist-level right pan, three girls in sheer mesh cover-ups walk past wet tiles holding canned drinks, one taking a selfie with a flip phone, thick-soled flip-flops slapping. [00:03-00:04.5] Shot 3: Pushing someone into the pool (Dutch Angle) Dutch angle medium shot, a girl pushes her bestie into the pool from behind, a Coke can flies out, the person crashes into the water, water splashes explosively, the pusher laughs doubled over. [00:04.5-00:06] Shot 4: FPV dive (FPV Drone Dive) FPV swoops down from high, skimming the water surface, girls lying on floats sunbathing, one raises a disposable film camera and flashes at the lens. [00:06-00:07] Shot 5: Ice cubes into a cup (Macro / Still) Macro still frame, ice cubes fall into a plastic cup, orange liquid splashes up, the hand holding the cup wears colorful rubber bracelets, sunlight penetrates the liquid casting caustic light spots. [00:07-00:08.5] Shot 6: Hot dance tracking (Tracking / Backward Follow) Backward tracking locks on the face, a girl with wet hair plastered to her face and butterfly clips, wearing a woven bikini, sways through the crowd, hoop earrings swinging, smile looking straight into the lens. [00:08.5-00:10] Shot 7: Diving silhouette (Worm's Eye / Push-in) Worm's-eye view push-in, a girl leaps from the diving board into a silhouette, the sun bursts with lens flare, water droplets turn into specks of light in the air. [00:10-00:11.5] Shot 8: Clinking glasses (Close-up / Left Pan) Quick left pan, two girls raise red plastic cups and clink, liquid splashes out in a golden arc, laughing with squinted eyes. [00:11.5-00:13] Shot 9: DJ over-the-shoulder (OTS / Pull-in) Push in from behind the DJ, foreground fingers press a button on the silver CD player, background girls splash water wildly to the beat, backlit water becomes a golden rain curtain. [00:13-00:15] Shot 10: Golden wide shot freeze frame (Extreme Wide / Crane Rise) Crane rapidly ascends, the entire pool party unfolds in the warm golden hour light, full of people and inflatable toys, the water surface like scattered gold. Overlay DV timestamp '08/15/2000 PM 5:47', freeze frame flickering to simulate VHS pause.

zh.p:
【风格】千禧复古泳池派对（Y2K Pool Party），MiniDV摄像机质感（Camcorder Footage），过曝暖黄，胶片颗粒（Film Grain），VHS干扰线，快节奏卡点
【时长】15秒
【场景】2000年代美式后院泳池派对，烈日，水面光斑刺眼，折叠躺椅，银色CD播放器，彩虹充气浮排，塑料鲸鱼
【角色】一群Y2K造型女生：低腰比基尼、腰链（Belly Chain）、彩色塑料太阳镜、蝴蝶发夹（Butterfly Clips）、亮片唇彩
[00:00-00:01.5] 镜头1：出水炸开（Close-up / Pullback）
DV开机蓝屏闪过REC红点。怼脸特写——戴彩色塑料墨镜的女生从水下炸出，湿发甩出水弧（Slow-mo），水珠溅镜头，对着DV大笑，阳光过曝纯白。
[00:01.5-00:03] 镜头2：poolside巡游（Low Angle / Right Pan）
低角度腰高右摇，三个女生穿薄纱罩衫拿罐装饮料走过湿瓷砖，其中一个用翻盖手机自拍，厚底人字拖啪嗒作响。
[00:03-00:04.5] 镜头3：推人下水（Dutch Angle）
荷兰角中景，一个女生从背后推闺蜜入池，可乐罐飞出，人砸入水中，水花炸溅，推人的笑到弯腰。
[00:04.5-00:06] 镜头4：FPV俯冲（FPV Drone Dive）
FPV从高处俯冲掠过水面，女生们躺在浮排上晒太阳，有人举一次性胶片相机（Disposable Camera）对镜头闪光。
[00:06-00:07] 镜头5：冰块入杯（Macro / Still）
微距静帧，冰块落入塑料杯，橙色液体溅起，握杯的手戴彩色橡胶手环，阳光穿透液体投出焦散光斑。
[00:07-00:08.5] 镜头6：热舞跟拍（Tracking / Backward Follow）
后退跟拍锁脸，湿发贴脸戴蝴蝶发夹的女生穿编织比基尼在人群中扭动，圆环耳环晃动，笑容直视镜头。
[00:08.5-00:10] 镜头7：跳水剪影（Worm's Eye / Push-in）
蚁视角上推，女生从跳板腾空成剪影，太阳炸出眩光（Lens Flare），水珠在空中化为光点。
[00:10-00:11.5] 镜头8：碰杯（Close-up / Left Pan）
快速左摇，两个女生举红色塑料杯碰杯，液体溅出成金色水弧，笑得眯眼。
[00:11.5-00:13] 镜头9：DJ过肩（OTS / Pull-in）
DJ肩后推进，前景手指按银色CD播放器按钮，背景女生们跟节奏疯狂泼水，逆光水花成金色雨幕。
[00:13-00:15] 镜头10：黄金全景定格（Extreme Wide / Crane Rise）
摇臂急速拉升，整个泳池派对铺开在黄金时刻暖光中，全是人和充气玩具，水面碎金。叠入DV时间戳"08/15/2000 PM 5:47"，定格闪烁模拟VHS暂停。

Subject:
Subject 1: A cute and stylish skeleton girl. She wears a navy sailor-style jacket, a pink pleated skirt, and a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a small skull. Her skeleton fingers are highly flexible, delicate, and expressive. For consistency in appearance and character, please refer to reference image.
Environment:
A high-quality 3D miniature diorama with a whimsical, clay-animation style. A small white grand piano sits on a stage with a stone-like texture. Surrounding her are several friendly, glowing white ghosts with simple black eyes, shaped like draped fabric. A dreamlike blue architectural space. Warm, fantastical light emanates from the ghosts and small lanterns. Toy-like texture.
Mood:
Eccentric, elegant, and cozy, yet somewhat eerie. The performance is not chaotic but deliberate, creating a magical and graceful impression.
Timeline:
[00:00-00:02] Shot 1: Wide-angle POV, slow push-in. A skeletal girl sits elegantly at the white grand piano on the stone stage. She raises her skeletal hands, slightly tucks her posture, and after snapping her head up to look straight ahead, begins to play the keys smoothly. Audio: A beautiful, elegant classical piano intro.
[00:02-00:03] Shot 2: Hard cut to a medium shot. Stable movement via gimbal. She is in complete control of the melody. Her skeletal fingers press the keys with clear, legible movements in a flowing cycle, gliding smoothly across the surface. Friendly, glowing white ghosts sway and bounce gently in time with the music’s rhythm. Audio: A fast-paced, rhythmic classical piano melody syncs perfectly with her finger movements.
[00:03-00:07] Shot 3: Close-up, tracking slightly. Focus on her face and the piano keys. She concludes her performance with a dramatic finale and removes her hands from the keys as the ghosts begin to glow more brightly in the warm lighting. She turns toward the camera and nods gently. Audio: The final, elegant piano chord resonates, followed by a soft, magical chorus.

zh.p: 主题：主题1：一位可爱又时尚的骷髅女孩。她身穿海军风水手外套、粉色百褶裙，头戴装饰着小骷髅的宽檐帽。她的骷髅手指灵活纤细，富有表现力。为保持外观和角色一致性，请参考参考图。环境：一个高品质的3D微缩立体模型，带有奇妙的黏土动画风格。一座小型白色三角钢琴矗立在石质纹理的舞台上。她周围环绕着几个友善的、发光的白色幽灵，它们有着简单的黑色眼睛，形状如同垂坠的布料。梦幻般的蓝色建筑空间。温暖奇幻的光芒从幽灵和小灯笼中散发出来。玩具般的质感。氛围：古怪、优雅、舒适，又带点诡异。表演不显杂乱，而是从容有序，营造出神奇而优雅的印象。时间线：[00:00-00:02] 镜头1：广角视角，缓慢推进。骷髅女孩优雅地坐在石质舞台上的白色三角钢琴前。她抬起骷髅双手，微微收拢姿势，猛地抬头直视前方后，流畅地开始弹奏琴键。音频：优美优雅的古典钢琴前奏。[00:00-00:02] 镜头2：硬切至中景。通过稳定器保持平稳移动。她完全掌控着旋律。骷髅手指以清晰可辨的动作按压琴键，循环流畅，在琴键表面平滑滑动。友善发光的白色幽灵随着音乐节奏轻轻摇摆弹跳。音频：快节奏、有韵律的古典钢琴旋律与她的手指动作完美同步。[00:03-00:07] 镜头3：特写，轻微跟拍。聚焦于她的面部和钢琴琴键。她以戏剧性的终曲结束演奏，双手离开琴键，此时幽灵们在温暖灯光下开始更明亮地发光。她转向镜头，轻轻点头。音频：最终优雅的钢琴和弦回荡，随后是轻柔奇幻的和声。

Original Japanese-Style Dark Fantasy Action Short Film:

Inside a dilapidated shrine hall, a white-robed warrior and a black-armored samurai engage in their final battle amid an atmosphere reminiscent of ritual chanting. Wooden beams creak, paper screens tear apart, and fragments scatter as moonlight filters through drifting dust and smoke. Tatami mats are disrupted and scattered across the floor.

The camera alternates between high-angle overhead shots and low-angle upward perspectives, emphasizing the spatial depth of traditional Japanese architecture, the oppressive tension surrounding the characters, and the solemn intensity of a fateful duel—evoking the climactic moment of an original Japanese fantasy animated film.

A strong hook within the first 2 seconds, followed by a stable and cohesive progression. Fluid, continuous action with cinematic composition, realistic lighting and shadow, an epic atmosphere, intense emotional weight, and high-definition detail. Designed for social media engagement. Avoids copyrighted characters and brand logos, ensuring a completely original creation.

SHOT:
  camera_motion: tracking shot
  movement_dynamics: The camera stays anchored on the central silhouetted swordsman, executing fast micro-pans and sudden whip-pans to frame each incoming enemy from the darkness. The camera shakes violently on each high-impact flash to emphasize the kinetic energy and aggressive strobing rhythm of the scene.
ACTIONS:
  core_action: A heavily silhouetted man in a deep red cinematic void stands in a martial arts combat stance holding a katana. A sequence of massive, monstrous silhouetted enemies rushes him sequentially from the shadows: a hulking bipedal reptile, a giant mutated arachnid, a shadowy wraith with elongated claws, a towering armored brute wielding a heavy mace, and a ferocious winged gargoyle. The swordsman executes blazing, precise katana strikes with authentic momentum conservation. Exactly upon blade contact with each target, a powerful 1-frame white light flash explodes, momentarily overexposing the entire scene and freezing the exact point of impact. Between the strobing flashes, the environment instantly plunges back into deep red darkness, while the defeated monsters immediately dissolve into black smoke or drop out of frame. The sequence maintains a relentless, high-contrast, hyper-kinetic rhythm of shadows, precise physical strikes, and sudden blinding light.

zh.p: 镜头：摄影机运动为跟拍，动态表现为：镜头始终锁定中央剪影剑客，通过快速微摇和突发甩摇捕捉从黑暗中袭来的每个敌人。每次高冲击闪光时镜头剧烈震动，以强调场景的动能与频闪般的侵略性节奏。动作：核心动作为——深红电影虚空中，一个浓重剪影男子摆出持刀格斗架势。一连串庞大可怖的剪影敌人从阴影中依次冲向他：巨型双足爬行生物、变异巨蛛、利爪幽影、挥舞重锤的铠甲巨兽、以及凶悍翼魔。剑客以精准的动量守恒施展炽烈刀法。刀刃触及目标的瞬间，爆发强力单帧白光闪光，短暂过曝整个画面并冻结撞击点。在频闪间隙，环境瞬间坠回深红黑暗，被击败的怪物立即化为黑烟或跌出画框。整段序列保持 relentless 的高对比度、超动态节奏——暗影、精准物理打击与突发眩光交织。

A sequence of massive, monstrous silhouetted enemies rushes him sequentially from the shadows: a hulking bipedal reptile, a giant mutated arachnid, a shadowy wraith with elongated claws, a towering armored brute wielding a heavy mace, and a ferocious winged gargoyle. The swordsman executes blazing, precise katana strikes with authentic momentum conservation. Exactly upon blade contact with each target, a powerful 1-frame white light flash explodes, momentarily overexposing the entire scene and freezing the exact point of impact. Between the strobing flashes, the environment instantly plunges back into deep red darkness, while the defeated monsters immediately dissolve into black smoke or drop out of frame. The sequence maintains a relentless, high-contrast, hyper-kinetic rhythm of shadows, precise physical strikes, and sudden blinding light.

Scene 2 (4-8s): upward-angle close-up of Big Ben's clock face, ornate gold gothic details sharp, pink petals drifting across the frame and briefly covering the hands, clock ticks visibly.

en.p: A dramatic character gacha reveal sequence. Phase 1: Against a dark backdrop featuring a large calligraphic emblem and halftone dot pattern decorations matching the character's aesthetic, golden cross-shaped stars fly in from off-screen with lens flare light spikes, landing into a horizontal row with pulsating flash impacts. Multiple waves of white-gold explosions confirm the 5-star rarity. Phase 2: Hard cut to black, then the character fades in from darkness at center-right. Bold white text of their signature catchphrase appears center-frame with kinetic typography and cyan glow effects, glitch-frame borders in magenta and green flicker at screen edges. The character performs confident action poses while lightning effects arc from their weapons. Phase 3: Dynamic action sequence with extreme camera angles — low angle looking up at the character mid-leap, debris flying, motion blur conveying speed. The character unleashes their signature attack with yellow energy blasts. Camera orbits around them showing multiple dramatic angles with shallow depth of field. Phase 4: Explosive rapid-fire montage — the entire screen shifts to the character's theme color as a duotone filter. Hard cuts every 2-5 frames cycle through close-ups, silhouettes, and action poses. Bold typography of the character name animates in fragments between cuts. Diagonal stripe overlays, hazard tape motifs, and 1-frame flash impacts punctuate every transition. Phase 5: The montage instantly resolves into a clean final composition — character's full standing illustration on the left, calligraphic emblem upper-right, name plate lower-right, large golden rank letter lower-left, theme-colored digital particle accents floating around the character.

zh.p: 抽卡演出 一场戏剧化的角色抽卡揭示序列。阶段一：在深色背景上，搭配符合角色美学的大型书法徽章和半色调圆点图案装饰，金色十字星从画面外飞入，带有镜头光晕的闪光尖刺，落成一排水平线，伴随脉动闪光冲击。多波白金色爆炸确认五星稀有度。阶段二：硬切至黑屏，随后角色从黑暗中淡入，位于画面中央偏右。角色标志性台词的粗体白色文字出现在画面中央，带有动态排版和青色辉光效果，品红色和绿色的故障帧边框在屏幕边缘闪烁。角色摆出自信的动作姿势，武器上电弧闪烁。阶段三：动态动作序列，采用极端摄影角度——低角度仰拍角色腾空跃起，碎片飞溅，运动模糊表现速度感。角色释放标志性攻击，伴随黄色能量爆裂。镜头环绕角色，展示多个戏剧性角度，浅景深效果。阶段四：爆炸性快速蒙太奇——整个屏幕切换为角色的主题色，应用双色调滤镜。每2到5帧的硬切循环展示特写、剪影和动作姿势。角色名称的粗体排版在切换间以碎片形式动画呈现。对角线条纹叠加、警示带图案和单帧闪光冲击点缀每一次过渡。阶段五：蒙太奇瞬间收束为干净的最终构图——角色全身立绘位于左侧，书法徽章位于右上角，名牌位于右下角，大型金色等级字母位于左下角，主题色数字粒子点缀在角色周围浮动。

en.p:
Camera Simulation
Shot on 65mm IMAX film with a vintage anamorphic lens. Noticeable film grain, subtle gate weave, and soft halation on highlights. Occasional lens breathing subtly warps the image as the body mutates.

Lighting Style
A dead, fog-covered wasteland under a massive dim moon.
Moonlight is unnaturally cold, casting blue-gray tones across the entire scene.
As the transformation begins, a deep amber-gold light burns from inside his body, clashing with the cold lunar light.

Dual-tone lighting:
Outside: cold lunar blue
Inside: feral burning orange

Scene Description
A man (use the uploaded face as reference, preserve exact facial identity and features) stands alone in a misty, desolate landscape. The camera moves in a handheld, slow circular orbit around him. Wind howls softly through the fog.

He looks up at the moon—his expression tired, resisting something within. His breathing becomes heavier. His fingers twitch unnaturally.

His body suddenly begins to break—his spine jerks, bones shift visibly beneath the skin in a disturbing, organic motion. A low growl escapes his throat, not fully human. Veins darken, then pulse with a dim amber glow from within.

His fingernails crack and extend into rough, uneven claws.

The transformation intensifies violently. His jaw stretches forward painfully, not snapping instantly but distorting in a slow, agonizing motion. Teeth push through his gums. Thick fur erupts unevenly across his body—messy, dirty, mixed with sweat and blood.

His posture collapses forward into a half-beast stance. The camera shakes more aggressively, reacting to the energy and movement.

He is caught in a disturbing hybrid state—not fully human, not fully beast:
One arm fully wolf-like, the other still human but breaking apart.
His face is asymmetrical—one eye human, the other glowing with feral light.

Nearby metal debris subtly vibrates—not magnetically, but reacting to a primal energy frequency emanating from him. His chest glows faintly, as if something inside is trying to break out.

Then—final snap.

His body fully transforms into a towering werewolf:
Massive, muscular frame
Wet, matted fur
Heavy breath steaming in the cold air
Eyes reflecting cold moonlight mixed with inner fire

His silhouette stands against the moon.

Silence.

He slowly lowers his head—not in rage, but pure instinct. The camera holds close on his face. A subtle twitch.

Then suddenly—he bursts forward at extreme speed, vanishing into the fog.

zh.p:
摄影模拟：使用65毫米IMAX胶片搭配复古变形镜头拍摄。可见胶片颗粒、细微的片门抖动，以及高光部分的柔和光晕。随着身体变异，偶尔的镜头呼吸使画面产生微妙的扭曲。

光影风格：一片死寂、雾气笼罩的荒原，头顶悬着一轮巨大的暗月。月光带着非自然的冷冽，为整个场景染上蓝灰色调。当转变开始时，他体内燃起深琥珀色的金光，与冰冷的月光形成冲突。双色调光影：外部是冷冽的月蓝，内部是狂野的炽橙。

场景描述：一名男子（以上传的面部为参考，保持精确的面部特征与样貌）独自站在雾气弥漫的荒凉景色中。镜头以手持方式缓慢环绕他做圆周运动。风在雾中低啸。他抬头望向月亮——表情疲惫，仿佛在抗拒着体内的某种东西。他的呼吸变得沉重，手指不自然地抽搐。他的身体突然开始崩裂——脊柱猛地一抽，骨骼在皮肤下清晰可见地移位，呈现出令人不安的有机运动。一声低吼从他喉咙中逸出，已不完全属于人类。血管变暗，随后从内部透出微弱的琥珀色光芒。他的指甲裂开，延伸成粗糙不平的利爪。

转变急剧加剧。他的下颚痛苦地向前拉伸，并非瞬间断裂，而是以缓慢而痛苦的方式扭曲变形。牙齿从牙龈中刺出。浓密的毛发不均匀地爆发出来，覆盖全身——凌乱、肮脏，混杂着汗水和血液。他的姿势向前坍塌，形成半兽的站姿。镜头晃动得更加剧烈，仿佛在回应这股能量与动作。他陷入一种令人不安的混合状态——既非完全的人类，也非完全的野兽：一只手臂已完全狼化，另一只仍保持人形却正在崩解。他的面孔变得不对称——一只眼睛仍是人眼，另一只则闪烁着野兽的光芒。

附近的金属碎片微微震动——并非出于磁性，而是对他体内散发出的原始能量频率产生反应。他的胸膛发出微光，仿佛有什么东西正试图从中破体而出。

然后——最后一声脆响。他的身体完全变形，化作一头高大的狼人：庞大的肌肉身躯，湿漉漉的乱毛，沉重的呼吸在冷空气中蒸腾成白雾。双眼反射着冰冷的月光，其中又混合着内在的火焰。他的剪影映在月亮之上。

寂静。他缓缓低下头——并非出于愤怒，而是纯粹的原始本能。镜头紧贴他的面部。一丝细微的抽动。然后，突然——他以极快的速度向前猛冲，消失在迷雾之中。

en.p:
TITLE: NATURE’S CODE — THE VENOM THAT TARGETS CANCER

FORMAT:
Seedance 2.0 | 15s | 6 cinematic cuts | Hyper-real | Science storytelling

INTENT
Create a visually compelling, scientifically grounded narrative explaining how honeybee venom (melittin) interacts with cancer cells.
Tone must be educational, precise, and cinematic, avoiding exaggeration or cure claims.
Focus on mechanism, contrast, and visual clarity, not drama.

COMMON STYLE
Ultra macro cinematic realism, biological visualization, high-detail cell structures, slow motion fluid physics, dark medical tone, volumetric lighting, golden highlights (venom), deep blacks (tumor mass), microscopic world scale, documentary + cinematic hybrid

TIMELINE
CUT 1 (0:00–0:02.5)
Macro honeybee in slow motion → transition into microscopic scale
VO: “Nature builds weapons… we are only beginning to understand.”
SFX: soft ambient hum

CUT 2 (0:02.5–0:05)
Venom particles (melittin) flowing through bloodstream
VO: “A single peptide… melittin.”
SFX: fluid motion

CUT 3 (0:05–0:07.5)
Tumor cells appear, irregular and unstable
VO: “Targets the most aggressive cancer cells…”
SFX: low tension tone

CUT 4 (0:07.5–0:10)
Melittin binds to cell membrane → pores form → membrane rupture
VO: “Breaking their defenses… from within.”
SFX: micro crackle

CUT 5 (0:10–0:12.5)
Cell collapses → signaling fades
VO: “Interrupting the signals that fuel growth.”
SFX: fading electrical tone

CUT 6 (0:12.5–0:15)
Healthy cells remain intact
VO: “Precision… not force.”
SFX: soft resolve

FINAL FRAME:
Black screen
Text: “Research is ongoing.”

zh.p:
标题：自然的密码——靶向癌症的毒液
格式：Seedance 2.0 | 15秒 | 6个电影级镜头 | 超写实 | 科学叙事
意图：打造一个视觉震撼、科学严谨的叙事，解释蜜蜂毒液（蜂毒肽）如何与癌细胞相互作用。语气需兼具教育性、精确性和电影感，避免夸张或声称能治愈。聚焦机制、对比和视觉清晰度，而非戏剧性。
通用风格：超微距电影写实主义、生物可视化、高细节细胞结构、慢动作流体物理、暗黑医学色调、体积光效、金色高光（毒液）、深黑色（肿瘤团块）、微观世界尺度、纪录片与电影混合风格
时间线
镜头1（0:00–0:02.5）：慢动作宏观蜜蜂 → 过渡到微观尺度
旁白：“自然锻造武器……我们才刚刚开始理解。”
音效：柔和的背景嗡鸣
镜头2（0:02.5–0:05）：毒液颗粒（蜂毒肽）在血液中流动
旁白：“一种单一的肽……蜂毒肽。”
音效：流体运动声
镜头3（0:05–0:07.5）：肿瘤细胞出现，形态不规则且不稳定
旁白：“瞄准最具侵袭性的癌细胞……”
音效：低紧张度音调
镜头4（0:07.5–0:10）：蜂毒肽与细胞膜结合 → 形成孔隙 → 膜破裂
旁白：“从内部……打破它们的防御。”
音效：微爆裂声
镜头5（0:10–0:12.5）：细胞崩塌 → 信号消失
旁白：“中断滋养生长的信号。”
音效：渐弱的电子音
镜头6（0:12.5–0:15）：健康细胞保持完整
旁白：“精准……而非蛮力。”
音效：柔和的解决音
最终画面：黑屏
文字：“研究仍在进行中。”

Story: A lone red exploration robot enters an abandoned overgrown bio-luminescent garden searching for a faint energy signal.

0–2s: Wide shot, robot enters gate, slow push-in.
2–4s: Close-up, sensors flicker, signal detected deeper inside.
4–6s: Action cut, fast movement through glowing plants, foliage reacts.
6–8s: Reveal shot, glowing flower appears in center clearing.

Original Sci-Fi Dark Comedy Action Short Film: Inside a high-tech experimental laboratory filled with glowing glass tubes, holographic screens, and flickering neon panels, a white-clad orange cat patient (wearing a full-body hospital gown with a white bandage wrapped around its forehead) frantically sprints between metallic workstations, pursued by a relentless hyena in a black suit and dark sunglasses. The environment hums with synthetic energy as alarms flash red. The orange cat dodges at high speed, knocking over fragile instruments, sending sparks and chemical fluids spilling across the glossy floor. The hyena charges forward undeterred, stepping through the chaos with predatory precision. The camera alternates between dynamic tracking shots and tight close-ups, emphasizing the claustrophobic intensity and futuristic atmosphere, like the climactic chase of an original animated sci-fi thriller.

At the peak of the chase, the orange cat suddenly stops, spins, and tosses a chicken bone high into the air. In a split second, the hyena’s fierce expression collapses into greedy distraction, eyes locked upward. Seizing the moment, the orange cat presses a button on a smartphone—instantly, a hidden net deploys from the ceiling, trapping the hyena mid-leap. The lab falls silent except for faint electrical buzzing. The orange cat slowly turns toward the camera, straightens its posture, and flashes a smug, victorious grin.

A powerful hook within the first 2 seconds, stable pacing with escalating tension, coherent action choreography, cinematic composition, realistic lighting and reflections on metallic surfaces, a blend of suspense and humor, high-definition detail, expressive character animation, and an original, highly shareable concept designed for social media impact.
en.t: Cat Outsmarts Hyena in Sci-Fi Lab

en.p:
0–2s

Handheld shaky tracking close-up, wind swirling hard, red tentacles floating around her, camera unstable and breathing.

2–4s

Tentacles suddenly snap and wrap tightly around her body from behind, pulling her upward slightly as she reacts instantly, her body jerking and resisting, movements sharp and uncontrolled.

4–6s

A deep alien voice echoes: “Serve us… conquer the Earth… and the power you seek will be yours.” Her body stiffens violently as energy surges through her, red glow spreading across her skin while she begins to struggle harder, shaking and twisting as if fighting the force.

6–8s

Camera circles her rapidly in handheld motion as transformation begins — her body convulses, movements erratic, she tries to pull away but fails. Her skin starts shifting unevenly, forming darker, thicker organic layers while she writhes in visible tension.

8–10s

Extreme close-up: her skin rapidly changes into layered, organic, slightly glossy textures, forming scale-like patterns. The transformation is unstable and reactive, surface moving like living tissue while she trembles and gasps.

10–11.5s

Cut to side/back shot: tall alien silhouettes move slowly around her, observing while she struggles violently, her body still twitching and resisting within the tentacles.

11.5–13s

Cut to front: tentacles suddenly retract sharply, releasing her mid-motion. She drops heavily to her knees, catching herself with unstable movement, breathing fast, body still twitching from the transformation.

13–15s

Handheld close-up pushes toward her face as the final transformation completes her facial structure shifts into an alien form with organic interconnected textures, surfaces stretching and reforming fluidly. She lifts her head slowly, then lets out a sharp hiss, revealing rows of sharp, unnatural teeth. Her eyes darken, expression turning predatory as the camera shakes subtly in front of her.

zh.p: 0-2秒 手持摇晃跟拍特写，狂风猛烈呼啸，红色触手在她周围飘动，镜头不稳且带有呼吸感。2-4秒 触手突然弹射并紧紧缠绕住她的身体，从背后将她微微向上提起，她瞬间做出反应，身体猛地抽搐挣扎，动作剧烈且失控。4-6秒 低沉的外星人声音回荡：“为我们效劳……征服地球……你渴望的力量将属于你。”她的身体猛然僵直，能量涌遍全身，红色光芒在皮肤上蔓延，她开始更激烈地挣扎，扭动翻转仿佛在与那股力量对抗。6-8秒 镜头以手持方式快速环绕她，变形开始——她的身体痉挛抽搐，动作紊乱，试图挣脱却徒劳无功。皮肤开始不均匀地变化，形成更暗沉、更厚重的有机层，她痛苦扭动，张力清晰可见。8-10秒 极端特写：她的皮肤迅速转变为层叠、有机、略带光泽的质感，形成鳞片状纹路。变形过程不稳定且具有反应性，表面像活体组织般蠕动，她颤抖着喘息。10-11.5秒 切至侧面/背面镜头：高大的外星人轮廓缓慢围住她，观察着她激烈挣扎，她的身体仍在触手中抽搐抵抗。11.5-13秒 切至正面：触手突然猛烈收缩，在半空中松开她。她重重跪倒在地，动作不稳地撑住身体，呼吸急促，身体因变形仍在抽搐。13-15秒 手持特写镜头推近她的面部，最终变形完成——她的面部结构转变为外星形态，带有有机互联的纹理，表面拉伸并流畅重塑。她缓缓抬起头，随即发出一声尖锐的嘶鸣，露出成排锋利怪异的牙齿。双眼暗沉，表情变得充满掠食性，镜头在她面前微微晃动。

en.p: Original oceanic fantasy fashion short film, purely artistic visual expression, aesthetic, serene, dreamlike, and sophisticated. The scene is an abstract ocean-inspired space with a clean, pure dark background. The only light in the frame comes from the texture of the clothing and a few glowing oceanic particles, creating a soft and restrained overall effect. The main color palette consists of cool cyan, soft purple, and pale gold, with delicate and airy glowing effects that emphasize a futuristic, high-fashion aesthetic. A tall original fashion character, wearing an original long gown, moves slowly through a calm, open ocean-inspired scene. The outfit is made of lightweight, layered materials with a softly flowing luminous texture that shifts naturally with movement. The hem and ribbons gently unfurl in the flowing environment, surrounded by a few floating fluorescent particles and small glowing fish. The frame is pure, and the rhythm is soothing. The camera starts with a steady long shot, slowly pushing in to reveal the overall composition of the character and scene; then transitions to a close-up side tracking shot, highlighting the fabric texture, glowing lines, flowing patterns, and delicate reflections. Following this, a top-down shot slowly descends as the character pauses, arms naturally extended, and the outer layer of the gown gradually opens, forming an elegant silhouette reminiscent of an ocean flower. In the ending, the character enters a light floating state, with the gown fully extended, surrounded by a few glowing particles, jellyfish-like light shapes, and soft schools of fish moving slowly around. The frame freezes in a beautiful, pure, and surreal oceanic fashion moment. Keywords: original character, original costume, oceanic fantasy, artistic fashion, aesthetic slow motion, glowing texture, light floating, pure visual storytelling, safe and neutral expression.

一位高挑原创时尚角色身着原创长裙，缓慢行进在平缓开阔的海洋灵感场景中。服装由轻薄层叠材质构成，表面带有柔和流动的发光纹理，随着动作自然变化。裙摆与飘带在流动环境中轻轻展开，周围漂浮少量荧光粒子与小型发光鱼群，画面纯净，节奏舒缓。

en.p: Style and Atmosphere: Apocalyptic naval destruction, dominated by low-saturation steel blue and gunmetal gray, with explosion amber and aviation fuel flames piercing the gray domain. Overhead storm-layer cumulonimbus clouds illuminated by lightning from within. Rain cuts across all surfaces. Telephoto compression layers destruction upon destruction. Realistic texture with violent aesthetics—no clean CG gloss, only grit, weight, and mass. Dynamic Description: A drone aerial shot pulls back from an extreme long view—a supercarrier catastrophically lists to port in towering waves, its flight deck tilted beyond forty-five degrees, seawater flooding the deck surface in a thin white film. Three fighter jets simultaneously break free from their tie-down chains, sliding sideways across the wet steel deck, landing gear scraping metal and sparking in bursts. The first jet tumbles over the deck edge and plunges into the churning gray sea. Cut to a handheld medium shot at water level looking up—the carrier's hull looms like a collapsing skyscraper overhead, barnacle-covered steel plates groan and bend, rivets pop out in rapid succession like gunfire, structural cracks split open from the midsection, and shockwaves ripple across the metal skin. Seawater pours in through the expanding fissures. Cut to a stable, wide-angle tracking shot circling around—the carrier breaks in two at the fracture point, the bow diving forward into a massive swell, the stern rising skyward, exposing propeller groups still spinning in the air, tons of seawater cascading off the elevated stern in waterfalls. Aviation fuel ignites on the sea surface—flames spread in an expanding ring across the water, black smoke columns twist upward into the storm. An anomalous twenty-meter-high wave surges in from the left side of the frame, slamming into the tilted bow, white spray exploding sixty meters into the air, engulfing the entire forward structure. Static Description: Catastrophic structural failure of a Nimitz-class supercarrier. North Atlantic storm sea conditions—fifteen-meter swells, horizontal rain, sixty-knot winds whipping wave crests into mist. Thunderstorm cloud base at three hundred meters with internal lightning illumination. Flight deck littered with loose fighters, broken tie-down chains, and flooding seawater. Midsection fracture exposes internal deck layers. Aviation fuel burns on the sea surface. An anomalous giant wave approaches from port.

zh.p: {"lang":"zh","prompt":"风格与氛围：末日级海军覆灭，以低饱和钢蓝与炮铜灰为主色调，爆炸琥珀与航空燃油烈焰刺破灰域。压顶风暴层积雷暴云内部被闪电照亮。雨线切割所有表面。长焦压缩将毁灭层层叠加。实拍质感暴力美学——无干净CG光泽，只有砂砾、重量与质量。动态描述：航拍无人机极远景后拉——一艘超级航母在滔天巨浪中向左舷灾难性倾斜，飞行甲板倾角超过四十五度，海水以白浪薄膜状态漫灌甲板表面。三架战斗机同时挣脱系留链锁，沿湿滑钢板横向滑移，起落架刮擦金属迸射火花串，第一架战机翻越甲板边缘坠入翻搅灰色海面。硬切至水面高度手持中景仰望——航母船体如崩塌摩天楼般耸立头顶，藤壶覆盖的钢板呻吟弯曲，铆钉如连发枪响般依次弹射，结构性裂缝从舰体中段劈开，可见冲击波沿金属表皮涟漪扩散。海水从扩张裂口倾泻灌入。切至稳定环绕广角跟拍——航母在断裂点一分为二，舰艏向前俯冲扎入巨型涌浪，舰艉翘向天空暴露出仍在空气中旋转的螺旋桨组，数吨海水从抬升舰艉倾泻而下形成瀑布群。航空燃油在海面点燃——火焰以扩张环形在水面蔓延，黑色烟柱扭曲上升钻入风暴。一道二十米高异常巨浪从画面左侧涌入，正面撞击倾斜舰艏，白色浪花爆炸至六十米高空，将整个前部结构吞没。静态描述：尼米兹级超级航母灾难性结构失效。北大西洋风暴海况——十五米涌浪、水平暴雨、六十节狂风将浪尖吹成水雾。雷暴云底三百米并伴有内部闪电照明。飞行甲板散落脱锁战机、断裂系留链、漫灌海水。舰体中段断裂暴露内部甲板层。航空燃油在海面燃烧。异常巨浪从左舷逼近。"}

en.p: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic video of a colossal, mountain-sized lobster emerging from the turquoise waters of Venice's Grand Canal. The lobster rises directly in front of the ornate Doge's Palace, its massive red and orange claws lifting toward a moody, overcast sky. Waves crash violently against the Gothic arches of the palace, sending white sea spray into the air. Show the lobster’s shell glistening with wet textures and detailed barnacle-like patterns. Include dynamic camera movement: start with a wide-angle establishing shot of the Grand Canal, then slowly zoom in on the lobster as it towers over the palace. Natural, diffused lighting with realistic reflections on the water and building. Epic scale, photorealistic, surrealism, dramatic, and suspenseful atmosphere.

en.p: Bullet time effect. A businessman in white shirt and black tie slipping and falling backwards on icy wet street in Wall Street, New York. Coffee cup standing on ground, liquid exploding outward frozen in mid-air. Ice chunks, water droplets, and coffee splash all completely suspended — time is frozen. Tall buildings on both sides creating a canyon effect. Camera smoothly orbits 360 degrees around the falling man at low ground level angle, only the camera moves while everything else remains perfectly still. Cinematic, overcast dramatic lighting, wide angle lens distortion.

en.p:
Cinematic dark comedy adventure shot on Arri Alexa 35 with handheld jitter, exaggerated reaction shots, and punchy fast-cut editing, featuring moody torch lighting, dusty particle VFX, and a claustrophobic ancient pyramid atmosphere.

S1: Low-angle tracking shot as an orange cat explorer in an Indiana Jones-style outfit leads a line of nervous cat apprentices holding flickering torches into a narrow pyramid corridor, shadows dancing wildly on the walls.
S2: Close-up of the orange cat’s confident smirk as he raises a paw dramatically, signaling the team forward, dust drifting in the torchlight.
S3: Wide handheld shot revealing a hidden burial chamber filled with ancient coffins and gold relics, the cats’ torchlight barely illuminating the vast darkness.
S4: Insert shot of a trembling apprentice cat accidentally brushing against a carved stone pedestal, triggering a subtle “click” echoing ominously.
S5: Medium shot of a massive Egyptian sarcophagus slowly creaking open, lid sliding aside with a deep grinding sound.
S6: Extreme close-up of glowing eyes snapping open inside the coffin—wrapped bandages shifting.
S7: Whip pan as a towering mummy gray bear bursts upright from the coffin, bandages unraveling, letting out a deep, absurdly loud roar.
S8: Rapid chaotic handheld shots of all cats screaming and scrambling, torches flailing, sparks flying as they run in different directions.
S9: Close-up of one apprentice slipping and slamming into a wall lever by accident—CLACK!
S10: Wide shot of a massive stone door dropping instantly, sealing the chamber with a thunderous BOOM, cutting off the escaping cats.
S11: Silence. Pitch black. Only faint breathing echoes in the darkness.
S12: Close-up in darkness as a tiny flame flickers—orange cat nervously lights a small lighter, illuminating his uneasy face.
S13: Slow push-in as the flame reveals the massive mummy gray bear standing inches away, both frozen, staring directly at each other.
S14: Extreme close-up split-second beat—wide eyes from both the orange cat and the bear.
S15: Sudden explosive reaction—both scream at the exact same time and violently jump backward in perfect sync, knocking over ancient artifacts in a chaotic comedic crash.

zh.p: 一部电影感黑色喜剧冒险片，采用Arri Alexa 35拍摄，手持镜头带抖动，夸张反应镜头，快节奏剪辑，搭配阴郁火炬光效、尘埃粒子特效，营造古墓幽闭氛围。S1：低角度跟拍镜头，一只穿着印第安纳·琼斯风格服装的橙色猫探险家，带领一队紧张兮兮的猫学徒，手持摇曳火炬，走进狭窄的金字塔走廊，墙上阴影狂舞。S2：特写镜头，橙色猫自信地咧嘴一笑，戏剧性地抬起爪子，示意队伍前进，火炬光中尘埃飘浮。S3：宽幅手持镜头，揭示一个隐藏的墓室，里面满是古棺和金器，猫们的火炬光勉强照亮无边的黑暗。S4：插入镜头，一只颤抖的学徒猫不小心碰到一个石雕基座，触发一声不祥的“咔哒”回响。S5：中景镜头，一具巨大的埃及石棺缓缓嘎吱打开，棺盖滑向一侧，发出深沉的摩擦声。S6：极端特写，棺材内闪烁的眼睛猛然睁开——裹尸布在移动。S7：快速摇镜，一具高大的灰色熊木乃伊从棺材中猛地站起，绷带散开，发出低沉而荒谬的震天怒吼。S8：快速混乱的手持镜头，所有猫尖叫着四散奔逃，火炬乱舞，火花飞溅。S9：特写镜头，一只学徒猫滑倒，意外撞上墙上的杠杆——咔哒！S10：宽幅镜头，一扇巨大的石门瞬间落下，伴随着雷鸣般的轰隆声封住墓室，切断了逃跑的猫们。S11：寂静。一片漆黑。只有微弱的呼吸声在黑暗中回荡。S12：黑暗中特写，一小簇火焰闪烁——橙色猫紧张地点燃一个打火机，照亮了他不安的脸。S13：缓慢推进镜头，火焰映出巨大的灰色熊木乃伊近在咫尺，两者僵住，直直对视。S14：极端特写，瞬间定格——橙色猫和熊都瞪大双眼。S15：突然爆发式反应——两者同时尖叫，同步向后猛跳，撞翻古代文物，引发一场混乱搞笑的碰撞。

en.p: Three anime girls (left: short black hair with horn accessories, black-cyan-magenta cyberpunk outfit; center: long silver-white hair, red eyes, black dress; right: red ponytail, blue eyes, white outfit) stand still as holographic wireframe CG objects surrounding them crack and explode into cyan particle dust over 6 seconds — fragments scatter outward like shattered glass. Stage clears to pure black. Girls walk slowly to center, forming back-to-back triangle, heads tilted up, eyes closed. Overhead single white spotlight narrows to illuminate only them. LED floor pulses one final triangle ripple outward from their feet. At 10 seconds hard cut to extreme close-up of center girl, silver hair flowing across face, single cyan light-streak crossing her red eye like a tear. Headset mic glows faintly. Dead silence framing. 15 seconds.

zh.p: 三位动漫少女（左：黑色短发配角状饰品，身着黑青品红赛博朋克装束；中：银白长发，红瞳，黑裙；右：红色马尾辫，蓝眼，白衣）静立不动，周围的全息线框CG物体在6秒内碎裂爆炸，化作青色粒子尘埃——碎片如碎玻璃般向外飞散。舞台渐暗至纯黑。少女们缓步走向中央，背靠背形成三角阵型，仰头闭目。头顶单束白色聚光灯收窄，仅照亮她们三人。LED地板从她们脚下脉冲出最后一道三角波纹。第10秒时硬切至中央少女的特写镜头，银发拂过面庞，一道青色光痕如泪痕般划过她的红瞳。头戴式麦克风微微发光。死寂的静默定格。15秒。

en.p:
Travel documentary footage of Japan, shot on Sony A7 IV,  natural film grain, photorealistic, no CGI, no stylization.

  [0-3s] A real weathered red torii gate at night. Camera starts  ground-level at the base of the gate looking up — then rapidly  orbits 180 degrees around the torii post, accelerating as it  swings, revealing the misty stone steps and orange lantern glow  on the other side. The movement is fast and sweeping.  

[3-6s] A narrow Kyoto backstreet at night. Camera bursts forward  at high speed down the alley in a fast dolly rush — wooden machiya  houses and red lanterns blur past on both sides. A woman in a dark  kimono steps aside. Camera tilts sharply upward mid-rush to reveal  the sky framed between the rooftops, then snaps back down.  

[6-9s] Shibuya scramble crossing at night. Camera starts low in  the crowd, spins 360 degrees fast at hip level — people and neon  signs streak past — then rapidly cranes straight up into the air,  rising fast to reveal the full intersection below. The spin-to-rise  transition is sudden and energetic. 

 [9-12s] A shinkansen N700 bullet train. Camera holds static for a  split second — then the train BLASTS past at full speed inches from  the lens, the shockwave shaking the frame violently. Camera  immediately whips to track it from behind, accelerating to match  speed, rice fields streaking. 

 [12-15s] Wide aerial Tokyo at dusk. Camera starts in tight on city  streets, then rockets upward fast — buildings shrinking rapidly —  spinning slightly as it rises, until the full Tokyo bay and Mount  Fuji horizon are revealed. Camera decelerates and holds the grand  final frame steady.  Audio style: High-energy EDM, hard synth drops, 140BPM, bass hit  on each camera snap. No text, subtitles, watermarks, or logos. Quality: photorealistic, natural textures, real locations, fluid  motion. Avoid: CGI look, artificial lighting, slow or static camera.
en.t: Japan Night Rush: Fast Camera Moves

zh.p: 日本旅行纪录片画面，使用索尼A7 IV拍摄，自然胶片颗粒感，照片级真实感，无CGI特效，无风格化处理。[0-3秒] 夜晚一座真实斑驳的红色鸟居。镜头从鸟居底部地面仰拍——随后快速环绕鸟居立柱旋转180度，摆动时加速，露出另一侧雾气弥漫的石阶与橙色灯笼的微光。运动快速而流畅。[3-6秒] 京都夜晚的狭窄后巷。镜头以高速向前冲刺，沿小巷快速推轨——木质町屋和红色灯笼在两侧模糊掠过。一位身着深色和服的女子侧身避让。镜头在冲刺中猛然向上倾斜，露出屋顶间框住的天空，随即迅速回落。[6-9秒] 夜晚的涩谷十字路口。镜头从人群中低角度开始，在腰部高度快速旋转360度——人群和霓虹灯牌飞掠而过——随后迅速向上直升高空，快速升起，露出下方完整的十字路口。从旋转到升起的过渡突然而充满活力。[9-12秒] 新干线N700系列车。镜头静止片刻——随后列车以全速从镜头前几英寸处呼啸而过，冲击波使画面剧烈震动。镜头立即甩向后方追踪列车，加速至同步速度，稻田飞掠而过。[12-15秒] 黄昏时东京的广阔航拍。镜头从城市街道的特写开始，随后快速向上拉升——建筑迅速缩小——上升时轻微旋转，直至露出完整的东京湾和富士山天际线。镜头减速并稳定在最终宏大画面上。音频风格：高能量电子舞曲，硬核合成器音效，140BPM，每次镜头切换时重低音击打。无文字、字幕、水印或标志。质量：照片级真实感，自然纹理，真实场景，流畅运动。避免：CGI效果，人工照明，缓慢或静态镜头。

en.p:
A moonlit piano chase where the mouse
turns the whole instrument into a trap.

What happens The mouse runs across piano keys, making playful notes. 

The cat stalks across the piano lid. The cat lunges, but the mouse slips into the piano. 

The cat gets nearly caught by the closing lid. Inside the piano, the mouse runs through strings and hammers. The cat’s tail gets plucked like an instrument. 

The cat crashes into the keyboard section, causing a chaotic musical explosion. Final gag: the mouse presses one neat final note while the cat pops out wearing sheet music on its head.

zh.p: 月光下的钢琴追逐战，老鼠把整架乐器变成了陷阱。故事是这样的：老鼠在琴键上奔跑，奏出俏皮的音符。猫悄悄爬过琴盖，猛地扑向老鼠，但老鼠溜进了钢琴里。猫差点被合上的琴盖夹住。在钢琴内部，老鼠穿梭于琴弦和音锤之间。猫的尾巴被拨动，像乐器般发出声响。猫撞进键盘区，引发了一场混乱的音乐爆炸。最后的笑点是：老鼠按下一个干净利落的尾音，而猫顶着一张乐谱纸从钢琴里冒了出来。

en.p:
Create a fast, seamless 16:9 flying POV sequence with five linked shots.
Shot 1: Start inside a dark ancient stone corridor with a wooden door at the far end. Fly straight toward it at high speed. As the camera reaches the door, it begins to swing open, revealing a gap of bright blue ocean behind it. End mid-opening.
Shot 2: Continue through the opening door into the ocean. Fly forward through fish, bubbles, light rays, and underwater plants. A giant fish approaches and opens its mouth directly in front of the camera. End inside its mouth.
Shot 3: The darkness inside the fish’s mouth becomes the dark interior of a large stainless steel kitchen hood or service opening. Fly forward into a busy high-end restaurant kitchen with chefs, flames, steam, pans, and plated dishes. Fly low over the counter. End with the glowing opening of a large industrial oven filling the frame.
Shot 4: Continue into the glowing oven as it transforms into a volcanic lava tunnel with molten light and black rock. Fly through the tunnel. End with a bright circular stone opening filling the frame.
Shot 5: Continue through the circular opening into a Mediterranean cliffside village above the sea. Fly fast between terraces, rooftops, arches, and sunlit walls toward the ocean. End with a wide sea-facing reveal.
Fast, smooth, continuous movement. No flying device, shadow, or reflection. Cinematic.

zh.p: 制作一个快速、无缝衔接的16:9飞行视角镜头序列，包含五个连贯镜头。镜头1：从一条黑暗的古老石廊开始，远端有一扇木门。以高速径直飞向木门。当镜头抵达门时，门开始向外打开，露出门后一片明亮的蓝色海洋。在门半开时结束。镜头2：穿过正在打开的门进入海洋。向前飞行，穿过鱼群、气泡、光束和水下植物。一条巨大的鱼迎面游来，在镜头正前方张开嘴。在鱼嘴内结束。镜头3：鱼嘴内的黑暗转变为大型不锈钢厨房排烟罩或服务通道的黑暗内部。向前飞入一个繁忙的高端餐厅厨房，厨师、火焰、蒸汽、平底锅和摆盘菜肴映入眼帘。低空飞过操作台。以充满画面的大型工业烤箱发光开口结束。镜头4：继续飞入发光的烤箱，它转变为熔岩隧道，充满熔岩光芒和黑色岩石。穿过隧道飞行。以充满画面的明亮圆形石洞开口结束。镜头5：穿过圆形开口进入地中海悬崖上的海边村庄。在露台、屋顶、拱门和阳光照耀的墙壁之间快速飞向大海。以开阔的海景收尾。快速、流畅、持续的运动。无飞行器、阴影或倒影。电影级质感。

en.p: 100% real human texture, Hollywood IMAX blockbuster quality, natural lighting, cold and stark documentary style, overcast natural light, full handheld one-shot, breathing-like camera shake, random focus and defocus, 16:9 widescreen. [Scene Environment] A destroyed city street stretching into the distance. On both sides are ruined concrete buildings with exposed rebar, broken windows, some still burning, with orange flames and black smoke rising. Abandoned cars are scattered on the cracked asphalt road, several of which are on fire. The sky is gloomy gray, with dust and smoke suspended in the air. Multiple meteorites streak across the sky, trailing flames and thick smoke. In the background, terrified civilians flee in all directions among the ruins, some falling, others dragging the wounded. [Main Character] A Chinese beauty with deep red hair tied into a loose, messy bun, with a few strands hanging by her face. Fair skin, sharp features, a defined jawline, natural makeup with detailed eye makeup. Attire: a black long leather trench coat over a black tank top, a black denim micro skirt, black flat combat boots, no belt, and black tech-style gauntlets on both hands. Her expression is tense and restrained, with a hint of pain, brows slightly furrowed—her eyes filled with despair and strong will. [15-Second One-Shot: Awakening Strike Version] 0-2 seconds: Awakening. Low-angle upward shot, framing her upper body and face, looking up at her standing alone in the middle of the destroyed street. The wind blows her black leather trench coat. She opens her lips and screams in Japanese: 'Kakuseishiro!' She suddenly opens her right hand, and the black tech gauntlet crackles. Purple crystal-like arcs burst from her arm and gauntlet. The air compresses inward, space distorts and warps. The shockwave emits a low sonic boom. Purple rune lines emerge and revolve around her body. 2-5 seconds: Eruption. The camera begins to orbit around her. Dark gold cracks burst open on her chest, and thick golden liquid gushes out like blood. She screams in agony. Purple mist and fine arcs of electricity shoot outward. All her clothing tears and explodes from the inside, each piece burning to ash—leaving nothing. Organic armor fragments blast outward, then unnaturally retract and reattach to her body. Purple lines symmetrically spread across her face. A crack splits open on her cheek, revealing pulsing purple light beneath. At the same time, multiple mechanical arm-like appendages violently burst from her back—dark metallic texture, blade-shaped, spreading out like demon wings. Sparks, blue arcs, and golden energy particles explode from the eruption point. The camera captures the full spread from behind—her silhouette against the gray sky, the mechanical appendages fanning out. The eruption sound is like tearing metal mixed with electrical discharge. 5-8 seconds: Growth. Organic matter seeps from within her body, the surface shimmering with iridescent luster. White armor plates clash and fuse, leaving burn marks. The armor extends downward, covering her legs, and the flat combat boots are completely engulfed and replaced, forming white and dark purple armored boots, locking into place with tiny sparks. She grits her teeth and lets out a pained roar. The core on her chest flickers like dying embers. Purple-black metal spreads over her face, forming an uneven mask, with the left eye covered before the right. Compound eyes begin to take shape, with liquid light media flickering irregularly. The camera continues to orbit around her. 8-12 seconds: Completion. The camera slowly continues its orbit. The mask fully seals. Horn-like structures grow upward from the top of her head, burning with purple-gold flames. One compound eye glows steadily, while the other flickers with unstable electrical currents. The armor is a mix of white and dark purple, uneven and battle-worn, with glowing purple cracks oozing light fluid. The mechanical appendages sway slightly behind her. Each armor piece locks into place with a crisp metallic click, followed by layered mechanical settling sounds. She slowly lowers her head to examine her hands—the white and dark purple armored gauntlets emit purple light from the knuckles. She slowly raises her head to look straight ahead, and her compound eyes suddenly flare up fully. 12-15 seconds: Supersonic Charge. The camera rapidly pulls back. She pushes off the ground, the asphalt instantly shattering into a deep crater, a violent purple energy explosion spreading from the launch point, sending rubble and asphalt fragments flying into the air. She launches into the air at supersonic speed, charging straight toward the camera—a cone-shaped sonic boom mist forms behind her, the mechanical appendages flattened backward by the airflow, creating intense motion blur. Her figure grows larger and closer, filling the entire frame. A purple energy trail drags behind her. In the final frame, her armored faceplate nearly hits the lens, her compound eyes glowing bright red, and the screen cuts abruptly to black. [Environmental Sounds] Low sonic boom during awakening, tearing metal and electrical discharge sounds, agonized screams, crisp metallic clicks, heavy metallic sounds of mechanical appendages unfolding, background crackling of fires and distant explosions, the final supersonic charge accompanied by the launch point explosion, sonic boom impact, and the rapidly approaching wind pressure sound, then everything falls silent as the screen cuts to black. [Physical Texture Enhancement] Realistic lighting, visible skin texture on the face before transformation, visible wear and tear on the leather trench coat before transformation. Mechanical appendages have physical weight and inertia—they sway slightly after unfolding, not rigidly still. Armor plates are a mix of white and dark purple, with visible scratches, weld marks, and uneven edges—not clean and smooth. All movements are steady and powerful, filled with pain but determination—she awakens while enduring. Occasional slight camera shake, a genuine handheld tracking feel. [Sound Design] From the screaming activation to the explosive mechanical burst, building up to the launch point explosion and the sonic boom of the supersonic charge, then abruptly cutting into silence. The entire sequence exudes absolute power. Only sound effects are generated, no music.

zh.p:
100%真人实拍质感，好莱坞IMAX大片质感，自然光影，冷峻纪实风格，阴天自然光，全程手持一镜到底，呼吸感晃动，随机焦点失焦，16:9宽屏。
【场景环境】
一条延伸至远方的被摧毁的城市街道。两侧是废墟混凝土建筑，钢筋外露，窗户破碎，部分建筑仍在燃烧，橙色火光与黑烟升腾。废弃汽车散落在开裂的沥青路面上，其中数辆正在燃烧。阴沉灰色天空，烟尘悬浮于空气中。多颗陨石拖着火焰与浓烟尾迹划过天际。背景中惊恐的平民在废墟间四散奔逃，有人跌倒，有人拖拽伤员。
【主体人物】
中国美女，深红色头发扎成松散凌乱的发髻，几缕发丝垂在脸旁。皮肤白皙，五官锋利，下颚线分明，自然妆容，眼妆细致。着装：黑色长款皮革风衣内搭黑色背心，黑色牛仔超短裙，黑色平底战斗靴，无腰带，双手佩戴黑色科技感护手。表情紧绷隐忍，微带痛苦，眉头微蹙——眼神中充满绝望与强烈的意志。
【15秒一镜到底·觉醒打击版】
0-2秒·觉醒
镜头低角度仰拍，取景她的上半身与面部，仰望独自站在被摧毁街道中央的她。风吹动她的黑色皮革风衣。她张开嘴唇，用日语尖叫:"かくせいしろ！"她猛然张开右手，黑色科技护手噼啪作响。紫色水晶质感的电弧从她手臂和护手爆发。空气向内压缩，空间扭曲畸变。冲击波发出低沉的音爆。紫色符文线条浮现并环绕她身体运转。
2-5秒·爆发
镜头开始环绕她运动。胸口爆裂出暗金色裂纹，浓稠的金色液体如血般涌出。她痛苦地尖叫。紫色雾气与细密电弧向外涌射。她的全部衣物从内部撕裂炸开，每一片都燃烧成灰烬——什么都不剩。有机装甲碎片向外爆射，随后以不自然的方式回缩重新附着在她身体上。紫色纹路对称蔓延过她的面部。面颊上裂开一道裂缝，露出下方脉动的紫色光芒。同时，多条机械臂状的附肢从她背部猛烈爆出——暗色金属质感，刀刃形状，如恶魔之翼般向外展开。火花、蓝色电弧和金色能量粒子从爆发点炸裂。镜头从背后捕捉完整的展开画面——她的剪影映衬在灰色天空下，机械附肢如扇形展开。爆发声如撕裂金属混合电弧放电。
5-8秒·生长
有机物质从体内渗出，表面闪烁虹彩光泽。白色装甲板对撞融合，留下灼烧痕迹。装甲向下延伸覆盖她的双腿，平底战斗靴被装甲完全吞噬取代，形成白色与暗紫色交织的装甲战靴，伴随微小火花锁定到位。她咬紧牙关发出痛苦的嘶吼。胸口核心如余烬般明灭闪烁。紫黑色金属蔓延覆盖她的面部，形成凹凸不平的面具，左眼比右眼先被覆盖。复眼开始成型，带有液态光介质不规则地闪烁。镜头持续环绕她运动。
8-12秒·完成
镜头继续缓慢环绕她。面具完全封合。角状结构从头顶向上生长，燃烧着紫金色火焰。一只复眼稳定发光，另一只带有电流不稳定的闪烁。装甲以白色与暗紫色交织，凹凸不平且布满战损，发光的紫色裂缝中渗出光液。机械附肢在她身后微微摆动。装甲每块锁定时发出清脆的金属卡扣声，随后是层次分明的机械归位声。她缓缓低头审视自己的双手——白色与暗紫色交织的装甲护手指节渗出紫色光芒。她缓缓抬头直视前方，复眼骤然全亮。
12-15秒·超音速冲锋
镜头急速后退。她双脚蹬地，脚下沥青瞬间炸裂形成深坑，一道猛烈的紫色能量爆炸从起飞点向外扩散，碎石与沥青碎块被炸飞至空中。她以突破音障的速度腾空飞射，直冲镜头方向——锥形音爆雾气在身后形成，机械附肢被气流向后压平，画面产生强烈的动态模糊。她的身影越来越大，越来越近，占满整个画面。紫色能量尾迹拖在身后。最后一帧，她的装甲面甲几乎撞上镜头，复眼猩红全亮，画面骤然切黑。
【环境音】
觉醒时的低沉音爆，撕裂金属与电弧放电声，痛苦的尖叫声，清脆的金属卡扣声，机械附肢展开的沉重金属声，背景中燃烧的噼啪声与远处爆炸声，最后的超音速冲锋伴随起飞点爆炸声、音爆冲击与急速逼近的风压声，画面切黑瞬间一切归于寂静。
【物理质感强化】
真实光影，变身前面部可见的皮肤质感，皮革风衣变身前可见的真实磨损与撕裂。机械附肢具有物理重量和惯性——展开后轻微摆动，并非僵硬不动。装甲板以白色与暗紫色交织，表面可见划痕、焊接痕迹和不平整边缘——不是干净光滑的。所有动作沉稳有力，充满痛苦但坚定——她在承受中觉醒。偶有轻微镜头晃动，纯正手持跟拍感。
【声音设计】
从尖叫激活到爆裂机械爆发，层层递进至起飞点爆炸与超音速冲锋的音爆，最终骤然切入寂静。整个序列散发着绝对的力量。仅生成音效，无音乐。

raw_p:
100%真人实拍质感，好莱坞IMAX大片质感，自然光影，冷峻纪实风格，阴天自然光，全程手持一镜到底，呼吸感晃动，随机焦点失焦，16:9宽屏。
【场景环境】
一条延伸至远方的被摧毁的城市街道。两侧是废墟混凝土建筑，钢筋外露，窗户破碎，部分建筑仍在燃烧，橙色火光与黑烟升腾。废弃汽车散落在开裂的沥青路面上，其中数辆正在燃烧。阴沉灰色天空，烟尘悬浮于空气中。多颗陨石拖着火焰与浓烟尾迹划过天际。背景中惊恐的平民在废墟间四散奔逃，有人跌倒，有人拖拽伤员。
【主体人物】
中国美女，深红色头发扎成松散凌乱的发髻，几缕发丝垂在脸旁。皮肤白皙，五官锋利，下颚线分明，自然妆容，眼妆细致。着装：黑色长款皮革风衣内搭黑色背心，黑色牛仔超短裙，黑色平底战斗靴，无腰带，双手佩戴黑色科技感护手。表情紧绷隐忍，微带痛苦，眉头微蹙——眼神中充满绝望与强烈的意志。
【15秒一镜到底·觉醒打击版】
0-2秒·觉醒
镜头低角度仰拍，取景她的上半身与面部，仰望独自站在被摧毁街道中央的她。风吹动她的黑色皮革风衣。她张开嘴唇，用日语尖叫:"かくせいしろ！"她猛然张开右手，黑色科技护手噼啪作响。紫色水晶质感的电弧从她手臂和护手爆发。空气向内压缩，空间扭曲畸变。冲击波发出低沉的音爆。紫色符文线条浮现并环绕她身体运转。
2-5秒·爆发
镜头开始环绕她运动。胸口爆裂出暗金色裂纹，浓稠的金色液体如血般涌出。她痛苦地尖叫。紫色雾气与细密电弧向外涌射。她的全部衣物从内部撕裂炸开，每一片都燃烧成灰烬——什么都不剩。有机装甲碎片向外爆射，随后以不自然的方式回缩重新附着在她身体上。紫色纹路对称蔓延过她的面部。面颊上裂开一道裂缝，露出下方脉动的紫色光芒。同时，多条机械臂状的附肢从她背部猛烈爆出——暗色金属质感，刀刃形状，如恶魔之翼般向外展开。火花、蓝色电弧和金色能量粒子从爆发点炸裂。镜头从背后捕捉完整的展开画面——她的剪影映衬在灰色天空下，机械附肢如扇形展开。爆发声如撕裂金属混合电弧放电。
5-8秒·生长
有机物质从体内渗出，表面闪烁虹彩光泽。白色装甲板对撞融合，留下灼烧痕迹。装甲向下延伸覆盖她的双腿，平底战斗靴被装甲完全吞噬取代，形成白色与暗紫色交织的装甲战靴，伴随微小火花锁定到位。她咬紧牙关发出痛苦的嘶吼。胸口核心如余烬般明灭闪烁。紫黑色金属蔓延覆盖她的面部，形成凹凸不平的面具，左眼比右眼先被覆盖。复眼开始成型，带有液态光介质不规则地闪烁。镜头持续环绕她运动。
8-12秒·完成
镜头继续缓慢环绕她。面具完全封合。角状结构从头顶向上生长，燃烧着紫金色火焰。一只复眼稳定发光，另一只带有电流不稳定的闪烁。装甲以白色与暗紫色交织，凹凸不平且布满战损，发光的紫色裂缝中渗出光液。机械附肢在她身后微微摆动。装甲每块锁定时发出清脆的金属卡扣声，随后是层次分明的机械归位声。她缓缓低头审视自己的双手——白色与暗紫色交织的装甲护手指节渗出紫色光芒。她缓缓抬头直视前方，复眼骤然全亮。
12-15秒·超音速冲锋
镜头急速后退。她双脚蹬地，脚下沥青瞬间炸裂形成深坑，一道猛烈的紫色能量爆炸从起飞点向外扩散，碎石与沥青碎块被炸飞至空中。她以突破音障的速度腾空飞射，直冲镜头方向——锥形音爆雾气在身后形成，机械附肢被气流向后压平，画面产生强烈的动态模糊。她的身影越来越大，越来越近，占满整个画面。紫色能量尾迹拖在身后。最后一帧，她的装甲面甲几乎撞上镜头，复眼猩红全亮，画面骤然切黑。
【环境音】
觉醒时的低沉音爆，撕裂金属与电弧放电声，痛苦的尖叫声，清脆的金属卡扣声，机械附肢展开的沉重金属声，背景中燃烧的噼啪声与远处爆炸声，最后的超音速冲锋伴随起飞点爆炸声、音爆冲击与急速逼近的风压声，画面切黑瞬间一切归于寂静。
【物理质感强化】
真实光影，变身前面部可见的皮肤质感，皮革风衣变身前可见的真实磨损与撕裂。机械附肢具有物理重量和惯性——展开后轻微摆动，并非僵硬不动。装甲板以白色与暗紫色交织，表面可见划痕、焊接痕迹和不平整边缘——不是干净光滑的。所有动作沉稳有力，充满痛苦但坚定——她在承受中觉醒。偶有轻微镜头晃动，纯正手持跟拍感。

从尖叫激活到爆裂机械爆发，层层递进至起飞点爆炸与超音速冲锋的音爆，最终骤然切入寂静。整个序列散发着绝对的力量。仅生成音效，无音乐。

en.p:
A highly dramatic, fast-cut anime MV with exaggerated cinematic tension and comedic payoff. 1930s Tokyo rice paddies, muddy textures, stormy sky. Extreme sense of falling urgency using rapid cuts, POV distortion, speed ramps, spinning camera, impact zooms. Dramatic orchestral music escalating non-stop, then sudden comedic release at the end. No dialogue, no voice-over. Each shot 0.6–1.2s.

0–0.8s (HOOK)
Extreme close-up: muddy water surface. Ripple expands → reflection shows a white tiger falling from the sky at insane speed.

0.8–1.6s
SMASH CUT → tiger tumbling mid-air, body spinning violently, wind tearing fur.

1.6–2.4s
POV tiger → ground rushing upward extremely fast. Rice paddies distort with speed.

2.4–3.2s
Cut → orange cat in muddy farmer clothes, calmly planting rice. Slow, peaceful motion.

3.2–4.0s
Back to tiger → extreme close-up eyes, panic rising. Sunglasses slightly slipping.

4.0–4.8s
Rapid micro-cuts: sky spin → ground zoom → cat step → sky spin → distance collapsing fast.

4.8–5.6s
Top-down shot → tiger perfectly aligned to crash into orange cat.

5.6–6.4s
Tiger yanks parachute → explosive deploy → instant violent spinning chaos.

6.4–7.2s
Camera rotates 360° with tiger. Horizon flips. Ground now dangerously close.

7.2–8.0s
Parachute unstable → cords under extreme tension. Tiger loses control completely.

8.0–8.8s
Tiger panic peaks → aggressively twists cords into a tight yarn-ball knot.

8.8–9.6s
Parachute collapses → freefall speed doubles. Sound compresses into heartbeat rhythm.

9.6–10.4s
Ultra-fast dive shot → motion blur streaks. Orange cat grows rapidly in frame.

10.4–11.2s
Cut → cat finally senses something. Slight head turn.

11.2–12.0s (IMPACT BUILD)
Extreme close-up: tiger face in silent scream → smash zoom toward ground.

12.0–12.8s (IMPACT)
Massive muddy explosion. Water and mud burst upward in slow motion.

12.8–13.6s
Mud rain falls. Silence. Shapes slowly appear through the splash.

13.6–14.2s (REVEAL)
White tiger sitting on top of the orange cat’s back, slightly dazed but intact.

14.2–15.0s (COMEDIC PAYOFF)
Close-up: orange cat’s face, completely covered in mud, eyes half-open, extremely annoyed.
White tiger casually adjusts sunglasses while sitting on him.
Freeze frame → dramatic music abruptly cuts.

zh.p: 一部极具戏剧性、快速剪辑的动漫MV，充满夸张的电影张力与喜剧收尾。背景设定在1930年代东京的水稻田，泥泞的质感，暴风雨的天空。通过快速切换、视角扭曲、变速、旋转镜头和冲击变焦，营造出极致的坠落紧迫感。管弦乐不断升级，最后突然以喜剧方式释放。无对白，无旁白。每个镜头时长0.6至1.2秒。0至0.8秒（钩子）：极特写——泥泞水面。涟漪扩散→倒影显示一只白虎以疯狂速度从天而降。0.8至1.6秒（猛切）：老虎在半空中翻滚，身体剧烈旋转，风撕裂皮毛。1.6至2.4秒（老虎视角）：地面极速上冲。水稻田因速度而扭曲。2.4至3.2秒（切换）：一只穿着泥泞农夫服的橘猫，正平静地插秧。动作缓慢而平和。3.2至4.0秒（回到老虎）：极特写眼睛，恐慌加剧。墨镜微微滑落。4.0至4.8秒（快速微切）：天空旋转→地面变焦→猫迈步→天空旋转→距离急速缩短。4.8至5.6秒（俯拍）：老虎完美对准，即将撞上橘猫。5.6至6.4秒：老虎猛拉降落伞→爆炸式展开→瞬间剧烈旋转混乱。6.4至7.2秒：镜头随老虎旋转360度。地平线翻转。地面已危险逼近。7.2至8.0秒：降落伞不稳→绳索极度紧绷。老虎完全失控。8.0至8.8秒：老虎恐慌达到顶峰→粗暴地将绳索扭成一个紧实的毛线球结。8.8至9.6秒：降落伞塌陷→自由落体速度加倍。声音压缩成心跳节奏。9.6至10.4秒：超高速俯冲镜头——动态模糊条纹。橘猫在画面中迅速变大。10.4至11.2秒（切换）：猫终于察觉异样。微微转头。11.2至12.0秒（冲击铺垫）：极特写老虎面孔——无声尖叫→变焦冲向地面。12.0至12.8秒（冲击）：巨大的泥泞爆炸。水和泥巴以慢动作向上喷溅。12.8至13.6秒：泥雨落下。寂静。溅射中缓缓浮现轮廓。13.6至14.2秒（揭示）：白虎坐在橘猫背上，略显恍惚但毫发无损。14.2至15.0秒（喜剧收尾）：特写橘猫面孔——满脸泥巴，半睁着眼，极度恼怒。白虎坐在它身上，随意调整墨镜。定格→戏剧性音乐戛然而止。

en.p:
[CINEMATIC] 8mm Fisheye lens, FPV racing drone camera, hyper-fluid motion. [@Image 1] (Lanky Knight, red coat) on a longboard. [@Image 2] (Steep coastal mountain road).
0-3s: [Extreme high-speed follow] [@Image 1] carves down the steep asphalt. The camera mimics an FPV drone, flying inches from the ground at blinding speed. The red coat whips violently in the wind.
3-6s: [360-degree barrel roll] [@Image 1] hits a hairpin turn, leaning horizontally. The camera executes a dizzying, hyper-fluid 360-degree roll over his head, maintaining focus on his armor reflecting the bright sky.
6-10s: [Under-board swoop & launch] [@Image 1] hits a ramp, launching into the air. The camera aggressively swoops underneath the board, capturing the massive ocean drop, before tilting up as [@Image 1] backflips.
10-15s: [Impact & rapid pull-back] [@Image 1] lands flawlessly, wheels smoking. The camera snaps backward in a rapid reverse-dolly motion, showcasing the majestic landscape as [@Image 1] speeds away.

zh.p: 【电影感】8毫米鱼眼镜头，FPV穿越机视角，超流畅运动。【@图1】（身穿红色长外套的高瘦骑士）踩着长板滑行。【@图2】（陡峭的海岸山路）。0-3秒：【极限高速跟拍】【@图1】在陡峭的柏油路上切弯俯冲。镜头模拟FPV穿越机，以令人目眩的速度紧贴地面飞行，红色外套在风中猛烈翻飞。3-6秒：【360度横滚旋转】【@图1】冲过发卡弯，身体水平倾斜。镜头完成令人眩晕的超流畅360度横滚，越过其头顶，始终聚焦于映照着明亮天空的铠甲。6-10秒：【板底俯冲与腾空】【@图1】冲上坡道，腾空跃起。镜头猛烈俯冲至滑板下方，捕捉到下方浩瀚的海面落差，随后上仰拍摄【@图1】完成后空翻。10-15秒：【落地与急速拉远】【@图1】完美落地，轮子冒烟。镜头以急速反向推轨的方式向后猛拉，在【@图1】飞驰远去时，展现出壮丽的景观。
