en.p: A panoramic, eye-level fixed shot of a desolate gray beach, with mist spreading forward from the depths of the background. Gothic architectural outlines loom faintly within the mist. The beach surface is covered with fine gray gravel and charred debris, with an overall color palette of extremely low-saturation, cold gray tones that feel oppressive. A bionic heroine (wearing a white formal suit, a silver mechanical neck guard and prosthetic arm, a black ponytail, gold gear earrings, red lips, and a photorealistic face that remains stable and undistorted throughout) stands at the center of the frame. The suit is slowly billowed by the sea breeze, while the silver prosthetic arm holds a staff upright. At the top of the staff, three rings burn with orange-red energy, casting a warm orange contour light onto the front of the heroine's white suit. A low, epic backing track slowly unfolds across a wide soundstage, interwoven with the sizzling of the burning energy and the heavy sensation of breathing. The camera pulls back as the heroine's silver prosthetic arm suddenly slams the staff into the sandy ground. The impact kicks up a large amount of gray dust that explodes outward, forming a semi-transparent golden dust cloud in the side-backlight. The three orange-red energy rings detach from the top of the staff, hover in midair, and rapidly accelerate in rotation. Each ring leaves a complete trail of orange-red light as it spins. The heroine's prosthetic arm abruptly raises high to signal an attack, and her cloak snaps backward with the motion, while the strands of her ponytail are lifted forward by the shockwave. The heavy thud of the staff hitting the ground, the metallic vibration, and the sound of wind whipping sand all crash in simultaneously. A low-angle close-up rapidly pushes in as the heroine's silver prosthetic arm's index finger swings sharply upward. Golden flames leap and burn on the precision metal fingertip, while blue-white electric arcs climb along the prosthetic arm's joints to the fingertip, merging with the flames. In the background, massive mechanical structures begin to collapse, with metal components tumbling and falling amidst the firelight. The sharp whistle of the finger cutting through the air and the high-frequency hum of converging energy suddenly pierce through. A panoramic fast panning shot tracks the first massive energy ring, which, like a flying saw, carves a complete arc of orange-red firelight through the air at extremely high speed. The arc's trail forms a continuously glowing streak in the gray sky, instantly slicing into the side armor of a giant steel airship. At the moment of impact, the armor plate bursts outward along the cut line, with orange-red molten lava spewing from the incision. The screeching friction of the saw cutting metal and the explosive crackling of sparks tear the soundscape apart. An overhead tracking shot presses down as the energy ring penetrates the side armor and continues slicing into the ship's core cabin. The moment the core is pierced, it triggers a chain of explosions. The first explosion expands spherically, while the second tears longitudinally along the ship's hull lines. Metal fragments, accompanied by thick black smoke columns and red firelight, spread outward at high speed. The sound of metal tearing and the distant low-frequency rumble interweave into an overwhelming wave of sound. A medium shot, eye-level and fixed, shows the second energy ring howling toward a massive bipedal walker mech on the ground. The orange light trail from the ring's rotation in its flight path creates a strong contrast between warm and cool tones against the dark background. The color saturation of the frame suddenly intensifies at this moment, while the low-frequency hum of the energy ring's high-speed rotation continuously vibrates within the scene. A low-angle medium shot shakes as the energy ring precisely strikes the core of the mech's left knee joint. A massive fireball erupts from within the joint, and the explosion's shockwave pushes the entire upper body of the mech backward. A cascade of sparks sprays from the explosion point, covering a ten-meter radius. The camera shakes violently with the impact, and the heavy metallic clang and the continuous explosive crackling of the mech's damaged electrical components crash in amidst the vibration. A panoramic side shot shows the mech's right knee subsequently hit by the third energy ring, rendering it completely disabled. The massive body slowly tilts to the right after both knees are destroyed, with armor plates continuously falling off during the tilt. The outlines of Gothic spires in the misty background tremble with the mech's collapse. The dull thud of the mech fully hitting the ground and the sound of rubble falling spread from near to far. At this moment, the BGM's rhythm reaches the first climax of the movement.

zh.p: 荒凉灰色沙滩全景平视固定，迷雾从背景深处向前蔓延，哥特式建筑轮廓在迷雾中若隐若现，沙滩地面覆盖着细碎的灰色砾石与焦黑残骸，整体色调 极低饱和度冷灰压抑。仿生女侠（白色正装西服、银色机械颈甲与义臂、黑色马尾、金色齿轮耳环、红唇，五官电影级写实全程稳定不变形）立于画面中央，西服被海风缓慢鼓起，银色义臂握持法杖 垂立，法杖顶端三个圆环燃烧橙红色能量，能量光芒将女侠正面白色西服染成暖橙色轮廓光，低沉史诗垫乐在宽阔音场中缓缓铺开，能量燃烧滋滋声与沉重呼吸感交织。 镜头后撤，女侠银色义臂猛然将法杖击向沙地，冲击力激起大量灰色沙尘向四周爆散，沙尘在侧逆光中形成半透明金色尘云，三个橙红能量环脱离法杖顶端悬浮于半空并迅速加速旋转，每个圆环旋转时拖出完整的橙红光尾残影，女侠义臂猛然高举示意出击，斗篷随举臂动作猛然向后展开，马尾发丝被冲击气流向前掀起，法杖撞地沉重轰响与金属震动声、狂风卷沙声同步轰入。 仰视特写快速推进，女侠银色义臂食指向上空猛然挥动，金色火焰在精密金属指尖跳跃燃烧，蓝白电弧沿义臂关节向上蔓延至指尖与火焰交融，背景中巨大机械结构开始崩塌，金属构件在火光中翻滚坠落，指尖划过空气的尖锐呼啸声与高频能量汇聚嗡鸣声骤然刺入。 全景快速横移追踪，第一个巨大能量圆环如飞锯般以极高转速在空中划出完整橙红火光弧线，弧线尾迹在灰暗天空中形成持续发光的轨迹，瞬间切入一艘巨型钢铁飞船的侧翼装甲，切入瞬间装甲板沿切割线从内向外炸裂，橙红熔浆从切口向外喷涌，锯片切割金属的刺耳摩擦声与火花四溅爆裂声将音场撕裂。 俯视追踪镜头压顶，能量圆环穿透侧翼继续切入飞船核心舱室，核心被贯穿瞬间引发连环爆炸，第一波爆炸呈球形膨胀，第二波沿舰体纹路纵向撕裂，金属碎片伴随浓黑烟柱与红色火光向四周高速扩散，金属撕裂声与远处低音轰鸣交织成压顶音浪。 中景平视固定，第二个能量圆环呼啸飞向地面一台巨大双足步行机甲 ，圆环在飞行轨迹中旋转产生的橙色光尾与阴暗背景形成极强冷暖对比，画面色彩饱和度在此刻骤然拉高，能量环高速盘旋的低频嗡鸣声在画面中持续震荡。 仰视中景震动，能量圆环精准击中机甲左膝关节核心，巨大火球从关节内部向外爆发，爆炸冲击波将机甲整个上半身向后推移，火星瀑布从爆炸点向四周喷溅覆盖半径十米，镜头随冲击剧烈震动，沉重金属撞击声与机甲受损电火花连续爆裂声在震动中轰然压入。 全景侧移，机甲 右膝随后被第三个能量圆环击中彻底瘫痪，庞大躯体在两膝连续被毁后向右侧缓缓倾倒，倾倒过程中装甲板持续脱落，哥特式尖顶建筑在迷雾背景中随机甲倒塌的震动而轮廓颤动，机甲彻底倒地的沉闷巨响与瓦砾坠落声由近及远散开，BGM节奏在此刻推至第一阶段高潮。

en.p:
Low-angle shot across a muddy battlefield under heavy rain. The camera tracks backward as a massive Viking charges forward, axes dragging sparks through wet ground.

Lightning flashes — the camera whip-pans as enemies collide with him. The shot becomes chaotic, handheld energy as he spins, cleaves, and roars, each strike sending blood into the rain.

The camera circles rapidly as he enters a berserk state — sound muffles except his breathing and heartbeat. He tackles a larger opponent — brutal close combat.

Final: he stands alone in the rain, chest heaving, axes dripping. The camera slowly pulls back as thunder rolls.

zh.p: 低角度镜头扫过暴雨中的泥泞战场。摄像机向后跟拍，一名身材魁梧的维京战士向前冲锋，双斧拖过湿泥地面，溅起火星。闪电划过——镜头急摇，敌人与他撞作一团。画面转为手持拍摄的混乱感，他旋转、劈砍、怒吼，每一下挥击都让鲜血混入雨中。当他进入狂战士状态时，摄像机快速环绕——除了他的呼吸和心跳声，其他声响都变得模糊。他扑倒一个更庞大的对手——展开残酷的近身肉搏。最终：他独自伫立在雨中，胸膛起伏，双斧滴血。雷声滚滚，摄像机缓缓向后拉开。

Blue-white electric arcs spread along the prosthetic arm's joints up to the fingertip, merging with the flames. In the background, massive mechanical structures begin to collapse, metal components tumbling and falling in the firelight. The sharp whistling of the finger cutting through the air and the high-frequency hum of energy convergence suddenly pierce through. A panoramic fast pan shot tracks the first massive energy ring, which, like a flying saw, carves a complete orange-red fire arc through the air at extremely high speed. The arc's trail forms a persistent glowing line in the gray sky, instantly slicing into the side armor of a giant steel airship. At the moment of impact, the armor plates burst outward from the inside along the cut line, with orange-red molten lava gushing from the incision. The piercing screech of the saw cutting metal and the explosive crackling of sparks tear through the soundscape. An overhead tracking shot presses down, the energy ring penetrates the side armor and continues slicing into the ship's core chamber. The moment the core is pierced triggers a chain of explosions: the first explosion expands spherically, the second tears longitudinally along the ship's hull lines. Metal fragments, accompanied by thick black smoke columns and red firelight, rapidly scatter outward. The sound of tearing metal and distant low-frequency rumbles interweave into an overwhelming wave of sound. A medium shot, level and fixed, shows the second energy ring howling toward a massive bipedal walker mech on the ground. The orange light tail generated by the ring's rotation in its flight path creates a strong contrast between warm and cool tones against the dark background. The color saturation of the frame suddenly spikes at this moment, and the low-frequency hum of the energy ring's high-speed spinning continuously vibrates within the frame. A low-angle medium shot trembles as the energy ring precisely strikes the core of the mech's left knee joint. A massive fireball erupts from within the joint, the explosion's shockwave pushing the entire upper body of the mech backward. A waterfall of sparks sprays from the explosion point, covering a ten-meter radius. The camera shakes violently with the impact, and the heavy sound of metal collision and the continuous crackling of electrical sparks from the damaged mech crash in amid the tremors. A panoramic side pan shot shows the mech's right knee subsequently hit by the third energy ring, completely disabling it. The massive body slowly tilts to the right after both knees are destroyed, with armor plates continuously falling off during the tilt. The outlines of Gothic spires in the misty background tremble with the vibrations from the mech's collapse. The dull thud of the mech fully hitting the ground and the sound of rubble falling spread from near to far, and the BGM's rhythm at this moment pushes to the first climax.

zh.p: 荒凉灰色沙滩全景平视固定，迷雾从背景深处向前蔓延，哥特式建筑轮廓在迷雾中若隐若现，沙滩地面覆盖着细碎的灰色砾石与焦黑残骸，整体色调极低饱和度冷灰压抑。仿生女侠（白色正装西服、银色机械颈甲与义臂、黑色马尾、金色齿轮耳环、红唇，五官电影级写实全程稳定不变形）立于画面中央，西服被海风缓慢鼓起，银色义臂握持法杖垂立，法杖顶端三个圆环燃烧橙红色能量，能量光芒将女侠正面白色西服染成暖橙色轮廓光，低沉史诗垫乐在宽阔音场中缓缓铺开，能量燃烧滋滋声与沉重呼吸感交织。 镜头后撤，女侠银色义臂猛然将法杖击向沙地，冲击力激起大量灰色沙尘向四周爆散，沙尘在侧逆光中形成半透明金色尘云，三个橙红能量环脱离法杖顶端悬浮于半空并迅速加速旋转，每个圆环旋转时拖出完整的橙红光尾残影，女侠义臂猛然高举示意出击，斗篷随举臂动作猛然向后展开，马尾发丝被冲击气流向前掀起，法杖撞地沉重轰响与金属震动声、狂风卷沙声同步轰入。 仰视特写快速推进，女侠银色义臂食指向上空猛然挥动，金色火焰在精密金属指尖跳跃燃烧，蓝白电弧沿义臂关节向上蔓延至指尖与火焰交融，背景中巨大机械结构开始崩塌，金属构件在火光中翻滚坠落，指尖划过空气的尖锐呼啸声与高频能量汇聚嗡鸣声骤然刺入。 全景快速横移追踪，第一个巨大能量圆环如飞锯般以极高转速在空中划出完整橙红火光弧线，弧线尾迹在灰暗天空中形成持续发光的轨迹，瞬间切入一艘巨型钢铁飞船的侧翼装甲，切入瞬间装甲板沿切割线从内向外炸裂，橙红熔浆从切口向外喷涌，锯片切割金属的刺耳摩擦声与火花四溅爆裂声将音场撕裂。 俯视追踪镜头压顶，能量圆环穿透侧翼继续切入飞船核心舱室，核心被贯穿瞬间引发连环爆炸，第一波爆炸呈球形膨胀，第二波沿舰体纹路纵向撕裂，金属碎片伴随浓黑烟柱与红色火光向四周高速扩散，金属撕裂声与远处低音轰鸣交织成压顶音浪。 中景平视固定，第二个能量圆环呼啸飞向地面一台巨大双足步行机甲，圆环在飞行轨迹中旋转产生的橙色光尾与阴暗背景形成极强冷暖对比，画面色彩饱和度在此刻骤然拉高，能量环高速盘旋的低频嗡鸣声在画面中持续震荡。 仰视中景震动，能量圆环精准击中机甲左膝关节核心，巨大火球从关节内部向外爆发，爆炸冲击波将机甲整个上半身向后推移，火星瀑布从爆炸点向四周喷溅覆盖半径十米，镜头随冲击剧烈震动，沉重金属撞击声与机甲受损电火花连续爆裂声在震动中轰然压入。 全景侧移，机甲右膝随后被第三个能量圆环击中彻底瘫痪，庞大躯体在两膝连续被毁后向右侧缓缓倾倒，倾倒过程中装甲板持续脱落，哥特式尖顶建筑在迷雾背景中随机甲倒塌的震动而轮廓颤动，机甲彻底倒地的沉闷巨响与瓦砾坠落声由近及远散开，BGM节奏在此刻推至第一阶段高潮。

en.p: Core Scene: A candlelit dinner at an upscale restaurant, where a husband presents his wife with a custom high-end noise-canceling headset. The wife is moved to tears, and the romantic moment of her putting it on is captured. Shot 1 (0-1s) ✨ Atmosphere Setting: Overhead shot of the entire upscale restaurant, warm candlelight flickering, crystal glasses refracting soft light, a black velvet tablecloth with exquisite French cuisine. The wife, in a velvet dress, looks down while cutting her steak, while the husband gazes at her tenderly, his fingers caressing a velvet gift box. Sound: Soft jazz BGM from the restaurant, the faint clink of knives and forks against porcelain plates. Dialogue: Husband (low and gentle): 'Darling, you've worked hard today.' Shot 2 (2-3s) 🎧 Surprise Reveal: Close-up of the husband slowly pushing the velvet gift box across the table. The wife looks up, stunned, her eyelashes trembling slightly. The husband opens the box, revealing the custom high-end headset (metallic texture with engraved details) gleaming with a cool, luxurious light in the candlelight. Sound: BGM fades, the soft sound of the box opening, the wife's sharp intake of breath. Dialogue: Wife (choking up): 'Is this...?' Husband: 'You always say the headphones at work are too noisy. This one only hears my voice.' Shot 3 (4-5s) 😭 Emotional Outburst: Close-up on the wife's face, tears streaming down her cheeks. She raises a hand to cover her mouth, her eyes full of surprise and emotion. The husband reaches out to gently wipe away her tears. Sound: BGM rises, with gentle piano notes added, the wife's soft sobs. Dialogue: Wife (crying and laughing): 'How did you know I've wanted this for so long...' Shot 4 (6-7s) 💞 Romantic Ending: Close-up of the husband picking up the headset, carefully placing it on his wife, his fingertips lightly touching her ear. The wife closes her eyes and smiles. As the headset fits snugly over her ears, the camera pulls back to show their intertwined hands, with the candlelight casting their shadows into a soft silhouette. Sound: BGM reaches a climax and then fades, leaving only the sound of their breathing. Dialogue: Husband (softly): 'From now on, no matter how noisy the world gets, I'll be right by your ear.'

zh.p: 核心场景：高级餐厅烛光晚餐，丈夫为妻子送上定制高奢降噪耳机，妻子感动落泪，完成佩戴的浪漫瞬间 镜头 1（0-1s）✨ 氛围铺垫 画面：俯拍高级餐厅全景，暖黄烛光摇曳，水晶杯折射柔光，黑丝绒桌布上摆着精致法餐，妻子穿着丝绒裙低头切牛排，丈夫温柔凝视她，指尖摩挲着丝绒礼盒 音效：餐厅轻柔爵士 BGM，刀叉轻碰瓷盘的细碎声 台词：丈夫（低沉温柔）：“亲爱的，今天辛苦你了。” 镜头 2（2-3s）🎧 惊喜揭晓 画面：特写丈夫缓缓推过丝绒礼盒，妻子抬眼愣住，睫毛轻颤；丈夫打开盒盖，定制款高奢耳机（金属质感 + 刻字细节）在烛光下泛着冷冽高级光 音效：BGM 渐弱，礼盒开合的轻响，妻子倒吸一口气的气音 台词：妻子（哽咽）：“这是……？” 丈夫：“你总说加班戴耳机吵，这个，只听得到我的声音。” 镜头 3（4-5s）😭 情绪爆发 画面：近景怼脸拍妻子，眼泪顺着脸颊滑落，抬手捂住嘴，眼神里满是惊喜与感动；丈夫伸手轻轻拭去她的泪 音效：BGM 升调，加入温柔钢琴音，妻子细微的抽噎声 台词：妻子（哭着笑）：“你怎么知道我想要这个很久了……” 镜头 4（6-7s）💞 浪漫收尾 画面：特写丈夫拿起耳机，小心为妻子戴上，指尖轻触她的耳廓；妻子闭眼微笑，耳机贴合耳际的瞬间，镜头拉远到两人交握的手，烛光将影子晕成温柔的轮廓 音效：BGM 达到高潮后渐弱，只剩两人的呼吸声 台词：丈夫（轻声）：“以后，世界再吵，我都在你耳边。”

en.p:
A female astronaut in a white EVA suit sprints across the outer ring of a damaged orbital station above Earth.

The station slowly rotates while massive solar panels break apart and drift into space.

At the 2-second mark she jumps from the rotating ring toward a drifting cargo module.

Camera floats beside her as Earth spins in the background.

She grabs a handle, swings through the airlock hatch, and seals the door just as debris slams into the station behind her.

Orbital debris field, zero-gravity leap, rotating space station exterior run, cinematic space lighting, 4K.

zh.p: 一名身穿白色舱外航天服的女宇航员在地球上空受损轨道空间站的外环上疾速奔跑。空间站缓缓旋转，巨大的太阳能板碎裂飘散入太空。第2秒时，她从旋转环纵身跃向一个漂移的货舱模块。摄像机悬浮在她身侧，背景中地球缓缓转动。她抓住扶手，荡入气闸舱口，刚关上舱门，碎片便砸中身后的空间站。轨道碎片区、零重力跳跃、旋转空间站外环奔跑、电影级太空光影、4K画质。

en.p: The rally truck blasts over the lava crest already at full throttle, all four wheels leaving the ground before it lands hard and drives forward. Bumper-height camera faces forward, locked on the hood and roll cage while black rock walls streak into dark ribbons on both sides. The track bends, the truck snaps right, all four wheels spinning on the loose lava gravel, body rolling hard before the suspension loads up and fires it out of the corner. Camera drops to the side, catching the gravel spray with the lava field stretching flat to the horizon. Then wide: the lava field from above, the truck a bright shape on the vast black plain. Low Icelandic sky pressing flat on the horizon. Dust trail hanging in the still air long after it passes. Black lava and bright livery, flat Icelandic overcast, volcanic plain palette, hyperreal rally photography, motion blur on rock and sky, frozen clarity on metal and rubber.

en.p: Completely preserving the reference image <<<Image1>>>, generate an ultra-realistic, cinematic high-speed action video. A cinematic action scene set among skyscrapers bathed in the warm light of golden hour, where a man uses high-tension webs like spider silk to propel himself at super speed between buildings. All movements must occur between buildings, close to exterior walls and windows, at or just below the roofline. Avoid prolonged exposure in open sky. [Action Structure (Important)] Start with a "forward acceleration." <<<Image1>>> shoots a web toward a building ahead and above, and the tension pulls him forward in a straight line at super speed through gaps between buildings. He grazes past walls and windows, showcasing strong speed and depth. Then, with momentum, he makes a large jump, leaping across a gap between buildings with a "BOOM." Here, he briefly enters open space but immediately transitions to the next action. After the jump, the character loses balance and begins to fall. Depict a realistic fall, pulled sharply downward by gravity, creating a moment of thrill. During the fall, <<<Image1>>> instantly shoots a web upward toward a building edge or structure, hooking onto it mid-air. At that moment, intense tension yanks his body upward in an explosive ascent. Then, he shoots a web forward again, returning to forward acceleration. Limit web usage to 2-3 times in total, ensuring each action is clearly shown. [Movement Characteristics] All movements must follow realistic physics based on inertia, gravity, and tension. No deceleration or hovering. Maintain an uninterrupted flow of speed, creating a clear rhythm of "acceleration → jump → fall → explosive ascent → re-acceleration." [Body Expression] At the moment of shooting the web, sharply thrust one arm forward or upward. During acceleration, the body is stretched by the pull, with legs trailing behind. During the jump, the whole body carries momentum; during the fall, it naturally collapses under gravity. During the ascent, the body is dynamically lifted upward in one motion. [Camera] The camera should primarily maintain a forward-tracking shot, following the character from behind or at close range. Always emphasize forward movement, maximizing speed and perspective changes. Do not use side angles. [Direction] Utilize reflections on glass walls, flowing window lines, strong motion blur, wind pressure on clothing, and light flares to create overwhelming speed and immersion. Keep the distance to walls consistently close, emphasizing the thrill of near-collision. [Emotion] Express focus, excitement, adrenaline, confidence, and the exhilaration of recovery from a momentary crisis (the fall). Overall, prioritize ultra-realism, cinematic quality, high-speed forward motion, strong depth, varied action rhythm, and physical realism.

zh.p:
在完全保留参考图像<<<Image1>>>的前提下，生成一段超写实、电影感十足的高速动作视频。场景设定在黄金时段温暖光线笼罩的高层建筑群中，一名男性使用类似蜘蛛丝的高张力蛛网，在楼宇之间以超高速穿梭。所有动作必须发生在建筑之间、外墙和窗户近旁、屋顶线以下或紧贴其边缘的位置，避免长时间暴露在开阔天空中。

【动作构成（重要）】
开头从“向前加速”开始。<<<Image1>>>向前上方建筑发射蛛网，利用张力瞬间被拉向前方，沿建筑缝隙直线超高速突进。擦过墙壁和窗户边缘，展现强烈的速度感和纵深。
随后，借助惯性大幅跳跃，猛然“砰”地越过建筑间隙。此时会短暂暴露在开阔空间中，但立即转入下一个动作。
跳跃后，角色一度失去平衡，开始坠落。描绘被重力牵引急剧下落的真实坠落感，制造瞬间的紧张刺激。
坠落过程中，<<<Image1>>>立即向上方建筑边缘或结构发射蛛网，在空中钩挂。瞬间，强烈的张力将身体猛然向上拉起，产生爆发式上升。
之后，再次向前方发射蛛网，回到向前加速状态。
蛛网使用次数控制在2到3次，确保每个动作都清晰展现。

【动作特征】
所有动作必须基于惯性、重力和张力的真实物理表现。禁止减速或悬停。始终保持速度流动不间断，形成“加速→跳跃→坠落→爆发上升→再加速”的明确节奏变化。

【身体表现】
发射蛛网的瞬间，单臂锐利地向前或向上伸出。加速时身体被拉伸，双腿向后飘动。跳跃时全身蓄势，坠落时顺应重力自然失控。拉起时身体猛然向上抬升，动作充满动态感。

【镜头】
镜头基本保持向前追踪的跟随视角，从角色后方或近距离跟拍。始终强调向纵深推进的动作，最大化速度和透视变化。不使用侧面角度。

【视觉效果】
利用玻璃外墙的反射、流动的窗线、强烈的运动模糊、风压造成的衣物飘动、光线光晕，营造压倒性的速度和沉浸感。与墙壁的距离始终保持很近，强调擦撞边缘的惊险感。

【情感】
表现专注、兴奋、肾上腺素激增、自信，以及从瞬间危机（坠落）中恢复所带来的振奋感。

整体上，注重超写实、电影感、高速直线推进、强烈纵深、节奏分明的动作以及物理真实感。

raw_p:
リファレンス画像の<<<Image1>>>  を完全に維持したまま、超リアルで映画のような高速アクション動画を生成してください。

ゴールデンアワーの暖かい光に包まれた高層ビル群の中、男性がクモの糸のような高張力ウェブを使って、ビルの間を超高速で突き進むシネマティックアクション。すべての動きはビルとビルの間、外壁や窓のすぐ近く、屋上ラインより下〜ギリギリ付近で行うこと。開けた空に長時間出ないこと。

【アクション構成（重要）】

最初は“前方加速”から始まる。
<<<Image1>>>  は前方上方向の建物に向かってウェブを発射し、その張力で一気に前へ引き込まれ、ビルの隙間を一直線に超高速で突き進む。壁や窓のすぐ横をかすめながら進み、強いスピードと奥行きを見せる。

その後、勢いを乗せたまま大きくジャンプし、ビルの隙間を一気に「ボーン」と飛び越える。ここでは一瞬だけ開けた空間に出るが、すぐに次のアクションへ移行する。

ジャンプ後、キャラクターは一度バランスを崩し、落下し始める。重力に引かれて急激に下へ落ちるリアルな落下を描写すること。ここで一瞬のスリルを作る。

落下中、<<<Image1>>>  は即座に上方向の建物の縁や構造物に向かってウェブを発射し、空中で引っ掛ける。その瞬間、強烈な張力によって体が一気に上方向へ引き上げられ、爆発的に上昇する。

その後、再び前方に向かってウェブを発射し、前進加速へ戻る。

ウェブの使用回数は全体で2〜3回に抑え、1つ1つのアクションをしっかり見せること。

【動きの特徴】
すべての動きは慣性、重力、張力に基づいたリアルな物理挙動にすること。減速やホバリングは禁止。常にスピードの流れが途切れず、「加速 → 跳躍 → 落下 → 爆発的上昇 → 再加速」という明確な緩急を作る。

【身体表現】
ウェブを発射する瞬間、片腕を鋭く前方または上方に突き出す。加速中は体が引っ張られて伸び、脚は後方へ流れる。ジャンプ時は全身で勢いを乗せ、落下時は重力に従い自然に崩れる。引き上げ時は体が一気に上へ持ち上がるダイナミックな動きにする。

【カメラ】
カメラは基本的に前進方向の追従ショットを維持し、キャラクターの後方または近距離から追いかける。常に奥へ進む動きを強調し、スピードとパースの変化を最大化する。サイドアングルは使用しない。

【演出】
ガラス外壁の反射、流れる窓のライン、強いモーションブラー、風圧による服の揺れ、光のフレアを活用し、圧倒的なスピードと没入感を演出する。壁との距離は常に近く、衝突ギリギリのスリルを強調する。

【感情】
集中、興奮、アドレナリン、自信、そして一瞬の危機（落下）からのリカバリーによる高揚感を表現する。

全体として、超リアル、シネマティック、高速直進、強い奥行き、緩急のあるアクション、物理的リアリズムを重視すること。

zh.p: 连续长镜头，摄像机倾斜、翻滚、旋转，穿梭于茂密的亚马逊雨林生态系统中。镜头从雾气缭绕的树冠层开始，避开悬挂的藤蔓和一只沉睡的树懒，随后俯冲进入一棵古老巨树的空心树干，掠过发光的真菌和一群蝙蝠。接着扫出至潮湿的林间地面，紧追一排搬运绿色碎片的切叶蚁，蜿蜒穿过巨大的蕨类植物和露珠。镜头直接扎入湍急的丛林河流，平滑过渡至水下，掠过疾游的水虎鱼和摇曳的水生植物，最终从轰鸣的瀑布中冲出，呈现黎明时分无边无际的绿色丛林令人屏息的航拍全景。无剪辑、不可能的运镜、无缝转场、充满活力、动感十足、电影感。8K高清画质。

raw_p: Continuous single take, camera tilting, rolling, spinning, flying through a dense Amazonian rainforest ecosystem. Starts flying through the misty canopy dodging hanging vines and a sleeping sloth, camera dives downward into the hollow trunk of a massive ancient tree, gliding past bioluminescent fungi and a colony of bats. Sweeps out onto the humid forest floor, closely following a rapid line of leaf-cutter ants carrying green fragments, weaving through giant ferns and dew drops. Camera dives directly into a fast-flowing jungle river, transitioning smoothly underwater past darting piranhas and swaying aquatic plants, before bursting out of a roaring waterfall into a breathtaking aerial view of the infinite green jungle at dawn. No cuts, impossible camera moves, seamless transitions, energetic, dynamic, cinematic. 8K high definition, high quality footage.

en.p: Rear chase steadicam 2.5 meters behind cheetah locked at 112 km/h through dense jungle undergrowth, camera height 40cm matching exact pace zero vertical drift. Subject banks hard left 28 degrees around massive fig trunk, spine compressing then exploding into full extension, all four limbs airborne in suspension phase as dappled golden hour light strobes across spotted coat. Immediate right bank 32 degrees threading gap between twin mahogany trunks, body tilting opposite camera tilt, background foliage streaking into pure motion blur while subject remains razor sharp center frame. Straight blast through fern corridor then aggressive left lean 25 degrees avoiding fallen log, spine flexing maximum compression to extension each stride cycle. Right bank 30 degrees following natural trail bend, warm side light catching muscular definition, long shadows raking across jungle floor at speed. Final left weave 27 degrees between bamboo cluster, sustained maximum velocity throughout, every direction change environmentally motivated, camera locked parallel never deviating from rear chase position.

zh.p: 猎豹后方2.5米处追拍稳定器，以112公里/小时锁定追踪，穿越茂密丛林下层植被，摄像机高度40厘米，与猎豹步伐完全同步，垂直方向零漂移。目标突然向左急转28度绕过巨大无花果树干，脊柱先压缩再猛然伸展至完全舒展，四足腾空进入悬空阶段，斑驳的黄金时段光线在斑点皮毛上闪烁。随即向右急转32度穿过两棵桃花心木树干间的缝隙，身体倾斜方向与摄像机倾斜方向相反，背景枝叶化作纯粹动态模糊，而目标始终锐利地居于画面中央。直线穿越蕨类植物走廊后，为避开倒木向左激进倾斜25度，每个步幅周期中脊柱从最大压缩到完全伸展。向右30度转弯沿自然小径弯曲前行，温暖侧光勾勒出肌肉线条，长影在丛林地面高速掠过。最后向左27度迂回穿过竹丛，全程保持最大速度，每次方向变化均由环境驱动，摄像机始终平行锁定，从未偏离后方追拍位置。

en.p: [0-4s Burst Opening] In a dim, abandoned underground parking lot, the cold white light of long tube ceiling lamps outlines the figure of an Asian warrior with a high topknot and shaved sides (Image 1). He wears a tattered white robe, adorned with exquisite silver dragon-patterned mechanical shoulder armor, neck guard, and mechanical gauntlets. The camera pushes forward from a low angle. The warrior, who was crouching on the roof of a battered car, suddenly tenses his entire body, muscles bulging beneath the white robe. His feet (combat boots) stomp hard through the car's hood [the metal hood instantly caves in and tears, sheet metal fragments fly in all directions, and a harsh screech of twisting metal explodes]. He jerks his head up, eyes sharp and fierce, his topknot swaying with the movement. His entire upper body lunges forward, the silver shoulder armor glinting under the cold light. The camera tracks quickly, instantly ramping up the combat tension. [4-8s Rhythm Duel] The warrior's thick arm, covered by a silver mechanical gauntlet, slams heavily into the car's body. Continuous heavy blows carry devastating brute force. The camera rapidly pans and tracks each strike. The first punch shatters the front windshield [the tempered glass instantly bursts into a spiderweb pattern, countless shards of glass spray out, and the seats inside are blasted away by the punch's force]. The second elbow strike crashes into the car's side [the door panel is punched through, the axle breaks, the tire instantly blows out and deflates, and the car tilts violently to one side]. The warrior leverages the momentum to flip over, his powerful legs kicking off the car body. The camera orbits to follow his spinning motion, maintaining seamless action continuity without any frame breaks. Each attack is accompanied by precise physical feedback. The slight shake of the handheld camera simulates the visceral impact of real combat. Dust swirls and dances in the overhead light, the white robe billows violently, and the silver armor reflects light intensely. [8-12s Peak Confrontation] The camera switches to a 360-degree orbiting shot, simultaneously activating slow-motion to showcase the warrior's peak power eruption. The warrior gathers all his strength, clenching both fists together and smashing them down onto the already severely deformed car. Every muscle line is stretched to the extreme in slow motion, veins bulging. The silver mechanical shoulder armor and gauntlets gleam with a cold sheen under the light. His face is resolute with a short beard, and the topknot warrior's expression is extremely ferocious. At the moment his fists make contact with the car body, ultimate destructive force erupts [the entire car body is completely flattened, the metal frame fully bent and snapped, the fuel tank ruptures, gasoline mixed with engine oil sprays out, debris and metal fragments on the ground are blasted into the air by the shockwave, and dust forms a ring-shaped airwave spreading outward]. The slow motion perfectly captures every detail of the power burst, with extreme physical simulation of fabric and metal. [12-15s Ultimate Freeze Frame] The slow motion ends. The camera quickly whips back to a low-angle upward shot. The warrior suddenly straightens up, standing on the flattened car. His feet planted on the completely wrecked vehicle, he roars a震慑 roar to the sky, every muscle in his body tensed. The tattered white robe rustles loudly in the residual wind of the shockwave [the remaining gasoline on the ground is ignited by friction sparks, faint flames spread at the bottom of the car, the surrounding walls are densely pitted by flying debris, dust slowly settles, and the entire underground parking lot echoes with the hum of metal aftershocks]. The shot finally freezes on the warrior's overwhelmingly oppressive and intimidating stance. Global parameters: 8K ultra-high definition, cinematic dark cold-tone color grading, extreme light and shadow contrast, full physical simulation of fabric and muscle movement, handheld camera to simulate the visceral impact of real combat, seamless action continuity throughout, high-detail reflections on the silver mechanical armor and dynamic fluttering of the white robe.

zh.p:
[0-4s 爆发起手] 昏暗废弃地下停车场，冷白长管顶灯的顶光勾勒出那位留着高顶髻、两侧剃短发的亚洲武士
图片1
的身影，他身穿破损白色长袍，外覆精致银色龙纹机械肩甲、颈甲和机械臂铠，手持镜头从低角度向前推进，原本蹲伏在破旧轿车车顶的武士猛然绷紧全身，白色长袍下的肌肉紧绷，双脚（战靴）狠狠踏碎轿车引擎盖 [金属引擎盖瞬间凹陷撕裂，钣金碎片向四周飞溅，刺耳的金属扭曲声炸裂]，他猛地抬起头，眼神锐利凶狠，顶髻在动作中晃动，整个上半身向前俯冲，银色肩甲在冷光下闪烁，镜头快速跟拍，瞬间拉升战斗张力； [4-8s 节奏博弈] 武士覆盖银色机械臂铠的粗壮手臂狠狠砸向轿车车身，连续的重击带着毁灭性的蛮力，镜头快速摇移跟拍每一次重击，第一拳砸烂车前挡风玻璃 [钢化玻璃瞬间呈蛛网状炸裂，无数玻璃碎屑喷涌而出，车内座椅被拳风掀飞]，第二记肘击狠狠撞向车身侧面 [车门钣金直接被砸穿，车轴断裂，轮胎瞬间爆胎瘪陷，车身向一侧剧烈倾斜]，武士借力翻身，强壮的双腿蹬踏车身，镜头环绕跟拍其回旋动作，全程保持动作的连贯性，无画面断裂，每一次攻击都伴随精准的物理反馈，手持镜头的轻微晃动模拟真实战斗的震撼感，灰尘在顶光中弥漫飞舞，白色长袍剧烈飘动，银色盔甲反光强烈； [8-12s 巅峰对垒] 镜头切换为 360 度环绕运镜，同时开启升格慢动作，展现武士的巅峰力量爆发，武士汇聚全身力量，双拳并拢狠狠向下砸向已经严重变形的轿车，全身肌肉线条在慢动作中极致绷紧，青筋暴起，银色机械肩甲和臂铠在冷光中泛着寒芒，面容坚毅短须，顶髻武士表情极度凶狠，拳锋与车身接触的瞬间，极致的破坏力爆发 [整个轿车车身被彻底砸扁，金属框架完全弯折断裂，油箱破裂，汽油混合着机油喷涌而出，地面碎石与金属碎片被冲击波掀飞至半空，灰尘形成环形气浪向四周扩散]，慢动作极致展现力量爆发的每一个细节，布料与金属物理模拟极致； [12-15s 终极定格] 升格结束，镜头快速甩镜拉回低角度仰拍，武士从砸扁的轿车上猛然站直身躯，双脚踏在彻底报废的车身上，仰天发出震慑的怒吼，全身肌肉紧绷，破损的白色长袍在冲击波的余风中猎猎作响 [地面残留的汽油被摩擦火花点燃，微弱的火焰在车身底部蔓延，周围墙体被飞溅的碎片砸出密集的凹痕，灰尘缓缓落下，整个地下停车场回荡着金属余震的嗡鸣]，最终镜头定格在武士极具压迫感的威慑姿态，全局参数：8K 超清画质，电影级暗黑冷色调调色，极端光影对比，全布料与肌肉运动物理模拟，手持镜头模拟真实战斗的震撼感，全程动作连贯无断裂，高细节银色机械盔甲反光与白色长袍动态飘动

en.p:
FORMAT: 15s / single continuous impossible camera move / no dialogue
STYLE: Dense Southeast Asian night market, wet stone, steam and fire, orange lantern light, photorealistic ground-to-aerial cinematic 8K
Shot 01 (0:00–2:00): Camera starts at ankle level. Forest of feet — sandals, bare feet, flip flops on glistening wet stone. Market sounds overwhelming. Camera weaves between legs like water. Audio: Wet footsteps, distant vendor calls, sizzling.

Shot 02 (2:00–3:30): Camera rises slowly past steaming woks. A gas flame bursts at exact eye level — camera briefly engulfed in orange fire then emerges through it, uncut. Audio: Gas flame WHOMP. Wok sizzle. Shot 03 (3:30–5:00): Camera weaves through hanging lanterns at mid-height, skimming past them like a moth navigating. Red and orange light strobing across the lens. Audio: Lantern chains clinking. Crowd murmur. Shot 04 (5:00–6:30): Camera dips suddenly under a low table. A child has fallen asleep on a bag under here. Quiet pocket of stillness inside the chaos. Camera lingers one beat. Audio: Noise muffled. Child's quiet breathing.
Shot 05 (6:30–8:00): Camera rises back up through the smoke of a charcoal grill — lens briefly obscured by smoke, then emerges above the stall canopy level. Audio: Charcoal crackle. Smoke hiss.
Shot 06 (8:00–10:00): Camera continues rising — now above rooftop level. The market reveals itself as an endless orange lantern sea stretching to the horizon. Camera tilts slowly, taking in the full scale. Audio: Market sounds fading to a low ambient hum.
Shot 07 (10:00–12:00): Camera begins descending back down — targeting a single stall at the market edge. A lone vendor counting coins. Everything closing around them. Audio: Distant vendor calls dying out one by one. Shot 08 (12:00–13:30): Camera settles at the vendor's hands. Close on coins being stacked methodically. One lantern swaying above them. Audio: Coin clinks. Wind in the lantern.
Shot 09 (13:30–15:00): Camera tilts up slowly to the vendor's face. They look up — directly into the camera. Hold. Fade to black. Audio: Last coin placed. Silence.
STYLE NOTES: Ground level feels claustrophobic and overwhelming. The aerial shot is the emotional exhale. Warm orange and red throughout — deepening to amber at the end. Wet stone reflections throughout. Real fire and real smoke, no CG substitutes. 8K.

zh.p:
格式：15秒 / 单一连续不可中断的镜头运动 / 无对白
风格：密集的东南亚夜市，湿漉漉的石板，蒸汽与火焰，橙色灯笼光，照片级真实的地面到空中电影级8K

镜头01（0:00–2:00）：镜头从脚踝高度开始。一片腿的森林——凉鞋、赤脚、人字拖踩在反光的湿石板上。市场喧嚣声铺天盖地。镜头像水流般在腿间穿梭。
音频：湿漉漉的脚步声，远处摊贩的叫卖声，滋滋作响的煎炒声。

镜头02（2:00–3:30）：镜头缓缓上升，掠过冒着热气的炒锅。一团燃气火焰恰好喷涌至视线高度——镜头短暂被橙色火焰吞没，随即穿透火焰而出，一气呵成。
音频：燃气火焰的“呼”声。炒锅的滋滋声。

镜头03（3:00–5:00）：镜头在半空高度穿梭于悬挂的灯笼之间，像飞蛾般擦过它们。红橙色的光在镜头前闪烁。
音频：灯笼链条的叮当声。人群的嗡嗡低语。

镜头04（5:00–6:30）：镜头突然俯冲至一张矮桌下方。一个孩子正枕着袋子在桌下酣睡。混乱中一片安静的静止角落。镜头停留片刻。
音频：噪音变得沉闷。孩子平稳的呼吸声。

镜头05（6:30–8:00）：镜头从炭火烤架的烟雾中重新升起——镜片短暂被烟雾遮蔽，随后从摊位遮阳篷上方浮现。
音频：炭火的噼啪声。烟雾的嘶嘶声。

镜头06（8:00–10:00）：镜头继续上升——现在已越过屋顶高度。市场展现出它绵延至地平线的无尽橙色灯笼海洋。镜头缓缓倾斜，尽收全景。
音频：市场喧嚣逐渐减弱为低沉的背景嗡鸣。

镜头07（10:00–12:00）：镜头开始下降——瞄准市场边缘的一个孤零零摊位。一位摊主独自数着硬币。一切在周围收拢。
音频：远处摊贩的叫卖声逐一消失。

镜头08（12:00–13:30）：镜头定格在摊主的双手上。特写硬币被有条不紊地叠放。头顶一盏灯笼轻轻摇曳。
音频：硬币的叮当声。灯笼中的风声。

镜头09（13:30–15:00）：镜头缓缓上移至摊主的面庞。他抬起头——直视镜头。定格。渐黑。
音频：最后一枚硬币落下。寂静。

风格提示：地面视角令人感到幽闭压抑。空中镜头是情感上的释放。贯穿始终的暖橙色与红色——结尾渐变为琥珀色。全片湿石板的反光。真实的火焰与烟雾，无CG替代。8K。

FORMAT: 15s / single continuous impossible camera move / no dialogue
STYLE: Dense Southeast Asian night market, wet stone, steam and fire, orange lantern light, photorealistic ground-to-aerial cinematic 8K
Shot 01 (0:00–2:00): Camera starts at ankle level. Forest of feet — sandals, bare feet, flip flops on glistening wet stone. Market sounds overwhelming. Camera weaves between legs like water. Audio: Wet footsteps, distant vendor calls, sizzling.

Shot 02 (2:00–3:30): Camera rises slowly past steaming woks. A gas flame bursts at exact eye level — camera briefly engulfed in orange fire then emerges through it, uncut. Audio: Gas flame WHOMP. Wok sizzle. Shot 03 (3:30–5:00): Camera weaves through hanging lanterns at mid-height, skimming past them like a moth navigating. Red and orange light strobing across the lens. Audio: Lantern chains clinking. Crowd murmur. Shot 04 (5:00–6:30): Camera dips suddenly under a low table. A child has fallen asleep on a bag under here. Quiet pocket of stillness inside the chaos. Camera lingers one beat. Audio: Noise muffled. Child's quiet breathing.
Shot 05 (6:30–8:00): Camera rises back up through the smoke of a charcoal grill — lens briefly obscured by smoke, then emerges above the stall canopy level. Audio: Charcoal crackle. Smoke hiss.
Shot 06 (8:00–10:00): Camera continues rising — now above rooftop level. The market reveals itself as an endless orange lantern sea stretching to the horizon. Camera tilts slowly, taking in the full scale. Audio: Market sounds fading to a low ambient hum.
Shot 07 (10:00–12:00): Camera begins descending back down — targeting a single stall at the market edge. A lone vendor counting coins. Everything closing around them. Audio: Distant vendor calls dying out one by one. Shot 08 (12:00–13:30): Camera settles at the vendor's hands. Close on coins being stacked methodically. One lantern swaying above them. Audio: Coin clinks. Wind in the lantern.
Shot 09 (13:30–15:00): Camera tilts up slowly to the vendor's face. They look up — directly into the camera. Hold. Fade to black. Audio: Last coin placed. Silence.
STYLE NOTES: Ground level feels claustrophobic and overwhelming. The aerial shot is the emotional exhale. Warm orange and red throughout — deepening to amber at the end. Wet stone reflections throughout. Real fire and real smoke, no CG substitutes. 8K.

en.p: A stylized cinematic 3D animation set on a nighttime city street with wet reflective pavement, soft street lights, and neon glow. An anthropomorphic white rabbit magician stands at the center, wearing a black tailcoat, white shirt, black bow tie, and a black top hat, surrounded by a loose semicircle of onlookers. The rabbit performs smooth, professional card handling with a standard 52-card deck. The deck is fanned evenly at chest height, all cards visible and unique. A hand from the camera selects one card from the fan — the Ace of Hearts. The rabbit takes the same card and holds it clearly facing the camera. The rabbit flicks the card lightly. The Ace of Hearts begins to glow at the edges, then disintegrates into fine red and gold particles. The particles form a controlled, continuous stream with motion trails, flowing forward across the street. The camera follows the particle stream as it travels toward a large glass building facade. Upon impact, a point of light appears and expands outward in a grid-like pattern across the glass surface. The entire building facade activates, and a massive glowing Ace of Hearts forms across it, bright and clearly defined, with subtle pulsing light. After a brief hold, the giant Ace of Hearts breaks apart into particles again. The particles reverse direction, streaming back through the air toward the rabbit. The rabbit steps forward and reaches into the air, catching the incoming particles. In close-up, the particles compress and reform into a single solid playing card in the rabbit’s hand — the Ace of Hearts, unchanged. The rabbit presents the card toward the camera. The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the crowd reacting and clapping, while the city lights and reflections remain vivid in the background.

zh.p: 一段风格化的电影级3D动画，场景设定在夜晚的城市街道上，路面湿漉漉的映着倒影，柔和的街灯与霓虹灯光交相辉映。一只拟人化的白兔魔术师站在中央，身穿黑色燕尾服、白衬衫、黑领结，头戴黑色高顶礼帽，周围围着一圈松散的半圆形观众。兔子用一副标准的52张扑克牌，流畅而专业地展示着牌技。牌组在胸前均匀展开成扇形，每张牌都清晰可见且各不相同。镜头中伸出一只手，从扇形牌中选出一张——红心A。兔子接过同一张牌，将其正面清晰地朝向镜头。兔子轻轻弹了一下牌面，红心A的边缘开始发光，随后分解成细密的红金色粒子。这些粒子形成一条受控的连续流束，带着运动轨迹，向前穿过街道。镜头跟随粒子流，一路飞向一栋大型玻璃建筑的外墙。撞击瞬间，一个光点出现，并在玻璃表面以网格状向外扩散。整面建筑外墙被激活，一个巨大的发光红心A图案浮现在其上，明亮而清晰，带着微微脉动的光芒。短暂停留后，巨大的红心A再次碎裂成粒子。粒子反向流动，穿过空气飞回兔子身边。兔子向前迈步，伸手在空中接住飞来的粒子。特写镜头中，粒子在兔子手中压缩重组，变回一张完整的扑克牌——红心A，完好如初。兔子将牌朝向镜头展示。镜头缓缓拉远，观众们纷纷鼓掌喝彩，背景中的城市灯光与倒影依然鲜明生动。

en.p: On the floor of a child's room, a miniature-sized girl rides a tiny skateboard, zipping along just above the floor at high speed. The scale makes human-sized toys and furniture appear gigantic. The camera follows closely from behind at a low angle, creating a one-shot-style image that continuously moves forward into the depth. Ultra-wide-angle lens, motion blur, depth of field, cinematic lighting. The speed gradually increases in three stages. In the first stage, she swiftly navigates narrow pathways resembling the valleys between buildings in a Lego city, slaloming between blocks as she advances. In the second stage, a giant ball rolls toward her from the front, and she slides into a narrow gap against the wall, barely dodges under falling blocks, and narrowly passes between the tires of a running toy car. In the third stage, she bursts through the gap between the pages of a picture book that is closing due to the wind, slips under the swaying arm of a stuffed animal, and finally dives into the narrow opening of a toy box that is about to close, disappearing into the dark depths at maximum speed. A thrilling and exhilarating sequence of narrow escapes. In a realistic child's room, this immersive, attraction-like footage leverages the giant obstacles and tiny gaps unique to a miniature perspective.

zh.p: 子ども部屋の床の上で、ミニチュアサイズの少女が小さなスケートボードに乗り、床すれすれを高速で走り抜ける。人間サイズのおもちゃや家具が巨大に見えるスケール感。カメラは主人公のすぐ背後から低い位置で追尾し、常に奥へ進み続けるワンカット風の映像。超広角レンズ、モーションブラー、被写界深度、シネマティックライティング。スピードは3段階で徐々に上がっていく。第1段階では、レゴの街のビルの谷間のような狭い通路を高速で抜け、積み木の間をスラロームしながら前進する。第2段階では、前方から巨大なボールが転がってきて壁とのわずかな隙間へ滑り込み、倒れてくる積み木の下を紙一重でくぐり抜け、走るミニカーのタイヤの間をギリギリで通過する。第3段階では、風で閉じかける絵本のページとページの隙間を突き抜け、揺れるぬいぐるみの腕の下をすり抜け、最後は閉まりかけるおもちゃ箱のフタのわずかな隙間へ飛び込み、最大速度のまま暗い奥へ消えていく。危機一髪の回避が連続する、スリリングで爽快感のある映像。現実にありそうな子ども部屋の中で、ミニチュア視点ならではの巨大な障害物と小さな隙間を活かした、没入感のあるアトラクションのような映像。

Style: cinematic, ultra dynamic, DreamWorks-level animation, dramatic lighting, motion blur, epic scale, fast cuts, emotional arc

0–2s
Clumsy gray cat in yellow kung fu suit slips and falls, gets smacked down by orange master cat in gray Taoist robe with long white eyebrows.
Master (cold): “Too slow.”
VO: “He was nothing.”

2–5s
Training montage: gray cat bruised, panting, failing kicks, collapsing in rain, then rising again.
Gray Cat (whisper): “Again…”
VO: “Until he chose to rise.”

5–8s
Arena reveal: massive animal kingdom tournament, roaring crowd. Gray cat stands alone.
Tiger lunges → fast dodge → counter strike.
VO: “Face the strong.”

8–11s
Rapid cuts: eagle dive attack → mid-air spin kick; lion roar clash → explosive impact.
Gray Cat (shout): “I’m not afraid!”
VO: “Become unstoppable.”

11–13s
Final shot: gray cat lands in victory stance, wind blowing. Master watches, slight nod.
Master (soft): “You’re ready.”
en.t: From Zero to Kung Fu Hero

Style: cinematic, ultra dynamic, DreamWorks-level animation, dramatic lighting, motion blur, epic scale, fast cuts, emotional arc

0–2s
Clumsy gray cat in yellow kung fu suit slips and falls, gets smacked down by orange master cat in gray Taoist robe with long white eyebrows.
Master (cold): “Too slow.”
VO: “He was nothing.”

2–5s
Training montage: gray cat bruised, panting, failing kicks, collapsing in rain, then rising again.
Gray Cat (whisper): “Again…”
VO: “Until he chose to rise.”

5–8s
Arena reveal: massive animal kingdom tournament, roaring crowd. Gray cat stands alone.
Tiger lunges → fast dodge → counter strike.
VO: “Face the strong.”

8–11s
Rapid cuts: eagle dive attack → mid-air spin kick; lion roar clash → explosive impact.
Gray Cat (shout): “I’m not afraid!”
VO: “Become unstoppable.”

11–13s
Final shot: gray cat lands in victory stance, wind blowing. Master watches, slight nod.
Master (soft): “You’re ready.”

en.p: In a spacious sunlit studio, an artist stands before a large canvas, brush in hand, deeply immersed in their work. Warm, cinematic natural light pours through tall windows, casting soft shadows that dance across the textured walls and wooden floor. The atmosphere hums with creativity, filled with scattered paint tubes, brushes, and sketches hinting at inspiration. Every stroke of the brush brings the canvas to life, capturing the passion and focus of the moment. The scene feels alive, intimate, and charged with artistic energy, inviting viewers to witness the birth of imagination in motion.

en.p: Theme 2: Minimalist Forest Style - Emerald Enchantment, Light of Love Visual Core: Utilize the Tyndall effect (Jesus light) and dappled light textures to create a fresh, ethereal, and vibrant elf-like feel. Photorealistic style, fresh and airy, 4K HD. 0-4 seconds: A drone perspective swoops down through the canopy and pushes forward. In the early morning primeval redwood forest, thick fog lingers, and a strong Tyndall effect (Jesus light) pours through the leaves, forming beams of light. The bride wears a lightweight French lace camisole wedding dress, and the groom wears a light khaki linen suit. Both are barefoot, running on moss-covered giant tree roots, with the hem of the wedding dress lightly weaving through the light and shadow. 5-9 seconds: The camera shifts to a low-angle upward tracking shot. The bride has a round, cute face, downturned eyebrows, clear almond-shaped eyes, a small delicate nose, and peach-like lips, beaming with smiles; the groom has soft contours, gentle eyes and brows, a high nose bridge, and a doting smile at the corners of his mouth. They stop under a massive main beam of light, and the groom embraces the bride from behind, their hands clasped together. A breeze blows, and glowing golden leaves drift down in mid-air. 10-15 seconds: The camera pushes to an extreme close-up side profile. Dappled tree shadows slowly glide across their faces. The bride closes her eyes, feeling the sunlight, while the groom gently rests his chin on the top of her head. The scene is filled with minimalist healing vibes, with the green background softly blurred, and a glowing firefly slowly drifts past the lens. The frame freezes on the moment sunlight illuminates their smiling profiles. Sound Effects: Ethereal guitar plucking, crisp bird chirps, the rustling sound of stepping on fallen leaves, and melodious Irish flute. Prohibited: Any text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

zh.p: 主题二：极简森系风 - 绿野仙踪，沐光之恋 视觉核心：利用丁达尔效应（耶稣光）和光影斑驳的质感，打造清新脱俗、充满生命力的精灵感。 真人写实风格，清新空灵，4K高清。 0-4秒：无人机视角从树冠穿梭而下，平推向前。清晨的原始红木森林，浓雾未散，强烈的丁达尔效应（耶稣光）穿透树叶倾泻而下，形成一道道光柱。新娘穿着轻盈的法式蕾丝吊带轻婚纱，新郎穿着浅卡其色亚麻西服。两人赤脚在布满青苔的巨大树根上奔跑，婚纱下摆在光影中轻盈穿梭。 5-9秒：镜头转为低角度跟随仰拍。新娘圆脸可爱，落尾眉，杏眼清澈，小巧鼻尖，蜜桃唇，笑意盈盈；新郎轮廓柔和，眉眼温柔，高挺鼻梁，嘴角带着宠溺的笑。两人在一束巨大的主光柱下停住，新郎从背后环抱新娘，双手交握。微风吹过，半空中飘落发光的金色落叶。 10-15秒：镜头推至极近景的侧脸特写。斑驳的树影在两人脸上缓缓游走。新娘闭上眼睛，感受阳光，新郎将下巴轻轻抵在新娘的头顶。画面充满极简的治愈感，绿色的背景被柔和虚化，镜头前有一只发光的萤火虫缓慢飞过。画面定格在阳光照亮两人微笑侧脸的瞬间。 音效：空灵的吉他拨弦、清脆的鸟鸣、踩在落叶上的沙沙声、悠扬的爱尔兰长笛。 禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

en.p: Generate a high-quality, high-energy K-pop style dance MV clip, paying attention to storyboard composition. Use dynamic tracking camera movements, with the lens smoothly performing 360-degree rotations and push-pull tracking around the subject. The frame focuses on a vibrant and energetic young Japanese woman, who is gracefully and explosively jumping, spinning, and singing joyfully. She wears a fashionable light pink pleated skirt and a white short sweater, with her hair loosely tied into small braids and adorned with silk ribbons. The scene is set in a sunny Tokyo park, surrounded by blooming cherry blossom trees, with petals fluttering and falling through the air like snow. The visual style is cinematic and realistic, with a beautiful Japanese high-key color palette and rich depth of field effects. The visual rhythm should sync with the upbeat, strong-beat pop music in the background, with the character's expressions vivid, radiant, and joyful, simulating natural singing mouth movements. Ensure the dance movements are smooth and free of jumps, with lighting transitioning naturally as the camera rotates.

en.p: Create a short video themed around a cat making handmade ramen at a late-night diner, with cinematic color grading (warm tones, full of the hustle and bustle atmosphere), fine grain, and shallow depth of field. The protagonist is a cat, playing the role of a professional ramen chef, with its appearance strictly following the reference in [@【@Figure 1】]. The scene is set in front of a Japanese-style late-night ramen stall on a city street. The background features warm yellow lanterns, a wooden counter, and blurred distant street neon lights. The video content needs to be presented in the following storyboard steps: Kneading and cutting the dough: The cat, wearing a small apron, rhythmically kneads the dough on a floured wooden board, then uses a sharp knife to cut the dough into evenly thin noodles. Boiling and draining the noodles: The cat shakes the noodles into a large pot of boiling water, then after a few seconds, uses a bamboo strainer to scoop them up, skillfully shaking them twice in the air to drain excess water. Preparing the broth: The cat holds a delicate long-handled ladle, scoops a spoonful of broth from a pot of rich, simmering white bone broth, and slowly pours it into a deep blue ceramic bowl. Plating: The cat neatly places the cooked noodles into the bowl with chopsticks, then arranges two thick slices of chashu, half a soft-boiled egg, a few pieces of seaweed, and chopped green onions on top of the noodles, with precise movements. Ending: The ending shot shows the cat chef gently pushing this steaming, misty bowl of ramen toward the camera and nodding slightly. Requirements: Video style: Realistic, clear picture, medium shot. Sound (ASMR): No voiceover throughout the video, but amplify the sounds: the "tap-tap" of cutting noodles, the "splash" of noodles entering the water, the "swish" of draining water, and the flow of hot broth into the bowl. Background music: Soft, soothing saxophone music in the background to create a quiet late-night atmosphere.

zh.p:
制作一个以猫咪在深夜食堂制作手作拉面为主题的短视频，电影级调色（暖色调，充满烟火气），细腻颗粒，浅景深。
主角是一只猫咪，扮演一位专业拉面师傅，形象外观严格参照【@【@图1】】。
场景设定为城市街头一家充满和式风情的深夜拉面摊位前。背景有温暖的黄色灯笼、木质吧台，以及远处模糊的街道霓虹灯。
视频内容需要按照以下步骤分镜展示：

揉面与切面： 猫咪穿着小围裙，有节奏地在撒了面粉的木质案板上揉捏面团，然后用一把锋利的面刀将面团切成均匀的细面条。

煮面与甩干： 猫咪将面条抖散投入沸腾的大锅中，几秒后用竹漏勺将面条捞起，熟练地在空中用力甩两下，将多余的水分甩干。

调汤底： 猫咪拿着一个精致的长柄勺，从熬制浓郁的白色骨汤锅里舀出一勺汤，缓缓倒入一个深蓝色的陶瓷大碗中。

摆盘： 猫咪用筷子整齐地放入煮好的面条，再依次在面条上摆放两片厚实的叉烧、半个溏心蛋、几片海苔和葱花，动作精细。

结尾： 结尾镜头猫咪师傅将这碗热气腾腾、冒着白烟的拉面轻轻推向镜头，并微微点头示意。

要求：

视频风格： 写实，画面清晰，中景。

声音（ASMR）： 整个视频不需语音旁白，但要放大：切面时的“哒哒”声、面条入水的“哗啦”声、甩干水分的“飒飒”声、热汤入碗的流动声等。

背景音乐： 背景有轻柔、舒缓的萨克斯风音乐，营造静谧的深夜氛围。

en.p:
Please generate a skiing video based on the provided reference image. The overall style should be bright, crisp, full of athletic energy, with smooth motion and cinematic camera language. Timeline and shot design as follows:

0–3s: The character from the image smiles at the camera in the snow. Subtle camera shake with snowflakes falling. Background wind noise gradually increases, and a fast-moving flow of wind and snow appears in the frame.

3–5s: Fast cut to an extreme close-up of the character's feet as the ski bindings snap shut, crushing the snow. Simultaneously, the camera rises, transitioning to an overhead view of a steep snowy slope, showing a clear incline as the sense of speed is about to explode.

5–8s: The character slides down from a height at high speed. Shot 1 is a side-front medium follow shot, with the body leaning forward and movements being sharp; Shot 2 cuts to an overhead shot as the steep slope extends downward, with the snow track lines stretching rapidly, creating a strong sense of speed.

8–11s: A series of rapid camera cuts. A low-angle ground shot shows the skis skimming the snow surface as snow powder is kicked up at high speed; a wide shot shows the character making a beautiful turn on the steep slope, their body and the snow line forming a smooth curve.

11–13s: The camera returns to a front-view follow shot as the character charges toward the lens at high speed, performing a sharp turn at close range, sending a massive spray of snow into the air.

13–15s: A large amount of snow powder splashes directly onto the lens, covering the screen in a white snow mist. The camera briefly loses focus before freezing, leaving a strong dynamic afterimage. The overall emphasis is on speed, cutting rhythm, realistic motion, and youthful vitality, with a bright, non-heavy aesthetic that highlights the thrill and freedom of skiing.

zh.p: 请根据提供的参考图像生成一段滑雪视频。整体风格应明亮、清爽，充满运动活力，动作流畅且具有电影感的镜头语言。时间线与镜头设计如下：0-3秒：图像中的人物在雪中对着镜头微笑。镜头轻微晃动，雪花飘落。背景风声逐渐增强，画面中出现快速流动的风雪流。3-5秒：快速切换至人物脚部的极端特写，滑雪板固定器啪嗒一声扣紧，压碎积雪。同时，镜头升起，转为陡峭雪坡的俯视视角，清晰显示坡度，速度感即将爆发。5-8秒：人物从高处高速滑下。镜头1为侧面中景跟拍，身体前倾，动作利落；镜头2切换至俯拍，陡坡向下延伸，雪道线条快速拉伸，速度感强烈。8-11秒：一系列快速镜头切换。低角度地面镜头展示滑雪板掠过雪面，高速扬起雪粉；广角镜头展示人物在陡坡上完成优美转弯，身体与雪线形成流畅曲线。11-13秒：镜头回到正面跟拍，人物高速冲向镜头，在近距离完成急转弯，激起大片雪雾。13-15秒：大量雪粉直接溅到镜头上，画面被白色雪雾覆盖。镜头短暂失焦后定格，留下强烈的动态残影。整体强调速度、剪辑节奏、真实动作和青春活力，风格明亮不沉重，突出滑雪的刺激与自由感。

5–8s: The character slides down from a height at high speed. Shot 1 is a side-front medium follow shot, with the body leaning forward and movements being sharp; Shot 2 cuts to an overhead shot as the steep slope extends downward, with the snow track lines stretching rapidly, creating a strong sense of speed.

8–11s: A series of rapid camera cuts. A low-angle ground shot shows the skis skimming the snow surface as snow powder is kicked up at high speed; a wide shot shows the character making a beautiful turn on the steep slope, their body and the snow line forming a smooth curve.

11–13s: The camera returns to a front-view follow shot as the character charges toward the lens at high speed, performing a sharp turn at close range, sending a massive spray of snow into the air.

13–15s: A large amount of snow powder splashes directly onto the lens, covering the screen in a white snow mist. The camera briefly loses focus before freezing, leaving a strong dynamic afterimage. The overall emphasis is on speed, cutting rhythm, realistic motion, and youthful vitality, with a bright, non-heavy aesthetic that highlights the thrill and freedom of skiing.

en.p: POV shot from a person’s perspective. A large brown and white eagle is frozen solid, encased in a thin, translucent ice shell on a snowy wooden railing in a misty mountain setting. the person hand using a small hammer to gently tap and shatter the ice. The ice cracks and falls away in large chunks, revealing the hawk’s feathers underneath. The hawk shakes its wings, looks at the camera with a relieved expression, and takes flight into the misty red background. The character said: “Easy now buddy, hang on. One more. There you go. Alright, whenever you’re ready.”

zh.p: 第一人称视角镜头。一只棕白相间的大鹰被冻得僵硬，包裹在一层薄薄的半透明冰壳中，停驻在雾气缭绕的山间雪覆木栏杆上。一只手握着小锤，轻轻敲击并震碎冰层。冰块碎裂成大块脱落，露出鹰隼的羽毛。鹰隼抖了抖翅膀，如释重负地看向镜头，随即振翅飞入雾气弥漫的红色背景中。那人说道：“别急，伙计，撑住。再来一下。好了。行，你随时可以飞走。”

en.p: Cute and sassy Pixar-inspired animated short of anthropomorphic breakfast items debating on a trendy kitchen counter in warm morning light: cool hipster Avocado half with sunglasses, tiny hat, and smooth attitude vs. anxious Slice of Toast with butter sweat drops and perfectionist face. Multi-shot sequence: medium shot of Avocado flexing its pit, close-up on Toast crisping up nervously, over-the-shoulder during smash attempt, chaotic final shot with chili flakes flying. Avocado says: "Bro, just smash me on you. We’ll be Instagram famous. Healthy fats, baby!" Toast panics: "Easy for you to say! You’re always fashionably late and half-rotten inside. I get burned every morning!" Twist: they combine but a hand adds chili flakes — both yell "Too much personality!" in spicy pain. Vibrant food colors, bouncy physics, exaggerated expressions and steam/heat effects. Cinematic foodie camera: quick cuts, slow-motion smash attempt, playful zooms. Warm golden hour lighting with appetizing highlights. Sound effects: sizzling, nervous crunches, spicy yelps, and Instagram camera shutter. High-quality smooth animation, 15 seconds, relatable millennial food trend humor perfect for viral shares.

zh.p: 在温暖晨光中，一群拟人化早餐食品在时尚厨房台面上争论的皮克斯风格动画短片，既可爱又俏皮：戴着墨镜、小帽子、态度酷拽的牛油果半身，与焦虑的吐司片（带着黄油汗珠、一脸完美主义）对峙。多镜头序列：牛油果展示果核的中景，吐司紧张焦脆的特写，试图压碎时的过肩镜头，最后辣椒碎飞溅的混乱镜头。牛油果说：‘兄弟，把我压在你身上吧。咱们能成网红。健康脂肪，宝贝！’吐司惊慌道：‘你说得轻巧！你总是时尚迟到，里面还半烂。我每天早上都被烤焦！’转折：它们结合了，但一只手撒上辣椒碎——两者在辣痛中大喊：‘个性太强了！’鲜艳的食物色彩、弹性的物理效果、夸张的表情和蒸汽/热效。电影级美食镜头：快速切换、慢动作压碎尝试、俏皮变焦。温暖的金色时光照明，配以诱人的高光。音效：滋滋声、紧张的嘎吱声、辣味尖叫和Instagram相机快门声。高质量流畅动画，15秒，贴近千禧一代食品潮流幽默，完美适合病毒式传播。

en.p: A hyper-realistic cinematic horror sequence set in an abandoned Victorian house at night, surrounded by dense fog and dead trees, unsettling atmosphere, cold desaturated tones, low-key lighting, volumetric fog, film grain, chromatic aberration, VHS glitch effects. Slow dolly-in through rusty gate, eerie ambience and low bass rumble. Cut to handheld hallway shot with cracked walls and shifting portraits, faint whispers, shadow flicker. Long corridor with flickering lights, ghostly female figure at end (pale skin, long black hair covering face, torn white dress, unnatural twitching). Sudden glitch distortion, entity instantly appears closer, head tilts unnaturally, faint glowing eyes, loud distorted scream. Hard cut to black, static noise, whisper “I’m still here.” Shot on full-frame camera, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, cinematic focus pulls, 4K UHD, 24fps, ultra-detailed, extremely realistic, uncanny valley, disturbing, viral horror short.

zh.p: 一段超写实的电影级恐怖片段，设定在夜晚一座废弃的维多利亚式房屋中，四周浓雾弥漫，枯树环绕，氛围令人不安，色调冷峻而褪色，采用低调照明、体积雾、胶片颗粒、色差和VHS故障效果。镜头缓慢推进生锈的铁门，伴随着诡异的氛围和低沉的低频轰鸣。切换到手提摄影机拍摄的走廊镜头，墙壁开裂，画像移位，隐约传来低语声，阴影闪烁。一条长走廊上灯光忽明忽暗，尽头出现一个幽灵般的女性身影（苍白皮肤、黑色长发遮面、撕裂的白裙、不自然的抽搐）。突然出现故障扭曲，实体瞬间逼近，头部不自然地歪斜，眼睛发出微光，伴随一声刺耳的扭曲尖叫。硬切至黑屏，静电噪音，低语声“我还在这里。”使用全画幅相机、35mm镜头、浅景深、电影级焦点变换、4K超高清、24帧/秒、极致细节、极度逼真、恐怖谷效应、令人不安、病毒式恐怖短片。

en.p: [Cinematography]: A dynamic low-angle tracking shot glides alongside a sleek black bus, rain streaking across the lens. The camera shifts into a slightly shaky, handheld style as tension builds, emphasizing the scale and intensity of the transformation. Shot on IMAX digital cameras with anamorphic lenses, high shutter speed capturing fine mechanical details, with water droplets clinging to the lens and a shallow depth of field isolating the transforming structure. [Subject]: A matte-black vintage school bus with subtle wear and darkened metal edges, driven by a focused young woman behind the wheel. As the transformation begins, the bus morphs into a towering, industrial T-Rex mecha—formed from interlocking blackened steel, rotating bus tires becoming powerful limb joints, and the front grille tearing open into a sharp, mechanical jaw. [Action]: The girl speeds down the rain-soaked road, gripping the wheel with determination as water sprays from the tires. Suddenly, hydraulic systems activate—the roof splits apart, wheels twist inward into legs, and the chassis rises vertically. The mecha slams onto the ground, cracking the wet asphalt. Its glowing red eyes ignite from the headlights, and it releases a blazing stream of fire into the stormy air. [Context]: A winding, rain-drenched road cutting through a dense, fog-covered pine forest. Towering trees loom on both sides, partially hidden by thick mist. Rain pours heavily, creating reflections on the slick asphalt that mirror the transformation. [Style & Ambiance]: A high-energy sci-fi action tone inspired by blockbuster transformation films. Realistic, gritty CGI textures with dark metallic finishes and subtle rust. The scene is lit with cold blue tones from the stormy twilight, sharply contrasted by the fiery orange glow of the mecha’s breath and piercing red eyes, enhancing the dramatic intensity.

zh.p: 【摄影】：一个动态的低角度跟拍镜头沿着光滑的黑色巴士滑行，雨水在镜头上划出痕迹。随着紧张感加剧，镜头切换为略带摇晃的手持风格，强调变形过程的规模与冲击力。采用IMAX数字摄影机搭配变形镜头拍摄，高快门速度捕捉精细的机械细节，水珠附着在镜头上，浅景深将变形结构从背景中剥离出来。【主体】：一辆哑光黑色复古校车，带有细微磨损和暗色金属边缘，由一位专注的年轻女子驾驶。变形开始时，巴士化身为一座高耸的工业级霸王龙机甲——由相互锁扣的黑色钢材构成，旋转的巴士轮胎变成有力的关节，前格栅撕裂成锋利的机械下颌。【动作】：女孩在湿透的道路上疾驰，紧握方向盘，雨水从轮胎下飞溅。突然，液压系统启动——车顶分裂，车轮向内扭转成腿部，底盘垂直升起。机甲轰然落地，砸裂湿漉漉的沥青路面。车头灯亮起猩红的双眼，向暴风雨的天空喷出一股炽热的火焰。【场景】：一条蜿蜒的雨路穿过浓雾笼罩的密林。高耸的树木在两侧若隐若现，被厚雾半掩。暴雨倾盆，在光滑的沥青路面上映出变形的倒影。【风格与氛围】：以大片变形电影为灵感的高能量科幻动作风格。逼真、粗粝的CGI质感，搭配暗色金属饰面和细微锈迹。场景以暴风雨暮色中的冷蓝色调照明，与机甲吐息和猩红双眼的炽热橙光形成强烈对比，增强戏剧张力。

en.p: 【Style】Eastern Wuxia ultimate showdown, Extreme Kinetic Energy, environmental destruction aesthetics, fast-paced editing, cinema-level particle effects, epic soundtrack atmosphere. 【Duration】15 seconds 【Characters】Master in White VS Master in Black [00:00-00:05] Scene 1: High-speed Collision. The masters in white and black turn into afterimages and collide violently in the center of an ancient stone platform. The moment weapons touch, dazzling sparks and a visible circular shockwave explode, causing the surrounding stone floor to crack instantly and debris to fly. [00:05-00:10] Scene 2: Mid-air Combat & Destruction. The two soar into the air, weaving and clashing at high speed among falling giant rocks, moves too fast to track. Every parry triggers an air distortion sound effect. They crash through a massive stone pillar, causing it to collapse and shatter into dust, demonstrating extreme destructive power. [00:10-00:15] Scene 3: Ultimate Climax. Upon landing, both unleash their finishing moves, with two massive energy spheres (one cyan, one red) blasting against each other. This triggers a world-shaking explosion of dust and energy, with mushroom-cloud-like smoke rising to obscure everything as the entire stone platform base begins to crumble and sink.

en.p:
A full, uncut first-person POV simulating an adult golden eagle escaping at extreme speed.

Camera style: ultra-wide distorted lens with intense edge stretching, an exaggerated sense of spatial depth and motion parallax, and a cinematic macro-like pressure effect. The camera surges forward at near-supersonic speed with violent whipping shakes, rapid dives, aggressive rolls, and chaotic aerial turbulence driven by powerful wing flaps.

The scene is set in an ancient version of New York during a catastrophic volcanic super-eruption. The skyline is reimagined as towering stone skyscrapers, primitive suspension bridges, and colossal monolithic structures. Volcanic ash storms rage as lava bombs rain from the sky, obliterating everything in their path.

The golden eagle dives at extreme speed through a massive stone archway resembling an ancient Manhattan gateway; flaming debris and collapsing towers explode outward as molten fragments strike. It spirals downward between towering structures, narrowly dodging falling stone slabs and fiery wreckage, skimming just above the ground before bursting through a collapsing avenue.

It then races through a grand, ancient Wall Street district, where colossal columns and statue-lined pathways shatter under volcanic shockwaves. Massive stone pillars snap and topple like dominoes, marble fragments scattering violently as the eagle performs sharp, chained evasive maneuvers between collapsing structures.

Next, it plunges vertically through a giant domed temple inspired by early New York architecture. The dome cracks under immense pressure, huge chunks crashing down as the eagle weaves through tight interior spaces and escapes through a ruptured wall.

The flight continues toward an ancient monumental complex resembling a primitive Statue of Liberty structure, now partially destroyed by lava impacts. The eagle darts through shattered frameworks and collapsing stone scaffolding, weaving in tight S-shaped paths through falling debris.

The camera remains violently unstable throughout, constantly shaken by shockwaves and turbulence. The atmosphere is dominated by a blood-orange volcanic sky, glowing lava trails streaking across the frame, and towering bursts of firelight. Ash, molten fragments, stone dust, and burning embers swirl chaotically around the camera.

Emotional tone: extreme, relentless, and adrenaline-surging, capturing a desperate high-speed escape through the destruction of an ancient New York.

zh.p: 一段完整、未经剪辑的第一人称视角模拟，展现一只成年金雕以极限速度逃逸。镜头风格采用超广角畸变镜头，边缘强烈拉伸，营造出夸张的空间纵深感和运动视差，并带有电影般的微距压迫效果。镜头以接近超音速的速度向前猛冲，伴随着剧烈的甩动摇晃、急速俯冲、猛烈翻滚，以及由强力翅膀拍打引发的混乱空中湍流。场景设定在远古版本的纽约，正值一场灾难性的超级火山大爆发。天际线被重新构想为高耸的石制摩天大楼、原始悬索桥和巨大的独石结构。火山灰风暴肆虐，熔岩炸弹如雨点般从天而降，摧毁沿途的一切。金雕以极限速度俯冲穿过一座形似远古曼哈顿门户的巨大石拱门；燃烧的碎片和倒塌的塔楼向外爆炸，熔岩碎片击中目标。它在高耸的建筑之间螺旋下降，惊险地躲过坠落的石板和燃烧的残骸，紧贴地面掠过，然后冲破一条坍塌的大道。接着，它冲过宏伟的远古华尔街区，巨大的柱子和雕像林立的道路在火山冲击波下碎裂。巨大的石柱像多米诺骨牌一样折断倒塌，大理石碎片猛烈飞散，金雕在倒塌的建筑之间进行一连串尖锐的规避动作。随后，它垂直俯冲穿过一座受早期纽约建筑启发的巨大圆顶神庙。圆顶在巨大压力下开裂，大块碎石轰然落下，金雕在狭窄的内部空间穿梭，并从破裂的墙壁逃出。飞行继续朝向一个类似原始自由女神像结构的远古纪念建筑群，该建筑已被熔岩撞击部分摧毁。金雕穿梭于破碎的框架和倒塌的石制脚手架之间，在坠落的碎片中以紧密的S形路径迂回前进。整个过程中，镜头因冲击波和湍流而剧烈晃动，极不稳定。氛围被血橙色的火山天空主导，发光的熔岩轨迹划过画面，高耸的火焰光芒冲天而起。火山灰、熔岩碎片、石尘和燃烧的火星在镜头周围混乱地旋转。情感基调：极致、无情、肾上腺素飙升，捕捉了一场穿越远古纽约毁灭景象的绝望高速逃逸。

The skyline is reimagined as towering stone skyscrapers, primitive suspension bridges, and colossal monolithic structures. Volcanic ash storms rage as lava bombs rain from the sky, obliterating everything in their path.

The golden eagle dives at extreme speed through a massive stone archway resembling an ancient Manhattan gateway; flaming debris and collapsing towers explode outward as molten fragments strike. It spirals downward between towering structures, narrowly dodging falling stone slabs and fiery wreckage, skimming just above the ground before bursting through a collapsing avenue.

It then races through a grand, ancient Wall Street district, where colossal columns and statue-lined pathways shatter under volcanic shockwaves. Massive stone pillars snap and topple like dominoes, marble fragments scattering violently as the eagle performs sharp, chained evasive maneuvers between collapsing structures.

Next, it plunges vertically through a giant domed temple inspired by early New York architecture. The dome cracks under immense pressure, huge chunks crashing down as the eagle weaves through tight interior spaces and escapes through a ruptured wall.

The flight continues toward an ancient monumental complex resembling a primitive Statue of Liberty structure, now partially destroyed by lava impacts. The eagle darts through shattered frameworks and collapsing stone scaffolding, weaving in tight S-shaped paths through falling debris.

The camera remains violently unstable throughout, constantly shaken by shockwaves and turbulence. The atmosphere is dominated by a blood-orange volcanic sky, glowing lava trails streaking across the frame, and towering bursts of firelight. Ash, molten fragments, stone dust, and burning embers swirl chaotically around the camera.

en.t: FBI Agent Confronts Alien at Party

zh.p:
镜头1 — 0:00至0:04 拥挤的室内派对场景，背景挂着暖色串灯，人们手持红色杯子欢笑。一名穿深色西装的严肃男子俯身向前，一只手稳稳按在灰色外星人光滑的大头顶上，另一只手将FBI徽章直怼镜头。他目光如炬，直直盯着前方，画面呈现颗粒感的胶片摄影美学，35毫米质感，浅景深效果，混乱的派对背景略微虚化。男子死死盯着镜头，缓缓说道：“我找了你二十六年。”

镜头2 — 0:04至0:09 灰色外星人的中近景特写，巨大的黑色眼睛一眨不眨，纹丝不动，面无表情。背景中派对喧闹声和笑声持续响亮，一段漫长而尴尬的沉默后，外星人缓缓眨了一次眼。外星人以平静、平淡、带着回音的传心术声音回应：“我们知道。你在我们母舰上留了很差的评价。”

镜头3 — 0:09至0:12 男子面部特写，下巴收紧，眼睛眯起，他慢慢放下FBI徽章，凝视了许久。周围的笑声略微减弱，背景中一人正笑着突然僵住，察觉到紧张气氛。昏暗的暖光映在他脸上，表情极度严肃，没有音乐，只有环境噪音。他轻声而坚定地说：“那次绑架可不是五星好评。”

镜头4 — 0:12至0:15 全景镜头，男子和外星人沉默地面向前方，派对在他们周围继续混乱地进行，完全不受影响。男子仍把手放在外星人头上，两人纹丝不动，这是最荒唐房间里最严肃的两个身影。镜头静止，缓慢地极轻微推近，渐黑。屏幕出现文字：“真相依然在外。”

风格说明：颗粒感35毫米胶片美学 · 温暖的实用派对灯光 · 荒诞背景下的冷面严肃基调 · 浅景深 · 无跳切 · 缓慢从容的节奏 · 微妙的氛围音效设计 · 逼真的外星人纹理 · 通过反差营造的冷幽默

en.p: An agile deep-sea explorer propelled by a sleek underwater jet-scooter through a massive, bustling bio-luminescent coral city, weaving effortlessly through swarms of glowing jellyfish, dodging massive sea turtles, submersible taxis, and towering kelp forests. She glides past ancient sunken ruins, busy aquatic intersections, and vibrant anemone farms, spinning through tight crevices with precision and style. Cinematic tracking shots follow her current-riding movement, enhanced by dynamic motion blur and piercing shafts of turquoise light illuminating the deep blue abyss. The underwater realm pulses with a vibrant aquatic vibe—bubbling vents, echoing whale songs, and nonstop fluid motion. Ultra-realistic detail with a marine action-movie aesthetic, capturing speed, grace, and fearless momentum beneath the waves.

zh.p: 一位敏捷的深海探险者驾驶着流线型水下喷气摩托，穿梭于一座庞大而繁华的生物荧光珊瑚城市中。她轻盈地绕过成群的发光水母，灵巧地避开巨型海龟、水下出租车和高耸的海藻森林。她滑过古老沉没的遗迹、繁忙的水下十字路口和生机勃勃的海葵农场，以精准而优雅的姿态旋转穿过狭窄的岩缝。电影般的跟踪镜头追随她随波逐流的动作，动态运动模糊和穿透深蓝深渊的碧绿光束增强了视觉效果。水下世界涌动着充满活力的水生氛围——冒着气泡的喷口、回荡的鲸歌和永不停歇的流动。超写实的细节融合了海洋动作片的美学，捕捉了海浪之下的速度、优雅和无畏的冲劲。

en.p: [@Image 1] (Male lead reference) [@Image 2] (Female lead reference) Cinematic quality, 15 seconds, montage editing, no subtitles, Korean dialogue. Opening from second 0 to second 1, warm yellow film tone, past. A sunny afternoon café, she lies asleep on the table, he sits opposite, chin resting on his hand, looking down at her, the corners of his mouth unable to suppress a smile, the frame has slight grain and overexposure. Hard cut to second 1, cold blue rainy night, present. An empty rooftop, he stands with his back to the camera in the rain, his coat soaked through, clinging to his back, motionless, like a stone statue abandoned by time. The temperature from warm yellow to cold blue fractures directly in this frame. Hard cut back to the past, second 2, outside a convenience store at night. She carries two hot drinks, handing one to him. He doesn't take it, looks down at her, '이거 나 주는 거야?' (Is this for me?) She rolls her eyes at him and turns to walk away. He smiles and follows, the camera tracking their backs as they disappear into the night. Hard cut to the present, second 3. She stands at the rooftop entrance, hand gripping the iron door. Rain hits her shoulder, she doesn't move, just stands there looking at his back, unsure whether to enter or leave. Hard cut to the past, second 4, extreme close-up. His hand puts earphones into her ears, his fingertips linger at her ear for a second, both pretend not to notice. Hard cut to the present, second 5, extreme close-up. The same hands, now in pockets, rainwater seeps in along the cuffs, the hand slowly clenches inside the pocket. From second 6 to second 10, everything slows down. She finally lets go of the iron door and walks into the rain, stops half a meter behind him. The rain is loud, but her voice still cuts through—'왜 연락 안 했어.' (Why didn't you contact me.) He doesn't turn around, silent for two seconds, '연락하면 뭐가 달라져?' (What would change if I did.) She closes her eyes, her chest feels like something heavy is pressing down. When she speaks again, her voice trembles—'달라지잖아. 나한테는.' (It would be different. For me.) He finally turns around, sees her face, unable to tell if it's rain or tears. His Adam's apple moves, he speaks low and hoarse—'알아. 그래서 더 못 했어.' (I know. That's why I couldn't do it even more.) From second 10 to second 13, dissolve montage. Same rooftop, same camera position. Past is a sunny evening, she stands by the railing, turns back to smile at him. He strides over and pulls her into his arms, the setting sun stretches their shadows long. Present is a rainy night, same spot, he stands before her. The two timelines overlap in the same frame for a full second, her past smile and her present tears pressed onto the same face. From second 13 to second 15, he doesn't speak anymore, raises his hand and presses her head into his chest. She holds on for two seconds, then slowly raises her hand, gripping the fabric of his back tightly. The camera slowly pulls back to an extreme wide shot, the two shrink into a silhouette in the rain curtain. Neon lights shatter and flicker in the puddles, the frame gradually freezes, sound fades away, black screen. Past scenes are entirely warm yellow-orange, 16mm film grain, handheld tracking. Present scenes are cold blue-black, rainwater reflections, stabilized. During dialogue, the camera pushes into extreme close-ups. At the dissolve moment, saturation spikes for one frame then pulls back to cold tones. Background music uses light guitar plucking in past scenes, entering present scenes, music fades to only rain sounds. After the last line of dialogue, a single low cello string sounds deeply, before the black screen, complete silence.

zh.p: 【@图片1】（男主参考）【@图片2】（女主参考） 电影级画质，15秒，蒙太奇剪辑，无字幕，韩语对白。 开场第0秒到第1秒，胶片暖黄，过去， 阳光午后咖啡馆，她趴在桌上睡着， 他坐对面，手撑着下巴低头看她， 嘴角压不住往上扬，画面有轻微颗粒感和过曝。 硬切第1秒，冷蓝雨夜，现在， 空旷天台，他背对镜头站在雨里， 大衣被淋透紧贴着背， 一动不动，像一座被时间遗弃的石像， 暖黄到冷蓝的温度在这一帧直接断裂。 硬切回过去第2秒，夜晚便利店门口， 她拎着两杯热饮递给他一杯， 他没接，低头看她， "이거 나 주는 거야？" （这是给我的？） 她白了他一眼转头走， 他笑着跟上去，镜头跟拍两人背影走进夜色。 硬切回现在第3秒， 她站在天台入口，手握着铁门， 雨打在她肩膀上，她没动， 就这样站着看他的背影， 不知道进去还是离开。 硬切过去第4秒，极近特写， 他的手替她把耳机塞进耳朵里， 指尖在她耳侧停留了一秒， 两个人都假装没注意到。 硬切现在第5秒，极近特写， 同一双手，现在插在口袋里， 雨水顺着袖口渗进去， 手在口袋里慢慢握紧。 第6秒到第10秒全部放慢， 她终于松开铁门走进雨里， 走到他背后半米停下， 雨声很大，她的声音还是穿过来了—— "왜 연락 안 했어." （你为什么不联系我。） 他没回头，沉默了两秒， "연락하면 뭐가 달라져？" （联系了又能怎样。） 她闭上眼睛， 胸腔像被什么东西重重压住， 她再开口，声音已经在抖—— "달라지잖아. 나한테는." （会不一样的。对我来说。） 他终于转过身， 看见她脸上分不清是雨还是泪， 他的喉结滚动， 低哑开口—— "알아. 그래서 더 못 했어." （我知道。所以才更做不到。） 第10秒到第13秒叠化蒙太奇， 同一个天台同一个机位， 过去是晴天傍晚， 她站在栏杆边回头对他笑， 他大步走过去把她整个人揽进怀里， 夕阳把两个人的影子拉得很长， 现在是雨夜，同一个位置， 他站在她面前， 两个时空叠在同一帧里整整一秒， 过去她的笑和现在她的泪压在同一张脸上。 第13秒到第15秒， 他没再说话， 抬手把她的头按进自己胸口， 她撑了两秒， 手慢慢抬起来死死抓住他背后的衣服， 镜头缓缓拉到极远， 两个人缩成雨幕里一个剪影， 霓虹灯光在积水里破碎晃动， 画面渐渐静止，声音渐渐消失，黑场。 过去场景全程暖黄橙16mm胶片颗粒手持跟拍， 现在场景冷蓝黑雨水反光稳定器， 对白时镜头推进到极近特写， 叠化瞬间饱和度爆一帧然后收回冷调， 配乐在过去场景用轻吉他拨弦， 进入现在场景消音只剩雨声， 最后一句对白后大提琴单弦低沉拉响， 黑场前完全静默。

en.p: Theme 1: Night Cityscape in Film Style - Starlight Fantasy City, Falling into the Galaxy Together. Visual Core: A collision of cyberpunk and ultimate romance, using neon reflections and raindrop close-ups to showcase urban sophistication. 9:16 vertical screen, realistic cinematic texture style, urban luxury, 4K high definition. 0-4 seconds: High-angle overhead shot, slowly descending. On a post-rain urban rooftop, the ground is a black asphalt road covered in water, reflecting the distant, hazy city neon lights like a mirror. A beautiful 25-year-old Chinese bride [idol-level] wears a sparkling fishtail custom wedding gown, and a handsome 28-year-old Chinese groom wears a dark velvet suit. The two are centered in the frame, holding a transparent umbrella, strolling in the rainy night. The image presents a vintage, literary film-style cinematic frame-jitter effect. 5-9 seconds: The camera performs a 360-degree slow-motion orbit around the two. The bride has a delicate oval face, natural eyebrows, cold and alluring fox eyes, a high nose bridge, and slightly parted red lips; the groom has a defined jawline, sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, with deep gaze. During the orbit, extremely slow, tiny raindrops fall from the sky (bullet time effect). The groom tilts the umbrella toward the bride, leaving his own shoulder slightly wet from the drizzle. Neon lights behind them transform into large, colorful bokeh spots (bokeh effect). 10-15 seconds: The camera cuts to a close-up, slightly low-angle shot. The bride drops the transparent umbrella, which slowly falls in the background. The bride wraps her arms around the groom's neck, and the groom lowers his head to gaze at her with deep affection. A warm orange rim light from a streetlamp shines from the side, illuminating the bride's eyelashes adorned with water droplets. The frame freezes at the moment just before they kiss, with the background neon completely blurred into a galaxy. Sound effects: Distant city ambient sounds, slow jazz cello, white noise of raindrops hitting the umbrella, cinematic heartbeat sounds. Prohibited: Any text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.
en.t: Neon Rain Romance in Cyberpunk City

zh.p: 主题一：电影夜景风 - 星光幻城，共坠星河 视觉核心：赛博朋克与极致浪漫的碰撞，利用霓虹倒影与雨滴微距展现都市高级感。 9:16竖屏，写实电影质感风格，都市奢华，4K高清。 0-4秒：高位俯拍，缓缓下降。雨后的都市天台，地面是积水的黑色柏油路，如镜面般反射着远处迷离的城市霓虹灯光。唯美25岁中国新娘【偶像级别】身穿闪钻鱼尾高定婚纱，28岁帅气中国新郎身穿深色丝绒西装。两人在画面正中，手撑一把透明雨伞，在雨夜中漫步。画面呈现复古文艺电影式的电影抽帧感。 5-9秒：镜头以两人为中心做360度环绕慢镜头。新娘瓜子脸精致，野生眉，狐狸眼冷艳，高鼻梁，红唇微张；新郎下颌线分明，剑眉星目，眼神深邃。环绕过程中，天空中飘落极慢的微小雨滴（子弹时间），新郎将伞倾向新娘，自己的半边肩膀被微雨打湿。霓虹灯光在他们身后化作巨大的彩色光斑（散景效果）。 10-15秒：镜头切至特写，微微仰拍。新娘丢掉透明雨伞，雨伞在背景中缓缓下落。新娘双手环住新郎的脖子，新郎低头深情凝视。一束路灯的暖橘色轮廓光从侧面打透新娘沾着水珠的睫毛。画面定格在两人即将吻上的瞬间，背景霓虹彻底虚化为星河。 音效：远处的城市环境音、缓慢的爵士大提琴、雨滴落在伞面上的白噪音、电影感的心跳声。 禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

en.p: A rogue data-courier riding a humming anti-gravity hoverboard at breakneck speeds through a neon-drenched cyberpunk megacity, weaving effortlessly through floating market stalls, dodging flying cars, rogue drones, and towering holographic advertisements. She glides past colossal metal structures and bustling mid-air intersections, executing sharp banks with precision and style. Cinematic tracking shots follow her movement, enhanced by dynamic motion blur and harsh, vibrant neon lights reflecting off wet metallic surfaces. The metropolis pulses with a frantic synthetic vibe—screeching repulsor engines, flashing sirens, and nonstop motion. Ultra-realistic detail with a sci-fi action-movie aesthetic, capturing speed, confidence, and fearless momentum through a futuristic dystopia.

zh.p: 一名无法无天的数据信使骑着一块嗡嗡作响的反重力悬浮滑板，以惊人的速度穿梭于霓虹浸染的赛博朋克大都市中。她灵巧地绕过漂浮的集市摊位，躲避飞车、失控的无人机以及高耸的全息广告牌。她滑过巨大的金属建筑与繁忙的半空交叉路口，精准而潇洒地完成急转弯。电影般的跟踪镜头紧随她的动作，动态模糊与刺眼鲜艳的霓虹灯光在湿漉漉的金属表面反射，增强了视觉效果。这座大都市脉动着狂乱的合成氛围——尖啸的反重力引擎声、闪烁的警笛声以及永不停歇的流动。超写实的细节与科幻动作片美学相结合，捕捉了穿越未来反乌托邦的速度、自信与无畏的冲劲。

Ultra-realistic detail with a sci-fi action-movie aesthetic, capturing speed, confidence, and fearless momentum through a futuristic dystopia.

en.p: 15 seconds, one continuous shot, Eastern dark mythology, imagery of celestial burial, megalophobia, Chinese-style surreal disaster landscape, no dialogue, no narration. The overall color palette is cold gray, bone white, old gold, and dark red, with a low-hanging sky and a large amount of feathers falling through the air like continuous snow. 0:00–0:03: Extreme close-up opening. 85mm telephoto macro, shallow depth of field. A bone-white feather slowly lands on the surface of a massive bronze bell, half-buried in black frozen soil, its surface covered in ancient runes and dried blood rust. As the feather lands, an extremely low-frequency muffled sound comes from inside the bell, causing small stones on the ground to vibrate. Cold top lighting, shadows pure black. 0:03–0:08: The camera pulls back close to the ground and slightly rises. 35mm, stable glide. Countless tilted wooden stakes and tattered ritual banners stand on the black wasteland, the ground covered in a layer of feathers. The camera sweeps past several huge withered antlers, which initially appear as ordinary remains, only to reveal they are part of a much larger entity. As the camera continues to retreat, layers of dark red ritual cloth are slowly pulled up from the ground, the fabric covered in dust, wax drips, and rain erosion marks, with small bronze bells hanging from the edges. The bells ring very softly, yet densely enough to be unsettling. 0:08–0:12: The camera passes through a collapsed stone gate, opening up to a vast scene. 24mm wide-angle, deep focus. The complete giant entity appears: a celestial burial deity lurking in the valley slowly rises, its body composed of hundreds of layers of heavy ritual cloth, animal horns, bone ornaments, and massive hollow masks, towering far above the mountain ridges. As it rises, patches of feathers are swept into the sky by the airflow, like reversed heavy snow. The abandoned temples and prayer flags in the distance appear extremely tiny at its feet. The sky is pale, with the upper part of the giant forming an oppressive silhouette. 0:12–0:15: The camera pushes forward extremely slowly. 50mm. The massive hollow mask hanging on the giant's chest slowly turns toward the camera, its face utterly empty, with only faint dark red embers deep within the eye sockets. All the bells ring softly at once, the feathers abruptly stop falling, the edges of the frame gradually lose light, fading to black. Sound effects: low-frequency wind pressure, distant bells, the dragging of massive fabric, and finally a single hollow bell toll followed by silence.

zh.p: 15秒，一镜到底，东方黑暗神话，天葬意象，巨物恐惧，中国式超现实灾厄景观，无对白，无旁白。整体色调为冷灰、骨白、旧金、暗红，天空低压，空气中飘落大量羽毛，像雪一样持续下坠。 0:00–0:03：极近特写开场。85mm长焦微距，浅景深。骨白羽毛缓慢落在一只巨大的青铜铃铛表面，铃铛半埋在黑色冻土中，表面布满古老符纹和干裂血锈。羽毛落下时，铃铛内部传来极低频的闷响，地面细小石粒震动。冷顶光，阴影纯黑。 0:03–0:08：镜头贴地后拉并微微抬升。35mm，稳定滑行。黑色荒原上立着无数倾斜木桩与残破祭幡，地面覆盖一层羽毛。镜头掠过几只巨大的枯鹿角，它们最初像普通遗骸，随后才意识到那其实是一个更庞大存在的一部分。随着镜头继续后退，一层层暗红色祭布从地面被缓慢拉起，布面沾满灰尘、蜡油和雨蚀痕迹，边缘挂满青铜小铃。铃声极轻，却密集得令人不安。 0:08–0:12：镜头穿过一片塌陷的石门，冲出后豁然开阔。24mm广角，深焦。完整巨物现身：一尊埋伏在山谷中的天葬神像缓缓起身，身体由成百上千层沉重祭布、兽角、骨饰和巨大空洞面具组成，高度远超山脊。它起身时，成片羽毛被气流卷向天空，像倒流的大雪。远处的废弃寺庙与经幡在它脚边显得极其渺小。天空惨白，巨物上部形成压迫剪影。 0:12–0:15：镜头极慢前推。50mm。巨像胸前悬挂的巨大空面具缓缓转向镜头，面具五官空无一物，只有眼眶深处浮现极微弱暗红火点。所有铃铛同时轻响一下，羽毛骤然停止下落，画面边缘逐渐失光，黑场。音效：低频风压、远处群铃、巨大布料拖拽、最后一声空洞钟鸣后静默。

en.p: A scavenger crawls to the top of a dune ridge on his stomach and looks over. Below in the basin, an entire buried city is surfacing, buildings pushing up through the sand slowly, like something breathing out. He doesn't move. Doesn't radio. Just watches the world underneath the world reveal itself. VFX: sand displacement from emerging structures, dust column particle systems, scale depth on the emerging cityscape, wind across the ridge surface. Aesthetic: Desert gold and shadow grey, the reveal as the event, Lawrence of Arabia ridge geometry, the scavenger as witness not participant, something ancient becoming present tense.

zh.p: 一名拾荒者匍匐着爬上沙丘脊线顶端，探头望去。下方盆地中，整座被掩埋的城市正浮出地表，建筑缓缓顶开沙层，如同某种生物在吐息。他一动不动，没有发报，只是凝视着这层世界之下的世界显露出真容。特效镜头：建筑破沙时的沙土位移，扬尘粒子系统，浮现城景的纵深尺度，沙脊表面的风纹。美学基调：荒漠金与暗影灰，揭示即事件，阿拉伯的劳伦斯式沙脊几何，拾荒者作为见证者而非参与者，某种远古之物正在成为现在进行时。
