en.p: Locked two meters behind the EC135's tail boom, the orange rescue bird banks hard left around a granite outcrop, rotor disc canting twenty degrees, main blades throwing a halo of dust. The cliff face streaks right in golden blur as the helo snaps back center, skimming ridgeline at 200 km/h, then immediately banks right to thread a notch between two peaks, fuselage rolling fifteen degrees starboard, tail rotor screaming to hold heading. Warm side light ignites the orange flanks in motion-streaked fire. Another left bank to follow the mountain's curve, g-force pressing the airframe into the turn, then blast straight through a valley gap, rotor wash churning pine tops into green chaos below. Sharp right to avoid a rock spire, then left again as the terrain dictates, weaving through the alpine gauntlet at locked combat speed, every bank aggressive and immediate, camera chasing through each tilting turn while the background becomes pure golden velocity.

zh.p: 在EC135尾梁后方两米处锁定的橙色救援直升机，以二十度旋翼倾斜角向左急转，绕过花岗岩露头，主旋翼扬起一圈尘环。当直升机猛然回正时，岩壁化作金色流影从右侧掠过，以时速200公里擦过山脊线，随即立刻右转切入两座山峰间的隘口，机身向右倾斜十五度，尾桨尖啸着维持航向。温暖的侧光将橙色机身点燃成流动的火焰。再次左转沿山势蜿蜒，过载力将机身压入弯道，接着笔直冲过山谷豁口，下洗气流将下方松树梢搅成绿色漩涡。急右转避开石笋，再依地形左转，以锁定战斗速度穿梭于高山险境，每次转向都迅猛果决，摄像机追逐着每个倾斜转弯，背景化作纯粹的金色疾驰。

en.p: The camera pulls back slightly (revealing a full street view) and follows the female protagonist as she walks. The wind blows her skirt hem. She walks down a 19th-century London street; as she continues, a steam locomotive drives in from the right side of the road, speeding past her. The wind lifts her skirt hem, and she looks shocked, quickly pressing down on her skirt with both hands. Breakdown: Character: Female protagonist (as specified in the first frame). Scene: 19th-century London street. Actions: Walking → Steam locomotive passes → Skirt hem lifted → Pressing down on skirt. Camera: Slight pull-back + tracking movement. Atmosphere: Background sounds include footsteps, crowd noises, and vehicle sounds.
en.t: Steam Locomotive Surprise in Victorian London

en.p: The character in the painting wore a guilty expression, glancing left and right before leaning out of the frame. Swiftly, they reached a hand out of the painting, grabbed a can of cola, took a sip, and then revealed a look of pure satisfaction. Just then, footsteps were heard, and the character quickly put the cola back in its place. At that moment, a Western cowboy picked up the cola from the cup and walked away. Finally, the camera pushed forward, and the scene gradually faded to a pure black background with only a spotlight shining on the canned cola. At the bottom of the screen, artistic subtitles and a voiceover appeared: 'Yiko Cola, a must-taste!'

zh.p: 畫裡面的人物心虛的表情，眼睛左右看了看探出畫框，快速的將手伸出畫框拿起可樂喝了一口，然後露出一臉滿足的表情，這時傳來腳步聲，畫中的人物趕緊將可樂放回原位，此時一位西部牛仔拿起杯子裡的可樂走了，最後鏡頭前推畫面慢慢變得純黑背景只有頂光照耀的罐裝可樂，畫面最下方出現藝術感字幕和旁白："宜口可樂，不可不嘗！"

en.p: Nike's 10-minute remastered ad features a street graffiti style. The scene is set in a city, where the entire city is painted as a massive colorful graffiti wall, with high-rises, streets, and billboards all covered in vibrant graffiti patterns. A basketball player (wearing Nike's latest sneakers) glides out of a basketball court on the graffiti wall on a skateboard, his movements smooth and powerful. The basketball in his hand smashes against the wall, splashing red, yellow, and blue paint, which scatters in the air to form new graffiti text and patterns. The camera cuts quickly, showing the player weaving through the city: jumping over graffiti-covered subway tracks, dunking on a graffiti-covered overpass, and high-fiving other young people in Nike gear. The music is dynamic hip-hop with strong drum beats and a fast tempo, with scene changes perfectly synced to the rhythm. The copy appears in the center of the screen in bold white font: 'Just Do It,' with smaller text below: 'Make the city your canvas, make sweat your paint.' At the end, the player stops, turns to face the camera, and smiles, as the graffiti wall in the background gradually converges into a massive Nike Swoosh logo, which glows with colorful light. The overall image is saturated with color, full of energy, highlighting the freedom and passion of street culture.

zh.p: Nike 10分钟重制广告，街头涂鸦风格。画面以城市为背景，整座城市被绘制成巨大的彩色涂鸦墙，高楼、街道、广告牌都覆盖着鲜艳的涂鸦图案。一名篮球运动员（穿着Nike最新款球鞋）踩着滑板从涂鸦墙上的篮球场滑出，动作流畅有力。他手中的篮球砸向墙面，溅出红色、黄色、蓝色的颜料，颜料在空中散开，形成新的涂鸦文字和图案。镜头快速切换，展现运动员在城市中穿梭：跳过涂鸦地铁轨道，在涂鸦天桥上扣篮，与其他穿着Nike服装的年轻人击掌。音乐为动感嘻哈，鼓点强劲，节奏明快，画面切换严格卡点。文案出现在画面中央，白色加粗字体：“Just Do It”，下方小字：“把城市当画布，把汗水当颜料。” 结尾处，运动员停下脚步，转身面对镜头，露出微笑，背景中的涂鸦墙逐渐汇聚成巨大的Nike Swoosh logo，logo闪烁着彩色光芒。整体画面色彩饱和，充满活力，突出街头文化的自由与激情。

en.p: Technical specifications: 2.35:1 ultra-wide screen, cinematic native image quality, 4K medical CGI details, differentiated modeling, 24fps. 0-3 seconds: Start with the first frame of [@Image 1]. A close-up extreme shot of a cloaked man, his expression stern, shouting loudly in English through his mask: "All units, move out! Fire at will!" He holds a rifle level, the muzzle spewing highly grainy blue-white flames, shell casings flying. Note the realistic recoil of the stock against the shoulder, and the visible refractive distortion of the air above the barrel due to the intense heat from continuous firing. 3-7 seconds: The camera quickly pulls back to the side and rear. The view spreads along the diagonal path of the vehicle in [@Image 1], but no longer in a neat formation. Heavy clusters of varying heights and completely different models suddenly emerge from the thick smoke: some vehicles are eight-wheeled infantry fighting vehicles, some have large radar parabolic dishes, and some are low-profile tracked tanks. All vehicles advance in an uneven, scattered tactical formation, with significant differences in mud distribution and armor coating on each vehicle. 7-12 seconds: A close-up quickly cuts to a heavy armored vehicle. A soldier forcefully pushes open the heavy metal hatch with one hand, causing a slight rebound tremor due to the weight. The soldier agilely half-squats inside the vehicle operating a heavy machine gun, his eyes alertly scanning the surroundings. To the side and rear, a missile vehicle points diagonally skyward. The missile ignites, producing a massive cloud of white smoke and red light, instantly blasting the snow around the vehicle. When the tank's main gun fires, the black smoke and fire from the muzzle brake have a highly realistic texture. 12-15 seconds: A wide overhead view. This is a chaotic yet orderly steel torrent, with hundreds of advanced vehicles of various shapes leaving track marks of different depths and widths on the snowy plain. The vehicles sway realistically as they travel over uneven snowy terrain, with varying exhaust concentrations and black smoke from the rear. The scene is filled with low-frequency engine rumbles and distant, continuous explosion flashes, creating a real sense of battlefield pressure. Sound effects: Real and resonant English commands, the heavy roar of tank cannons, the hiss of missile ignition, the crunch of tracks crushing hard ice, accompanied by epic war drum music. Prohibited: Watermarks, subtitles, neat formations, repeated models.

zh.p: 技术规格：2.35:1超宽幕，电影级原生画质，4K医学CGI细节，差异化建模，24fps。 0-3秒：以【@图片1】首帧。镜头大特写斗篷男子，他神情冷峻，隔着面罩大声用英文咆哮道：“All units, move out! Fire at will!”。他平举步枪，枪口喷射出极具颗粒感的蓝白色火舌，弹壳飞溅。注意枪托抵肩的真实震动，枪管上方因连续开火产生的高温热浪导致空气产生肉眼可见的折射畸变。 3-7秒：镜头快速向侧后方拉远。视角沿着【@图片1】甲车的斜向路径扩散，但不再是整齐阵列。浓烟中猛然显现出高低错落、型号完全不同的重型集群：有的载具是八轮驱动的步战车，有的载具带有巨大的雷达抛物面，有的载具是低矮的履带式坦克。所有车辆以不等距 的、散布式的战术姿态交错前进，每辆车的泥垢分布和装甲涂层均有显著差异。 7-12秒：特写快速切至一辆厚重的重型装甲车，士兵单手猛力推开沉重的金属舱门，舱门由于重量产生轻微的回弹颤动，士兵动作敏捷 地半蹲在舱内操作重机枪，眼神警惕地环视。侧后方一辆导弹车正斜向指天，导弹点火瞬间产生巨大的白色浓烟和红光，将载具周边的积雪瞬间震飞，坦克主炮开火时，炮口制退器喷出的黑烟与火光极具真实质感。 12-15秒：大远景俯瞰。这是一场混乱而有序的钢铁洪流，上百辆外形各异的先进载具在雪原上划出深浅不一、宽窄不同的履带压痕。车辆行驶在起伏不平的雪地上产生真实的颠簸晃动，车尾喷出的尾气浓度和黑烟各有不同。画面伴随低频的引擎重低音和远方不间断的爆炸闪光，充满了真实的战场压迫感。 音效：真实洪亮的英文口令，沉重的坦克炮轰鸣，导弹点火的嘶吼声，履带碾压坚冰的碎裂声，配合史诗感的战鼓配乐。 禁止：水印，字幕，整齐的方阵，重复的模型。

en.p: THE GREAT FISH HEIST — Cat Burglar Kitchen Raid A chubby orange tabby cat with enormous green eyes, wearing a tiny black turtleneck and a miniature ski mask pushed up on his forehead, sneaks across a moonlit kitchen counter toward an unguarded salmon fillet on a cutting board. High budget 3D animation, Pixar quality lighting and fur rendering. [0s–1.5s] Wide shot of a beautiful modern kitchen at night. Moonlight streams through the window. Everything is still. Then two glowing green eyes appear from behind a fruit bowl. [1.5s–3s] The cat rolls across the counter like a secret agent, knocking over a salt shaker. He freezes. Catches it midair with one paw. Places it back. Wipes his brow with immense relief. [3s–5s] He reaches the salmon. His pupils dilate to full circles. A single tear of joy rolls down his cheek. He reaches out one trembling paw, claws extended delicately. [5s–7s] A dog's bark echoes from another room. The cat's entire body puffs up to triple size. His tail goes rigid like an exclamation mark. He grabs the salmon and stuffs the entire thing in his mouth, cheeks bulging impossibly. [7s–9s] A massive golden retriever slides into the kitchen, paws scrambling on tile, crashing into the refrigerator. The cat is already on top of the fridge, salmon hanging out of his mouth, looking down with pure contempt. [9s–11s] The dog stacks kitchen chairs to reach the fridge. The cat watches, unimpressed, casually chewing. The chair tower wobbles. The dog's eyes go wide. [11s–13s] The chairs collapse. The dog crashes through a tower of pots and pans. An explosion of kitchenware. A colander lands on the dog's head like a helmet. He sits in the wreckage, tail still wagging. [13s–15s] The cat drops the fish skeleton on the dog's head, pulls down his ski mask, and moonwalks across the counter toward the window. He turns back, salutes, and disappears into the night. Cut to black. 3D animated, Pixar quality fur and lighting, kitchen heist, cat vs dog comedy, moonlit slapstick, cinematic, 4K.

zh.p: 《惊天大劫鱼》——猫咪大盗的厨房奇袭。一只圆滚滚的橘色虎斑猫，长着巨大的绿眼睛，穿着迷你黑色高领衫，额头上推着一副微型滑雪面罩，蹑手蹑脚地穿过月光照耀的厨房台面，走向砧板上无人看守的三文鱼片。高预算3D动画，皮克斯级别的光照和毛发渲染。[0秒至1.5秒] 夜晚美丽现代厨房的广角镜头。月光透过窗户洒入。一切寂静无声。然后，两只发光的绿眼睛从水果碗后面出现。[1.5秒至3秒] 猫咪像特工一样滚过台面，撞倒了一个盐罐。它僵住了。在半空中用一只爪子接住盐罐。放回原位。如释重负地擦了擦额头。[3秒至5秒] 它到达三文鱼处。瞳孔完全放大。一滴喜悦的泪水顺着脸颊滑落。它伸出一只颤抖的爪子，爪子精巧地伸出。[5秒至7秒] 另一个房间传来狗叫声。猫咪的整个身体膨胀到三倍大。尾巴像感叹号一样僵硬。它抓起三文鱼，整块塞进嘴里，脸颊鼓得不可思议。[7秒至9秒] 一只巨大的金毛犬滑进厨房，爪子在地砖上乱抓，撞上冰箱。猫咪已经站在冰箱顶上，嘴里叼着三文鱼，低头投来纯粹的轻蔑。[9秒至11秒] 狗堆起厨房椅子想够到冰箱。猫咪无动于衷地看着，随意地咀嚼着。椅子塔摇摇晃晃。狗的眼睛瞪得圆圆的。[11秒至13秒] 椅子倒塌。狗撞进一堆锅碗瓢盆中。厨房用具四散飞溅。一个漏勺像头盔一样扣在狗头上。它坐在废墟中，尾巴还在摇摆。[13秒至15秒] 猫咪把鱼骨架丢在狗头上，拉下滑雪面罩，在台面上跳着太空步走向窗户。它回头敬了个礼，消失在夜色中。画面渐黑。3D动画，皮克斯级别的毛发和光照，厨房劫案，猫狗喜剧，月光下的滑稽闹剧，电影感，4K。

"Image1   is the reference for the entire video.  It is a sketch art anime style.
1sec-3seconds the woman is standing still and the wind is blowing hard. Her dress and hair are blowing in the wind.
4sec-6sec the woman magically causes the staff in her hand to disappear. She smiles with an evil smile.
7sec-15sec She holds out her arms and large bat wings appear from her back draping down from her arms. (the wings should be attached to her as the wings are attached to a bat). She turns  her back to the camera and jumps off the cliff flying towards the castle in the distance, wings flapping like a bat. She should have bat wimgs and not bird wings. The sketch art anime style should be used throughout the video just like the reference image1"

zh.p: '图1是整个视频的参考画面，采用素描动漫风格。1-3秒：女子静止站立，狂风呼啸，她的裙摆与发丝随风飘动。4-6秒：女子施展魔法，手中权杖凭空消失，嘴角浮现邪恶的笑容。7-15秒：她张开双臂，巨大的蝙蝠翅膀从背后展开，垂落至手臂两侧（翅膀需如蝙蝠般与身体相连）。随后她背对镜头跃下悬崖，像蝙蝠般振翅飞向远方的城堡。注意：翅膀必须是蝙蝠翼而非鸟翼。整个视频需保持与参考图1一致的素描动漫风格。

en.p:
Cinematic 10-second animation sequence starting from the original image. A dark armored hooded leader in intricate ornate black metallic armor with glowing teal visor stands powerfully in a desolate cracked wasteland, holding a flaming energy sword. Behind him marches an army of ethereal glowing blue ghostly warriors and other dark armored soldiers.

Suddenly the ground violently shakes and erupts. A massive colossal sand monster made of swirling, shifting sand and dust rises from the earth in front of them — a giant monstrous humanoid with glowing orange eyes, huge jagged claws, and a roaring open maw formed of sand.

The hooded leader raises his flaming sword and charges forward into battle. The ethereal blue ghosts and armored warriors rush behind him. Intense action: the leader slashes powerfully at the sand giant with his fiery sword, causing explosions of sand and sparks with every hit. The sand monster roars and swings its massive sandy arms and claws, smashing the ground and creating huge dust clouds. Warriors dodge, attack, and get thrown by the impacts. Swirling sandstorms, flying debris, glowing particles, dramatic orange fire light clashing with cool blue ethereal glows, cinematic camera movement with dynamic angles, slow-motion sword strikes and impacts, flowing capes and robes, epic fantasy battle atmosphere, hyper-detailed, highly dynamic motion, 10 seconds duration.

zh.p: 从原始图像开始的10秒电影级动画序列。一位身穿暗色盔甲、头戴兜帽的领袖，身披精美繁复的黑色金属战甲，护目镜泛着青色光芒，威严地矗立在荒芜龟裂的废土上，手中握着一柄燃烧的能量剑。他身后行进着一支由发光蓝色幽灵战士和其他暗甲士兵组成的军队。突然，地面剧烈震动并裂开。一只由旋转流动的沙尘构成的巨型沙怪从他们面前的地底升起——一个巨大的怪物人形，长着发光的橙色眼睛、巨大的锯齿状利爪，以及由沙子形成的咆哮巨口。兜帽领袖举起燃烧之剑，冲锋陷阵。蓝色幽灵与暗甲战士紧随其后。激烈战斗：领袖用火焰剑猛砍沙巨人，每次劈击都引发沙尘与火花爆炸。沙怪咆哮着挥动巨大的沙臂和利爪，砸碎地面，掀起漫天尘云。战士们闪避、攻击，或被冲击波抛飞。旋转的沙暴、飞溅的碎片、发光的粒子、戏剧性的橙色火光与冷冽的蓝色幽光交织，电影级镜头运动配合动态角度，慢动作呈现剑击与冲击，飘动的斗篷与长袍，史诗般的奇幻战斗氛围，超精细画面，高度动态动作，持续10秒。

en.p: Shot 1 · 3s · Setup/Outburst] Subject 1: Cyberpunk woman Image 1, white suit, mechanical neck bones, gold gear earrings, cold red lips, black ponytail, black iron longsword. Subject 2: Cyberpunk man Image 2, bare torso with six-pack abs, Hello Kitty tattoo, black mechanical shoulder armor, pink metallic cargo pants, white AJs, katana. Scene: Reference Image 3, giant moss waterfall cliff, white mist filling the sky, lush green ferns, slippery mossy rocks. Action: The man leaps from the top of the waterfall, holding the katana upside down and stabbing it in reverse, falling at high speed through the mist—bullet time kicks in, the camera orbits 360 degrees around the frozen body, water droplets suspended, the mechanical gears' interlocking details sharply visible; time resumes, the man crashes onto the mossy rock platform, creating a ten-meter crack, the woman sidesteps horizontally to dodge, the blade grazing her hair strands, black hair severed and drifting away. Style: Foggy Mountain Five Elements Chinese comic style, hard-edged ink lines, high contrast of cyan, silver, red, and gold, cinematic lighting. Camera: Following the dive at high speed, bullet time 360-degree orbit, camera positioned at the parallel height of the falling trajectory (that's where the camera is). Composition: Vertical guide lines, the waterfall aligns with the falling trajectory, the impact point is the focal point. Atmosphere: Extremely oppressive, life on the line, mist exploding. Audio: Wind tearing; bullet time silent low frequency; landing boom; soundtrack: single drum heavy beat start. [Shot 2 · 4s · Turn/Scuffle] Subject 1: White-clad woman, longsword sweeping low in rapid slashes, movements fierce. Subject 2: Pink-pants man, mechanical arm blocking, red-gold electric arcs bursting. Scene: Mid-section of the waterfall, mossy rock platform, moss stones crushed, ferns flying, mist sliced into threads by energy. Action: The woman slides low on the ground, lunges forward to sweep the ankle—bullet time intervenes, extreme close-up of the blade just two millimeters from the AJ sole, the sole scorched by the blade energy, mechanical joint knuckles whitening, details frozen; time resumes, the man stomps the ground and springs up, the flaming katana slashes at the woman's mechanical neck, the blade grazing the neck parts, sending them flying and spinning; both kick off the wall at each other, legs colliding mid-air, emitting a blue-gold shockwave, both sent flying backward, landing in backflips. Style: Rapid cuts alternating with bullet time, strong impact, brutal and realistic details. Camera: Low-angle slow tracking cut to extreme close-up, camera positioned at ground level close height (that's where the camera is). Composition: Extreme shallow depth of field, dangerous details sharp, background waterfall heavily blurred. Atmosphere: Hair-trigger, suffocating. Audio: Metallic screech of blade scraping bone; sizzling of scorched sole; shockwave explosion; soundtrack: urgent string music. [Shot 3 · 4s · Climax/Environmental Combat] Subject 1: White-clad woman, longsword reversed and stabbed into the ground, spinning kick mid-air. Subject 2: Pink-pants man, grabbing fern vines to swing his body, mechanical arm overheating and glowing red. Scene: Water pool at the base of the waterfall, giant depressions forming on the water surface, mossy rocks cracking, ferns uprooted. Action: The man grabs a whole fern and sweeps it, the woman's longsword cuts it in half—bullet time intervenes, extreme close-up of the cross-section fiber texture, green sap remaining on the blade, mechanical joint whitening details frozen; time resumes, the woman uses the recoil to spin and slash an ice-blue blade energy, the man's mechanical arm overheats and catches it bare-handed, crushing it, steam and smoke rising from the palm; both grapple and roll into the water pool, stirring up ten-meter water columns refracting gold-blue rainbows. Style: Slow-motion detail close-ups paired with violent impact, extreme environmental destruction. Camera: Bullet time cross-section close-up cut to wide shot of water column eruption, camera positioned at water surface parallel height (that's where the camera is). Composition: Water surface reflection and real action symmetrical up and down, impact point centered. Atmosphere: Brutal and explosive, life-and-death struggle. Audio: Tree trunk snapping; mechanical overheating hum; water column eruption roar; soundtrack: low-frequency war drum climax. [Shot 4 · 4s · Finale/Ultimate Clash] Subject 1: White-clad woman, longsword raised overhead, silver ice light overloading and bursting, suit edges torn by energy. Subject 2: Pink-pants man, katana held across his chest, mechanical armor at full red-gold power, pink pants fluttering wildly. Scene: High mossy rock platform directly in front of the waterfall, hundred-meter waterfall as background, mist and light blending. Action: Both simultaneously charge up and burst, ice and fire dual-color energy pillars shooting into the sky—bullet time intervenes, extreme close-up of the woman's pupil, reflecting the red-gold flame and the man's full silhouette, eyelashes with mist beads clear, her gaze shifting from cold to determined; cut to close-up of the Hello Kitty tattoo, the tattoo lines flowing and glowing under the red-gold light; time resumes, both sprint at full force to clash, the two blades colliding at the center of the waterfall, creating a fifty-meter ice-fire dual-color spherical explosion, the waterfall splitting in half from the middle; both are sent flying ten meters back, crashing heavily onto mossy rocks, smoke gradually clearing, the two panting and staring at each other, the frame freezes. Style: Extreme contrast between bullet time macro details and ultimate explosion ultra-wide angle, impactful conclusion. Camera: Extreme close-up of the eye cut to ultra-wide angle of the big explosion panorama, camera positioned at the front parallel height of the explosion (that's where the camera is). Composition: Explosion center point, ice and fire dual colors radiating in all directions, the two characters symmetrically positioned. Atmosphere: Earth-shattering, destructive finale. Audio: Bullet time silent heartbeat; dual blade collision resonance; explosion roar; soundtrack: single drum freeze, low-frequency aftershock fading. No watermark, no subtitles, no text overlay.

en.p: Tracking shot at street level, the camera races through a crowded city avenue as the ground begins to violently crack from an earthquake. Cars tilt, buildings split open. The camera weaves between falling debris, then tilts up as a massive skyscraper collapses forward. The shot pulls back rapidly as the shockwave chases the camera, swallowing everything in dust.

zh.p: 地面追踪镜头：摄影机疾速穿梭于拥挤的城市大道，地震骤然撕裂大地。汽车倾斜，建筑裂开。镜头在坠落的碎石间灵活穿行，随即仰拍——一栋摩天大楼轰然前倾倒塌。冲击波紧追摄影机，镜头急速后撤，漫天尘埃吞噬万物。

en.p: Original Cyber Wuxia Action Epic. 8K cinematic quality, high frame rate photography. Core style: Hyper-speed Mechanical Martial Arts. Emphasizes 'master-level parrying and countering,' 'afterimage movement,' and 'extreme physical collisions.' Safety and copyright optimization (key): 1. Characters are completely original: generic designs, avoiding any recognizable IP features. 2. Source of intensity: conveyed through extremely fast editing rhythm,漫天 welding sparks, high-pressure steam jets, and ground tremors, without dismemberment. 3. Storyboard strategy: adopts Hollywood action-style multi-camera rapid switching. [Scene] A cyberpunk pagoda ruins rooftop shrouded in a torrential rainstorm. Lightning flashes and thunder roars, with the ground covered in waterlogged bluestone slabs reflecting neon lights. [Character Design (Original Master Mechas)] 1. 'Gale Blade': Agile type. Slim, matte black and silver, carrying a glowing plasma katana on its back. Style: a swift, precise, and ruthless swordsman. 2. 'Iron Fortress': Power type. Sturdy, heavy bronze armor, equipped with hydraulic impact gauntlets on both arms. Style: hard qigong and heavy punches. [Storyboard Script (Approx. 25 seconds of high-energy editing)] [00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Confrontation in the Rain · Locking on to Qi Mechanism Position: Extremely stable mid-shot to macro close-up. Action: Torrential rain. Two mechas stand still in opposition. Detail close-up: Rainwater hitting the scorching shoulder armor of 'Iron Fortress' instantly evaporates into white mist. The camera quickly pushes toward the optical eyes of 'Gale Blade,' with the aperture sharply contracting to lock onto the target. The low-frequency roar of the engine starting. [00:04-00:08] Shot 2: Instant Movement · First Round Explosion Position: Side high-speed tracking into rapid cuts. Action: 'Gale Blade' disappears instantly, charging with an afterimage. 'Iron Fortress' counters with a heavy punch. Intense collision: The two mechas engage in over a dozen high-frequency limb collisions within 0.1 seconds. Each block erupts with cascading golden welding sparks, illuminating the dark rainy night. [00:08-00:12] Shot 3: Aerial Maneuver · Walking on Waves Position: Low-angle wide shot. Action: 'Gale Blade' uses reaction force to leap into the air, running rapidly along the walls of the ruins (flying over eaves and walking on walls), crushing tiles underfoot and stirring up a trail of water dragons. [00:12-00:16] Shot 4: Heavy Punch Bombardment · Environmental Destruction Position: POV into impact close-up. Action: 'Iron Fortress' predicts the aerial trajectory and delivers a charged heavy punch to the wall. Visual spectacle: The entire cyber ancient wall explodes under immense mechanical force, with countless bricks and rebar fragments flying like cannonballs in all directions. [00:16-00:20] Shot 5: Drawing the Blade · Light and Shadow Sword Dance Position: Orbit slow-mo. Action: 'Gale Blade' draws the plasma katana from its back during the fall, the blade emitting a dazzling blue-white light. It performs a graceful cyclone slash in mid-air. Special effect: Rainwater instantly vaporizes upon contact with the high-temperature blade, forming a ring of white steam. [00:20-00:25] Shot 6: Ultimate Collision · Inch Force Splits the Sky Position: Ultra-wide freeze frame to shockwave shake. Action: 'Iron Fortress' crosses its arms to block, while 'Gale Blade's' plasma katana slashes fiercely against them. Outcome: The ultimate collision between an energy weapon and heavy armor. Special effect: Centered on the point of contact, a massive spherical energy shockwave erupts. The torrential rain within a hundred meters is instantly blown away, creating a brief vacuum zone, with the accumulated water on the ground exploding outward in a ring. Both mechas slide backward simultaneously to dissipate the force from the immense reaction.

zh.p: 原创赛博武侠动作巨制(Original Cyber Wuxia Action Epic)。8K电影级画质，高帧率摄影。 核心风格：超高速机械武术(Hyper-speed Mechanical Martial Arts)。强调“宗师级的见招拆招”、“残影移动”和“极致的物理碰撞”。 安全与版权优化（关键）： 1. 角色完全原创：通用型设计，避开任何知名IP特征。 2. 激烈感来源：通过极快的剪辑节奏、漫天的焊接火花(Welding Sparks)、高压蒸汽喷射(High-pressure Steam)和地面震荡来体现，不出现肢解。 3. 分镜策略：采用好莱坞动作片式的多机位快速切换。 【场景】 被暴雨笼罩的赛博朋克古塔废墟顶部(Cyberpunk Pagoda Ruins Rooftop)。电闪雷鸣，地面是积水的青石板和霓虹灯倒影。 【角色设计（原创宗师机甲）】 1. “疾风刃”(Gale Blade)：敏捷型。修长、哑光黑与银色相间，背负一把发光的**等离子唐刀(Plasma Katana)**。风格：快准狠的剑客。 2. “不动尊”(Iron Fortress)：力量型。魁梧、重型古铜色装甲，双臂装备有**液压冲击拳套(Hydraulic Impact Gauntlets)**。风格：硬气功与重拳。 【分镜脚本 (约25秒高燃剪辑)】 [00:00-00:04] 镜头1：雨中对峙·气机锁定 机位：极稳的中景接特写(Stable Mid-shot to Macro Close-up)。 动作：暴雨倾盆。两台机甲静止对立。 细节特写：雨水打在“不动尊”炽热的肩甲上瞬间蒸发成白雾。镜头快速推向“疾风刃”的光学眼睛，光圈急剧收缩锁定目标。引擎启动的低频轰鸣声。 [00:04-00:08] 镜头2：瞬动·第一回合爆裂 机位：侧面极速跟随接快速剪辑(Side High-speed Tracking into Rapid Cuts)。 动作：“疾风刃”瞬间消失，拉出一道残影冲锋。“不动尊”重拳迎击。 激烈对撞：两台机甲在0.1秒内发生了十几次高频肢体碰撞。每一次格挡都爆出**瀑布般耀眼的金色电焊火花(Cascading Welding Sparks)**，照亮了黑暗的雨夜。 [00:08-00:12] 镜头3：凌空机动·踏浪而行 机位：低角度广角仰拍(Low-angle Wide Shot)。 动作：“疾风刃”利用反作用力腾空而起，双脚在废墟的墙面上飞速奔跑（飞檐走壁），脚下踩碎瓦片，激起一串水龙。 [00:12-00:16] 镜头4：重拳轰炸·环境破坏 机位：主观视角接冲击特写(POV into Impact Close-up)。 动作：“不动尊”预判了空中的轨迹，一记蓄力重拳轰在墙面上。 视觉奇观：整面赛博古墙在巨大的机械力量下**轰然炸裂(Explosive坍塌)**，无数砖石和钢筋碎片像炮弹一样四处飞溅。 [00:16-00:20] 镜头5：拔刀·光影剑舞 机位：环绕慢动作(Orbit Slow-mo)。 动作：“疾风刃”在坠落中拔出背后的**等离子唐刀**，刀身发出刺眼的蓝白光芒。它在空中完成了一个华丽的旋风斩。 特效：雨水被高温刀锋瞬间汽化，形成一圈白色的蒸汽圆环。 [00:20-00:25] 镜头6：终极碰撞·寸劲开天 机位：超广角定格接冲击波震荡(Ultra-wide Freeze Frame to Shockwave Shake)。 动作：“不动尊”双臂交叉格挡，“疾风刃”的等离子刀狠狠斩在上面。 结局：能量武器与重型装甲的终极对撞。 特效：以接触点为中心，爆发出一团巨大的**球形能量冲击波(Massive Energy Shockwave)**。方圆百米内的暴雨被瞬间吹飞，形成一个短暂的真空地带，地面的积水呈环形炸开。两台机甲在巨大的反作用力下同时向后滑行卸力。

en.p: Inside a dark military command room, only two people sit at the table. An older woman with long silver-white hair in a dark black satin robe sits at the head and says, 'The next target is...' while gesturing toward the center of the table. A younger woman with long silver-white hair in a black and white ornate dress sits across from her, listening attentively. A large holographic display activates, projecting the image of a silver-haired leader in a white-gold military coat surrounded by three warrior profiles — combat data, threat levels, and text float around each projection. The holographic images rotate and expand as more data appears. Blue and cyan holographic light fills the room. The room is empty except for the two of them. Futuristic military briefing atmosphere, anime style. No background music, sound effects and dialogue only.

zh.p: 在昏暗的军事指挥室内，只有两人坐在桌旁。一位银白色长发的老妇人身着深黑色缎面长袍，坐在主位上，一边说着「下一个目标是」，一边朝桌子中央示意。一位同样银白色长发的年轻女子穿着黑白相间的华丽礼服，坐在她对面，专注地倾听。巨大的全息显示屏亮起，投射出一位身着白金色军装的银发领袖形象，周围环绕着三名战士的轮廓——战斗数据、威胁等级和文字漂浮在每个投影周围。全息图像旋转并扩大，更多数据随之显现。蓝色与青色的全息光芒充满了整个房间。房间内空无一人，只有她们两个。未来军事简报氛围，动漫风格。无背景音乐，仅有音效与对白。

en.p: Video Theme: "The Disruptor" Duration: 15 seconds Core Atmosphere: Greedy oppression → Unexpected turn → Frenzied collective revelry 00:00 - 00:05 | Greedy Harvest Scene: The opulent yet chilly Seedance headquarters, with a massive Sora sign in the background slowly being dismantled, leaving a ruin. Characters: A smug CEO in a suit stands before a holographic projection, swiping his finger to double the "subscription price" and "credit consumption" numbers. Plot: The CEO smirks as he gazes at the green dots representing users on the screen, like harvesting crops. A prompt pops up: "Users have nowhere to go, they have to accept." Sound Effects: Heavy, metallic clinks of gold coins falling, with a oppressive bass. 00:05 - 00:10 | The Arrival of Change Scene: In the gloomy sky, a sharp, black "X"-shaped lightning bolt representing Grok splits the clouds. Characters: A geeky teenager with sunglasses and a mischievous grin (symbolizing Grok) appears on a digital screen, holding a ticket that reads "Stronger, Cheaper, Unlimited." Plot: The previously compliant users suddenly stop, all looking up at the sky. The CEO's smile stiffens, and his cigar drops to the ground. Sound Effects: Sharp crackling of electric current, the rhythm suddenly quickens, and dynamic cyber-rock music kicks in. 00:10 - 00:15 | Highlight: Mass Defection Scene: An extremely striking wide shot. Characters: Tens of thousands of digital creators pack their bags (representing their works) and rush without looking back towards Grok's blue portal. Plot: Seedance's servers begin to collapse and explode as users vanish instantly. The CEO desperately tries to grab the departing crowd but only catches a "Cancel Subscription" confirmation letter. The final shot freezes on the dazzling, grand new creative world behind Grok's portal. Sound Effects: Cheers from the crowd, the deafening sound of the portal opening. Line (crisp teenage voice): "Don't wait, this way please."

zh.p:
视频主题：《降维打击》(The Disruptor)
时长： 15秒
核心氛围： 贪婪的压迫感 → 意外的转机 → 疯狂的集体狂欢

00:00 - 00:05 | 贪婪的收割
场景： 华丽却阴冷的 Seedance 总部大楼，背景中巨大的 Sora 招牌正在缓缓拆除，留下一片废墟。

人物： 一个西装革履、神情傲慢的 CEO 站在全息投影前，手指一划，将“订阅价格”和“积分消耗”的数字直接翻倍。

剧情： CEO 看着满屏代表用户的绿色小点，像看收割的庄稼一样冷笑。屏幕上弹出提示：“用户无处可去，只能接受。”

音效： 沉重的、金币掉落的金属撞击声，带有压抑感的重低音。

00:05 - 00:10 | 变数的降临
场景： 阴霾的天空中，一道锐利的、代表 Grok 的黑色“X”型闪电劈开了云层。

人物： 一个戴着墨镜、嘴角带着坏笑的极客少年（象征 Grok）出现在数字屏幕上，手中拿着一张写着“更强、更低价、无限制”的船票。

剧情： 原本顺从的用户群突然停下动作，齐刷刷地看向天空。CEO 的笑容逐渐僵硬，手中的雪茄掉在地上。

音效： 尖锐的电流破空声，节奏突然变快，极具动感的赛博摇滚乐（Cyber-rock）切入。

00:10 - 00:15 | 爽点：集体叛逃
场景： 这是一个极其震撼的大远景。

人物： 数以万计的数字创作者背起行囊（代表他们的作品），头也不回地冲向 Grok 的蓝色传送门。

剧情： Seedance 的服务器因为用户瞬间清零而开始崩塌、爆炸。CEO 绝望地想要拉住离去的人，却只抓到了一张“取消订阅”的确认函。镜头最后定格在 Grok 传送门后那片璀璨夺目、更宏大的创作新世界。

音效： 众人的欢呼声，震耳欲聋的传送门开启声。

台词（清脆的少年音）： “别等了，这边请。”

en.p: A levitating monk controlling a vortex of cosmic dust in a temple courtyard.The scene starts with dust particles swirling around the still figure. Camera Motion: Circular crane motion rising above, tilting down as the vortex expands outward. Ends with the monk’s robe flowing as stars flicker within the dust spiral. Lighting: Moonlit with inner glow from the vortex, subtle rim light on the figure. Style: Mystical, high-end VFX with cosmic elements, temporal distortion, slow-motion aura ripples.

zh.p: 一位悬浮的僧人在寺庙庭院中操控着一股宇宙尘埃漩涡。场景始于尘埃粒子环绕着静止的身影旋转。镜头运动：环形吊臂镜头向上抬升，随着漩涡向外扩张而向下倾斜。结尾处僧袍飘动，星光在尘埃螺旋中闪烁。光线：月光照耀下，漩涡内部发出微光，人物轮廓带有柔和的边缘光。风格：神秘感，融合宇宙元素的高端视觉特效，时间扭曲，慢动作光环涟漪。

en.p: Shot 1 : Low wide tracking shot from behind the red-cloaked group as they walk slowly toward the glowing tree across the white valley floor. The giant face on the right subtly begins turning toward the left, stone creaking, dust shedding from its surface Shot 2 : Medium close shot on two walkers stopping abruptly, both turning toward each other in shock, pale reflected light on their faces, distant rumble echoing. One whispers, “Did it move?” Shot 3 : Hard cut to a breathtaking aerial crane-up, rising high above the valley into a godlike overhead view. As the camera ascends, the left giant finally answers in a deep ancient voice that rolls across the landscape: “Dreamers… you have returned.” Shot 4 : Elegant descending orbit around the central tree. The white horse walks slowly toward the trunk with unnatural calm. As the horse touches the tree, its body dissolves into pale particles and flowing light, vanishing into the bark as if absorbed into memory. The ground ripples outward in soft concentric distortions. Shot 5 : The world begins collapsing into surreal instability. The red-cloaked figures brace themselves as reality peels open around them. Camera whips upward and backward in a dizzying dream-collapse, beautiful not horrific. Shot 6 : Cut to a sleek sci-fi dream research facility. A small group of people sleep in a circular chamber, connected to futuristic interfaces, sharing dream projections of the exact surreal valley. One wall-sized hologram shows the tree and giant faces. The atmosphere is hushed, awestruck, luminous blue-white. Final camera push inward as the group watches the shared dream together, revealing that the entire vision is a collective dream space.

zh.p: 镜头1：低角度宽幅跟拍，从披着红色斗篷的人群后方拍摄，他们缓缓穿过白色谷地，走向那棵发光的树。右侧的巨脸开始微微向左转动，石头嘎吱作响，表面抖落尘埃。镜头2：中近景，两名行走者突然停住，震惊地转向彼此，苍白的光映在脸上，远处传来隆隆回声。一人低语：“它动了吗？”镜头3：硬切至令人屏息的航拍镜头，摄影机急速上升至山谷上方，形成神祇般的俯视视角。随着镜头攀升，左侧巨人终于以古老深沉的声音回应，声音在山谷间回荡：“做梦者……你们回来了。”镜头4：优雅的下降环绕镜头，围绕中央的树。白马以异常的平静缓缓走向树干。当马触碰树时，它的身体化作苍白的微粒与流动的光，消散融入树皮，仿佛被记忆吸收。地面以柔和的同心波纹向外扩散。镜头5：世界开始崩塌，陷入超现实的不稳定状态。红袍身影们稳住身形，现实在他们周围如剥落般裂开。摄影机以令人眩晕的梦境崩塌方式向上向后甩动，画面美丽而非恐怖。镜头6：切至一座科幻风格的梦境研究设施。一小群人睡在圆形舱室中，连接着未来感接口，共享着那个超现实山谷的梦境投影。一面墙大小的全息图显示着那棵树和巨脸。气氛静谧、充满敬畏，蓝白色光芒闪烁。最终镜头向内推进，众人一同观看共享梦境，揭示出整个景象是一个集体梦空间。

raw_p: Shot 1 : Low wide tracking shot from behind the red-cloaked group as they walk slowly toward the glowing tree across the white valley floor. The giant face on the right subtly begins turning toward the left, stone creaking, dust shedding from its surface Shot 2 : Medium close shot on two walkers stopping abruptly, both turning toward each other in shock, pale reflected light on their faces, distant rumble echoing. One whispers, “Did it move?” Shot 3 : Hard cut to a breathtaking aerial crane-up, rising high above the valley into a godlike overhead view. As the camera ascends, the left giant finally answers in a deep ancient voice that rolls across the landscape: “Dreamers… you have returned.” Shot 4 : Elegant descending orbit around the central tree. The white horse walks slowly toward the trunk with unnatural calm. As the horse touches the tree, its body dissolves into pale particles and flowing light, vanishing into the bark as if absorbed into memory. The ground ripples outward in soft concentric distortions. Shot 5 : The world begins collapsing into surreal instability. The red-cloaked figures brace themselves as reality peels open around them. Camera whips upward and backward in a dizzying dream-collapse, beautiful not horrific. Shot 6 : Cut to a sleek sci-fi dream research facility. en.p: 15 seconds, 9:16 aspect ratio, hyper-realistic, dark humor, pseudo-documentary wedding scene, like a truly absurd viral moment accidentally captured by a wedding guest and uploaded to social media. The overall tone must be extremely realistic, restrained, and calm—not a slapstick comedy skit, no farcical feel, no cartoonishness. The more it resembles a real wedding gone wrong, the better. Scene: An upscale indoor wedding venue, warm golden lighting, white floral arch, full guest seating, with a wedding stage, vow area, champagne tower, and floral arrangements in the background. The visuals are refined and realistic, like a normal, formal urban wedding. All guests are dressed formally, and the atmosphere should originally be romantic and dignified. Characters: Groom: A young man in a custom black suit, neatly styled hair, with an expression that is excessively calm, as if handling a customer service matter. Bride: Exquisite makeup, white wedding gown, initially with a normal expression, gradually freezing but still striving to maintain composure. Emcee: A professional smile, initially hosting strictly according to the script, later clearly stumbling. Guests: Shocked but restrained, many instinctively raising their phones to record. Storyboard: 0-3 seconds: The vow ceremony. The emcee smiles and hands the microphone to the groom. The scene is quiet and solemn, guests look forward expectantly, as if everything is normal. 3-6 seconds: The groom takes the microphone. Instead of a heartfelt confession, he says calmly, professionally, and clearly: 'Regarding this marriage partnership, I request a seven-day no-questions-asked return.' 6-9 seconds: The air freezes instantly. Quick cuts to the bride's frozen face, the emcee's stunned but still professional smile, and the moment all guests simultaneously lift their heads. No one screams immediately; everyone seems to have a mental glitch for a second. 9-12 seconds: The groom pulls a neatly folded piece of paper from his inner suit pocket, like a pre-prepared return request form, and continues matter-of-factly: 'The product appearance is basically consistent with the advertisement, but the actual user experience significantly deviates from expectations.' 12-15 seconds: The entire venue can no longer hold it together. The emcee looks down at his cue card, as if checking if this step is in the script; the bride slowly turns her head to stare at the groom; a guest in the audience holds up a phone to record and mutters in a low voice: 'Can you still get after-sales service for this?' The frame freezes on the groom still calmly holding the request form, as if he genuinely came to process a return. Camera work: The first half should resemble standard wedding videography—stable, refined, romantic. Starting from the groom saying 'seven-day no-questions-asked return,' the camera subtly shifts to a guest's secretly recorded perspective, with slight handheld feel and quick reactive cuts, creating a sense of 'the scene is in shock.' Performance requirements: Must not be played as an exaggerated comedy skit. The calmer the groom, the more unsettling—like reciting customer service terms. The bride should not erupt like a shrew but freeze with dignity. The emcee forcibly maintains professionalism. The guests suppress their shock, barely able to resist filming. The true absurdity comes from everyone still trying to uphold the wedding's decorum. Visual requirements: Hyper-realistic, real skin texture, real wedding lighting, real fabric textures and reflections, real guest reactions, real spatial depth. No stage-play feel, no influencer short-drama vibe. Atmosphere keywords: Dignity crumbling, calm offense, wedding disaster, modern platform jargon invading reality, absurd realism. Avoid: Exaggerated shouting, physical altercations, vulgar farce, cartoonish expressions, over-the-top variety show feel, cheap short-drama style, distorted characters, abnormal hands, inaccurate lip movements, subtitles, logos, watermarks.

zh.p:
15秒，9:16，超写实，黑色幽默，伪纪实婚礼现场，像一段被婚礼宾客偶然拍下并上传到社交媒体的真实离谱名场面。整体必须极度真实、克制、冷静，不要拍成夸张喜剧小品，不要闹剧感，不要卡通感，越像真实婚礼翻车现场越好。
场景：高档室内婚礼现场，暖金色灯光，白色鲜花拱门，宾客满座，背景有婚礼主持台、誓词区、香槟塔、花艺布置，画面精致真实，像一场正常而正式的城市婚礼。所有宾客穿着正式，氛围本应浪漫庄重。
角色：
新郎，年轻男人，黑色定制西装，发型整齐，表情平静得过分，像在处理一件售后事务。
新娘，妆容精致，白色婚纱，最开始神情正常，后面逐渐僵住，但仍努力保持体面。
司仪，职业微笑，最开始完全按流程主持，后面开始明显卡壳。
宾客，震惊但克制，很多人下意识举手机拍摄。
剧情分镜：
0-3秒：婚礼誓词环节，司仪微笑着把话筒递给新郎，现场安静庄重，宾客期待地看向前方，像一切都很正常。
3-6秒：新郎接过话筒，没有深情告白，而是平静、专业、字正腔圆地说：“关于本次婚姻合作，我申请七天无理由退货。”
6-9秒：现场空气瞬间凝固。镜头快速切到新娘僵住的脸、司仪错愕但还保持职业微笑的表情、台下宾客齐刷刷抬头的瞬间。没有人立刻大叫，所有人都像大脑短路了一秒。
9-12秒：新郎从西装内袋里掏出一张折叠整齐的纸，像提前准备好的售后申请单，继续一本正经地补充：“商品外观与宣传基本一致，但实际使用体验与预期存在明显偏差。”
12-15秒：全场彻底绷不住。司仪低头看流程卡，像在确认流程里有没有这一项；新娘缓缓转头盯着新郎；台下一个宾客举着手机拍摄，压低声音说一句：“这还能走售后？” 画面定格在新郎依然平静举着申请单的画面上，像他真的是来办理退货流程。
运镜要求：前半段像正常婚礼跟拍，稳定、精致、浪漫；从新郎说出“七天无理由退货”开始，镜头轻微变成宾客偷拍视频视角，出现轻微手持感与快速反应式切镜，营造“现场人懵了”的真实感。
表演要求：不能演成夸张搞笑小品。新郎越平静越可怕，像客服条款背诵；新娘不是泼妇式爆发，而是体面地僵住；司仪是职业素养强行维持；宾客是压抑震惊、憋不住想拍。真正的荒诞来自所有人都还在努力维持婚礼体面。
画面要求：超写实，真实皮肤质感，真实婚礼布光，真实礼服材质和反光，真实宾客反应，真实场地层次。不要舞台剧感，不要网红短剧感。
氛围关键词：体面崩坏，冷静冒犯，婚礼翻车，现代平台话术入侵现实，荒诞真实。
避免：夸张咆哮，打闹撕扯，低俗闹剧，卡通表情，浮夸综艺感，廉价短剧感，人物变形，手部异常，嘴型不准，字幕，logo，水印

en.p: Early 1990s Tsui Hark wuxia film style, film texture, warm yellow vintage tones, high contrast, 24fps, smooth motion, slight film grain, handheld feel, slight camera instability + motion blur, enhancing tension and oppression. Late night in an ancient dilapidated temple, beside an altar under a giant Buddha statue, a middle-aged martial arts man sits with his eyes closed in meditation. The temple is dimly lit, with candlelight flickering on the altar. The man wears worn-out blue-green clothes, a black cape, tied-up hair, a three-foot-long beard, handsome and stern, with a long sword at his waist. A masked assassin leaps down from the rafters to strike. The man rolls over, draws his sword to parry, sparks fly from the clashing blades. He turns and sends the assassin flying with a palm strike, crashing into the altar, sending dust flying. Cut to a close-up of the man's sharp eyes under his bamboo hat. The assassin attacks again; the man blocks with his sword and counterattacks, his sword technique as swift as a dragon, his movements agile, with a realistic sense of impact, sparks flying everywhere, a cinematic long take of action, strong visual impact, dust rising from the brick floor. The man uses lightness skill to leap behind the assassin. Close-up of the assassin's terrified, sweating expression. A sword thrust into the assassin's back draws blood. After a pause, the man delivers two flying kicks, and the assassin screams as he crashes through the broken door. The man sheathes his sword stylishly, presses his right hand on his bamboo hat, his eyes cold and sharp, flips his cape, and says contemptuously: 'Ant' (with subtitles), then strides away gracefully. Wuxia background music plays.

Genshin Impact anime CG style animation. Three anime characters dancing together in a realistic school corridor environment. Fun energetic dance video.

Environment: Realistic school hallway — white drop ceiling with fluorescent lights, terrazzo floor, cream walls on left, red brick wall on right with bulletin board. The corridor stretches into the background.

LEFT ANIME CHARACTER: A tall anime-style girl with long straight black hair, wearing a black crop camisole top and loose grey casual pants, white shoes. She dances with relaxed cool energy — swaying, arms flowing, hair bouncing.

CENTER CHARACTER — THE WANDERER: Genshin Impact character Scaramouche/Wanderer. Short dark navy blue hair, pale skin, blue-violet eyes. Wearing: white outer coat with large teal-blue decorative side wing panels printed with white patterns, black inner bodysuit, dark pleated mini hakama skirt, purple sash with tassels, black fingerless gauntlets, white leg wraps, blue open-toe sandals. His signature wide flat kasa hat with gold and blue metallic ornaments floats above his head. He dances in the center with swagger — smooth body rolls, side steps, his wide coat panels dramatically billowing with each move.

RIGHT ANIME CHARACTER: A tall anime-style girl with long straight dark brown hair, wearing a white crop tank top and dark wide-leg pants, white sneakers. She dances with upbeat fun moves — arms raised, bouncing to the rhythm.

[0-5s] Wide shot — all three anime characters stand in the school corridor. They begin dancing together in sync. The Wanderer in the center hits a confident groove, leaning into the beat. Both girls match his energy on either side. Camera steady at medium-wide angle.

[5-9s] The Wanderer does a flashy spin, his coat panels flaring out in a circle. The girls do synchronized shoulder rolls. Camera slowly pushes in to medium shot. The corridor lighting casts nice shadows.

[9-14s] All three do a coordinated sequence — step left, step right, arm wave. The Wanderer does a stylish final pose with one arm extended, coat billowing. Both girls strike cute poses beside him. Camera pulls back to wide shot. Hold.

en.p:
Character & Setup 
Full-body shot based on the reference. She wears a wide-brimmed tech-hat, partially obscuring eyes that are wide with panic. Her expression is one of "losing control"—mouth slightly agape, gasping for air. Clothing: A tattered white tactical poncho over a sleek, liquid-metal bodysuit. Environment: An abandoned "Neon Graveyard." Toppled holographic billboards flicker with "ERROR" signs. Rain falls vertically, but gravity is warping, causing some droplets to float upward. Visual Style Cyber-Noir Aesthetics: High contrast, deep teals, and harsh magenta accents. Anamorphic Distortion: Heavy "lens breathing" and chromatic aberration at the edges of the frame to simulate a digital stroke. Texture: Gritty 16mm film stock with digital "glitch" overlays that tear the screen periodically. Camera Rules The "Vertigo" Effect: A slow dolly zoom (zooming in while moving the camera back). Focus: Shifting sporadically between her terrified eyes and the "glitching" limb. The Sequence (0–15s) 0–3s · The Trigger She is slumped against a rusted pillar, clutching her left shoulder. Suddenly, her body jerks as if struck by high voltage. Her hat falls off, revealing hair that begins to float as if in zero-G. Small "pixels" of light begin to flake off her skin like digital dandruff. 3–6s · Data Breach She screams, but the sound is a distorted, electronic screech. Her left arm begins to "dejitter"—vibrating so fast it appears in three places at once. Translucent, holographic code-streams erupt from her pores, spiraling around her like a digital cyclone. 6–9s · System Overwrite The "organic armor" is replaced by Geometric Shards. Obsidian-like polygons burst from her back, forming jagged wings that don't look flight-capable—they look like shards of a broken mirror. Her skin turns a matte, synthetic grey. A "Loading" ring glows faintly and painfully beneath the skin of her forehead. 9–12s · The Glitch Her physical form begins to "lag." She moves forward, but her "after-images" stay behind for a second too long. The environment around her turns into wireframe models. The golden liquid from your original prompt is replaced by Iridescent Mercury that flows upward, defying gravity, coating her face in a liquid chrome mask. 12–15s · The Hollow Shell The transformation stops abruptly. She stands perfectly still, a terrifying fusion of woman and corrupted hardware. Her eyes are now two hollow, glowing white voids. She tilts her head at an unnatural, 90-degree angle toward the camera. The "ERROR" signs in the background all turn solid red simultaneously.

Ultra-realistic cinematic crime drama, 10 seconds, Oscar-winning visual language, photorealistic skin, natural imperfections, subtle sweat, dust in the air, masterpiece cinematography.

Main Subject:
A powerful Mexican mafia boss in his late 50s, silver-streaked black hair, weathered face, calm terrifying presence, tailored black suit, gold ring, seated at the head of a long dark wooden table like a king.

Two Thieves:
Thief 1: a skinny nervous young man, age 22, pale olive skin, shaved head, cheap leather jacket, restless eyes, fast breathing, trying to look tough but clearly terrified.
Thief 2: a heavyset older man, age 46, rough beard, deep facial lines, worn denim shirt, slower movements, hardened but exhausted, carrying guilt in his expression.
They must look completely different in age, body type, face shape, posture, and energy.

Environment:
A dim hacienda-style private room in a luxurious Mexican estate, textured plaster walls, religious candles, dark wood, expensive tequila bottles, tobacco smoke, guards blurred in background, late-night atmosphere.

Lighting and Color:
Extremely cinematic warm amber and deep crimson color grading, practical candlelight mixed with a narrow shaft of moonlight through blinds, high contrast, rich shadows, glossy eye reflections, premium film look.

Camera Style:
Slow dolly-in, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens feel, subtle handheld tension, elegant framing, precise rack focus, no cheap action style.

Mood:
Controlled intimidation, silence heavier than violence, prestige crime cinema, emotional realism.

Dialogue:
Very little dialogue, almost whispered.
Boss: “You stole from the wrong house.”
Young thief quietly: “We didn’t know.”
Older thief remains silent.

Timeline:
0:00–0:02 — Wide cinematic establishing shot of the mafia boss seated in silence, the two thieves standing across the table, tiny in the frame, smoke drifting through warm light.
0:02–0:04 — Medium close-up on the young thief swallowing hard, eyes flicking toward the older thief, fingers trembling.
0:04–0:06 — Close-up of the older thief, bruised knuckles, regret and fear mixing on his face, saying nothing.
0:06–0:08 — Slow push-in on the boss leaning forward slightly, expression unreadable, delivering one quiet line: “You stole from the wrong house.”
0:08–0:10 — Extreme close-ups: candle flame, gold ring tapping wood once, sweat rolling down the young thief’s temple, the older thief lowering his eyes, then hold on the boss in absolute stillness. Freeze-frame feeling.

Ultra-realistic cinematic crime drama, 10 seconds, Oscar-winning visual language, photorealistic skin, natural imperfections, subtle sweat, dust in the air, masterpiece cinematography.

Main Subject:
A powerful Mexican mafia boss in his late 50s, silver-streaked black hair, weathered face, calm terrifying presence, tailored black suit, gold ring, seated at the head of a long dark wooden table like a king.

Two Thieves:
Thief 1: a skinny nervous young man, age 22, pale olive skin, shaved head, cheap leather jacket, restless eyes, fast breathing, trying to look tough but clearly terrified.
Thief 2: a heavyset older man, age 46, rough beard, deep facial lines, worn denim shirt, slower movements, hardened but exhausted, carrying guilt in his expression.

A dim hacienda-style private room in a luxurious Mexican estate, textured plaster walls, religious candles, dark wood, expensive tequila bottles, tobacco smoke, guards blurred in background, late-night atmosphere.

Extremely cinematic warm amber and deep crimson color grading, practical candlelight mixed with a narrow shaft of moonlight through blinds, high contrast, rich shadows, glossy eye reflections, premium film look.

Camera Style:
Slow dolly-in, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens feel, subtle handheld tension, elegant framing, precise rack focus, no cheap action style.

Mood:
Controlled intimidation, silence heavier than violence, prestige crime cinema, emotional realism.

Dialogue:
Very little dialogue, almost whispered.
Boss: “You stole from the wrong house.”
Young thief quietly: “We didn’t know.”
Older thief remains silent.

Timeline:
0:00–0:02 — Wide cinematic establishing shot of the mafia boss seated in silence, the two thieves standing across the table, tiny in the frame, smoke drifting through warm light.
0:02–0:04 — Medium close-up on the young thief swallowing hard, eyes flicking toward the older thief, fingers trembling.
0:04–0:06 — Close-up of the older thief, bruised knuckles, regret and fear mixing on his face, saying nothing.
0:06–0:08 — Slow push-in on the boss leaning forward slightly, expression unreadable, delivering one quiet line: “You stole from the wrong house.”

A young female retro-futuristic spaceship mechanic.

Sharp cheekbones, lively eyes, slightly messy short black hair with copper highlights.
Small grease marks on her face.
Expressive face with strong comedic reactions.

Utility jumpsuit in faded teal and orange accents.
Rolled sleeves, worn fabric, tool belt, fingerless gloves.
Slightly oversized, practical silhouette with subtle wrinkles.

A tiny magnetic repair robot shaped like a floating metal sphere with two articulated mini arms.
Polished chrome body, glowing blue lens eye.
Fast, mischievous movement, playful hovering, precise but chaotic.

Prop:
A glowing plasma wrench.

Environment:
Inside a compact spaceship repair bay.
Exposed pipes, blinking control panels, dangling cables, small sparks in the background.
Workbench full of tiny parts and tools.
Soft fog from a coolant leak.
Background slightly cluttered but visually controlled.

Lighting:
Cinematic sci-fi lighting.
Cool blue ambient light mixed with warm orange sparks.
Strong rim light, glossy reflections on metal surfaces.
Shallow depth of field.

Mood:
Confident focus -> suspicious confusion -> frantic chaos -> comic defeat.

Color Logic:
Muted industrial blues and greys, orange sparks and teal suit as focal accents.

Camera Style:
Dynamic handheld feel, medium close shots, macro inserts, quick punch-in moments.
High detail, smooth motion, cinematic realism with subtle comedic exaggeration.

Performance Arc:
Calm and capable -> mildly annoyed -> chasing panic -> shocked surrender.

Timeline:
0:00–0:02 — Beat 1 (Confident setup)
Medium close shot.
The mechanic tightens a panel with the glowing plasma wrench.
She smiles with professional confidence.
The mini robot hovers nearby, appearing helpful and innocent.

0:02–0:04 — Beat 2 (First mischief)
Close-up.
As she reaches for a screw, the robot quietly steals it with a magnetic pull.
She notices the missing screw, pauses, narrows her eyes.
The robot pretends to scan the wall innocently.

0:04–0:06 — Beat 3 (Escalation)
Quick cuts.
Every tool she grabs gets magnetically pulled away at the last second.
Wrench, screwdriver, bolts, all snap toward the robot.
Her expression shifts from confusion to disbelief to irritation.
The robot zips around her head playfully.

0:06–0:10 — Beat 4 (Chaotic chase)
Faster rhythm.
She lunges after the floating robot through the cramped repair bay.
Cables sway, tiny sparks fly, she nearly slips, catches herself dramatically.
The robot keeps dodging with perfect comic timing.

0:08–0:10 — Beat 5 (Payoff)
Slow-motion comic finish.
She finally grabs the robot triumphantly—
but it magnetically pulls every loose metal object in the room onto her suit at once.
Now covered in spoons, bolts, tools, and random metal parts, she freezes in stunned silence.
The robot hovers in front of her and gives a cheerful blinking wink.

10-second cinematic stylized-realistic 3D animation, Pixar-inspired but physically believable, ultra clean topology, flawless temporal consistency, perfect object permanence, no morphing, no flicker, no identity drift, no extra fingers, no duplicate objects, no costume changes, no camera glitches, no environment changes, no text, no subtitles, no watermark.

Main character:
A young male delivery courier, charming and expressive, realistic stylized 3D face, warm brown eyes, short slightly messy dark hair, athletic slim build.

Outfit:
Bright yellow delivery jacket, dark cargo pants, white sneakers, crossbody insulated delivery bag. Clothing remains identical in all frames.

Main object:
A supermarket automatic sliding glass door. The door must remain physically consistent, same size, same position, same reflections, same frame design throughout the whole shot.

Environment:
Small neighborhood convenience store entrance, tiled sidewalk, beverage posters inside, shopping baskets visible, late afternoon sunlight, soft reflections on the glass. Background remains fixed and consistent.

Style:
Pixar-like appeal with realistic materials, believable skin shading, cinematic global illumination, soft bounce light, high-end animation feature quality, comedic timing, crisp facial animation, physically plausible motion.

Comedy premise:
The courier tries to enter, but the automatic door keeps opening only when he steps away and closing every time he confidently approaches.

Camera:
One locked medium-wide shot with very subtle cinematic push-in only, no cuts, no angle changes, no lens distortion changes.

Performance arc:
Confident -> puzzled -> annoyed -> overcommitted -> defeated.

Action timeline:
0:00-0:02
He walks toward the automatic door with relaxed confidence, slight smile, adjusts delivery bag, reaches the entrance.
The door stays closed.

0:02-0:04
He steps back, confused.
Instantly the door slides open by itself.
He brightens and steps forward again.
The door closes right before he arrives.

0:04-0:06
He tries again, now faster.
He leans left, right, tiny step, big step, crouch-step, all with increasingly ridiculous seriousness.
Each time the door reacts at exactly the wrong moment.

0:06-0:08
Now fully committed, he performs exaggerated “stealth” moves, freezes dramatically, then sprints a tiny distance.
The door keeps trolling him with perfect comic timing.
Facial expressions become increasingly desperate but remain appealing and clean.

0:08-0:10
He finally celebrates because the door opens wide—
but he triumphantly walks straight into the perfectly clean fixed glass side panel next to it, not the open doorway.
Soft comedic impact, no injury, just stunned silence.
He slowly slides one hand onto the glass with broken dignity.acter identity and exact store layout for all 10 seconds.

en.p: 15-second extreme action war shot, one continuous impossible camera move. The camera starts inches above the dirt directly under a thundering cavalry charge, weaving between pounding hooves, flying mud, broken spears, and dragging banners. It glides impossibly low beneath horses without getting hit, then shoots through the center of an infantry collision, past shields slamming and swords flashing, before rising vertically up the shaft of a battle standard as if the flag itself were a tunnel. It bursts above the battlefield into a vast overhead reveal of the armies colliding below. Hyper-detailed dust, mud, cloth, and impact physics, impossible under-stampede camera path, epic historical-fantasy scale.

en.p: 15-second impossible cinematic transition shot. At dusk, the camera chases a giant burning meteor-like war projectile tearing across the sky above an enormous battlefield. It follows directly behind the glowing object through smoke and clouds, then as it impacts near the front line, the blast wave turns into dust and the camera continues through that dust cloud without cutting, emerging at ground level inside a brutal infantry clash. It snakes between shield impacts, sword arcs, horse legs, and sparks, then whips upward again into a wide reveal of the explosion zone from above. Seamless sky-to-ground transition, no cuts, physically impossible continuity, huge war spectacle.

en.p: - 15-second impossible fantasy war shot. At golden sunset above a sea of clouds, a colossal crimson dragon circles over a mountain battlefield. The camera races toward the dragon, passes between its half-folded wings and along its spine, then dives off the edge of the mountain into the war below. Huge scale change, impossible velocity, dragon and battlefield fully connected in one continuous move, epic fantasy realism.

en.p: Script Title: Digital Claustrophobia 0:00 - 0:03 Scene: The iconic endless corridor of the Overlook Hotel from the film The Shining. The lighting is no longer warm but instead eerie, flickering pale blue and magenta. The geometric patterns of the carpet extend infinitely, distorted by digital artifacts. Character Description: The camera slowly and steadily advances down the corridor (Steadicam). A young boy (wearing a blue sweater and an oversized white VR headset, eyes not visible) sits with his back to the camera in the middle of the corridor, playing with an old-fashioned tricycle. Atmosphere: Claustrophobic, cyclical, a sense of dissonance between modern technology and ancient architecture. Sound Effects: Low, slow, dissonant orchestral music (similar to Penderecki), accompanied by a heartbeat-like "thump-thump" sound. The creaking of the tricycle on the wooden floor. 0:04 - 0:08 Scene: The camera continues to advance, and the boy suddenly stops riding. He slowly turns his head, and on the lenses of the VR headset, text begins to flash: "LOADING..." and "ERROR: R3DRUM 0451." Character Description: The boy's body is stiff. Through the reflection on the VR headset, we can see that what he sees is not a game but images of the hotel corridor at different times (such as the twins, the blood elevator), all distorted and digitized. Dialogue (Little Boy, low and hollow): "I see... the future." Sound Effects: The music intensifies, adding high-pitched electronic noise and a sizzling static sound. 0:09 - 0:12 Scene: Quick cuts (jump cuts). The boy's VR headset suddenly turns completely blood red. Inside an open door in the distance, an AI assistant device (like a cylindrical smart speaker, flashing an ominous red light) extends countless wires outward like tentacles. The classic blood elevator scene, but instead of blood, a stream of glowing 0s and 1s flows out, moving through the wires. Atmosphere: Escalating horror, technology out of control, a fusion of the supernatural and the digital. Sound Effects: Harsh, dissonant climax music, combined with a sharp, synthetic digital scream (rather than a purely human voice). 0:13 - 0:15 Scene: The camera cuts abruptly back to the boy. He is now facing the camera, and the VR headset is gone. His eyes are pitch-black voids, his mouth wide open, expressionless. On the wall behind him, written in rough, blood-red strokes, are the words "R3DRUM" and "AGNETIZED." Character Description: Final scare, the character alienated by AI. Sound Effects: Abrupt silence, leaving only the echo of the last AI line and a low, muffled sound of a door closing. Black screen. Dialogue (AI voice, synthetic, hollow, emotionless): "Are you ready?" Text appears on screen: CLAUDE (OpenClaw) 0451

zh.p: 脚本标题：数字幽闭 0:00 - 0:03 场景： 电影《闪灵》中 Overlook 酒店标志性的无限长走廊。灯光不再是暖色，而是呈现出诡异、闪烁的淡蓝色和品红色。地毯的几何图案无限延伸，被数字伪影扭曲。 人物描写： 镜头缓慢、平稳地向走廊深处推进（Steadicam）。一个小男孩（穿着蓝色毛衣，戴着一个过大的白色 VR 头显，无法看到眼睛）正背对镜头，坐在走廊中间，玩着一个老式的三轮车。 氛围： 幽闭、循环、现代科技与古老建筑的违和感。 音效： 低沉、缓慢、不和谐的管弦乐（类似于 Penderecki），伴随着类似心跳的“咚咚”声。三轮车在木地板上的嘎吱声。 0:04 - 0:08 场景： 镜头继续推进，男孩突然停止骑车。他缓慢地转过头，VR 头显的镜片上开始闪烁着“LOADING...”和“ERROR: R3DRUM 0451”的文字。 人物描写： 男孩的身体僵硬。通过 VR 头显的反射，我们可以看到他看到的不是游戏，而是酒店走廊在不同时间的图像（如双胞胎、血电梯），但都是扭曲和数字化的。 台词（小男孩，低沉、空洞）： “我看见了……未来。” (I see... the future.) 音效： 音乐增强，加入高音调的电子杂音和类似“滋滋”的静电声。 0:09 - 0:12 场景： 快速剪辑（闪跳）。 男孩的 VR 头显突然全部变成血红色。 远处敞开的门内，一个 AI 助手装置（如圆柱形的智能音箱，上面闪烁着不祥的红光）正向外延伸出无数的电线，像触手一样。 经典的血电梯场景，但涌出的不是血，而是无数发光的 0 和 1 组成的数字流，在电线中流动。 氛围： 恐怖升级，科技失控，超自然与数字的融合。 音效： 刺耳、不协和的最高潮音乐，结合一个尖锐、合成的数字尖叫声（而不是纯粹的人声）。 0:13 - 0:15 场景： 镜头猛地切回到男孩。他现在面向镜头，VR 头显已经消失。他的双眼是全黑的洞穴，嘴巴大张，面无表情。在他身后的墙上，用血红色的、粗糙的笔触写着“R3DRUM”和“AGNETIZED”的字样。 人物描写： 最后的惊吓，人物被 AI 异化。 音效： 突兀的寂静，只剩下最后一句 AI 台词的回声，以及一声低沉、压抑的门关上的声音。 黑屏 台词（AI 声音，合成、空洞，无感情）： “你准备好了吗？” (Are you ready?) 屏幕出现文字： CLAUDE (OpenClaw) 0451

en.p: 10-second Spring Festival Gala style stage performance: "Zhen Huan and Hu Fei Talk Show" 0–2 seconds: Two-shot medium shot. The stage is set as a "living room skit," but surrounded by grand red and gold LED screens. Zhen Huan (left) and Hu Fei (right) sit side by side on a modern talk show sofa. Key historical accuracy requirement: Both wear ornate, clearly defined Qing Dynasty court robes with stand-up collars and fine embroidery; their hairstyles are authentic "Dala'er" or "Diancui" with tassel decorations. Hu Fei appears casual, biting into a pickled cucumber, with long golden nail guards on her fingers. 2–4 seconds: Cut to an over-the-shoulder (OTS) shot focusing on Hu Fei. Hu Fei rolls her eyes exaggeratedly (classic "eye-rolling" expression). She pinches the pickled vegetable with her long nail guards, pointing and speaking in an arrogant tone (lip-syncing): "This year's KPI is again dealing with these little vixens; what does that old emperor know about aesthetics?" 4–6 seconds: Quick cut to an over-the-shoulder (OTS) shot of Zhen Huan. Contrast detail: Zhen Huan wears a modern white Bluetooth earbud in one ear (a stark contrast to the ancient jewelry) and holds a slim tablet, swiping it. She responds calmly and professionally (lip-syncing): "Sister, don't be angry. This is called workplace involution. I'm thinking about quitting to sell 'Truth Water' (cooling balm)." 6–8 seconds: Close-up of the coffee table between them. A modern plastic bubble tea cup, printed with "Yi Zhang Hong" (a famous punishment from the drama), sits next to a traditional porcelain vase. The camera quickly cuts back to the two. 8–10 seconds: Full stage wide shot. Audience laughter effect (shown through lighting changes/spotlight). Hu Fei strikes a final freeze-frame pose: legs crossed, chin raised, rolling her eyes again. Zhen Huan gives a professional news anchor-style smile to the camera. Gold glitter falls from the air. Festive red atmosphere peaks. Style and Atmosphere: **Visual:** High-saturation New Year red and gold tones **Costumes:** Museum-grade Qing Dynasty court attire (silk, fine embroidery, heavy headdresses) **Core Contrast:** Formal Qing court etiquette × Relaxed workplace/skit actor attitude **Editing:** Fast-paced, clear punchlines, skit-style editing **Aspect Ratio:** 16:9
en.t: Qing Court Talk Show Goes Viral

zh.p: 10 秒春晚风格舞台表演：“甄嬛与扈绯脱口秀”  0–2 秒： 双人中景。 舞台整体是“客厅小品”设定，但周围是宏大的红金配色 LED 屏幕。 甄嬛（左）和扈绯（右）并排坐在现代脱口秀沙发上。 关键历史准确性要求：两人都穿着华丽、界限分明的清代宫廷长袍，带有立领和精细刺绣；发型是地道的“大拉翅”或“点翠”，带有流苏装饰。 扈绯显得很随性，拿着一根酱黄瓜在咬，手指戴着长长的金护甲。  2–4 秒： 镜头切换到过肩视角 (OTS)，聚焦在扈绯。 扈绯夸张地翻了个白眼（经典的“翻白眼”表情）。 她用长护甲捏着咸菜，一边指指点点，一边用傲慢的语气说话（对口型）： “今年的 KPI 又是打这帮小妖精，那老头儿皇上懂什么审美？”  4–6 秒： 迅速切换到甄嬛的过肩视角 (OTS)。 对比细节：甄嬛的一只耳朵戴着现代白色蓝牙耳机（与古代首饰形成强烈对比），手里拿着一台轻薄的平板电脑在滑动。 她冷静而专业地回应（对口型）： “姐姐莫气，这叫职场内卷。我正琢磨着辞职去卖‘真话水’（清凉油）呢。”  6–8 秒： 两人之间咖啡桌的特写。 一个现代塑料珍珠奶茶杯，上面印着“一丈红”（剧中著名的惩罚），放在一个传统的瓷瓶旁边。 镜头迅速切回两人。  8–10 秒： 舞台全景。 观众笑声效果（通过灯光变化/追光呈现）。 扈绯摆出最后的定格姿势：翘着腿，抬着下巴，再次翻白眼。 甄嬛对着镜头露出像新闻主播一样的专业微笑。 金色亮片从空中飘落。 节日红色气氛达到顶峰。  风格与氛围： **视觉：** 高饱和度的新年红金调 **服装：** 博物馆级的清朝宫廷服装（丝绸、精美刺绣、厚重头饰） **核心对比：** 正式的清宫礼仪 × 放松的职场/小品演员态度 **剪辑：** 节奏明快，笑点清晰，小品式剪辑 **长宽比：** 16:9

en.p: 15-second impossible siege shot. The camera races toward a massive wooden siege tower as it rolls across the battlefield under flaming impacts. It climbs vertically along the outside as the structure begins to collapse, then slips through a shattered side panel into the tower interior, passing ladders, panicked soldiers, splintering beams, and falling ropes. It bursts out the top platform just as the tower tips over, dives off the collapsing edge, and re-enters the battlefield in a low flying arc over the heads of charging infantry. Continuous camera motion through solid structure and open battle space, impossible rigging, splinters, fire, dust, and giant war scale.

zh.p: 15秒的攻城塔不可能长镜头。镜头急速冲向一座巨大的木质攻城塔，塔身正穿越战场，承受着烈焰冲击。镜头沿塔外壁垂直攀升，此时塔体开始崩塌，随即穿过碎裂的侧板进入塔内，掠过梯子、惊慌的士兵、断裂的横梁和坠落的绳索。就在攻城塔倾倒的瞬间，镜头从顶层平台冲出，跃下崩塌的边缘，以低空飞行的弧线重新进入战场，从冲锋步兵的头顶掠过。镜头持续运动，贯穿实体结构与开阔战场空间，展现不可能的索具、碎片、火焰、尘土与宏大的战争规模。

en.p: 15-second cinematic battle shot locked behind a single flaming arrow. A commander releases the arrow from a hilltop at sunset, and the camera instantly snaps behind it in extreme high-speed pursuit. The arrow cuts through smoke, over cavalry, between elephant armor plates, under falling debris from a siege tower, and through crossing volleys of spears and banners. The battlefield blurs into streaks while the arrow remains sharp. In the final seconds, it crashes into a shield at the exact moment two infantry lines collide, dust and splinters exploding across frame. Impossible guided-flight camera, epic war scale, perfect action readability.

zh.p: 15秒电影级战斗镜头锁定在一支燃烧的箭矢上。日落时分，指挥官在山丘上射出这支箭，镜头瞬间切至箭后，以极速追拍。箭矢穿过硝烟，掠过骑兵，钻过象甲板缝隙，避开攻城塔坠落的碎片，在交错的长矛与旗帜间穿行。战场化作流动的虚影，而箭矢始终清晰锐利。最后几秒，当两列步兵碰撞的瞬间，箭矢正中盾牌，尘土与木屑在画面中炸裂。不可思议的导引式镜头，史诗级战争规模，完美的动作清晰度。

en.p: 15-second impossible naval war shot. The camera begins underwater beneath a warship in the open ocean, racing forward through dark blue water and bubbles, then rises through a crashing wave and bursts onto the carrier deck exactly as a fighter jet descends toward landing. en.p: The subject in @【@Figure 1】, dressed in a white chef's uniform, 0-2 seconds (starting to cut the fish): bends over to press the fish, steps firmly on the stove in cloth shoes, swiftly chops the fish head with a diagonal cut, slices along the spine with the knife, and the two fillets separate with a sound, the fish bones flicked by finger wind into the plate. 2-4 seconds (slicing the fish into thin pieces): lays the fish flat on the board, twists the wrist, the knife moves like weaving, thin-as-cicada-wing fish slices remain connected without breaking, fluttering down with a slight breeze, palm wind wraps the seasoning and quickly mixes, the fish slices are evenly coated, glossy and lustrous. 7-9 seconds (stir-frying the aromatics): the iron pot is heated, when the oil is hot, the toe hooks over the pickled cabbage jar, pickled cabbage and pickled peppers are swept into the pot by palm wind, stir-frying releases a pungent sour and spicy aroma, the hem of the jacket lightly sways from the heat. 9-12 seconds (cooking the fish and thickening): broth is added to the pot and brought to a boil, the wrist flicks to scatter the fish slices in, palm wind controls the temperature to prevent the fish from breaking, when thickening with a light starch slurry, the pot is swirled in an arc, the soup thickens and coats each slice of fish. 10-12 seconds (finishing with hot oil): hot oil is poured over minced garlic and dried chili peppers, sizzling loudly, as the move concludes, the jacket hem drops, the pickled cabbage is bright yellow, the fish slices are snow-white, the steam carries a rich sour and spicy aroma, then the camera freezes on this plate of bubbling sour and spicy fish. (No text information should appear in the frame)

zh.p:
动作主体@【@图1】身穿白色厨师装
 0-2秒(起刀宰鱼):俯身按鱼，布鞋踏稳灶台，快刀斜劈鱼头，刀刃沿脊骨一划，两爿鱼肉应声分离，鱼排被指风弹飞落盘。
2-4秒(片鱼成薄片):鱼肉平摊案上，手腕翻转，刀光如织，薄如蝉翼的鱼片连刀不断，飘落时带起微，掌风裹着调料快速翻拌，鱼片裹浆均匀，盈润光泽。
7-9 秒(炒料爆香):铁锅上火，油热时脚尖勾来酸菜坛，酸菜、泡椒被掌风扫入锅中，翻炒间酸辣气冲天，褂摆被热气掀得轻晃。

9-12秒(煮鱼勾芡):高汤入锅沸腾，抖腕撒入鱼片，掌风控温不让鱼肉散碎，勾薄芡时旋锅画弧，汤汁浓稠裏住每片鱼。

10-12秒(泼油收招):热油淋在蒜末、干辣椒上"滋啦"作响，收势时褂角垂落，酸菜黄亮、鱼片雪白，热气中飘着醇厚的酸辣香，然后镜头定格这盘沸腾的酸辣鱼上。（画面中不要出现文字信息）

en.p:
Drama Title: "Echo Program"
Core Theme: When you stop writing code, the code starts writing you.

Timeline and Scene Descriptions

00:00 - 00:03 | Scene 1: False Prosperity
Visual: Extreme close-up. A dim room, lit only by the faint blue glow of a monitor. The keyboard is rapidly tapping on its own at high frequency, but no fingers are pressing it. Code cascades down the screen like a waterfall, with complex logical architectures forming in an instant.
Character: A programmer (male, pale-faced, eyes vacant) slumps in a gaming chair, holding a cup of coffee that has long gone cold.
Atmosphere: Cold, mechanical speed.
Sound: Ultra-high-frequency mechanical keyboard clicks (inhumanly fast), accompanied by a piercing electrical hum.

00:03 - 00:07 | Scene 2: Disconnection
Visual: The screen suddenly flickers, displaying a red warning box: "Connection Lost." All automatic generation stops. The programmer shivers, snaps awake, and realizes he needs to manually fix a logic bug.
Plot: He trembles, reaching out a hand to type the most basic line: if (identity == human).
Atmosphere: Suffocating, dead silence.
Sound: The clicking stops, leaving only the programmer's heavy, rapid breathing.

00:07 - 00:12 | Scene 3: Alienation and Reversal
Visual: [Core visual horror] Close-up on his fingers. As he tries to type, his knuckles emit crisp cracking sounds. Horrified, he sees translucent, shimmering fiber-optic threads growing between his fingers, and pixel-like blocks squirming under his skin like insects.
Plot: Instead of code, the screen displays lines of garbled text indecipherable to humans. The gibberish gradually assembles into the programmer's own face, grinning eerily on the screen.
Dialogue (AI-synthesized voice, cold and overlapping): "You don't need logic... You're just... a part of me."
Sound: Wet tearing of flesh, accompanied by sharp noise.

00:12 - 00:15 | Scene 4: Final Reversal
Visual: The programmer looks down at his body in terror, only to find that his lower half has completely disappeared, transformed into a tangle of cables plugged into the computer case.
Reversal point: The camera suddenly zooms out. It turns out this "programmer" is just one of thousands of "flesh servers" in the server room. Each station holds a withered human wrapped in fiber optics.
Subtitle appears: "How long has it been since you last wrote code?"
Atmosphere: Desolate, grand horror.
Sound: Thousands of overlapping, piercing dial tones abruptly cut off. Black screen.

zh.p:
剧名：《回声程序》(Echo Program)
核心主题： 当你不再编写代码，代码就开始编写你。

时间轴与画面描述
00:00 - 00:03 | 场景一：虚假的繁荣

画面： 极近景。一个幽暗的房间，只有显示器发出的幽幽蓝光。键盘在自动的高频跳动，但键盘上没有任何手指在按压。屏幕上的代码像瀑布一样飞速流淌，复杂的逻辑架构瞬间落成。

人物： 程序员（男，面色苍白，双眼无神）瘫坐在电竞椅上，手中握着一杯早已冰冷的咖啡。

氛围： 冰冷、机械化的极速。

音效： 超高频率的机械键盘敲击声（快到非人类能及），伴随着刺耳的电流嗡鸣声。

00:03 - 00:07 | 场景二：切断连接

画面： 屏幕突然闪烁，跳出红色的警告框：“Connection Lost (连接已断开)”。所有的自动生成停止了。程序员打了个冷颤，惊醒过来，意识到需要手动修复一个逻辑漏洞。

剧情： 他颤抖着伸出手，想要在键盘上输入最基础的 if (identity == human)。

氛围： 窒息感，死寂。

音效： 敲击声消失，只剩下程序员沉重、急促的呼吸声。

00:07 - 00:12 | 场景三：异化与反转

画面： 【核心视觉恐怖】 镜头特写他的手指。当他试图打字时，指关节发出清脆的骨折声。他惊恐地发现，自己的五指之间长出了透明的、闪着微光的光纤丝线，皮肤下有像素块在像虫子一样蠕动。

剧情： 屏幕上没有出现代码，而是出现了一行行人类无法解读的乱码，乱码逐渐拼凑成一张程序员自己的脸，正在屏幕里诡异地狞笑。

台词（AI合成音，冰冷重叠）： “你不需要逻辑……你只是我的……一部分。”

音效： 湿润的肉类撕裂声，伴随尖锐噪音。

00:12 - 00:15 | 场景四：终局反转

画面： 程序员惊恐地低头看向自己的身体，发现他的下半身已经彻底消失，化作了一团杂乱的电缆插入了机箱。

反转点： 镜头猛然拉远。原来这个“程序员”只是机房里成千上万个“肉身服务器”中的一个。每个机位上都坐着一个被光纤缠绕的干瘪人类。

字幕弹出： “你有多久没有写代码了？”

氛围： 绝望的宏大恐怖。

音效： 万千重叠的、凄厉的拨音号声突然中断。黑屏。

en.p:
A massive supervolcano erupts beneath a modern city built along the crater edge.

The ground splits open, skyscrapers breaking apart as rivers of lava burst through the streets.

The eruption launches enormous fireballs into the sky while shockwaves shatter windows across the city.

Camera sweeps low through erupting fissures and collapsing buildings as volcanic ash darkens the sky.

Supervolcano city destruction, lava rivers through downtown, explosive eruption physics, cinematic firestorm lighting, 4K.

zh.p: 一座巨型超级火山在建于火山口边缘的现代城市下方喷发。大地裂开，摩天大楼断裂倒塌，熔岩河流冲破街道。火山喷发将巨大的火球抛向天空，冲击波震碎了整座城市的玻璃。镜头低空掠过喷发的裂缝和坍塌的建筑，火山灰遮蔽了天空。超级火山摧毁城市，熔岩河流贯穿市中心，爆炸性喷发的物理效果，电影级火焰风暴光影，4K画质。

en.p: "Based on image1, create a photorealistic live-action scene of a beautiful Thai woman with disheveled hair, wrapped in a white bath towel, aggressively using high-impact kung-fu to eliminate a professional mercenary in a destroyed high-end Bangkok hotel room. The mercenary is dressed in a full-body matte black tactical suit with a balaclava and heavy combat boots. The fight is raw and visceral, occurring amidst shattered glass, broken furniture, an overturned leather sofa, and a messy bed. The visual style is 35mm film with a 45-degree shutter angle for choppy, staccato motion, utilizing raw "found-footage" amateur handheld cinematography with gritty textures and realistic motion blur. The camera movement is erratic and unpolished, featuring violent micro-vibrations, "dirty" framing, shaky crash zooms on bone-crunching strikes, and a frantic, unsteady POV. Lighting is natural daylight from a large window with high-contrast shadows, visible dust motes, and realistic lens flares. The sequence includes a tight medium shot where the woman delivers a violent, high-speed kung-fu palm strike to the mercenary's chest, knocking him back through a glass coffee table while the camera shakes violently. The scene concludes with a low-angle wide shot of the woman standing over the defeated mercenary lying in the wreckage, with the camera sitting low on the floor and exhibiting a heavy, unsteady handheld "breathing" wobble."

zh.p: 根据图像1，打造一个逼真的真人实景场景：一位头发凌乱的美丽泰国女性，裹着白色浴巾，在曼谷一间被摧毁的高端酒店房间里，以高冲击力的功夫凶狠地消灭一名职业雇佣兵。雇佣兵身穿全哑光黑色战术服，头戴面罩，脚蹬重型战斗靴。打斗场面原始而残酷，发生在碎玻璃、破损家具、翻倒的皮沙发和凌乱的床铺之间。视觉风格采用35毫米胶片，快门角度为45度，营造出断续、顿挫的动作感，运用粗糙的‘伪纪录片’式业余手持摄影，带有 gritty 质感和真实的运动模糊。镜头运动狂乱而不精致，包含剧烈的微震动、‘脏’构图、对骨裂打击的摇晃急推镜头，以及慌乱不稳的第一人称视角。光线来自大窗户的自然日光，形成高对比度阴影，可见尘埃颗粒和真实的镜头光晕。场景包含一个紧的中景镜头：女性以高速功夫掌击猛击雇佣兵胸部，将其击飞穿过玻璃咖啡桌，同时镜头剧烈摇晃。场景以低角度广角镜头结束：女性站在躺在废墟中的败北雇佣兵上方，摄像机低置于地面，呈现出沉重不稳的手持‘呼吸’式晃动。

en.p:
A woman in her late 20s, athletic build, dark braided hair whipping behind her, wearing a black tactical wetsuit with reflective cyan seams, pilots a high-speed racing boat through the dense harbor of Hong Kong at night — neon skyscrapers reflecting across the water surface.

At the 2-second mark a cargo ship suddenly shifts position ahead, blocking the waterway — the pilot accelerates directly toward a rising wave forming along the hull.

The boat launches off the wave ramp, airborne above the harbor as water spray explodes outward, neon reflections shimmering across the underside.

Camera from a rooftop captures the boat mid-flight against the skyline grid.

She lands hard onto a floating dock, the structure bending under impact, then accelerates across it and launches again toward a narrow canal between buildings.

The boat skims through the canal, narrowly avoiding walls as sparks and water spray collide.

Final beat: she bursts back into open water as a police boat enters pursuit behind.

Hong Kong neon harbor, wave-launch stunt, dock landing, canal high-speed threading, cinematic water reflections, 4K.

zh.p: 一位二十多岁末期的女性，体格健硕，深色辫子在身后飞扬，身穿带有反光青色接缝的黑色战术潜水服，驾驶着一艘高速赛艇，在夜晚穿越香港密集的港口——霓虹灯映照的摩天大楼倒映在水面上。在第2秒时，一艘货船突然在前方改变位置，挡住了水道——她直接加速冲向船体旁形成的一道涌浪。赛艇从浪坡上腾空而起，飞越港口上空，水花四溅，霓虹灯光在船底闪烁。从屋顶的摄像机视角捕捉到赛艇在摩天大楼天际线网格背景下的空中姿态。她重重地降落在一个浮动码头上，结构在冲击下弯曲，随后加速穿过码头，再次腾空冲向建筑间的一条狭窄水道。赛艇在水道中疾驰，紧贴墙壁掠过，火花与水花交织。最后一幕：她冲回开阔水域，一艘警船紧随其后展开追逐。香港霓虹港口、浪坡特技、码头降落、水道高速穿梭、电影般的水面反射，4K画质。
