en.p: SUBJECTS / PEOPLEMale protagonist, in his 30s, cold and tough, short hair, sharp facial features, wearing a well-fitted black suit, black shirt, and black tie. The outfit remains consistent throughout the entire video. His movements are steady, precise, and highly professional. He has extremely strong body control, with short and steady steps. In close combat, his movements are like a highly trained tactical fighter: turning, gun-suppression, elbow strikes, deflecting force, and repositioning—all executed smoothly in one breath. The enemies are a group of adult male thugs, wearing a mix of dark street clothes or suits, with clear primary and secondary roles. They are responsible for rushing out from all sides and approaching in turns, without stealing the visual focus from the protagonist. The male lead is always the center of the frame, and all actions revolve around him. His performance exudes a calm, ruthless aura with no wasted movements. OBJECTSA black tactical pistol. It is always the same gun—no morphing, no disappearing, and no second gun ever appears. Enemies can approach with melee weapons or bare-handed, but there should be no exaggerated weapon stacking and no heavy firearms. Knocked-down enemies can gradually appear on the ground, but the change in numbers must be logical; all fallen individuals come from the same group that rushed out earlier. The male lead's gun is always clearly visible. During close combat, the gun remains in his hand or pressed near his body line; it should never suddenly disappear. No extra weapons, no duplicate hero, no duplicated enemies, same pistol throughout the full shot sequence. ENVIRONMENTAn indoor hall at night or an underground club corridor. The space is wide but oppressive, with a black and gold color palette. The floor is slightly reflective. The background features pillars, dark walls, localized warm lights, and cold rim lighting. The foreground of the scene leaves room for the protagonist's actions, the midground shows constantly approaching enemies, and the background reveals more silhouettes rushing out from the shadows. Lighting shines down from above and from the side/rear, creating strong contrasting silhouettes, ensuring the male lead's suit, pistol, and body turns are clearly visible. Environmental elements remain consistent throughout the video. Do not cut to unrelated spaces, and do not suddenly change to a street or rooftop. MOODHigh-pressure, cold-blooded, explosive. It is not an out-of-control brawl, but a precise, slaughterhouse-style suppression. The pacing gets increasingly fierce, but remains legible at all times. Emotionally, it must deliver the oppressive thrill of facing a multi-person siege alone, yet completely controlling the situation. CAMERA LANGUAGEThird-person cinematic camera, mainly using medium-close shots and tight wide shots, interspersed with a few close-ups to emphasize the moment of takedowns. The camera overall uses a stabilizer follow-shot + a slight handheld impact feel. Cut as little as possible, prioritizing continuous panning, pushing forward, and orbital tracking shots to reinforce the illusion of a one-take. The camera always revolves around the male lead. It never loses track of the main gun, never loses the protagonist's body orientation, and never lets enemies completely block the frame. Every takedown action must be clearly seen: who rushes up, how the male lead makes contact, how he switches fire, how the enemy falls, and where the camera finally rests. CONSISTENCY RULESThe male lead's clothing, hairstyle, and body shape remain unchanged throughout. There is always only the same male lead; no stunt double faces, no duplicate protagonists. There is always only the same black pistol. The enemies come from the same group that rushed out; the decreasing number is logical, and they do not suddenly respawn. Every takedown must clearly show the contact, counterattack, and the resulting fall. No chaotic blind firing, no floating movements, no supernatural abilities. The male lead consistently maintains a professional, calm, and precise rhythm. The ending must be a final display shot of the male lead standing steadily, surrounded by fallen enemies, with his gun muzzle pointing down or resting at his side. TIMELINE 0:00–0:02A tight medium shot starts from behind the male lead's side, and the camera slowly pushes forward. The male lead stands in the center of the hall, slightly turned, shoulder line tense, holding the same black pistol, his gaze locked on the shadows ahead. In the background, several enemies suddenly rush out from both sides and directly in front, their footsteps syncing with heavy drumbeats. The camera stops at a position where both the male lead's half-profile and the incoming crowd ahead are clearly visible simultaneously; the crisis has formed. 0:02–0:05The camera quickly pushes in to a medium-close shot. The first enemy lunges forward into close-combat distance. The male lead side-steps to dodge the trajectory, raises his hand to press down on the enemy's shoulder/neck, uses the pistol to maintain close-line control, and executes a clean, sharp close-range counterattack. The first person immediately loses balance and smashes into the ground. At almost the same rhythm, the male lead uses the momentum to turn around. A second enemy rushes in from the side; he uses an elbow strike and the gun body to create space, then follows up with an extremely short finishing move, flipping the second person right at his feet. The camera follows the male lead's turn with a slight pan, finally resting on a state where two enemies are already down, and a third is about to enter the frame. 0:05–0:08The camera slightly orbits to the male lead's front, maintaining a medium shot so his full body actions are legible. The third and fourth enemies approach one after the other. The male lead first steps forward, uses a close-quarters block to interrupt the former's action, then immediately switches fire to handle the latter. The movements are like a compressed spring instantly releasing—clean, fast, with no extra swaying. The former staggers back after being interrupted, while the latter is directly taken down. The camera stabilizes as the male lead returns to a neutral posture, clearly showing multiple people already fallen around him. 0:08–0:11The camera slightly pulls back to a wider medium shot, showing the spatial relationship. ### 文本翻译开始 ###
**主题/人物**
男主角，30多岁，冷酷强悍，短发，面部轮廓分明，身穿剪裁得体的黑色西装、黑衬衫和黑领带。整段视频中服装保持一致。他的动作沉稳、精准且极为专业。身体控制力极强，步伐短促而稳健。近身格斗时，动作如同训练有素的战术斗士：转身、枪械压制、肘击、卸力、重新站位——所有动作一气呵成，流畅连贯。敌人是一群成年男性暴徒，穿着混杂的深色街头服装或西装，主次分明。他们负责从四面八方冲出并轮流逼近，不会抢夺男主角的视觉焦点。男主角始终是画面的中心，所有动作都围绕他展开。他的表演散发出冷静、冷酷的气场，没有多余的动作。

**物品**
一把黑色战术手枪。始终是同一把枪——没有变形，没有消失，也从未出现第二把枪。敌人可以手持近战武器或徒手逼近，但不应有夸张的武器堆叠，也不应有重型枪械。被击倒的敌人可以逐渐出现在地面上，但人数变化必须合乎逻辑；所有倒下的人都来自之前冲出的同一批人。男主角的枪始终清晰可见。近身格斗时，枪始终握在他手中或紧贴身体线条；绝不应突然消失。没有额外武器，没有替身主角，没有重复的敌人，整个镜头序列中始终是同一把手枪。

**环境**
夜晚的室内大厅或地下俱乐部走廊。空间宽阔但压抑，色调为黑金色。地板略带反光。背景有柱子、深色墙壁、局部暖光和冷色轮廓光。场景前景为男主角的动作留出空间，中景是不断逼近的敌人，背景则显示出更多从阴影中冲出的身影。灯光从上方和侧面/后方照射下来，形成强烈的对比轮廓，确保男主角的西装、手枪和身体转向清晰可见。环境元素在整段视频中保持一致。不要切换到无关的空间，也不要突然变成街道或屋顶。

**氛围**
高压、冷血、爆发力强。这不是失控的混战，而是精准、屠宰场式的压制。节奏越来越激烈，但始终清晰可辨。情感上，必须传达出独自面对多人围攻却完全掌控局面的压迫感。

**镜头语言**
第三人称电影镜头，主要使用中近景和紧凑的全景，穿插少量特写以强调击倒瞬间。镜头整体采用稳定器跟拍+轻微手持冲击感。尽可能少剪辑，优先使用连续摇摄、推进和轨道跟踪镜头，以强化一镜到底的错觉。镜头始终围绕男主角旋转。绝不丢失主枪的视野，绝不丢失主角的身体朝向，绝不让敌人完全遮挡画面。每一个击倒动作都必须清晰可见：谁冲上来，男主角如何接触，如何切换火力，敌人如何倒下，以及镜头最终停留在何处。

**一致性规则**
男主角的服装、发型和体型始终保持不变。始终只有同一个男主角；没有替身面孔，没有重复的主角。始终只有同一把黑色手枪。敌人来自同一批冲出的人；人数减少合乎逻辑，他们不会突然重生。每一次击倒都必须清晰展示接触、反击和倒地的过程。没有混乱的盲目射击，没有漂浮的动作，没有超自然能力。男主角始终保持专业、冷静、精准的节奏。结局必须是男主角稳稳站立，周围是倒下的敌人，枪口朝下或垂在身侧的最终展示镜头。

**时间线**
**0:00–0:02**：一个紧凑的中景镜头从男主角身侧后方开始，摄像机缓慢推进。男主角站在大厅中央，微微侧身，肩线紧绷，握着同一把黑色手枪，目光锁定前方的阴影。背景中，几名敌人突然从两侧和正前方冲出，脚步声与沉重的鼓点同步。摄像机停在能同时清晰看到男主角半侧脸和前方逼近人群的位置；危机已经形成。

**0:02–0:05**：摄像机快速推进到中近景。第一个敌人猛冲进入近战距离。男主角侧步闪避其轨迹，抬手压住敌人的肩膀/颈部，用手枪保持近距离控制，并执行干净利落的近距离反击。第一个人立即失去平衡，摔倒在地。几乎在同一节奏下，男主角借势转身。第二个敌人从侧面冲来；他用肘击和枪身拉开空间，随后以极短的终结动作将第二个人掀翻在脚边。摄像机跟随男主角的转身轻微摇摄，最终停留在两名敌人已经倒地，第三名即将进入画面的状态。

**0:05–0:08**：摄像机略微环绕到男主角前方，保持中景，使其全身动作清晰可辨。第三和第四名敌人相继逼近。男主角先迈步上前，用近距离格挡打断前者的动作，然后立即切换火力对付后者。动作如同压缩的弹簧瞬间释放——干净、快速，没有多余的晃动。前者被格挡后踉跄后退，后者则被直接击倒。男主角立即转身对前者进行最后的压制，完成连续双杀。摄像机在男主角恢复中立姿态时稳定下来，清晰显示他周围已有数人倒地。

**0:08–0:11**：摄像机略微拉远至更宽的中景，展示空间关系。剩余几名敌人同时从左右两侧逼近。男主角没有后退，而是切入敌人最集中的一侧，用极其短促的步法不断变换位置，将敌人逐一拉入他的近战节奏。他先控制最近的人作为短暂盾牌，然后迅速从盾牌边缘旋出，连续击倒两人。最后一人试图从背后猛扑，但被男主角转身精准拦截并摔倒在地。摄像机在他切入和转身时做出一个干净的弧线运动，结束于男主角重新站回中心，最后一名仍在移动的敌人踉跄后退的瞬间。

**0:11–0:13**：快速推进到特写镜头，聚焦最终对决。最后一名敌人咆哮着正面冲锋。男主角眼神冷静，身体微沉，等待对手进入范围后瞬间出击，用最凌厉的一套近距离枪斗术将其击倒。这个动作必须完全可见：接触、控制、反击和倒地，一气呵成。摄像机在敌人重重落地时轻微晃动，然后迅速稳定，清晰显示男主角依然站立。

**0:13–0:15**：摄像机缓慢

en.p:
Character & Setup
Full-body based on reference image (upper-body reference), with face, hairstyle, and features matched exactly. She wears a hat. Expression is tense and restrained, slightly painful, with a faint frown—carrying a strong sense of despair and intensity in his eyes.

Clothing: Dark grey coat, dark inner layer, no belt, wearing heavy black-tech gauntlets.

Environment: Apocalyptic wasteland, grey-blue sky, strong winds, smoke and debris in the air. Meteors streak across the sky with faint flames and trails of smoke.

⸻

Visual Style

IMAX film look with a 35mm Panavision lens.

Low-saturation grey tones, compressed shadows with preserved detail, subtle film grain and edge vignetting.

Heavy, oppressive atmosphere with realistic lighting and physical presence.

⸻

Camera Rules

One continuous handheld shot with subtle breathing motion.

Starts from a low-angle upward shot, focusing on the face and upper body, slowly circling to a frontal view during transformation. The weapon in his hand remains the visual anchor.

⸻

0–3s · Stare

The injured protagonist stands still, slightly lowering his head. Her body is tense.

She slowly raises his right arm forward, stiff and heavy.

A dim glow surrounds the gauntlet. Her breathing subtly moves her body.

Suddenly, her eyes ignite with purple-white light, creating strong lens flares.

⸻

3–6s · Activation

A deep whisper: “Transform!”

She snaps his right hand sharply.

Purple crystal-like electricity bursts from her arm. The air compresses inward, distorting space.

A circular shockwave expands around her. Strange glowing blue runic lines appear and orbit his body.

⸻

6–9s · Tearing

Dark gold cracks erupt from her chest. Thick golden liquid flows like blood.

Blue mist and fine electric arcs surge outward.

Her coat tears apart from the inside, edges burning into ash.

Fragments of organic armor burst outward, then unnaturally retract and reattach.

Her face tightens in pain as glowing blue markings spread symmetrically. A small tear opens on his cheek, revealing pulsing orange light beneath.

⸻

9–12s · Growth

New organic matter seeps from within, shimmering with iridescent light and moving toward the chest.

White armor plates collide and fuse, leaving scorched marks.

The chest core flickers like embers, not fully stabilized.

Her outer clothing is violently stripped away.

Purple-black metal spreads across her face, forming an uneven mask.

Compound eyes begin forming, flickering irregularly.

⸻

12–15s · Completion

The helmet seals fully. Horn-like structures grow upward, burning with purple-gold flames.

One eye glows steadily while the other flickers with electrical instability.

Armor is uneven and battle-damaged, with glowing cracks and leaking fluid.

The camera slowly circles to her right, then pulls back from above.

She shifts into a ready combat stance, standing against the harsh environment.

zh.p: 角色与设定 全身基于参考图像（上半身参考），面部、发型及特征完全匹配。她戴着一顶帽子。表情紧张而克制，略带痛苦，眉头微蹙——眼神中透出强烈的绝望与锐利。服装：深灰色大衣，深色内搭，无腰带，佩戴重型黑科技护手。环境：末日废土，灰蓝色天空，狂风呼啸，空气中弥漫着烟雾与碎片。流星划过天际，带着微弱的火焰与烟迹。⸻ 视觉风格 IMAX电影质感，搭配35毫米潘那维申镜头。低饱和度灰色调，压缩阴影保留细节，微妙的胶片颗粒与边缘暗角。沉重压抑的氛围，写实的光影与实体感。⸻ 镜头规则 单一手持长镜头，带有微弱的呼吸感。从低角度仰拍开始，聚焦面部与上半身，在变身过程中缓慢环绕至正面视角。他手中的武器始终作为视觉锚点。⸻ 0–3秒 · 凝视 受伤的主角静立不动，微微低头。她身体紧绷。她缓缓抬起右臂向前，动作僵硬而沉重。护手周围泛起微光。她的呼吸带动身体微微起伏。突然，她的双眼燃起紫白色光芒，产生强烈的镜头光晕。⸻ 3–6秒 · 激活 低沉低语：“变身！”她猛地握紧右手。紫色水晶般的电流从手臂迸发。空气向内压缩，空间扭曲。一道环形冲击波在她周围扩散。奇异的蓝色发光符文线条出现并环绕她的身体。⸻ 6–9秒 · 撕裂 暗金色裂纹从她胸口绽开。浓稠的金色液体如血液般流淌。蓝色雾气与细微电弧向外喷涌。她的大衣从内部撕裂，边缘燃烧成灰烬。有机装甲碎片向外爆裂，随后异常地收缩并重新附着。她的脸因痛苦而紧绷，蓝色发光纹路对称蔓延。她脸颊上裂开一道小口，露出下方脉动的橙色光芒。⸻ 9–12秒 · 生长 新的有机物质从内部渗出，闪烁着虹彩光泽，向胸口移动。白色装甲板碰撞融合，留下焦灼痕迹。胸口核心如余烬般闪烁，尚未完全稳定。她的外衣被猛烈剥离。紫黑色金属覆盖她的面部，形成不规则的假面。复眼开始成形，不规则地闪烁。⸻ 12–15秒 · 完成 头盔完全闭合。角状结构向上生长，燃烧着紫金色火焰。一只眼睛稳定发光，另一只则因电流不稳而闪烁。装甲参差不齐，带有战斗损伤，发光的裂缝中渗出液体。镜头缓慢环绕至她的右侧，随后向上拉远。她转入战斗姿态，在严酷环境中屹立。

IMAX film look with a 35mm Panavision lens.

One continuous handheld shot with subtle breathing motion.

White armor plates collide and fuse, leaving scorched marks.

Her outer clothing is violently stripped away.

Purple-black metal spreads across her face, forming an uneven mask.

Compound eyes begin forming, flickering irregularly.

The helmet seals fully. Horn-like structures grow upward, burning with purple-gold flames.

One eye glows steadily while the other flickers with electrical instability.

Armor is uneven and battle-damaged, with glowing cracks and leaking fluid.

en.p: SUBJECTS: Subject 1: A frantic barista — small, wiry, early 30s with permanently startled eyes and perpetual five o'clock shadow. Wild curly black hair barely contained under a brown newsboy cap. Wears a wrinkled olive-green apron over a flannel shirt with haphazardly rolled sleeves. Moves like a pinball — bouncing between stations, sliding across the floor, catching things mid-air without looking. Every movement triggers the next part of the machine. His body IS part of the mechanism. Pixar-style 3D rendering: rubbery expressive limbs, exaggerated squash-and-stretch on fast movements, warm skin tones. Subject 2: The café itself — every object is a component of one interconnected Rube Goldberg machine. The espresso machine is the central engine. The sequence involves: a marble track built from bent spoons along the ceiling, balanced cups on saucers that tip like dominoes, a hanging mobile of sugar cubes acting as a counterweight system, a toy train on a track delivering milk from the fridge to the steamer, and a small catapult made from a ruler and napkin holder that launches the finished cup to the counter. Subject 3: The customer — a deadpan woman in a business suit, briefcase in hand, reading glasses on a chain. Completely unfazed by the chaos. She stands at the counter with the patience of someone who has seen this before. ENVIRONMENT: A tiny corner café — barely ten feet wide. Exposed brick walls covered in chalkboard menus with hand-drawn coffee illustrations. Every horizontal surface has a mechanical element: marble tracks on shelves, cup-and-saucer balance chains along the counter, tiny pulleys strung from the ceiling with twine. Warm morning light streams through a single front window catching dust and steam. A small bell hangs above the door. The whole space feels like a brilliant inventor's workshop that serves coffee. MOOD: Manic joy. The barista is in his element — the chaos is intentional, practiced, musical. Every crash, pour, and launch is precisely timed. The punchline deflates the entire spectacle in the best possible way. TIMELINE: 0:00–0:03: The door opens — bell dings. The customer places her briefcase on the counter. Says nothing. The barista points at her, nods — he knows the order. He flicks a marble from his apron pocket onto a ceiling track. The marble rolls — clicking over ridges, banking around a curve, dropping through a funnel into a cup on a saucer on a high shelf. The cup's weight tips the saucer, pulls a string, releases a cabinet latch — coffee beans slide down a ramp into a hand-crank grinder. Audible: bell ding, marble clicking on track, cup clinking, string twang, beans cascading. 0:03–0:06: The barista cranks the grinder with one hand while pulling a lever starting the toy train. The train chugs along a counter-edge track — passes the fridge where a small arm places a milk carton in the car — continues to the steam wand where the track tilts and pours milk into a steaming pitcher. Ground coffee falls through a chute into the portafilter. The barista slams it in with his elbow while catching a falling sugar cube from the overhead mobile with his other hand, dropping it into a cup. Audible: grinder crunching, train chugging and whistling, milk pouring, portafilter clicking, mobile tinkling. 0:06–0:09: Espresso machine fires — rich dark coffee flowing into a porcelain cup. Close-up: crema forming, thick and golden-red, swirling. The barista steams milk — pitcher vibrating, velvety microfoam building. He pours with a practiced wrist flick — a perfect rosetta latte art pattern forms. He tops it with a single coffee bean placed dead center. Camera lingers on the completed drink — perfect, beautiful. Audible: espresso hissing, milk steaming (tearing-paper sound), the gentle pour, the bean placed with a tiny tap. 0:09–0:12: The delivery. The barista places the cup on the ruler catapult and slams his palm down. The cup launches in a perfect arc — camera follows in slow motion as it rotates, latte art intact, not a drop spilled. It lands with a clean clink on a saucer directly before the customer. Steam rises in a perfect spiral. The barista slides into frame behind the counter, slightly breathless, fingers pointing at the drink with showman's pride. Audible: catapult snap, cup whistling through air, clean landing clink, a beat of silence. 0:12–0:15: The customer adjusts her reading glasses. Looks at the latte art. Looks at the barista. "Actually — can I get tea?" The barista's face falls — completely deflated. Shoulders drop. Cap slides askew. A long beat. Then his eyes snap back to life. He pulls out a different marble — a green one — and flicks it onto a completely different track on the opposite wall. The entire café begins moving again — a whole new sequence activating. The customer takes a seat. She's done this before. Cut to black. Audible: her flat delivery, the defeated exhale, then the green marble clicking onto the track and the café machine roaring back to life.

zh.p: 主题：主题一：一位手忙脚乱的咖啡师——身材瘦小精干，三十出头，永远瞪着一双受惊的眼睛，胡茬永远刮不干净。一头狂野的黑色卷发勉强塞在棕色报童帽下。法兰绒衬衫外系着皱巴巴的橄榄绿围裙，袖子随意卷起。他像弹球一样移动——在各个工位间弹跳，在地板上滑行，头也不抬就能凌空接住东西。每个动作都会触发机器的下一环节。他的身体本身就是机械装置的一部分。皮克斯风格3D渲染：橡胶般富有表现力的四肢，快速动作时夸张的拉伸与挤压，暖色调肤色。主题二：咖啡馆本身——每件物品都是环环相扣的鲁布·戈德堡机械的一个部件。意式浓缩咖啡机是核心引擎。整个序列包括：用弯曲的勺子在天花板上搭建的大理石轨道，像多米诺骨牌一样倾斜的杯碟平衡装置，充当配重系统的方糖悬挂风铃，沿着轨道运送牛奶从冰箱到蒸汽棒的玩具火车，以及用尺子和餐巾架做成的小型弹射器，将成品咖啡弹射到吧台上。主题三：顾客——一位面无表情的女士，身穿商务套装，手提公文包，挂着链子的老花镜。她对眼前的混乱完全无动于衷。她站在吧台前，耐心得像个见过世面的人。环境：一家小小的街角咖啡馆——宽度不足十英尺。裸露的砖墙上挂满了黑板菜单，上面画着手绘咖啡插图。每个水平面上都有机械元素：架子上的大理石轨道，吧台上的杯碟平衡链，天花板上用细绳悬挂的小滑轮。温暖的晨光透过唯一的临街窗户洒进来，捕捉着尘埃和蒸汽。门上方挂着一只小铃铛。整个空间感觉像是一位天才发明家的工作室，顺便卖咖啡。氛围：狂热的快乐。咖啡师如鱼得水——混乱是有意为之、经过练习、富有节奏的。每一次碰撞、倾倒和弹射都精准卡点。最后的包袱以最妙的方式戳破了整个盛大的场面。时间线：0:00–0:03：门开了——铃铛叮当作响。顾客把公文包放在吧台上。一言不发。咖啡师指了指她，点了点头——他知道她要什么。他从围裙口袋里弹出一颗弹珠，弹到天花板轨道上。弹珠滚动着——咔嗒咔嗒地越过凸起，绕过弯道，掉进一个漏斗，落入高架上一个碟子里的杯子中。杯子的重量压翻了碟子，拉动一根绳子，松开了一个柜门锁扣——咖啡豆沿着斜坡滑进手摇研磨机。声音：铃铛叮当声，弹珠在轨道上的咔嗒声，杯子碰撞声，绳子绷紧声，豆子倾泻声。0:03–0:06：咖啡师一只手摇动研磨机，同时拉动杠杆启动玩具火车。火车沿着吧台边缘的轨道突突前进——经过冰箱时，一只小机械臂将一盒牛奶放进车厢——继续驶向蒸汽棒，轨道在那里倾斜，将牛奶倒入蒸汽壶。研磨好的咖啡粉通过滑槽落入手柄。咖啡师用肘部将其压紧，同时另一只手接住从头顶风铃上掉下的一块方糖，丢进杯子里。声音：研磨机的碾压声，火车的突突声和汽笛声，牛奶倾倒声，手柄卡入声，风铃叮当声。0:06–0:09：意式浓缩咖啡机启动——深色浓郁的咖啡流入瓷杯。特写：油脂形成，浓稠的金红色，旋转着。咖啡师蒸牛奶——奶壶震动，丝滑的微奶泡逐渐形成。他熟练地抖动手腕倾倒——完美的罗塞塔拉花图案显现。他在正中央放上一颗咖啡豆作为点缀。镜头停留在成品上——完美，美丽。声音：意式浓缩咖啡的嘶嘶声，牛奶蒸煮声（撕裂纸张般的声音），轻柔的倾倒声，咖啡豆落下时轻微的咔嗒声。0:09–0:12：交付。咖啡师将杯子放在尺子弹射器上，手掌猛地一拍。杯子划出一道完美的弧线——镜头慢动作跟随，杯子旋转着，拉花完好无损，一滴未洒。它清脆地落在顾客面前的碟子上。蒸汽呈完美的螺旋状升起。咖啡师滑入吧台后的画面，微微喘息，手指指向饮品，带着表演者的骄傲。声音：弹射器的啪嗒声，杯子在空中飞过的呼啸声，干净利落的落杯声，片刻的寂静。0:12–0:15：顾客调整了一下老花镜。看了看拉花。又看了看咖啡师。“其实——我能换成茶吗？”咖啡师的脸垮了下来——彻底泄了气。肩膀耷拉下来。帽子歪向一边。长长的停顿。然后他的眼睛重新亮了起来。他掏出另一颗弹珠——绿色的——弹到对面墙上一条完全不同的轨道上。整个咖啡馆再次运转起来——全新的序列被激活。顾客坐了下来。她以前就这么干过。画面切黑。声音：她平淡的语调，泄气的呼气声，然后绿色弹珠在轨道上的咔嗒声，以及咖啡馆机器重新轰鸣起来的声音。

raw_p: SUBJECTS: Subject 1: A frantic barista — small, wiry, early 30s with permanently startled eyes and perpetual five o'clock shadow. Wild curly black hair barely contained under a brown newsboy cap. Wears a wrinkled olive-green apron over a flannel shirt with haphazardly rolled sleeves. Moves like a pinball — bouncing between stations, sliding across the floor, catching things mid-air without looking. Every movement triggers the next part of the machine. His body IS part of the mechanism. Pixar-style 3D rendering: rubbery expressive limbs, exaggerated squash-and-stretch on fast movements, warm skin tones. Subject 2: The café itself — every object is a component of one interconnected Rube Goldberg machine. The espresso machine is the central engine. The sequence involves: a marble track built from bent spoons along the ceiling, balanced cups on saucers that tip like dominoes, a hanging mobile of sugar cubes acting as a counterweight system, a toy train on a track delivering milk from the fridge to the steamer, and a small catapult made from a ruler and napkin holder that launches the finished cup to the counter. Subject 3: The customer — a deadpan woman in a business suit, briefcase in hand, reading glasses on a chain. Completely unfazed by the chaos. She stands at the counter with the patience of someone who has seen this before. ENVIRONMENT: A tiny corner café — barely ten feet wide. Exposed brick walls covered in chalkboard menus with hand-drawn coffee illustrations. Every horizontal surface has a mechanical element: marble tracks on shelves, cup-and-saucer balance chains along the counter, tiny pulleys strung from the ceiling with twine. Warm morning light streams through a single front window catching dust and steam. A small bell hangs above the door. The whole space feels like a brilliant inventor's workshop that serves coffee. MOOD: Manic joy. The barista is in his element — the chaos is intentional, practiced, musical. Every crash, pour, and launch is precisely timed. The punchline deflates the entire spectacle in the best possible way. TIMELINE: 0:00–0:03: The door opens — bell dings. The customer places her briefcase on the counter. Says nothing. The barista points at her, nods — he knows the order. He flicks a marble from his apron pocket onto a ceiling track. The marble rolls — clicking over ridges, banking around a curve, dropping through a funnel into a cup on a saucer on a high shelf. The cup's weight tips the saucer, pulls a string, releases a cabinet latch — coffee beans slide down a ramp into a hand-crank grinder. Audible: bell ding, marble clicking on track, cup clinking, string twang, beans cascading. 0:03–0:06: The barista cranks the grinder with one hand while pulling a lever starting the toy train. The train chugs along a counter-edge track — passes the fridge where a small arm places a milk carton in the car — continues to the steam wand where the track tilts and pours milk into a steaming pitcher. Ground coffee falls through a chute into the portafilter. The barista slams it in with his elbow while catching a falling sugar cube from the overhead mobile with his other hand, dropping it into a cup. Audible: grinder crunching, train chugging and whistling, milk pouring, portafilter clicking, mobile tinkling. 0:06–0:09: Espresso machine fires — rich dark coffee flowing into a porcelain cup. Close-up: crema forming, thick and golden-red, swirling. The barista steams milk — pitcher vibrating, velvety microfoam building. He pours with a practiced wrist flick — a perfect rosetta latte art pattern forms. He tops it with a single coffee bean placed dead center. Camera lingers on the completed drink — perfect, beautiful. Audible: espresso hissing, milk steaming (tearing-paper sound), the gentle pour, the bean placed with a tiny tap. 0:09–0:12: The delivery. The barista places the cup on the ruler catapult and slams his palm down. The cup launches in a perfect arc — camera follows in slow motion as it rotates, latte art intact, not a drop spilled. It lands with a clean clink on a saucer directly before the customer. Steam rises in a perfect spiral. The barista slides into frame behind the counter, slightly breathless, fingers pointing at the drink with showman's pride. Audible: catapult snap, cup whistling through air, clean landing clink, a beat of silence. 0:12–0:15: The customer adjusts her reading glasses. Looks at the latte art. Looks at the barista. "Actually — can I get tea?" The barista's face falls — completely deflated. Shoulders drop. Cap slides askew. A long beat. Then his eyes snap back to life. He pulls out a different marble — a green one — and flicks it onto a completely different track on the opposite wall. The entire café begins moving again — a whole new sequence activating. The customer takes a seat. She's done this before. Cut to black. Audible: her flat delivery, the defeated exhale, then the green marble clicking onto the track and the café machine roaring back to life.

en.p: Side angle cinematic shot. A massive ancient stone door grinds downward rapidly, rumbling and scraping stone-on-stone. At the last possible second, a figure in silhouette — leather jacket, hat brim — drops and slides along the dusty floor underneath the closing gap, barely making it through. The stone door SLAMS shut with a thunderous boom that shakes the frame. Dust explosion. The figure rolls, comes up onto one knee, breathing hard. Torch flames on the wall whip violently from the shockwave then settle. Silence except for settling dust and heavy breathing. The figure is backlit, silhouette only — no face visible. The rumbling is now muffled behind the sealed door. Deep cinematic sound design — stone grinding, the massive slam reverberating, then sudden quiet. Warm torchlight, deep shadow, film grain. Cinematic adventure, Indiana Jones tone.

zh.p: 侧面电影感镜头。一扇巨大的古老石门急速向下砸落，发出隆隆的石头摩擦声。在最后一刻，一个剪影般的身影——皮夹克、帽檐——俯身滑过尘土飞扬的地面，从即将闭合的门缝中勉强钻过。石门轰然关闭，发出雷鸣般的巨响，震得画面都在颤抖。尘土飞扬。那身影翻滚起身，单膝跪地，急促喘息。墙壁上的火炬火焰因冲击波猛烈摇曳，随后恢复平静。除了尘埃落定和沉重的呼吸声，四周一片寂静。身影背光而立，仅见轮廓——看不清面容。石门后的隆隆声变得沉闷。深邃的电影级音效设计——石头摩擦声、巨门关闭的轰鸣回荡，随后骤然寂静。温暖的炬光、深邃的阴影、胶片颗粒感。电影冒险风格，印第安纳·琼斯式的基调。

en.p: Cinematic VFX sci-fi transformation shot on Arri Alexa Mini LF with a low-angle steady-cam orbit. The scene features a rugged American soldier standing in a dusty desert hangar; as he activates a wrist-mounted neural trigger, heavy matte-black industrial armor plates and hydraulic pistons surge upward from his boots, encasing his body in a militaristic mecha frame. The camera circles closely as copper wires and steel framework interlock with violent precision, capturing his grimace of physical strain. The process accelerates with high-pressure steam venting from shoulder joints as a bulky chest plate slams shut. The transformation concludes with a heavy metallic resonance as a reinforced tactical helmet locks into place. The atmosphere is gritty and visceral, driven by a rhythmic crescendo of clanking metal and pressurized air, ending in a powerful, grounded stance.

zh.p: 使用Arri Alexa Mini LF拍摄的电影级科幻变身特效，采用低角度稳定器环绕运镜。场景中，一名粗犷的美国士兵站在尘土飞扬的沙漠机库里；当他激活手腕上的神经触发器时，厚重的哑光黑色工业装甲板和液压活塞从靴子处向上涌起，将他的身体包裹在军事化机甲框架中。镜头紧密环绕，铜线与钢架以暴烈的精准度相互咬合，捕捉到他因身体承受压力而扭曲的表情。随着厚重的胸甲砰然闭合，肩关节处喷出高压蒸汽，变身过程加速推进。最后，强化战术头盔锁定就位时发出沉重的金属共鸣声。整个氛围粗粝而充满实感，伴随着金属碰撞声和加压空气的节奏性渐强，最终以充满力量感的稳固姿态收尾。

As it rises, the outer casing smoothly peels away and separates into multiple floating panels, revealing the intricate internal circuitry and components in an "exploded view" style. The movement is slow, fluid, and weightless, with the pieces maintaining a symmetrical arrangement. The background and warm golden lighting remain consistent throughout the transformation. Smooth transition, technical animation style, maintaining high-detail textures and cinematic quality.

en.p: Use Image 1 as the first frame, referencing the character design, outfit color palette, and overall visual style of Image 1. The girl is performing a high-speed downhill skateboard ride on a winding suburban mountain road. The shot uses a Steadicam follow perspective, with an intense sense of speed throughout. The powerful wind generated by the fast ride makes her hair and clothing whip violently in the air. At the beginning, the girl pushes off with one foot to gain speed, then lowers her body to reduce wind resistance and continues accelerating. The scene features heavy motion blur to emphasize the extreme speed of the skateboard. While riding, she repeatedly shifts her center of gravity downward and leans left and right through multiple turns on the road. As she carves into the corners, the arm on the inside of the turn lowers as if lightly trying to touch the ground. On straight sections, she bends forward, keeps her knees low, and places both hands behind her back to minimize drag. In the distance, fireworks are going off above a seaside town, while a passenger airplane flies across the sky. The overall visual style should be ultra-realistic, with highly lifelike image quality and realistic photographic cinematography. No background music, only environmental sound design.

zh.p: 以图像1作为第一帧，参考其角色设计、服装配色及整体视觉风格。女孩在蜿蜒的郊区山路上进行高速下坡滑板骑行。镜头采用斯坦尼康跟拍视角，全程充满强烈的速度感。高速骑行产生的强风使她的头发和衣物在空中剧烈飘动。开始时，女孩单脚蹬地加速，随后压低身体以减少风阻并持续加速。画面运用大量动态模糊来强调滑板的极致速度。骑行过程中，她反复下压重心，在道路的多个弯道处左右倾斜身体。切入弯道时，内侧手臂放低，仿佛轻轻尝试触碰地面。在直道部分，她前倾身体、压低膝盖，双手置于背后以最小化阻力。远处，海滨小镇上空绽放着烟花，一架客机划过天际。整体视觉风格应为超写实，具备高度逼真的画质和真实的摄影构图。无背景音乐，仅保留环境音效设计。

en.p: Cinematic VFX racing sequence shot on Arri Alexa 35 with anamorphic lenses featuring a low-profile tracking shot following a high-performance race car tearing through a rain-drenched circuit at extreme speeds. As the engine roars, the scene shifts into a hyper-realistic bullet-time sequence where time slows to a crawl, capturing millions of crystalline rain droplets suspended in mid-air around the aerodynamic chassis. The camera orbits the vehicle showing Surface water ripples in slow motion against the tires before time suddenly snaps back to full speed with a thunderous exhaust note as the car vanishes into a misty blur of taillights. The atmosphere is immersive and high-octane, characterized by a rhythmic transition from chaotic motion to frozen elegance, ending with an explosive sense of momentum.

zh.p: 使用Arri Alexa 35搭配变形镜头拍摄的电影级视觉特效赛车片段，以低角度跟拍镜头追踪一辆高性能赛车在暴雨浸透的赛道上极速飞驰。引擎轰鸣之际，画面转入超现实子弹时间特效——时间骤然凝滞，捕捉到数百万颗晶莹雨滴悬浮在空气动力学车身周围。镜头环绕车辆，慢镜头中轮胎激起的水面涟漪清晰可见，随后伴随雷鸣般的排气声浪，时间瞬间恢复全速，赛车化作尾灯朦胧的残影消失。沉浸式高能氛围贯穿始终，从混沌动感到凝固优雅的节奏转换，最终以爆发性的速度感收尾。

en.p:
15-second comedic animated short in the world and visual tone of Zootopia. High-quality stylized 3D animation, expressive facial acting, clean readable slapstick, bright police-station interior, polished reflective floor, warm indoor daylight. Visual comedy only, little or no dialogue.

Judy Hopps: small fast rabbit police officer, blue ZPD uniform, hyper-serious, explosive sprinting, precise slides, determined face, ears reacting sharply.
Nick Wilde: tall slim fox, green shirt and tie, relaxed posture, minimal movement, dry amused expression.
Background: one distant sloth clerk at a far desk only, never entering foreground.

Key object: one single strawberry jelly donut, same donut for the entire clip, falls from Nick’s small brown paper bag, rolls across the floor, gets stopped by Nick, then gets sealed into one clear evidence bag by Judy. No duplicate donuts, no extra props, no continuity errors.

Camera language: third-person cinematic comedy, medium shots, low-angle close tracking on the donut, one side tracking shot, one final tight two-shot. Smooth stabilized movement, tiny comedic whip corrections only when needed. Always keep donut, Judy, and Nick spatially readable.

0:00–0:03
Medium shot, light tracking in ZPD lobby. Judy and Nick walk side by side past the front desk. Judy carries a small clipboard, Nick carries a brown paper bag. One strawberry jelly donut slips out of the bag, drops to the floor, and starts rolling. Judy’s ears snap upright and she locks onto it like a fleeing suspect. Camera dips lower to keep the donut in the foreground.

0:03–0:06
Low close tracking shot on the same donut rolling fast over the shiny floor. Judy bursts into frame from behind, clipboard tucked under one arm, sprinting hard with both paws reaching forward. She almost grabs it but misses by centimeters. The donut keeps rolling. Quick readable camera adjustment, no chaotic motion.

0:06–0:09
Side medium-wide tracking shot. The donut curves around a fixed desk leg. Judy makes an exaggerated quick step and low slide to intercept, but it slips past her again. She pivots and chases immediately. In the background, Nick simply walks on a shorter diagonal path, calm and unhurried. Keep the same donut clearly visible.

0:09–0:12
Frontal medium-close shot. The donut rolls toward camera. Nick’s paw enters calmly from frame right and presses the same donut to a stop. Judy slides in from frame left and freezes with her nose just inches from it, still in full arrest pose. Hold the reaction beat clearly.

0:12–0:15
Tight two-shot. Nick lifts the same donut with two fingers and hands it over with a dry smug grin. Judy instantly switches back to formal police mode, pulls out one clear evidence bag, seals the same donut inside, and proudly presents it to camera like a major arrest. Nick stands beside her with an amused look. In deep background, the sloth clerk slowly raises a stamp. End on a clean comedic freeze frame: evidence bag with the donut

zh.p: 15秒喜剧动画短片，风格与视觉基调参照《疯狂动物城》。高品质风格化3D动画，表情生动，干净利落的滑稽动作，明亮的警局室内场景，抛光反光地板，温暖的室内自然光。纯视觉喜剧，极少或没有对白。朱迪·霍普斯：体型小巧、行动敏捷的兔子警官，蓝色ZPD制服，极度严肃，爆发式冲刺，精准滑步，表情坚定，耳朵反应灵敏。尼克·王尔德：高挑瘦削的狐狸，绿色衬衫配领带，姿态放松，动作幅度极小，表情干练而带嘲弄。背景：远处办公桌后仅有一位树懒职员，始终不进入前景。关键道具：一个草莓果酱甜甜圈，全片仅此一个，从尼克的小棕色纸袋中掉落，滚过地板，被尼克截停，随后被朱迪封入一个透明证物袋。无重复甜甜圈，无多余道具，无连续性错误。镜头语言：第三人称电影喜剧风格，中景，低角度近景跟拍甜甜圈，一次侧面跟拍，最终一个紧凑的双人镜头。稳定平滑的移动，仅在必要时加入微小的喜剧性甩镜。始终确保甜甜圈、朱迪和尼克的空间位置清晰可辨。0:00–0:03 中景，轻微跟拍，ZPD大厅。朱迪和尼克并肩走过前台。朱迪拿着一个小写字板，尼克拎着一个棕色纸袋。一个草莓果酱甜甜圈从袋中滑出，掉到地上并开始滚动。朱迪的耳朵猛地竖起，她像锁定逃犯一样盯住甜甜圈。镜头降低，将甜甜圈置于前景。0:03–0:06 低角度近景跟拍，同一甜甜圈在闪亮地板上快速滚动。朱迪从后方冲入画面，写字板夹在腋下，双爪前伸全力冲刺。她几乎抓住甜甜圈，但差之毫厘。甜甜圈继续滚动。镜头快速但清晰调整，无混乱运动。0:06–0:09 侧面中全景跟拍。甜甜圈绕过一个固定桌腿。朱迪夸张地快速跨步并低姿滑铲拦截，但甜甜圈再次从她身边溜走。她立即转身继续追赶。背景中，尼克只是沿着更短的斜线路径悠然步行，不紧不慢。确保同一甜甜圈清晰可见。0:09–0:12 正面中近景。甜甜圈朝镜头滚来。尼克的爪子从画面右侧从容伸入，将同一甜甜圈按住停下。朱迪从画面左侧滑入，在离甜甜圈仅几英寸处定格，仍保持完全抓捕姿势。清晰保留反应节拍。0:12–0:15 紧凑双人镜头。尼克用两根手指拎起同一甜甜圈，带着干巴巴的得意笑容递过去。朱迪瞬间切换回正式警官模式，掏出一个透明证物袋，将同一甜甜圈封入其中，并像展示重大逮捕成果般骄傲地举向镜头。尼克站在她身旁，表情玩味。深远背景中，树懒职员缓缓举起一枚印章。以干净的喜剧定格画面结束：证物袋中的甜甜圈。

en.p:
Environment:

A surreal ocean in the sky where enormous waves float between cloud layers. Waterfalls spill endlessly downward into the clouds below while golden sunset light illuminates the horizon.

Action:

15.0s sequence. A colossal sky-whale made of shimmering water currents glides through the floating ocean waves. Rising from the clouds below, a massive kraken formed from swirling storm clouds and lightning tendrils attacks.

They collide as the kraken’s tentacles wrap around the whale while both creatures crash through floating waves.

Velocity Ramp choreography: the whale’s massive tail strike slows to reveal suspended droplets and lightning arcs before detonating outward as the motion resumes.

Camera:

Wide aerial tracking shot flying alongside the whale before diving beneath the floating ocean surface as the creatures crash through the water.

Style & Constraints:

Photorealistic water physics, volumetric cloud lighting, ray-traced reflections on wave surfaces, cinematic sunset atmosphere, 8K resolution.

zh.p: 环境：一片超现实的天空海洋，巨大的波浪悬浮在云层之间，瀑布不断向下倾泻，落入下方的云海中，金色的夕阳照亮了地平线。动作：15秒的连续镜头。一头由闪烁水流构成的巨型天空鲸鱼在漂浮的海洋波浪中滑行。从下方云层中升起一只由旋转风暴云和闪电触须组成的巨大海怪发起攻击。两者相撞，海怪的触手缠绕住鲸鱼，同时两个生物冲破漂浮的波浪。速度变化编排：鲸鱼巨大的尾巴打击动作放慢，露出悬浮的水滴和闪电弧，随后随着动作恢复向外爆发。镜头：宽广的空中跟踪镜头，与鲸鱼并排飞行，然后在生物冲破水面时潜入漂浮的海洋表面之下。风格与限制：逼真的水物理效果、体积云光照、波浪表面的光线追踪反射、电影般的日落氛围、8K分辨率。

en.p: Shot 1 (0-3 seconds): The princess throws a tantrum. Scene: Inside an ancient boudoir, a rosewood dressing table. The princess [@Image 2] wears a red wedding dress, a golden phoenix crown, and her long hair is braided into a thick braid hanging over her chest. The princess is beautiful and cute, with furrowed brows, pouting in a tantrum, hands on her hips. Close-up of facial expression, warm candlelight. Dialogue: The princess coquettishly says, 'I don’t want to marry someone I’ve never met!' Shot 2 (3-6 seconds): The princess boards the bridal sedan. Scene: Inside a red festive bridal sedan, the princess [@Image 2] holds a red round fan to cover her face, sitting in the sedan. Red gauze curtains flutter, the princess looks displeased, muttering. Sounds of joyful music come from outside. Dialogue: The princess’s inner monologue: 'Anyway, he’s definitely an ugly monster...' Shot 3 (6-12 seconds): Stunning encounter. Scene: In the hall of an ancient mansion, the princess [@Image 2] slowly descends from the sedan holding a round fan, looks up. The male lead [@Image 1], in a purple-gold cloud-pattern brocade robe, walks out from the backlight, wearing a white gauze outer garment, his hair tied with a gold filigree crown, a ruby sparkling on the crown. He wears a dark purple wide belt, adorned with white jade step ornaments and a jade pendant. The purple-gold robe shimmers in the sunlight, exuding luxury. His ink-black hair flows, peach blossom eyes smile, extraordinarily handsome. Sunlight spills over, as if gilded with a layer of gold. Cinematic lighting, slow motion, robes fluttering, combining ethereal beauty and nobility. Shot 4 (12-15 seconds): The princess swoons. Scene: Close-up of the princess [@Image 2], the round fan drops, pupils dilate, eyes frozen. Her cheeks instantly flush red, lips slightly parted. She bites her lip shyly, fingers twisting the sleeve. The scene fades out with a romantic, soft filter. Dialogue: The princess’s inner monologue: '...So good.'

镜头1（0~3秒）郡主闹脾气 
画面：古代闺房内，红木梳妆台，郡主【@图片2】身穿红色嫁衣，头戴金色凤冠，长发编成粗辫垂胸前。郡主貌美可爱，眉头紧锁，撅嘴闹脾 气，双手叉腰。特写脸部表情，暖色调烛光。 
台词：郡主撒娇道:"我才不要嫁给素昧蒙面的人！" 

镜头2（3~6秒）郡主上花轿 
画面：红色喜庆花轿内景，郡主【@图片2】手持红色团扇遮面，坐在 轿中。红色纱帐飘动，郡主表情不满，嘟囔着。外面喜乐声传来。 
台词：郡主内心OS:"反正肯定是个丑八怪..."

en.p:
Act 1: Disaster film realism style, one continuous shot. The shot begins above the floating capital city in a stormy sky, diving down to the shattered roof of a flooded museum, where a lone cyberpunk heroine stands (Image 1). She spots a rescue flare in the distance and starts running. The camera follows closely, capturing her crossing collapsed roofs, leaping over broken skylights, sliding down a tilted glass dome, and grabbing a dangling cable. Below, dark floodwaters surge through streets filled with floating cars and statues. She lands on a partially submerged tram roof, continues forward, and reaches the rescue beacon platform just as a massive wave crashes behind her. Cold gray-blue apocalyptic tones, hyper-realistic water physics, wind, splashing water, handheld camera urgency, one continuous shot, no cuts. 

Act 2 Transition: Video (Video 1) extended by 10 seconds. Subject: Bionic heroine (Image 1)—white formal suit (soaked through, torn hem), silver mechanical neck guard, silver bionic arm, wet and disheveled black ponytail, gold gear earrings, cinematic realistic facial expression shifting from despair to determination to shock. Scene: A half-flooded rescue beacon platform, raging storm, surging waves, floating cars and debris colliding around the platform, oppressive gray-blue sky, distant capital buildings tilting and sinking in the flood. Action sequence: First, a massive wave crashes over the platform from behind the heroine, water reaching her knees, her white suit violently flapping in the surge, ponytail completely wet and clinging to her face. The heroine’s silver bionic arm plunges into the central console of the platform, precise metallic fingers gripping the red signal button—close-up: the red button emits a faint pulsing light in the gray-blue storm light—the silver arm presses down forcefully, the button hitting bottom with a heavy electrical click, the red signal light suddenly igniting, dyeing the surrounding water into a ring of blood-red ripples. Then, the platform ground begins to tremble, the water rippling outward in circles from the vibration; a vertical crack tears open in the center of the platform, with edges emitting a blend of blazing white and amber energy halos, rapidly expanding into an elliptical spacetime portal about three meters high, arcs of electricity crackling around its edges, the scene inside blurred and distorted—faint warm colors and noisy human voices seeping through the portal gap. Waves surge again, the platform tilting and sinking to one side, the heroine stumbling back several steps, pushed by the water. Finally, the heroine steadies herself, looks up directly at the spacetime portal, her eyes shifting from shock to determination; her silver bionic arm grabs the crackling energy boundary of the portal’s edge, the hem of her white suit and ponytail, soaked and clinging, suddenly blown backward by the heat wave from the portal. She steps her left foot across the threshold—the camera follows closely over her shoulder—at the moment of crossing, the cold gray-blue storm light is abruptly replaced by the warm golden sunlight of noon pouring from the portal, the roar of waves drowned out by the clamor of a bustling market. As the camera passes through the portal frame, the scene hard-cuts from cold gray-blue to warm orange-yellow, the heroine’s white suit dazzling again under the noon sun, her ponytail transforming from wet and disheveled to flying in the wind from running—seamlessly transitioning to the opening of Prompt 2. Style: Disaster film cold gray-blue realistic texture hard-cut to ancient Eastern market warm orange tones, a dual leap in color temperature and era at the moment of crossing the threshold, handheld shake throughout, hyper-realistic water physics and energy effects coexisting, 4K cinematic realism. Camera: From a front-facing level view of the platform → push in for a close-up of the arm pressing the button → pull back to a full shot capturing the formation of the spacetime portal → close shoulder-level follow as the heroine steps into the portal, the camera always positioned about half a meter behind the heroine’s right shoulder (that’s where the camera is). Composition: The spacetime portal centered on the screen’s axis, the heroine’s silhouette forming an absolute visual focus in the strong contrast between the cold blue storm background and the warm golden glow from the portal. Atmosphere: Desperation → miracle → crossing, clash of cold and warm light colors, a sense of temporal disconnect between the apocalyptic and classical civilizations. Audio: Storm and wave roar + low-frequency resonance hum of the spacetime portal gradually intensifying → electrical click of the red signal light → crackling arcs of the spacetime portal → at the moment of crossing, the wave sound is hard-cut and replaced by the noisy clamor of the market; no watermarks, no subtitles, no text overlays.

Act 4: Following Video 1 extended by 15 seconds, the heroine (Image 1) rushes into a deserted narrow alley in an ancient Chinese street market. Noon sunlight cuts diagonally from the alley entrance, forming a strong light pillar, the stone pavement bleached white by the sun, old wooden walls and red lanterns hanging silently on both sides. The heroine runs from the market into the alley, stops abruptly, and turns around. The hem of her white suit flips violently from the sudden stop. A slender, glowing blue longsword materializes in the palm of her silver bionic arm as she stands in the middle of the alley. Zombies emerge from the shadows at both ends of the alley, surrounding her. Their rotting faces are especially grotesque in the strong contrast between the noon light and shadows. The sound of a pipa string plucking suddenly distorts, zombie growls approach from afar, and the blue hum of the unsheathed longsword rings out. The heroine swiftly weaves through the zombie horde, the camera tracking quickly. Her silver bionic arm swings the glowing blue longsword in continuous horizontal slashes, leaving strong afterimages of blue blade light in the alley where noon sunlight and shadows intersect. The cold blue blade light and warm golden sunlight create a striking contrast of cold and warm. When zombies are hit, dark red blood splashes in clear liquid arcs in the sunlight, with a distinct sense of physical fragmentation. The white suit is stained with dark red marks, the ponytail swinging widely with sharp turns. A powerful drumbeat erupts, and the sharp whistle of the longsword cutting through the air alternates with the dull, wet impact of hitting rotting flesh. The heroine uses her bionic arm to push off the ground, leaping suddenly into the air. The camera looks up to follow her. The hem of her white suit and ponytail spread downward violently in the upward airflow, with the background of the alley’s gray walls and the strong blue sky at the entrance. The gold earrings are blown parallel to the ground in the moment of the leap. The longsword, pivoting on the bionic arm, traces a huge arc of blue flowing light, the blue light still clearly dazzling under the strong sunlight. The sound of the upward airflow bursts, accompanied by the heroine’s short battle cry.

。她看到远处有一束救援信号弹，便开始奔跑。镜头紧随其后，拍摄他穿越坍塌的屋顶、跃过破碎的天窗、从倾斜的玻璃穹顶滑下，并抓住一根悬垂的电缆。下方，黑暗的洪水在满是漂浮汽车和雕像的街道中汹涌。他落在部分被淹没的电车屋顶上，继续前进，并在巨浪从他身后冲过时到达救援信标平台。冷灰蓝色末世色调，超真实的水物理效果，风，飞溅的水花，手持拍摄带来的紧迫感，一镜到底，无剪辑。

延长10秒。主体: 仿生女侠
图片1
——白色正装西服（被海水浸透贴身、下摆撕裂）、银色机械颈甲、银色仿生义臂、黑色马尾发丝湿透散乱、金色齿轮耳环，面部电影级写实，神情从绝望转为决绝再到震撼 场景: 被洪水半淹的救援信标平台，暴风雨肆虐，四周海浪翻涌，漂浮汽车与残骸在平台四周碰撞，天空灰蓝压迫，远处都城建筑在洪水中倾斜沉没 动作序列: 先巨浪从女侠身后轰然拍过平台，海水漫过膝盖，白色西服被海浪冲刷猛烈翻卷，马尾发丝完全湿透贴面；女侠银色机械义臂猛然插入平台中央控制台，精密金属指节扣住红色信号按钮——特写：红色按钮在灰蓝暴雨光线下发出微弱脉冲光——银色义臂猛然按下，按钮触底发出沉重电气咬合声，红色信号灯骤然亮起，将周围海水染成一圈血红涟漪。 然后平台地面开始震动，海水在震动中向四周荡开圆形波纹；平台中央凭空撕裂出一道竖向裂缝，裂缝边缘涌出炽白色与琥珀色交织的能量光晕，光晕迅速扩张成一道高约三米的椭圆形时空门，门框边缘电弧跳窜，门内景象模糊扭曲——隐约可见暖色光影与嘈杂人声从门缝中透出；海浪再度涌来，平台开始向一侧倾斜下沉，女侠被海水推搡踉跄后退数步。 最后女侠稳住身形，抬头直视时空门，眼神从震撼骤然转为决绝；她银色义臂猛然抓住门框边缘电弧跳窜的能量边界，白色西服下摆与马尾发丝在时空门涌出的热浪中从湿透贴身骤然被向后猛烈掀起；她迈出左脚跨入门槛——镜头紧贴其肩侧跟入——跨越瞬间灰蓝暴雨冷光被门内涌出的正午暖金阳光骤然取代，海浪轰鸣声被嘈杂集市叫卖声淹没，镜头穿过门框的瞬间画面从冷灰蓝硬切为暖橙黄，女侠白色西服在正午阳光下重新刺目，马尾发丝从湿透散乱变为被奔跑气流掀起飞扬——无缝衔接提示词2开场。 风格: 灾难片冷灰蓝写实质感无缝硬切至古代东方集市暖橙色调，跨越门槛瞬间完成色温与时代的双重跳跃，手持晃动贯穿全程，超真实水物理与能量特效并存，4K电影级写实 镜头: 从平台正面平视→推近义臂按钮特写→拉回全景捕捉时空门成形→肩侧紧贴跟随女侠跨入门内，相机始终位于女侠右后方约半米处(thats where the camera is) 构图: 时空门居画面中轴线，女侠剪影在冷蓝暴雨背景与门内暖金光晕的强烈冷暖对撞中形成绝对视觉焦点 氛围: 绝境→奇迹→跨越，冷暖光色对撞，末世与古典文明的时空断层感 音频: 暴雨海浪轰鸣+时空门低频共鸣嗡鸣渐强→红色信号灯电气咬合声→时空门电弧跳窜声→跨门瞬间海浪声被集市嘈杂叫卖声硬切取代；无水印、无字幕、无文字叠加

第一幕：灾难片写实风格，一镜到底。镜头从暴风雨天气中漂浮的都城上空开始，向下俯冲至一座被淹没的博物馆碎裂的屋顶上，那里站着一名孤独的赛博朋克女侠
图片1
。她看到远处有一束救援信号弹，便开始奔跑。镜头紧随其后，拍摄他穿越坍塌的屋顶、跃过破碎的天窗、从倾斜的玻璃穹顶滑下，并抓住一根悬垂的电缆。下方，黑暗的洪水在满是漂浮汽车和雕像的街道中汹涌。他落在部分被淹没的电车屋顶上，继续前进，并在巨浪从他身后冲过时到达救援信标平台。冷灰蓝色末世色调，超真实的水物理效果，风，飞溅的水花，手持拍摄带来的紧迫感，一镜到底，无剪辑。

第二幕过渡：视频
视频1
延长10秒。主体: 仿生女侠
图片1
——白色正装西服（被海水浸透贴身、下摆撕裂）、银色机械颈甲、银色仿生义臂、黑色马尾发丝湿透散乱、金色齿轮耳环，面部电影级写实，神情从绝望转为决绝再到震撼 场景: 被洪水半淹的救援信标平台，暴风雨肆虐，四周海浪翻涌，漂浮汽车与残骸在平台四周碰撞，天空灰蓝压迫，远处都城建筑在洪水中倾斜沉没 动作序列: 先巨浪从女侠身后轰然拍过平台，海水漫过膝盖，白色西服被海浪冲刷猛烈翻卷，马尾发丝完全湿透贴面；女侠银色机械义臂猛然插入平台中央控制台，精密金属指节扣住红色信号按钮——特写：红色按钮在灰蓝暴雨光线下发出微弱脉冲光——银色义臂猛然按下，按钮触底发出沉重电气咬合声，红色信号灯骤然亮起，将周围海水染成一圈血红涟漪。 然后平台地面开始震动，海水在震动中向四周荡开圆形波纹；平台中央凭空撕裂出一道竖向裂缝，裂缝边缘涌出炽白色与琥珀色交织的能量光晕，光晕迅速扩张成一道高约三米的椭圆形时空门，门框边缘电弧跳窜，门内景象模糊扭曲——隐约可见暖色光影与嘈杂人声从门缝中透出；海浪再度涌来，平台开始向一侧倾斜下沉，女侠被海水推搡踉跄后退数步。 最后女侠稳住身形，抬头直视时空门，眼神从震撼骤然转为决绝；她银色义臂猛然抓住门框边缘电弧跳窜的能量边界，白色西服下摆与马尾发丝在时空门涌出的热浪中从湿透贴身骤然被向后猛烈掀起；她迈出左脚跨入门槛——镜头紧贴其肩侧跟入——跨越瞬间灰蓝暴雨冷光被门内涌出的正午暖金阳光骤然取代，海浪轰鸣声被嘈杂集市叫卖声淹没，镜头穿过门框的瞬间画面从冷灰蓝硬切为暖橙黄，女侠白色西服在正午阳光下重新刺目，马尾发丝从湿透散乱变为被奔跑气流掀起飞扬——无缝衔接提示词2开场。 风格: 灾难片冷灰蓝写实质感无缝硬切至古代东方集市暖橙色调，跨越门槛瞬间完成色温与时代的双重跳跃，手持晃动贯穿全程，超真实水物理与能量特效并存，4K电影级写实 镜头: 从平台正面平视→推近义臂按钮特写→拉回全景捕捉时空门成形→肩侧紧贴跟随女侠跨入门内，相机始终位于女侠右后方约半米处(thats where the camera is) 构图: 时空门居画面中轴线，女侠剪影在冷蓝暴雨背景与门内暖金光晕的强烈冷暖对撞中形成绝对视觉焦点 氛围: 绝境→奇迹→跨越，冷暖光色对撞，末世与古典文明的时空断层感 音频: 暴雨海浪轰鸣+时空门低频共鸣嗡鸣渐强→红色信号灯电气咬合声→时空门电弧跳窜声→跨门瞬间海浪声被集市嘈杂叫卖声硬切取代；无水印、无字幕、无文字叠加

en.p: Core Theme: Realistic sci-fi tokusatsu; ruin collapse; dark energy convergence; heavily armored dark knight + armored Taotie (pure form) undergoing synchronized transformation; cinematic-level weight and oppression; CG realism blending biotechnology and dark heavy armor aesthetics. Character Setup Face: Strict 1:1 replication of reference image. Facial features, face shape, and hairstyle must match exactly, with no beautification or stylization. Visible bruises and minor abrasions on the face; traces of blood at the corner of the mouth. Expression: Overall exhausted and suppressed. During transformation: extreme pain (brows tightly furrowed, teeth clenched, facial muscles tensed, increasing blood traces, body convulsing uncontrollably). After transformation: pain is instantly restrained, shifting to a cold, oppressive, and composed demeanor. Pre-transformation Clothing: Strictly based on reference, with added heavy battle damage (tears, burn marks, dirt, dust accumulation). Preserve original silhouette and structural details; do not alter the outfit design. Pre-transformation Creature: Cute creature. small enough to be held with one hand. Fur slightly messy with dirt; expression gentle yet alert; shows dependency on the protagonist; consistently protected in the protagonist's arms. Heavily Armored Dark Knight Design A robust physique fully covered in dark iron heavy armor (deep black base with cold metallic reflections). Shoulder and chest armor feature spikes and intricate rune engravings. Helmet: fully enclosed, crown-like with three forward-curving spikes; faceplate completely sealed; narrow, non-glowing visor. A heavy charcoal-gray cloak drapes down to the calves. Right hand carries a massive rune battle axe (dark metallic body with embedded dim gold glowing runes). Left arm exposed, showing defined muscles and prominent veins; stance upright and imposing. Armored Taotie (Evolved from the animal): The animal gradually mutates into a four-legged beast: A fusion of lion and reptile traits; huge size with explosive musculature. Body covered in layered, irregular dark gray scales with cold silver edges. Head develops a pair of thick curved horns with ring-like textures. Entire body gains matching dark iron armor (layered shoulder plates and dense spiked chest armor). Limbs are thick and powerful, especially the forelimbs; claws are black and hook-shaped. Mouth slightly open, revealing pale fangs. Final pose: stationary beside the knight in a guardian stance. Core Prop In the protagonist's right hand: "Sacred Ring Crystal Core" — black base infused with high-frequency dark gold energy flow (overall dark-gold tone to match the theme). Environment Post-apocalyptic rooftop in a ruined city. Overcast sky, light wind, distant ongoing warfare. Gray-blue sky with meteors streaking across, trailing fire and smoke. Ground scattered with dark-gold rune fragments. Visual Quality & Lighting IMAX film texture; Panavision C-series 35mm lens (f/4 aperture). Low saturation gray-blue + dark gold color scheme. Shadows are deep but retain detail. Soft edge focus with natural film grain. Strong contrast between "physical pain" and "cold metal". Effects Core Dark energy + dark-gold rune particles forming a vortex. Protagonist and capybara are enveloped simultaneously. Armor assembly conveys intense piercing pain (reflected in facial and body reactions). Sharp, harsh metal-clamping sounds. Battle axe gradually materializes. animal transforms frame-by-frame (scale growth → body expansion → horn emergence → single eye activation). Energy surges tightly synchronized with pain responses. No holy or divine effects; purely oppressive dark atmosphere emphasizing their bond. Camera Movement One continuous take; handheld with subtle breathing motion. Path: extreme wide falling shot → shaking push-in to mid close-up → transformation orbit → pull-back low-angle dual frame → aerial top-down pull-away. 0–15s Shot Breakdown 0–3s: Protagonist falls from high altitude, tightly holding the capybara protectively; rolls on impact, kicking up dust. Struggles to stand; briefly looks at the capybara (soft moment), then stares at the crystal core. Camera follows fall, impact shake, and rapid push-in close-up. 3–6s: Protagonist locks eyes with the animal, conveying strong bond; whispers "Let's do this together." Crushes the core; a dark energy pillar erupts skyward. Energy vortex engulfs both. Eyes turn black; runes appear on the animal. Slight camera shake. 6–9s: Protagonist tilts head back with a suppressed painful roar; body convulses, veins bulge, blood increases. Dark metal fragments and energy burst outward. Armor assembles in a "devouring" manner. Helmet closure marks peak pain. Animal expands, scales form, horns emerge. Camera shakes violently with brief defocus. 9–12s: Knight armor fully forms; cloak drops; battle axe materializes. animal fully evolves into armored Taotie, standing beside. Old clothing disintegrates. Camera orbits to showcase the completed forms. 12–15s: Knight stands upright with axe; pain fully suppressed, presence cold and dominant. Taotie subtly moves, showing bond. Low-angle shot with floating debris. Sudden vertical launch; ground cracks, shockwave expands. Camera briefly blurs from force, then stabilizes with heat distortion. Audio No background music. Only: metal clashing, energy bursts, rune vibrations, and battle axe materialization sounds.

zh.p:
核心主题：写实科幻特摄；废墟崩塌；暗能量汇聚；重甲暗黑骑士+装甲饕餮（纯形态）同步变身；电影级重量感与压迫感；CG写实融合生物科技与暗黑重甲美学。

角色设定
面部：严格1:1复刻参考图。五官、脸型、发型必须完全一致，不得美化或风格化。面部可见淤青和轻微擦伤；嘴角有血迹。
表情：整体疲惫压抑。变身时：极度痛苦（眉头紧锁、牙关紧咬、面部肌肉紧绷、血迹增多、身体不受控地抽搐）。变身后：痛苦瞬间收敛，转为冷酷、压迫、沉稳的神态。
变身前的服装：严格依据参考图，增加重度战斗损伤（撕裂、烧痕、污渍、积灰）。保留原始轮廓和结构细节，不改变服装设计。
变身前的生物：可爱生物。小到可以单手握住。皮毛微乱带尘土；表情温柔但警觉；对主角有依赖感；始终被主角护在怀中。

重甲暗黑骑士设计
健壮体格完全覆盖暗黑铁重甲（深黑底色带冷金属反光）。肩甲和胸甲有尖刺和复杂符文雕刻。
头盔：全封闭式，冠冕状带三根前弯尖刺；面甲完全密封；窄缝式不发光视孔。一件厚重的炭灰色披风垂至小腿。
右手持巨型符文战斧（暗黑金属斧身，镶嵌暗淡金色发光符文）。左臂裸露，肌肉线条分明，青筋凸显；站姿挺拔威严。

装甲饕餮（由动物进化而来）：
动物逐渐变异为四足巨兽：狮与爬行动物的融合体；体型巨大，肌肉爆发力强。
身体覆盖多层不规则深灰色鳞片，带冷银色边缘。头部生出一对粗壮弯角，有环状纹理。
全身覆盖匹配的暗黑铁装甲（层叠肩甲和密集尖刺胸甲）。四肢粗壮有力，尤其前肢；爪子呈黑色钩状。嘴巴微张，露出苍白獠牙。
最终姿态：静止立于骑士身侧，呈守护姿态。

核心道具
主角右手所持：“圣环晶核”——黑色基底注入高频暗金色能量流（整体暗金色调以匹配主题）。

环境
废城末日屋顶。阴天，微风，远处持续交战。灰蓝色天空有流星划过，拖着火焰和烟雾。地面散落暗金色符文碎片。

视觉质量与光照
IMAX胶片质感；Panavision C系列35mm镜头（f/4光圈）。低饱和度灰蓝+暗金色调。阴影深邃但保留细节。柔边对焦，自然胶片颗粒。“肉体痛苦”与“冰冷金属”形成强烈对比。

特效核心
暗能量+暗金色符文粒子形成漩涡。主角和卡皮巴拉同时被包裹。
装甲组装传达强烈穿刺痛感（反映在面部和身体反应上）。尖锐刺耳的金属夹紧声。战斧逐渐实体化。
动物逐帧变形（鳞片生长→身体膨胀→角出现→单眼激活）。能量涌动与痛苦反应紧密同步。无神圣或神性效果；纯粹压抑的黑暗氛围，强调两者羁绊。

运镜
一镜到底；手持带轻微呼吸感。路径：极远坠落镜头→抖动推近至中近景→变身环绕→拉远低角度双人构图→航拍俯视拉远。

0-15秒镜头分解
0-3秒：主角从高处坠落，紧紧护住卡皮巴拉；落地翻滚，扬起尘土。挣扎站起；短暂看向卡皮巴拉（温柔瞬间），然后凝视晶核。镜头跟随坠落、撞击震动并快速推近特写。
3-6秒：主角与动物对视，传递强烈羁绊；低语“我们一起上。”捏碎晶核；暗能量柱冲天而起。能量漩涡吞噬两者。眼睛变黑；动物身上出现符文。轻微镜头抖动。
6-9秒：主角仰头发出压抑的痛苦咆哮；身体抽搐，青筋暴起，血迹增多。暗黑金属碎片和能量向外爆发。装甲以“吞噬”方式组装。头盔闭合标志痛苦巅峰。动物膨胀，鳞片形成，角出现。镜头剧烈抖动并短暂失焦。
9-12秒：骑士装甲完全成型；披风落下；战斧实体化。动物完全进化为装甲饕餮，立于身侧。旧服装崩解。镜头环绕展示完成形态。
12-15秒：骑士持斧直立；痛苦完全压制，气场冷酷霸道。饕餮轻微移动，展现羁绊。低角度镜头，碎片漂浮。突然垂直升空；地面龟裂，冲击波扩散。镜头因冲击力短暂模糊，随后稳定并带热畸变。

音频
无背景音乐。仅有：金属碰撞声、能量爆发声、符文震动声、战斧实体化声。

raw_p: Core Theme: Realistic sci-fi tokusatsu; ruin collapse; dark energy convergence; heavily armored dark knight + armored Taotie (pure form) undergoing synchronized transformation; cinematic-level weight and oppression; CG realism blending biotechnology and dark heavy armor aesthetics. Character Setup Face: Strict 1:1 replication of reference image. Facial features, face shape, and hairstyle must match exactly, with no beautification or stylization. Visible bruises and minor abrasions on the face; traces of blood at the corner of the mouth. Expression: Overall exhausted and suppressed. During transformation: extreme pain (brows tightly furrowed, teeth clenched, facial muscles tensed, increasing blood traces, body convulsing uncontrollably). After transformation: pain is instantly restrained, shifting to a cold, oppressive, and composed demeanor. Pre-transformation Clothing: Strictly based on reference, with added heavy battle damage (tears, burn marks, dirt, dust accumulation). Preserve original silhouette and structural details; do not alter the outfit design. Pre-transformation Creature: Cute creature. small enough to be held with one hand. Fur slightly messy with dirt; expression gentle yet alert; shows dependency on the protagonist; consistently protected in the protagonist's arms. Heavily Armored Dark Knight Design A robust physique fully covered in dark iron heavy armor (deep black base with cold metallic reflections). Shoulder and chest armor feature spikes and intricate rune engravings. Helmet: fully enclosed, crown-like with three forward-curving spikes; faceplate completely sealed; narrow, non-glowing visor. A heavy charcoal-gray cloak drapes down to the calves. Right hand carries a massive rune battle axe (dark metallic body with embedded dim gold glowing runes). Left arm exposed, showing defined muscles and prominent veins; stance upright and imposing. Armored Taotie (Evolved from the animal): The animal gradually mutates into a four-legged beast: A fusion of lion and reptile traits; huge size with explosive musculature. Body covered in layered, irregular dark gray scales with cold silver edges. Head develops a pair of thick curved horns with ring-like textures. Entire body gains matching dark iron armor (layered shoulder plates and dense spiked chest armor). Limbs are thick and powerful, especially the forelimbs; claws are black and hook-shaped. Mouth slightly open, revealing pale fangs. Final pose: stationary beside the knight in a guardian stance. Core Prop In the protagonist's right hand: "Sacred Ring Crystal Core" — black base infused with high-frequency dark gold energy flow (overall dark-gold tone to match the theme). Environment Post-apocalyptic rooftop in a ruined city. Overcast sky, light wind, distant ongoing warfare. Gray-blue sky with meteors streaking across, trailing fire and smoke. Ground scattered with dark-gold rune fragments. Visual Quality & Lighting IMAX film texture; Panavision C-series 35mm lens (f/4 aperture). Low saturation gray-blue + dark gold color scheme. Shadows are deep but retain detail. Soft edge focus with natural film grain. Strong contrast between "physical pain" and "cold metal". Effects Core Dark energy + dark-gold rune particles forming a vortex. Protagonist and capybara are enveloped simultaneously. Armor assembly conveys intense piercing pain (reflected in facial and body reactions). Sharp, harsh metal-clamping sounds. Battle axe gradually materializes. animal transforms frame-by-frame (scale growth → body expansion → horn emergence → single eye activation). Energy surges tightly synchronized with pain responses. No holy or divine effects; purely oppressive dark atmosphere emphasizing their bond. Camera Movement One continuous take; handheld with subtle breathing motion. Path: extreme wide falling shot → shaking push-in to mid close-up → transformation orbit → pull-back low-angle dual frame → aerial top-down pull-away. 0–15s Shot Breakdown 0–3s: Protagonist falls from high altitude, tightly holding the capybara protectively; rolls on impact, kicking up dust. Struggles to stand; briefly looks at the capybara (soft moment), then stares at the crystal core. Camera follows fall, impact shake, and rapid push-in close-up. 3–6s: Protagonist locks eyes with the animal, conveying strong bond; whispers "Let's do this together." Crushes the core; a dark energy pillar erupts skyward. Energy vortex engulfs both. Eyes turn black; runes appear on the animal. Slight camera shake. 6–9s: Protagonist tilts head back with a suppressed painful roar; body convulses, veins bulge, blood increases. Dark metal fragments and energy burst outward. Armor assembles in a "devouring" manner. Helmet closure marks peak pain. Animal expands, scales form, horns emerge. Camera shakes violently with brief defocus. 9–12s: Knight armor fully forms; cloak drops; battle axe materializes. animal fully evolves into armored Taotie, standing beside. Old clothing disintegrates. Camera orbits to showcase the completed forms. 12–15s: Knight stands upright with axe; pain fully suppressed, presence cold and dominant. Taotie subtly moves, showing bond. Low-angle shot with floating debris. Sudden vertical launch; ground cracks, shockwave expands. Camera briefly blurs from force, then stabilizes with heat distortion. Audio No background music. Only: metal clashing, energy bursts, rune vibrations, and battle axe materialization sounds.

en.p: Cinematic VFX war sequence shot on Arri Alexa 65 with a high-speed tracking shot featuring an extreme close-up of a main battle tank's barrel as it recoils violently, triggering a hyper-realistic bullet-time transition. As the shell exits the muzzle, time slows to a near-halt, revealing a massive, intricate shockwave of fire and sand frozen in mid-air. The camera follows the spinning, glowing projectile as it ripples through heat-distorted air toward a target armored vehicle. Upon impact, the armor buckles in slow motion, sending sparks and molten metal fragments spraying outward in exquisite detail. Just as the internal explosion begins to expand, time snaps back to full speed with a deafening blast and a massive plume of black smoke. The atmosphere is gritty and overwhelming, shifting from a silent, frozen mechanical moment to a chaotic, high-intensity battlefield climax.climax.

en.p:
**Scene Setup - Ruined Martial Arts Arena**
On the shattered ruins of the legendary martial arts arena, the ground is cracked and unstable. Broken stone, drifting smoke, and fragments of ancient carvings scatter across the battlefield. Ruined temple structures tremble as waves of energy distort the air.

The visual style is high-energy anime cinematic: stylized lighting, exaggerated motion, glowing energy effects, and strong color contrast.

Two fighters face each other: @Image1 and @Image2, both holding swords, standing still in a tense standoff.

**The Duel Begins**
@Image1 moves first. Purple energy ignites along the blade.

In an instant, he vanishes and reappears in front of @Image2, delivering a lightning-fast slash.

The camera crash-zooms forward at the moment of impact.

Blades collide.

A brief hit-stop moment freezes the frame:
sparks, energy trails, and dust suspended in the air—

then motion resumes explosively.

**场景设定 - 破败的武道竞技场**
在传说中武道竞技场的破碎废墟上，地面龟裂且不稳。碎裂的石块、飘散的烟雾以及古代雕刻的碎片散落在战场上。破败的庙宇结构随着能量波动而震颤，空气也因此扭曲。视觉风格为高能动漫电影级：风格化的光影、夸张的动作、发光的能量特效以及强烈的色彩对比。两名战士对峙而立：@Image1 和 @Image2，均手持长剑，在紧张的僵持中静止不动。

**对决开始**
@Image1 率先行动。紫色能量沿剑刃燃起。瞬间，他消失并出现在 @Image2 面前，发动闪电般的一斩。镜头在碰撞瞬间急速前推。双刃相击。短暂的停顿定格画面：火花、能量轨迹与悬浮的尘埃——随后动作爆发性地恢复。每一次挥砍都释放出锐利的能量斩击，撕裂地面与空气。

**近身交锋**
战斗升级为极限高速剑术对决。
- 快速斩击与格挡反击
- 持续的刀刃碰撞
- 每次动作后留下的能量轨迹

动态动漫风格镜头运用：
- 攻击间快速甩镜
- 环绕两名战士的旋转镜头
- 低角度跟拍横扫的剑弧
- 眼睛、剑刃与碰撞点的极限特写

能量斩击划过竞技场，留下发光的切痕并激起碎石飞溅。

**升级**
@Image1 化作紫色动态模糊消失，随后出现在 @Image2 身后，发动强力下劈。镜头从上方急速俯冲而下。@Image2 瞬间转身，以金色能量剑刃格挡。碰撞引发紫金两色能量的巨大爆炸。地面碎裂，碎石升腾，冲击波向外扩散。

一场巨大爆炸撕裂竞技场。地面粉碎。碎石冲天而起。
从渐逝的光芒中，@Image2 平静地迈步向前。一记决定性的斩击。@Image1 被击飞，穿过废墟。

高能动漫动作。夸张的动作、发光的剑刃轨迹、能量斩击、强烈的停顿瞬间。动态镜头运用：急速推镜、甩镜、旋转镜头、空中俯冲、极限特写插入。8K 动漫电影级画质，精细粒子特效，戏剧性光影，高速动作，强劲视觉节奏。

### TEXT ###
Scene 1: Right-Hand Fire Magic (Gira). An extreme close-up of the Great Sage Poron (a boy dressed as a clown) thrusting his right hand forward. As he chants "Gira from my right hand," a blazing red fire magic sphere ignites in his right palm, illuminating the surroundings with a warm and passionate red light. High quality, cinematic lighting, dynamic movement. Direction note: The camera work is intended to focus the viewer's attention on the "red (flame)" of the right hand. A dramatic lighting effect is incorporated, such that the reflection of the flames dyes the right half of Poron's face red.

Scene 2: Left-Hand Vacuum Magic (Bagi). An extreme close-up of Poron's left hand thrust forward. As he chants "Bagi from my left hand," a sharply swirling white vacuum (wind) magic appears in his left palm, emitting a white light. High quality, cinematic lighting, dynamic movement. Direction note: This time, the focus is on the "white (wind)" of the left hand. In contrast to the red of the right hand from before, a white tone spreads across the entire screen, visually highlighting that magic of different attributes is being prepared on the left and right sides.

Scene 3: Generation of Combined Magic (Bagira). A medium shot of Poron bringing his right and left hands together. As he chants "Combine" while watching the merging magic, the blazing red flame and swirling white vacuum wind magic collide and merge in front of his chest. The two contrasting colors intertwine and rapidly transform into a radiant sphere containing immense magical power. Particle effects, cinematic lighting. Direction note: The red and white lights on the left and right sides of the screen converge in the center, depicting a catharsis as they change into an intense pink light. By scattering particles such as light swirls and sparks, the sense of energy expansion and instability when the magic combines is expressed.

Scene 4: Release of Combined Magic. Poron thrusts both hands powerfully forward. As he chants "Combined Magic Bagira!" the blazing red flame and white vacuum tornado, with tremendous kinetic energy, tear through the air and are released toward the camera, the direction in which he thrusts his hands. Grand fantasy action, motion blur, particle effects.

zh.p:
### 文本 ###
场景1：右手火焰魔法（吉拉）
大贤者波隆（小丑装扮的少年）右手向前伸出的极端特写。当他念出“右手释放吉拉”时，他的右手掌心燃起炽热的红色火焰魔法球，散发出温暖而热情的红色光芒，照亮周围。高品质、电影级照明、动态动作。
演出说明：为了让观众的视线集中在右手的“红色（火焰）”上，设想采用聚焦手部的镜头运动。通过火焰的反射，波隆的右脸被染成红色，营造出戏剧性的光影效果。

场景2：左手真空魔法（巴基）
波隆左手向前伸出的极端特写。当他念出“左手释放巴基”时，他的左手掌心出现锐利旋转的白色真空（风）魔法，散发出白色光芒。高品质、电影级照明、动态动作。
演出说明：这次将焦点放在左手的“白色（风）”上。与之前右手的红色形成对比，通过让整个画面弥漫白色调，在视觉上突出左右手准备的不同属性魔法。

场景3：合体魔法（巴基拉）的生成
波隆将右手和左手合拢的中景镜头。当他注视着融合的魔法念出“合体”时，炽热的红色火焰和旋转的白色真空风魔法在他胸前碰撞并融合。两种对比鲜明的颜色交织在一起，迅速变化成一个蕴含巨大魔力的发光球体。粒子特效、电影级照明。
演出说明：描绘画面左右的红白光芒在中央交汇，转变为强烈粉色光芒的升华感。通过散布光之漩涡和火花等粒子，表现魔法合体时能量的膨胀感和不稳定性。

场景4：合体魔法的释放
波隆双手用力向前伸出，当他念出“合体魔法巴基拉！”时，炽热的红色火焰和闪耀的白色真空龙卷风以猛烈的动能撕裂空气，朝着他双手伸出的方向——即镜头方向释放魔法。宏大的奇幻动作、动态模糊、粒子特效。

raw_p:
シーン1：右手の火炎魔法（ギラ） 大賢者ポロン（ピエロの恰好をした少年）が右手を突き出す極端なクローズアップ。彼が「右手からギラ」と唱えると、彼の右の手のひらから燃え盛る赤色に輝く火炎魔法の球が発火し、周囲を暖かく情熱的な赤い光で照らし出す。高品質、シネマティックな照明、ダイナミックな動き。 演出の説明: 視聴者の視線を右手の「赤（炎）」に集中させるため、手元にフォーカスしたカメラワークを想定しています。炎の照り返しでポロンの顔の右半分が赤く染まるような、ドラマチックな光の演出を取り入れます。 

シーン2：左手の真空魔法（バギ） ポロンの左手が前に突き出される極端なクローズアップ。彼が「左手からバギ」と唱えると、彼の左の手のひらに鋭く渦巻く白色の真空（風）魔法が現れ、白い光を放つ。高品質、シネマティックな照明、ダイナミックな動き。 演出の説明: 今度は左手の「白（風）」に焦点を当てます。先ほどの右手の赤色とは対照的に、画面全体に白色のトーンを広げることで、左右で異なる属性の魔法が準備されていることを視覚的に際立たせます。 

シーン3：合体魔法（バギラ）の生成 ポロンが右手と左手を合わせるミディアムショット。彼が融合する魔法を見ながら「合体」と唱えると、燃え盛る赤い炎と渦巻く白い真空の風の魔法が彼の胸の前で衝突し、融合する。2つの対照的な色が絡み合い、巨大な魔力を秘めた、光り輝く球体へと急速に変化する。パーティクルエフェクト、シネマティックな照明。 演出の説明: 画面の左右にあった赤と白の光が中央で交わり、ピンク色の強烈な光へと変化するカタルシスを描きます。光の渦や火の粉といったパーティクル（粒子）を散らすことで、魔法が合体した際のエネルギーの膨張感や不安定さを表現します。

シーン4：合体魔法の放出 ポロンが両手を力強く前方に突き出し、彼が「合体魔法バギラ！」と唱えると、燃え盛る赤く輝く炎と白く輝く真空の竜巻が猛烈な運動エネルギーで、空気を切り裂きながら、彼が両手を突き出している方向、カメラに向かって魔法が放たれるシーン。壮大なファンタジーアクション、モーションブラー、パーティクルエフェクト。

en.p:
A man in his early 30s, olive skin, short cropped hair, wearing a matte graphite riding suit with gold reflective piping and reinforced armored boots, accelerates a high-performance sport motorbike across a narrow glass skybridge connecting two skyscrapers in downtown Dubai at night — the city glowing gold beneath with traffic streams forming rivers of light.

At the 2-second mark the skybridge ahead fractures under structural stress — glass panels cracking outward as the rider increases speed instead of braking.

The bike launches off the collapsing skybridge, suspended hundreds of meters above the city as shards of glass fall away into the void. Neon reflections from surrounding towers streak across the bike’s polished frame as it rotates slightly mid-air.

Camera positioned from a neighboring tower captures the full silhouette of the rider cutting across the skyline while debris trails behind.

He lands hard on the sloped rooftop of a luxury hotel, tires screeching across wet marble tiles, sliding sideways before regaining control.

Without stopping, the rider accelerates toward the rooftop edge and launches again onto a descending parking ramp built into the building’s exterior.

Inside the spiral ramp, he drifts along the walls at high speed, sparks trailing from foot pegs as headlights sweep across the curved concrete structure.

Street level: the rider bursts out into a neon-lit boulevard, weaving through traffic as reflections ripple across rain-soaked asphalt.

Dubai skyline, skybridge collapse stunt, rooftop landing, spiral ramp drift, continuous velocity flow, cinematic grain, 4K.

zh.p: 一名三十岁出头的男子，橄榄色皮肤，短发平头，身穿哑光石墨色骑行服，配有金色反光滚边和加固装甲靴，在迪拜市中心两座摩天大楼之间狭窄的玻璃天桥上，深夜驾驶一辆高性能运动摩托车加速飞驰——城市在脚下金光闪耀，车流如光河般流淌。在第2秒时，前方的天桥因结构应力而断裂——玻璃面板向外裂开，而骑手非但没有刹车，反而加速。摩托车从崩塌的天桥上腾空而起，悬在数百米高的城市上空，玻璃碎片坠入虚空。周围塔楼的霓虹灯光在摩托车抛光车身上划过条纹，车身在半空中微微旋转。从邻近塔楼拍摄的镜头捕捉到骑手剪影划过天际线，碎片紧随其后。他重重落在豪华酒店的倾斜屋顶上，轮胎在湿滑的大理石瓷砖上尖叫着侧滑，随后重新掌控平衡。骑手没有停下，加速冲向屋顶边缘，再次跃入建筑外部的下行停车坡道。在螺旋坡道内，他高速贴墙漂移，脚踏板擦出火花，车灯扫过弯曲的混凝土结构。街面层：骑手冲入霓虹灯照耀的林荫大道，在车流中穿梭，雨水浸湿的柏油路上倒映着光影。迪拜天际线、天桥崩塌特技、屋顶着陆、螺旋坡道漂移、连续速度流、电影质感颗粒、4K。

en.p: 9:16 vertical screen, 15 seconds, realistic lifestyle style, warm yellow indoor lighting, slightly low-angle shot from a phone stand perspective. In the frame, a woman in her twenties [Image 1] sits at a small table in a rented room, bare-faced except for lipstick, with her hair casually tied into a messy bun, wearing a faded gray oversized hoodie. In front of her is a freshly opened takeout of malatang, steaming hot with a red oil broth. Scattered around are a phone, tissues, and an open can of cola. The background is a typical rented living room, with a small 'fortune' sticker on the wall, and through the window, the distant lights of the opposite building are faintly visible. The woman picks up a piece of lotus root with chopsticks, blows on it, pops it into her mouth, and speaks vaguely to the camera. A bit of red oil stains the corner of her mouth; she casually wipes it with the back of her hand, then picks up a strand of vermicelli and slurps it in. At some point, she suddenly laughs, points the chopsticks at the camera, still chewing, her eyes curving into crescents. Then she lowers her head again, digging into the malatang, her expression natural and relaxed. Dialogue (woman, casual and relaxed tone, speaking Teochew): 'I'm not going home for Chinese New Year this year, alone in Shenzhen... Eh, this malatang is actually pretty good! Mom called asking when I'm getting married, I said I'm married to malatang now, hahaha.' Sound effects: the sound of chopsticks hitting a plastic bowl, the slurping of vermicelli, faint firecracker sounds from outside the window, and occasional phone notification sounds. Prohibited: any text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

zh.p: 9:16竖屏，15秒，写实生活风格，暖黄室内光， 手机支架视角略微仰拍，画面中一个二十多岁的女生【图片1】坐在出租屋的小桌前， 素颜只涂了口红，头发随意扎成丸子头，穿着一件洗得发白的灰色oversized卫衣， 面前摆着一份刚拆开的麻辣烫外卖，热气腾腾，红油汤底， 旁边散落着手机、纸巾和一罐打开的可乐， 背景是普通出租屋客厅，墙上贴着一个小小的福字， 窗户外隐约能看到对面楼的万家灯火， 女生一边用筷子夹起一块藕片吹了吹塞进嘴里，一边对着镜头含糊地说话， 嘴角沾了点红油，随手用手背擦了一下，又夹起一根粉丝呲溜吸进去， 说到什么地方突然笑了，筷子指着镜头，嘴里还嚼着东西，眼睛弯成月牙， 然后又低头继续扒拉麻辣烫，表情自然松弛。 台词（女生，轻松随意语气，讲潮汕话）："今年过年无等内，一个人在深圳……诶，这个麻辣烫还真不赖！阿姆打电话来问我几时嫁，我讲我嫁给麻辣烫了啦哈哈哈。" 音效：筷子碰塑料碗的声音、吸粉丝的呲溜声、窗外隐约的鞭炮声、手机偶尔的消息提示音。 禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO或水印

en.p: One person appears on screen, @, 12 seconds, top-tier car commercial quality, cinematic shots, realistic sense of speed and pressure, smooth time-space transitions, consistent character throughout, stable visuals, escalating emotions. 0.0-4.0 seconds: Ultra-low angle close-up at ground level, warm golden afternoon sunlight illuminates a beige plush carpet, dust particles float, vintage Kodak film warm yellow tone. Young @ shows only a small childish hand, fiercely pushing a red Porsche toy sports car forward. The camera follows closely at high speed from the front of the toy car, simulating a first-person view of real racing, speed increasing, childhood imagination fully ignited. 4.0-5.5 seconds: The toy car charges straight into the dark shadow under the sofa, light suddenly vanishes, carpet texture stretches into radial speed trails, the entire frame is swallowed by darkness. Using the blocking action of entering the shadow for a seamless transition, creating a time-space leap from childhood to reality. 5.5-9.0 seconds: In the blackout, engine roar explodes, a real red Porsche 911 GT3 roars out from the darkness, track cold gray, sky light sharp, paint reflection intense, tires kick up heat and slight dust. The camera maintains the same ground-level high-speed tracking shot as the previous scene, as if the same car has transformed from toy size into a real race car, visually striking, physical sense of speed real and fierce. 9.0-12.0 seconds: Cut to extreme close-up inside the car, adult @'s hand in racing gloves fiercely grips the suede steering wheel and violently shifts gears, mechanical vibration, sweat, friction details clearly visible. The camera suddenly tilts up and pushes in, freezing on @'s burning, determined eyes under the helmet, sweat drips from the forehead, the gaze as if childhood fantasy has been fully driven into reality. The interior space quickly pans, intense vibration, pressure maxed out, ending with a climax freeze on the eyes. Negative: Blurry, low resolution, distorted characters, multiple people, hand errors, car model errors, jump cuts, abrupt transitions, stuttering, frame drops, plastic texture, fake car feel, excessive effects, anime style, cheap filters, unstable face, age transition confusion.
en.t: From Toy to Reality: Speed Unleashed

zh.p:
1人出镜，@，12秒，顶级汽车广告质感，电影级镜头，真实速度压迫感，丝滑时空转场，前后人物一致，画面稳定，情绪层层递进。

0.0-4.0秒：
超低机位贴地微距，午后暖金阳光照亮米色毛绒地毯，尘埃粒子漂浮，复古柯达胶片暖黄调。
小时候的@只露出稚嫩小手，猛地推动一辆红色保时捷玩具跑车向前冲刺。
镜头紧贴玩具车车头高速滑行跟拍，模拟真实赛车第一视角，速度越来越快，童年想象力被彻底点燃。

4.0-5.5秒：
玩具车径直冲入沙发底部黑暗阴影，光线骤灭，地毯纹理拉成放射状速度残影，整个画面被黑暗吞没。
利用冲入阴影的遮挡动作完成无缝转场，形成从童年到现实的时空跃迁。

5.5-9.0秒：
黑场中引擎轰鸣炸开，真实红色保时捷911 GT3从黑暗中咆哮冲出，赛道冷灰，天光锐利，车漆反光凌厉，轮胎卷起热浪与轻微烟尘。
镜头保持与前一镜完全一致的贴地高速跟拍，像同一辆车从玩具尺寸直接变成真实赛车，视觉震撼强烈，物理速度感真实凶猛。

9.0-12.0秒：
切入车内极限特写，成年@戴赛车手套的手狠狠攥住翻毛皮方向盘并暴力换挡，机械震动、汗水、摩擦细节清晰可见。
镜头猛然上摇推近，定格头盔下@灼热坚定的双眼，额头汗水滑落，眼神像把童年的幻想彻底开进现实。
车内空间快速摇摄，震动强烈，压迫感拉满，最后以眼神高潮定格收尾。

负面：
模糊，低清，人物变形，多人，手部错误，车型错误，跳切，转场生硬，卡顿，掉帧，塑料质感，假车感，过度特效，动漫感，廉价滤镜，脸部不稳定，年龄衔接混乱。
