en.p:
Mecha Samurai · Waterfall Wonderland Solo Performance · 1980s Martial Arts Film Still · VHS Tape · Film Grain · Moss Waterfall Scene

Character Lock: Figure 1 Mecha Samurai — Short hair, mechanical arms in dark gray alloy, pink glossy combat pants, white sneakers, samurai sword, bare torso with visible abs. Outer layer: cyan-blue wide-sleeved robe, jade belt at waist, hair bun with crown, cold and handsome face. Appearance remains unchanged throughout.

Scene Lock: Figure 2 Moss Waterfall Wonderland — Multi-tiered waterfall cascading from moss-covered boulders, mist-filled air, deep green damp moss, ferns surrounding, cold blue-green base tone. Scene does not abruptly change throughout.

1980s Hong Kong martial arts film texture, VHS scan lines overlaid, heavy film grain with high noise, faded yellowish-green colors, heavy vignetting at corners, slight lens distortion at edges, dim eerie side lighting, cinematic medium shots. Style remains consistent throughout. No character face changes, no sudden costume changes, no text subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

0-1 second: Ultra-wide-angle low-altitude dive push — Strong perspective, high-speed forward push with slight rotation, maximum motion blur, VHS motion area snow noise bursts. Mecha samurai leaps into close-up from deep within waterfall mist, cyan-blue wide sleeves flapping violently, jade belt swinging in an arc with the leap, samurai sword blade reflecting cold white light. Presence is overwhelming, camera keeps moving without pause, waterfall mist forms radial afterimages due to high-speed motion.

Sound effects: Low-frequency roar of water mist, fabric cutting through air, metallic ring of samurai sword unsheathing, VHS electronic background noise.

1-4 seconds: Low-angle upward shot · Leaping consecutive slashes — Low-angle upward shot from moss ground. Mecha samurai pushes off wet rocks to leap, cyan-blue wide sleeves spread like wings, samurai sword performs continuous horizontal and vertical slashes, each move clean and seamless, blade trailing light blue sword light afterimages. Waterfall curtain forms a white backdrop, silhouette tension at full.

Water droplets shaken off moss rocks by sword aura, forming dense rain of droplets falling from above in the upward shot. Circular tracking shot begins, orbiting 180 degrees around the mecha samurai, pink combat pants creating extreme warm-cold color contrast in the cold blue-green mist, white sneakers leaving water prints on damp moss.

Sound effects: Samurai sword slicing wind, water droplets falling, water mist roar, robe flapping fabric sounds.

4-8 seconds: Side tracking flat shot · Slow-motion climax — Camera side flat shot high-speed tracking. Mecha samurai leaps and maneuvers among moss boulders, steps swift as wind, each landing precisely on rock edges, water splashing from impact points, sword techniques continuous.

[Slow-motion · 0.3-second climax] At the maximum amplitude of the samurai sword's horizontal sweep — speed drops into slow motion. Every fabric thread of the cyan-blue wide sleeves is clear, water droplets flying from sleeve tips form complete arc trajectories in the air, samurai sword blade reflects waterfall light creating delicate spectrum, light blue sword aura afterimages freeze and hover, vibration patterns on moss rock surface water film clearly visible. After 0.3 seconds, instantly returns to high speed, VHS frame rate jump noise at the speed switch moment.

Large swing cut to high-angle overhead shot, continuous leap water print trails on moss wetland, sword light afterimages form spiral light patterns from overhead perspective.

Sound effects: Extremely slow water sound of droplets scattering at slow-motion climax, sudden burst impact sound when returning to high speed, waterfall roar frequency shifts with speed switch.

8-12 seconds: High-energy zoom push-pull · Multi-angle switching — Camera high-energy zoom, first extreme pull-back — mecha samurai's pink combat pants become the only warm color visual anchor against the green-white waterfall background — then sharp push-in to samurai sword tip close-up, light blue particles flowing continuously at the sword tip, water mist refracting cold blue glimmer in the sword light.

Three rapid consecutive perspective switches:
① Low-angle upward shot — Samurai sword slashes down from above, blade and waterfall curtain form dual white light collision in the same vertical frame
② Side tracking flat shot — Wide sleeves and waterfall flow direction form horizontal-vertical intersecting force lines
③ High-angle overhead shot — Figure's reflection in moss water surface creates dual afterimages simultaneously

Each switch accompanied by VHS horizontal scan line tearing brief distortion, dense snow noise in high-speed motion areas. Sword light afterimages stack three times, ultimately forming a light blue light net covering the waterfall scene.

Sound effects: Frame jump noise from multi-angle switching, dense metallic ringing of continuous samurai sword slashes, waterfall roar sharp push and pull with perspective switches.

12-15 seconds: Aerial finishing pose · Sword aura diffusion · Grand wide shot — Mecha samurai pushes off the highest moss boulder to leap into the air at the highest point, cyan-blue wide sleeves fully spread, jade belt swinging at maximum arc, pink combat pants in backlight with most saturated color, white sneakers suspended above waterfall mist. Both hands grip the samurai sword for a downward finishing move —

[Finale triple burst]
① Samurai sword contacts water surface: Light blue sword aura spreads outward in concentric circular light wave ripples, pushing the entire waterfall curtain outward to form an arc-shaped water wall
② Light wave touches moss rock wall: All moss water droplets lift off simultaneously, dense droplet curtain scatters outward, refracting cold blue spectrum in dim light
③ Sword aura bursts upward: Light blue light column shoots up from the sword tip, piercing through the waterfall mist layer to form a blue-white light column, mist churns and scatters violently, ferns bent by the air blast

[Finale slow-motion · 3 seconds full duration] Light wave ripple diffusion patterns on moss water surface, droplet curtain refraction spectrum in sword light, fabric thread flow of wide sleeves in the air blast, white sneakers' final splash landing freeze frame — every detail clear and stunning.

Camera slowly pulls back, grand wide shot concludes — full view of multi-tiered waterfall reappears, mecha samurai stands on the highest moss boulder, light blue sword light afterglow slowly dissipates in the mist, pink combat pants final freeze frame against the green-white waterfall background.

VHS corners fully darkened to black, film grain bursts into silver-white noise in the light column's highlight areas, slight lens distortion at edges for the finish, frame tension at maximum.

Sound effects: Low-frequency resonance boom of sword aura diffusion, heavy water sound of light wave contacting water curtain, dense fine sounds of droplet curtain lifting off, high-frequency energy sound of light column shooting upward, all sounds in slow-motion drop in frequency for an ethereal texture, after camera pull-back, only waterfall roar and mist wind remain.

Technical specifications: VHS scan lines overlaid throughout, heavy film grain, faded yellowish-green colors, heavy vignetting at corners, slow-motion 0.3-second action climax + 3-second full finale, high-energy zoom push-pull, rapid multi-angle switching, light blue sword light particles flowing throughout, natural and realistic physical particle motion of moss and water mist.

zh.p: 两名精英战士在地球轨道上的一座破碎空间站内进行零重力搏斗。碎裂的金属板和漂浮的残骸在他们周围缓缓飘移，而蓝色星球透过破损的墙壁发出微光。战士们蹬踏着漂浮的碎片，向彼此飞扑而去。

en.p:
This depicts the battle between Saitama and Garou.
With just a single punch from Saitama, a massive gust of wind erupted, shattering the ground beneath them. Garou, using his incredible speed and agility, parried the blow and launched a counterattack. As the two exchanged a flurry of punches and kicks, the sky and the earth shook with the deafening roar of their confrontation.

zh.p: 这一幕描绘了埼玉与饿狼之间的激战。埼玉仅一拳挥出，便掀起狂风巨浪，脚下大地崩裂。饿狼凭借超凡的速度与敏捷，格挡开这一击并展开反攻。两人拳脚交错间，天地为之震颤，震耳欲聋的碰撞声回荡四野。

en.p:
Cinematic vertical video (9:16), photorealistic pet vlog style,
warm indoor daytime setting, dining area or kitchen counter.

CONTINUITY: After the betrayal of EP3, Grayson walked away 
with dignity. Now he has a new plan. He spots food on the table.

Action sequence:
① Grayson's eyes and forehead slowly rise above table edge 
   from below — just his eyes visible, scanning left and right.
② Full head appears, locks onto a piece of food on the table.
   Expression: calm, focused, zero guilt.
③ One paw extends slowly toward the food, deliberate and steady.
   He pauses halfway — turns head directly to camera. Holds eye 
   contact for 2 seconds. Expression: completely unbothered.
④ Paw continues, nudges food off table edge. 
   Grayson disappears below frame to retrieve it.
   Tail visible above table edge, swishing once, then gone.

Camera: table-level angle, food item sharp in foreground,
Grayson's face rising into frame. Shallow DOF, warm bokeh behind.

Lighting: warm daytime indoor light, slightly brighter than EP1-3.
Audio: lo-fi resumes playfully, brief comedic pause during eye contact.
Mood: sneaky, confident, zero remorse. 100% realistic.

zh.p:
00:00–00:02（2s）【开场钩子 - 逃婚名场面】
- 景别：高空俯拍转近景推近
- 场景：将军府朱红高墙，墙角种满一株盛开的红梅
- 服装：
- 女主【@图1】：一身粉色交领齐胸襦裙，外罩一层薄纱杏色大袖，裙摆绣满缠枝莲纹样。发尾垂落几缕碎发，显得既隆重又凌乱。
- 男主【@图2】：玄色暗金龙纹锦袍，腰间束玉带，发丝高束，面容冷峻。
- 女主双腿跨在围墙上，身体微微前倾，紧张得鼻尖冒汗，双手死死扒着墙沿。
- 镜头微推，特写她咬着下唇，眼神既不舍又决绝，偷偷往后院墙的方向张望。
- 音效：急促的呼吸声 

00:02–00:06（4s） 
- 景别：中景跟拍 + 低角度仰拍
- 动作：
1. 女主脚下一滑，身体瞬间失去重心。
2. 她惊呼一声 “啊——！”，双手胡乱挥舞，裙摆被风吹得飞扬起来。 
- 表情：女主瞳孔地震，从慌张变成惊恐。
- 音效：风声 + 重物落地的闷响（被接住的声音）

 00:06–00:15（9s） 
- 景别：特写环绕 + 近景
- 动作：
1. 墙角下站着的的摄政王长臂一伸，精准有力地扣住女主的细腰，没有让她摔在地上。
2. 顺势将她打横抱进怀里。
3. 女主整个人撞进他坚实的胸膛，鼻尖蹭到他衣襟上冷冽的龙涎香。
- 表情：
- 女主：瞬间僵住，双手抵在他胸口，耳尖红得滴血，脸颊烫得能煮熟鸡蛋，眼神慌乱躲闪不敢看他。女主惊慌失措的说道：“你…你是谁呀？快…快放我下来! ” 
- 男主：原本冰冷的眉眼，在触到她温热的身体时，眼底瞬间柔和，嘴角勾起一抹极淡的、不易察觉的笑意。
- 台词（男主低沉磁性，带着一丝宠溺的无奈）： “我是谁?我就是你翻墙也要逃婚的摄政王。” 

- 景别：双人怼脸特写（CP感拉满）
- 动作：
1. 男主拇指轻轻摩挲着女主被他抓在掌心的手腕。
2. 微微俯身凑近，额头抵着她的额头，两人鼻尖相触，呼吸交缠。
3. 女主睫毛剧烈颤抖，长长的睫毛在眼下投出一片阴影。
- 表情：
- 女主眼神湿漉漉的，带着水汽，又气又羞，眼眶微红。眼神闪躲，双手抵住男主的胸口。
- 男主深情凝视她，眼神里满是占有欲和藏不住的温柔。

en.p: With 'Supercar Personality and Performance' as the core, connect five distinctive supercars (red-black carbon fiber supercar, blue-green glossy supercar, yellow classic Lamborghini, yellow-black racing-style supercar, silver futuristic concept car) within 10 seconds, covering five major scenes: indoor garage, bright showroom, outdoor display area, racetrack, and tech-sense indoor setting. From static design to dynamic driving, comprehensively present the exterior texture and performance attributes of the supercars. Adopt a progressive storyboard approach: 'static close-up → static lighting enhancement → dynamic driving → dynamic effects intensification → sci-fi dynamic.' Focus on static details of the supercars (materials, lines) from 0-2 seconds. Use scenes and lighting effects to highlight visual focal points from 2-4 seconds, and gradually intensify the dynamic feel from 4-10 seconds. For static segments, use 'partial push-in (e.g., carbon fiber texture, headlights) + overall freeze-frame' shots; for dynamic segments, switch to 'tracking shot (yellow-black supercar driving on track) + circling shot (fluorescent green supercar moving) + dynamic follow (concept car weaving).' Each 2 seconds forms a rhythm unit: 0-2 seconds (quick-cut static) uses fast storyboard at 0.5 seconds/frame; 2-4 seconds (steady lighting) focuses on the fusion of yellow Lamborghini and lighting effects at 1 second/frame; 4-10 seconds (intense dynamic) speeds up again and enhances visual impact through effects. Lighting effects align with the supercar positioning; motion blur uses 'progressive blur intensity' to let the audience perceive 'increasing speed'; screen distortion effects are designed for the concept car to enhance the sci-fi sense of 'future travel.' When capturing static shots, pay attention to details like 'air intake edges, number of wheel spokes'; during dynamic shots, capture 'slight body vibrations, tail wing adjustments with speed, synchronized movement of wheels and body.' In terms of color, dynamic segment lighting effects match the supercar colors; static segments all use 'dark + bright' color combinations; multiple supercars highlight 'performance-oriented details'; scenes retain 'ground texture clarity.' Pair with Brazilian funk music.

zh.p:
以“超跑个性与性能”为核心，10秒内串联5款特色超跑（红黑碳纤维超跑、蓝绿色光泽超跑、黄色经典兰博基尼、黄黑赛事风超跑、银色未来概念车），覆盖室内车库、明亮展厅、户外展示区、赛道、科技感室内5大场景。

从静态设计到动态行驶，全方位呈现超跑的外观质感与性能属性。

采用“静态特写→静态光效衬托→动态行驶→动态特效强化→科幻化动态”的递进式分镜。

0-2秒聚焦超跑静态细节（材质、线条）。

2-4秒用场景+光效突出视觉焦点，

4-10秒逐步强化动态感。

静态段落用“局部推近（如碳纤维纹理、车灯）+整体定格”镜头，动态段落切换为“跟拍（黄黑超跑赛道行驶）+环绕（荧光绿超跑移动）+动态跟随（概念车穿梭）”。

每2秒为一个节奏单元，0-2秒（快切静态）用0.5秒/帧的快速分镜，2-4秒（稳承光效）1秒/帧聚焦黄色兰博基尼与光效的融合，4-10秒（强动态）再次提速并通过特效增强视觉冲击。

光效贴合超跑定位，运动模糊通过“模糊程度递进”让观众感知“速度递增”，画面扭曲特效为概念车设计强化“未来穿梭”科幻感。

镜头捕捉静态时关注“进气口棱角、轮毂辐条数量”等细节，动态时捕捉“车身轻微颠簸、尾翼随速度调整、车轮与车身同步运动”。

色彩上动态段落光效色与超跑色呼应，静态段落均为“深色+亮色”搭配，多辆超跑突出“性能化细节”，场景保留“地面纹理清晰度”。搭配巴西funk音乐。

光效贴合超跑定位，运动模糊通过“模糊程度递进”让观众感知“速度递增”，画面扭曲特效为概念车设计强化“未来穿梭”科幻感。

镜头捕捉静态时关注“进气口棱角、轮毂辐条数量”等细节，动态时捕捉“车身轻微颠簸、尾翼随速度调整、车轮与车身同步运动”。

色彩上动态段落光效色与超跑色呼应，静态段落均为“深色+亮色”搭配，多辆超跑突出“性能化细节”，场景保留“地面纹理清晰度”。搭配巴西funk音乐。

en.p: An iPhone with a Dynamic Island, initially showing the front with the time displayed as 9:41. There are three scenes, which are three discontinuous shots gradually zooming in on the phone's body. Each zoom centers on the pill-shaped black Dynamic Island at the top of the screen. At the end of the third scene, the perspective enters this pill-shaped black Dynamic Island, and then the entire screen turns black. In this blackness, a metal-framed iPhone with three cameras slowly rises from the bottom, exquisitely detailed. Suddenly, the iPhone disappears, leaving behind a puff of smoke and a string of glowing white text: Titanium. Then, this glowing white text transforms into: iPhone 15 Pro.

zh.p:
一台iPhone手机，有灵动岛，开头显示的是正面，显示时间为9:41。

三个画面，是镜头逐渐拉近手机主体的三个不连续画面，每次拉近中心点都是屏幕上方的药丸型黑色灵动岛，在第三个画面结束时，视角进入这块药丸型黑色灵动的，随后，整个画面变成黑色。

在这一片黑色中，从底部缓慢升起一台金属边框的三个摄像头的iPhone，十分精美。随后，这台iPhone突然消失，留下一阵烟，和一串白色发光字体：Titanium，然后这串白色发光字体变成：iPhone 15 Pro。

en.p: 【Core Theme】 Realistic sci-fi tokusatsu, awakening on the battlefield, shattering of the dark smoke orb, black iron mecha dark knight, cinematic dark divinity 【Character Basic Setting】 100% realistic Korean male face, with knife wounds and bruises on the face, blood seeping from the corner of the mouth, eyes filled with extreme exhaustion and a burning will after despair. Worn black combat suit, fabric scorched at the edges by war flames, stained with dirt and dark red blood. Robust physique, kneeling on one knee gasping for breath, right hand tightly gripping a 'Dark Domain Orb' emitting surging dark purple smoke—inside the orb, a vortex of deep red and dark purple energy rotates, like a sealed black hole. 【Atmosphere and Image Quality】 Visual tone: cinematic quality, IMAX film camera, Panavision DXL2 lens, focal length 28mm, aperture f2.8 Color tone: dark orange·scorched black·dark purple as the main palette, flame backlighting outlines the silhouette, shadow details preserved with compression Style core: heavy industrial CG aesthetics, emphasizing the fusion of metallic texture and dark magic, as if reality is torn apart Special effects core: solidification and convergence of dark smoke particles, micro-animation of mecha interlocking, black flame diffusion, spatial tremor 【Camera Movement·FPV Extreme Handheld】 Full FPV first-person follow-shot feel, high-speed camera position switching, no stabilizer handheld Lens breathing sensation: simulating extreme follow-shooting by a battlefield photographer, intense tremor + rapid focus breathing Dynamic trajectory: extreme close-up impact → fast orbit → low-angle violent pull-back → battlefield panoramic dive 【Timeline·Storyboard】 0–3 seconds｜Battlefield Remnants Action: Battlefield ruins, a medieval fortress in blazing fire, corpses strewn across the field, thick smoke billowing, the blood-red sky torn by black clouds. The male lead kneels on one knee, his comrades fallen behind him, head lowered, hair stained with blood, right hand tightly gripping the Dark Domain Orb, the orb trembling, dark purple smoke seeping through his fingers. He slowly raises his head, his eyes shifting from despair to a burning resolve. Camera: FPV extremely low angle rushing toward the character, passing fallen soldiers, shaking to an extreme close-up of the face, capturing the moment of eye change. The camera shakes violently, as if handheld during the shockwaves of artillery fire. 3–6 seconds｜Orb Shattering·Awakening Ignition Action and Effects: The male lead grits his teeth, lets out a low roar, and suddenly crushes the orb with his right fist. The moment of shattering—a low energy explosion, as if an abyss has split open. A black-purple shockwave erupts outward from the character as the center, sending stones flying, flattening the surrounding flames before they violently rebound. Dark smoke particles surge from the fragments like living things, quickly wrapping around the right arm and spreading to the whole body. The male lead's pupils are replaced by dark red flames, a faint smile curls at the corner of his mouth, and a dark calm covers his exhaustion. Camera: The camera shakes violently and loses focus at the moment of the orb shattering, the shockwave sweeping over the lens causing chromatic aberration and distortion, then quickly correcting and orbiting around the right side at high speed. 6–9 seconds｜Tearing and Reconstruction·Pain of the Flesh Action: The male lead looks up, his brow tightly furrowed, enduring the forced rewriting of dark energy within his body. Effects Core: Dark metallic fragments burst from the skin surface, as if piercing outward from within Black liquid metal seeps from the spine, spreading along the body like molten dark iron Clothing is torn and stripped away, fabric fragments absorbed by the dark energy field and turned to ashes The dull sound of bone restructuring, dark purple electric arcs bursting from the joints A black-red glow emanates from within the chest, energy patterns appearing like cracks on the skin Camera: Handheld close-up follow-shot, frequent loss of focus and refocusing due to energy impact, simulating the effect of the photographer being pushed back by the airwave. 9–12 seconds｜Black Iron Mecha·Descent Assembly Armor Growth Effects (Ultra-Detailed): Torso armor: Black iron streamlined armor plates materialize from the dark smoke, with blood-red energy pattern reliefs, a surface texture like cooled lava cracks, dark purple energy light streams seeping from the gaps Shoulder armor: Massive spiked shoulder plates clash and interlock, bursting with black electric light, leaving permanent bite marks, the bone spikes on top of the shoulder armor slowly growing like living things Helmet covering: Black armor fragments spread from the neck upward to wrap the face, forming a pointed ghost king helmet shape as in the reference image—a sharp three-pronged crown piercing from the top, dark red light glowing through the helmet visor gaps, no transparent display, pure dark steel intimidation Battle cloak: A tattered black cloak automatically unfurls from the shoulder armor, like the silhouette of dark flame burning wings Micro-animation details: The spines at the armor joints tremble slightly to adjust, as if breathing; the corrosion patterns on the edges of each armor piece spread in real-time Atmosphere effects: At the moment of transformation completion, the blood and dust on the ground within a ten-meter radius are compressed into circular ripples by the black pressure field, and all surrounding flames turn into purple-black fire. Camera: Fast 360° low-angle orbit, the camera trembles in sync with each armor piece interlocking, as if the physical shockwave directly hits the camera. 12–15 seconds｜Completion·Battlefield Slaughter Final Form: Full set of black iron spiked mecha, Sauron-style ghost king design as in the reference image—three-pronged pointed helmet, giant blade shoulder armor, full-body dark heavy armor, blood-red energy patterns. Weapon Materialization: Hands open, dark smoke in the palms condenses and spins, instantly transforming into a giant black flame greatsword—the blade thick and wide, engraved with ancient curse patterns, black flames burning along the edge, occasionally bursting with dark purple lightning. Battlefield Slaughter Sequence (Quick Cuts): First slash: The greatsword sweeps horizontally, the airwave sending three enemy soldiers flying simultaneously, the camera FPV following the sword's trajectory Second slash: Upward thrust and pierce, the camera low-angle looking up as the blade slashes down, the shockwave blasting the ground Third slash: Spinning slash, the camera is rotated by the airwave, the frame spinning and destabilizing in sync The dark knight stops, standing among flames and fallen enemies, the black flame cloak billowing, dark red light from the helmet visor staring directly into the camera Final shot: Extremely low-angle looking up, the camera slowly pulls back, the dark knight stands majestically on the burning battlefield ruins, the black flame greatsword planted in the ground, flames reflecting off the black iron armor, the frame freezes.

zh.p:
【核心主题】

写实科幻特摄，战场觉醒，暗烟法球碎裂，黑铁机甲暗骑士，电影级黑暗神性

【人物基础设定】

100%真实韩国男性面孔，面部有刀伤与淤青，嘴角渗血，眼神中带着极度疲惫与绝望后的燃烧意志。黑色破损战斗服，布料被战火灼焦边缘，沾满泥土与暗红血迹。身形壮硕，单膝跪地喘息，右手紧握一颗散发翻涌暗紫黑烟的"暗域法球"——球体内部旋转着深红与暗紫的能量漩涡，如同被封印的黑洞。

【氛围与画质】

视觉基调：电影质感，IMAX胶片摄影机，Panavision DXL2镜头，焦段28mm，光圈f2.8

色彩影调：暗橙·焦黑·暗紫主调，火焰逆光打亮轮廓，暗部压缩保留细节

风格核心：重工业CG美学，强调金属质感与黑暗魔力的融合，仿佛现实撕裂

特效核心：暗烟粒子实体化汇聚、机甲咬合微动画、黑焰扩散、空间震颤

【运镜·FPV极限手持】

全程FPV第一人称跟拍感，高速机位切换，无稳定器手持

镜头呼吸感：模拟战场摄影师极限跟拍，剧烈震颤＋快速对焦呼吸感

动态轨迹：极近距特写冲击 → 快速绕轨 → 仰拍暴力拉远 → 战场全景俯冲

【时间轴·分镜】

0–3秒｜战场残存

动作： 战场废墟，烈火燃烧的中世纪要塞遗迹，尸横遍野，浓烟滚滚，血红天空被黑云撕裂。男主单膝跪地，身后战友已倒，他低垂着头，发丝沾血，右手死死捏着暗域法球，球体震颤，暗紫烟气从指缝渗出。他缓缓抬起头，眼神从绝望切换为燃烧。

镜头： FPV极低机位贴地冲向人物，经过倒地士兵，震颤推至面部极近特写，捕捉眼神变化瞬间。镜头抖动激烈，如同在炮击震波中手持拍摄。

3–6秒｜法球碎裂·觉醒引爆

动作与特效： 男主咬紧牙关，低吼一声，右拳猛然握碎法球。

碎裂瞬间——一声低沉的能量爆鸣，如同深渊裂开。黑紫色冲击波以人物为圆心向外炸裂扩散，地面石块被气浪掀飞，周围火焰被压平再暴力反弹。暗烟粒子如活物般从碎片中喷涌，迅速缠绕右臂向全身蔓延。

男主双眼瞳孔被暗红烈焰取代，嘴角微微上扬，一种黑暗的平静覆盖了疲惫。

镜头： 法球碎裂瞬间镜头猛烈震颤失焦，冲击波扫过镜头产生色差畸变，快速修正后绕右侧高速环轨一圈。

6–9秒｜撕裂与重构·肉身之痛

动作： 男主仰头，眉心死死锁紧，承受体内黑暗能量的强行重写。

特效核心：

皮肤表面迸射出暗色金属碎屑，如同从体内向外穿刺

黑色液态金属从脊柱处开始渗出，如融化的暗铁沿身体蔓延

衣物被撕裂抽离，布料碎片被黑色能量场吸附后化为灰烬

骨骼重组的闷响声，关节处迸发出暗紫电弧

胸腔内部透出黑红色光芒，皮肤如裂缝般显现能量纹路

镜头： 手持近身跟拍，因能量冲击频繁失焦再对焦，模拟摄影师被气浪推退的效果。

9–12秒｜黑铁机甲·降临组装

装甲生长特效（超细节）：

躯干甲：黑铁流线型装甲板从暗烟中实体化，带有血红能量纹路浮雕，表面如熔岩冷却的裂痕质感，缝隙中渗出暗紫能量光流

肩甲：巨大的锋刺肩甲对撞咬合，爆发黑色电光，留下永久咬合齿痕，肩甲顶端的骨刺如活物般缓慢生长

头盔覆盖：黑色装甲碎片从颈部向上蔓延包裹面部，形成参考图中的尖顶鬼王头盔造型——尖锐的三叉王冠从顶部刺出，面甲缝隙透出暗红眼光，无任何透明显示屏，纯粹的黑暗钢铁威压

战斗披风：黑色残破披风从肩甲处自动展开，如同暗焰燃烧的翅膀轮廓

微动画细节：装甲接缝处的棘刺微微震颤调整，如同呼吸；每块甲片边缘的腐蚀纹路实时蔓延

氛围特效： 变身完成瞬间，方圆十米地面上的血迹与尘土被黑色威压气场压成环形波纹，周围火焰全部变色为紫黑色火焰。

镜头： 快速环绕360°低角度轨道，装甲每一块咬合时镜头同步震颤，如同物理冲击波直接打在摄影机上。

12–15秒｜完成·战场屠戮

最终形态： 全套黑铁尖刺机甲，参考图中索伦式鬼王造型——三叉尖顶头盔，巨型锋刃肩甲，全身暗黑重甲，血红能量纹路。

武器具象化： 双手张开，掌心暗烟凝聚旋转，瞬间化作一把巨型黑焰大剑——剑身宽厚，刻满古老诅咒纹路，黑焰沿剑刃燃烧，偶尔迸出暗紫闪电。

战场屠戮序列（快剪）：

第一斩：大剑横扫，气浪将三名敌兵同时击飞，镜头FPV跟随剑轨运动

第二斩：仰冲刺穿，镜头贴地仰拍剑刃向下劈落，冲击波炸开地面

第三斩：旋转斩击，摄影机被气浪旋转带动，画面同步旋转失稳

暗骑士停步，站立于火焰与倒伏敌兵之间，黑焰披风翻卷，头盔缝隙透出暗红眼光直视镜头

最终镜头： 极低角度仰拍，镜头缓慢向后拉远，暗骑士巍然伫立于燃烧的战场废墟之上，黑焰大剑插地，火焰映照黑铁甲身，画面定格。

氛围特效： 变身完成瞬间，方圆十米地面上的血迹与尘土被黑色威压气场压成环形波纹，周围火焰全部变色为紫黑色火焰。

镜头： 快速环绕360°低角度轨道，装甲每一块咬合时镜头同步震颤，如同物理冲击波直接打在摄影机上。

12–15秒｜完成·战场屠戮

最终形态： 全套黑铁尖刺机甲，参考图中索伦式鬼王造型——三叉尖顶头盔，巨型锋刃肩甲，全身暗黑重甲，血红能量纹路。

武器具象化： 双手张开，掌心暗烟凝聚旋转，瞬间化作一把巨型黑焰大剑——剑身宽厚，刻满古老诅咒纹路，黑焰沿剑刃燃烧，偶尔迸出暗紫闪电。

战场屠戮序列（快剪）：

第一斩：大剑横扫，气浪将三名敌兵同时击飞，镜头FPV跟随剑轨运动

第二斩：仰冲刺穿，镜头贴地仰拍剑刃向下劈落，冲击波炸开地面

第三斩：旋转斩击，摄影机被气浪旋转带动，画面同步旋转失稳

暗骑士停步，站立于火焰与倒伏敌兵之间，黑焰披风翻卷，头盔缝隙透出暗红眼光直视镜头

最终镜头： 极低角度仰拍，镜头缓慢向后拉远，暗骑士巍然伫立于燃烧的战场废墟之上，黑焰大剑插地，火焰映照黑铁甲身，画面定格。

en.p:
A colossal ocean leviathan, 300 meters long with armored whale-like plating and luminous bioluminescent currents flowing through translucent fins, rises from the deep ocean just offshore of a megacity harbor — hook at second two: the creature breaches vertically through the water, displacing millions of tons of ocean in a single eruption.

The harbor instantly becomes a hydraulic disaster.

A wall of water surges outward from the breach point.

The destruction is tidal and structural: container ships lift like toys in the surge, harbor cranes snap as their bases flood, and seawalls crumble under the sudden pressure of displaced ocean mass.

Each movement of the leviathan generates secondary tidal waves.

Entire docks tear free from their foundations.

The gauntlet progresses inland through a waterfront district consumed by the surge: port infrastructure ripped apart → cargo ships sliding through city streets → mid-rise buildings collapsing as floodwater erodes their foundations.

Oil storage tanks rupture.

Ferries crash into office towers.

Chase-cam skimming just above the floodwater as the leviathan swims through partially submerged streets.

Velocity ramp when the creature’s tail strike generates a secondary megawave that overtops the entire harbor barrier.

Cut to aerial: half the coastal district now underwater.

The leviathan circles within the newly formed inland sea.

Diegetic deep-ocean bioluminescence reflecting through floodwater and shattered glass, cinematic water displacement physics, massive volumetric spray and debris simulation, 4K.

zh.p: 一头长达300米的巨型海洋巨兽，身披鲸类般的装甲鳞甲，半透明鳍翼上流淌着发光的生物电流，从超级都市港口近海深处缓缓升起——第二秒的关键时刻：这头巨兽垂直破水而出，一次腾跃便排开数百万吨海水。港口瞬间沦为水力灾难现场。一道水墙从破水点向外狂涌。毁灭性的潮汐与结构破坏接踵而至：集装箱船在巨浪中如玩具般被抛起，港区起重机因基座被淹而拦腰折断，海堤在海水位移的骤然压力下崩塌。巨兽的每个动作都引发次生潮汐波。整座码头被连根拔起。灾难浪潮向内陆推进，席卷滨水城区：港口基础设施四分五裂→货轮滑入城市街道→洪水侵蚀地基导致中层建筑接连倒塌。储油罐相继爆裂。渡轮撞入办公大楼。追拍镜头紧贴洪水表面，跟随巨兽游过半淹的街道。当巨兽尾击掀起第二波超级巨浪漫过整座港口防波堤时，画面速度骤然提升。切至航拍视角：沿海区域半数已没入水下。巨兽在新形成的内海中盘旋。源自深海的生物荧光透过洪水和碎玻璃折射，电影级水体位移特效，海量体积化水雾与碎片模拟，4K画质。

en.p: "Generate a cinematic, large-scale action long take animation. Theme: A Chinese youth flies a kite through crowded streets, leaps up steps, flips and lands, dashes toward a high platform, and executes a difficult jump. The drumbeat erupts the moment he lands. One single continuous shot throughout, no cuts, fluid movements, clear weight, inertia, and landing cushioning. Style transition: 0–5s: Clear, highly saturated yet controlled Makoto Shinkai style, with moist reflections. 6–10s: Ink wash explosion; background buildings simplified with ink strokes, speed lines in dry-brush splatter style, drumbeats visualized as ink shockwaves. The protagonist and kite must remain clearly defined. 4K video, American military marching band with over 50 members parading on campus, sunny weather. Band in formal dark blue military uniforms with golden epaulets, marching in neat formation. Brass players perform classic military marches, drummers play steady rhythms, conductor leads with a baton. Background: cheering students, American flags, ancient red-brick campus buildings. Camera: dynamic tracking, alternating wide and medium shots, smooth movement. Audio: stereo brass melodies, drumbeats, crowd cheers. Atmosphere: bright, energetic, patriotic, warm sunlight tones."
en.t: Kite Flight Through Ink and Brass

zh.p: 生成一段电影级、大规模动作长镜头动画。主题：一名中国少年在拥挤的街道上放风筝，跃上台阶，翻腾落地，冲向高台，完成一次高难度跳跃。落地瞬间鼓声炸裂。全程一镜到底，无剪辑，动作流畅，体现清晰的重量感、惯性和落地缓冲。风格转换：0-5秒：新海诚风格，画面清澈、高饱和度但克制，带有湿润的反光。6-10秒：水墨爆发；背景建筑简化为水墨笔触，速度线以干笔飞白风格呈现，鼓声具象化为水墨冲击波。主角和风筝必须保持清晰可辨。4K视频，美国军乐队（50人以上）在校园中游行，天气晴朗。乐队身着深蓝色正式军服，配金色肩章，队列整齐。铜管乐手演奏经典军乐，鼓手敲击稳定节奏，指挥手持指挥棒引领。背景：欢呼的学生、美国国旗、古老的红砖校园建筑。镜头：动态跟拍，交替使用全景和中景，运动流畅。音频：立体声铜管旋律、鼓点、人群欢呼。氛围：明亮、充满活力、爱国、温暖的阳光色调。

A high-end luxury skincare commercial with an ultra-premium visual style. The product must precisely match the provided reference image in terms of bottle shape, label details, liquid color, reflections, and overall design. The bottle is positioned upright at the exact center of the frame, placed on a glossy liquid surface with smooth, elegant ripples. Delicate fluid splashes rise around the base, forming a refined crown-like shape that reflects light like crystal.
The background features a soft, dreamy gradient transitioning from pastel aqua to gentle lavender, creating a silky, creamy ambiance with faint floating mist particles. The camera executes a slow, seamless 360-degree cinematic orbit around the product, maintaining a constant speed with no shaking, zooming, or variation in motion. The bottle remains perfectly centered, vertical, and completely stable throughout, captured in a mid close-up beauty composition as the primary focal point.
Lighting is crafted in a premium studio style, delivering soft diffused illumination, subtle highlights, glossy reflections, and a gentle rim light to define the bottle’s edges. The glass and liquid appear luminous, hydrated, and smooth. The overall mood is elegant, sensual, and sophisticated—true to a luxury beauty campaign—featuring cinematic depth of field, polished textures, soft reflections, and a slow-motion aesthetic in 4K photorealistic quality.

zh.p: 一支高端奢华护肤广告，采用超高级视觉风格。产品必须与提供的参考图像在瓶身形状、标签细节、液体颜色、反光及整体设计上完全一致。瓶子垂直立于画面正中央，置于光滑的液体表面，水面泛起优雅细腻的涟漪。瓶底周围升腾起精致的水花，形成优雅的皇冠状造型，如水晶般折射光芒。背景呈现柔和梦幻的渐变，从淡雅水蓝色过渡到温柔薰衣草紫，营造丝滑奶油般的氛围，伴有朦胧飘浮的微粒。镜头围绕产品进行缓慢、无缝的360度电影级环绕拍摄，保持恒定速度，无抖动、缩放或运动变化。瓶子始终完美居中、垂直且完全稳定，以中近景美妆构图作为主要焦点。灯光采用高级影棚风格，呈现柔和漫射照明、微妙高光、镜面反光及柔和边缘光勾勒瓶身轮廓。玻璃与液体呈现晶莹、水润、丝滑质感。整体氛围优雅、感性且精致——符合奢华美妆广告调性——具备电影级景深、抛光质感、柔和反光，以及4K超写实画质的慢动作美学。

en.p: Format: 15 seconds / single continuous shot / cinematic realism / no cuts, oppressive and heavy suspense, post-war ember ambient sound design. Scene Description: A battlefield where the flames of war have just been extinguished, with low visibility and air thick with choking smoke and lingering burnt odor. The ground is soaked with blood and fire, littered with broken flags, shattered weapons, and layers of fallen soldiers' bones. A warrior in tattered armor kneels alone amidst the chaos, a spear thrust into the blood-soaked earth supporting his body, his armor stained with blood and soot, his frame seemingly on the verge of collapsing from cold and exhaustion. The audience should feel a strong sense of desolation, suffocation, and tension as if shrouded in darkness, as though the war has ended but a more terrifying threat still lurks in the shadows. The entire segment must be presented with an uninterrupted, stealthy camera movement. Timeline: 0:00-0:04 | Setup: A low-angle stealth tracking shot moves through dense smoke and scattered embers. The lens is constantly hit by flying charcoal particles and dust, creating flickering visual obstructions. The camera glides past a tattered battle flag stained with blood and mud, bearing a faded unit insignia, then reveals a silhouette stacked under the ashes: an armor pierced by arrows, a helmet half-buried in the soil. The overall composition exhibits David Fincher-style precise control and informational restraint. Sound Effects: Roaring remnants of fire, harsh scraping of soot against metal, distant lingering explosions. 0:04-0:10 | Escalation: The camera turns right, focusing on a kneeling armored warrior. Using the spear thrust into the ground as a pivot, he remains motionless at first, only heavy breaths emitting white mist in the cold. The tattered battle robe whips violently in the cold wind, blood and soot on the armor cracking and falling off with his trembling. The camera slowly approaches and circles behind him with almost imperceptible precision, continuously tightening the frame, refusing to offer any sense of security. Sound Effects: Heavy breathing, creaking armor, violent whipping of the battle robe, faint collisions of debris buried under the soil in the wind. 0:10-0:15 | Climax: Over the warrior's shoulder, the smoke briefly thins, and a massive figure with an incredibly heavy force passes through the black curtain, its full form never fully revealed. The warrior senses the threat, looks up in fear, breathing rapidly, gripping the spear handle tightly, then forcefully pulls it out. The action of pulling the spear kicks up soil and embers toward the lens, and at that moment, the giant creature's outline becomes momentarily clearer. Sound Effects: Heavy footsteps, sudden drop in wind and smoke sounds, rapid intake of breath, sharp sound of steel breaking free from blood-soaked earth, explosive scattering of soil and ashes.

zh.p:
格式： 15秒 / 一镜到底 / 电影级写实 / 无剪辑、压抑且沉重的悬疑感、战后余烬环境音效设计 

场景描述： 战火刚刚熄灭的战场，能见度低，空气中弥漫着呛人的浓烟和未散去的焦味。地面被鲜血和战火浸透，满是破碎的旗帜、折断的兵器和层叠的战殁将士尸骨。一名身穿残破盔甲的将士，独自跪在一片狼藉之中，长枪插在血土中支撑着身体，盔甲上沾满血迹和烟灰，他的身躯仿佛随时会因寒冷和疲惫而倒下。观众应感受到强烈的凄凉感、窒息感以及仿佛被黑暗笼罩的紧张感，仿佛战火虽然熄灭，但某种更可怕的威胁仍在暗处潜伏。整个片段必须以一段不间断的、带有潜行感的运镜呈现。

 时间轴： 
0:00-0:04 | 铺垫： 低角度的潜行视角追踪镜头，穿过浓密的硝烟和零星的余烬。镜头不断被飞扬的焦炭颗粒和灰尘击中，形成忽明忽暗的视觉遮蔽。相机滑过一面沾满鲜血和泥土、印有残缺番号的破烂战旗，随后揭示出灰烬下堆叠的轮廓：一具被箭矢刺穿的铠甲，一个被半埋在土里的头盔。整体构图呈现出大卫·芬奇式的精准控制与信息留白。 音效： 狂暴的烈火残留声、烟灰摩擦金属的刺耳声、远方未散去的爆炸残响。

 0:04-0:10 | 升级： 镜头向右转动，聚焦于一名跪地的装甲将士。他以插入地面的长枪为支点，起初一动不动，唯有沉重的呼吸在寒冷中呼出白气。残破的战袍在寒风中剧烈抽打，铠甲上的血迹和烟灰随着身体的颤抖而碎裂脱落。镜头以几乎不可察觉的精度缓慢逼近并绕至其身后，不断收紧框架，拒绝提供任何安全感。 音效： 粗重的呼吸声、盔甲的嘎吱声、战袍剧烈的抽打声、埋在土下的残骸在风中发出的微小碰撞声。

 0:10-0:15 | 高潮： 越过将士肩膀，烟雾短暂变稀，一个庞大的身影带着沉重得不可思议的力量穿过黑色帷幕，其全貌始终未曾完全显露。将士感知到了威胁，恐惧地抬起头，呼吸急促，双手紧握枪柄，随后猛力拔出长枪。拔枪的动作将泥土和余烬扬起并甩向镜头，此时巨兽的轮廓在瞬间变得更加清晰。 音效： 沉重的踩踏声、烟雾风声骤降、急促的吸气声、钢铁挣脱血土的尖锐声、泥土和灰烬爆裂四散声。

 0:10-0:15 | 高潮： 越过将士肩膀，烟雾短暂变稀，一个庞大的身影带着沉重得不可思议的力量穿过黑色帷幕，其全貌始终未曾完全显露。将士感知到了威胁，恐惧地抬起头，呼吸急促，双手紧握枪柄，随后猛力拔出长枪。拔枪的动作将泥土和余烬扬起并甩向镜头，此时巨兽的轮廓在瞬间变得更加清晰。 音效： 沉重的踩踏声、烟雾风声骤降、急促的吸气声、钢铁挣脱血土的尖锐声、泥土和灰烬爆裂四散声。

Shot 1 (0-3 seconds): Medium shot + low-angle shot, the fairy hovers in mid-air, robes fluttering, hands rapidly forming seals, chanting: "Boundless Heaven and Earth—" The background is a gloomy sky, with distant black-clad enemies arrayed in formation, the camera slowly moving up from the enemy front to the fairy. 2. Shot 2 (3-6 seconds): Close-up + orbiting shot, the fairy's hand seals accelerate, fingertips glowing purple, continuing: "Borrowing the Power of the Universe!" Countless sword shadows instantly appear in the sky, initially rotating slowly, the camera orbits the fairy to capture the seal changes, the sword group gradually accelerating with the incantation. 3. Shot 3 (6-10 seconds): Full shot + diving camera movement, purple lightning tears through the clouds at the center of the sword group, thunder roars, the rotation speed breaks the limit, forming a vortex of light. The fairy's arm swings down sharply, the sword group pours down like a purple dragon swarm, the camera follows the dive, light and shadow tracking the blade trajectories. 4. Shot 4 (10-15 seconds): Wide-angle full shot, the black-clad enemies raise a massive black light shield to defend, the sword group crashes into the shield, triggering chain explosions, flames and purple light interweave, gale winds stir up dust across the battlefield, as the shield shatters, the camera pulls back to reveal the explosive light and shadow effects between heaven and earth.

zh.p:
仙子外貌特征参考@【@图1】
1. 镜头1（0-3秒）：中景+仰拍，仙子悬浮空中，衣袂翻飞，双手开始快速结印，口中念：“天地无极——” 背景是阴沉天空，远处黑衣敌人阵列严阵以待，运镜从敌人阵前缓缓上移至仙子。
2. 镜头2（3-6秒）：特写+环绕，仙子结印手势加速，指尖泛紫光，续念：“乾坤借法！” 天空中瞬间浮现无数剑影，初始缓慢旋转，镜头环绕仙子捕捉印诀变化，剑群随咒语逐渐加速。
3. 镜头3（6-10秒）：全景+俯冲运镜，剑群中心紫色闪电撕裂云层，雷声轰鸣，旋转速度突破极限形成光涡。仙子手臂猛地下挥，剑群如紫色龙群倾泻而下，镜头跟随剑群俯冲，光影追踪剑刃轨迹。
4. 镜头4（10-15秒）：广角全景，黑衣敌人撑起巨大黑色光盾抵挡，剑群撞击光盾引发连环爆炸，火光与紫光交织，狂风卷着尘土弥漫战场，光盾碎裂瞬间，镜头拉远展现天地间炸裂的光影特效。

en.p: Preset scene: The sword bearer stands on a mountain peak above the clouds, with the sunset clouds surging like vast rivers and seas below, and the wind blowing through strands of hair and white robes. 【0-2s】 Action: The sword bearer stands still on a bluestone slab at the cliff's edge, holding the sword handle in reverse with the right hand, the blade pointing diagonally down at the sea of clouds, with an aura of restrained energy. Camera: An ultra-wide-angle lens slowly tilts up from a low angle, capturing a full view of the steep cliff, rolling sea of clouds, and the sword bearer, with dark, cool tones creating a solemn atmosphere. Scene: The cliff edge is lined with ancient, gnarled pine trees, their branches wildly swaying in the mountain wind, clouds churning beneath the feet, and occasionally an eagle circling in the sea of clouds. 【2-4s】 Action: The sword bearer pushes off with the right foot, darting out like an arrow while drawing the sword from its sheath, the sword following the body in a sweeping semicircular arc. Camera: A tracking shot rapidly advances with a slight rotation, capturing the cold gleam of the blade as it leaves the sheath, with motion blur enhancing the sense of speed. Scene: Sword energy tears through the clouds, forming irregular air currents, and stones on the cliff are knocked loose by the footsteps, falling into the sea of clouds and disappearing. 【4-6s】 Action: The body leaps into the air, the left hand forming a sword gesture pointing to the sky, the right hand slashing horizontally with the sword, the move forceful and powerful. Camera: A drone circles from the side to capture the moment of the mid-air slash, slowing down by 0.5 seconds to highlight the sharpness of the sword's momentum. Scene: The clouds in the air are shattered by the sword energy, forming ring-shaped mist clusters, with distant snow-capped mountains faintly visible in the clouds, their peaks glittering under the sunlight. 【6-8s】 After landing, the left toe touches the ground, the body spins 360 degrees, the sword following the rotation, with layers of sword flowers blooming. Camera: A circular tracking shot follows closely, with rapid zoom to capture details of the sword flowers, and slight camera shake to enhance the impact of the spin. Scene: The air currents from the spin stir up pine needles, intertwining with the clouds, and snow on the cliff is churned into snow mist by the rotating sword energy. 【8-10s】 Action: The sword is transferred to the left hand, the right hand forms a palm and pushes forward, while the left foot steps forward, the sword thrusting straight ahead following the palm's momentum. Camera: A close-up shot focuses on the sword tip, advancing from the tip's perspective to show the swift speed of the thrust. Scene: The sword tip pierces through the clouds, with clouds condensing into water droplets at the tip, and the faint outline of a floating fairy island visible in the sea of clouds ahead. 【10-12.5s】 Action: The sword is sheathed at the waist, the body drifts backward, the right foot drawing an arc on the bluestone slab, leaving a shallow mark. Camera: The lens pulls back from a full view, gradually narrowing, capturing the drifting trajectory and the mark on the slab, with dark tones highlighting the ethereal feel of the movement. Scene: The air currents from the drifting cause the pine branches to shake violently, the sound of pine waves echoing in the valley, and the sea of clouds stirred into layers of ripples. 【12.5-15s】 Action: The moment the right foot lands, the sword is drawn again, lifting upward in a graceful and agile move. Camera: A low-angle upward shot follows the sword's movement, slowing down the moment of the lift to emphasize the agility of the move. Scene: Sword energy lifts the clouds above, forming a misty curtain, with faint rosy light shining through the sky behind the curtain.

zh.p: 预设场景：持剑人站在云层之上的山巅，下面日落云霞翻涌如涛涛江海，风吹的的发丝和白衣飞舞。 【0-2s】动作：持剑人于悬崖之巅的青石板上静立，右手反握剑柄，剑身斜指下方云海，周身气息内敛。镜头：超广角镜头从低角度缓缓上摇，全景展现悬崖峭壁、翻腾云海与持剑人，暗调冷色营造肃杀氛围。场景：悬崖边缘布满苍劲古松，松枝被山风吹得狂舞，云雾在脚下翻涌，偶尔有雄鹰在云海间盘旋 【2-4s】动作：持剑人右脚蹬地，身形如箭窜出，同时拔剑出鞘，剑随身走，划出一道半圆弧线。镜头：跟拍镜头极速推进，伴随轻微旋转，捕捉剑身出鞘瞬间的寒芒，运动模糊强化速度感。场景：剑气撕裂云雾，形成不规则气流，悬崖上的碎石被脚步震落，坠入云海消失不见 【4-6s】动作：身形腾空，左手剑诀指天，右手剑横向劈出，剑招刚劲有力 无人机从侧面环绕拍摄，定格空中劈剑的瞬间，慢放0.5秒凸显剑势凌厉。场景：空中云雾被剑气搅碎，形成环形雾团，远处的雪山在云雾中若隐若现，山顶积雪在阳光下闪耀 【6-8s】落地后左脚尖点地，身形旋转360度，剑随身旋，剑花层层绽放。镜头：环形环绕镜头贴身跟拍，快速变焦捕捉剑花细节，镜头微震强化旋转冲击力。场景：旋转带起的气流卷动松针，松针与云雾交织飞舞，悬崖上的积雪被旋转剑气搅出雪雾 【8-10s】动作：剑交左手，右手化掌推出，同时左脚前踏，剑随掌势直刺前方。镜头：特写镜头聚焦剑尖，从剑尖视角向前推进，展现直刺的迅猛速度。场景：剑尖刺破云雾，云雾在剑尖凝结成水滴，前方的云海中隐约可见一座悬浮的仙岛轮廓 【10-12.5s】动作：收剑于腰侧，身形向后飘退，右脚在青石板上划出一道弧线，留下浅浅痕迹。镜头：拉远镜头从全景逐渐缩小，捕捉飘退轨迹与石板痕迹，暗调光影突出身形飘逸感。场景：飘退带起的气流吹得松枝剧烈晃动，松涛声在山谷中回荡，云海被气流搅出层层涟漪 【12.5-15s】动作：右脚落地瞬间，剑再次出鞘，向上撩起，剑招灵动飘逸。镜头：低角度仰拍镜头，跟随剑势向上移动，慢放剑撩起的瞬间，凸显剑招灵动。场景：剑气将上方的云雾向上挑起，形成一道雾帘，雾帘后的天空透出淡淡的霞光

en.p: Character setting: @Male Lead, modern attire (black trench coat or dark long coat, naturally tousled hair), cold and domineering temperament, eyes sharp as blades, maintaining character consistency throughout. 0–3s: Extreme close-up of the face, @Male Lead stands atop a snowy mountain peak, the biting wind stirring his hair and coat hem, left hand behind his back, right hand slowly raised pointing to the sky, the camera locks onto his eyes—shifting from calm to explosive, with rolling thunderclouds reflected in his pupils, his lips clearly forming the roar 'Sword, come!', the sound and image synchronizing with impact, volumetric light piercing through cloud gaps to strike his face, creating a strong silhouette. 3–7s: The camera rapidly and seamlessly zooms out to a God's-eye view, the figure of @Male Lead on the snowy peak quickly shrinking to a black dot at the center of the frame, the camera continues pulling back to reveal a grand panoramic view of a modern city—skyscrapers, overpasses, neon lights all in sight, the entire city under thunderclouds in a tense and oppressive atmosphere, rolling thunder and lightning, the sky displaying a cold, steel-like texture. 7–12s: Thousands of swords burst forth from all corners of the city—piercing through glass curtain walls, stabbing through asphalt roads, soaring up from subway platforms—tens of thousands of swords swirling and gathering in the thunderous sky, their blades reflecting cold white light in the flashes, epic in scale and shocking, the camera cuts from the overhead view to a mid-shot of @Male Lead, standing unmoved at the center of the storm, his coat wildly flapping in the gale, his eyes staring straight ahead with a domineering roar, his right hand pointing into the distance, countless swords whistling away with his gesture. 12–15s: The camera slowly pushes in for a full back view of @Male Lead, standing on the snowy peak overlooking the spectacular scene of ten thousand swords returning to their positions, volumetric light bursting and pouring from the dark clouds, striking his shoulders and back to form a strong rim light, he slowly turns his head, his profile sharply defined in the interplay of lightning and volumetric light, his lips clearly and deeply uttering: 'If Heaven had not given birth to Zhongni, the ages would be an eternal night.' As the words fall, the frame freezes, ten thousand swords hang motionless in the air, all around falls into dead silence, only the wind on the snowy mountain and the distant echoes of thunder lingering. Image specifications: 8K ultra-high definition, cold blue-gray steel tones, cinematic lighting, volumetric light effects throughout, film grain, hardcore modern martial arts style, epic scale, realistic style.

zh.p:
人物设定：@男主，现代装束（黑色风衣或深色长款外套，发型自然凌乱），气质冷峻霸道，眼神如刃，全程保持角色一致性。

0–3s：极致面部特写，@男主立于雪山之巅，凛冽寒风吹动发丝与风衣衣角，左手负于身后，右手缓缓抬起指向苍天，镜头锁定他的眼睛——眼神从冷静到爆发，瞳孔中倒映着翻滚雷云，嘴型清晰怒吼「剑来！」二字，声音与画面同步震撼，体积光从云层缝隙穿透打在他脸上，轮廓感极强。

3–7s：镜头以极速无缝广角推远切换至上帝俯瞰视角，雪山之巅的@男主身影迅速缩小至画面中心一个黑点，镜头持续拉远展现宏伟现代都市全景——摩天大楼、立交桥、霓虹灯尽收眼底，整座城市在雷云笼罩下气氛压抑震撼，雷云滚滚电闪雷鸣，天空呈现冷青钢铁质感。

7–12s：万千长剑从城市各处破空飞出——穿透玻璃幕墙、刺穿柏油路面、从地铁站台腾空而起，数以万计的长剑在雷云翻滚的天空中盘旋聚集，剑身在电光中反射出冷白光芒，规模史诗震撼，镜头从俯瞰切回@男主中景，他立于风暴中心岿然不动，风衣在狂风中剧烈翻飞，眼神直视前方霸气咆哮，右手指向远处，无数长剑随他的动作呼啸而去。

12–15s：镜头缓慢推近@男主背影全景，他站在雪山之巅俯瞰万剑归位的壮观景象，体积光从乌云中爆裂倾泻，打在他的肩背上形成强烈轮廓光，他缓缓转头，侧脸在电光与体积光的交织中轮廓分明，嘴型清晰低沉吐出：「天不生仲尼，万古如长夜。」话音落下，画面定格，万剑悬停于空中纹丝不动，四周陷入死寂，唯有雪山风声与远处雷鸣余震回荡。

画面规格：8K超高清，冷青钢铁色调，电影级光影，体积光效果贯穿全程，电影胶片颗粒，硬核现代武林风，史诗级规模，写实风格。

12–15s：镜头缓慢推近@男主背影全景，他站在雪山之巅俯瞰万剑归位的壮观景象，体积光从乌云中爆裂倾泻，打在他的肩背上形成强烈轮廓光，他缓缓转头，侧脸在电光与体积光的交织中轮廓分明，嘴型清晰低沉吐出：「天不生仲尼，万古如长夜。」话音落下，画面定格，万剑悬停于空中纹丝不动，四周陷入死寂，唯有雪山风声与远处雷鸣余震回荡。

画面规格：8K超高清，冷青钢铁色调，电影级光影，体积光效果贯穿全程，电影胶片颗粒，硬核现代武林风，史诗级规模，写实风格。

en.p: Create a 16:9 ultra-cinematic ultra-realistic video of an old pickup truck rumbling down a dusty desert highway at sunset. A young male driver inside suddenly pretends to see danger and slams the brakes in panic. The truck’s front grille suddenly starts glowing bright cyan. The camera orbits 360° smoothly around the entire truck while it violently transforms into a massive stone mech rhino. Use seamless multi-shot sequences: wheels and suspension split and extend into four powerful armored legs with glowing cyan joints and crushing hooves (low orbit), main body chassis expands into a colossal stone-plated torso with twisting mechanical rings (side orbit), cab and hood reassemble into a fierce rhino head with glowing headlights as eyes and a massive horn (front orbit), bed and tailgate morph into thick spiked armor plates and a dripping mechanical tongue inside the giant maw (overhead spiraling orbit). The creature aggressively ejects the driver from the cab, catches him mid-air with its horn, then places him securely on its back where he stands firm holding glowing railings. It strikes a powerful roaring pose while charging forward and spitting dust and sparks. The transformation is chaotic and aggressive — constant twisting, wheels spinning in sand, metal and stone cracking with flying sparks, steam venting from valves, windows and tires staying visibly intact. Epic Hollywood VFX, heavy cinematic film grain, photorealistic dusty stone and metal textures, volumetric god rays through sunset dust, dramatic lens flares, intense shocking background music, epic tone. smooth and seamlessly transition , hollywood style VFX and award winner direction
en.t: Desert Truck Becomes Stone Mech Rhino

zh.p: 制作一段16:9超影院级超写实视频：一辆老旧皮卡在日落时分的尘土沙漠公路上颠簸行驶。车内年轻男司机突然假装看到危险，惊慌猛踩刹车。卡车前格栅骤然亮起亮青色光芒。镜头以360°平滑环绕整车，车辆剧烈变形为巨型石质机械犀牛。采用无缝多镜头序列：车轮与悬挂分裂延展成四只强力装甲腿，带有亮青色关节与粉碎性蹄足（低空环绕）；主车架底盘扩展为覆盖石板的庞大躯干，机械环状结构旋转扭动（侧向环绕）；驾驶室与引擎盖重组为凶悍犀牛头部，车灯化作发光双眼，巨型独角耸立（正面环绕）；货箱与尾板变形为厚重尖刺装甲板，巨颚内垂落滴液的机械舌头（顶部螺旋环绕）。机械兽粗暴弹出驾驶员，用独角凌空接住，将其稳稳置于背部——青年紧握发光护栏屹立。巨兽摆出咆哮姿态向前冲锋，喷吐尘土与火花。变形过程混乱暴烈：部件持续扭转，车轮在沙中空转，金属与岩石迸裂飞溅火花，阀门喷涌蒸汽，车窗与轮胎始终清晰可见。史诗级好莱坞视效，厚重电影颗粒感，照片级尘土与金属纹理，日落尘埃中体积光柱倾泻，戏剧性镜头光晕，震撼冲击配乐，史诗基调。流畅无缝转场，好莱坞级特效与获奖级导演手法。

en.p: Stop-motion clay animation with handcrafted tactile materials and real fabric, set under warm afternoon park lighting. Wide shot: a clay figure with a matchbox head and a clay figure with a lit candle head sit together on a real tiny park bench, mid-conversation. The candle flame flickers gently, the matchbox drawer is slightly open, and they appear close and relaxed. [cut] A distant rumble. Both heads turn. [cut] Close-up: a clay figure with a fire extinguisher head rolls in on a real tiny motorcycle, pressure gauge redlined, nozzle tilted back, and one hand loose on the handlebar. He stops and says nothing. [cut] Close-up of the candle head: the flame doubles in size instantly and wax drips straight down. [cut] Wide shot: the candle stands up, smooths her skirt, and gets on the back of the motorcycle without looking back. The motorcycle pulls away. [cut] Close-up of the matchbox head: alone on the bench, the little drawer slides open and all the matches slowly fall out one by one onto the ground.

zh.p: 手工触感材料与真实布料制成的定格黏土动画，场景设定在温暖午后的公园灯光下。全景镜头：一个火柴盒脑袋的黏土人偶与一个头顶点燃蜡烛的黏土人偶并肩坐在真实的小公园长椅上，正聊着天。烛火轻轻摇曳，火柴盒抽屉微微敞开，两人显得亲密而放松。[切换]远处传来隆隆声。两个脑袋同时转向。[切换]特写镜头：一个头顶灭火器的黏土人偶骑着真实的小摩托车驶来，压力表指针飙红，喷嘴向后倾斜，一只手松松地搭在车把上。他停下车，一言不发。[切换]烛火人偶的特写：火焰瞬间膨胀一倍，蜡泪直直滴落。[切换]全景镜头：蜡烛人偶站起身，抚平裙摆，头也不回地坐上摩托车后座。摩托车扬长而去。[切换]火柴盒人偶的特写：独自坐在长椅上，小抽屉缓缓滑开，所有火柴一根接一根地掉落到地上。

en.p:
A dramatic sports sequence begins on a lush, windswept coastal cliff during a violent rainstorm. A golfer in bright yellow rain gear stands on the tee box, gripping a driver. His stance is planted firmly, eyes locked on a distant green across a churning ocean cove.

As he swings, the clubhead connects with a resounding crack, launching the dimpled white ball into the stormy sky. The camera immediately accelerates and locks onto the golf ball mid-flight.

The camera tracks directly behind the spinning sphere, maintaining perfect alignment as it cuts through the driving rain. The ocean waves and dark clouds become a streaking motion blur while the ball remains sharp and centered.

The howling wind roars as the projectile travels straight and true. The manicured green grows rapidly larger. In the final seconds, the camera closes in tightly as the ball strikes the turf. End on an extreme close-up of the ball ripping through the wet grass, throwing up a spray of dirt before dropping perfectly into the cup.

zh.p: 一场激烈的体育比赛场景在狂风暴雨中展开，地点是草木茂盛、海风呼啸的悬崖之巅。一位身着亮黄色雨衣的高尔夫球手站在发球台上，紧握一号木杆。他双脚稳稳扎地，目光锁定在波涛汹涌的海湾对面那片遥远的果岭上。挥杆之际，杆头与球碰撞发出清脆的爆裂声，将布满凹痕的白色小球送入暴风雨的天空。镜头随即加速，紧紧锁定飞行中的高尔夫球。摄像机从旋转的球体正后方追踪，在穿过倾盆大雨时始终保持完美对齐。海浪与乌云化作流动的模糊影像，而球体则清晰居中。呼啸的狂风咆哮着，而球体笔直精准地向前飞去。修剪整齐的果岭迅速放大。最后几秒，镜头急剧拉近，捕捉到球撞击草地的瞬间。最终以极端特写镜头收尾：球撕裂湿漉漉的草皮，溅起一片泥土，随后完美落入球洞。

en.p:
Subject/Character:
A warrior wearing a sleek black combat outfit with subtle crimson accents, gripping an elegant black katana that emits a faint red energy glow.

Environment/Setting:
A wide stone courtyard at dusk with drifting fog, scattered debris, and loose objects such as leaves, dust, and small fragments across the ground. The atmosphere feels tense and charged with energy.

Action:
The warrior unleashes an ultimate technique with intense and fast cinematic motion. The katana rises upward as powerful red energy rapidly forms a spinning tornado-like vortex. The vortex grows stronger and pulls surrounding debris into a violent spiral of energy and wind. With a swift and powerful motion, the warrior swings the katana directly toward the camera, causing the massive vortex to collapse instantly into explosive red light particles that fade into the air. No graphic violence, no blood, no injury detail.

Shot Breakdown:
Shot 1 (5s): Wide cinematic establishing shot. Wind begins to surge across the courtyard as dust and debris lift from the ground. Red energy starts gathering around the black katana, crackling with intensity.

Shot 2 (6s): Fast dynamic rotating tracking shot. The katana is raised high as a massive red energy tornado erupts around the warrior. Leaves, stones, and fragments spiral upward while the vortex grows larger and more chaotic with powerful CGI energy streams.

Shot 3 (4s): Aggressive forward camera push as the katana is swung toward the camera in a decisive motion. The giant vortex instantly collapses into a burst of glowing red particles and fading shockwave ripples, leaving the environment suddenly calm.

Lighting:
Strong crimson energy lighting from the vortex combined with dark cinematic dusk tones, glowing particles, energy trails, and dramatic highlights on the blade.

Style:
cinematic, ultra high detail, intense pacing, fast motion, dynamic composition, film-like motion, high-end CGI energy effects, atmospheric particles

Duration:
15 seconds

Audio Note:
Deep cinematic bass buildup, powerful wind vortex sounds, rising energy pulses, followed by a sharp energy release and fading ambient wind. No spoken dialogue.

zh.p: 角色：一位身穿利落黑色战斗服、点缀暗红纹路的武士，手握一柄散发微弱红光的优雅黑刃。场景：黄昏时分，宽阔的石板庭院中雾气弥漫，地面散落着落叶、尘土与碎石，空气中弥漫着紧张而充满能量的气息。动作：武士以极具冲击力的电影级快动作释放终极招式。黑刃向上挥起，强大的红色能量迅速形成旋转的龙卷风状漩涡。漩涡愈发猛烈，将周围碎片卷入狂暴的能量与风之螺旋。武士以迅捷有力的动作将黑刃直劈向镜头，巨大的漩涡瞬间崩解为爆炸性的红色光粒子，消散于空中。无暴力血腥画面，无血迹与受伤细节。分镜：镜头1（5秒）：宽幅电影级定场镜头。庭院中风势骤起，尘土与碎片从地面扬起。红色能量开始聚集于黑刃周围，噼啪作响。镜头2（6秒）：快速动态旋转跟拍镜头。黑刃高举，巨大的红色能量漩涡在武士周身爆发。树叶、石块与碎片螺旋升空，漩涡在强大的CGI能量流中愈发庞大混乱。镜头3（4秒）：镜头猛烈前推，黑刃以决定性动作劈向镜头。巨型漩涡瞬间坍缩，迸发出炽热的红色粒子与渐弱的冲击波纹，环境骤然归于平静。灯光：漩涡的强烈猩红能量光与暗调电影级黄昏色调交织，辅以发光粒子、能量轨迹及刀身戏剧性高光。风格：电影级、超精细、节奏紧凑、动作迅疾、构图动感、胶片质感运镜、高端CGI能量特效、氛围粒子。时长：15秒。音频提示：深沉电影级贝斯渐强、强劲风旋声、能量脉冲攀升，随后是锐利的能量释放与渐弱的氛围风声。无对白。

Strong crimson energy lighting from the vortex combined with dark cinematic dusk tones, glowing particles, energy trails, and dramatic highlights on the blade.

zh.p:
总时长15秒，参考角色
图片1
形象，身着青碧色广袖长袍，腰系玉带，发髻簪冠，衣袂轻扬，面容冷峻英挺，气质凌厉沉静。 【场景基调】 古风奇幻仙境，高山之巅，云雾翻涌如瀑，漫山落英飘散，粉白花瓣如雪席卷；光影对比强烈，暗调打底搭配桃花漫射柔光；画质极细腻，电影级宽画幅构图，高对比度HDR色调，2K超清分辨率。 【角色动作 · 全程】 角色单手持细长古剑，施展高速武术身法，纵跃腾挪，步伐迅疾如风，剑法连绵不断，招式之间无停顿，每一式干净利落、气势凌厉；剑身流动着淡蓝色光晕，剑气轨迹在空中留下流光残影；衣袂随动势剧烈翻飞，发丝、发带随风舞动；全程动作高速流畅，无空档无停顿，节奏紧密酣畅。 【分镜运镜 · 三段式】 0-1秒：超广角低空俯冲推进镜头，强透视感，镜头高速前推并轻微旋转，动态模糊感强，角色从远景跃入近景，气场扑面而来，镜头持续运动不静止。 1-12秒：镜头紧随剑势高速同步移动，急停急启交替；环形环绕跟拍加大幅度甩镜切换视角加高能变焦推拉加极限升格慢镜（仅在关键动作顶点慢放约0.3秒后立即恢复高速），镜头始终以古剑为视觉核心，贴剑追随不偏移；多次快速切换，视角交替（低角仰拍、侧跟平拍、高位俯拍），节奏紧凑。 12-15秒：角色凌空跃起至最高点，双手持剑向下施展收势，剑气能量向四周扩散形成光波涟漪，漫天花瓣与云雾随气流翻涌飞散，花瓣水珠随动势四溅，光柱冲天，镜头缓缓拉远，壮阔全景收尾。 【特效细节】 剑身光晕粒子持续流动，花瓣碎片随招式飞散，云雾随剑气扰动翻涌；动作顶点有真实物理质感，花瓣和水雾颗粒运动轨迹自然；剑鸣声与动作节奏同步共鸣；动作顶点打击质感强烈，慢放瞬间细节清晰震撼，画面张力满格。 【风格标签】 古风奇幻武术表演，写实物理引擎，高速运镜，强动作质感，高对比暗调光影，桃花仙境场景，2K电影级画质。

An epic futuristic car assembly sequence inside a dark, glossy digital showroom. A white high performance Lamborghini begins forming in the center of a reflective black stage. The environment is minimal, clean, and dramatic, with powerful spotlights cutting through the darkness and reflecting across the polished floor.

The sequence starts with macro close ups of glowing mechanical components floating in the air. Engine parts appear first, pistons and gears rotating slowly as if suspended in zero gravity. Each component moves smoothly into position, connecting with precise mechanical clicks. Transmission pieces slide together, electronics light up with soft blue energy, and glowing cables run through the chassis.

The camera slowly moves around the structure as more elements assemble. Carbon fiber body panels descend and align perfectly with the frame. Wheels spin gently before locking onto the axles. The dashboard lights activate with elegant digital displays.

Bright flashes of light mark each completed connection. Subtle holographic grids and UI lines briefly appear as the vehicle takes shape. The lighting emphasizes the glossy white surfaces and sharp aerodynamic curves.

As the final panel locks into place, the headlights ignite with a powerful white glow. The engine starts with a deep, cinematic growl.

The camera pulls back and begins a smooth 360 degree orbit around the completed Lamborghini, revealing the full car in dramatic lighting. Reflections ripple across the floor while beams of light sweep across the bodywork, highlighting every contour.

Cinematic lighting, sleek product showcase, high contrast reflections, futuristic atmosphere, ultra detailed mechanical assembly, epic reveal, dramatic camera movement, premium automotive commercial style.

zh.p: 在暗黑光洁的数字展厅中，一场史诗级未来主义汽车装配序列正在上演。一辆白色高性能兰博基尼在反光黑色舞台中央开始成型。环境极简、洁净而富有戏剧性，强力聚光灯划破黑暗，在抛光地板上投下粼粼波光。序列以悬浮空中的发光机械部件微距特写开场。发动机部件率先显现，活塞与齿轮如失重般缓缓旋转。每个组件流畅移至预定位置，以精准的机械卡扣声完成衔接。变速箱零件滑动组合，电子元件泛起柔蓝能量，发光线缆贯穿底盘。镜头随更多部件组装缓缓环绕结构。碳纤维车身面板垂降而下，与车架完美贴合。轮毂轻旋后锁定车轴。仪表盘灯光亮起，呈现优雅数字显示。每次连接完成时迸发炫目闪光。随着车身成型，全息网格与UI线条若隐若现。灯光着重凸显亮白漆面与锐利空气动力学曲线。当最后一块面板卡入定位，车灯骤然亮起强光白芒。引擎发出电影级深沉轰鸣。镜头后拉，开始环绕完整兰博基尼进行流畅360度旋转，在戏剧性光影中展现全车。地板倒影涟漪荡漾，光束扫过车身，勾勒每道轮廓。电影级布光、精致产品展示、高对比反射、未来主义氛围、超细节机械装配、史诗级揭幕、戏剧性运镜、顶级汽车广告风格。

en.p: A young witch flies on a broom over an ancient European town at golden hour. The camera stays tight behind her back as the town opens ahead. Her dark purple cloak whips directly into camera, animated with hand-drawn cloth physics. Her long messy brown hair lashes wildly in all directions with expressive independent strands. She flies between narrow stone buildings with flower pots, red tiled roofs, and climbing greenery. Hand-drawn wind lines split around her body and curl into small vortices behind her. As she passes windows, her wind blasts shutters open in a domino chain. White curtains burst outward. Golden sunlight flashes through the glass and creates hand-drawn 2D lens bloom with glowing dust. The town below reacts. People point upward, hats blow away, rooftop cats jump, pigeons explode into flocks, leaves spiral through her wake, and laundry lines whip violently. Suddenly laundry lines cross her path. She tries to dodge. She brakes hard. Her body lurches forward over the broom from the sudden deceleration while her legs lift backward. Too late. She bursts through the first line. A large white shirt catches on her face and completely covers it. A sheet wraps around her body. A sock dangles from the broom. She wobbles on the broom - one leg kicked sideways, one hand gripping tightly, the other yanking wildly at the shirt covering her face. Angry muffled words bubble under the fabric. Her head jerks right-left-right in exaggerated hand-drawn motion with extreme squash and stretch. Her neck elongates with each shake. Her eyes briefly spin when the shirt lifts. She pulls hard. The shirt flies off her face. Her face is revealed: messy hair, comic fury, clenched teeth, burning eyes, deeply furrowed brows - then a long exhale and visible relief. She straightens herself on the broom, leans forward, grips tightly, and accelerates. Hand-drawn speed lines stream around her. A building suddenly appears ahead. She brakes sharply. Her body and broom compress forward. She banks hard around it, shoulder nearly scraping the wall, then snaps back to a straight path and accelerates again. A shop sign appears overhead. She flattens herself low against the broom as the sign passes mere centimeters above her head. Another laundry line appears. This time she twists her body and narrowly passes beneath it at the last moment. A single sock catches on her nose. She flicks it away irritably. Pure 2D hand-drawn traditional animation with hand-painted watercolor backgrounds. Tight rear-follow shot locked close behind the young witch's back for the entire sequence. Camera shows her shoulders, her hair, the broom, the world opening ahead of her. Continuous tracking shot following directly behind her. Occasional hand-drawn 2D lens bloom when sunlight bursts through opened windows. With every acceleration, her body stretches backward, hair and cloak are pushed back harder, hand-drawn speed lines intensify. With every sudden slowdown, her body is thrown forward, hair wraps across her face, cloak folds inward over her back. With every turn, the broom bends, her body leans into the turn, her legs tuck and react expressively.

zh.p: 一位年轻女巫在金色黄昏时分骑着扫帚飞过一座古老欧洲小镇。镜头紧贴她的后背，随着小镇在她前方展开。她深紫色的斗篷直接拍打到镜头上，以手绘布料物理效果呈现动画。她凌乱的棕色长发狂野地向四面八方飞舞，每一缕发丝都充满表现力地独立飘动。她穿梭于狭窄的石砌建筑之间，这些建筑点缀着花盆、红瓦屋顶和攀缘绿植。手绘的风线在她身体周围分流，并在她身后卷成小小的漩涡。当她掠过窗户时，她的风劲吹得百叶窗像多米诺骨牌一样接连打开。白色窗帘向外翻飞。金色阳光透过玻璃闪烁，形成手绘的2D镜头光晕，并伴有发光的尘埃。下方的小镇有了反应。人们向上指指点点，帽子被吹走，屋顶上的猫跳起来，鸽子炸开成一群，树叶在她飞过的尾迹中旋转，晾衣绳猛烈地抽动。突然，晾衣绳横亘在她的路径上。她试图躲避。她猛地刹车。由于突然减速，她的身体向前猛冲，越过扫帚，而双腿则向后抬起。但为时已晚。她冲破了第一根绳子。一件白色大衬衫挂在了她的脸上，完全遮住了它。一条床单缠绕在她身上。一只袜子从扫帚上垂下来。她在扫帚上摇摇晃晃——一条腿向侧边踢出，一只手紧紧抓住，另一只手疯狂地拉扯着遮住脸的衬衫。布料下传出愤怒而含糊的嘟囔声。她的头以夸张的手绘动作左右猛地扭动，伴随着极端的挤压和拉伸。她的脖子随着每次甩动而拉长。当衬衫被掀起时，她的眼睛短暂地旋转。她用力一拉。衬衫从她脸上飞走。她的脸露了出来：凌乱的头发，漫画式的愤怒，紧咬的牙齿，燃烧的眼睛，深锁的眉头——然后是一声长长的呼气，以及明显的如释重负。她在扫帚上坐直身体，向前倾身，紧紧握住，然后加速。手绘的速度线在她周围流动。一栋建筑突然出现在前方。她猛地刹车。她的身体和扫帚向前压缩。她猛地倾斜绕过它，肩膀几乎擦到墙壁，然后迅速弹回直线路径，再次加速。一个商店招牌出现在头顶。她压低身体紧贴扫帚，招牌从她头顶仅几厘米处掠过。又一根晾衣绳出现了。这次她扭动身体，在最后一刻勉强从下方穿过。一只袜子挂在了她的鼻子上。她烦躁地把它弹开。纯2D手绘传统动画，配以手绘水彩背景。整个序列中，镜头紧跟在年轻女巫背后，采用紧密的后方跟拍。镜头展示她的肩膀、她的头发、扫帚，以及在她前方展开的世界。连续跟拍镜头直接紧随其后。当阳光从打开的窗户中迸射时，偶尔出现手绘的2D镜头光晕。每次加速，她的身体向后拉伸，头发和斗篷被更猛烈地推向后，手绘速度线增强。每次突然减速，她的身体被向前抛，头发裹住她的脸，斗篷向内折叠在她的背上。每次转弯，扫帚弯曲，她的身体向转弯方向倾斜，她的腿收起并做出富有表现力的反应。

raw_p: A young witch flies on a broom over an ancient European town at golden hour. The camera stays tight behind her back as the town opens ahead. Her dark purple cloak whips directly into camera, animated with hand-drawn cloth physics. Her long messy brown hair lashes wildly in all directions with expressive independent strands. She flies between narrow stone buildings with flower pots, red tiled roofs, and climbing greenery. Hand-drawn wind lines split around her body and curl into small vortices behind her. As she passes windows, her wind blasts shutters open in a domino chain. White curtains burst outward. Golden sunlight flashes through the glass and creates hand-drawn 2D lens bloom with glowing dust. The town below reacts. People point upward, hats blow away, rooftop cats jump, pigeons explode into flocks, leaves spiral through her wake, and laundry lines whip violently. Suddenly laundry lines cross her path. She tries to dodge. She brakes hard. Her body lurches forward over the broom from the sudden deceleration while her legs lift backward. Too late. She bursts through the first line. A large white shirt catches on her face and completely covers it. A sheet wraps around her body. A sock dangles from the broom. She wobbles on the broom - one leg kicked sideways, one hand gripping tightly, the other yanking wildly at the shirt covering her face. Angry muffled words bubble under the fabric. Her head jerks right-left-right in exaggerated hand-drawn motion with extreme squash and stretch. Her neck elongates with each shake. Her eyes briefly spin when the shirt lifts. She pulls hard. The shirt flies off her face. Her face is revealed: messy hair, comic fury, clenched teeth, burning eyes, deeply furrowed brows - then a long exhale and visible relief. She straightens herself on the broom, leans forward, grips tightly, and accelerates. Hand-drawn speed lines stream around her. A building suddenly appears ahead. She brakes sharply. Her body and broom compress forward. She banks hard around it, shoulder nearly scraping the wall, then snaps back to a straight path and accelerates again. A shop sign appears overhead. She flattens herself low against the broom as the sign passes mere centimeters above her head. Another laundry line appears. This time she twists her body and narrowly passes beneath it at the last moment. A single sock catches on her nose. She flicks it away irritably. Pure 2D hand-drawn traditional animation with hand-painted watercolor backgrounds. Tight rear-follow shot locked close behind the young witch's back for the entire sequence. Camera shows her shoulders, her hair, the broom, the world opening ahead of her. Continuous tracking shot following directly behind her. Occasional hand-drawn 2D lens bloom when sunlight bursts through opened windows. With every acceleration, her body stretches backward, hair and cloak are pushed back harder, hand-drawn speed lines intensify. With every sudden slowdown, her body is thrown forward, hair wraps across her face, cloak folds inward over her back. With every turn, the broom bends, her body leans into the turn, her legs tuck and react expressively.

She has long light-blonde hair and a relaxed friendly expression. She is wearing a light blue fitted tank top and black athletic shorts. 【Scene】 A cozy modern apartment kitchen with brick walls and a large window letting in soft daylight. A ceramic coffee mug sits near the edge of the wooden counter beside the sink. 【Storyboard Script】 [00:00–00:03] The video begins from the reference image pose. The woman casually reaches for the coffee mug sitting near the edge of the counter. As she lifts it slightly, it slips from her fingers. [00:03–00:07] The mug falls off the counter. The camera **quickly zooms and follows the mug downward** toward the floor in a smooth tracking shot. The mug spins slightly as it falls. [00:07–00:08] The mug hits the floor and **shatters loudly into several pieces**, coffee splashing across the floor. [00:08–00:12] The camera **cuts back to the original starting camera angle**. Ultra-realistic wildlife documentary footage. A red fox moves cautiously along the edge of a snowy forest at dawn. Its breath forms small clouds in the freezing air. Beneath the snow, faint movements reveal a hidden vole tunneling just below the surface. The fox tilts its head, listening carefully. Suddenly it leaps high into the air and dives headfirst into the snow, emerging seconds later with the vole in its jaws. Natural handheld documentary camera, shallow depth of field, cinematic slow motion, snow particles scattering through the air, dramatic golden sunrise lighting, authentic winter forest sounds.

"Beneath the silent blanket of snow, life continues unseen. But the fox has mastered the art of listening… and with perfect timing, the hunter strikes."

en.p: A woman in her late 20s of Brazilian heritage, her dark curly hair contained under a structured white bucket hat, wearing a matching oversized black utility jacket, wide black trousers, and chunky white boots, rides a bright chrome BMX through a dense favela-style hillside neighborhood of narrow stone alleys and painted walls. At the 2-second mark, she rides up a staircase, taking sixty stone steps in ten continuous tire contacts, the rhythm of it visible in the camera shake as her body absorbs the impacts with practiced ease. Arriving at the top, she immediately transitions into a wall-ride along a painted facade, her wheels running vertically on the mural with the staircase visible below in a wide shot. The camera chases from below during the climb, then cuts to a mounted side angle for the wall-ride, blurring the mural colors at speed. She transitions from the wall-ride into a gap between two rooftops, clears it at speed, and continues her descent as the camera captures the chrome bike threading the alley geometry from above. Dark burgundy, chrome BMX, painted favela wall, staircase vertical climb, stair-climb rhythm, mural wall-ride, rooftop gap transition, hillside descent aerial, cinematic grain, 4K.
en.t: Favela BMX Stair Climb & Wall Ride

en.p:
Traditional modern 3D animation style: 

0.0s-4s: 
Mighty Anubis sits in his throne and a group of villains stand in front of him with a mecha robot. The mecha robot is currently holding Anubis arms above his head. The group of villains demand Anubis to reveal the secrets of his powers and Anubis nonchalantly and bored says that he won’t tell these mortals anything. 

4.1s-6s: 
1 of the villains pushes a button on a remote control with a grin and 2 additional mechanical arms emerge from the mecha robot with white gloved hands towards Anubis’s armpits. Anubis watches as they approach his armpits with confusion. 

6.1s-7.5s: 
Closeup view of one glove tickling Anubis’s exposed armpit with gentle finger wriggling going „Kocho Kocho“. 

7.6s-10s: 
Anubis’s expression immediately changes into a wide grin in goofy fashion and letting out muffles giggles in his deep voice because he is very ticklish. The gloves continue tickling Anubis’s armpits and Anubis continues his muffled giggling while trying to move his upperbody but his arms remain secured above his head and the gloves keep tickling his armpits. The villains demand again that Anubis reveals his secrets.

Seedance 2.0 视频生成提示词

本视频是一个流畅的、高精细度的、特摄风格（Toku-style）科幻动作场景，核心在于将@图片天衣无缝地转化为全身动力装甲，并伴随流畅的能量特效和场景交互。

[场景描述 - Gritty Urban Battlefield]

环境: 一个阴沉、多云天气下的废弃混凝土室外体育场。地面充满裂纹、碎石和老旧的白色标线。背景是破旧的、生锈的球门门框和高耸的铁丝网围栏。远处有几棵稀疏的树木和公用设施塔架。

氛围: 紧张、荒凉、科幻与现实碰撞。
初始角色: 年轻亚洲女性（根据输入图片），长发，身穿米色卫衣和白色短裙。背景中有几名年轻男性正在打篮球或闲逛。
[动作编排 - Transformation Sequence]

冲突升级 (Conflict Escalation):
在远处，从地面裂缝中，一个巨大的、黑色金属和岩石质感的怪兽（类似 Kaiju，有尖刺，双眼放紫光）轰然站起，掀起巨大尘土。
群众恐慌四散。

核心变身流程 (Fluid Transformation - 关键流畅性描述):
女性察觉怪物，看向怪物，右手举起，露出手腕上的微型紫色发光装置。
（流体转换开始）： 紫色和粉色能量涟漪从装置开始，像液体金属和能量流一样在她的身体上生长和流动。
米色卫衣和短裙流畅地、有机地被一套复杂的、黑色和暗金色相间的全身动力装甲所覆盖和吸收。装甲块从四肢、躯干、腿部生长并锁定。
一个带有紫色核心的复杂腰带锁在她的腰间。装甲表面有精细的纹理和发光的紫色/粉色能量导管。
特效 (VFX): 飞刃（晶体状，紫色发光）在变身完成的同时从她身边Levitate（漂浮）并围绕她流畅地运行。
[战斗与决战 - Action & Decisive Battle]
战斗动作:
怪物咆哮并向她冲来。
装甲女性抬起手臂，紫色能量飞刃从身边弹射，组成流畅的飞舞编队攻向怪物。
她同时释放一道强大的、脉冲式的紫罗兰色能量波。

击中效果:
飞刃和能量波流畅地击中怪物，产生大规模的、炫目的紫色爆炸效果和大量尘土。
怪物受击倒退，地面裂纹加深。
[结局与余波 - Resolution & Aftermath]
结局: 怪物被击败，消失或爆炸（产生最终尘土）。
最后镜头: 装甲女性站在体育场中心，尘土慢慢落下。飞刃返回其轨道。她流畅地回头看了一眼（类似输入图片），然后转过身，向废弃的球门方向走去，她的装甲在阴郁的光线下闪烁，留下深重的脚印。
[导演总结 - Technical Details]
摄影机: 动态特写和中景。变身时使用平滑的跟踪镜头捕捉流畅感，战斗时使用动感和快速的镜头（Shaky cam/snap zoom）。

色彩: 阴郁的灰色场景，对比鲜明、脉冲式的紫色和粉色能量色彩。

纹理: 高精细度的装甲纹理、岩石质感的怪物、 gritty 的混凝土地面。
关键流畅性指令: 变身必须是一次流畅的、不间断的流动，而不是片段拼接。能量特效（变身、飞刃、攻击）必须流畅、有逻辑地流动和变色。

Action:

Visuals:
A crisp pshhht impact.

Action:
The can spins to maximum velocity and launches upward out of frame.
Visuals:
The background clears into a bright refreshing gradient — 
ready to seamlessly loop again.

en.p: 【Core Theme】 Realistic sci-fi mecha transformation, mid-air fall assembly, mechanical armor flight convergence, future armor awakening, cinematic mechanical divinity. 【Character Basic Setting】 Female protagonist, in combat state. Slight abrasions and dust on the face, a trace of blood at the corner of the mouth. Expression tired but determined. During the fall, the expression carries suppressed pain, with a slight frown, but remains calm. Clothing: Gray sports jacket + black sports bra + dark gray tight sports pants. Clothes blown by strong winds, torn at the edges, showing obvious battle damage. Hair: Light-colored long hair, wildly flying in the high-speed falling airflow. 【Core Mechanism】 Mecha origin: Hundreds of white mechanical armor modules suspended in the sky. Armor structure: Futuristic mechanical style, silver-white armor + titanium alloy structure + blue energy conduits. Edges of the armor equipped with micro mechanical locks and magnetic levitation interfaces. Power core: Blue-white high-frequency energy core at the center of the armor, energy pulses flickering like a heartbeat. 【Scene Environment】 Doomsday city. Background: High above an abandoned city, dust and smoke fill the air between skyscrapers. The sky is gloomy, with gray-blue clouds pressing low. In the distant sky, burning meteors continuously fall trailing flames. Strong winds howl. High-altitude dust and debris float in the air. 【Atmosphere and Image Quality】 Visual tone: Cinematic realistic CG. Camera: IMAX film camera simulation, Panavision C series lens. Focal length: 24mm → 50mm dynamic change. Aperture: f4. Image features: Low-saturation gray-blue tones, realistic film grain, slight edge soft focus, strong motion blur. Style core: Real mechanical texture + CG futuristic technology. Emphasis: High-speed mechanical assembly, energy arcs, metal collision sparks. 【Camera Movement】 Single shot, one continuous take, no cuts. Camera mode: FPV first-person perspective follow. Camera features: Strong handheld camera feel, high-speed motion, breathing-like shake, screen tremor from energy impacts. Dynamic trajectory: High-altitude fall follow → orbit rotation → fast push-in → low-angle hero shot. 【Timeline】 0-3 seconds: High-altitude fall. Action: Protagonist falls rapidly from high altitude. Body tumbles and loses control in the air. Long hair and clothes violently blown by the strong wind. Air is sharply cut through, producing piercing wind sounds. Camera: FPV perspective high-speed dive follow. Camera shakes violently. Clouds are broken through, creating explosive airflow. Distant city rapidly enlarges. Air produces strong motion blur. 3-6 seconds: Mecha flight convergence. Protagonist spreads her arms. Clenches teeth and whispers: 'Initiate armor protocol.' Instantly. Numerous mecha parts in the sky begin to fly at high speed. Hundreds of armor modules fly in from different directions. Flight trajectory: High-speed rotation, magnetic levitation track, blue energy trails. Sound: Dense mechanical whistling, metal vibration sounds, electromagnetic hum. Camera: Orbits rapidly around the protagonist. FPV lens briefly loses focus. Armor parts whiz past the lens at high speed. 6-9 seconds: Mechanical assembly. First armor piece impacts the protagonist's chest. Instantly unfolds and locks. Click— Mechanical structure automatically expands. Then: Shoulder armor, leg armor, arm armor, waist core. Armor modules fly in one after another. High-speed assembly. Mechanical locks frantically engage. Blue energy conduits light up. Electric arcs burst at metal connections. Sparks continuously erupt in the air. Camera: Orbit rotation. High-speed push-in. Assembly moment generates shockwaves. 9-12 seconds: Complete mecha formation. Last helmet component flies in from a distance. High-speed rotation. Camera slow-motion capture. Helmet automatically unfolds. Transparent HUD visor closes. Eyes light up with blue light. Back armor expands. Two large propulsion wings unfold and lock. Energy core activates. Blue energy flow runs through the entire mecha. Mechanical system startup sound: Low rumbling vibration. 12-15 seconds: Superhero landing. Protagonist falls rapidly toward the ground. Ground quickly approaches. At the last moment. Propulsors burst with blue flames. She abruptly descends. Superhero landing pose: One knee on the ground, one fist slams the ground. Instantly. Ground cracks. Rocks fly up. Shockwave spreads. Surrounding dust forms a huge ring-shaped airwave. Camera: Strong vibration. FPV quickly retreats. Final shot: Low-angle upward shot. Mecha stands up. Blue energy flows over the armor surface. Protagonist looks up at the sky. Distant meteor falls. Mecha propulsors ignite. She instantly takes off vertically. Charges into the clouds at high speed. Camera shaken by strong airflow. Scene gradually pulls away. Cinematic ending shot.

zh.p:
【核心主题】

写实科幻机甲变身，空中坠落组装，机械装甲飞行聚合，未来战甲觉醒，电影级机械神性

【人物基础设定】

女性主角，战斗状态。

面部有轻微擦伤与灰尘，嘴角带一点血迹。
表情疲惫但意志坚定。
坠落过程中表情带有压抑的痛感，眉心微微皱起，但保持冷静。

服装：

灰色运动外套 + 黑色运动内衣 + 深灰色紧身运动裤。
衣服被强风吹动，边缘撕裂，战损状态明显。

头发：
浅色长发，在高速坠落气流中疯狂飞舞。

【核心机制】

机甲来源：

天空中悬浮的数百个白色机械装甲模块。

装甲结构：

未来机械风格，白银色装甲 + 钛合金结构 + 蓝色能量导管。
装甲边缘带有微型机械锁扣和磁悬浮接口。

动力核心：

装甲中心拥有蓝白色高频能量核心，能量脉冲如心跳般闪烁。
【场景环境】

末日城市。

背景：

废弃都市高空，摩天大楼之间弥漫烟尘。
天空阴沉，灰蓝色云层压低。

远处天空不断有燃烧的陨石拖着火焰坠落。

强风呼啸。

高空尘埃与碎片在空气中漂浮。

视觉基调：

电影级写实CG。

摄影机：

IMAX胶片摄影机模拟
Panavision C 系列镜头

焦段：

24mm → 50mm 动态变化

光圈：

f4
画面特征：

低饱和灰蓝色调
真实胶片颗粒
边缘轻微柔焦
强烈运动模糊

风格核心：

真实机械质感 + CG未来科技

强调：

高速机械组装
能量电弧
金属撞击火花

【运镜】
单镜头一镜到底，无剪辑。
镜头模式：
FPV第一视角跟随。

强烈手持镜头感
高速运动
呼吸式抖动
能量冲击导致画面震颤

动态轨迹：

高空坠落跟随 → 环绕旋转 → 快速推进 → 仰角英雄镜头
【时间轴】
0-3秒 高空坠落

动作：

主角从高空急速坠落。

身体在空中翻滚失控。

长发与衣服被狂风剧烈吹动。

空气被高速划开，发出尖锐破风声。

镜头：
FPV视角高速俯冲跟随。
镜头剧烈晃动。
云层被冲破，产生爆裂气流。

远处城市迅速放大。

空气产生强烈运动模糊。

3-6秒 机甲飞行汇聚

主角张开双臂。

咬牙低声说：

“启动装甲协议。”

瞬间。

天空中大量机甲零件开始高速飞行。

数百块装甲模块从不同方向飞来。

飞行轨迹：

高速旋转
磁悬浮轨道
蓝色能量拖尾

声音：

密集机械呼啸声
金属震动声
电磁嗡鸣声

镜头：

围绕主角高速旋转。

FPV镜头出现短暂失焦。

装甲零件从镜头前高速掠过。

6-9秒 机械组装

第一块装甲撞击到主角胸口。

瞬间展开锁定。

咔嚓——

机械结构自动展开。

随后：

肩甲
腿甲
手臂装甲
腰部核心
装甲模块接连飞来。
高速组装。

机械锁扣疯狂咬合。

蓝色能量导管亮起。
金属连接处爆出电弧。
空气中不断迸发火花。

镜头：

环绕旋转。

高速推近。

装甲组装瞬间产生冲击波。

9-12秒 完整机甲成型

最后一块头盔组件从远处飞来。

高速旋转。

镜头慢动作捕捉。

头盔自动展开。

透明HUD面罩合拢。

双眼亮起蓝色光芒。
背部装甲展开。
两片大型推进翼展开锁定。
能量核心启动。

蓝色能量流贯穿整个机甲。

机械系统启动声：

低沉震动轰鸣。

12-15秒 超级英雄落地

主角高速坠向地面。

地面迅速逼近。

最后一刻。

推进器爆发蓝色火焰。

她猛然下落。

超级英雄落地姿态：

单膝跪地
一拳砸地

瞬间。

地面爆裂。

碎石飞起。

冲击波扩散。

周围灰尘形成巨大环形气浪。

镜头：

强烈震动。

FPV快速后撤。

最终镜头：

低角度仰拍。

机甲站起。

蓝色能量在装甲表面流动。

主角抬头看向天空。

远处陨石坠落。

机甲推进器点燃。

她瞬间垂直起飞。

高速冲入云层。

镜头被强烈气流震动。

画面渐渐拉远。

电影级结束镜头。

写实科幻机甲变身，空中坠落组装，机械装甲飞行聚合，未来战甲觉醒，电影级机械神性

【人物基础设定】

女性主角，战斗状态。

面部有轻微擦伤与灰尘，嘴角带一点血迹。

en.p: [Shot 1 | Opening Tone · 3 seconds] Cinematic wedding photography, golden hour backlight on a prairie, @Heroine wearing a flowing white wedding dress with a train, sheer fabric gently swaying in the wind, back to the camera gazing into the distance, @Hero slowly approaches from the right side of the frame, gently wrapping his arm around her waist. Low-angle camera shot looking up, foreground wildflowers softly blurred and trembling, shallow depth of field, warm golden halo outlining the characters' silhouettes, backlight highlighting the flowing details of the gauze skirt. Movement: Camera slowly pushes forward, creating a breathing feel. Style: Italian luxury wedding gown editorial, Vogue wedding editorial, film texture, warm white and gold tones. [Shot 2 | Intimate Close-up · 3 seconds] High-end wedding photography close-up, @Hero gently cups @Heroine's face, their foreheads touching, eyes slightly closed, restrained smiles at the corners of their mouths, eyelashes fluttering, capturing delicate emotions. Camera facing front at eye level, extremely shallow depth of field, background softened into creamy white and champagne-colored bokeh, skin texture delicate and translucent, natural diffused light. Movement: Camera still, slight handheld tremor, like a stolen intimate moment. Style: High-end emotional editorial, TIME magazine's wedding photography of the year, creamy white and cool pink tones. [Shot 3 | Dynamic Corridor · 4 seconds] Luxurious hotel white arched corridor, rose petals scattered on the floor, @Heroine and @Hero walk side by side slowly, @Heroine gently leans on @Hero's shoulder, the long dress train glides through the petals, their side profiles elegantly outlined. Camera follows with a tracking shot, framing from waist to head, from a low angle at 45 degrees behind, light cascading from the top of the arch, creating a Tyndall effect. Movement: Camera moves forward steadily with the characters, slightly rising. Style: Valentino/Dior wedding gown editorial feel, architectural light and shadow aesthetics, high-contrast white tones. [Shot 4 | Closing Elevation · 4 seconds] Dusk on a coastal cliff, @Hero and @Heroine embrace, facing the setting sun, @Hero gently kisses @Heroine's forehead, sea breeze blowing the sheer fabric and shirt hem, the vast orange-red sunset glow silhouetting their figures. Camera adopts a distant aerial shot composition, centered symmetrically on the two, gradually pulling back and rising slowly, the characters shrinking from occupying one-third of the frame to silhouettes, the sky and horizon spreading out magnificently. Movement: Slow push then slow pull, finally freezing on the full silhouette shot. Style: Oscar de la Renta wedding dress ad, epic romance, orange-gold and deep blue gradient tones.

zh.p:
【镜头一｜开场定调 · 3秒】

电影级婚纱摄影，黄金时刻的逆光草原，@女主角 身着拖尾白色婚纱，薄纱随风轻扬，背对镜头凝视远方，@男主角 从画面右侧缓步走近，轻轻揽住她的腰。

摄影机低机位仰拍，镜头前景虚化的野花轻轻颤动，浅景深，暖金色光晕环绕人物轮廓，逆光勾勒出纱裙流光细节。

运动：摄影机极缓慢向前推进，画面呼吸感十足。

风格：意大利顶奢婚纱大片，Vogue wedding editorial，胶片质感，色调暖白金。

【镜头二｜亲密特写 · 3秒】

高端婚纱摄影特写镜头，@男主角 双手轻捧 @女主角 的脸，二人额头相抵，眼眸微闭，嘴角带着克制的微笑，睫毛颤动，细腻情绪特写。

摄影机正面平视，极浅景深，背景柔化为米白与香槟色光斑，皮肤质感细腻通透，自然散射光。

运动：摄影机静止，轻微手持颤抖感，仿若偷拍的私密时刻。

风格：高级感情绪大片，TIME杂志年度婚礼摄影，色调奶油白+冷粉。

【镜头三｜动态走廊 · 4秒】

奢华酒店白色拱形长廊，地面铺满玫瑰花瓣，@女主角 @男主角 并肩缓步前行，@女主角 轻靠在 @男主角 肩膀，长裙拖尾在花瓣间滑过，二人侧颜轮廓优雅。

摄影机采用跟拍运镜，保持人物腰部到头顶构图，从背后斜45度低角度跟随，光线从拱廊顶端倾泻而下，丁达尔光效。

运动：摄影机随人物匀速向前，轻微升镜。

风格：Valentino/Dior婚纱大片质感，建筑光影美学，高对比度白调。

【镜头四｜收尾升华 · 4秒】

黄昏海岸悬崖，@男主角 @女主角 相拥而立，面朝落日，@男主角 轻吻 @女主角 的额头，海风吹起薄纱与衬衫衣摆，漫天橙红霞光将两人身影镀成剪影。

摄影机远景航拍感构图，以两人为中心对称，逐渐缓慢拉远上升，人物由占画面1/3渐渐缩小为剪影，天空与海平线壮阔铺开。

运动：缓推后缓拉，最终定格在二人剪影全景。

风格：Oscar de la Renta婚纱广告，史诗级浪漫，色调橙金+深蓝渐变。
