en.p: @Image, a seasonal flower goddess ancient-style costume change video, with strong rhythm, maximum contrast, and极致 visual impact. No dialogue throughout, creating a dreamy and high-profile ancient-style emotional atmosphere. The picture is delicate with rich layers, exuding a high-end feel. Using backlighting, hair light, Rembrandt lighting, and side-backlighting to create high-exposure and overexposure effects, achieving a hazy and artistic aesthetic. Overlaid with film grain texture, soft focus, low saturation, and dreamy tones. BGM: A Chinese-style electronic track with a gentle prelude and heavy drum beats in the climax, a brisk rhythm, interspersed with crisp bird chirping samples. [Before Costume Change] A fast circular tracking shot around a character wearing a loose white sweater with slightly messy hair, sitting on a bench in a snowy park playing with a withered branch. A quick push-in close-up of the branch suddenly blooming, with petals exploding as the background shifts to a pink-green cherry blossom forest. A sea of flowers spreads at the feet, light pink transparent gauze ribbons flutter in the air, cherry blossom snow effects, petals floating upward against gravity, with dynamic blur on foreground petals to enhance spatial depth. [Seasonal Costume Changes] 1. Spring Goddess: The camera pushes in for a close-up as the gauze ribbon is removed to complete the costume change, with the spring goddess styling, clothes and hair flowing in the wind. 2. Summer Goddess: Holding a folding fan, a pull-back shot transitions to complete the costume change, with summer goddess styling. 3. Autumn Goddess: Water swirls, with maple leaves and autumn flowers forming a vortex around the character, transitioning as maple leaves fall to complete the costume change, with autumn goddess styling. 4. Winter Goddess: Clear divine makeup with exquisite eye makeup, a fixed crown, and light strands of hair brushing the face. Each season's styling matches a specific color palette, paired with different shot types and dynamic camera movements. [Ending Shot] Freeze on a winter scene, with a white bird flying in. The character gently flicks their sleeve, and the white bird instantly transforms into a flock of startled birds (synced with the dense drum beats). The flock circles around the character, creating a swirling snow vortex. The character closes their eyes and leans back, body relaxed, as the camera instantly pulls back. Snowflakes and birds dance wildly, filling the frame and engulfing the character, whose body gradually dissipates into a flurry of snowflakes.

en.p: Fixed wide-angle time-lapse photography, fully documenting the entire process of a building from a bare foundation to completion. The camera remains fixed throughout, only using time compression (10-30x speed-up) to present the construction rhythm, with natural light cycling through the frame (morning → noon → dusk → night). Phase 0｜Blank Starting Point: An empty, leveled original site with visible survey stakes and layout lines. Construction equipment has not yet arrived, and the background environment (mountains/sea/city skyline) is clearly visible, serving as the only constant stable element throughout the entire film. The static shot lasts 3 seconds. Phase 1｜Site Preparation and Foundation Work: Excavators and bulldozers quickly enter the site, fencing is erected, and safety signs are put in place. Excavators dig the foundation trench, with soil being scooped up by loaders, transported, and stockpiled to one side of the site. Rebar mats are rapidly laid and formed within the excavation pit, concrete mixer trucks drive in, pour concrete, and it is leveled. The foundation outline gradually becomes clear in the frame. Phase 2｜Main Structure Growth: Scaffolding rapidly climbs upward from the ground, like skeletal growth. Concrete columns and floor slabs are poured layer by layer; after each floor is completed, the building visibly rises higher—presenting a stepped upward rhythm (not continuous ascent). The crane rotates continuously, precisely lifting rebar, formwork, and concrete components to the working floor. A material storage area remains visible beside the building, with material piles fluctuating in size according to the construction progress. Phase 3｜Enclosure and External Wall Closure: After the floor slab structure is completed, external wall materials begin to be installed: Brick-and-concrete structure: Workers lay bricks layer by layer, the wall surface rising quickly. Glass curtain wall: The crane lifts entire glass units, workers align and fix them in place. Timber external wall: Workers assemble panels piece by piece, wooden slats covering the surface in sequence. Stone facade: Cut stone slabs are hoisted, adhered, and pressed into place. The building gradually 'fills in' from a transparent skeleton, its outline becoming increasingly clear. Phase 4｜Roof Completion: The roof structure is laid with worker cooperation: waterproofing membrane is unrolled, insulation layer is covered, and the surface material is installed piece by piece (tiles/metal roofing/flat roof paving). Roof closure marks the completion of the building's main form, with the overall outline presented fully for the first time. Phase 5｜Door and Window Installation and MEP Services: Door and window frames are precisely installed into openings, glass is slowly positioned by workers using lifting gear. Simultaneously, electrical conduits, water pipes, and air ducts are quickly threaded through walls, inside and out, like blood vessels extending within the building. Electrical equipment and sanitary fixtures arrive and are installed sequentially, transforming the interior space from an empty shell into a functional entity. Phase 6｜Interior Finishing and External Finalization: Interior floor laying, wall painting, and ceiling installation proceed step by step, each space transitioning from rough to finished state. Exterior work progresses concurrently: facade closure, external wall paint rolling or cladding attachment, window sill capping—the building's surface texture gradually becomes refined. Phase 7｜Landscaping and Site Completion: Fencing is removed, construction equipment leaves one by one. Landscaping vehicles arrive: topsoil is spread, trees are lifted by crane into planting pits, shrubs quickly cover the ground, and turf is laid in sections. Hard paving (stone/wood/concrete) is assembled piece by piece. Lighting, signage, and amenities are installed sequentially. Phase 8｜Completion State: The last construction vehicle departs, the site returns to a clean state. The building stands complete: the facade is pristine, the landscape is lush, lights are on. The static shot lasts 5 seconds. The background environment (mountains/sea/skyline) remains exactly as it was initially, unchanged. The frame freezes—from empty land to building, witnessing the birth of a house. Technical Specifications: Camera Position: Fixed wide-angle, composition covering the main building + surrounding material storage area + vehicle access route. Style: Construction documentary, 4K ultra-high definition, industrial texture tones → warm tones at completion. Time Compression: 10-30x speed, retaining readability of mechanical actions. Audio: Construction sounds (machinery roar, rebar clanging) sped up → transitions to ethereal soundtrack at completion. No watermark, no subtitles, no text overlay. Precision Deconstruction: [Reference Image Building Name] Ordered Deconstruction Time-lapse, Type: Building Precision Deconstruction Time-lapse / Fixed Camera Reverse Recording, Duration: High-speed Reverse Evolution Sequence (Complete Ordered Deconstruction Cycle), Core Principle: No magical transitions; use fast-forward to show the real process of mechanical and manual ordered deconstruction, material stacking, transport, and clearing. Absolutely prohibit uncontrollable shots like collapse, explosion, or sudden disappearance. All deconstruction must be controllable, step-by-step, ordered engineering work. Demolition Methodology: Industrial-grade Precision Deconstruction: Manual + mechanical coordination → piece-by-piece removal → classified stacking → systematic transport → site clearance. Reference Image Analysis: Instruction: Deeply analyze the user-provided [Reference Image], silently record all key building details as the 100% precise starting point for the deconstruction state. Analysis Checklist: [Building style type (modern/traditional/mixed/tropical/industrial, etc.), Building floor count and overall scale (single-story/multi-story/villa/large house), Main structural form (timber/concrete/steel/brick-concrete), Facade material (wood/stone/glass/concrete/metal/paint), List of deconstructable components (roof/doors/windows/external wall panels/floor slabs/columns/beams, etc.), Material estimation (how many cubic meters of timber/steel/concrete blocks need to be stacked, etc.), Deconstruction difficulty assessment (which parts need a crane/which can be manually dismantled)]. Initial State Lock: Phase 0 must 100% replicate the completed state of the reference image as the starting point for ordered deconstruction. Narrative Timeline: [Phase 0: Completed state (pre-deconstruction preparation), Phase 1: Deconstruction preparation and landscape removal, Phase 2: Interior item dismantling and transport, Phase 3: First batch of material transport (clear part of storage area), Phase 4: Door, window, and special component removal, Phase 5: External wall material removal, Phase 6: Second batch of large-scale material transport, Phase 7: Main structure removal (top-down ordered dismantling), Phase 8: Foundation removal and material clearing] - Each phase contains detailed visual descriptions, motion_style, key_action, material_flow, and importance/emphasis notes. 固定机位广角延时摄影，完整记录一座建筑从空白地基到竣工落成的全过程。镜头始终固定，仅通过时间压缩（10-30倍速快进）呈现建造节奏，可见自然光在画面中循环更替（清晨→正午→黄昏→夜间）。 Phase 0｜空白起点 空旷平整的原始场地，地面可见测量桩和轮廓放线。施工设备尚未进场，背景环境（山/海/城市天际线）清晰可见，是全片唯一不变的稳定元素。静止画面持续3秒。 Phase 1｜场地准备与基础施工 挖掘机、推土机快速进场，围挡搭建，安全标识就位。挖掘机开挖基槽，土方被装载车铲起、转运、堆放至场地一侧。钢筋网在基坑内快速铺设成型，混凝土搅拌车驶入、浇筑、抹平。地基轮廓在画面中逐渐清晰。 Phase 2｜主体结构生长 脚手架从地面快速向上攀升，如骨架生长。混凝土柱和楼板逐层浇筑，每一层完成后建筑整体明显升高——呈现阶梯状上升节奏（非连续飞升）。吊车持续旋转，将钢筋、模板、混凝土构件精准吊至作业层。材料堆放区在建筑旁侧始终可见，材料堆随作业进度此消彼长。 Phase 3｜围护与外墙封闭 楼板结构完成后，外墙材料开始安装： 砖混结构：工人逐层砌砖，墙面快速升高 玻璃幕墙：吊车吊起整块玻璃单元，工人对位固定 木质外墙：工人逐块拼装，木板条按顺序覆盖 石材外立面：切割好的石板被吊装、粘贴、压紧 建筑从透明骨架逐渐被外墙"填满"，轮廓日益清晰。 Phase 4｜屋顶完工 屋面结构在工人配合下完成铺设：防水层展开、隔热层覆盖、面层材料逐块就位（瓦片/金属屋面/平屋顶铺装）。屋顶封闭标志建筑主体形态完成，整体轮廓第一次完整呈现。 Phase 5｜门窗安装与机电管线 门窗框架被精准安装入洞口，玻璃由工人配合吊具缓慢就位。与此同时，线管、水管、风管在墙内外快速穿布，如血管在建筑内部延伸。电气设备、卫浴洁具陆续进场安装，室内空间由空壳快速转变为功能体。 Phase 6｜室内装修与外部收尾 室内地面铺装、墙面涂料、吊顶逐步完成，每个空间依次从毛坯变为精装状态。室外同步推进：外立面收口、外墙涂料滚涂或饰面贴附、窗台压顶，建筑表面质感逐渐细腻。 Phase 7｜景观与场地落成 围挡拆除，施工设备依次驶离。绿化施工车辆进场：种植土摊铺，乔木被吊车吊入种植穴，灌木丛快速覆盖地面，草坪分块铺展。硬质铺装（石材/木板/混凝土）逐块拼接完成。灯具、标识、设施依次安装。 Phase 8｜竣工状态 最后一辆施工车辆驶离，场地恢复整洁。建筑完整矗立：外立面光洁，景观绿意盎然，灯光亮起。静止画面持续5秒。背景环境（山/海/天际线）依然是最初那片，未曾改变。 画面定格——从空地到建筑，见证一座房子的诞生。 技术参数 机位：固定广角，构图覆盖建筑主体+周边材料堆放区+进出车辆通道 风格：建造纪录片，4K超清，工业质感色调→竣工暖色调 时间压缩：10-30倍速，保留机械动作可读性 音频：施工声（机械轰鸣、钢筋碰撞）快进处理→竣工时转为空灵配乐 无水印、无字幕、无文字叠加

en.p:
[00:00 – 00:03 | OVER-THE-SHOULDER MEDIUM SHOT - SLOW PUSH IN] 
Camera sits just behind and above the red-haired girl's left shoulder, her wild crimson waves and the neck of her acoustic guitar filling the foreground in soft bokeh. Across from her, Ruby, brown curls, dark tee, quilt-covered bed at her back, comes into sharp focus. The warm amber glow of the bedside lamp halos the room. The red-haired girl's strumming hand begins to move. She opens her mouth and sings softly: "Ruby… oh Ruby…" The camera breathes forward almost imperceptibly, closing the emotional distance. 

[00:03 – 00:06 | EXTREME CLOSE-UP - GUITAR HAND, LOW ANGLE] 
Cut to a ground-level macro shot angled upward at the strumming hand against the guitar body. Fingers move with loose, unhurried grace across the strings. The warm lamplight catches the shimmer of each string vibration. The faint resonance of the acoustic body fills the frame. Her voice drifts over: "…do you know how much you mean to me?" 

[00:06 – 00:10 | TIGHT CLOSE-UP - RUBY'S FACE, STATIC] 
Hard cut to Ruby's face centered, lit entirely by the golden lamp behind her. Her lips are parted just slightly, cheeks flushed, eyes glistening with the quiet weight of being truly seen. A slow, disbelieving smile creeps in at the corner of her mouth. She doesn't speak. She doesn't need to. The song does it all: "Ruby… my Ruby…" 

[00:10 – 00:13 | TWO-SHOT MEDIUM - WIDE, HANDHELD DRIFT] 
Camera floats back on a subtle handheld drift, revealing both girls in the full frame for the first time the cluttered bookshelves, the faded quilt, the soft chaos of a lived-in room. The red-haired girl leans slightly forward as she reaches the final line, voice barely above a whisper: "…I'll love you till the very end." The last chord rings out and hangs in the air. 

[00:13 – 00:15 | EXTREME CLOSE-UP - RUBY'S EYES, SLOW RACK FOCUS] 
The final cut lands on Ruby's eyes alone. Focus pulls soft… then razor sharp. A single tear catches the lamplight on her lower lash line, not yet fallen. She exhales.

zh.p: 【00:00 – 00:03 | 过肩中景 - 缓慢推进】镜头紧贴红发女孩左肩后方，她狂野的红色卷发与原声吉他的琴颈在柔和的虚化中占据前景。对面的露比——棕色卷发、深色T恤、身后是铺着被子的床——清晰对焦。床头灯温暖的琥珀色光芒为房间笼上一层光晕。红发女孩拨弦的手开始动作。她启唇轻唱：“露比……哦，露比……”镜头几乎难以察觉地向前推进，拉近情感距离。【00:03 – 00:06 | 极特写 - 吉他手，低角度】切至地面仰拍微距镜头，对准琴身上方拨弦的手。手指以松弛从容的优雅姿态划过琴弦。温暖的灯光捕捉到每根琴弦振动的微光。原声琴体的微弱共鸣充盈画面。她的歌声飘来：“……你知道你对我有多重要吗？”【00:06 – 00:10 | 紧特写 - 露比面部，静态】硬切至露比的面部居中特写，完全由身后金色台灯照亮。她双唇微启，脸颊泛红，眼中闪烁着被真正看见的沉静分量。一抹缓慢的、难以置信的微笑在她嘴角浮现。她未发一言。也无需言语。歌声已道尽一切：“露比……我的露比……”【00:10 – 00:13 | 双人中景 - 广角，手持漂移】镜头以微妙的手持漂移感向后拉开，首次将两位女孩完整纳入画面——杂乱的书籍、褪色的被子、生活空间的柔软凌乱。红发女孩在唱最后一句时微微前倾，声音近乎耳语：“……我会爱你直到永远。”最后一个和弦响起，悬停在空气中。【00:13 – 00:15 | 极特写 - 露比双眼，慢速变焦】最终镜头落在露比的双眸上。焦点由柔化转为锐利。一滴泪珠在她下睫毛处捕捉到灯光，尚未滑落。她呼出一口气。

en.p: Anime style, JRPG-style battle performance, cinematic camera movement. In a dark cave, a red-haired, purple-eyed girl battles a giant earth dragon. She wears a white shirt with a red tie and a black rivet belt. The girl erupts with a purple flash, splitting into five figures, leaving purple afterimages as they rapidly scatter and stand around the earth dragon, swords aimed at it. The five simultaneously charge toward the dragon along purple trajectory lines, slashing through it and continuing forward, each stopping at a distance, standing with their backs to the dragon. Five glowing purple slash marks appear on the dragon's body, erupting with purple energy. A white-purple halo expands, and golden sparks scatter. The energy dissipates, and the girl returns to a single figure, standing alone. Dark cave background, cyan ambient light, purple energy effects, high-quality animation.

en.p:
A man in his early 30s, stubble beard, wearing a black armored motorcycle suit with reflective alpine stripes and a tinted racing visor, races a superbike along a narrow mountain highway carved into a cliffside in the Swiss Alps.

Snow whips across the road as the camera tracks low beside the motorcycle tires gripping the frozen asphalt.

At the 2-second mark a thunderous crack echoes across the mountain — an avalanche begins collapsing above the road.

A massive wall of snow pours over the cliff behind him while chunks of ice crash onto the highway.

The rider accelerates through a narrow tunnel opening just as the avalanche spills across the road.

Exiting the tunnel he launches off a broken section of highway, the bike airborne above a deep alpine valley before landing on the next stretch of road.

Alpine avalanche escape stunt, frozen cliffside highway, airborne motorcycle jump, cinematic snow debris chaos, 4K.

zh.p: 一名三十岁出头的男子，留着胡茬，身穿带有反光阿尔卑斯条纹的黑色装甲摩托车服，戴着深色赛车护目镜，在瑞士阿尔卑斯山悬崖边一条狭窄的山间公路上飞驰。雪花横扫路面，摄像机低角度跟拍摩托车轮胎紧抓冰冻沥青的画面。第2秒时，一声雷鸣般的巨响在山间回荡——雪崩开始从公路上方崩塌。巨大的雪墙从他身后的悬崖倾泻而下，冰块碎片砸落在公路上。骑手加速冲入一个狭窄的隧道入口，就在雪崩席卷公路的瞬间。驶出隧道后，他冲上一段断裂的公路，摩托车腾空飞越深邃的阿尔卑斯山谷，最终降落在下一段路面上。阿尔卑斯雪崩逃生特技、冰冻悬崖公路、摩托车空中飞跃、电影级雪崩碎片混乱场景，4K画质。

en.p: **Visual Tone**: Sci-fi cinematic, realistic, film grain > Close-up, continuous tracking shot moving downward along the forearm. The frayed leather jacket cuff of a male [Image 1] suddenly splits open, and the hidden metal mechanical plates beneath burst outward and unfold. Heavy titanium pistons extend, locking together with precise gear sets in a crisp 'clicking' sound. Thick industrial-style metal armor segments rapidly spread upward along the arm, covering the shoulder and chest. The entire process is filled with a sense of heavy mechanical weight and industrial power. Side cold cyan ambient light, hard light with sharp-edged contours. The camera moves smoothly along a linear track, sliding upward from the forearm. Sound effects: the hiss of piston exhaust, the crisp metallic 'click-clack' of gears engaging, and the heavy 'thud' of armor plates locking. > Transition from close-up to medium shot, the camera continues moving downward (same long take). In the armored palm, intricate metal mechanical parts fold and unfold layer by layer, reassembling and transforming into a heavy industrial-style sword hilt. The tip of the hilt suddenly ignites, and a blazing blue light core flares up. Then, semi-transparent holographic laser crystals extend forward from the core in segments—each segment briefly hovers in mid-air before quickly locking into place—finally combining with a 'hum' into a complete, extremely slender holographic laser katana. The blade emits a deep blue glow and faint digital particles. 45-degree top hard light, deep shadows. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the full sword. The character transforms into the final form of a heavy mecha [Image 2]. Sound effects: the friction and reassembly of metal parts, the crackling arc of laser ignition, and finally a deep, powerful low-frequency 'hum'.

zh.p:
**视觉基调**：科幻电影感，写实感，胶片颗粒感
> 特写，持续跟踪向下拍摄前臂。一名男性【@图片1】
的破旧皮夹克袖口突然裂开，下方隐藏的金属机械板猛然向外弹射展开。沉重的钛合金活塞伸出，与精密的齿轮组发出清脆的"咔哒"声后相互咬合锁定。厚重的工业风金属装甲片段沿着手臂迅速向上覆盖蔓延至肩膀和胸口。整个过程充满沉重的机械感和工业力量感。侧面冷青色环境光，边缘锐利的轮廓硬光。镜头以平稳的线性轨道从前臂向上滑移跟踪。音效：活塞排气的嘶嘶声，齿轮咬合的清脆金属"咔哒咔哒"连续声，装甲板锁定的沉重"砰"声。
> 特写转中景，镜头持续向下移动（同一长镜头）。装甲手掌中，精密的金属机械零件层层翻折展开，重新拼合变形为一个充满工业感的重型剑柄。剑柄顶端突然点燃，一道炽热的蓝色光芒核心亮起。随后，半透明的全息激光晶体以分段的形式从核心向前极速延伸——每一段在空中短暂悬停后迅速拼合锁定——最终"嗡"地一声组合成一把完整的、极其修长的全息激光武士刀。刀刃散发出深蓝色的辉光和微弱的数字化颗粒。45度顶光硬光，深重阴影。镜头缓慢后拉展示全刀。人物变身重装机甲最终形态【图片2】
音效：金属零件摩擦重组声，激光点燃的电弧噼啪声，最后是深沉有力的低频"嗡"鸣。

en.p: The video begins with [@Image 1] holding a camera, shaking it to shoot close-up of the astronaut's nervous eyes behind the mask. The exhaled breath fogs up the glass, and red head-up display information scrolls. Cut to another shot. Continuously track and shoot her forearm, where the mechanical plate unfolds outward, with pistons and gears meshing together. The camera moves down to her hand, and mechanical components flip out from her hand, transforming layer by layer into a futuristic, industrial-style hilt. In this continuous shot, as the hilt continues to form a glowing laser blade and ignite, the camera keeps moving down. Then, in the same continuous shot, the holographic laser blade extends in holographic segments, which are digitally processed and combined into a complete laser katana. Cut to another shot. A shaking wide-angle lens shows an industrial docking舱, with rusty gantries hidden in the fog. We hear and see a huge alien monster rushing towards her from the fog. Cut to another shot. A medium shot slowly moves down, showing her leaning forward in a dramatic martial arts sword-holding pose. Her laser blade leaves an energy trail and emits a powerful hum. The film style is sci-fi cinematic, with a low-saturation blue color palette paired with warm orange, featuring a film grain effect and handheld camera shake. Sound effects include the hum of the blade, metallic clicks, the sound of boots stepping on metal, focused breathing, deep impacts, and cinematic horror drone sounds.

zh.p: 视频开头，[@Image 1]手持摄像机，摇晃着拍摄宇航员面具后紧张的眼睛特写。呼出的气息在玻璃上凝结成雾，红色平视显示器信息滚动。镜头切换。持续追踪拍摄她的前臂，机械板向外展开，活塞与齿轮啮合。镜头下移至手部，机械部件从手掌中翻出，层层变形为未来工业风刀柄。在这组连续镜头中，随着刀柄继续生成发光的激光剑刃并点燃，镜头持续下移。随后，在同一连续镜头中，全息激光剑刃以全息分段形式延伸，经数字处理组合成完整的激光武士刀。镜头切换。摇晃的广角镜头展现工业对接舱，生锈的龙门架隐没在雾气中。我们听到并看到一只巨大的外星怪物从雾气中向她冲来。镜头切换。中景镜头缓慢下移，展现她以戏剧性的武术持刀姿势前倾。她的激光剑刃留下能量轨迹，发出强劲的嗡鸣。影片风格为科幻电影感，低饱和度蓝色调搭配暖橙色，带有胶片颗粒效果和手持摄像机抖动。音效包括剑刃嗡鸣、金属咔嗒声、靴子踩踏金属声、专注的呼吸声、沉重的撞击声以及电影级恐怖低鸣声。

en.p: Full unedited perspective, first-person POV, simulating the lens style of an adult eagle in a high-speed escape. Ultra-wide-angle distorted lens, with strong stretching at the edges of the frame, extreme spatial depth and motion parallax, cinematic macro oppressive lens advancing at supersonic speed, accompanied by violent whip-pans, extreme dives, rapid rolls, and intense aerial turbulence and irregular tremors from wing flapping. The scene is set in a twilight apocalyptic world, with a vast abandoned city ruin above the sea—broken skyscrapers, collapsed bridges, rusted metal frames, shattered glass curtain walls, floating debris intertwined with giant waves. The sunset is blood-gold, with low-angle light piercing through thick dust and smoke, the ruins twisting and shaking in heat waves and sea fog, long shadows stretched infinitely. The eagle skims low over the sea surface and ruins, with broken buildings, rusted steel plates, rolling giant waves, and splashing seawater rushing past the lens rapidly. Behind is the pursuit of apocalyptic disaster: falling building debris, explosion shockwaves, rolling seas of fire, pervasive thick smoke, and flying metal fragments. Giant buildings collapse with a roar, steel bars twist and break, glass and concrete fragments rain down, explosions blaze into the sky, sparks and ashes dance wildly in the air. The lens maintains millisecond-level extreme dodging, narrowly brushing past falling steel beams, explosion shockwaves, and the edges of fire seas, with airflow and shockwaves violently shaking the lens, creating a strong physical presence. Lighting and shadow are cinematic quality: warm golden sunset highlights, strong contrast reflections from explosion flames, thick apocalyptic fog, deep and elongated shadows, particle effects maxed out—smoke, ashes, seawater spray, metal debris, and burning embers swirling wildly around the lens. Emotional tone: extreme adrenaline, life-or-death escape, apocalyptic oppression, wild survival instinct. Full immersive on-site sound effects: sharp eagle cries, howling wind, intense wing flapping, loud building collapse sounds, metal tearing, explosion roars, roaring waves, and the loud sound of shockwaves tearing through the air. The video abruptly ends at its climax: the eagle dashes at full speed through fire and smoke, making a narrow escape in the cracks of the apocalyptic ruins. Image quality: 8K cinematic texture, hyper-realistic rendering.

zh.p:
全程无剪辑视角，第一人杯POV，模拟一只极速逃生的成年雄鹰镜头风格。

超广角畸变镜头，画面边缘强烈拉伸，极度夸张的空间纵深感与运动视差(Motion Parallax)，电影级微距压迫感镜头以超音速级速度推进，伴随狂暴的甩摇(Whip-pans)、极限俯冲、急速滚转、翅膀扇动带来的剧烈空中颠簸与不规则震颤。

场景设定在黄昏末世，海面之上是巨大的废弃都市废墟，断裂的摩天大楼、坍塌的桥梁、锈蚀的金属钢架、破碎的玻璃幕墙、漂浮的残骸与巨浪交织。

夕阳呈血金色，低角度光线穿透厚重尘雾与浓烟，废墟在热浪与海雾中扭曲晃动，长长的阴影被无限拉长。雄鹰紧贴海面与废墟低空掠过，破碎建筑、锈蚀钢板、翻滚的巨浪、飞溅的海水在镜头前极速划过。

身后是末日灾难的追击：坠落的建筑残骸、爆炸冲击波、翻滚的火海、弥漫的浓烟与飞散的金属碎片。

巨型建筑轰然倒塌，钢筋扭曲断裂、玻璃与混凝土碎片如雨般砸落，爆炸火光冲天，火星与灰烬在空气中狂舞。镜头始终保持毫秒级极限闪避，与坠落的钢梁、爆炸冲击波、火海边缘险之又险擦身而过，气流与冲击波剧烈晃动镜头，带来极强的物理临场感。

光影为电影级质感：暖金夕阳高光、爆炸火光的强对比反射、厚重末日雾需、深邃拉长的阴影、粒子特效拉满——烟尘、灰烬、海水飞沫、金属碎屑、燃烧余烬在镜头周围疯狂旋转。

情绪基调：极致肾上腺素、生死逃亡、未日压迫感、野性求生本能。

全现场沉浸式音效：雄鹰尖锐啸叫、狂风呼味、翅膀剧烈振翅声、建筑崩塌巨响、金属撕裂声、爆炸轰鸣、海浪咆哮、冲击波撕裂空气的巨响视频在最高潮处戛然而止：雄鹰全速穿越火海与浓烟，在末日废墟的夹缝中极限逃生。

画质：8K电影质感，超写实渲。

en.p: In a scene rendered in a modern Chinese 3D animation style, the powerful jackal god Anubis sits on his throne with his hands behind his head. A human approaches him. Anubis, in a casual and bored tone, tells the human that he needs to make him laugh. The human grins and reaches out to tickle Anubis's armpits, while Anubis looks puzzled. The camera zooms in as the human wiggles their fingers in Anubis's armpits. Anubis immediately breaks into a grin, closes his eyes, and lets out a low, muffled laugh because he is ticklish. The human continues tickling Anubis's armpits, and Anubis giggles uncontrollably with his eyes shut, then hugs himself to protect his armpits. After a few laughs, Anubis tells the human that he did well and can leave.

zh.p: 在一段采用中国现代3D动画风格的画面中，强大的胡狼神阿努比斯双手枕在脑后，端坐在王座上。一个人类走近他。阿努比斯用他那漫不经心、百无聊赖的语气告诉人类，他需要逗他笑。人类咧嘴一笑，伸手去挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯一脸疑惑。镜头拉近，人类的手在阿努比斯的腋窝里扭动着手指。阿努比斯立刻咧嘴一笑，闭上眼睛，发出低沉的、闷闷的笑声，因为他怕痒。人类继续挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯闭着眼睛咯咯地笑个不停，然后抱紧自己，护住腋窝。笑了几声后，阿努比斯告诉人类他做得很好，可以走了。

en.p: Cinematic shot with strong visual impact, centered composition + low-angle upward shot; the heroine is the character in @Image 1; close-up of the heroine, with a cold expression, hands rapidly forming seals, fingertips surrounded by a flowing blue luminous effect, brilliant and richly layered in light effects, the entire set of moves completed swiftly at super high speed; while forming seals, the camera rapidly pulls back, quickly switching to a grand wide-angle panoramic view, behind the character, a towering female crimson Asura manifestation rises from the ground (a giant version of the character in Image 1), the character appears tiny, the Asura occupies the entire background space, quickly striking a domineering and fierce pose, overwhelming the scene with its presence; the Asura manifestation has eight arms, each holding a different weapon, with a tall crown and fluttering skirt, the frame finally freezes on the full view of the manifestation, with a mysterious rune halo spinning behind it, light particles flying everywhere, creating a strong visual oppressive feeling and an epic battle atmosphere, overall rendered with fine light and shadow effects.

zh.p:
电影级镜头，强视觉冲击力，居中构图 + 低角度仰拍；女主角为@图片1
中人物； 女主角近景镜头，面容清冷，双手翻飞极速结印，指尖萦绕幽蓝流动光效，流光溢彩且光效层次丰富，整套招式动作迅猛超高速完成；结印同时镜头急速向后拉远，快速切换至宏大广角全景，角色身后地面崛起顶天立地的女性赤红色修罗法相（@图 1 中人物的巨大化版本），角色身形渺小，法相占据整个背景空间，快速摆出霸气凌厉姿势，气场碾压全场； 修罗法相有八条手臂，各持不同兵器，发冠高耸、裙裾飞扬，画面最终定格法相全貌，其背后旋转神秘符文光轮，漫天飞舞光粒子，营造极强视觉压迫感、史诗级战斗氛围，整体做精细的光影渲染。

en.p: 【Core Theme】 Realistic sci-fi tokusatsu, falling from ruins, gathering of sacred feathers, platinum mecha angel, cinematic divinity. 【Basic Character Setting】 Bruises on the face, bloodstains at the corner of the mouth. Expression slightly weary. At the moment of transformation, slight pain on the face, brows only slightly furrowed, maintaining a sense of oppression. White tattered coat, black casual tattered shirt, and white torn pants, battle-worn clothing. Core prop: Right hand tightly grips a 'Holy Ring Crystal Core' emitting high-frequency pure white-blue light. 【Scene Environment】 Post-apocalyptic, city, skyscraper rooftop, overcast, light breeze, war-torn, gray-blue sky. Meteors with flames and thick smoke streak across the sky. 【Atmosphere and Image Quality】 Visual tone: Cinematic quality. Simulating IMAX film camera, paired with Panavision C-series lens (focal length 35mm, aperture f4). Color and lighting: Low-saturation gray-blue main tone. Dark areas compressed, retaining details. Edges with slight soft focus and moderate film grain. Style core: CG aesthetic style. Emphasizing the fusion of biological texture and alien technology, creating a sense of oppression, heaviness, and realistic physical pain. Special effects core: Emphasizing the dynamic process of countless luminous feathers materializing and gathering, as well as the divinity during mecha assembly. 【Camera Movement】 Single shot: One continuous take, no cuts. Dynamic trajectory: Opening extreme wide-angle fall -> Trembling push to half-body close-up -> Orbit during transformation -> Pull back to low-angle full-body shot. Breathing feel: Handheld shooting, maintaining a slight, breath-like camera float throughout, enhancing immersion. 【Timeline】 0-3 seconds Fall: Action: The protagonist crashes heavily from a height into the ruins, inertia causing her body to roll several times, delivering a visually tragic impact. The body stirs up ring-shaped dust clouds. She gasps heavily, struggling to stand, messy dark brown hair, mud-stained face lowered, eyes fixed on the pulsating blue-white crystal core in her right hand. Camera: Follows the fall, strong tremor upon impact, quickly pushes to half-body. 3-6 seconds Feathers Gather: The protagonist mutters firmly in a low voice: 'Then do it again!' Action and effects: The protagonist grits her teeth and crushes the crystal core in her hand. Accompanied by a crisp energy burst sound, a blinding white light shoots into the sky. Feathers gather: Countless glowing white feathers materialize out of thin air, forming a high-speed rotating vortex, instantly enveloping her right arm and rapidly spreading to her entire body. The protagonist's pupils are replaced by pure white light. Environmental resonance: A huge, faint golden halo totem appears behind her. The camera trembles slightly due to the energy impact, like tinnitus. 6-9 seconds Tear: Expression: Slight frown, enduring pain. The protagonist looks up, enduring the massive impact, brows tightly furrowed. A sacred white airwave bursts from within her body. Core: A few glass shards eject from the surface of her skin. Golden light dust overflows, spreading from the inside of the belt to her torso with rainbow-colored micro-light. Body: White smoke erupts from within, carrying hair-like strands. 9-12 seconds Reorganization and Wing Spread: New substance: A full set of white armor covers her entire body, the surface with a pearl-like matte texture and golden sacred relief patterns, with faint blue energy light streams seeping from the gaps. Shoulder armor: The newly formed golden shoulder armor collides, bursting into electric sparks, leaving permanent, burn-like tooth marks. Feather core display: Accompanied by a shocking mechanical roar, a pair of huge mechanical wings made of white metal feathers suddenly spread behind her, the edges scattering glowing light feathers. Clothing: The original clothes are already tattered, quickly stripped from the protagonist's body by some eerie force. Face covering: White transparent LED fragments begin to spread from the face, forming a semi-transparent helmet that leaves the face exposed, with a semi-transparent face display showing vital signs and battle information on the eyes. Golden halo: Fiber optics generate a circular golden halo behind the back, alternating between white and gold. The golden halo rotates, with energy pulses surging rhythmically. Gaze: Throughout the transformation, the protagonist's gaze remains fixed on the distance. Slender golden arcs emit crackling sounds. The airflow around her body begins to churn, the churning heat waves causing slight chromatic aberration distortion effects on the image. Armor growth: Accompanied by a divine mechanical clicking sound, white streamlined armor pieces materialize in the glow of feathers, quickly fitting onto her torso and limbs for assembly. Dazzling golden arcs burst from the metal joints. Shell fragments: Shell fragments scatter, with rainbow prism fragments flickering and floating around her body, spinning and hovering briefly before eerily retracting and reassembling into armor parts. Face: Eyes continue to emit white light, with a divine presence, symmetrical bold line totem tattoos appear on the face. Camera: Shakes violently due to the impact, loses focus, then sharply pulls back into focus. 12-15 seconds Completion: Helmet: The entire face is covered by a white mask, leaving only the eyes exposed. Weapon manifestation: The protagonist suddenly spreads both arms to the sides. Countless light feathers gather in her palms, instantly transforming into two holy energy battle knives emitting white flames. Final composition: The camera pulls back and switches to a low-angle upward shot. The protagonist, clad in platinum armor, with huge mechanical wings fully spread, holds dual weapons in a combat stance. The divine pressure emanating from her causes the surrounding rubble to levitate into the air, the frame freezing in a shocking moment like an angel descending. Final shot: Orbits to the right side of the character, camera position changes to a top-down shot, gradually pulling back at a very slow speed. Transformation complete, the character launches upward vertically, flying out of the frame. The camera shakes due to the massive airflow and heat waves.

zh.p:
【核心主题】
写实科幻特摄 ，废墟坠落 ，圣洁羽毛汇聚 ，白金机甲天使 ，电影级神性 

【人物基础设定】
面部有淤青，嘴角有血渍。表情略显疲态。
变身瞬间，表情轻微痛苦，眉心仅轻微蹙起，保持压抑感。 
白色破烂外套黑色随性破烂衬衣，和白色破裤子，经历了战斗的战损衣服。 
核心道具：
右手紧握一块散发着高频纯白蓝光芒的“圣环水晶核心”。 
场景环境：
末日，城市，摩天大楼天台，阴天，微风，战火纷飞，灰蓝色调天空。天空中划过带有火焰与浓烟的陨石。 

【氛围与画质】
视觉基调：电影质感。模拟 IMAX 胶片摄影机，搭配 Panavision C 系列镜头（焦段 35mm，光圈 f4）。 
色彩与影调：低饱和灰蓝主调。暗部信息压缩，保留细节。边缘添加轻微柔焦与适度的胶片颗粒感。 
风格核心：CG美学风格。强调生物质感与外星科技的融合，营造压抑、沉重、实拍的肉身痛苦感。 
特效核心：强调无数发光羽毛实体化汇聚的动态过程，以及机甲装备时带有神性。

【运镜】
单镜头：一镜到底，无剪辑。 
动态轨迹：开场极广角坠落 -> 震颤推至半身特写 -> 变身时环绕 -> 拉远仰拍全身。 
呼吸感：手持拍摄，全程保持轻微的、如呼吸般的镜头浮动，增强临场感。 

【时间轴】
0-3秒 坠落 动作：
主角从高空重重砸在废墟中惯性让身体滚了几圈，给人很惨烈的视觉冲击。身体激起环形烟尘气浪。她剧烈喘息着艰难站起，黑棕色头发凌乱，沾满泥污的脸低垂，目光死死盯着右手中搏动的蓝白色水晶核心。 
镜头：跟随坠落，砸地瞬间强烈震颤，快速推至半身。 

3-6 秒 羽毛汇聚 ：
主角喃喃自语低声坚定的说：“那就再来一次！"
动作与特效：主角咬牙手捏碎手中的水晶核心。伴随清脆的能量爆裂声，一道刺目的白光冲天而起。
 羽毛汇聚：空气中凭空浮现出无数发光的洁白羽毛，它们形成一个高速旋转的涡流，瞬间包裹住她的右臂并迅速向全身蔓延。主角双眼瞳孔被纯白光芒取代。 
环境共鸣：身后浮现出一个巨大的、若隐若现的金色光环图腾。镜头因能量冲击产生耳鸣般的微颤。

6-9 秒 撕裂 ：
表情：轻微皱眉，忍受痛苦。 主角仰头承受巨大冲击，眉心紧锁。体内爆发出神圣的白色气浪 
核心：全身皮肤表面弹射出少许玻璃碎屑。金色光尘溢出，闪着彩虹色微光从腰带内侧向身体躯干蔓延。 
身体：白色烟雾从体内喷涌，裹挟着发丝般。 

9-12 秒 重组与展翅：
新物质：全套白色机甲覆盖全身，装甲表面带有珍珠般的哑光质感和金色的神圣纹路浮雕，缝隙中透出淡蓝色的能量光流。肩甲：新生的金色肩甲对撞，爆发出电光火花，留下永久的、如同烫伤的齿痕。 
羽毛核心展现：伴随着一声震撼的机械轰鸣，一对巨大的、由白色金属羽翼构成的机械翅膀在她身后猛然展开，翅膀边缘散落着发光的光羽。 
衣物：原有的衣物已经破烂不堪，被某种诡异的力量从主角身上快速抽离，离开身体。 
面部覆盖：白色机透明led碎面从面部开始蔓延面部，头戴由羽毛组成的皇冠，组成漏出面部的半透明头盔，头盔半透明面部显示屏中有生命体征和战斗信息的屏幕双眼。 
金色光环：背部有光纤量子生成圆形金色光环在背后浮现，白色金色色相间。金色光环旋转，旋转能量光脉冲式涌动。 视线：在整个变身过程中，主角的视线始终注视远方。纤细的金色电弧，发出滋滋碎响。身体周围的气流开始翻涌，翻涌的热浪对画面产生轻微色散畸变效果。 
装甲生长：伴随着富有神性的机械咬合声，白色的流线型机甲片在羽毛的光辉中实体化，迅速贴合她的躯干与四肢进行组装。金属连接处迸发出耀眼的金色电弧。
甲壳：甲壳碎屑四溅，有彩虹色棱镜碎片闪烁飘出，飘在身体周围，旋转悬停片刻后诡异回缩，重新回溯组合成战衣零件。 
面部：眼睛持续发白光，带有神性的威亚，面部出现对称的粗线条图腾纹身。 镜头：因冲击剧烈晃动、失焦，随即猛拉回正。 

12-15秒 完成 
头盔：整个面部被白色面具覆盖，只露出双眼。 
武器具象化：主角双臂向身体两侧猛然张开。掌心无数光羽凝聚，瞬间化作两把散发着白色烈焰的圣能战刀 
最终构图：镜头拉远并切为低角度仰拍。主角身着白金机甲，巨大的机械翅膀完全伸展，手持双武器摆出战斗姿态。她周身散发的神圣威压导致周围地面的碎石悬浮升空，画面定格在如天使降临般的震撼瞬间。 
最终镜头：环绕至人物右侧，机位变为俯拍，镜头以极缓速度逐渐向后拉远，变身完毕人物向正上方弹射起飞，垂直飞出画面。镜头被巨大的气流和热浪影响而抖动。

en.p: A turbulent emerald sea crashing under the pale light of a crescent moon. A majestic 18th-century galleon rides the roaring waves, sails billowing. The camera swoops down from the storm clouds like a falcon, rushing over the choppy water. The ornate stern of the ship grows huge, featuring intricate stained-glass windows framing the captain's quarters. Matching the ship's violent rocking, the camera passes seamlessly through a glass pane into a surprisingly still, candle-lit cabin. A colorful macaw sleeps quietly on a hanging brass perch, undisturbed by the storm. The camera glides past the bird and exits seamlessly through a side porthole. It sweeps high into the night sky, the massive ship reduced to a toy on the water. The sound of crashing waves fades to silence.

en.p: A vibrant interstellar panorama framed by a swirling purple nebula. A sleek, silver star-cruiser travels silently across the cosmic void. The camera rushes forward at light-speed, rapidly overtaking the ship. The cruiser's glowing geometry becomes massive, a panoramic observation window coming into view. en.p: 9 seconds, nostalgic Hong Kong-style urban retro film texture, neon rainy night, strong film grain, cold blue and warm red neon interweaving, characters performing with utmost seriousness, atmosphere like a destined reunion. 0-2 seconds: Flashback, in the corridor of an old residential building, the young male lead casually stabilizes a nearly collapsing red plastic stool and gently pushes it back against the wall, close-up shot; 3-6 seconds: Present day, at the entrance of a convenience store on a rainy night, a woman in a dark trench coat slowly walks over from the neon reflections, shielding the male lead from a flying umbrella and cardboard box, Slow Dolly In shot, atmosphere solemn like a reunion after many years; 7-9 seconds: The male lead asks in a low voice, 'Are you that old acquaintance from back then?' The woman calmly replies, 'No, I am the red plastic stool you stabilized.' The next second, she instantly transforms back into a red plastic stool, lightly tripping him, and the male lead falls awkwardly to the ground, creating a deadpan absurd comedy. All characters are original fictional creations, not based on any real celebrities or public figures, not imitating any real person's appearance, and not featuring any recognizable celebrity traits; faces are low-distinction, stylized, non-realistic, without overemphasizing facial details. Prohibited: firearms, fights, chases, crimes, police elements, subtitles, logos, watermarks.
en.t: A Stool's Revenge on a Rainy Night

zh.p:
9秒，90年代港风都市怀旧电影质感，霓虹雨夜，强胶片噪点，冷蓝和暖红霓虹交错，人物表演极其认真，气氛像命运重逢。 
0-2秒：闪回，旧居民楼走廊里，年轻男主顺手把一张快散架的红色塑料凳重新卡稳，轻轻推回墙边，镜头近景； 
3-6秒：现实，雨夜便利店门口，一位穿深色风衣的女子从霓虹倒影中缓缓走来，替男主挡住飞来的雨伞和纸箱，镜头Slow Dolly In，气氛庄重得像多年后重逢； 
7-9秒：男主低声问“你是当年那位故人？”女子平静说“不，我是你卡稳的那把塑料凳。”下一秒她瞬间变回红色塑料凳，轻轻一绊，男主狼狈坐倒在地，形成一本正经的荒诞喜剧。 
人物均为原创虚构角色，非任何现实明星或公众人物，不模仿任何真人长相，不出现任何可识别名人特征；面部低辨识度、类型化、非写实处理，不过度强调五官细节。
禁止枪械、打斗、追逐、犯罪、警察元素、字幕、LOGO、水印。

en.p: 9:16 vertical screen, first-person perspective, ancient court drama texture, cinematic high-definition. 0-3 seconds: Imperial garden, rockeries and flowing water, peonies in full bloom, dappled sunlight. A noble consort stands by the flowers, adorned with pearl hairpins and a phoenix crown, wearing a bright yellow phoenix robe, holding a round fan. She hears footsteps and turns, half-covering her face with the fan, giving a charming smile and saying: 'The Emperor has arrived, your consort greets you~' 4-8 seconds: She gracefully walks forward, the phoenix robe flowing, the camera retreats. As she gets closer, she realizes something is wrong, lowers the fan, her expression shifting from charm to confusion. She leans in to look closely at the camera and asks: 'Wait... you're not the Emperor?' 9-12 seconds: A voice off-screen (eunuch's shrill tone): 'Your Highness, this servant is Xiao Guizi...' The consort's expression changes, she awkwardly steps back, quickly composes herself, clears her throat, and says: 'I... I knew that, of course.' 13-15 seconds: She turns her back to the camera, her shoulders visibly slumping, covers her face with the round fan, and mutters softly: 'So embarrassing...' The frame freezes on her regretful back and falling flower petals, accompanied by an 'awkward' sound effect. Sound effects: footsteps, wind, eunuch's shrill voice, awkward cough, 'it's over' sound effect. Prohibited: any text, subtitles, LOGO, or watermark.

zh.p:
9:16竖屏，第一人称视角，古装宫廷剧质感，电影级高清。
0-3秒：皇宫御花园，假山流水，牡丹盛开，阳光斑驳。贵气妃子站在花丛旁，珠钗凤冠，明黄凤袍，手持团扇听到脚步声转身，团扇半遮面，妩媚一笑说："皇上驾到，臣妾有礼了~"
4-8秒：她款款走来，凤袍飘动，镜头后退，她走近后发现不对，团扇放下，表情从妩媚变成疑惑，凑近镜头仔细看，问道："等等……你不是皇上？"
9-12秒：镜头外的声音（太监尖细嗓音）："娘娘，奴才是小桂子啊……"妃子脸色一变，尴尬地后退一步，快速整理仪态，咳嗽一声说："本宫……本宫当然知道。"
13-15秒：她转身背对镜头，肩膀明显垮下，用团扇捂脸，小声嘟囔："丢死人了……"画面定格在她懊恼的背影和飘落的花瓣，配"尴尬"音效。音效：脚步声、风声、太监尖嗓音、尴尬咳嗽声、"完了"音效。禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

en.p: 9:16 vertical screen, realistic human style, dreamy and ethereal, 4K high definition. 0-4 seconds: Extremely low-angle upward shot, the mirror-like salt flat extends to the top of the frame, with the sky and lake merging into one. White clouds drift in the azure sky, their reflections crystal clear. The groom and bride stand side by side in the lower center of the frame, the groom in a sharp black suit, the bride in a flowing white wedding dress. They face the distant horizon, holding hands. Their reflections perfectly mirror the real scene, as if standing at the intersection of two worlds. 5-9 seconds: The camera slowly pushes forward and tilts slightly upward. The bride has a gentle round face, straight eyebrows, smiling phoenix eyes, a perky nose, full red lips, and a dimple on her right cheek; the groom has a strong square face, straight eyebrows, bright almond-shaped eyes, a high nose bridge, and firm thin lips. The groom embraces the bride, who rests her head on his shoulder, her white veil gently fluttering in the wind. The reflection of their embrace syncs with the real scene, leaving only the two of them between heaven and earth. 10-15 seconds: The camera continues to push in to a close-up. The bride looks up at the groom, who lowers his head to place a kiss on her forehead. Sunlight spills from the side and behind, casting a golden rim light around them. Their reflections also 'kiss' at the same spot, creating perfect symmetry between the top and bottom of the frame. The white clouds in the sky, the figures of the couple, and the hem of the wedding dress—the real scene and its reflection are like a mirror world, pure and dreamy in blue and white tones. The final frame freezes, with the groom and bride embracing in the sky mirror, their reflection like a painting. Sound effects: Dreamy synthesizer sounds, minimalist piano, gentle wind, and a soft female humming. Prohibited: Any text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

zh.p: 9:16竖屏，真人写实风格，梦幻唯美，4K高清。 0-4秒：极低角度仰拍，镜面盐湖延伸至画面顶端，天空与湖面融为一体。湛蓝天空中白云朵朵飘浮，倒影清晰画。新郎新娘并肩站在画面中央偏下位置，新郎黑色西装挺拔，新娘白色婚纱飘逸。两人面向远方地平线，手牵 手。倒影中的他们与实景完美对称，仿佛站在两个世界的交汇处。 5-9秒：镜头缓慢前推并微微上仰。新娘圆脸温婉，一字眉，丹凤眼含笑，翘鼻，厚唇红润，右脸颊有酒窝；新方脸阳刚，一字眉，杏眼有神，高鼻梁，薄唇坚毅。新郎将新娘拥入怀中，新娘头靠在他的肩上，白色头纱随风轻扬。倒影中的拥抱与实景同步，天地间只有他们两人。 10-15秒：镜头继续推进至近景。新娘抬头望向新郎，新郎低头在新郎额头落下一吻。阳光从侧后方洒落，为两镀上一层金色轮廓光。倒影中的他们也在同样的位置"接吻"，画面上下完美对称。天空的白云、两人的身影、婚 纱的裙摆，实景与倒影如镜中世界，蓝白色调纯净梦幻。最后画面定格，新郎新娘在天空之镜中相拥，倒影如画 。音效：梦幻的合成器音效、极简钢琴、风声轻柔、温柔的女声哼唱。 禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

en.p:
Pure hand-drawn 2D cartoon animation only — absolutely no 3D. Ever. 24fps on ones, 16:9. Every line breathes with subtle hand-drawn imperfections. A young adventurous boy rides a flying paper airplane over a vibrant seaside town during sunset. The camera stays closely behind his back the entire time — we see his shoulders, messy hair, fragile paper wings, and the world opening ahead.
His loose sky-blue scarf whips toward the camera with fully hand-drawn cloth physics, every fold unique. His messy dark hair flies wildly in the wind with exaggerated cartoon motion. The wind itself appears as flowing white and pale-blue hand-drawn brush strokes swirling around him and trailing behind the plane.
He glides between pastel seaside buildings with wooden balconies, flower pots, and laundry lines. As he passes, shutters burst open in a domino effect and curtains fly outward. Each window releases glowing golden sunset light that hits the camera, forming hand-drawn 2D lens flares and floating dust particles.
The town below is alive — fishermen point upward, children run through streets, seagulls scatter, cats leap across rooftops, and market flags whip in the wind he leaves behind.
Suddenly colorful festival banners stretch across the street. He tries to dodge by pulling the paper plane upward, but the sudden slowdown throws his body forward. He bursts through a banner — a red cloth wraps over his face while ribbons tangle around the wing.
He wobbles on the fragile plane, gripping with one hand while pulling the cloth away with the other. His head shakes left-right-left with exaggerated squash and stretch animation, neck stretching comically and eyes spinning briefly.
Finally he yanks the cloth free. It flies away in the wind. His face appears messy and annoyed — teeth clenched and brows furrowed — then he exhales with relief.
He leans forward and accelerates again, hand-drawn speed lines rushing around him. A clock tower appears suddenly — he brakes hard and sharply banks around it, barely missing the bricks.
Another obstacle appears — a string of lanterns. He flattens himself against the paper plane as they pass inches above his head. One final banner swings into his path; he twists and slides underneath, but a tiny ribbon lands on his nose and he flicks it away in irritation.
Every acceleration stretches his body backward, scarf and hair whipping violently. Every stop throws him forward. Every turn bends the plane dramatically.
The environment is painted in soft watercolor textures — glowing orange and pink skies, terracotta rooftops, emerald trees, and violet shadows with layered parallax depth. Warm golden sunset light washes over everything as seagulls cross the glowing horizon.
Pure 2D. Hand-drawn. No 3D. Ever.

zh.p: 纯手绘二维卡通动画——绝对禁止三维。永远。每秒24帧逐帧绘制，16：9画幅。每一根线条都带着手绘特有的微妙瑕疵，仿佛在呼吸。一位少年冒险家乘着纸飞机，在日落时分飞越一座生机勃勃的海滨小镇。镜头全程紧贴他的后背——我们能看到他的肩膀、凌乱的头发、脆弱的纸翼，以及前方展开的世界。他松散的浅蓝色围巾迎风飘向镜头，完全依靠手绘布料物理效果，每一道褶皱都独一无二。他乱蓬蓬的黑发在风中狂舞，带着夸张的卡通动态。风本身化作流动的白色与浅蓝色手绘笔触，在他周围旋转，在纸飞机后拖出轨迹。他在粉彩色的海滨建筑间滑翔，这些建筑有木质阳台、花盆和晾衣绳。他经过时，百叶窗像多米诺骨牌般接连弹开，窗帘向外飞扬。每扇窗户都迸发出金色的夕阳余晖，直射镜头，形成手绘的二维镜头光晕和漂浮的尘埃颗粒。下方的小镇生机勃勃——渔夫们向上指指点点，孩子们在街道上奔跑，海鸥四散，猫儿跃过屋顶，市场的旗帜在他留下的风中猎猎作响。突然，五彩的节日横幅横跨街道。他试图拉起纸飞机躲避，但骤然减速让他的身体向前冲去。他撞破一条横幅——一块红布蒙住了他的脸，彩带缠住了机翼。他在脆弱的纸飞机上摇摇晃晃，一只手紧握机身，另一只手扯开布料。他的头左右摇摆，伴随着夸张的挤压与拉伸动画，脖子滑稽地拉长，眼睛短暂地转圈。最后他猛地扯下布料。布料随风飘走。他的脸显得狼狈又恼怒——牙齿紧咬，眉头紧皱——然后他如释重负地呼了口气。他俯身再次加速，手绘的速度线在他周围呼啸而过。一座钟楼突然出现——他急刹车，猛地倾斜绕过它，几乎擦着砖墙掠过。又一个障碍出现——一串灯笼。他紧贴纸飞机，灯笼从他头顶几英寸处掠过。最后一条横幅晃入他的路径；他扭身从下方滑过，但一条小彩带落在他的鼻子上，他烦躁地弹开它。每次加速都把他的身体向后拉伸，围巾和头发猛烈甩动。每次急停都让他向前冲。每次转弯都让纸飞机大幅弯曲。环境以柔和的水彩质感绘制——橙粉色的天空、赤陶屋顶、翠绿的树木、紫色的阴影，带有分层的视差深度。温暖的金色夕阳余晖洒满一切，海鸥划过发光的地平线。纯二维。手绘。没有三维。永远。

en.p: Realistic Nordic snowy night. A man runs fast through deep snow, tracked closely from behind at foot level. A wolf chases him, maintaining a strong sense of speed. The man trips and rolls; the wolf lunges at him. A border collie jumps in, knocking the wolf aside. The animals wrestle; the wolf breaks free and howls. Multiple wolves slowly surround the man and dog. Close-up on the dog as the owner slowly sits up. Background music: tense and evolving with the action.

zh.p: 写实的北欧雪夜。一名男子在深雪中疾奔，镜头紧贴地面从后方追踪。一只狼紧追不舍，保持着强烈的速度感。男子绊倒翻滚，狼扑向他。一只边境牧羊犬跃入画面，将狼撞开。两只动物撕咬缠斗，狼挣脱后仰天长嚎。多只狼缓缓包围男子与狗。特写镜头中，主人慢慢坐起身。背景音乐：随动作节奏逐渐紧张升级。

en.p: A cinematic film still, capturing the interior of a massive O'Neill space colony (Island One concept) from a grounded, human perspective. A young family—mother, father, and child—are standing on a rugged, overgrown grassy ridge at dusk, looking upward in profound awe. The curving landscape of the habitat, covered in diverse farms, small towns, and winding rivers, sweeps majestically overhead, creating an impossible, yet tangible sky-arch above them. The entire scene is illuminated by the powerful, warm, golden "terminator line" of sunlight bursting through a vast, dust-mote-filled gap in the articulated mirror arrays high above the central axis. This dramatic backlighting creates a striking rim-light on the family and casts incredibly long, shifting shadows across the textured fields below. The atmosphere is thick with haze and particles, creating strong, visible "god rays" that pierce the colony's interior. A soft, classic Spielbergian lens flare subtly strikes the corner of the frame. The metal and composite structures of the colony's central spine are visible, appearing worn and lived-in, not sterile or graphics-like. Tangible details in the foreground include a weathered fence post, a functional, aged tractor wheel, and overgrown vines, adding grit and texture. The camera uses a slightly shallow depth of field, making the opposite side of the cylinder an imposing but softened backdrop. Natural film grain, non-digital focus aesthetic, 1980s analog cinematography style, non-English text on screen is forbidden.

zh.p: 电影级静态画面，以贴近地面的凡人视角，捕捉巨型奥尼尔太空殖民地（岛屿一号概念）的内部景象。黄昏时分，一对年轻夫妇与孩子站在杂草丛生的崎岖山脊上，仰望天际，满目敬畏。栖息地弯曲的地貌——覆盖着多样农田、小镇与蜿蜒河流——如壮丽穹顶般从头顶掠过，在他们上方形成一道既超现实又触手可及的空中拱廊。整幅画面被一道炽烈温暖的金色‘明暗交界线’照亮，这道光线从中央轴线上方巨大铰接镜阵列的尘埃弥漫缝隙中迸射而出。戏剧性的逆光为一家三口勾勒出鲜明轮廓，并在下方纹理分明的田野上投下极长而摇曳的阴影。大气中弥漫着雾霭与微粒，形成穿透殖民地内部的强烈可见‘神光’。画面角落掠过一抹柔和的经典斯皮尔伯格式镜头光晕。殖民地中央脊柱的金属与复合材料结构清晰可见，表面带着岁月与生活的痕迹，毫无冰冷或数字感。前景中可辨的细节包括一根风化栅栏柱、一个老旧但仍在使用的拖拉机轮，以及蔓延的藤蔓，增添了粗粝质感。镜头采用略浅的景深，使圆柱体对侧成为压迫感十足却柔化的背景。画面呈现自然胶片颗粒感、非数字对焦美学、1980年代模拟电影摄影风格，且禁止出现非英文文字。

en.p:
Concept : Neon Dumpling Courier FORMAT: 15s / 6 SHOTS / action-comedy rooftop chase STYLE: Rainy night market megacity, lantern reds, cyan neon, steam clouds, wet tile roofs, practical comedy timing, ultra-detailed food steam and reflections 
Shot 01 (0:00-0:02) A young delivery courier launches a compact anti-grav scooter off a noodle-shop awning into a maze of wet rooftops, carrying a tower of steaming bamboo baskets. 
Shot 02 (0:02-0:04) The camera skims beside the scooter as dumpling steam trails behind like a dragon tail, neon signs reflecting across chrome panels and rain-slick tiles. 
Shot 03 (0:04-0:07) A rival delivery drone swarm cuts across the lane; the courier ducks through hanging duck racks, clipped laundry lines, and bamboo scaffolding without dropping a single basket. 
Shot 04 (0:07-0:10) One basket pops open midair, dumplings flying in slow motion while the scooter slides under a closing market gate and sparks off the metal track. 
Shot 05 (0:10-0:13) The rider vaults a roof gap, lands on a moving tram canopy, then threads between giant boiling exhaust pipes and red paper lanterns. 
Shot 06 (0:13-0:15) Final reveal: the courier lands at a tiny rooftop table above the whole city, gently sets down the food perfectly intact, while the skyline glows behind in rain and steam

zh.p:
概念：霓虹饺子快递员
格式：15秒/6个镜头/动作喜剧屋顶追逐
风格：雨夜夜市大都市，灯笼红，青色霓虹，蒸汽云，湿瓦屋顶，实用喜剧节奏，超详细的食物蒸汽和倒影

镜头01（0:00-0:02）：一名年轻快递员驾驶一辆紧凑型反重力滑板车，从面馆雨棚跃入湿漉漉的屋顶迷宫，载着一摞冒着热气的竹蒸笼。

镜头02（0:02-0:04）：镜头紧贴滑板车侧面，饺子蒸汽如龙尾般拖曳，霓虹灯牌在金属面板和雨淋瓷砖上反射出光影。

镜头03（0:04-0:07）：一群敌对快递无人机横穿车道；快递员低头躲过悬挂的鸭架、晾衣绳和竹脚手架，一个蒸笼都没掉落。

镜头04（0:07-0:10）：一个蒸笼在半空弹开，饺子慢动作飞散，滑板车则滑入正在关闭的市场大门下，金属轨道擦出火花。

镜头05（0:10-0:13）：骑手跃过屋顶缝隙，落在一辆行驶中的电车顶棚上，随后穿梭于巨大的沸腾排气管和红纸灯笼之间。

镜头06（0:13-0:15）：最终揭晓：快递员降落在城市上方一张小小的屋顶餐桌旁，轻轻放下完好无损的食物，背景中天际线在雨雾和蒸汽中闪烁发光。

en.p: A dense, mist-shrouded ancient forest at midnight. A jet-black, horse-drawn carriage thunders down a narrow dirt path, kicking up leaves. The camera weaves rapidly through the dense, twisted tree trunks, closing in on the speeding vehicle. The carriage's polished wood exterior comes into focus, an ornate velvet-curtained window rattling on its hinges. Matching the galloping speed, the camera passes seamlessly through the gap in the curtains into the dark interior. A pale, elegantly dressed man calmly clicks a silver pocket watch closed, completely isolated from the chaotic ride. The camera drifts past his pristine collar and exits seamlessly out the opposite window. It sweeps up through the forest canopy to the full moon. The frantic hoofbeats fade to silence.

en.p: "FORMAT: live action, cinematic video, 15s, continuous rotation match cut SCENE CONCEPT A stylish woman stands at the center of the frame while the camera performs a smooth circular orbit around her. She moves naturally like a travel influencer filming a fashion reel - small turns, relaxed walking steps, confident poses and subtle hair movement. During each rotation moment, the environment and her outfit transform to match a different famous world landmark. CAMERA Continuous orbiting camera around the character at waist height. The camera never stops rotating. Match cuts occur when the camera briefly passes behind her back or shoulder. TIMELINE 0:00–0:03 Paris - Eiffel Tower visible in the background. She wears a chic Parisian outfit: elegant dress, sunglasses, light scarf. She makes a small influencer pose and turns slightly toward the camera. 0:03–0:06 Rotation match cut. New York - Times Square neon lights and billboards. Her outfit transforms into modern urban street fashion. She takes a few confident steps forward like a fashion reel. 0:06–0:09 Rotation match cut. Egypt - pyramids and desert horizon behind her. Her clothing shifts into a desert-inspired travel outfit with flowing fabric. Wind moves her hair and fabric as she slowly turns. 0:09–0:12 Rotation match cut. India - Taj Mahal courtyard environment. Her outfit becomes an elegant traditional-inspired dress with vibrant colors. She lightly spins once like a travel influencer moment. 0:12–0:15 Final rotation match cut. Japan - Mount Fuji landscape with cherry blossoms drifting in the air. Her outfit becomes modern Japanese-inspired fashion. She finishes the movement facing the camera as the orbit completes. STYLE continuous orbit camera, influencer fashion reel energy, seamless landmark transitions, wardrobe transformation, cinematic lighting, travel montage aesthetic"

en.p: Facial reference of the character @【@Figure 1】Warm light slants into the car, 24mm focal length, f1.8 large aperture, ISO100, shutter speed 1/50s, shallow depth of field blurring the background. 0-2 seconds, windows fully open, a gentle breeze blows into the car, her falling brown hair flutters in the wind, the tips brushing over her off-shoulder dress, the shoulder line and hem of the dress and fabric are lifted into a noticeable curve by the wind, accompanied by the whistling wind and the rustling sound of clothes fluttering. 2-3 seconds, she looks up towards the camera direction, with a hint of casual relaxation at the corners of her eyes. 3-5 seconds, her fingertips quickly lift and forcefully gather the tousled strands, pressing down on the flying ends with a lazy motion. 5-7 seconds, the camera shifts slightly to sweep over the rapidly receding cherry blossom shadows outside the window, the wind mixed with the blurred hustle and bustle of the distant rapeseed flower fields. 7-9 seconds, cut back to a close-up as she leans her side face against the car seat back, a soft smile curving at the corners of her lips, her long hair still wildly dancing in the wind, a few strands sticking to her cheek only to be blown away again. 9-15 seconds, she turns to look out the window at the rapeseed flower fields, immersed in the beautiful spring atmosphere.

en.p:
Face: Refer to (upload your image). Facial structure and features must match exactly with no beautification.

Clothing: worn, weathered jacket.

Environment: black soil ground beside a lake under a dull grey sky.

Visual Style: cinematic widescreen transformation scene. Simulate IMAX film camera with Panavision C-series lens (35mm, f/4). Low-saturation grey color grading with compressed shadows while preserving detail.

Camera: single continuous shot, no cuts.

Scene begins underwater, low upward angle toward the character. Water surface ripples distort the image. The protagonist kneels by the lake, blurred through the water. Light scattering, shallow depth of field, humid lens effect. Camera slowly pushes forward as the protagonist lowers their head and gently touches the water with a slightly bent index finger.

Activation (1–4.5s): whisper “Berubah!”. When the finger touches the water, a circular electromagnetic pulse erupts outward. Purple particles surge, air trembles. Camera bursts out of the water in first-person motion, traveling along fingers, arm, and torso while glowing pulse patterns climb the body layer by layer. Eyes ignite white-purple, violet smoke leaks from the sockets, mechanical systems awaken beneath cracking skin. Air bends inward forming rippling shockwaves.

Tearing (4.5–9.5s): camera pulls slightly back revealing an alien insect attacking from behind. Dark red cracks spread across the body, purple liquid energy leaks out. Black mist bursts with fine electric arcs as clothing tears and burns from within.

Transformation & Fight (9.5–13s): armor plates slam onto the body with purple flashes and shockwaves. The protagonist blocks a blade, spins into a sweeping kick ripping through the enemy; green fluid and black mist scatter. Helmet forms with glowing compound eyes, some flickering like faulty units. Combat remains brutal and close: bone-breaking strikes, grappling, ending with the protagonist crushing the creature’s throat until it dissolves into black mist.

Final (13–15s): camera circles to the front and slowly pulls away. The protagonist breathes heavily in the bleak lakeside environment. Freeze for three seconds. No dialogue, no explosions.

zh.p: 面部：参照（上传你的图像）。面部结构与特征必须完全匹配，不得美化。服装：破旧、风化的夹克。环境：阴沉灰天下，湖边黑土地。视觉风格：电影级宽银幕变身场景。模拟IMAX胶片摄影机搭配Panavision C系列镜头（35mm，f/4）。低饱和度灰色调色，压缩阴影同时保留细节。镜头：单一连续镜头，无剪辑。场景始于水下，低角度仰拍角色。水面涟漪扭曲影像。主角跪在湖边，透过水面模糊可见。光线散射，浅景深，镜头起雾效果。镜头缓慢前推，主角低头，用微曲的食指轻触水面。触发（1–4.5秒）：低语“Berubah！”。手指触水时，圆形电磁脉冲向外爆发。紫色粒子翻涌，空气震颤。镜头以第一人称视角冲出水面，沿手指、手臂、躯干移动，同时发光脉冲纹路层层攀爬身体。双眼燃起白紫色光芒，眼窝渗出紫色烟雾，皮肤开裂处机械系统苏醒。空气向内弯曲，形成涟漪状冲击波。撕裂（4.5–9.5秒）：镜头稍向后拉，露出从背后袭来的异星昆虫。身体上蔓延暗红色裂纹，紫色液态能量渗出。黑色雾气爆裂，夹杂细微电弧，衣物从内部撕裂燃烧。变身与战斗（9.5–13秒）：装甲板伴随紫色闪光与冲击波砸落身体。主角格挡刀刃，转身扫踢撕裂敌人；绿色体液与黑雾飞散。头盔成型，复眼发出光芒，部分如故障单元般闪烁。战斗保持残酷近身：碎骨打击、扭抱，最终主角捏碎生物喉咙直至其化为黑雾消散。结局（13–15秒）：镜头环绕至正面并缓慢拉远。主角在荒凉的湖边环境中沉重喘息。定格三秒。无对白，无爆炸。

en.p: Meteorite Fall · One Continuous Shot, Handheld Phone Camera Footage · Hyper-Realistic · 15 Seconds · Full Description: Tokyo Rainbow Bridge, 3:00 PM, light traffic. The camera follows a Japanese man in his 30s, wearing a dark gray suit and white shirt, looking slightly haggard, standing by his car while talking business on the phone, with his other hand in his pants pocket. There is nothing unusual on the bridge; the wind blows normally, and in the distance, the surface of Tokyo Bay is calm and reflective. Before he hangs up, a small meteorite suddenly appears in the sky, falling into the water in the direction of Tokyo Bay within three seconds. The man does not react immediately, continuing his phone conversation, but his gaze involuntarily drifts toward that direction. Two seconds later, a dull, low-frequency vibration comes from underfoot, not very loud, but the steel plates of the bridge tremble slightly. A person in a nearby car rolls down the window and peers out. The man stops talking, the phone still pressed to his ear, his eyes fixed on Tokyo Bay. A low, white mist rises from the sea surface, covering a wide area, as if something has exploded underwater. There is no fire, no mushroom cloud, and no massive waves. Then more meteorites begin to fall from the sky. Five seconds later, a massive shockwave destroys the city. The frame freezes. Fades to black.

zh.p: 陨石坠落 · 一镜到底，手持手机拍摄镜头 超写实 · 15秒 · 完整描述 东京彩虹大桥，下午三点，轻度堵车。 镜头跟随一名30岁左右、深灰西装、白衬衫、略显憔悴的日本男性，他站在自己车旁边打电话谈生意，另一只手插在裤兜里。桥上没有异常，风正常地吹，远处东京湾的海面平静反光。 电话还没挂，天空突然出现一颗小陨石，三秒内坠落在东京湾方向的水里。男子没有立刻反应，继续说着电话，只是眼神不自觉飘向那个方向。 两秒后，一声沉闷的低频震动从脚底传来，不是很响，但桥面的钢板在轻微颤抖。旁边车里的人摇下车窗探头张望。男子停止说话，手机还贴着耳朵，眼睛看向东京湾。 海面升起一团低矮的白色水雾，范围很大，像是什么东西在水下爆炸。没有火，没有蘑菇云，掀起巨浪。随后天空出现更多的陨石坠落。 五秒后巨大的冲击波将城市毁灭。画面定格。渐黑。

en.p: 【Core Theme】 Realistic sci-fi tokusatsu, falling from ruins, gathering of holy feathers, platinum mecha angel, cinematic divinity. 【Basic Character Setting】 Bruises on the face, bloodstains at the corner of the mouth. Expression slightly weary. At the moment of transformation, slight pain on the face, brows only slightly furrowed, maintaining a sense of oppression. White tattered coat, black casual tattered shirt, and white torn pants—battle-worn clothing. Core Prop: Right hand tightly grips a 'Holy Ring Crystal Core' emitting high-frequency pure white-blue light. 【Scene Environment】 Post-apocalyptic, city, skyscraper rooftop, overcast, light breeze, war-torn, gray-blue sky. Meteors with flames and thick smoke streak across the sky. 【Atmosphere and Image Quality】 Visual Tone: Cinematic quality. Simulating an IMAX film camera paired with a Panavision C-series lens (focal length 35mm, aperture f4). Color and Lighting: Low-saturation gray-blue main tone. Shadow details compressed but retained. Edges with slight soft focus and moderate film grain. Style Core: CG aesthetic style. Emphasizing the fusion of biological texture and alien technology, creating a sense of oppression, heaviness, and realistic physical pain. Special Effects Core: Emphasizing the dynamic process of countless glowing feathers materializing and converging, along with a divine quality during mecha assembly. 【Camera Movement】 Single Shot: One continuous take, no cuts. Dynamic Trajectory: Opening extreme wide-angle fall -> trembling push to half-body close-up -> circling during transformation -> pull back to low-angle full-body shot. Breathing Sensation: Handheld shooting, maintaining a slight, breath-like camera float throughout, enhancing immersion. 【Timeline】 0-3 seconds: Fall. Action: The protagonist crashes heavily from a height into the ruins, rolling several times due to inertia, creating a visually intense impact. The body stirs up a ring of dust and smoke. She breathes heavily, struggling to stand, her dark brown hair disheveled, mud-stained face lowered, eyes fixed on the pulsating blue-white crystal core in her right hand. Camera: Follows the fall, strong shake upon impact, quickly pushes to half-body shot. 3-6 seconds: Feathers Converge. Action: The protagonist mutters to herself, firmly saying, 'Then let's do it again!' Action and Effects: Gritting her teeth, she crushes the crystal core in her hand. With a crisp energy burst, a blinding white light shoots into the sky. Feather Convergence: Countless glowing white feathers materialize out of thin air, forming a high-speed rotating vortex that instantly envelops her right arm and rapidly spreads across her entire body. The protagonist's pupils are replaced by pure white light. Environmental Resonance: Behind her, a massive, faint golden halo totem appears. The camera trembles slightly due to the energy impact, like tinnitus. 6-9 seconds: Tearing. Expression: Slight frown, enduring pain. The protagonist tilts her head back, bearing the immense impact, brows tightly knit. A sacred white airwave bursts from within her body. Core: A few glass-like fragments eject from the surface of her skin. Golden light dust spills out, spreading from the inner side of the belt to her torso with a rainbow micro-glow. Body: White smoke erupts from within, carrying hair-like strands. 9-12 seconds: Reassembly and Wing Spread. New Material: A full set of white armor covers her body, the surface with a pearl-like matte texture and golden sacred relief patterns, with faint blue energy flows seeping through the gaps. Shoulder Armor: Newly formed golden shoulder armor clashes, sparking electric flashes, leaving permanent, burn-like tooth marks. Feather Core Display: With a resounding mechanical roar, a pair of massive mechanical wings made of white metal feathers suddenly unfurl behind her, the edges scattering glowing light feathers. Clothing: The original clothes are already tattered, rapidly stripped from the protagonist's body by some eerie force. Face Coverage: White LED-like fragments spread from the face, forming a crown of feathers that creates a semi-transparent helmet revealing the face. The helmet's semi-transparent face display shows vital signs and combat information on the screen-like eyes. Golden Halo: A fiber-optic quantum-generated circular golden halo appears behind her, alternating between white and gold. The golden halo rotates, with energy light pulses surging. Gaze: Throughout the transformation, the protagonist's gaze remains fixed on the distance. Fine golden arcs crackle with a sizzling sound. The airflow around her begins to churn, the surging heat causing slight chromatic aberration distortion in the image. Armor Growth: With a divine mechanical clicking sound, white streamlined armor plates materialize in the glow of the feathers, quickly fitting onto her torso and limbs for assembly. Dazzling golden arcs burst from the metal joints. Shell Fragments: Shell fragments scatter, with rainbow prism-like fragments flickering and floating around her body, pausing in rotation before eerily retracting and reassembling into armor parts. Face: Eyes continue to emit white light, with a divine presence, symmetrical thick-line totem tattoos appear on the face. Camera: Shakes violently due to the impact, loses focus, then sharply pulls back into alignment. 12-15 seconds: Completion. Helmet: The entire face is covered by a white mask, leaving only the eyes visible. Weapon Manifestation: The protagonist suddenly spreads both arms to the sides. Countless light feathers converge in her palms, instantly forming two holy energy blades emitting white flames. Final Composition: The camera pulls back and switches to a low-angle upward shot. The protagonist, clad in platinum armor, with massive mechanical wings fully extended, wields dual weapons in a combat stance. The sacred pressure she emits causes surrounding debris to levitate, freezing the frame in a stunning moment like an angel's descent. Final Shot: Circles to the character's right side, camera shifts to a top-down view, slowly pulling back at an extremely gradual pace. Transformation complete, the character launches vertically upward, flying out of the frame. The camera shakes due to the massive airflow and heat waves.

zh.p:
【核心主题】
写实科幻特摄 ，废墟坠落 ，圣洁羽毛汇聚 ，白金机甲天使 ，电影级神性 

【人物基础设定】
面部有淤青，嘴角有血渍。表情略显疲态。
变身瞬间，表情轻微痛苦，眉心仅轻微蹙起，保持压抑感。 
白色破烂外套黑色随性破烂衬衣，和白色破裤子，经历了战斗的战损衣服。 
核心道具：
右手紧握一块散发着高频纯白蓝光芒的“圣环水晶核心”。 
场景环境：
末日，城市，摩天大楼天台，阴天，微风，战火纷飞，灰蓝色调天空。天空中划过带有火焰与浓烟的陨石。 

【氛围与画质】
视觉基调：电影质感。模拟 IMAX 胶片摄影机，搭配 Panavision C 系列镜头（焦段 35mm，光圈 f4）。 
色彩与影调：低饱和灰蓝主调。暗部信息压缩，保留细节。边缘添加轻微柔焦与适度的胶片颗粒感。 
风格核心：CG美学风格。强调生物质感与外星科技的融合，营造压抑、沉重、实拍的肉身痛苦感。 
特效核心：强调无数发光羽毛实体化汇聚的动态过程，以及机甲装备时带有神性。

【运镜】
单镜头：一镜到底，无剪辑。 
动态轨迹：开场极广角坠落 -> 震颤推至半身特写 -> 变身时环绕 -> 拉远仰拍全身。 
呼吸感：手持拍摄，全程保持轻微的、如呼吸般的镜头浮动，增强临场感。 

【时间轴】
0-3秒 坠落 动作：
主角从高空重重砸在废墟中惯性让身体滚了几圈，给人很惨烈的视觉冲击。身体激起环形烟尘气浪。她剧烈喘息着艰难站起，黑棕色头发凌乱，沾满泥污的脸低垂，目光死死盯着右手中搏动的蓝白色水晶核心。 
镜头：跟随坠落，砸地瞬间强烈震颤，快速推至半身。 

3-6 秒 羽毛汇聚 ：
主角喃喃自语低声坚定的说：“那就再来一次！" 
动作与特效：主角咬牙手捏碎手中的水晶核心。伴随清脆的能量爆裂声，一道刺目的白光冲天而起。
 羽毛汇聚：空气中凭空浮现出无数发光的洁白羽毛，它们形成一个高速旋转的涡流，瞬间包裹住她的右臂并迅速向全身蔓延。主角双眼瞳孔被纯白光芒取代。 
环境共鸣：身后浮现出一个巨大的、若隐若现的金色光环图腾。镜头因能量冲击产生耳鸣般的微颤。

6-9 秒 撕裂 ：
表情：轻微皱眉，忍受痛苦。 主角仰头承受巨大冲击，眉心紧锁。体内爆发出神圣的白色气浪 
核心：全身皮肤表面弹射出少许玻璃碎屑。金色光尘溢出，闪着彩虹色微光从腰带内侧向身体躯干蔓延。 
身体：白色烟雾从体内喷涌，裹挟着发丝般。 

9-12 秒 重组与展翅：
新物质：全套白色机甲覆盖全身，装甲表面带有珍珠般的哑光质感和金色的神圣纹路浮雕，缝隙中透出淡蓝色的能量光流。肩甲：新生的金色肩甲对撞，爆发出电光火花，留下永久的、如同烫伤的齿痕。 
羽毛核心展现：伴随着一声震撼的机械轰鸣，一对巨大的、由白色金属羽翼构成的机械翅膀在她身后猛然展开，翅膀边缘散落着发光的光羽。 
衣物：原有的衣物已经破烂不堪，被某种诡异的力量从主角身上快速抽离，离开身体。 
面部覆盖：白色透led碎面从面部开始蔓延面部，头戴由羽毛组成的皇冠，组成漏出面部的半透明头盔，头盔半透明面部显示屏中有生命体征和战斗信息的屏幕双眼。 
金色光环：背部有光纤量子生成圆形金色光环在背后浮现，白色金色色相间。金色光环旋转，旋转能量光脉冲式涌动。 视线：在整个变身过程中，主角的视线始终注视远方。纤细的金色电弧，发出滋滋碎响。身体周围的气流开始翻涌，翻涌的热浪对画面产生轻微色散畸变效果。 
装甲生长：伴随着富有神性的机械咬合声，白色的流线型机甲片在羽毛的光辉中实体化，迅速贴合她的躯干与四肢进行组装。金属连接处迸发出耀眼的金色电弧。
甲壳：甲壳碎屑四溅，有彩虹色棱镜碎片闪烁飘出，飘在身体周围，旋转悬停片刻后诡异回缩，重新回溯组合成战衣零件。 
面部：眼睛持续发白光，带有神性的威亚，面部出现对称的粗线条图腾纹身。 镜头：因冲击剧烈晃动、失焦，随即猛拉回正。

头盔：整个面部被白色面具覆盖，只露出双眼。 
武器具象化：主角双臂向身体两侧猛然张开。掌心无数光羽凝聚，瞬间化作两把散发着白色烈焰的圣能战刀 
最终构图：镜头拉远并切为低角度仰拍。主角身着白金机甲，巨大的机械翅膀完全伸展，手持双武器摆出战斗姿态。她周身散发的神圣威压导致周围地面的碎石悬浮升空，画面定格在如天使降临般的震撼瞬间。 
最终镜头：环绕至人物右侧，机位变为俯拍，镜头以极缓速度逐渐向后拉远，变身完毕人物向正上方弹射起飞，垂直飞出画面。镜头被巨大的气流和热浪影响而抖动。

右手紧握一块散发着高频纯白蓝光芒的“圣环水晶核心”。

en.p: 15 seconds, 9:16 vertical screen, deliberately imitating low-quality mobile phone video, handheld POV, high noise + motion blur + digital compression distortion + timestamp watermark (upper left corner, 2007 style). 0-5 seconds: Handheld, following a girl in the rain at night from behind [Image 1], overall image quality deliberately aged—like a 2007 Nokia shot, but the protagonist is stunning, oversized thick sweater, neon wet ground reflections, details all in the contrast. 5-9 seconds: She stops and looks back, delayed focus from blurry to sharp, staring directly at the camera, expression shifting from dazed to a light smile, casual and sweet; steps closer to the camera, tucks wet hair behind her ear. 9-13 seconds: She leans in close to the camera, pokes the lens with her finger—the screen instantly shows blur and shake from the touch—then steps back two paces, hands in pockets, looking at you with a hint of smugness against the neon backlight. 13-15 seconds: She turns and walks into the rainy night, stops after two steps, doesn't look back, just raises one hand to wave, then disappears into the neon rain and mist; the camera lingers on the empty street for 2 seconds, digital noise slowly eating away the image. Sound effects: Throughout, city rain background noise + slight electrical hum from phone recording, ambient sound fading out at the end. Prohibited: Subtitles, additional watermarks (except timestamp), any modern UI elements.

zh.p: 在一座最高安全级别的监狱里，警报声刺耳响起，囚犯们在走廊上暴动。金属门砰然打开，狱警们奋力试图恢复秩序，而囚犯们如暴风般涌入走廊，暴力肆虐。一名意志坚定的越狱者在混乱中奋力突围，躲避着警棍和催泪瓦斯。

raw_p: Inside a maximum-security prison, alarms blare as inmates riot in the corridors. Metal doors slam open, guards struggle to regain control, and prisoners flood the hallways in a storm of violence. A determined escapee fights through the chaos, dodging batons and tear gas

en.p: 16:9 horizontal screen, national comic movie-level visuals, gold and white holy light color palette. 0-3 seconds: Dark clouds gather above a cliff, a young swordsman kneels with both hands gripping an ancient sword embedded in the rock, baby face with round eyes, single eyelids, messy black hair soaked with sweat. Runes swirl around the ancient sword emitting a humming sound, the camera slowly descends from a top-down view. 4-7 seconds: The demon army from the sky presses down, led by a demon general wielding a black war halberd, square face with a thick beard, green ghost fire burning in his eye sockets. He waves his hand to signal the army to attack, countless black arrows shoot toward the young man like locusts, the camera quickly zooms in. 8-12 seconds: The young man suddenly pulls out the ancient sword, a golden-white light surges into the sky dispelling the dark clouds. The dragon pattern on the sword awakens with a dragon's roar, the young man swings the sword unleashing a golden sword aura that turns all arrows to dust, the camera follows the sword aura's trajectory at high speed. 13-15 seconds: The young man steps into the air, a golden dragon phantom appears behind him, he slashes at the demon general. The demon general raises his halberd to block but the weapon is cut in two, and he is split from shoulder to waist. Golden light engulfs the entire battlefield, the demon army retreats in terror, the frame freezes on the silhouette of the young man holding the sword looking down, sunlight piercing through the clouds behind him. Sound effects: Sword humming, dragon roar shaking the heavens, arrows shattering, demon screams. Prohibited: Any text, subtitles, LOGO, or watermark.

zh.p:
16:9 横屏，国漫电影级画面，金白圣光色调。
0-3 秒：断崖之上乌云密布，少年剑客跪地双手握住插在岩石中的古剑，娃娃脸配圆眼，单眼皮，黑发凌乱被汗浸湿，古剑周围符文流转发出嗡鸣，镜头从俯视缓慢旋转下降。
4-7 秒：天空魔族大军压境，为首魔将手持黑色战戈，方脸配络腮胡，眼眶中燃烧绿色鬼火，挥手示意大军进攻，无数黑色箭矢如蝗虫般射向少年，镜头快速推近。
8-12 秒：少年猛然拔出古剑，金白光芒冲天而起驱散乌云，剑身上龙纹苏醒发出龙吟，少年挥剑斩出金色剑气将所有箭矢化为齑粉，镜头跟随剑气轨迹高速推进。
13-15 秒：少年踏空而起，身后浮现金色巨龙虚影，一剑斩向魔将，魔将举戈格挡却被一剑斩断兵器并从肩膀到部劈开，金色光芒笼罩整个战场，魔族大军惊恐后退，画面定格在少年持剑俯视的剪影，身后阳光刺破云层。
音效：剑身嗡鸣、龙吟震天、箭矢碎裂、魔族惊呼。
禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO 或水印。

en.p: [Visual Composition] A 15-second continuous action sequence (4 shots) with a clear narrative structure, recreating the climax of a fantasy film. [Visual Style] Ultra-high-quality photorealistic cinematic imagery. A piercing blue sky, physics-based fabric movement, and dynamic camera work. [Characters] 1. Fairy: A brown beret, white dress, iridescent transparent wings on her back. 2. Monster: A giant, ominous shadow-like creature. 3. Warrior: A stunningly beautiful woman with long silver hair, clad in silver armor, riding a flying dinosaur (wyvern) with enormous wings. [Shot 1: Tense Escape] (Starting from the initial frame) The fairy, crouching on a massive white stone staircase, suddenly notices something behind her, gasps, stands up, and desperately runs up the stairs. The camera aggressively follows her from behind. [Shot 2: Monster's Pursuit] From the bottom of the stairs, a giant monster crawls up at a terrifying speed, closing in on the girl's feet. As the stone steps shatter, the girl is cornered at the top of a tower. [Shot 3: Desperate Dive] Reaching the edge of the tower, the girl hesitates for a moment but then, making up her mind, plunges headfirst into the sky without looking back. The camera runs alongside her, providing a POV perspective of rapidly falling toward the ground. [Shot 4: Rescue by Wings] From below the tower, amidst a blinding light, a silver-haired female warrior on a flying dragon appears at high speed. The warrior reaches out, firmly catches the girl mid-air, and holds her tightly. [Shot 5: Toward the Sky of Hope] The dragon carrying the warrior spreads its wings wide, ascends sharply, and crosses the screen. The two fly gracefully through the wind toward the beautiful white stone cityscape below. The scene ends with their silhouettes glowing in the backlight.

zh.p:
【映像構成】ファンタジー映画のクライマックスを再現した、起承転結のある15秒間（4ショット）の連続アクション映像。 

【映像スタイル】超高品質なフォトリアル・シネマティック映像。突き抜けるような青空、物理演算に基づいた衣装のなびき、ダイナミックなカメラワーク。

 【キャラクター】 1. 妖精：茶色のベレー帽、白いドレス、背中に虹色の透明な羽。 2. モンスター：巨大で禍々しい影のような怪物。 3. 戦士：銀の甲冑を纏った、白髪ロングヘアの絶世の美女。巨大な翼を持つ飛ぶ恐竜（ワイバーン）に跨っている。 

【Shot 1: 緊迫の逃走】（初期フレームから開始）白亜の巨大な階段にうずくまっていた妖精が、背後の異変に「ハッ」として立ち上がり、必死に階段を駆け上がっていく。カメラは背後から彼女を激しく追いかける。 

【Shot 2: モンスターの追撃】階段の下から巨大なモンスターが恐ろしいスピードで這い上がり、少女の足元にまで迫る。階段の石が砕け散る中、少女は塔の頂上へと追い詰められる。 

【Shot 3: 決死のダイブ】塔の端に到達した少女。一瞬だけ躊躇するが、意を決して後ろを振り向かずに真っ逆さまに空へと身を投じる。カメラは彼女の傍らを並走しながら、急速に地面へ向かって落下するPOV視点。 

【Shot 4: 翼の救出】塔の下方、眩しい光の中から飛ぶ恐竜に乗った白髪の女戦士が猛スピードで現れる。戦士は手を伸ばして空中で少女をガッシリと受け止め、力強く抱きかかえる。

 【Shot 5: 希望の空へ】戦士を乗せた飛竜が大きく翼を広げ、急上昇して画面を横切る。二人は眼下に広がる白亜の美しい街並みに向かって、風を切りながら優雅に飛んでいく。逆光の中で二人のシルエットが輝いて終わる。

First-person POV of a lightning bolt forming inside a massive thundercloud.

Electric tendrils spread outward through dark vapor tunnels.

At the moment of discharge the bolt accelerates violently toward the ground.

The world blurs past as the lightning branches through the air.

The strike hits a city skyscraper and energy explodes across the rooftop.

Electric plasma POV, storm cloud interior, lightning strike descent, cinematic weather energy, 4K.

zh.p: 第一人称视角：一道闪电在巨大的雷暴云中形成。电流触须通过黑暗的蒸汽隧道向外蔓延。放电瞬间，闪电猛烈加速冲向地面。世界在闪电分支划过空气时变得模糊。闪电击中城市摩天大楼，能量在屋顶上爆发。电流等离子体视角，暴风云内部，闪电下落，电影级天气能量，4K。

Please generate a smooth dueling scene centered around the two female leads, in the classic style of wuxia and xianxia films, with dense green bamboo groves and falling leaves. Ultra-high-speed photography, entirely live-action with real actors, requiring the use of storyboard shots and different perspective switches to make the entire scene more rhythmic and cinematic, with strong visual impact. Only generate fighting sound effects and environmental sounds, no background music. Shot 1: Medium shot, the woman in white swiftly attacks with her sword, the woman in green quickly spins to dodge and delivers a strike. Shot 2: Close-up shot, the woman in white swings her sword to block. Then, cut to a medium-long shot, the woman in white slides backward, the woman in green follows closely with her sword, dust rises from the ground, and the camera tracks the movement. Shot 3: Medium-long shot, circling follow, the two exchange sword strikes in the bamboo forest, with strong visual impact. Shot 4: Close-up shot, the woman in white's sword suddenly breaks. Then cut to a medium shot, the woman in green points her sword at the woman in white's throat and withdraws it. Note: The woman in white wields a white sword throughout, while the woman in green wields a sword with a black blade (must be a black blade), consistent with the reference images. Both hold their swords with one hand, and the other hand holds nothing.]
en.t: Bamboo Forest Sword Duel: Two Heroines Clash

en.p: Pixar-style smooth animation, cozy bedroom with sunlight from window, toy shelf in background. Camera dolly-in to white table. A stack of origami papers floats gracefully, each sheet folding mid-air into Avengers heroes: red-gold becomes Iron Man, green shapes into Hulk, blue with star into Captain America, black-red into Black Widow, silver-blue into Thor with paper Mjolnir. Camera pans and tilts smoothly with each transformation. Background folds into origami skyscrapers and glowing sky. Final pullback shows full Avengers team pose in a vibrant origami city, cinematic yet playful tone.

en.p: 0-2 seconds: Medium front shot, three pets—dog, parrot, and cat—lined up looking at the camera. The person off-screen raises their hand like a gun and says, "Come on, let's do a drill." 2-5 seconds: Cut to a close-up of the dog. The off-screen person shouts, "Biu!" The dog dramatically falls over, sticking out its tongue. The off-screen person nods and says, "Good job, Wangcai, very dedicated." 5-8 seconds: Cut to a close-up of the parrot. The off-screen person shouts, "Biu!" The parrot tilts its head back, stiffens, and falls over. The off-screen person says approvingly, "The extra is cooperating well too." 8-12 seconds: Cut to a close-up of the cat. The off-screen person says, "Biu." The cat sits still, staring coldly at the camera. The off-screen person frowns and says, "Why aren't you following the script?" 12-15 seconds: The off-screen person locks eyes with the cat, points at it sternly, and says, "If you don't fall over—" then pauses before adding, "all the cat food today goes to Wangcai!" The cat instantly lies down. On-screen, a subtitle appears: "The Self-Cultivation of an Actor."

Background: Ancient immortal sect architecture (eaves and corridors, peach blossom branches, bluestone ground, mist, palace lanterns, flowing water). zh.p: 风格：仙气古风、清新甜美、第一视角沉浸式跟随、柔光唯美 总时长：15s = 6 个分镜 × 2.5s / 镜（单镜≤3s，符合要求） 核心人设：小师妹｜月白浅粉渐变纱衣、广袖飘逸、满头blingbling 珍珠碎钻发簪、眉眼清甜、软萌灵动 背景：仙门古建（飞檐回廊、桃花枝、青石地、薄雾、宫灯、流水） 内容：小师妹主动带路参观 + 即兴轻舞，沉浸式治愈感 完整分镜脚本（动作极详细，即梦直接适配） 镜头 1｜2.5s｜第一视角跟随・近景 + 慢推 运镜：第一视角向前慢推，沉浸式迎面走来 画面 & 动作： 小师妹站在古建回廊口，侧身回头对你笑，眼弯成月牙； 右手轻轻撩起一侧纱袖，左手自然垂在身侧，发簪随转头闪细碎光； 脚尖轻点青石地，小碎步上前，主动伸手做「跟我来」的邀请手势。 背景：木质飞檐、垂挂白纱、淡粉桃花枝、薄雾轻绕 特效：发丝柔光、发簪碎钻反光、浅淡花瓣粒子 镜头 2｜2.5s｜侧跟运镜・中景・移步参观 运镜：第一视角侧跟，平稳移动 画面 & 动作： 小师妹转身带路，广袖纱衣随风轻飘； 左手轻扶回廊木栏，右手自然摆动，步伐轻盈小碎步； 路过桃花枝时，抬手轻轻拂过花瓣，指尖碰落两瓣桃花，回头对你甜甜眨眼。 背景：古建回廊、青石步道、垂枝桃花、朦胧宫灯 特效：花瓣飘落、裙摆动态飘纱、发簪流光 镜头 3｜2.5s｜环绕运镜・中景・庭院驻足 运镜：慢环绕小师妹半圈，沉浸式看庭院全景 画面 & 动作： 走到庭院中央，小师妹停下转身面向你； 双手背在身后，脚尖微微踮起，歪头笑，介绍庭院； 发簪随歪头晃动，blingbling 反光，纱衣下摆轻旋。 背景：仙门古建庭院、石桌石凳、薄雾、远山飞檐、满庭桃花 特效：地面柔光、淡雾流动、花瓣慢落 镜头 4｜2.5s｜近景推镜・起手式・预备跳舞 运镜：镜头快速轻推至半身近景 画面 & 动作： 小师妹轻声一笑，双手缓缓抬起至肩侧，广袖自然展开； 左脚轻踏半步，重心微侧，身体微微后仰，做古典舞起手式； 眉眼温柔，发丝轻扬，发簪在柔光下闪钻光，仙气拉满。 背景：虚化古建庭院，聚焦人物 特效：袖摆流光、周身淡粉色仙气光晕、细碎星光粒子 镜头 5｜2.5s｜全景俯拍・轻舞旋转・核心表演 运镜：轻俯拍 + 小幅环绕，唯美全景 画面 & 动作： 小师妹原地小旋身 1 圈，广袖纱衣完全展开如花瓣； 右手高举拂袖过头顶，左手轻按腰侧，脚尖点地小跳； 舞步轻柔，裙摆飘飞，发簪随旋转闪连续亮光，笑容甜美。 背景：古建飞檐、满庭桃花、薄雾环绕、沉浸式全景 特效：旋身带粉色光尾、花瓣随舞步飞起、仙气雾效 镜头 6｜2.5s｜近景定格・收尾比心・甜美收尾 运镜：镜头拉回近景，轻微定格 画面 & 动作： 旋身停下，小师妹面向你，双手在脸颊旁比出小巧爱心； 头轻轻歪向一侧，甜甜笑，发簪垂落碎光； 纱袖轻垂，脚步站稳，温柔收尾。 背景：模糊古建 + 桃花，柔光特写 特效：爱心淡光效、发簪 blingbling 高光、花瓣收尾飘落 即梦「一键复制」生成指令（逐镜直接粘贴） 镜头 1（2.5s） 第一视角沉浸式，古风仙气小师妹，月白浅粉纱衣，满头 blingbling 珍珠钻发簪，清新甜美，回廊口回头笑，小碎步上前伸手邀请，古建飞檐白纱桃花，薄雾柔光，发簪反光，花瓣粒子，唯美古风，高清流畅 镜头 2（2.5s） 第一视角侧跟，仙气小师妹带路，轻扶古建木栏，拂过桃花枝，回头眨眼甜笑，广袖纱衣飘逸，青石回廊桃花，动态飘纱，发簪流光，花瓣飘落，沉浸式古风，高清 镜头 3（2.5s） 慢环绕运镜，仙气小师妹庭院驻足，背手踮脚歪头笑，介绍庭院，古建庭院石桌桃花，薄雾柔光，发簪 blingbling 反光，清新甜美，沉浸式古风，高清 镜头 4（2.5s） 轻推近景，仙气小师妹古典舞起手式，抬手展袖，侧身踮脚，眉眼温柔，纱衣广袖飘逸，发簪钻光，周身淡粉仙气光晕，星光粒子，唯美古风，高清 镜头 5（2.5s） 轻俯拍环绕，仙气小师妹轻舞旋身 1 圈，广袖展开如花瓣，踮脚小跳拂袖，裙摆飘飞，古建庭院桃花薄雾，旋身光尾花瓣飞舞，发簪流光，高燃唯美古风，高清 镜头 6（2.5s） 近景定格，仙气小师妹跳舞跳舞收尾，双手比心歪头甜笑，纱袖轻垂，发簪碎钻高光，爱心光效，桃花花瓣收尾，古建柔光背景，清新甜美仙气，高清流
