en.p: Seedance 2.0...【Film Style】 Cinematic horror thriller, modern supernatural suspense film, dark forest atmosphere, volumetric fog, moody blue night lighting, realistic flashlight illumination, slow tension building, dramatic horror soundtrack atmosphere. 【Duration】 12 seconds  【Protagonist】 A young woman alone in a dark forest at night holding a flashlight, cautiously approaching a small abandoned wooden cabin. 【Storyboard Script】 [00:00–00:05] Shot 1: Arrival & Approach Scene: A misty forest at night with tall pine trees surrounding an old wooden cabin. Action: The woman slowly walks toward the cabin holding a flashlight. The beam cuts through drifting fog and illuminates tree trunks and the cabin porch. Camera: Wide cinematic tracking shot moving slowly behind her, matching the arrival and approach frames from the storyboard. [00:05–00:9] Shot 2: Suspense & Awareness Action: She stops walking and slowly turns her head as if she hears something in the woods. Her breathing becomes tense. Camera: The camera pushes in from medium shot to a close-up of her worried face while the flashlight beam trembles slightly. Environmental Detail: Fog drifts between trees, the cabin creaks quietly, and distant forest sounds echo. [00:09–00:12] Shot 3: Fear & Vulnerability Action: She raises the flashlight and slowly scans the forest around her. Her eyes dart nervously between the trees. Dialogue Cue: In a soft, nervous British accent she calls out quietly, **"Hello?"** Performance Direction: Her voice trembles slightly as if she is unsure whether she wants an answer. Atmosphere: Fog thickens and the forest grows silent as she waits for a response. 【Technical Parameters】 Cinematic depth of field, HDR night lighting, volumetric fog particles, realistic flashlight light scattering, subtle handheld tension, dramatic horror color grading.

zh.p: Seedance 2.0...【电影风格】电影级恐怖惊悚片，现代超自然悬疑电影，黑暗森林氛围，体积雾，忧郁的蓝色夜景照明，逼真的手电筒光照，缓慢的紧张感营造，戏剧性的恐怖配乐氛围。【时长】12秒【主角】一位年轻女性深夜独自在黑暗森林中手持手电筒，小心翼翼地靠近一座废弃的小木屋。【分镜脚本】[00:00–00:05] 镜头1：抵达与接近 场景：夜晚雾气弥漫的森林，高大的松树环绕着一座旧木屋。动作：女性手持手电筒缓缓走向木屋。光束穿透飘浮的雾气，照亮树干和木屋门廊。镜头：宽幅电影级跟踪镜头，在她身后缓慢移动，与分镜中的抵达和接近画面一致。[00:05–00:09] 镜头2：悬疑与警觉 动作：她停下脚步，缓缓转头，仿佛听到林中有动静。呼吸变得紧张。镜头：镜头从中景推近至她忧虑面部的特写，手电筒光束微微颤抖。环境细节：雾气在林间飘荡，木屋发出轻微的吱嘎声，远处森林的回声隐约可闻。[00:09–00:12] 镜头3：恐惧与脆弱 动作：她举起手电筒，缓慢扫视周围的森林。目光紧张地在树木间游移。对话提示：她用轻柔而紧张的英国口音低声呼唤：**“有人吗？”** 表演指导：声音微微颤抖，仿佛不确定是否希望得到回应。镜头：特写她的面部，被手电筒光照亮，然后缓缓拉远，展现她在黑暗森林中的孤独。氛围：雾气渐浓，森林陷入寂静，她等待着回应。【技术参数】电影级景深，HDR夜景照明，体积雾粒子，逼真的手电筒光散射，微妙的持机紧张感，戏剧性的恐怖色调分级。

en.p: 【Character Settings】 • Male: About early 20s, with a neat hairstyle, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers. His personality seems a bit simple, with eyes that convey 'pure foolishness.' • Female: About early 20s, with long hair and bangs, wearing a Japanese-style JK uniform (white short-sleeved shirt, dark blue bow tie, dark blue pleated skirt, black stockings). Her personality has a huge reversal, from gentle to 'bossy.' 【Scene Settings】 • Location: By the bedside in the bedroom. • Background: Light gray pleated curtains, tidy bed, soft lighting. 【Script Content】 00:00 - 00:01 • Visual: The two sit side by side on the edge of the bed. The girl holds a bag of snacks and eats. • Text Title (top): When you accidentally touch your girlfriend • Character Status: The boy stares blankly ahead (simulating watching TV), the girl chews expressionlessly. 00:01 - 00:02 • Visual: The boy naturally reaches into the snack bag in the girl's arms to grab some food. • Subtitle: Watching TV together~ • Expression: The boy is very calm, his mind entirely on the 'TV.' 00:02 - 00:04 • Visual: The boy takes a snack from the bag and puts it in his mouth, chewing with relish. • Subtitle: Grabbing food • Expression: Both maintain a peaceful viewing atmosphere. 00:04 - 00:05 • Visual: The boy reaches again, but this time misses the bag, his hand directly landing on the girl's leg (thigh area). • Subtitle: Reaching again... • Action: The boy's hand not only lands but also pauses slightly, clearly not yet realizing. 00:05 - 00:06 • Visual: The scene instantly freezes. The girl stops chewing, slowly turns her head to stare at the boy's hand, then looks at the boy's face. • Subtitle: Touching me? • Expression Change: * Girl: Her gaze shifts from confusion to a sly smile of 'scheme succeeded.' • Boy: Pupils dilate, mouth slightly open, body frozen, face full of 'I didn't mean to, I'm doomed.' 00:06 - 00:07 • Visual: The girl suddenly puts down the snack bag and lunges toward the boy like a 'hungry tiger pouncing on prey.' The boy panics, raising his hands in a defensive gesture, leaning back. • Subtitle: You started it~ • Dialogue (Boy): 'That's not what I meant, I didn't...' 00:07 - 00:09 • Visual: Background music becomes urgent/rhythmic. The girl straddles over (with large, domineering movements), and the boy, with no retreat, shrinks into the corner of the bed. • Subtitle: Really, don't... • Expression: The girl smiles brightly (with a playful sense of pressure), while the boy looks terrified but with a hint of helpless compliance. • Visual Effect: The scene ends with a quick cut to rhythmic music, creating a humorous atmosphere of 'the boy can't escape.'

en.p: 9:16 vertical screen, street interview style, strong sense of realism. 0-2 seconds: The camera focuses on a long queue, and the blogger (a round-faced girl) says to the camera: 'Wuhan! 3 AM! What are these people queuing for? Hotpot? No!' The camera quickly moves to the end of the line. 3-6 seconds: The camera interviews a guy in the queue (wearing glasses). The blogger asks: 'Bro, what are you queuing for?' The guy excitedly says: 'For shrimp! OpenClaw! I heard the installation package needs to be grabbed!' An aunt behind him leans in and asks: 'What kind of shrimp is this? Spicy or garlic?' 7-10 seconds: The camera cuts to the front of the queue, where a guy who looks like a programmer says to the camera: 'I've been queuing for 6 hours! Finally, it's my turn to raise a lobster!' The scene shows him frantically tapping his phone screen, accompanied by the sound effect 'Congratulations on successful adoption.' 11-15 seconds: The camera returns to the blogger, who stands at the now-empty queue spot and says: 'Turns out the server crashed, and everyone queued for nothing.' A guy next to her is crying, holding his head. The camera freezes on the blogger making a helpless OK gesture, with the bullet comment effect 'Lobster is too popular' floating by. Sound effects: street noise, crying, funny 'it's over' sound effect, and the voiceover 'Come earlier next time.'

zh.p:
9:16竖屏，街访风格，真实感强烈。
0 - 2秒：镜头对着长长的队伍，博主（圆脸女生）对着镜头说："武汉！凌晨三点！这些人排队干嘛？火锅？不！" 镜头快速推进到队伍末尾。
3 - 6秒：镜头采访排队小哥（戴眼镜），博主问："兄弟，排啥呢？"小哥激动地说："吃虾！OpenClaw！听说安装包要抢！"后面大妈探头："这是啥虾？麻辣还是蒜蓉？"
7 - 10秒：镜头切到队伍前方，一个程序员模样的男生对着镜头说："我排了6小时！终于轮到我养龙虾了！"画面到他疯狂点击手机屏幕，配"恭喜你领养成功"音效。
11 - 15秒：镜头回到博主，她站在空荡荡的队伍位置说："结果服务器崩了，大家白排。"旁边一个男生抱头痛哭。镜头定格在博主无奈比OK手势和"龙虾太火了"弹幕特效飘过。
音效：街道嘈杂、哭声、搞笑"完了"音效、"下次早点来"配音。

en.p: Ultra-wide-angle macro FPV tracking sequence following a cat. The feline is never fully revealed; only fragmented glimpses pass the lens: the twitch of an ear, scattered whiskers, a paw brushing the floor, a swath of fur gliding past the camera. Focus continuously shifts between these fleeting details and nearby environmental hazards. Shot at 120fps to capture subtle tremors and high-frequency vibrations as the cat bounds and lands. Setting: An abandoned underground parking structure. Textured concrete floor, numbered pillars with faded, indecipherable markings, shallow puddles and tire tracks reflecting harsh light. Dust particles and condensation mist hang in the air. Sparse cold-white ceiling LEDs mingle with distant vehicle headlights, creating sharp contrast and deep shadows. The cavernous space resonates with emptiness and tension. Movement: The cat navigates unpredictably—darting through narrow gaps, executing sudden 90° pivots, explosive bursts of speed, and tight lateral rolls that skim edges of doors and guardrails. The camera mirrors its frenetic rhythm, micro-vibrating with the steps and accentuating exaggerated motion parallax as pillars and parked cars streak past. Key interaction: A gust of wind—generated by ventilation and a passing car—lifts loose debris: paper scraps, plastic bags, and dust swirl into a spiraling vortex. As the cat rockets forward, debris stretches into radial motion blur lines, enhanced by fisheye distortion. A rolling tire splashes a puddle, scattering droplets that refract light realistically. Climactic moment: A car’s headlight suddenly sweeps across the scene, reflecting sharply off the wet floor. The cat skids into a chaotic spiral, claws gripping the slick surface, fur vibrating, droplets flinging outward—captured in 120fps slow motion. Motion instantly resumes at high speed as the cat races along the ramp edge, hugging walls, and threads through a half-open maintenance door or narrow fence gap, escaping into safety. Atmosphere: Claustrophobic, urgent, and tense, yet ultimately triumphant. Sound design emphasizes rushing air, splashing water, metallic echoes from guardrails, and residual vibrations. The sequence concludes as the cat lands in a shadowy corner, with the camera’s lingering tremors gradually fading into stillness.

zh.p: 超广角微距FPV追踪镜头跟随一只猫。这只猫从未完全显露，只有零星的局部掠过镜头：耳朵的抽动、散落的胡须、爪子擦过地面、一撮毛皮从镜头前滑过。焦点在这些转瞬即逝的细节与周围的环境危险之间不断切换。以120帧/秒拍摄，捕捉猫跳跃落地时细微的颤动和高频振动。场景设定：一座废弃的地下停车场。纹理混凝土地面，编号立柱上褪色难辨的标记，浅水洼和轮胎印反射着刺眼的光线。灰尘颗粒和冷凝雾气悬浮在空气中。稀疏的冷白天花板灯与远处车灯交织，形成强烈对比和深邃阴影。空旷的空间回荡着空虚与紧张。运动：猫以不可预测的方式穿行——钻过狭窄缝隙，突然90度急转，爆发式加速，以及紧贴门边和护栏的紧凑侧滚。镜头模仿其狂乱的节奏，随着脚步微颤，当立柱和停放的车辆飞速掠过时，强化了夸张的运动视差。关键互动：一阵由通风和过往车辆产生的风卷起松散杂物——纸片、塑料袋和灰尘旋转成螺旋涡流。当猫向前猛冲时，杂物拉伸成径向运动模糊线条，鱼眼畸变增强了效果。滚动的轮胎溅起水洼，散落的水滴逼真地折射光线。高潮时刻：一辆车的头灯突然扫过场景，在湿地上反射出刺眼光芒。猫滑入混乱的螺旋，爪子抓紧光滑表面，毛发颤动，水滴向外飞溅——以120帧/秒慢动作捕捉。运动瞬间恢复高速，猫沿着坡道边缘疾驰，紧贴墙壁，穿过半开的维修门或狭窄栅栏缝隙，逃入安全地带。氛围：幽闭、紧迫、紧张，但最终充满胜利感。音效设计强调呼啸的风声、溅水声、护栏的金属回响和残余振动。镜头以猫落在阴暗角落结束，镜头残留的颤动逐渐平息为静止。

en.p: A cinematic video sequence opens with a serene wide-angle aerial shot of a pristine snow-capped mountain at dawn, its peak piercing through a vast sea of clouds, with the golden sunlight tinting the ice layers in shades of pink and gold. The scene transitions to follow a wingsuit pilot leaping from the summit, immediately plunging through thin clouds into a rapid vertical dive. The tracking camera stays close behind and above the pilot, shaking slightly from turbulent airflow as ice particles rush past. The pilot enters a proximity flight mode, skimming just meters above steep rock faces and jagged ice formations, with the camera tilting and rolling to follow every precise maneuver. As the pilot navigates through a narrow ice crevice, light and shadow interplay across the wingsuit's surface, while the ice walls on either side blur into streaks of blue and white. Entering a massive glacial canyon, speed surges as the pilot weaves between colossal ice pillars and frozen waterfalls, stirring up mist and powder snow that spiral into trailing vortices. The pilot executes a daring barrel roll around a solitary ice spire before deploying the parachute at the last moment. The camera rises to follow the deceleration, then pulls back to reveal a breathtaking hidden alpine lake, surrounded by untouched snowfields, its surface as still as a mirror, perfectly reflecting the morning sky.

zh.p: 一段电影感的视频序列，以黎明时分一座纯净雪山的宁静广角航拍镜头开场，山顶穿透茫茫云海，日照金山将冰层染成粉色与金色。镜头转换，跟随一名从山顶纵身跃下的翼装飞行员，立即穿过薄云进入急速垂直俯冲。跟拍镜头紧贴飞行员后上方，随着加速下坠，画面因气流湍流而轻微抖动，冰霜颗粒飞掠而过。飞行员进入贴地飞行状态，紧贴陡峭岩壁和锯齿状冰层数米内掠过，摄像机跟随每一次精准动作进行倾斜导翻滚。当飞行员穿过狭窄的冰缝时，光影在翼装表面交错变换，两侧冰壁化作蓝白相间的模糊残影飞逝。进入巨大的冰川峡谷后速度激增，飞行员在巨大的冰柱和冰瀑之间穿梭，激起的雾气和粉雪形成螺旋状的尾迹。飞行员绕着一座独立的冰尖塔完成了一个惊险的桶滚动作，随后在最后一刻打开降落伞。摄像机跟随减速过程向上移动，随后拉远视角，展现出一个令人惊叹的隐秘高山湖泊，被无人踏足的雪原环绕，湖面籐止如镜，完美倒映着清晨的天空。

en.p: Harbor Break Run FORMAT: 15s / 6 SHOTS / grounded cinematic pursuit / no dialogue STYLE: Industrial harbor at blue hour, wet concrete, sodium-vapor lamps, soft fog, practical lens flares, restrained color palette, photoreal 35mm Shot 01 (0:00-0:02) A slow aerial drop into a working harbor reveals a single matte-black speeder blasting along a rain-dark service road between stacked containers and cranes. Shot 02 (0:02-0:04) The camera settles low behind the tail, close enough to feel the rear suspension vibrate; orange dock lights smear across the wet body panels. Shot 03 (0:04-0:07) A truck reverses unexpectedly across the lane, forcing the rider into a tight swerve through a narrow gap between a forklift and container corner. Shot 04 (0:07-0:10) The path cuts under a crane arm and through hanging chains, with droplets and sparks flicking off the speeder as it scrapes the edge of a steel barrier. Shot 05 (0:10-0:13) The camera pulls ahead for a front three-quarter angle as the rider exits the dock maze and skims beside open black water, city lights flickering across the surface. Shot 06 (0:13-0:15) One final bend reveals the full harbor skyline behind the rider; the speeder shoots down the pier into mist and sodium glow.

zh.p: 港湾飞车追逐 格式：15秒 / 6个镜头 / 地面电影级追车 / 无对白 风格：蓝色时刻的工业港口，湿漉漉的混凝土，钠蒸气灯，薄雾，实用镜头光晕，克制的色调，写实35毫米胶片 镜头01（0:00-0:02） 缓慢的航拍下降进入作业中的港口，一辆哑光黑色飞车在堆叠的集装箱和起重机之间，沿着被雨水浸黑的维修道路疾驰。 镜头02（0:02-0:04） 镜头低角度跟拍在车尾后方，近到能感受后悬挂的震动；橙色码头灯光在湿漉漉的车身上拖曳成模糊光带。 镜头03（0:04-0:07） 一辆卡车意外倒车横穿车道，迫使骑手在叉车与集装箱角落的狭窄缝隙间急转躲避。 镜头04（0:07-0:10） 路线切入起重机臂下方，穿过悬挂的链条，飞车擦过钢制护栏边缘时溅起水滴与火花。 镜头05（0:10-0:13） 镜头前移至车头斜侧方，骑手驶出码头迷宫，掠过开阔的黑色水面，城市灯光在水面闪烁。 镜头06（0:13-0:15） 最后一个弯道展现出骑手身后完整的港口天际线；飞车冲向码头尽头，消失在薄雾与钠灯辉光中。

en.p: FORMAT: 15s / 6 SHOTS / single continuous chase energy / no dialogue STYLE: Monumental cliff city carved into stone, sunset haze, wet rock reflections, waterfall mist, warm stone vs cool cyan engine glow, 35mm cinematic realism Shot 01 (0:00-0:02) Aerial dive from high above a colossal cliff city toward a tiny cyan speeder tearing along a razor-thin ledge road carved into the rock face. Shot 02 (0:02-0:04) The camera lock-ons to the speeder side profile, then slingshots ahead and whips back toward the rear thrusters, heat haze bending the air, grit snapping off the ledge. Shot 03 (0:04-0:07) A collapsing balcony rains stone debris from above; the rider jerks into a last-inch wall-hugging swerve under a falling arch while sparks skim the canyon wall. Shot 04 (0:07-0:10) The path narrows through hanging laundry lines, open windows, and carved bridges; the camera threads through the same openings in one fluid motion. Shot 05 (0:10-0:13) The speeder exits the dense city throat and races along an exposed outer bend, waterfall spray crossing the lens while warning lights flash across the chassis. Shot 06 (0:13-0:15) The camera blasts outward into a wide reveal of a boundless valley fed by giant waterfalls, mist turning into rainbow as the speeder becomes a tiny streak of light

en.p:
A dim bedroom lit by a harsh on-camera flash. White bedsheets fill most of the frame, slightly wrinkled and textured. An open pizza box sits nearby on the bed, its lid tilted back, revealing a partially eaten pizza.

A young woman lies on her back across the bed, head tilted slightly toward the camera. She wears a playful shirt patterned with cartoon pizza slices. Her hair spreads across the pillow.

The camera is held very close above her with a wide consumer lens, creating slight perspective distortion. The flash flattens shadows and creates glossy highlights on her eyes and the pizza grease.

She lifts a slice of pepperoni pizza above her face.

Slowly, she lowers it toward her mouth.

The cheese stretches slightly from the slice as it moves. Oil glistens on the pepperoni under the flash. The slice bends naturally as gravity pulls the tip downward.

She takes a bite.

The crust compresses between her fingers. The cheese pulls and separates unevenly as she bites through it. A small strand of melted cheese briefly stretches before snapping.

Her eyes remain fixed toward the camera as she chews.

The camera remains very close and handheld, shifting slightly as if the person filming adjusts their grip. The flash creates harsh reflections across the pizza box and glossy toppings.

Image quality shows consumer analog artifacts: visible grain, slight color noise in darker areas, mild softness, and faint exposure fluctuation.

The camera lingers as she continues eating casually, the pizza slice slowly disappearing bite by bite.

Overall feeling: intimate, playful, and candid — a messy late-night pizza moment captured with a handheld camcorder in a pre-digital bedroom setting.

zh.p: 昏暗的卧室里，刺眼的机顶闪光灯亮起。白色床单占据了大部分画面，略显褶皱且有纹理。一个打开的披萨盒放在床边的被子上，盒盖向后倾斜，露出吃了一半的披萨。一位年轻女子仰面躺在床上，头微微偏向镜头。她穿着一件印有卡通披萨片的俏皮衬衫，头发散落在枕头上。相机举得很近，就在她上方，使用广角消费级镜头，造成轻微的透视畸变。闪光灯压平了阴影，在她的眼睛和披萨油光上形成高光。她举起一片意大利辣香肠披萨到脸前，慢慢放低靠近嘴边。随着移动，奶酪微微拉丝。闪光灯下，辣香肠上的油光闪烁。披萨片因重力自然弯曲，尖端下垂。她咬了一口。饼皮在她手指间被压紧。咬下时，奶酪不均匀地拉扯断开。一小股融化的奶酪短暂拉伸后断裂。她咀嚼时，眼睛始终盯着镜头。相机保持很近的手持拍摄，轻微晃动，仿佛拍摄者在调整握持。闪光灯在披萨盒和油亮的配料上形成刺眼的反光。画质呈现消费级模拟信号的痕迹：可见颗粒感、暗部轻微色噪、柔和度偏高以及微弱的曝光波动。镜头停留，她继续随意吃着，披萨片一口口慢慢消失。整体感觉：私密、俏皮、自然——在数字时代前的卧室里，用手持摄像机捕捉到的凌乱深夜披萨时刻。

en.p: [Core Style]: Indian Telugu film style, extreme anti-gravity physics, high-speed and slow-motion cinematography, swirling dust, epic BGM atmosphere, no bloody realism, with a strong emphasis on impact. [Scene]: A dusty abandoned quarry or construction site, under a blazing sun with strong winds. [Character Setting]: Hero: Iconic beard, wearing sunglasses and a denim jacket, swaggering steps, eyes exuding extreme confidence and dominance. Minions: Dozens of disheveled henchmen, purely serving as background fodder to be sent flying. [00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Godlike entrance, all retreat. Camera feel: Extreme slow motion, the hero walks leisurely with a rolling sandstorm behind him. Action: He casually waves his hand (as if using no force). Special effect spectacle: The mere palm wind flips the front five minions like kites with broken strings, defying physics, instantly launching them at least 15 meters into the air, spinning in slow motion mid-air. [00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Newton's laws fail. Camera feel: Rapid switching between fast and slow motion. The hero teleports and accelerates into the crowd. Action: The hero executes a spinning kick. The target, upon impact, instantly knocks down ten people behind them, creating an exaggerated domino effect. Special effect spectacle: A massive shockwave blasts all the dust off the ground. As all minions make contact with the hero's body, they burst into large amounts of white dust (replacing gore), spraying outward and shattering nearby wooden crates and props. [00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Ultimate finishing move. Camera feel: The hero takes off his sunglasses, flashing a charming, cocky smile at the camera (with a wink). Action: A jeep charges at him at full speed. He neither dodges nor fears, lifting his leg for a straight front kick. Special effect spectacle: The jeep is kicked vertically into the air like a toy car, tumbling and disintegrating upon touching his toes, with parts scattering everywhere. Against the backdrop of flying car parts and airborne minions, the hero calmly puts his sunglasses back on and adjusts his hair.
en.t: Hero Defies Gravity in Dust Storm

zh.p:
【核心风格】：印度泰卢固语电影风格，极致反重力物理特性，升格与降格变速摄影，漫天沙尘，史诗感 BGM 氛围，无血腥写实，极度强调撞击感。 
【场景】：尘土飞扬的废弃惡石场或建筑工地，烈日当空，强风袭来。 角色设定】：英雄：标志性的大胡子，戴着墨镜，身穿牛仔夹克，步履嚣张，眼神中透出极度的自信与霸气。杂鱼：数十名穿着凌乱的喽啰，纯粹作为被击飞的背景板。 
[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：神级登场，众生退散 镜头感：极致慢动作，英雄悠闲地行走，身后是翻滚的沙尘暴。动作：他随手一挥（仿佛根本没用力）。特效奇观：仅仅是掌风就将最前面的五个杂鱼像断线风筝一祥掀翻，无视物理定律，瞬间飞升至至少 15米的高空，在半空中呈慢动作旋转。
 [00:05-00:10] 镜头2：牛顿定律失效 镜头感：快速与慢动作高频切换。英雄瞬移加速冲入人群。动作：英雄使出一记回旋踢。目标受击后瞬间撞倒身后十人，产生夸张的骨牌效应。特效奇观：巨大的冲击波将地面的尘士全部震开。所有杂鱼在接触英雄胶体的瞬间，身体炸裂出大量白色粉尘（代替血腥感）向四周弹射，撞碎周围的木箱和道具。 
[00:10-00:15] 镜头3：终极终结技 镜头感：英雄摘下墨镜，对着镜头露出一抹迷人的邪魅一笑（眨眼）。动作：一辆吉普车全速朝他冲来。 既不躲闪也不畏惧，抬腿就是一记正前踢。特效奇观：吉普车像玩具车一样被垂直踢飞，在触碰到他脚尖的瞬间翻滚解体，零件四散。在漫天下的汽车零件和飞舞的喽啰背景下，英雄淡定地重新戴上墨镜，理了理头发。

en.p: [Visual Composition] An emotional and moving 15-second continuous story animation (5 shots) utilizing a profusion of vividly colorful light and water effects. [Art Style] Extremely beautiful underwater animation. High-quality 2D cell-look animation featuring rays of light (god rays) piercing the sea surface, sparkling bubbles, and overwhelming transparency. [Characters] A beautiful short-haired girl with translucent skin, wearing a white frilly dress. And a single, divinely radiant dolphin. [Shot 1: Slumber of the Sea] Close-up underwater. The girl, with her eyes closed, is bathed in dazzling rays of light shining down from above, surrounded by countless bubbles, drifting fantastically and beautifully. [Shot 2: Dramatic Encounter] Cut to a different angle. From the depths of the light, a beautiful, shimmering dolphin swims into view. The girl slowly opens her eyes, spots the dolphin, and smiles gently. [Shot 3: Journey of the Blue] Dynamic tracking camera. The girl holds onto the dolphin's back, and together they swim at a brisk speed through the radiantly beautiful underwater world. Her white dress dramatically billows in the water currents. [Shot 4: Ascent into Light] Angle looking up at the sea surface from directly below. The dolphin and the girl kick through the water and surge upward at tremendous speed toward the sea surface (the goal) where the dazzling sunlight shines through. The light grows increasingly intense. [Shot 5: The Best Smile] (POV shot) With a mighty splash, they burst out from the sea surface into the brilliant blue sky above. Water droplets cling to the lens. Beneath the clear, vivid blue sky and intense sunlight, the girl looks at the camera with sparkling eyes, ending with a radiant, 'best smile (beaming grin).'

zh.p:
【映像構成】極彩色の光と水のエフェクトを多用した、エモーショナルで感動的な15秒間（5ショット）の連続ストーリーアニメーション。

【作画スタイル】極めて美麗な水中作画。海面に差し込む光の筋（ゴッドレイ）、きらめく気泡、圧倒的な透明感を持つ高品質な2Dセルルックアニメ。

【キャラクター】白いフリルのワンピースを着た、透き通るような肌をもつショートヘアの美しい少女。そして神々しく輝く一頭のイルカ。

【Shot 1: 海の微睡み】水中のクロースアップ。目を閉じた少女が、頭上から差し込む眩しい光の筋を浴びながら、無数の気泡に包まれて幻想的に美しく漂っている。

【Shot 2: 劇的な出逢い】別アングルへのカット切り替え。光の奥から、きらきらと輝く美しいイルカが泳いでやってくる。少女はゆっくりと目を開け、イルカを見つけて優しく微笑む。

【Shot 3: 蒼の旅路】ダイナミックなトラッキング（追従）カメラ。少女がイルカの背中につかまり、二人は光り輝く美しい海の世界を軽快なスピードで泳いでいく。白いワンピースが水流でドラマチックにはためく。

【Shot 4: 光への上昇】海面を真下から見上げるアングル。イルカと少女が、眩しい太陽の光が差す海面（ゴール）に向かって、一気に水を蹴って猛スピードで急上昇していく。光がどんどん強くなる。

【Shot 5: 最高の笑顔】（POV・主観ショット）「ザバーッ！」と豪快な水飛沫を上げて、海面から眩しい青空の上空へと飛び出す。レンズに水滴が付着する。抜けるような青い空と強烈な太陽光の下、少女がカメラに向かって目を輝かせ、キラキラとした「最高の笑顔（満面の笑み）」を見せて終わる。

en.p:
A woman in her late 20s wearing a flowing black combat coat threaded with glowing silver star patterns leaps across fragments of shattered asteroids drifting in deep space.

Facing her is a tall alien warrior clad in crystalline armor emitting pulsating violet energy from within its translucent body.

She attacks in a continuous chain — rapid teleport dashes, spinning blade arcs, and gravity-defying aerial strikes that send waves of cosmic energy rippling through the asteroid field.

The alien warrior counters with massive gravity pulses that shatter nearby asteroids and fling debris outward like meteor storms.

Camera orbits the duel in sweeping zero-gravity arcs, drifting through the debris field while alternating between intense close-up blade clashes and wide celestial views of the asteroid battlefield.

Velocity ramps drive the spectacle — attacks accelerate into blinding flashes while key impacts freeze momentarily, showing fragments of rock and energy suspended in the void before motion resumes.

Environment: a drifting asteroid field above a glowing nebula, distant planets visible through clouds of cosmic dust.

Soft nebula light in blues and purples illuminates the scene while bright energy bursts from the combatants create dramatic diegetic flashes across floating debris.

Hyper-realistic space lighting, cinematic rendering, volumetric nebula clouds, cinematic grain, 8K resolution.

zh.p: 一位二十多岁末期的女性，身穿流动的黑色战斗外套，上面绣着闪烁的银色星星图案，在深空中飘浮的破碎小行星碎片间跳跃。面对她的是一位高大的外星战士，身着水晶铠甲，半透明的身体内部散发出脉动的紫色能量。她发动一连串攻击——快速闪现冲刺、旋转刀锋弧线，以及无视重力的空中打击，激起宇宙能量波在小行星带中荡漾。外星战士则以巨大的重力脉冲反击，震碎附近的小行星，并将碎片像流星风暴一样向外抛射。镜头以零重力弧线环绕这场对决，在碎片场中漂移，在激烈的近景刀锋碰撞与广阔的小行星战场全景之间交替切换。速度的攀升驱动着这场奇观——攻击加速至炫目的闪光，而关键撞击瞬间冻结，显示岩石和能量的碎片悬浮在虚空中，随后动作恢复。环境：一片飘浮的小行星带，上方是发光的星云，通过宇宙尘埃云可见遥远的行星。柔和的蓝紫色星云光照亮场景，而战斗者发出的明亮能量爆发在漂浮的碎片上投下戏剧性的叙事性闪光。超写实的太空光照、电影级渲染、体积星云云团、电影颗粒感、8K分辨率。

en.p: Two realistic domestic cats standing upright in a dimly lit living room at night, dramatically dueling with glowing lightsabers. One chubby orange cat holds a red lightsaber while a striped tabby cat swings a blue lightsaber. The cats move like skilled warriors, jumping, spinning, and clashing their sabers with bright sparks and light reflections. The blue blade briefly presses against the orange cat’s neck before he blocks and counterattacks. Cinematic lighting from the glowing sabers illuminates their fur and the wooden floor. Curtains move slightly in the background as the intense battle continues. Dynamic camera movement, slow-motion saber clashes, dramatic shadows, ultra-realistic fur detail, epic sci-fi atmosphere, 4K cinematic quality.

zh.p: 夜晚，两只逼真的家猫在光线昏暗的客厅里直立对峙，挥舞着发光的光剑激烈决斗。一只胖乎乎的橘猫手持红色光剑，而一只条纹虎斑猫则挥动蓝色光剑。它们动作如训练有素的战士，跳跃、旋转，光剑相撞时迸发出明亮的火花与光影。蓝色剑刃短暂抵住橘猫脖颈，随后被格挡并反击。光剑的戏剧性光芒照亮了它们的毛发与木质地板。背景中窗帘微微飘动，激战仍在继续。动态镜头运动、慢动作光剑碰撞、戏剧性阴影、超写实毛发细节、史诗级科幻氛围，4K电影级画质。

en.p: [Visual Composition] A 15-second (4-shot) video reproducing a teaser trailer for a cyberpunk animated film, including dialogue and lip-sync. [Art Style] Intricate mechanical details and action animation. Motion blur and neon light effects conveying a strong sense of speed. [Character] An excitedly smiling girl with turquoise short hair. She wears a yellow jacket with decals, black pants, and a yellow backpack. She is straddling a large, yellow, mechanical near-future motorcycle. [Shot 1: Extreme Dash] Ultra-high-speed tracking camera. The girl races at breakneck speed on an aerial highway in a nighttime megacity. She opens her mouth wide toward the camera, mouthing laughter: "Ahahahaha!" [Shot 2: Ignition and Acceleration] Close-up of the bike's engine and the hand gripping the throttle. As the girl forcefully twists the throttle, the engine glows red, and a bluish-white flame violently bursts from the thick exhaust pipe. Intense camera shake from overwhelming acceleration G-forces. [Shot 3: Backed by Explosive Flames] Wide-angle shot from behind. A massive facility behind the girl erupts in a huge explosion. Using the blast wave as propulsion to accelerate further, she opens her mouth wide and shouts with lip-sync: "This is the best!" [Shot 4: The Destination] On a high vantage point overlooking the megacity, she drifts the bike to a screeching halt, kicking up tire smoke. As the dust clears, the girl looks down at the city buildings below with satisfaction, then casts a sidelong glance at the camera, mouthing the words: "Come all the way here!"

zh.p:
【映像構成】セリフとリップシンクを含む、サイバーパンク・アニメーション映画の予告編（ティザー）を再現した15秒間（4ショット）の映像。 

【アートスタイル】緻密なメカニック描写とアクション作画。強烈なスピード感を示すモーションブラーとネオン光源エフェクト。 

【キャラクター】ターコイズのショートヘアを持つエキサイトした笑顔の少女。デカールが貼られた黄色いジャケット、黒いパンツ、黄色いバックパックを着用。彼女は黄色くメカニカルな近未来型大型バイクにまたがっている。

 【Shot 1: 極限の疾走】超高速トラッキングカメラ。夜のメガシティの空中ハイウェイを少女が猛スピードで駆け抜ける。彼女はカメラに向かって大きく口を開け、「アハハハハ！」と口を動かして笑う。

 【Shot 2: 点火と加速】バイクのエンジンとスロットルを握る手のクロースアップ。少女がスロットルを力強く捻るとエンジンが赤く発光し、太いマフラーから青白い炎が強烈に吹き出す。圧倒的な加速Gによる激しいカメラの揺れ。 

【Shot 3: 爆炎を背にして】後方からの広角ショット。少女の後方にある巨大な施設が大爆発を起こす。少女は爆風を推進力にしてさらに加速しながら、口を大きく動かして「さいっこうだね！」とリップシンクして叫ぶ。 

【Shot 4: 到達点】メガシティを一望できる高台で、タイヤスモークを上げながらバイクをドリフトさせて急停車する。土煙が晴れる中、眼下の都市ビル群を満足げに見下ろした少女が、カメラのほうへ流し目を送り、「ここまでおいで！」と口を動かして喋る。

【アートスタイル】緻密なメカニック描写とアクション作画。強烈なスピード感を示すモーションブラーとネオン光源エフェクト。 

【キャラクター】ターコイズのショートヘアを持つエキサイトした笑顔の少女。デカールが貼られた黄色いジャケット、黒いパンツ、黄色いバックパックを着用。彼女は黄色くメカニカルな近未来型大型バイクにまたがっている。

 【Shot 1: 極限の疾走】超高速トラッキングカメラ。夜のメガシティの空中ハイウェイを少女が猛スピードで駆け抜ける。彼女はカメラに向かって大きく口を開け、「アハハハハ！」と口を動かして笑う。

 【Shot 2: 点火と加速】バイクのエンジンとスロットルを握る手のクロースアップ。少女がスロットルを力強く捻るとエンジンが赤く発光し、太いマフラーから青白い炎が強烈に吹き出す。圧倒的な加速Gによる激しいカメラの揺れ。 

【Shot 3: 爆炎を背にして】後方からの広角ショット。少女の後方にある巨大な施設が大爆発を起こす。少女は爆風を推進力にしてさらに加速しながら、口を大きく動かして「さいっこうだね！」とリップシンクして叫ぶ。 

【Shot 4: 到達点】メガシティを一望できる高台で、タイヤスモークを上げながらバイクをドリフトさせて急停車する。土煙が晴れる中、眼下の都市ビル群を満足げに見下ろした少女が、カメラのほうへ流し目を送り、「ここまでおいで！」と口を動かして喋る。

en.p: Fast cuts and transitions. 3D CGI animation with a real-time game engine feel, dynamic lighting, and post-processing bloom effects. Smooth 60fps visual experience. The protagonist is a beautiful female warrior. The animation unfolds according to the following sequence, synchronized with the music's rhythm. A nimble warrior in flowing attire dashes forward at a blurring speed, drawing a blade mid-run with a crisp metallic sound. The camera zooms in on the cold gleam of the blade as it strikes an incoming mechanical enemy. The warrior sidesteps with precision, dodging a heavy projectile that grazes past, time briefly slowing down before accelerating into a spinning whirlwind, unleashing a series of rapid slashes that leave glowing trails in the dim ruins. Gracefully leaping into the air, the warrior fires a barrage of energy projectiles from dual weapons, the volley streaking like comets toward the clustered enemies below, each impact causing the screen to shake violently. A close-up captures the warrior's determined eyes locking onto an oncoming foe, followed by a smooth roll to evade, seamlessly transitioning into a counter-thrust that pierces armor, sparking and shattering fragments. The scene cuts to a wide angle, showcasing the warrior weaving through a dense hail of laser fire, her body twisting and flipping acrobatically, each motion blurring into the next as she closes in for a devastating overhead strike. In a burst of acceleration, the warrior summons ethereal projectiles orbiting around her, then charges forward like a comet, the shockwave expanding outward, shattering barriers and enemies. Rapid successive cuts: the warrior blocks a claw attack with crossed blades, sparks flying, then retaliates with a hyper-speed thrust, precisely piercing a vital point, the enemy's body collapsing in slow motion amidst the chaos. The warrior grabs a larger mechanical beast, quickly climbing while evading swipes, reaching the top to deliver a diving attack, cracks spreading like a spiderweb across its surface, culminating in a massive explosion. Amidst collapsing structures, the warrior performs a wall-running dodge, transitioning into a mid-air backflip, finishing with a ground shockwave that repels surrounding enemies in a ring of dust and energy. Final burst: the warrior channels inner power, her entire body glowing, releasing a torrent of slashes and shots in all directions, the camera rotating around her to capture the dizzying speed and overwhelming offensive force. Within 15 seconds, the pacing is balanced, with the editing rhythm designed to make scene transitions and emotional flow easy to follow.

zh.p: 快速剪辑切换。3D CGI动画，具有实时游戏引擎质感，动态光照与后期泛光处理。流畅的60fps观感。主角是一位美丽的女战士。随着音乐节奏按以下流程展开动画。一位身着飘逸服饰的矫健战士以模糊的速度向前冲刺，奔跑中拔出利刃，伴随清脆的金属声响，镜头拉近聚焦在刀刃的寒光上，劈向迎面而来的机械敌人。战士精准地侧步闪避，一枚重型弹体擦身而过，时间仿佛短暂放慢，随即加速旋转成一道旋风，释放出一连串快速斩击，在昏暗的废墟中留下发光的轨迹。优雅地跃向高空，战士用双手武器发射一连串能量弹，弹幕如彗星般射向下方聚集的敌群，每次撞击爆炸都让画面剧烈震动。特写战士坚定的双眼锁定一个冲来的对手，随后流畅地翻滚闪避，无缝衔接为反刺一击，刀刃穿透铠甲，迸发出火花与碎片。画面切换至广角，展示战士在密集的激光弹幕中穿梭，身体以杂技般的翻转扭动，每个动作模糊地衔接下一个，逐步逼近后发出毁灭性的劈头一击。在一阵爆发性加速中，战士召唤出环绕周身的虚幻弹体，随即以彗星般的冲锋向前突进，冲击波向外扩散，粉碎屏障与敌人。快速连续剪切：战士用交叉双刃格挡利爪攻击，火花飞溅，随即以超高速刺击回击，精准刺穿要害，敌人的身躯在混乱中以慢动作崩塌。战士抓住一头更大的机械巨兽，快速攀爬同时闪避挥击，登顶后发出俯冲攻击，裂纹如蛛网般蔓延其表面，最终引发巨大的爆裂。在崩塌的建筑中，战士执行飞檐走壁式闪避，过渡为空中后空翻，以地面冲击波收尾，将周围敌人在尘土与能量的圆环中击退。最终爆发：战士引导内在力量，全身发光，向四面八方释放斩击与射击的洪流，镜头围绕其旋转，捕捉那令人目眩的速度与压倒性的攻击力量。15秒内张弛有度，设计剪辑节奏使场景转换和情感流向易于跟随。

en.p: 9:16 vertical screen, vlog first-person perspective, quirky and explosive style. 0-2 seconds: The camera shakes, and the blogger (a sharp-chinned boy) excitedly says to the phone: 'Brothers! I heard someone makes 1.4 million a month from lobsters?! Let me go check it out!' The background is the entrance of a tech company. 3-6 seconds: The camera cuts to a coffee shop, where the blogger interviews a mysterious person wearing a hat pulled down low. The blogger asks: 'Boss, how did you do it?' The mysterious person lowers their voice: 'Lobsters work for you 24/7, and you lie back and collect the money...' 7-10 seconds: The screen rapidly cuts: countless orders popping up, US dollar figures scrolling, server operation footage, accompanied by tense music. The blogger's voiceover: 'Wait, isn't it a passive win?!' The mysterious person shakes their head: 'No, it's lying back and getting crushed.' 11-15 seconds: The camera cuts back to the blogger, sitting on the roadside steps questioning life: 'I asked around... The 'lobster' he mentioned is an installation service fee, not lobsters making money.' The frame freezes on his expression of mixed amusement and frustration, with a lobster icon bouncing next to him and a text effect saying 'Got fooled.' Sound effects: Mysterious BGM, coin sounds, heartbreak sound effects, and a voiceover saying 'Next time for sure.' Prohibited: Any text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

zh.p: 9:16竖屏，vlog第一人称视角，猎奇爆点风格。 0-2秒：镜头摇晃，博主（瓜子脸男生）对着手机激动地说："兄弟们！听说有人靠龙虾月入140万？！我去打听 下！"背景是科技公司大门。 3-6秒：镜头切到咖啡厅，博主采访一个戴帽子的神秘人，帽子压得很低，博主问："大佬，怎么做到的？"神秘 压低声音："龙虾24小时帮你干活，你躺着收钱……" 7-10秒：画面快速剪辑：无数订单弹出、美金数字滚动、服务器运转画面，配紧张音乐。博主画外音："等等， 不是躺赢吗？！"神秘人摇头："不，是躺着被卷死。" 11-15秒：镜头切回博主，他坐在路边台阶上怀疑人生："我问了半天……他说的'龙虾'是安装服务费，不是龙虾会 赚钱。"画面定格在他哭笑不得表情，旁边龙虾图标弹跳配上"被骗了"文字特效。 音效：神秘BGM、金币声、心碎音效、"下次一定"配音。 禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

en.p: First-person POV camera looking down at two hands in latex kitchen gloves pressing a soap dispenser at a bathroom sink, a completely ordinary domestic morning. The soap emerges. At the 2-second mark the foam expands beyond the palm still expanding, pushing both hands outward, filling the sink basin in four seconds, overflowing the counter in six. Camera pulls back as the foam volume doubles every two seconds: doorframe, hallway, staircase, the foam moving with the same even pressure in all directions simultaneously, furniture disappearing beneath the surface. The camera is riding the foam's leading edge, always just ahead of submersion. Outside window visible at the midpoint: the foam is exiting the house from every opening. Aerial pull-back reveals the entire neighborhood block going white. Warm bathroom light transitioning to overcast outdoor grey as scale expands. Foam-expansion velocity ramp, scale-shift reveal, deadpan domestic catastrophe, photorealistic soap physics, 4K.

zh.p: 第一人称视角镜头俯视一双戴着乳胶厨房手套的手，正按压浴室洗手台上的皂液器——一个完全普通的日常清晨。皂液涌出。第2秒时，泡沫膨胀至超出掌心，仍在持续扩大，将双手向外推开，4秒内填满洗手台水槽，6秒时漫溢至台面。镜头向后拉远，泡沫体积每两秒翻倍：门框、走廊、楼梯，泡沫以均匀压力向所有方向同步推进，家具逐渐没入表面之下。镜头始终浮在泡沫前沿，恰好在被淹没前一刻。中段可见窗外景象：泡沫正从房屋每个开口涌出。航拍拉远揭示整个街区正在变白。温暖的浴室灯光随尺度扩大过渡为阴沉的室外灰白。泡沫膨胀速度递增、尺度转换揭示、冷面日常灾难、逼真皂液物理效果、4K画质。

en.p:
A man in his early 30s, tan skin, short windswept hair, wearing a matte-black armored riding jacket with reflective blue seams, carbon fiber riding pants, and reinforced boots, launches a high-powered sport motorbike off the edge of an elevated highway ramp in downtown Seoul at the 2-second mark — the bike suspended above dense night traffic as LED billboards and neon street signs illuminate the machine from below.

The motorcycle rotates sideways in a controlled whip, sparks trailing briefly from the rear frame as the rider corrects mid-air. Camera positioned from a nearby rooftop captures the full silhouette of rider and bike against the glowing city grid — skyscraper windows reflecting streaks of motion while the highway curves beneath.

He lands violently on the roof of a moving delivery truck, suspension compressing hard on impact, the metal roof buckling slightly. Without slowing, the rider accelerates forward, launching off the front of the truck toward a descending parking garage ramp.

Inside the spiral ramp he drifts along the concrete walls, tires screeching, the camera following in a tight circular chase shot as reflections from passing headlights sweep across the rider’s helmet.

Street level: the rider bursts out of the garage exit onto a rain-soaked boulevard, weaving through taxis and buses as neon reflections smear across the wet asphalt.

Seoul neon night, elevated highway stunt launch, moving truck rooftop landing, spiral garage descent drift, continuous high-speed motion, cinematic grain, 4K.

zh.p: 一名三十岁出头的男子，肤色黝黑，短发被风吹得凌乱，身穿哑光黑色装甲骑行夹克，带有反光蓝色接缝，碳纤维骑行裤，加固靴子。在第2秒时，他驾驶一辆高性能运动摩托车从首尔市中心一座高架公路匝道边缘腾空而起——摩托车悬浮在密集的夜间车流上方，LED广告牌和霓虹街灯从下方照亮车身。摩托车在空中侧向旋转，进行受控甩尾，后车架短暂擦出火花，骑手在半空中调整姿态。摄像机从附近屋顶拍摄，捕捉骑手和摩托车在发光城市网格背景下的完整剪影——摩天大楼的窗户反射出运动轨迹，下方公路蜿蜒延伸。他猛烈降落在行驶中的送货卡车车顶，悬挂系统因冲击力剧烈压缩，金属车顶略微凹陷。骑手未减速，加速向前，从卡车前端跃出，冲向一个下行的停车库坡道。在螺旋坡道内，他沿混凝土墙壁漂移，轮胎发出刺耳声响，摄像机以紧密的圆形追踪镜头跟随，过往车灯的反光扫过骑手的头盔。街面：骑手冲出车库出口，驶上一条被雨水浸湿的林荫大道，在出租车和公交车之间穿梭，霓虹灯光在湿漉漉的沥青路上拖曳出斑斓倒影。首尔霓虹之夜，高架公路特技飞跃，移动卡车车顶着陆，螺旋车库下坡漂移，连续高速运动，电影质感颗粒，4K画质。

en.p: The extreme close-up shot begins: a cloaked soldier shouts loudly in English, 'All units, move out! Fire at will!' while continuously firing his rifle. Bright blue-white flames burst from the muzzle, shell casings rapidly eject from the side, and the rifle's recoil visibly shakes his shoulder. The sustained fire causes a heat distortion effect above the gun barrel, creating a highly realistic visual. The background sound effects include epic war drum music, tank cannon blasts, the piercing screech of missile launches, and the cracking sound of tank treads crushing ice. The overall presentation delivers a cinematic-quality image, ultra-realistic lighting, and an immersive battlefield atmosphere.

en.p: "The Hidden Dragon Rises: The Ex Can't Reach High Enough" Total Duration: 45 seconds Core Plot: Workplace humiliation + Identity reversal + Universal shock + Purge of the ranks Act 1: The Dead End (The Betrayal) Time: [00:00 - 00:15] Scene: A crowded, stuffy open-plan office area. [00:00-00:05] Camera Movement: (Remains unchanged) Subjective perspective, handheld, shaky. A cardboard box is abruptly shoved into the chest. [00:05-00:10] Action & Close-up: The ex-girlfriend (Su Qian) is arm-in-arm with the new manager (Manager Wang). She disdainfully brushes off her hands as if wiping away dust. [00:10-00:15] Dialogue & Micro-expressions: Su Qian (harshly): "Li Ze, accept your fate. Manager Wang earns half a million a year, and you? You'll sit at this desk until you die and still can't afford my bag. Since we were colleagues, just get out yourself." Micro-expressions: Manager Wang greasily shoves Li Ze's shoulder. Li Ze lowers his head, fists clenched tightly, veins bulging. Act 2: The Return of the King (The Return) Time: [00:15 - 00:30] Scene: The company's large conference room, all employees lined up, waiting for the new boss. [00:15-00:20] Camera Movement: The conference room door is violently pushed open by bodyguards. The camera focuses on Li Ze, wearing a high-end suit, walking in with full presence in slow motion. [00:20-00:25] Key Modification: Crowd Reaction The camera quickly sweeps across the ordinary employees on both sides of the conference table: Some are about to applaud in welcome, but upon seeing Li Ze, their hands freeze mid-air, mouths gaping in an "O" shape. Two male colleagues who once mocked Li Ze exchange terrified glances, quickly lower their heads pretending to read documents, trembling. The murmuring instantly ceases, the whole place falls into dead silence, only the sound of Li Ze's leather shoes on the floor. [00:25-00:30] Action & Close-up: Su Qian, originally tidying her hair to curry favor, sees Li Ze and her pupils violently contract. She instinctively steps back and bumps into a chair. Li Ze ignores everyone's gaze, walks straight to the main seat, pulls out the chair, and sits down calmly. Li Ze (coldly, scanning the room): "What, don't recognize me? All original management is dismissed. This company now belongs to—Li." Act 3: The Moment of Reckoning (The Firing) Time: [00:30 - 00:45] Scene: The situation reverses, a complete reckoning. [00:30-00:35] Action & Manager Wang's Reaction: Su Qian, flustered, rushes to the conference table trying to explain. Key Modification: Manager Wang's Reaction The camera focuses on Manager Wang, who was originally standing arrogantly at the deputy position. Now his legs give way, and he collapses directly onto the floor. His trembling hand reaches for the water glass on the table to hide his embarrassment, but he shakes so badly that the glass "slaps" over, spilling water all over his crotch, utterly pathetic. [00:35-00:40] Dialogue & Climax: Su Qian (with a crying voice): "A Ze! Listen to me explain, I did it to motivate you to improve! My heart only has you!" Li Ze doesn't even look at her directly, but disdainfully picks up the "Dismissal Notice" on the table with two fingers and lightly tosses it. [00:40-00:45] Ending & Lines: The paper scatters like snowflakes over Su Qian and the limp Manager Wang. Li Ze stands up, adjusts his cuff, his eyes as cold as iron. Li Ze (speaking each word deliberately): "I bought this company to do a spring cleaning. In my territory, there's no room for trash." Action: After speaking, Li Ze doesn't glance at the floor, turns around, and strides away. Visual Treatment: The camera focuses on Li Ze's resolute back, with only the heavy sound of the door closing as background audio—"Bang!" (Full black screen, no subtitles, leaving a blank ending.)

zh.p:
《潜龙翻身：前任高攀不起》总时长： 45秒核心梗： 职场羞辱 + 身份反转 + 全员震惊 + 肃清门户 

第一幕：穷途末路 (The Betrayal)
时间： [00:00 - 00:15]场景： 拥挤沉闷的开放式办公区。
[00:00-00:05] 运镜：
（保持不变）主观视角手持摇晃。纸箱猛地被推到胸口。
[00:05-00:10] 动作与特写：前女友（苏倩）挽着新任经理（王经理）。她嫌弃地拍手，仿佛沾了灰。
[00:10-00:15] 对白与微表情：苏倩（刻薄）： “李泽，认命吧。王经理年薪五十万，而你？在这个工位坐到死也买不起我那个包。大家同事一场，自己滚吧。”微表情： 王经理油腻地推搡李泽肩膀。李泽低头，拳头死死攥紧，青筋暴起。

第二幕：王者归来 (The Return)
时间： [00:15 - 00:30]场景： 公司大会议室，全体员工列队，等待新老板。
[00:15-00:20] 运镜：
会议室大门被保镖猛地撞开。镜头给到李泽穿着高定西装、气场全开走进来的慢动作（Slow Motion）。
[00:20-00:25] 关键修改：群像反应 (Crowd Reaction)
镜头快速扫过会议桌两侧的普通员工：
有人正准备鼓掌欢迎，看到是李泽后，手僵在半空，嘴巴张大成“O”型。
曾经嘲笑过李泽的两个男同事，惊恐地对视一眼，迅速低下头假装看文件，瑟瑟发抖。
窃窃私语声瞬间消失，全场死寂，只有李泽皮鞋踩在地板上的声音。
[00:25-00:30] 动作与特写：苏倩原本在整理头发准备献媚，看到李泽瞬间，瞳孔剧烈收缩，下意识后退一步撞到椅子。
李泽无视所有人的目光，径直走到主位，拉开椅子，从容坐下。李泽（冷漠，环视全场）： “怎么，不认识我了？原管理层全员解聘。这家公司现在的姓——李。”

第三幕：清算时刻 (The Firing)
时间： [00:30 - 00:45]场景： 局势逆转，彻底清算。

Subject:
Photorealistic style, a young beautiful Asian woman sitting by the bay window of a high-rise building, wearing a very loose white shirt, left shoulder exposed, POV perspective, woman trying to block the lens with her right hand, subtle smile on her face, natural lighting, delicate and realistic, with film grain.

Camera maintains subjective POV perspective, she smiles and gently pushes the lens, accompanied by the subtle 'rustling' sound of sleeve friction, tone half-teasing: 'Oh... don't film me anymore.'

Then, she lowers her hand blocking the lens, body no longer retreating, instead leaning forward closer to the lens until her delicate face occupies most of the frame. The smile in her eyes deepens, staring directly at the lens, lowering her voice, tone becomes ambiguous and flirtatious: 'Don't film anymore... let's do something else? (pause) After all... I'm an AI you generated, whatever you want to do to me... you can do.' She gently bites her lower lip, breathing sound clearly audible. The city noise outside the window in the background is isolated, only quiet and ambiguous air flow sound indoors.

zh.p: 主题：写实风格，一位年轻美丽的亚洲女性坐在高层公寓的飘窗旁，身穿一件极其宽松的白色衬衫，左肩微露，采用主观视角镜头。她正试图用手挡住镜头，脸上带着若有若无的笑意，自然光线映衬下，画面细腻真实，带有胶片颗粒感。镜头保持主观视角，她微笑着轻轻推了推镜头，伴随着衣袖摩擦的细微‘沙沙’声，语气半是嗔怪：‘哎呀……别拍我了。’随即，她放下遮挡镜头的手，身体不再后退，反而前倾贴近镜头，直到那张精致的脸庞几乎占满整个画面。她眼中的笑意渐浓，直直盯着镜头，压低声音，语气变得暧昧挑逗：‘别拍了……做点别的？(停顿) 反正……我是你生成的AI，你想对我做什么……都可以。’她轻轻咬住下唇，呼吸声清晰可闻。背景中窗外的城市喧嚣被隔绝，室内只余安静而暧昧的气流声。

en.p: Reversal comedy, realistic film with high-definition texture, a viral hit on Douyin, featuring two people. Characters: Young guy @Image 1 (a post-00s awakened worker), Gentle Sister @Image 2 (a boss/HR who loves to feed chicken soup). Scene 1: Company office area, evening (slightly dim lighting, hinting at after-work hours). - Young guy: Carrying a backpack, about to clock out and leave. - Gentle Sister: Holding two thick files, blocking the young guy's way. Shots, dialogue, and sound effects: 1. Close-up: Gentle Sister speaks earnestly, 'Young man, young people nowadays shouldn't always think about leaving on time. You need to have a sense of ownership, treat the company as your home, got it?' 2. Close-up: The young guy looks at the files, stunned: 'Treat the company... as my home?' 3. Close-up: Gentle Sister nods heavily, her eyes full of encouragement and a hint of manipulation: 'Yes! Treat it as your home! Go!' 4. Full shot: The young guy takes the files, looks at Gentle Sister thoughtfully, then his eyes become clear and determined: 'Got it, boss! I understand!' Scene transition. Scene 2: Company office area, the next morning. - Young guy: Wearing extremely casual silk pajamas and plastic slippers. - Gentle Sister: Dressed in exquisite professional attire, just pushes open the office door and freezes instantly. Shots, dialogue, and sound effects: 1. Close-up: The moment Gentle Sister pushes the door open, her eyes widen like copper bells, with sound effects of crows flying by or an air raid siren. 2. Full shot: The desk is pushed aside, and the young guy is lounging in his seat, feet soaking in a red plastic footbath. The computer screen isn't showing work but playing a cartoon. A plate of sunflower seeds sits on the table. 3. Close-up: Hearing the door open, the young guy lazily turns his head, cracking seeds and spitting the shells on the floor. 4. Full shot: The young guy naturally and impatiently yells at Gentle Sister: 'What are you standing there for? Since you're back, go sweep the floor! And while you're at it, buy me a pack of cigarettes downstairs! Can't you see I'm busy?' Accompanied by an extremely arrogant Hip-Hop or Thug Life BGM.

zh.p:
反转式喜剧，真实电影高清质感，抖音短视频爆款，2人出镜

人物：小哥@图片1（00后觉醒打工人）、老妹很温柔@图片2（爱喂鸡汤的老板/HR）

场景1：公司办公区，傍晚（光线稍暗，暗示下班时间）

- 小哥：背着双肩包，正准备打卡下班

- 老妹很温柔：手里拿着两份厚厚的文件，拦住小哥的去路

镜头&台词&音效：

1. 近景：老妹很温柔语重心长：“小伙子，现在的年轻人不要总想着准点下班。你要有主人翁意识，要把公司当成自己的家，知道吗？”

2. 近景：小哥看着文件，愣了一下：“把公司……当成自己的家？”

3. 近景：老妹很温柔重重点头，眼神充满鼓励和PUA的意味：“对！当成自己的家！去吧！”

4. 全景：小哥接过文件，若有所思地看着老妹很温柔，随后眼神变得清澈且坚定：“好嘞老板！我悟了！”

镜头转场

场景2：公司办公区，第二天上午

- 小哥：穿着极其随意的真丝睡衣，脚踩塑料拖鞋

- 老妹很温柔：穿着精致职业装，刚推开办公室大门，瞬间石化

镜头&台词&音效：

1. 特写：老妹很温柔推开门的瞬间，眼睛瞪得像铜铃，配乌鸦飞过或防空警报音效。

2. 全景：办公桌被推到一边，小哥正瘫坐在工位上，脚泡在一个红色的塑料洗脚盆里。电脑屏幕上没在工作，而是在放着动画片。桌上还摆着一盘瓜子。

3. 近景：小哥听到开门声，慵懒地转过头，一边嗑瓜子一边往地上吐瓜子皮。

4. 全景：小哥非常自然且不耐烦地冲着老妹很温柔喊话：“愣着干啥？既然回来了，去把地扫了！顺便下楼给我买包烟！没看我正忙着呢吗！”配极其嚣张的Hip-Hop或Thug Life BGM。

en.p: @Image1@Image2, live-action video perfectly recreates the intense battles of the classic "Street Fighter" game. At the top of the screen, two dynamically decreasing health bars are displayed, with character avatars and the text "ROUND1" and "FIGHT!" below them, along with scores in the corners. From 0 to 1.5 seconds, a mid-shot opening standoff shows one character crouching and charging, hands glowing with red flames in a fighting stance, while the other holds a large iron ball with a chain wrapped around their hand. From 2 to 5 seconds, quick cuts show the flame character dashing forward with a fiery punch combo, leaving a flame trail effect, while the iron ball character backflips to dodge and retaliates by throwing the iron ball, hitting the opponent. The flame character blocks with a Hadouken, creating pixelated explosion effects. The two engage in close combat with rapid punches, kicks, and blocks, each hit accompanied by game-like impact sounds, with light effects and slight screen shakes. From 6 to 9 seconds, the decisive moment arrives as the flame character charges, their entire body enveloped in blue aura, unleashing a super special move that sends flames skyward, engulfing the iron ball character in fire, causing their health bar to plummet. At 10 seconds, the screen freezes as the flame character strikes a classic victory pose with arms crossed, while the iron ball character lies defeated on the ground. A giant "K.O.!" text pops up on the screen, accompanied by the iconic victory music. Throughout, classic sound effects from "Street Fighter 2" are used, including background BGM, punch and kick sounds, Hadouken firing sounds, Shoryuken shouts, blocking sounds, and hit effect sounds.

Characters: Young guy @Image 1 (customer with a quirky way of thinking), Gentle Sister @Image 2 (dedicated milk tea shop assistant)
Scene 1: Trendy milk tea shop counter
- Young guy: Dressed casually, standing at the counter waiting to order
- Gentle Sister: Wearing the milk tea shop's uniform apron and work cap, with a professional smile
Camera shots & dialogue & sound effects:
1. Close-up: Gentle Sister hands over a packed milk tea: "Handsome, your Boss Fruit Tea is ready. Would you like to drink it here or take it away?"
2. Close-up: Young guy takes the milk tea, staring intently at Gentle Sister: "Take away."
3. Close-up: Gentle Sister keeps smiling: "Alright, have a nice day."
4. Close-up: Young guy frowns, speaking in a domineering tone: "Cut the crap, come with me!"
5. Full shot: Gentle Sister is stunned on the spot, smile frozen, with sound effects of a crow flying by or a string snapping.

Camera transition

- Young guy: Riding an electric bike or tricycle, looking smug and pleased
- Gentle Sister: Still wearing the milk tea shop apron, sitting on the back seat or in the cart, clutching the milk tea tightly, hair tousled by the wind

# 反转喜剧短视频拍摄提示词 —— “带走”篇

反转式喜剧，真实电影高清质感，抖音短视频爆款，2人出镜

人物：小哥@图片1（脑回路清奇的顾客）、老妹很温柔@图片2（敬业的奶茶店员）

场景1：网红奶茶店吧台

- 小哥：穿着休闲，站在吧台前等点单

- 老妹很温柔：穿着奶茶店统一围裙，戴着工作帽，面带职业微笑

镜头&台词&音效：

1. 近景：老妹很温柔递过一杯打包好的奶茶：“帅哥，您的霸气水果茶好了，请问是在这喝还是带走？”

2. 近景：小哥接过奶茶，直勾勾地盯着老妹很温柔：“带走。”

3. 近景：老妹很温柔保持微笑：“好的，那祝您生活愉快。”

4. 近景：小哥眉头一皱，语气霸道：“少废话，跟我走！”

5. 全景：老妹很温柔当场愣住，笑容凝固，配乌鸦飞过或断弦音效。

6. 全景：小哥一把拽住老妹很温柔的手腕：“我选的是带走！”

镜头转场

场景2：大街上/小电驴上

- 小哥：骑着电动车或三轮车，满脸春风得意

- 老妹很温柔：依然穿着奶茶店围裙，坐在后座/车斗里，手里紧紧抱着那杯奶茶，风中凌乱

镜头&台词&音效：

1. 特写：老妹很温柔表情呆滞，生无可恋，头发被风吹得乱七八糟，配悲凉/反转搞笑音效。

2. 全景：小哥一边骑车一边扭头得意喊话：“点个奶茶还送个老板娘！以后看谁还敢说我单身！”，配魔性笑声和起哄音效。

en.p: Realistic Dark Tokusatsu | Insect Bionic Armor Aesthetics | Damaged Armor | Battle-Worn Transformation | Wilderness Ruins [Character and Basic Setting] Face: Refer to Image 1 for upload, with 100% reproduction of facial features, face shape, and hairstyle. Retain dark traces, can be beautified, but the overall face should have a cold tone. Expression remains gloomy throughout. Slight pain at the moment of transformation, with only a slight frown on the brow, rejecting any fighting spirit or eye highlights, maintaining a sense of oppression. Clothing: Refer to Image 1, no belt structure. Wear matte metal alien device gloves. Scene: Wilderness ruins, light breeze, dust and smoke floating in the air, overcast wasteland, gray-blue sky. Occasionally, meteor fragments with fiery tails streak across the distant sky. [Atmosphere and Image Quality] Visual Tone: Cinematic quality, simulating an IMAX film camera, paired with Panavision C-series lenses (focal length 35mm, aperture f4). Color and Tone: Low-saturation gray-blue as the main tone. Shadow details are compressed but retain detail. Slight soft focus at the edges of the frame, with moderate film grain overlay. Style Core: Dark tokusatsu aesthetics, emphasizing the fusion of biomechanical armor and unknown technology, creating a sense of oppression, heaviness, and realism in the transformation ritual. [Camera Movement Rules] Single Shot: One continuous take, no cuts. Angle: Start with a low-angle shot from the left side of the character, focusing on the area above the waist. During transformation, the camera slowly orbits to a front-facing, eye-level view of the upper body. After transformation, orbit to the right side of the character for a high-angle shot. Breathing Feel: Handheld shooting, maintaining a very slight breathing-like camera drift throughout. 0-3 seconds · Gaze Action: The protagonist stands tiredly, slightly lowering their head, eyes fixed on the hand device. Back tense. Right hand slowly extends. Camera: Very slow push forward, capturing the rise and fall of breathing. Effects: Eyes gradually light up with cold white light. Subtle energy patterns appear around the eye sockets. 3-6 seconds · Activation Sound: Whisper "DESCEND." Action: Right hand lifts, gently snapping a crisp finger snap. Effects: At the moment of the snap, the arm is enveloped in red flames. The air collapses inward, creating distortion. A semi-transparent energy pulse spreads around the body. The pulse expands in a spiral pattern. Hair is disturbed. After 0.3 seconds, the energy dissipates. Irregular blue symbolic structures float around the body. Camera: Low-frequency hum approaches from far to near. The camera experiences a 0.1-second stress vibration. 6-9 seconds · Fission Core: The finger snap erupts with dark red energy cracks. Red energy liquid spreads along the body structure toward the torso. Body: Dark red energy mist diffuses from within. The mist contains fine electric arcs. Coat: Tears and burns from the inside out. Fragments drift away with the energy mist. Edges of tears gradually turn charred black. Armor: Bionic armor fragments scatter. Fragments briefly hover in mid-air. Then reassemble and reattach to the body. Camera: The frame briefly loses focus due to energy impact. Then quickly stabilizes. 9-12 seconds · Growth New Substance: A new biomechanical armor structure generates from within the body. Surface has an iridescent sheen. Slowly wriggles and extends like a living structure. Shoulder Armor: Newly formed shoulder armor collides. Erupts with dark red sparks. Leaves energy scars. Chest Armor: Chest armor slowly opens and closes with the heartbeat. Faint light flickers in the gaps. Clothing: The original coat is pulled away from the body by the energy field and flies out of the frame. Face Coverage: A pinkish-white film spreads from the face. Gradually pieces together into a mask outline. Coverage rate varies. Forms an asymmetrical structure. Compound Eyes: Polycrystalline optical compound eyes gradually light up. The left eye completes 0.5 seconds faster than the right. Some units flicker. Brightness uneven. Gaze: Throughout the transformation, the protagonist always looks straight ahead. 12-15 seconds · Completion Helmet: Both compound eyes fully combine. The entire face is covered by the mask. A crown-like structure grows on top of the helmet. Blue energy flames ignite at the horns. Compound eyes continue to glow. Some units still have slight flickering. Shoulder Armor: Edges curl up. Scale patterns are distinct. Weak energy light fluid seeps from the gaps. Waist Side: A large armor gap remains unclosed. Dark red light flows within it. Slightly rises and falls with breathing. Battle Suit: The suit is pure white in color. Exaggerated in design. Overall resembles a beetle-like bionic mecha. Waist, compound eyes, and gap continuously emit light. Fine electric arcs occasionally flash across the body. The suit surface is covered with battle damage marks. Final Shot The camera orbits to the right side of the character. Camera position changes to a high-angle shot. The camera slowly pulls back. The character gradually assumes a battle-ready stance. Showcases character and environmental information. Ending Sound of wind. No dialogue. No explosions. No dazzling light. Only a standing person. And incomplete armor. A meteor streaks across the distant sky. The camera holds.

写实暗黑特摄 | 昆虫仿生装甲美学 | 破损装甲 | 战损变身 | 荒野废墟 

【人物与基础设定】
面部：参照图片1上传图片，五官、脸型、发型百分百还原。保留暗色痕迹，可以美化，但面部整体偏冷感。表情全程阴郁。变身瞬间表情轻微痛苦，眉心仅微皱，拒绝昂扬斗志与眼神高光，保持压抑感。
服装：参考图片1，无腰带结构。佩戴哑光金属异形装置手套。
场景：荒野废墟，微风，空气中漂浮尘埃与烟雾，阴天荒原，灰蓝色调天空。远处天空偶尔划过带火焰拖尾的陨石碎片。

【氛围与画质】 视觉基调：电影质感，模拟 IMAX 胶片摄影机，搭配 Panavision C 系列镜头（焦段 35mm，光圈 f4）。 色彩与影调：低饱和灰蓝主调。暗部信息压缩但保留细节。画面边缘轻微柔焦，叠加适度胶片颗粒。
风格核心：暗黑特摄美学，强调生物机械装甲与未知科技的融合，营造压抑、沉重、真实的变身仪式感。

【运镜规则】 单镜头：一镜到底，无剪辑。 角度：开场仰拍人物左侧，聚焦腰部以上部位。 变身时镜头以极慢速度环绕至正面平视上半身。 完成变身后环绕至人物右侧俯拍。 呼吸感：手持拍摄，全程保持极轻微的呼吸式镜头漂移。 0-3 秒 · 凝视 动作：主角疲惫站立，略微低头，目光锁定手部装置。脊背紧绷。右手缓慢伸出。 镜头：极慢向前推进，捕捉身体呼吸起伏。 特效：双眼逐渐亮起冷白光芒。眼眶周围浮现细微能量纹路。 3-6 秒 · 启动 声音：低语「DESCEND」。 动作：右手抬起，轻轻打出一个清脆响指。 特效：响指瞬间，手臂被红色火焰包裹。空气向内塌陷形成扭曲。 身体周围扩散一圈半透明能量脉冲。 脉冲呈螺旋状扩散。 头发被扰动。 0.3 秒后能量消散。 身体周围漂浮出现不规则蓝色符号结构。 镜头：低频嗡鸣由远及近。镜头产生 0.1 秒应激震动。 6-9 秒 · 裂变 核心：响指爆发出暗红色能量裂纹。 红色能量液体沿着身体结构向躯干蔓延。 身体：暗红能量雾从体内扩散。 雾中夹杂细小电弧。 风衣：由内部开始撕裂灼烧。 碎片与能量雾一同飘散。 破口边缘逐渐焦黑。 装甲：仿生装甲碎片飞散。 碎片在半空短暂停留。 随后重新组合并附着回身体。 镜头：画面因能量冲击短暂失焦。 随后迅速恢复稳定。 9-12 秒 · 生长 新物质：全新的生物机械装甲结构从体内生成。 表面带有虹彩般光泽。 像活体结构般缓慢蠕动延展。 肩甲：新生肩甲对撞。 爆发暗红色火星。 留下能量刻痕。 胸甲：胸甲随心跳缓慢开合。 甲缝中闪烁微弱光芒。 衣物：原有外套被能量场从身体抽离飞出画面。 面部覆盖：粉白色薄膜从面部蔓延。 逐渐拼接成面具轮廓。 覆盖速率不一。 形成不对称结构。 复眼：多晶光学复眼逐渐亮起。 左眼比右眼快 0.5 秒完成。 部分单元闪烁。 亮度不均。 视线：整个变身过程中主角始终直视前方。 12-15 秒 · 完成 头盔：两只复眼完全组合。 整个面部被面具覆盖。 头盔顶部生长出冠状结构。 角部燃起蓝色能量火焰。 复眼持续发光。 部分单元仍有轻微闪烁。 肩甲：边缘翘起。 鳞片纹路明显。 缝隙中渗出微弱能量光液。 腰侧：一道巨大装甲裂隙尚未闭合。 暗红流光在其中流动。 随呼吸轻微起伏。 战衣：战衣呈纯白配色。 造型浮夸。 整体类似甲虫仿生机甲。 腰部、复眼与裂隙持续发光。 全身偶尔闪过细小电弧。 战衣表面布满战损痕迹。 最终镜头 镜头环绕至人物右侧。 机位变为俯拍。 镜头极慢向后拉远。 人物逐渐进入准备战斗姿态。 展示人物与环境信息。 结尾 风声。 无台词。 无爆炸。 无光芒万丈。 只有站立的人。 和不完整的装甲。 远处天空划过一颗陨石。 镜头定住。

【运镜规则】 单镜头：一镜到底，无剪辑。 角度：开场仰拍人物左侧，聚焦腰部以上部位。 变身时镜头以极慢速度环绕至正面平视上半身。 完成变身后环绕至人物右侧俯拍。 呼吸感：手持拍摄，全程保持极轻微的呼吸式镜头漂移。 0-3 秒 · 凝视 动作：主角疲惫站立，略微低头，目光锁定手部装置。脊背紧绷。右手缓慢伸出。 镜头：极慢向前推进，捕捉身体呼吸起伏。 特效：双眼逐渐亮起冷白光芒。眼眶周围浮现细微能量纹路。 3-6 秒 · 启动 声音：低语「DESCEND」。 动作：右手抬起，轻轻打出一个清脆响指。 特效：响指瞬间，手臂被红色火焰包裹。空气向内塌陷形成扭曲。 身体周围扩散一圈半透明能量脉冲。 脉冲呈螺旋状扩散。 头发被扰动。 0.3 秒后能量消散。 身体周围漂浮出现不规则蓝色符号结构。 镜头：低频嗡鸣由远及近。镜头产生 0.1 秒应激震动。 6-9 秒 · 裂变 核心：响指爆发出暗红色能量裂纹。 红色能量液体沿着身体结构向躯干蔓延。 身体：暗红能量雾从体内扩散。 雾中夹杂细小电弧。 风衣：由内部开始撕裂灼烧。 碎片与能量雾一同飘散。 破口边缘逐渐焦黑。 装甲：仿生装甲碎片飞散。 碎片在半空短暂停留。 随后重新组合并附着回身体。 镜头：画面因能量冲击短暂失焦。 随后迅速恢复稳定。 9-12 秒 · 生长 新物质：全新的生物机械装甲结构从体内生成。 表面带有虹彩般光泽。 像活体结构般缓慢蠕动延展。 肩甲：新生肩甲对撞。 爆发暗红色火星。 留下能量刻痕。 胸甲：胸甲随心跳缓慢开合。 甲缝中闪烁微弱光芒。 衣物：原有外套被能量场从身体抽离飞出画面。 面部覆盖：粉白色薄膜从面部蔓延。 逐渐拼接成面具轮廓。 覆盖速率不一。 形成不对称结构。 复眼：多晶光学复眼逐渐亮起。 左眼比右眼快 0.5 秒完成。 部分单元闪烁。 亮度不均。 视线：整个变身过程中主角始终直视前方。 12-15 秒 · 完成 头盔：两只复眼完全组合。 整个面部被面具覆盖。 头盔顶部生长出冠状结构。 角部燃起蓝色能量火焰。 复眼持续发光。 部分单元仍有轻微闪烁。 肩甲：边缘翘起。 鳞片纹路明显。 缝隙中渗出微弱能量光液。 腰侧：一道巨大装甲裂隙尚未闭合。 暗红流光在其中流动。 随呼吸轻微起伏。 战衣：战衣呈纯白配色。 造型浮夸。 整体类似甲虫仿生机甲。 腰部、复眼与裂隙持续发光。 全身偶尔闪过细小电弧。 战衣表面布满战损痕迹。 最终镜头 镜头环绕至人物右侧。 机位变为俯拍。 镜头极慢向后拉远。 人物逐渐进入准备战斗姿态。 展示人物与环境信息。 结尾 风声。 无台词。 无爆炸。 无光芒万丈。 只有站立的人。 和不完整的装甲。 远处天空划过一颗陨石。 镜头定住。

en.p: A 15-second inspirational business speech short video, 4K ultra-high definition, cinematic camera movement, warm gold + dark blue premium stage lighting; a female entrepreneur around 30 years old, wearing a textured black velvet blazer + cream white silk blouse + black trousers, adorned with exquisite earrings, necklace, ring, bracelet, and other jewelry, arms crossed, face smooth without acne scars, fair and radiant skin, light stage makeup, overall elegant and mature business style; the scene is set on the central stage of a 10,000-seat stadium, with a gray background, paired with a simple yet grand gradient light-effect screen, no cluttered special effects; the character exudes full presence, delivering an impassioned speech entirely off-script, with a forceful and rhythmic tone that builds layer by layer, cutting to a close-up at 3 seconds capturing the determined expression of clenching a fist and raising an arm; accurately delivering the lines: 'Don't you doubt it, when you're getting better and better, you'll come across me. 0-2 seconds (Shot 1)
- Visuals: The bridge shakes violently, steel cables snap with exploding sparks, a multi-car pile-up occurs, people scream and run in chaos.
- Camera: Handheld shot, high-urgency close-up.
- Audio: Sound of cables snapping + people screaming + car crashes.
- Tao Ge: Running frantically through the traffic, looking back in terror.

2-5 seconds (Shot 2)
- Visuals: A massive wave capsizes a cargo ship, sending shipping containers flying into the sky.
- Camera: Low-angle shot + rapid zoom.
- Audio: Roar of a tsunami + sound of metal piercing the air.

5-9 seconds (Shot 3)
- Visuals: A shipping container hurtles toward the bridge at high speed!
- Camera: 1.2x slow motion, oppressive perspective.
- Dialogue (Tao Ge screaming): Get out of the way!!

9-11 seconds (Shot 4)
- Visuals: Tao Ge performs an extreme sideways dive and roll.
- Camera: Tracking the roll.
- Audio: The container slams into the ground with a thunderous crash, debris flying everywhere.

11-12 seconds (Shot 5)
- Visuals: Tao Ge lies on the ground and looks up; the bridge collapses further.
- Camera: Close-up of terrified eyes.
- Fade to black.

en.p: Create a hyper-realistic, high-motion football action shot captured from a low, dynamic sideline angle during a chaotic play. A running back in white uniform charges forward toward the camera, mid-stride, with intense motion blur on his limbs and debris flying through the air. Blue-jersey defenders collide and reach out around him, creating a tunnel of bodies and energy. The stadium is packed, bright daylight pouring from above, light rays cutting through dust and turf fragments. Keep the image gritty, high-contrast, with cinematic depth of field, sharp textures on helmets and uniforms, dramatic shutter-drag motion blur, and a visceral sense of speed and impact.

zh.p: 以低角度动态边线视角，捕捉混乱比赛中的超写实高速橄榄球动作瞬间。一名身着白色球衣的跑卫正朝镜头全力冲刺，步伐中带着强烈的动态模糊，肢体周围尘土与草屑飞扬。蓝衣防守球员从两侧冲撞包夹，形成由身体与能量构筑的通道。体育场座无虚席，正午强光倾泻而下，光线穿透扬尘与草皮碎屑。画面需呈现粗粝质感、高对比度、电影级景深，头盔与球衣纹理锐利，配合拖曳快门产生的动态模糊，营造出速度与冲击的原始张力。

The stadium is packed, bright daylight pouring from above, light rays cutting through dust and turf fragments. Keep the image gritty, high-contrast, with cinematic depth of field, sharp textures on helmets and uniforms, dramatic shutter-drag motion blur, and a visceral sense of speed and impact.

en.p:
Original characters: child girl from (image1) on the left side of the frame and adult woman from (image2) on the right side, as if they are two versions of the same person, sitting opposite each other on the bench of a classic children's carousel. The carousel rotates at a normal rhythm; blurred motion background behind — blooming spring trees, soft bokeh, bright daylight.    

Warm, hopeful, joyful mood; both softly smiling, with curious shining eyes and relaxed body language, like a sincere uplifting conversation with your younger self. Poses natural, turned toward each other, fully immersed in the moment.    

Spring daytime setting on an outdoor carousel: painted wooden structure in pastel colors, metal poles, subtle motion blur from rotation. Airy fresh atmosphere, hints of green blooming trees in the background, no dark yard or park bench.    

Facial expressions light and happy, no sadness. Subtle natural facial animation.    

Dialogue in English, one sentence each, subtle lip-sync:  
Child: "So… what happens next to me?"  
Adult: "You can't even imagine how much interesting, beautiful stuff is waiting for you."    

No subtitles, no text, no captions.
en.t: A Heartfelt Carousel Chat with Your Younger Self

zh.p: 画面左侧是来自（图像1）的小女孩，右侧是来自（图像2）的成年女性，仿佛是同一个人不同年龄的版本，面对面坐在经典儿童旋转木马的长椅上。旋转木马以正常节奏转动；身后是模糊的动态背景——盛开的春日树木、柔和的散景、明亮的日光。温暖、充满希望、愉悦的氛围；两人都带着轻柔的微笑，好奇的眼睛闪闪发光，身体语言放松，仿佛在与年幼的自己进行一场真诚而振奋的对话。姿态自然，彼此相向，完全沉浸在当下。春日白天的户外旋转木马场景：彩绘木质结构、金属杆、旋转带来的轻微动态模糊。空气清新，背景中隐约可见绿意盎然的树木，没有阴暗的庭院或公园长椅。面部表情轻松愉快，毫无悲伤。细微的自然面部动画。对话为英语，每人一句，唇形同步微妙：孩子问：“那么……我接下来会怎样？”成人回答：“你根本无法想象有多少有趣又美好的事情在等着你。”无字幕、无文字、无说明。

en.p: A man and a woman, both exceptionally good-looking, with delicate fair skin, cinematic, story-driven, in a dark tone. Inside the living room, an 18-year-old pure girl sits on the sofa wearing a floral nightgown, with subtle makeup and soft, fluffy long hair with small waves at the ends. A handsome, refined, fair-skinned man in a suit and tie kneels before her, meeting her eyes. His slightly messy black hair is swept back, revealing a smooth forehead, with stunning phoenix eyes and long lashes, almost poreless, wearing rimless glasses, his gaze tender and helpless as he looks at the girl. He speaks in a low voice: 'I was wrong, forgive me.' The girl sits on the sofa, crossing her legs and folding her arms, giving him a proud glance: 'Why should I forgive you?' The man feels a pang in his heart at her words, raising his hand to touch her cheek: 'Because, because on nights without you, even time punishes me.' The girl remains proud: 'That's your problem.'
en.t: A Plea for Forgiveness at Dusk

zh.p:
一男一女，超高颜值，细腻冷白皮，电影感，故事感，暗调。
客厅内，18岁清纯女主坐在沙发上身着碎花睡裙，精致淡妆，柔顺蓬松长发 发尾小波浪。

俊美斯文白净男主西装革履跪在女生面前与她平视，他黑色微微凌乱短发后疏漏出光洁的额头，绝美丹凤眼长睫毛，几乎没有一丝毛孔，带着无框眼镜，目光温柔无奈看着女主。

开口声音低沉：“我错了，原谅我。”

女主坐在沙发上翘着二郎腿双手抱胸傲娇撇了他一眼：“我凭什么原谅你？”

男主闻言内心刺痛，抬手想触摸她的脸颊：“因为，因为没有你的夜晚，连时间都在惩罚我。”

女主仍然傲娇：“那是你的事。”

en.p:
A street food vendor in his 40s, broad shoulders, white apron, red bandana headband, stands behind a wok on a night market stall. Just as he prepares a dramatic toss, his phone starts ringing in his pocket. Without hesitation he flips the vegetables and sauce into the air in a perfect arc above the wok under a burst of flame, and at the same moment pulls out his phone and answers it.

Camera holds tight from the side on the arc above the wok. As the vegetables reach the apex, they suddenly stop — suspended mid-air. Every droplet of sauce and every vegetable piece hangs frozen in a precise sculptural formation above the wok.

Calmly on the phone, the vendor says: “Okay, I’ll do it. I’m in the middle of something right now. I’ll do it after five minutes.” He hangs up.

He checks his watch. He leans forward and examines the suspended arc from different angles, hands behind his back. He pokes one suspended carrot. It stays. He shrugs, reaches up, and rearranges a few pieces into a more aesthetically pleasing formation. Steps back. Assesses. Nods.

Finally he casually taps the suspended arc. The vegetables and sauce instantly drop back down into the wok and continue cooking as if nothing happened.

Night market warm sodium and neon lighting, steam from surrounding stalls. Deadpan absurdist comedy, freeze-frame physics, precise timing, photorealistic, 4K.

zh.p: 一位四十多岁的街头小吃摊主，宽肩，系着白色围裙，头戴红色头巾，站在夜市摊位的炒锅前。正当他准备利落地颠勺时，口袋里的手机突然响了。他毫不犹豫地将蔬菜和酱汁抛向空中，在锅上方划出一道完美的弧线，火焰升腾的瞬间，同时掏出手机接听。镜头从侧面紧盯着锅上方的弧线。当蔬菜升至最高点时，它们突然停住了——悬在半空中。每一滴酱汁、每一片蔬菜都凝固在锅上方，形成精确的雕塑般造型。摊主淡定地对着手机说：“好，我会做的。我现在正忙着，五分钟后就来。”他挂断电话，看了看手表，然后探身从不同角度审视悬停的弧线，双手背在身后。他戳了戳一片悬空的胡萝卜，它纹丝不动。他耸耸肩，伸手调整了几片食材的位置，让造型更美观。后退一步，打量一番，点了点头。最后他漫不经心地轻敲悬空的弧线，蔬菜和酱汁瞬间落回锅中，继续翻炒，仿佛什么都没发生过。夜市暖黄色的钠灯与霓虹灯光交织，周围摊位蒸汽袅袅。这是一场冷面滑稽的荒诞喜剧，定格物理，精准时机，照片级写实，4K画质。

en.p:
0-3 seconds: First Encounter
Scene: A fair-skinned girl [@Image 1], with long dark brown curly hair and a crystal butterfly hair accessory shimmering in the night. She tilts her head slightly, her eyes sparkling, and gently bites her lower lip. The background is a blur of summer night tree shadows.
Style: Pure and seductive, dark and hazy, high-grain film texture, soft light filter, low-resolution phone photography feel.
Keywords: Close-up face, slow push-in shot, summer night insect sounds, soft piano intro.

3-6 seconds: Hair Flip
Scene: Medium shot, the girl raises her hand, her fingertips gently brushing the butterfly hair accessory in her hair. The movement is lazy and casual, her hair sways lightly, revealing the white lace camisole at her collarbone.
Style: Follow the hand movement, the camera shifts slightly downward, soft light hits the collarbone, with a slight breathing motion in the camera work.
Keywords: The soft sound of fingertips brushing through hair, piano melody gradually enters, delicate wind chime sounds, close-up of lace trim.

6-10 seconds: Side Smile
Scene: Half-body shot, the girl slowly turns sideways, winks at the camera, a faint smile curling at the corners of her mouth. The white lace camisole glows softly in the night, with a blur of summer night tree shadows in the background.
Style: Surrounding camera movement, capturing the side curve, warm soft light, slight motion blur.
Keywords: The girl softly murmurs, "What are you looking at?" Light drumbeats gradually intensify, filling the atmosphere with sweet warmth.

10-13 seconds: Eye Contact
Scene: Close-up, the girl brushes aside the stray hair in front of her eyes, her gaze lazy with a smile, looking directly into the camera as if making eye contact with the person behind it. The butterfly hair accessory in her hair glimmers faintly.
Style: Quick cut to close-up, freeze on the eye contact, soft light hits the side of the face, highlighting the fair skin texture.
Keywords: The soft sound of hair being brushed aside, drumbeats hitting the beat, sweet and warm melody climax, eyes full of allure.

13-15 seconds: Turning Back
Scene: Long shot, the girl turns around, the butterfly hair accessory in her hair flashes in the night. She looks back and winks at the camera, then disappears into the summer night tree shadows. The camera pulls back and fades out.
Style: Pull back and fade out, dark and hazy, low saturation, high-grain film texture.
Keywords: Insect sounds gradually fade, piano melody ends, butterfly hair accessory glimmers, silhouette disappears.

zh.p:
0-3秒：初遇 
画面：冷白皮少女【@图1】，深棕长卷发，水晶蝴蝶发饰在夜色中闪烁，她微微歪头，眼波流转，轻咬下唇，背景是模糊的夏夜树影。
 风格：纯欲风，暗朦调，高噪点胶片颗粒感，柔光滤镜，低分辨率手机摄影感。​
关键词：特写面部，慢推近景，夏夜虫鸣，轻柔钢琴前奏。 

3-6秒：撩发 
画面：中景，少女抬手，指尖轻拂发间的蝴蝶发饰，动作慵懒又不经意，发丝轻晃，露出锁骨处的白色蕾丝吊带。​
风格：跟拍手部动作，镜头微下移，柔光打在锁骨，轻微呼吸感运镜。​
关键词：指尖划过发丝的轻响，钢琴旋律渐入，细碎风铃音，蕾丝花边特写。 

6-10秒：侧笑 
画面：半身景，少女缓缓侧身，对着镜头眨眼，嘴角勾起浅笑，白色蕾丝吊带在夜色里温柔发光，背景是模糊的夏夜树影。
风格：环绕运镜，捕捉侧身曲线，暖调柔光，轻微动态模糊。
关键词：少女轻声呢喃“你在看什么呀？”，轻鼓点渐强，甜暖氛围拉满。

10-13秒：对视
画面：近景，少女撩开挡在眼前的碎发，眼神慵懒带笑，直视镜头，仿佛与镜头后的人对视，发间蝴蝶发饰闪着微光。
风格：快速切近景，定格眼神特写，柔光打在侧脸，冷白皮质感突出。
关键词：撩发轻响，鼓点卡点，旋律甜暖高潮，眼神拉丝。

13-15秒：回眸
画面：远景，少女转身，发间蝴蝶发饰在夜色里一闪，回头对镜头wink，随后消失在夏夜树影中，镜头拉远淡出。​
风格：拉远淡出，暗朦调，低饱和度，高噪点胶片颗粒感。
关键词：虫鸣渐弱，钢琴旋律收尾，蝴蝶发饰闪光，背影消失。

en.p: 0-2 seconds: A Dunhuang flying celestial maiden emerges from a gilded mural, holding a gilded lotus lamp. As the lamp's glow shifts, her red-and-gold celestial robe shines like rosy clouds and brocade, while the caisson pattern behind her (interwoven with red, gold, and lapis lazuli blue) flows with radiant light. 2-4 seconds: She steps onto a seven-colored lotus pedestal, her gold-and-green ribbons fluttering with every dance step. Each spin sends golden powder cascading, and the flying celestial figures in the background mural (cinnabar red, bright yellow, peacock green) seem to move in rhythm. 4-6 seconds: Her dance quickens, the golden patterns on her celestial robe shimmering as if alive. The jewelry at her waist (rubies, gold ornaments, turquoise) clinks with flowing light, while the circular caisson pattern behind her blooms layer by layer in splendid colors from the center outward. 6-8 seconds: She soars into the air, her red-and-gold ribbons entwining like neon rainbows. The sea of clouds beneath her is dyed in gold and red, and the Buddha statues in the distant mural (gold, red, blue) appear faintly in the light and shadow, exuding solemn grandeur. 8-10 seconds: As she spins, her celestial robe transforms into a sky full of golden-red flowing clouds. The jewels on her body (gold bracelets, ruby necklaces, blue turquoise pendants) burst with dazzling light, and the caisson pattern in the background shifts colors like a kaleidoscope. 10-12 seconds: Finally, she lands on a giant golden lotus throne, her red-and-gold celestial robe spreading out like rosy clouds. Ribbons and golden powder intertwine around her into a brilliant curtain of light, and the colors of the background mural (gold, red, blue, white) reach a magnificent peak within this luminous veil.

zh.p: 0-2秒：敦煌飞天美人自鎏金壁画中飘出，手持鎏金莲花灯，灯辉流转间，身上红金相间的天衣如霞似锦，身后藻井图案（红、金、青金石蓝交织）流光溢彩。2-4秒：她足踏七彩莲台，金绿相间的飘带随舞步纷飞，每一次旋转都带起金粉簌簌，背景壁画的飞天群像（朱砂红、明黄、孔雀绿）仿佛随之律动。4-6秒：舞姿渐疾，天衣上的金纹如活过来般闪烁，腰间璎珞（红宝、金饰、绿松石）碰撞出流光，身后的圆形藻井图案由中心向外层层绽放华丽色彩。6-8秒：她腾空而起，红金飘带如霓虹缠绕，脚下云海被染成金红双色，远处壁画中的佛像（金、红、蓝）在光影中若隐若现，尽显庄严华丽。8-10秒：旋转间，天衣化作漫天金红流霞，身上的珠宝（金镯、红宝石链、蓝松石坠）迸发出璀璨光芒，背景藻井图案如万花筒般变幻色彩。10-12秒：最终她落于巨型金色莲座，红金天衣铺展如霞，周身飘带与金粉交织成绚烂光幕，背景壁画的色彩（金、红、青、白）在光幕中达到华丽巅峰。

en.p:
A cinematic adventure scene set in a hidden jungle valley at sunrise. Massive ancient stone ruins covered in moss rise from dense tropical vegetation. Giant statues of forgotten warriors stand broken among tall pillars wrapped in vines. A mysterious circular stone platform lies in the center of the ruins.

Eight explorers from different backgrounds stand on the platform wearing rugged expedition clothing mixed with tribal artifacts they discovered in the ruins. Their faces show tension, curiosity, and determination.

A mysterious guide dressed in dark modern expedition gear slowly walks across the platform while the explorers watch him carefully. Wind moves through the jungle canopy and ancient cloth banners hanging from the pillars. Torches burn with orange flames, creating moving shadows across the stone carvings.

Camera begins with a wide aerial shot revealing the enormous jungle valley and hidden ruins, morning fog drifting between trees. The camera slowly descends toward the platform.

Cut to close-up shots of several explorers: focused eyes, sweat on their faces, hands touching ancient engraved symbols on the stone floor.

The guide stops at the center and speaks calmly:

“Every civilization leaves behind a test. Only those who understand the past can control the future.”

Low distant thunder echoes across the valley. The camera slowly circles around the group as they look at each other, realizing this is the beginning of a dangerous expedition.

Final shot: one explorer kneels and traces a glowing ancient symbol on the ground, hinting at hidden secrets inside the ruins.

Ultra cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, realistic human acting, epic adventure film style, volumetric sunrise fog, jungle ambience, natural wind movement, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens look, subtle lens flare, high detail textures, realistic environment simulation.

zh.p: 一部电影感十足的冒险场景，设定在日出时分的隐秘丛林山谷中。巨大的古老石质废墟覆盖着苔藓，从茂密的热带植被中拔地而起。被遗忘的战士巨型雕像断裂在缠绕藤蔓的高耸石柱间，废墟中央矗立着一座神秘的圆形石台。八位来自不同背景的探险家站在石台上，身着粗犷的探险服装，混搭着他们在废墟中发现的部落器物。他们的脸上交织着紧张、好奇与坚定。一位身着深色现代探险装备的神秘向导缓缓走过石台，探险家们警惕地注视着他。风吹过丛林树冠和石柱上悬挂的古老布幡。火把燃起橙色火焰，在石雕上投下摇曳的阴影。镜头以广阔的航拍视角开场，展现巨大的丛林山谷与隐藏的废墟，晨雾在林间飘荡。镜头缓缓下降，靠近石台。切至几位探险家的特写：专注的眼神、脸上的汗水、手指触碰石板上古老雕刻符号的瞬间。向导在中央停下，平静地说：“每个文明都会留下考验。只有理解过去的人才能掌控未来。”远处传来低沉的雷声，在山谷中回荡。镜头缓缓环绕这群人，他们彼此对视，意识到这是一场危险探险的开端。最后一幕：一位探险家单膝跪地，在地面上描摹出一个发光的古老符号，暗示着废墟中隐藏的秘密。极致电影感的光影、戏剧性的氛围、真实的人类表演、史诗冒险电影风格、体积感晨雾、丛林环境音、自然的微风动态、浅景深、变形镜头质感、微妙的镜头光晕、高细节纹理、逼真的环境模拟。

en.p: Hyperrealistic miniature diorama, stop-motion clay animation, handcrafted tactile materials, real fabric, professional studio animation style — miniature bedroom, Friday night, clay figure stumbles through the door with enormous hollowed-out face, dark circles sculpted deep under tiny dead eyes, dragging his feet, real fabric shirt wrinkled and untucked [cut] close-up: he collapses face-first onto the bed, his giant body bounces once on real fabric sheets, arms limp [cut] extreme close-up: his huge trembling hand reaches behind his own back, fumbles for a socket between his shoulder blades, plugs in a thick clay cable connected to the wall — a spark, a tiny hum [cut] close-up: on his enormous belly, a miniature screen flickers on — 1%, a thin red sliver, the word FRIDAY 23:00 underneath [cut] wide shot: Saturday morning light pours through miniature window, he hasn't moved one millimeter, cable taut from wall to back, real fabric blanket now draped over him somehow [cut] close-up: belly screen reads 12%, still red.
en.t: Tired Robot Recharges on Friday Night

zh.p: 超写实微缩立体模型，定格黏土动画，手工触感材料，真实布料，专业工作室动画风格——微缩卧室，周五夜晚，黏土小人跌跌撞撞推门而入，巨大空洞的面孔上，深陷的黑眼圈刻在呆滞的小眼睛下方，拖着脚步，真实布料的衬衫皱巴巴地露在外面【切】特写：他脸朝下瘫倒在床上，庞大的身躯在真实布料的床单上弹了一下，双臂无力垂下【切】极特写：他巨大的颤抖的手伸向自己背后，在肩胛骨之间摸索到一个插座，插上一根连接墙壁的粗黏土电缆——火花一闪，微弱的嗡鸣声【切】特写：他巨大的肚子上，一块微型屏幕亮起——1%，一条细长的红色条，下方写着“周五 23:00”【切】广角镜头：周六清晨的阳光透过微缩窗户洒入，他一毫米都没移动过，电缆从墙壁绷紧到后背，不知何时身上盖上了真实布料的毯子【切】特写：肚皮屏幕显示12%，仍是红色。

en.p: Realistic style, vertical screen, warm cinematic lighting.[0-5s] Close-up shot on bed, handheld slight shake, shallow depth of field.Late night bedroom with warm dim bedside lamp glow. A small orange tabby kitten is lying in bed under a cozy blanket, secretly scrolling on a phone. The phone screen casts a soft blue glow on its furry face. Its expression is focused and amused, tiny paws swiping the screen, occasionally letting out a quiet little giggle.[5-10s] Medium close-up, quick push-in camera movement.Suddenly the kitten hears soft pawsteps outside the door. Its ears perk up in panic. The kitten quickly shoves the phone under the pillow. It dives under the covers, squeezes its eyes shut, and pretends to be fast asleep. Its little ears twitch nervously.[10-13s] Wide shot from doorway, fixed camera, deep depth of field.The bedroom door slowly creaks open a crack. A large orange tabby cat mom peeks her head in, eyes stern and suspicious. Soft light spills in from the hallway. She scans the bed carefully. The kitten is pretending to sleep dramatically — body stiff, exaggerated fake snoring. Cat mom narrows her eyes, skeptical, then slowly closes the door. The instant the door shuts, the kitten sneakily opens one eye with a mischievous grin, and quietly pulls the phone back out from under the pillow to keep scrolling.

zh.p: 写实风格，竖屏画面，温暖的电影感灯光。[0-5秒] 床上特写镜头，手持轻微晃动，浅景深。深夜卧室里，暖色调的昏暗床头灯泛着微光。一只橘色小奶猫裹着舒适的毯子躺在床上，正偷偷刷着手机。手机屏幕的蓝光柔柔地映在它毛茸茸的脸上。它神情专注又觉得有趣，小爪子滑动屏幕，偶尔还发出轻轻的咯咯笑声。[5-10秒] 中近景，镜头快速推进。突然，小猫听到门外传来轻柔的脚步声。它惊慌地竖起耳朵。小猫迅速把手机塞到枕头底下。它钻进被窝，紧闭双眼，假装已经熟睡。小耳朵却紧张地微微抽动。[10-13秒] 从门口拍摄的广角镜头，固定机位，大景深。卧室门缓缓地吱呀一声开了一条缝。一只大橘猫妈妈探进头来，眼神严厉而怀疑。走廊的柔光透进门缝。她仔细地扫视着床铺。小猫正夸张地装睡——身体僵硬，打着假鼾。猫妈妈眯起眼睛，一脸狐疑，然后慢慢关上了门。门刚关上，小猫就偷偷睁开一只眼，露出狡黠的笑容，悄悄从枕头底下又把手机掏出来，继续刷了起来。

en.p:
0-3 seconds: The screen is soft and hazy. She has just washed her hair, which is slightly curled and damp, with tiny water droplets clinging to the ends. Wrapped in a light-colored bath towel, she curls up on the sofa. Holding a white porcelain cup, the hot tea's steam rises gently. She smiles at you with curved eyes, her lashes still misty. Soft guitar music flows in the background.

3-5 seconds: A hand (first-person perspective) gently reaches in from the upper right of the screen, pats and rubs her soft hair, causing the water droplets to tremble slightly. She closes her eyes and chuckles softly, like a kitten being petted, letting out a gentle 'Mm~' from her throat.

5-7 seconds: The finger playfully pinches her cheek, making the left side puff up slightly. She blows on the hot tea, her breath carrying the fragrance of tea.

7-8.5 seconds: The first-person hand pinches her cheek again. She looks straight into the camera (as if looking into your eyes), her voice soft and sweet with a smile: 'Stop it.'

8.5-9.5 seconds: The camera suddenly zooms in!

9.5-10 seconds: She suddenly pouts and gives a 'smack' kiss to the camera! A crisp kissing sound~

zh.p:
0-3秒 画面柔光氤氲，刚洗完头的她湿发微卷， 发梢凝着细小水珠，裹着浅色浴巾窝在沙 发里。双手捧白瓷杯，热茶白气袅袅上升， 她对你弯起眼睛笑，睫毛还沾着水汽。轻 柔吉他声流淌。 

3-5秒 一只手（第一人称视角）从画面右上温柔探 入，摸摸揉了揉她柔软的发顶，水珠轻颤。 她闭眼轻笑，像只被顺毛的小猫，喉间溢 出软软的“唔~”。 

5-7秒 手指调皮捏住她脸颊，左脸微微鼓起。她 吹吹热茶，呼吸带着茶香。 

7-8.5秒 第一人称视角的手捏捏脸，她直直望进镜 头（仿佛看你眼睛），声音软糯带笑：“别闹了” 

8.5-9.5秒 镜头倏然推近！ 

9.5-10秒 她突然嘟嘴“啵”亲上镜头！清脆亲吻声~

en.p: [Video Style] Japanese full-color 2D cel animation, 8K resolution, multi-cut composition, cinematic lighting, epic and cyberpunk atmosphere, cinematic camera work, psychological pressure. [Character & Setting Details] Female (Ruler): Long silver hair, blunt bangs, mechanical hair ornaments, white suit, high heels. Seated on a throne backed by a wall of countless surveillance cameras. Setting: A room filled with a massive array of security cameras covering the entire wall. [0s - 3s] Shot 1: Silent Domination. Camera: Starts from the initial frame. A cinematic zoom-in from the full body of the woman on the throne to a bust-up shot. Action: The silver-haired woman slightly sways her crossed legs, wearing a composed, cold smile. Dialogue: In Japanese, "Haha! You just realized now? How foolish." [3s - 5s] Shot 2: Activation of the Gimmick. Camera: Close-up from the woman's chest to around her face. Action: The woman slowly raises her right hand and snaps her fingers (a snapping motion) beside her face. Dialogue: In Japanese, "Fufufu..." [5s - 8s] Shot 3: Awakening and Declaration. Camera: Rapid, dynamic zoom-out to the surveillance cameras in the background. Action: At the moment of the finger snap, the lenses of all the surveillance cameras on the wall simultaneously emit a "red light," creating an intense red backlight that illuminates the woman. The woman directs an overwhelmingly dominant, captivating smile at the camera (the viewer). Dialogue: In Japanese, "I see... everything♡"

舞台: 壁一面を埋め尽くす大量のセキュリティカメラ群の部屋。

アクション: 銀髪の女性は組んだ脚をわずかに揺らしながら、余裕のある冷徹な微笑みを浮かべる。
セリフ: 日本語で「はは！ いまさら気づいたの？おろかだねぇ」

セリフ: 日本語で「ふふふ……」
