en.p: an old, green, oversized, and extra-tall American-style bus is parked in a dilapidated parking lot in a forest. A young Asian driver slams on the brakes, looking tense and speechless. The bus begins to violently disassemble and reorganize from the inside out, transforming into a grumpy, evil Cybertronian mechanical giant caterpillar. The driver's cabin reassembles into a mechanical head, the windshield becomes its glasses, and the bumper turns into a chin. Both sides of the mouth use hydraulic devices, the tongue is made of seats, and the teeth are formed from broken orange handrails inside the bus. The headlights transform into its eyes, and the entire body is composed of large vehicle components in segments. It spits the driver out of its mouth, bites his head, and tosses him into the air to land on its back; the driver grabs the handrails on the back to stand firm. The mechanical giant caterpillar strikes a cool pose, roaring and spitting sparks. The windows and tires remain intact. The transformation process is aggressive, with the body constantly twisting and crawling, parts rubbing and sparking, dust flying, and valves venting air. The camera moves continuously from the cabin to the exterior, showing the mechanical body's massive yet slender stature. Use a realistic visual style for the generated material, employing a humorous yet terrifying transformation style, accompanied by intense and shocking background music.
en.t: Bus Transforms into Giant Robot Caterpillar

zh.p: 一辆老旧、绿色、超大型的美式巴士停在一片森林中破败的停车场里。一位年轻的亚裔司机猛踩刹车，神情紧张，一言不发。巴士开始从内到外剧烈地拆解重组，变成一只暴躁邪恶的赛博坦机械巨虫。驾驶室重组为机械头部，挡风玻璃变成眼镜，保险杠化作下巴。嘴巴两侧采用液压装置，舌头由座椅构成，牙齿则由车内断裂的橙色扶手形成。车灯变成眼睛，整个身体由大型车辆部件分段组成。它将司机从嘴里吐出，咬住他的头，抛向空中让其落在背上；司机抓住背部的扶手站稳。机械巨虫摆出酷炫姿势，咆哮着喷出火花。车窗和轮胎保持完好。变形过程充满攻击性，身体不断扭动爬行，零件摩擦迸出火花，尘土飞扬，阀门喷气。镜头从驾驶室持续移动到外部，展现机械身体庞大而修长的姿态。生成素材采用写实视觉风格，运用幽默又恐怖的变形方式，配以激烈震撼的背景音乐。

en.p:
a city street during a red light; everyone is stopped and waiting. a young man is on a bicycle with a ragdoll cat perched on the back. beside him, a beautiful young woman is on another bicycle, carrying a basket full of dead fish on her rear rack.

the camera angle is a pov shot from inside a car parked directly behind the two bicycles. the ragdoll cat reaches out a paw, attempting to snatch a fish. just as its paw extends, the car honks - beep, beep, beep! startled, the cat flinches and quickly retracts its paw. it turns to glare fiercely at the car behind it, lets out a sharp meow, and raises a paw to swipe angrily toward the camera. the scene is filled with the sound of fierce, disgruntled meowing.
en.t: Cat's Fish Heist Foiled by Honk

zh.p: 红灯下的城市街道，所有人都停下等待。一个年轻人骑着自行车，后座上蹲着一只布偶猫。他身旁，一位美丽的年轻女子骑着另一辆自行车，后架上载着一篮死鱼。镜头视角来自停在两辆自行车正后方的一辆汽车内。布偶猫伸出爪子，试图偷鱼。就在爪子伸出的瞬间，汽车鸣笛——哔哔哔！猫吓了一跳，猛地缩回爪子。它转头怒视后方汽车，发出一声尖锐的喵叫，抬起爪子愤怒地朝镜头挥去。整个场景充斥着激烈不满的喵喵声。

raw_p:
a city street during a red light; everyone is stopped and waiting. a young man is on a bicycle with a ragdoll cat perched on the back. beside him, a beautiful young woman is on another bicycle, carrying a basket full of dead fish on her rear rack.

the camera angle is a pov shot from inside a car parked directly behind the two bicycles. the ragdoll cat reaches out a paw, attempting to snatch a fish. just as its paw extends, the car honks - beep, beep, beep! startled, the cat flinches and quickly retracts its paw. it turns to glare fiercely at the car behind it, lets out a sharp meow, and raises a paw to swipe angrily toward the camera. the scene is filled with the sound of fierce, disgruntled meowing.

en.p: Live-action cinematic sequence in real time. Aerial wide shot: a vast white mountain range, completely silent and endless. Cut to close-up of a compass in a gloved hand, needle spinning then settling. Cut to medium shot of a lone explorer trudging through deep snow, wind whipping around her. Cut to insert shot of footprints in the snow being erased by the wind almost immediately. Cut to extreme close-up of her face behind snow goggles — determined. Cut to wide shot of her stopping at the edge of a cliff, looking out. Cut to POV shot: an enormous hidden valley below, completely untouched, green and warm despite the snow above. Cut to tracking shot circling her slowly as she takes in the view. Cut to close-up of her hand pulling out a weathered journal and opening it. Cut to insert shot of a sketch in the journal — the exact valley she is now looking at, drawn decades ago. Cut to extreme close-up of her eyes: disbelief turning into triumph. Cut to final aerial wide shot pulling back slowly: she stands tiny at the cliff edge, the hidden valley vast and glowing below her.

zh.p: 实时真人电影级镜头序列。航拍远景：一片广袤的白色山脉，万籁俱寂，绵延无尽。切至戴着手套的手持指南针特写，指针旋转后停定。切至中景：一名孤独的探险者深一脚浅一脚跋涉于厚雪中，狂风在她四周呼啸。切至插入镜头：雪地脚印几乎瞬间被风抹平。切至雪镜后脸庞的大特写——神情坚定。切至远景：她在悬崖边停下，极目远眺。切至主观镜头：下方隐藏着一座巨大的山谷，完全未经开发，尽管上方白雪皑皑，谷内却绿意盎然、温暖如春。切至环绕她的跟拍镜头，她缓缓环视景色。切至她掏出一本泛黄日志并翻开的手部特写。切至日志中素描的插入镜头——正是她此刻所见的山谷，画于数十年前。切至她双眼的大特写：难以置信转为胜利的喜悦。切至最终航拍远景，镜头缓缓拉远：她如微尘般立于崖边，下方隐藏的山谷广阔无垠，熠熠生辉。

en.p: [Film Style]: 90s Hong Kong Art Cinema style, retro film feel, high ISO grain, ambiguous yellow-green tint, frame stepping effect, melancholic atmosphere. [Core Dialogue (for emotion control)]: 'If memories were canned food, I hope they never expire.' [Video Duration]: 10 seconds [Script]: [00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Through the Glass Peeping. Scene: A rain-covered red public telephone booth. Character: A man (or woman) in a khaki trench coat holding the receiver tightly, not speaking, just listening. Emotional Performance: Through the glass refraction, see his/her eyes hollow yet deeply emotional. Rain flows down the glass, distorting his face like an oil painting. Subtitle/Narrative sense: The picture seems frozen, only the sound of rain. [00:04-00:07] Shot 2: Extreme Close-up & Micro-expression. Scene: Focus on the character's lips and half face. Action: He/She whispers softly into the receiver. Lips tremble slightly, seeming to want to say something but swallow it back. Lighting: Street neon bokeh flows across his face, bright and dim alternately. Dialogue Emotion Mapping: Shows the ultimate restraint and loneliness of 'wanting to touch but drawing back'. [00:07-00:10] Shot 3: Signature Slow-shutter Drag Shadow. Scene: Character hangs up phone, turns around and walks into the rainy crowd. Visual Effect: Using frame stepping effect (stop-motion feel), the character's back becomes blurred with trailing shadows (motion blur), as if the soul stayed in place while only the body walks away. Environment: Background is flowing city car lights forming elongated light trails. [Technical Parameters]: Simulated handheld camera, shallow depth of field, color shift, emotionally intense.

en.p: 15-second aesthetic pure love narrative shot, cinematic realistic quality, 2.35:1 aspect ratio. 0-4 seconds: Warm yellow tones, afternoon sunlight streaming through blinds onto a wooden desk, creating subtle Tyndall effects. A girl rests her head on the desk in a light sleep, a gentle breeze stirring the stray hairs by her ear and the pages of a book. The camera slowly pushes in for a close-up of her profile. 5-10 seconds: Cut to the boy sitting across from her, gazing at her absentmindedly, his eyes clear and overflowing with tenderness. Noticing her eyelashes flutter, he immediately flusters, lowering his head to pretend to read, nervously rubbing the corner of the book with his fingers. 11-15 seconds: Extreme close-up of the moment their eyes meet. The girl shyly purses her lips, the boy reveals a bashful smile. The background blurs into dreamy bokeh, with sound effects of faint cicadas and the rustling of pages. No watermarks, subtitles, or text allowed.

Cinematic full color japanese action anime of 【@图片1】in dynamic combat against an army of humanoid robots. 
Fast paced fight where she fights an army of humanoid robots. She fights at close quarters against the robots while dodging and deflecting bullets as she strikes with a samurai sword. en.p: 15 seconds, vertical 9:16, front-facing phone camera texture, slight overexposure + occasional autofocus blur, late-night Taipei street, cold white fluorescent light from the convenience store contrasting with the warm yellow light of street lamps outside. The protagonist is a Taiwanese girl [Image 1], with a low ponytail, wearing her boyfriend's oversized white T-shirt + shorts, with a slightly puffy bare face. The entire scene is shot from the girl's single-handheld selfie POV, with the camera slightly shaking as her wrist moves. 0-4 seconds: Outside late at night, the girl holds up her phone facing herself, with the convenience store glass door in the background. She looks back to check her surroundings, then lowers her voice, leans closer to the camera, and makes a shushing gesture. Dialogue (lowered voice, excited): 'Shh—sneaking out to buy a late-night snack, don't tell my mom, okay?' 4-9 seconds: She pushes the door and enters the convenience store, the entry chime sounds. The cold white fluorescent light suddenly hits her face, she squints, and the camera focus blurs for a moment before recovering. She walks to the oden counter, flips the phone to face the counter—the camera focuses on the steaming oden full view, holds for 2 seconds, then flips it back to face herself. She pouts slightly, looking conflicted toward the counter. Dialogue (muttering in hesitation): 'Radish or meatball... forget it, I'll take both, since you're paying anyway.' 9-12 seconds: She pushes the door and walks out of the convenience store holding a paper bowl. The convenience store's white light and the street lamp's warm yellow light create a cool-warm contrast on her body. [Door chime fades + nighttime ambient sound, no dialogue] 12-15 seconds: She switches the phone to her other hand, uses chopsticks to pick up a piece of radish and brings it close to the camera. Hot steam drifts by forming a thin mist. She takes a bite, burns her mouth, opens it to exhale, then bursts into laughter at the camera. Dialogue (muffled from the heat, in two beats): 'So hot—you try it first! This radish is absolutely amazing!' No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks allowed.

zh.p:
15秒，竖屏9:16，手机前置镜头质感，轻微过曝+自动对焦偶发虚焦， 深夜台北街头，便利店冷白荧光灯与室外路灯昏黄光冷暖对比， 主角台湾女生【图片1】，低马尾，男友oversized白T恤+短裤，素颜微肿状态。 全程女生单手持机自拍POV，镜头随手腕轻微晃动。 
0-4秒：室外深夜，女生举手机对着自己，背景是便利店玻璃门， 她回头确认了一下四周，压低声音凑近镜头比嘘手势； 台词（压低声音、兴奋）："嘘——偷跑出来买宵夜，你不要跟我妈说喔。" 
4-9秒：她推门进入便利店，进店提示音响起， 冷白荧光灯骤然打脸，她眯了一下眼，镜头对焦模糊一瞬后恢复； 她走到关东煮柜台前，将手机翻转朝向柜台——镜头对准热气蒸腾的关东煮全景， 停留2秒，再翻回对着自己，她嘴唇微嘟、眼神纠结地看向柜台方向； 台词（纠结碎碎念）："萝卜还是贡丸……算了两个都夹，反正你付钱。" 
9-12秒：她端着纸碗推门走出便利店， 便利店白光与路灯昏黄光在她身上形成冷暖交接； [门铃声渐弱+夜晚环境音，无台词] 
12-15秒：她换手持机，另一只手用筷子夹起萝卜凑近镜头， 热气飘过形成薄雾，她咬了一口烫到张嘴哈气，随即对着镜头大笑； 台词（被烫含糊，分两拍）："好烫——你先吃！这个萝卜真的绝了！" 
禁止出现文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

12-15秒：她换手持机，另一只手用筷子夹起萝卜凑近镜头， 热气飘过形成薄雾，她咬了一口烫到张嘴哈气，随即对着镜头大笑； 台词（被烫含糊，分两拍）："好烫——你先吃！这个萝卜真的绝了！" 
禁止出现文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

en.p: [Subject]: Refer to the woman in the uploaded photo, change into K-pop stage performance clothing. The character's face references @【@Figure 1】. Upper body: off-white cropped long-sleeved lace knit top, inner layer: nude tube top, high-waisted vintage blue denim shorts with leopard-print fluffy edges, dark leather belt with a brown heart-shaped plush accessory. Temperament: gentle yet with a sense of strength, delicate and clear facial features, stable and undistorted face, consistent character identity. [Action]: Continuous dance in one take, professional choreography quality. Start with feet shoulder-width apart, core always engaged. First beat: take a big step to the right with the right foot, lower the center of gravity, simultaneously 'chop' the right hand diagonally downward from above the head, left hand on the hip, head turns in the direction of the right hand. Second beat: quickly retract the right foot, perform a figure-eight hip rotation, cross hands in front of the chest and then 'explode' them outward to the sides. Third beat: step back with the left foot, lean the body backward into a wave, 'smooth' hair from the top of the head backward with both hands. Fourth beat: shift the center of gravity forward into a lunge, point the right hand forward toward the camera, pull the left hand backward, creating diagonal tension. Throughout the movement, there is a sense of extension, with direction in both fingertips and toes, not soft, floppy motions. [Scene]: Fashionable and simple indoor stage background, warm side lighting outlines the body lines, slight mirror reflection on the floor, cinematic depth of field blurring the background. [Camera Movement]: Medium shot, smooth orbit slowly circling the subject, keeping the character always in the center of the frame, simulating a professional stage direct shot. [Style/Quality]: 4K ultra-high definition, cinematic quality, eliminates re-shooting noise, sharp and clear, rich in detail, natural and realistic colors, no flickering, smooth motion without frame drops. [Constraints]: Normal human body structure, movements have points of force and extension, facial features highly restored to the original image, stable and smooth picture, prohibited from posing like a still or doing calisthenics.

zh.p:
[主体]：参考所上传照片中的女性，换上K-pop舞台风格服装。人物面部参考@【@图1】上身米白色镂空针织短款长袖罩衫，内搭肤色抹胸，高腰复古蓝色牛仔短裤配豹纹毛绒边缘，深色皮质腰带挂棕色爱心毛绒挂件。气质温婉中带着力量感，五官精致清晰，面部稳定不变形，同一角色一致性。

[动作]：一镜到底连贯舞蹈，专业编舞质感。从双脚开立与肩同宽开始，核心始终收紧。第一拍：右脚向旁迈一大步，重心压低，同时右手从头顶向斜下方"劈"出，左手扶胯，头随右手方向甩；第二拍：快速收回右脚，胯部做八字绕环，双手在胸前交叉后向两侧"炸"开；第三拍：左脚向后撤步，身体后仰做wave，双手从头顶向后"捋"头发；第四拍：重心前移成弓步，右手向前"指"镜头，左手向后拉，形成对角线张力。全程动作有延伸感，手指尖和脚尖都有方向，不是软绵绵的摆动。

[场景]：时尚简洁的室内舞台背景，暖色侧光勾勒身体线条，地面有轻微镜面反射，电影级景深虚化背景。

[运镜]：中景镜头，Smooth Orbit缓慢环绕主体，保持人物始终在画面中心，模拟专业舞台直拍。

[风格/画质]：4K超高清，电影质感，消除翻拍噪点，锐度清晰，细节丰富，色彩自然真实，无闪烁，动作流畅无掉帧。

[约束]：人体结构正常，动作有发力点和延伸感，面部特征高度还原原图，画面稳定流畅，禁止动作像摆pose或做广播体操。

en.p:
【Style】 Hollywood Sci-fi cinematic. The entire camera frame rotates 360 degrees in a slow, sickening corkscrew to match the ship's roll. 【Duration】 10 seconds
Characters:

Darrow (@): Charcoal heavy mech armor, golden hair visible before the helmet closes.

Sevro (@): Background character, rugged mohawk, checking gear.

Victra (@): Tall, fierce woman in high-tech tactical gear.

Shot Actions:

Shot 1 (The Anchored Kiss): Medium Shot on Darrow and Victra. As the frigate begins a violent corkscrew maneuver to dodge flak, the gravity shifts. The camera begins to rotate 180 degrees. Darrow and Victra are forced to grab onto a hydraulic steam pipe and a magnetic rail to stay upright. Mid-rotation, Victra pulls Darrow in by his chest plate for a firm, desperate kiss. In the background, Sevro is visible bracing his boots against the floor to keep from sliding.

Shot 2 (The Impact & Visor): Extreme Close-up. The ship takes a massive kinetic hit to the hull; a violent jolt shakes the camera frame. Victra pulls back, her face illuminated by flickering red strobes, and whispers in a British accent: "Good luck." She reaches up and slams Darrow’s heavy metallic helmet visor down over his face with a loud mechanical clack. Another massive impact jolts the camera just as the visor locks, and the frame completes its 360-degree rotation into total chaos.

zh.p: 【风格】好莱坞科幻电影风格。整个镜头以缓慢而令人眩晕的螺旋方式旋转360度，与飞船的翻滚动作同步。【时长】10秒。角色：达罗（@）：身穿炭黑色重型机甲装甲，头盔合拢前可见金色头发。塞弗罗（@）：背景角色，留着粗犷的莫西干发型，正在检查装备。维克特拉（@）：身材高挑、气质凶悍的女性，身着高科技战术装备。镜头动作：镜头1（锚定之吻）：达罗与维克特拉的中景镜头。当护卫舰开始剧烈螺旋机动以躲避防空炮火时，重力发生偏移。镜头开始旋转180度。达罗和维克特拉被迫抓住液压蒸汽管和磁轨以保持直立。旋转至半程时，维克特拉抓住达罗的胸甲将他拉近，献上一个坚定而绝望的吻。背景中可见塞弗罗用靴子抵住地板以防滑倒。镜头2（冲击与面罩）：极端特写镜头。飞船船体遭受巨大动能打击；剧烈震动使镜头摇晃。维克特拉后退一步，她的脸被闪烁的红色频闪灯照亮，用英式口音低语：“祝你好运。”她伸手将达罗沉重的金属头盔面罩猛地扣下，发出响亮的机械咔嗒声。就在面罩锁定的瞬间，又一次巨大冲击震动镜头，画面完成360度旋转，陷入彻底混乱。

en.p: Single continuous cinematic shot. Audio begins with daytime Shibuya street noise mixed with 8-bit video game sounds and chaotic Japanese chatter. Background music: shamisen strings. The camera pushes low along the ground. A girl’s leather shoe slams into frame — heavy first step. A Japanese schoolgirl in JK uniform sprints into frame at extreme speed, then suddenly slows on the second beat. She side-rolls and runs along a Shibuya crosswalk, shoulder nearly brushing the lens, skirt sweeping across frame. Obstacle ahead. She suddenly accelerates, steps onto a low wall — explosive jump. The camera lifts into the air with her. City lights streak below. She lands steadily, stabilizes with one hand, immediately rolls forward. The camera rotates half a turn with the roll, then quickly corrects. She sprints again. Full speed. Charges toward a railing. No hesitation. She leaps. The camera follows into weightlessness. Wind roars. Shamisen music briefly cuts midair. She lands on a lower platform. Knees absorb impact. Lowest point. Next beat — she snaps her head up and resumes sprinting into the crowd.

zh.p: 一镜到底的连续电影镜头。音频以白天涩谷的街道噪音开场，混合着8位电子游戏音效和嘈杂的日语交谈声。背景音乐是三味线的弦音。镜头紧贴地面向前推进。一只女式皮鞋猛然踏入画面——沉重的第一步。一名身着JK制服的女高中生以极速冲入画面，却在第二个节拍突然放慢。她侧身翻滚，沿着涩谷的人行横道奔跑，肩膀几乎擦过镜头，裙摆扫过画面。前方出现障碍。她骤然加速，踏上矮墙——爆发式起跳。镜头随她腾空而起。城市灯光在下方流泻。她稳稳落地，单手撑地稳住身形，随即向前翻滚。镜头随着翻滚旋转半圈，又迅速回正。她再次冲刺。全速前进。冲向栏杆。毫不犹豫。她纵身一跃。镜头跟随她进入失重状态。风声呼啸。三味线音乐在半空中短暂中断。她落在较低的平台上。膝盖缓冲冲击。降至最低点。下一个节拍——她猛然抬头，重新冲入人群。

en.p: Theme: Based on the user-provided photo of a New Year's Eve dinner, generate a 15-second cinematic documentary-style short film about food, referencing the style of "A Bite of China". The visuals should be in widescreen 16:9, 24fps, with cinematic color grading and fine grain, primarily using macro and close-up shots with shallow depth of field, realistic steam and oil sheen. The scene should be set in a northern Chinese family's New Year's Eve kitchen and dining table, featuring warm lighting, a wooden table, and white porcelain plates and bowls. Only the chef's hands and forearms are allowed (no faces), with realistic and restrained movements. The editing consists of 8 hard cuts, each lasting 1.5–2 seconds, ending with all three dishes and dumplings on the table. Shot 1: Based on the photo, hot oil sizzling with spices, fine bubbles and oil ripples on the surface, thin steam rising, clean highlights on the pot rim, with a clear "sizzling" sound. Shot 2: Braised pork belly being stir-fried in the wok to caramelize, clear details of the skin's gelatin, realistic oil sheen, and the sound of the spatula scraping lightly. Shot 3: Based on the photo, poached fish in chili oil, lifting the lid of the steamed fish, the flesh trembling slightly, aroma wafting, steam billowing. Shot 4: Sichuan peppercorns and dried chilies hitting the hot oil, clear fibers of the particles, restrained splattering, strong aromatic sensation. Shot 5: Before serving the poached fish, red chili oil is poured, forming ribbon-like flows, tiny oil droplets splashing at the impact point, layers of hot steam rising. Shot 6: Based on the photo, green vegetables being stir-fried in the wok, vibrant green and crisp-tender, thin layers of wok steam rising, clean and crisp stir-frying rhythm. Shot 7: Dumplings being taken out of the pot, clear layers of large and small bubbles in the boiling water, water droplets clinging to the dumpling skins, steam rushing out as the lid is lifted. Shot 8: Three dishes and dumplings placed on the table: a plate of braised pork belly with glossy red-brown color, a large bowl of poached fish with surging red oil, a plate of stir-fried greens in refreshing green, and a plate of plump, white dumplings; the camera slowly pushes in and holds for 0.5 seconds, steam rising in layers like breathing. Audio: Music has the highest priority, must generate documentary-style background music with the temperament of "A Bite of China": warm, restrained, with Chinese charm using strings/woodwinds/light percussion atmosphere; at the same time, clear and realistic cooking sound effects must be present (sizzling, bubbling, boiling, spatula sounds, steam from lifting lids), audio cannot be missing. Voiceover has high priority: add a low, restrained Chinese documentary-style voiceover (not advertising tone), using short sentences to describe "heat control, steam, reunion, and time", without mentioning brands, titles, or specific place names.
en.t: A Northern New Year's Eve Feast

zh.p:
主题：
根据用户提供的年夜饭照片，生成一段15秒电影级写实美食纪录片短片，风格参考《舌尖上的中国》，画面宽银幕16：9，24fps，电影级调色与细腻颗粒，微距与近景为主，浅景深，真实蒸汽与油光。

场景根据照片中的北方家庭年夜饭厨房与餐桌场景，包含暖色灯光、木质餐桌与白瓷盘碗。允许出现厨师的手与前臂（只拍手，不拍脸），动作真实克制。

剪辑为8个短镜头硬切，每镜头1.5–2秒，最后必须三菜一饺子齐上桌。

镜头1：根据照片中的热油爆香，油面细密气泡与油纹波动，薄蒸汽上升，锅沿高光干净，听到清晰“滋滋”声。

镜头2：红烧肉下锅翻炒上色，肉皮胶质细节清晰，油光真实，锅铲轻刮声。

镜头3：根据照片中的水煮鱼，蒸鱼开盖，鱼肉微微抖动，香气扑面而来，蒸汽翻涌。

镜头4：花椒与干辣椒入油瞬间，颗粒纤维清晰，飞溅克制，香气感强。

镜头5：水煮鱼出锅前红油淋下，形成丝带状流动，落点溅起微小油滴，热气翻层。

镜头6：根据照片中的青菜，青菜下锅煸炒，翠绿脆嫩，锅气蒸汽薄层上涌，翻炒节奏干净利落。

镜头7：饺子出锅，沸水大泡小泡层次清晰，饺子表面挂水珠，揭盖蒸汽扑面。

镜头8：三菜一饺子端上桌：红烧肉一盘油亮红棕，水煮鱼一大盘红油翻涌，清炒青菜一盘清爽翠绿，饺子一盘白润饱满；镜头微推定格0.5秒，蒸汽像呼吸一样翻层。

音频：
音乐权重最高，必须生成《舌尖上的中国》气质的纪录片配乐：温润克制、具有中国气韵的弦乐/木管/轻打击乐氛围；
同时必须有清晰真实的烹饪拟音（爆香滋滋、咕嘟收汁、沸腾、锅铲、揭盖蒸汽），音频不可缺失。

旁白VO权重高：加入低声克制的中文纪录片旁白（非广告腔），用简短句描述“火候、热气、团圆与时间”，不出现品牌、不出现片名、不出现具体地名。

en.p: **Visual Description:** This is a majestic and epic fantasy aerial shot, showcasing the grand visual of a barren land awakening from slumber. The main color palette consists of oppressive iron black, somber deep red, and eerie dark purple. The camera begins with an extreme high-angle overhead view, using dynamic movements to reveal the texture of the terrain—a canyon resembling dried-up blood vessels. The air is thick with heavy sand particles, and the lighting emphasizes extreme contrasts: purple lightning surging through the clouds like a dragon diving, instantly illuminating the barren black wasteland below. When the golden light at the center bursts forth...
en.t: Barren Land Awakens in Epic Fantasy

zh.p:
**视觉描述：**
这是一段气势磅礴的玄幻史诗航拍镜头，展现了荒芜之地从沉睡到觉醒的宏大视觉。画面主色调由压抑的玄铁黑、暗沉的深红与诡谲的冥紫色构成。镜头以极高空俯瞰视角切入，通过极具张力的运镜展现地表的纹理——那是一片如同干涸血脉般的裂谷。空气中弥漫着厚重的风沙颗粒，光影处理强调极端对比：云层中翻涌的紫色雷电如巨龙俯冲，瞬间照亮下方贫瘠的黑色荒原。当中心点的金色流光炸...

en.p: [Transformation] Fox A: Fiery red fur, cunning and agile, lying on a green stone in a bamboo grove. Transformation process: Enveloped in white light, red fur fades, body elongates, facial features feminize. Beauty B: Stunningly beautiful, plain white Hanfu, clear eyes, hair pinned with a jade hairpin, examining her hands with confusion. Scene: Moonlit bamboo grove, dappled moonlight, cobblestone ground, distant misty pavilions. Movement: Fox lying down -> White light -> Transformation -> Beauty stands up -> Confusedly looks at hands -> Gently strokes her hair. Camera: Starts with a close-up of the fox's eyes, gradually pulls back to circle around the beauty in the bamboo grove. Atmosphere: Mysterious, ethereal, fantastical, serene, elegant, dreamlike. Style: Ink wash painting + CG illustration, soft and gentle, freehand and flowing, hazy light and shadow, classical Eastern charm.

zh.p: [形变] 狐狸A：火红毛发，狡黠灵动，卧于青石竹林。形变过程：白色光芒笼罩，红毛褪去，身形修长，五官女性化。美女B：倾城容颜，素白汉服，清澈眼神，玉簪挽发，疑惑打量双手。场景：月夜竹林，斑驳月影，鹅卵石地，远处朦胧亭台。运动：狐狸卧 -> 白光 -> 形变 -> 美女起身 -> 疑惑看手 -> 轻拂秀发。镜头：特写狐狸眼始，渐远至环绕美女竹林。氛围：神秘唯美奇幻空灵静谧优雅梦幻。风格：水墨画+CG插画，淡雅柔和，写意飘逸，朦胧光影，古典东方韵味。

en.p: The background music rhythm perfectly matches the speed of skateboarding/skiing actions, with the background music volume lower than the live sound effects, without overpowering the skateboarding and skiing sounds. First-person perspective from a backward-leaning angle on a skateboard, ultra-wide-angle with strong perspective, slight camera shake to simulate the sensation of following the ride, one continuous shot without cuts, transitions, or breaks. The character's movements are standard and smooth, with no motion distortion, no unnecessary 360-degree spins, and normal human body structure. Spring: A 2D cosplay girl wearing light spring sportswear, entering a turn at low speed and quickly accelerating, performing an ollie while leaning into the turn, with tender green roadside plants and flowers, sparkling sea surface, and slight wheel trails. Spring to Summer: The girl performs a difficult ollie, with an instant slow-motion shot, the camera slowly circles around the character, her outfit naturally transitions into a summer short-sleeve top, and the scene smoothly shifts to lush summer greenery, with a gentle seasonal transition without abrupt changes. Summer: The 2D cosplay girl glides through high-speed S-turns, executing an inward 180 ollie with a toe-side flip, movements clean and standard, with strong motion blur and speed lines. Summer to Autumn: The girl performs a difficult aerial spin, with an instant slow-motion shot, the camera slowly circles around the character, her outfit naturally transitions into an autumn long-sleeve jacket, and the scene gradually changes to an autumn maple forest, with golden leaves drifting in the sky, a smooth transition without abrupt changes. Autumn: The 2D cosplay girl performs a brief high-speed glide sequence, with falling leaves swirling, the scene clean and smooth, movements standard without distortion. Autumn to Winter: The girl performs a difficult aerial maneuver, with an instant slow-motion shot, the camera slowly circles around the character, her outfit naturally transitions into a winter professional ski suit, the skateboard smoothly transforms into a snowboard, and the scene gradually changes to a snowy winter mountain landscape, with snow falling from the sky and the ground turning into a ski slope, no abrupt changes or distortion. Winter: The duration is significantly extended, with the 2D cosplay girl gliding smoothly and at high speed on the ski slope, executing continuous smooth turns, her posture stylish and relaxed, snow spray flying, the snow scene grand and open, with no unnecessary spins, no 360-degree turns, and no motion distortion; after gliding for a while, she finally performs a super cool and powerful skiing braking pose, lowering her center of gravity, with a stylish back view, the snowboard carving clear and stylish braking marks on the snow, ending perfectly with the snowy mountain landscape. Sound effects: Skateboard rolling, ollie, and friction sounds naturally transition into snowboard gliding and braking sounds on snow, with wind sounds changing with speed; the entire sequence is one continuous shot, with gentle and coherent seasonal transitions, stable movements without distortion, and no unnecessary spins. 2D art style, delicate facial features, high-definition quality, natural lighting and shadows, stable movements without breaking.

en.p: Style: Everyday vlog casual shooting style, iPhone original camera texture, slight motion blur in the footage, candid captures of everyday life, low-quality graininess, authentic and unpretentious, full of daily vibes. Duration: 15s Subject: An 18-year-old dance student beauty, with straight, smooth black hair naturally draped over her shoulders (a lazy just-woke-up feel), bangs at eyebrow level, a delicate and petite oval face, fair and moisturized skin, cool-toned fair complexion. Wearing a short sailor uniform with a pink collar and white elsewhere, showing her belly button, a pink pleated skirt, barefoot. A small pink cherry blossom hair clip pinned beside her ear. Her temperament is soft and sweet, full of girlish charm. Scene: A warm and cozy girl's bedroom, with plush bear and rabbit toys piled on the bed, the blanket slightly messy, a warm yellow desk lamp and a few manga books on the bedside table, sunlight streaming through white curtains, creating a lazy weekend morning atmosphere. [00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Lazy Awakening Visual: 45-degree side angle upper body close-up, soft and warm lighting. She just woke up and sits by the bed, hair a bit messy but cute. Action: She slowly stretches, then lowers her head to rub her eyes, lets out a small yawn, movements lazy and natural. Expression: Eyes half-open and half-closed, expression lazy with a hint of playfulness. [00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Lazy Playfulness Visual: The camera zooms in slightly, morning light falls on her side face, skin glowing white. Action: She lifts her head, one hand propped on the bed, the other naturally tidying her scattered bangs. Then she turns her face to look at the camera, the corners of her mouth slightly lifting. Expression: Eyes have a just-woke-up daze, but her smile is sweet and soft. [00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Good Morning Greeting Visual: Mumu turns to face the camera directly, holding a plush bear in her arms. Action: She rubs her face against the bear's head, then gently waves at the camera, lips moving slightly as she says, 'Baby, good morning.' Expression: Soft and sweet smile, eyes curving into crescent moons, cheeks slightly pink, the whole person like a just-awakened kitten. Visual Texture: iPhone original camera direct output feel, slight graininess, motion blur, casual candid angles, composition random but authentic.

zh.p:
风格：
日常Vlog随手拍风格，iPhone原相机质感，画面略带动态模糊，不经意间的生活感抓拍，低画质颗粒感，真实不做作，日常感十足。 

时长：15s

主体：
18岁舞蹈生美少女，笔直光滑的黑色长发自然披散在肩上（刚睡醒的慵懒感），齐眉刘海，精致小巧的鹅蛋脸，皮肤白皙水润，冷白皮。穿着衣领是粉红色，其余部位是白色的短款水手服，露着肚脐，粉红色的褶裙，赤着脚。耳侧别着粉色樱花小发夹。气质软糯甜美，少女感十足。 

场景：
温馨少女卧室，床上堆着毛绒小熊和兔子玩偶，被子有点凌乱，床头柜上有暖黄色台灯和几本漫画书，阳光透过白色窗帘洒进来，充满慵懒的周末早晨氛围。

 [00:00-00:05] 镜头1：
慵懒苏醒 
画面：45度侧角上半身特写，光线柔和温暖。她刚睡醒坐在床边，头发有点凌乱但很可爱。
动作：她缓缓伸了个懒腰，然后低头揉眼睛，打了个小哈欠，动作慵懒自然。 
表情：眼睛半睁半闭，表情慵懒又带点撒娇。

 [00:05-00:10] 镜头2：
慵懒撒娇 画面：镜头稍微拉近，晨光洒在她的侧脸上，皮肤白得发光。 
动作：她抬起头，一只手撑在床上，另一只手自然地整理散落的刘海。然后她侧过脸看镜头，嘴角微微上扬。 
表情：眼睛里有刚睡醒的迷糊感，但笑得很甜很软。

 [00:10-00:15] 镜头3：早安问候 
画面：沐沐转向镜头正前方，双手抱着怀里的毛绒小熊。 动作：她把脸贴在小熊头上蹭了蹭，然后对着镜头轻轻挥手，嘴唇微动着说"宝宝，早安"。 
表情：软糯的笑，眼睛弯成月牙，脸颊粉粉的，整个人像一只刚睡醒的小猫。 

画面质感：iPhone原相机直出感，轻微颗粒感，动态模糊，不经意的抓拍角度，构图随意但真实。

en.p: [Character] Girl with a pure and seductive style [Style] Ultra-realistic daily home life, cozy living room, soft indoor lighting, real and natural, cinematic quality, first-person boyfriend perspective [Scene] The girl is sitting on the sofa, watching TV and eating chips, while the boyfriend sits on the sofa watching her. [Actions and Dialogue in Strict Sequence, each line delivered after the previous one, no overlap, no disorder] 1. From the camera perspective, the guy says: I want to eat some chips too. 2. The girl smirks at the camera and says: Call me mommy, and I'll give you some. 3. From the camera perspective, the guy immediately says: Mommy. 4. The girl is instantly surprised, blushes with shyness, takes a chip from the bag, and says: Oh my, you actually called me that? Alright, alright, here you go, eat up. 5. From the camera perspective, the guy gently pushes her hand back and says: I want you to feed me yourself. 6. The girl blushes even more, bites half of the chip with her mouth, holds it between her lips, slowly leans closer to the camera, and speaks softly and indistinctly with the chip in her mouth: I really spoil you too much. [Requirements] Movements are smooth and natural, expressions are delicate and realistic, pace is slow, creating a cozy couple atmosphere, with stable and clear visuals.

en.p: /imagine Master Prompt: A captivating fusion of magical engineering and minimalist design, showcasing the effortless, silent birth of a complete Tesla ecosystem from a single, mysterious source. Core Scene: A minimalist Tesla-branded crate magically unfolds in a futuristic space, simultaneously revealing a Tesla Cybertruck and assembling a sleek showroom around it. Technical Specifications: - Format: Cinematic 16:9 - Quality: 4K, 24fps - Motion Intensity: Medium - Camera Stability: Locked Characters/Objects: - Object 1: A perfect matte white cubic crate, embossed with a delicate, glowing Tesla logo. Its seams pulse gently with a soft white internal light. - Object 2: A brand-new Tesla Cybertruck, featuring a brushed stainless steel exoskeleton, its sharp angles capturing the emerging light. The windows are dark and seamless. - Object 3: Minimalist showroom elements, including a white Tesla Wall Connector, polished concrete floor panels, and a sleek, understated faux leather bench. Environment and Setting: - Location: The scene begins in a vast, dark, empty void. This space transforms into a bright, minimalist Tesla showroom with seamless white walls and polished flooring. - Atmosphere: Starts mysterious and futuristic, then shifts to a feeling of awe, purity, and innovation. - Lighting: Initially, the only light source is the crate's glowing seams in the darkness. As it opens, clean, bright, diffused architectural lighting fades in from above, illuminating the entire space with high-end gallery-like clarity. Emotional Arc and Rhythm: - 0-2 seconds: Anticipation. The solitary crate pulses in the darkness from a fixed wide-angle shot. - 2-6 seconds: Revelation. The crate panels retract flawlessly. The Cybertruck is revealed as showroom elements rise and unfold with precise, swift elegance. A subtle zoom begins. - 6-8 seconds: Climax. Assembly completes, final bright lights activate, and the shot holds on the perfect, inviting, fully-formed showroom. Performance, Action, and Dialogue (Key): - Interaction: The crate's glowing seams intensify before the panels smoothly retract into the base and vanish without a trace. As the Cybertruck is unveiled, polished floor panels slide into place around it. The Tesla Wall Connector unit emerges seamlessly from the wall. The showroom bench self-assembles with silent precision. At the end, the Cybertruck's light bar flashes brightly once. - Micro-expressions: None. - Dialogue Timing and Delivery: None (no dialogue). Cinematography and Visual Style: - Shot Progression: A single continuous shot. - Camera Movement: The camera is in a locked wide-angle shot, but performs a very slow, almost imperceptible digital zoom on the Cybertruck between 2 and 7 seconds to enhance focus on the final centerpiece. - Visual Reference: The pure, futuristic product reveal aesthetic of Apple ads, combined with the architectural minimalism of Tadao Ando. - Focus and Depth of Field: Deep depth of field is maintained throughout, ensuring the car and all transforming showroom elements remain in sharp focus. Audio Mix Instructions (Key): - Music: Begins with a deep, low-frequency hum, building into a pure, uplifting electronic synth score that intensifies in sync with the showroom's assembly, ending on a resolved, atmospheric chord. - Dialogue Mix: None. - Sound Effects: - (0-2 seconds) Soft, pulsing electrical hum from the crate. - (2 seconds+) A series of clean servo motor whirs and soft magnetic clicks accompanying the crate's retraction. - (3-7 seconds) A symphony of subtle, synchronized 'whoosh' sounds and precise assembly clicks. No heavy or jarring noises. - (7.5 seconds) A final, satisfying soft 'thump' as everything locks into place, followed by a crisp electrical activation sound as the Cybertruck's light bar flashes. - Audio-Visual Sync: All mechanical and assembly sounds must be perfectly synchronized with their corresponding visual actions. Quality Control Tags: - Positive: Photorealistic CGI, clean design, minimalist aesthetic, sharp focus, smooth animation, high-tech, seamless transitions, glow effects, architectural visualization - Negative: No text, no people, no camera reflections, no dust or scratches, avoid organic textures, no awkward movements, no background distractions /duration 8 seconds

总指令：一场魔法工程与极简设计的迷人融合，从一个单一、神秘的源头，展示一个完整的特斯拉生态系统的毫不费力的、寂静的诞生。

核心场景：一个极简主义的特斯拉品牌板条箱在一个未来空间中神奇地展开，同时揭示出一辆特斯拉Cybertruck，并在其周围组装出一个时尚的陈列室。

技术规格：
- 格式：电影感16:9
- 质量：4K, 24fps
- 运动强度：中
- 相机稳定性：锁定

角色/对象：
- 对象1：一个完美的哑光白色立方体板条箱，印有精致、发光的特斯拉标志。其接缝随着柔和的白色内部光线轻轻脉动。
- 对象2：一辆崭新的特斯拉Cybertruck，拥有拉丝不锈钢外骨骼，其锐利的角度捕捉着初现的光线。车窗是深色且浑然一体的。
- 对象3：极简主义的陈列室元素，包括一个白色的特斯拉壁挂式充电器、抛光混凝土地板面板，以及一张时尚、低调的人造革长凳。

环境与布景：
- 地点：场景始于一个广阔、黑暗、空无一物的虚空。这个空间转变为一个明亮、极简的特斯拉陈列室，拥有无缝的白色墙壁和抛光的地面。
- 氛围：开始时神秘且充满未来感，然后转变为令人敬畏、纯净和创新的感觉。
- 光线：最初，唯一的光源是黑暗中板条箱发光的接缝。当它打开时，干净、明亮、漫射的建筑照明从上方渐入，以高端画廊般的环境清晰度照亮整个空间。

情绪曲线与节奏：
- 0-2秒：期待。孤独的板条箱在黑暗中从固定的广角镜头中脉动。
- 2-6秒：揭示。板条箱面板完美无瑕地收回。Cybertruck被揭示出来，同时陈列室的元素以精确、快速而优雅的方式升起和展开。一个微妙的变焦开始。
- 6-8秒：高潮。组装完成，最终的明亮灯光激活，镜头定格在完美、诱人、完全成形的陈列室上。

表演、动作与对话 (关键)：
- 互动：板条箱发光的接缝在面板平滑地缩回底座并消失得无影无踪之前增强了亮度。随着Cybertruck的亮相，抛光的地面面板在它周围滑入到位。特斯拉壁挂式充电器单元从墙壁中无缝出现。陈列室长凳以寂静的精确度自我组装。在最后，Cybertruck的前灯条会明亮地闪烁一次。
- 微表情：无。
- 对话时机与表达：无（没有对话）。

摄影与视觉风格：
- 镜头进程：一个单一的连续镜头。
- 摄像机运动：摄像机处于锁定的广角拍摄状态，但在2秒到7秒之间对Cybertruck进行非常缓慢、几乎无法察觉的数字变焦，以增强对最终核心展品的关注。
- 视觉参考：苹果广告的纯净、未来感的产品揭示美学，结合安藤忠雄的建筑极简主义。
- 焦点与景深：全程保持大景深，确保汽车和所有变换中的陈列室元素都保持锐利对焦。

音频混合指令 (关键)：
- 音乐：开头是深沉的低频嗡嗡声，随后构建成一段纯净、振奋的电子合成器配乐，该配乐与陈列室的组装同步增强，最终以一个解析、氛围感的和弦收尾。
- 对话混音：无。
- 音效：
  - (0-2秒) 板条箱发出柔和、脉动的电嗡嗡声。
  - (2秒+) 一系列干净的伺服电机旋转声和柔和的磁性咔嗒声，伴随板条箱收回。
  - (3-7秒) 一曲由微妙、同步的“嗖”声和精确的组装声组成的交响乐。没有笨重或刺耳的噪音。
  - (7.5秒) 当一切锁定到位时，发出最后一声令人满意的柔和“砰”声，随后是Cybertruck灯条闪烁时清脆的电气激活声。
- 音画同步：所有机械和组装声音必须与其相应的视觉动作完美同步。

质量控制标签：
- 正面：写实感CGI、纯净设计、极简主义美学、锐利对焦、流畅动画、高科技、无缝过渡、发光效果、建筑可视化
- 负面：无文字、无人物、无摄像机反射、无灰尘或划痕、避免有机纹理、无笨拙运动、无背景干扰

/duration 8秒

en.p: Shot 1: Opening with Intense Battle · Weapon Clash. Foggy Mountain Five Elements orthodox Chinese comic style, sharp hard-edged ink wash lines, high-contrast red-black color palette. The opening has no buildup; two warriors clash head-on with their weapons, swords/spears colliding fiercely, sparks and ink-colored shockwaves erupting simultaneously. The action is swift and ruthless, with equal power, evenly matched, each with their own strengths. Camera movement: low-angle high-speed tracking, slight camera shake, close-up strikes, same rhythmic camera movement as Foggy Mountain Five Elements. Shot 2: High-Speed Offense and Defense · Exchange of Moves. Foggy Mountain Five Elements-style ultra-smooth combat, with afterimages and overlapping figures of the two, weapons crossing in slashes, blocks, and counterattacks, each move lethal. One is fierce and explosive, the other agile and swift, completely different styles but equal in strength. Ink flows, speed lines, and motion blur are maximized, with explosive impact. Camera movement: orbiting rotation, quick cuts, smooth focus pulling, strong light-shadow contrast. Shot 3: Weapon Combos · Close-Range Combat. Both abandon distance for close-quarters weapon combat, unleashing combos of chops, slashes, thrusts, lifts, and smashes. Upon impact, shockwaves burst forth, the ground cracks, and dust flies. Their offensive and defensive rhythms are perfectly balanced, neither overpowering the other, maximizing combat tension. Camera movement: slow-motion close-up of impact moments, ultra-wide-angle lens, camera shake feedback. Shot 4: Ultimate Move Clash · Equal Aura. Both unleash their full power simultaneously, their weapons infused with ink-colored aura/flame light, charging head-on in a full-force clash. The energy shockwave explodes, shaking heaven and earth. The style is wild, the atmosphere epic, with both sides' auras completely equal, each with their own strengths, maximizing oppressive tension. Camera movement: epic low-angle panoramic view, backlit silhouettes, cinematic deep depth of field composition. Shot 5: Stalemate Freeze · Evenly Matched. The battle abruptly stops, weapons locked, the two stand facing each other, aura surging, dust swirling. Their eyes are cold, evenly matched, the outcome undecided, with a strong sense of blank space. Camera movement: medium shot slow push freeze, Foggy Mountain Five Elements premium animation texture. Global Universal Intensifiers (to be added to each segment): Foggy Mountain Five Elements animation-level art style, extremely sharp lines, intense weapon combat, bone-crushing impact, super strong sense of impact, evenly matched, each with their own strengths, high-burning combat.

zh.p:
镜头1：开场即激战·武器对撞 雾山五行正统国漫画风，锐利硬边水墨线条，高对比红黑色调。 开场无铺垫，两名侠客持武器正面硬撼，刀剑/长兵激烈碰撞，火花与墨色气浪同时爆发。 动作迅猛狠辣，力量感均等，势均力敌，各有千秋。 运镜：低角度高速跟拍，镜头微震，打击特写，雾山五行同款节奏运镜。 

镜头2：高速攻防·招式互换 雾山五行式极致流畅打斗，两人残影叠影，武器交错斩击、格挡、反击，招招致命。一人刚猛爆裂，一人灵动迅捷，风格完全不同却实力相当。墨气流、速度线、动态模糊拉满，打击感炸裂。 
运镜：环绕旋转运镜，快速切镜，丝滑跟焦，强光影对比。 

镜头3：武器连击·近身搏杀 双方放弃距离，贴身武器搏杀，劈、砍、刺、挑、砸连招爆发，击中瞬间爆发冲击波，地面崩裂、烟尘飞溅。两人攻防节奏完美制衡，谁也不压谁，打斗张力拉满。 运镜：慢动作特写打击瞬间，超广角镜头，镜头震动反馈。 

镜头4：大招对轰·气场平分秋色 两人同时爆发全力，武器灌注墨色罡气/焰光，正面全力对轰，能量冲击波炸开，天地震动。画风狂放，气势史诗，双方气场完全对等，各有千秋，压迫感拉满。 运镜：史诗级仰视全景，逆光剪影，电影级大景深构图。 

镜头5：僵持定格·势均力敌 战斗骤停，武器相抵，两人对峙而立，气息激荡，烟尘弥漫。眼神冷峻，势均力敌，胜负未分，留白感极强。 运镜：中景慢推定格，雾山五行高级动画质感。 全局通用强化词（每段必加） 雾山五行动画级别画风，极致凌厉线条，武器激烈打斗，拳拳到肉，打击感超强，势均力敌，各有千秋，高燃打斗。

en.p: Stop-motion clay animation, handcrafted tactile materials, real fabric, warm afternoon park lighting. Wide shot: a clay figure with a matchbox head and a clay figure with a lit candle head sit together on a real tiny park bench, mid-conversation — candle flame flickering gently, matchbox drawer slightly open, easy and close. [cut] A distant rumble. Both heads turn. [cut] Close-up — a clay figure with a fire extinguisher head rolls in on a real tiny motorcycle, pressure gauge redlined, nozzle tilted back, one hand loose on the handlebar. He stops. Says nothing. [cut] Close-up of the candle head — the flame doubles in size instantly. The wax drips straight down. [cut] Wide shot — the candle stands up. Smooths her skirt. Gets on the back of the motorcycle without looking back. The motorcycle pulls away. [cut] Close-up of the matchbox head — alone on the bench. The little drawer slides open. Then slowly, all the matches fall out one by one onto the ground.

en.p: Technical Specifications: 2.35:1 ultra-wide screen, cinematic native quality, 4K medical CGI details, differentiated modeling, 24fps. 0-3 seconds: Start with the first frame of [@Image 1]. A close-up extreme shot of a cloaked man, his expression stern, shouting loudly in English through his mask: "All units, move out! Fire at will!" He holds a rifle level, the muzzle spewing highly grainy blue-white flames, shell casings flying. Note the realistic recoil of the stock against the shoulder, and the visible refractive distortion of the air above the barrel due to the intense heat from continuous firing. 3-7 seconds: The camera quickly pulls back to the side and rear. The view spreads along the diagonal path of vehicle A in [@Image 1], but no longer in neat formation. Heavy clusters of varying heights and completely different models suddenly emerge from the thick smoke: some vehicles are eight-wheeled infantry fighting vehicles, some have large radar parabolic dishes, and some are low-profile tracked tanks. All vehicles advance in an uneven, scattered tactical formation, with significant differences in mud distribution and armor coating on each vehicle. 7-12 seconds: A quick cut to a close-up of a heavy armored vehicle. A soldier forcefully pushes open the heavy metal hatch with one hand, causing a slight rebound tremor due to its weight. The soldier swiftly crouches inside to operate a heavy machine gun, his eyes alertly scanning the surroundings. To the side and rear, a missile vehicle points diagonally skyward. The missile ignites, producing massive white smoke and red light, instantly blasting the snow around the vehicle. When the tank's main gun fires, the black smoke and fire from the muzzle brake have a highly realistic texture. 12-15 seconds: A wide overhead view. This is a chaotic yet orderly steel torrent, with hundreds of advanced vehicles of various shapes leaving track marks of differing depths and widths on the snowy plain. The vehicles sway realistically as they traverse the uneven snow-covered ground, with varying exhaust concentrations and black smoke from their tails. The scene is filled with low-frequency engine rumbles and distant, continuous explosion flashes, creating a genuine sense of battlefield pressure. Sound Effects: Real and resonant English commands, heavy tank cannon roars, the hiss of missile ignition, the crunch of tracks crushing hard ice, accompanied by epic war drum music. Prohibited: Watermarks, subtitles, neat formations, repeated models.

zh.p: 技术规格：2.35:1超宽幕，电影级原生画质，4K医学CGI细节，差异化建模，24fps。 0-3秒：以【@图片1】首帧。镜头大特写斗篷男子，他神情冷峻，隔着面罩大声用英文咆哮道：“All units, move out! Fire at will!”。他平举步枪，枪口喷射出极具颗粒感的蓝白色火舌，弹壳飞溅。注意枪托抵肩的真实震动，枪管上方因连续开火产生的高温热浪导致空气产生肉眼可见的折射畸变。 3-7秒：镜头快速向侧后方拉远。视角沿着【@图片1】甲车的斜向路径扩散，但不再是整齐阵列。浓烟中猛然显现出高低错落、型号完全不同的重型集群：有的载具是八轮驱动的步战车，有的载具带有巨大的雷达抛物面，有的载具是低矮的履带式坦克。所有车辆以不等距 的、散布式的战术姿态交错前进，每辆车的泥垢分布和装甲涂层均有显著差异。 7-12秒：特写快速切至一辆厚重的重型装甲车，士兵单手猛力推开沉重的金属舱门，舱门由于重量产生轻微的回弹颤动，士兵动作敏捷 地半蹲在舱内操作重机枪，眼神警惕地环视。侧后方一辆导弹车正斜向指天，导弹点火瞬间产生巨大的白色浓烟和红光，将载具周边的积雪瞬间震飞，坦克主炮开火时，炮口制退器喷出的黑烟与火光极具真实质感。 12-15秒：大远景俯瞰。这是一场混乱而有序的钢铁洪流，上百辆外形各异的先进载具在雪原上划出深浅不一、宽窄不同的履带压痕。车辆行驶在起伏不平的雪地上产生真实的颠簸晃动，车尾喷出的尾气浓度和黑烟各有不同。画面伴随低频的引擎重低音和远方不间断的爆炸闪光，充满了真实的战场压迫感。 音效：真实洪亮的英文口令，沉重的坦克炮轰鸣，导弹点火的嘶吼声，履带碾压坚冰的碎裂声，配合史诗感的战鼓配乐。 禁止：水印，字幕，整齐的方阵，重复的模型。

en.p: Aspect ratio '16:9' Guangzhou city portrait, featuring ancient Xiguan mansions, exquisite Cantonese dim sum, and the towering Canton Tower (Little Waist), with rich and saturated colors. [Action]: The camera slowly pushes through the steam rising from a tea house, instantly match-cutting to the dazzling lights of Zhujiang New Town; a lion dance leaps lightly through an ancient street, with smooth and natural movements, not stiff. [Scene]: The Chen Clan Ancestral Hall under the morning light, with delicate wood carving textures, and the Tyndall effect penetrating the Manchu windows;

en.p:
Cinematic sequence, 15 seconds, dark fantasy video game.

[0:00–0:03] Wide shot of the stone golem with his red knitted scarf and glowing orange chest orb walking slowly toward a tranquil lake surrounded by ancient weeping willows, their long branches gently swaying and touching the water's surface, soft golden light filtering through the canopy.

[0:03–0:05] The golem sits down heavily at the edge of the lake, his reflection visible in the still water alongside the glow of his chest orb, a moment of stillness.

[0:05–0:08] Frontal shot facing the golem. Suddenly, the water begins to shimmer and ripple with ethereal light. A fairy emerges from the lake — a delicate, luminous, translucent figure made of soft white and pale blue light, with flowing features that dissolve into particles at the edges, small glowing sparks orbiting around her. She floats gracefully toward the golem, hovering just above the water. She leans close to him and whispers. Faint glowing text appears on screen: "Humanity awaits you. Only you can save them."

[0:08–0:10] Cut to close-up of the golem's face — his black eyes widen, his head tilts back in a clear expression of shock and surprise. The orb in his chest flares brightly, pulsing with intense golden light.

[0:10–0:12] The fairy dissolves into particles that scatter upward into the air and disappear. The golem stares at the empty space for a brief moment.

[0:12–0:15] The golem stands up abruptly, his heavy stone body rising with sudden urgency. He turns and begins running away from the lake with determined thundering steps, his red scarf trailing and bouncing behind him. Cut to black.

Atmospheric lighting with cool blue-greens around the lake transitioning to warm gold when the fairy appears, cinematic depth of field, volumetric light through willow branches.

Sound design only, no music: heavy stone footsteps on soft earth approaching the lake, water lapping gently at the shore, a heavy stone thud when he sits, willow branches rustling, water shimmering and chiming when the fairy emerges, a soft ethereal whisper voice delivering the message, silence on the close-up of the golem's surprised face, a bright resonant pulse from the orb flaring, fairy dissolving with

zh.p: 电影级镜头序列，时长15秒，暗黑奇幻风格电子游戏。[0:00–0:03] 广角镜头：石巨魔缓缓走向一片宁静湖泊，颈间系着红色针织围巾，胸口橙色宝珠散发微光。湖畔环绕着古老垂柳，修长枝条轻拂水面，柔和的日光透过树冠洒落。[0:03–0:05] 巨魔在湖边沉重坐下，静止水面倒映出他的身影与胸口宝珠的光芒，时间仿佛凝固。[0:05–0:08] 正面特写巨魔。突然，水面泛起幽光涟漪，一位精灵从湖中升起——她由柔白与淡蓝光芒凝结而成，身形纤巧通透，边缘化作流动光粒，周身环绕细碎星火。她优雅飘向巨魔，悬停于水面之上，俯身低语。屏幕浮现微弱发光文字：“人类在等待你。唯有你能拯救他们。”[0:08–0:10] 切至巨魔面部特写——黑色瞳孔骤然扩张，头颅后仰，震惊之色清晰可辨。胸口宝珠猛然迸发炽烈金光。[0:10–0:12] 精灵化作光粒向上飘散，消逝于空中。巨魔凝视虚空片刻。[0:12–0:15] 巨魔猛然起身，沉重石躯迸发急促力量。他转身踏出决绝步伐，红色围巾在身后翻飞飘扬。画面渐黑。氛围光影：湖畔冷蓝绿调在精灵现身时转为暖金，电影级景深效果，柳枝间透出体积光。仅保留环境音效，无配乐：巨魔踏过松软泥土的沉重脚步声，湖水轻拍岸边的呢喃，落座时石体沉闷的撞击声，柳枝沙沙作响，精灵浮现时水面闪烁的叮咚声，传递讯息时缥缈空灵的耳语，巨魔惊愕面部的静默，宝珠迸发的明亮脉冲声，精灵消散时...

en.p:
Stormy night ocean, massive waves under lightning flashes. The sea churns violently as a colossal feline titan rises from the depths, water cascading off its fur in slow motion. Low-angle cinematic shot, glowing eyes piercing rain and fog. Navy warships surround it, firing missiles and cannons, explosions lighting the clouds. The giant cat roars, shockwaves rippling across the water. It swipes a destroyer aside, metal bending, sparks flying.

Its dorsal fur begins glowing electric blue, energy pulsing from tail to head. Close-up as bright blue light builds inside its mouth. The storm falls silent. Suddenly, a concentrated blue energy beam blasts forward, cutting across the fleet. Ships erupt in fireballs, steam rising as ocean water vaporizes. Wide aerial shot of destruction glowing blue across dark waves. Hyper-realistic, volumetric fog, cinematic lighting, IMAX scale, dramatic orchestral mood, 4K detail.

zh.p: 暴风雨之夜的海面，闪电划破天际，巨浪翻涌。一头巨大的猫形泰坦从深海缓缓升起，水珠从它的毛发上慢动作滑落。低角度电影镜头中，它发光的双眼穿透雨雾。海军战舰将其包围，导弹与炮火齐发，爆炸照亮云层。巨猫发出咆哮，冲击波在水面扩散开来。它一爪拍开驱逐舰，金属扭曲，火花四溅。背脊的毛发开始闪烁电光蓝，能量从尾部涌向头部。特写镜头中，它的口中凝聚起明亮的蓝光。风暴骤然寂静。一道集中的蓝色能量光束猛然射出，横扫整个舰队。战舰化作火球，海水蒸发升腾。广角航拍视角下，毁灭性的蓝光在暗色波涛间闪烁。超写实风格，体积雾特效，电影级光影，IMAX画幅，戏剧性管弦配乐，4K细节。

en.p: A girl, without makeup, is playing with a flute in the living room. She picks up the flute and spins it in her hand like Sun Wukong holding his golden cudgel, accidentally tossing it into the air during the spin. As she catches it, the girl makes a costume change at the beat: the style is a portrait photo, with a realistic aesthetic, textured lighting, natural light, and a highly textured photographic style. It is accented with gold and silver. The main subject of the frame is a close-up of a head with fluffy, silky, glossy hair, as she plays a bamboo flute. The girl's clothing is made of materials like sequined tulle, sequined velvet, and organza, featuring exquisite lace, tassels, embroidery, and prints, with complex, cascading folds, paired with lavish accessories and traditional dark-patterned clothing. The background is dark, complemented by brocade cloud-patterned curtains, surrounded by a sea of layered flowers. The composition is dynamic, freezing a moment in time, with a shallow depth of field making the subject more vibrant, light spots dotting the dark areas, and moon white as the main color scheme. It requires the use of popular internet music, slow motion at the beat, and both costume changes are of the same girl.

zh.p:
一个女孩，素颜，在客厅把弄着一个笛子，她把笛子拿起来，像孙悟空拿着金箍棒那样放在手上旋转着，旋转时不经意间把它丢上半空。

在一接往时，女孩卡点变装:风格为写真,写真风，质感光照，自然光线，质感十足，摄影风格。

还点缀着金色和银色。画面的主体是一位蓬松长发、头发如绸缎般有光泽的头部特写，她正吹奏着竹笛。

少女的衣服由亮片纱、亮片丝绒、欧根纱等材质构成，有着精美的花边、流苏、刺绣、印花，有着繁复垂坠的褶皱，搭配着华丽丰富的饰品和传统衣服暗纹。

背景为深色系，搭配着提花云锦帷幔，周围环绕着重瓣花海，采用动感的构图，定格时间凝固的瞬间，浅景深使主题更加鲜艳，光斑点缀在暗面区域，以月亮白色为主要的配色。

要求使用网络流行音乐，卡点时使用慢动作，两个变装是一个女孩。

The camera slowly pushes in from the doorway, and suddenly the coffin lid bursts open with a 'bang'! A Qing Dynasty zombie jumps straight up— face dark and green, fangs protruding, nails like knives, tattered official robes, arms extended straight forward, hopping forward one jump at a time.

en.p: 15 seconds, vertical 9:16, overcast diffused natural light + the damp texture of rain soaking everything, occasional raindrops splashing on the phone lens causing partial blur, under the arcade of a Taipei street, the protagonist is a Taiwanese girl [Image 1], her long hair wet and plastered to her cheeks and neck, a white thin shirt slightly see-through when wet. The entire scene is a selfie POV held by the girl with one hand, the lens gently shaking with wrist movements. 0-5 seconds: The handheld lens shakes violently, with raindrops splashing on the lens causing blurred water droplets in the first few frames; the girl holds the phone up to herself with one hand while pulling someone to run with the other, the lens bouncing with the running motion; after running into the arcade, she leans against a pillar, panting heavily, wet hair sticking to her forehead, casually brushing aside strands that immediately fall back; dialogue (panting and laughing): 'Haha, I'm dying from running! I told you it would rain and you didn't believe me! Look, look, I'm completely soaked!' 5-9 seconds: She slowly slides down the pillar, the phone lowering with her, the background showing the heavy rain forming a curtain outside the arcade and blurred car light spots, she looks down at her wet shirt, wrinkles her nose, then looks up at the lens with a helpless yet amused expression; dialogue (playfully complaining): 'I look super ugly like this, don't film me! ...Hey, but don't you think this rain is kind of romantic?' 9-12 seconds: She pulls a crumpled tissue pack from her pocket, takes one to wipe her cheek, then takes another and reaches it toward the lens—her eyes signaling, a slight smile curling at the corner of her mouth; [rain sounds + street ambient noise, no dialogue] 12-15 seconds: She slowly brings the phone closer, her face gradually filling the frame, her nose almost touching the lens, the lens slightly out of focus then refocusing; dialogue (suddenly gentle): 'Next time remember to bring an umbrella, dummy... But getting caught in the rain with you is not so bad.' No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks allowed.

zh.p:
15秒，竖屏9:16，阴天漫射自然光+雨水打湿一切的潮湿质感， 手机镜头上偶尔溅到雨滴造成局部模糊，台北街头骑楼下， 主角台湾女生【图片1】，长发被雨打湿贴在脸颊和脖子上，白色薄衬衫微微透湿。 全程女生单手持机自拍POV，镜头随手腕轻微晃动。 
0-5秒：镜头Handheld剧烈晃动，画面前几帧有雨水溅到镜头造成模糊水珠； 女生一只手举机对着自己，另一只手拉着某人奔跑，镜头随奔跑颠簸晃动； 跑进骑楼后她靠上柱子大口喘气，湿发贴着额头， 随手撩起发丝马上又滑落； 台词（喘着气又笑）："哈哈哈跑死我了！跟你说会下雨你不信！你看你看全湿了啦！" 
5-9秒：她靠着柱子缓缓滑坐下去，手机跟着降低， 背景是骑楼外倾盆大雨形成的雨帘和模糊车灯光斑， 她低头看湿透的衬衫皱了一下鼻子，抬头对镜头露出无奈又好笑的表情； 台词（无奈撒娇）："我这个样子超丑你不要拍！……欸但你有没有觉得这雨还蛮浪漫的？" 
9-12秒：她从口袋摸出一包揉皱的纸巾，抽一张擦了擦自己的脸颊， 再抽一张朝镜头方向递去——眼神示意，嘴角微微上扬； [雨声+街道环境音，无台词] 
12-15秒：她慢慢把手机凑近，脸逐渐占满画面，鼻尖几乎贴到镜头， 镜头轻微虚焦再拉回清晰； 台词（突然温柔）："下次记得带伞啦笨蛋……不过跟你在一起淋雨也还好啦。" 
禁止出现文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

en.p:
Primordial Chaos Opens * Scene: A pure black background with no elements, only extremely faint ink-colored mist slowly swirling at the center of the frame, as if the universe is still undivided in its primordial state. * Camera Movement: Fixed position, with a slight breathing motion to create a tense, oppressive atmosphere. * Sound Effects: Low drumbeats and string tremolos, gradually increasing in frequency. * Visual Effects: Ink mist particles spread outward from the center, with edges displaying a semi-transparent texture resembling ink wash painting; particle density increases over time. 

Brushstroke Falls Like a Startling Swan * Scene: A white ink stroke like lightning breaks through from the top of the frame, with a sharp, knife-like brush tip and dynamic blur that tears through the air, abruptly stopping at the center to form the initial stroke of the character "李." * Camera Movement: The camera follows the ink stroke in a rapid dive, trembling slightly at the moment the brush tip pauses to enhance the impact. * Visual Effects: Golden particle fragments burst from the edges of the ink stroke, scattering like stardust in all directions; the ink contains flowing golden light patterns within, with a brief glow explosion at the brush tip. * Sound Effects: Metallic tearing sound + heavy drumbeat, accompanied by sharp wind sounds as the ink stroke passes. 

Reverse Stroke Creates Momentum * Scene: From the ending point of the character "李," a winding ink ribbon extends downward like a spiritual serpent, the brush momentum transitioning from rigid to soft. It suddenly reverses at the bottom of the frame, starting with a reverse brush tip to outline the contour of the character "岳." At the turning points, the ink ribbon bursts into ink particles, forming fragmented ripples. * Camera Movement: The camera slowly rotates around the ink ribbon, capturing its flow trajectory from an oblique top angle, then rapidly advancing at the start of the character "岳" to focus on the power of the brush tip. * Visual Effects: Golden light flows within the ink ribbon; particle density doubles at turning points, creating a fusion of ink and metallic textures, with semi-transparent glow at the edges. * Sound Effects: Rapid string turns + drumbeat accents, accompanied by a low dragon roar as the ink ribbon reverses. * Particle System: Ink particles (density: 0.8, size: 2-8px, lifespan: 1.2s, diffusion speed: 15px/s), golden light patterns (flow speed: 0.5s/circle, glow intensity: 0.6). * Lighting: Main light is a golden beam from the top (intensity: 0.9, color temperature: 3200K, beam width: 15%), auxiliary light is a cool-colored fill from the side (intensity: 0.3, color temperature: 6500K). * Materials: Ink characters are matte white with metallic edges (roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.7); seal is matte red with flame edges (roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.4). * Post-Processing: Contrast +20%, sharpening +15%, vignette intensity: 0.2, color grading: shadows lean toward cool blue, highlights lean toward warm gold.

zh.p:
混沌初开
 * 画面： 纯黑背景，无任何元素，只有极淡的墨色雾气在画面中心缓慢涌动，仿佛宇宙鸿蒙未判。
 * 运镜： 固定机位，镜头微微呼吸，营造压抑的张力。
 * 音效： 低沉的鼓点与丝弦颤音，频率逐渐加快。
 * 特效： 墨雾粒子从中心向外扩散，边缘呈现水墨晕染的半透明质感，粒子密度随时间递增。

笔落惊鸿
 * 画面： 一道如闪电般的白色墨痕从画面顶部破空而下，笔锋锐利如刀，带着撕裂空气的动态模糊，在画面中央骤然停顿，形成“李”字的起笔。
 * 运镜： 镜头跟随墨痕快速俯冲，在笔锋停顿瞬间轻微震颤，强化冲击力。
 * 特效： 墨痕边缘迸发出金色粒子碎屑，如星屑般向四周溅射，墨色内部蕴含流动的金色光纹，笔锋处有短暂的辉光爆发。
 * 音效： 金属撕裂声 + 重鼓点，伴随墨痕划过的尖锐风声。

逆笔成势
 * 画面： “李”字的收笔处延伸出一道蜿蜒的墨带，如灵蛇般向下盘绕，笔势由刚转柔，在画面下方骤然反转，以逆锋起笔，勾勒出“岳”字的轮廓。墨带在转折处迸发出水墨粒子，形成破碎的涟漪。
 * 运镜： 镜头环绕墨带缓慢旋转，从侧上方捕捉墨带的流动轨迹，在“岳”字起笔时快速推进，聚焦笔锋的力量感。
 * 特效： 墨带内部有金色光流涌动，转折处粒子密度倍增，形成水墨与金属质感的融合，边缘呈现半透明的辉光。
 * 音效： 丝弦急转 + 鼓点重音，墨带反转时伴随低沉的龙吟声。

 * 粒子系统： 水墨粒子（密度：0.8，大小：2-8px，寿命：1.2s，扩散速度：15px/s），金色光纹（流动速度：0.5s/圈，辉光强度：0.6）
 * 光影： 主光源为顶部金色光束（强度：0.9，色温：3200K，光束宽度：15%），辅助光为侧方冷色补光（强度：0.3，色温：6500K）
 * 材质： 墨字为哑光白 + 金属边缘（粗糙度：0.3，金属度：0.7），印章为哑光红 + 火焰边缘（粗糙度：0.5，金属度：0.4）
 * 后处理： 对比度 +20%，锐化 +15%，暗角强度：0.2，色彩分级：暗部偏冷蓝，亮部偏暖金。

en.p: The goal is to create a font animation for the four characters '哥飞出海'. At the dawn of chaos, sword intent lurks beneath the surface, with the scene starting from absolute pitch black, devoid of any light source. As deep string music and metallic tremors resonate, an extremely faint blue-white particle stream begins to emerge at the center of the screen, slowly converging like an undercurrent in the deep sea, forming a faint vertical band of light. The edges of this light band are accompanied by fine ink splash effects, and the particle density gradually increases, creating a sense of oppression akin to 'a storm brewing'. The sword momentum breaks the situation, and the brush intent first appears as the particle stream suddenly accelerates, erupting from the vertical light band into a sharp white light that cuts through the screen, like a sword blade tearing through the air, instantly ripping apart the darkness. Where the white light of the characters passes, the text rapidly takes shape in a splash-ink style, with the edges of the strokes featuring sharp, jagged light effects. The ink color transitions from deep black to cyan-blue, and within the strokes, fine reflective particles of sword blades flow, presenting an overall dynamic tension of 'a sword blade splitting a mountain'.
en.t: Sword Splits Dark Ink Font Animation

zh.p:
目标是给“哥飞出海”四个字做字体动画。
混沌初开，剑意潜涌，画面从绝对纯黑开始，无任何光源。随着低沉的弦乐与金属颤音响起，画面中心开始浮现极淡的青白色粒子流，如深海暗流般缓慢汇聚，形成 一道若有若无的竖形光带，光带边缘伴随细碎的墨色飞溅特效， 粒子密度逐渐提升，营造出“山雨欲来”的压迫感。剑势破局，笔意初现粒子流突然加速， 从竖形光带中爆发出一道贯穿画面的凌厉白光，如剑刃破空，瞬间撕裂黑暗。字的白光所过之处，文字以水墨泼洒的方式快速成型，笔画边缘带有锋利的锯齿状光效， 墨色由深黑渐变为青蓝，笔画内部流动着细碎的剑刃反光粒子，整体呈现出“剑刃劈山” 的动态张力。

en.p: A lone woman stands on the roof of a brutalist concrete building at sunrise, wind pulling her coat backward as the city stretches endlessly below in soft golden haze, distant traffic glowing like veins of light. The camera begins in an extreme wide aerial shot, then slowly descends in a smooth spiraling orbit around her, tightening into a close profile as her eyes close and she breathes in. Dust particles float in the sunlight, lens flare streaks across the frame, subtle handheld vibration adds human fragility. Cinematic natural light, soft atmospheric diffusion, 35mm film texture, shallow depth of field, poetic realism. Avoid cartoon colors, avoid digital sharpness, avoid artificial CGI look.

zh.p: 日出时分，一名孤身女子伫立于粗野主义混凝土建筑的屋顶，风将她的外套向后吹拂，脚下城市在柔和的金色薄雾中无尽延伸，远处车流如光之脉络般闪烁。镜头始于极远的航拍全景，随后以平滑螺旋轨迹环绕她缓缓下降，逐渐收紧至侧面特写——她闭目深吸。尘埃微粒在阳光中浮动，镜头光晕划过画面，细微的手持震颤平添人性脆弱。电影级自然光，柔和大气漫射，35毫米胶片质感，浅景深，诗意写实。避免卡通色调，拒绝数字锐利感，摒弃人工CGI效果。

en.p: Hyperrealistic miniature diorama, stop-motion animation, handcrafted tactile materials — real fabric, clay, wire armatures, actual tiny props. A clay man sits at a miniature desk in a cozy office, a real tiny laptop open in front of him glowing with a familiar chat interface — white screen, alternating grey and white bubbles. His clay head is in cross-section — one half of his skull open like a hinged lid revealing a plump, healthy, pink clay brain filling the entire cavity. He types a question. [cut] The chat responds — a grey bubble appears. He smiles. In stop-motion the brain shrinks slightly, a tiny gap appearing between brain and skull. He doesn't notice. He types again. [cut] Rapid montage — each question fired off in quick stop-motion. With every sent message the brain shrinks one click smaller — plump to walnut to grape to pea. The empty skull space fills with real tiny cobwebs, a miniature tumbleweed rolls through, a small 'FOR RENT' sign pops up on a tiny stake inside his head. [cut] Close-up of the skull interior — the brain is now a single tiny pink crumb rattling around the bottom of an enormous empty cavity. A real tiny echo visual — the crumb bounces off the walls like a screensaver. [cut] Wide shot — the man leans back with a huge satisfied clay grin, arms behind his head, feet on the desk. The laptop screen shows hundreds of conversations in the sidebar. On the wall behind him, framed diplomas gather real dust. A real tiny spider has built a web between his ear and his shoulder. He looks completely content. The brain crumb settles in a corner and stops moving

zh.p: 超写实微缩立体模型，定格动画，手工触感材质——真实布料、黏土、金属丝骨架、实物大小微缩道具。一个黏土人坐在温馨办公室的微型书桌前，面前摊开的真实迷你笔记本电脑屏幕泛着熟悉的聊天界面白光——白色背景上交替浮现灰白气泡。他的黏土脑袋呈剖面状——半边头骨像铰链盖般掀开，露出填满整个颅腔的饱满健康粉色黏土大脑。他敲出一个问题。[切换镜头] 聊天界面弹出灰色气泡作为回复。他露出微笑。定格动画中，大脑微微缩小，颅骨与脑组织间出现细缝。他浑然不觉，继续打字。[切换镜头] 快速蒙太奇——每个问题在急促的定格动画中接连抛出。每发送一条消息，大脑就咔嗒缩小一档——从饱满到核桃到葡萄到豌豆。空出的颅腔空间里，真实微尘结出蛛网，微型风滚草滚过，一根小木牌在他脑袋里竖起'招租'字样。[切换镜头] 颅腔内部特写——大脑已缩成一颗粉色碎屑，在巨大空腔底部叮当滚动。真实微缩回声效果——碎屑像屏保图案般在腔壁间弹跳。[切换镜头] 全景镜头——黏土人向后靠去，露出心满意足的巨大笑容，双臂枕在脑后，双脚翘上桌面。笔记本电脑侧边栏显示着数百个对话窗口。他身后墙上，镶框文凭积着真实灰尘。一只真实微缩蜘蛛在他耳畔与肩膀间织网。他看起来全然满足。大脑碎屑在角落停驻，不再动弹。

en.p: Realistic human style, vertical screen, first-person perspective. Inside a luxury suite, floor-to-ceiling windows reveal a dazzling night view, while the room is bathed in soft, warm ambient lighting. A young Asian woman of noble elegance stands before the floor-to-ceiling windows, her wavy long hair cascading down, wearing a champagne-colored silk slip dress with thin straps subtly visible, her curves gracefully outlined. Action description: She faces away from the camera, gazing at the night view outside. Upon hearing a sound, she slowly turns around, her eyes seductive with a faint smile, saying, 'The night view is beautiful, isn’t it? But I think what you really want to see is me.' She slowly walks toward the camera, her fingers lightly brushing over the sofa backrest. The camera follows her movement and pans downward. She steps barefoot on the soft carpet, her ankles slender, her toes painted with nude nail polish, her gait elegant and sensual. The lighting is ambiguous, the texture luxurious, with cinematic high-definition quality.

en.p: [Subject]: A portrait of Wuhan city, featuring the red walls and yellow tiles of Yellow Crane Tower, steaming hot dry noodles, the steel structure of the Yangtze River Bridge, and cherry blossoms swirling at Wuhan University—the scene is full of vibrant colors. [Action]: The camera slowly advances from the steam of the hot dry noodles, then instantly cuts to the vast misty waves of the Yangtze River; a dragon dance weaves flexibly through old streets, with smooth and natural movements, free of stiffness. [Scene]: Yellow Crane Tower at dawn, with the Tyndall effect piercing through the eaves; at night, a "light show" shines on both banks of the Yangtze, with neon lights casting brilliant reflections on the river surface. [Camera Movement]: FPV drone perspective, diving rapidly from the smoky alleys of Liangdao Street, skimming over the river surface and pulling up, then seamlessly transitioning to a 180-degree orbit around the main tower of the Yangtze River Bridge—the footage is stable, smooth, and free of jitter. [Style/Quality]: 8K ultra-high definition, cinematic quality, rich in detail, sharp and clear, blending the cultural heritage of Jingchu with the modern technological feel of the river city. [Constraints]: Normal building proportions, no distortion or deformation, stable faces, no flickering in the footage, with a 15-second one-shot narrative logic.
en.t: Wuhan: A City of Vibrant Contrasts

zh.p:
[主体]: 武汉城市群像, 包含黄鹤楼的红墙黄瓦、热气腾腾的热干面、长江大桥的钢铁结构、樱花飞舞的武汉大学, 画面色彩极具生命力.
[动作]: 镜头从热干面的蒸汽中缓慢推进, 瞬间匹配剪辑硬切至长江江面的浩渺烟波; 舞龙在老街灵活穿梭, 动作连贯自然, 不僵硬.
[场景]: 晨曦下的黄鹤楼, 丁达尔效应穿透飞檐; 夜幕下长江两岸“灯光秀”闪耀, 霓虹灯光在江面泛起璀璨倒影.
[运镜]: FPV穿越机视角, 从粮道街的烟火巷弄极速俯冲并贴着江面拉升, 衔接180度环绕长江大桥主塔, 画面平稳无抖动, 丝滑流畅.
[风格/画质]: 8K超高清, 电影质感, 细节丰富, 锐度清晰, 结合荆楚文化底蕴与江城现代科技感.
[约束]: 建筑比例正常, 无扭曲变形, 面部稳定, 画面无闪烁, 15秒一镜到底叙事逻辑.

en.p: 15-second vertical video 9:16, film-like filter with natural grain, Taipei Tamsui Riverbank Trail, background golden sunset + sparkling river surface + distant情人桥 silhouette, protagonist Taiwanese girl [Image 1], long hair slightly wavy, beige knit cardigan, clear and light makeup, full scene boyfriend handheld POV follow-shot, slight camera shake, no perspective switching, 0-4 seconds: Handheld follow-shot, girl walking two steps ahead of the camera, turns head to the camera, slightly furrows brows pretending to be angry, one hand pressing down wind-blown hair strands, the other hand makes a 'hurry up' gesture behind her, sunset side-backlight outlines cheek contours and flowing hair ends; dialogue (soft and coquettish): 'Hey, walk faster! It's all because you're dragging your feet!' 4-8 seconds: Girl suddenly stops, looks at the river surface, camera smoothly pans following her gaze to the opposite shore — golden sunset panoramic view + sparkling water +情人桥 silhouette, pauses about 2 seconds; pans back to girl's front view, Golden Hour warm light tints her face golden, she laughs with eyes squinting into slits; dialogue (short exclamation): 'Wow — look at this light!' 8-10 seconds: Girl's eyes light up looking at a roadside stall, pulls the camera direction and walks quickly over, handheld camera shakes faster with movement; [natural street ambient sound, no dialogue] 10-13 seconds: Girl already holding a tall Tamsui soft-serve ice cream, raises it to the camera pretending to feed; dialogue (playful): 'First bite for you —' pauses a beat, she turns the ice cream to herself and takes a big bite, because the ice cream is too tall, when biting down her nose tip rubs against the cream top getting a bit of milky white; dialogue (smug): '— Just kidding!' 13-15 seconds: She chews the ice cream, looks down and sees the cream on her nose tip, crosses her eyes to glance down, freezes for half a second then bursts into laughter at the camera, handheld slightly shakes; dialogue (laughing so much she can't speak clearly): 'Hahaha... you pass today!' No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks allowed.
en.t: Golden Sunset Chase on Tamsui Riverbank

8-10秒:女生眼神一亮看向路旁小摊,拉着镜头的方向快步走过去, 镜头Handheld跟着加速晃动; [自然街道环境音,无台词]

en.p: Scene: A modern-style hotel room at night. Characters: • Male lead: Hair dyed in streaks of gold and black. Wearing a light-colored (off-white/cream) silk or satin pajama set with black piping. • Female lead: Long black hair. Wearing a simple white crew-neck short-sleeved T-shirt, with a full chest and visible collarbones, lying on the bed. Actions and Plot: Shot 1 (00:00 - 00:01): The scene begins, with a yellow subtitle always displayed at the top of the screen: "When I'm about to sleep." The female lead lies flat on a bed with white sheets and pillows. The male lead kneels by the bedside, leaning over to face the female lead, and they look at each other. Shot 2 (00:01 - 00:03): The male lead slowly moves downward, resting his head on the female lead's chest/embrace, closing his eyes to sleep. A new subtitle appears at the bottom of the screen: "Lying in my wife's arms~" The female lead's face is turned to the side, looking at the male lead with a calm expression. Shot 3 (00:03 - 00:06): The female lead slowly raises her arms, preparing to embrace the male lead lying in her arms. Shot 4 (00:06 - 00:07): At this point, the female lead's extended arm seems to pull a thin white blanket or cover from the foot of the bed or under the sheets, draping it over the male lead's back. The original subtitle "Lying in my wife's arms~" is replaced by a new subtitle: "Covering with a little blanket." The male lead continues to sleep with his eyes closed in the female lead's arms. Shot 5 (00:07 - 00:10): At the end of the scene, the female lead tightly hugs the male lead with her arms and adjusts the blanket/cover to a comfortable position. The subtitle changes again. The yellow subtitle "When I'm about to sleep" remains, while below it becomes "Holding tightly." The two maintain their hugging posture, lying quietly on the bed, with the male lead still peacefully sleeping in the female lead's arms.

zh.p:
场景： 现代风格酒店房间，夜晚。

人物：
• 男主： 头发挑染成金色和黑色。身穿一件带黑色滚边的浅色（米白色/奶油色）丝绸或缎面睡衣。
• 女主： 留着黑色长发。身穿一件简单的白色圆领短袖T恤，胸部丰满，可以看到锁骨，躺在床上。

动作与情节：
画面1 (00:00 - 00:01): 场景开始，画面上方始终显示黄色字幕：“当我准备睡觉的时候”。女主平躺在铺着白色床单和枕头的床上。男主跪在床边，弯腰面向女主，两人对视。

画面2 (00:01 - 00:03): 男主慢慢地向下移动，将头靠在女主的胸口/怀里，闭上眼睛准备睡觉。画面下方出现新字幕：“躺在老婆怀里～”。女主的脸侧向一旁，神情平静地看着男主。

画面3 (00:03 - 00:06): 女主慢慢举起双臂，准备拥抱躺在她怀里的男主。

画面4 (00:06 - 00:07): 此时，女主伸出的手臂似乎是从床尾或被子里拉出一块白色的薄毯子或被子，盖在男主背上。原有的字幕“躺在老婆怀里～”被新字幕“盖上小被子”取代。男主继续闭目睡在女主怀里。

画面5 (00:07 - 00:10): 场景的最后，女主用手臂紧紧抱住男主，并将毯子/被子调整到舒适的位置。字幕再次改变，黄色字幕“当我准备睡觉的时候”依然存在，下方则变为“紧紧抱住”。两人保持着拥抱的姿势，静静地躺在床上，男主依然安稳地睡在女主怀里。

en.p: The protagonist is [@Image 1]. The scene is a breakfast stall on a city street in the morning, with the stall referencing [@Image 2]. The camera is fixed at the perspective of [@Image 1]. The kitten holds a large spoon in its left hand and a wooden scraper in its right hand, scraping the batter from the spoon in its left hand. It puts down the large spoon with its left hand while spreading the batter on the griddle with its right hand. With its left hand, it picks up an egg, cracks it on the edge of the griddle, and with one hand, breaks the egg onto the batter. It then tosses the eggshell backward and spreads the egg with its right hand. After that, it puts down the wooden scraper, picks up a small spatula with its right hand, lifts the batter, and folds it in half. With its left hand, it takes out a brush dipped in sweet bean sauce and brushes the sauce onto the batter three times. Then, with its right hand, it picks up a crispy fried dough stick, breaks it in half, and places it on the batter. Next, it takes some shredded seaweed with its left hand and some shredded potatoes with its right hand, sprinkling them on the batter. It then rolls up the batter, picks up the small spatula with its right hand, cuts the rolled pancake in half down the middle, and finally picks up a plastic bag to pack it, handing it toward the camera.

en.p: First-person male perspective, in the living room on the sofa, a young woman (facial reference @【@Image 1】) is lying on her side in loose white pajamas, propping her head up with one hand while scrolling through videos on her phone with the other, her legs casually draped over the armrest, revealing pale calves and ankles. She stares intently at the screen, occasionally letting out a smile. The main perspective sits beside her, watching her relaxed demeanor, and can't help but reach out to gently touch her calf. Just as the fingertips make contact with her skin—she instantly shudders all over, nearly dropping her phone, and abruptly turns her head to stare wide-eyed at the viewer, a flicker of panic and surprise in her eyes, her mouth slightly open as if startled. Yet in the next second, her expression shifts dramatically. A slow grin curls at the corners of her mouth, her eyes narrow slightly, revealing a meaningful, sly smile. She slowly puts down her phone, sits up straight, and looks at the viewer as if she's discovered something amusing. Before the main perspective can react, she suddenly leans forward and lunges directly at the viewer. Her hands press against the viewer's chest, her entire body weight bearing down, pushing the viewer back against the sofa backrest. She stares into the viewer's eyes up close, her smile deepening. The main perspective, caught off guard by this sudden move, freezes in panic, hands hovering in mid-air, afraid to touch her, stammering, 'Wait, wait... you've got it wrong, I didn't mean it that way...' She just smiles and leans in closer, saying nothing. The scene is a living room with warm-toned home lighting, shallow depth of field, focusing on her changing expressions and the lunging motion, rendered in a realistic style. Film grain texture, enhanced light-shadow contrast, detail reconstruction, digital noise removal.

zh.p:
第一人称男生视角，客厅沙发上，一位年轻女性（面部形象参考@【@图1】）穿着宽松白色睡衣侧躺，一只手撑着脑袋，另一只手拿着手机刷视频，两条腿随意搭在沙发扶手上，露出白皙的小腿和脚踝。她专注盯着屏幕，偶尔笑一下。

主视角坐在她身旁，看着她放松的样子，忍不住伸手轻轻碰了碰她的小腿，指尖刚触到皮肤——

她瞬间浑身一颤，手机差点掉落，猛地转过头瞪大眼睛看向观看者，眼神中闪过一丝惊慌和意外，嘴巴微微张开，像是被吓到。

然而下一秒，她表情骤然变化。嘴角慢慢勾起，眼睛微微眯起，露出一抹意味深长的邪笑。她缓缓放下手机，坐直身体，盯着观看者的眼神像是发现了什么有趣的事。

还没等主视角反应，她突然身体前倾，直接朝观看者身上扑了过来。双手按在观看者胸口，整个人压了上来，将观看者推倒在沙发靠背上。她近距离盯着观看者的眼睛，笑意更深。

主视角被这突如其来的动作弄得手足无措，身体僵住，双手悬在半空不敢碰她，慌乱地开口：“等、等一下……你误会了，我没那个意思……”

她只是笑着凑近，一言不发。

场景是客厅，暖色调家居灯光，浅景深，焦点集中在她的表情变化和扑过来的动作上，使用写实风的画面风格生成素材。胶片颗粒感, 增强光影对比度, 画面细节重塑, 消除数码噪声。

她瞬间浑身一颤，手机差点掉落，猛地转过头瞪大眼睛看向观看者，眼神中闪过一丝惊慌和意外，嘴巴微微张开，像是被吓到。

然而下一秒，她表情骤然变化。嘴角慢慢勾起，眼睛微微眯起，露出一抹意味深长的邪笑。她缓缓放下手机，坐直身体，盯着观看者的眼神像是发现了什么有趣的事。

还没等主视角反应，她突然身体前倾，直接朝观看者身上扑了过来。双手按在观看者胸口，整个人压了上来，将观看者推倒在沙发靠背上。她近距离盯着观看者的眼睛，笑意更深。

主视角被这突如其来的动作弄得手足无措，身体僵住，双手悬在半空不敢碰她，慌乱地开口：“等、等一下……你误会了，我没那个意思……”

她只是笑着凑近，一言不发。

场景是客厅，暖色调家居灯光，浅景深，焦点集中在她的表情变化和扑过来的动作上，使用写实风的画面风格生成素材。胶片颗粒感, 增强光影对比度, 画面细节重塑, 消除数码噪声。

en.p: [Subject]: Guangzhou city portrait, featuring ancient Xiguan mansions, exquisite Cantonese dim sum, and the towering Canton Tower (Little Waist), with rich and saturated colors. [Action]: The camera slowly advances from the rising steam of a tea house, instantly cutting to the dazzling lights of Zhujiang New Town via match cut; a lion dance leaps gracefully through an old street, with smooth and natural movements, not stiff. [Scene]: The Chen Clan Ancestral Hall at dawn, with intricate wood carvings and the Tyndall effect penetrating the Manchu windows; at night, neon lights flicker along both sides of the Pearl River, with reflections shimmering on the water. [Camera Movement]: Extreme FPV drone perspective, diving from old city alleys and pulling up close to the ground, transitioning to a 180-degree orbit around the top of Canton Tower, with stable, shake-free, and silky smooth footage. [Style/Quality]: 8K ultra-high definition, cinematic texture, extreme detail, sharp clarity, blending new Chinese aesthetics with a futuristic cyberpunk feel. [Constraints]: Normal building proportions, no distortion or deformation, stable facial features, no flickering in the frame, 15-second one-shot logic.

[约束]: 建筑比例正常, 无扭曲变形, 人物面部稳定, 画面无闪烁, 15秒一镜到底逻辑.

en.p: The vibrant modern cityscape of Zibo, featuring the majestic landmark Haidai Tower at night, interwoven with the ancient charm of Zhoucun Ancient Commercial City's architecture. The scene includes an extremely rich array of rapid transitions, shifting from colorful琉璃 (glazed) crafts to the bustling flow of city traffic. The camera moves swiftly with the intense rhythm of the music, zooming from grand wide shots of massive buildings to close-ups, employing whip pans with motion blur for transitions. Strong neon lights sweep across the frame, accompanied by dynamic light trail effects. Bright and vivid color styles, a collision of traditional Chinese aesthetics and modernity in aurora tones, 4K high-definition, delivering a powerful visual impact. Sound effects: Strong, rhythmic drum beats synced to the beat, mixed with modern electronic music.

zh.p: 充满活力的淄博现代城市风貌，气势宏伟的地标海岱楼夜景，与古色古香的周村古商城建筑交织。画面包含极其丰富的场景快速切换，时而是色彩斑斓的琉璃工艺品，时而是川流不息的城市车流。镜头配合强烈的音乐节奏快速平移穿梭，从宏大建筑大全景快速拉近特写，运用带有拉伸模糊的甩镜头转场。具有强烈的霓虹光影掠过画面，带有动感的光轨拖影特效。鲜艳明快的色彩风格，国潮与现代碰撞的极光色调，4K高清，极具视觉冲击力。 音效：强劲有力的鼓点卡点，现代电子乐混音。

en.p: Fast-paced FPV drone tracking shot from behind, closely following a 3D anime-style girl with white hair skateboarding down a steep, winding mountain road at incredibly high speed. Extreme forward momentum, wide-angle perspective, wind rushing effect. The video starts in a vibrant summer setting with lush green mountains, a bright sunny sky, a distant ocean, and brown leaves flying past the camera. At the 3-second mark, a magical wave of frost sweeps forward from the skateboard: the environment seamlessly transforms into a freezing winter landscape. The green grass instantly turns to deep white snow, heavy snowflakes start falling, and the distant mountains become snow-capped peaks. The camera never breaks the intense, smooth, continuous downhill tracking motion. High-octane action, masterpiece 3D animation, photorealistic lighting.

zh.p: 高速第一人称FPV无人机跟拍镜头，紧追一位白发3D动漫风格少女，她正以惊人速度踩着滑板沿陡峭蜿蜒的山路俯冲而下。极强的前冲感、广角透视、狂风呼啸效果。视频始于盛夏场景：苍翠群山、明媚晴空、远海与飘过镜头的棕色落叶。第3秒时，滑板向前迸发出一道魔法霜浪：环境无缝切换至冰封寒冬——青草瞬间化为深白雪原，鹅毛大雪纷飞，远山变为雪顶峰峦。镜头始终保持激烈流畅的连续下坡跟拍运动。高能动作、顶级3D动画、照片级光影质感。
