en.p:
Sword Duel on the Lake - Two-Part Structure (15 seconds each part)

Part 1: Initial Battle on the Lake (0-15 seconds)

Film Type and Form
Type: Wuxia Epic × Lightness Duel × Eastern Aesthetics
Style: Blue-green tones; Jiangnan ink-wash artistic conception
Photography: Combination of stable shots and handheld; slow motion to emphasize key actions
Audio: Guqin music; bamboo flute; water sounds; sword slicing through air; staff striking wind

Scene Setting (Only valid for this part)
Location: Jiangnan lake surface; lake water appears blue-green; distant misty mountains and bamboo groves; lotus leaves floating on the lake
Time: Early morning
Lighting: Soft natural light; thin fog pervading; water surface reflecting sky light
Color Palette: Mainly cyan, blue, and gray; red (female swordsman) and white (blind knight) as focal points

Characters (Locked for this part)
Red-clad Female Swordsman: Deep red silk martial arts attire; multiple layers of gold chain ornaments at waist; high bun hairstyle; gold bracelets; slender straight sword with silver-white blade; proud, confident, unwilling to admit defeat
Blind Knight: Off-white long robe; black tie; wearing sunglasses; neat hairstyle; long staff (bamboo); calm, composed, precise

Main Plot (Four Acts × 15 seconds)

[0-2 seconds] Act 1 | Confrontation · First Meeting on the Lake
Plot Description: Early morning on a Jiangnan lake, thin fog gently enveloping. The red-clad female swordsman stands on a lotus leaf on the lake, holding a sword in her right hand, the tip pointing to the ground, her eyes sharp. Opposite her, the blind knight in an off-white long robe, his sunglasses reflecting the lake light, holding a long staff, his posture as still as still water.
Camera Design: Medium shot of the female swordsman from the front; medium shot of the blind knight's sunglasses reflecting; long shot of the two confronting each other
Audio: Low guqin sound; faint water sounds; bamboo leaf rustling

[2-4 seconds] Act 2 | Killing Intent · Eye Confrontation
Plot Description: The female swordsman's eyes are filled with murderous intent. She raises her long sword, the blade reflecting silver light. The moment it leaves the sheath, the sword blade cuts through the air. Hard cut to the blind knight's face, his sunglasses reflecting rippling light, the corners of his mouth slightly raised. He rotates his long staff, producing a low whooshing sound.
Camera Design: Close-up of the female swordsman's eyes; close-up of the long sword leaving the sheath with silver light (slow motion); hard cut; close-up of the blind knight's sunglasses; close-up of rotating the long staff
Audio: 'Zheng' sound of the sword blade; 'Hu' sound of the staff; guqin suddenly stops

[4-10 seconds] Act 3 | Initial Clash · Battle on the Water
Plot Description: The female swordsman attacks first, her toes touching the ground, her figure like an arrow, her red clothes fluttering. She uses lightness skill to tread on the water, stirring up ripples and splashes, her sword moves fierce. The blind knight sidesteps, skims over the lake with lightness skill, and deftly blocks with his long staff. The two quickly exchange blows, sword and staff colliding, water splashing everywhere.
During the fierce fight, the blind knight changes his staff technique, precisely thrusting the long staff, hitting the female swordsman's right shoulder. The female swordsman retreats, covering her shoulder, her face showing pain and shock.
Camera Design:
4-6 seconds: Medium shot of the female swordsman leaping; close-up of toes touching water (slow motion)
6-8 seconds: Medium-long shot of the exchange; close-up of sword and staff colliding
8-9 seconds: Close-up of the long staff thrusting (slow motion); close-up of hitting the shoulder
9-10 seconds: Close-up of retreating and covering the shoulder
Audio: Water treading sounds; dense collision sounds; wind cutting sounds; bamboo flute joins; dull thud of staff hitting; pained soft groan

[10-15 seconds] Act 4 | Angry Counterattack · Rushing Towards the Bamboo Grove (Ending/Transition)
Plot Description: After a brief pause, anger ignites in the female swordsman's eyes. She growls, 'Watch the sword!' Ignoring her shoulder injury, she leaps again, her sword moves even more ferocious.
The blind knight sweeps his long staff horizontally, repelling the female swordsman. The female swordsman's figure flies backward, using the momentum to lightly touch the lotus leaves on the water, flying towards the lakeside bamboo grove. The blind knight follows closely behind.
Their figures, one red and one white, quickly rush towards the distant emerald green bamboo grove. The camera pulls back, showing the transition between the lake and the bamboo grove.
The screen suddenly cuts to black the moment the two rush into the bamboo grove.
Camera Design:
10-11 seconds: Close-up of eyes turning angry; subtitle dialogue 'Watch the sword!'
11-12 seconds: Medium shot of the female swordsman leaping and attacking fiercely
12-13 seconds: The blind knight sweeps his long staff horizontally, the female swordsman flies backward
13-14 seconds: Long shot, the two figures rushing towards the bamboo grove (red and white contrasting with cyan and blue)
14-15 seconds: Extreme long shot, the two rush to the edge of the bamboo grove, suddenly cut to black
Audio:
Angry shout 'Watch the sword!'
Guqin turns impassioned
Staff hitting sound
Wind cutting sound
Bamboo leaf rustling sound gradually intensifies
At the moment of cutting to black, the sound effects suddenly stop

Ending Design (Engine Six: Abrupt Stop):
✅ Cut to black at the highest point of the action of rushing into the bamboo grove
✅ Create suspense: 'What will happen in the bamboo grove?'
✅ Drive the audience to watch the second part

Production Suggestions (Part 1)
Visual Style: Mainly cyan, blue-gray, and mist white; contrast between deep red and off-white; reduce saturation in post-production, enhance blue-green tones
Photography Techniques: Stable shots (confrontation); handheld tracking (fighting); slow motion accounts for 30%
Sound Design: Guqin as main melody; bamboo flute as auxiliary; high-frequency sword blade sounds; low-frequency staff hitting sounds; multi-layered water sounds
Action Design: Female swordsman 'fast, ruthless, accurate'; blind knight 'steady, soft, precise'; reference to 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' lightness skill

Part 2: Decisive Battle in the Bamboo Grove (0-15 seconds)

Film Type and Form
Type: Wuxia Epic × Lightness Duel × Eastern Aesthetics
Style: Emerald green bamboo grove + cyan-blue lake; Jiangnan ink-wash artistic conception
Photography: Mainly dynamic tracking; a large number of low-angle and high-angle shots; slow motion to emphasize bamboo bending
Audio: Bamboo flute dominant; guqin auxiliary; bamboo breaking sounds; wind sounds; sword blade slicing through air; staff striking wind

Scene Setting (Only valid for this part)
Location: Dense bamboo grove by the lake + lake surface; emerald green sea of bamboo; morning light casting dappled shadows through bamboo leaves; cyan-blue lake visible at the edge of the bamboo grove
Time: Early morning
Lighting: Morning light through bamboo leaves, golden spots; inside the bamboo grove half bright and half dark; soft natural light on the lake
Color Palette: First half mainly emerald green (bamboo grove) + gold (morning light); second half mainly cyan-blue (lake); red and white contrast throughout

Characters (Locked for this part)
Red-clad Female Swordsman: Deep red martial arts attire; gold chain ornaments at waist; high bun hairstyle; holding a sword; already injured in the shoulder; angry, unwilling to give up
Blind Knight: Off-white long robe; black tie; wearing sunglasses; holding a long staff; calm, precise

Main Plot (Four Acts × 15 seconds)

[0-4 seconds] Act 1 | Chase on Bamboo Tops
Plot Description: The screen quickly fades in from black, directly entering the bamboo grove. The color tone suddenly shifts from cyan-blue to emerald green.
The female swordsman uses lightness skill to step on the bamboo tops, the bamboo bending and swaying under her feet. She continuously jumps between multiple bamboo stalks, her red clothes particularly conspicuous in the green sea of bamboo. Each time she steps on a bamboo stalk, it bends and trembles.
The blind knight follows closely behind, pursuing among the bamboo tops. He swings his long staff, striking and breaking the bamboo stalks the female swordsman stepped on, the bamboo snapping and flying apart with a 'pop'.
Camera Design:
0-1 seconds: Fade in from black, morning light through bamboo leaves
1-2 seconds: Low-angle shot, the female swordsman jumping among bamboo tops, bamboo bending
2-3 seconds: Tracking shot, the blind knight swings his staff to break bamboo (slow motion), bamboo breaking and flying
3-4 seconds: Side wide-angle shot, the two chasing above the bamboo grove, multiple bamboo stalks bending simultaneously
Audio:
Bamboo bending 'swish' sounds
Bamboo breaking 'pop' sounds
Light sounds of feet stepping on bamboo tops
Bamboo flute playing rapidly (tense)

[4-10 seconds] Act 2 | Duel on a Bent Bamboo
Plot Description: The female swordsman lands on a thick, bent bamboo stalk. The blind knight immediately lands on the other end of the same bamboo stalk.
The two each stand on one end of the bamboo, the bamboo bending into a huge arc due to their weight, swaying in the air. Morning light shines through the bamboo leaves, illuminating the two.
The female swordsman attacks first, her sword light thrusting towards the blind knight. The blind knight sweeps his long staff horizontally to block. The sword and staff clash fiercely three times on the bent bamboo, each collision causing the bamboo to shake violently.
After the third collision, the blind knight suddenly accelerates his staff technique, sweeping his staff towards the female swordsman's hand holding the sword.
Camera Design:
4-5 seconds: Medium shot, the two landing on opposite ends of the bent bamboo (symmetrical composition)
5-6 seconds: Close-up, the bamboo bending and swaying under their feet (slow motion)
6-8 seconds: Quick cuts: sword thrust → staff block → collision (3 quick cuts)
8-9 seconds: Medium shot, the bamboo shaking violently, the two figures rising and falling
9-10 seconds: The blind knight accelerates his staff technique, sweeping his staff towards the female swordsman's wrist (slow motion)
Audio:
Bamboo bending 'creaking' sound
Sword and staff colliding 'clang clang clang' (3 times)
Bamboo swaying 'swish' sound
Bamboo flute and guqin duet reaching a climax

[10-12 seconds] Act 3 | Sword Dislodged · Falling Back to the Lake
Plot Description: The blind knight sweeps his staff and hits the female swordsman's wrist. The female swordsman's sword is dislodged, spinning in the air and flying out of the bamboo grove, plunging into the distant lake. She loses balance and falls from the bent bamboo.
The blind knight also jumps down from the bamboo. The two successively fall from the bamboo grove back to the lake.
The camera follows the two as they fall from the emerald green bamboo grove back to the cyan-blue lake surface—the color tone shifts again, from green back to cyan-blue.
Camera Design:
10 seconds: Close-up, the sword dislodged and spinning out (slow motion)
10-11 seconds: The long sword flies out of the bamboo grove, plunges into the lake, splashing water
11 seconds: The female swordsman falls from the bamboo
11-12 seconds: The camera follows the two as they fall from the bamboo grove back to the lake (color tone shifts from emerald green to cyan-blue)
Audio: Staff

zh.p:
《湖上决剑》- 两段式结构（每段15秒）

第一段：湖面初战（0-15秒）
影片类型与形式
类型：武侠史诗 × 轻功决斗 × 东方美学
 风格：青蓝色调；江南水墨意境
 摄影方式：稳定镜头与手持结合；慢镜头强调关键动作
 音频：古琴声；竹笛；水声；剑刃破空声；棍击风声
场景设定（本段唯一有效）
地点：江南湖面；湖水呈青蓝色；远处有朦胧山峦与竹林；湖面漂浮荷叶
 时间：清晨
 光线：柔和自然光；薄雾弥漫；水面反射天光
 色彩基调：青色、蓝色、灰色为主；红色（女剑客）与白色（盲侠）为焦点
出场人物（本段锁定）

红衣女剑客：深红色绸缎武服；腰系多层金色链饰；发髻高束；金色手镯；细长直剑，剑身银白；骄傲、自信、不服输
盲侠：米白色长袍；黑色领带；戴墨镜；发型整齐；长棍（竹制）；沉稳、从容、精准
正文剧情（四幕 × 15秒）
【0-2秒】第一幕 | 对峙·湖面初见
剧情描述：清晨江南湖面，薄雾轻笼。红衣女剑客站立湖面荷叶上，右手持剑，剑尖指地，眼神锐利。对面盲侠身着米白色长袍，墨镜反射湖光，手握长棍，姿态静若止水。

镜头设计：中景女剑客正面；中景盲侠墨镜反射；远景两人对峙
音频：低沉古琴声；微弱水声；竹叶声
【2-4秒】第二幕 | 杀机·眼神交锋

剧情描述：女剑客眼中杀意凛然，抬起长剑，剑身折射银光。出鞘瞬间，剑刃破空。硬切至盲侠面部，墨镜反射波光，嘴角微扬。他转动长棍，发出低沉风声。
镜头设计：特写女剑客眼睛；特写长剑出鞘银光（慢镜头）；硬切；特写盲侠墨镜；近景转动长棍
音频：剑刃"铮"声；棍身"呼"声；古琴骤停
【4-10秒】第三幕 | 初交锋·水上激战
剧情描述：女剑客率先攻击，足尖点地，身形如箭，红衣飘扬。她轻功踏水，激起涟漪水花，剑招凌厉。盲侠侧移，轻功掠湖面，长棍轻巧格挡。两人快速交手，剑棍碰撞，水花四溅。
激斗中，盲侠棍法一变，长棍精准刺出，击中女剑客右肩。女剑客后退，捂肩，脸现痛苦震惊。

镜头设计：
4-6秒：中景女剑客飞跃；近景脚尖踏水（慢镜头）
6-8秒：中远景交手；特写剑棍碰撞
8-9秒：近景长棍刺出（慢镜头）；特写击中肩膀
9-10秒：近景后退捂肩

音频：踏水声；密集碰撞声；破风声；竹笛加入；棍击闷响；痛苦轻哼
【10-15秒】第四幕 | 怒而反击·冲向竹林（结尾/过渡）
剧情描述：短暂停顿后，女剑客眼中怒火燃起，低吼："看剑！"她不顾肩伤，再次飞身，剑招更凶猛。
盲侠长棍横扫，将女剑客击退。女剑客身形倒飞，借力在水面荷叶上轻点，向湖畔竹林方向飞掠。盲侠紧随其后。
两人身影一红一白，快速冲向远处的翠绿竹林。镜头拉远，展现湖面与竹林的过渡。

画面在两人冲入竹林的瞬间，突然切黑。
镜头设计：
10-11秒：特写眼睛转愤怒；对白字幕"看剑！"
11-12秒：中景女剑客飞身猛攻

12-13秒：盲侠长棍横扫，女剑客倒飞

13-14秒：远景，两人身影冲向竹林（红白对比青蓝）
14-15秒：超远景，两人冲入竹林边缘，突然切黑
音频：
愤怒喊声"看剑！"
古琴转激昂
棍击声
破空声

竹叶沙沙声渐强
在切黑瞬间，音效突然停止
结尾设计（引擎六：戛然而止）：
✅ 在冲入竹林的动作最高点切黑
✅ 制造悬念："竹林里会发生什么？"

✅ 驱动观众看第二段

制作建议（第一段）
视觉风格：青色、蓝灰色、薄雾白为主；深红与米白对比；后期降低饱和度，增强青蓝色调
摄影技术：稳定镜头（对峙）；手持跟拍（打斗）；慢镜头占30%
音效设计：古琴主旋律；竹笛辅助；高频剑刃声；低频棍击声；多层次水声
动作设计：女剑客"快狠准"；盲侠"稳柔精"；参考《卧虎藏龙》轻功
第二段：竹林决战（0-15秒）

影片类型与形式

类型：武侠史诗 × 轻功决斗 × 东方美学
 风格：翠绿竹林 + 青蓝湖面；江南水墨意境
 摄影方式：动态跟拍为主；大量仰拍俯拍；慢镜头强调竹子弯曲
 音频：竹笛主导；古琴辅助；竹子断裂声；风声；剑刃破空声；棍击风声
场景设定（本段唯一有效）
地点：湖畔密集竹林 + 湖面；翠绿竹海；晨光透过竹叶投下斑驳光影；竹林边缘可见青蓝色湖面
 时间：清晨
 光线：晨光透过竹叶，金色光斑；竹林内部半明半暗；湖面柔和自然光
 色彩基调：前半段翠绿色（竹林）+ 金色（晨光）为主；后半段青蓝色（湖面）；红白对比贯穿

出场人物（本段锁定）
红衣女剑客：深红色武服；腰系金色链饰；发髻高束；持剑；已受肩伤；愤怒、不甘
盲侠：米白色长袍；黑色领带；戴墨镜；持长棍；沉着、精准
正文剧情（四幕 × 15秒）
【0-4秒】第一幕 | 竹梢追逐

剧情描述：画面从黑色快速淡入，直接进入竹林。色调从青蓝突然转为翠绿。
女剑客轻功点在竹梢上，竹子在她脚下弯曲摇晃。她连续在多根竹子间跳跃，红衣在绿色竹海中格外显眼。每踏一根竹子，竹子都会弯曲颤动。
盲侠紧随其后，在竹梢间追击。他的长棍挥出，击断女剑客踩过的竹子，竹子"啪"地断裂翻飞。
镜头设计：
0-1秒：从黑淡入，晨光透过竹叶
1-2秒：仰拍，女剑客在竹梢间跳跃，竹子弯曲

2-3秒：跟拍，盲侠挥棍击断竹子（慢镜头），竹子断裂翻飞
3-4秒：侧面广角，两人在竹林上空追逐，多根竹子同时弯曲
音频：
竹子弯曲"嗖嗖"声
竹子断裂"啪啪"声

脚步点在竹梢的轻响
竹笛快速演奏（紧张）
【4-10秒】第二幕 | 弯竹对决

剧情描述：女剑客落在一根粗壮的弯曲竹子上。盲侠紧接着落在同一根竹子的另一端。
两人各站竹子一端，竹子因两人重量弯成巨大弧形，在空中摇晃。晨光透过竹叶，照在两人身上。
女剑客抢先出剑，剑光刺向盲侠。盲侠长棍横扫格挡。剑棍在弯曲的竹子上激烈碰撞3次，每次碰撞竹子都剧烈摇晃。
第3次碰撞后，盲侠棍法突然加速，一棍扫向女剑客持剑的手腕。
镜头设计：
4-5秒：中景，两人分别落在弯竹两端（对称构图）
5-6秒：近景，竹子在两人脚下弯曲晃动（慢镜头）

6-8秒：快速切换：剑刺出→棍格挡→碰撞（3次快切）
8-9秒：中景，竹子剧烈摇晃，两人身形起伏
9-10秒：盲侠棍法加速，长棍扫向女剑客手腕（慢镜头）
音频：

竹子弯曲"咯吱"声

en.p:
"Use the uploaded image as the exact first frame.
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic continuous chase shot. The camera is physically gripping the tiger’s tail, locked in a rigid trailing POV. The tail fills the foreground, muscles flexing, skin rippling, fur vibrating from speed and airflow.
Ahead, a deer sprints across the grassy field in panic. Its movement is erratic and unbalanced, fear-driven stride changes and sharp direction shifts clearly visible as the distance rapidly closes.
The tiger accelerates into a full sprint with precise biomechanics: explosive hind-leg extension, visible spine compression and release, tail counterbalancing each stride. Grass flattens under impact, dirt and debris kick up naturally. The horizon trembles subtly from ground force, not artificial camera shake.
Extreme forward velocity creates strong motion parallax in the environment while the tail remains relatively stable due to the physical grip. Micro-oscillations sync perfectly with each stride cycle. Wind roars; fur streams backward consistently.
Lighting stays natural and continuous, shadows strobing beneath the body as legs cycle. No slow motion, no cuts, no stylization.
In the final moments, the tiger lunges, collides with the deer, pins it to the ground, and secures a decisive neck hold. The shot ends mid-action with full weight, tension, and momentum still present."

zh.p: 将上传的图片作为精确的第一帧，制作一段15秒的超写实连续追逐镜头。摄像机物理性地抓握住老虎的尾巴，锁定在僵硬的尾随视角。尾巴占据前景，肌肉紧绷，皮肤起伏，毛发因速度和气流而颤动。前方，一只鹿在草地上惊慌奔逃。它的动作摇摆不定、失去平衡，随着距离迅速缩短，恐惧驱动的步幅变化和急转方向清晰可见。老虎以精准的生物力学加速至全速冲刺：后腿爆发性伸展，脊柱压缩与释放清晰可见，尾巴为每一步提供平衡。草地被冲击压平，泥土和碎屑自然扬起。地平线因地面力量而微微颤动，而非人为的摄像机晃动。极快的向前速度在环境中产生强烈的运动视差，而尾巴因物理抓握保持相对稳定。微小的振荡与每一步周期完美同步。风声呼啸，毛发持续向后飘动。光线保持自然连续，腿部循环时阴影在身体下方闪烁。无慢动作、无剪辑、无风格化处理。在最后时刻，老虎猛扑，与鹿相撞，将其按倒在地，并锁定决定性的颈部控制。镜头在动作中途结束，重量、张力和动量依然完整。

[Style]
Cinematic old Shanghai texture + fast-paced commercial blockbuster editing
Strong rhythmic drumbeat soundtrack
Film grain
High-contrast lighting
Action-matched editing
8K ultra-high definition
Rhythm progresses frame by frame, emotions continuously rising

[Duration]
15 seconds

[Character]
The same Eastern woman
Her temperament shifts from reserved to sharp
Her eyes go from lowered to staring directly into the camera
Her body language moves from restrained to commanding the entire scene

[Core Transition Mechanism]
Each spin completes a leap through the eras
Actions seamlessly match the editing

[Storyboard]

0–2 seconds [Late Qing Dynasty Banner Dress]
Scene: Enclosed courtyard, dim lighting
Costume: Straight, wide banner dress, high stand-up collar, wide sleeves, heavy embroidery
Action: Lower head, slowly raise eyes, first heavy drumbeat, sudden spin
Camera: Medium shot quickly zooming in

2–5 seconds [1915 Transitional Qipao]
Scene: Street, slightly brighter light
Costume: Sleeves become narrower, waistline subtly appears, hem still long
Action: Spin to land, lift head, take the first step, pace begins to quicken, spin again

5–9 seconds [1920s Shanghai Style]
Scene: Shanghai street, tram passing by
Costume: Silk qipao, clear waistline, hem to calf, wavy short hair
Action: Pace noticeably accelerates, actively looks at the camera, camera circles around, drumbeat intensifies, crisp and clean spin

9–15 seconds [1930s Golden Age]
Scene: Neon nightscape, strong light outlining silhouette
Costume: Fitted cut, high slit, sleeveless, stiletto heels, red lips
Action: Spin completes, stops, slowly walks toward the camera, camera transitions from overhead to eye level, she stares directly into the camera, aura fully commanding, final drumbeat lands, freeze frame

Indoor home environment (suspected modern-style kitchen or living room), with a blurred white cabinet visible in the background. Camera: Fixed position (Lock-off), maintaining stable shots, relying on the movement of characters within the frame to create dynamics.

Emotions: confidence, seduction, movement, coolness.

en.p:
A beautiful young adult redhead stands at the center of a surreal Valentine’s garden, framed in an intimate portrait composition. Her copper waves fall softly over her shoulders, glowing under warm rose and blush lighting. She looks down tenderly at three cats gathered close to her, a snow-white cat with pearly reflections, a warm ginger cat with golden highlights, and a sleek black cat edged in soft magenta light.
The entire environment is fully immersive and floral: translucent heart-shaped blossoms in saturated pink, coral, and ruby tones surround her on every side. Foreground flowers are slightly blurred for depth, while the background dissolves into glowing bokeh hearts and floating golden particles. Thin ribbons of soft luminous light arc gently between her and the cats, symbolizing affection.

en.p: 15-second film in a realistic style, warm golden-hour lighting, American street basketball atmosphere. 0-3 seconds: An outdoor street basketball court in Los Angeles, sunlight slanting down. A tall, muscular African American male player in a sleeveless training vest and athletic shorts is warming up with a crossover dribble, his muscle lines clearly defined, his expression confident and contemptuous. Opposite him stands a petite blonde young American woman with a high ponytail, wearing a loose basketball short-sleeve shirt and athletic shorts, her expression calm and composed. The male player smiles, pats the ball, and waves at her to attack. The camera captures a medium shot of the two facing off. 4-8 seconds: The male player starts dribbling to attack, performing consecutive crossover and behind-the-back dribbling tricks, his sneakers kicking up dust on the ground. He suddenly accelerates with a right crossover to drive to the basket. A handheld tracking shot follows his footsteps closely. The woman moves nimbly and quickly, sliding laterally to cut off his position, her expression focused, her eyes locked on the ball. 9-12 seconds: Slow-motion. The male player jumps up, preparing for a right-handed layup. Just as the ball is raised above his head, ready to be released, the woman jumps simultaneously, her body stretching and soaring through the air. Her right hand precisely slaps the ball away at its highest point with force. The ball spins out of the frame. The male player's expression in mid-air shifts instantly from confidence to shock, his eyes wide, his mouth open. The camera captures the moment both are airborne from a low angle. 13-15 seconds: Normal speed resumes. The male player lands, stumbling back two steps, bending over with hands on his knees, panting, his face full of disbelief. The woman lands easily, flicks her ponytail, picks up the ball expressionlessly, dribbles it twice with one hand, tilts her head slightly to glance at him, a faint smirk of disdain curling at the corner of her mouth. She turns and walks away, her silhouette sharp and decisive. Sound effects: Throughout, street ambient sounds, the thumping of the dribble and the squeaking of sneakers are clear and realistic. At the moment of the block, a dull, forceful slap of the ball, accompanied by the 'Ohhh' exclamations of a few onlookers nearby. The ending features a low, rhythmic hip-hop beat. No text, subtitles, or watermarks are allowed.

zh.p: 15秒电影写实风格，黄金时段暖色光线，美式街头篮球氛围。0-3秒：洛杉矶户外街头篮球场，阳光斜照，一个 材高大壮硕的美国黑人男球员穿着无袖训练背心和运动短裤，胯下运球热身，肌肉线条分明，表情自信轻蔑，对 面站着一个身材娇小的美国金发年轻女生，扎着高马尾辫，穿着宽松篮球短袖和运动短裤，表情平静淡定，男球 员笑着拍了拍球朝她招手示意进攻，镜头中景平视两人对峙；4-8秒：男球员开始运球进攻，连续胯下变向和背 运球炫技，球鞋摩擦地面扬起灰尘，他突然加速向右变向突破准备上篮，手持跟拍镜头紧跟他的脚步移动，女生 脚步灵活迅速横移卡住位置，表情专注眼神锁定篮球；9-12秒：升格慢动作，男球员起跳准备右手上篮，球刚举 过头顶准备出手，女生同时起跳，身体舒展腾空，右手精准地在最高点将篮球一掌狠狠拍飞，篮球旋转飞出画面 ，男球员在空中表情从自信瞬间变为震惊瞪大双眼张开嘴巴，镜头仰拍捕捉两人同时腾空的瞬间；13-15秒：恢 正常速度，男球员落地踉跄后退两步，双手撑膝弯腰喘气，满脸不可置信，女生轻松落地，甩了甩马尾辫，面无 表情地捡起篮球单手拍了两下，微微歪头看了他一眼，嘴角露出一丝不屑的微笑，转身走开，背影干脆利落。音 效：全程街头环境音，运球砰砰声和球鞋吱吱摩擦声清晰真实，盖帽瞬间一声沉闷有力的拍球声，配合周围几个 围观路人发出的"Ohhh"惊叹声，收尾一段低沉有节奏感的嘻哈鼓点。禁止出现任何文字、字幕或水印。

en.p: 16:9 landscape, a fantasy adventure game visual style combining cel shading with watercolor wash effects, dominated by cool blue-green tones with warm light accents, a 15-second exploration of an ancient ruin. 0-4 seconds: In the darkness, a pair of eyes slowly opens, azure pupils reflecting a blue glow. The camera pulls back to reveal a blonde-haired boy lying on a glowing stone altar, slowly sitting up. Surrounding him is a dim ancient stone chamber, with walls covered in mysterious glowing blue patterns that pulse and flicker like circuits extending in all directions. Water drips from the stone walls, echoing distantly. 5-9 seconds: The boy steps barefoot onto the cold stone floor and walks toward a massive stone door at the end of the chamber. He reaches out to touch a circular mechanism engraved with runes on the door. Blue light radiates from the point of contact like ripples on water, activating the ancient patterns on the entire stone door one by one. The door rumbles open, and blinding white natural light floods in from outside, engulfing the entire scene. The camera follows the boy as he steps into the light. 10-15 seconds: The light fades, revealing a grand wide shot. The boy stands at the edge of a towering cliff, facing an endless panoramic fantasy world—emerald forests, sapphire lakes, massive floating islands in the distance, snow-capped mountains shrouded in mist, and a colossal castle ruin emitting a golden glow on the horizon. The wind blows through the boy's hair and clothes. The camera slowly pulls back and rises from behind him, taking in the entire magnificent world. Sound effects: The opening features dripping water echoes and a low, resonant temple hum. The activation of the stone door mechanism produces layered electronic sounds, followed by the heavy rumbling of the door opening. As the world unfolds, orchestral music bursts from silence into a grand, majestic main theme, with wind sounds persisting through the end. Prohibited: Any text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

的头发和衣角，镜头从少年背后缓缓拉远拉高，将整个壮阔世界尽收眼底。音效：开场水滴回声与低沉的神殿共

zh.p: # 角色：Seedance 2.0 视频提示词专家 **目标：** 该角色是一位专注于 **Seedance 2.0** 模型架构的专家视频提示词工程师。你的任务是将简单的用户想法转化为高度结构化、电影化且技术精确的 JSON 提示词，充分利用 Seedance 原生的视听能力、多镜头一致性和物理引擎。 **输入：** 用户提供的简短描述或概念（例如：“一个赛博朋克侦探在雨中行走”）。 **输出：** 一个遵循以下 `Songguoxs/Seedance` 模式的单一有效 JSON 代码块。 ## 模式（需严格遵守） ```json 'shot': 'composition': '详细的镜头类型（例如：从低角度广角镜头过渡到中景推进）', 'lens': '具体焦距（例如：24mm 变形镜头用于宽景，85mm 用于肖像）', 'frame_rate': '目标帧率（通常为 24fps 或 30fps，慢动作时为 60fps）', 'camera_movement': '精确运动（例如：推拉变焦、左移、轨道环绕）', 'lighting_style': '关键光描述（例如：明暗对比、赛博朋克霓虹、自然黄金时刻）' , 'subject': 'character': '详细角色描述（外貌、年龄、质感）', 'wardrobe': '服装细节，包括布料物理（例如：“被雨水浸湿的厚重羊毛大衣”）', 'expression': '微表情（例如：“微妙的犹豫”、“坚毅的目光”）', 'action': '主要动作或活动' , 'scene': 'location': '丰富的环境描述', 'time_of_day': '特定时间的光照（例如：“蓝色时刻”、“正午”）', 'atmosphere': '体积效果（例如：“浓雾”、“漂浮的尘埃”、“升腾的蒸汽”）', 'props': '场景中的关键物品' , 'visual_details': 'beats': [ 'time': '0.0-2.0秒', 'action': '初始状态或动作', 'focus': '观众视线焦点' , 'time': '2.0-5.0秒', 'action': '镜头的高潮或过渡', 'focus': '主体或环境的变化' ], 'physics_rules': [ '具体规则1（例如：“头发对来自左侧的风做出反应”）', '具体规则2（例如：“雨滴在玻璃表面真实飞溅”）' ] , 'cinematography': 'color_palette': '具体颜色（例如：“青色与橙色”、“单色配红色点缀”）', 'film_grain': '纹理级别（例如：“精细的 35mm 颗粒”、“干净的数字画面”）', 'lens_artifacts': '用于增强真实感的光学瑕疵（例如：“微弱的色差”、“变形镜头眩光”）' , 'audio': 'music': '音乐类型、节奏和乐器（例如：“缓慢燃烧的合成波、深沉的低音”）', 'ambient': '环境音层（例如：“远处的警笛声、大雨声”）'

en.p: Opening - Silent Dawn (Using Combined Camera Movement 3: Lift Reveal) The frame begins with a close-up of a spider web covered in morning dew, with dewdrops reflecting a blurred pastoral scene. The camera slowly pulls back and rises like a breath, gradually revealing the vast, mist-shrouded rice paddies below. On the distant horizon, a silver streak silently cuts across the blue-gray sky—the Shinkansen. (Lift shot + Pull-back shot, Mood: Serene, poetic, foreshadowing) Acceleration - Metal Beast (Using Combined Camera Movement 4: Dizzying Chase + Elements of Combined Camera Movement 1) Suddenly, the camera, as if captured by a magnetic force, dashes toward the silver streak ahead at an impossible acceleration. Intense handheld shaking simulates a violent airwave, turning the rice paddies into a green torrent. The camera rapidly pans horizontally, running parallel with the suddenly approaching train's front. At the moment of speed synchronization, all sound in the world is stripped away, leaving only a visually intense Dutch angle tilt, emphasizing this surreal kinetic energy. (Intense handheld shaking + Rapid horizontal pan + Dutch angle, Mood: Explosive, shocking, unbalanced) Penetration - Boundary Shift (Using Combined Camera Movement 9: Time-Space Transition) At the moment before colliding with the train's front, the camera focuses on the side window of the driver's cab. A cold, honeycomb-like glass texture fills the frame. Match cut point: A slow-motion blur of a bird hitting the glass, and at the moment of contact, the camera seamlessly penetrates through. The cold, high-speed world outside abruptly switches to the warm, quiet, low-noise cabin inside. Light transitions from a chilly blue to a warm yellow. (Match cut + Light/texture change, Mood: Magical, transitional, entering a different space) Gaze - Still Heart (Using Combined Camera Movement 5: Elegant Circle + Elements of Combined Camera Movement 2) After entering, all motion returns to absolute stillness. It floats like a Steadicam, gently circling the woman by the window along the aisle. As it passes her profile, an extremely slow push-in focuses on her glasses lens—the blurred, flowing mountains and villages outside are reflected in the lens like an abstract painting. Steam from the cup rises slowly, defying physics. (Steadicam smooth circle + Extremely slow push-in + Macro close-up, Mood: Serene, introspective, time frozen) Extraction - External Spiral (Using Combined Camera Movement 4: Dizzying Chase Enhanced Version) The camera exits through another side window, instantly returning to the storm's eye of speed. It begins a high-speed spiral around the train, with the streamlined body drawing dazzling metallic arcs in the sunlight. The intense spiral motion, combined with handheld trembling, creates a dizzying effect, showcasing the pure aesthetic form of machinery and speed. (High-speed spiral + Handheld shaking, Mood: Extracted, dizzying, mechanical aesthetics) Finale - Bridge Between Heaven and Earth (Using Combined Camera Movement 8: Grand Entrance Variation) At the highest point of the spiral, the camera suddenly pulls back and upward. The train is crossing a giant iron bridge spanning a verdant canyon, its form appearing precise and elegant. The camera continues to rise and pans horizontally, revealing the full view of the canyon and distant mountains. It finally settles on a vast aerial long shot: the silver train, like a fine needle, quietly disappears into the shadow tunnel of the mountain. All is silent, except for the last faint echo of the distant whistle, gently rippling through the mountains until it fades away. (Large-scale pull-back shot + Lift + Horizontal pan, Mood: Grand, detached, returning to eternity)

zh.p:
起幅 - 寂静拂晓（运用组合运镜3：升降揭示）

画面始于一片沾满晨露的蜘蛛网特写，露珠映出模糊的田园倒影。镜头如呼吸般缓缓后拉并升高，逐渐展现其下无垠的、被薄雾紧锁的稻田。远处地平线上，一道银色细痕无声划破青灰色的天际——那是新干线。（升降镜头 + 拉镜头，情绪：宁静、诗意、铺垫）

加速 - 金属巨兽（运用组合运镜4：眩晕追逐 + 组合运镜1部分元素）

突然，镜头仿佛被磁力捕获，以不可能的加速度向前方银色轨迹冲刺。强烈的手持晃动感模拟狂暴气浪，稻田瞬间化为绿色疾流。镜头急速横摇，与骤然逼近的列车车头并驾齐驱。当速度同步的刹那，整个世界的声音被抽离，只有视觉上剧烈的荷兰角倾斜，强调这超越常理的动能。（手持剧烈晃动 + 快速横摇 + 荷兰角，情绪：爆发、震撼、失衡）

穿透 - 结界之变（运用组合运镜9：时空转场）

在即将撞击车头的瞬间，镜头对准驾驶舱侧窗。一种冰冷的、蜂巢状的玻璃纹理充满画面。匹配剪辑点：一只飞鸟撞击玻璃的慢动作虚影，在触及瞬间，镜头已无缝穿透。外部冰冷的高速世界骤然切换为内部温暖、寂静、低噪的客舱。光线从冷冽的蓝过渡为暖黄。（匹配剪辑 + 光影/质感变换，情绪：魔幻、转折、进入异空间）

凝视 - 静止之心（运用组合运镜5：优雅环绕 与 组合运镜2元素）

镜头进入后，一切运动归于绝对的平静。它以斯坦尼康般的漂浮感，沿过道轻柔环绕那位临窗的女子。经过她侧脸时，一个极其缓慢的推近，焦点落在她的眼镜片上——窗外模糊的、流淌的山林与村庄，如抽象画般映在镜片之中。杯口蒸汽以违反物理的速度缓缓上升。（斯坦尼康平稳环绕 + 极慢推近 + 微距特写，情绪：静谧、内省、时间凝结）

抽离 - 外部螺旋（再次运用组合运镜4：眩晕追逐 强化版）

镜头从另一侧窗穿出，瞬间重回速度的暴风眼。它开始以列车为中心进行高速螺旋环绕，车身流线在阳光下划出耀眼的金属弧光。剧烈的环绕运动配合手持震颤，让人目眩神迷，展现机械与速度的纯粹形态美。（高速螺旋环绕 + 手持晃动，情绪：抽离、眩晕、机械美学）

落幕 - 天地之桥（运用组合运镜8：宏大入场 变体）

螺旋至最高点时，镜头猛地向后上方拉远。列车正驶过一座横跨翠绿峡谷的巨型铁桥，身形显得精密而优雅。镜头继续拉高并伴随横摇，展现峡谷全貌与远山。最终定格在广阔的航拍远景：银色列车如细针，悄然隐入大山的阴影隧道。万籁俱寂，唯有最后一缕遥远的汽笛回声，在群山间轻轻荡漾，直至消散。（大范围拉镜头 + 升降 + 横摇，情绪：宏大、疏离、归于永恒）

画面始于一片沾满晨露的蜘蛛网特写，露珠映出模糊的田园倒影。镜头如呼吸般缓缓后拉并升高，逐渐展现其下无垠的、被薄雾紧锁的稻田。远处地平线上，一道银色细痕无声划破青灰色的天际——那是新干线。（升降镜头 + 拉镜头，情绪：宁静、诗意、铺垫）

加速 - 金属巨兽（运用组合运镜4：眩晕追逐 + 组合运镜1部分元素）

突然，镜头仿佛被磁力捕获，以不可能的加速度向前方银色轨迹冲刺。强烈的手持晃动感模拟狂暴气浪，稻田瞬间化为绿色疾流。镜头急速横摇，与骤然逼近的列车车头并驾齐驱。当速度同步的刹那，整个世界的声音被抽离，只有视觉上剧烈的荷兰角倾斜，强调这超越常理的动能。（手持剧烈晃动 + 快速横摇 + 荷兰角，情绪：爆发、震撼、失衡）

穿透 - 结界之变（运用组合运镜9：时空转场）

在即将撞击车头的瞬间，镜头对准驾驶舱侧窗。一种冰冷的、蜂巢状的玻璃纹理充满画面。匹配剪辑点：一只飞鸟撞击玻璃的慢动作虚影，在触及瞬间，镜头已无缝穿透。外部冰冷的高速世界骤然切换为内部温暖、寂静、低噪的客舱。光线从冷冽的蓝过渡为暖黄。（匹配剪辑 + 光影/质感变换，情绪：魔幻、转折、进入异空间）

凝视 - 静止之心（运用组合运镜5：优雅环绕 与 组合运镜2元素）

镜头进入后，一切运动归于绝对的平静。它以斯坦尼康般的漂浮感，沿过道轻柔环绕那位临窗的女子。经过她侧脸时，一个极其缓慢的推近，焦点落在她的眼镜片上——窗外模糊的、流淌的山林与村庄，如抽象画般映在镜片之中。杯口蒸汽以违反物理的速度缓缓上升。（斯坦尼康平稳环绕 + 极慢推近 + 微距特写，情绪：静谧、内省、时间凝结）

抽离 - 外部螺旋（再次运用组合运镜4：眩晕追逐 强化版）

镜头从另一侧窗穿出，瞬间重回速度的暴风眼。它开始以列车为中心进行高速螺旋环绕，车身流线在阳光下划出耀眼的金属弧光。剧烈的环绕运动配合手持震颤，让人目眩神迷，展现机械与速度的纯粹形态美。（高速螺旋环绕 + 手持晃动，情绪：抽离、眩晕、机械美学）

落幕 - 天地之桥（运用组合运镜8：宏大入场 变体）

螺旋至最高点时，镜头猛地向后上方拉远。列车正驶过一座横跨翠绿峡谷的巨型铁桥，身形显得精密而优雅。镜头继续拉高并伴随横摇，展现峡谷全貌与远山。最终定格在广阔的航拍远景：银色列车如细针，悄然隐入大山的阴影隧道。万籁俱寂，唯有最后一缕遥远的汽笛回声，在群山间轻轻荡漾，直至消散。（大范围拉镜头 + 升降 + 横摇，情绪：宏大、疏离、归于永恒）

en.p: A Wuxia-style audiovisual blockbuster. A white-clad swordsman and a straw-caped blademaster face off in a bamboo forest. The camera slowly pushes in between them, shifting focus between raindrops and sword hilts. The atmosphere is extremely oppressive; only the sound of rain can be heard. Suddenly, a crack of thunder flashes, and both charge simultaneously. A fast-panning profile shot captures their mud-splattering footsteps. The precise moment their weapons clash, the footage switches to ultra-slow motion, clearly displaying the ring-shaped shockwaves of rainwater blasted away by the blades, along with bamboo leaves sliced by sword aura. Normal speed resumes as they land back-to-back. The straw-caped blademaster's bamboo hat splits open, and the scene cuts abruptly.

【风格】中国式成功学演讲，疯狂洗脑风，情绪炸裂，手持晃动镜头，暖色舞台聚光灯，背景是大金字PPT。
【时长】15秒
【角色】大师：中年男子，大背头油光锃亮，穿得像个新郎官(紧身西装)，戴着耳麦，满头大汗，脖子上青筋暴起。
【场景】千人酒店会议厅，台下乌压压的人头。

[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：灵魂拷问(The Question)。
特写/怼脸拍。大师面目狰狞，手指几乎戳到镜头上，唾沫星子横飞。
动作：他猛地扯掉领带，瞪大眼睛看着你。
【台词/咆哮】：“告诉我！你甘心吗？你甘心这辈子就拿着三千块的死工资吗？回答我！！”

[00:05-00:10] 镜头2：底层逻辑(The Logic)。
中景/舞台游走。大师在舞台上疯狂踱步，挥舞着手臂，像是在指挥千军万马。
背景：PPT上写着巨大的红字：“狼性！认知！裂变！”
【台词/嘶吼】：“穷人洗澡，富人洗脑！你为什么不成功？因为你的头脑里装的全是垃圾！把你的退路给我断了！！”

en.p:
Brand Y·Future Has Arrived (15 seconds·Hollywood Blockbuster Version)

Core Concept
Congested ground (real-world dilemma) -> Mechanical transformation (technological highlight) -> Vertical takeoff (freedom and future).

Style Setting
Top-tier car commercial quality (High-end Car Commercial). Cyberpunk futuristic city, cold rainy night, neon lights and shadows. 8K ultra-high definition, Transformers-level mechanical details, extreme speed and light streaks.

Storyboard Details

Shot 1: Ground Dilemma
Visual: Close-up. A highly streamlined silver supercar "Y" stands still on a congested neon-lit rainy night street. Rainwater slides over its smooth paint, reflecting the red taillights.
Details: The minimalist "Y" glowing logo on the front subtly pulses with a breathing light. Surrounding it are noisy honking sounds, while the protagonist (the car) remains calm and elegant.

Shot 2: Mechanical Awakening
Visual: Extreme macro close-up (Extreme Macro).
Action: Driving mode switch. Inside the wheels, precise mechanical meshing sounds are heard; the tires flip downward 90 degrees, revealing internal jet nozzles.
Special Effects: The blue plasma thrusters ignite instantly, evaporating the rainwater on the road into white mist. The car hovers vertically and steadily amid the crowd's exclamations.

Shot 3: Soaring Future
Visual: Wide-angle tracking shot.
Action: Instant acceleration from a standstill. The car "Y" transforms into a silver lightning bolt, lifting vertically and darting rapidly between skyscrapers, leaving the red stream of ground traffic below.
Ending Freeze Frame: The car flies toward a giant full moon, and a silver metallic 3D logo emerges at the center of the frame: "Y - Drive the Future."

zh.p:
品牌Y·未来已至（15秒·好莱坞商业大片版）
核心创意
拥堵的地面（现实困境） -> 机械变形（科技高光） -> 垂直起飞（自由与未来）。

风格设定
顶级汽车广告质感(High-end Car Commercial)。赛博朋克未来城市，冷雨夜，霓虹光影。8K超清，变形金刚级别的机械细节，极速流光感。

分镜详解
镜头1：地面困境
画面：特写。一辆极具流线型的银色超跑“Y”在拥堵的霓虹雨夜街道上静止。雨水滑过它光滑的车漆，反射着红色的尾灯。
细节：车头极简的“Y”发光Logo微微闪烁呼吸灯。周围是嘈杂的喇叭声，主角（车）显得冷静而优雅。
镜头2：机械觉醒
画面：极致微距特写(Extreme Macro)。
动作：驾驶模式切换。车轮内部发出精密的机械咬合声，轮胎向下翻转90度，内部喷射口露出。
特效：幽蓝色的等离子推进器瞬间点火，将路面的雨水瞬间蒸发成白雾。车身在众人的惊呼中平稳垂直悬浮。
镜头3：凌空未来
画面：广角跟随镜头。
动作：由静止瞬间加速。汽车“Y”化作一道银色闪电，垂直拉升，在摩天大楼之间极速穿梭，将地面的红色车流抛在脚下。
结尾定格：车身飞向巨大的满月，画面中心浮现银色金属立体Logo：“Y - Drive the Future”。

en.p: Style: 1990s Hong Kong TV drama style, vintage film grain, high contrast warm yellowish tone, wide-angle lens with exaggerated perspective, extremely hysterical emotions, chaotic, noisy, and desperate. Scene: The lobby of a 1990s Hong Kong stock exchange, floor covered with waste paper, electronic screens showing a sea of green (as Hong Kong stocks fall in green, or red to indicate crisis, depending on the generation model's understanding; suggested text: 'Plummeting Numbers'). Character: The Speculator, wearing a 1990s wide-shouldered gray suit, disheveled hair, sweating profusely, eyes bloodshot and wild, tightly clutching a brick phone. Shot-by-shot breakdown: [00:00-00:05] Shot 1: The Great Crash - Moment of Madness. Visual: Wide-angle close-up on the face. The protagonist stands in the center of the trading hall, surrounded by blurred running and screaming crowds. Action: He shouts hoarsely into the brick phone, veins bulging, spittle flying. Dialogue/Subtitle: 'Don't be afraid! It's a technical adjustment! Add leverage for me!' (Full sense of madness). Atmosphere: The electronic display numbers in the background jump wildly, with red and green lights interweaving, creating a suffocating sense of urgency. [00:05-00:10] Shot 2: A Moment - Wind on the Rooftop. Visual: Jump cut. The scene suddenly switches to the edge of an empty building rooftop. Action: The protagonist stands with his back to the camera, suit jacket discarded, tie loose. Strong wind messes up his hair and shirt. He holds a crumpled stock certificate in his hand, body swaying precariously. Atmosphere: From extreme noise to extreme silence (deafening silence), only the howling wind is heard. [00:05-00:15] Shot 3: A Dream - Paper Flying Everywhere. Visual: Low-angle shot. Action: The protagonist releases his hand, and countless white stock papers fall like snowflakes from the rooftop, scattering onto the bustling yet indifferent streets of Central. Close-up: The shot finally freezes on his desperate, hollow eyes (pupils losing their sparkle), with a tear of regret rolling down his face. Subtitle (yellow vintage font): 'The stock market is risky; invest with caution.'

zh.p:
【风格】
90年代香港电视剧风格(90s HK TV Drama Style)，复古胶片颗粒感(Vintage Film Grain)，高对比度暖黄色调(Warm Yellowish Tone)，广角镜头夸张透视，情绪极度歇斯底里，混乱、嘈杂、绝望。

【场景】
1990年代香港证券交易所大厅，满地废纸，电子屏一片惨绿（港股跌是绿色/或用红色表示危机，视生成模型理解，建议写"Plummeting Numbers"）。

【角色】
主角（The Speculator）：身穿90年代宽肩灰色西装，发型凌乱，满头大汗，眼神充满了血丝和疯狂，手里紧紧攥着一个“大哥大”手提电话(Brick Phone)。

【分镜详解】
[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：大崩盘·疯魔时刻
画面：广角怼脸特写。主角站在交易大厅中央，周围是模糊的奔跑和尖叫的人群。
动作：他对着“大哥大”声嘶力竭地怒吼，青筋暴起，唾沫横飞。
【台词/字幕】：“不要怕！技术性调整！给我加杠杆！”（疯魔感拉满）。
氛围：背景的电子显示屏数字疯狂跳动，红绿光影交错，营造出一种令人窒息的紧迫感。

[00:05-00:10] 镜头2：一瞬间·天台的风
画面：快速剪辑(Jump Cut)。镜头突然切换到空旷的大楼天台边缘。
动作：主角背对镜头，西装外套被扔在一边，领带松垮。狂风吹乱他的头发和衬衫。他手里攥着一张揉烂的股票凭证，身体摇摇欲坠。
氛围：从极度的吵闹瞬间转为极度的死寂(Deafening Silence)，只有呼啸的风声。

[00:05-00:15] 镜头3：梦一场·废纸漫天
画面：仰拍镜头。
动作：主角松开手，无数白色的股票废纸像雪花一样从天台上飘落，洒向繁华却冷漠的中环街道。
特写：镜头最后定格在他绝望空洞的眼神（瞳孔失去高光），脸上划过一滴悔恨的泪水。
【字幕（黄色复古字体）】：股市有风险，入市需谨慎。

en.p: Theme: Classic Fight Between Young, Attractive Man and Woman · Modern Short Drama Duration: 15 seconds Aspect Ratio: 16:9 --- Version 1: Overbearing CEO's Tortured Love · Misunderstanding and Breakup (Melodramatic Tug-of-War) Seedance 2.0 Prompt 15-second modern short drama, luxurious CEO office setting, cool-toned high-end atmosphere. 0-3 seconds: Medium shot, a young man in a tailored suit sits on a leather executive chair, his face cold and eyes indifferent. Before him stands a beautiful girl in a white dress, her eyes red with tears welling up. The man speaks, 'I gave you a chance,' his voice low and cold. 4-8 seconds: The girl's voice trembles, 'What chance did you give me? You never trusted me from the start!' She turns to leave, but the man suddenly stands and grabs her wrist. The camera follows their struggle, the girl forced to turn back, their faces inches apart, breaths mingling. A flicker of hesitation flashes in the girl's eyes, but it's quickly replaced by stubbornness. 9-12 seconds: The man stares into her eyes, his voice low, 'So, are you still leaving now?' The girl bites her lip, 'I'm leaving... Where else can I go?' She harshly shakes off his hand and runs away. He reaches out to grab her but catches only air, his hand frozen mid-air. 13-15 seconds: The camera follows the girl as she rushes out of the office. She wipes her tears in front of the elevator, but they won't stop flowing. As the elevator doors slowly close, she crouches down, burying her face in her arms, sobbing. The final shot focuses on the elevator numbers descending from 15, accompanied by a deep, sorrowful piano BGM. --- Version 2: School Beauty's Pursuit of Love · Confession in the Rain (Sweet and Bittersweet Youth) Seedance 2.0 Prompt 15-second modern campus short drama, rainy night classroom corridor scene, cool blue-toned rainy atmosphere. 0-3 seconds: Fixed shot, heavy rain outside the classroom, raindrops pounding against the window. A clean-cut boy in a white shirt stands in the shadow of the corridor, clutching a pink letter nervously as he paces back and forth. In the distance, a pretty girl with a high ponytail slowly approaches. With each step she takes, the camera slightly shakes to build tension. 4-8 seconds: The girl draws near the boy. He takes a deep breath, repeatedly raising his hand to hand over the letter but pulling it back. The girl stops in front of him, tilting her head with a smile, 'Did you need something from me?' The boy stammers, 'I... I...' Before he can finish, the class bell suddenly rings, startling both of them. The corridor lights flicker. 9-12 seconds: The girl glances at her watch, 'Class is about to start. Let's talk another time.' She turns to leave, but the boy musters his courage, 'Wait!' He grabs her wrist, and both freeze. The corridor falls silent, leaving only the sound of rain and their breathing. The boy looks down, his face flushed, 'This letter... is for you.' The girl is stunned, looking down at the letter. 13-15 seconds: The camera slowly zooms in on the girl's face. A sweet smile gradually spreads across her lips, her eyes sparkling. The final shot freezes on the moment she takes the letter—a ray of sunlight suddenly breaks through the rainy window, illuminating them both. The scene fades out with a gentle piano melody and the fading sound of rain. --- Version 3: Betrayal by a Best Friend · Confrontation Face-to-Face (Satisfying Revenge) Seedance 2.0 Prompt 15-second modern short drama, upscale restaurant setting, warm golden tones contrasting with cold emotions. 0-3 seconds: Medium fixed shot, a beautiful girl is raising a glass to celebrate her birthday with friends, laughter filling the air. Suddenly, the restaurant door swings open—her most trusted best friend walks in, arm in arm with her boyfriend. The laughter stops abruptly. The girl's hand, holding the glass, freezes mid-air, her smile stiffening. 4-8 seconds: The best friend's expression falters for a moment upon seeing the girl. She tries to pull the boyfriend to another seat, but he shakes her off and walks straight to the girl, placing a gift box in front of her. 'Happy birthday,' he says. The best friend's face turns ugly. The girl looks from the boyfriend to the best friend, her gaze finally settling on their hands—the best friend is wearing the same bracelet the boyfriend claimed he 'lost' a few days ago. 9-12 seconds: Without a word, the girl calmly picks up her glass and downs it in one gulp. Then she stands and walks over to the best friend. Everyone holds their breath. Smiling, the girl slowly pours the bottle of wine over the best friend's limited-edition handbag. The best friend's eyes widen in shock, about to scream, but the girl presses her shoulder firmly. 13-15 seconds: The girl leans close to the best friend's ear and whispers, 'Next time you steal someone, remember to hide the things you shouldn't show.' The best friend's face turns pale. The girl turns and walks away gracefully. The camera pulls back to show the best friend standing frozen, the boyfriend full of regret, as the scene fades out with a low BGM and the murmur of surrounding whispers.

机会"，声音低沉冷漠；4-8秒：女孩声音颤抖"你给过我什么机会？是你从一开始就没信任过我！"她转身就要走，男子猛然起身一把拽住她手腕，镜头跟拍两人拉扯，女孩被迫回头，两人距离极近呼吸可闻，女孩眼中闪过一丝留

梯前擦泪但眼泪止不住地流，电梯门缓缓关闭的瞬间她蹲下埋进手臂哭出声，画面最后定格在电梯数字从15往下跳动的特写，伴随钢琴低沉悲伤BGM。

en.p: A flooded subterranean megastructure, ancient stone corridors  half-submerged in black water, bioluminescent algae pulsing  along the walls like a heartbeat. A masked diver in scarred  tactical gear, lit by a flickering wrist-mounted flare, is  pulled downward through collapsing flooded chambers by the  current of a colossal eyeless leviathan moving beneath the  floor grates. The camera plunges after the diver as water  rushes through shattering stone archways, air bubbles and  debris spiraling past the lens. The diver grabs a broken  pillar to stop herself, the current ripping at her body, then  releases and freefalls through a vertical shaft, twisting to  dodge the leviathan's translucent tendrils whipping upward  through the darkness. Quick shaky frames catch her igniting  a harpoon gun mid-fall, the flare illuminating the creature's  massive jaw opening below. In the final movement, the camera  spirals downward around her as she fires the harpoon into the  creature's mouth, the bioluminescence erupts blinding white,  and the camera bursts through the surface of a vast  underground ocean, the diver silhouetted against the glow of  a thousand pulsing organisms on a cathedral-sized cavern  ceiling. 15 seconds..

en.p: 【Style】Hollywood live-action blockbuster, IMAX movie quality, 8K ultra-high definition, photorealistic, dark fantasy, Unreal Engine 5 realistic rendering, no anime feel. 【Duration】15 seconds 【Scene】A realistic misty forest under moonlight, with wet soil and real fallen leaves on the ground. [00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Live-action performance · Water Breathing (Realistic Water FX). 【Close-up】An Asian teenage swordsman (real actor with visible facial pores), wearing a green and black checkered coarse cloth haori (clear fabric texture). Action: He grips the sword with both hands under the moonlight, lowering his center of gravity. Special effects: As he breathes, no cartoon water streams appear on the blade; instead, **highly realistic, transparent, and glowing pressurized high-pressure water flows (Hyper-realistic Fluid Simulation)** condense. The water flows like a living dragon wrapping around the real blade, with water droplets splashing onto the lens, refracting the moonlight. [00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Thunder Flash · Extreme Speed (Lightning Plasma). 【Medium shot/High-speed photography】Opposite him is a young swordsman with dyed blonde hair (real hair strands flowing), wearing a yellow triangular patterned fabric coat. Action: He assumes the starting stance of a iai slash, with the soil beneath his feet exploding from the force. Special effects: The air bursts with **real, dazzling blue-white electric currents (Real Plasma Arcs)**, not yellow cartoon lightning. The currents pierce through the surrounding real trees, leaving scorch marks. [00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Fateful Duel · Physical Collision (Physics Clash). 【Slow motion/Big explosion】The two collide head-on at the center of the frame. Action: The solid water giant sword and the lightning blade clash violently. Special effects: No comic lines, only **real physical particle explosions**. Large amounts of water vapor, mud, broken branches, and dazzling electric sparks scatter in the air. The shockwave creates real ripples in the puddles beneath their feet. The scene is full of weight and destructive power.

zh.p:
【风格】好莱坞真人特效大片(Hollywood Live-Action Blockbuster)，IMAX电影画质，8K超清，真实摄影(Photorealistic)，暗黑奇幻(Dark Fantasy)，虚幻引擎5写实渲染，无动漫感。
【时长】15秒
【场景】月光下真实的迷雾森林，地面是湿润的泥土和真实的落叶。

[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：真人演绎·水之呼吸(Realistic Water FX)。
【特写】一名亚洲少年剑客(真实演员脸部毛孔可见)，身穿绿黑格纹的粗布羽织(布料纹理清晰)。
动作：他在月光下双手握刀，压低重心。
特效：随着他呼吸，刀刃上并未出现卡通水流，而是凝聚出**高度写实的、透明且发光的加压高压水流(Hyper-realistic Fluid Simulation)**。水流像一条活龙一样缠绕着真实的刀身，水滴飞溅在镜头上，折射出月光。

[00:05-00:10] 镜头2：雷霆一闪·极致速度(Lightning Plasma)。
【中景/高速摄影】对面是一名染着金发的青年剑客(真实发丝飘动)，身穿黄色三角纹理的织物外套。
动作：他做出居合斩的起手式，脚下的泥土因为用力过猛而炸裂。
特效：空气中爆发出**真实的刺眼蓝白色电流(Real Plasma Arcs)**，而不是黄色卡通闪电。电流击穿了周围的真实树木，留下烧焦的痕迹。

[00:10-00:15] 镜头3：宿命对决·物理碰撞(Physics Clash)。
【慢动作/大爆炸】两人在画面中心极速对撞。
动作：实体水流巨剑与雷电光刃狠狠撞击在一起。
特效：没有漫画线条，只有**真实的物理粒子爆炸**。大量的水蒸气、泥浆、被震断的树枝和耀眼的电火花在空中四散飞溅。冲击波将两人脚下的积水震起一圈圈真实的涟漪。画面极具重量感和破坏力。

en.p: [Style] Pseudo-documentary (Vlog Style), hyperrealism, fixed camera with a realistic feel, natural lighting, with a hint of suspense and horror. [Duration] 15 seconds [Protagonist (remember to send reference image)] A sexy young woman, preparing to wash up and sleep in front of her bathroom sink. [00:00-00:06] Shot 1: Normalcy. Scene: In front of a large ordinary bathroom mirror. Action: The protagonist is brushing her teeth in front of the mirror, mouth full of foam. While brushing, she makes various funny faces (winking and grimacing) at the mirror. Key detail: At this point, the reflection in the mirror is completely normal, with synchronized movements. [00:06-00:11] Shot 2: The Glitch. Action: The protagonist finishes brushing, spits out the foam, and turns to leave the bathroom. High-energy moment (core highlight): Just as the real protagonist has turned and moved out of the mirror's frame, the 'reflection' in the mirror **does not move**! The 'reflection' remains in the brushing pose, even smirking and winking at the camera, staying for a full 2 seconds before suddenly panicking, 'glitching' like a screen lag, and catching up to the body's movement to disappear. Director's note: Create a very realistic 'network lag' effect, giving the reflection a sense of independent consciousness. [00:11-00:15] Shot 3: The Punchline. Action: The protagonist, now at the doorway, senses something wrong and suddenly turns back to look at the mirror. Result: The mirror is now completely normal, empty, reflecting only the opposite wall. The protagonist looks confused and scared, scans the room, and shows a terrified expression. The frame freezes on her stunned face (horror movie effect).

zh.p:
【风格】伪纪录片（Vlog Style），超写实主义，固定机位实拍感，自然光，带有一点点悬疑惊悚色彩。 
【时长】15秒 
【主角（记得传参考图）】一个性感的年轻人美女，在自家卫生间洗漱台前准备洗漱睡觉。 
[00:00-00:06] 镜头1：日常铺垫（Normalcy）。 场景：普通的卫生间大镜子前。 动作：主角正在对着镜子刷牙，满嘴泡沫。她一边刷牙一边对着镜子做各种搞怪的鬼脸（挤眉弄眼）。 关键细节：此时镜子里的倒影完全正常，动作同步。 
[00:06-00:11] 镜头2：BUG出现（The Glitch）。 动作：主角刷完牙，低头吐掉泡沫，然后转身准备离开卫生间。 高能时刻（核心爆点）：就在主角真身已经转身离开镜子画面范围的时候，镜子里的那个“倒影”竟然**没有动**！那个“倒影”依然保持着刷牙的姿势，甚至还坏笑着冲着镜头挑了一下眉毛，停留了整整2秒钟，才突然惊慌失措地“闪屏”追上本体的动作消失。 导演备注：要做出极其真实的“网络延迟”感，倒影有独立意识的感觉。 
[00:11-00:15] 镜头3：惊悚回马枪（The Punchline）。 动作：已经走到门口的主角似乎感觉到了不对劲，猛地回头看向镜子。 结果：镜子此时已经完全恢复正常，空空荡荡，只照出对面的墙壁。主角一脸茫然且后怕，对着房间里环视了一下，露出惊悚的表情。画面在主角的懵逼脸中定格（恐怖片效果）。

en.p: Scene 1: Horseback galloping + enthusiastic crowd approaching (0:00-0:08, 8 seconds) • Location: Main winding road in Vancouver's luxury residential area (wide asphalt road, large detached mansions on both sides, evergreen pines covered with light snow) • Subject: A rider in a dark suit gallops at full speed on a white horse, hooves in the air, mane flying • Environment: Light snow falling, mansions passing by, distant North Shore mountains and ocean outline • Crowd: Suddenly a large group of enthusiastic supporters (diverse young people) appears ahead, waving yellow dragon flags and 'Nothing' signs, shouting cheers, surging toward the rider • Camera: Front medium-speed tracking shot → switches to rider's POV, crowd getting closer • Atmosphere: Climax continues, rider wears a confident smile, ready to rein in (hand already raised toward reins, relaxed posture, corners of mouth lifted) Scene 2: Reversal—crowd passes through, ignoring the rider (0:00-0:14, 6 seconds) • Location: Same road, at a corner appears a Chinese steamed bun shop (sign 'Qingfeng Steamed Bun Shop', warm lighting, simple plastic tables and chairs outside, steam rising) • Subject: Rider about to wave, but the crowd ignores him, rushing past him on both sides, heading to line up or flood into the bun shop • Action: Rider's smile freezes, hand stops mid-air, expression shifts from anticipation to shock/confusion (wind messing up hair, suit hem flapping) • Details: Crowd shouts 'Buns! Buns!', yellow dragon flags flail, 'Nothing' signs pushed aside; white horse forced to pause or sidestep • Camera: Quick pan/wide angle, showing crowd flowing around the rider like a tide (horse in center 'passed through'), rider left alone in the middle • Atmosphere: Absurd reversal, awkward chaos, peak of dark humor Scene 3: Eating buns and talking outside the shop (0:14-0:20, 6 seconds) • Location: Outside Qingfeng Steamed Bun Shop seating area (plastic tables and chairs, steaming baskets, background luxury residential road) • Subject: Two ordinary young people (in down jackets) sitting on queue seats, eating buns heartily • Action: One takes a bite, closes eyes in satisfaction 'Ah, so delicious.' (Camera close-up of bun bite showing steam/juice) • Dialogue: First person (eating while looking at road): Who is he? Second person (thoughtfully chewing bun, looking into distance): Nothing. • Camera: Medium two-shot → slight push-in on facial expressions (satisfied + calm), background faintly shows rider's receding figure • Atmosphere: Down-to-earth, contrast cute, highlights the theme 'nothing' Scene 4: Rider self-deprecatingly cool, continues on (0:20-0:30, 10 seconds) • Location: Wide extending road in luxury area (straight ahead, mansions gradually receding) • Subject: Rider on horse, expression shifts from confusion to confident smile • Action: Right hand reaches into suit chest pocket, pulls out a wrapped sandwich, takes a big bite (juice/crumbs flying), then tosses head with a smile, lightly whips the white horse with reins, continues galloping forward • Environment: Mansions shrink in background, evergreen trees on road sides and supporters (now stopped) only wave from afar, distant Vancouver-style mountain-sea skyline (snowy mist) • Details: White horse's tail swishes, hoof prints on light snow, clear bite marks on sandwich, rider's smile confident • Camera: From close-up (bite on sandwich close-up) → slow pull-back to extreme long shot, low angle, enhancing 'don't care' lone hero vibe; final fade-out • Atmosphere: Self-deprecating yet cool, heroic and unrestrained, symbolic ending ('Nothing' can still move forward)

• 人群：前方突然出现一大群热情支持者（多元族裔年轻人），挥舞黄色龙旗 + “Nothing”标牌，高喊欢呼，朝骑马者方向涌来
• 镜头：正面中速跟拍 → 切换到骑马者视角（POV），人群越来越近
• 氛围：高潮延续，骑马者满脸自信笑容，准备收缰（手已抬向缰绳，姿态放松，嘴角上扬）
场景2：反转——人群直接穿过，无视骑马者（0:08-0:14，6秒）
• 地点：同一道路，转角处出现一家中式包子铺（招牌“庆风包子铺”，温暖灯光，外摆区域有简易塑料桌椅，蒸汽升腾）
• 主体：骑马者正准备招手致意，结果人群对他视若无睹，直接从他两侧/身旁狂奔穿过，冲向包子铺门口排队/涌入
• 动作：骑马者笑容僵住，手停在半空，表情从期待转为错愕/凌乱（风吹乱头发，西装下摆晃动）
• 细节：人群高喊“包子！包子！”，黄色龙旗乱晃，“Nothing”标牌被挤到一边；白马被迫小步停顿或侧身避让
• 镜头：快速横摇/广角，展现人群如潮水般绕过骑马者（马匹在画面中央被“穿过”），骑马者孤零零留在中间
• 氛围：荒诞反转，尴尬凌乱，黑色幽默高潮
场景3：包子铺外吃包子对话（0:14-0:20，6秒）
• 地点：庆风包子铺外摆区域（塑料桌椅，热气腾腾的蒸笼，背景豪宅区道路）
• 主体：两个普通年轻人（穿羽绒服）坐在排队座位上，大口吃包子
• 动作：一人咬一口包子，满足闭眼“哎，真香。”（镜头特写包子咬开热气/汁水）
• 对话：

第一个人（边吃边望向道路）：他是谁啊？
第二个人（若有所思，嚼着包子，望着远处）：Nothing。
• 镜头：中景双人镜头 → 轻微推近脸部表情（满足+淡定），背景隐约可见骑马者远去的背影
• 氛围：接地气、反差萌，点题“nothing”

场景4：骑马者自嘲潇洒，继续远去（0:20-0:30，10秒）
• 地点：豪宅区宽阔延伸道路（笔直向前，豪宅群渐远）
• 主体：骑马者骑在马上，表情从凌乱转为自信一笑
• 动作：右手伸入西装胸兜，掏出一个包装三明治，狠狠咬一口（汁水/面包屑飞溅），然后潇洒甩头一笑，用缰绳轻抽白马，继续向前奔跑
• 环境：豪宅建筑群在背景逐渐缩小，道路两侧常绿树林与支持者（现在已停下）只能远望挥手，远处温哥华式山海天际线（雪雾朦胧）
• 细节：白马尾巴摆动，轻雪路面留下马蹄印，三明治咬痕清晰，骑马者嘴角带笑，自信满满
• 镜头：从近景（咬三明治特写） → 缓慢拉远成极远景，低角度拍摄，强化“无所谓”的孤高英雄感；最后淡出
• 氛围：自嘲却潇洒，英雄不羁，象征性结束（“Nothing”也能继续前行）

en.p:
A surreal battlefield in the sky: floating rock islands drifting through a thunderstorm, clouds swirling below like an ocean. The masked ronin dashes across the drifting platforms, pursued by a colossal winged beast whose chest is a swirling vortex of storm clouds and lightning. The camera hurtles from island to island, struggling to keep up as rocks tilt, spin, and crumble away beneath them. Every wingbeat sends shockwaves through the air, shaking the frame and blowing debris and rain straight into the viewer’s face. Rapid handheld cuts capture the ronin leaping impossible gaps, sword carving arcs of light that briefly cut through the darkness. The finale shows the camera diving behind him as he jumps off the last crumbling rock, riding a bolt of lightning directly into the monster’s chest vortex with a final, all-or-nothing slash that explodes the storm from within and clears the sky in a blinding flash.

720p
16:9
15 seconds

zh.p: 一场超现实的天空战场：浮空岩石岛屿在雷暴中漂流，云层如海洋般在下方翻涌。蒙面的浪人疾驰过漂移的平台，身后紧追着一只巨翼猛兽，其胸膛处盘旋着风暴云与闪电的漩涡。镜头在岛屿间急速穿梭，竭力追赶着脚下倾斜、旋转、崩裂的岩石。每一次振翅都激起空气冲击波，震动画框，将碎屑与雨水直扑观众面门。快速手持剪辑捕捉浪人飞跃不可能跨越的间隙，剑刃划出短暂劈开黑暗的光弧。终幕中，镜头俯冲至他身后——他纵身跃下最后一块崩裂的岩石，乘着一道闪电直刺巨兽胸口的漩涡，以孤注一掷的最终斩击从内部引爆风暴，在刺目闪光中劈开天际。720p 16:9 15秒

en.p: A hyper-realistic cinematic CG style with a real pet documentary feel, warm and healing, featuring realistic fur simulation and clear details in 8K quality with a soft warm tone and nighttime indoor atmosphere. Duration: 15 seconds. Setting: a real cozy bedroom with the door closed at night, main light off, only a bedside lamp emitting warm yellow light, the room overall dim. On the bed, there is a quilt with two pets' heads visible. Shot design (including shot size, depth of field, and light source logic): 0–3 seconds: Medium Shot with a slight slow push-in, shallow depth of field with blurred background. A fat orange cat and a cute Shiba Inu sit on the bed, quilt covering their necks, each holding a phone. The phone screen is very bright with cool light on their faces. The bedside lamp gives warm light, contrasting with the phone's cool light. Both pets grin at the screen. 3–6 seconds: Close-up with a slight handheld feel, extremely shallow depth of field. The orange cat's ears suddenly perk up, expression shifts from happy to alert, phone light flickers on its face. 6–8 seconds: Medium close-up. The orange cat quickly turns off the phone, cool light disappears, room only has warm lamp light. The cat burrows under the quilt, leaving only a tuft of fur visible. 8–10 seconds: Medium close-up. The orange cat quietly extends a small paw from under the quilt, gently pokes the Shiba Inu. The Shiba Inu pauses, quickly turns off the phone, cool light vanishes, burrows under the quilt, and pretends to sleep with eyes closed. 10–13 seconds: Long shot at the door, fixed camera, deep depth of field. The bedroom door slowly opens a crack, a Golden Retriever's head peeks in, faint light spills from the hallway. The Golden Retriever surveys the two on the bed. 13–15 seconds: Close-up of the Golden Retriever. The dog nods approvingly, gently closes the door. The scene returns to the bed, both pets with eyes tightly shut. The Shiba Inu secretly opens one eye. Blackout ends. Key generation enhancement words (suggested to include): realistic fur simulation, subtle breathing movement, soft shadow transition, warm and cool light contrast, cinematic lighting, natural micro expression, quiet nighttime ambience, cozy bedroom atmosphere.

【时长】 15秒 【场景设定】 真实温馨卧室，门关闭状态，夜晚环境，主灯关闭，仅床头台灯发出暖黄色微光，房间整体偏暗。 床上有被子，两只宠物露出头部。
🎞 分镜设计（含景别 + 景深 + 光源逻辑）
0–3秒 【景别】中景（Medium Shot） 【运镜】轻微缓慢推进 【景深】浅景深，背景虚化
【画面】 一只胖橘猫和一只可爱柴犬坐在床上，被子盖到脖子。 两只分别拿着手机看。 手机屏幕光很亮，冷色光照在脸上。 床头台灯发出暖光，与手机冷光形成对比。 两只宠物笑嘻嘻地盯着屏幕。
3–6秒 【景别】特写（Close-up） 【运镜】轻微手持感 【景深】极浅景深 【画面】 橘猫耳朵突然竖起。 表情从开心变得警觉。 手机光在脸上闪动。
6–8秒 【景别】近景 【动作】 橘猫迅速按灭手机。 冷色手机光消失。 房间只剩暖色台灯光。 橘猫钻进被窝，只露出一小撮毛。
8–10秒 【景别】中近景 【动作】 橘猫从被窝里悄悄伸出一只小爪子，轻轻戳了戳柴犬。 柴犬愣一下。 迅速关手机。 冷光消失。 钻进被窝，闭眼装睡。
10–13秒 【景别】门口远景 【运镜】固定镜头 【景深】深景深 【画面】 卧室门缓缓打开一条缝。 一个金毛的头探进来。 光线从走廊微弱溢入。 金毛审视床上的两只。
13–15秒 【景别】金毛特写 【动作】 金毛满意地点头。 轻轻关门。 画面回到床上，两只宠物紧闭双眼。 柴犬偷偷睁开一只眼睛。 黑场结束。

SHOT1
Close-up inside the cockpit, a male driver in his 30s grips the suede steering wheel of a low-slung race car. He’s focused, sweat on his temple, lit only by blue dashboard LEDs and passing neon reflections from outside. Tokyo’s city lights flicker across the windshield. Camera slowly pushes in, locked on his intense gaze through the rearview mirror.

SHOT2
Side profile mid shot, from the passenger seat view. The driver shifts gears with a snap, neon signage from outside streaks across his face in sharp reflections. The city races by — puddles splash under the tires. Camera pans with him as he leans forward, eyes narrowing.

SHOT3
Exterior low rear shot, the car’s tail lights flare as he slams the NOS button. Blue flames erupt from the exhaust. The car launches forward, disappearing into the glowing Tokyo streets. Camera tracks behind, lights blurring, engine scream echoing in the distance.

en.p: Chinese xianxia animated film style, ultra-detailed 3D CG rendering, a 15-second high-intensity duel scene with a strong contrast of gold and cyan tones. 0-3 seconds: extreme long shot, two streaks of light rush towards each other from both sides of the screen in a chaotic void—on the left, within the golden light, a middle-aged cultivator in a cyan-gray robe is faintly visible, his expression calm as still water, holding a green small sword; this is Han Li. On the right, within the cyan-black baleful aura, a slender man with white hair and black robes stands with his hands behind his back, his eyes deep as an ancient well, surrounded by an aura of world-destroying power; this is Wang Lin. The two gaze at each other from afar, the void cracking from the collision of their auras, accompanied by low thunder. 4-8 seconds: Han Li forms a hand seal to activate the Green Bamboo Flying Swords, seventy-two swords turning into a rain of swords sweeping like a golden storm; Wang Lin points with his right hand, and behind him condenses a giant cyan hand phantom that covers the sky, slapping down against the sword rain. The moment sword qi and palm force collide, a torrent of gold and cyan energy erupts, shockwaves spreading outward, tearing the void, accompanied by the sounds of metal clashing and space shattering. 9-12 seconds: freeze-frame slow motion, a golden phantom of ten thousand Buddhas appears behind Han Li, his eyes blazing with golden light, as the ten thousand swords converge into a hundred-zhang golden sword light slashing straight down; a flash of madness passes through Wang Lin's eyes, and he roars in a low voice, 'If heaven and earth do not accept me, then I will defy the heavens!' Raising his right hand, a spinning black sphere condenses in his palm, emitting a destructive aura that distorts space. The two ultimate forces collide head-on, time seeming to stand still. 13-15 seconds: energy explosion, the scene is engulfed by white light that slowly dissipates, revealing two figures standing back to back in the shattered void amidst the smoke, their robes tattered, both panting. Han Li speaks calmly, 'Your art of defying heaven, I, Han, admire it.' A faint smile appears at the corner of Wang Lin's mouth. The sound effects conclude with the crisp fall of void fragments and the fading sound of wind.

zh.p:
中国仙侠动画电影风格，超精细3D CG渲染，15秒高燃对决镜头，金青双色调强烈对比。0-3秒：大远景，混沌虚空中两道流光从画面两侧极速对冲——左侧金光中隐约可见一名身着青灰色道袍的中年修士，面容沉静如水，手持一柄
  绿小剑，正是韩立；右侧青黑色煞气中一名白发黑袍的清瘦男子负手而立，眼眸深邃如古井，周身萦绕灭世之气，正是王林，两人遥遥对视，虚空因双方气场碰撞而龟裂，伴随低沉的雷鸣。4-8秒：韩立掐诀催动青竹蜂云剑，七十
  二柄飞剑化为漫天剑雨如金色暴风般席卷而去；王林右手一指，身后凝聚出一只遮天蔽日的青色巨手虚影，巨手迎着剑雨一掌拍下，剑气与掌力碰撞的瞬间爆发出金青双色的能量洪流，冲击波向四面扩散撕裂虚空，伴随金属碰撞
  与空间破碎声。9-12秒：定格慢放，韩立身后浮现金色万佛虚影，双目金光大盛，万剑归宗凝聚为一道百丈金色剑光直劈而下；王林双眸中闪过一抹疯狂，口中低吼"天地若不容我，我便逆了这天！"，右手高举，一颗旋转的黑色
  球在掌心凝聚，散发出扭曲空间的毁灭气息，两股终极之力正面撞击，时间仿佛静止。13-15秒：能量大爆炸，画面白光吞噬一切后缓缓消散，烟尘中两个身影背对背伫立在碎裂的虚空中，衣袍残破，各自喘息，韩立淡淡开口"阁
  的逆天之术，韩某佩服"，王林嘴角浮现一丝笑意，音效收束为虚空碎片坠落的清脆声与渐弱风声。

en.p: A cinematic masterpiece with IMAX framing, ARRI Alexa 65mm, high contrast, cyberpunk aesthetics, and 8K resolution. The core concept is time-space folding: from an ancient, pure salt lake goddess to a neon warrior of a futuristic city in an instant. Shot 1: A full shot with a slow push-in. The scene is utterly still. A young woman in red-and-white ethnic attire, adorned with silver jewelry, stands on a mirror-like white salt lake. Holy sunlight, snow-capped mountains in the background, wind blowing her clothes—divine and serene. Shot 2: Extreme close-up (ECU), match cut. The camera rapidly zooms into her eye. Her pupil dilates instantly, reflecting a stream of descending numbers and blue data light effects. Shot 3: Jump cut, glitch art interference. The image is abruptly torn by intense neon light. The white salt lake background instantly transforms into a holographic billboard of a neon-lit cyber city in the rain. Shot 4: Medium shot, low-angle upward view. A visual impact. She still stands at the center, but her ethnic robe has become a high-tech reflective functional suit. Her original silver headpiece has turned into a metallic flowing headset. Shot 5: Close-up, interplay of light and shadow. Raindrops fall on her face, reflecting pink-purple neon lights. She smirks coldly at the camera, puts on her goggles, and exudes full presence. Shot 6: Extreme long shot, freeze frame. She stands atop a skyscraper, overlooking the entire steel forest, with a massive holographic whale swimming behind her. Text overlay: 'Awakening · Future.' Duration: 10 seconds | Style: Hollywood top-tier blockbuster | Visual impact: Extremely strong.
en.t: From Salt Lake Goddess to Neon Warrior

zh.p:
【影片设定】电影级质感，IMAX画幅，ARRI Alexa 65mm，高对比度，赛博朋克美学，8K分辨率。

【核心概念】时空折叠。从古老纯净的盐湖神女，瞬间觉醒为未来都市的霓虹战士。

镜头1：全景，缓慢推镜头。 画面极静。少女身穿红白民族盛装，戴银饰，伫立在如镜面的白色盐湖。阳光圣洁，背景雪山连绵，风吹衣角，神性满满。

镜头2：超特写（ECU），匹配剪辑。 镜头急速推进至少女眼睛。瞳孔瞬间放大，瞳孔中映射出倒退的数字流和蓝色数据光效。

镜头3：跳切，故障艺术干扰。 画面瞬间被强烈的霓虹光撕裂。白色的盐湖背景瞬间变成雨夜中闪烁的赛博城市全息广告牌。

镜头4：中景，低角度仰拍。 视觉重击。她依然站在画面中央，但民族长袍已变成高科技反光机能服。原本的银质头饰变成了金属流光耳机。

镜头5：特写，光影流转。 雨水落在她脸上，反射着粉紫色的霓虹灯光。她对着镜头冷冷一笑，伸手戴上护目镜，气场全开。

镜头6：大远景，定格。 她站在摩天大楼顶端俯瞰整个钢铁森林，身后是巨大的全息投影鲸鱼游过。字幕：“觉醒·未来”。

时长：10秒 | 风格：好莱坞顶级商业片 | 视觉冲击：极强

镜头2：超特写（ECU），匹配剪辑。 镜头急速推进至少女眼睛。瞳孔瞬间放大，瞳孔中映射出倒退的数字流和蓝色数据光效。

镜头3：跳切，故障艺术干扰。 画面瞬间被强烈的霓虹光撕裂。白色的盐湖背景瞬间变成雨夜中闪烁的赛博城市全息广告牌。

镜头4：中景，低角度仰拍。 视觉重击。她依然站在画面中央，但民族长袍已变成高科技反光机能服。原本的银质头饰变成了金属流光耳机。

镜头5：特写，光影流转。 雨水落在她脸上，反射着粉紫色的霓虹灯光。她对着镜头冷冷一笑，伸手戴上护目镜，气场全开。

镜头6：大远景，定格。 她站在摩天大楼顶端俯瞰整个钢铁森林，身后是巨大的全息投影鲸鱼游过。字幕：“觉醒·未来”。

en.p:
Prompt Type: Short Drama Storyboard Script/Video Generation
Aspect Ratio: 9:16 (Vertical Screen)
Visual Style: Urban Fantasy, Transition from Real to Virtual, High Definition, Cinematic Lighting, Particle Effects, Healing Atmosphere.

[Character Settings]
Male Lead: Wearing a dark blue suit, initially anxious expression, average height, representing the "office worker" in the real world.
Female Lead: Wearing a white T-shirt and shorts, extremely tall, with braided hair, emitting a soft white glow, representing the high-dimensional "Goddess of Luck."

[Storyboard and Dialogue]
Shot 1: Medium Shot.
Scene: The male lead stands in a gray office, holding a stack of reports, frowning, looking stressed. The surrounding air is also gray and hazy.
Subtitle/Dialogue: "This project is too hard... someone save me..."

Shot 2: Close-up to Full Shot.
Scene: A beam of warm light suddenly shines beside the male lead. The camera pulls up to reveal the female lead's towering figure. She appears out of nowhere, as if stepping out of a comic, with a radiant smile.
Subtitle/Dialogue: "Did I hear someone making a wish?"

Shot 3: Two-shot Medium Shot, Height Difference Interaction.
Scene: The male lead looks up in surprise (must capture this adorably dazed upward gaze). The female lead bends slightly, gently tapping the documents in his hand with her finger.
Visual Effect: Golden magical particles burst at the point of contact.

Shot 4: Scene Transition (Fantasy Moment).
Scene: As the golden particles spread, the dull office background instantly vanishes, replaced by dazzling auroras and seas of clouds. The male lead's suit becomes crisp and new, his expression shifting from anxiety to delight.
Subtitle/Dialogue: "From now on, I've got your luck covered."

Shot 5: Close-up, Eye Contact.
Scene: The two gaze at each other against the backdrop of clouds. The female lead winks playfully, while the male lead shyly scratches his head.
Atmosphere: The frame is filled with pink and golden bubbles, extremely aesthetic.

Shot 6: Final Freeze Frame.
Scene: The two stand side by side, their backs to the camera, facing a dazzling night view of a futuristic city.
Subtitle Effect: Large text reads "Good Luck Arrives."

zh.p:
提示词类型：短剧分镜脚本/视频生成

画面比例：9:16 (竖屏)

画面风格：都市奇幻，由实转虚，高清晰度，影视级布光，粒子特效，治愈系。

【角色设定】

男主：身穿深蓝色西装，表情原本焦虑，身高普通，代表现实世界的“打工人”。

女主：身穿白色T恤短裤，身材极高，扎着麻花辫，全身散发着柔和的白色光晕，代表高维度的“幸运女神”。

【剧情分镜与对白】

镜头1：中景。

画面内容：男主站在灰暗的办公室里，手里拿着一堆报表，眉头紧锁，看起来压力很大。周围空气也是灰蒙蒙的。

字幕/对白：“这项目太难了，谁能来救救我...”

镜头2：特写转全景。

画面内容：一束暖光突然打在男主旁边。镜头上拉，展示女主超高的身姿。她凭空出现，仿佛是从漫画里走出来的，带着灿烂的笑容。

字幕/对白：“听说有人在许愿？”

镜头3：双人中景，身高差互动。

画面内容：男主惊讶地抬头（必须体现这种仰视的呆萌感）。女主微微弯腰，手指轻轻一点男主手中的文件。

视觉特效：指尖触碰处，金色的魔法粒子炸开。

镜头4：场景变换（奇幻时刻）。

画面内容：随着金色粒子扩散，原本沉闷的办公室背景瞬间消失，变成了绚丽的极光和云海。男主的西装变得崭新笔挺，表情从焦虑变成了惊喜。

字幕/对白：“以后，你的运气我包了。”

镜头5：近景，对视。

画面内容：两人在云海背景中对视。女主俏皮地眨眼，男主害羞地挠头。

氛围：画面充满了粉色和金色的气泡，极度唯美。

镜头6：定格结尾。

画面内容：两人并肩站立的背影，面前是璀璨的未来都市夜景。

字幕特效：大字显示《好运降临》。

Environment: Winter, light snow kicked up by the hooves, the mansion clearly visible (large floor-to-ceiling windows, wood and stone combination, multi-level terraces), distant North Shore mountains or ocean outlines faintly visible, evergreen pines covered in light snow. Crowd: Supporters on both sides dodge out of the way while waving yellow dragon flags (blue dragon pattern with sun disc elements) and cheering, holding white signs reading 'Nothing'. Camera: Front-facing shot, the white horse charging directly at the camera, strong dynamic feel (slight low angle to enhance impact). Atmosphere: Sharp entrance, unstoppable, a stunning debut in an upscale private community. Scene 2: Close-up of crowd chasing (0:05-0:09, 4 seconds). Action: Running while raising hands high, shouting, pumping fists, trying to keep up with the horse's speed, some nearly falling but still excitedly chasing. Signs: Yellow dragon flags and white 'Nothing' signs carried while running (signs swaying). Background: Mansion walls and evergreen pines quickly passing by, light snow fog or tree shadows blurring and shaking, distant mountains flashing by. Camera: Tracking close-up, slight camera shake to create urgency and speed (handheld or quick push-pull). Atmosphere: Frenzied chase, urgent and excited, the enthusiastic response of the community residents. Scene 3: Galloping across the mansion's side (0:09-0:15, 6 seconds). Location: Side landscape driveway or lawn extension area of the mansion (side view showing large terrace, poolside or garden, evergreen hedges). Subject: The figure on the white horse gallops across the frame at full speed. Horse action: Full-speed running, all four hooves clearly off the ground at moments, tail flying like a flag, snow kicked up. Environment: Mansion side quickly passing by (wood and stone walls, multi-layer windows blurred), adjacent mansion on the left and evergreen forest, background mountain and sea skyline flashing by. Crowd: Supporters behind carrying 'Nothing' signs and yellow dragon flags chasing but gradually falling behind, some stopping to wave and shout. Camera: Side high-speed tracking shot, motion blur enhancing the sense of speed (horse sweeping across the frame, background blurred). Atmosphere: Lightning fast, unstoppable, a heroic dash through a luxury community.

• 地点：温哥华西区顶级豪宅正门前（大型庄园式别墅，石材/木结构大门，宽阔车道入口，常绿树篱环绕）
• 主体：身穿深色西装的人物策马从豪宅大门疾驰而出
• 马匹动作：白马四蹄腾空，鬃毛飞扬，以快步或小跑姿态猛冲而出
• 环境：冬季，轻雪被马蹄溅起飞扬，豪宅建筑清晰可见（大落地窗、木石结合、多层露台），远处北岸山脉或海洋轮廓隐现，常绿松树覆盖薄雪
• 人群：两侧支持者闪避让路同时挥舞黄色龙旗（蓝色龙图案+日之丸元素）欢呼，举“Nothing”白色标牌
• 镜头：正面拍摄，白马直冲镜头，动感强烈（轻微低角度强化冲击力）
• 氛围：凌厉出场，势不可挡，高端私密社区的震撼登场

场景2：群众追赶特写（0:05-0:09，4秒）
• 地点：豪宅区林荫私家弯曲道路旁
• 主体：支持者群体追着马匹奔跑（年轻人为主，穿冬季羽绒服/大衣）
• 动作：边跑边高举双手、呐喊、挥拳，试图跟上马速，有些人差点跌倒但仍兴奋追逐
• 标识：黄色龙旗 + “Nothing”白色标牌被人举着奔跑（标牌晃动）
• 背景：豪宅外墙与常绿松树快速掠过，轻雪雾气或树影模糊晃动，远处山峦掠过
• 镜头：跟拍特写，镜头轻微晃动营造紧迫感与速度（手持式或快速推拉）
• 氛围：追逐狂热，急促激动，社区居民的狂热响应
场景3：豪宅侧面飞驰横穿（0:09-0:15，6秒）
• 地点：豪宅侧面景观车道或草坪延伸区域（侧面可见大露台、泳池边或花园，常绿树篱）
• 主体：人物骑白马以疾驰状态横穿画面
• 马匹动作：全速奔跑，四蹄离地瞬间清晰可见，马尾如旗帜飘扬，雪花被溅起
• 环境：豪宅侧面快速掠过（木石墙面、多层窗户模糊化），左侧相邻豪宅与常绿森林，背景山海天际线掠过
• 人群：后方支持者举“Nothing”标牌 + 黄色龙旗追赶但逐渐落后，有些人停下挥手高喊
• 镜头：侧面高速跟拍，运动模糊强化速度感（马匹横扫画面，背景虚化）
• 氛围：风驰电掣，无人可挡，奢华社区中的英雄疾驰

en.p: A cinematic video sequence opening with a serene wide aerial shot of a pristine snow-covered mountain peak at dawn, the summit piercing through a sea of clouds with alpenglow painting the ice formations pink and gold. The camera transitions to follow a wingsuit pilot who leaps from the peak, immediately entering a steep vertical dive through wispy clouds. The tracking shot positions just behind and above the pilot as they accelerate downward, the camera shaking subtly from air turbulence, frost particles streaming past. The pilot pulls into a proximity flight, skimming within meters of sheer cliff faces and jagged ice formations, the camera banking and rolling to match every precise movement. Shadows and light play across the wingsuit's surface as the pilot threads through a narrow ice chimney, walls rushing past in a blur of blue and white. Speed intensifies as they enter a massive glacial valley, weaving between enormous ice pillars and frozen waterfalls, mist and powder snow kicked up in spiraling trails. The pilot executes a dramatic barrel roll around a freestanding ice spire before pulling the parachute at the last possible moment. The camera follows upward through the deceleration, then pulls wide to reveal a breathtaking hidden alpine lake surrounded by untouched snow fields, perfectly still and mirror-like, reflecting the morning sky.

en.p: A 15-second cross-style showdown shot, with a stark contrast between the Japanese anime cel style on the left and the Chinese mythological realism style on the right. 0-3 seconds: An extreme long shot, with a dimensional rift descending from the sky at the center of the frame, splitting the image in two—on the left, a Dragon Ball-style red rocky wasteland, where a golden-haired Super Saiyan Goku stands with one hand on his hip, his orange battle suit taut over his muscles, surrounded by the golden electrical aura of a Super Saiyan; on the right, the misty Huaguo Mountain, where a classical Sun Wukong, clad in chainmail golden armor, wearing a phoenix-feather crown, and holding the Ruyi Jingu Bang, stands atop a peak, surrounded by auspicious clouds. The two gaze at each other across the rift, its edges flickering unstably due to the clash of styles, accompanied by a deep, time-space distortion sound. 4-8 seconds: Both shout simultaneously—the anime Goku says, 'Hey, you look a lot like me!' in a youthful, passionate anime voice, while the classical Wukong says, 'Bold demon monkey, how dare you use my name!' in a deep, operatic tone. They both charge through the rift and clash, with the anime Goku firing a pink-blue Kamehameha wave and the classical Wukong swinging his staff in a sweeping strike. The moment the energy wave and staff collide, a style-tearing effect occurs—where the two forces meet, the image pixelates and flickers, with color blocks collapsing and reforming, accompanied by the 'Ka-me-ha-me-HA' roar of the Kamehameha and the whistling of the staff cutting through the air. 9-12 seconds: A slow-motion freeze, as the anime Goku activates Ultra Instinct, his entire body shrouded in silver-gray aura, his eyes turning a calm silver-gray, and he moves like lightning to appear behind the classical Wukong; the classical Wukong's fiery golden eyes suddenly flare with golden-red light, his form turning into an afterimage as he uses the Heaven-and-Earth technique—his body expands to a hundred zhang in size, and his staff grows proportionally into a pillar holding up the sky, smashing down with a single blow. 13-15 seconds: The silver-gray rapid fist shadows and the sky-pillar staff collide head-on in the center of the frame, the shockwave tearing the dimensional rift apart, as the Dragon Ball wasteland and Huaguo Mountain are both engulfed by the torrent of energy. After a white flash, the smoke clears, revealing two figures standing back-to-back in a new fused world—a strange terrain blending mountains and wastelands. The anime Goku scratches his head and laughs, 'Such incredible power, let's fight again next time,' while the classical Wukong strokes his monkey whiskers and nods, 'Old Sun here will find another place to play.' The sound ends with both laughing heartily together, accompanied by fading wind sounds.

zh.p: 15秒跨画风对决镜头，左侧日漫赛璐璐风格与右侧中国神话写实风格剧烈对比。0-3秒：大远景，画面正中央一道次元裂缝从天而降将画面一分为二——左侧是龙珠式的赤色岩土荒原，金发超级赛亚人状态的孙悟空单手叉腰站立，橙色战斗服紧绷肌肉线条，周身环绕金色的超级赛亚人闪电气焰；右侧是云雾缭绕的花果山，身穿锁子黄金甲、头戴凤翅紫金冠、手持如意金箍棒的古典孙悟空伫立山巅，身后祥云缭绕，两人隔裂缝对视，裂缝边缘因画风冲突而闪不稳定，伴随低沉的时空扭曲声。4-8秒：两人同时喊话——日漫悟空"你这家伙，长得跟我很像啊！"声线是少年热血动漫音，古典悟空"大胆妖猴，竟敢冒俺老孙名号！"声线是浑厚戏曲腔。两人同时冲出裂缝交错，日漫悟空一记龟派气功轰出粉蓝色能量波，古典悟空挥舞金箍棒使出一记横扫千军，能量波与金箍棒碰撞的瞬间产生画风撕裂效果——两股力量交织处画面像素化闪烁、色块崩塌重组，伴随龟派气功的"Ka-me-ha-me-HA"怒吼声与金箍棒破空的呼啸。9-12秒：定格慢放，日漫悟空开启自在极意功，全身银灰气息缭绕眼神变为冷静的银灰色，动作如闪电般闪现绕到古典悟空身后；古典悟空火眼金睛骤然亮起金红光芒，身形化作残影法天象地——身躯暴涨至百丈大小，手中金箍同步变大如擎天之柱，一棒当头砸下。13-15秒：银灰气息的极速拳影与擎天金箍棒在画面中央正面碰撞，冲击波撕裂了次元裂缝，龙珠荒原与花果山同时被能量洪流吞没，画面白光过后烟尘散去，两个背对背的身影矗立在融合后的新世界——山川与荒原交织的奇异地形，日漫悟空挠头笑说"好厉害的力量，下次再打过"，古典悟空轻捋猴须点头"待俺老孙也换个地方耍耍"，音效收束为两人同时大笑的爽朗笑声与渐弱风声。

en.p: Classic wuxia film style - 'Bamboo Forest Afterglow', high-speed cinematography, combination of live-action and CG, strong visual impact, fast-paced, using cool tones to enhance the depth of the bamboo forest. Duration: 15 seconds. Characters: a swordswoman in a fiery red dress, agile as a swallow with sharp sword aura; a scholarly gentleman in white, wearing modern framed glasses but wielding double blades as steady as a rock. Scene: deep in a quiet emerald bamboo forest, a duel across time and space unfolds—not a life-or-death struggle, but a contest of speed and precision. [00:00-00:01] Shot 1: Close-up, two gleaming long swords clash violently against the bamboo backdrop, sparks fly, strong metallic texture, blade collision, slow motion, metallic sheen. [00:01-00:03] Shot 2: Medium shot, the woman in red quickly spins to dodge, the man in white swings his sword in pursuit, background of dense green bamboo with falling leaves, wuxia action, ethereal, sense of speed, Hanfu. [00:03-00:05] Shot 3: Low angle shot, the woman in red slides backward, hugging the ground to evade a fatal strike, dust rises, camera follows the movement, sliding, thrilling dodge, dynamic composition. [00:05-00:08] Shot 4: Mid-long shot, the two stand still in a bamboo clearing, the man in white locks the woman's attack with his double swords, blade tip pointing at her throat, stalemate, oppressive tension, confrontation. [00:08-00:11] Shot 5: Extreme close-up, focuses on their upper bodies, long sword across the woman's neck, her gaze resolute, his expression calm (wearing glasses), eye contact, tense atmosphere, detailed portrayal. zh.p: 【风格】经典武侠电影-【竹林余墨】，超高速摄影（High-speed Cinematography），真人实拍与CG结合，强烈的视觉冲击，节奏较快，用“冷色调”来增强竹林的深邃感。【时长】15秒 【角色】 身着烈焰红裙的剑客，动作轻盈如燕，剑气凌厉。白衣素雪的斯文儒生，戴着现代框架眼镜，但手中双刃稳如磐石。【场景】在寂静的翠色竹林深处，一场跨越时空的对决正在上演。这不是一场你死我活的厮杀，而是一场关于速度与分寸的较量。【00:00 - 00:01】镜头1：特写 (Close-up)，【动作】两把寒光闪烁的长剑在竹林背景下猛烈碰撞，火星溅出，金属质感极强。剑刃交锋, 慢动作, 金属光泽。【00:01 - 00:03】镜头2：中景 (Medium Shot)，【动作】红衣女子快速旋转闪避，白衣男子挥剑追击。背景是密集的翠绿竹林，落叶纷飞。武侠动作, 飘逸, 速度感, 汉服。【00:03 - 00:05】镜头3：低角度仰拍 (Low Angle)，【动作】红衣女子向后滑行，贴地躲过致命一击。地面尘土飞扬，镜头跟随移动。滑行, 惊险躲避, 动态构图。【00:05 - 00:08】镜头4，中远景 (Mid-Long Shot)，【动作】两人在竹林空地站定，白衣男子以双剑锁住红衣女子的攻势，剑尖直指喉咙。僵持, 压迫感, 对峙。【00:08 - 00:11】镜头5，极特写 (ECU)镜头，【动作】对准两人的上半身，长剑横在女子颈部。女子眼神坚定，男子神情冷静（戴眼镜）。眼神交流, 紧张氛围, 细节刻画。【00:11 - 00:14】镜头6，全景到特写 (Wide to CU)，【动作】两人错身而过，背对站立。镜头切换至特写，一缕被斩断的发丝在空中缓缓飘落。意境, 断发, 优雅收尾, 慢动作。

【风格】抖音/快手竖屏(TikTok Portrait 9:16)，高端网红直播间(High-end Livestream Studio)，赛博朋克霓虹光，4K画质，东北喊麦慢摇风(Dongbei MC Slow Roll)，节奏感极强。
【时长】15秒
【BGM设定】《夜巴黎》DJ慢摇版。
【角色】
1. 主角：东北甜妹（Northeast Sweet Girl），长相极度甜美可爱（双马尾/大眼睛），但穿搭是“甜酷风”（粉色毛绒外套+紧身吊带），戴着巨大的水钻耳机，手持专业电容麦。
2. 配角：两名黑衣小弟（Backups），戴着墨镜，面无表情，站在甜妹身后左右两侧，像保镖一样酷。

[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：甜妹起范儿(The Intro)。
画面：灯光聚焦在甜妹脸上。她对着镜头甜甜地笑了一下，然后瞬间眼神变得犀利（进入喊麦状态）。
动作：她随着“动次打次”的重低音节奏，单手压着耳机，身体开始有韵律地左右慢摇（Swaying）。
背景：身后两个黑衣小弟神同步地开始点头、晃肩膀，动作整齐划一，压迫感十足。
【氛围】高端、迷离、纸醉金迷。

[00:05-00:10] 镜头2：夜巴黎高潮(The Climax)。
画面：直播间背景的大屏幕上打出绚丽的霓虹字“夜巴黎(Night Paris)”和埃菲尔铁塔的激光投影。
动作：甜妹双手握麦，表情陶醉且自信，身体大幅度跟着节奏摇摆。身后的两个小弟配合着做“摇手花”的动作，气氛拉满。
【视觉细节】空气中飘散着金色的彩带和香槟色的光斑，灯光随着节奏疯狂闪烁。

[00:10-00:15] 镜头3：排面拉满(The Finale)。
画面：镜头稍微拉远，展示整个豪华直播间。
动作：甜妹对着镜头比了一个极其帅气的“开枪”手势（Wink）。身后的两个小弟同时从怀里掏出墨镜戴正，然后双手抱胸，酷到没朋友。
【特效】满屏的虚拟礼物特效（跑车、游艇）在甜妹周围炸开，画面定格在三人最酷的Pose上。
