Ultra-cinematic 15-second rally car race through a rugged mountain dirt road during golden hour, dust and gravel dominating the scene.

0–2s: Wide aerial shot — rally car speeds along a winding dirt road carved into the mountains, dust trail stretching far behind.

2–4s: Low tracking shot — wheels tearing through gravel, rocks flying outward, suspension compressing over uneven terrain.

4–6s: Side angle — car drifts aggressively around a sharp corner, rear sliding wide, thick dust cloud expanding.

6–8s: Front tracking shot — car charges toward camera, headlights flickering through dust, driver barely visible inside.

8–10s: Close-up — tires gripping and slipping, gravel spraying in bursts, strong sense of traction fighting.

10–12s: High-speed section — car accelerates on a straight dirt stretch, slight fishtail corrected instantly.

12–13.5s: Jump moment — car hits a bump and lifts slightly off the ground, suspension extending mid-air.

13.5–15s: Landing + exit — car lands hard, kicks up a massive dust cloud, continues accelerating into the distance.

Camera: dynamic tracking, low angles, aerial + ground mix, slight handheld vibration for realism.

Environment: mountain dirt road, rocks, dust clouds, dry terrain, open landscape.

Lighting: warm golden hour sunlight, long shadows, dust glowing in light.

Style: ultra-cinematic realism, rally physics, aggressive drifting, heavy particle effects (dust, gravel), no text, no overlays, stable proportions without stretch.

zh.p: 超电影级15秒拉力赛车穿越崎岖山间土路，黄金时段拍摄，尘土与碎石主导画面。0-2秒：广角航拍——赛车沿山间蜿蜒土路疾驰，身后扬起长长尘烟。2-4秒：低角度跟拍——轮胎碾过碎石，岩石向外飞溅，悬挂系统在崎岖地形上压缩。4-6秒：侧拍——赛车急弯处猛烈漂移，车尾大幅甩出，浓密尘雾扩散。6-8秒：正面跟拍——赛车冲向镜头，车灯在尘土中闪烁，驾驶员隐约可见。8-10秒：特写——轮胎抓地打滑，碎石间歇喷溅，强烈牵引力对抗感。10-12秒：高速路段——赛车在直道土路上加速，轻微甩尾瞬间修正。12-13.5秒：飞跃瞬间——赛车撞击凸起后微微腾空，悬挂在半空中伸展。13.5-15秒：落地+离场——赛车重重落地，激起巨大尘云，继续加速驶向远方。拍摄手法：动态跟拍、低角度、航拍与地面镜头结合，轻微手持震动增强真实感。环境：山间土路、岩石、尘云、干燥地形、开阔景观。光线：温暖黄金时段阳光、长阴影、尘土在光线中发光。风格：超电影级写实、拉力赛物理、激进漂移、重粒子特效（尘土、碎石）、无文字、无叠加层、稳定比例无拉伸。

raw_p:
Ultra-cinematic 15-second rally car race through a rugged mountain dirt road during golden hour, dust and gravel dominating the scene.

0–2s: Wide aerial shot — rally car speeds along a winding dirt road carved into the mountains, dust trail stretching far behind.

2–4s: Low tracking shot — wheels tearing through gravel, rocks flying outward, suspension compressing over uneven terrain.

4–6s: Side angle — car drifts aggressively around a sharp corner, rear sliding wide, thick dust cloud expanding.

6–8s: Front tracking shot — car charges toward camera, headlights flickering through dust, driver barely visible inside.

8–10s: Close-up — tires gripping and slipping, gravel spraying in bursts, strong sense of traction fighting.

10–12s: High-speed section — car accelerates on a straight dirt stretch, slight fishtail corrected instantly.

12–13.5s: Jump moment — car hits a bump and lifts slightly off the ground, suspension extending mid-air.

13.5–15s: Landing + exit — car lands hard, kicks up a massive dust cloud, continues accelerating into the distance.

Camera: dynamic tracking, low angles, aerial + ground mix, slight handheld vibration for realism.

Environment: mountain dirt road, rocks, dust clouds, dry terrain, open landscape.

Lighting: warm golden hour sunlight, long shadows, dust glowing in light.

Style: ultra-cinematic realism, rally physics, aggressive drifting, heavy particle effects (dust, gravel), no text, no overlays, stable proportions without stretch.

en.p:
First-person perspective, immersive ARPG dialogue scene, single continuous shot.

A small white rabbit adventurer stands directly in front of the camera. Its fur is soft and finely detailed, and its right eye is a glowing red mechanical eye. It reaches out toward the camera in an inviting gesture, with a calm and confident demeanor.

The environment is a vast fantasy world: rolling green grasslands, ruined ancient stone structures, distant mountain ranges, and a lightly smoking volcano. The morning light is soft, the air is clear, and a gentle breeze moves the grass and leaves, creating a strong cinematic atmosphere with depth.

The camera is in first-person view, with slight handheld motion and natural breathing sway. Shallow depth of field, cinematic realism.

The rabbit looks directly into the camera and says:
“Good morning, adventurer. It’s time to set out.”
A semi-transparent game UI (modern ARPG style) appears on the right side:
Alright, let’s go.
Not right now.
Why not?

The cursor moves smoothly twice, pauses for 0.3 seconds, then selects “Why not?”
The rabbit smiles slightly, tilts its head, and responds in a relaxed tone:
“Sure.”
In the next moment, all UI elements (dialogue box, options, health bar, minimap) fade out smoothly, returning the scene to a clean, UI-free world.
The rabbit turns around, its cloak and backpack swaying naturally with physics, and begins walking forward along a stone path.

The camera maintains a first-person follow, with subtle handheld motion, synchronized with the character’s walking rhythm.

While walking, the rabbit raises its hand and points toward the distant horizon (mountains and a faint city silhouette), saying:
“Look, that’s our destination.”
A brief pause of about 0.5 seconds. The wind intensifies slightly, causing more noticeable movement in the grass and clothing, enhancing the epic atmosphere.

The rabbit continues walking and says:
“We have to get there before 8:08 PM.”

The camera slowly pushes forward, focusing toward the distance. The far view transitions from slightly blurred to clear, with a subtle lens flare appearing, reinforcing the sense of a journey beginning and a clear objective.

No subtitles, no background music. Only natural ambient sounds: wind, footsteps, and distant birds.

zh.p: 第一人称视角，沉浸式ARPG对话场景，单次连续镜头。一只小白兔冒险家正站在镜头正前方。它的毛发柔软细腻，右眼是一只发着红光的机械眼。它朝镜头伸出手，做出邀请的姿态，神情平静而自信。环境是一片广阔的奇幻世界：起伏的绿色草原、残破的古代石造建筑、远方的山脉，以及一座冒着轻烟的火山。晨光柔和，空气清澈，微风拂动草地和树叶，营造出强烈的电影感与景深感。镜头采用第一人称视角，带有轻微的手持晃动和自然的呼吸起伏。浅景深，电影级写实风格。兔子直视镜头说道：“早上好，冒险家。该出发了。”右侧浮现半透明的游戏界面（现代ARPG风格）：好的，出发。现在不行。为什么？光标流畅地移动两次，停顿0.3秒，然后选择“为什么？”兔子微微一笑，歪了歪头，用轻松的语气回应：“当然。”下一秒，所有界面元素（对话框、选项、血条、小地图）平滑淡出，场景恢复为干净无界面的世界。兔子转身，斗篷和背包随物理效果自然摆动，开始沿着一条石路向前走去。镜头保持第一人称跟随，带有细微的手持晃动，与角色行走的节奏同步。行走时，兔子抬起手，指向远方的地平线（山脉和一座模糊的城市轮廓），说道：“看，那就是我们的目的地。”短暂停顿约0.5秒。风势稍强，草地和衣物的摆动更加明显，增强了史诗氛围。兔子继续前行，说道：“我们必须在晚上8点08分之前到达那里。”镜头缓缓向前推进，聚焦远方。远景从略微模糊逐渐变得清晰，出现细微的镜头光晕，强化了旅程开始和目标明确的感觉。无字幕，无背景音乐。只有自然的环境音：风声、脚步声和远处的鸟鸣。

en.p:
A lone female archer stands in a quiet mountain valley at dawn, practicing slow, controlled breathing while holding a traditional bow. She wears a flowing dark-green robe with subtle wind-reactive fabric layers. She releases a single arrow → before it lands, multiple masked attackers emerge silently from the fog. She remains still → then pivots with precision, drawing and releasing arrows in rapid succession. Combat sequence: Fluid archery combined with close-range defensive movements. She uses bow strikes, evasive footwork, and controlled spins. Arrows move with subtle motion trails, hitting targets with precise impact. overhead rotating camera shows her centered as attackers close in → arrows create a circular defensive pattern around her → brief slow-motion moment as one arrow splits mid-air into multiple trajectories (realistic, no fantasy exaggeration). 
 
Silence returns. She retrieves the first arrow she fired, plants it into the ground calmly, and lowers her bow. Lighting: soft golden sunrise, light fog, gentle wind through grass. 
Minimal motion trails, dust interaction, realistic arrow physics. Tone: stillness → awareness → precision → quiet control.

zh.p: 黎明时分，一名孤身女弓箭手伫立于寂静的山谷中，手持传统长弓，缓缓练习着受控的呼吸。她身披一袭飘逸的深绿长袍，衣料在微风中泛起细腻的涟漪。她射出一支箭——箭未落地，数名蒙面袭击者已悄然从雾中现身。她纹丝不动，随即精准转身，以迅捷之势连续搭箭拉弓。战斗动作连贯流畅：箭术与近身防御动作无缝衔接。她以弓身格挡、闪避步法、控制性旋转应对突袭。箭矢划过时留下细微轨迹，精准命中目标。俯视旋转镜头中，她始终居于画面中心，袭击者步步逼近——箭矢在她周身形成环形防御阵型——短暂慢镜头中，一支箭在半空分裂出多重轨迹（写实风格，无夸张奇幻元素）。万籁俱寂。她拾回最初射出的那支箭，平静地将其插入地面，缓缓放下长弓。光影：柔和的晨曦金光，薄雾轻笼，微风拂过草地。极简的轨迹特效、扬尘交互、写实的箭矢物理。氛围基调：凝滞→警觉→精准→沉静掌控。

en.p: A 15-second cinematic 2D side-scrolling fighting game scene in Chinese ink-wash anime style, clean and sharp with no noise, high-contrast black ink visuals with red accents, set on a cliff with misty mountains, plum blossoms, and traditional architecture in the background; two characters face each other in a wide shot, left is an aggressive black-robed swordsman and right is a calm white-robed swordsman, with full game UI visible including health bars at the top left and right (no numbers or secondary status bars) and a large countdown timer in the center starting at 15 and decreasing every second in real time; from  to  (timer 15 to 12) the black-robed character dashes forward and performs a fast slash while the white-robed character blocks with a clear guard effect, sparks and ink splash, minimal damage and slight reduction in the white character’s health bar; from  to  (timer 12 to 9) the white-robed character counterattacks with a quick thrust combo, the black-robed character partially blocks but still gets hit, small damage numbers appear and the black character’s health bar decreases slightly with visible hit impact effects and red ink streaks; from  to  (timer 9 to 6) both characters exchange rapid slashes mid-screen, swords collide with sparks and circular ink shockwaves, both health bars decrease moderately; from  to  (timer 6 to 3) the white-robed character dodges sideways with afterimage motion blur while the black-robed character misses a heavy strike and briefly pauses, creating tension; from  to  (timer 3 to 0) the black-robed character activates a powerful ultimate ability with a massive sweeping ink-brush slash and a red energy arc across the screen, the camera slightly zooms in with subtle shake and enters slow motion at the moment of impact as the white-robed character is struck directly, a large damage number appears and the white character’s health bar rapidly drains to zero; final moment shows the timer reaching 0 as the white-robed character collapses or freezes in defeat pose, and bold Chinese characters appear in the center of the screen reading “已击败 白衣客”, with ink particles and red petals drifting in the air, cinematic timing, smooth animation, dynamic camera shake, visible health bar reduction after every hit, and dramatic finishing effect

zh.p: 一段15秒的电影级2D横版格斗游戏场景，采用中国水墨动画风格，画面干净锐利无噪点，高对比度黑色水墨视觉搭配红色点缀，背景设定在悬崖之上，远处有云雾缭绕的山峦、梅花和传统建筑；两个角色以全景镜头对峙，左侧是一名气势汹汹的黑袍剑客，右侧是一名沉稳的白袍剑客，完整游戏UI可见，包括左上角和右上角的血条（无数字或次级状态条），以及屏幕中央一个从15开始每秒实时递减的大型倒计时器；从（计时器15到12秒）黑袍角色向前冲刺并快速挥砍，白袍角色格挡并产生清晰的防御效果，火花与墨迹飞溅，白袍角色血条轻微减少且损伤极小；从（计时器12到9秒）白袍角色以快速突刺连击反击，黑袍角色部分格挡但仍被击中，出现小伤害数字，黑袍角色血条略微下降，伴有明显的命中冲击效果和红色墨迹；从（计时器9到6秒）双方在屏幕中央快速对砍，刀剑碰撞产生火花和圆形水墨冲击波，双方血条均适度减少；从（计时器6到3秒）白袍角色以残影动态模糊侧向闪避，黑袍角色重击落空并短暂停顿，营造紧张感；从（计时器3到0秒）黑袍角色发动强力终极技能，以巨大的横扫水墨斩击和红色能量弧划过屏幕，镜头轻微拉近并伴有细微震动，在命中瞬间进入慢动作，白袍角色被直接击中，出现大伤害数字，白袍角色血条迅速归零；最终时刻显示计时器归零，白袍角色倒地或定格于败北姿态，屏幕中央出现粗体汉字“已击败 白衣客”，空气中飘散着墨粒和红色花瓣，电影级节奏，流畅动画，动态镜头震动，每次命中后血条可见减少，以及戏剧性的终结效果

en.p: A collage of 12 candid, natural emotional snapshots capturing moments of a young Japanese woman traveling solo in Hawaii, shot in the style of spontaneous smartphone photography. Each frame feels like a fleeting private memory—imperfect, sun-drenched, intimate, and unposed. The woman has a naturally curvy figure with soft, gentle lines, and her chest appears natural, not exaggerated. The overall vibe is authentic and unpretentious, like a personal photo album. Scenes include: walking barefoot on the beach, by the seaside under strong sunlight, swaying palm trees, overexposed reflections on the sea surface, a local niche café, a modest motel room, a sunset coastline, a night market, and views from inside a moving car. The shooting texture is smartphone-style—slight motion blur, soft focus, highlight overexposure from tropical sunlight, lens flares, sun reflections, high ISO noise at night, irregular composition, and accidental cropping. The composition is random and casual—the subject is sometimes off-center, partially cropped, in motion, or obscured by light leaks. Lighting varies: harsh midday sun, warm golden hour soft light, rich sunset tones, and humid nighttime street lights. Color palette: cinematic faded tones, slightly desaturated, warm highlights, nostalgic film texture, fine grain, and lifted blacks. Emotional atmosphere: loneliness, fleeting youth, bittersweet nostalgia, quiet introspection, like memories of a solo trip. Layout: 12 photos arranged in a loose, imperfect collage grid, slightly tilted and misaligned, like a scrapbook. No text, no watermark. This is an AI-generated character, with each storyboard frame converted into a video clip and seamlessly connected. An emotional vlog-style video with natural handheld shake. A young foreign woman. Summer seaside background music.

en.p: Camera accelerates forward without stopping. Environments don’t transition cleanly, they tear into each other mid-motion. Desert rips into ocean, ocean into city, city into cavern, layers overlap for split seconds. Objects from different worlds collide in-frame. Camera maintains relentless forward motion through impossible spatial seams. Extreme parallax, no stability. Final second: everything resolves into a single calm environment.

en.p:
A female lone martial artist (Western woman) in an ancient Chinese village, interrupted while drinking tea, fights 10–20 attackers. She wears a clean white karate gi (karate uniform), slightly stylized with subtle historical-fusion elements (light fabric layering for cinematic flow).

She sits calmly at a wooden tea table → attacker slams the table → she slowly rises, calmly deflects the first strike → sudden shift into hyper-fast combat using karate-based strikes, blocks, palm strikes, elbow counters, spinning kicks. Each movement is fluid and precise, with motion trails, dust bursts, and controlled impact waves.
Mid-fight overhead spinning camera shot shows her white gi flowing dynamically, enemies pushed outward in a radial shock pattern → brief slow-motion moment during a mid-air clash, emphasizing balance and precision → then speed resumes as she rapidly finishes remaining attackers.
Final scene: silence returns. She calmly sits back at the wooden table, picks up her tea, and takes a composed sip.
Lighting: soft natural daylight, light mist across the village, glowing dust particles in air, cinematic contrast between calm and chaos.
VFX: subtle motion trails, fabric flow, debris bursts, restrained energy shockwaves.
Tone: calm → explosive precision → slow-motion control → calm resolution.

zh.p: 一位女性独行武者（西方女子）置身于古代中国村落，饮茶时遭十至二十人突袭。她身着素白空手道服，衣料略作历史融合风格的轻纱层叠处理，以增强电影化动态美感。她静坐于木制茶案前——突袭者猛拍案几——她缓缓起身，从容拨开第一击——骤然转入超高速格斗，施展空手道式拳击、格挡、掌击、肘击与回旋踢。每个动作行云流水，精准凌厉，带出运动轨迹、扬尘与可控冲击波。中段俯拍镜头中，白色道服翻飞如浪，敌人呈放射状向外震退——半空交锋瞬间切入慢镜头，凸显平衡与精准——随即恢复高速，迅速击溃剩余敌手。终幕：万籁俱寂。她从容坐回木案前，执盏啜茶。光影：柔和的自然天光，薄雾轻笼村落，空气中浮尘泛光，动静之间形成电影化对比。特效：隐现的运动轨迹、衣袂飘动、碎屑飞溅、克制的能量冲击波。基调：沉静→爆发式精准→慢镜掌控→归于平静。

en.p:
image1's character as the subject (dark superhero with glowing white eyes, batik cape, and smoke aura). The scene and enemy Dutch colonial soldiers on a Javanese street.

0–3s: Wide establishing shot from low angle looking up at the sky. The superhero from image1 hovers mid-air, dark smoke swirling around his body, batik cape flowing in the wind. Below, Dutch soldiers aim their rifles upward and fire. Muzzle flashes erupt. Bullets pass through the superhero harmlessly, dissolving into wisps of black smoke on contact. Camera slowly pushes in toward the floating figure.

4–8s: The superhero descends rapidly from the sky, landing with a heavy impact on the dirt road — a shockwave of black smoke radiates outward. Camera follows with a crane shot tilting down. The soldiers stagger back in fear, scrambling to reload. The superhero stands upright, glowing eyes piercing through the smoke. He begins walking toward the soldiers with supernatural speed.

9–13s: Fast-paced sequence — the superhero dashes from soldier to soldier with blur-speed movement. Each time he touches a soldier with his hand, the soldier instantly disintegrates into black smoke and vanishes completely. One touch, one vanish. Camera uses whip pans between each elimination, tracking the superhero's movement. Three to four soldiers dissolve in rapid succession.

13–15s: Final wide shot — the street is now empty, only lingering black smoke where the soldiers once stood. The superhero stands alone in the center of the road, smoke curling around him, glowing eyes facing the camera. Slow push in to medium close-up. Fade to black.

Style: Cinematic quality, desaturated color grading with warm undertones, 1940s Indonesian colonial atmosphere. Dramatic lighting with volumetric smoke effects.
Sound: Deep ominous bass drone, gunfire sounds at 0–3s, heavy impact boom at 4s, rapid whoosh sounds during the touch-and-vanish sequence, eerie silence at the end with wind ambience.

Extend the scene in this video1. At the end, the dark superhero character raises his hand and destroys all the Dutch soldiers into thick smoke.

zh.p: 以图像1中的角色为主角（黑暗超级英雄，拥有发光的白色眼睛、蜡染披风和烟雾光环）。场景与敌人：爪哇街道上的荷兰殖民士兵。0-3秒：从低角度仰视天空的广角定场镜头。图像1中的超级英雄悬停在空中，黑色烟雾在他身体周围旋转，蜡染披风随风飘扬。下方，荷兰士兵举起步枪向上射击。枪口闪光爆发。子弹无害地穿过超级英雄，接触时化为缕缕黑烟消散。镜头缓慢推进，聚焦于悬浮的身影。4-8秒：超级英雄从天空急速下降，重重落在土路上——一股黑烟冲击波向外扩散。镜头以吊臂拍摄向下倾斜。士兵们惊恐地踉跄后退，慌忙重新装弹。超级英雄站直身体，发光的眼睛穿透烟雾。他以超自然的速度开始向士兵走去。9-13秒：快节奏序列——超级英雄以模糊般的速度从一个士兵冲向另一个士兵。每次他用手触碰士兵，士兵便瞬间化为黑烟，完全消失。一触即消。镜头在每次消灭之间使用快速摇摄，追踪超级英雄的动作。三到四名士兵接连消散。13-15秒：最终广角镜头——街道现在空无一人，只有士兵曾站立的地方残留着黑烟。超级英雄独自站在路中央，烟雾在他周围缭绕，发光的眼睛面向镜头。缓慢推近至中近景。渐黑。风格：电影质感，去饱和色调搭配暖色基调，1940年代印度尼西亚殖民地氛围。戏剧性灯光配合体积烟雾效果。音效：深沉不祥的低音嗡鸣，0-3秒的枪声，4秒的重击轰鸣，触碰即消序列中的快速嗖嗖声，结尾处诡异的寂静伴随风声。在此视频1中扩展场景。结尾处，黑暗超级英雄角色举起手，将所有荷兰士兵摧毁成浓烟。

SHOT 02: Side tracking shot pacing the bike at high speed, perfectly stable line, suspension subtly working over the road surface, reflections sliding across the fairings, controlled power, no erratic movement, photorealistic.
SHOT 03: Rear tracking shot, the motorcycle accelerating hard, exhaust vibration visible, heat distortion behind the bike, strong forward pull, clean high-speed motion.
SHOT 04: Front-facing shot as the bike approaches rapidly in a straight line, rider locked in aerodynamic position, wind pressure visible in slight gear movement, smooth and precise, intense closing speed.
SHOT 05: Close-up on rear wheel under steady acceleration, tire gripping cleanly, subtle deformation under load, no slip, pure traction, asphalt texture crisp, mechanical realism.
SHOT 06: Wide angle shot of the bike carving a long, smooth curve at speed, no aggressive lean extremes, just precise line control, continuous motion, fluid and confident riding.
SHOT 07: Tracking shot alongside the bike as it exits the curve and accelerates harder, engine power building, background stretching into motion blur, stable but intense forward momentum.
SHOT 08: Ultra-low pass-by shot as the motorcycle blasts past the camera at extreme speed, air displacement and motion blur overwhelming the frame, clean trajectory, no instability.
SHOT 09: Long rear shot as the bike continues accelerating into the distance, heat haze trailing behind, road lines compressing visually, sustained speed and control.
SHOT 10: Wide cinematic shot of the open road ahead as the motorcycle disappears toward the horizon, environment calm but charged with residual energy, smooth finish, no chaos.

镜头04：正面拍摄，摩托车沿直线急速逼近，骑手保持空气动力学姿态，风力压迫下装备轻微摆动，动作平滑精准，逼近速度极具压迫感。

en.p:
Shot 1 (0–8s) - Low oblique aerial, approaching across the water: A small lakeside town at night, seen from a low aerial angle gliding just above the water's surface, approaching from the south. The lake is irregularly shaped with a rocky, forested far bank of dense pine trees - no houses on that side. Wooden cabins and a small main street are clustered only along the near western shore, scattered unevenly, warm porch lights glowing and reflecting in the still black water. Crickets chirp, water laps gently against a wooden dock, a distant dog barks once. Camera drifts slowly forward. Suddenly, the water ahead bulges, ripples explode outward, and a massive metallic disc-shaped spaceship rises silently from beneath the surface, water cascading off its smooth hull, blue-white underglow illuminating the lake and the tree line.

Shot 2 (8–15s) - Low ground-level angle from a porch: Cut to a low-angle shot from a wooden cabin porch on the western shore, foreground silhouette of a porch railing and an empty rocking chair. The spaceship hovers above the lake in the mid-distance, humming with a deep bass resonance that rattles windows. One by one, lights flick on in neighboring cabins along the shore. A dog barks frantically. Then, in a sudden flash, the spaceship shoots straight up into the sky with a whoosh and a shockwave ripple spreading across the water, vanishing into the stars. Silence returns. The water settles.

Style tags: cinematic, photorealistic, moody night lighting, anamorphic lens, subtle lens flare, ambient sound design, 24fps film look, irregular natural shoreline, asymmetric composition.

zh.p:
镜头1（0-8秒）——低角度斜向航拍，掠过水面：夜晚的小湖镇，从低空航拍视角掠过水面，自南侧接近。湖泊形状不规则，对岸是岩石密布的松林地带——未见房屋。木屋和小型主街仅聚集在西侧近岸，疏密不均，门廊暖灯在静止的黑色水面上投下倒影。蟋蟀鸣叫，湖水轻拍木码头，远处传来一声犬吠。镜头缓缓前移。突然，前方水面隆起，涟漪炸开，一艘巨大的金属圆盘状飞船无声地从水下升起，水流从光滑船体倾泻而下，蓝白色底光映亮湖面与林际线。

镜头2（8-15秒）——门廊低角度地面视角：切换至西岸木屋门廊的低角度镜头，前景是门廊栏杆和空摇椅的剪影。飞船悬停在湖面中景，发出低沉共鸣的嗡鸣声，震得窗户作响。沿岸邻屋的灯光逐一亮起。一只狗疯狂吠叫。突然，一道闪光中，飞船呼啸着直冲云霄，冲击波在水面扩散开去，消失于星辰之间。万籁俱寂。水面恢复平静。

风格标签：电影感、超写实、阴郁夜景布光、变形镜头、微妙镜头光晕、环境音效设计、24帧电影质感、不规则自然湖岸线、非对称构图。

en.p: Cinematic continuous single-take shot, IMAX film simulation, Panavision C-series 35mm lens, f/4, strong backlighting, heavy shadows, desaturated grey colors. The camera starts with a low-angle shot from behind a battle-worn warrior sitting motionless on a massive black warhorse on dark soil under a dull grey sky. He is wearing black warrior armor. The camera smoothly rises toward his right hand as he violently pulls the reins. The horse rears up, instantly triggering a dramatic bullet-time slow-motion effect. Black-red flames violently erupt from the horse, burning nearby alien insects to ash. The rider's face, mostly in shadow, undergoes a painful, raw transformation: his previously normal eyes ignite with a piercing white-gold flash, leaking thick black smoke. His right palm splits open, erupting with dark blood and twisting nerve-like fibers that solidify into a brutal halberd made of smoke and living tissue. The horse's body fractures with glowing red cracks, channeling lava-like energy up into the rider. Heavy, uneven black bio-mechanical armor pieces aggressively slam onto his body with bursts of red light and intense shockwaves, tearing away his worn clothes. A dark, organic-metal mask violently grows across his face, forming uneven, flickering compound eyes and flaming horns. As bullet time suddenly ends, the camera circles closely into fast-paced brutal combat. The rider aggressively thrusts and sweeps the halberd, impaling and shattering enemies with trails of black smoke and flames. The heavy warhorse spins and charges, crushing alien insects beneath its hooves. Suddenly, the violence ceases

zh.p: 电影级连续单镜头拍摄，IMAX胶片模拟，潘纳维申C系列35毫米镜头，光圈f/4，强逆光，浓重阴影，低饱和度灰色调。镜头以低角度起拍，聚焦于一名身经百战的战士——他静坐在暗灰色天空下、黑色荒土上的一匹巨型黑色战马背上，身披黑色战甲。镜头平稳上升至他右手时，他猛然拉扯缰绳。战马前蹄腾空，瞬间触发戏剧性的子弹时间慢动作特效。黑红色烈焰从马身狂暴喷涌，将附近的外星昆虫焚为灰烬。骑手面部隐于阴影中，正经历痛苦而原始的蜕变：原本正常的双眼骤然迸发出刺目的白金色光芒，渗出浓黑烟雾。右手掌心裂开，喷涌暗红血液与扭曲的神经纤维，凝结成一把由烟雾与活体组织构成的凶残长戟。战马躯体崩裂出赤红裂纹，将熔岩般的能量传导至骑手体内。沉重而不规则的黑金机械装甲碎片裹挟着红光与冲击波，狂暴地撞击在他身上，撕裂残破衣物。一副暗色有机金属面具野蛮地覆上他的脸庞，形成不规则闪烁的复眼与燃烧的犄角。子弹时间骤然终结，镜头急速环绕切入快节奏的残酷搏杀。骑手猛刺横扫长戟，拖曳黑烟与烈焰贯穿粉碎敌人。重型战马旋转冲撞，铁蹄碾碎外星昆虫。杀戮戛然而止。

en.p:
Style: ultra-cute 3D chibi, soft cinematic lighting, high detail, Pixar-like shading, cozy indoor realism, shallow depth of field, smooth animation, 24fps
Scene Setup:
A warm, cozy apartment with wooden floor, soft yellow lighting, glass door with bluish evening light outside. Camera at low eye-level, slightly wide lens.
⏱️ Timeline (4 seconds total)
[0.0 – 1.2s]
The penguin-suit girl stands with a tiny pout, arms stiff, looking slightly annoyed.
The white cat-suit girl smiles brightly, leaning forward a bit, eyes sparkling.
Subtle idle motion: blinking, slight breathing, soft ambient light flicker.
[1.2 – 2.5s]
Cat girl suddenly claps her fluffy hands → soft “pop” sound.
A tiny glowing heart appears between them.
Penguin girl’s expression slowly shifts from grumpy → surprised (eyes widen slightly).
[2.5 – 3.5s]
The glowing heart floats toward penguin girl and gently boops her face.
Her cheeks turn pink, she looks shy and glances away.
Cat girl giggles, bouncing slightly in place.
[3.5 – 4.0s]
Penguin girl softly smiles (very subtle), tiny tail wiggle.
Both characters lean slightly closer together.
End with warm cozy freeze-frame feeling.
Animation Tags:
cute interaction, expressive faces, soft squash & stretch, subtle physics, floating VFX heart, cozy vibe, wholesome energy
Camera:
static with slight handheld micro-movement, gentle focus breathing
Lighting:
warm indoor + cool blue window contrast, soft shadows, skin glow

zh.p: 风格：超萌3D Q版角色，柔和电影级布光，高细节，皮克斯风格着色，温馨室内写实感，浅景深，流畅动画，24帧/秒。场景设定：温暖舒适的公寓，木地板，柔和的黄色灯光，玻璃门外透出淡蓝色暮光。摄像机位于低平视角度，略带广角镜头。⏱️ 时间线（共4秒）[0.0 – 1.2秒] 企鹅装女孩站着，微微嘟嘴，双臂僵硬，表情略显不悦。白猫装女孩灿烂微笑，身体前倾，眼睛闪闪发光。细微的静态动作：眨眼、轻微呼吸、柔和的环境光闪烁。[1.2 – 2.5秒] 猫女孩突然拍打毛茸茸的双手 → 发出轻柔的“啪”声。一颗微小的发光爱心出现在她们之间。企鹅女孩的表情从气鼓鼓慢慢转为惊讶（眼睛微微睁大）。[2.5 – 3.5秒] 发光爱心飘向企鹅女孩，轻轻碰触她的脸颊。她脸颊泛红，害羞地移开视线。猫女孩咯咯笑着，原地轻轻蹦跳。[3.5 – 4.0秒] 企鹅女孩露出淡淡的微笑（非常细微），小尾巴轻轻摆动。两个角色微微靠近彼此。结尾定格在温暖舒适的温馨画面。动画标签：可爱互动、表情丰富、柔和的挤压与拉伸、细腻物理效果、漂浮的爱心特效、温馨氛围、治愈能量。摄像机：静态但带有轻微手持微动，柔和的焦点呼吸感。布光：温暖室内光与冷色窗光对比，柔和阴影，皮肤光泽。

en.p: A matador-style performer in a rain-dark arena snaps a crimson cape across frame and the charging bull commits. Instead of tracking the bull, the camera locks to the cape cloth whipping through the air, then resolves into the final dodge with mud tearing up under the hooves. 15-second cinematic sequence, dramatic rain-soaked arena, moody lighting, ultra-smooth camera work, high detail on fabric motion and mud physics.

zh.p: 在雨幕笼罩的昏暗斗牛场上，一位斗牛士风格的表演者将猩红斗篷横甩过画面，迎面冲来的公牛发起进攻。镜头并未追随公牛，而是紧锁在空中翻飞的斗篷布料，随后切入最终闪避的瞬间，马蹄下泥浆飞溅。15秒电影级片段，暴雨浸透的竞技场氛围阴郁，光影低沉，运镜极致流畅，织物飘动与泥浆飞溅的物理细节高度逼真。

en.p: [0–5s]: The Plunge An extremely fast, straight vertical drop from a stormy, overcast sky, plummeting right down the length of a towering galleon’s mainmast. The camera falls like a cannonball past tattered canvas sails and thick rigging. Intense camera shake mimics the buffeting of hurricane winds, with heavy raindrops streaking past the lens to emphasize the blistering downward speed.  [5–10s]: The Deck-Level Weave Inches before smashing into the rain-slicked wooden deck, the camera aggressively pulls up, instantly stabilizing into a buttery-smooth, high-speed FPV glide. It threads the needle through a chaotic, brutal boarding skirmish. The camera ducks under a swinging grappling hook, weaves tightly between two sailors clashing cutlasses, and dodges a spray of splintering wood from the ship's rail.  [10–15s]: The Slide and Whip-Pan The camera executes a low, water-spraying powerslide beneath a fallen mast, sliding dangerously close to a massive, roaring bronze cannon just as it fires and violently recoils on its thick ropes. Using the explosive flash of the cannon as a transition, the camera executes a vicious, blurred whip-pan 180 degrees to the right—snapping perfectly onto a Royal Navy Commodore in a soaked, gold-braided coat, capturing the exact frame he fires a smoking flintlock pistol directly at the lens.

zh.p:
【0-5秒】俯冲：镜头从雷雨交加、乌云密布的高空急速垂直坠落，沿着高耸帆船的主桅杆直冲而下。摄像机如炮弹般掠过破旧的帆布和粗壮的索具，剧烈抖动模拟飓风的冲击，密集雨滴划过镜头，强化了令人窒息的俯冲速度。
【5-10秒】甲板穿梭：在即将撞上湿滑木甲板的瞬间，镜头猛然拉起并稳定成丝滑高速的FPV滑行，灵巧地穿梭于混乱的登船肉搏战中——低头躲过飞来的钩爪，紧贴两名挥刀对砍的水手间穿行，避开船舷飞溅的木屑。
【10-15秒】滑铲与甩镜：镜头在倒下的桅杆下完成低空水花四溅的滑铲，擦着一尊正在开火、粗绳剧烈后坐的青铜巨炮掠过。借炮火爆闪为转场，镜头向右猛甩180度形成模糊的甩镜——精准锁定一位身着湿透金边大衣的皇家海军准将，恰好捕捉到他举着冒烟燧发枪直指镜头的瞬间。

en.p: A person in a dark hoodie stands on rain-soaked deserted train tracks in a dystopian city. In the distance, a large hovering red glowing eye stares at them. Slowly, the eye blinks and completely closes. The person then suddenly runs forward with determination, splashing water under their feet. The environment is gloomy with barren buildings, light rain, and wet reflective surfaces. The camera is positioned low behind the individual, slightly zooming in during the motion.

zh.p: 一个身穿深色连帽衫的人站在反乌托邦城市中被雨水浸透的废弃铁轨上。远处，一只巨大的悬浮红色发光眼睛正凝视着他们。那只眼睛缓缓眨动，然后完全闭合。接着，这个人突然坚定地向前奔跑，脚下溅起水花。周围环境阴郁，建筑荒芜，细雨绵绵，湿漉漉的表面反射着微光。镜头以低角度置于此人身后，在其奔跑过程中略微拉近。

en.p: A surreal battlefield in the air: floating rocky islands drift in a thunderstorm, clouds churning below like an ocean. A masked ronin dashes across the floating platforms, followed by a colossal winged beast whose chest is a vortex of storm clouds and lightning. The camera races between the islands, struggling to keep up as rocks tilt, spin, and collapse beneath their feet. Each flap of wings sends shockwaves through the air, shaking the frame and sending debris and rain directly into the viewer's face. A rapid handheld shot captures the ronin leaping across impossible gaps, his sword arcing through the darkness. The final shot shows the camera swooping down behind him as he leaps from the last collapsing rock, riding a bolt of lightning directly into the monster's chest vortex for a desperate final blow, detonating the storm from within and clearing the sky in a blinding flash.

zh.p: 一场超现实的空中战场：浮空岩石岛屿在雷暴中飘移，下方云海翻涌如怒涛。一位蒙面浪人疾驰于浮台之间，身后紧随着一头巨翼猛兽——其胸膛处盘旋着风暴云团与闪电。镜头在岛屿间急速穿梭，竭力追赶着脚下倾斜、旋转、崩塌的岩块。巨翼每次振翅都激起空气震波，令画面剧烈晃动，碎石与雨水直扑观众面门。手持镜头剧烈晃动中，浪人纵身跃过不可能跨越的裂隙，刀锋在黑暗中划出弧光。最终镜头俯冲至他身后，当他在最后一块崩塌的岩石上腾空而起时，竟踏着一道闪电直刺巨兽胸口的风暴漩涡——以决死一击引爆体内风暴，刺目白光中云开雾散。

en.p:
scene 1 (00:00 – 00:05) — Aerial Drift (Handheld Cinematic Feel)

A stabilized handheld tracking shot follows slightly behind and to the side of a female character, @img1, suspended mid-air as if gliding using controlled body movement rather than obvious magic. She wears soft pink, lightweight silk robes inspired by traditional wuxia, but slightly weathered and textured. The wind pulls unevenly at her sleeves and hair, creating natural drag and resistance.

Below her: a dense cloud layer with occasional breaks revealing realistic mountain ridges and forests far beneath. The lighting is late afternoon golden hour but slightly diffused by atmospheric haze, creating soft shadows rather than glowing fantasy light. Subtle camera shake and lens breathing add realism.

scene 2 (00:05 – 00:10) — Emergence Through Atmosphere (Documentary Tone)

A wider lens captures @img1 continuing forward when turbulence in the clouds forms—air currents visibly shifting the mist. From below, a large Eastern dragon emerges, but not glowing—its surface resembles wet, reflective scales catching scattered sunlight.

The dragon doesn’t “burst” unrealistically; it pushes through clouds with weight and resistance, displacing vapor around its body. Its movement is powerful but grounded, like a massive flying creature navigating air pressure.

The camera struggles slightly to keep focus, adjusting exposure as light hits the dragon’s reflective body. @img1 maintains balance with subtle body adjustments, not perfectly still.

scene 3 (00:10 – 00:15) — Controlled Ride (Aerial Cinematography / Drone Style)

A wide aerial shot, as if captured by a high-end drone, reveals @img1 standing on the dragon’s head—but her stance isn’t exaggerated heroic posing. She keeps a low center of gravity, knees slightly bent to absorb motion.

The dragon flies fast, but the motion feels heavy and believable—air drag affecting both the creature and her clothing. The camera orbits slowly but with minor stabilization imperfections, like real aerial footage.

The environment: layered clouds, distant terrain fading into atmospheric perspective, no overly saturated fantasy colors. Textures remain detailed but grounded. Wind noise implied through movement. The koverall tone feels like a rare natural phenomenon captured on film rather than a staged fantasy scene.

zh.p:
场景1（00:00 – 00:05）——空中滑翔（手持电影感）
一段稳定的手持跟拍镜头，从女性角色@img1的侧后方略偏角度跟随。她悬浮在半空中，仿佛通过控制身体动作滑行，而非明显的魔法。她身着受传统武侠启发的浅粉色轻质丝绸长袍，但略带磨损和纹理。风不均匀地拉扯着她的衣袖和头发，形成自然的阻力和拖曳感。下方是密集的云层，偶尔有缝隙露出远处真实的山脊和森林。光线是傍晚黄金时刻，但被大气薄雾略微柔化，投下柔和的阴影，而非奇幻的发光效果。轻微的镜头抖动和呼吸感增添了真实感。

场景2（00:05 – 00:10）——穿越大气层（纪录片风格）
更广的镜头捕捉到@img1继续前行，此时云层中形成湍流——气流明显搅动雾气。一条巨大的东方龙从下方浮现，但并非发光——其表面像湿润、反光的鳞片，捕捉着散射的阳光。龙并非不切实际地“冲出”，而是带着重量和阻力穿过云层，将水汽排开在身体周围。它的动作有力而扎实，如同巨大的飞行生物在气压中穿行。镜头略微吃力地保持对焦，当光线照射到龙的反光身体时调整曝光。@img1通过细微的身体调整保持平衡，并非完全静止。

场景3（00:10 – 00:15）——受控骑行（空中摄影/无人机风格）
一个宽广的空中镜头，仿佛由高端无人机拍摄，显示@img1站在龙的头部——但她的姿态并非夸张的英雄造型。她保持低重心，膝盖微曲以吸收运动。龙飞得很快，但动作感觉沉重且可信——空气阻力同时影响着生物和她的衣物。镜头缓慢环绕，但带有轻微的稳定瑕疵，如同真实的航拍画面。环境：层叠的云层，远处的地形在空气透视中逐渐模糊，没有过度饱和的奇幻色彩。纹理保持细节但接地气。通过运动暗示风声。整体基调更像是胶片上捕捉到的罕见自然现象，而非精心设计的奇幻场景。

en.p:
TITLE: “The Spider Cave Trial (Budget Enlightenment)”
Seedance 2 | 15-second cinematic wuxia-comedy | 1960s Hong Kong studio aesthetic | intentionally cheap props | visible wires | painted backdrops | rubber set pieces | theatrical lighting | exaggerated acting | fast comedic timing | punchy sound design | American-style dark humor dialogue
A stylized mountain path at dusk. Painted backdrop, flat perspective, overly vivid colors. Wind machines blow unevenly. Fake fog drifts across the ground.
A BLACK CAT with long white eyebrows, dressed as a calm wandering monk (loose beige robes, prayer beads), sits serenely atop a clearly fake WHITE TIGER prop (stiff, visible seams).
Beside him, an ORANGE CAT dressed as a rebellious staff-wielding trickster (gold headband, red outfit) hovers on a flickering cloud platform. He scans the area cautiously.
They pass a cave covered in thick cotton spider webs. From inside: eerie, exaggerated female laughter.
0–3 seconds:
Wide shot. Wind howls.
Black cat gently pats the tiger (it squeaks).
Black cat (calm):
"Night’s falling. This feels like a mistake worth making."
Orange cat squints at the cave.
Orange cat:
"Yeah, this is how people disappear. I’ll check."
Black cat nods.
3–6 seconds:
Orange cat raises one finger—
A cheap flashlight pops into his hand.
Orange cat (dry):
"If I don’t come back, avenge me… or at least pretend."
He glides into the cave on his cloud.
6–9 seconds:
Inside. Dark.
He pushes through webs, annoyed.
Orange cat:
"Great. Zero cleaning budget."
He spots light deeper inside—
Accelerates toward it.
9–12 seconds:
Reveal: fake garden set. Painted flowers, plastic plants.
GRAY CATS with heavy makeup and flowing white gauze outfits laugh and run theatrically.
One notices him.
Gray cat (cold):
"Look. A volunteer."
Orange cat drops down, staff appearing in hand.
Orange cat:
"Enough. Monsters don’t get warnings twice."
Fight burst:
He spins, strikes, flips—fast, flashy.
Gray cats effortlessly dodge, laughing.
Gray cats (mocking):
"Cute."
"He trained for this."
Orange cat frustrated—targets one—leaps for a finishing strike—
12–14 seconds:
Two fingers suddenly stop the staff mid-air.
Reveal: black cat behind him.
Black cat (gentle):
"We don’t harm the living."
Instant shift—
Gray cats turn grotesque and lunge at him.
14–15 seconds:
Black cat murmurs a chant. Golden light bursts outward.
Gray cats freeze, collapse, dissolve into black smoke.
Silence.
Orange cat lowers his staff, looks at camera.
Orange cat (deadpan):
"So when I hit them, it’s wrong…
but when you erase them, it’s wisdom?"
Black cat stays silent, peaceful.
Awkward beat.
Cut to black with a sharp comedic sting.

zh.p:
《蜘蛛洞试炼（预算觉悟）》第二幕 | 15秒武侠喜剧短片 | 1960年代香港片场美学 | 刻意粗糙的道具 | 可见的钢丝 | 手绘背景板 | 橡胶布景 | 戏剧化灯光 | 夸张表演 | 快速喜剧节奏 | 利落音效设计 | 美式黑色幽默对白
黄昏时分风格化的山间小径。手绘背景板，平面透视，色彩过于鲜艳。鼓风机不均匀地吹着。假雾在地面飘散。一只长着白色长眉的黑猫，扮作平静的游方僧（宽松米色僧袍，持念珠），安详地坐在一只明显是假的白虎道具上（僵硬，可见接缝）。他身旁，一只橘猫扮作叛逆的持棍戏弄者（金箍，红衣），站在闪烁的云台上。他警惕地环顾四周。他们经过一个覆盖着厚棉蛛网的洞穴。洞内传来诡异而夸张的女笑声。
0-3秒：全景。风声呼啸。黑猫轻拍老虎（老虎发出吱吱声）。黑猫（平静）：'天快黑了。这感觉像是个值得犯的错。'橘猫眯眼看着洞穴。橘猫：'是啊，人就是这么消失的。我去看看。'黑猫点头。
3-6秒：橘猫竖起一根手指——一个廉价手电筒啪地出现在他手中。橘猫（干巴巴地）：'我要没回来，替我报仇……至少装装样子。'他驾云滑入洞穴。
6-9秒：洞内。黑暗。他烦躁地拨开蛛网。橘猫：'好极了。清洁预算为零。'他注意到深处有光——加速朝光飞去。
9-12秒：揭示：假花园布景。手绘花朵，塑料植物。几只灰猫浓妆艳抹，身着飘逸白纱，夸张地笑着跑着。一只灰猫注意到他。灰猫（冷冷地）：'看，来了个志愿者。'橘猫落下，棍子出现在手中。橘猫：'够了。怪物没有第二次警告。'打斗爆发：他旋转、击打、翻腾——快速、花哨。灰猫轻松躲闪，大笑。灰猫（嘲弄地）：'可爱。''他练过的。'橘猫受挫——瞄准一只——跃起准备致命一击——
12-14秒：两根手指突然在半空中停住棍子。揭示：黑猫在他身后。黑猫（温和地）：'我们不伤害生灵。'瞬间转变——灰猫变得狰狞，扑向他。
14-15秒：黑猫低念咒语。金光迸发。灰猫僵住，倒地，化为黑烟消散。寂静。橘猫放下棍子，看向镜头。橘猫（面无表情）：'所以我打它们就是错……但你消灭它们就是智慧？'黑猫沉默，安详。尴尬的停顿。画面切黑，伴随尖锐的喜剧音效。

Gray cats freeze, collapse, dissolve into black smoke.
Silence.
Orange cat lowers his staff, looks at camera.
Orange cat (deadpan):
"So when I hit them, it’s wrong…
but when you erase them, it’s wisdom?"
Black cat stays silent, peaceful.
Awkward beat.
Cut to black with a sharp comedic sting.

en.p: A scrappy clay saloon kitchen girl with messy blonde hair tied in a loose bun, flour-smudged cheeks, and twin soup ladles strapped to her belt rockets into frame in the first two seconds as a giant runaway frontier stew cauldron mounted on iron stagecoach legs crashes through the kitchen wall behind her, instantly creating the hook, and the whole short becomes a full-speed action comedy through dusty Western town streets, swinging saloon doors, wooden boardwalks, cattle-side markets, hanging lanternless lamp posts, and collapsing rope bridges over dry canyons, where she slides on spilled gravy, swings from tavern signs, launches food projectiles, and uses kitchen tools as weapons while the monstrous iron cauldron stomps through wagons, flips market stalls, sprays boiling steam and broth, and turns the town into one huge chain-reaction mess, all in colorful Western-style stop-motion plasticine animation, with dusty textures, glossy sauces, bouncy squash-and-stretch motion, visible hand-shaped clay details, and dense handcrafted frontier town environments, and just as she finally wedges the cauldron under a giant rodeo-style festival arch and thinks she has won, the lid rattles open and dozens of tiny armored biscuit-bandit dumplings climb out in formation.

zh.p: 一个邋遢的粘土酒吧厨房女孩，乱糟糟的金发松散地盘成发髻，脸颊沾满面粉，腰间别着两把汤勺，在头两秒内冲入画面。与此同时，一个装在铁制马车腿上的巨大失控边疆炖锅从她身后的厨房墙壁中轰然撞出，瞬间制造出悬念。整部短片变成了一场高速动作喜剧，场景穿梭于尘土飞扬的西部小镇街道、摇摆的酒吧门、木板人行道、牛群市场、没有灯笼的灯柱，以及干涸峡谷上摇摇欲坠的绳桥。她滑过泼洒的肉汁，荡过酒馆招牌，发射食物弹丸，用厨房工具当武器，而那个巨大的铁锅则踩碎马车、掀翻市场摊位、喷出滚烫的蒸汽和肉汤，将小镇变成一连串连锁混乱。这一切都以色彩鲜艳的西部风格定格粘土动画呈现，带有尘土质感、光泽酱汁、弹性的挤压拉伸动作、可见的手工粘土细节，以及精心手工制作的边疆小镇环境。就在她最终将炖锅卡在一个巨大的牛仔竞技节拱门下，以为自己获胜时，锅盖咔嗒作响地打开，几十个微小的装甲饼干强盗饺子排成队列爬了出来。

0-2 sec:
Camera starts low at the front wheel, slight handheld cinematic shake. Subtle engine vibration. The biker grips the handle tighter. No dust bursts, just grounded realism.
2–4 sec:
He slowly turns his head over his shoulder, scanning behind him. The camera begins a smooth lateral slide to reveal more of his back and gear. Background stays soft and moody.
4–6 sec:
He performs a sharp zero-cut turn of the bike in place, pivoting cleanly without doing a full circle. Tires grip the cracked ground with minimal dust, सिर्फ light debris shift.
6–8 sec:
As soon as the bike aligns forward, he accelerates. Camera transitions into a tracking follow shot from behind, maintaining medium distance. Suspension compresses slightly as he gains speed.
8–10 sec:
The biker rides straight into the abandoned road, camera smoothly following from behind. Environment blurs subtly, no exaggerated effects. Scene ends with him riding into the foggy distance.

Minimal lab setup, soft blue lighting, 4K–8K, 24fps. A computer screen displays a simple communication interface.
Camera: over-the-shoulder → slow push-in.
Action sequence:
Scientist types a message labeled “To Future Self”
He sends it
Instantly, a reply appears
He reads it slowly
His expression becomes serious
Message on screen: You don’t change anything.
Strict constraints:
Clean readable UI
No glitching text
Natural typing motion
Stable lighting
Voice-over
I thought I could learn from the future…
Fix my mistakes…
But the answer came fast…
And it wasn’t what I expected.

en.p: A 31-year-old woman with close-cropped silver hair, high cheekbones, deep brown skin, wearing a navy pressure-woven trench coat threaded with luminous tidal-flow patterns that ripple across the fabric like moving water — hook at second two: she drops both hands onto the pavement of a coastal boulevard and the tidal lines ignite, glowing aquamarine beneath the asphalt as underground water mains rupture in sequence. The street begins to buckle as pressurized water channels surge upward through the infrastructure grid. The fight is hydraulic and architectural: hydrants explode into geysers mid-combat, storm drains invert into upward water cannons, and entire intersections liquefy as subterranean flood tunnels erupt to the surface. Her movements redirect the water systems — each step sending pressure waves through the ground that burst upward as towering water pillars. The gauntlet moves through a waterfront district progressively consumed by ocean force: street level flooded knee-deep → ferry terminal ripped open by tidal surges → elevated expressway collapsing into a rising inland sea. Ships break their moorings and slide into city blocks. Glass towers fracture as high-pressure jets shear through their lower levels. Chase-cam along a collapsing seawall as an incoming megawave overtops the harbor barrier. Velocity ramp at the moment the harbor gates fail and the ocean pours into the city basin. Cut to aerial: the coastline has been redrawn inland by half a kilometer. She stands atop a flooded skyline, tidal currents spiraling around the remaining buildings. Diegetic ocean-blue emissive lighting from the coat patterns interacting with churning floodwater, volumetric mist and spray particles, cinematic storm lighting, ultra-detailed water simulation, 4K.

zh.p: 一名31岁女性，留着银色短发，颧骨高耸，深棕色皮肤，身穿海军蓝压织风衣，衣料上绣有发光潮汐纹样，如流水般在织物表面荡漾——第二秒的钩子：她将双手按在滨海大道的路面上，潮汐线瞬间点燃，沥青下泛起水蓝色光芒，地下水管依次爆裂。随着加压水流沿基础设施网格向上喷涌，街道开始扭曲变形。这场战斗是液压与建筑的较量：消防栓在激战中喷涌成间歇泉，雨水井倒转为冲天水炮，地下泄洪隧道破土而出，整片十字路口化为液态。她的动作引导着水系统——每一步都将压力波传入地下，继而化作擎天水柱冲天而起。这场鏖战穿越滨水区，逐渐被海洋力量吞噬：街道积水没膝→渡轮码头被潮涌撕裂→高架快速路崩塌，沉入不断上涨的内海。船舶挣脱锚链滑入城市街区。高压水刃切穿玻璃塔楼底层。追拍镜头沿坍塌防波堤推进，巨型浪潮正越港而过。港湾闸门失效的瞬间，速度骤升，海水涌入城市盆地。切至航拍：海岸线已向内陆推进半公里。她立于被淹没的天际线上，潮汐流环绕残存建筑旋转。风衣纹路与翻涌洪水相互作用，发出剧情式海洋蓝光，体积雾与飞沫粒子弥漫，电影级风暴照明，超精细水模拟，4K画质。

Natural motion only

Quietly…

en.p: 1/2: This is the final moments before a meteor 15km across is about to hit earth. It will wipe out humanity. Rapid cuts to people all around the world reacting to the impending doom. Even the sounds of chaos and panic subside as the meteor enters the atmosphere. A man in his early 30s looks up at the sky with horror as the meteor that fills the sky falls directly toward him. His eyes widen and he sinks to his knees as tears well up in his eyes. The meteor lands, causing a devastating explosion with the entire city wiped out in an instant. The shockwave and explosion can be seen from space. 2/2: The sleeping boy wakes up screaming with terror. He slowly turns to look at the digital clock which reads '3:22am' in large font, and below it in a slightly smaller font, 'May 7, 2007'. The boy slowly composes himself as he says calmly, 'One year less again.' He slowly slumps and hangs his head. ECU on his hands trembling. He grits his teeth and says in a frightened voice of extreme sorrow that cracks, 'There's no way I can save humanity!' The boy sobs quietly in the dark.

en.p: In VR first-person perspective, the stone door of the Spider Cave slowly pushes open. Steam and mist rush toward the face, causing the lenses to fog up before gradually clearing. Seven spider spirits in the hot spring turn to gaze at the player. The nearest one rises, walks toward the camera, and reaches out to gently touch the VR lens. The HUD interface frantically flashes a red demonic aura warning. The virtual glove trembles as it lifts, and a 'Call Wukong' button pops up on the right, hastily pressed by a finger. In the distance, the sound of the Golden Cudgel cutting through the air is heard. The edges of the VR lens remain persistently distorted with a halo of light.

zh.p: 主题：布偶猫搞笑沙龙理发大变身。视觉：专业宠物美容环境，配有环形灯，特写镜头展示一只蓬松的布偶猫穿着黑色美容围裙，使用真实的美容工具和技巧，打造出搞笑的“碗状发型”。镜头：微距特写镜头，交替切换正面、侧面和俯拍角度。风格：高调光，真实，搞笑宠物内容，ASMR美容美学。动作：人类的手轻轻向上梳理布偶猫丝滑的长毛——轻柔的梳毛声+顺滑的毛摩擦声[切换]侧面：水雾喷在布偶猫头上，毛发变得微湿光滑——喷瓶声+细水雾[切换]俯拍：剪刀沿着梳子夹住的湿毛剪出一条直线——剪发声+精准剪切动作[切换]正面：打薄剪快速修饰前“刘海”——快速剪发声+柔软毛打薄质感[切换]侧面：吹风机吹风，丝滑的毛发蓬松起来，在风中轻轻飘动——吹风机嗡嗡声+轻柔风声[切换]正面：用梳子和剪刀最后修整，完善圆碗状发型——轻柔梳毛+细小剪发声[切换]最终亮相：布偶猫优雅地坐着，顶着完美的蘑菇状碗形发型，慢慢眨眼，左右看向镜头——轻柔满足的咕噜声

Warm amber streetlights, busy pedestrians walking in both directions, shop windows glowing. 0:00–0:05: <<<image_1>>> a man in a dark coat walks calmly along the crowded sidewalk toward the camera. Pedestrians pass him in the opposite direction. A young man walks toward him looking normal and healthy. <<<image_1>>> The man reaches out and places his hand on the young man's shoulder as they cross paths. At the exact moment of contact, the young man's hair rapidly turns white, his face wrinkles, his body hunches — he ages decades in two seconds and drops to his knees. <<<image_1>>> The man pulls his hand back, golden energy visibly flows up his arm, his posture straightens, his presence becomes more powerful. He keeps walking forward without looking back. Cinematic steadicam, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, 8K. 0:05–0:10: <<<image_1>>> the man continues walking forward through the crowd. A woman walks past him looking normal and healthy. He brushes his fingers across her arm as she passes. At the exact moment of contact, her skin turns grey, her movement freezes mid-step, and she slowly crumbles into fine dust that scatters in the wind. A visible pulse of golden energy flows from where she stood into his chest. His eyes glow briefly with amber light, the air around him shimmers with time distortion like heat haze. Remaining pedestrians nearby step away from him in fear. Cinematic medium shot, volumetric golden light, photorealistic VFX, 8K. 0:10–0:15: <<<image_1>>> the man stops walking in the middle of the now-clearing sidewalk. Golden time energy swirls visibly around his entire body. He slowly raises both hands and opens his palms — all the stolen time releases upward in a massive vertical beam of golden light shooting into the darkening sky, illuminating the entire street. His coat and hair blow upward from the energy surge. The beam fades, he lowers his hands, the glow disappears. The street around him is completely empty — every pedestrian has vanished. He puts his hands in his pockets and walks away alone into the amber-lit dusk. Cinematic extreme wide shot, dramatic orchestral swell, Dolby Vision grade, 8K.

zh.p: 一段电影感十足的15秒片段，场景设定在黄昏时分拥挤的伊斯坦布尔人行道上。温暖的琥珀色街灯亮起，行人匆匆双向穿行，商店橱窗泛着微光。0:00–0:05：<<<image_1>>>一名穿深色大衣的男子沿着拥挤的人行道平静地向镜头走来。行人从他身旁逆向而过。一名年轻男子迎面走来，看起来正常且健康。<<<image_1>>>当两人擦肩时，男子伸手搭在年轻男子的肩上。就在接触的瞬间，年轻男子的头发迅速变白，脸上皱纹浮现，身体佝偻——两秒内衰老了几十年，双膝跪地。<<<image_1>>>男子收回手，金色能量清晰可见地沿手臂涌上，他的身姿挺直，气场更显强大。他继续前行，头也不回。电影级稳定镜头，浅景深，照片级真实感，8K画质。0:05–0:10：<<<image_1>>>男子继续穿过人群前行。一名女子从他身边走过，看起来正常且健康。他经过时手指轻拂过她的手臂。就在接触的瞬间，她的皮肤变为灰色，动作在半空中凝固，然后缓缓碎成细尘，随风飘散。一道可见的金色能量脉冲从她站立之处涌入他的胸膛。他的双眼短暂闪烁琥珀光芒，周围空气因时间扭曲而如热浪般 shimmer。附近剩余的行人惊恐地退开。电影级中景，体积光金色效果，照片级真实感视觉特效，8K画质。0:10–0:15：<<<image_1>>>男子在逐渐清空的人行道中央停下脚步。金色时间能量在他全身可见地旋转涌动。他缓缓举起双手，张开手掌——所有窃取的时间向上释放，形成一道巨大的金色光柱射入渐暗的天空，照亮整条街道。他的大衣和头发因能量冲击而向上飘动。光柱消散，他放下双手，光芒消失。周围街道空无一人——所有行人已消失无踪。他将双手插进口袋，独自走向琥珀色暮光中。电影级极远景，戏剧性管弦乐渐强，杜比视界调色，8K画质。

en.p:
[0s - 2s] Shot: Wide fisheye angle, low-to-high.

Action: Two girls in Thai school uniforms launch from opposite skyscrapers into the air. One girl (left) gathers a glowing blue plasma vortex in her hands; the other girl (right) ignites a bright orange solar sphere.

Camera: Fast dolly-in towards the center.

[3s - 6s]

Shot: Medium tracking shot, profile view.

Action: The girls accelerate toward each other. The environment is a concrete jungle with high-rise buildings. The girls’ hair and skirts flutter violently due to high-speed flight physics. Debris and concrete chunks begin to lift off the buildings, floating due to the energy pressure.

Camera: Handheld shake to increase intensity.

[7s - 10s]

Shot: Center-aligned wide shot.

Action: The blue and orange energy spheres collide in the center of the frame, creating a blinding white light and a massive shockwave. A brutalist building directly behind them shatters, with huge slabs of concrete exploding outward.

Camera: Extreme fisheye lens, slow-motion effect during the impact

en.p: A cinematic 15 second time lapse video of a house being built from an empty plot. The scene begins with a clear, vacant land under daylight. Construction starts quickly: workers arrive, laying the foundation with concrete and steel. The structure rises rapidly walls form, bricks are placed, and scaffolding appears. The roof is installed, followed by windows and doors. Exterior finishing and painting happen smoothly. The surrounding area becomes neat and landscaped. The final scene reveals a fully completed modern house standing beautifully on the plot. Smooth time-lapse transitions, dynamic camera movement, realistic construction details, bright natural lighting, high detail, 4K quality.

zh.p: 一段15秒的电影级延时摄影视频，记录从空地到房屋建成的全过程。画面始于晴朗日光下的一片平整空地。施工迅速展开：工人们抵达现场，用混凝土和钢筋打下地基。建筑结构快速拔地而起——墙体成形、砖块砌筑、脚手架逐层搭建。屋顶安装完成后，门窗陆续就位。外墙装饰与粉刷工序流畅推进，周边环境也同步完成整洁的景观布置。最终画面呈现一栋完美落成的现代住宅，优雅矗立于地块之上。流畅的延时过渡、动态镜头运动、逼真的施工细节、明亮的自然光线、高精细度、4K画质。

zh.p: 一幅超写实、充满动感的动作镜头：一辆未来风格的装甲越野车在灾难性事件（如巨大爆炸或超自然风暴）中疾驰穿越森林。镜头类型：低角度无人机追踪镜头；镜头参数：28mm宽银幕变形镜头，光圈f/8.0；机位：从贴近越野车后轮的低位开始，随后向后拉远并呈弧形上升，以展现车辆全貌及后方巨大的毁灭性风暴；焦点：以越野车为兴趣点；效果：大景深，使车辆和周围混乱环境保持清晰锐利。环境设定：地点为松林间崎岖泥泞的小径；破坏状态：环境正遭受暴力摧毁，树木被无形力量劈裂抛飞，地面被翻搅成泥浆与碎片的混合物；风暴：背景中，由烟雾、云层和碎片构成的巨大漩涡状气团占据天空，暗示着巨大爆炸或非自然龙卷风；氛围：空气中充满高分辨率粒子模拟的浓密烟雾、尘土、余烬和碎裂木片，所有物体均以高速运动。光照：主光源为阴暗暴风雨天空，位于头顶上方，被巨大烟雾/云层漩涡严重遮蔽；补光来自爆炸与余烬，呈闪烁的炽热橙红色，强度提供温暖、混乱而恐怖的光线，在越野车装甲上形成反光并照亮旋转的碎片。车辆：装甲越野车；材质：车身采用哑光黑色无反射复合材料的棱角分明装甲板，表面布满严重划痕、凹痕和泥浆；轮胎为巨型越野轮胎，裹满厚泥；细节：驾驶舱配备装甲玻璃，车顶可见多根天线和传感器。动画：越野车以极高速度行驶，在泥泞地形中侧滑漂移，长行程悬挂剧烈运作，车轮独立起伏，扬起巨大的泥浆、岩石和碎片尾迹。音效：未来风格涡轮或电动引擎在最大输出时发出的尖锐啸叫声。

en.p:
FORMAT: 15s / 140 BPM / 9 SHOTS / beat-synced cinematic trailer from the 3x3 storyboard grid

STYLE: IMAX live action, dark amber palette, practical firelight and gold luminescence, photorealistic 8K.
MOOD: Epic ancient combat, visceral tension, triumphant finale.
MUSIC: Deep war drums, metallic percussion, rising orchestral brass.

SHOT 1 (0:00-0:02): Wide establishing shot. Massive ancient colosseum at dusk, marble columns with gold circuit veins, torchlight flickering across the tiers, storm clouds above. Slow aerial push-in.

SHOT 2 (0:02-0:03): Interior wide. Arena floor from the stands, thousands of spectators in torchlit shadow, amber firelight on wet marble. Camera glides forward.

SHOT 3 (0:03-0:05): Close-up iron gate. Rusted ancient bars. Two glowing amber eyes emerge from darkness. Smoke curls through gaps. Camera pushes in slow.

SHOT 4 (0:05-0:07): Medium shot. Gladiator in weathered bronze armor with gold circuit patterns enters the arena, marble shield raised, short sword drawn. Camera tracks alongside.

SHOT 5 (0:07-0:09): Wide action. Massive mechanical lion with obsidian plating charges across the arena, fire erupting from its jaws, dust and sparks trailing. Camera sweeps low.

SHOT 6 (0:09-0:10): Dynamic close-up. Shield blocks the lion attack, sparks explode where metal meets stone, gold circuits on armor flare bright. Camera shakes with impact.

SHOT 7 (0:10-0:11): Low angle. Gladiator on one knee, battered, shield cracked, mechanical lion circling in dust and firelight behind him. Camera holds steady.

SHOT 8 (0:11-0:13): The kill. Gladiator drives his sword upward through the lion jaw, blade glowing gold, mechanical parts shattering outward in slow motion. Camera tracks the upward thrust.

SHOT 9 (0:13-0:15): Victory. Gladiator stands alone center arena, arm raised, gold circuit patterns pulse across the marble floor radiating outward. Camera pulls back wide.

zh.p:
格式：15秒/140BPM/9个镜头/基于3x3故事板网格的节拍同步电影预告片
风格：IMAX实景拍摄，深琥珀色调，实用火光与金色光芒，照片级8K画质
氛围：史诗级古代战斗，紧张感十足，胜利终局
音乐：深沉战鼓，金属打击乐，渐强的管弦铜管乐

镜头1（0:00-0:02）：广角定场镜头。黄昏时分巨大的古罗马斗兽场，大理石柱上布满金色电路纹路，火把光芒在层层看台上摇曳，上方雷云密布。缓慢的空中推进镜头。

镜头2（0:02-0:03）：内部广角。从看台俯瞰竞技场地面，数千名观众隐没在火把照亮的阴影中，琥珀色火光映在潮湿的大理石上。镜头向前滑行。

镜头3（0:03-0:05）：铁门特写。锈蚀的古老铁栏。黑暗中浮现两只发光的琥珀色眼睛。烟雾从缝隙中缭绕而出。镜头缓慢推进。

镜头4（0:05-0:07）：中景镜头。身穿风化青铜铠甲（饰有金色电路图案）的角斗士步入竞技场，举起大理石盾牌，拔出短剑。镜头平行跟拍。

镜头5（0:07-0:09）：广角动作镜头。黑曜石装甲的巨型机械狮冲过竞技场，口中喷出火焰，身后扬起尘土与火星。镜头低角度横扫。

镜头6（0:09-0:10）：动态特写。盾牌挡住狮子的攻击，金属与石头碰撞处火花四溅，铠甲上的金色电路纹路骤然亮起。镜头随冲击力震动。

镜头7（0:10-0:11）：低角度镜头。角斗士单膝跪地，伤痕累累，盾牌开裂，机械狮在他身后的尘土与火光中盘旋。镜头保持稳定。

镜头8（0:11-0:13）：致命一击。角斗士将剑向上刺入狮子的下颌，剑刃闪耀金光，机械部件以慢动作向外碎裂。镜头跟随上刺轨迹。

镜头9（0:13-0:15）：胜利时刻。角斗士独自立于竞技场中央，高举手臂，金色电路图案在大理石地面上脉动扩散。镜头向后拉远成广角。

en.p: No BGM, only sound effects. Exaggerated motions in a cartoon animation style. Movements emphasize 'slow in and slow out' plus 'fast middle,' distorting between poses with a swoosh. The character repeatedly performs large, rhythmic high-speed left-right movements, alternating between 'moving' and 'striking a cute pose and stopping.' The performance sequence: the character repeats large, rhythmic high-speed left-right movements, alternating between 'moving' and 'striking a cute pose and stopping.' Close-up on the face: looking up to the upper right, then to the upper left; blushing cheeks, covering the mouth with a hand while smirking mischievously; comic-style exaggerated expressions and gestures; quickly pulling back to a strong perspective pose; a foreshortening effect with a hand thrust toward the camera. Camera: dynamic and kinetic cuts, combining strong perspective, exaggerated depth, character tracking, and rapid acceleration, making the rhythm and beats visually felt. Motion design: the shoulders, hips, and legs move in coordination, with the core body bending significantly, balancing flexibility and explosive power. Movements are rough yet refined, with no wasted motion. Emotional flow: concentration, acceleration, immersion, release. Clearly depict facial expression changes that blend tension and ecstasy. Effects: sharp effects along the trajectory of attacks and movements, with visual reactions bursting upon impact. Hair and clothing sway greatly due to wind pressure and shockwaves, instantly balancing 'weight' and 'sharpness.' Slow motion: used only just before a decisive moment or during the pose itself, stretching time to maximize emotion and impact. Background: a fancy indoor base treated like a canvas. Layer priority: character, graphic patterns, white background. Graphic elements: circles, triangles, stars, polygons, soft blobs, and dot clusters. Flat coloring, sharp edges, opaque, high contrast. Color scheme limited to pastel colors. Motion linkage: shapes move in response to the character's movements and poses, amplifying visual energy without covering the face or important parts. Composition design: naturally integrate all elements while keeping the viewer's focus on the character, maintaining strong contrast between the character and background. 'Leaving me alone? In many ways, you've got some nerve!'

zh.p:
BGMなし。SEのみ。
 カートゥーンアニメ調の誇張されたモーション。 
動きは「ゆっくりした入りと抜き」＋「中間の高速化」を強調し、ポーズ間をビュンと歪ませるように崩す。 
キャラクターは左右へ大きく緩急のある高速移動を繰り返し、 「移動 → 可愛い決めポーズで静止」をリズミカルに反復する。 

演出シークエンス： キャラクターは左右へ大きく緩急のある高速移動を繰り返し、 「移動 → 可愛い決めポーズで静止」をリズミカルに反復する。
顔アップ ・右上を見る → 左上を見る ・頬を赤らめ、手で口元を隠しながら意地悪にニヤリ ・マンガ的誇張表情＋ジェスチャー ・高速で後方へ引き、強いパースの決めポーズ ・手をカメラに突き出すフォーショアトニング 

カメラ： ダイナミックかつキネティックなカット割り。強い遠近感、誇張パース、キャラ追従と急加速を組み合わせる。リズムと“拍”を視覚で体感させる。 

動作設計： 肩・腰・脚を連動させ、体幹が大きくしなる。 しなやかさと爆発的な力を両立。 
荒々しくも洗練され、無駄のない動き。 

感情の流れ： 集中 → 加速 → 没入 → 解放 緊張と恍惚が同居する表情変化を明確に描写。 

エフェクト： 攻撃や動作の軌跡にシャープなエフェクト。 衝突時に弾けるビジュアル反応。 風圧・衝撃波で髪と衣装が大きく揺れる。 「重さ」と「鋭さ」を瞬間的に両立。 

スローモーション： 決定的瞬間の直前または決めのみで使用。 時間を引き延ばし、感情とインパクトを最大化。

 背景： ファンシーな室内ベース、キャンバス的扱い。 

レイヤー優先順位： キャラクター グラフィック模様 白背景 

グラフィック要素： 円、三角形、星形、多角形、柔らかいブロブ、ドット群。 フラット塗り、シャープエッジ、不透明、高コントラスト。 配色はパステルカラー限定。

 モーション連動： 図形はキャラクターの動き・ポーズに反応して動く。 視覚的エネルギーを増幅するが、顔や重要部位は遮らない。 構図設計： 全要素を自然に統合しつつ、視線は常にキャラクターへ集中。 キャラクターと背景のコントラストを強く保つ。 

「私を放置とは、色んな意味でいい度胸です！」

en.p: Style: Urban Women's Portrait Film, Cinematic Color Grading, Photorealistic, dark and high-end feel, 4K HD, three characters appearing. Duration: 15 seconds. Scene: Late-night city—nightclub backstage, apartment bedroom, office. Characters: Woman A (image 1, long black hair, black leather slip dress + white fur coat, large gold hoop earrings, gold necklace, sunglasses on head, cold and glamorous aura). Woman B (image 2, long curly orange-red hair, white oversized cozy sweater, pearl necklace, gentle and serene). Woman C (image 3, long straight black hair, white shirt + black tie + black skirt, gold earrings, red-rimmed eyes, restrained and stubborn). [00:00-00:02] Shot 1: Nightclub Queen (Slow-mo Entrance). Japanese narration in low female voice: 'In the night of this city, three stories breathe.' Slow-mo medium shot: Dim nightclub backstage, newspaper-covered walls, warm yellow hard light from tungsten bulbs. Woman A stands with one hand on her hip, fur coat slipping from shoulder to elbow, slightly tilting her head, glancing at the camera from above her sunglasses, a cold smirk on her lips. Gold earrings sway with head movement, reflecting specks of light. [00:02-00:06] Shot 2: Late-night Solitude (Intimate Moment). Japanese narration: 'One hides a face she shows no one.' Medium close-up side shot: Warm desk lamp light intertwined with cold blue moonlight from the window. Woman B sits on the bed, one hand gently pulling her sweater collar, orange-red hair falling over shoulders and chest, head lowered, eyes slightly closed, eyelashes casting shadows. Pearl necklace glimmers faintly at the collarbone. City lights outside blur into bokeh. [00:06-00:10] Shot 3: Office Breaking Point. Japanese narration: 'One is not even allowed to cry.' Front medium shot slow dolly in: Cold white fluorescent-lit office, empty after work. Woman C leans against the desk, hands hanging at her sides gripping her skirt, knuckles white. Camera slowly pushes toward her face—eyes red, tears welling but held back, lips trembling slightly, jaw tight. Tie loosened, shirt collar slightly open. [00:10-00:13] Shot 4: Rapid Cross-Cut. Japanese narration: 'Even so—' Jump cut alternating three sets of images: Woman A suddenly turns and pushes open the nightclub door, stepping into the night, fur coat fluttering in the wind—Woman B looks up at the moonlight through the window, eyes shifting from gentle to determined—Woman C wipes a tear from the corner of her eye with the back of her hand, takes a deep breath, and straightens her back—each image 1 second, pace accelerating, with low-frequency drum beats. [00:13-00:15] Shot 5: Final Frame. Japanese narration: 'They do not stop.' Triple split screen: Left, Woman A walking on the street against the light; center, Woman B standing by the window in profile; right, Woman C in an elevator looking straight at the camera. All three freeze simultaneously. Black screen, white handwritten Japanese subtitle appears: 'Three nights, three kinds of strength.'
en.t: Three Women, One Night in the City

zh.p:
【风格】都市女性群像短片（Urban Women's Portrait Film），电影调色（Cinematic Color Grading），真实摄影质感（Photorealistic），暗调高级感，4K高清，3人出镜
【时长】15秒
【场景】深夜都市——夜店后台、公寓卧室、办公室
【角色】
A女@图片1（黑色长发，穿黑色皮质吊带裙+白色皮草外套，金色大圈耳环，金项链，墨镜架在头顶，冷艳气场）
B女@图片2（橘红色长卷发，穿白色慵懒大毛衣，珍珠项链，温柔恬静）
C女@图片3（黑色长直发，穿白衬衫+黑色领带+黑色短裙，金色耳环，眼眶泛红，隐忍倔强）

[00:00-00:02] 镜头1：夜店女王（Slow-mo Entrance）
【日语旁白】低沉女声："この街の夜には、三つの物語が息をしている。"（这座城市的夜晚，有三个故事在呼吸。）
慢动作中景（Slow-mo Medium Shot）：昏暗的夜店后台，报纸糊墙，钨丝灯泡打出暖黄硬光。A女单手叉腰，皮草从肩头滑落到手肘，她微微侧头，目光从墨镜上方扫向镜头，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。金色耳环随头部动作晃动，反射出点点光斑。

[00:02-00:06] 镜头2：深夜独处（Intimate Moment）
【日语旁白】："一人は、誰にも見せない顔を隠している。"（一个人，藏着不给任何人看的脸。）
中近景侧拍（Medium Close-up Side Shot）：暖色台灯光+窗外冷蓝月光交织。B女坐在床边，一只手轻轻拢住毛衣领口，橘红色长发垂落在肩膀和胸前，她低头微微闭眼，睫毛投下阴影。珍珠项链在锁骨处微微发光。窗外城市灯光虚化成光斑（Bokeh）。

[00:06-00:10] 镜头3：办公室崩溃边缘（Breaking Point）
【日语旁白】："一人は、泣くことさえ許されない。"（一个人，连哭都不被允许。）
正面中景缓推（Slow Dolly In）：冷白色日光灯的办公室，下班后空无一人。C女靠在办公桌边，双手垂在身侧握紧裙摆，指节发白。镜头缓缓推向她的脸——眼眶通红，泪水在眼眶里打转但死死忍住不掉，嘴唇微微颤抖，下巴绷紧。领带被扯松了一截，衬衫领口微敞。

[00:10-00:13] 镜头4：三人交叉剪辑（Rapid Cross-Cut）
【日语旁白】："それでも——"（即便如此——）
快速剪辑（Jump Cut）三组画面交替闪切：
A女猛然转身推开夜店大门走入夜色，皮草在风中翻飞——
B女抬起头望向窗外月光，眼神从温柔转为坚定——
C女用手背猛地抹掉眼角的一滴泪，深吸一口气挺直腰板——
每组画面1秒，节奏加速，配低频鼓点。

[00:13-00:15] 镜头5：定格收束（Final Frame）
【日语旁白】："彼女たちは、立ち止まらない。"（她们，不会停下脚步。）
三分屏画面（Triple Split Screen）：左A女逆光走在街头、中B女站在窗前侧脸轮廓、右C女在电梯里抬头直视镜头。三人同时定格。
黑屏，白色日文手写体字幕浮现："三つの夜、三つの強さ。"（三个夜晚，三种坚强。）

en.p:
A young woman with short hair, scratched face, eyes wide in panic, wearing casual urban clothes covered in dust, body tense and reactive.
Sprints through collapsing streets, jumping over broken asphalt while a giant quadruped creature charges behind her smashing everything in its path.
city blocks with collapsing buildings, sparks from broken cables, fire spreading across vehicles.
FPV tracking shot directly behind her with rapid head-like motion, micro jitters and sharp tilts, creature entering frame behind with each stride, debris hitting lens, intense motion blur and survival-driven chaos

zh.p: 一名短发年轻女子，脸上带着抓痕，双眼因惊恐而圆睁，身着沾满灰尘的休闲都市服装，身体紧绷且反应敏捷。她在崩塌的街道上狂奔，跃过碎裂的沥青路面，身后一头巨大的四足生物正横冲直撞，摧毁沿途一切。城市街区建筑坍塌，断裂电缆迸出火花，火焰在车辆间蔓延。第一人称视角跟踪镜头紧贴她身后，模拟头部快速运动，带有细微抖动和剧烈倾斜，每步间那生物都闯入画面，碎片击打镜头，强烈的运动模糊与求生本能引发的混乱交织。

zh.p: 场景以每3秒快速切换电影镜头的方式拍摄，采用不同机位。镜头1（3秒）——广角定场镜头：两名身着全黑装束、搭配及膝黑色长外套的英俊黑人男子。两人均梳着带有精致纹路的头皮辫，背后展开巨大的天使翅膀不断扇动。他们在布满灰尘的空旷废弃仓库中相互周旋，外套随风飘动，手持武士刀，攻击前弥漫着紧张对峙。镜头2（3秒）——侧面跟拍镜头：一名武士以闪电般的速度弓步前冲，斜劈出武士刀。镜头3（3秒）——低角度机位：第二名武士俯身滑过尘土，同时向上反手挥刀。镜头4（3秒）——俯拍航拍镜头：一名战士凌空翻转，向下劈砍。

Use the provided images as visual references for the Hero Fight League arena, Bee Kang, and Sir Walrus with only a shield in one hand. Anime 2D cel-shaded style only. Clean linework, painted backgrounds, cinematic anime fight energy, no 3D, no photorealism. SFX only, no music, no commentator, no crowd chant.

Inside the arena, Sir Walrus fights aggressively with his shield and free hand, becoming more emotional as the fight progresses. Bee Kang stays calm and highly mobile, using extremely fast martial-arts footwork, evasive movement, and precise counters to stay one step ahead.

Keep the fight dynamic and readable with varied cinematic coverage, including wide shots, close impacts, reaction moments, and angle changes. Bee Kang’s strikes should feel crisp, controlled, and impactful, with clear reactions from Sir Walrus.

[00:00-00:02] Wide arena face-off. Sir Walrus steps forward behind the shield. Bee Kang stands calm and ready.

[00:02-00:04] Sir Walrus launches an aggressive opening attack. Bee Kang narrowly avoids it with quick evasive movement.

[00:04-00:06] Bee Kang counters from a new angle with a fast martial-arts strike, then resets position.

[00:06-00:08] Sir Walrus presses harder, trying to overwhelm him with shield pressure and close-range attacks, but Bee Kang avoids the pressure with fluid footwork.

[00:08-00:10] Bee Kang returns with another quick counter combination.

[00:10-00:12] Fast exchange of attack, evasion, counter, and repositioning, shown through varied cinematic angles.

[00:12-00:15] Bee Kang finishes with a low spinning kick inspired by the reference, landing cleanly across Sir Walrus’s face. End on strong close-combat tension.

Important: Sir Walrus must have only the shield in one hand, no spear. Bee Kang should feel extremely fast, precise, and physically readable.

zh.p: 捐赠者镜头。使用提供的图像作为英雄格斗联盟竞技场、蜜蜂康和仅单手持有盾牌的沃尔鲁斯爵士的视觉参考。仅采用动漫2D赛璐珞风格。线条干净，背景手绘，具有电影般的动漫战斗能量，无3D，无照片写实。仅音效，无音乐，无解说，无人群呐喊。在竞技场内，沃尔鲁斯爵士用盾牌和空手激进战斗，随着战斗进行情绪愈发激动。蜜蜂康保持冷静且高度机动，使用极快的武术步法、闪避移动和精准反击，始终领先一步。通过多样化的电影镜头覆盖（包括广角、近距离冲击、反应时刻和角度变化）保持战斗动态且清晰。蜜蜂康的攻击应感觉干脆、可控且有力，沃尔鲁斯爵士的反应明确。[00:00-00:02] 竞技场广角对峙。沃尔鲁斯爵士持盾向前迈步。蜜蜂康冷静待战。[00:02-00:04] 沃尔鲁斯爵士发动激进开场攻击。蜜蜂康通过快速闪避动作惊险躲开。[00:04-00:06] 蜜蜂康从新角度用快速武术攻击反击，然后复位。[00:06-00:08] 沃尔鲁斯爵士加大压力，试图用盾牌压迫和近身攻击压制他，但蜜蜂康以流畅步法避开压力。[00:08-00:10] 蜜蜂康再次快速反击组合。[00:10-00:12] 通过多样化的电影角度展示攻击、闪避、反击和重新定位的快速交换。[00:12-00:15] 蜜蜂康以参考中启发的低扫踢结束，干净地击中沃尔鲁斯爵士面部。以强烈的近战紧张感收尾。重要提示：沃尔鲁斯爵士必须仅单手持有盾牌，无长矛。蜜蜂康应感觉极快、精准且动作清晰可辨。

en.p:
Cinematic supernatural thriller, small-town night setting, foggy atmosphere, flickering streetlights, abandoned houses, deep shadows, cool blue tones mixed with dim warm practical lights, subtle film grain, eerie tension.

0–3s: wide shot of an empty street at night, fog drifting slowly, distant electrical buzzing, a group of scared young people walking cautiously, looking around, whispering, handheld camera with slight shake.

3–6s: medium close-up, one girl stops suddenly, sensing something, eyes widen, slow head turn toward a dark alley, background lights flicker irregularly.

6–9s: tracking shot, group slowly backs away, tension rising, faint unnatural sound builds, shadows in the alley seem to stretch and move unnaturally.

9–12s: close-up on a boy holding a flashlight, beam shaking, light flickers, briefly revealing a tall distorted humanoid silhouette deep in the darkness, barely visible.

12–15s: sudden reveal, creature shifts slightly forward, elongated limbs and unnatural posture, lights burst and go dark for a split second, quick cut to black as the group reacts in fear, heavy atmospheric finish, cinematic horror tone.

zh.p: 电影级超自然惊悚片，小镇夜景，雾气弥漫，路灯闪烁，废弃房屋，深邃阴影，冷蓝色调与昏暗暖色实用灯光交织，微妙的胶片颗粒感，令人不安的紧张氛围。0-3秒：空旷街道的广角夜景，雾气缓缓飘移，远处传来电流嗡鸣声，一群神色惊恐的年轻人谨慎前行，环顾四周，低声交谈，手持摄影机轻微晃动。3-6秒：中近景镜头，一名女孩突然停步，察觉到异样，双眼圆睁，缓缓转头望向黑暗小巷，背景灯光不规则闪烁。6-9秒：跟拍镜头，众人缓慢后退，紧张感加剧，微弱的非自然声响渐起，巷中阴影仿佛不自然地延伸扭动。9-12秒：男孩手持手电筒的特写，光束颤抖，灯光闪烁，短暂照亮黑暗中一个高大扭曲的人形轮廓，若隐若现。12-15秒：突然揭示，怪物微微前倾，四肢修长，姿态诡异，灯光爆裂后瞬间陷入黑暗，快速切至黑屏，众人惊恐反应，浓重的氛围收尾，电影级恐怖基调。

zh.p: 超写实印度教室街头斗殴。单次连续长镜头，无剪辑。原始手持手机拍摄，带有自然微抖动、轻微滚动快门，无防抖。纪录片式真实感。音频：无音乐。仅保留原始环境音——脚步声、课桌摩擦声、衣物摩擦声、拳击声、风扇嗡鸣、呼吸声、远处教室嘈杂声。灯光：混合暖色+冷色电影色调。教室实用照明。吊扇阴影移动。光柱中可见灰尘颗粒。主角（严格身份锁定）：印度男性（17-18岁），冷峻无表情面孔，与参考图像完全一致。黑色直发侧梳，棕色杏仁眼，锐利下颌线，自然印度肤色，瘦削面庞。服装锁定（不可更改）：黑色校服西装外套、白衬衫、黑领带、黑裤。无连帽衫/叠穿。西装外套略微修身，领带松散。全片必须保持完全一致。动作：0-2秒：主角从背后抓住对手A，单手将其头部猛砸向课桌。书本/铅笔向外飞散。课桌因摩擦拖动。A瘫软倒地。2-5秒：抓住对手B，一拳击中腹部，B弯腰，随即头部被猛砸向课桌。头部短暂压在地砖上。镜头短暂稳定。B面朝下倒地。粗重呼吸，可见汗水。5-6秒：西装外套轻微移位，衬衫+领带露出（领带歪斜）。C和D从后方进入，分左右包抄。仅剩脚步声、风扇嗡鸣。6-8秒：混战。D快速出拳攻击。主角略微踉跄。C抓住西装外套向后拉扯。膝盖击中腹部。身体前倾。粗重呼吸。风扇阴影移动。8-10秒：头槌击中D，D踉跄。主角利落地抓住C的衣领。10-12秒（黑板撞击）：主角将C猛推向绿色黑板。背部先撞上，头部轻微后仰。粉笔灰向外爆散，在暖光中完全可见。粉笔槽咔嗒作响，碎片掉落。撞击瞬间微慢动作（0.2-0.3秒）后恢复实时速度。C失去力气，沿黑板滑下留下粉笔痕迹，瘫倒。灰尘飘散。12-13秒：D冲向主角，主角侧步闪避，旋转一拳击中颧骨。汗水在空中划出弧线。D撞翻课桌。大面积倒塌，书本散落。D不动，手垂下。主角勉强站立，粗重呼吸。13-14秒：中近景。胸膛起伏。缓慢转向镜头。透过眼镜的冰冷眼神对视。擦去鼻血（可见血迹）。摘下眼镜扔向一旁，旋转落地。14-15秒（结尾）：地面水平广角镜头。边缘轻微模糊，暖色调，金色灰尘。主角摘下眼镜，脱下西装外套→扔向对手。仅剩白衬衫+黑领带。领带松散，轻微晃动。走向出口。外套落下。寂静教室。灰尘漂浮。渐黑。

en.p:
FORMAT
cinematic continuous shot / motivated camera movement / 15s
SCENE
A bustling Elizabethan-era market street in London, circa 1500s, at dusk. Timber-framed buildings lean over a narrow muddy street, upper floors nearly touching. Wooden market stalls overflow with bread, fish, herbs, and cloth. Butchers’ hooks hang with raw meat, barrels of ale line the الطريق, and livestock—geese, chickens, and a stray pig—wander freely.
Vendors shout in the 거리, accents rough and lively. Smoke rises from chimneys, mixing with damp fog rolling in from the nearby River Thames. The ground is wet, reflecting torchlight and lantern glow in uneven puddles.
CAMERA CONCEPT
A continuous, motivated camera move where each subject’s motion naturally redirects attention—flowing like a living observer through the chaos of the market.
SEQUENCE
0:00–0:03
Close street-level view of a wooden stall stacked with apples and root vegetables.
CAMERA FOCUS: a cloaked woman argues over price with a merchant. She bites into an apple to test it, then reluctantly drops worn coins into his hand.
0:03–0:05
A horse-drawn cart loaded with sacks of grain suddenly splashes through muddy water across the foreground, briefly obscuring the scene.
CAMERA SHIFT: the camera picks up the cart and begins tracking alongside it.

zh.p:
格式：电影化连续镜头 / 有动机的摄影机运动 / 15秒
场景：16世纪伦敦伊丽莎白时代熙攘的集市街，黄昏时分。木框架建筑倾斜在狭窄泥泞的街道上，上层楼面几乎相触。木制货摊堆满面包、鱼、香草和布料。肉铺挂钩悬挂生肉，啤酒桶沿街排列，家禽——鹅、鸡和一只流浪猪——自由游荡。小贩在街上吆喝，口音粗犷而生动。烟囱升起的炊烟与泰晤士河飘来的潮湿雾气交织。地面湿润，火把和灯笼的光在凹凸不平的水洼中闪烁。

摄影概念：连续且有动机的摄影机运动，每个主体的动作自然引导视线转移——如同一个活生生的观察者穿梭于市场的混乱之中。

序列：
0:00–0:03：低角度街景，木制货摊堆满苹果和根茎蔬菜。摄影机焦点：一位披斗篷的妇女正与商贩讨价还价。她咬了一口苹果试味，随后不情愿地将磨损的硬币丢入商贩手中。
0:03–0:05：一辆载满谷物袋的马车突然溅起泥水冲过前景，短暂遮蔽画面。摄影机转移：镜头跟随马车，开始平行移动。
0:05–0:07：马车在狭窄街道中颠簸前行，擦过一面悬挂的布制旗帜，旗上褪色的行会徽章隐约可见。布料掠过镜头。摄影机转移：布料移开后，一群鹅在道路上四散惊叫。
0:07–0:09：一个衣衫褴褛的街头男孩突然闯入画面，手持木棍追赶鹅群，穿梭于人群和篮子之间。摄影机转移：镜头跟随男孩，躲避过往行人。
0:09–0:12：男孩冲过昏暗酒馆入口，消失在人群中。摄影机转移：酒馆门吱呀作响，一名醉醺醺的顾客踉跄走出。
0:12–0:15：镜头滑过他，进入酒馆内部。浓烟弥漫空中，被摇曳的油灯照亮。粗糙的木桌、泼洒的麦酒、低语的人声。摄影机最终焦点：角落中坐着一位沉默的盔甲身影——并非光鲜的骑士，而是饱经风霜的雇佣兵——泥污的靴子、凹陷的铠甲、一柄长剑倚靠在长凳旁。他缓缓抬眼，望向镜头。

风格：真实的伊丽莎白街头生活，密集人群编排，写实主义基调，历史质感细节。

灯光：室外湿泥反射温暖的火把光，冷雾弥漫；室内昏暗的金色油灯光晕，烟雾浓重。

品质：照片级真实感，电影化布光，历史细节扎实，沉浸式镜头流动，浓郁的16世纪伦敦氛围。

en.p: A 10-second scene of a smiling girl in a castle, inviting someone from the boundary between dream and reality. She whispers two lines in Japanese. Elegant and mysterious. Soft pastels and gold. The character is a silver-haired girl in a fluffy princess dress, with an elegant, composed smile and a fairy-like mystique. She says, 'Come this way, now...' with a smile, invitingly. The light increases, and the entire castle glows. The BGM is elegant and mysterious ambient, with main instruments like harp or music box, scattered bell sounds, and an overall transparent, dreamy tone. Tempo is slow, mysterious, and dreamlike. No vocals, only sounds. Prohibited: dark colors, sad expressions, and sudden movements.

zh.p:
【映像コンセプト】
城でにっこり笑う少女が、夢と現実の狭間で誰かを招待する10秒。ウィスパーボイス（日本語）で呟く2つのセリフ。優雅で妖しい。淡いパステル×ゴールド。

【キャラクター】
銀髪の少女。ふわふわなプリンセスドレス。優雅で余裕ある笑顔。妖精的な神秘性。

【背景】
壮大なファンタジー城。パステルピンク、淡い紫、ゴールド。光が差し込む。

【Shot 1（0-5秒）】
カメラ：城の中。少女が笑顔で立つ。
少女：「ふふ、夢か現実なんて、どうだっていいじゃありませんか」（優雅な笑顔で）光がやさしく彼女を包む。

【Shot 2（5-10秒）】
カメラ：少女が手を伸ばす。
少女：「こっちにいらして、さぁ…」（にっこり。誘うように）光が増す。城全体が輝く。

【BGM】
優雅で妖しいアンビエント。メイン楽器はハープまたはオルゴール。鈴の音が点在。全体は透明感のある、夢のような音色。
テンポ：ゆっくり。神秘的で、夢心地。
ボーカル：なし。音のみ。

【禁止】暗い色。悲しい表情。急激な動き。

Create a 15-second vertical 9:16 ultra-realistic cinematic cooking scene with warm natural lighting and a cozy kitchen environment. A real human woman is clearly visible throughout the scene, including her face, hands, and focused expressions while baking.

Top-down + slight angled cinematic camera showing a warm wooden table near a window with sunlight streaming in. All ingredients and tools are neatly arranged and visible: Oreo cookies, eggs, butter, sugar, flour, cocoa powder, heavy cream, vanilla extract, macarons, blueberries, sakura flowers, chocolate bar, piping bags, offset spatula, cake pan, cooling rack.

(0–2s): The woman crushes Oreo cookies inside a bag using a rolling pin on a wooden table. Close-up of her hands and focused face in soft sunlight.

(2–4s): Melted butter is mixed into Oreo crumbs and pressed firmly into a cake pan base. Her face shows concentration as she works.

(4–6s): She cracks eggs one by one into a bowl, adds sugar, and whisks until pale and smooth. Camera captures her face and hands clearly.

(6–8s): Flour and cocoa powder are sifted into the mixture and gently folded with a spatula. Her expression remains calm and precise.

(8–10s): Heavy cream and vanilla are added, creating a smooth dark chocolate batter. Close-up of her mixing motion and focused face.

(10–11s): Batter is poured into the cake pan evenly.

(11–12s): The cake is shown baking in the oven with a warm golden glow. Timer feel implied.

(12–13s): The baked cake is placed on a cooling rack. Steam gently rises.

(13–14s): Chocolate ganache is poured over the cake, slowly dripping down the sides. Offset spatula smooths the top in one clean motion.

(14–15s): Final decoration: piping cream rosettes, Oreo cookies placed around edges, macarons in center, blueberries scattered, sakura flowers added delicately by hand. Sunlight highlights glossy chocolate finish.

Ultra-realistic cinematic look, warm cozy mood, natural sunlight, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, emotional calm cooking atmosphere.

zh.p: 制作一段15秒的竖屏9:16超写实电影级烹饪场景，采用温暖自然光线和舒适的厨房环境。全程清晰可见一位真实女性，包括她的面部、双手以及烘焙时的专注表情。俯拍加轻微角度的电影镜头，展现窗边洒满阳光的木质餐桌。所有食材和工具整齐摆放且清晰可见：奥利奥饼干、鸡蛋、黄油、糖、面粉、可可粉、淡奶油、香草精、马卡龙、蓝莓、樱花、巧克力棒、裱花袋、抹刀、蛋糕模具、冷却架。（0-2秒）：女性在木桌上用擀面杖将袋装奥利奥饼干压碎。特写她的双手和专注的面部，沐浴在柔和阳光下。（2-4秒）：将融化的黄油混入奥利奥碎中，用力压实在蛋糕模具底部。她工作时神情专注。（4-6秒）：她将鸡蛋逐个打入碗中，加入糖，搅拌至颜色发白顺滑。镜头清晰捕捉她的面部和双手。（6-8秒）：将面粉和可可粉筛入混合物中，用刮刀轻柔翻拌。她的表情保持平静而精准。（8-10秒）：加入淡奶油和香草精，形成顺滑的深色巧克力面糊。特写她搅拌的动作和专注的面部。（10-11秒）：将面糊均匀倒入蛋糕模具。（11-12秒）：蛋糕在烤箱中烘烤，泛着温暖的金色光泽，营造出计时器的暗示感。（12-13秒）：烤好的蛋糕放在冷却架上，缓缓升起蒸汽。（13-14秒）：将巧克力甘纳许淋在蛋糕上，缓慢滴落边缘。抹刀一次干净利落地抹平顶部。（14-15秒）：最终装饰：裱出奶油玫瑰花，边缘摆放奥利奥饼干，中心放置马卡龙，撒上蓝莓，用手精巧地放上樱花。阳光凸显巧克力表面的光泽质感。超写实电影感，温暖舒适的氛围，自然光线，浅景深，柔和胶片颗粒，宁静温馨的烹饪情绪。

en.p: A cinematic side-tracking shot of a young woman (same as reference image) riding a sleek modern motorbike through a vibrant city at dusk. She wears a fitted black leather jacket and matching leather pants, with subtle metallic accents. Her hair flows naturally in the wind as she rides at a steady, confident speed, not rushed, but purposeful. The camera moves smoothly alongside her in a lateral tracking shot, maintaining a medium profile angle that highlights both her expression and the bike’s motion. The background features blurred city lights, passing cars, neon reflections, and soft motion streaks, creating a strong sense of movement and depth. Lighting is cinematic, warm streetlights mixed with cool ambient tones, reflecting off the bike and wet pavement. Slight lens flares and bokeh enhance the atmosphere. The environment feels alive but not chaotic. Ultra-realistic, cinematic color grading, smooth motion, high detail, film-like quality, 4K, anamorphic lens feel, subtle camera shake for realism.

zh.p: 一个电影感的横向跟拍镜头：一位年轻女性（与参考图一致）在黄昏时分骑着时尚的现代摩托车穿行于繁华都市。她身穿合身的黑色皮夹克与配套皮裤，点缀着细微的金属光泽。长发随风自然飘动，以稳健自信的速度骑行——不显匆忙，却带着明确的目的性。镜头以横向平移的方式平滑跟随，保持中景侧面角度，既捕捉她的神情，也展现摩托车的动态。背景中模糊的城市灯光、穿梭的车辆、霓虹倒影与柔和的光轨交织，营造出强烈的运动感与纵深。光影处理充满电影质感：温暖的街灯与冷调环境光交融，在车身与湿润路面上形成反射。轻微的镜头光晕与散景效果增强了氛围。画面采用浅景深，骑手主体清晰锐利，背景柔化虚化。她的表情冷静、自信，略带专注，仿佛正执行着某项使命。环境充满生机却毫不杂乱。超写实电影级调色，动作流畅，细节丰富，呈现胶片质感，4K分辨率，带有变形镜头特有的视觉风格，并辅以细微的镜头抖动增强真实感。

Use @[storyboard] as the main storyboard reference for the full sequence. Follow the same character consistency, wardrobe, backyard setting, comedic tone, and retro 1970s cinematic visual style shown in the storyboard.

Create a single 15 second retro 1970s cinematic backyard comedy video. Kodak 5247 film look, vibrant warm colors, golden hour sunlight, soft film grain, subtle film scratches, light leaks, playful slapstick comedy tone.

Scene progression with dialogue:
0–5 seconds: A stylish woman in a bright hot pink mini dress and high heels walks slowly across a sunny suburban backyard beside a swimming pool. Her long hair flows in the breeze, she smiles playfully toward the camera.
Audio: Upbeat 70s funk music.
Dialogue: Woman, softly playful at 3s: “Well… hello, sunshine.”
5–8 seconds: Cut to Mike, a fit young gardener in his 20s, wearing a tank top, riding a red lawnmower while mowing straight lines. He suddenly looks up and notices her. His eyes lock on her.
Audio: Music suddenly stops with a record scratch.
Dialogue: Mike, stunned at 6.5s: “Whoa…”
8–11 seconds: Mike reacts in exaggerated comedic shock. His eyes widen, jaw drops, and his hands slip off the steering wheel as he forgets he is still driving.
Audio: Dreamy harp sting.
Dialogue: Mike, panicking softly at 9.5s: “Oh no… no, no, no.”
11–15 seconds:The lawnmower veers through a flower bed and crashes into the swimming pool with a huge splash. Mike lands in the water. Final moment: Mike sits soaked in the pool, red mower half-submerged nearby, while the woman laughs softly in the background. End on a freeze frame of Mike giving a weak thumbs-up.
Audio: Flower bed crunch, loud splash, then comedic boing on the final freeze frame.
Dialogue: Mike, soaked and embarrassed at 13.5s: “I’m okay.” Woman, laughing softly at 14.3s: “Nice parking, Mike.”
Camera: Use cinematic shot progression matching the storyboard: slow motion tracking shot for the woman, medium shot and slow push in for Mike noticing her, close up for Mike’s reaction, wide action shot for the crash, then medium comedic final frame in the pool.
Lighting: Warm golden hour sunlight, soft shadows, bright pool reflections, subtle lens flare, nostalgic summer atmosphere.

A wide cinematic shot of a quiet city at night, wet roads reflecting neon lights.
A powerful heavy bike engine sound fades in.The girl slowly enters frame, mounting her heavy bike with calm confidence.Helmet adjustment, close-up on hands gripping the throttle.

4s – 8s (Ignition & Start)
Close-up of ignition turning ON.
Bike headlights flare dramatically into the dark street. She revs the engine once strong vibration, cinematic slow motion. Camera rotates around her showing determined expression (face consistent with reference image).

8s – 12s (Ride Begins)
Fast tracking shot from behind as she speeds through empty neon-lit streets. Wind motion, jacket movement, light streaks reflecting on the bike. Low angle shots emphasize power and dominance of the heavy bike. City feels alive but silent around her.

12s – 16s (Climax Shot)
High speed cinematic side tracking shot. She rides confidently into a glowing tunnel of light. Slow motion transition as her face briefly turns toward camera calm, powerful expression (reference face consistency maintained).
Fade out into neon glow + engine sound fading.

zh.p: 0秒至4秒（开场镜头）：城市夜景的宽幅电影镜头，湿漉漉的马路反射着霓虹灯光。重型摩托车引擎的轰鸣声渐入。女孩缓缓步入画面，冷静自信地跨上重型机车。调整头盔，特写镜头聚焦她握紧油门的手。4秒至8秒（点火启动）：特写镜头显示点火开关开启。摩托车头灯骤然照亮黑暗的街道。她猛轰一次油门——强烈的震动，电影慢动作。镜头环绕她旋转，捕捉其坚定的表情（与参考图面部保持一致）。8秒至12秒（骑行开始）：快速跟拍镜头从后方跟随她疾驰过空无一人的霓虹街道。风吹动衣摆，夹克翻飞，灯光条纹在摩托车上流动。低角度镜头强调重型机车的动力与统治力。城市在她周围显得生机勃勃却寂静无声。12秒至16秒（高潮镜头）：高速侧方跟拍电影镜头。她自信地驶入一条发光的隧道。慢动作过渡中，她短暂转头面向镜头——冷静而充满力量的表情（保持参考图面部一致性）。画面渐隐于霓虹光芒中，引擎声逐渐消散。

Mid-air the driver ejects, deploying a wingsuit parachute while the car crashes into a lava river below. The camera follows the driver gliding above the erupting volcano landscape. Volcanic stunt launch, wingsuit ejection, lava explosions below, cinematic disaster landscape, 4K.

A highly detailed, mysterious optical illusion personality test image designed to go massively viral on X/Twitter. The text at the top in bold, eye-catching white font with black outline reads: "This image knows your personality — What did you see first?"

Create a complex double-image optical illusion in a dark, moody, cinematic style with high contrast and rich colors. Show two completely different clear interpretations that compete for attention:

- One prominent figure: a beautiful elegant woman in a flowing dress looking over her shoulder (mysterious and alluring)
- Hidden in the negative space and lines: a fierce roaring lion or wolf staring directly at the viewer

Make both interpretations equally strong and obvious once noticed, but the brain flips between them. Dramatic lighting, subtle smoke/fog elements, intricate patterns in the hair/dress that form the animal features. Dark fantasy aesthetic, deep purples, blacks, golds and crimson accents. Cinematic composition, perfect for social media.

Ultra-detailed, 8k, trending on X, maximum engagement style, mysterious and intriguing atmosphere.

zh.p:
一张高度精细、充满神秘感的视错觉人格测试图，专为在X/Twitter上病毒式传播而设计。顶部以粗体、醒目的白色字体配黑色描边写着：“这张图看透你的性格——你第一眼看到了什么？”采用黑暗、情绪化、电影感的风格，高对比度与丰富色彩，打造复杂的双重图像视错觉。呈现两个截然不同、相互争夺注意力的清晰解读：
- 一个突出的人物：一位身着飘逸长裙的优雅美女，回眸一瞥（神秘而迷人）
- 隐藏在负空间与线条中：一只凶猛咆哮的狮子或狼，直勾勾地盯着观者
两种解读一旦被察觉，都同样强烈且明显，但大脑会在两者间切换。戏剧性光影、微妙的烟雾/雾气元素、头发/裙摆中构成动物特征的复杂图案。暗黑奇幻美学，深紫、黑、金与深红点缀。电影感构图，完美适配社交媒体。超精细、8K画质、X平台热门趋势、极致互动风格，神秘而引人入胜的氛围。
