Audio: Only natural environment sound loud crowd cheering, overlapping voices shouting, rapid camera shutter clicks, phones recording audio, distant airport announcements echoing, footsteps, fabric movement, subtle engine idle and revving.
Lighting: Natural daylight filtering through large airport glass panels. Mixed reflections on polished surfaces. Soft but realistic shadows. Slight atmospheric haze for depth.
Main Character: @IMG
Calm, controlled presence. Subtle confident smile. Face identity must remain perfectly consistent across all frames.
Outfit (STRICT LOCK):
Black zip-up jacket (matte, soft fleece texture) worn open
Clean light grey/white t-shirt underneath
Beige/cream tailored pants
Accessories:
Transparent beige square-frame luxury-style sunglasses with gradient lenses
(No branding, no logo, no variation)
Scene Flow
0–3s:
Camera starts from inside a dense crowd behind barricades. Handheld, slightly unstable. View partially blocked by people in front. Multiple phones raised, some screens visible recording. Crowd energy is loud, chaotic, restless.
3–6s:
Camera lifts slightly above shoulder level, still handheld. Focus shifts naturally between heads, waving hands, and glimpses of the arrival gate. Occasional bright flashes from media cameras. Anticipation rises as crowd leans forward.
6–10s:
Security personnel step in, pushing the crowd back slightly. Camera reacts with natural shake. Through shifting gaps, the main character appears in the distance—initially soft and partially obscured, gradually becoming clearer while walking forward with a small escort team.
10–13s:
Subtle handheld push-in (natural movement, not digital zoom). The main character is now clearly visible, walking confidently at center frame. Path is being cleared. He raises one hand and gives a calm, controlled wave with a slight smile. Camera struggles slightly to keep framing due to crowd movement.
13–15s:
Camera shifts and tilts trying to follow. A luxury convoy becomes partially visible: a low-profile angular sports car in front, followed by two large premium SUVs. A security member opens a vertical-style door. The main character enters quickly. Engine revs naturally. Vehicles begin moving forward. Camera lifts slightly as people try to capture the moment.

zh.p: 风格：超写实的大规模名人抵达现场。单次连续镜头。手持摄像机从人群视角拍摄。自然的轻微抖动。无剪辑。纪录片级别的真实感。音频：仅收录自然环境音——人群震耳欲聋的欢呼声、重叠的喊叫声、相机快门的快速咔嚓声、手机录像声、远处机场广播的回音、脚步声、衣物摩擦声、以及引擎怠速与加速的细微声响。光线：自然日光透过机场大型玻璃面板洒落。抛光表面形成混合反射。柔和但真实的阴影。略带大气雾霭以增强景深感。主要人物：@IMG 冷静克制的存在感。嘴角挂着微妙的自信微笑。面部特征必须在所有画面中保持完全一致。服装（严格锁定）：黑色拉链夹克（哑光、柔软抓绒质感）敞开穿着，内搭干净的浅灰/白色T恤，米色/奶油色定制长裤。配饰：透明米色方框奢华风格渐变太阳镜（无品牌标识、无Logo、无任何变化）。场景流程：0–3秒：镜头从路障后方密集的人群内部开始。手持拍摄，略带不稳定感。视野被前方人群部分遮挡。多部手机举起，部分屏幕可见正在录像。人群喧闹、混乱、躁动不安。3–6秒：镜头略微抬升至肩膀以上，仍保持手持。焦点在人群头部、挥舞的手臂以及到达口的一瞥之间自然切换。媒体相机的闪光灯偶尔亮起。随着人群前倾，期待感逐渐升温。6–10秒：安保人员介入，将人群向后推挤。镜头随之自然晃动。透过移动的缝隙，主要人物出现在远处——起初模糊且部分被遮挡，随后在小型护卫团队的陪同下稳步前行，逐渐清晰可见。10–13秒：手持镜头轻微推进（自然移动，非数字变焦）。主要人物现在清晰可见，自信地走在画面中央。通道被清理出来。他抬起一只手，带着淡淡的微笑冷静克制地挥手致意。由于人群移动，镜头在构图时略显吃力。13–15秒：镜头移动并倾斜试图跟随。豪华车队部分可见：前方是一辆低矮棱角分明的运动型轿车，随后是两辆大型高端SUV。一名安保人员打开一扇垂直开启的车门。主要人物迅速进入车内。引擎自然加速。车辆开始前行。镜头略微抬起，人们争相捕捉这一瞬间。

en.p:
**[0s-5s]**
Close-up on the man’s face as he lies in the crater; his eyes snap open, glowing with a hollow, void-like black light. He erupts upward in a **violent burst of dark energy**, instantly clearing the smoke. The camera executes a **rapid whip-pan** to follow him as he teleports—appearing as a black blur—behind the woman. She reacts with a spinning back-kick, but he catches her ankle mid-air, the dark energy "corroding" the air around his hand.

**[5s-10s]**
High-speed tracking shot. The man swings the woman with superhuman force, slamming her through a series of **rotting wooden shoji screens**. The camera follows her through the debris in a single, continuous lateral move. She flips mid-air to recover, but he is already there, delivering a **brutal flurry of palm strikes** infused with black lightning. Each hit creates a localized gravity distortion, warping the light around them.

**[10s-15s]**
The camera switches to a **shaky, handheld POV** from the woman’s perspective as she is driven back toward a stone lantern. He charges a final, massive sphere of dark energy between his palms and thrusts it forward. The shot cuts to a **wide overhead view** as the courtyard floor shatters completely, the lantern disintegrating into dust. 4K ultra HD, high-contrast lighting, intense particle effects. 

**Audio:** 
Distorted electronic screeches, the sound of glass shattering, deep-frequency "void" hums, and a deafening, bass-boosted explosion as the energy connects.

zh.p: 【0-5秒】男子躺在弹坑中的面部特写，他猛然睁眼，瞳孔中泛起空洞虚无的黑色光芒。随着一道狂暴的暗能量爆发，他冲天而起，瞬间驱散烟雾。镜头急速甩拍追踪他瞬移的黑色残影，闪现至女子身后。女子旋身回踢，却被他凌空抓住脚踝，暗能量在他掌缘腐蚀空气。 【5-10秒】高速跟拍镜头。男子以超人力道挥臂，将女子砸穿数扇腐朽的木质障子门。镜头连续横向移动，跟随她穿过碎屑。女子空中翻转试图稳住身形，男子却已近身，裹挟黑色闪电的暴风骤雨般掌击倾泻而下。每次击中都会引发局部重力扭曲，令周遭光线变形。 【10-15秒】镜头切换为女子视角的摇晃手持主观镜头，她被逼退至石灯笼前。男子双掌间凝聚出最终巨型暗能量球，猛然向前推进。画面切至广角俯拍，庭院地面彻底碎裂，石灯笼化为齑粉。4K超高清画质，高对比度光影，粒子特效炸裂。 【音效】扭曲的电子尖啸、玻璃碎裂声、低频虚空嗡鸣，以及能量碰撞时震耳欲聋的重低音爆炸声。

en.p:
A cheerful and attractive American female influencer is filming a UGC-style video in a cozy, sunlit bedroom, speaking directly to the camera while casually going through her morning routine. The video feels natural and unfiltered, like a real moment from her day rather than staged content. She speaks in clear English with a natural American accent, using a calm, friendly, and relatable tone.
She is wearing a soft, minimal lounge outfit—like an oversized sweater and shorts—with natural, no-makeup makeup and slightly messy hair.
She smiles gently, occasionally adjusting the camera or sipping from a mug while talking.
She says:
"I don’t know who needs to hear this, but you don’t have to have your life together by 9am. Some days I wake up slow, take my time, and honestly… those days feel the best."
The room is softly lit with natural sunlight coming through a window. Background is minimal—bed, plant, maybe a mirror.
Camera shot: handheld, slightly shaky front-facing camera, medium close-up.
Overall style: cozy, real-life, soft aesthetic.
Language: English
Accent: American
Tone: calm, comforting, relatable
Speaking speed: slow to natural

zh.p: 一位开朗迷人的美国女博主正在一间温馨、阳光充足的卧室里拍摄一条UGC风格的视频。她一边对着镜头说话，一边随意地做着晨间例行事务。视频感觉自然且未经修饰，就像她一天中真实的瞬间，而不是刻意编排的内容。她用清晰的美式英语、自然的美式口音，以平静、友好且接地气的语气说话。她穿着一身柔软简约的居家服——比如一件宽松毛衣和短裤——妆容自然，近乎素颜，头发略显凌乱。她温柔地微笑着，偶尔调整一下相机，或者边说话边啜饮杯子里的饮品。她说：‘我不知道谁需要听到这个，但你不必在早上9点前就把生活安排得井井有条。有些日子我慢慢醒来，不慌不忙，说实话……那些日子感觉最棒。’房间里柔和地洒满透过窗户照进来的自然光。背景简洁——床、一盆植物，也许还有一面镜子。镜头画面：手持拍摄，前置摄像头略带晃动，中近景。整体风格：温馨、真实、柔和的美感。语言：英语。口音：美式。语气：平静、令人安心、接地气。语速：缓慢到自然。

en.p: A stylized illustrated poster titled “An Art of Freestyle – Basketball Style.” The artwork features a teenage boy with short black hair, wearing a khaki school uniform shirt and black pants, performing basketball freestyle moves across a 4x4 grid (16 panels). Each panel shows a different dribbling or trick move, such as crossover, behind-the-back, between-the-legs, finger spin, hesitation, and spin moves. The art style is semi-realistic anime with soft shading, sketch-like linework, and muted earthy tones. The background is lightly sketched urban scenery, giving a street basketball vibe. Purple doodle accents (arrows, stars, circles) highlight motion and energy throughout the panels. Each frame includes small handwritten captions describing the move (e.g., “Bounce with control,” “Cross it over,” “Finger spin magic”). The overall composition feels like a creative instructional poster mixed with street art aesthetics. Add subtle texture like paper grain for a hand-drawn feel. At the bottom, include a motivational tagline in handwritten font: “Practice. Express. Have Fun. That’s Freestyle.” A sketch-style poster comes to life. Start with a still frame of a hand-drawn title: “An Art of Freestyle – Basketball Style.” Soft paper texture, pencil strokes visible. [0–3s] Camera slowly zooms in as the first panel animates — a teenage boy in a khaki school uniform spins a basketball in his hand. Purple doodle arrows flicker into motion. [3–6s] Quick cuts between panels: – Low dribble (ball bouncing smoothly) – Crossover (fast hand switch) – Between the legs (clean transition) Each move leaves behind sketchy motion trails. [6–9s] Behind-the-back and spin move animate fluidly. The background remains lightly sketched, while purple accents (stars, arrows) pulse with energy. [9–12s] Finger spin trick — ball spins on his finger in slow motion. Then a hesitation move freezes briefly, followed by a sudden explosive dash forward. [12–15s] Final pose: the boy lands confidently, spinning the ball again. The poster fully forms back into a clean layout. Text writes itself in a handwritten style: “Practice. Express. Have Fun. That’s Freestyle.” 🎧 Audio: Lo-fi hip-hop beat with basketball bounce sound effects synced to transitions.

zh.p: 一幅风格化的插画海报，标题为《自由式艺术——篮球风格》。画面中，一位黑色短发少年身着卡其色校服衬衫与黑色长裤，在4x4网格（共16格）中展示篮球自由式动作。每格呈现不同的运球或花式技巧，如交叉步、背后运球、胯下运球、指尖旋转、急停假动作及转身动作。艺术风格为半写实动漫，融合柔和阴影、素描感线条与哑光大地色调。背景以轻描淡写的城市街景勾勒，营造街头篮球氛围。紫色涂鸦元素（箭头、星星、圆圈）贯穿各格，突出动感与能量。每帧附有手写小字说明动作（如“掌控节奏的运球”“交叉突破”“指尖旋转魔法”）。整体构图兼具创意教学海报与街头艺术美学。添加纸张纹理等细腻质感，强化手绘效果。底部以手写字体呈现励志标语：“练习。表达。享受乐趣。这就是自由式。”一幅素描风格海报跃然眼前。开场定格手绘标题：“自由式艺术——篮球风格”。柔和纸张纹理与铅笔笔触清晰可见。[0–3秒] 镜头缓缓推近，首格画面中，身着卡其校服的少年单手旋转篮球。紫色涂鸦箭头闪烁跃动。[3–6秒] 多格快速切换：低运球（篮球平稳弹跳）、交叉步（快速换手）、胯下运球（流畅衔接）。每个动作留下素描感运动轨迹。[6–9秒] 背后运球与转身动作流畅呈现。背景保持轻描淡写，紫色元素（星星、箭头）随能量脉动。[9–12秒] 指尖旋转技巧——篮球在指尖慢速旋转。随后急停假动作短暂定格，继而爆发式前冲。[12–15秒] 最终定格：少年自信落地，再次旋转篮球。海报完整恢复为清晰布局。文字以手写风格逐字浮现：“练习。表达。享受乐趣。这就是自由式。”🎧 音频：低保真嘻哈节拍搭配篮球弹跳音效，与画面切换同步。

en.p:
seconds, photoreal cinematic live-action with seamless macro scale transition, anamorphic lens feel, extreme shallow depth of field, volumetric light, golden embers and dust particles drifting through frame, warm amber and gold highlights with deep teal shadows. No subtitles, no text, no narration.

Opening frame: extreme close-up on the wooden shaft of a flying arrow that fills the entire frame, soft-blurred ancient battlefield glowing in the background, embers drifting past in slow motion at 120fps feel.

0-4s — Macro push-in on the shaft:
Camera pushes slowly forward along the arrow shaft. Focus racks across the surface, revealing intricate carved runes, lacquer cracks, and weathered wood grain. Light glints off the iron arrowhead in the distance of frame. A seamless, imperceptible scale shift begins — the grain of the wood deepens into canyon-like ridges, the carved runes become massive cliff walls, lacquer flakes turn into stone slabs. Sound design morphs from muffled battlefield roar into a deeper, echoing micro-world ambience.

4-9s — Microscopic civilization on the arrow:
Full macro reveal. A tiny civilization of splinter-sized warriors wages its own war across the fletching and shaft. Miniature soldiers in matching East Asian lamellar armor scale the carved runes like canyon walls using ropes and ladders. Tiny catapults along the shaft hurl fragments of dust and wood splinters that arc through the air in slow motion. Rows of micro-banners in red and blue wave between the feather barbs of the fletching, which tower overhead like enormous plumes. Tiny torches flicker along the shaft, casting warm pinpoint glows. Two opposing micro-formations clash near a rune carving, swords sparking. Camera does a slow lateral dolly along the shaft, revealing more of this hidden world, then settles on a single micro-warrior raising his banner triumphantly. Final frame holds on this tiny hero against the blurred, glowing battlefield far below as the arrow continues its endless slow-motion flight through golden embers.

Cinematography: single continuous macro take, smooth weighty camera motion, no jitter, no cuts. Believable miniature physics — tiny cloth banners, ropes, sparks, dust all behave at micro scale.

Atmosphere: dreamlike and mythic, the discovery of an entire hidden world living on a single arrow in flight. The vast battlefield and the micro-civilization mirror each other.

zh.p: 秒级时长，电影级逼真画面，无缝宏观到微观尺度转换，变形镜头质感，极浅景深，体积光，金色余烬与尘埃粒子在画面中飘荡，暖琥珀色与金色高光，搭配深蓝绿色阴影。无字幕、无文字、无旁白。开场画面：飞箭的木制箭杆占据整个画面的极端特写，背景中模糊的古战场泛着微光，余烬以120帧/秒的慢动作飘过。0-4秒——箭杆的宏观推进：镜头沿箭杆缓慢向前推进。焦点在表面移动，露出精细雕刻的符文、漆面裂纹和风化的木纹。画面远处的铁制箭头反射出微光。一次无缝、不易察觉的尺度转换开始——木纹加深成峡谷般的脊线，雕刻的符文变成巨大的悬崖壁，漆片化为石板。音效从模糊的战场喧嚣转变为更深沉、回响的微观世界氛围。4-9秒——箭上的微观文明：完全宏观展示。一个由碎片大小战士组成的微小文明在箭羽和箭杆上展开自己的战争。微型士兵身着东亚式札甲，用绳索和梯子攀爬符文，如同攀爬峡谷壁。箭杆上的小型投石机投掷出灰尘和木屑碎片，在空中以慢动作划出弧线。红蓝两色的微型旗帜在箭羽的羽片间飘扬，羽片如巨大的羽毛般高耸。微型火把沿箭杆闪烁，投下温暖的点状光芒。两个对立的微型阵型在符文雕刻附近交锋，剑刃迸出火花。镜头沿箭杆缓慢横向移动，揭示更多隐藏世界，最后停留在一个微型战士高举旗帜的胜利姿态上。最终画面定格在这位微小英雄身上，背景是下方模糊发光的战场，箭矢继续在金色余烬中无尽慢速飞行。摄影：单一连续宏观镜头，平稳沉重的相机运动，无抖动，无剪辑。可信的微型物理效果——微型布旗、绳索、火花、尘埃均以微观尺度表现。氛围：梦幻而神秘，发现一个隐藏世界存在于飞行中的箭矢之上。广阔战场与微观文明相互映照。

地球上空の高高度。

カメラ：宇宙の縁から撮影された広角のシネマティックショット。

キャラクターは後ろを向いており、0.5秒間静止したまま浮遊している。

下方に雲が広がり、地球の曲面が見える。

大気がかすかに輝いている。

キャラクターが突然前方へ加速する。

カメラ：

後方追跡ショット（やや後方かつ下方から）。

巨大な衝撃波の爆発（ソニックブーム）。

空気の歪みと放射状のボケ。

重低音の「ドーン」＋激しい風の轟音。

--------------------------------------------------

アクション：

キャラクターが極限の超高速で飛行する。

カメラ：

固定された後方追跡カメラ。キャラクターを追い越さない。

環境：

雲が激しく裂ける。

海面に筋状の光が走る。

都市が光の軌跡となる。

エフェクト：

強いモーションブラー、スピードライン、大気の裂け目。

体の周囲に、稲妻のような微かなエネルギーが漂う。

--------------------------------------------------

アクション:

超高速の地球一周。

ズームアウトした軌道ビューから、動きを追うように切り替わる。

ビジュアル：

足元で地球が急速に回転する。

大陸が横切っていく。

昼夜の変化が瞬時に見える。

重要：

キャラクターは数秒で地球を一周する。

----------- ---------------------------------------

[0:12–0:14]

アクション：

キャラクターが急に減速する。

カメラ：

正面からのシネマティックなクローズアップ。

エフェクト：

空気が前方へ圧縮され、衝撃波が波紋のように広がる。

--------------------------------------------------

[0:14–0:15]

エンディング：

キャラクターが空中停止する。

ポーズ：

スーパーヒーローのような自信に満ちたポーズ。

背景：

背後に地球、雲が静まり返る。

--------------------------------------------------

超リアルな照明

滑らかなグラデーション

滑らかな陰影

ノイズなし、粒状感なし、アーティファクトなし

主な強調点：

極限のスピード

圧倒的なスケール

物理法則を無視した勢い

project: crosswalk_chaos_v1
format: vertical_9x16
fps: 24
shot_duration: ~0.9s
total_shots: 16
total_duration: 15s
style: American dark comedy, fast-paced, expressive animation, exaggerated reactions, cinematic lighting, slight handheld shake

Global rule: All hyenas are inside vehicles as drivers. No human pedestrians appear anywhere in the scene.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:01)
Wide shot. Busy chaotic street packed with speeding cars driven by aggressive hyenas. No pedestrians on the road. Honking everywhere.
Audio: horns blaring, engines roaring.

SHOT 2 (0:01–0:02)
Close-up. Gray cat in blue overalls, right leg in cast, holding a crutch. Sweating, hopeless expression.
Gray Cat (muttering): “No way…”

SHOT 3 (0:02–0:03)
Over-shoulder rear shot. The gray cat’s shoulders and head dominate foreground, completely still, frozen in place at the curb.
In the background, cars blast past at high speed in continuous motion blur, barely any gaps.
A taxi swerves by — a sunglasses-wearing hyena driver leans out of the driver seat window toward camera.
Hyena Driver (shouting): “Don’t block the road!”

SHOT 4 (0:03–0:04)
Medium shot. Behind him, stylish white cat in pink t-shirt and white pants notices. Oversized diamond sunglasses sparkle.
White Cat: “Oh boy…”

SHOT 5 (0:04–0:05)
Cut to sidewalk. Kindergarten bunnies walking with backpacks, holding floating balloons. Innocent vibe. No humans present.

SHOT 6 (0:05–0:06)
Fast action. White cat snatches a white balloon from a bunny.
Bunny: “Hey—!”

SHOT 7 (0:06–0:07)
Close-up. White cat stuffs balloon under shirt, forming a fake pregnant belly. Shirt stretches.

SHOT 8 (0:07–0:08)
White cat steps onto crosswalk, one hand holding belly, acting in pain. Dramatic limp.
White Cat (groaning): “Oh… it’s happening…”

SHOT 9 (0:08–0:09)
Cars slam brakes simultaneously. Tires screech. All visible hyenas remain inside driver seats, shocked.
Hyena Driver: “Whoa!!”

SHOT 10 (0:09–0:10)
Wide shot. Entire road frozen. Engines idling. White cat confidently turns back.

SHOT 11 (0:10–0:11)
White cat grabs gray cat’s hand.
White Cat: “Let’s go!”
Gray Cat: “Seriously?!”

SHOT 12 (0:11–0:12)
They hurry across. Gray cat limps fast, nearly tripping.

SHOT 13 (0:12–0:13)
Close-up. Balloon under shirt suddenly POPS loudly.
SFX: *BANG!*

SHOT 14 (0:13–0:14)
White cat freezes. Belly instantly flat. Awkward silence. Sunglasses slightly tilt.

SHOT 15 (0:14–0:15)
Hyena drivers still inside vehicles turn furious, honking aggressively.
White cat pushes gray cat to safety, then bows repeatedly in the middle of the road.
White Cat (shouting): “MY BAD, SORRY!”

项目：斑鬣狗混乱v1 格式：竖屏9x16 帧率：24 镜头时长：约0.9秒 总镜头数：16 总时长：15秒 风格：美式黑色喜剧、快节奏、夸张动画、夸张反应、电影级光影、轻微手持抖动 全局规则：所有斑鬣狗都在车内担任司机。场景中不得出现任何人类行人。

镜头1（0:00–0:01）全景。繁忙混乱的街道上，暴躁的斑鬣狗司机们驾驶着汽车疾驰。路上没有行人。喇叭声此起彼伏。音效：喇叭轰鸣，引擎咆哮。

镜头2（0:01–0:02）特写。穿着蓝色工装裤的灰猫，右腿打着石膏，拄着拐杖。满头大汗，一脸绝望。灰猫（喃喃自语）：“不会吧……”

镜头3（0:02–0:03）过肩后景镜头。灰猫的肩膀和头部占据前景，完全静止，僵在人行道路边。背景中，汽车高速飞驰而过，形成连续动态模糊，几乎没有空隙。一辆出租车突然转向——戴着墨镜的斑鬣狗司机从驾驶座车窗探出身子，朝向镜头。斑鬣狗司机（大喊）：“别挡路！”

镜头4（0:03–0:04）中景。灰猫身后，穿着粉色T恤和白色裤子的时尚白猫注意到了情况。超大钻石墨镜闪闪发光。白猫：“哎呀……”

镜头5（0:04–0:05）切到人行道。背着书包的幼儿园小兔子们走着，手里拿着漂浮的气球。天真无邪的氛围。没有人类出现。

镜头6（0:05–0:06）快速动作。白猫从小兔子手里抢过一个白色气球。小兔子：“嘿——！”

镜头7（0:06–0:07）特写。白猫把气球塞进衬衫下面，伪装成怀孕的肚子。衬衫被撑开。

镜头8（0:07–0:08）白猫踏上斑马线，一只手扶着肚子，装出痛苦的样子。夸张地跛行。白猫（呻吟着）：“哦……要生了……”

镜头9（0:08–0:09）汽车同时急刹车。轮胎发出刺耳声。所有可见的斑鬣狗都留在驾驶座上，震惊不已。斑鬣狗司机：“哇！！”

镜头10（0:09–0:10）全景。整条路都静止了。引擎空转。白猫自信地回头。

镜头11（0:10–0:11）白猫抓住灰猫的手。白猫：“走吧！”灰猫：“真的假的？！”

镜头12（0:11–0:12）他们匆忙过马路。灰猫快速跛行，差点绊倒。

镜头13（0:12–0:13）特写。衬衫下的气球突然“砰”地一声爆裂。音效：*砰！*

镜头14（0:13–0:14）白猫僵住。肚子瞬间变平。尴尬的沉默。墨镜微微倾斜。

镜头15（0:14–0:15）车内的斑鬣狗司机们变得愤怒，疯狂按喇叭。白猫把灰猫推到安全地带，然后在路中间连连鞠躬。白猫（大喊）：“我的错，对不起！”

en.p:
cinematic romantic sequence featuring a glowing film strip telling a love story at night over the ocean.
[0-3s] FIRST FRAME — Camera focuses on the first frame of a luminous film strip: a couple met on the beach at sunset. They are holding hands, silhouettes against orange and pink sky. Soft golden glow surrounds the frame. Gentle ocean waves in the background. Camera slowly pushes in.
[3-7s] LOVE MONTAGE — Camera smoothly moves between different film frames showing various romantic moments: first date under floating hot air balloons with colorful patterns, a passionate kiss on a sailboat at dusk with golden reflections on water, walking hand in hand under a starry sky with Milky Way visible, dancing together on the beach with sparklers. Each frame glows with warm golden light. Transitions between frames are fluid and dreamlike with soft light flares.
[7-10s] EMOTIONAL PEAK — Camera lingers on the most intimate frame: the proposal moment on the same beach, ring box opening, tears of joy, tight embrace. Golden particles float around them. The frame pulses brighter than others. Ocean waves reflect the golden light. Hot air balloons drift in the background sky.
[10-13s] REAL WORLD — Camera exits from the film strip, revealing a real couple standing on the rocky shore looking up at this same glowing film strip in the night sky. They stand close together, arms around each other, watching their memories displayed above. She rests her head on his shoulder. Ocean waves gently lap at the rocks. Their reflection visible in shallow water.
[13-15s] UNITY & ETERNITY — The couple and the glowing film strip merge in one unified frame. The boundary between reality and memories dissolves magically. Golden light flows from the film to envelop the real couple. Stars twinkle brilliantly in the deep blue sky, hot air balloons float peacefully. Final shot: love is captured in eternity, the film strip and couple becoming one luminous entity. Romantic, timeless atmosphere with infinite feeling.
en.t: Glowing Love Story Over Ocean Night

zh.p: 电影般的浪漫场景：一条发光的胶片在夜海上空讲述着爱情故事。[0-3秒] 第一帧——镜头聚焦于发光胶片的首帧：一对情侣在日落时分的海滩相遇。他们手牵着手，剪影映衬着橙粉色的天空。柔和的金色光芒环绕着画面。背景中传来轻柔的海浪声。镜头缓缓推进。[3-7秒] 爱情蒙太奇——镜头在不同胶片帧之间流畅移动，展现各种浪漫瞬间：第一次约会时漂浮着彩色图案的热气球下，黄昏时分帆船上的深情一吻，水面泛着金色波光，在银河璀璨的星空下牵手漫步，手持烟花棒在海滩共舞。每帧画面都闪耀着温暖的金色光芒。帧与帧之间的转换如梦境般流畅，伴有柔和的光晕。[7-10秒] 情感高潮——镜头停留在最私密的一帧：同一片海滩上的求婚时刻，戒指盒打开，喜悦的泪水，紧紧的拥抱。金色粒子在他们周围飘散。这帧画面比其他帧更加明亮。海浪反射着金光。热气球在背景天空中飘荡。[10-13秒] 现实世界——镜头从胶片中退出，展现一对真实的情侣站在岩石海岸上，仰望夜空中那条发光的胶片。他们紧紧依偎，互相搂着腰，看着上方展现的回忆。她将头靠在他的肩上。海浪轻轻拍打着岩石。浅水中映出他们的倒影。[13-15秒] 合一与永恒——情侣与发光的胶片融合在一个统一的画面中。现实与记忆的界限神奇地消融。金色光芒从胶片流向现实中的情侣，将他们包裹。深蓝色天空中繁星闪烁，热气球宁静地漂浮。最后一幕：爱情被定格在永恒中，胶片与情侣合为一体，成为发光的存在。浪漫、永恒的氛围，充满无限之感。

General Technical Specifications: ultra-cinematic blockbuster, photorealistic 8K, f/0.4 aperture, high contrast, deep blue neon night, volumetric rain and fog

Lighting: strong neon contrast (blue, magenta), reflections on wet asphalt, flickering signage, backlight silhouettes

Shot List and Sequence:

Shot 1: Wide Shot (2s)
A lone cybernetic gunslinger stands in a neon-lit street at night. Rain falling. Coat moving slightly. Shadowy figures emerge from alleys, forming a loose circle.

Shot 2: Close-Up (1.5s)
Face tight. One eye glowing. Subtle mechanical flicker. Calm, focused.

Shot 3: Insert Shot (1s)
Hand near holster. Fingers twitch with precise servo motion.

Shot 4: Medium + Whip Pan (2s)
An attacker rushes forward. Camera whip pans as the gunslinger turns sharply.

Shot 5: Action Shot (2s)
Instant draw. A sharp energy discharge fires forward, creating a brief air distortion ripple.

Shot 6: Impact Shot (1.5s)
Attacker is pushed backward, sliding across wet ground, sparks scattering.

Shot 7: Side Tracking (2s)
Two more figures approach. The gunslinger pivots and fires in controlled succession, minimal movement, maximum precision.

Shot 8: Close Combat (1.5s)
One attacker reaches close range. Fast mechanical arm movement creates strong kinetic displacement, sending them off balance.

Shot 9: Micro Slow Motion (1s)
Rain freezes briefly as another shot cuts through the air, glowing trail visible.

Shot 10: Final Hero Shot (1.5s)
Silence. The gunslinger stands alone. Weapon lowered slightly. Neon reflections ripple across the wet street.

Camera: a lot of camera angles and shot switches, ultra dynamic, whip pans, fast cuts, controlled micro slow-motion

Style: 80s/90s action movie style, ultra dynamic, dramatic cloth movement, volumetric rain and fog, grounded physics, normal proportions without stretch

zh.p: 通用技术规格：超电影级大片，照片级真实8K画质，f/0.4光圈，高对比度，深蓝霓虹夜色，体积感雨雾。照明：强烈霓虹对比（蓝、品红），湿沥青路面反光，闪烁的招牌，逆光剪影。镜头列表与序列：镜头1：广角镜头（2秒）一名孤身赛博枪手伫立于霓虹灯街巷的夜色中。雨丝飘落。风衣微微摆动。暗影中的人影从巷道浮现，松散围成圆圈。镜头2：特写（1.5秒）面部紧绷。一只眼睛泛着微光。机械元件细微闪烁。神情冷静而专注。镜头3：插入镜头（1秒）手靠近枪套。手指以精准的伺服动作微微抽动。镜头4：中景+甩镜（2秒）一名袭击者猛冲上前。枪手骤然转身，镜头随之甩动。镜头5：动作镜头（2秒）瞬间拔枪。一道锐利能量射流向前迸发，激起短暂空气扭曲波纹。镜头6：冲击镜头（1.5秒）袭击者被击退，在湿滑地面滑行，火星四溅。镜头7：侧向跟拍（2秒）又有两人逼近。枪手转身，以受控的节奏连续射击，动作最小化，精度最大化。镜头8：近身格斗（1.5秒）一名袭击者逼近至近身范围。机械臂快速动作产生强烈动能位移，令其失去平衡。镜头9：微慢动作（1秒）雨滴短暂凝滞，另一发子弹划破空气，留下可见的发光轨迹。镜头10：最终英雄镜头（1.5秒）寂静。枪手孑然独立。武器微微下垂。霓虹倒影在湿漉漉的街面上荡漾。摄影：大量机位与镜头切换，超动态，甩镜，快速剪辑，受控的微慢动作。风格：80/90年代动作片风格，超动态，戏剧化衣料飘动，体积感雨雾，基于物理的实感，正常比例无拉伸。

Ultra-realistic cinematic FPV snowboard sequence, 4K HDR, high contrast, cold blue color grading, natural lighting, strong motion blur, realistic snow physics, 16:9.

LOCATION:
High mountain snowy landscape, wide open slopes, powder snow, golden hour sunlight, dramatic sky.

MAIN SUBJECT:
A professional snowboarder wearing a modern snow jacket, helmet, and goggles. Smooth, aggressive riding style.

CAMERA STYLE:
FPV drone-style follow cam, ultra dynamic, close tracking, fast acceleration, precise movement.

[0–5s]
The camera starts behind the snowboarder at the top of a snowy peak. Strong wind blows snow particles. The rider drops in aggressively downhill. Powder snow sprays toward the camera, slight lens snow effects, intense speed feeling.

[5–10s]
High-speed carving sequence. The camera follows very closely, shifting slightly side-to-side. Snow sprays dynamically with each turn. Strong motion blur and wind streak effects. Terrain uneven and fast.

[10–15s]
The rider launches off a small cliff. The camera follows upward smoothly. Mid-air slow motion: floating snow particles, dramatic lighting. The rider performs a stylish trick. Hard landing with explosive snow impact, subtle camera shake, then stabilizes.

zh.p: 超写实电影级FPV单板滑雪跟拍，4K HDR高动态范围，高对比度，冷蓝色调，自然光效，强烈运动模糊，真实雪景物理模拟，16:9画幅。场景设定：高山雪原景观，开阔雪坡，粉雪覆盖，黄金时刻阳光，戏剧性天空。主体：专业单板滑雪者，身着现代滑雪夹克、头盔和护目镜，流畅且富有攻击性的滑行风格。镜头风格：FPV无人机式跟拍，极致动态，近距离追踪，快速加速，精准运镜。[0-5秒]镜头起始于雪峰顶端的滑雪者身后。强风卷起雪粒。滑手以侵略性姿态俯冲而下。粉雪向镜头飞溅，轻微镜头积雪效果，强烈速度感。[5-10秒]高速刻雪转弯序列。镜头极近距离跟随，左右轻微摆动。每次转向都带起动态雪雾。强烈运动模糊与风痕特效。地形崎岖且快速变化。[10-15秒]滑手从小悬崖跃起。镜头平稳向上跟随。空中慢动作：漂浮的雪粒，戏剧性光线。滑手完成炫酷技巧动作。硬着陆时雪爆四溅，镜头轻微震动后恢复稳定。

First-person VR-player POV (female pilot), two gloved hands visible in frame gripping a sleek hybrid wingsuit-glider rig with glowing rune-circuit accents along the wrists. A faint reflection of glowing eyes flickers in the visor between cuts.

Live-action cinematic realism fused with next-gen game-engine clarity. A vast fantasy sci-fi open world: floating sky islands tethered by chains of light, a colossal stone-built Data Center pulsing with glowing glyph circuits in the distance, a mirror-flat reflective ocean below, towering cliffs, ancient ruins fused with holographic tech, and dragon-shaped drones patrolling the airspace. Semi-transparent rounded panels with soft shadows and glowing edges, slight parallax with head motion. Visible elements:

Cold open: pitch-black visor, then a snap boot-up — glassmorphism HUD assembles around the view in one fluid sweep. Hands clamp the rig. en.p:
12 seconds, top-tier luxury car commercial quality, cinematic footage, intense realistic speed and pressure, seamless time-space transition, consistent character appearance before and after, stable footage, emotions building layer by layer.

**0.0-3.2 seconds:**  
Extreme low-angle ground-level macro shot, warm golden afternoon sunlight illuminating a beige fluffy carpet, floating dust particles, retro Kodak film warm yellow tone.  
A child’s small, tender hand pushes a red Porsche toy race car forward with force.  
The camera sticks tightly to the toy car’s front, tracking at high speed, simulating a real racing first-person perspective. Speed increases rapidly, fully igniting the child’s imagination.

**3.2-4.8 seconds:**  
The toy car races straight into the dark shadow under the sofa. Light suddenly disappears, carpet textures stretch into radial motion blur, the entire frame is swallowed by darkness.  
Use the action of entering the shadow as a natural seamless transition, creating a time-space leap from childhood to reality.

**4.8-8.0 seconds:**  
In the darkness, a powerful engine roar explodes. A real red Porsche 911 GT3 bursts out from the dark, roaring onto a cold gray racetrack. Sharp daylight, fierce reflections on the glossy paint, tires kicking up heat waves and light tire smoke.  
The camera maintains the exact same low ground-level high-speed tracking shot as the previous scene, making it feel like the same car instantly scales from toy size to a real racing car. Extremely powerful visual impact and realistic physics of speed.

**8.0-12.0 seconds:**  
Cut to an intense interior close-up. The adult version of the character, wearing racing gloves, grips the suede steering wheel tightly and shifts gears violently. Mechanical vibrations, sweat, and friction details are clearly visible.  
The camera suddenly tilts up and pushes in, freezing on the determined, burning eyes under the helmet. Sweat drips down the forehead. The gaze feels like turning childhood dreams into reality.  
Fast, shaky interior camerawork with strong vibrations and overwhelming pressure. End with a powerful emotional climax on the intense eye close-up.

**Negative Prompt:**  
blurry, low resolution, deformed characters, multiple people, wrong hands, wrong car model, abrupt cuts, stiff transitions, stuttering, frame drops, plastic texture, fake car feeling, excessive effects, anime style, cheap filters, unstable faces, inconsistent age transition.

Extreme low-angle ground-level macro shot, warm golden afternoon sunlight illuminating a beige fluffy carpet, floating dust particles, retro Kodak film warm yellow tone.  
A child’s small, tender hand pushes a red Porsche toy race car forward with force.  
The camera sticks tightly to the toy car’s front, tracking at high speed, simulating a real racing first-person perspective. Speed increases rapidly, fully igniting the child’s imagination.

**3.2-4.8 seconds:**  
The toy car races straight into the dark shadow under the sofa. Light suddenly disappears, carpet textures stretch into radial motion blur, the entire frame is swallowed by darkness.  
Use the action of entering the shadow as a natural seamless transition, creating a time-space leap from childhood to reality.

**4.8-8.0 seconds:**  
In the darkness, a powerful engine roar explodes. A real red Porsche 911 GT3 bursts out from the dark, roaring onto a cold gray racetrack. Sharp daylight, fierce reflections on the glossy paint, tires kicking up heat waves and light tire smoke.  
The camera maintains the exact same low ground-level high-speed tracking shot as the previous scene, making it feel like the same car instantly scales from toy size to a real racing car. Extremely powerful visual impact and realistic physics of speed.

**8.0-12.0 seconds:**  
Cut to an intense interior close-up. The adult version of the character, wearing racing gloves, grips the suede steering wheel tightly and shifts gears violently. Mechanical vibrations, sweat, and friction details are clearly visible.  
The camera suddenly tilts up and pushes in, freezing on the determined, burning eyes under the helmet. Sweat drips down the forehead. The gaze feels like turning childhood dreams into reality.  
Fast, shaky interior camerawork with strong vibrations and overwhelming pressure. End with a powerful emotional climax on the intense eye close-up.

**Negative Prompt:**  
blurry, low resolution, deformed characters, multiple people, wrong hands, wrong car model, abrupt cuts, stiff transitions, stuttering, frame drops, plastic texture, fake car feeling, excessive effects, anime style, cheap filters, unstable faces, inconsistent age transition.

en.p:
High action, chaotic desert sequence, shot on 35mm with harsh sunlight, heat shimmer, and heavy dust trails. Vast open dunes, scattered rock outcrops. Sound: roaring engine, wind, deep underground rumble, sand blasts.

⸻

Shot 1 (0–3s):
A Jeep tears across open desert at high speed, kicking up dust. Inside—two friends: a woman (mid-20s, athletic, focused) and a male driver (late 20s, tense, gripping the wheel).
Suddenly—the sand ahead erupts violently—a massive sand leviathan bursts upward, jaws wide, blocking their path.

⸻

Shot 2 (3–6s):
The driver yanks the wheel—hard swerve. The Jeep skids sideways, narrowly missing the creature’s snapping jaws. Sand explodes around them.
The creature dives back under—a fast-moving ripple chases them beneath the sand.

⸻

Shot 3 (6–9s):
The Jeep bounces violently over uneven dunes. The creature erupts again from the side—almost clipping the rear. The driver swerves again, barely controlling the vehicle.
Inside, the woman braces—then suddenly loses balance and half-falls sideways in the seat, grabbing onto the frame.

⸻

Shot 4 (9–12s):
Still moving at speed, she reaches into her bag and pulls out a compact explosive device—metallic, cylindrical.
The ground beside them bulges—the creature rises again, lunging toward the Jeep.
Timing it perfectly—she leans out and catapults the device straight into its open mouth.

⸻

Shot 5 (12–15s):
The Jeep speeds forward. Behind them—
a split-second pause—

Then a massive internal explosion rips through the creature.
It bursts apart in a spray of dark goo and sand, splattering across the air.

The Jeep drives straight through the falling debris—windshield hit with gunk.

They keep driving—alive.

zh.p: 高能动作，混乱的沙漠场景，用35毫米胶片拍摄，烈日强光、热浪 shimmer、厚重沙尘尾迹。广阔的开阔沙丘，散布的岩石露头。声音：引擎轰鸣、风声、地下低沉的隆隆声、沙暴冲击。⸻ 镜头1（0-3秒）：一辆吉普车在开阔沙漠中高速飞驰，扬起沙尘。车内——两个朋友：一名女性（25岁左右，体格健壮，专注）和一名男性司机（近30岁，紧张，紧握方向盘）。突然——前方沙地剧烈喷发——一条巨大的沙海怪猛地冲出，大嘴张开，挡住了他们的去路。⸻ 镜头2（3-6秒）：司机猛打方向盘——急转弯。吉普车侧滑，险险躲过怪物的咬合。沙尘在他们周围炸开。怪物潜回沙下——一道快速移动的波纹在沙下追赶他们。⸻ 镜头3（6-9秒）：吉普车在起伏的沙丘上剧烈颠簸。怪物再次从侧面冲出——几乎擦到车尾。司机再次急转，勉强控制住车辆。车内，女性稳住身体——然后突然失去平衡，在座位上向一侧半倒，抓住车架。⸻ 镜头4（9-12秒）：仍在高速行驶中，她伸手到包里掏出一个紧凑型爆炸装置——金属圆柱体。他们旁边的地面隆起——怪物再次升起，扑向吉普车。她精准把握时机——探出身子，将装置直接投进它张开的嘴里。⸻ 镜头5（12-15秒）：吉普车加速向前。身后——瞬间停顿——然后一声巨大的内部爆炸撕裂了怪物。它在黑色黏液和沙尘的喷溅中炸裂开来，洒向空中。吉普车径直穿过落下的碎片——挡风玻璃被黏液击中。他们继续行驶——活着。

en.p:
“Volcanic Web Escape” (15s, 5 Shots)

High action, chaotic sequence on an alien volcanic jungle island, shot on 35mm with heat shimmer, drifting ash, bioluminescent plants, and glowing lava fissures. Terrain is uneven, with hanging vine-like structures and deep vents emitting orange light. Sound: heavy breathing, crackling lava, alien screeches.

⸻

Shot 1 (0–3s):
A woman (mid-20s, athletic, rugged explorer gear) sprints across jagged terrain, leaping over glowing cracks where lava pulses beneath. Behind her, something skitters rapidly through the environment—unseen but close.

⸻

Shot 2 (3–6s):
Suddenly—she’s yanked violently upward by a thick, elastic web strand. She spins mid-air, suspended above the ground.

Below, a massive spider-like creature emerges—long limbs, fast, climbing toward her.

⸻

Shot 3 (6–9s):
Hanging upside-down, she pulls a blade and cuts one web strand. She swings sideways in a wide arc, gaining momentum.
The creature lunges upward—just misses her.

⸻

Shot 4 (9–12s):
She kicks off a nearby rock/tree structure, redirecting her swing and dropping to the ground. She lands, rolls, instantly back on her feet.
Behind her—the creature crashes down, immediately chasing again.

She runs toward a large glowing lava vent ahead.

zh.p:
《火山蛛网逃生》（15秒，5个镜头）

高能动作、混乱场景，发生在外星火山丛林岛屿上，采用35毫米胶片拍摄，画面中热浪扭曲、灰烬飘散、生物发光植物闪烁，熔岩裂缝发出橙光。地形崎岖不平，悬挂着藤蔓状结构，深坑中透出橙色光芒。音效：急促呼吸声、熔岩噼啪声、外星生物的尖啸声。

⸻

镜头1（0–3秒）：
一名女子（二十多岁，体格健硕，身穿粗犷探险装备）在崎岖地形上狂奔，跃过下方熔岩涌动的发光裂缝。她身后，某种东西在环境中快速窜动——看不见，但近在咫尺。

⸻

镜头2（3–6秒）：
突然——她被一根粗壮而有弹性的蛛丝猛地向上拽起。她在半空中旋转，悬停在地面之上。
下方，一只巨大的蜘蛛状生物出现——长腿，行动迅速，正朝她爬来。

⸻

镜头3（6–9秒）：
她倒挂悬空，拔出刀刃切断一根蛛丝。她向侧面大幅摆动，积蓄动能。
那生物向上猛扑——刚好与她擦肩而过。

⸻

镜头4（9–12秒）：
她蹬踏附近的岩石或树木结构，改变摆动方向，落向地面。她落地后翻滚，瞬间重新站起。
她身后——那生物重重砸下，立即再次追赶。
她朝前方一个巨大的发光熔岩坑跑去。

en.p:
Stylized realistic 3D animation, Shaw Brothers retro cinema aesthetic fused with exaggerated animal characters, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, saturated reds and deep shadows, high-detail 18th-century Japanese tatami bedroom. Snowy Mount Fuji visible through a wooden window frame, cold blue moonlight slicing into warm lantern-lit interior. Comedic heist-turned-chaos mood: theatrical tension, sudden slapstick destruction, absurd tonal shifts. Fast, rhythmic choreography with precise timing: sneak → scan → target → intrusion → mistake → panic → chaos → reveal → escape → absurd luxury payoff. No gore, no real harm. Dynamic camera: voyeuristic framing, POV sweeps, low-angle impacts, dramatic zooms, stylized slow-motion beats, split-screen reaction with debris. Ultra-smooth motion, sharp comedic timing, vintage film grain overlay, implied exaggerated foley (wood cracks, fabric swish, dramatic gasps, metallic sparkle chimes).

Characters

1. Orange cat thief: slim, agile, sly expression, wearing a loose gray Taoist robe. Movements stealthy but slightly overconfident, feline precision with theatrical flair.
2. White cat: elegant, curvy silhouette, pink kimono, pale purple eyeshadow, vivid red lips. Sleeps dramatically, snores softly, then shifts to exaggerated panic and later glamorous poise.
3. Black bear: large, muscular, wearing a red dudou (belly garment), wielding a crude wooden stick. Movements heavy, explosive, wildly inaccurate but powerful.
4. Background townsfolk: gray rabbits in rough cloth garments, curious, reactive.

Sequence (0:00–0:15)
0:00–0:01.1 close-up exterior: orange cat crouches outside wooden window, snow drifting. Fuji glows. Cat whispers: “Jackpot night.” Eyes narrow.
0:01.1–0:02.2 POV sweep: rapid scan across dark tatami room, shadows sliding past like brush strokes.
0:02.2–0:03.2 POV hold: white cat sleeping under blanket, soft snoring. Subtle comedic snore bubble.
0:03.2–0:04.2 POV shift: gaze lands on low table—golden beckoning cat statue gleams under lantern light, tiny sparkle pulse.
0:04.2–0:05.0 close-up: orange cat’s lower face, slow crooked grin. “Mine.”
0:05.0–0:06.2 medium: orange cat slips through window silently, lands, pads forward in exaggerated tiptoe, robe swaying.
0:06.2–0:07.0 detail: as cat kneels and reaches—his foot accidentally nudges the white cat’s blanket. Fabric shifts. Suspense beat.
0:07.0–0:07.8 snap close-up: white cat’s eyes burst open. Sharp inhale.
0:07.8–0:08.6 scream: “THIEF! HELP!!” echoing dramatically.

zh.p: 时长：10秒。风格：超写实电影级科幻毁灭、真人实拍质感、极致细节视觉、残酷高速混乱、真实物理效果、灾难级赛博朋克末世、爆炸性动作、大片级破坏、激进节奏、顶级视觉特效轰炸。镜头：高度动态混乱的电影级运镜、激进追踪跟拍、破坏性街景镜头、冲击震动、隧道追逐、低角度动作镜头、战术落地镜头、全机械变形特写、爆炸终局构图。主角：一名清瘦青年（基于参考图像，保持面部特征完全一致），身穿栗红色T恤、橄榄绿工装裤、运动鞋，佩戴未来风格腕表和耳机，开场时驾驶未来悬浮滑板。环境：全面陷入混乱的新东京未来巨型都市，道路拥堵不堪、交通系统崩溃、民众恐慌逃窜、全息影像故障闪烁、车辆爆炸、街道碎裂、数字毁灭、基础设施坍塌。场景：0.0–1.5秒：青年以低空模式驾驶未来悬浮滑板，在新东京拥挤的城市街道上疾驰，在车辆、拥挤路口和密集行人区之间高速穿梭。1.5–3.0秒：突然爆发全市范围的数字灾难。巨型全息系统剧烈故障，道路断裂，车辆相撞，爆炸四起，行人四散，摩天大楼广告牌扭曲变形，一个巨大的超写实黄色数字吃豆人实体从崩溃的全息网络中具现化。吃豆人狂暴地撕裂城市，在巨大的爆炸混乱中吞噬汽车、道路、交通信号灯、广告牌以及整片基础设施。3.0–7.0秒：全程生存追逐。青年将悬浮滑板推至极限速度，在全面城市毁灭中穿行，惊险地避开坍塌的高速公路、爆炸的车辆、碎片风暴、隧道崩塌以及身后被巨型吃豆人吞噬的整条街道。吃豆人无情地摧毁一切紧追不舍，引发冲击波、数字碎片化、大规模爆炸和全城浩劫。7.0–8.0秒：在极限速度下，青年从悬浮滑板上向前跃入主车道，随后在碎裂的沥青路面上完成一次残酷的写实战斗翻滚，在周围混乱爆发的环境中滑行、翻转并摩擦着碎片覆盖的路面。8.0–9.0秒：当他正在街面上翻滚时，悬浮滑板保持同步运动紧随其侧，并以完整的机械细节在屏幕上变形为一门巨大的白金色超级激光炮：反重力引擎分裂开来，金属车身面板旋转展开，武器化结构部署，内部能量腔体点燃，青色等离子核心过载，发光能量环形成——整个变形过程在翻滚期间完整呈现。9.0–9.7秒：青年从最终动作中直接起身

Stylized original 3D animation, exaggerated proportions, crisp cinematic lighting. Warm late-night bakery interior with soft amber pendant lights and cool moonlight through large windows. Flour-dusted wooden counters, glass pastry cases, organized tools, glowing oven as visual anchor. Cozy but competitive atmosphere. No brand logos, no readable text, no copyrighted characters.

Tone: playful high-stakes bake-off, competitive but wholesome. Head baker = calm perfectionist tactician. Rivals = flashy confidence unraveling. Rhythm: prep → align → accelerate → precision moment → effortless finish.

Camera: macro close-ups on hands shaping dough, medium reaction shots, reflections in oven glass, flour particles in light, slow push-ins, sharp rhythmic cuts. Ultra-smooth motion, tactile detail, satisfying implied kitchen sounds.

Characters:
1) Head Baker: lean adult, rolled sleeves, flour-dusted apron, calm focused eyes, minimal precise movements.
2) Rival Baker 1: tall, flashy, dramatic gestures, overconfident grin, loses control under pressure.
3) Rival Baker 2: shorter, technical, tool-heavy workflow, mutters to self, precision breaks under speed.
4) Apprentice: young trainee, wide-eyed, holding tray, reacts like silent commentator.

Sequence (0:00–0:15):
0:00–0:02 close-up: flour sifts onto counter, head baker sets timer beside dough, rivals exchange confident looks.
0:02–0:05 medium: head baker rolls dough perfectly once, rivals aggressively shape theirs, oven glow intensifies, apprentice leans in.
0:05–0:08 tracking: fold → press → turn → cut rhythm, rivals start fumbling, dough sticks, tools slip, head baker leans slightly forward.

en.p: Ultra epic wow visual with a thrilling clear crisp great lighting scene with a frozen grassland under a pale orange dawn, where a girl rider in layered wool armor and carved antler shoulder plates faces a long-necked ice predator with translucent fins and six running limbs, intense anticipation across the open plain. The camera begins at horse level, racing beside the rider as the beast charges from the right. The rider throws a rope harpoon into the beast’s shoulder fin, circles wide to avoid its bite, then uses the horse’s turn to pull the beast off line. Snow trails and breath plumes show direction clearly. The camera speeds up with a clean lead shot in front of the horse, a wide side sweep showing the rope tension, and a gradual overhead arc as the beast recovers and sprints again. Climax: the rider dismounts onto a boulder, anchors the rope, and the beast’s own speed brings it down in a slide of ice and snow. Ending: the horse slows, the beast stops struggling, and the rider cuts the rope loose as dawn light warms the plain.

en.p:
A fast-paced, emotional cinematic montage showing how AI helps animals.
Start with a lost puppy in a dense forest, looking scared. Cut to an AI-powered drone scanning from above, highlighting the puppy’s location with a digital overlay. Transition to a wildlife rescue team receiving real-time data on a tablet and rushing to the spot.

Next scene: an injured elephant in the wild—AI analyzes its condition through thermal imaging and alerts veterinarians. Quick cut to poachers detected at night through AI surveillance, triggering an instant response from rangers.

End with rescued animals safe and healthy, running free in nature. Warm sunlight, hopeful tone.

Text on screen: “AI is giving animals a second chance.”
Style: cinematic, realistic, emotional, soft dramatic music, high contrast lighting, smooth transitions

zh.p: 一段快节奏、情感充沛的电影蒙太奇，展现人工智能如何帮助动物。开场是一只迷路的小狗在茂密森林中，神情恐惧。镜头切换至一架搭载AI的无人机从高空扫描，通过数字叠加层标出小狗的位置。接着，野生动物救援队通过平板电脑接收实时数据，迅速赶往现场。下一幕：一头受伤的大象在野外——AI通过热成像分析其状况，并通知兽医。快速切入夜间通过AI监控发现的偷猎者，触发护林员的即时响应。结尾是获救的动物们安然无恙、健康活泼，在自然中自由奔跑。温暖的阳光，充满希望的基调。屏幕文字显示：“人工智能正在给动物第二次机会。”风格：电影感、写实、情感充沛，轻柔戏剧化配乐，高对比度光线，流畅转场。

en.p:
Format: horizontal 16:9
Duration: 15s
FPS: 24
Style: cinematic podcast show, American dark comedy, subtle absurdism, claymation + semi-realistic hybrid
Audio: light lo-fi podcast intro → awkward silence → sudden TV SFX → audience laugh track + applause
Lighting: warm studio key light, soft shadows, slight flicker from old TV

0:00–0:02 — Establishing wide shot
A cozy recording studio. LEFT: a white cat host wearing silver-rim glasses, pink dress, lavender eyeshadow, bright red lipstick, resting chin on one hand, bored elegance. Beside her, an old CRT TV (screen off, dusty). RIGHT: Einstein as a clay puppet, oversized head, messy white hair, wrinkled suit, holding a book titled “AI Physics.”
Soft lo-fi intro music fades.

HOST (dry tone):
“So, Professor… what do you think about Cat Master making dumb comedy videos?”

0:02–0:04 — Medium close-up on Einstein
He adjusts the book slowly, eyes slightly unfocused but confident.

EINSTEIN:
“In my professional opinion… stupidity is a fundamental force of the universe.”

Audience: light chuckle

0:04–0:06 — Shoulder view from behind host toward Einstein
Einstein leans forward slightly, more engaged.

EINSTEIN:
“And Cat Master… is simply harnessing it.”

Audience: louder laughter + claps

0:06–0:07 — Quick close-up on host (NEW BEAT)
She raises one eyebrow slightly, curiosity breaking her bored expression.

HOST (short, curious):
“…Harnessing it?”

0:07–0:09 — Sudden TV activation (wide shot)
The CRT TV beside the host flickers ON with a loud bzzt. Static → cuts to chaotic footage:
An orange cat in a gray Taoist robe fighting suited hyenas wearing sunglasses in an ancient courtyard (sanheyuan), dust flying, exaggerated kung-fu chaos.

0:09–0:11 — Close-up on Einstein, TV light flickering on his face
He watches intensely, eyes widening like revelation.

EINSTEIN (excited whisper):
“This… confirms my theory.”

0:11–0:12.5 — Insert TV footage (dynamic zoom)
Orange cat launches into absurd slow-motion spin kick while hyenas dramatically overreact.

Audience: explosive laughter

0:12.5–0:14 — Close-up on Einstein
He raises one finger like a genius breakthrough moment.

EINSTEIN:
“Quantum physics suggests… a parallel cat universe.”

0:14–0:15 — Wide shot (final punchline)
Host side-eyes the camera. Einstein stares directly forward.

EINSTEIN (dead serious):
“Also… statistically speaking… the audience might be AI.”

Beat.

Audience: HUGE laughter + applause

TV flickers. Freeze frame energy. End.

zh.p:
格式：横向16:9
时长：15秒
帧率：24
风格：电影感播客秀，美式黑色喜剧，微妙荒诞主义，黏土+半写实混合
音频：轻低保真播客开场→尴尬沉默→突然电视音效→观众笑声+掌声
灯光：暖色演播室主光，柔和阴影，老电视轻微闪烁

0:00–0:02 — 建立全景镜头
一个舒适的录音室。左侧：一只戴银框眼镜的白猫主持人，穿粉色连衣裙，涂淡紫色眼影和亮红色口红，单手托腮，慵懒优雅。旁边是一台老式CRT电视（屏幕关闭，布满灰尘）。右侧：爱因斯坦黏土人偶，大头，凌乱白发，皱巴巴西装，手持一本名为《AI物理学》的书。
轻柔低保真开场音乐渐弱。

主持人（干巴巴语气）：
“那么，教授……您怎么看猫主子拍那些蠢喜剧视频？”

0:02–0:04 — 爱因斯坦中近景
他缓缓调整书本，眼神略显涣散但自信。

爱因斯坦：
“依我的专业判断……愚蠢是宇宙的基本力。”

观众：轻笑

0:04–0:06 — 从主持人背后肩部视角看向爱因斯坦
爱因斯坦微微前倾，更投入。

爱因斯坦：
“而猫主子……只是在驾驭它。”

观众：更大笑声+掌声

0:06–0:07 — 主持人快速特写（新节拍）
她微微挑眉，好奇打破无聊表情。

主持人（简短，好奇）：
“……驾驭它？”

0:07–0:09 — 电视突然启动（全景镜头）
主持人旁边的CRT电视“哔”一声闪烁亮起。雪花屏→切入混乱画面：
一只穿灰色道袍的橘猫，在古色古香的四合院里与戴墨镜的西装鬣狗打斗，尘土飞扬，夸张功夫混战。

0:09–0:11 — 爱因斯坦特写，电视光在他脸上闪烁
他专注观看，眼睛睁大如顿悟。

爱因斯坦（兴奋低语）：
“这……证实了我的理论。”

0:11–0:12.5 — 插入电视画面（动态缩放）
橘猫腾空而起，慢动作旋转踢，鬣狗夸张反应。

观众：爆笑

0:12.5–0:14 — 爱因斯坦特写
他竖起一根手指，如天才突破时刻。

爱因斯坦：
“量子物理学表明……存在一个平行猫宇宙。”

0:14–0:15 — 全景镜头（最终笑点）
主持人斜视镜头。爱因斯坦直视前方。

爱因斯坦（一脸严肃）：
“另外……从统计学上讲……观众可能是AI。”

停顿。

观众：巨大笑声+掌声

电视闪烁。定格画面。结束。

en.p: DreamWorks animation style. Scene 1: A bustling Egyptian market is lively and crowded, the camera shifts to a muscular jackal Anubis merchant, wearing arm rings, showcasing his goods and beckoning people to come closer. Meanwhile, not far away, an evil hippo thief and an evil bird pirate are eyeing a golden urn on his stall. Scene 2: The bird pirate swiftly flies toward the golden urn, snatches it with its sharp claws, and flies away. Scene 3: Anubis quickly notices the bird pirate's escape, gasps, and turns to look at the fleeing bird pirate. He immediately gives chase. The bird pirate rises slowly, but Anubis manages to grab the urn with both hands, arms raised above his head, engaging in a tug-of-war with the bird pirate. The bird pirate tries to fly upward while Anubis, on the ground with arms stretched high, holds the urn tightly, attempting to pull it down. Scene 4: Anubis looks tense, straining with all his might to hold onto the urn and pull it downward. The hippo thief grins, appears beside Anubis, and tells him he should smile more. The hippo thief extends a feather and points it at Anubis's armpit (due to the tug-of-war, Anubis's arms are raised high, making his armpits easily accessible). Scene 5: A close-up shows the hippo pirate gently sliding the feather up and down Anubis's armpit, repeating the motion with comedic sound effects. Meanwhile, we hear Anubis's muffled laughter. Scene 6: A close-up focuses on Anubis's upper body, his eyes closed and grinning widely, emitting muffled laughs, as the hippo thief continues to gently slide the feather in Anubis's armpit. Scene 7: The hippo thief keeps tickling Anubis's armpit with the feather, and Anubis giggles, struggling to hold onto the golden urn but to no avail. Scene 8: The hippo thief continues tickling Anubis's armpit with the feather, and Anubis bursts into laughter, finally letting go of the golden urn, hugging himself, and continuing to chuckle. Meanwhile, the bird pirate flies away with the golden urn in its claws, and the hippo thief joins the bird pirate in escape, both laughing slyly. Scene 9: Anubis snaps out of his laughter, glaring angrily at the fleeing thieves. English voiceover.

zh.p: 梦工厂动画风格。 场景一：熙熙攘攘的埃及集市热闹非凡，镜头转向一位肌肉发达的胡狼阿努比斯商人，他手臂上戴着环，正炫耀着自己的商品，招呼人们走近细看。与此同时，不远处，一个邪恶的河马盗贼和一个邪恶的鸟海盗正盯着他摊位上的一个金瓮。 场景二：鸟海盗迅速飞向金瓮，用利爪将其抓走，然后飞走了。 场景三：阿努比斯很快注意到鸟海盗的逃跑，倒吸一口凉气，转头看向逃窜的鸟海盗。他迅速追了上去。鸟海盗缓缓上升，但阿努比斯设法用双手抓住了瓮，双臂高举过头，与鸟海盗展开了一场拉锯战。鸟海盗试图飞上去，而阿努比斯则在地上，双臂高举过头，紧紧抓住瓮，试图将其拉下来。 场景4：阿努比斯神情紧张，竭尽全力抓住瓮并向下拽。河马盗贼咧嘴一笑，出现在阿努比斯身边，告诉他应该多笑笑。河马盗贼伸出一根羽毛，指向阿努比斯的腋窝（由于拉锯战，阿努比斯的双臂高举过头，腋窝很容易够到）。 场景5：特写镜头显示河马海盗用手轻轻地将羽毛在阿努比斯的腋窝上上下滑动，反复地重复这个动作，同时伴有滑稽的音效。与此同时，我们听到阿努比斯闷闷不乐的笑声。 场景6：特写镜头聚焦于阿努比斯的上半身，他闭着眼睛咧嘴大笑，发出闷闷的笑声，而河马盗贼继续用羽毛轻轻地在阿努比斯的腋窝里滑动。 场景7：河马盗贼继续用羽毛挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯咯咯地笑着，努力想抓住金瓮，但却徒劳无功。 场景8：河马盗贼继续用羽毛挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯哈哈大笑，最后他松开了金瓮，抱紧自己，继续傻笑。与此同时，鸟海盗用爪子抓着金瓮飞走了，河马盗贼也跟着鸟海盗和河马盗贼一起逃跑，两人都发出狡黠的笑声。 场景9：阿努比斯从笑声中回过神来，愤怒地怒视着逃跑的盗贼们。 英文语音。

en.p:
Cinematic Truth Source & Setup
High-production viral K-pop dance challenge video filmed inside a professional dance practice studio. Spacious bright room with high ceilings, full wall-to-wall mirror on the back wall reflecting the entire studio, light-colored wooden sprung dance floor, professional lighting rigs with soft diffused key lights and vibrant magenta and cyan accent lights. Minimalist clean studio atmosphere with large speakers and subtle equipment visible in the background. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF in 4K 60fps, crisp digital cinema look with clean vibrant pop color grading.
Image Reference
@character1 positioned on the left and @character2 on the right. Exact character identities locked strictly via tags @character1 and @character2 from frame 0 to end. Starting pose on frame 0: both standing front facing camera in synchronized sharp choreography stance with hands on hips and intense gaze.
Timeline (Second-by-Second)
0-3s: Medium full shot from front. Strong beat drop triggers sharp synchronized opening: right arm sharp pull across chest with left arm extending outward, powerful chest pop + shoulder isolation, quick intricate footwork (heel-toe slides with hip accents). Both execute precise double arm circles into a strong side pose. Camera subtly pushes in.
3-6s: Seamless transition into complex body waves — full undulation from head to hips followed by reverse isolation. Intricate layered arm choreography (one arm tutting while the other does smooth waves), sharp finger snaps and wrist flicks perfectly synced. Heavy bass hits matched with powerful torso isolations.
6-9s: High-intensity section — rapid directional changes with quick foot shuffles, knee lifts, and explosive arm swings. Synchronized hair flip during half-turn, followed by sharp locking moves, pointing choreography toward camera, and dynamic level change (deep plié to rise). Mirror-perfect sync maintained.
9-12s: Climactic finale — powerful synchronized jumps into wide stance, big dynamic arm hits with full body contraction, quick spin + final sharp pose freeze. Camera slowly pulls back revealing full body and studio reflection as they hold the ending with fierce expressions.
Style, Quality Boosters & Negative Prompts
Natural realistic fabric dynamics and hair movement with accurate physics, perfect anatomical precision, natural motion blur on fast actions. Strong vibrant yet realistic color grading, subtle film grain. --no deformed anatomy, no extra limbs, no rubbery or floaty movements, no face identity drift between @character1 and @character2, no unsynced dancing, no blurry motion, no cartoonish physics, stable hands and fingers, perfect synchronization throughout, no text or watermarks.

zh.p: 电影级真实感来源与设定：在专业舞蹈练习室内拍摄的高制作病毒式K-pop舞蹈挑战视频。宽敞明亮的房间，高天花板，后墙整面落地镜映照整个工作室，浅色木制弹簧舞池，专业灯光设备配备柔和的漫射主光以及鲜艳的品红与青色点缀光。极简干净的工作室氛围，背景可见大型音箱和少量设备。使用ARRI Alexa Mini LF以4K 60fps拍摄，呈现清晰数字电影质感，色彩分级干净鲜艳且富有活力。图像参考：@character1位于左侧，@character2位于右侧。从第0帧到结束，角色身份严格通过标签@character1和@character2锁定。第0帧起始姿势：两人正面朝向镜头，同步做出利落的编舞姿态，双手叉腰，目光专注。时间线（逐秒）：0-3秒：中全景正面拍摄。强烈的节拍落下触发利落的同步开场：右臂利落地横拉过胸前，左臂向外伸展，有力的胸部震动加肩部孤立动作，快速复杂的脚步动作（脚跟-脚尖滑动配合臀部点缀）。两人精准完成双臂绕圈动作，转入有力的侧身姿态。镜头轻微推进。3-6秒：无缝过渡到复杂的身体波浪——从头到臀的完整起伏，随后反向孤立动作。复杂的层次化手臂编舞（一只手臂做tutting动作，另一只做流畅波浪），精准同步的利落响指和手腕轻弹。沉重的贝斯节拍与有力的躯干孤立动作相呼应。6-9秒：高强度段落——快速方向变化，配合快速脚步移动、抬膝和爆发性手臂挥动。半转身时同步甩发，随后是利落的locking动作，指向镜头的编舞动作，以及动态高度变化（深plié到起身）。保持镜像般的完美同步。9-12秒：高潮结尾——有力的同步跳跃进入宽站姿，大幅动态手臂击打配合全身收缩，快速旋转加最终利落姿态定格。镜头缓慢拉远，露出全身和工作室镜面反射，两人以凶猛表情保持结束姿态。风格、质量提升与负面提示：自然的真实布料动态和头发运动，物理效果准确，解剖结构完美，快速动作有自然运动模糊。强烈鲜艳但真实的色彩分级，细微胶片颗粒。--无变形解剖结构，无多余肢体，无橡胶感或漂浮动作，无@character1和@character2之间的面部身份漂移，无不同步舞蹈，无模糊运动，无卡通物理效果，手和手指稳定，全程完美同步，无文字或水印。

en.p: An isekai fantasy anime scene. The setting is a castle town in another world. The castle is not depicted. It's a scene where, suddenly, Image 3 and Image 2 are being affectionate with the man from Image 4, while Image 1 watches from a distance and becomes jealous, causing Images 2 to 4 to look frightened. Scene 1 (0-3 seconds): A top-down view of the male adventurer from Image 4 walking through the market. The beast-girl beauty from Image 3 clings to Image 4's arm, smiling at him and saying, 'Zahha-san.' Then, the knight girl from Image 2 clings to Image 4's other arm, smiling at him and saying, 'Zahha.' Scene 2 (3-7 seconds): A side view of them. Image 4 panics, 'Wha-what are you two doing?' Image 2 and Image 3, still clinging to his arms, turn their faces toward him and smile. Suddenly, the background behind the three characters turns pitch black, with small lightning effects (like warning signs). They look startled and turn around toward the screen. Scene 3 (7-9 seconds): A full-body shot of Image 1's girl standing in front of the market. She stands with her arms crossed. Passersby walk back and forth in front of her. Scene 4 (9-11 seconds): A close-up of Image 1's girl. Then, the background turns pitch black. Her face is smiling, but the background effect shows flames of jealousy blazing. One of her eyes twitches. Scene 5 (11-13 seconds): A scene where Image 4, Image 3, and Image 2 all panic simultaneously, going 'Ah-wa-wa-wa.' Their faces become chibi-fied, turning into Japanese manga-style faces. Their eyes become round white (no pupils), their mouths become wobbly, and round sweat drops fly off with a 'pipipi' effect.

zh.p:
異世界ファンタジーのアニメシーン。舞台は異世界の城下町。城は描かない。画像4の男性にいきなり画像3と画像2が甘えていると、画像１が遠くからそれを見ていて嫉妬、画像2〜4がそれを見ておびえるシーンです。

シーン①(0〜3秒):画像4の男性の冒険者が市場を歩いているシーンを上から。画像3の獣人美少女が画像4の腕にしがみつき「ザッハさん」と彼に微笑みかける。そのあと、画像2の騎士の彼女が「ザッハ」と画像4のもう片方の腕にしがみつき彼に微笑みかける。
シーン②(3秒〜7秒):彼らを横からの視点で。あわてる画像4「き、君たち？」。画像2と画像3は腕にしがみついたまま、彼に顔を向け微笑んでいる。すると3人のキャラクターの背景が真っ暗になり、小さな雷のエフェクト(危険信号みたいなもの)、彼らがハッとした顔をして、画面に向け振り返る。
シーン③(7〜9秒):画像１の彼女が市場の前に立っている全身の姿。腕を組んで立っている。彼女の前を通行人たちが行き交っている。
シーン④(9〜11秒):画像１の彼女のアップ. その後、背景が真っ暗に。顔は笑っているが嫉妬の炎でメラメラと背景のエフェクト。片目がピクピクしている。
シーン⑤(11秒〜13秒):画像4、画像3、画像2が3人同時に「あわわわ」とうろたえている場面。顔のみがちびキャラ化、日本のマンガ顔に。彼らの目は丸い白目(黒目は無し)になり、口がフニャフニャになり、丸い汗がピピピっと飛んでいる。

zh.p: 镜头类型：超写实第一人称视角纸飞机飞行。锐利的白色纸飞机机头/尖端在整个视频中始终锁定在画面底部中央（绝不消失）。视觉风格：超真实电影级写实主义，具备真实世界的深度、比例和光照。仅限单次连续拍摄。无剪切、无转场、无瞬移、无扭曲、无变形、无畸变。一切必须呈现物理真实感。摄像机感受：摄像机刚性固定在纸飞机上。快速向前滑翔，遵循自然纸飞机物理原理。风速变化带来有机的速度波动。仅在高速时出现物理精确的运动模糊。微弱的湍流抖动和振动。运动必须感觉轻盈、不稳定且空灵（绝非无人机风格）。场景设定：西班牙马贝拉——地中海沿岸城市。白色别墅、屋顶、棕榈树、狭窄街道、阳台、咖啡馆、林荫大道商店。下方有行驶的汽车和微小的真实行人。光照：明亮的地中海白天阳光，略带暖金色调。白色建筑上呈现真实阴影和高光。飞行序列（严格时间8秒）：0:00–0:02 从<<<image_1>>>屋顶视角精确开始。瞬间向前加速。轻微向下俯冲进入城市。屋顶和树木紧贴掠过，伴有强烈运动模糊。0:02–0:04 快速平滑右转进入通往林荫大道的街道。两侧建筑紧贴掠过，产生强烈视差。棕榈叶扫过画面边缘。转弯时一只鸟极近距离交叉掠过（险些相撞）。0:04–0:06 高速直线飞行穿过马贝拉林荫大道。下方有行驶的汽车、行走的行人、可见的咖啡馆和露台。速度变化：快速→轻微减速→再次快速。加速时运动模糊增强。两只鸟在不同深度掠过。0:06–0:08 飞机降低至接近街道水平。险些相撞时刻：极近距离掠过棕榈树或阳台边缘。最后快速冲向地平线。金色阳光照耀建筑。一只鸟极近距离掠过镜头，营造电影感结尾。音效设计：强烈风声（主导）、微弱的纸张颤动声、远处城市环境音（汽车+街道噪音）、近距离掠过时的鸟翼拍打声。强制规则：纸飞机尖端必须100%时间可见。起始帧必须与<<<image_1>>>精确匹配。仅限单次连续拍摄。无故障、无扭曲、无AI弯曲伪影。仅允许真实运动模糊和真实世界物理。时长：8秒。优先级：最大真实感、电影感、稳定的运动一致性。

Extreme close-up, muscular Black male athlete’s face, focused intense eyes, sweat on skin, breathing controlled.
He whispers: “One week.”
SFX: heartbeat + low bass hit

Fast cut to frog stand, low angle close-up, hands pressing into ground, body balancing forward.
Camera: handheld micro-shake, dynamic tension
SFX: subtle strain + floor contact

Medium shot, smooth transition into L-sit, legs extend sharply, core tight.
Lighting highlights abs and muscle definition
Music: rock beat kicks in stronger

Tracking shot, athlete shifts into tuck planche, body hovering above ground, controlled strength.
Camera circles slightly to emphasize balance

[00:08–00:10]
Wide shot, explosive transition into elbow lever, body fully horizontal, held steady.
SFX: whoosh + bass hit accent

[00:10–00:12]
Hard cut, upside-down headstand, clean vertical alignment.
Camera slowly rotates 180° to match inversion perspective

[00:12–00:14]
Rapid montage flashes (0.3s cuts): frog stand → L-sit → planche → elbow lever → headstand
Energy peaks, synced with rock music hits

[00:14–00:15]
Hero shot, full body, athlete stands upright, breathing strong, confident stare into camera.
Text appears: “MASTER YOUR BODY”
SFX: final bass impact + echo

en.p:
A hyper-real fast paced action sequence set on a storm-tossed sea at night. Heavy rain, lightning flashes, violent waves. A damaged ship lists, with a broken railing and loose debris. Sound: thunder, wind, crashing water.

⸻

Shot 1 (0–2s):
On the slick deck, a woman slips near the broken railing—falls overboard into the dark water.
A young man lunges, misses, screams:
“No!”

⸻

Shot 2 (2–6s):
He looks up into lightning—face contorts. His body mutates into a fish-like humanoid: gills open, skin slickens, limbs streamline. He sprints and dives cleanly into the sea.

⸻

Shot 3 (6–10s):
Underwater, murky and turbulent—she’s sinking, disoriented. A shark silhouette cuts through the water, accelerating toward her.

The transformed man powers forward, faster, weaving through bubbles and debris—closing the gap.

⸻

Shot 4 (10–13s):
He reaches her a moment before the shark, grabs her securely, and kicks hard away, changing direction sharply. The shark overshoots, turns, but loses distance in the churn.

He ascends toward floating wreckage.

⸻

Shot 5 (13–15s):
He lifts her onto a piece of floating debris, then reverts back to human form—gills sealing, skin normalizing.

Lightning flashes.

Cut.

zh.p:
暴风雨之夜，惊涛骇浪的海面上演着超现实的极速动作戏码。暴雨倾盆，闪电撕裂夜空，狂浪翻涌。一艘破损的船只倾斜着，断裂的栏杆与散落的碎片在风雨中飘摇。背景音效：雷鸣、狂风、惊涛拍岸。

镜头1（0-2秒）：湿滑的甲板上，一名女子在断裂的栏杆旁失足——坠入漆黑的海水。年轻男子飞扑过去，却未能抓住她，嘶吼着：“不！”

镜头2（2-6秒）：他仰头望向闪电——面容扭曲。身体突变为人鱼形态：鳃裂张开，皮肤变得滑腻，四肢流线化。他疾冲入海，以完美的姿态跃入水中。

镜头3（6-10秒）：水下世界浑浊汹涌——女子正下沉，意识模糊。鲨鱼的剪影划破海水，加速逼近。变身后的男子奋力前游，速度更快，在气泡与碎片间穿梭——距离不断缩短。

镜头4（10-13秒）：他在鲨鱼扑来的瞬间抓住女子，牢牢抱住她，奋力蹬腿转向。鲨鱼扑空，转身追击，却在激流中失去优势。他带着女子向漂浮的残骸升去。

镜头5（13-15秒）：他将女子托上一块浮木，随即恢复人形——鳃部闭合，皮肤恢复正常。闪电划过。画面骤黑。

Ultra-cinematic 15-second cyberpunk gunslinger sequence in a neon-lit futuristic street at night, light rain reflecting colors on the ground.

0–2s: Wide shot — a lone cybernetic gunslinger stands still in the middle of the street, long coat slightly moving in the wind, neon signs flickering around.

2–4s: Slow push-in — subtle mechanical details visible: one glowing eye, faint light lines under the skin, small energy pulses running through cybernetic arm.

4–6s: Close-up — hand resting near a holstered futuristic revolver, fingers twitch slightly with mechanical precision, tiny servo movements visible.

6–8s: VFX moment — the eye briefly intensifies with a scanning glow, a thin holographic flicker passes across vision, reflecting in the rain.

8–10s: Medium shot — the gunslinger draws the weapon smoothly, motion extremely controlled, coat shifting with the movement.

10–12s: Action beat — a fast precise shot is fired, represented by a sharp flash of light and energy ripple in the air, subtle distortion wave expanding forward.

12–13.5s: Impact reaction — distant object reacts to the hit with a burst of sparks and displacement, no visible target detail.

13.5–15s: Final shot — gunslinger lowers the weapon slightly, standing still again, neon reflections moving across armor and wet ground.

Camera: slow cinematic push-ins, minimal cuts, controlled framing, slight handheld micro movement.

Environment: cyberpunk street, neon signage, wet asphalt, light rain, atmospheric haze.

Lighting: strong neon contrast (blue, magenta), reflections on surfaces, glowing tech elements.

Style: ultra-cinematic realism, restrained VFX (glow, scan, energy ripple), grounded motion, no text, no overlays, stable proportions without stretch.

zh.p: 超电影感15秒赛博朋克枪手片段，场景设定在霓虹闪烁的未来街道夜晚，细雨将灯光色彩映在地面。0-2秒：广角镜头——一名独行赛博枪手静立街中央，长外套随风微动，四周霓虹招牌明灭闪烁。2-4秒：缓慢推进——机械细节渐显：一只发光义眼、皮肤下隐约的光纹、机械臂中流动的微小能量脉冲。4-6秒：特写——手悬于未来左轮手枪枪套旁，手指以机械精度轻颤，可见微型伺服动作。6-8秒：视觉特效时刻——义眼短暂增强扫描光芒，一道全息闪烁掠过视野，映在雨幕中。8-10秒：中景——枪手流畅拔枪，动作极度克制，外套随势摆动。10-12秒：动作高潮——快速精准射击，以锐利闪光和空中能量涟漪呈现，细微扭曲波向前扩散。12-13.5秒：命中反应——远处目标被击中，迸发火花与位移，无可见目标细节。13.5-15秒：最终镜头——枪手微垂武器，再次静立，霓虹倒影在装甲与湿地上流动。摄影：缓慢电影感推进，极少切换，构图克制，轻微手持微动。环境：赛博朋克街道，霓虹招牌，湿沥青路，细雨，氛围雾霭。灯光：强烈霓虹对比（蓝、品红），表面反光，发光科技元素。风格：超电影感写实，克制视觉特效（发光、扫描、能量涟漪），动作扎实，无文字，无叠加，比例稳定无拉伸。

en.p:
STORY FORMAT: 15s / 150 BPM / MULTI-CUT / American dark comedy / fast physical comedy with ironic twist

TONE: exhaustion → temptation → eerie interruption → sudden threat → misdirection → absurd dominance twist

SETTING: Mountain slope at sunrise near Mount Fuji, golden light, dramatic sea of clouds, cliffside edge, light wind moving trees

CHARACTERS:
Orange cat monk: wearing a gray Taoist robe, sweaty, exhausted, carrying a heavy bundle of firewood
White cat (mysterious woman): wearing a purple kimono, light purple eyeshadow, vivid red lips, sly and playful
Black bear ronin: wearing ancient Japanese ronin outfit, black sword sheath at waist, aggressive, intimidating

CAMERA STYLE: cinematic wide landscapes, quick reaction cuts, sudden whip pans, exaggerated impact physics, dark comedy timing

SCENE

0–3s
Wide cinematic shot: mountain slope

The orange cat struggles uphill, carrying firewood on his back, breathing heavily

Cliff edge beside him, vast sea of clouds and sunrise near Mount Fuji in the distance

He stops… slowly turns

His eyes soften at the beautiful view

He drops the firewood

Sits down

Pulls out a hidden rice ball

Orange cat (relieved, whispering):
“…Finally.”

3–5s
Close-up: he’s about to eat

A distant female voice echoes softly

White cat (O.S., playful, eerie):
“Cat master… I’m hungry too…”

The orange cat freezes

Rice grains stuck on his lips

He looks around, nervous

Orange cat (muttering):
“…Nope. Don’t like that.”

5–7s
Cut to forest behind him

Through the shadows: the white cat in a purple kimono watches silently, smirking

Suddenly a black bear ronin steps into frame

He sees the rice ball

Drool slowly drips

Black bear (deep growl):
“…Hand it over.”

7–10s
The orange cat sighs, annoyed

He places the rice ball on the firewood

Rolls his shoulders

Orange cat:
“Fine. Let’s do this.”

He charges the bear

HAND-TO-HAND COMBAT begins

Fast, chaotic, exaggerated strikes

10–12s
Sudden blur from the side

The white cat dashes out of the forest

She grabs the rice ball instantly

Shoves the whole thing into her mouth

Her cheeks puff up comically

She chews mid-chaos, amused

[0–4 sec]
Golden sunset. A tired American father in a construction uniform sits in his pickup truck, hands rough, eyes heavy.
His young son runs toward him from the porch, smiling wide.
Ambient sound: soft wind, distant birds.
[4–8 sec]

The father lifts his son into his arms, despite exhaustion. The boy laughs, touching his father’s dusty face.
Dialogue (soft):
Son: “Did you miss me?”
Father (smiling): “Every second.”

[8–12 sec]
They sit on the truck hood together, sharing a sandwich. The boy leans on his father’s shoulder.
The father quietly watches him, eyes filled with love and pride.

[12–15 sec]
The son falls asleep in his arms. The father gently holds him tighter, looking at the fading sunset.
Final whisper: “I’m doing all this for you.”
Fade to black.

Ultra-realistic lighting (golden hour tones)
Cinematic depth of field

[0s-5s] Cinematic wide shot with dark, moody lighting. A ruined, post-apocalyptic traditional Japanese courtyard filled with mist. A woman in glossy black latex and a purple-haired man in a white suit stand in combat stances. Glowing white energy radiates from her, and dark black energy from him. The camera dynamically tracks the woman as she performs a swift, fluid dash forward and lands a smooth, powerful uppercut.

The woman leaps after him, and the camera smoothly orbits the two characters as she delivers a continuous, fluid sequence of mid-air strikes. The glowing energy trails follow their movements seamlessly.

[10s-15s] The camera pushes in quickly as she executes a forceful downward blow. The man crashes hard into the stone courtyard floor. Thick smoke and dust billow heavily into the air, revealing deep cracks forming in the ground. 4K ultra HD, highly stable footage, sharp details. Audio: Intense cinematic bass drops, energy whooshes, mid-air impact thuds, and the loud, heavy rumble of crumbling stone.

en.p: A colossal stone gargoyle awakens atop Notre-Dame at dusk, its cracked surface shifting as glowing energy pulses through ancient engravings, opening on an extreme close-up of stone fragments breaking apart from its face, then the camera pulls back into a dramatic crane shot revealing Paris below, transitioning into a vertigo dolly zoom as the gargoyle spreads its massive wings and leaps into the air, camera diving alongside it in a hyperspeed aerial chase between Haussmann buildings, wings smashing through rooftops, debris raining into the streets, cutting to a ground-level tracking shot as civilians flee while shadows sweep across the city, then snapping into a 360° orbit as the creature lands violently on the Seine riverbank, causing a shockwave that cracks pavement and shatters windows, followed by a low-angle push-in as it roars, dust and stone particles swirling in volumetric light, ending with a wide aerial shot of Paris engulfed in chaos, smoke rising around the Eiffel Tower in the distance, ultra-realistic destruction, cinematic lighting, and epic apocalyptic atmosphere.

zh.p: 黄昏时分，巴黎圣母院顶上一尊巨大的石像鬼骤然苏醒，龟裂的表面随着古老刻痕中涌动的能量光芒而震颤，镜头以极端特写捕捉其面部崩落的碎石，随后拉远成戏剧性的俯拍镜头，展现下方巴黎全景。当石像鬼展开巨翼腾空而起时，画面切换为眩晕式推拉变焦，摄影机以超高速俯冲姿态穿梭于奥斯曼建筑群间，巨翼击碎屋顶，碎石如雨倾泻街道。镜头骤降至地面跟拍，市民四散奔逃，阴影掠过城市上空。随着石像鬼猛烈砸落塞纳河岸，画面急转为360°环绕镜头，冲击波震裂路面、震碎玻璃，最后以低角度推进镜头呈现其咆哮姿态，尘埃与石屑在体积光中旋舞。结尾以广角航拍展现陷入混乱的巴黎，远处埃菲尔铁塔周围浓烟升腾，极致写实的毁灭场景，电影级光影渲染，史诗般的末日氛围。

STYLE: Photorealistic cinematic, shot on ARRI Alexa, anamorphic lens, warm tungsten + shafts of dust-lit window light, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain. Sound design implied: page-flutter, ink-splash, quill-scratch.
0:00–0:02  OLD LIBRARY — DAY
SHOT: Close-up push-in on a focused young man (24), sharp features, slightly tousled dark hair, wearing a casual button-up shirt with rolled sleeves. He sits at a heavy oak desk. An ancient leather-bound book lies open before him.
ACTION: His eyes scan the page intensely. A subtle smirk forms. He pulls off his thin-framed glasses, drops them onto the desk with confidence — then suddenly LAUNCHES forward, diving headfirst into the page.
CAMERA: Dolly-in matches his dive, accelerating rapidly.
SCALE: Normal human size.
0:02–0:04  INTO THE PAGE
SHOT: He breaks through the paper surface like liquid. Ink ripples outward in concentric waves.
ACTION: IMPACT — he lands in a low, controlled crouch. SCALE SNAP: now matchstick-sized. Towering printed letters surround him like massive black ridges. Without hesitation, he sprints forward between them.
CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot racing beside him through serif letter “canyons.”
0:04–0:06  PAPER AIRPLANE LAUNCH
SHOT: A jagged paper airplane slices past at high speed.
ACTION: He pivots, leaps cleanly onto it, sliding briefly before popping up into a balanced surfer stance. SCALE SNAP: now sparrow-sized relative to the plane. Wind blasts his hair back as the text below stretches into a rushing white expanse.
CAMERA: Over-shoulder tracking → whip-pan to side profile as the plane banks sharply.
0:06–0:08  INK-BLOT OBSTACLE COURSE
ACTION: The plane rockets forward. Massive ink blots erupt upward like explosive geysers. He ducks, shifts his weight, weaving with athletic precision.
A heavy ink pen crashes down beside him like a falling column.
A magnifying glass sweeps overhead — distorting everything beneath it. He cuts straight through the warped zone, briefly stretched and refracted, then snaps back to normal.
CAMERA: Aggressive handheld tracking, dutch tilts, motion blur on edges.
0:08–0:10  MARGIN STORM
ACTION: The plane dives into the book’s gutter — a deep canyon. Letters (A, R, K, 7) float and tumble in slow-motion suspension.
A drawn storm cloud in the margin animates — releasing delicate ink droplets.
He reaches out mid-ride, catching one drop in his palm. His expression softens — a moment of awe.
CAMERA: 120fps slow-motion orbit around him, lens flares streaking across drifting letters.
0:10–0:12  QUILL SWAP
ACTION: Speed snaps back. The plane shreds apart mid-air.
A feather quill streaks past — he grabs it mid-flight, swings himself up, and rides it like a broomstick.
The nib drags wet ink behind him as he carves fluid figure-eights.
He narrowly avoids a massive descending thumbprint.
CAMERA: Fast tracking, slight roll synced to his movement.

zh.p: 风格：照片级电影感，ARRI Alexa拍摄，变形镜头，暖色钨丝灯+尘埃漫射的窗光，浅景深，35mm胶片颗粒。音效设计暗示：书页翻动声、墨水飞溅声、羽毛笔刮擦声。0:00–0:02 旧图书馆——白天镜头：特写推近一位专注的年轻男子（24岁），轮廓分明，深色头发微乱，穿着休闲纽扣衬衫，袖子卷起。他坐在厚重的橡木书桌前。一本古旧皮装书摊开在面前。动作：他目光如炬地扫视书页，嘴角浮现一丝狡黠笑意。他摘下细框眼镜，自信地扔在桌上——随即猛然前冲，一头扎进书页。镜头：推轨同步他的俯冲，急速加速。尺度：正常人类大小。0:02–0:04 进入书页镜头：他如液体般穿透纸面。墨水如涟漪般向外扩散。动作：冲击——他以低姿可控的蹲伏落地。尺度骤变：此刻如火柴棍大小。高耸的印刷字母如黑色山脊环绕四周。他毫不犹豫地在其间冲刺奔跑。镜头：低角度跟拍，在他身旁掠过衬线字母“峡谷”。0:04–0:06 纸飞机发射镜头：一架棱角分明的纸飞机高速掠过。动作：他转身，干净利落地跃上飞机，短暂滑行后弹起，摆出平衡的冲浪姿势。尺度骤变：此刻相对于飞机如麻雀大小。狂风将他的头发向后吹起，下方文字延伸成一片疾驰的白色旷野。镜头：过肩跟拍→急摇至侧影，飞机急转弯。0:06–0:08 墨迹障碍赛动作：飞机火箭般前冲。巨大墨迹如爆炸喷泉般冲天而起。他俯身、转移重心，以运动员般的精准闪避。一支沉重的墨水笔如倒塌的柱子砸落身旁。放大镜从头顶扫过——扭曲下方一切。他径直穿过扭曲区域，身体短暂拉伸折射，随即恢复原状。镜头：激进的手持跟拍，荷兰角镜头，边缘运动模糊。0:08–0:10 页边风暴动作：飞机俯冲入书脊——一道深邃峡谷。字母（A、R、K、7）在慢动作悬浮中飘浮翻滚。页边手绘的暴风云开始动画——释放出细腻的墨滴。他在骑行中伸手，接住掌心一滴。表情柔和——瞬间的敬畏。镜头：120fps慢动作环绕他旋转，镜头光晕在飘浮字母间拖曳。0:10–0:12 羽毛笔切换动作：速度骤然恢复。飞机在半空碎裂。一支羽毛笔疾驰而过——他凌空抓住，借力跃起，如骑扫帚般驾驭它。笔尖拖曳湿墨，划出流畅的8字轨迹。他惊险避开一枚巨大的下压指纹。镜头：快速跟拍，轻微滚动同步他的动作。

2–4s: Transitions into fluid torso motion (3 in @image1.png age1 → 5 in @image1.png age1), combining a controlled body roll with a chest-driven wave, camera subtly orbiting right.
4–6s: Quick rhythmic accents, shoulders and upper body snap with attitude (6 in @image1.png age1 → 9 in @image1.png age1), synced to hi-hats.
6–8s: A dynamic level change, dancer lifts into a fast step and drops low (7 in @image1.png ge1 → 16 in @image1.png age1), slight motion blur for impact.

zh.p: @image1.png 一位自信的街头舞者，身处极简摄影棚内，柔和的定向光线与微妙的阴影交织，身着宽松工装裤与紧身背心。镜头起始角度略低，缓缓推进。0-2秒：舞者步入画面，摆出接地气的站姿，重心平稳转移（@image1.png 图1→图2），配合一个利落的指向动作，与重低音节拍同步。2-4秒：过渡到流畅的躯干律动（@image1.png 图3→图5），融合了受控的身体滚动与胸腔驱动的波浪，镜头轻微向右环绕。4-6秒：快速节奏重音，肩部和上半身带着态度猛然律动（@image1.png 图6→图9），与踩镲声同步。6-8秒：动态层次变化，舞者跃起快速踏步并压低身体（@image1.png 图7→图16），轻微运动模糊增强冲击力。8-10秒：平稳恢复至律动状态，臀部摇摆，双臂向外舒展（@image1.png 图10→图11），光线勾勒出动作轮廓。10-12秒：俏皮魅力时刻，歪头与富有表现力的手势（@image1.png 图12→图8），与镜头进行眼神交流。12-14秒：力量序列，凌厉的对角线手臂击打接高能量踢腿（@image1.png 图13→图14），镜头震动强化效果。14-15秒：干净利落的收尾，强健的直立姿态与自信定格（@image1.png 图15），微光闪烁与节拍骤停。风格：电影感、写实、高对比度黑白或柔和色调、浅景深、流畅镜头运动、清晰编舞重点、无夸张AI伪影。

Cinematic sports documentary style focused on wrestling intensity and grit.

Opening shot: dimly lit training gym, sweat dripping onto the mat. Slow-motion close-up of taped hands tightening laces. Heavy breathing sound design.

Voiceover (calm, powerful):
“Every match begins long before the whistle…”

Cut to fast montage: explosive takedown, grapple struggle on the mat, muscles straining, referee hand slapping the floor. Dust and chalk particles in the air under harsh arena lights.

Mid sequence: crowd roar builds as two wrestlers clash in a dramatic lock-up, slow-motion reversal into pin attempt.

Voiceover continues:
“…it begins in silence, pain, and discipline.”

Final shot: one wrestler standing victorious under spotlight, breathing heavily as confetti falls slowly.

Text on screen:
“Wrestling is war without weapons.”

Fade out with stadium echo and heartbeat sound.

A UGC-style coffee advertisement. The video opens on a confident young Black man in a black leather jacket and gold watch, standing outside against a grey wall, tapping his temple with two fingers — the classic "big brain" gesture — smiling knowingly at the camera. A glowing pulse animation radiates from his head, symbolizing sharp mental energy and focus. He nods slightly, as if to say "yeah, I figured it out."

He then reaches down to a nearby table and picks up a sleek white coffee cup clearly labeled "Zero Sleep Coffee" in bold black typography. He brings it to his lips and takes a slow, satisfying sip, closing his eyes for a moment as if feeling the effect instantly. He looks back at the camera with a confident smirk and says directly:

"This is the secret to staying active."

The camera slowly pulls back to reveal a branded Zero Sleep Coffee box sitting on the table beside him — matte black packaging with bold white lettering. The camera then smoothly zooms into the box in a cinematic close-up, holding on the product. A clean text overlay appears:

"Zero Sleep Coffee — Pick Yours Up Today."

Warm natural lighting, handheld slightly shaky UGC camera style, realistic skin tones

zh.p: 一条UGC风格的咖啡广告。视频开场，一位自信的年轻黑人男性身穿黑色皮夹克、佩戴金表，站在户外灰色墙壁前，用两根手指轻点太阳穴——经典的‘高智商’手势——对着镜头露出心领神会的微笑。一道脉冲光效从他头部散发，象征敏锐的精神能量与专注力。他微微点头，仿佛在说‘没错，我想通了。’随后他俯身从旁边的桌上拿起一只光滑的白色咖啡杯，杯身用粗体黑字清晰印着‘零睡咖啡’。他将杯子送到唇边，缓慢而满足地啜饮一口，闭目片刻，仿佛瞬间感受到效果。他回看镜头，带着自信的假笑直言：‘这就是保持活力的秘诀。’镜头缓缓后拉，露出他身旁桌上放着的品牌‘零睡咖啡’礼盒——哑光黑色包装搭配醒目的白色字体。随后镜头以电影感特写流畅推进至礼盒，聚焦产品。画面叠印简洁文字：‘零睡咖啡——今日即享。’温暖自然光线，手持轻微晃动的UGC拍摄风格，肤色呈现真实质感。

[0:00 – 0:03] INT. MASSIVE INDUSTRIAL PLATFORM – NIGHT Low-angle wide shot: Black tactical soldiers (Spearhead team) fast-rope down onto a dark bridge-like structure. Red emergency lights flash. They land in perfect formation, rifles raised.

[0:03 – 0:06] WEAPONS POWER-UP Close-up on rifles lighting up with bright blue energy. Soldiers shout silently (mouths moving). One soldier slams a magazine in massive blue pulse radiates outward. “Weapons free” energy vibe.

[0:06 – 0:09] FIRST CONTACT Spectrals (glowing white-blue ghost-like figures) emerge from the shadows. Soldiers open fire bright blue energy bolts rip through the air. Slow-motion: Multiple spectrals get hit and explode into particles.

[0:09 – 0:12] THE REFORM Slow-motion horror: The destroyed spectrals start pulling back together in mid-air, reforming right in front of the soldiers. One spectral’s head snaps back into place as it stares directly at camera.

[0:12 – 0:15] CHAOS ERUPTS Dozens more spectrals swarm in from all sides. Soldiers spin and fire desperately while backing up. One spectral lunges straight at camera glowing hand reaching out. Final frame: Soldier’s eyes widen in shock as the screen fills with blinding blue light.

No BGM. Only SE.
1980s anime, magical girl transformation parody sequence, gritty comedic tone.
A chubby orange cat sits on the ground
Wearing heavy blue eyeshadow and exaggerated bright red lipstick
Breathing heavily, dramatic, clearly exhausted
(Deep male voice)
Orange Cat: "With my power... this is as far as it goes..."

A black rabbit and a white rabbit rush into frame
Black Rabbit & White Rabbit: "Hey—use this instead!!"
The two rabbits raise their paws, releasing chaotic magical energy
The energy flickers erratically, unstable and slightly dangerous
A glowing object materializes midair
It glitches and warps—then stabilizes into a burning sparkler
It crackles loudly, sparks flying everywhere
The orange cat grabs it with sudden confidence
Orange Cat: "Now THIS I can work with."
Suddenly—an 80s Japanese-style transformation song BLASTS (diegetic, slightly distorted, overdramatic)

Transformation sequence begins
The background explodes into an intense, overly saturated rainbow vortex

The orange cat’s body glows pure white—only a silhouette remains
Transformation sequence in order:
Arm
Leg
Torso
Chest
Head

Each part transforms with exaggerated spark bursts and overly ornate visual effects
Decorations are hyper-detailed—stars, moons, flowers—clashing, excessive, almost ridiculous
Sound effects sync aggressively:
ZAP FWOOSH TWINKLE CRACKLE
The burning sparkler continues to spit sparks mid-transformation

Full-body reveal
The figure now wears a pristine sailor-style magical girl outfit
Elegant, dramatic, perfectly styled

Beat. Silence.

Close-up:

The face is completely bare—no makeup
A thick, messy beard fully covers the lower half of the face

Awkward silence

Brushstroke-style text slams onto the screen:
"Magical Girl...???"
Orange Cat (deep male voice, unwavering confidence):
"With the power of… whatever this is—I summon chaos."
Cut to wide shot
A group of hyenas wearing black suits and sunglasses recoil in shock
Some stumble backward, one trips and drags another down
Hyena #1: "Nah—NOPE."
Hyena #2: "Ain’t magical, this is a lawsuit."
Cut to side

The black rabbit and white rabbit stand stiffly
They lean toward each other, whispering awkwardly
Black Rabbit: "...something was wrong."
White Rabbit: "Yeah—we should go."

They slowly back away out of frame
Final shot

The orange cat strikes a dramatic magical pose
Still holding the violently burning sparkler

Small sparks land on the outfit, lightly scorching it

Freeze frame
SE: sizzle… pop… awkward silence

zh.p: 无背景音乐，仅有音效。1980年代动画风格，魔法少女变身恶搞片段， gritty喜剧基调。一只胖橘猫坐在地上，涂着浓重的蓝色眼影和夸张的亮红色口红，喘着粗气，戏剧化地显得精疲力竭。（低沉男声）橘猫：“以我的力量……只能到这里了……”一只黑兔子和一只白兔子冲入画面。黑兔与白兔：“喂——用这个代替吧！！”两只兔子举起爪子，释放出混乱的魔法能量。能量闪烁不定，不稳定且略带危险。一个发光的物体在半空中实体化。它闪烁扭曲——然后稳定成一根燃烧的烟花棒。噼啪作响，火花四溅。橘猫突然自信地抓住它。橘猫：“这个我可拿手。”突然——一首80年代日式变身歌曲炸响（剧情内音源，略带失真，过度戏剧化）。变身序列开始。背景爆裂成强烈、过饱和的彩虹漩涡。橘猫的身体发出纯白光芒——只剩一个剪影。变身顺序：手臂、腿、躯干、胸部、头部。每个部位都伴随着夸张的火花爆发和过度华丽的视觉效果。装饰细节超载——星星、月亮、花朵——冲突、过度、近乎荒谬。音效激烈同步：咻、嗖、叮、噼啪。燃烧的烟花棒在变身过程中持续喷溅火花。全身亮相。此刻身穿一尘不染的水手式魔法少女服装。优雅、戏剧化、完美造型。节拍。沉默。特写：脸部完全素净——没有妆容。浓密杂乱的胡须完全覆盖下半张脸。尴尬的沉默。笔触风格文字猛然砸在屏幕上：“魔法少女……？？？”橘猫（低沉男声，坚定不移的自信）：“以这……随便什么的力量——我召唤混沌。”切至广角镜头。一群穿着黑色西装、戴着墨镜的鬣狗震惊地后退。有的踉跄后退，一个绊倒并拖倒了另一个。鬣狗1：“不——不行。”鬣狗2：“这哪是魔法，这是要被告的。”切至侧面。黑兔子和白兔子僵硬地站着。他们互相靠近，尴尬地低语。黑兔：“……有点不对劲。”白兔：“是啊——我们该走了。”他们慢慢后退，退出画面。最终镜头。橘猫摆出戏剧性的魔法姿势。仍然握着猛烈燃烧的烟花棒。小火花落在服装上，轻微烧焦。定格画面。音效：嘶嘶……啪……尴尬的沉默。

The two rabbits raise their paws, releasing chaotic magical energy
The energy flickers erratically, unstable and slightly dangerous
A glowing object materializes midair
It glitches and warps—then stabilizes into a burning sparkler
It crackles loudly, sparks flying everywhere
The orange cat grabs it with sudden confidence

Suddenly—an 80s Japanese-style transformation song BLASTS (diegetic, slightly distorted, overdramatic)

Transformation sequence begins

Head

ZAP FWOOSH TWINKLE CRACKLE

Full-body reveal

Elegant, dramatic, perfectly styled

Beat. Silence.

A thick, messy beard fully covers the lower half of the face

Awkward silence

Brushstroke-style text slams onto the screen:

Cut to wide shot

Cut to side

They slowly back away out of frame
Final shot

The orange cat strikes a dramatic magical pose
Still holding the violently burning sparkler

Small sparks land on the outfit, lightly scorching it

Freeze frame
