Ultra-fast cinematic continuous shot, 15 seconds, 150 BPM, dark comedy fantasy chaos, seamless motion transitions, no cuts
MAIN CHARACTER: A chubby orange cat wearing an exaggerated vampire outfit, flowing black robe, high collar, long protruding fangs, goofy overconfident expression
ENVIRONMENT: Gothic European castle at night to vertical freefall past stone walls to dense forest canopy to shallow stream to medieval marketplace street
MOOD ARC: Confident to instant failure to chaotic suffering to false relief to sudden danger to absurd escape to public humiliation payoff
0.0–2.0s Extreme close-up, candlelight flickers, wind howls through tall gothic windows. The orange cat leans toward camera with a smug grin and says, “Follow me.” He spins and jumps out the window. Camera whips after him in tight FPV pursuit.
2.0–4.5s Mid-air, he spreads his arms confidently like a vampire about to fly. Beat. He drops fast. His face shifts to panic. “Wait… why am I not flying—OH NO—” Strong motion blur, rapid vertical parallax as castle walls rush past.
4.5–8.0s He crashes through dense tree branches, spinning violently. “MY FACE—” A nest snaps apart, a sleeping eagle wakes and immediately attacks, pecking his head repeatedly. “HEY—STOP—AAAH—” Each hit sends him tumbling faster downward.
8.0–10.5s He slams into a shallow stream, water explodes upward, camera dips underwater then resurfaces. He stands up soaked, forces a confident thumbs-up and says, “Ha… I’m good.”
10.5–12.5s The water ripples. Several crocodiles slowly rise around him with jaws wide open. He freezes. “…no way.” The crocodiles surge forward. “NOPE—NOPE—NOPE—”
12.5–14.0s At the last second he transforms into a fat orange bat with tiny wings. He flaps frantically, barely lifting off as jaws snap beneath him. “WHY ARE MY WINGS SO SMALL—”
14.0–15.0s As he wobbles upward, camera pans to reveal a white rabbit in glasses and a reporter outfit hiding in nearby bushes, filming calmly. “This is gold.” Smash transition to a medieval street where a hyena vendor shouts, “Extra! Extra! Vampire cat fails to fly!” Camera pushes into a newspaper showing the orange bat mid-panic while crocodiles pose behind him. Freeze frame.

zh.p:
超高速电影级连续镜头，15秒，150BPM，暗黑喜剧奇幻混乱，无缝动作转场，无剪辑

主角：一只穿着夸张吸血鬼服装的胖橘猫，飘逸的黑色斗篷，高领，长而突出的尖牙，傻乎乎又过度自信的表情

环境：夜晚的哥特式欧洲城堡→垂直自由落体掠过石墙→茂密森林树冠→浅溪→中世纪市场街道

情绪弧线：自信→瞬间失败→混乱受难→虚假解脱→突发危险→荒谬逃脱→当众出丑的报应

0.0–2.0秒：极端特写，烛光摇曳，风在哥特式高窗间呼啸。橘猫带着得意的笑容凑近镜头说：“跟我来。”它转身跳出窗外。摄像机紧随其后，以紧密的第一人称视角追踪。

2.0–4.5秒：半空中，它自信地张开双臂，像要飞翔的吸血鬼。停顿。它急速下坠。表情转为恐慌。“等等……我怎么飞不起来——哦不——”强烈的运动模糊，城堡墙壁飞速掠过，产生快速垂直视差。

4.5–8.0秒：它撞穿茂密的树枝，剧烈旋转。“我的脸——”一个鸟巢被撞散，睡醒的鹰立即攻击，不断啄它的头。“嘿——住手——啊啊啊——”每次攻击都让它翻滚着更快下坠。

8.0–10.5秒：它重重摔进浅溪，水花四溅，摄像机潜入水下又浮出水面。它浑身湿透地站起来，强装自信地竖起大拇指说：“哈……我没事。”

10.5–12.5秒：水面泛起涟漪。几只鳄鱼缓缓浮出，张着大嘴围拢过来。它僵住了。“……不会吧。”鳄鱼们猛扑上来。“不行——不行——不行——”

12.5–14.0秒：最后一刻，它变成一只胖乎乎的橙色蝙蝠，翅膀极小。它疯狂拍打翅膀，勉强飞起，下方利齿咔嚓作响。“为什么我的翅膀这么小——”

14.0–15.0秒：它摇摇晃晃向上飞时，镜头平移，露出躲在附近灌木丛中、戴着眼镜、穿着记者服装的白兔，正冷静地拍摄。“这可是绝佳素材。”画面猛地切换到中世纪街道，一只鬣狗小贩喊道：“号外！号外！吸血鬼猫飞行失败！”镜头推向一张报纸，上面是惊慌失措的橙色蝙蝠，身后鳄鱼们摆着姿势。定格画面。

A hyper-real fast paced action sequence set in the Punjab countryside during daytime but overcast. Mustard fields, muddy path, scattered trees, a group of cows grazing calmly. Slight dust in the air. Sound: distant gunshots, heavy breathing, drone buzz approaching.

⸻

Shot 1 (0–2s):
Dutch angle An Indian woman in a red sari with shorts underneath runs fast through muddy farmland, barefoot slipping slightly. Gunshots echo behind her. She looks back, terrified, breathing hard.

⸻

Shot 2 (2-5s):
She skids in wet sludge, nearly falling, stopping beside a group of calm Jersey cows. She quickly raises her wrist and taps a device.

A faint mechanical sound begins.

⸻

Shot 3 (5-10s):
One cow beside her splits open seamlessly—its head tilts, back panels slide apart, revealing a hollow, metallic interior disguised beneath organic texture.

She doesn’t hesitate—runs through the mud and gets into the cow. 

The cow closes instantly, returning to a normal grazing posture.

⸻

Shot 4 (10–13s):
Seconds later—armed soldiers rush in with rifles. A small surveillance drone hovers overhead, scanning.

One soldier speaks into radio (Hindi):
“Sir, yahan koi nahi hai… sirf cows hain.”
(“Sir, no one’s here… only cows.”)

They scan briefly, confused.

⸻

Shot 5 (13–15s):
Quick interior cut—dim, woman sitting inside the cow.
She watches everything on a screen inside , breathing quietly.

Outside, soldiers begin to leave.

0:00-0:03 | The Discovery Scene: A young girl with a messy bob and a sundress finds a fallen "Star-Sprout"—a glowing, pulsing flower—tangled in high grass. Camera: A sweeping low-altitude "grass-cam" fly-through, parting the blades of grass to reveal the glowing flower in a soft glow.
0:03-0:06 | The Touch Scene: As she reaches out, the flower shivers and floats upward, trailing golden stardust that defies gravity. Camera: A slow-motion extreme close-up on her wide, shimmering eyes reflecting the golden light.

0:09-0:12 | The Ascent Scene: She begins climbing the gnarled roots. The wind picks up, sending a swirl of pink flower petals around her. Camera: A corkscrew crane shot that circles upward with her, spiraling toward the canopy.

Scene:
A storm-covered mountain peak at night, black clouds rotating overhead, lightning branching across the sky, wet stone reflecting white-blue flashes, wind tearing through torn banners fixed to ancient pillars.
Subject:
A towering Lightning God with a muscular human form, glowing white-blue eyes, long silver hair whipping in the storm, golden armor etched with luminous runes, and arcs of electricity crawling across both arms.
Action:
The Lightning God stands on the edge of the peak, raises one hand toward the clouds, lightning gathers into his palm, his armor runes flare brighter, then he slams the charged hand downward into the stone as a circular shockwave of electricity expands across the mountain.
Camera:
Wide low-angle shot, camera pushes forward from the base of the stone platform toward the Lightning God, then tilts upward as the lightning gathers above his hand.
Physics:
Rain lashes diagonally in strong wind, hair and fabric react to gusts, lightning briefly overexposes nearby surfaces, loose stones lift from the shockwave then fall with gravity, electrical arcs snap between wet rocks and armor plates.
Audio:
Thunder cracks overhead, roaring wind, rain striking stone, deep electric hum, explosive shockwave impact.

zh.p: 场景：暴风雨笼罩的山顶夜晚，黑色云层在头顶旋转，闪电如枝杈般划过天空，湿漉漉的岩石反射着蓝白色的闪光，狂风撕扯着古老立柱上破碎的旗帜。主体：一位高大的雷神，拥有肌肉分明的人形身躯，发光的蓝白色眼睛，银色长发在风暴中飞舞，金色铠甲上刻有发光的符文，电弧在双臂上爬行。动作：雷神站在山顶边缘，向云层举起一只手，闪电汇聚到他的掌心，铠甲符文变得更亮，然后他将充能的手向下猛击岩石，一道环形电击波在山间扩散。镜头：宽广的低角度镜头，从石台底部向雷神推进，然后在他手中闪电汇聚时向上倾斜。物理：雨水在强风中斜射，头发和织物随风摆动，闪电短暂地使附近表面过曝，松动的石块因冲击波升起后因重力落下，电弧在湿岩石和铠甲板之间噼啪作响。音频：头顶雷声炸裂，狂风呼啸，雨水击打岩石，深沉的电鸣声，爆炸性冲击波撞击声。风格：史诗级神话奇幻电影，高特效闪电模拟，逼真的风暴光照，强大的物理规模，戏剧性的高对比度蓝金色调。

raw_p:
Scene:
A storm-covered mountain peak at night, black clouds rotating overhead, lightning branching across the sky, wet stone reflecting white-blue flashes, wind tearing through torn banners fixed to ancient pillars.
Subject:
A towering Lightning God with a muscular human form, glowing white-blue eyes, long silver hair whipping in the storm, golden armor etched with luminous runes, and arcs of electricity crawling across both arms.
Action:
The Lightning God stands on the edge of the peak, raises one hand toward the clouds, lightning gathers into his palm, his armor runes flare brighter, then he slams the charged hand downward into the stone as a circular shockwave of electricity expands across the mountain.
Camera:
Wide low-angle shot, camera pushes forward from the base of the stone platform toward the Lightning God, then tilts upward as the lightning gathers above his hand.
Physics:
Rain lashes diagonally in strong wind, hair and fabric react to gusts, lightning briefly overexposes nearby surfaces, loose stones lift from the shockwave then fall with gravity, electrical arcs snap between wet rocks and armor plates.
Audio:
Thunder cracks overhead, roaring wind, rain striking stone, deep electric hum, explosive shockwave impact.
Style:
Epic mythological fantasy cinema, high VFX lightning simulation, realistic storm lighting, powerful physical scale, dramatic high-contrast blue and gold color palette.

Scene 1 (0s–4s): Picnic Moment
A serene park bathed in golden afternoon light.A girl wearing a flowing butter-yellow summer dress sits on a soft picnic blanket with her friends. They laugh gently, surrounded by flowers, fruit, and pastel picnic decor. The camera slowly pans, capturing soft smiles, sunlight filtering through trees, and a calm breeze moving her hair.

Scene 2 (4s–8s): Soft Interaction
Close-up shots of the girl (matching reference face exactly), smiling while holding a drink or fruit. Her friends are slightly blurred in the background. Light flares and soft focus enhance the dreamy tone. Fabric of the dress moves gently, emphasizing elegance and softness.

Scene 3 (8s–12s): Bicycle by the Lake
Transition to the girl riding a vintage-style bicycle along a lakeside path in the same park. The butter-yellow dress flows naturally with motion. The lake reflects sunlight, creating a glowing atmosphere. Camera follows from side angle, smooth tracking shot.

Scene 4 (12s–16s): Peaceful Ending
The girl slows down near the lake, stepping off the bicycle. She pauses, looking at the water with a calm, content expression. Soft wind, subtle smile, sunlight highlighting her face. Final frame fades into a warm, dreamy glow.

zh.p: 场景1（0-4秒）：野餐时刻。午后金色阳光洒满宁静的公园。一位身穿飘逸奶油黄夏裙的女孩与朋友们坐在柔软的野餐垫上。她们轻声欢笑，周围点缀着鲜花、水果和柔和的野餐装饰。镜头缓缓移动，捕捉温柔的笑容、透过树叶的阳光，以及微风吹动她发丝的宁静画面。场景2（4-8秒）：轻柔互动。女孩（与参考面容完全一致）手持饮料或水果微笑的特写镜头。背景中的朋友略微虚化。光线晕染与柔焦效果增强了梦幻氛围。裙摆随微风轻拂，凸显优雅与柔美。场景3（8-12秒）：湖畔骑行。画面切换至女孩骑着复古自行车，沿着同一公园的湖畔小径前行。奶油黄连衣裙随动作自然飘动。湖面反射阳光，营造出流光溢彩的氛围。侧角度跟拍镜头平稳流畅。场景4（12-16秒）：静谧尾声。女孩在湖畔减速，从自行车上下来。她驻足凝望水面，神情平静而满足。微风轻拂，嘴角微扬，阳光勾勒出她的面容。最终画面渐隐于温暖梦幻的光晕中。

zh.p: 静谧奢华，锋芒暗藏。一位身着白色短裙、脚踩红色高跟鞋的时尚女性，带着两只罗威纳犬，驾驶经典红色电动兰博基尼超跑，穿越迷雾山脉，驶向壮丽海岸。深饱和色调：暗红、哑光黑、雾灰。节奏由缓慢沉重的陷阱节拍与深沉808贝斯驱动，搭配电影感十足的韵律剪辑，单画面无分屏构图。🎬 从上传照片开始，以极致电影感、超写实风格呈现。镜头序列：镜头1（0-1.5秒）中景镜头缓慢推进。这位引人注目的女性——长白金发、纹身、白裙——自信地站在两只强壮的罗威纳犬之间，背景是雾蒙蒙的海岸山路，红色兰博基尼停在她身后。她直视镜头，神情冷静而威严。音效：低沉的陷阱节拍前奏+远处海浪声。镜头2（1.5-2.5秒）极特写静态镜头对准她的脸。她缓缓摘下墨镜（或歪头），露出锐利的眼神和一抹自信的浅笑。纹身与白金发在戏剧性光线下闪耀。音效：沉重的808贝斯重击。镜头3（2.5-4秒）特写一只罗威纳犬凶狠吠叫，慢动作中龇牙咧嘴，唾液飞溅。充满力量与威慑力。音效：与节拍同步的深沉低音犬吠。镜头4（4-5秒）中景她单手打开兰博基尼车门。一只罗威纳犬优雅跃入副驾驶座。动作流畅有力。音效：沉重的车门关闭声。镜头5（5-6.5秒）微距特写红色兰博基尼的翻盖大灯猛然弹开，明亮光束刺破雾气。音效：机械转动声+引擎轰鸣启动。镜头6（6.5-8秒）广角跟拍镜头红色兰博基尼在蜿蜒的雾中海岸公路上激烈漂移，轮胎尖叫，扬起雾气。可见她单手驾驶，副驾驶座上一只罗威纳犬。音效：轮胎摩擦声+引擎咆哮。镜头7（8-9.5秒）车内中景车内：她单手自信转向，罗威纳犬将头伸出窗外，耳朵在风中拍打。音效：强风+低沉的引擎低吼。镜头8（9.5-11.5秒）广角跟拍镜头低角度从兰博基尼后方拍摄，它沿陡峭悬崖公路飞驰，一侧是海洋，另一侧是险峻山脉，浓雾盘旋。音效：强劲排气声+沉重的808贝斯低音。镜头9（11.5-13秒）广角镜头兰博基尼在海岸公路的雾弯中疾驰，红色尾灯划破雾气。音效：轮胎抓地声+引擎呼啸。镜头10（13-15秒）极广角镜头镜头大幅拉远。女性与两只罗威纳犬站在悬崖边缘，狂风猛烈吹动她的头发和犬耳，红色兰博基尼停在一旁。

en.p:
Style: Hyper-expressive stylized 3D animation, neon sci-fi lighting, volumetric fog, exaggerated squash-and-stretch physics, cinematic motion blur, vibrant colors (teal, magenta, electric blue), shallow depth of field.

0-3s:
A tiny overconfident alien courier wearing a glowing jetpack suit descends through a circular hatch inside a futuristic spaceship kitchen. Below floats a giant glowing energy donut emitting soft neon light. The alien’s visor reflects the donut as his eyes widen with excitement.
Camera: Smooth crane-down from above, passing holographic UI elements, ending with a slight snap-zoom toward the donut.

3-6s:
The alien lands on the floating donut. Everything pauses. Suddenly, a massive robotic guard drone drops into frame upside down, its red eye activating and scanning. The alien squashes into a cube shape from fear, then pops back.
Camera: Fast whip-pan into a 180-degree orbit, ending with the drone towering in the background.

6-9s:
The alien grabs the oversized donut (it wobbles like jelly) and rockets forward. His jetpack sputters, leaving zig-zag trails. He hits a floating metal tray that bends like rubber and launches him forward like a slingshot. The drone fires a slow laser that narrowly misses.
Camera: Fast side-tracking shot with motion blur, then tilt upward as he launches.

9-12s:
Mid-air, the alien spins, then deploys a holographic parachute shaped like a pizza slice. It glitches briefly, then stabilizes. He glides forward, wobbling. Behind him, the drone stretches unnaturally, its limbs extending to grab him.
Camera: Dynamic follow shot from behind with slight rolling motion.

12-15s:
The alien crashes into a narrow maintenance hatch, bounces off the walls, then sticks a superhero landing inside. He takes a huge bite of the glowing donut, sending sparks and crumbs in slow motion. The hatch slams shut as a robotic claw reaches in.
Camera: Rapid push-in on the bite, slow-motion particles, then quick iris-out to black.

en.p:
Style:

Ultra realistic mass celebrity entry scene. Single continuous shot. Handheld camera from crowd perspective. Natural micro-shake. No cuts. Documentary realism.

Audio:

Only natural environment sound loud crowd cheering, people shouting, rapid camera shutter clicks, phones recording audio, airport announcements echoing, footsteps, fabric movement, distant engine idle and rev.

Lighting:

Natural daylight through airport glass panels. Mixed reflections. Realistic shadows. Slight haze for depth.

Main Character:

A female celebrity in [@/image1] with, Calm, confident presence with a subtle controlled smile. Face must remain consistent.

SCENE

0-3s:

Handheld camera starts from inside the crowd behind barricades. Slight natural shake. People in front partially block the view. Phones raised high, some screens visible recording. Crowd is loud and restless and shouting "Sarah". Camera tries to find a clear view toward the arrival gate.

3-6s:

Camera lifts slightly above shoulder level, shaky but controlled. Focus shifts between heads, waving hands, and glimpses of the arrival gate. Media cameras flash. Anticipation builds as people lean forward.

6-10s:

Security suddenly steps in, pushing the crowd slightly back. Camera reacts naturally with a small shake. Through the gaps, the celebrity becomes visible in the distance, slightly blurred at first, then gradually clearer as she walks forward with bodyguards.

10-13s:

Camera zooms slightly (natural handheld push-in feel). Celebrity now clearly visible, walking confidently in center. Security clears the path. She raises his hand and gives a calm wave with a slight smile. Camera struggles slightly to keep her in frame as people move.

13-15s:

Camera tilts and shifts trying to follow her as she reaches her convoy. Partial view of Mercedes Benz, with Mercedes G63 and Innova behind. A bodyguard opens the door of the car. The celebrity enters quickly. Engine revs. Vehicles begin moving forward. Camera lifts slightly as people jump to see.

Fade to black.

zh.p: 风格：超写实的大规模名人入场场景。单次连续镜头。手持摄像机从人群视角拍摄。自然的轻微抖动。无剪辑。纪录片式真实感。音频：仅收录自然环境音——人群震耳欲聋的欢呼声、人们的喊叫声、相机快门的快速咔嚓声、手机录音声、机场广播的回音、脚步声、衣物摩擦声、远处引擎怠速与加速声。灯光：透过机场玻璃面板的自然日光。混合反射光。真实阴影。轻微雾效增强景深感。主要角色：一位女性名人，身着[@/image1]中的装束，神情冷静自信，带着一丝克制的微笑。面部必须保持一致性。场景0-3秒：手持摄像机从路障后方的人群中开始拍摄。轻微自然抖动。前方人群部分遮挡视线。手机高高举起，部分屏幕可见正在录制。人群喧闹不安，高喊着“莎拉”。摄像机试图寻找通往到达口的清晰视野。3-6秒：摄像机略微抬升至肩部以上，虽抖动但控制得当。焦点在人群头部、挥舞的手臂和到达口的片段之间切换。媒体相机闪光灯闪烁。人们前倾身体，期待感逐渐增强。6-10秒：安保人员突然介入，将人群向后推挤。摄像机随之自然轻微抖动。透过人群缝隙，远处可见名人身影，起初略微模糊，随后随着她与保镖一同前行逐渐清晰。10-13秒：摄像机轻微变焦（模拟手持推进的自然感）。名人清晰可见，自信地走在中央。安保人员清出通道。她抬起手，带着浅笑平静挥手。摄像机因人群移动而略显吃力地保持她在画面中。13-15秒：摄像机倾斜移动，试图跟随她抵达车队。画面中可见梅赛德斯-奔驰轿车，后方跟随梅赛德斯G63和Innova。一名保镖打开车门。名人迅速上车。引擎轰鸣。车辆开始前行。摄像机随人群跳跃而略微抬高。画面渐黑。

A high-quality cinematic video of a teenage girl performing a basketball freestyle routine, strictly following a structured 16-step choreography sequence (4x4 grid timing) over 10 seconds total duration.

Character:
A slim, athletic teenage girl with the same face and identity as the provided reference image (must remain consistent throughout the video). She has a slightly nerdy, awkward-cool charm, soft pale skin with light freckles, expressive eyes, and slightly messy light-toned hair tied loosely. She wears thin-frame glasses and a modern street basketball outfit: oversized jersey, loose shorts, crew socks, and high-top sneakers with subtle pastel accents (soft purple and light blue). Her personality feels shy-but-confident, revealing high-level freestyle skills.

Environment:
Minimal indoor basketball court studio. Clean wooden court floor with subtle markings, soft diffused lighting, light neutral walls, no distractions. Slight depth-of-field for a polished editorial sports look.

Style & Motion:
Smooth, controlled freestyle basketball flow. Natural body mechanics, realistic dribbling physics, fluid transitions between moves. Slight stylized cinematic feel but grounded in realism.

Camera:
Mostly medium full-body framing, slight dynamic tracking and subtle handheld feel. Occasional micro-zooms and angle shifts to enhance motion. Keep subject centered and clearly visible at all times.

⸻

⏱️ STRICT SEQUENCE (must follow exactly in order and timing)

Each move flows continuously into the next with no cuts:

Right-hand low dribble (controlled stance)
Behind-the-back transfer (right → left)
Quick crossover (left → right)
Between-the-legs dribble
Hesitation dribble (pause + fake shift)
Behind-the-back (reverse side)
Smooth 360° spin move (left direction)
Ball spin on finger (brief controlled balance)
Behind-the-back into crossover combo
Step-back motion with dribble
Fake pass (upper body feint)
Around-the-world ball motion
Behind-the-back + step-through footwork
Behind + crossover combo (tight control)
Quick low rapid dribble sequence
Stylish finish pose (confident stance, slight smile, holding ball)

⸻

🎯 Key Constraints:

The routine must strictly follow the exact step order (1–16)
Total duration: ~10 seconds (fast but readable transitions)
Ball must remain physically accurate and consistent in motion
No skipped or merged steps
No extra tricks beyond listed sequence
Character face must remain identical to reference throughout (no drift)
Maintain consistent outfit, proportions, and style

⸻

Soft pastel accents in outfit subtly visible
Natural shadows and lighting consistency

STYLE: Bright, playful 3D animation, soft global illumination, vibrant colors, smooth cinematic motion, childlike warmth

⸻

CHARACTER SETUP:
•@img1 = main character (MUST remain EXACTLY as reference: no mouth, no nose, same mask, same proportions, same outfit, no alterations)
•@img2 = LEGO-style figurine model inspiration (final build result)

⸻

SCENE 1 (0s–3s) – ESTABLISHING

Full room view, warm sunlight pouring through a window onto a clean desk.
@img1 sits at the desk, posture slightly leaned forward, focused and calm.
LEGO pieces scattered across the table.
Camera: slow cinematic push-in.
Mood: peaceful, creative, bright daytime energy.

⸻

SCENE 2 (3s–6s) – TIME-LAPSE START

Time-lapse begins.
@img1 rapidly assembles LEGO bricks with precise, smooth hand movements.
Blocks snap together quickly, forming the base structure.
Camera: quick angle cuts (front → side → over-the-shoulder).
Lighting remains soft and sunlit.

⸻

Close-up on hands.
Fingers nimbly snapping LEGO pieces together with satisfying motion.
Bricks begin to resemble @img2’s form.
Camera tracks hand movement smoothly, shallow depth of field.

⸻

SCENE 4 (9s–12s) – BUILD PROGRESSION

Time-lapse intensifies.
The LEGO creation rapidly evolves into a clear version of @img2.
@img1’s body language shows focus shifting into excitement (head tilt, subtle posture lift — NO facial change since no mouth).
Camera: orbiting slow motion mixed with time-lapse.

⸻

Time-lapse ends.
@img1 pauses, looks down at the finished LEGO figure (matching @img2).
Subtle head lift to acknowledge completion (no smile, expression conveyed through posture only).
Camera pulls back to wide shot, sunlight glowing over the desk.
Final frame: completed LEGO figure centered in view.

•DO NOT add a mouth or nose to @img1
•DO NOT change head shape, mask, or textures
•DO NOT stylize @img1 into LEGO form

zh.p:
格式：15秒 / 多镜头 / 延时搭建序列
风格：明亮、俏皮的3D动画，柔和的全局光照，鲜艳的色彩，流畅的电影感运镜，童趣般的温暖氛围

角色设定：
• @img1 = 主角（必须严格保持与参考图一致：无嘴、无鼻、相同面具、相同比例、相同服装，不得改动）
• @img2 = 乐高风格人偶模型灵感（最终搭建成果）

场景1（0-3秒）—— 开场
房间全景，温暖的阳光透过窗户洒在整洁的书桌上。@img1坐在桌前，身体微微前倾，神情专注而平静。桌上散落着乐高积木。镜头：缓慢的电影感推进。氛围：宁静、富有创造力、明亮的日间能量。

场景2（3-6秒）—— 延时开始
延时摄影开始。@img1以精准流畅的手部动作快速组装乐高积木。积木块迅速拼接，形成基础结构。镜头：快速切换角度（正面→侧面→过肩视角）。光线保持柔和，阳光充足。

场景3（6-9秒）—— 手部细节
手部特写。手指灵巧地拼接乐高积木，动作令人愉悦。积木逐渐呈现出@img2的形态。镜头平滑跟随手部动作，浅景深效果。

场景4（9-12秒）—— 搭建进展
延时摄影加速。乐高作品迅速演变为清晰的@img2形态。@img1的肢体语言从专注转向兴奋（头部微倾、姿态轻微上扬——因无嘴，面部无变化）。镜头：慢速环绕运镜与延时摄影结合。

场景5（12-15秒）—— 最终揭示
延时摄影结束。@img1停顿片刻，低头看向完成的乐高人偶（与@img2一致）。头部微微抬起以示完成（无微笑，仅通过姿态传达表情）。镜头拉远至全景，阳光洒满桌面。最终画面：完成的乐高人偶居中展示。

⚠️ 严格角色规则
• 不得为@img1添加嘴或鼻
• 不得改变头部形状、面具或纹理
• 不得将@img1风格化为乐高形态
• 始终保持@img1与参考图完全一致

en.p:
Cinematic sci-fi scene at dusk in an empty open landscape. Two people sitting on the hood of a parked car, a laptop placed between them. The laptop screen glows in the dark, showing breaking news about a mysterious unknown threat. They are mid-conversation, slightly tense, illuminated by the soft blue light of the screen.
Suddenly, they both look up. A massive alien creature begins descending from the cloudy sky above. The creature is enormous, slowly emerging from dark storm clouds, casting a gigantic shadow over them and the car.
Dramatic lighting, volumetric clouds, wind blowing dust around, cinematic composition, ultra-realistic scale, high detail textures.
Wide-angle shot, low camera angle to emphasize scale, dark atmospheric tone, slow reveal feeling, film still from a high-budget sci-fi movie, 8K realism, depth of field, moody color grading.
en.t: Alien Descends Over Tense Sci-Fi Duo

zh.p: 黄昏时分，空旷开阔的荒野上，一幅电影般的科幻场景徐徐展开。两人坐在停靠的汽车引擎盖上，中间放着一台笔记本电脑。屏幕在黑暗中泛着微光，正播放着关于某个神秘未知威胁的突发新闻。他们交谈正酣，神情略显紧张，被屏幕柔和的蓝光映照着。突然，两人同时抬头望去。一个巨大的外星生物开始从头顶乌云密布的天空中降临。这生物体型庞大，缓缓从暗黑的暴风云中浮现，投下笼罩着他们和汽车的巨大阴影。戏剧性的光线、体积感十足的云层、风卷起尘土飞扬，电影级构图、超写实的尺度感、高细节纹理。广角镜头、低角度拍摄以凸显规模，黑暗氛围基调，缓慢揭示的节奏感，仿佛来自高预算科幻电影的电影剧照，8K超写实画质，景深效果，情绪化的色彩分级。

en.p: Ultra-realistic cinematic 15-second vertical video (9:16), 4K, dark rustic wooden table, soft dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, natural textures, no text, no subtitles, no music.0–2sTop-down shot: delicate hands with soft blue nail polish gently touch a bowl of flour.Around it: scattered blueberries, mint leaves, butter cubes.Subtle ambient movement, calm setup.2–4sSide close shot: flour being sifted into a glass bowl.Fine particles fall in slow motion, catching warm light.4–6sMacro shot: hands kneading dough.Sticky texture stretches between fingers, light flour dust visible on skin.6–8s45-degree angle: fresh blueberries pour into a pie crust.Berries bounce naturally, filling the base with slight movement.8–10sTop angled close-up: hands carefully place lattice strips over the pie.Precise woven pattern forming, smooth controlled motion.10–12sSide shot: oven door opens.Warm golden light spills out with gentle steam.Pie placed inside, heat distortion subtly visible.12–13.5sClose-up: crust brushed with glaze.Surface becomes glossy, light reflecting softly.13.5–14.5sMacro: fresh blueberries and mint placed on top of baked pie.Tiny details, natural imperfections, realistic textures.14.5–15sFinal frontal shot: finished blueberry pie on rustic table.Hands enter frame softly.A small white kitten sits nearby, quietly observing.

en.p: A hooded fighter glides on enchanted ice skates across a vast frozen lake, carving deep blue trails, racing toward a towering crystalline ice golem cracking the surface with each step. The hero spirals up a frozen shard ramp, launches skyward, and plunges twin daggers into the colossus's glowing core, shattering it into a blizzard of shards. Dolly-in low angle, then orbital aerial shot. Pale arctic dawn, god rays piercing fog, frost particles, cinematic teal palette, hyperrealistic 4K, shallow depth of field.
en.t: Ice Golem Battle on Frozen Lake

zh.p: 一名戴兜帽的战士脚踩附魔冰刀，在辽阔的冰封湖面上滑行，划出深蓝色的轨迹，冲向一尊高耸的水晶冰魔像——它每踏一步都令冰面龟裂。英雄沿着一道冰晶斜坡螺旋上升，腾空跃起，将双匕首刺入巨像发光的核心，使其碎裂成一场冰屑暴风雪。低角度推近镜头，随后转为轨道环绕航拍。北极的苍白黎明，神光刺穿雾气，霜粒纷飞，电影感的青绿色调，超写实4K画质，浅景深。

en.p: A cinematic luxury skincare advertising storyboard infographic for a glycolic acid exfoliating serum. Layout: 16 panels arranged in a clean 4x4 grid, each panel showing a progressive skincare routine and transformation sequence. Subject: A modern young woman with clear glowing skin, natural makeup, soft minimal beauty aesthetic, holding and using a premium glass dropper bottle of glycolic acid serum. Style: high-end skincare advertisement storyboard, ultra clean dermatology aesthetic, soft cinematic lighting, white marble and pastel background tones, premium editorial beauty photography style, realistic illustration with subtle glow and smooth skin refinement effects. Sequence (visual progression across panels): 1. luxury serum bottle hero shot on marble surface 2. close-up of glass bottle and label 3. dropper extracting serum 4. serum applied to fingertip 5. gentle application on face 6. absorption into skin close-up 7. skin texture smoothing effect 8. subtle before-after transition hint 9. radiant glow beginning to appear 10. skincare routine mirror scene 11. dermatologist clean aesthetic vibe 12. hydration and clarity improvement focus 13. close-up glowing healthy skin portrait 14. sunlight reflecting on smooth skin 15. premium product beauty shot with glow 16. final hero frame: serum bottle + glowing skin model Design: clean grid separation, minimal elegant numbering 1–16, thin lines between panels, soft arrows indicating progression flow, refined editorial layout, balanced composition. Title at top: “GLYCOLIC ACID – 16 STEP SKIN TRANSFORMATION” Negative prompt: blurry, messy layout, low quality, distorted face, acne exaggeration, watermark, oversaturated colors, broken text, unrealistic anatomy, cluttered design Motion prompt: A smooth cinematic skincare commercial animation. Gently transition through the 16-panel storyboard in sequence, as if the camera is moving across each frame. Soft zoom-ins on key moments like serum drop, application on skin, and glowing skin results. Maintain a clean luxury beauty aesthetic with soft lighting, white marble tones, and elegant motion flow. Subtle camera pans, slow transitions, and minimal motion blur. Focus on premium skincare advertisement feel with calm, soothing progression and radiant skin glow effects. End on a hero shot of the product with glowing healthy skin.

zh.p: 一款电影级奢华护肤广告故事板信息图，展示乙醇酸去角质精华液。布局：16个面板整齐排列成4x4网格，每个面板展示逐步护肤流程和肌肤转变过程。主体：一位现代年轻女性，肌肤清透有光泽，妆容自然，呈现柔和简约美学，手持并正在使用一款高级玻璃滴管瓶装的乙醇酸精华液。风格：高端护肤广告故事板，极致洁净的皮肤科美学，柔和的电影级布光，白色大理石与柔和粉彩背景色调，高端编辑类美妆摄影风格，写实插画带有微妙光泽和细腻肌肤修饰效果。序列（面板间的视觉递进）：1. 奢华精华瓶置于大理石表面的主视觉 2. 玻璃瓶与标签特写 3. 滴管吸取精华液 4. 精华液滴在指尖 5. 轻柔涂抹于面部 6. 精华液被肌肤吸收的特写 7. 肌肤纹理平滑效果 8. 使用前后对比的微妙暗示 9. 光泽感开始显现 10. 护肤流程中的镜前场景 11. 皮肤科医生式的洁净美学氛围 12. 聚焦水润与清透度的提升 13. 健康光泽肌肤的特写肖像 14. 阳光在光滑肌肤上反射 15. 带有光泽感的高级产品美妆镜头 16. 最终主视觉：精华瓶+光泽肌肤模特。设计：清晰的网格分隔，1-16的极简优雅编号，面板间细线分隔，柔和箭头指示递进流程，精致的编辑式布局，平衡的构图。顶部标题：“乙醇酸——16步肌肤焕变”。负面提示：模糊、杂乱布局、低质量、面部扭曲、痘痘夸张、水印、色彩过饱和、文字破损、不真实的人体结构、杂乱设计。动态提示：一段流畅的电影级护肤商业动画。按顺序轻柔地过渡16个面板，仿佛镜头在每一帧间移动。在关键瞬间如精华液滴落、涂抹于肌肤和光泽肌肤效果处柔和放大。保持洁净奢华的美妆美学，柔和布光、白色大理石色调和优雅的动态流。微妙的镜头平移、缓慢过渡和最小化动态模糊。聚焦于高端护肤广告的感觉，带来平静舒缓的递进和肌肤光泽效果。以产品与光泽健康肌肤的主视觉镜头结束。

en.p:
Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opening with a medium static shot at approximately a 30° side angle.

Environment: a smoke-filled apocalyptic battlefield set in Jakarta. In the distance, ruined skyscrapers and abandoned high-rise buildings dominate the skyline. Strong winds carry light rain. The ground is cracked concrete scattered with metal debris, with puddles reflecting dim, cold light.

The camera slowly pushes forward.
A vehicle (@Image2 reference) rushes in from the distance at high speed, then performs a sudden hard brake, splashing water mist into the air. Motion blur emphasizes the speed and weight.
The protagonist (@Image1 reference) steps out of the car. His expression is serious and heavy. He looks toward the devastated city, exhales deeply, then lightly pats the car hood.
At that moment, the vehicle levitates and begins transforming—metal panels shifting and unfolding—into a blue humanoid mech (autobot-like). The transformation is powerful and mechanical, with sharp, precise movements.

The mech lands beside the protagonist. They stand side by side, facing forward, ready for battle.

Visual Style: highly realistic cinematic rendering, strong impact, dynamic motion blur on fast movements, sharp focus on key subjects. Atmospheric, epic scale, grounded realism.
Character Style: professional, authoritative digital human appearance.

Audio Style: authoritative, grounded tone design with intense, angry emotional atmosphere.
No dialogue. No background music. Only environmental sound, mechanical transformation, wind, rain, and distant destruction.

zh.p: 单次连续长镜头，无剪辑。开场采用约30度侧角的中景静态镜头。环境设定在雅加达烟雾弥漫的末日战场。远处天际线被废弃的摩天大楼与高层建筑占据。强风裹挟着细雨。地面是布满金属碎片的龟裂混凝土，水洼倒映着暗淡的冷光。镜头缓缓向前推进。一辆车辆（参考图2）从远处高速冲来，突然急刹，激起水雾。动态模糊强调速度与重量感。主角（参考图1）下车，神情凝重。他望向满目疮痍的城市，深吸一口气，轻拍引擎盖。此时车辆悬浮升空，金属板件开始移位展开，变形为蓝色人形机甲（类似汽车人）。变形过程充满机械力量感，动作干脆利落。机甲落地立于主角身侧。二者并肩而立，面向战场，蓄势待发。视觉风格：高度写实的电影级渲染，冲击力强，快速运动时采用动态模糊，关键主体对焦清晰。氛围宏大史诗，兼具现实质感。角色风格：专业权威的数字人类形象。音频风格：权威沉稳的音效设计，伴随激烈愤怒的情绪氛围。无对白。无背景音乐。仅保留环境音、机械变形声、风雨声与远处毁灭的声响。

A lone ancient tree stands in the middle of a vast, slowly urbanizing landscape. Golden hour lighting, soft cinematic tones. A calm, deep narrator voice begins:

“For over 300 years… it has watched everything change.”

Quick cuts: old black-and-white scenes fading into modern city construction around the tree. Birds flying away. Close-up of textured bark, wind rustling leaves.

Narration continues:

“It remembers what we forgot.”

Final shot: the tree surrounded by buildings, standing still. Text fades in:

“Nature doesn’t need us. We need it.”

Soft piano outro, fade to black.

en.p:
Subject: Downhill Mountain Bike 

Race Style: Hyper-realistic, Action Adventure, GoPro first-person/chase cam aesthetic. 

Action: A high-intensity downhill race following a lead pack of elderly cyclists. They speed down a grassy slope, drifting through rugged terrain with dust and grass clippings flying. 

The Twist: As the bikes reach the valley’s edge, the lead rider pulls a hidden lever. Suddenly, the bicycles deploy makeshift rocket-powered thrusters and handcrafted gliders. Instead of stopping, the bikes launch off the cliff, soaring over the village below as engines roar and blue flames erupt from the exhausts. 

Camera Movement: Dynamic chase cam. The camera pushes forward rapidly, weaving between the elderly racers. As they hit the cliff edge, the camera performs a seamless transition into a dizzying free-fall perspective, tilting downward to reveal the massive drop before leveling out to follow the bikes gliding through the air. 

Environment: Sunny rural landscape with vibrant greens and blues. The peaceful valley floor is now a mile below, with the village appearing like a miniature model set. 

Details: Intense motion blur on the edges and violent vibration of the bikes. Heat haze shimmering from the rocket thrusters, lens flares as the sun hits the metallic gliders, and the visible shock on the elderly racers' faces through their goggles as they break the sound of the wind with a sudden sonic pop.
en.t: Elderly Rocket Bikers Soar Over Valley

zh.p: 主题：山地速降自行车赛 风格：超写实、动作冒险、GoPro第一人称/追逐镜头美学。动作：一场高强度的速降比赛，跟随一群领先的老年自行车手。他们飞速冲下草坡，在崎岖地形中漂移，尘土和草屑飞扬。转折点：当自行车抵达山谷边缘时，领骑者拉动一个隐藏的杠杆。突然，自行车展开临时改装的火箭推进器和手工制作的滑翔翼。自行车没有停下，而是从悬崖边腾空而起，引擎轰鸣，蓝色火焰从排气管喷出，飞越下方的村庄。镜头运动：动态追逐镜头。摄像机快速向前推进，在老年车手之间穿梭。当他们冲上悬崖边缘时，镜头无缝过渡到令人眩晕的自由落体视角，向下倾斜展现出巨大的落差，然后恢复水平，跟随自行车在空中滑翔。环境：阳光明媚的乡村景观，充满鲜活的绿色和蓝色。宁静的山谷底部现在在一英里之下，村庄看起来像微缩模型。细节：边缘强烈的运动模糊和自行车的剧烈震动。火箭推进器散发的热浪 shimmer，阳光照射金属滑翔翼产生的镜头光晕，以及老年车手们透过护目镜露出的震惊表情——他们突破风声时突然爆发出音爆般的声响。

en.p: Create a high-quality 4K cinematic football (soccer) storyboard showing a full sequence from tackle to goal, using dynamic lighting, dramatic stadium atmosphere, and professional sports broadcast style. The scene begins with an intense midfield moment where a defender performs a strong sliding tackle, grass and dirt particles flying in slow motion as the ball is cleanly won. Transition immediately into a fast counterattack: the player recovers, pushes the ball forward, and accelerates past opponents with quick footwork. Show close-ups of boots striking the ball, sweat, and focused expressions, mixed with wide shots of the field opening up. Add a key pass moment where the ball is threaded through defenders, followed by a sprint toward goal with the crowd rising in anticipation. Build tension with a slow-motion approach to the penalty box, then a powerful shot on goal—either a clean strike or a curled finish. Show the ball hitting the net with dramatic impact, net rippling, and goalkeeper reaction. End with an emotional celebration: the scorer running, sliding, or raising arms as teammates join, stadium lights glowing and crowd erupting. Use varied camera angles (wide, tracking, close-up, POV, slow motion), strong motion blur, and realistic physics (ball spin, turf impact), emphasizing the shift from defensive intensity to attacking triumph and victory.
en.t: From Tackle to Triumph: Soccer Storyboard

zh.p: 制作一段高质量的4K电影级足球故事板，完整呈现从抢断到进球的连贯场景，运用动态光影、戏剧化的球场氛围和专业体育转播风格。开场聚焦中场激烈对抗：防守球员完成一记凶狠的滑铲，草屑与泥土在慢镜头中飞溅，皮球被干净利落地夺下。随即转入快速反击：得球球员迅速起身，向前推进，以灵巧的盘带连续突破对手。特写镜头捕捉球鞋击球瞬间、汗珠与专注神情，穿插展现球场开阔视野的全景画面。加入关键传球时刻——皮球精准穿越防线，随后球员向球门冲刺，观众席的期待感逐渐升温。通过慢镜头逼近禁区营造紧张感，继而呈现一记势大力沉的射门——无论是干净利落的抽射还是弧线球破门。皮球以极具冲击力的方式击中球网，网兜震颤，门将反应被定格。最终以情感迸发的庆祝收尾：进球者奔跑、滑跪或振臂高呼，队友蜂拥而至，球场灯光璀璨，观众席爆发出震耳欲聋的欢呼。采用多角度运镜（全景、跟拍、特写、第一人称视角、慢动作），强化动态模糊与真实物理效果（足球旋转、草皮受力），突出从防守强度到进攻胜利的戏剧性转变。

en.p:
0–3s: Dark frozen sky, violent snowstorm, camera rushing downward, atmosphere inspired by Game of Thrones. A woman falls from the sky while tightly holding her dog — a black dog with a white chest and white paws, sharp ears, powerful intense stare. She screams loudly, “Aaaaah!” as they fall through the storm. She wears black leather northern warrior clothing: fitted leather corset, belts, long gloves, high boots, heavy fur cloak on her shoulders.  
3–6s: They crash into a snowy valley. The woman rises to one knee and grabs a glowing ancient blue amulet. She looks at her dog and says: “Let’s do this.” The black dog with white markings growls and stares forward. In the distance, icy walkers appear through the blizzard.  
6–9s: The amulet explodes with bright blue light. Ice spreads across the woman’s hands and face. Her leather clothing transforms into majestic black steel and ice armor with sharp detailed patterns.  
9–12s: The woman fully transforms into the Ice Queen of the walkers — pale blue skin, glowing blue eyes, frozen crown, powerful dark armor. The dog begins transforming into a giant ice dragon, keeping its black fur and white chest markings.  
12–15s: A massive black ice dragon with white markings and glowing blue eyes spreads its wings. The Ice Queen climbs onto its back and they rise into the storm, while the army of walkers kneels before them.
en.t: Ice Queen Rises with Dragon Dog

zh.p: 0-3秒：暗黑冰封的天空，猛烈的暴风雪，镜头急速下坠，氛围灵感源自《权力的游戏》。一名女子从高空坠落，怀中紧抱着一只狗——黑色身躯、白色胸脯和白色爪子、尖耳朵、目光锐利而充满力量。她大声尖叫着“啊——！”在风暴中坠落。她身穿黑色皮革北方战士装束：紧身皮胸衣、腰带、长手套、高筒靴，肩上披着厚重的毛皮斗篷。3-6秒：她们坠入雪谷。女子单膝跪地，抓起一枚发光的古老蓝色护身符。她看着狗说：“来吧。”那只带有白色斑纹的黑狗低吼着，目光直视前方。远处，冰霜行者穿过暴风雪显现。6-9秒：护身符爆发出耀眼的蓝光。冰霜蔓延到女子的手和脸上。她的皮革装束转变为宏伟的黑色钢铁与寒冰铠甲，带有锐利的精致纹路。9-12秒：女子完全蜕变为冰霜女王——淡蓝色皮肤、发光的蓝眼睛、冰冠、强大的暗色铠甲。那只狗开始变形为巨大的冰龙，保留着黑色毛发和白色胸斑。12-15秒：一只巨大的黑色冰龙，带有白色斑纹和发光的蓝眼睛，展开双翼。冰霜女王爬上它的背，她们升入风暴中，而冰霜行者大军在她们面前跪拜。

en.p:
Scene 1 (0–4s):
Warm evening atmosphere at a cozy street restaurant. The girl sits with her friends, laughing softly while finishing dinner. Ambient lights glow, plates and drinks on the table. CameYra slowly pans, capturing genuine expressions and lively surroundings.

Scene 2 (4–8s):
Outside the restaurant, she says goodbye to her friends. Subtle smiles, casual hugs. The street is calm with dim yellow lights. She turns and begins walking alone, camera follows from a slight side angle.

Scene 3 (8–12s):
She enters a narrow alley on her way home. Lighting becomes cooler and slightly dim. Her footsteps echo softly. She slows down, her expression shifts subtle tension. She glances back briefly, sensing something off.

Scene 4 (12–16s):
The atmosphere grows tense but controlled. The camera moves closer to her face, capturing alert eyes and cautious breathing. A faint shadow or movement appears in the background, but nothing fully revealed. She continues walking, slightly faster, maintaining suspense without showing danger.

zh.p:
场景1（0-4秒）：温馨的傍晚氛围，一家舒适的街边餐厅。女孩与朋友们坐在一起，轻声笑着享用晚餐。环境灯光柔和，桌上摆着餐盘和饮品。镜头缓慢平移，捕捉真实的表情和热闹的环境。

场景2（4-8秒）：餐厅外，她与朋友们告别。淡淡的微笑，随意的拥抱。街道安静，昏黄的灯光。她转身独自离开，镜头从侧面跟随。

场景3（8-12秒）：她走进回家必经的窄巷。光线变冷，略显昏暗。脚步声轻轻回荡。她放慢脚步，表情中透出微妙的紧张。她短暂回头一瞥，感觉有些不对劲。

场景4（12-16秒）：气氛变得紧张但克制。镜头拉近她的脸庞，捕捉警觉的眼神和谨慎的呼吸。背景中隐约出现一个影子或动静，但未完全显露。她继续前行，步伐稍快，悬念持续，危险并未直接呈现。

en.p:
Visual Style: Vibrant 3D animation, exaggerated squash-and-stretch physics, and cinematic lighting.
Time
Scene Description
Camera Movement
0-3s
A tiny, sophisticated Hamster in a high-tech harness lowers from a ceiling vent toward a giant chocolate chip cookie on a kitchen island.
Crane Shot: Smoothly descends from the ceiling, following the hamster’s POV as the "target" gets closer.
3-6s
Just as his paws touch the cookie, a shadow looms. A sleepy Ginger Cat enters the frame, yawning wide right next to him.
Low-Angle Pan: Rapidly circles 180° around the hamster to reveal the massive cat towering in the background.
6-9s
The hamster panics, grabs the cookie (which is twice his size), and sprints. He uses a silver spoon as a catapult to launch into the air.
Tracking Shot: A fast side-scrolling "profile" shot, keeping pace with the hamster's frantic running.
9-12s
Mid-air, the hamster opens a tiny paraglider made of a cocktail napkin. He soars over the cat’s head while the cat swipes blindly.
Dynamic Follow: The camera "glides" behind the hamster’s shoulder, dipping and diving through the air.
12-15s
The hamster sticks a superhero landing back inside the dark vent. He takes a huge, satisfying bite as the vent cover slams shut.
Push-In to Zoom: A rapid zoom into the hamster’s face for the "crunch," followed by a quick "iris-out" black screen.

zh.p:
视觉风格：鲜艳的3D动画、夸张的挤压拉伸物理效果，以及电影级布光。

时间 | 场景描述 | 镜头运动
0-3秒 | 一只穿着高科技背带的小巧仓鼠，从天花板通风口降下，目标直指厨房岛台上的一块巨型巧克力曲奇。 | 吊臂俯拍：从天花板平稳下降，跟随仓鼠的第一视角，让“目标”越来越近。
3-6秒 | 就在它的爪子碰到曲奇时，一道阴影笼罩下来。一只睡眼惺忪的姜黄色猫咪进入画面，在它身旁打了个大大的哈欠。 | 低角度环绕：迅速绕仓鼠180°旋转，揭示背景中那只巨大的猫。
6-9秒 | 仓鼠惊慌失措，抓起那块比自己大两倍的曲奇，拔腿狂奔。它用一把银勺当弹弓，腾空跃起。 | 跟拍：快速侧向“横版”镜头，紧追仓鼠慌乱的奔跑节奏。
9-12秒 | 半空中，仓鼠展开一面用鸡尾酒餐巾做成的小滑翔伞。它从猫头顶掠过，而猫则盲目地挥爪扑击。 | 动态跟随：镜头在仓鼠肩后“滑翔”，在空中起伏穿梭。
12-15秒 | 仓鼠以一个超级英雄式的落地姿势，稳稳落回黑暗的通风口内。它咬下一大口曲奇，心满意足，与此同时通风口盖砰然关闭。 | 推近变焦：快速推近到仓鼠脸部特写，捕捉“咔嚓”咬下的瞬间，随后画面迅速“圈出”至黑屏。

en.p:
[Cinematography]: Dynamic tracking shot moving alongside the vehicle at a low angle, transitioning into a shaky, handheld camera movement to emphasize impact and scale during the transformation. Shot on IMAX digital cameras with anamorphic lenses, high shutter speed to capture mechanical intricacies, water droplets on the lens, shallow depth of field focusing on the shifting metal.

[Subject]: Initially a weathered, emerald-green vintage school bus with rusted wheel wells. It morphs into a colossal, industrial T-Rex mecha composed of twisted chassis metal, bus tires functioning as limb joints, and the front grille splitting to form a jagged, metallic maw.

[Action]: The bus speeds down the wet asphalt, splashing puddles. Suddenly, hydraulic pistons engage; the roof splits, the wheels rotate inward to become legs, and the body reconfigures vertically. The newly formed mecha stomps the ground, cracking the pavement, and unleashes a torrent of fire from its mouth while its headlights-turned-eyes flare bright red.

[Context]: A winding, rain-slicked road cutting through a dense, foggy coniferous forest. Tall pine trees line the path, shrouded in mist. The atmosphere is stormy, with heavy rain pouring down, reflecting the transformation in the wet road surface.

[Style & Ambiance]: High-octane sci-fi action aesthetic, reminiscent of Michael Bay films. Gritty, realistic CGI textures with metallic sheen and rust details. Lighting is dramatic and moody, dominated by cool blue tones of the rainy twilight, contrasted sharply by the warm orange glow of the mecha's fire breath and glowing eyes.
en.t: School Bus Transforms Into T-Rex Mecha

zh.p: [摄影]: 动态跟拍镜头以低角度沿车辆移动，在变形过程中切换为手持摄影的晃动效果，以强调冲击力与规模感。采用IMAX数字摄影机搭配变形镜头拍摄，高快门速度捕捉机械细节，镜头沾附水珠，浅景深聚焦于金属变形过程。[主体]: 初始为一辆锈迹斑斑的翡翠绿复古校车，轮拱处布满铁锈。随后变形为巨型工业风霸王龙机甲，由扭曲的车架金属构成，巴士轮胎充当关节，前格栅分裂形成锯齿状金属巨颚。[动作]: 巴士在湿漉漉的柏油路上疾驰，溅起水花。突然液压活塞启动，车顶裂开，车轮向内旋转变为腿部，车身垂直重组。新生的机甲重踏地面，震裂路面，口中喷出烈焰，车灯转化的双眼迸发血红光芒。[场景]: 蜿蜒湿滑的道路贯穿浓雾弥漫的针叶林，高耸松树沿路排列，笼罩在雾气中。暴风雨天气下暴雨倾盆，湿漉漉的路面倒映着变形过程。[风格与氛围]: 高能科幻动作美学，致敬迈克尔·贝电影风格。粗粝写实的CGI质感呈现金属光泽与锈蚀细节。戏剧性暗调灯光以雨夜冷蓝色调为主，与机甲火焰吐息及发光双眼的暖橙色形成强烈对比。

raw_p:
[Cinematography]: Dynamic tracking shot moving alongside the vehicle at a low angle, transitioning into a shaky, handheld camera movement to emphasize impact and scale during the transformation. Shot on IMAX digital cameras with anamorphic lenses, high shutter speed to capture mechanical intricacies, water droplets on the lens, shallow depth of field focusing on the shifting metal.

[Subject]: Initially a weathered, emerald-green vintage school bus with rusted wheel wells. It morphs into a colossal, industrial T-Rex mecha composed of twisted chassis metal, bus tires functioning as limb joints, and the front grille splitting to form a jagged, metallic maw.

[Action]: The bus speeds down the wet asphalt, splashing puddles. Suddenly, hydraulic pistons engage; the roof splits, the wheels rotate inward to become legs, and the body reconfigures vertically. The newly formed mecha stomps the ground, cracking the pavement, and unleashes a torrent of fire from its mouth while its headlights-turned-eyes flare bright red.

[Context]: A winding, rain-slicked road cutting through a dense, foggy coniferous forest. Tall pine trees line the path, shrouded in mist. The atmosphere is stormy, with heavy rain pouring down, reflecting the transformation in the wet road surface.

[Style & Ambiance]: High-octane sci-fi action aesthetic, reminiscent of Michael Bay films. Gritty, realistic CGI textures with metallic sheen and rust details. Lighting is dramatic and moody, dominated by cool blue tones of the rainy twilight, contrasted sharply by the warm orange glow of the mecha's fire breath and glowing eyes.

en.p:
Cinematic super-speed cooking commercial, Flash-style kitchen action comedy aesthetic, high-energy dynamic mood with playful twist. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF with 24mm wide and 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, cinematic film grain, high contrast color grading. Color palette: warm kitchen amber and brass, electric yellow and blue speed trails, vibrant vegetable greens and reds, golden fire flames, creamy whites. Lighting: warm overhead pendant kitchen lights, flashes of fire and electric speed energy, atmospheric steam and flour dust catching the light. Hyper-dynamic camera with rapid whip-pans, speed ramps, orbital moves, bullet time freezes.
Hero: Western young woman with straight blonde hair, fair skin, expressive face, natural makeup, confident yet playful energy. Casual modern outfit (light neutral tones), slightly tousled straight blonde hair catching the light.
MOOD: Energetic, fun, heroic, delicious. The feeling of a Flash superhero using her powers for the most important mission — dinner.
TIMELINE:
0:00–0:02 — Opening shot
Hero stands in the middle of a beautiful modern kitchen in profile, hands in pockets, looking at a completely empty wooden dining table in front of her. Her stomach audibly rumbles. She looks tired and hungry. Camera slowly pushes in from the side. Warm amber kitchen light, quiet peaceful atmosphere.
0:02–0:03 — The decision
She slowly closes her eyes with a subtle confident smirk spreading across her face. Electric yellow energy begins to crackle softly around her body. A few strands of her straight blonde hair lift slightly from the energy. Camera freezes on her smirk for a beat. Bass drop moment.
0:03–0:05 — The explosion of speed
She bursts into super-speed motion in slow motion 120fps, leaving electric yellow and blue speed trails behind her. Camera rapidly tracks as she zips to the refrigerator, flings it open, multiple vegetables and ingredients fly out into the air in slow motion — tomatoes, herbs, onions, peppers, all suspended mid-flight.
0:05–0:07 — Super-speed chaos montage
Rapid quick-cut sequence of hyper-dynamic kitchen action, each cut 0.3 seconds: she zips past the counter with speed trails, a knife spins in the air chopping vegetables by itself, a pan on the stove bursts into flames, a pot of boiling water steams dramatically, flour clouds explode in the air, a mixer runs without being touched, spices sprinkle themselves over ingredients. Electric speed trails crisscross the kitchen in all directions. Camera rapidly whip-pans between every action.
0:07–0:09 — The plating
Extreme macro close-ups in rapid succession — sauce pouring in a perfect swirl, vegetables placing themselves on a plate in elegant arrangement, garnish floating down gently, a perfect steak searing in a pan with orange flames, pasta twirling through the air, parmesan grating itself in slow motion. Every shot is hyper-detailed, restaurant-quality food styling. Warm

zh.p: 电影级超高速烹饪广告，闪电侠风格的厨房动作喜剧美学，充满活力且带俏皮转折的动态氛围。使用ARRI Alexa Mini LF摄影机搭配24mm广角和50mm镜头拍摄，浅景深，电影感颗粒，高对比度调色。色彩基调：暖色调的厨房琥珀色与黄铜色，电光黄与蓝的速度拖尾，鲜亮的蔬菜绿与红，金色火焰，奶油白。灯光：头顶暖色吊灯，火焰与电光能量的闪烁，蒸汽与面粉粉尘在光线中飞舞。超动态镜头配合快速甩镜、变速拍摄、环绕运镜、子弹时间定格。主角：西方年轻女性，金色直发，白皙肌肤，表情丰富，淡妆，自信中带俏皮。休闲现代装束（浅中性色调），微乱的金色直发在光线中闪耀。氛围：充满能量、趣味、英雄气概、美味。如同闪电侠用超能力执行最重要任务——做晚餐。时间线：0:00–0:02——开场镜头，主角侧身立于现代美厨中央，双手插兜，凝视面前空无一物的木餐桌。肚子咕咕作响，神情疲惫饥饿。镜头从侧面缓缓推进。暖琥珀色厨房灯光，宁静平和氛围。0:02–0:03——决定时刻，她缓缓闭眼，嘴角浮现一丝自信俏皮的笑意。淡黄色电光开始在她周身轻柔噼啪作响。几缕金发因能量微微扬起。镜头定格在她的笑意上。重低音切入。0:03–0:05——速度爆发，她以120fps慢动作进入超高速运动，留下电光黄与蓝的速度拖尾。镜头快速跟拍她闪至冰箱，猛地拉开，多种蔬菜食材慢动作飞出——番茄、香草、洋葱、辣椒，全部悬浮半空。0:05–0:07——超高速混乱蒙太奇，快速剪辑序列，每段0.3秒：她带着速度拖尾掠过台面，刀具在空中自行旋转切菜，炉上平底锅窜起火焰，沸水锅蒸汽升腾，面粉云团炸开，搅拌机无人自转，香料自行洒落食材。电光拖尾在厨房中纵横交错。镜头在每个动作间快速甩动。0:07–0:09——摆盘，极速微距特写连拍——酱汁完美旋涡状倾注，蔬菜自行优雅排列于盘中，装饰物缓缓飘落，完美牛排于平底锅中滋滋作响泛起橘焰，意面在空中旋转，帕玛森芝士慢动作自行刨丝。每帧画面极致细腻，餐厅级美食造型。温暖

en.p:
STORY FORMAT: 15s / 150 BPM / MULTI-CUT with one continuous acrobatic segment / American dark comedy with absurd ninja satire / playful mischief with a twisted punchline
TONE: sneaky curiosity → rising temptation → covert action → sudden exposure → ridiculous charm reversal
SETTING: Nighttime traditional Japanese house, wooden structure, tiled roof, soft moonlight, Mount Fuji silhouette in the background, pine trees swaying, cool blue tones with warm kitchen light contrast
CHARACTERS:
Orange cat ninja: dressed in full black ninja outfit, only eyes and mouth visible, agile, sneaky, slightly goofy greed-driven personality
White cat cook: wearing a pink kimono, gentle but easily startled, expressive reactions
Black bear father: wearing a red belly cloth, sitting at a wooden table in the courtyard, stern and impatient, loud presence
CAMERA STYLE: cinematic push-ins, stealth POV shots, smooth tracking, sudden comedic snap zooms, light handheld shake during action, exaggerated smoke effects
SCENE
0–2s
Wide shot: Rooftop silhouette
The orange cat ninja crouches on the edge of a tiled roof, moonlight outlining his figure
Mount Fuji and pine trees in the background
He slowly leans forward, peeking into a lit kitchen window
2–4s
POV shot into kitchen
The white cat stands by the stove, stir-frying with a spatula
Thick white smoke rises heavily
The smoke drifts upward… reaching the ninja
Close-up: ninja sniffing
He pauses… then grins
A little drool forms
Orange cat (whispering):
“Oh yeah… that smells illegal.”
4–6s
Cut to courtyard
The black bear sits at a wooden table, tapping impatiently
Black bear (yelling):
“Kid! Is dinner ready or what?!”
6–7s
Cut back to kitchen
White cat panics
She hurriedly scoops food from the pan onto a cracked plate
White cat (nervous):
“It’s ready! Coming!”
Some food still remains in the pan
7–9s
She carefully carries the plate outside
Places it in front of the black bear
He nods with smug satisfaction
Black bear:
“About time.”
9–10s
Cut to rooftop
Orange cat narrows eyes
Orange cat (whispering):
“Perfect timing.”
10–13s CONTINUOUS ACTION SHOT
The ninja launches
— flips off the roof in one smooth motion
— lands silently near the kitchen entrance
— quickly looks left and right
No one
He slips inside
Runs to the stove
Starts grabbing food with his bare hands
Orange cat (excited whisper):
“Five-finger buffet, let’s go.”
He lifts food toward his mouth
13–14s
Suddenly
White cat appears in the doorway
White cat (shocked):
“Who are you?!”
Freeze beat
14–15s FINAL PAYOFF
The ninja instantly throws a smoke bomb to the ground
Orange cat (shouting):
“SMOKE EXIT, BABY!”
Black smoke bursts everywhere
When it clears
The ninja is gone
In his place—
A small, cute white fox
The white cat gasps, hands clasped
White cat (soft, melted):
“Oh my gosh… you’re adorable…”
Final shot
The white fox looks directly at camera
Winks one eye
A sly, mischievous grin forms

zh.p:
故事格式：15秒 / 150拍每分钟 / 多段剪辑配合一段连续杂技动作 / 美国黑色喜剧风格，融入荒诞忍者讽刺元素 / 顽皮恶作剧，结尾反转荒诞有趣
基调：鬼鬼祟祟的好奇 → 逐渐升起的诱惑 → 暗中行动 → 突然暴露 → 滑稽可爱的反转
场景：夜晚的传统日式房屋，木质结构，瓦片屋顶，柔和的月光，背景中富士山的剪影，松树摇曳，冷蓝色调与厨房暖光形成对比
角色：
橙色猫忍者：身穿全黑忍者装，只露出眼睛和嘴巴，动作敏捷、鬼祟，性格略带滑稽、被贪婪驱使
白色猫厨师：穿着粉色和服，性格温柔但容易受惊，反应夸张
黑熊父亲：穿着红色兜裆布，坐在庭院木桌旁，表情严肃不耐烦，气场强大
镜头风格：电影式推进镜头、潜行视角、流畅跟拍、突然的喜剧式快速变焦、动作时轻微手持抖动、夸张的烟雾效果
场景0–2秒：广角镜头：屋顶剪影
橙色猫忍者蹲在瓦片屋顶边缘，月光勾勒出他的轮廓
背景中富士山和松树
他慢慢前倾，偷看亮着灯的厨房窗户
2–4秒：潜行视角看向厨房
白色猫站在炉灶旁，用锅铲翻炒
浓重的白烟升起
烟雾向上飘散……飘到忍者面前
特写：忍者嗅了嗅
他停顿了一下……然后咧嘴一笑
嘴角流出一丝口水
橙色猫（低声说）：“哦，没错……这味道简直犯规。”
4–6秒：切换到庭院
黑熊坐在木桌旁，不耐烦地敲着桌子
黑熊（大喊）：“小子！晚饭好了没？！”
6–7秒：切回厨房
白色猫惊慌失措
她匆忙从锅里舀出食物放到一个裂了缝的盘子里
白色猫（紧张地）：“好了！来了！”
锅里还剩一些食物
7–9秒：她小心地端着盘子走到外面
把盘子放在黑熊面前
他满意地点点头
黑熊：“总算好了。”
9–10秒：切换到屋顶
橙色猫眯起眼睛
橙色猫（低声说）：“时机正好。”
10–13秒：连续动作镜头
忍者一跃而起——一个流畅的动作翻下屋顶——悄无声息地落在厨房入口附近——迅速左右张望
没人
他溜了进去
跑到炉灶旁
开始用手抓食物
橙色猫（兴奋地低语）：“五指自助餐，走起。”
他把食物送到嘴边
13–14秒：突然
白色猫出现在门口
白色猫（震惊地）：“你是谁？！”
定格
14–15秒：最终反转
忍者立刻向地面扔出一颗烟雾弹
橙色猫（大喊）：“烟雾退场，宝贝！”
黑烟四处弥漫
烟雾散去时
忍者不见了
取而代之的是——
一只小巧可爱的白狐
白色猫倒吸一口气，双手合十
白色猫（温柔地，心被融化）：“天哪……你太可爱了……”
最后一幕
白狐直视镜头
眨了一只眼
露出一丝狡黠、顽皮的笑容

A young parkour runner, athletic build, sweat dripping, jaw clenched, eyes scanning every path ahead

zh.p: 一名年轻跑酷者，体格健硕，汗珠滴落，下颌紧绷，目光扫视前方每条路径。他在屋顶上全速冲刺，飞跃看似不可能的间隙，滑行穿过障碍物，身后紧追不舍。密集的城市天际线中，狭窄的屋顶、天线林立，下方是深不见底的落差。第一人称视角镜头紧贴其后，快速倾斜与景深变化，跳跃时强烈的动态模糊，动态视差强化了高度与危险感。

en.p: Strictly maintain the original Chinese ink-wash style, character image, scene, and composition. The drizzle continues to fall, with ripples spreading across the water surface; the black-canopied boat slowly passes under the bridge, its oar stirring the water. The weeping willow branches gently sway in the wind; the scholar slightly raises his head, gazing at the distant green mountains. The camera has a subtle breathing effect, slowly panning left a little. The motion is natural and smooth, with no flickering or frame skipping, and the ink-wash texture remains consistent. 10 seconds, 1080p, 60fps.

zh.p: 严格保持原图的国风水墨风格、人物形象、场景和构图不变。 细雨持续飘落，水面涟漪不断扩散；乌篷船缓慢划过桥下，船桨拨动水面。 垂柳枝条随风轻轻摆动；书生微微抬头，望向远处的青山。 镜头有轻微的呼吸感，缓慢向左平移一点。 运动自然流畅，无闪烁，无跳帧，水墨质感保持一致。 10秒，1080p，60fps。

A clean instructional poster in a 4x4 grid (16 panels) showing a male martial artist demonstrating Pencak Silat choreography. The subject is a fit man with medium-length dark hair and a beard, wearing a red button-up shirt, beige pants, and white sneakers. Style is semi-realistic illustration mixed with hand-drawn sketch lines, soft shadows, and a light textured paper background. Each panel includes subtle motion arrows and small captions. Minimalist, balanced layout. शीर्ष title at top: 'Pencak Silat Choreography – 16 Counts – 10 Seconds – Smooth Flowy Chill'.

Panel 1: wide ready stance, knees bent, one hand guarding forward, focused expression.
Panel 2: step forward with outward block, arm extended defensively.
Panel 3: inside block sweeping upward diagonally, torso rotating.
Panel 4: strong straight punch forward, aligned hips.
Panel 5: side step into low stance, both hands pushing outward.
Panel 6: knee lifted high in chamber position, balanced posture.
Panel 7: front kick extended forward, opposite arm guarding.
Panel 8: step backward into defensive cover, arms crossing.
Panel 9: low block, sweeping arm downward in deep stance.
Panel 10: hook punch across body with hip rotation.
Panel 11: turning body with pivoting feet, circular motion.
Panel 12: forward palm strike, stable stance.
Panel 13: low sweeping motion near ground in squat stance.
Panel 14: rising smoothly from low stance, upward motion.
Panel 15: controlled locking pose, one arm raised defensively.
Panel 16: closing salute, feet together, hands pressed at chest, calm posture.

Include hand-drawn arrows (blue and purple accents), clean infographic layout, evenly spaced panels, consistent character design across all frames.

A focused male martial artist performs a smooth, flowing Pencak Silat sequence in a minimalist studio. He is in his late 20s, athletic build, medium height, warm tan skin, with thick wavy dark hair and a short, well-groomed beard. He wears a fitted deep red button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, beige slim-fit pants with slight wear at the knees, and clean white sneakers. His expression is calm, controlled, and intent. The setting is a softly lit neutral studio with an off-white textured backdrop and a slightly worn wooden floor. Lighting is diffused and cinematic, creating gentle shadows and emphasizing fluid motion. The choreography is continuous and rhythmic, with no abrupt cuts: 0–2s: يبدأ in a grounded ready stance, knees bent, one palm forward in guard, eyes locked ahead 2–4s: steps forward into an outward block, transitioning into an inside sweeping block upward 4–6s: rotates hips into a straight punch, then shifts weight into a side step with a pushing motion 6–8s: lifts knee smoothly and extends into a controlled front kick, maintaining balance 8–10s: steps back into a guarded cover, drops into a low block, then rises into a hook punch 10–12s: pivots the body with a clean turn, transitioning into a forward palm strike 12–14s: lowers into a sweeping motion, then rises fluidly into a locking control pose 14–15s: finishes upright with a respectful closing salute, hands together at chest level Movement style is soft, flowing, controlled, with precise martial intention rather than aggression. Emphasis on balance, breath, and continuity. Camera is a steady medium-wide shot with subtle slow tracking, no cuts.

zh.p: 一张4x4网格（16格）的干净教学海报，展示一位男性武术家演示班卡西拉武术编排。人物为中等身材、留中长发和胡须的健壮男性，穿着红色纽扣衬衫、米色长裤和白色运动鞋。风格为半写实插画混合手绘素描线条，柔和阴影，浅色纹理纸背景。每格包含细微动作箭头和小标题。极简平衡布局。顶部标题：'班卡西拉武术编排 – 16拍 – 10秒 – 流畅舒缓'。第一格：宽距预备姿势，屈膝，一手前护，专注表情。第二格：向前迈步同时向外格挡，手臂防御性伸展。第三格：向内格挡斜向上扫，躯干旋转。第四格：有力直拳向前，臀部对齐。第五格：侧步进入低姿，双手向外推。第六格：膝盖高抬至蓄力位置，平衡姿态。第七格：前踢向前伸展，对侧手臂护守。第八格：后退进入防御掩护，双臂交叉。第九格：低格挡，手臂向下扫，深蹲姿势。第十格：勾拳横跨身体，伴随臀部旋转。第十一格：转身同时脚部旋转，圆形动作。第十二格：向前掌击，稳定站姿。第十三格：蹲姿中贴近地面的低扫动作。第十四格：从低姿平稳上升，向上运动。第十五格：受控锁定姿势，一臂防御性抬起。第十六格：结束敬礼，双脚并拢，双手合十于胸前，平静姿态。包含手绘箭头（蓝色和紫色点缀），干净的信息图布局，均匀间隔的网格，所有画面中角色设计一致。一位专注的男性武术家在极简工作室中表演流畅的班卡西拉套路。他约二十七八岁，运动体型，中等身高，暖色棕肤，浓密波浪黑发，短而整洁的胡须。穿着合身的深红色纽扣衬衫，袖子卷至前臂，米色修身长裤膝盖处略有磨损，白色干净运动鞋。表情平静、克制而专注。场景为柔和照明的中性工作室，米白色纹理背景和略微磨损的木地板。光线漫射且具电影感，形成柔和阴影，强调流畅动作。编排连续且有节奏，无突兀中断：0-2秒：以接地预备姿势开始，屈膝，一手前护，目光锁定前方。2-4秒：向前迈步进入向外格挡，过渡到向内斜向上扫。4-6秒：旋转臀部进入直拳，然后重心转移至侧步并伴随推手动作。6-8秒：平稳抬膝并伸展为受控前踢，保持平衡。8-10秒：后退进入防守掩护，下蹲至低格挡，然后起身进入勾拳。10-12秒：身体旋转完成干净转身，过渡到向前掌击。12-14秒：下蹲至扫腿动作，然后流畅起身进入锁定控制姿势。14-15秒：直立结束，以恭敬的结束敬礼收尾，双手合十于胸前。动作风格柔和、流畅、受控，带有精准的武术意图而非攻击性。强调平衡、呼吸和连续性。镜头为稳定的中全景，伴随细微缓慢的跟踪，无切换。

A cinematic commercial for a refreshing soft drink. A young adult walks through a hot, sunlit city street at midday, visibly tired and sweating. The environment is vibrant but hazy with heat. Close-up shots show sunlight reflecting off glass buildings, slow-motion dust particles in the air, and people fanning themselves.

The character stops at a small street kiosk and grabs a chilled bottle of sparkling soft drink from an ice-filled cooler. The bottle is covered in condensation, with droplets slowly dripping down. Extreme close-up of the cap twisting open with a crisp fizz sound, bubbles rising in slow motion.

As the character takes a sip, the scene transforms instantly: colors become more saturated, lighting softens, and a cool breeze flows through the street. The environment shifts into a refreshing, lively atmosphere with subtle motion in trees and people appearing energized.

Cut to macro shots of carbonation bubbles, liquid splashing, and ice cubes tumbling in crystal-clear detail.

Final shot: the character smiles, refreshed, holding the drink against a bright, clean background.

Text overlay: "Refresh Your Moment."

Style: ultra-realistic, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, high detail, 4K, smooth slow motion, vibrant color grading, professional commercial style.
en.t: Refresh Your Moment Soft Drink Ad

zh.p: 一部清爽软饮的影院级广告。正午时分，一名年轻人穿过炎热明亮的城市街道，明显可见疲惫与汗水。环境充满活力却因热浪而朦胧。特写镜头捕捉到玻璃建筑反射的阳光、空气中缓慢飘浮的尘埃颗粒，以及人们扇风纳凉的动作。主角在一处街边小摊停下，从装满冰块的冷藏箱中取出一瓶冰镇气泡软饮。瓶身凝结着水珠，缓缓滑落。极致特写：瓶盖旋开时发出清脆的嘶嘶声，气泡在慢镜头中升腾。当主角啜饮一口时，画面瞬间转变：色彩饱和度提升，光线变得柔和，清凉微风拂过街道。环境转为清爽生动的氛围，树木轻摇，行人重现活力。镜头切换至微距画面：碳酸气泡、飞溅的液体、翻滚的冰块，细节晶莹剔透。最终镜头：主角手持饮料，在明亮纯净的背景中展露清爽笑容。字幕浮现：‘Refresh Your Moment.’ 风格：超写实、电影级布光、浅景深、高细节、4K画质、流畅慢动作、鲜艳调色、专业广告质感。

en.p: Rapid cuts and transitions. A 3D CGI animation with a real-time game engine aesthetic, dynamic lighting, and post-processing bloom effects. Smooth 60fps visual experience. The protagonist is a beautiful female warrior. The animation unfolds to the rhythm of the music as follows: A agile warrior in flowing attire dashes forward at blurring speed, drawing a blade mid-run with a crisp metallic sound. The camera zooms in on the cold gleam of the blade as it slices toward an incoming mechanical enemy. The warrior precisely sidesteps, a heavy projectile whizzing past, time briefly slowing before accelerating into a spinning whirlwind, unleashing a series of rapid slashes that leave glowing trails in the dim ruins. Gracefully leaping high, the warrior fires a barrage of energy bolts from dual weapons, the projectiles streaking like comets into the clustered foes below, each impact explosion violently shaking the frame. A close-up of the warrior's determined eyes locks onto a charging opponent, followed by a fluid roll to evade, seamlessly transitioning into a counter-thrust as the blade pierces armor, sparking with fragments. The scene cuts to a wide angle, showing the warrior weaving through a dense laser barrage, body contorting with acrobatic flips, each motion blurring into the next, gradually closing in for a devastating overhead strike. In a burst of acceleration, the warrior summons phantom projectiles orbiting around her, then charges forward like a comet, shockwaves expanding outward, shattering barriers and enemies. Rapid successive cuts: The warrior parries claw attacks with crossed blades, sparks flying, then retaliates with hyper-speed thrusts, precisely piercing vital points, the enemy's body collapsing in slow motion amidst chaos. The warrior grabs a larger mechanical beast, quickly climbing while dodging swipes, reaching the top to deliver a diving attack, cracks spreading like a spiderweb across its surface, culminating in a massive explosion. Amid collapsing buildings, the warrior executes wall-running evasions, transitioning into a mid-air backflip, finishing with a ground shockwave that repels surrounding foes in a ring of dust and energy. Final burst: The warrior channels inner power, body glowing, unleashing a torrent of slashes and shots in all directions, the camera spinning around her, capturing the dizzying speed and overwhelming offensive force. Within 15 seconds, the pacing is balanced, with editing rhythm designed to make scene transitions and emotional flow easy to follow.

zh.p: 快速剪辑切换。3D CGI动画，具有实时游戏引擎质感，动态光照与后期泛光处理。流畅的60fps观感。主角是一位美丽的女战士。随着音乐节奏按以下流程展开动画。一位身着飘逸服饰的矫健战士以模糊的速度向前冲刺，奔跑中拔出利刃，伴随清脆的金属声响，镜头拉近聚焦在刀刃的寒光上，劈向迎面而来的机械敌人。战士精准地侧步闪避，一枚重型弹体擦身而过，时间仿佛短暂放慢，随即加速旋转成一道旋风，释放出一连串快速斩击，在昏暗的废墟中留下发光的轨迹。优雅地跃向高空，战士用双手武器发射一连串能量弹，弹幕如彗星般射向下方聚集的敌群，每次撞击爆炸都让画面剧烈震动。特写战士坚定的双眼锁定一个冲来的对手，随后流畅地翻滚闪避，无缝衔接为反刺一击，刀刃穿透铠甲，迸发出火花与碎片。画面切换至广角，展示战士在密集的激光弹幕中穿梭，身体以杂技般的翻转扭动，每个动作模糊地衔接下一个，逐步逼近后发出毁灭性的劈头一击。在一阵爆发性加速中，战士召唤出环绕身周的虚幻弹体，随即以彗星般的冲锋向前突进，冲击波向外扩散，粉碎屏障与敌人。快速连续剪切：战士用交叉双刃格挡利爪攻击，火花飞溅，随即以超高速刺击回击，精准刺穿要害，敌人的身躯在混乱中以慢动作崩塌。战士抓住一头更大的机械巨兽，快速攀爬同时闪避挥击，登顶后发出俯冲攻击，裂纹如蛛网般蔓延其表面，最终引发巨大的爆裂。在崩塌的建筑中，战士执行飞檐走壁式闪避，过渡为空中后空翻，以地面冲击波收尾，将周围敌人在尘土与能量的圆环中击退。最终爆发：战士引导内在力量，全身发光，向四面八方释放斩击与射击的洪流，镜头围绕其旋转，捕捉那令人目眩的速度与压倒性的攻击力量。15秒内张弛有度，设计剪辑节奏使场景转换和情感流向易于跟随。

en.p:
A hyper-realistic, cinematic 14-second vertical video (9:16 aspect ratio) shot at 60fps with intense motion blur and dynamic tracking camera work. The main subject is a sleek, futuristic insectoid drone with an iridescent metallic blue-green exoskeleton that shifts in the light like a beetle shell. It has two large glowing orange compound eyes that pulse with energy, spinning translucent propeller-wings that blur into discs during high-speed flight, thin black mechanical legs/tendrils, and long antennae. The drone is highly agile, fast, and organic in its movements, like a living cybernetic dragonfly.
Scene sequence (timed for precise 14-second duration):
0–2s: Extreme high-angle aerial shot racing over a vast, endless emerald-green Amazonian jungle canopy under bright daylight. The drone bursts into frame from the top, flying directly toward camera at breakneck speed before diving sharply downward into the dense forest.
2–8s: Chaotic, high-speed first-person and close third-person chase through the thick jungle interior. The drone weaves aggressively between massive moss-covered tree trunks, hanging vines, and dense ferns at dizzying speed. Volumetric god rays pierce the misty air. Brightly colored macaws (vivid red, blue, and yellow) scatter and fly chaotically around it, some nearly colliding with the drone. Camera follows tightly with whip pans, Dutch angles, and rapid tilts to convey extreme velocity and danger. Heavy motion blur on background foliage. The drone tilts, rolls, and banks sharply to avoid branches, its orange eyes glowing brighter during maneuvers.
8–11s: Tight, dramatic close-ups of the drone as it navigates deeper into darker, mistier sections of the jungle. Sunlight shafts cut through the canopy. The drone’s propellers spin furiously, occasionally clipping leaves and sending small debris flying. Its iridescent body reflects greens and golds from the environment. Camera orbits and pushes in close for mechanical detail.
11–14s: The drone bursts out of the dense jungle into a breathtaking open clearing. It flies straight toward a massive, powerful waterfall cascading dramatically into a turquoise lagoon far below. Thick white mist fills the air, creating a perfect rainbow arching across the scene. The drone hovers briefly in the center of frame, backlit by the waterfall and rainbow, its glowing orange eyes and iridescent shell catching the light dramatically. Final shot slowly pulls back to reveal the full majestic scale of the waterfall and rainbow as the drone holds position.

zh.p: 一段超写实、电影感的14秒竖屏视频（9:16画幅），以60fps拍摄，带有强烈的运动模糊和动态追踪镜头。主体是一只造型流畅的未来感昆虫无人机，拥有虹彩金属蓝绿色外壳，会像甲虫甲壳一样随光线变化。它有一对巨大的橙色发光复眼，脉冲般闪烁能量，旋转的半透明螺旋桨翼在高速飞行时模糊成圆盘，细长的黑色机械腿/触须，以及长长的触角。这只无人机动作极其敏捷、快速且有机，宛如一只活生生的赛博蜻蜓。场景序列（精确计时14秒）：0-2秒：极端高角度航拍镜头，在明亮日光下飞掠广阔无垠的翠绿亚马逊丛林树冠。无人机从顶部冲入画面，以极快速度直冲镜头，随后急剧俯冲进入密林。2-8秒：混乱的高速第一人称和近距第三人称追逐，穿越茂密丛林内部。无人机以令人眩晕的速度在巨大的苔藓覆盖树干、悬挂藤蔓和茂密蕨类植物间猛烈穿梭。体积光穿透雾气弥漫的空气。色彩鲜艳的金刚鹦鹉（鲜艳的红、蓝、黄色）四散纷飞，在它周围混乱飞行，有些几乎与无人机相撞。镜头紧追不舍，使用快速摇摄、荷兰角和急速俯仰来传达极速和危险感。背景树叶带有强烈运动模糊。无人机倾斜、翻滚、急转以避开树枝，其橙色眼睛在机动时更亮。8-11秒：紧张的无人机特写镜头，它深入更暗、更雾的丛林区域。阳光光束穿透树冠。无人机的螺旋桨疯狂旋转，偶尔削过叶片，扬起细小碎片。其虹彩机身反射出环境的绿色和金色。镜头环绕并推近以捕捉机械细节。11-14秒：无人机冲出密林，进入一片令人惊叹的开阔空地。它直飞向一座巨大的、气势磅礴的瀑布，瀑布倾泻而下，落入下方碧绿的泻湖。浓密的白雾弥漫空中，形成一道完美的彩虹横跨场景。无人机短暂悬停在画面中央，背衬瀑布和彩虹，其发光的橙色眼睛和虹彩外壳戏剧性地捕捉光线。最终镜头缓缓拉远，在无人机保持位置时，展现瀑布和彩虹的壮丽全貌。

Camera follows tightly with whip pans, Dutch angles, and rapid tilts to convey extreme velocity and danger. Heavy motion blur on background foliage. The drone tilts, rolls, and banks sharply to avoid branches, its orange eyes glowing brighter during maneuvers.

zh.p: ”化粧台” に座って鏡の前で”女の子”が化粧をしているシーン。明るく朝日が差し込む室内、可愛らしい化粧品が並んでいる。 ”女の子”は2Dアニメ調の絵柄を維持し、それ以外は全て実写とする。 １） ”女の子”はブラシを使って髪の毛を整えている。鼻歌を歌っている。 ２） ”女の子”は化粧品棚から口紅を取り出すと、ふたを開けて口紅を出す。淡いピンク色の口紅が見えると image1 はにっこり微笑む。 ３）鏡に向かって”女の子”は口紅を自分の口に細く薄く塗る。再び鼻歌を歌い始める。 ４）”女の子”は口紅を塗り終わった後、鏡で自分の唇を見る。ほんのり明るいピンク色に塗られた唇を見て「うん、よし！」と言う。 ５）”女の子”は鏡を見ている後ろ姿からカメラの方を振り返って見る。「どう、きれい？」といたずらっぽい表情でカメラに問いかけるように話をする。

en.p: Classic retro Disney animation style. Scene 1: On a pirate ship in the vast ocean, a group of evil bird pirates capture a dragon. The dragon is tied up with ropes, only its feet are free. The bird captain orders the dragon to take them to the treasure and points a sword at the dragon. Scene 2: The dragon defiantly puffs out a puff of smoke, glares angrily, then turns its head away, refusing to speak to the bird pirates. Scene 3: The bird pirate smirks slyly, plucks a feather, and extends it toward the dragon's sole. The dragon looks on blankly, and the bird pirate says he will regret it. Scene 4: A close-up shows the feather rubbing against the dragon's sole, accompanied by comical sound effects. Meanwhile, we hear the dragon chuckle softly. Scene 5: The camera focuses on the dragon's upper body, the dragon grins widely, eyes closed, emitting muffled laughter, while the bird pirate continues tickling the dragon's sole with the feather. Scene 6: The bird pirate tickles the dragon's sole with the feather, and the dragon laughs heartily. Amid the laughter, the dragon says he will take him to find the treasure, then continues laughing. Scene 7: After tickling the sole for a while, the bird pirate finally stops and hums contentedly. English voiceover.
en.t: Pirate Birds Tickle Dragon for Treasure

zh.p: 经典的复古迪士尼动画风格。 场景一：在茫茫大海的一艘海盗船上，一群邪恶的鸟类海盗捕获了一条龙。这条龙被绳子捆绑着，只有双脚是自由的。鸟船长命令巨龙带他们去宝藏的地方，并用剑指向巨龙。 场景二：巨龙挑衅地吐出一口烟，怒目而视，然后转过头去，不肯与鸟海盗说话。 场景三：鸟海盗狡黠地一笑，拔出一根羽毛，伸向巨龙的脚底。巨龙一脸茫然地看着，鸟海盗说他会后悔的。 场景四：特写镜头展现羽毛在巨龙脚底的摩擦，伴随着滑稽的音效。同时，我们听到巨龙轻笑。 场景五：镜头聚焦于巨龙的上半身，巨龙咧嘴大笑，闭着眼睛发出闷闷的笑声，而鸟海盗则继续用羽毛挠巨龙的脚底。 场景六：鸟海盗用羽毛挠龙的脚底，龙哈哈大笑。笑声中，龙说他会带他去寻找宝藏，说完又继续大笑起来。 场景七：挠了一会儿脚底后，鸟海盗终于停了下来，满意地哼了一声。英文语音。

Cut to close-up of his face — he looks heartbroken. On-screen captions:

en.p:
Scene 1 (0–4s):
A young girl sits by a softly lit window, painting on a canvas. Golden sunlight falls across her face. Her expression is calm and focused as she carefully adds color to a nearly complete artwork. Paint tubes and brushes are scattered neatly around her workspace. Gentle camera push-in.

Scene 2 (4–8s):
She squeezes a paint tube, but nothing comes out. She checks others empty. Her expression subtly shifts from focus to concern. Close-up of her hands pressing the tubes, then a cut to her face showing quiet realization.

Scene 3 (8–12s):
She leans back slightly, looking at the unfinished section of her painting. The missing colors leave a visible gap in the artwork. Soft shadows deepen the mood. A slow pan across the incomplete canvas emphasizes what’s missing.

Scene 4 (12–16s):
She gently sets the brush down and gazes at the painting, her expression thoughtful—not defeated, but paused. Light fades slightly warmer. Final shot: over-the-shoulder view of the incomplete artwork, symbolizing interruption rather than failure.

zh.p: 场景1（0-4秒）：一个年轻女孩坐在柔光窗边，在画布上作画。金色阳光洒在她脸上，她神情专注平静，正为即将完成的作品精心添色。颜料管与画笔整齐散落在工作区周围。镜头缓缓推进。场景2（4-8秒）：她挤压颜料管，却挤不出颜料。检查其他管子——都已空竭。神情从专注悄然转为忧虑。特写她按压管子的双手，切至她若有所悟的面部。场景3（8-12秒）：她微微后仰，望向画作未完成的部分。缺失的色彩在画布上留下明显空白。柔和的阴影加深了氛围。镜头缓慢横摇过未完成的画作，强调缺失之处。场景4（12-16秒）：她轻轻放下画笔，凝视画作，神情若有所思——并非挫败，而是停顿。光线渐暖。最终镜头：越过肩膀的视角望向未完成画作，象征中断而非失败。

en.p:
A cinematic dark sci-fi action scene in a destroyed cyberpunk industrial city at night, rain-soaked streets reflecting neon lights, burning debris, smoke and sparks filling the air.

A fierce female cybernetic fighter with an athletic build and tied-back hair stands in a low combat stance facing a massive charging monster. She wears heavy mechanical gauntlets that glow with energy and release bursts of steam with sharp hissing sounds.

She suddenly dashes forward at extreme speed, the camera dynamically tracking her movement. She leaps into the air, pulling back her fist as energy builds inside her gauntlets. The monster swings a massive blade upward.

Her punch collides with the blade mid-air, creating a powerful shockwave and explosive sparks. Both are pushed apart.

They charge again into close combat. Her punches are fast, heavy, and impactful, with steam blasting from her gauntlets. Each hit staggers the monster backward until it crashes into a wall, sending debris flying.

She lowers into a stance, charging power. Her gauntlets expand slightly, venting steam as their energy shifts from blue to glowing red.

The monster emerges from smoke. She unleashes a devastating final punch, releasing a massive heatwave with air distortion and glowing embers.

She follows with rapid strikes, then a powerful rising uppercut that launches the monster into the air before it crashes violently to the ground.

She lands and faces the camera. Behind her lies the defeated monster. She slowly clenches her fist as the gauntlets release a final burst of steam.

zh.p: 夜晚，一座被摧毁的赛博朋克工业城市中上演着电影般的黑暗科幻动作场景。雨水浸透的街道反射着霓虹灯光，燃烧的残骸、烟雾与火花弥漫在空气中。一位体格健壮、束着马尾辫的凶猛女性赛博格战士摆出低姿态战斗架势，直面一头巨大的冲锋怪物。她佩戴着重型机械护手，护手闪烁着能量光芒，随着尖锐的嘶嘶声喷出蒸汽。她突然以极速向前冲刺，摄像机动态追踪着她的动作。她跃入空中，拳头后拉，护手内积蓄着能量。怪物向上挥动巨刃。她的拳头与刀刃在半空中相撞，产生强大的冲击波和爆炸性的火花。双方被震退。他们再次冲入近战。她的拳头快速、沉重且充满冲击力，护手不断喷出蒸汽。每一击都让怪物踉跄后退，直到它撞上墙壁，碎片飞溅。她压低身体摆出架势，蓄积力量。她的护手微微膨胀，排放蒸汽，能量从蓝色转为炽热的红色。怪物从烟雾中现身。她释放出毁灭性的最后一拳，爆发出巨大的热浪，空气扭曲，余烬闪烁。她紧接着快速连击，随后一记强力上勾拳将怪物击飞至空中，最终它重重砸落地面。她落地后直面镜头。身后是倒下的怪物。她缓缓握紧拳头，护手喷出最后一股蒸汽。

Side tracking shot.

时长：15秒
0.0 – 2.0 工厂全景（延长以营造氛围）。管道喷出浓密蒸汽，链条轻微移动。镜头：下摇+推进。角色从链条上荡下→重重落地（冲击更强，火花更多）。镜头跟随向下（垂直跟拍），略带手持晃动。
2.0 – 4.0 机器人从三个方向逼近。手持中景（混乱能量感）。快速战斗：1记重拳→机器人被砸向管道（可见凹痕+火花）；1记回旋踢→机器人撞上悬挂链条；角色立即重新站位（跨步+转身，无停顿姿态）。
4.0 – 5.0 （关键时刻——延长）镜头甩拍跟随动作。微停顿（<0.3秒，仍保持快节奏）。瞬间弹出利爪（双手齐出），无手掌张开，无能量充能，机械卡扣声在0.2秒内完成。镜头：快速推进至双手，轻微角度偏移以强调，随即迅速拉回。
5.0 – 8.0 角色冲过大型工业管道（延长动作以增强空间纵深感）。侧向跟拍镜头。前景元素（管道/链条）快速掠过，营造强烈景深。攻击序列：1记横斩→击中2个机器人（清晰冲击反应）；紧接着1记前冲突刺（无停顿）。火花与金属撕裂清晰可见。
8.0 – 11.0 甩拍切换至新平台区域（连续工厂环境）。镜头半环绕+手持。延长连击：快速左斩，身体旋转→肘击/肩撞（强烈物理冲击），反向爪击（反手动作）。机器人反应剧烈：被击退，装甲破损可见，火花+变形。
11.0 – 13.0 短距离冲刺重新站位（非慢跑）。中近景侧向跟拍镜头。最终连击：双爪攻击（双手齐出），1记斜向终结斩。最后一个机器人被猛烈向后推倒。

延长开场与战斗中期以优化节奏
增加连击变化（无空档间隙）
工厂区域间清晰的空间过渡
更强的冲击力与受击反应

en.p: A cinematic emotional confrontation in a stylized semi-realistic painterly illustration style with anime-influenced design language, elegant elongated proportions, strong silhouettes, clean shape design, painterly digital brushwork, selective sharp edges on the focal faces, softer painted edges in the atmospheric background, polished concept-art finish, non-photorealistic. Blue-violet dusk on a rain-damp rooftop with shallow puddles, low concrete ledge, blurred city skyline, soft cool skylight from camera left, subtle city rim light behind the characters, wet reflections on the ground. Two characters only. CHARACTER_A is an early-20s woman with wet dark shoulder-length hair, slim build, charcoal long coat over a pale sweater and dark trousers, already emotional and trying not to cry. CHARACTER_B is a mid-20s man with dark rain-wet short hair, lean build, dark jacket over black shirt and dark pants, restrained and guilty. Begin with a medium-wide two-shot at eye level from near CHARACTER_A’s side, slow push-in, showing both characters already in the aftermath of an argument, light rain, wind, distant city ambience, and a very restrained sparse piano cue with low sustained strings under the natural sound. Cut to a medium close-up over CHARACTER_A’s shoulder on CHARACTER_B as he quietly says, “I did it to protect you,” in a low warm controlled voice with guilt underneath. Cut to a medium close-up on CHARACTER_A as she takes one small step forward, eyes filling, breath catching, and says with hurt disbelief, “Protect me? You lied to me.” Cut to a tight close-up on CHARACTER_A as tears break free and she says, in a soft breathy trembling voice, “You betrayed me.” Hold briefly after the line so the emotion lands. Keep all motion restrained and readable.

zh.p: 一场电影化的情感对峙，以风格化的半写实绘画插图风格呈现，融合了动漫影响的设计语言、优雅修长的身形比例、强烈的剪影、简洁的造型设计、绘画感的数字笔触——焦点面部保留锐利边缘，氛围背景则采用柔和的绘画边缘，抛光的概念艺术质感，非写实风格。蓝紫色的黄昏笼罩着雨湿的屋顶，浅水洼散布，低矮的混凝土边缘，模糊的城市天际线，来自镜头左侧的柔和冷色天光，角色身后微弱的城市轮廓光，地面上的湿润反光。仅有两个角色。角色A是一位二十出头的女性，湿漉漉的及肩黑发，身材纤细，穿着炭灰色长外套，内搭浅色毛衣和深色长裤，情绪激动，强忍泪水。角色B是一位二十五岁左右的男性，深色短发被雨水打湿，身材清瘦，穿着深色夹克，内搭黑衬衫和黑裤，神情克制而愧疚。从角色A身旁的视线高度开始，以中远景双人镜头缓慢推进，展现两人争吵后的余波——细雨、微风、远处的城市环境音，以及一段极为克制的稀疏钢琴旋律，伴随低沉的持续弦乐融入自然声响。切至角色A肩后的中近景，对准角色B，他低声说道：“我这么做是为了保护你。”声音低沉温暖，却带着克制的愧疚。切至角色A的中近景，她向前迈出一小步，眼眶盈泪，呼吸凝滞，带着受伤的难以置信说道：“保护我？你骗了我。”切至角色A的特写镜头，泪水夺眶而出，她用轻柔颤抖的声音说道：“你背叛了我。”台词结束后稍作停顿，让情绪沉淀。所有动作保持克制而清晰可辨。

Scene 1: The Blueprint (0-3s) A tiny, resourceful ant named Barnaby stands on a kitchen counter, wearing a miniature high-tech visor. A blueprint of a donut is projected in front of him. A single, colossal rainbow sprinkle rests beside him.

Scene 2: The Approach (3-6s) Barnaby cautiously approaches the sprinkle. The camera zooms in dramatically, emphasizing the ant’s small size against the bright, textured surface of the confectionery.

Scene 3: The Heavy Lifting (6-9s) He attempts to lift the sprinkle. Barnaby strains, his antennae vibrating. He leverages his tiny strength, but the sprinkle remains frustratingly rooted to the counter.

Scene 4: The Innovation (9-12s) Suddenly, a tiny, segmented robotic leg extends from Barnaby’s backpack. He uses the device to effortlessly pry the sprinkle loose, a digital cheer icon appearing above his visor.

Scene 5: The Sweet Success (12-15s) The robotic leg helps Barnaby carry the massive sprinkle on his back. He marches off screen, humming a tiny tune, the colorful prize a gleaming testament to his victory.
en.t: Ant's Sweet Victory Over Giant Sprinkle

en.p:
0s – 4s (Arrival at the Academy)
A massive gothic magical academy appears above floating cliffs, surrounded by storm clouds and glowing runes. The girl walks through the grand iron gates. Her expression is calm but curious. Floating spell books drift around the entrance. Cinematic slow push-in shot, mist and dramatic lighting.

4s – 8s (The Forbidden Core Reveal)
Inside a grand hall, students channel elemental magic. The girl stands still as her “sealed magical core” reacts. Dark energy briefly flickers around her chest, but she doesn’t collapse like others would. The academy masters observe in shock. Close-up on her face with glowing rune reflections in her eyes.

8s – 12s (Soul-Binding Lesson)
In a floating classroom, chains of light connect students’ souls to magical entities. The girl absorbs a forbidden spell instead of being harmed. The spell dissolves into her body safely. Books levitate violently around her. Slow-motion, cinematic orbit camera around her.

12s – 16s (Forbidden Power Awakens)
A sudden magical duel breaks out. She steps forward and releases a silent wave of forbidden magic. Reality bends slightly around her. Runes explode into glowing fragments in the air. The academy freezes in awe as her power stabilizes. Final shot: her standing alone under floating spell books, softly glowing.

zh.p:
0-4秒（抵达学院）：一座哥特式魔法学院悬浮在浮空峭壁之上，四周环绕着风暴云和发光符文。少女穿过宏伟的铁门，神情平静中带着好奇。入口处漂浮着自动翻动的魔法书。采用电影感缓慢推进镜头，配合薄雾与戏剧性光影。

4-8秒（禁忌核心显现）：宏伟殿堂内，学生们正在引导元素魔法。少女静止站立时，她“被封印的魔法核心”产生异动。暗色能量短暂在她胸前闪烁，但她并未像其他人那样倒下。学院导师们震惊地注视着她。特写镜头中，她眼中倒映着发光的符文。

8-12秒（灵魂契约课）：在悬浮教室中，光之锁链将学生们的灵魂与魔法实体相连。少女非但未被禁忌咒语所伤，反而将其吸收。咒语安全地融入她体内。书籍在她周围剧烈悬浮。采用慢动作与电影化环绕镜头。

12-16秒（禁忌之力觉醒）：突然爆发的魔法对决中，她踏前一步释放出无声的禁忌魔法波纹。周围现实微微扭曲。符文在空中炸裂成发光碎片。当她的力量稳定时，整个学院陷入敬畏的静止。最终镜头：她独自立于漂浮的魔法书下，周身泛着微光。

Use the first reference image as the exact choreography and motion-process guide. Use the second reference image as the identity reference for the adult woman dancer.

Create a graceful traditional dance performance that follows all 16 illustrated steps in order, from the confident opening pose to the respectful closing pose. The dancer performs with poised posture, soft knee bends, precise cross steps, elegant wrist waves, curved fingers, shoulder accents, hip sways, flowing turns, and expressive selendang sweeps.

Keep the camera in a clean full-body cinematic frame, mostly front-facing, with slow controlled movement that supports the dance instead of distracting from it. During the left and right turns, allow a subtle circular camera drift, then return to a centered frontal composition. The dancer’s hands, feet, facial expression, and selendang fabric must remain visible throughout.

Use soft studio lighting, refined contrast, and a calm traditional performance atmosphere. The motion should feel smooth, rhythmic, respectful, and feminine, with the selendang floating naturally as the dancer glides forward and backward. End on a still closing pose with hands at the heart, peaceful smile, and elegant silence.

zh.p: 以第一张参考图作为精确的舞蹈编排与动作流程指南，以第二张参考图作为成年女性舞者的身份参照。创作一场优雅的传统舞蹈表演，严格按照全部16个图示步骤依次完成，从自信的开场姿态到恭敬的结束造型。舞者需保持从容的体态、轻柔的屈膝、精准的交叉步、优雅的手腕摆动、弯曲的手指、肩部点缀、臀部轻摆、流畅的转身以及富有表现力的纱巾挥洒。摄像机保持干净的全景电影画幅，以正面拍摄为主，配合缓慢可控的运动，以衬托舞蹈而非分散注意力。在左右转身时，允许摄像机做微妙的环形漂移，随后回归居中的正面构图。舞者的双手、双脚、面部表情以及纱巾布料必须全程可见。采用柔和的棚拍灯光、精致的对比度，营造宁静的传统表演氛围。动作应流畅、富有韵律、恭敬且柔美，纱巾随舞者前后滑步自然飘动。最终以静止的结束造型收尾——双手合于胸前，面带平和微笑，呈现优雅的静谧。

en.p: A realistic human face with highly detailed skin texture, pores, and micro-musculature. Scene: Tight portrait close-up against a dark, void-like background. Style: Cinematic realism, 35mm film aesthetic, shallow depth of field with soft bokeh, moody and introspective. Lighting: Dynamic emotional lighting that shifts in color temperature and direction to match the internal state. Audio: Ambient atmospheric drone, soft rhythmic breathing, subtle emotional orchestral swells. Avoid: Identity drift, jitter, distorted limbs, unnatural morphing artifacts. [0-3s] Camera: Slow, imperceptible push-in. Action: The face breaks into a genuine, soft smile; eyes crinkle at the corners and the cheeks lift. Lighting: Warm golden-hour glow, soft and frontal. Vfx: Subtle lens flare. [3-6s] Camera: Static extreme close-up. Action: The smile dissolves into a heavy, downward curve; eyes well up with glistening tears that catch the light, and the lower lip trembles. Lighting: Transition to a cool, melancholy blue wash from above. [6-9s] Camera: Controlled lateral pan. Action: The brow furrows deeply into a sharp V-shape; the jaw clenches visibly, and nostrils flare with rhythmic, heavy breathing. Lighting: Harsh, high-contrast red and orange side-lighting creating deep shadows. [9-12s] Camera: Subtle handheld micro-shake for tension. Action: The eyes snap wide, pupils dilating; the face pales as the muscles go taut, and the mouth hangs slightly open in a shallow gasp. Lighting: Dim, desaturated, flickering low-key light. [12-15s] Camera: Gentle pull-out to a medium close-up. Action: All tension drains from the face; the eyes slowly close, and the features settle into a mask of perfect, serene stillness. Lighting: Soft, diffused white light enveloping the subject like a halo.

zh.p: 一张高度写实的人脸，皮肤纹理、毛孔和细微肌肉结构清晰可见。场景：紧贴面部的特写镜头，背景为黑暗虚无。风格：电影级写实主义，35毫米胶片美学，浅景深搭配柔焦虚化，氛围忧郁而内省。灯光：动态情绪化照明，色温与方向随内心状态变化。音效：环境氛围低鸣、轻柔的规律呼吸声、细腻的情感管弦乐渐强。避免：身份漂移、画面抖动、肢体扭曲、不自然的变形伪影。[0-3秒] 镜头：缓慢、不易察觉的推进。动作：脸上浮现真诚而温柔的笑容；眼角泛起笑纹，双颊上扬。灯光：温暖的金色余晖，柔和且正面照射。特效：微弱的镜头光晕。[3-6秒] 镜头：静态极限特写。动作：笑容逐渐消散，嘴角沉重下垂；眼眶盈满晶莹泪珠，在光线下闪烁，下唇微微颤抖。灯光：过渡为冷色调忧郁蓝光，从上方倾泻。[6-9秒] 镜头：受控的水平横移。动作：眉头紧锁，形成尖锐的倒V形；下颌明显咬紧，鼻翼随沉重而有节奏的呼吸翕动。灯光：强烈的高对比度红橙色侧光，投下深邃阴影。[9-12秒] 镜头：微妙的持机抖动，营造紧张感。动作：双眼猛然睁大，瞳孔扩张；面部因肌肉紧绷而苍白，嘴巴微张，发出浅促的喘息。灯光：昏暗、低饱和度、闪烁的低调光。[12-15秒] 镜头：轻柔拉远至中近景。动作：所有紧张感从面部褪去；双眼缓缓闭合，五官归于完美、宁静的静止面具。灯光：柔和漫射的白光如光环般笼罩主体。
