en.p:
[CINEMATIC SETUP]

Film Style: Photorealistic neo-noir grounded in reality. Midday lighting, not stylized night.

Lens: 50mm–85mm natural portrait range. Moderate depth of field — subject readable but environment present.

Color Grade: Neutral daylight base. Subtle warm sun spill from frame-left, cool ambient from overhead transit structure. No extreme split-tone.

Lighting: Real-world station lighting — skylight diffusion + fluorescent overheads. Soft shadows. Skin and metal respond naturally.

Camera: Observational, handheld or stabilized micro-movement. Slight drift. Never locked-off or stylized.

Audio: Station PA (Japanese), footsteps, rolling luggage, distant train arrival, low city hum. No dramatic sound design.

[TIMELINE]
0–3s — ESTABLISHING FLOW 
Wide shot of busy Japanese transit corridor at midday. Commuters moving naturally in all directions. No one reacts to camera. Subject is present but not highlighted.

3–6s — SUBJECT FOUND 
Camera settles into a medium tracking shot as the android-hybrid woman walks with the crowd. Short silver hair, natural skin with subtle circuit seams along right cheek and temple. Mechanical neck partially visible above collar. She blends in — no crowd separation.

6–9s — NATURAL INTERACTION 
While walking, she casually raises her right hand to her face — as if adjusting skin or brushing something away. Fingers land precisely along a faint seam on her right cheek. Expression neutral. Gaze forward. No pause in walking.

9–12s — PANEL ACTIVATION + OPEN (KEY MOMENT) 
With a small, deliberate press + slight upward slide of her fingers: 
– A hidden facial panel unlocks along a clean seam (temple → cheek → jaw) 
– The skin segment rotates outward on a hinge near the ear (~15–20°) 
– Motion is smooth, engineered, quiet — no tearing, no stretching 
– Interior revealed: synthetic skeletal lattice, micro-actuators, cable bundles, compact mechanical architecture with subtle amber signal pulses 
– Eye remains anchored and stable 
She continues walking at the same pace through the crowd

12–15s — CLOSE PASS 
Camera moves into a tighter portrait as she passes. Panel remains partially open. Internal structure catches shifting daylight and overhead fluorescents. Surrounding commuters continue normally, unfazed.

15–18s — RESET 
She lowers her hand. Panel rotates back into place seamlessly and locks flush with skin. Seam becomes barely visible again. No one reacts.

18–20s — EXIT INTO CROWD 
She continues forward and blends fully back into the flow of people. Camera lingers briefly as she disappears into the crowd.

[STYLE & BEHAVIOR CONSTRAINTS]
All motion must feel casual and unremarkable — no staged or dramatic beats 
Crowd behavior fully natural — no parting, no reactions 
Transformation must be rigid mechanical — hinged panel, not organic splitting 
No melting, stretching, or morphing 
Facial identity must remain perfectly stable 
Lighting continuity must match real-world environment

zh.p: 【电影场景设定】电影风格：基于现实的写实新黑色电影。正午光线，非风格化夜景。镜头：50mm–85mm自然人像范围。中等景深——主体可辨识但环境清晰。色彩基调：中性日光基底。左侧有微暖阳光漫射，头顶交通结构带来冷色环境光。无极端分色调。灯光：真实车站照明——天窗漫射光+荧光顶灯。柔和阴影。皮肤与金属自然反光。摄影：观察式，手持或稳定微动。轻微漂移。无固定或风格化镜头。音频：车站广播（日语）、脚步声、滚轮行李箱声、远处列车进站声、低微城市嗡鸣。无戏剧化音效设计。【时间线】0–3秒——建立人流 正午繁忙日本交通走廊的广角镜头。通勤者自然向各方向移动。无人对镜头做出反应。主体出现但未突出。3–6秒——发现主体 镜头转为中景跟拍，仿生混合体女性随人群行走。银色短发，自然肤色，右颊与太阳穴有细微电路接缝。衣领上方可见部分机械颈。她融入人群——无人避让。6–9秒——自然互动 行走中，她随意抬起右手触碰面部——仿佛调整皮肤或拂去异物。手指精准落在右颊一道隐约接缝上。表情中性。目光向前。行走节奏不变。9–12秒——面板激活与开启（关键瞬间） 手指刻意按压并轻微上滑： – 隐藏面部面板沿清晰接缝解锁（太阳穴→面颊→下颌） – 皮肤片段以耳部为轴向外旋转（约15–20°） – 动作流畅、机械、无声——无撕裂或拉伸 – 内部显露：合成骨骼框架、微型致动器、线束、紧凑机械结构，伴有微弱琥珀色信号脉冲 – 眼睛保持稳定锚定 她以相同步速继续穿过人群12–15秒——近景掠过 镜头推近至更紧凑的人像，她擦肩而过。面板仍半开。内部结构捕捉到变化的正午阳光与头顶荧光灯。周围通勤者如常行动，毫无异样。15–18秒——复位 她放下手。面板无缝旋转回原位，与皮肤齐平锁紧。接缝再次几乎不可见。无人反应。18–20秒——融入人群 她继续前行，完全汇入人流。镜头短暂停留，直至她消失于人群。【风格与行为约束】所有动作须自然随意——无刻意或戏剧化节拍 人群行为完全自然——无避让、无反应 变形须为刚性机械——铰接面板，非有机分裂 无融化、拉伸或形变 面部身份须保持完全稳定 光线连续性须匹配真实环境 机械内部结构须在面板开启时保持可见

Create Part 1 of a cinematic short film: a 15-second uncut supernatural martial-arts horror fight in an abandoned hospital hallway at night. Follow @[CurrentStoryboardRef] for action order, framing, camera rhythm, timing, sound beats, and final fade. Use character refs only to preserve faces, hair, body type, wardrobe, and supernatural markers.

Characters:
An Voaen: lean athletic male, mid-20s to early 30s, angular face, wet messy black medium hair, torn black combat top, dark pants, forearm wraps, faint glowing gold eyes, controlled Hanuman-possessed fury.
The Deluded One: wiry male, late 20s to early 30s, gaunt face, messy black hair, torn dirty hospital clothing, blackened veins across skin, unstable snarling menace.

Scene:
Abandoned hospital hallway, flickering red emergency lights, cracked wet tiles, blood smears, deep shadows, claustrophobic corridor depth, gritty cinematic realism. Tone is tense, feral, brutal, supernatural, grounded.

Camera:
One continuous handheld shot, no visible cuts. Close, reactive, readable. Slight forward push, side tracking, low dips, quick body-follow movement. Keep choreography clear, not blurry.

Action timing:
0–3s: Both fighters charge. An lands a lightning spinning elbow to the Deluded One’s jaw. The Deluded One staggers, then counters with a savage low Thai kick that buckles An’s knee.
3–7s: An drops into a Bokator low sweep, trips him, then stomps down hard to the ribs. The Deluded One roars, grabs An’s ankle, and yanks him down.
7–11s: They roll violently on the floor. The Deluded One claws An’s shoulder. An headbutts him, then drives a knee into his solar plexus. Both slam into the wall, leaving smeared impact marks.
11–15s: An explodes upward with a flying knee to the face. The Deluded One counters mid-air with a spinning back elbow across An’s temple. They separate for one heartbeat, chests heaving, eyes locked, both injured. Fade to black on impact energy.

Sound:
No dialogue, no voiceover. Only breathing, footsteps, cloth scrape, impact hits, body slam, wall hit, distant water drip, red light electrical hum.

Style:
Cinematic realistic, handheld uncut action horror, wet skin, sweat, grime, red emergency-light contrast, grounded supernatural realism.

Negative:
Do not show storyboard grid, panel borders, numbers, captions, arrows, or labels. No text, no subtitles, no watermark. No extra characters. No face drift, no wardrobe drift, no environment change. No clean heroic posing. No exaggerated fantasy VFX. Do not break the one-take feeling.

zh.p: 创作一部电影级短片的第一部分：一段15秒无剪辑的超自然武术恐怖打斗场景，发生在夜晚废弃医院走廊。遵循@[当前故事板参考]的动作顺序、构图、镜头节奏、时间点、音效节拍及最终淡出。仅使用角色参考来保留面部、发型、体型、服装和超自然特征。角色：安·沃恩——精瘦运动型男性，20多岁至30岁出头，棱角分明的脸，湿漉漉的凌乱黑色中长发，撕裂的黑色战斗上衣，深色裤子，前臂缠带，微弱的金色发光眼睛，受控的哈努曼附身怒火。被迷惑者——瘦削男性，20多岁至30岁出头，憔悴的脸，凌乱黑发，撕裂肮脏的病号服，皮肤上布满黑色血管，不稳定的咆哮威胁。场景：废弃医院走廊，闪烁的红色应急灯，开裂潮湿的地砖，血迹斑斑，深邃阴影，幽闭的走廊纵深，粗粝的电影现实主义。基调：紧张、野性、残酷、超自然、接地气。镜头：单次连续手持拍摄，无可见剪辑。近景、反应式、清晰可辨。轻微前推、侧向跟拍、低角度下探、快速跟随身体运动。保持动作清晰，不模糊。动作时间：0–3秒：双方战士冲锋。安以一记闪电般的旋转肘击击中被迷惑者的下巴。被迷惑者踉跄，随后以一记凶猛的泰式低扫反击，使安的膝盖弯曲。3–7秒：安下潜至博卡托低扫，将其绊倒，然后猛踩其肋骨。被迷惑者咆哮，抓住安的脚踝，将其拽倒。7–11秒：两人在地板上激烈翻滚。被迷惑者抓伤安的肩膀。安用头撞击他，然后一记膝击顶入他的太阳神经丛。两人猛撞到墙上，留下撞击痕迹。11–15秒：安爆发跃起，一记飞膝直击面部。被迷惑者在空中以旋转后肘反击，击中安的太阳穴。他们分开一瞬，胸膛起伏，目光锁定，双双受伤。在冲击能量中淡出至黑屏。音效：无对话，无旁白。只有呼吸声、脚步声、布料摩擦声、撞击声、身体撞击声、墙击声、远处水滴声、红灯电流嗡鸣声。风格：电影级写实，手持无剪辑动作恐怖，湿漉漉的皮肤、汗水、污垢、红色应急灯对比，接地气的超自然现实主义。禁止：不显示故事板网格、面板边框、编号、说明文字、箭头或标签。无文字、无字幕、无水印。无额外角色。无面部漂移、无服装漂移、无环境变化。无干净英雄式摆拍。无夸张奇幻特效。不破坏一镜到底的感觉。

en.p:
A cinematic timelapse journey through Earth’s most breathtaking natural colors. In Kyoto, ancient cherry blossom trees erupt from bare branches into oceans of pale pink bloom as petals swirl like snow through rose-gold dawn light. A sudden wind lifts the blossoms into the sky where they transform midair into vivid ribbons of scarlet, yellow, violet, and crimson — reforming into the endless tulip fields of the Netherlands beneath dramatic racing clouds and a solitary Dutch windmill. Seasons accelerate as tulips burst from the earth in waves of impossible color, sunlight and shadow sweeping across geometric fields stretching to the horizon.

The colors dissolve again into the lavender-covered hills of Provence, France, where endless purple fields sway like a living ocean beneath the changing light of an entire summer day compressed into seconds. Bees blur through the flowers, horse carts glide silently between rows, and the sky slowly darkens from warm gold to deep indigo. Stars emerge as the world transforms into Iceland — a frozen volcanic landscape surrounding a perfectly still glacial mirror lake. Above it, the aurora awakens. Emerald curtains of light surge across the heavens, joined by violet and brilliant white ribbons that ripple endlessly across the night sky and reflect perfectly in the water below. A lone figure stands motionless beneath the celestial storm as the camera slowly pulls back, revealing an infinite world of ice, stars, and living color before the aurora fades softly into darkness. Cinematic. Dreamlike. Transcendent.

zh.p: 一场电影般的延时摄影之旅，穿越地球上最令人叹为观止的自然色彩。在京都，古老的樱花树从光秃的枝干上骤然绽放，化作浅粉色花海，花瓣如雪般在玫瑰金色的晨曦中旋转飘落。一阵突如其来的风将花瓣卷向天空，它们在半空中幻化成鲜红、明黄、紫罗兰与深红交织的绚丽缎带——最终重组为荷兰绵延无尽的郁金香花田，上方是疾驰的云层与一座孤零零的风车。季节加速流转，郁金香以不可思议的色彩浪潮破土而出，阳光与阴影掠过几何状的花田，延伸至天际。色彩再次消融，化作法国普罗旺斯的薰衣草山丘，无垠的紫色田野如活生生的海洋般摇曳，整个夏日的光影变化被压缩成短短几秒。蜜蜂在花丛中穿梭，马车静静滑行于田垄之间，天空从温暖的金色渐变为深邃的靛蓝。星辰浮现，世界随之化为冰岛——一片冰封的火山地貌环绕着如镜般静止的冰川湖。湖面上方，极光苏醒了。翡翠色的光幕在苍穹中涌动，紫罗兰与亮白色的光带加入其中，在夜空中无尽荡漾，完美倒映在下方水面。一个孤独的身影静静伫立在这片天穹风暴之下，镜头缓缓拉远，展现出由冰、星辰与鲜活色彩构成的无限世界，直到极光温柔地消散于黑暗之中。电影感。如梦似幻。超凡脱俗。

Ultra-realistic urban warehouse street fight. Single continuous shot, no cuts. Raw handheld mobile footage with natural micro-jitters, slight rolling shutter, no stabilization. Documentary realism.

Lens: 8mm fisheye wide-angle, subtle barrel distortion at the edges, soft vignette in the corners. GoPro POV grain. Cinematic warm-cool colour grade.

Audio: No music. Only raw ambient sound — footsteps, fabric friction, cloth movement, punches, distant city hum, breathing, low ambient room tone. Lighting: mixed warm + cool cinematic tones, practical overhead lighting, slow shifting shadows, visible dust particles in light shafts.

MAIN CHARACTER (STRICT IDENTITY LOCK): is @Image1 lean athletic build, cold emotionless face matching reference image exactly.

OUTFIT LOCK (NO CHANGE): same as image and black tapered trousers, black army boots.

OPPONENT RULES: All opponents have unique faces, no resemblance to protagonist. Opponents wear varied dark streetwear (different from protagonist).

ACTION:

0–2s: Protagonist grabs Opponent A from behind → one-hand head slam onto a heavy wooden crate/table. Tools and debris burst outward. Crate drags with friction. A collapses limp.

2–5s: Grabs Opponent B → punch to abdomen → B folds → immediate head slam into the table. Head pressed briefly to the surface. Camera stabilizes briefly. B falls face-down. Heavy breathing, visible sweat on protagonist’s brow.

5–6s: Hoodie shifts slightly, neckline visible (hood sways). C & D enter from back, split and flank. Only footsteps, low ambient hum.

6–8s: Chaotic fight. D attacks with rapid punches. Protagonist stumbles slightly. C grabs hoodie, pulls back. Knee to abdomen. Body bends forward. Heavy breathing. Shadows moving across the floor.

8–10s: Headbutt to D → D staggers. Protagonist grabs C collar efficiently.

10–12s (WALL IMPACT): Protagonist drives C backward into a concrete brick wall. Back hits first, head snaps slightly. Dust bursts outward, fully visible in warm light. Tools on a nearby rack rattle, pieces fall. Micro slow-motion (0.2–0.3s) at impact → back to real-time. C loses tension, slides down leaving smears on the wall, collapses. Dust drifts.

12–13s: D charges → protagonist sidesteps → rotational punch to cheekbone. Sweat arcs mid-air. D crashes into stacked crates. Massive collapse, debris scatters. D motionless, hand drops. Protagonist barely standing, heavy breathing.

13–14s: Medium-close. Chest rising. Slow turn to camera. Cold eye contact through glasses. Wipes sweat from brow (visible smear).

14–15s (FINAL): Ground-level wide shot. Slight edge blur, warm tone, golden dust. Protagonist → looks at the camera, winks and point at it, and walks away fade to black

zh.p: 超写实城市仓库街头斗殴。单次连续拍摄，无剪辑。原始手持手机录像，带有自然的微抖动、轻微滚动快门，无防抖。纪录片式真实感。镜头：8毫米鱼眼广角，边缘有轻微桶形畸变，角落有柔和暗角。GoPro第一人称视角颗粒感。电影级冷暖色调。音频：无音乐。仅有原始环境音——脚步声、布料摩擦、衣物移动、拳击声、远处城市喧嚣、呼吸声、低沉的室内环境音。灯光：混合暖色与冷色电影级色调，实用顶灯照明，缓慢移动的阴影，光柱中可见的灰尘颗粒。主角（严格身份锁定）：是@Image1，瘦削运动型身材，冷漠无表情的脸，与参考图像完全一致。服装锁定（不可更改）：与图像相同，黑色锥形裤，黑色军靴。对手规则：所有对手都有独特面孔，与主角无相似之处。对手穿着各异的深色街头服饰（与主角不同）。动作：0–2秒：主角从背后抓住对手A → 单手将其头部猛砸向一个沉重的木箱/桌子。工具和碎片向外飞溅。木箱摩擦拖动。A瘫软倒下。2–5秒：抓住对手B → 一拳击中腹部 → B弯腰 → 立即将其头部砸向桌子。头部短暂压在桌面上。镜头短暂稳定。B面朝下倒地。主角呼吸沉重，额头可见汗水。5–6秒：连帽衫轻微移动，领口可见（帽子晃动）。C和D从后方进入，分左右包抄。只有脚步声和低沉的嗡嗡声。6–8秒：混乱打斗。D快速出拳攻击。主角略微踉跄。C抓住连帽衫向后拉。膝盖击中腹部。身体前倾。呼吸沉重。阴影在地板上移动。8–10秒：用头撞击D → D踉跄。主角迅速抓住C的衣领。10–12秒（撞墙）：主角将C向后推向一堵混凝土砖墙。背部先撞墙，头部轻微后仰。灰尘向外飞溅，在暖光中清晰可见。附近架子上的工具嘎嘎作响，零件掉落。撞击时出现微慢动作（0.2–0.3秒）→ 回到实时速度。C失去力气，滑下墙壁留下污迹，瘫倒。灰尘飘散。12–13秒：D冲来 → 主角侧步闪避 → 旋转一拳击中颧骨。汗水在空中划出弧线。D撞入堆叠的木箱。大量倒塌，碎片散落。D不动，手垂下。主角勉强站立，呼吸沉重。13–14秒：中近景。胸部起伏。缓慢转向镜头。透过眼镜投来冷漠的眼神。擦去额头的汗水（可见污迹）。14–15秒（结尾）：地面水平广角镜头。边缘轻微模糊，暖色调，金色灰尘。主角 → 看向镜头，眨眼并指向镜头，然后走开，渐隐至黑屏。

5–6s: Hoodie shifts slightly, neckline visible (hood sways). C & D enter from back, split and flank. Only footsteps, low ambient hum.

6–8s: Chaotic fight. D attacks with rapid punches. Protagonist stumbles slightly. C grabs hoodie, pulls back. Knee to abdomen. Body bends forward. Heavy breathing. Shadows moving across the floor.

8–10s: Headbutt to D → D staggers. Protagonist grabs C collar efficiently.

10–12s (WALL IMPACT): Protagonist drives C backward into a concrete brick wall. Back hits first, head snaps slightly. Dust bursts outward, fully visible in warm light. Tools on a nearby rack rattle, pieces fall. Micro slow-motion (0.2–0.3s) at impact → back to real-time. C loses tension, slides down leaving smears on the wall, collapses. Dust drifts.

12–13s: D charges → protagonist sidesteps → rotational punch to cheekbone. Sweat arcs mid-air. D crashes into stacked crates. Massive collapse, debris scatters. D motionless, hand drops. Protagonist barely standing, heavy breathing.

13–14s: Medium-close. Chest rising. Slow turn to camera. Cold eye contact through glasses. Wipes sweat from brow (visible smear).

14–15s (FINAL): Ground-level wide shot. Slight edge blur, warm tone, golden dust. Protagonist → looks at the camera, winks and point at it, and walks away fade to black

en.p:
Ultra-realistic cinematic video, 9:16 vertical, ARRI Alexa look, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft warm indoor lighting, subtle film grain. A young man sits casually on a couch in a dim cozy room at night, illuminated by the cool glow of his smartphone. He scrolls through social media with a bored expression. Suddenly, a hyper-realistic pizza ad fills his screen—golden crispy crust, bubbling cheese, pepperoni glistening with oil, steam rising in slow motion.
Camera pushes in closer to the phone. The screen light intensifies and flickers. The pizza inside the phone begins to subtly move—cheese stretching beyond the screen edges. The man notices, confused. In a surreal transition, the pizza starts emerging out of the phone screen into real life—cheese stretching between digital and physical space.
Close-up: molten cheese pull bridging the screen and reality. The pizza fully materializes in his hands, hot and steaming. His face shifts from confusion to amazement. Warm light from the pizza replaces the cold phone glow, changing the mood.
Final shot: cinematic slow motion of him taking the first bite, cheese stretch, eyes closing in satisfaction. End with a soft glow and lingering steam in the air.
en.t: Pizza Emerges from Phone in Surreal Ad

zh.p: 超写实电影感视频，9:16竖屏，ARRI Alexa色调，35mm镜头，浅景深，柔和温暖的室内灯光，微妙的胶片颗粒感。夜晚，一位年轻男子随意坐在昏暗舒适的房间里，智能手机的冷光映照着他的脸庞。他百无聊赖地刷着社交媒体。突然，屏幕上出现一则超写实的披萨广告——金黄酥脆的饼皮、拉丝的芝士、油光闪烁的意大利辣香肠，蒸汽缓缓升腾。镜头向手机推进，屏幕光线增强并开始闪烁。手机里的披萨开始微妙地动起来——芝士从屏幕边缘向外延伸。男子察觉异样，面露困惑。在一场超现实的过渡中，披萨开始从手机屏幕中浮现到现实世界——芝士在数字与物理空间之间拉伸。特写：融化的芝士丝连接着屏幕与现实。披萨完整地出现在他手中，热气腾腾。他的表情从困惑转为惊叹。披萨散发的暖光取代了手机的冷光，氛围随之转变。最终镜头：他以电影慢动作咬下第一口，芝士拉丝，他满足地闭上双眼。结尾以柔和的光芒和空气中萦绕的蒸汽收场。

en.p:
Ultra cinematic action sequence starring a fearless young woman in a futuristic neon Tokyo alley during heavy rain at night. She wears a black tactical leather jacket with glowing blue accents, wet hair, intense sharp eyes, and subtle battle damage on her face. Camera opens with a slow-motion shot of her standing alone under flickering neon signs while rain pours around her. Suddenly multiple futuristic attack drones descend from the sky with red laser targeting systems.

0–3s:
Massive cinematic wide shot. Rain splashes across puddles reflecting neon pink and blue lights. Her robotic katana slowly activates with glowing energy running through the blade. Wind blows her jacket dramatically. Background filled with cyberpunk billboards, steam vents, flying cars in distance.

3–7s:
Fast aggressive combat begins. She dashes forward at superhuman speed slicing drones mid-air. Sparks explode everywhere. Slow-motion close-up of glowing eyes and water droplets flying from her hair. Dynamic camera shakes and whip transitions. One drone crashes into a ramen shop causing fiery debris explosion.

7–12s:
She jumps from wall to wall while firing a futuristic pistol in mid-air. Massive explosion behind her lights the entire alley orange and blue. Final shot shows her standing on top of a destroyed police hover car breathing heavily while rain and smoke surround her. She stares directly into the camera with intense villain energy.

Style:
Hyper realistic cinematic action, John Wick meets Ghost in the Shell meets Cyberpunk 2077, dramatic lighting, Hollywood trailer energy, realistic rain physics, ultra detailed textures, emotional intensity, anamorphic lens, cinematic motion blur, volumetric smoke, realistic explosions, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical viral TikTok aesthetic.

zh.p: 超电影级动作场面，主角是一位无畏的年轻女子，背景设定在未来的霓虹东京小巷，深夜暴雨倾盆。她身穿黑色战术皮夹克，带有蓝色发光饰边，湿漉漉的头发，锐利而充满力量的眼神，脸上带着细微的战斗伤痕。镜头以慢动作开场，她独自站在闪烁的霓虹灯牌下，雨水倾泻而下。突然，多架未来攻击无人机从天而降，配备红色激光瞄准系统。0-3秒：宏大的电影级广角镜头。雨水溅起水花，倒映着霓虹粉蓝光芒。她的机械武士刀缓缓激活，刀刃上流动着发光能量。风猛烈吹动她的夹克。背景充满赛博朋克广告牌、蒸汽排气口、远处飞行的汽车。3-7秒：快速激烈的战斗开始。她以超人类速度冲刺，在空中劈砍无人机。火花四溅。慢动作特写：发光的眼睛，水珠从她头发上飞溅。动态镜头抖动和快速切换。一架无人机撞入拉面店，引发炽热碎片爆炸。7-12秒：她在墙壁间跳跃，同时在空中发射未来手枪。身后巨大的爆炸将整条小巷照亮成橙蓝色。最终镜头：她站在一辆被摧毁的警用悬浮车顶上，呼吸急促，雨水和烟雾环绕四周。她直视镜头，散发出强烈的反派气场。风格：超写实电影级动作场面，融合《疾速追杀》、《攻壳机动队》和《赛博朋克2077》元素，戏剧性光影，好莱坞预告片能量，逼真的雨水物理效果，极致细节纹理，情感张力，变形宽银幕镜头，电影级动态模糊，体积烟雾，真实爆炸效果，浅景深，9:16竖屏病毒式TikTok美学。

en.p:
3D cartoon character; STYLE: High-end stylized 3D animated character, cinematic lighting, expressive face, polished materials, exaggerated but believable cute motion, heartwarming visual storytelling, Pixar-like warmth. WARDROBE: Tiny white chef apron with strawberry pattern in all shots, oversized chef hat in shots 1-12, hat replaced with small tilted party hat in shots 13-15. CHARACTER: Tiny round baby dragon, mint-green. scales with soft pink belly, huge sparkling amber eyes, two tiny wings, small round horns, chubby cheeks, the size of a teacup. ENVIRONMENT: Cozy cottage kitchen with warm wooden shelves, copper pots, flower windowsill, fairy lights, small dragon-sized stool. MOOD: Sweet, clumsy, hopeful, slightly chaotic, ending in pure tenderness and magic.

SHOT 1: ECU, 85mm push-in / Old recipe book opens itself, page shows "Mama's Birthday Cake" in glowing letters. SHOT 2: MCU, handheld 50mm/The baby dragon climbs onto the stool, peeks over the counter, whispers: "Okay. I can do this." SHOT 3: Detail close-up, 85mm / Tiny claws crack an egg but the whole egg falls in with the shell. SHOT 4: MCU, 50mm slide/He stares at the bowl, blinks twice, shrugs his little wings. SHOT 5: Top-down detail shot, 35mm/ He pours flour from a bag twice his size flour explodes everywhere, covers his face white.
SHOT 6: MCU, handheld 50mm / He sneezes a tiny puff of fire sparks fly, he gasps and covers his mouth with both paws. SHOT 7: Detail close-up, 85mm / The fire accidentally lights the oven. His eyes go wide with surprise. SHOT 8: MS, 50mm / He drags the heavy mixing bowl across the counter, tiny wings flapping desperately. SHOT 9: Detail close-up, 85mm /He pours pink batter into a heart-shaped pan, tongue sticking out in concentration. SHOT 10: MCU, 50mm push-in/He watches the oven through the glass, tail wagging slowly, eyes reflecting the warm orange light. SHOT 11: ECU, 85mm / A timer dings his ears perk up sharply. SHOT 12: MS, handheld 35mm / He pulls out a perfect tiny pink cake, gasps, whispers: "It worked!"
SHOT 13: MCU, 50mm / He decorates the cake with strawberries, places one tiny candle on top, lights it with a careful puff of fire. SHOT 14: WS, 24mm tracking / He carries the cake bigger than himself toward the door, balancing on tiptoes. SHOT 15: WS, 35mm slow push-in / Mama dragon's huge warm eyes appear in the doorway. She smiles. He whispers: "Happy birthday, Mama." She gently nuzzles him. The candle flickers softly.
en.t: Baby Dragon Bakes a Birthday Cake

zh.p: 3D卡通角色；风格：高端风格化3D动画角色，电影级布光，表情丰富，材质精致，夸张但可信的可爱动作，温馨的视觉叙事，皮克斯式的温暖。服装：所有镜头中均穿着带有草莓图案的白色小厨师围裙，第1-12个镜头中戴着超大厨师帽，第13-15个镜头中帽子换成一顶歪戴的小派对帽。角色：迷你圆滚滚的幼龙，薄荷绿色鳞片，柔软的粉色肚皮，巨大的闪亮琥珀色眼睛，两只小翅膀，小小的圆角，胖乎乎的脸颊，茶杯大小。环境：舒适的乡村厨房，有温暖的木质架子、铜锅、花窗台、仙女灯，以及一张小龙尺寸的小凳子。氛围：甜蜜、笨拙、充满希望、略带混乱，最终归于纯粹的温柔与魔法。镜头1：特写，85mm推镜/旧食谱书自动翻开，书页上显示发光的字迹“妈妈的生日蛋糕”。镜头2：中近景，手持50mm/小龙爬上凳子，偷看柜台，低声说：“好吧。我能做到。”镜头3：细节特写，85mm/小爪子打鸡蛋，但整个鸡蛋连壳一起掉进碗里。镜头4：中近景，50mm横移/它盯着碗，眨了两下眼，耸了耸小翅膀。镜头5：俯拍细节，35mm/它倒面粉时，袋子有它两倍大，面粉四处飞溅，把它的脸全弄白了。镜头6：中近景，手持50mm/它打了个喷嚏，喷出一小团火焰，火花飞溅，它倒吸一口气，用两只爪子捂住嘴。镜头7：细节特写，85mm/火焰意外点燃了烤箱。它惊讶地睁大了眼睛。镜头8：中景，50mm/它拖着沉重的搅拌碗在柜台上移动，小翅膀拼命扑腾。镜头9：细节特写，85mm/它把粉色面糊倒入心形烤盘，专注地伸出舌头。镜头10：中近景，50mm推镜/它透过玻璃看着烤箱，尾巴慢慢摇摆，眼睛里映着温暖的橙色光芒。镜头11：特写，85mm/计时器叮的一声，它的耳朵猛地竖起。镜头12：中景，手持35mm/它取出一个完美的粉色小蛋糕，倒吸一口气，低声说：“成功了！”镜头13：中近景，50mm/它用草莓装饰蛋糕，在上面放了一根小蜡烛，小心翼翼地喷出一口火焰点燃。镜头14：全景，24mm跟拍/它端着比自己还大的蛋糕走向门口，踮着脚尖保持平衡。镜头15：全景，35mm慢推/龙妈妈巨大的温暖眼睛出现在门口。她微笑着。它低声说：“妈妈，生日快乐。”她温柔地用鼻子蹭了蹭它。蜡烛轻轻摇曳。

en.p:
Cinematic 15-second racing film set at a professional circuit with Mount Fuji towering in the distant background at golden hour, gradually transitioning into a dramatic dusk atmosphere. The video consists of 15 rapid one-second shots with clean cuts and smooth visual flow.

Ultra-realistic racing environment with detailed asphalt textures, tire marks, heat haze, and high-performance vehicle design. The red race car features aggressive aerodynamic styling, sponsor decals, and reflective surfaces. The orange cat driver wears a gray racing suit covered in brand logos, exuding confidence and focus. Warm golden sunlight shifts into deeper cinematic tones, while bold Nike-style typography is embedded into the environment and motion. High-end commercial automotive cinematography style, consistent across all shots.

Shot List Sequence:

1. Aerial establishing shot of the racetrack with Mount Fuji in the distance, crowds gathering. Oversized faint typography embedded in the landscape: “DARE”.

2. Camera slowly forward glide through the pit lane — Gray cats in mechanic jumpsuits cheer loudly as the orange cat walks confidently toward a red race car.

3. Medium hero shot — the orange cat pauses beside the car, wind subtly moving fabric. Massive typography behind: “COURAGE”.

4. Close-up of the orange cat’s face — determined eyes, subtle sweat, reflected track lights. Micro-text overlays flicker across reflections.

5. Low-angle shot of the car door opening. The orange cat steps in. Text stretches along the ground perspective: “STEP IN”.

6. Interior cockpit POV — hands gripping the steering wheel, dashboard lights flicker to life. Minimal UI text: “FOCUS”.

7. Engine ignition — tight macro shot of vibration and revs. Typography pulses with the sound: “IGNITE”.

8. Hard cut to race start — multiple race cars launch forward. Tire smoke blends with fragmented kinetic text: “GO ALL IN”.

9. High-speed tracking shot alongside the red car. Motion blur streaks across the frame, elongated typography flows with speed: “NO LIMIT”.

10. Near-collision moment — razor-thin overtake. Camera shakes slightly. Text fractures dynamically: “RISK”.

11. Interior POV again — heavy breathing, intense steering corrections. Reflections of competitors flash across the visor. Subtle overlay: “HOLD”.

12. Wide cinematic shot — the red car drifts through a corner with Mount Fuji glowing in dusk light. Typography arcs across the sky: “CHASE THE DREAM”.

13. Final straight sprint — engine screaming, camera low and aggressive. Bold text embedded into track lines: “NEVER BACK DOWN”.

14. Finish line crossing — explosive moment. Lights flare. Typography locks hard: “VICTORY”.

15. Final hero shot — the orange cat leans against the red race car, holding a large trophy. One arm wraps around a white cat wearing a pink short dress. Around them, cheering animal fans in casual outfit
en.t: Racing Cat Dares at Fuji Circuit

zh.p: 一段15秒的电影级赛车短片，场景设定在专业赛道上，远处富士山在金色时刻高耸入云，随后逐渐过渡到戏剧性的黄昏氛围。视频由15个快速的一秒镜头组成，剪辑干净利落，视觉流动顺畅。超写实的赛车环境，包含细腻的沥青纹理、轮胎痕迹、热浪扭曲效果以及高性能车辆设计。红色赛车采用激进的空气动力学造型，带有赞助商贴纸和反光表面。橙色猫咪车手身穿布满品牌标志的灰色赛车服，神情自信专注。温暖的金色阳光逐渐转为更深沉的电影色调，同时耐克风格的粗体文字被嵌入环境和动态之中。高端商业汽车电影摄影风格，所有镜头保持一致。镜头列表顺序：1. 航拍定场镜头，展现赛道全景，远处富士山可见，人群聚集。景观中嵌入巨大的模糊文字：“敢”。2. 镜头缓缓向前滑过维修区——穿着机械师连体服的灰色猫咪们大声欢呼，橙色猫咪自信地走向一辆红色赛车。3. 中景英雄镜头——橙色猫咪在车旁停下，微风轻轻吹动织物。背景出现巨大文字：“勇气”。4. 橙色猫咪面部特写——坚定的眼神，细微的汗水，反射的赛道灯光。微小的文字叠影在反光中闪烁。5. 低角度镜头拍摄车门打开，橙色猫咪踏入车内。文字沿地面透视延伸：“踏入”。6. 驾驶舱内部主观视角——双手握紧方向盘，仪表盘灯光亮起。极简界面文字：“专注”。7. 引擎点火——紧凑的微距镜头展现震动和转速。文字随声音脉动：“点燃”。8. 硬切到比赛开始——多辆赛车同时冲出。轮胎烟雾与破碎的动态文字混合：“全力以赴”。9. 高速跟拍镜头与红色赛车并排。运动模糊划过画面，拉长的文字随速度流动：“无极限”。10. 险些碰撞的时刻——极限超车。镜头轻微晃动。文字动态碎裂：“冒险”。11. 再次内部主观视角——急促呼吸，激烈修正方向盘。竞争对手的倒影在面罩上闪过。微妙叠影：“坚持”。12. 宽幅电影镜头——红色赛车漂移过弯，富士山在暮光中闪耀。文字弧线划过天空：“追逐梦想”。13. 最后直道冲刺——引擎嘶吼，低角度激进镜头。粗体文字嵌入赛道标线：“永不退缩”。14. 冲过终点线——爆发时刻。灯光闪耀。文字锁定：“胜利”。15. 最终英雄镜头——橙色猫咪靠在红色赛车旁，手持一个大奖杯。一只手臂搂着一只穿着粉色短裙的白色猫咪。周围是穿着休闲服的欢呼动物粉丝。

raw_p:
Cinematic 15-second racing film set at a professional circuit with Mount Fuji towering in the distant background at golden hour, gradually transitioning into a dramatic dusk atmosphere. The video consists of 15 rapid one-second shots with clean cuts and smooth visual flow.

Ultra-realistic racing environment with detailed asphalt textures, tire marks, heat haze, and high-performance vehicle design. The red race car features aggressive aerodynamic styling, sponsor decals, and reflective surfaces. The orange cat driver wears a gray racing suit covered in brand logos, exuding confidence and focus. Warm golden sunlight shifts into deeper cinematic tones, while bold Nike-style typography is embedded into the environment and motion. High-end commercial automotive cinematography style, consistent across all shots.

Shot List Sequence:

1. Aerial establishing shot of the racetrack with Mount Fuji in the distance, crowds gathering. Oversized faint typography embedded in the landscape: “DARE”.

2. Camera slowly forward glide through the pit lane — Gray cats in mechanic jumpsuits cheer loudly as the orange cat walks confidently toward a red race car.

3. Medium hero shot — the orange cat pauses beside the car, wind subtly moving fabric. Massive typography behind: “COURAGE”.

4. Close-up of the orange cat’s face — determined eyes, subtle sweat, reflected track lights. Micro-text overlays flicker across reflections.

5. Low-angle shot of the car door opening. The orange cat steps in. Text stretches along the ground perspective: “STEP IN”.

6. Interior cockpit POV — hands gripping the steering wheel, dashboard lights flicker to life. Minimal UI text: “FOCUS”.

7. Engine ignition — tight macro shot of vibration and revs. Typography pulses with the sound: “IGNITE”.

8. Hard cut to race start — multiple race cars launch forward. Tire smoke blends with fragmented kinetic text: “GO ALL IN”.

9. High-speed tracking shot alongside the red car. Motion blur streaks across the frame, elongated typography flows with speed: “NO LIMIT”.

10. Near-collision moment — razor-thin overtake. Camera shakes slightly. Text fractures dynamically: “RISK”.

11. Interior POV again — heavy breathing, intense steering corrections. Reflections of competitors flash across the visor. Subtle overlay: “HOLD”.

12. Wide cinematic shot — the red car drifts through a corner with Mount Fuji glowing in dusk light. Typography arcs across the sky: “CHASE THE DREAM”.

13. Final straight sprint — engine screaming, camera low and aggressive. Bold text embedded into track lines: “NEVER BACK DOWN”.

14. Finish line crossing — explosive moment. Lights flare. Typography locks hard: “VICTORY”.

15. Final hero shot — the orange cat leans against the red race car, holding a large trophy. One arm wraps around a white cat wearing a pink short dress. Around them, cheering animal fans in casual outfit

en.p:
Cinematic hyper-realistic 14-second night launch of a NASA Space Shuttle at Kennedy Space Center, photorealistic 8K, dramatic lighting, wet reflective concrete pad, epic scale, filmic color grading, no text, no logos.
0-2 seconds: Wide static establishing shot of the full Space Shuttle stack (white orbiter with black heat tiles, massive orange external tank, two white SRBs) standing vertically on the launch pad next to the tall metal tower under a deep dark blue night sky. Subtle ambient lights, calm before ignition.
2-4 seconds: Sudden violent ignition — three main engines and two SRBs fire simultaneously with blinding orange-white flames and explosive clouds of thick white smoke + steam from the water deluge system erupting from the base. Camera cuts to intense low-angle close-up of the roaring engines and orbiter belly, fire and dense smoke rapidly filling the frame, ground shaking, dramatic orange glow reflecting on wet pad.
4-6 seconds: Extreme low-angle close-up on the engines and lower orbiter/external tank as the flames intensify and massive billowing smoke clouds swirl and expand violently upward, thick white vapor pouring out, intense heat distortion, cinematic orange illumination lighting the entire structure from below.
6-8 seconds: Camera pulls back to medium-wide low-angle shot as the shuttle begins to slowly lift off the pad; enormous golden-orange fire and expanding smoke clouds engulf the launch tower base, brilliant reflections on the wet ground, raw power visible.
8-10 seconds: Dramatic wide shot of the Space Shuttle clearing the tower and rising majestically into the night sky; massive expanding clouds of fire and thick white/orange smoke billow outward across the entire pad, tower lit dramatically by the engine glow, epic ascent beginning.
10-12 seconds: Dynamic low-angle tracking shot from below the ascending shuttle, focusing on the three blazing engine nozzles and SRBs producing powerful blue-white exhaust plumes, smoke continuing to surge upward, shuttle gaining altitude against the dark sky.
12-14 seconds: Final wide heroic shot of the fully ascending Space Shuttle climbing higher into the night, surrounded by enormous glowing clouds of smoke and fire that light up the launch complex, dramatic reflections, sense of immense power and scale as it continues its powerful vertical climb.
Style: Hyper-realistic, photorealistic details, intense contrast between dark night and blazing exhaust, cinematic camera movement with slight Dutch angles and smooth tracking, epic and emotionally powerful, no voiceover.

zh.p: 电影级超写实14秒NASA航天飞机在肯尼迪航天中心夜间发射，照片级8K画质，戏剧性光影，湿漉漉的反光混凝土发射台，史诗级规模，电影调色，无文字无标志。0-2秒：广角静态定场镜头，展示完整的航天飞机组合体（白色轨道器配黑色隔热瓦、巨大的橙色外部燃料箱、两枚白色固体火箭助推器）垂直矗立在发射台上，紧邻高耸的金属塔架，背景是深邃暗蓝的夜空。微弱的氛围灯光，点火前的宁静。2-4秒：突然的剧烈点火——三台主发动机和两枚固体火箭助推器同时喷发，刺眼的橙白色火焰和爆炸性浓密白烟+水淋系统喷出的蒸汽从基座喷涌而出。镜头切换至强烈的低角度特写，聚焦轰鸣的发动机和轨道器腹部，火焰和浓烟迅速填满画面，地面震动，戏剧性的橙色光芒映照在湿漉漉的发射台上。4-6秒：极低角度特写发动机和轨道器/外部燃料箱下部，火焰愈发猛烈，巨大的翻滚烟云剧烈向上旋转扩散，浓密白色蒸汽喷涌而出，强烈的热浪扭曲，电影般的橙色照明从下方照亮整个结构。6-8秒：镜头拉远至中广角低角度镜头，航天飞机开始缓慢离开发射台；巨大的金橙色火焰和扩散的烟云吞没发射塔基座，湿地上闪耀着灿烂的反光，原始力量尽显。8-10秒：戏剧性广角镜头，航天飞机脱离塔架，庄严地升入夜空；巨大的火焰和浓密白/橙色烟云在整个发射台向外翻涌，塔架被发动机光芒戏剧性地照亮，史诗般的升空开始。10-12秒：动态低角度跟拍镜头，从上升的航天飞机下方拍摄，聚焦三台喷焰的发动机喷嘴和固体火箭助推器产生强劲的蓝白色尾焰，烟雾继续向上翻涌，航天飞机在暗色天空中不断升高。12-14秒：最终广角英雄式镜头，完全升空的航天飞机在夜空中攀升更高，被巨大的发光烟云和火焰环绕，照亮整个发射场，戏剧性的反光，展现其持续强力垂直攀升时无与伦比的威力和规模。风格：超写实，照片级细节，暗夜与炽热尾焰的强烈对比，电影级运镜配合轻微荷兰角和平滑跟拍，史诗级且情感充沛，无旁白。

en.p: Fixed Camera Angle (Unchanged): Shot 1: On the keyboard lying on the floor, the CTRL and C keys are pressed simultaneously; the banknote floating in mid-air gives a slight flutter, after which the keys return to their original position and remain still. Shot 2: The CTRL and V keys on the floor-mounted keyboard are pressed simultaneously once, causing a single U.S. dollar bill to randomly float into the air; pressing them again adds another dollar bill—a sequence repeated a total of five times. en.p: Cinematic film still, hyperrealistic. Subject: A humanoid robot, more humanoid in face structure — slightly softer facial geometry but clearly mechanical, seated at a lab workstation. Face has layered polymer panels over a steel substructure, eyes currently dim with a warm amber/blue mixed glow just initiating startup. Expression: Blank, resting — neutral startup state, subtle asymmetry in one eye light suggesting partial boot sequence. Clothing/Surface: Matte pearl-white chest panels with exposed metallic rib structure underneath, forearm plating in brushed steel, finger joints delicate and human-proportion. Action: Head slightly tilted down at 5 degrees, hands resting flat on desk — a posture of dormancy about to break. Primary Light: Warm amber practical light from a desk lamp at the right — soft falloff across the robot's chest. Secondary Light: Cold blue neon strip behind the server rack, casting a rim light on the robot's left shoulder and jaw. Atmosphere: Hazy warm-cold contrast, subtle smoke/vapor near server vents. Background: Dense lab environment — whiteboards with equations, circuit trays, blinking blue server status lights, cabling overhead. Color Grade: Warm amber midtones with cool blue edge tones | Slightly lifted blacks. Camera: Slightly low eye-level, medium shot — torso and face fully visible, 50mm cinematic lens. Vibes: Westworld meets Her meets Prometheus. Not CGI, photoreal cinematic.

zh.p: 电影级静帧画面，超写实风格。主体：一个类人机器人，面部结构更接近人类——面部几何轮廓稍显柔和，但明显带有机械特征，正坐在实验室工作台前。面部由层压聚合物面板覆盖在钢制骨架之上，双眼此刻呈暗淡状态，正泛起暖琥珀色与冷蓝色交织的启动微光。表情：空白、静止——中性启动状态，其中一只眼睛的光线存在细微不对称，暗示着部分启动进程。服装/表面：哑光珍珠白胸板，下方露出金属肋状结构，前臂覆盖拉丝钢面板，手指关节精致且比例接近人类。动作：头部微微低垂5度，双手平放于桌面——一种即将打破的休眠姿态。主光源：右侧台灯投射的暖琥珀色实用光，柔和地漫射在机器人胸部。辅助光：服务器机架后方的冷蓝色霓虹灯带，在机器人左肩与下颌处勾勒出轮廓光。氛围：朦胧的冷暖对比，服务器通风口附近有细微烟雾/蒸汽。背景：密集的实验室环境——白板上写满方程式、电路托盘、闪烁蓝色状态灯的服务器、头顶密布的线缆。色调：暖琥珀色中间调搭配冷蓝色边缘色调 | 轻微提亮的暗部。镜头：略低于视平线，中景——躯干与面部完全可见，50mm电影镜头。氛围：《西部世界》遇见《她》再遇《普罗米修斯》。非CGI，照片级电影质感。

Visuals: Professional multi-camera broadcast sequence — start with wide high-angle tracking shot following the puck, quick cut to side medium shot of players stickhandling and battling along the boards, fast skate into offensive zone, dramatic shot on goal with goalie save and ice spray explosion, subtle handheld camera shake during intensity, crowd standing and cheering, perfect character consistency, realistic physics on skates/puck/sticks, authentic broadcast color grading and lens effects.

On-screen graphics: Live-updating scorebug (TOR 3 - BOS 2, time counting down), player stats pop-ups, channel logo top-right, lower-third ticker.

Audio & Dialogues (synchronized perfectly with action, energetic sports commentator style, clear male voices, background arena noise):
- 0-3s (wide tracking shot): Play-by-play announcer (excited, fast): "Here we go! Matthews with the puck, entering the zone... he drops it back to Nylander!"
- 3-7s (board battle + shot): Color commentator (deeper voice): "Oh what a battle along the boards! Boston trying to clear but Toronto's forecheck is relentless... wrist shot! Save by Ullmark!"
- 7-10s (after save, crowd roar): Play-by-play: "Big save! The Maple Leafs keep the pressure on... crowd is on their feet here at Scotiabank Arena!"
- Background: Loud arena crowd roar building, ice skate scratches, puck impacts, stick clacks, faint on-ice player shouts ("Pick it up!", "Screen!").

Photorealistic broadcast quality, 1080p 60fps, perfect lip-sync if any close-ups, no AI artifacts, maximum realism, cinematic sports documentary style.

zh.p: 将参考图像_1制作成一段15秒的动态超写实NHL冰球联赛电视转播片段。视觉效果：专业多机位转播序列——从广角高角度跟拍冰球开始，快速切换至侧方中景镜头，展现球员控球及沿板墙拼抢，快速滑入进攻区，戏剧性的射门得分场景，门将扑救并激起冰屑爆炸，激烈时刻手持镜头轻微晃动，观众起立欢呼，角色一致性完美，冰刀/冰球/球杆物理效果真实，转播级调色与镜头特效。屏幕图形：实时更新的比分条（多伦多枫叶3-波士顿棕熊2，倒计时），球员数据弹窗，右上角频道标志，底部滚动字幕。音频与对话（与动作完美同步，充满活力的体育解说风格，清晰的男声，背景场馆噪音）：- 0-3秒（广角跟拍镜头）：实况解说员（兴奋、语速快）：'来了！马修斯控球，进入区域……他回传给尼兰德！'- 3-7秒（板墙拼抢+射门）：色彩评论员（低沉嗓音）：'哦，板墙边真是激烈！棕熊队试图解围，但枫叶队的前场逼抢毫不松懈……腕射！乌尔马克扑救！'- 7-10秒（扑救后，观众欢呼）：实况解说：'关键扑救！枫叶队持续施压……斯科舍银行球馆的观众们全都站起来了！'- 背景：场馆内震耳欲聋的欢呼声渐强，冰刀刮擦声，冰球撞击声，球杆碰撞声，冰上球员模糊喊声（'接住！''挡拆！'）。照片级转播画质，1080p 60帧，特写镜头唇形同步完美，无AI伪影，极致真实感，电影级体育纪录片风格。

en.p:
A 24-year-old archivist wrapped in layered winter garments with frost-covered eyelashes and pale skin races through a frozen cathedral complex in the first two seconds as a towering ice entity forms behind her from collapsing arches and frozen pillars, its body composed of crystalline structures and swirling snow, instantly cracking stained glass windows into cascading shards, and the entire sequence flows forward without pause as she runs through icy corridors, collapsing staircases, frozen bridges, and echoing halls while the entity pursues in segmented motion, reforming itself through shattered ice, launching spear-like shards across the environment, and freezing surfaces instantly in its path, forcing her to slide across ice floors, leap between collapsing platforms, and weave through falling debris.

Rendered with hyper-detailed ice simulation, volumetric fog, cold blue lighting, visible breath vapor, and subtle lens bloom on crystalline edges, the camera stays tight in pursuit with sudden wide reveals showing the entity’s size and structural destruction, and at the climax, as she reaches a massive frozen gate, the entire cathedral fractures at once, suspended for a split second before collapsing in a cascading avalanche of ice.
en.t: Frozen Cathedral Chase: Ice Entity Pursuit

zh.p: 一名24岁的档案管理员裹着层层冬衣，睫毛结霜、面色苍白，在最初两秒内疾速穿过一座冰封的教堂建筑群——身后，崩塌的拱门与冻结的立柱间升起一个由晶体结构与旋转雪花构成的巨型冰霜实体，瞬间将彩绘玻璃窗震裂成飞溅的碎片。整个镜头一气呵成：她奔过冰封走廊、坍塌楼梯、冻结桥梁与回响大厅，而冰霜实体以分段式运动追击，通过碎裂的冰层重组自身，向四周投掷长矛般的冰晶碎片，所过之处瞬间冻结地表。她被迫滑过冰面、在崩塌平台间跳跃、穿梭于坠落的碎石中。画面采用超精细冰面模拟、体积雾、冷蓝色调光影、可见的呼吸白雾，以及晶体边缘的微妙镜头光晕；摄像机紧追不舍，时而突然拉远展现冰霜实体的体型与建筑结构的毁灭性破坏。高潮处，当她抵达一扇巨大的冰封大门时，整座教堂同时碎裂，悬停一瞬后如冰崩般倾泻坍塌。

en.p: A magnificent cinematic royal wedding arrival sequence set at night under a blazing sky of fireworks. The setting is a grand palatial Indian wedding venue — a sweeping marble courtyard lined with towering brass oil torches burning bright orange, rows of marigold garlands strung between ornate pillars, and hundreds of wedding guests dressed in vivid jewel-toned traditional attire lining both sides of a wide ceremonial path, clapping and cheering with euphoric energy. The star of the scene: a stunning pure white Arabian horse, immaculately groomed, its mane braided with fresh jasmine flowers, marigold strings, and tiny golden bells. The horse is draped in an elaborate hand-embroidered red and gold ceremonial cloth fitted with dangling gold tassels and jeweled ornaments that catch torchlight with every step. Riding atop is the groom dressed in a regal ivory sherwani with heavy gold zardozi embroidery, a crimson turban adorned with a jeweled brooch and cascading white floral sehra veil hanging over his face, gold mojri shoes gleaming. He sits tall and proud, one hand on the reins, expression radiating joy and confidence. Overhead the sky is absolutely alive — massive fireworks exploding in cascading gold, crimson, electric blue, and silver bursts, each one reflecting off the marble ground below in shimmering pools of color. Smoke trails drift across the sky between explosions. Sparklers in the hands of guests light the pathway on both sides like a river of stars. Camera movement is dynamic and cinematic throughout — sweeping, dramatic, full of grandeur and energy. CUT 1 (0–4s): Wide aerial establishing shot — the full courtyard from above, the white horse at the far end beginning its procession down the torch-lit path, fireworks exploding overhead painting the sky in gold and crimson, hundreds of guests visible on both sides. CUT 2 (4–8s): Ground-level medium tracking shot — camera moves alongside the horse at eye level, capturing the groom's proud posture, the horse's decorated chest and bobbing floral mane, marigold garlands swaying, guests cheering and throwing flower petals into the path ahead, fireworks bursting directly overhead. CUT 3 (8–12s): Low dramatic angle from directly in front — camera at ground level looking up at the horse and groom advancing toward the lens, massive firework explosion erupting behind and above them, silhouetting the groom in a halo of gold and white light, torches blazing on either side like a corridor of fire. CUT 4 (12–15s): Slow-motion extreme close-up medley — the horse's hooves stepping on petal-strewn marble in slow motion → groom's hand adjusting the reins, gold embroidery catching firelight → groom's eyes behind the sehra, warm and emotional → final wide pull-back as the grandest firework of all explodes across the entire sky, flooding the scene in pure golden light. Style: Cinematic Bollywood grandeur meets Natio

zh.p: 一场壮丽的电影式皇家婚礼入场场景，发生在夜晚，漫天烟花绽放。背景是一座宏伟的印度宫殿式婚礼场地——宽阔的大理石庭院两侧排列着高大的黄铜油灯，燃烧着明亮的橙色火焰；装饰柱之间悬挂着一串串万寿菊花环；数百名身着鲜艳宝石色调传统服饰的婚礼宾客分列在宽阔的仪式通道两旁，充满狂喜地鼓掌欢呼。场景的主角是一匹 stunning 的纯白色阿拉伯马，毛发梳理得完美无瑕，鬃毛上编着新鲜的茉莉花、万寿菊花环和小金铃。马身上披着精美手工刺绣的红金色仪式布，垂挂着金色流苏和珠宝装饰，每一步都映照着油灯的光芒。骑在马上的新郎身着华丽的象牙色谢尔瓦尼，上面有厚重的金色扎尔多齐刺绣，头戴深红色头巾，饰有珠宝胸针，垂下的白色花帘面纱遮住脸庞，金色莫杰里鞋闪闪发光。他坐得挺拔而自豪，一只手握着缰绳，表情洋溢着喜悦和自信。头顶的天空充满生机——巨大的烟花爆炸成金色、深红、电蓝和银色的瀑布，每一束光芒都反射在大理石地面上，形成闪烁的色彩池。爆炸之间，烟雾轨迹飘过天空。宾客手中的烟花棒照亮了通道两侧，宛如一条星星之河。镜头运动全程充满动感和电影感——扫视、戏剧化、宏伟而充满能量。镜头1（0-4秒）：广角空中定场镜头——从上方俯瞰整个庭院，白色马匹在远处开始沿着油灯照亮的通道行进，烟花在头顶爆炸，将天空染成金色和深红，两侧可见数百名宾客。镜头2（4-8秒）：地面水平中景跟踪镜头——镜头与马匹齐平移动，捕捉新郎骄傲的姿态、马匹装饰的胸部和摇摆的花卉鬃毛、摇曳的万寿菊花环、宾客欢呼并将花瓣抛向前方道路，烟花在头顶直接绽放。镜头3（8-12秒）：低角度戏剧性镜头，从正前方拍摄——镜头在地面水平仰视马匹和新郎向镜头走来，巨大的烟花在他们身后和上方爆发，将新郎笼罩在金色和白色的光环中，两侧油灯燃烧如火焰走廊。镜头4（12-15秒）：慢动作极端特写混合——马蹄慢动作踩在铺满花瓣的大理石上→新郎的手调整缰绳，金色刺绣映照着火光→新郎在面纱后的眼睛，温暖而充满情感→最后广角拉远，最盛大的烟花在整个天空爆炸，将场景淹没在纯金色的光芒中。风格：电影式宝莱坞的壮丽与民族风情的结合。

en.p:
(0s–4s)
A peaceful afternoon inside a warm sunlit room. The girl sits near a large window while soft sunlight pours across the floor. A fluffy orange cat slowly walks toward her. She notices the cat and smiles gently. The cat rubs against her hand as she softly pets its head. Floating dust particles glow in the sunlight creating a dreamy atmosphere.
Camera: slow cinematic dolly-in, soft focus background, close-up shots of hands touching fur
Mood: calm, heartwarming, peaceful

 (4s–8s)
The girl plays with the cat using a small ribbon toy. The cat jumps around energetically across the wooden floor while she laughs naturally. Her hair moves softly as she leans forward chasing the cat playfully. The cat suddenly runs across the couch and she follows while smiling brightly.
Camera: handheld cinematic movement mixed with slow motion cat jumps
Mood: lively, joyful, genuine connection.

(8s–12s)
The energy slows down. The girl lies on the floor beside the cat while the cat curls near her shoulder. She gently scratches under its chin while looking at it lovingly. The cat closes its eyes peacefully. Warm sunset light fills the room with orange and golden tones.
Camera: intimate close-ups, soft side profile shots, shallow depth of field
Mood: emotional, comforting, soft cinematic warmth.

(12s–16s)
The girl carries the cat toward the window while city lights begin glowing outside during blue hour. The cat rests calmly in her arms. She looks outside, then toward the camera with a soft smile. Final cinematic freeze-frame feeling as the cat lightly touches her cheek with its paw.
Camera: slow orbit shot ending in cinematic close-up
Mood: wholesome, emotional, memorable ending.

zh.p:
（0-4秒）午后暖阳透过窗棂洒满木地板，女孩静坐窗边。一只橘色胖猫缓步靠近，她含笑垂眸，轻抚猫咪毛茸茸的脑袋。阳光中浮尘轻舞，氤氲出梦幻氛围。镜头：电影级慢推镜头，柔焦背景，特写指尖抚过绒毛。氛围：恬静治愈，暖意融融。
（4-8秒）女孩抖动着缎带逗猫，猫咪在木地板上雀跃扑腾，她笑靥如花。俯身追逐时发丝轻扬，猫咪忽地跃上沙发，她眉眼弯弯紧随其后。镜头：手持跟拍与慢动作猫跃交织。氛围：生机盎然，满溢欢愉。
（8-12秒）时光渐缓。女孩侧卧在地，猫咪蜷缩肩头。她轻挠猫咪下颌，目光缱绻。猫咪安然阖眼，暮色将房间染成琥珀色。镜头：亲密特写，侧颜柔光，浅景深。氛围：温情脉脉，如诗如画。
（12-16秒）华灯初上时分，女孩抱猫走向窗边。猫咪温顺依偎怀中，她望向窗外，转而对镜头浅笑。猫咪肉垫轻触她脸颊的瞬间定格成永恒。镜头：环绕慢镜收束于电影级特写。氛围：治愈入心，余韵悠长。

Vertical cinematic anime sci-fi sequence, 9:16 aspect ratio, ultra-fluid animation, premium anime movie quality, highly detailed futuristic world design, cinematic lighting, atmospheric depth, smooth realistic motion, immersive next-generation anime game aesthetic, 60fps feeling.

World Design: A floating futuristic city above the clouds during nighttime. Massive glowing towers, holographic advertisements, transparent sky bridges, flying vehicles, energy rails, floating islands, glowing waterfalls, and massive moonlight reflections. The environment feels alive with moving lights, rain particles, mist, and distant traffic in the sky.

Main Character: A futuristic anime boy with messy black hair and glowing cyan eyes, wearing a long techwear coat with illuminated blue patterns, fingerless gloves, dark cargo pants, and magnetic sneakers. His outfit reacts naturally to wind and movement. Hair physics and facial consistency are highly realistic anime quality.

Camera Style: Cinematic third-person tracking camera with smooth motion and dynamic angle changes. Slight handheld realism during movement scenes. Soft motion blur during fast actions. Advanced anime HUD visible with holographic interface elements, energy bar, radar system, and glowing objectives.

Sequence:

0–3s
The character runs across a glowing sky bridge high above the city while flying vehicles rush past beneath him. Rain particles and neon reflections move naturally across the environment.

3–6s
He jumps from the bridge toward a floating platform while activating glowing energy blades from his arms. Time slows briefly during the mid-air movement as holographic particles surround him.

6–8s
The character lands smoothly on a floating rooftop and slides forward while avoiding security drones scanning the area with red laser lights.

8–10s
Massive cinematic reveal shot. The camera pulls far back showing the endless floating cyber city while the character stands calmly at the edge looking over the glowing skyline beneath the moonlight. Wind moves his coat dramatically as neon lights flicker across the environment.

Style & Quality: Premium anime film rendering, futuristic sci-fi atmosphere, cinematic action trailer quality, detailed environmental storytelling, realistic anime movement, advanced lighting, immersive world depth, polished AAA anime aesthetic.

Negative Prompt: blurry animation, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, stiff movement, broken hands, low detail, ugly lighting, floating objects, low fps, clipping, bad textures, shaky camera, unrealistic physics, oversaturated colors, poor face consistency

zh.p: 垂直电影级动漫科幻片段，9：16画幅比例，超流畅动画，顶级动漫电影品质，高度精细的未来世界设计，电影级光影，氛围深度，平滑逼真的动态，沉浸式次世代动漫游戏美学，60帧流畅感。世界设计：夜晚云端之上的悬浮未来都市。巨大的发光塔楼、全息广告、透明空中桥梁、飞行器、能量轨道、浮空岛屿、发光瀑布以及巨大的月光倒影。环境充满生机，流动的灯光、雨滴粒子、薄雾以及远处天空中的车流交织。主角：一位未来风格的动漫少年，黑色凌乱头发，发光的青色眼眸，身穿带有发光蓝色图案的长款科技外套，无指手套，深色工装裤，以及磁力运动鞋。他的服装会随风和动作自然摆动。头发物理效果和面部一致性达到高度逼真的动漫品质。镜头风格：电影级第三人称追踪镜头，运动平滑，角度动态变化。运动场景中带有轻微手持摄影的真实感。快速动作时伴有柔和动态模糊。可见高级动漫HUD，包含全息界面元素、能量条、雷达系统和发光目标。序列：0-3秒 角色在发光的空中桥梁上奔跑，下方飞行车辆疾驰而过。雨滴粒子和霓虹反射在环境中自然流动。3-6秒 他从桥梁跳向浮空平台，同时激活手臂上的发光能量刃。空中动作时时间短暂放缓，全息粒子环绕周身。6-8秒 角色平稳降落在浮空屋顶上，向前滑行，同时躲避用红色激光扫描区域的安保无人机。8-10秒 宏大的电影级揭示镜头。镜头大幅拉远，展现无尽的赛博都市，角色平静地站在边缘，俯瞰月光下闪耀的天际线。风吹动他的外套，霓虹灯光在环境中闪烁。风格与品质：顶级动漫电影渲染，未来科幻氛围，电影级动作预告片品质，细致的环境叙事，逼真的动漫动作，先进光影，沉浸式世界深度，精良的AAA级动漫美学。负面提示：模糊动画、扭曲解剖、多余肢体、僵硬动作、破损手掌、低细节、丑陋光影、漂浮物体、低帧率、穿模、劣质纹理、抖动镜头、不真实物理、过饱和色彩、面部一致性差

en.p:
Style: Cinematic realism, fast-paced editing, warm tungsten kitchen lighting, energetic handheld camera movement, shallow depth of field, dramatic sound design with comedic tension, cozy late-night atmosphere.

0–3s — The Craving Begins
A tired young man opens the fridge at midnight. Cold blue fridge light illuminates his exhausted face. Nearly empty shelves—only eggs, cheese, and leftover noodles remain. A quiet stomach growl echoes in the silent apartment.

3–6s — Cooking Frenzy
Rapid-fire cuts: pan slamming onto the stove, butter sizzling aggressively, knife chopping at high speed, noodles tossed into the air. Handheld camera shakes slightly with the movement. Steam and warm light flood the kitchen.

6–10s — Disaster Moment
Oil flares up unexpectedly. He freezes in panic. Spoon drops in dramatic slow motion. Toast nearly burns while chaotic music spikes. Fast cuts between smoke, frantic movements, and widening eyes create comedic tension.

10–13s — Masterpiece Reveal
Suddenly, silence. Beautiful cinematic close-up of spicy cheesy noodles perfectly plated. Steam rises slowly in warm golden kitchen light. Camera lingers like a luxury food commercial.

13–15s — Final Bite Victory
He takes one bite and instantly relaxes with relief. Slow push-in shot as city lights glow softly through the kitchen window behind him. Lo-fi music fades in gently while the midnight chaos finally settles.

He takes one bite and instantly relaxes with relief. Slow push-in shot as city lights glow softly through the kitchen window behind him. Lo-fi music fades in gently while the midnight chaos finally settles.

en.p: Photorealistic cinematic, ARRI Alexa, anamorphic lens, warm tungsten light, dust-lit windows, shallow DOF, 35mm grain. In an old library, a stern elderly librarian removes her glasses and dives headfirst into an ancient book. She punches through the page, shrinks to matchstick size, and sprints between giant ink letters. A paper airplane made from torn pages flies past; she jumps on and rides it across a vast text landscape while dodging erupting ink blots, falling pens, and warped magnified zones. Entering the book’s gutter canyon, floating letters and ink rain surround her in dreamy slow motion. The airplane disintegrates; she grabs a flying quill and rides it like a broomstick, carving ink trails across the page. Finally, she rockets upward through the paper, returning full-size into the real library, landing perfectly beside her desk. She calmly closes the book, picks up her glasses, and gives a subtle confident smile as a single ink droplet falls onto the desk.

zh.p: 电影级逼真画面，ARRI Alexa摄影机，变形镜头，暖色钨丝灯光，尘埃弥漫的窗户，浅景深，35毫米胶片颗粒感。在一座古老图书馆里，一位严肃的年长图书管理员摘下眼镜，一头扎进一本古籍中。她穿透书页，缩成火柴棍大小，在巨大的墨字之间飞奔。一架由撕下的书页折成的纸飞机掠过，她跳上去，骑着它飞越浩瀚的文字景观，同时躲避喷涌的墨渍、掉落的钢笔和扭曲的放大区域。进入书脊的峡谷沟壑，漂浮的文字和墨雨在梦幻般的慢镜头中环绕着她。纸飞机解体，她抓住一支飞行的羽毛笔，像骑扫帚一样骑着它，在书页上划出墨迹轨迹。最后，她如火箭般冲破纸张，恢复原大小回到现实中的图书馆，稳稳落在书桌旁。她平静地合上书，拿起眼镜，露出一丝自信的微笑，一滴墨水恰好滴落在桌面上。

en.p: 10 seconds, 16:9, anime-style 3D cartoon animation. A street corner at night after school. Soft neon lights and street lamps. A youthful romantic comedy atmosphere. The woman from Image 1 stands in the foreground. She has a slightly tsundere attitude, looking away with an expression that says, 'It's not like I...' She lightly crosses her arms and pouts to hide her embarrassment. Behind her, the woman from Image 2 rapidly moves left and right at a fast pace, teasing the red-haired girl. For each line of dialogue, she repeats the pattern: 'fast movement → sudden stop → cute pose.' 0–2 seconds: The woman from Image 2 pops her face out from behind the right side of the woman from Image 1. 'Oh, really~' She covers her mouth with one hand, grinning mischievously while leaning forward. With her other hand, she wiggles her finger as if to say, 'You're busted~' After speaking, she quickly moves to the left. 2–4 seconds: The woman from Image 2 now pops her face out energetically from the left side of the woman from Image 1, saying, 'Saying that...' She spreads both arms and shrugs her shoulders. Then, she points one hand at the woman from Image 1 and winks playfully. Her hair and ribbon sway dramatically. 4–6 seconds: The woman from Image 2 quickly moves directly behind the woman from Image 1. 'The truth is, about that guy...' She brings her face close over the shoulder of the woman from Image 1, wearing a meaningful, mischievous grin. She clasps her hands in front of her chest and sways her body slightly left and right. The woman from Image 1 looks down, her body trembling. 6–10 seconds: Finally, the woman from Image 2 pops out from beside the woman from Image 1, saying, 'You're curious about him, aren't you?' She looks up with a smile and makes a large 🫶 hand sign with both hands. She then brings her face closer and freezes in a cute, deliberately charming pose. The woman from Image 1 can't take it anymore, blushes, and protests with her eyes closed, 'Th-that's wrong!' The movements are in an exaggerated 3D cartoon animation style. 'Slow entry and exit' + 'fast middle section.' The poses are distorted with a swoosh-like effect between them. Camera: Dynamic character tracking. Slight panning to follow the blue-haired woman's left and right movements. Close-ups on faces during poses. Quick, rhythmic cuts. Motion design: Shoulders, hips, and legs move in coordination to express emotions through the whole body. Hair, skirt, and ribbon sway dramatically. Comical yet high-quality Japanese animation. Effects: Light afterimages and wind pressure during fast movements. Sharp line effects along the motion trajectory. Brief slow-motion during poses.

zh.p: 10秒、16:9、动画风格3D卡通动画。夜晚放学后的街角。柔和的霓虹灯与路灯。青春恋爱喜剧般的氛围。图1的女性站在画面近处。她略带傲娇地移开视线，表情仿佛在说“我才没有……”。她轻轻交叉双臂，嘟起嘴试图掩饰害羞。在她身后，图2的女性一边快速左右移动，一边调侃红发的她。每句台词都重复“高速移动→瞬间静止→可爱定格姿势”的动作。0-2秒：图2的女性从图1女性的右后方探出头来。“又来了～”她一手掩嘴，坏笑着前倾身体。另一只手像在说“被发现了哦～”般轻轻摆动手指。说完后高速移动到左侧。2-4秒：图2的女性这次从图1女性的左后方猛地探出头，“嘴上这么说～”她张开双手耸肩。接着用一只手指着图1的女性，调皮地眨眼。头发和蝴蝶结大幅摆动。4-6秒：图2的女性高速移动到图1女性的正后方。“其实啊，你明明——”图2的女性从图1女性的肩旁凑近脸，露出意味深长的坏笑。双手在胸前交握，身体左右轻摇。图1的女性低头，身体微微颤抖。6-10秒：最后图2的女性从图1女性的旁边蹦跳着探出身子，“是在意那家伙吧？”她抬眼微笑，双手比出大大的🫶手势。接着凑近脸，摆出可爱又做作的定格姿势。图1的女性终于忍不住脸红，闭眼抗议道：“才、才不是！”动作采用夸张的3D卡通动画风格。“缓慢的进入与退出”+“中间的高速化”。姿势之间以嗖的一声扭曲变形过渡。镜头：动态跟随角色。随着蓝发女性的左右移动轻微平移。定格姿势时切换为面部特写。节奏明快地切换镜头。动作设计：联动肩、腰、腿，用全身表达情感。头发、裙子、蝴蝶结大幅摆动。滑稽且高品质的日本动画。特效：高速移动时带有轻微残影和风压。动作轨迹上添加锐利的线条特效。定格姿势时加入短暂的慢动作。

raw_p:
10秒、16:9、アニメ調3Dカートゥーンアニメーション。  
夜の学校帰りの街角。柔らかなネオンと街灯。青春ラブコメ風の空気感。  

画像1の女性が画面手前に立っている。  
少しツンとした態度で視線をそらしながら、「私は別に……」と言いたげな表情。  
腕を軽く組み、照れを隠すように口を尖らせる。  

その後ろで、画像2の女性が、テンポよく左右へ高速移動しながら赤髪の彼女をからかう。  
各セリフごとに「高速移動 → ピタッと静止 → 可愛い決めポーズ」を繰り返す。  

0〜2秒:  
画像2の女性が画像1の彼女の右後ろから、ぴょこんと顔を出す。  
「またまた〜」  
片手を口元に当て、ニヤニヤ笑いながら身体を前に倒す。  
もう片方の手で“バレてるよ〜”というように指をフリフリ.  
言い終わると、高速で左側へ移動。  

2〜4秒:  
画像2の女性が今度は画像1の女性の左後ろから勢いよく顔を出し、  
「そんなこと言って」  
両手を広げて肩をすくめるジェスチャー。  
さらに片手で画像1の女性を指差しながら、いたずらっぽくウインク。  
髪とリボンが大きく揺れる。  

4〜6秒:  
画像2の彼女が画像1の彼女のすぐ後ろへ高速移動。  
「ホントはアイツのこと」  
画像2の女性は画像1の女性の肩越しに顔を近づけ、意味深なニヤニヤ笑顔。  
両手を胸の前で組み、身体を左右に小さく揺らす。  画像1の女性はうつむき、体をプルプルとふるわせている。

6〜10秒:  
最後は画像2の女性が画像1の彼女の横からぴょこんと飛び出し、  
「気になってるんじゃないの？」  
と上目遣いでニコッと笑いながら、両手で大きな🫶ハンドサイン。  
そのまま顔を近づけ、あざと可愛い決めポーズで静止。  
画像1の彼女は耐えきれず赤面し、画像2の彼女に向かって「ち、ちがう！」と目を閉じて抗議する

動きは誇張された3Dカートゥーンアニメ調。  
「ゆっくりした入りと抜き」＋「中間の高速化」。  
ポーズ間をビュンと歪ませるように崩す。  

カメラ：  
ダイナミックなキャラ追従。  
青髪の彼女の左右移動に合わせて軽くパン。  
決めポーズ時は顔のアップ。  
テンポよくカット切り替え。  

動作設計：  
肩・腰・脚を連動させ、全身で感情表現。  
髪、スカート、リボンが大きく揺れる。  
コミカルかつ高品質な日本アニメーション。  

エフェクト：  
高速移動時に軽い残像と風圧。  
動きの軌跡にシャープなラインエフェクト。  
決めポーズ時に短いスローモーション。

en.p: Speak the lines quickly and at a good pace. Don't take too long pauses. Girlfriend: 'What do you want for dinner?' Boyfriend: 'Anything is fine.' Girlfriend: 'Then how about pasta?' Boyfriend: 'Not in the mood for that today.' Girlfriend: 'Japanese food?' Boyfriend: 'A bit heavy.' Girlfriend: 'A café?' Boyfriend: 'That's not enough.'

zh.p: 台词要说得语速稍快、节奏紧凑。不要停顿太久。 她：“晚饭想吃什么？” 男友：“随便。” 她：“那意面呢？” 男友：“今天不太想吃那个。” 她：“日式料理？” 男友：“有点腻。” 她：“去咖啡馆？” 男友：“那吃不饱。”

セリフは早口気味でテンポよく言う。長い間を取りすぎない。

彼女「夜ごはん何がいい？」
彼氏「なんでもいいよ」
彼女「じゃあパスタ？」
彼氏「今日はそんな気分じゃない」
彼女「和食？」
彼氏「ちょっと重い」
彼女「カフェ？」
彼氏「それは足りない」

Reference rules:
Use the uploaded person image as the ONLY face and identity reference.
Preserve the uploaded person’s facial identity, overall likeness, hairstyle, hair color, and general appearance.
Use the uploaded person image as the ONLY outfit reference.
Keep the outfit based on the uploaded person’s clothing throughout the entire video, preserving the overall design, silhouette, layering, colors, patterns, fabric feel, and styling details.
The model in the video must consistently wear the uploaded person’s outfit in every shot.

---

0–2s — HOOK / INTIMATE IMPACT
Extreme close-up of her lips very near the camera, handheld and slightly shaky. Soft ASMR whisper in English: “Hey… look.” Breath slightly audible. Instantly cut with a loud rock guitar drop.

2–4s — IMPACT CUTS / ENERGY BURST
Rapid-fire cuts synced to drums. Full-body shot: she stands casually wearing the exact outfit from the uploaded person reference, hands in pockets if suitable for the outfit. Side profile shot with a soft confident smile. Hair brushes across her face in slow motion. She looks into the camera and whispers in English: “But you like it, don’t you?” End with a sharp flash frame and final snap zoom freeze-frame with an air kiss.

en.p:
Style: Soft cinematic realism, cozy café atmosphere, warm natural window lighting, shallow depth of field, aesthetic minimalism, dreamy slow motion, intimate feminine elegance, ambient coffee shop soundscape with rain and soft jazz undertones.

0–3s — Quiet Entrance
A stylish girl steps into a cozy coffee shop on a rainy morning. Soft diffused window light wraps gently around her face. Natural makeup, oversized sweater, subtle confidence. Background hum of conversation and espresso machine steam creates a warm atmosphere.

3–6s — Small Elegant Moments
Close-up shots: fingers tucking hair behind ear, steam rising from a fresh cup of coffee, delicate jewelry catching soft light. Slow-motion glance toward rain-streaked windows. Gentle jazz blends with café ambience.

6–9s — Cinematic Details
Aesthetic micro-cuts: coffee pouring into a ceramic cup, notebook pages turning slowly, spoon reflections warping light, eyelashes blinking in golden highlights. Subtle handheld camera movement for an intimate, lived-in feel.

9–12s — Calm Confidence
She takes a slow sip of coffee and smiles faintly. Natural light brightens across the table. Background crowd remains softly blurred. Her calm presence contrasts the busy city outside the rain-covered glass.

12–15s — Dreamlike Ending
Slow-motion exit: she stands, coat shifting gently as she leaves. Warm café lights glow behind her. Final lingering shot on the half-finished coffee cup as rain continues outside, fading into a peaceful cinematic close.

zh.p:
风格：柔和的电影写实主义，温馨咖啡馆氛围，温暖的窗边自然光，浅景深，极简美学，梦幻慢动作，亲密的女性优雅，伴有雨声和轻柔爵士乐的咖啡馆环境音。
0-3秒——安静入场：一个时尚的女孩在一个雨天的早晨走进一家温馨的咖啡馆。柔和的漫射窗光轻轻包裹着她的脸庞。自然的妆容，宽松的毛衣，微妙的自信。背景中交谈声和咖啡机蒸汽声营造出温暖的氛围。
3-6秒——优雅小瞬间：特写镜头：手指将头发别到耳后，新鲜咖啡杯上升起的蒸汽，精致的首饰捕捉柔和光线。慢动作望向雨痕斑驳的窗户。轻柔的爵士乐与咖啡馆环境音交融。
6-9秒——电影感细节：美学微剪：咖啡倒入陶瓷杯，笔记本书页缓缓翻动，勺子反射扭曲光线，睫毛在金色高光中眨动。微妙的持机手部运动，营造亲密而真实的感觉。
9-12秒——平静自信：她慢慢啜饮一口咖啡，微微一笑。自然光在桌面上亮起。背景人群保持柔和虚化。她平静的存在与窗外雨幕覆盖的繁忙城市形成对比。
12-15秒——梦幻结尾：慢动作离开：她起身，外套随动作轻轻摆动。温暖的咖啡馆灯光在她身后闪烁。最后镜头停留在半杯咖啡上，窗外雨继续下着，渐渐淡入宁静的电影式结尾。
zh.t: 雨日咖啡馆的优雅瞬间

en.p: A hyper-realistic live-action commercial, 15 seconds, 16:9, 480p, cinematic, high quality, natural colors, film-like lighting. Overall tone: a stylish, bright, and lively world like an Italian bar. BGM is a light and sophisticated Italian espresso jazz (accordion + piano + light percussion). Emphasizes morning freshness and happiness. Characters: a Japanese woman, 25 years old, living alone, natural and cute, slightly messy bed hair, light makeup, loungewear (simple and clean clothes). Reference: image of a canned coffee (Image 1: completely reproduce the design and texture of this can). Scene composition: ① (0-4 seconds) Morning in a Japanese 1K room. A small kitchen with soft morning sunlight. On a slightly lived-in table, a can of coffee (same as reference image). The woman wakes up sleepily and naturally picks up the can. The camera slowly dollies in, cinematic. ② (4-7 seconds) The moment the woman opens the can with a 'pssh' is beautifully emphasized in slow motion. Not carbonated, but the opening moment creates an effect like aromatic steam. Sound: the opening sound is pleasantly emphasized. ③ (7-13 seconds) ★Main scene (longer, more vibrant). The moment it opens, the space seamlessly transforms. The Japanese kitchen, enveloped in light, changes into a glamorous Italian bar: cobblestones, colorful buildings, an espresso machine, a showcase of bread and sweets, lively people (smiling, chatting), warm and bright sunlight. The camera follows the spatial change in a smooth single shot (transition is magically natural). The woman is surprised, then quickly turns to a happy expression. She takes a sip of the canned coffee: looks truly delicious, natural and cute smile, slightly squints her eyes in a happy reaction. Combines slow motion and normal speed to emphasize happiness. Light is golden, soft, and beautiful. ④ (13-15 seconds) The canned coffee floats in the air, slowly rotating (a premium product shot). The front label of the can is always controlled to face the camera. Beautiful reflections, lighting, highlights. The background is a slightly blurred Italian streetscape. Narration (young female voice, bright and light): 'Open it, and it's Italy! Via Espresso.' Additional specifications: prioritize live-action quality (eliminate CG feel). Skin, light, shadows, reflections all realistic. Camera work is smooth and cinematic. Use depth of field appropriately. Colors are warm, evoking appetite and happiness. Overall, visual expression that conveys the aroma.

zh.p:
超リアリスティックな実写CM、15秒、16:9、480p、シネマティック、高品質、自然な色彩、映画のようなライティング 
■全体トーン イタリアのバールのようなおしゃれで明るく活気のある世界観 BGMは軽快で洗練されたイタリア風エスプレッソジャズ（アコーディオン＋ピアノ＋軽いパーカッション） 朝の爽やかさと幸福感を強調 
■登場人物 日本人女性、25歳、一人暮らし、ナチュラルで可愛らしい、寝起きの少しラフな髪、薄いメイク、部屋着（シンプルで清潔感のある服） 
■参照 缶コーヒーの画像 Image 1 （この缶のデザイン・質感を完全に再現すること） 
■シーン構成 
①（0〜4秒） 日本の1Kの部屋の朝 柔らかい朝日が差し込む小さなキッチン 少し生活感のあるテーブルの上に缶コーヒー（参照画像と同じ） 女性が眠そうに起きてきて、自然な動作で缶コーヒーを手に取る カメラはゆっくりと寄り（ドリーイン）、シネマティック 
②（4〜7秒） 女性が缶コーヒーをプシュッと開ける瞬間をスローモーションで美しく強調 炭酸ではないが、開封の瞬間に香りの蒸気のような演出 音：開封音を気持ちよく強調
 ③（7〜13秒）★メインシーン（長め・華やか） 開けた瞬間、空間がシームレスに変化 日本のキッチンが、光に包まれながらイタリアの華やかなバールへ変わる ・石畳 ・カラフルな建物 ・エスプレッソマシン ・パンやスイーツが並ぶショーケース ・活気ある人々（笑顔・会話） ・暖かく明るい太陽光 カメラはスムーズなワンカットで空間変化を追う（トランジションは魔法のように自然） 女性は驚き→すぐに嬉しそうな表情に変わる 女性が缶コーヒーを一口飲む →本当に美味しそうに、自然で可愛い笑顔 →少し目を細めて幸せそうなリアクション スローモーションと通常速度を組み合わせ、幸福感を強調 光はゴールデンで柔らかく、美しく 
④（13〜15秒） 缶コーヒーが空中に浮かび、ゆっくり回転（高級感あるプロダクトショット） 缶の正面ラベルが常にカメラに向くよう制御 美しい反射、ライティング、ハイライト 背景はややボケたイタリアの街並み 
■ナレーション（若い女性の声、明るく軽やか） 「開けたら、イタリア♪ ビア エスプレッソ」
■追加指定 ・実写クオリティを最優先（CG感を排除） ・肌、光、影、反射すべてリアル ・カメラワークは滑らかで映画的 ・被写界深度を適切に使用 ・色は暖かく食欲と幸福感を引き出す ・全体に“香りが伝わるような映像表現”

Title: Luxury Desert Villa Sunrise — Golden Calm Morning 🏜️✨

Style: Ultra-realistic cinematic luxury, soft golden tones, calm minimal aesthetic, high-end architectural photography, slow motion, shallow depth of field, warm natural light.

0–3s — Desert Awakening
Wide aerial shot of a luxury desert villa surrounded by endless dunes. Early sunrise light slowly rises over the horizon, soft wind moves across the sand.

3–6s — Interior Glow
Cut to a modern open villa interior: sunlight streams through large glass walls. Curtains gently move, casting soft shadows on marble floors and elegant furniture.

6–9s — Calm Morning Ritual
Close-up cinematic shots: coffee being poured into a cup, steam rising in golden light. A hand opens sliding glass doors revealing the desert view.

9–12s — Pool Reflection
Infinity pool reflects the rising sun. Water ripples slowly, mirroring the golden sky and desert landscape. Palm shadows move softly.

12–15s — Peaceful Ending
A figure stands quietly on the terrace, facing the sunrise. Wind flows gently as the camera slowly pulls back, fading into warm golden light.

en.p:
Static camera pointing down at a Nokia phone with flipped-out QWERTY keyboard matching the phone in the uploaded image, resting on a check-beige checkered tea towel inside a closed bread container with a curved transparent plastic dome on a kitchen countertop surrounded by soft indoor light shadows.

The phone begins a complex mechanical transformation into a miniature bipedal robot, roughly same volume as the Nokia phone. The illuminated glitchy screen brightens and expands upward to form the robot’s head and chest plate, while the display shifts into glowing eye-like structures. The flipped-out keyboard divides and swings outward to become articulated shoulders and arms with mechanical fingers, the main body chassis lifts and separates, and the lower section unfolds downward into powerful metallic legs with visible hydraulic joints and intricate moving parts. Maintaining the phone’s classic Nokia design language with glossy black and silver panels, refined metallic textures, and subtle branding details. The transformation is seamless and highly detailed, with precise moving parts and realistic mechanical motion.

The robot looks up curiously at the curved plastic dome of the bread container, and walks on the tea towel causing tiny creases under its footsteps.
en.t: Nokia Phone Transforms into Mini Robot

zh.p: 静态摄像头俯拍一部诺基亚手机，其翻盖式QWERTY键盘与上传图片中的手机一致，手机搁在厨房台面上一个带弧形透明塑料罩的封闭面包容器内，下方垫着米色格纹茶巾，周围环绕着柔和的室内光影。手机开始进行复杂的机械变形，化为与诺基亚手机体积相当的微型双足机器人。发着故障闪烁光芒的屏幕向上延展并增亮，形成机器人的头部与胸甲，显示屏随之转化为发光的眼部结构。翻盖键盘分裂并向外旋转，成为带机械手指的铰接式肩臂；主机身底盘抬升分离，下部向下展开为强健的金属双腿，液压关节与精密活动部件清晰可见。整体延续诺基亚经典设计语言——亮黑与银色面板、精炼金属质感、细微品牌标识细节。变形过程无缝衔接且细节丰富，部件运动精准，机械动作逼真。机器人好奇地仰视面包容器的弧形塑料罩，在茶巾上行走时，脚下压出细小的褶皱。
zh.t: 诺基亚手机变形机器人

en.p:
Style: Found footage, grainy 35mm home security camera footage.

Camera: Static, wide-angle lens, locked-off tripod perspective.

Lighting: Flat, natural indoor daylight coming from two large windows in the background.

Atmosphere: Raw, mundane, realistic suburban home environment with hardwood floors, brown sofas, and a bookshelf.

Audio: low-quality microphone hiss, loud structural wood snapping, and metallic impacts.

 [ENVIRONMENT & CHARACTER DESCRIPTION]

The scene is a messy living room. A large, starburst-shaped white paint spill covers the center of the hardwood floor. A silver metal ladder lies fallen across the paint.

Character 1: A man in a plain white t-shirt and dark jeans, barefoot.

Character 2: A man with messy hair wearing red and black flannel pajamas.

Character 3: A large, grey hippopotamus in a white porcelain clawfoot bathtub.

[TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND]

0-3s: [Wide Shot] The man in the white t-shirt is seen hanging desperately from a white drum pendant light fixture. The fixture rips violently from the ceiling with plaster debris. The man falls directly into the white paint puddle with realistic splashing physics.

[Sound] Sharp metallic snap, heavy wet thud.

3-7s: [Wide Shot] A massive 4-foot section of the ceiling completely collapses. A second man, seated at a dark wooden upright piano, falls through the hole from the floor above. The piano slams into the floor, emitting a loud, dissonant musical chord.

[Physics] Volumetric dust and white plaster chunks fill the air. 

7-10s: [Medium Shot] The piano man sits among the wreckage, looking dazed and confused, glancing side-to-side.

[Sound] Muffled coughing and the clicking of settling debris. 

10-14s: [Wide Shot] Another massive section of the ceiling gives way. A full-sized porcelain bathtub containing a live hippopotamus crashes into the center of the room. A massive wave of water splashes across the sofas and floor.

[Sound] Explosive wet crash followed by a deep, guttural hippo grunt.

14-15s: [Closing Shot] Static shot of the total wreckage. The hippo remains in the tub, blinking slowly. The camera remains perfectly still.

[Sound] Water dripping and a low-frequency electronic hum.

zh.p: 风格：伪纪录片风格，颗粒感35毫米家庭安防摄像头画面。镜头：固定机位，广角镜头，三脚架锁定视角。光线：平淡的自然室内日光，来自背景中两扇大窗户。氛围：原始、平凡、逼真的郊区家庭环境，铺有硬木地板，摆放着棕色沙发和一个书架。音频：低质量麦克风嘶嘶声，响亮的木质结构断裂声和金属撞击声。[环境与角色描述] 场景是一个凌乱的客厅。硬木地板中央有一大片星爆状白色油漆污渍。一把银色金属梯子横倒在油漆上。角色1：一名身穿纯白T恤和深色牛仔裤、赤脚的男人。角色2：一名头发凌乱、身穿红黑格子法兰绒睡衣的男人。角色3：一只灰色大 hippopotamus，位于白色陶瓷爪足浴缸中。[时间线逐秒描述] 0-3秒：[广角镜头] 穿白T恤的男人绝望地悬挂在一个白色鼓形吊灯装置上。装置猛烈地从天花板撕裂，带着石膏碎片。男人直接落入白色油漆水坑中，溅起逼真的水花。[声音] 尖锐的金属断裂声，沉重的湿闷撞击声。3-7秒：[广角镜头] 天花板上一大块4英尺长的区域完全坍塌。第二名男子，坐在一架深色木制立式钢琴前，从楼上地板上的洞口坠落。钢琴猛撞地板，发出响亮、不和谐的和弦声。[物理效果] 充满空气的体积灰尘和白色石膏块。7-10秒：[中景镜头] 钢琴男坐在废墟中，神情恍惚困惑，左右张望。[声音] 闷闷的咳嗽声和碎片沉降的咔嗒声。10-14秒：[广角镜头] 天花板另一大块区域塌陷。一个装满活 hippopotamus 的全尺寸陶瓷浴缸砸入房间中央。一大波水溅到沙发和地板上。[声音] 爆炸性的湿重撞击声，随后是深沉、粗哑的 hippopotamus 咕噜声。14-15秒：[结束镜头] 静态镜头展示完全废墟。hippopotamus 仍留在浴缸中，缓慢眨眼。摄像头保持完全静止。[声音] 水滴声和低频电子嗡嗡声。

[4-8s]: Medium shot, locked tripod. She slowly raises the cigarette to her lips to take a drag. Soft key lighting from 45 degrees, 35mm film aesthetic.

en.p: Stop motion claymation, handcrafted tactile materials, mixed real materials, — continuous lateral tracking shot, the camera gliding alongside the subject at her own walking pace, macro photography depth of field. The piece opens at a forest pond in deep mossy greens under soft morning light and ends on a city sidewalk under cold tungsten glow. [cut] A tiny clay duckling, soft with real yellow down, waddles along the muddy shore of a forest pond, real dried reeds and real felt lily pads beside it, real moss underfoot; the body gives a soft shiver and a few yellow feathers loosen at the back, drifting onto the mud behind it. [cut] Mid-stride the body has lengthened, real yellow down still clinging to the chest while real brown-and-white pheasant feathers spread across the back and tail, the orange clay beak darkening to a deeper amber, the muddy shore giving way to a forest path of real dried oak leaves under the webbed feet. [cut] Now a fully grown clay duck — real felt webbed feet pressing into the leaves while the legs draw upward like slow-pulled clay strings over an exposed copper wire armature, the spine lifting, two soft tufts of real blonde human hair pushing through the skull around the still-orange clay beak, the path fading into a moss-edged suburban verge. [cut] Standing tall on thin clay shins, the orange beak half-retracted and softening into clay flesh that swells into puffy lips, the remaining pheasant feathers slipping downward along the body and unspooling into threads of real pink silk that weave themselves around the waist as a fitted mini dress takes shape, the verge dissolving into a sidewalk of real grey cardboard with painted rain sheen. [cut] A clay woman strides onto the city sidewalk in the finished real pink silk mini dress, real tiny pink leather high-heels clicking softly on the cardboard pavement, the glossy lips quietly swelling another half-size as she walks, painted miniature shopfronts dissolving into a cool tungsten haze behind her. [cut] She stops in front of a shop window — the camera holds steady — she raises a tiny clay smartphone, purses her lips into a duck-face pose for a selfie, and the lips keep inflating in real time, swelling and rebounding gently with every soft click of the shutter until they cover the lower half of her face, her eyes still smiling, her body unmoving, deadpan.
en.t: Clay Duckling Transforms into City Woman

zh.p:
定格黏土动画，手工触感材料，混合真实材质——连续横向跟拍镜头，摄像机以角色步行的速度平行滑行，微距摄影景深。开场于森林池塘，深苔绿色笼罩在柔和的晨光中，结尾在城市人行道，冰冷的钨丝灯光下。

【切换】一只小小的黏土小鸭，身上附着真实的黄色绒毛，摇摇摆摆地走在森林池塘的泥泞岸边，身旁是真实的干芦苇和毛毡睡莲叶，脚下是真实的苔藓；身体轻轻一颤，几根黄色羽毛从后背松动，飘落在身后的泥地上。

【切换】迈步途中，身体拉长，真实的黄色绒毛仍贴在胸前，而真实的棕白相间雉鸡羽毛铺满后背和尾巴，橙色黏土喙逐渐加深成琥珀色，泥泞的岸边让位于一条森林小径，蹼足下是真实的干橡树叶。

【切换】现在是一只完全长成的黏土鸭子——真实的毛毡蹼足踩进树叶中，双腿像缓慢拉起的黏土线一样向上提起，露出铜线骨架，脊柱抬起，两缕真实的金色人类头发从头骨中钻出，环绕着仍是橙色的黏土喙，小径渐渐淡入长满苔藓的郊区路缘。

【切换】细长的黏土小腿上站直身体，橙色喙半缩回去，软化成黏土肌肤，膨胀成丰满的嘴唇，剩余的雉鸡羽毛顺着身体滑落，散成真实的粉色丝线，缠绕在腰间，一件合身的迷你裙逐渐成形，路缘溶解成真实的灰色纸板人行道，表面涂有雨水的光泽。

【切换】一位黏土女性穿着完工的粉色真丝迷你裙，大步走在城市人行道上，真实的粉色小皮鞋在纸板路面上轻轻咔嗒作响，她边走边让光泽的嘴唇悄悄再膨胀半号，身后绘制的微型店铺橱窗渐渐消散在冰冷的钨丝光雾中。

【切换】她在商店橱窗前停下——摄像机保持稳定——她举起一个小小的黏土智能手机，噘起嘴唇摆出鸭子嘴造型自拍，嘴唇在实时中不断膨胀，随着每一次快门轻响，温柔地鼓起又弹回，直到覆盖住她下半张脸，她的眼睛仍在微笑，身体一动不动，面无表情。

[cut] She stops in front of a shop window — the camera holds steady — she raises a tiny clay smartphone, purses her lips into a duck-face pose for a selfie, and the lips keep inflating in real time, swelling and rebounding gently with every soft click of the shutter until they cover the lower half of her face, her eyes still smiling, her body unmoving, deadpan.

en.p:
ULTRA-REALISTIC CINEMATIC VIKING RAID - STORMY COASTAL AMBUSH
Style: Grounded historical gritty realism, photorealistic, handheld 35mm feel, natural gloomy coastal light, raw human movement, physically accurate combat. Preserving the same fatigued English shieldman consistently across every shot: same rugged face, same tattered tunic over chainmail, same crude shield, same rain-slicked mud, and high-stress exhaustion.
Setting: A rocky, rain-soaked Saxon coastal village under heavy, overcast skies. Drifting mist. Drenching rain. Longships landed on the pebble beach. Village structures begin to ignite, smoke mixing with fog. Chaos as raiders clash with the local militia.
SHOT 1 - OVERHEAD DRONE ESTABLISHING SHOT Cold, desaturated wide shot looking down on the village. Rain-slicked paths. Longships pulled high on the shore. Figures fighting in clusters near burning thatched roofs. Distant screams. Smoke drifts toward the sea. Cinematic scale emphasizing the chaotic spread of the raid.
SHOT 2 - HANDHELD MEDIUM SHOT (THE PROTOTAGONIST) Low angle, moving handheld shot focusing on the tired Saxon shieldman. The camera moves backward, struggling to keep him framed as he moves through knee-deep mud. He is exhausted, gasping for air, dodging past panicking villagers. Sweat and rain streak his face. His chainmail clinks heavily. He keeps his crude, round wooden shield raised high, deflecting an unseen arrow. His expression is weary but resolved.
He barks a panicked command: "Form up! To the church! Move!"
SHOT 3 - POV TRACKING SHOT (CHAOS) From his perspective (POV), moving rapidly through the village. Blades clash. A raider lunges—he brings his shield down hard (impact felt in the camera shake). He splashes through puddles, the reflection of a burning roof visible. The sound design is immersive: heavy breathing, rain, mud sucking at boots, the clang of steel.
SHOT 4 - LOW ANGLE, SIDE PROFILE SHOT Running parallel to him as he hits the main line. He slams his shield into a Viking raider, the impact vibrating through his entire body. The camera captures the raw physics: shoulders bracing, feet slipping on the slick grass, teeth clenched in exertion. The depth of field is shallow, blurring the frantic combat happening just feet behind him.
He shouts over the din: "Hold the line! For England!"
SHOT 5 - CLOSE UP, REACTION SHOT A sudden whistle. He flinches. An arrow thumps deep into his shield. He glances down, eyes wide with adrenaline, then snaps his gaze forward. Time seems to slow slightly. A Viking berserker, screaming, ax raised, locks eyes with him from across the melee.
SHOT 6 - OVER-THE-SHOULDER, THE CLIMAX The berserker charges. The shieldman braces, planting his feet in the mud. The camera is close behind his shoulder. The impact is visceral—the ax embeds itself into the upper rim of his shield. He staggers but holds his ground, raising his seax (short sword) in defense. The gri

zh.p:
超写实电影级维京突袭——暴风雨海岸伏击战
风格：基于历史真实感的粗粝现实主义，照片级真实感，手持35毫米胶片质感，自然阴郁的海岸光线，原始的人类动作，物理精确的战斗。每个镜头中保持同一名疲惫的英格兰盾兵形象：同一张饱经风霜的面孔，同一件锁子甲外破烂的束腰外衣，同一面粗糙的盾牌，同一片被雨水浸透的泥泞，以及高压下的疲惫。
场景：一个岩石遍布、被雨水浸透的撒克逊沿海村庄，天空阴沉厚重。薄雾飘荡。大雨倾盆。长船停泊在卵石滩上。村庄建筑开始燃烧，烟雾与雾气交织。突袭者与当地民兵混战，一片混乱。
镜头1——无人机俯拍定场镜头
冷色调、低饱和度的广角镜头俯瞰村庄。雨水浸透的小径。长船被拖上高高的海岸。燃烧的茅草屋顶附近，人影成簇搏斗。远处传来尖叫声。烟雾向海面飘散。电影级画面强调突袭蔓延的混乱场面。
镜头2——手持中景镜头（主角）
低角度、移动的手持镜头聚焦于疲惫的撒克逊盾兵。摄像机向后移动，艰难地将他框入画面，他正穿过齐膝深的泥泞。他筋疲力尽，大口喘气，躲避着惊慌的村民。汗水与雨水顺着他的脸颊流下。锁子甲沉重地叮当作响。他高举粗糙的圆形木盾，挡开一支看不见的箭。他的表情疲惫但坚定。他惊慌地吼道：“列阵！去教堂！快！”
镜头3——主观跟踪镜头（混乱）
从他的视角快速穿过村庄。刀剑碰撞。一名突袭者猛扑过来——他用力压下盾牌（撞击感通过摄像机抖动体现）。他踏过水坑，水面倒映着燃烧的屋顶。音效设计沉浸感十足：沉重的呼吸声、雨声、泥泞吸住靴子的声音、钢铁的碰撞声。
镜头4——低角度侧面特写镜头
与他平行移动，他冲入主战线。他将盾牌猛撞向一名维京突袭者，冲击力震动全身。摄像机捕捉到真实的物理反应：肩膀抵住，双脚在湿滑的草地上打滑，牙齿因用力而紧咬。景深较浅，模糊了他身后仅几步之遥的激烈战斗。他在喧嚣中喊道：“守住战线！为了英格兰！”
镜头5——特写反应镜头
突然传来一声呼啸。他猛地一缩。一支箭深深扎入他的盾牌。他低头看去，因肾上腺素而睁大眼睛，随即目光锐利地向前扫视。时间仿佛略微放慢。一名维京狂战士，尖叫着，高举战斧，在混战中与他四目相对。
镜头6——过肩镜头，高潮
狂战士冲锋而来。盾兵稳住身形，双脚在泥泞中站定。摄像机紧贴他的肩膀后方。冲击感强烈——战斧嵌入他盾牌的上缘。他踉跄了一下，但稳住了脚步，举起短刀（撒克逊短剑）防御。画面定格于此。

3–7秒 — 拆包装的满足感
切换至微距特写镜头。双手缓慢拆开巧克力包装。强调ASMR包装纸声音（清脆、真实）。柔和的暖色小彩灯反射在巧克力表面，随着巧克力露出，镜头缓缓推进，呈现令人满足的细节。氛围：感官体验，舒适核心，令人平静的TikTok ASMR风格。

7–11秒 — 第一口的逃离
慢动作电影级特写。她咬了一口巧克力。背景柔和虚化（浅景深）。她的表情变化：从压力转为舒适。闭上眼睛，肩膀放松。暖光绽放效果，柔和电影级照明，自然发丝飘动。氛围：情感释放，舒适食物带来的逃离感，病毒式慢动作反应。

11–15秒 — Z世代收尾
回到手持自拍角度。轻微镜头晃动以增加真实感。她对着镜头微笑，将巧克力靠近镜头。屏幕文字：“这能解决一切 🍫✨”她发出一个自然的轻笑。最后一帧定格在她微笑的脸上，霓虹光晕、柔和胶片颗粒感和温馨灯光。氛围：令人满意的病毒式结尾，relatable 的Z世代收尾，适合TikTok的定格画面。

超写实，UGC网红风格，TikTok病毒式剪辑，舒适卧室美学，霓虹粉紫灯光，电影级手持镜头，ASMR细节聚焦，情感叙事，零食核心美学，柔和胶片颗粒，浅景深，自然皮肤纹理。

Style: Cinematic slice-of-life realism, soft natural lighting, handheld documentary feel, shallow depth of field, subtle emotional tone, ambient grocery store soundscape, slow-motion everyday highlights, grounded realism.

0–3s — Entrance Calm
A shopper pushes a cart through automatic sliding doors into a busy grocery store. Soft chime as doors open. Warm indoor lighting replaces the outside world. Background crowd movement slightly blurred, calm yet alive atmosphere.

3–6s — Choosing Moments
Close-up shots of hands selecting fresh fruit, gently pressing items, comparing labels on shelves. Subtle slow motion on small decisions. Other shoppers pass in soft focus. Cart wheels roll smoothly over polished floors.

6–9s — Human Chaos Rhythm
Aisles become busier. People cross paths naturally, carts pass closely in narrow spaces. A child reaches excitedly for snacks. A brief shared pause as two shoppers hesitate in the same aisle, then continue moving.

9–12s — Checkout Pressure
At the counter, items scan in rapid rhythm. Repeating barcode beeps create a steady tempo. Quick cuts of wallet opening, phone payments, subtle impatience and tired expressions in line. Realistic store noise builds layered texture.

12–15s — Quiet Exit Moment
Groceries are handed over in final bag. The shopper steps outside. Warm sunlight hits the face instantly. Store noise fades into distant hum as the door closes behind—ordinary routine dissolving into a quiet cinematic ending.
