zh.p: 超写实电影级动作片段，时长15秒，快速剪辑。一位身着旧风衣的坚毅女子在雨夜中狂奔于40层高楼的屋顶，脚下是霓虹闪烁的城市。镜头1[0-2秒]：极微距特写——她猛然睁眼，瞳孔扩张，红色应急灯光倒映其中，额间汗珠，浅景深，手持微颤。镜头2[2-4秒]：超广角低空无人机视角——她从通风井跃下，风衣在慢镜头中翻飞，下方浓雾弥漫，城市光斑虚化，变形镜头光晕。镜头3[4-6秒]：快速横向跟拍，斜角镜头——她转身冲向屋顶边缘，三名武装人员出现在身后，浅焦处理，背景中敌人模糊。镜头4[6-8秒]：120帧幻影慢镜头特写——她徒手抓住磨损的钢缆，指节泛白，子弹火花擦过缆绳，金色实用光爆裂，电影级动态模糊。镜头5[8-10秒]：空中眩晕俯冲——她荡出边缘，在两座玻璃摩天楼间自由坠落，下方城市网格闪烁，戏剧性拉远镜头，纯粹电影眩晕感。镜头6[10-12秒]：侧面中景——她撞上玻璃天窗，蛛网状裂纹实时扩散，她翻滚起身不停歇，实用碎裂特效，尘埃粒子。镜头7[12-14秒]：缓慢推进过肩镜头——她回头一瞥，下颌紧绷，眼神冰冷而坚定，城市雾气飘过画面。镜头8[14-15秒]：骤黑切镜——她进入黑暗楼梯间，门砰然关闭。照片级真实，8K分辨率，变形宽银幕2.39:1画幅，青橙色调，暗部压黑，高光褪色，实用霓虹反射光，红色应急灯，杜比视界HDR，全程雨景特效，湿滑表面镜面反射，电影级音效设计。

en.p: High-tension horror sequence inside a brightly lit 24-hour laundromat at night. Rows of industrial washing machines, fluorescent lighting, reflective tiled floor, vending machines humming softly. Sound: washing machine hum, distant traffic outside, phone scrolling taps, slowly interrupted by violent metallic banging. Shot 1 (0–3s): A young woman sits alone in the laundromat scrolling on her phone while several washing machines run behind her. Suddenly— All the machines begin vibrating unnaturally at the same time. Coins rattle. Lights flicker slightly. She slowly looks up. Shot 2 (3–6s): The vibrations intensify into loud metallic BANGS from inside the machines. One machine violently shakes side to side. Then another. Green-tinted water suddenly begins leaking out beneath the doors, spreading across the floor. She stands up nervously: “What… what is happening?” Shot 3 (6–9s): The camera slowly circles around her as more machines begin slamming violently from inside. The laundromat now echoes with distorted screeching noises mixed with the banging. Green liquid floods across the tiles. Shot 4 (9–12s): One washing machine door suddenly POPS open. A grotesque wet creature crawls out. Then another machine opens. Then another. More creatures emerge one by one from different machines around her, dripping green slime onto the floor. She slowly backs away in panic as the camera continues orbiting around her. Shot 5 (12–15s): All the creatures suddenly stop moving. Silence for half a second. Then every creature simultaneously SCREAMS and charges toward her from every direction across the laundromat. She panics and stumbles backward— the creatures leap— cut to black.

zh.p: 深夜，一间灯火通明的24小时自助洗衣店内上演着高度紧张的恐怖场景。成排的工业洗衣机、荧光灯管、反光瓷砖地面、低声嗡鸣的自动售货机。声音：洗衣机的嗡鸣声、远处街道的车流声、手机滑动点击声，突然被暴力的金属撞击声打断。镜头1（0-3秒）：一名年轻女子独自坐在洗衣店内刷手机，身后几台洗衣机正在运转。突然——所有机器同时开始不自然地剧烈震动。硬币哗啦作响。灯光微微闪烁。她缓缓抬起头。镜头2（3-6秒）：震动升级为机器内部传出的巨大金属撞击声。一台洗衣机猛烈左右摇晃。接着是另一台。泛着绿光的水突然从机门下方渗出，在地板上蔓延开来。她紧张地站起身：“这……这是怎么回事？”镜头3（6-9秒）：摄像机缓缓环绕她移动，更多机器开始从内部剧烈撞击。洗衣店内回荡着扭曲的尖叫声与撞击声交织的噪音。绿色液体漫过瓷砖。镜头4（9-12秒）：一台洗衣机的门突然弹开。一只畸形的湿漉漉生物爬了出来。接着另一台机器打开。又一台。更多怪物从她周围不同的机器中一只接一只地钻出，滴落着绿色黏液。她惊恐地缓缓后退，摄像机继续环绕拍摄。镜头5（12-15秒）：所有怪物突然静止不动。半秒寂静。接着所有怪物同时尖叫着从洗衣店各个方向朝她冲来。她惊慌失措地踉跄后退——怪物们纵身扑来——画面切至黑屏。

en.p: High-tension horror sequence inside a neon-lit bowling alley at night. Retro arcade lighting, reflective bowling lanes, colorful LED glow, realistic practical lighting. Shot 1 (0–3s): A young woman stands frozen near the bowling lane holding a bowling ball. Her breathing becomes uneasy. Around her, she suddenly sees massive insect-like creatures crawling across the bowling alley walls and ceiling—giant spiders moving between neon signs and hanging lights. People nearby appear distorted and unaware. Shot 2 (3–5s): One insect crawls rapidly across the lane toward her. She panics— Then suddenly snaps out of it. Everything is normal again. Just a regular bowling alley. Her friends laugh and wave at her from behind. Shot 3 (5–8s): Still shaken, she slowly steps forward and rolls the bowling ball down the lane. The camera tracks low beside the ball as it spins toward the pins. Shot 4 (8–11s): As the ball nears the pins, she suddenly hears the disturbing insect clicking sound again. Her smile fades. From the empty lane beside hers— something rapidly moves in the darkness. Shot 5 (11–15s): A gigantic insect creature suddenly bursts out from the side lane, skittering violently across the polished floor toward the group. Everyone starts screaming and stumbling backward. The creature launches directly at the woman.

zh.p: 深夜霓虹灯下的保龄球馆内，一场高度紧张的恐怖场景。复古街机灯光、反光的保龄球道、五彩LED光芒、逼真的实景照明。镜头1（0-3秒）：一名年轻女子僵立在球道旁，手中握着保龄球，呼吸变得急促。她突然看到周围保龄球馆的墙壁和天花板上爬满了巨大的昆虫状生物——巨型蜘蛛在霓虹灯牌和吊灯间穿梭。附近的人显得扭曲且毫无察觉。镜头2（3-5秒）：一只昆虫迅速爬过球道向她冲来。她惊慌失措——然后猛地回过神来。一切恢复正常。只是个普通的保龄球馆。身后的朋友们笑着向她挥手。镜头3（5-8秒）：她仍心有余悸，缓缓上前将保龄球沿球道滚出。镜头低角度跟随旋转的球向球瓶逼近。镜头4（8-11秒）：当球接近球瓶时，她突然再次听到令人不安的昆虫咔嗒声。笑容凝固。旁边空荡荡的球道——黑暗中有什么东西在快速移动。镜头5（11-15秒）：一只巨大的昆虫生物突然从侧道冲出，在抛光地板上疯狂爬行扑向人群。所有人尖叫着踉跄后退。那生物径直朝女子扑去。

en.p:
A highly cinematic 15-second ultra-realistic fantasy sequence featuring a fearless warrior queen riding a massive black stallion across a war-torn dark realm. The scene opens with a sweeping aerial establishing shot of a ruined kingdom beneath violent storm clouds, flashes of lightning revealing shattered towers, burning siege weapons, drifting ash, and rivers of smoke across the battlefield. Rain and embers swirl through the air as distant explosions illuminate the horizon.

The camera transitions into a fast dynamic tracking shot alongside the rider as the horse charges through mud and fire at full speed, its armor rattling while the warrior’s tattered cloak whips violently in the wind. Lightning briefly reflects across her engraved armor and determined expression. Cut into a dramatic low-angle slow-motion sequence where the horse leaps over collapsing debris and flaming wreckage while monstrous shadow creatures emerge from thick smoke around her.

A cinematic close-up captures the warrior drawing a glowing enchanted sword infused with supernatural energy, fiery reflections burning within her eyes. The soundtrack intensifies as rapid action shots show her slicing through dark entities while galloping, sparks, magical particles, and explosive energy bursts scattering through the storm with hyper-realistic motion blur and cinematic impact.

The final moments pull into an epic aerial pullback shot as she rides deeper into the battlefield surrounded by an advancing army of demonic creatures. Massive lightning strikes crash behind her, illuminating the chaos in dramatic flashes. Volumetric fog, anamorphic lens flares, seamless camera transitions, film-grade color grading, realistic environmental physics, and stunning 4K cinematic realism create an intense dark fantasy atmosphere from beginning to end.
en.t: Warrior Queen Rides Through Dark Realm

zh.p: 一段极具电影感的15秒超现实奇幻片段，描绘了一位无畏的女王骑士骑着黑色战马穿越战火纷飞的黑暗领域。开场以宏大的航拍镜头展现暴风雨云下破碎的王国，闪电瞬间照亮了断裂的塔楼、燃烧的攻城器械、飘散的灰烬以及战场上如河流般涌动的硝烟。雨滴与火星在空中交织，远方的爆炸映红了天际。镜头快速切换为动态跟拍，战马全速冲过泥泞与火焰，铠甲叮当作响，女战士残破的斗篷在风中猛烈翻飞。闪电短暂映照在她雕刻般的铠甲与坚毅的面容上。画面切入戏剧性的低角度慢动作：战马跃过坍塌的废墟与燃烧的残骸，浓烟中浮现出 monstrous 的暗影生物。电影级特写捕捉到女战士拔出附魔长剑的瞬间，剑身萦绕着超自然能量，火焰的倒影在她眼中燃烧。配乐骤然激昂，快速动作镜头中她策马劈开黑暗实体，火花、魔法粒子与爆炸能量在风暴中四散，伴随超写实的动态模糊与电影冲击力。最终镜头拉升至史诗级航拍：她深入战场，四周涌动着恶魔大军。巨型闪电在她身后炸裂，戏剧性的闪光将混乱景象照得惨白。体积雾、变形镜头光晕、无缝镜头转换、电影级调色、逼真的环境物理效果，以及惊艳的4K电影级写实感，从头至尾营造出浓烈的黑暗奇幻氛围。

en.p: Create a luxurious 15-second cinematic fantasy video in vertical 9:16. A glamorous Western woman with long dark curly hair, glowing skin, and elegant makeup wears a shimmering neon turquoise sequined mini dress. She holds a fluffy Persian cat with emerald-green eyes and a matching turquoise jeweled bow. Both are posed inside an ornate turquoise crystal picture frame against a dark teal background with sparkling bokeh and floating glitter. 0–3s: Static portrait like a living painting. 3–6s: The painting comes to life—she smiles, strokes the cat, and the cat blinks and looks around. 6–9s: Turquoise particles burst as she steps out of the frame with a dramatic hair flip. 9–12s: Quick fashion cut scenes: twirl, close-up of shimmering dress, playful cat interaction. 12–15s: Final runway-style hero pose with swirling sparkles and the glowing frame behind. Style: photorealistic, magical luxury aesthetic, high-fashion editorial, cinematic lighting, realistic fur and fabric textures, 35mm film look, ultra-detailed 8K.

zh.p: 制作一段15秒的奢华电影感竖屏奇幻视频（9:16比例）。一位魅力四射的西方女性，拥有深色长卷发、光泽肌肤与精致妆容，身着闪耀霓虹绿松石色亮片迷你裙。她怀抱一只祖母绿眼眸、佩戴同色珠宝蝴蝶结的蓬松波斯猫。二者置身于装饰繁复的绿松石水晶相框内，背景为深蓝绿色，点缀闪烁散景与漂浮亮片。0-3秒：静态肖像如活体画作。3-6秒：画作苏醒——她微笑抚猫，猫咪眨眼环顾。6-9秒：绿松石粒子迸发，她甩发跨出画框。9-12秒：快速时尚切换镜头——旋转、亮片裙特写、与猫俏皮互动。12-15秒：最终T台式英雄定格，旋转星尘环绕，身后相框流光溢彩。风格：照片级写实、魔幻奢华美学、高定时尚大片、电影级布光、真实毛绒与织物质感、35mm胶片效果、超精细8K画质。

raw_p: Realistic iPhone audience recording inside a crowded 4DX-style cinema. The first seconds look like a normal movie screening, with many people seated, watching a giant underwater movie screen, some holding phones. Single continuous handheld iPhone-style shot, vertical framing, chaotic but readable, realistic crowd panic, dark cinema lighting, blue underwater screen glow, no gore, no blood, no subtitles, no watermark.

raw_p:
PART 1 — "A GOLDEN MORNING" (0–15 seconds)
Visual Style: Soft watercolor illustration, warm pastel palette, gentle painted textures, thick storybook outlines, Pixar-meets-picture-book warmth. Every frame should look like it could be lifted from a printed children's book page.
 Music: Gentle music box melody, soft and dreamy.

✂️ CUT 1 — The Town Wakes Up (0–3s)

Storybook illustrated wide shot of a tiny golden town at sunrise. Cobblestone streets, pastel shop fronts, flowers in window boxes. Soft watercolor sky in peach and lavender. A warm narrator title card fades in like a book page turning. Camera gently pushes forward. No characters yet — just the world breathing awake. Painterly, soft, magical. Children's picture book aesthetic.

✂️ CUT 2 — They Appear (3–6s)

Illustrated medium shot. Two heroic girls stroll into frame side by side down the golden street. The blonde girl has long wavy golden hair catching the morning light, bright blue eyes, wearing a blue superhero shirt with a red-and-gold crest, a flowing tan coat and red skirt. Beside her, a tall dark-haired girl in a full navy blue superhero suit with a flowing red cape. Both hold iced drinks with green straws. They walk in easy, comfortable silence. Warm amber light. Storybook illustration style — soft outlines, gentle cel-shading, children's book warmth.

✂️ CUT 3 — The Little Girl Watches (6–9s)

Storybook close-up at child's eye level. A tiny girl with pigtails presses her nose against a bakery window, eyes wide with wonder as the two superhero cousins pass outside. Illustrated golden reflections on the glass. Warm, tender, magical. The moment feels frozen — like a painting inside a book. No dialogue. Just wonder.

🗣️ Only Dialogue in Part 1:

KARA: (kneeling gently to the little girl, soft smile) "The real kind. Just like you'll be someday."

✂️ CUT 4 — The Cloud Arrives (9–12s)

Illustrated wide shot. The warm golden sky above the town slowly shifts. A single large storybook storm cloud — illustrated with soft curling edges, not scary, like a cloud from a picture book — drifts in from the horizon. The cousins look up slowly. Their expressions go calm and ready. Camera tilts upward toward the cloud. The warm light dims slightly to cool lilac. Still painterly and safe — this is a children's story.

✂️ CUT 5 — Drinks Down. Capes Up. (12–15s)

Slow illustrated close-up. Two iced drinks placed gently side by side on a low stone wall. Camera pulls back in slow motion. The cousins stand tall, side by side, capes beginning to lift in the rising wind. Their silhouettes are bold and warm against the shifting sky. The frame freezes — like the last illustration before a chapter turn. Storybook page texture overlays softly. Painterly. Heroic. Tender.

zh.p: 第一部分 — 《金色清晨》（0–15秒） 视觉风格：柔和的水彩插画，温暖的粉彩色调，温柔的绘画质感，粗厚的故事书轮廓，皮克斯与图画书相遇的温馨感。每一帧都应像是从印刷的儿童书页中摘取出来的。 音乐：轻柔的音乐盒旋律，柔和而梦幻。 ✂️ 剪切1 — 小镇苏醒（0–3秒） 故事书风格的插画广角镜头：日出时分一座金色的小镇。鹅卵石街道，粉彩色的店面，窗台花箱里的花朵。桃色与淡紫色的柔和水彩天空。一张温暖的旁白标题卡像书页翻动般淡入。镜头缓缓向前推。尚未出现人物——只有世界在呼吸中苏醒。绘画感、柔和、奇幻。儿童图画书美学。 ✂️ 剪切2 — 她们出现（3–6秒） 插画中景镜头。两位英气十足的少女并肩走在金色街道上。金发少女有着长而卷曲的金色长发，迎着晨光，明亮的蓝眼睛，身穿蓝色超级英雄衫，上有红金徽章，飘逸的卡其色外套和红色裙子。她身旁是一位高个子黑发少女，穿着全套深蓝色超级英雄制服，披着飘逸的红色斗篷。两人都手持带有绿色吸管的冰饮。她们在轻松、舒适的沉默中行走。温暖的琥珀色光线。故事书插画风格——柔和的轮廓，温和的赛璐珞着色，儿童书的温暖感。 ✂️ 剪切3 — 小女孩注视着（6–9秒） 故事书风格的特写，与儿童视线平齐。一个扎着辫子的小女孩把鼻子贴在面包店的窗户上，眼睛因惊奇而睁大，看着两位超级英雄表姐妹从外面经过。插画中的金色倒影映在玻璃上。温暖、温柔、奇幻。这一刻仿佛凝固了——像书里的一幅画。没有对话。只有惊奇。 🗣️ 第一部分唯一对话： 卡拉：（轻轻跪在小女孩面前，温柔地微笑）‘真正的那种。就像你将来有一天那样。’ ✂️ 剪切4 — 云朵到来（9–12秒） 插画广角镜头。小镇上方温暖的金色天空缓缓变化。一朵巨大的故事书风暴云——以柔和的卷曲边缘绘制，并不吓人，像图画书里的云——从地平线飘来。两位表姐妹缓缓抬头。她们的表情变得平静而准备好。镜头朝云朵仰拍。温暖的光线微微变暗，转为凉爽的淡紫色。依然是绘画感且安全的——这是给孩子们的故事。 ✂️ 剪切5 — 放下饮品。披风扬起。（12–15秒） 缓慢的插画特写镜头。两杯冰饮被轻轻并排放在一堵矮石墙上。镜头以慢动作拉远。两位表姐妹高高站立，并肩而立，披风在渐起的风中开始飘动。她们的剪影在变化的天空下显得醒目而温暖。画面定格——像章节翻页前的最后一幅插画。故事书页纹理轻柔叠加。绘画感。英雄气概。温柔。

zh.p: 一位令人畏惧的女武神，长发如雪在风中狂舞，身披刻有古老符文的风化银甲，锐利的蓝眸闪烁寒光，巨大的羽翼长矛燃烧着神圣能量——她从风暴云层中降临至一片战场，成千上万的亡灵战士正碾压王国最后的守军，镜头随她穿越暴雨与闪电俯冲而下，直击混乱中心；——她以野蛮而精准的势头冲入亡灵大军，长矛贯穿多名敌人，神圣冲击波撕裂骷髅阵列，战马与战士在她周围激烈碰撞，甩镜头紧随 brutal 的打击与被抛飞于泥泞烈火间的躯体；——她冲天而起，将长矛如雷霆般掷出，在耀眼的光芒中彻底毁灭亡灵之王，余下的亡灵纷纷坍倒，而镜头升向战场高空，呈现她屹立于万千陨落敌兵间的胜利之姿。超写实英雄奇幻，残酷战争，神圣视觉特效，写实盔甲物理，暴风雨白昼光景，IMAX级电影磅礴尺度。

Animate the production storyboard as a seamless chronological culinary sequence, following the exact order of the nine storyboard scenes without skipping, reordering, or repeating any step. Each transition should flow naturally into the next, maintaining the same restaurant setting, lighting, cookware, table styling, and cinematic color grading throughout.
Scene 01: A chef carefully seasons and arranges premium marinated beef on a wooden preparation board surrounded by garlic, scallions, sesame seeds, fresh aromatics, and traditional Korean sauces.
Scene 02: A heated stone tabletop grill begins to smoke as a light coating of oil spreads across the surface. Soft flames glow beneath while warm reflections shimmer across the stone.
Scene 03: Thin slices of marinated beef are gently placed onto the hot grill. The meat immediately begins to sizzle as rendered fat glistens and golden caramelization develops.
Scene 04: Thick pork belly slices and fresh mushrooms are added to the grill, creating a vibrant mixed barbecue filled with rising steam and dynamic cooking action.
Scene 05: Metal tongs carefully flip and reposition the meats, revealing beautifully caramelized surfaces with juices glistening under warm restaurant lighting.
Scene 06: Transition to an elegant overhead view as colorful Korean side dishes, dipping sauces, leafy greens, steamed rice, and fresh garnishes are arranged around the glowing tabletop grill.
Scene 07: Hands assemble a traditional Korean lettuce wrap by layering grilled meat, steamed rice, vegetables, roasted garlic, herbs, and savory sauce, highlighting freshness and texture.
Scene 08: Traditional Korean grilling scissors neatly cut the cooked meat into bite-sized pieces while aromatic steam rises dramatically from the hot grill.
Scene 09: Finish with a cinematic wide hero shot of a lively Korean barbecue dining experience featuring sizzling meats, abundant side dishes, glowing charcoal heat, natural interaction between diners, drifting smoke, and a warm, inviting restaurant atmosphere.
Style & Camera Direction: Luxury editorial food cinematography, ultra-realistic, premium commercial quality, warm tungsten lighting balanced with subtle charcoal-blue shadows, shallow depth of field, rich food textures, handcrafted ceramic serving ware, textured stone grill, brushed steel utensils, cinematic smoke, natural camera movement, smooth scene-to-scene transitions, realistic cooking physics, highly appetizing presentation.
Output Specifications: 15 seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio, photorealistic, cinematic, no music, no subtitles.

zh.p: 将制作故事板动画化，呈现为一条无缝衔接的、按时间顺序的烹饪序列，严格遵循九个故事板场景的先后顺序，不跳过、不重排、不重复任何步骤。每个转场应自然过渡至下一个，全程保持相同的餐厅环境、灯光、厨具、餐桌摆台和电影级调色。场景01：一位厨师在木质备料板上精心调味并摆放优质腌渍牛肉，周围环绕着大蒜、青葱、芝麻、新鲜香草和传统韩式酱料。场景02：加热的石板烤盘开始冒烟，表面涂有一层薄油。下方微弱的火焰发出暖光，石板上泛起温润的反光。场景03：将薄切的腌渍牛肉轻轻铺在炙热的烤盘上。肉片立即发出滋滋声，油脂析出并闪烁光泽，表面逐渐形成金黄焦化层。场景04：将厚切五花肉片和新鲜菌菇加入烤盘，形成色彩丰富的混合烧烤，蒸汽升腾，烹饪动态十足。场景05：金属夹子小心地翻动并调整肉片位置，露出焦香诱人的表面，肉汁在餐厅暖光下闪闪发光。场景06：转场至优雅的俯拍视角，色彩缤纷的韩式小菜、蘸酱、生菜叶、蒸米饭和新鲜装饰配菜环绕在发光的桌面烤盘四周。场景07：一双手将烤好的肉片、蒸米饭、蔬菜、烤蒜、香草和咸鲜酱料层层包裹进传统的生菜包中，突显食材的新鲜与丰富口感。场景08：传统韩式烧烤剪将烤好的肉整齐剪成一口大小，滚烫的烤盘上升腾起浓郁的热气与香气。场景09：以电影级广角主镜头收尾，展现热闹的韩式烧烤用餐体验，炙烤中的肉类、丰盛的小菜、发光的炭火、食客间的自然互动、飘散的烟雾，以及温暖宜人的餐厅氛围。风格与镜头方向：奢华编辑级美食摄影，超写实，高端商业广告质感，暖色钨丝灯配合微妙的炭灰蓝色阴影，浅景深，丰富的食物纹理，手工陶瓷餐具，质感石烤盘，拉丝不锈钢器具，电影级烟雾，自然运镜，场景之间平滑过渡，逼真的烹饪物理效果，极具食欲的画面呈现。输出规格：15秒，16:9比例，照片级真实，电影质感，无音乐，无字幕。

Scene 02: A heated stone tabletop grill begins to smoke as a light coating of oil spreads across the surface. Soft flames glow beneath while warm reflections shimmer across the stone.
Scene 03: Thin slices of marinated beef are gently placed onto the hot grill. The meat immediately begins to sizzle as rendered fat glistens and golden caramelization develops.
Scene 04: Thick pork belly slices and fresh mushrooms are added to the grill, creating a vibrant mixed barbecue filled with rising steam and dynamic cooking action.
Scene 05: Metal tongs carefully flip and reposition the meats, revealing beautifully caramelized surfaces with juices glistening under warm restaurant lighting.
Scene 06: Transition to an elegant overhead view as colorful Korean side dishes, dipping sauces, leafy greens, steamed rice, and fresh garnishes are arranged around the glowing tabletop grill.
Scene 07: Hands assemble a traditional Korean lettuce wrap by layering grilled meat, steamed rice, vegetables, roasted garlic, herbs, and savory sauce, highlighting freshness and texture.
Scene 08: Traditional Korean grilling scissors neatly cut the cooked meat into bite-sized pieces while aromatic steam rises dramatically from the hot grill.
Scene 09: Finish with a cinematic wide hero shot of a lively Korean barbecue dining experience featuring sizzling meats, abundant side dishes, glowing charcoal heat, natural interaction between diners, drifting smoke, and a warm, inviting restaurant atmosphere.
Style & Camera Direction: Luxury editorial food cinematography, ultra-realistic, premium commercial quality, warm tungsten lighting balanced with subtle charcoal-blue shadows, shallow depth of field, rich food textures, handcrafted ceramic serving ware, textured stone grill, brushed steel utensils, cinematic smoke, natural camera movement, smooth scene-to-scene transitions, realistic cooking physics, highly appetizing presentation.

Around her neck hangs a classic 35mm analog film camera.

Theme:
"A Day With My Camera"
A relaxing weekend in 2026, following a girl who loves documenting ordinary moments with her analog camera. The video should feel authentic, nostalgic, and effortlessly beautiful.

Everything takes place around modern Indonesia in 2026:
quiet neighborhood streets, small coffee shops, city parks, bookstores, pedestrian sidewalks, and cozy residential areas.

The entire video must look like it was filmed naturally by her best friend using a modern mirrorless camera. Absolutely no posing, no influencer behavior, no scripted acting. Every smile, glance, and movement feels spontaneous and real.

Camera language is the highest priority.

Natural handheld movement.

Gentle camera sway.

Occasional focus breathing.

Real autofocus adjustments.

Slight framing imperfections.

Natural motion blur.

Documentary-style tracking shots.

Soft depth of field.

Authentic available sunlight.

Premium lifestyle vlog aesthetic.

Sequence:

She walks out of her house while adjusting the analog camera hanging around her neck, smiling softly as morning sunlight lights up her face.

She stops beside a quiet street and photographs flowers, bicycles, passing people, and little everyday details with genuine curiosity.

She enters a cozy camera store, happily choosing a fresh roll of 35mm film before carefully loading it into her camera.

Walking through the city, she photographs random candid moments: children playing, street cats, trees moving in the breeze, reflections on café windows, and interesting architecture.

She sits alone inside a cozy café reviewing her newly taken photos, smiling while enjoying an iced latte.

Golden hour arrives. She slowly walks through a city park while continuing to shoot photographs, warm sunlight creating beautiful natural lens flares.

She notices the person filming her, laughs shyly, lifts her analog camera toward the lens as if taking one final photo of the viewer.

The camera gently lowers while she keeps smiling naturally.

Recording suddenly cuts off mid-motion like a real weekend vlog ending.

Bright natural morning sunlight transitioning into warm golden hour.

Natura

zh.p: 图像1中的主要人物必须完全保持不变。面部、发型、身材比例、肤色、服装、配饰和整体外观在整个视频中必须完美一致。她是一位甜美且天生丽质的印尼女孩，18岁，拥有柔和温暖的小麦色肌肤、富有表现力的深棕色眼睛、长发扎成随性凌乱的发髻并带有松散刘海、青春洋溢的笑容、淡妆，身穿简约的白色宽松T恤、浅蓝色牛仔裤、白色运动鞋，背着一个复古棕色帆布相机包。她脖子上挂着一台经典的35毫米胶片单反相机。主题：“与我的相机共度一日”。2026年一个悠闲的周末，跟随一位喜欢用胶片相机记录平凡瞬间的女孩。视频应呈现真实、怀旧且毫不费力的美感。所有场景都发生在2026年的现代印尼：宁静的街区小巷、小咖啡馆、城市公园、书店、人行道和舒适的居民区。整个视频必须看起来像是她的好友用现代无反相机自然拍摄的。完全没有摆拍、网红做作行为或剧本化表演。每一个微笑、眼神和动作都显得自然而真实。镜头语言是最高优先级。自然的手持运镜、轻柔的镜头晃动、偶尔的呼吸式对焦、真实的自动对焦调整、轻微的画面取景瑕疵、自然的动态模糊、纪录片风格的跟拍镜头、柔和的景深、真实的可用自然光、高品质生活类Vlog美学。场景序列：她走出家门，调整挂在脖子上的胶片相机，晨光洒在脸上时温柔地微笑。她在安静的街边停下，带着真诚的好奇心拍摄花朵、自行车、路人和日常小细节。她走进一家温馨的相机店，开心地挑选一卷新的35毫米胶片，然后仔细地装入相机。穿行于城市中，她抓拍随机的真实瞬间：玩耍的孩子、街猫、微风中摇曳的树木、咖啡馆玻璃上的倒影，以及有趣的建筑。她独自坐在舒适的咖啡馆里，翻看刚拍的照片，边喝冰拿铁边微笑。黄金时刻来临。她缓缓走过城市公园，继续拍摄，温暖的阳光形成美丽的自然镜头光晕。她注意到拍摄她的人，害羞地笑了，举起胶片相机朝向镜头，仿佛在为观众拍下最后一张照片。镜头轻轻放下，她继续自然地微笑。录制在动作中突然中断，如同一个真实的周末Vlog结尾。光线：明亮的自然晨光过渡到温暖的黄金时刻。色彩：自然

raw_p:
Duration: 15 seconds

A single uninterrupted cinematic shot begins at sunrise on a prehistoric shoreline. The camera glides inches above crystal-clear water as tiny ripples shimmer under soft golden light. Microscopic life drifts beneath the surface, creating a quiet sense of anticipation.

At the third second, the camera follows a primitive fish swimming toward the shore. As it reaches shallow water, its fins gradually strengthen into limbs. Bones, muscles, skin, and posture evolve naturally in one continuous transformation while it crawls onto land. Every stage is smooth and biologically believable with no sudden morphing.

Without cutting, the camera gently circles the creature while keeping perfect pace beside it. As it walks forward, millions of years pass around it. Giant ferns rise from the earth, dense prehistoric forests spread across the landscape, and the climate becomes warmer. The creature slowly transforms into a powerful dinosaur. Its skeleton reshapes, muscles expand, scales develop intricate textures, and its movements remain fluid and lifelike.

The camera continues tracking alongside the dinosaur. A bright meteor streaks silently across the distant sky. Dust gradually fills the atmosphere as the environment changes into a frozen world. Snow begins falling, glaciers appear, and the dinosaur slowly evolves into a woolly mammoth. Thick fur grows naturally, tusks curl outward, and each breath forms visible clouds in the cold air.

Time continues accelerating. Ice melts into green valleys while the mammoth gradually transforms into an early human. Fur disappears, posture straightens, hands become dexterous, and simple stone tools appear in the environment. The human never stops walking.

As the camera smoothly moves to the front, civilization unfolds around the traveler. Primitive camps become farming villages. Villages become ancient cities. Stone buildings become castles. Castles become industrial towns. Steam gives way to electricity. Roads become highways. Skyscrapers rise toward the sky. Vehicles evolve from horse-drawn carts to modern transportation while aircraft leave elegant trails overhead. The environment transforms continuously without any cuts.

Near the end, the modern explorer naturally evolves into a futuristic space explorer wearing an advanced exploration suit assembled piece by piece around the body. The landscape transitions into the surface of another world beneath a sky filled with distant planets.

The explorer walks toward the horizon. The camera slowly moves closer until only the reflective visor fills the frame. Inside the reflection, every previous stage of evolution appears walking together in perfect harmony, symbolizing the continuous journey of life.

The final shot reveals a distant blue planet rising over the horizon as soft sunlight illuminates the explorer, ending with a feeling of hope, discovery, and endless possibility.

**Camera:** One continuou

zh.p: 时长：15秒。一个连续不间断的 cinematic 镜头始于史前海岸线上的日出。摄影机贴着晶莹剔透的水面几英寸处滑行，细微的涟漪在柔和的金色光线中闪闪发光。微观生命在水面下漂移，营造出一种安静的期待感。在第三秒，摄影机跟随一条原始鱼类游向岸边。当它到达浅水区时，其鱼鳍逐渐增强为四肢。骨骼、肌肉、皮肤和姿势在一次连贯的转化中自然演化，同时它爬上陆地。每个阶段都流畅且生物学上可信，没有突然的变形。在没有剪辑的情况下，摄影机轻轻环绕该生物，同时完美地保持在其侧边。当它向前行走时，数百万年时光在它周围流逝。巨大的蕨类植物从地面升起，茂密的史前森林遍布大地，气候变得更加温暖。该生物缓慢地转化为一只强大的恐龙。其骨架重塑，肌肉扩张，鳞片发展出复杂的纹理，而它的动作依然流畅而栩栩如生。摄影机继续在恐龙身旁跟拍。一颗明亮的流星无声地划过遥远的天空。尘埃逐渐弥漫大气层，环境变为一个冰封世界。雪开始飘落，冰川出现，恐龙慢慢进化为一只长毛猛犸象。厚实的毛皮自然生长，象牙向外弯曲，每一次呼吸在冷空气中形成可见的雾气。时间继续加速。冰消融为绿色山谷，而猛犸象逐渐转变为早期人类。毛发消失，姿势变直，双手变得灵巧，环境中出现简单的石器。这个人类从未停止行走。当摄影机平顺地移到前方时，文明在旅者周围展开。原始营地成为农耕村落。村落成为古城。石砌建筑成为城堡。城堡成为工业城镇。蒸汽让位于电力。道路成为高速公路。摩天大楼升向天空。交通工具从马车演变为现代运输方式，而飞行器在头顶留下优雅的航迹。环境连续变化，没有任何剪辑。接近尾声时，现代探索者自然地进化为一名未来太空探索者，身穿一套先进的探索服，在身体周围一件件装配而成。地貌过渡到另一个世界的表面，天空布满遥远行星。探索者走向地平线。摄影机缓慢靠近，直到只有反光面罩充满画面。在倒影中，每一个先前的进化阶段一起和谐地行走，象征着生命的持续旅程。最后一个镜头揭示一颗遥远的蓝色行星在地平线上升起，柔和的阳光照亮探索者，以希望、发现和无限可能的感觉结束。**摄影机：** 一次连续

raw_p:
首帧 FIRST FRAME（=上传参考图，100%锁定）：

古风女子，乌发高髻、金步摇发钗垂珠流苏，绛红描金绣花襦裙、

肩披薄纱粉色帔帛，金线凤纹腰封系白玉环佩，腕戴翡翠镯；

右手轻抬触碰桃花枝。背景：漫山桃花林、远山叠翠、瀑布飞泻、

黄昏暖光、花瓣飘飞。人物五官、发型、服饰、配饰、姿态与首帧

完全一致，全程不得变形、不得换脸。

人物·表情·动作·台词（情绪戏，口型与台词严格对齐）：

0-2秒：维持触碰花枝的姿态，垂眸凝望指尖桃花，嘴角含浅笑。

〔轻声·气声〕"今年的桃花……开得真早。"

2-4秒：指尖轻抚花瓣，缓缓转头望向远山瀑布，眼神舒展明亮。

〔语气轻柔〕"这满山的春色，竟也无人共看。"

4-6秒：笑意微敛，眼底浮起一丝浅淡的怅惘，唇瓣微动欲言又止。

〔半句收住〕"若是你也在……"（话音停住）

6-8秒：垂手收回花枝，视线下沉，安静片刻，神情温柔而失落。

〔几乎无声·气声〕"罢了。"

8-10秒：轻阖双眼，深吸一口气，再睁眼时已是释然的浅笑。

〔自语·气声〕"花开花落，本就由它去。"

10-12秒：抬头迎向暖光，纱帔随风轻扬，神情温柔从容。

〔轻而稳〕"我等得起，也看得开。"

12-15秒：目视前方/画面右侧，眼神柔和微润，唇瓣轻动似欲语还休，

最终归于安静凝望远方，定格在温柔清雅、略带一缕惆怅。

〔最后一句气声·渐弱〕"……愿这春光，岁岁常在。"

声音设定：女声，温柔清雅，气声偏多，语速偏慢，尾音轻微上扬后下沉；

情绪克制不外放，似自语呢喃，全程贴合面部口型。

镜头 CAMERA：

固定中近景，极缓慢推近（轻微 push-in），对准面部与眼神；

浅景深，前景桃花与背景远山瀑布虚化。一镜到底，无切换、无转场。

氛围·光线：

黄昏金色侧逆光，暖调柔和；桃花瓣随微风自然飘落，

薄纱帔帛与流苏轻扬，瀑布远景流动，空气感细腻；

基调温柔清雅、含蓄惆怅。

CONSTRAINTS（约束）：

- 4K 超清，15秒，画面与首帧人物/服饰/场景 100% 一致

- 台词与口型严格同步，发音清晰自然，气声质感，不假唱、不错位

- 表情按情绪曲线递进，过渡连贯，不跳帧、不卡顿

- 眼神有戏；禁止眼睛发光、禁止瞳孔异常

- 风动、落花、纱帔、流苏、瀑布符合真实物理，轻柔不夸张

- 结尾无黑屏、无转场，自然定格

- 无字幕、无水印、无任何标记符号、无文字

- 4K 超清，15秒，画面与首帧人物/服饰/场景 100% 一致

- 台词与口型严格同步，发音清晰自然，气声质感，不假唱、不错位

- 表情按情绪曲线递进，过渡连贯，不跳帧、不卡顿

- 眼神有戏；禁止眼睛发光、禁止瞳孔异常

en.p: First frame FIRST FRAME (= upload reference image, 100% locked): ancient-style woman, black hair in a high bun, gold step-shaking hairpin with pearl tassels, crimson embroidered gold-patterned ru skirt, pink gauze shawl draped over shoulders, gold-thread phoenix-pattern waistband with white jade ring pendant, jade bangle on wrist; right hand lightly raised to touch a peach blossom branch. Background: peach blossom forest stretching over the hills, layered green distant mountains, a cascading waterfall, warm dusk light, petals drifting in the air. The character's facial features, hairstyle, attire, accessories, and posture remain completely identical to the first frame throughout, with no deformation or face-swapping allowed. Character expression action dialogue (emotional scene, lip-sync strictly aligned with lines): 0-2 sec: maintaining the posture of touching the branch, eyes lowered to gaze at the peach blossom on the fingertips, a faint smile at the corners of the mouth. [Soft, breathy voice] 'This year's peach blossoms... bloomed so early.' 2-4 sec: fingertips gently stroke the petals, slowly turn head to gaze at the distant mountains and waterfall, eyes bright and open. [Gentle tone] 'All this spring scenery on the mountain, yet no one to share it with.' 4-6 sec: smile fades slightly, a faint trace of wistfulness rises in the eyes, lips part as if to speak but hesitate. [Half-finished line] 'If only you were here too...' (voice trails off) 6-8 sec: lowers hand, withdraws from the branch, gaze drops, silent for a moment, expression tender yet lost. [Almost inaudible, breathy] 'Never mind.' 8-10 sec: gently closes eyes, takes a deep breath, and when opening them again, a resigned faint smile appears. [Muttering to herself, breathy] 'Blossoms bloom and fall, they simply take their course.' 10-12 sec: looks up toward the warm light, the gauze shawl flutters gently in the wind, expression tender and composed. [Soft and steady] 'I can wait, and I can let go.' 12-15 sec: gazes straight ahead / to the right side of the frame, eyes soft and slightly glistening, lips move faintly as if about to speak, ultimately settling into a quiet, distant gaze, frozen in a gentle, elegant, and slightly melancholic pose. [Last line, breathy, fading out] '...May this spring light remain year after year.' Voice setting: female voice, gentle and elegant, mostly breathy, slow tempo, slight upward then downward inflection at the ends; emotions restrained and not outwardly expressed, like murmuring to oneself, fully synchronized with facial mouth movements. Camera CAMERA: fixed medium close-up, extremely slow push-in (slight push-in), focused on the face and eyes; shallow depth of field, with foreground peach blossoms and distant mountains and waterfall blurred. One continuous shot, no cuts, no transitions. Atmosphere lighting: golden side-backlight at dusk, warm and soft tones; peach petals naturally falling with the breeze, gauze shawl and tassels gently swaying, distant waterfall flowing, delicate air texture; overall tone gentle, elegant, reserved, and wistful. CONSTRAINTS: - 4K ultra-high definition, 15 seconds, 100% consistency with the first frame in character attire scene - Lines strictly synced with lip movements, clear and natural pronunciation, breathy texture, no lip-sync mismatch or misalignment - Expressions progress along the emotional curve smoothly, with coherent transitions, no frame skipping or stuttering - Eyes convey emotion; no glowing eyes, no abnormal pupils - Wind movement, falling petals, gauze shawl, tassels, and waterfall follow realistic physics, gentle not exaggerated - No black screen at the end, no transitions, natural freeze - No subtitles, no watermarks, no markers, no text of any kind

raw_p:
SCENE – Seedance 2.0 | 15s Everyday Island Moments
@ image1 = Main Subject.
Preserve the exact face, identity, hairstyle, skin tone, and proportions from @ image1 throughout. Same outfit and accessories.
Authentic Indonesian woman. Late-2000s pocket camcorder aesthetic. Raw handheld footage with noticeable shake, accidental framing, focus hunting, slight grain, washed warm tones, and nostalgic home-video imperfections.
00:00–00:02 Small local market near the harbor. Selfie shot while weaving through stalls, smiling at the camera as vendors arrange fresh fruit.
00:02–00:04 Wooden bridge crossing a narrow canal. Camera follows from behind as she walks casually, brushing her fingers along the railing.
00:04–00:06 Tiny bakery window. She receives a paper-wrapped snack from an elderly shop owner and laughs softly.
00:06–00:08 Quiet seaside path. She pauses to watch children flying a kite in the distance, turning briefly toward the camera.
00:08–00:10 Under a large tree beside parked bicycles. Sitting on a low bench, flipping through old postcards or notes.
00:10–00:12 Small beach area. Standing barefoot near the shoreline, letting waves touch her feet while wind moves her hair.
00:12–00:15 Casual selfie shot while walking away from the beach. She smiles, says something playful to the lens, and the recording stops abruptly.
Natural ambience only: waves, birds, children playing, bicycle bells, distant conversations, breeze, footsteps, and harbor sounds.

zh.p: 场景——Seedance 2.0 | 15秒 日常岛屿瞬间 @ image1 = 主体人物。全程保持@ image1中的面部、身份、发型、肤色和比例完全一致。相同服装和配饰。真实的印尼女性。2000年代末期口袋摄像机美学。手持拍摄原始画面，带有明显抖动、偶然取景、对焦漂移、轻微颗粒感、偏暖褪色色调，以及怀旧家庭录像特有的不完美质感。00:00–00:02 港口附近的小型本地市场。穿梭于摊位间的自拍镜头，对着镜头微笑，商贩们正在摆放新鲜水果。00:02–00:04 横跨狭窄运河的木桥。镜头从背后跟随她随意行走，手指轻拂栏杆。00:04–00:06 小小面包店窗口。她从年迈店主手中接过纸包好的小吃，轻声笑起来。00:06–00:08 安静的海边小径。她驻足观看远处孩子们放风筝，短暂地转向镜头。00:08–00:10 停着自行车的大树下。坐在低矮长凳上，翻看旧明信片或笔记。00:10–00:12 小片沙滩区域。赤脚站在水边，让浪花轻拍双脚，风吹动她的头发。00:12–00:15 离开海滩时的随性自拍镜头。她微笑着对镜头说了句俏皮话，录像戛然而止。仅自然氛围声：海浪、鸟鸣、儿童嬉戏、自行车铃声、远处的交谈声、风声、脚步声和港口声响。

AAA open-world third-person gameplay inspired by GTA VI, set in a vibrant Vice City-style tropical street with palm trees, colorful buildings, moving traffic, pedestrians, cyclists, murals, and a living city atmosphere. The scene begins in over-the-shoulder gameplay view behind a muscular male playable character wearing a sleeveless tank top, cap, and cargo shorts. The city feels alive with cars passing, NPCs walking, people crossing streets, and tropical sunlight reflecting on vehicles.

The character starts walking forward on the sidewalk, then suddenly sprints into the street toward a nearby car. Pedestrians react naturally, traffic slows, and the gameplay camera follows smoothly like a modern AAA open-world game. He opens the car door, gets inside, starts the engine, and drives away into the busy Vice City-inspired avenue. Keep a subtle modern gameplay HUD with minimap, time, money counter, and wanted-star style indicators. Next-gen graphics, ultra-realistic lighting, dynamic shadows, screen-space reflections, realistic traffic, living open-world city, third-person gameplay camera, 4K, no gore, no subtitles, no watermark.

zh.p: 受《GTA VI》启发的AAA开放世界第三人称玩法，设定在充满活力的类罪恶都市风格热带街道上，有棕榈树、彩色建筑、流动的车流、行人、骑行者、壁画，以及生动的城市氛围。场景以越肩第三人称视角开始，跟随一位身穿无袖背心、戴棒球帽和工装短裤的肌肉健壮的可操控男性角色。城市充满生机，车辆驶过，NPC行走，人们穿行街道，热带阳光在车身上反射。角色开始在人行道上向前走，随后突然冲刺跑向街道附近的一辆车。路人自然反应，交通减速，游戏镜头像现代AAA开放世界游戏一样平滑跟随。他打开车门，坐进车内，启动引擎，驶入繁忙的类罪恶都市大道。保留细微的现代游戏HUD，包含小地图、时间、金钱计数和通缉星级样式指示器。次世代画面，超写实光照，动态阴影，屏幕空间反射，真实交通，生动的开放世界城市，第三人称游戏视角，4K，无血腥，无字幕，无水印。

raw_p: [风格 + 摄影 + 氛围]延续上一段的同一白昼未来沙漠星港、同一女特工、同一辆白色机甲超级摩托。动作从她刚刚冲入星港外围飞船残骸区后开始。这里仍是阳光明媚的白天，强烈自然光照亮尘土山路、岩石山丘、悬崖边缘和巨大金属残骸。沙地跑道与碎石坡、断裂飞船装甲、半埋机械构件、金属桥面和天然岩壁混合在一起，既有真实越野地貌u7531914676_Futuristic_desert_city_with_enormous_hover_buses__97da34be-e6db-43ed-805c-33913927a69e_3，也有宏大科幻星港u7531914676_PROMPT_Hundreds_of_futuristic_starfighters_and_at_d5349092-30f9-4588-9713-472bb413a207_0。远处环形传送门u7531914676_Giant_circular_portal_activating_with_blue_energy_2e6ca808-9df8-4dca-b7c9-e6e3a907487d_1持续释放蓝色能量，空中舰队和低空战机穿过明亮天空，画面保持粗粝、真实、危险、超电影感。 [角色 + 载具统一] 主角仍是同一位参考图穿着图片_20260520195912_211_1403固定形象的女特工，不额外改变发型、装束、体型或面部状态。她驾驶同一辆白色超未来机甲超级摩托hf_20260627_043019_63b2479c-1228-44b5-bfab-69010a4a430f：全片必须始终保持同一位骑手和同一辆摩托，不能换车、变形、增加骑手或改变车身结构。 [逐秒时间线] [逐秒时间线] 0-4秒：[后方低位追逐] 镜头从女特工身后低位开始，白色机甲摩托冲进飞船残骸区，前方是破碎金属舱板、倾斜支架、松散碎石和半埋在沙土里的机械碎片。她迅速左右闪避，车身贴着残骸边缘掠过，金属装甲擦出火花，轮胎在沙地与碎石之间不断跳动。身后黑色装甲车队u7531914676_Gigantic_autonomous_robotic_artillery_firing_magn_ef23fd66-21e7-4be0-9fde-f4452b5feb15_0紧追不舍，低空战机u7531914676_A_cybernetic_pilot_flying_a_massive_futuristic_st_b1e9adb0-2b39-4357-8d49-5bd0cd067e46_2从上方掠过，炮火在通道两侧炸开。 4-8秒：[侧滑穿越狭窄通道] 摄像机转到摩托右侧高速跟拍。女特工压低重心，摩托在沙地和金属桥面交界处侧滑，后轮甩出沙浪、碎石和火花。她从两块坍塌飞船装甲之间穿过，距离极窄，透明风挡几乎擦到金属边缘。追击装甲车体型过大，被迫撞碎残骸，碎片向镜头飞来。阳光穿过尘雾，照出每一粒沙尘和飞散金属片，增强真实白昼质感。 8-12秒：[飞跃与慢动作高潮] 前方出现一段由断裂飞船舱板和天然岩石坡共同形成的斜坡，外侧就是悬崖深谷。女特工没有减速，直接冲上斜坡，白色机甲摩托短暂腾空。慢动作只出现一瞬：背景中巨大环形传送门u7531914676_Giant_circular_portal_activating_with_blue_energy_2e6ca808-9df8-4dca-b7c9-e6e3a907487d_1、空中舰队、雪山天际线、岩石山丘和蓝色炮火同时入画；摩托前轮微微下压，悬挂完全伸展，发光轮圈拖出短暂光轨，几发能量弹 from 身后掠过，击中斜坡边缘，引发碎石和金属残片飞散。 12-15秒：[重落地与爆炸突围] 慢动作结束，摩托重重落回尘土山路，悬挂深度压缩，轮胎砸出沙浪并重新抓地，女特工稳住车身后立刻加速。身后一辆装甲追击车撞上断裂飞船残骸，引发巨大爆炸，火焰、黑烟、蓝色能量碎片、沙尘和金属残片向外翻涌。镜头迅速拉成广角，展现她驾驶白色机甲摩托沿悬崖山路冲向远处巨型传送门，身后是爆炸、追击车队、低空战机、岩石山丘和宏大的未来星港战场u7531914676_Futuristic_desert_city_with_enormous_hover_buses__97da34be-e6db-43ed-805c-33913927a69e_3。 [画质 + 约束] 真实8K电影质感，白昼自然光、硬朗阴影、空气热浪、沙尘颗粒、岩石纹理、碎石滚动、金属车身反光、发光轮圈、机械传动、炮火尘柱和远景星港都要清晰。所有加速、侧倾、转弯、悬挂压缩、碎石飞溅和炮火冲击符合真实物理逻辑。无随机文字、无logo、无字幕、无水印、无UI；避免摩托变形、车轮畸形、骑手变化、额外骑手、漂浮物体、场景跳变、动作难以辨认、画面闪烁和违反物理规律。

en.t: Agent Rides Mecha Bike Through Wreckage
en.p: [Style + Photography + Atmosphere] Continuing from the previous segment, the same daytime futuristic desert starport, the same female agent, the same white mecha super motorcycle. The action begins right after she has just charged into the peripheral spacecraft wreckage zone of the starport. It remains a bright sunny daytime, with strong natural light illuminating the dusty mountain roads, rocky hills, cliff edges, and massive metal wreckage. The sandy runways mix with gravel slopes, shattered ship armor, half-buried mechanical components, metal bridge decks, and natural rock faces, combining both realistic off-road terrain u7531914676_Futuristic_desert_city_with_enormous_hover_buses__97da34be-e6db-43ed-805c-33913927a69e_3 and grand sci-fi starport u7531914676_PROMPT_Hundreds_of_futuristic_starfighters_and_at_d5349092-30f9-4588-9713-472bb413a207_0. In the distance, the giant circular portal u7531914676_Giant_circular_portal_activating_with_blue_energy_2e6ca808-9df8-4dca-b7c9-e6e3a907487d_1 continuously releases blue energy, with fleets in the sky and low-altitude fighters crossing the bright sky, maintaining a gritty, realistic, dangerous, and ultra-cinematic look. [Character + Vehicle Consistency] The protagonist remains the same female agent from the reference image, with the fixed appearance from image_20260520195912_211_1403, without any additional changes to hairstyle, outfit, physique, or facial expression. She rides the same white ultra-futuristic mecha super motorcycle hf_20260627_043019_63b2479c-1228-44b5-bfab-69010a4a430f: throughout the entire sequence, the same rider and the same motorcycle must be consistently maintained, with no vehicle swaps, transformations, additional riders, or structural changes to the bike. [Per-Second Timeline] 0-4s: [Low rear chase shot] The shot starts from a low angle behind the female agent, as the white mecha motorcycle charges into the wreckage zone, with broken metal cabin panels, tilted supports, loose gravel, and mechanical fragments half-buried in sand ahead. She quickly weaves left and right, the bike skimming past wreckage edges, metal armor sparking on contact, tires bouncing between sand and gravel. Behind her, a black armored vehicle convoy u7531914676_Gigantic_autonomous_robotic_artillery_firing_magn_ef23fd66-21e7-4be0-9fde-f4452b5feb15_0 gives close pursuit, while low-altitude fighters u7531914676_A_cybernetic_pilot_flying_a_massive_futuristic_st_b1e9adb0-2b39-4357-8d49-5bd0cd067e46_2 pass overhead, artillery fire exploding on both sides of the passage. 4-8s: [Side-slide through narrow passage] The camera shifts to a high-speed side tracking shot from the right of the motorcycle. The female agent lowers her center of gravity, the bike sliding sideways at the boundary between sand and metal deck, rear wheels kicking up sand waves, gravel, and sparks. She passes between two collapsed ship armor plates through an extremely narrow gap, the transparent windshield nearly scraping against the metal edges. The pursuing armored vehicles, being too large, are forced to crash through the wreckage, sending debris flying toward the lens. Sunlight cuts through the dust haze, illuminating every grain of sand and airborne metal fragment, enhancing the realistic daytime texture. 8-12s: [Jump and slow-motion climax] Ahead appears a ramp formed by a broken ship deck and a natural rock slope, with a sheer cliff drop beyond. The female agent does not slow down, charging straight up the ramp, the white mecha motorcycle briefly airborne. Slow motion occurs only for an instant: in the background, the massive circular portal u7531914676_Giant_circular_portal_activating_with_blue_energy_2e6ca808-9df8-4dca-b7c9-e6e3a907487d_1, the aerial fleet, snow-capped mountain skyline, rocky hills, and blue artillery fire all enter the frame simultaneously; the front wheel tilts slightly downward, suspension fully extended, glowing rims trailing brief light trails, as several energy bolts from behind whiz past, striking the ramp edge and triggering scattered gravel and metal fragments. 12-15s: [Hard landing and explosive breakout] The slow motion ends, the motorcycle lands heavily back on the dusty mountain road, suspension deeply compressed, tires kicking up sand waves and regaining grip, as the female agent steadies the bike and immediately accelerates. Behind her, one of the pursuing armored vehicles crashes into a broken ship wreckage, triggering a massive explosion, with flames, black smoke, blue energy shards, dust, and metal fragments billowing outward. The camera quickly pulls to a wide angle, showcasing her riding the white mecha motorcycle along the cliffside road toward the distant giant portal, with the explosion, pursuit convoy, low-altitude fighters, rocky hills, and the grand futuristic starport battlefield u7531914676_Futuristic_desert_city_with_enormous_hover_buses__97da34be-e6db-43ed-805c-33913927a69e_3 behind. [Image Quality + Constraints] Real 8K cinematic quality, with natural daylight, harsh shadows, heat haze, dust particles, rock textures, rolling gravel, metal body reflections, glowing rims, mechanical drivetrain details, artillery dust columns, and distant starport all clearly rendered. All accelerations, leaning, turns, suspension compression, debris scattering, and artillery impacts must adhere to real physical logic. No random text, no logos, no subtitles, no watermarks, no UI; avoid motorcycle deformation, wheel distortion, rider changes, extra riders, floating objects, scene jumps, unrecognizable actions, screen flickering, and any violations of physical laws.

raw_p:
首帧 FIRST FRAME（=上传参考图，仅作起手姿态，之后人物自然活动）：

唐风美人，乌发高髻、金步摇旁簪一朵红牡丹，眉心花钿，

米白薄纱外披罩绛橙描金抹胸襦裙，双手在身前自然交叠；

身畔牡丹丛、身后紫禁城楼台、黄昏暖金光、空气微尘浮动。

人物五官妆容服饰与首帧一致，肢体全程自然松弛，不僵直。

核心要求：真人纪实表演质感，去掉一切「AI 味」——

皮肤有真实毛孔与细绒、油光与呼吸起伏，

微表情有不完美的真实感（眼神偶尔游移、嘴角先动一下再笑、

眨眼节奏不规律、偶有极轻的吞咽/抿唇/调整重心的小动作）。

分镜脚本（少台词·重真实细节表演）：

SHOT 1｜0-4秒｜中近景（手持镜头·极轻微呼吸晃动）

她低头看着交叠的双手，指尖无意识地轻捻衣带，

重心从一只脚换到另一只，肩膀松一下；

随后被身旁牡丹引去注意，自然抬眼侧望，眼神先到、头才转过去。

无台词，仅自然呼吸与环境声（风、远处鸟鸣）。

SHOT 2｜4-7秒｜面部特写（眼神戏）

镜头轻推到面部：眼睫不规律地眨动，瞳孔有细微对焦的游移，

鼻翼随呼吸极轻翕动，唇角先抿了一下、才漾开一个真实的浅笑，

笑意先从眼睛起来——不是程式化的标准微笑。

〔几乎气声·一句〕"这花……开得真好。"

SHOT 3｜7-11秒｜半身动态

她抬手轻触身旁牡丹花瓣，指腹真实地陷进花瓣的软，

手腕自然转动，纱袖滑下一截，她下意識用另一只手把袖子撩回去，

身子随之微微側轉，碎髮被風吹亂、貼在臉頰，她不去理。

滿畫面都是真實的、不刻意的小動作。無台詞。

SHOT 4｜11-15秒｜回到中近景（收束·自然定格）

她收回手，目光重新落回前方，輕輕吐了口氣，

眼神裡帶著一點真實的悵然又釋然，嘴唇微動想說什麼、終究沒說，

最後是一個沒那麼完美、卻很真實的淺笑，自然停在那一刻。

〔氣聲·漸弱·像自語〕"……也好。"

聲音設定：女聲，自然生活化，氣聲偏多，語速隨情緒不勻，

不字正腔圓、略帶真實的呼吸停頓；全程僅兩處極短輕語。

鏡頭 CAMERA：

手持質感（極輕微自然晃動與呼吸感），多分鏡：

中近景／面部特寫／半身／回中近景，切換自然不炫技；

真實淺景深、焦點偶有極細微的呼吸式重對焦，背景宮闕牡丹虛化。

氛圍·光線：

黃昏真實自然光，側逆光鑲髮絲金邊，暖調；

空氣微塵、花瓣偶爾飄落、紗披與碎髮隨真實微風動，

整體像膠片實拍，顆粒細膩、高光柔和不過曝。

CONSTRAINTS（约束）：

- 4K 超清，15秒，人物妝容服飾與首幀一致（換鏡不換臉不換裝）

- 核心：真人紀實表演——真實皮膚質感、不規律眨眼、自然重心轉移、

微表情有「不完美的真實感」，嚴禁僵硬呆滯或塑料假臉

- 去 AI 味：避免過度磨皮、過度對稱、過度順滑的運動與完美微笑

- 兩處台詞與口型嚴格同步，氣聲生活化，不假唱、不字正腔圓

- 風動、落花、紗袖、碎髮符合真實物理，自然不誇張

- 眼神有戲、有真實焦點游移；禁止眼睛發光、瞳孔異常

- 結尾在自然的小動作餘韻裡定格，無黑屏無轉場

- 無字幕、無水印、無任何標記符號、無文字

en.p: First frame (=upload reference image, serves only as starting posture; the figure will move naturally afterward): Tang-style beauty, jet-black hair in a high bun, a red peony pinned beside the golden step-shake hair ornament, a floral forehead adornment, an off-white gauze outer robe over a crimson-orange gold-embroidered wrapped chest skirt and ruqun, hands naturally folded in front; peony bushes beside her, the Forbidden City pavilions behind, warm golden dusk light, floating dust motes in the air. The facial features, makeup, and attire remain consistent with the first frame; the body stays naturally relaxed throughout, never stiff. Core requirement: a real human documentary performance texture, removing all 'AI feel' — skin has real pores and fine fuzz, natural oil sheen and breathing rise-and-fall, micro-expressions with imperfect realism (eyes occasionally wandering, the corner of the mouth moving slightly before smiling, irregular blinking rhythm, occasional very slight swallowing/lip-pressing/minor weight-shifting movements). Storyboard (minimal dialogue · emphasis on real detailed performance): SHOT 1 | 0-4 sec | Medium close-up (handheld camera · very slight breath-like shake) She looks down at her folded hands, fingertips unconsciously twisting the sash, shifting weight from one foot to the other, letting one shoulder relax; then drawn by the peony beside her, she naturally raises her eyes and looks sideways — eyes move first, then the head turns. No dialogue, only natural breathing and ambient sounds (wind, distant birdsong). SHOT 2 | 4-7 sec | Close-up on face (eye acting) Camera gently pushes in to the face: lashes blink irregularly, pupils have subtle focusing shifts, nostrils move very slightly with breath, lips press together briefly before a genuine slight smile spreads — the smile starts from the eyes first, not a programmed standard smile. [Almost breathy, one line] 'These flowers... are blooming so beautifully.' SHOT 3 | 7-11 sec | Half-body dynamic movement She raises a hand to lightly touch the peony petals beside her, fingertips genuinely sinking into the softness of the petals, wrist turning naturally, the gauze sleeve sliding down a bit — she instinctively uses the other hand to pull the sleeve back up, body turning slightly as she does, stray hairs blown messy by the wind, sticking to her cheek, she ignores them. The whole frame is filled with real, uncalculated small movements. No dialogue. SHOT 4 | 11-15 sec | Back to medium close-up (closure · natural freeze) She withdraws her hand, her gaze returns to the front, she lets out a soft breath, a hint of genuine wistfulness mixed with relief in her eyes, lips part slightly as if to speak but finally nothing comes out, ending with a not-so-perfect but very real slight smile, naturally pausing at that moment. [Breathy, fading, like talking to herself] '...That's fine too.' Audio setting: female voice, natural and conversational, mostly breathy, speech tempo uneven with emotion, not standardly enunciated, with realistic breath pauses; only two extremely short soft lines throughout. Camera: handheld texture (very slight natural shake and breath feel), multi-shot: medium close-up / face close-up / half-body / back to medium close-up, transitions natural and unflashy; real shallow depth of field, occasional very subtle breath-like refocusing, background palace and peonies blurred. Atmosphere · Lighting: real natural dusk light, side-backlight gilding hair edges with golden rim, warm tone; airborne dust, occasional falling petals, gauze cape and stray hairs moving with real breeze, overall like film real-shot, fine grain, soft highlights without overexposure. CONSTRAINTS: - 4K ultra-HD, 15 seconds, figure's makeup and attire consistent with first frame (no face change, no costume change across shots) - Core: real human documentary performance — real skin texture, irregular blinks, natural weight shifts, micro-expressions with 'imperfect realism', strictly no rigidity or plastic fake-face - Remove AI feel: avoid over-smoothing, over-symmetry, overly slick motion and perfect smile - Two lines of dialogue strictly sync with mouth movements, breathy and conversational, not lip-synced stiffly, not overly enunciated - Wind motion, falling petals, sleeve movement, stray hairs follow real physics, natural and not exaggerated - Eyes must act, with real focus shifts; forbid glowing eyes or abnormal pupils - End freezes in the lingering afterglow of natural small movements, no black screen, no transitions - No subtitles, no watermarks, no markers, symbols, or text of any kind

TOKYO TRAVEL VLOG — 15 SEC MUSIC CUT

Subject: Same girl as the reference images. Young Korean idol-like woman in her early 20s. Long straight black hair with soft natural volume, fair porcelain skin, large bright expressive eyes, delicate V-line face, small nose, natural glossy lips, fresh minimal makeup, effortlessly cute and approachable expression. Casual Japanese streetwear (white hoodie / dark oversized hoodie / oversized jacket). 26mm phone lens, deep focus, realistic skin texture, mild HDR, neutral iPhone color science, unedited candid, no cinematic grading, no studio lighting, no light trails, no motion blur effects.

(0:00–0:01) — walking shot, Tokyo Tower reveal Selfie, low angle. Tower behind her, sky overexposed. Natural smile. Neutral daylight, deep focus. Dialogue: "드디어 도쿄에 왔어요...!" Transition: Hard cut / beat drop

(0:01–0:02) — Shibuya Crossing Mid-stride into crowd. Turns head toward camera. Neon signs sharp behind her. Real night exposure. Transition: Fast cut on beat

(0:02–0:03) — Convenience Store Holds onigiri up to camera, eyebrows raised. Harsh fluorescent interior. Cool white light, realistic skin. Transition: Snap cut on beat

(0:03–0:04) — Yoyogi Park Seated, looking away. Dappled light, lens smudge visible. Music drops one beat — wind, birds — snaps back. Transition: Cut on natural movement

(0:04–0:06) — Takoyaki Reaction Bites, eyes wide, pulls back laughing. Warm practical lantern light. Realistic skin in amber. Dialogue: "뜨거워! 진짜 맛있어!" Transition: Cut on laugh end

(0:06–0:07) — Vending Machine Night Stands before glowing vending machine. Mixed LED light on face. Slight smirk. No glow fx. Transition: Single beat cut

(0:07–0:08) — Train Window Face reflected in window. City blurred naturally outside. She looks out, not at camera. Transition: Snap cut

(0:08–0:09) — Torii Gate Low angle. Walks toward and through shrine gate. Gate fills top of frame. Natural daylight. Transition: Snap cut

(0:09–0:11) — Digital Light Exhibit ★ SIGNATURE Looks up slowly. Blue, violet, gold projection on face. Rack focus — face sharp, lights diffused. Just projection on skin, no bloom. Speed: ~60% slow motion Transition: Soft cut mid-upward motion

(0:11–0:12) — Gundam Reveal Face → camera tilts up → full statue in frame. Small impressed smile. Wide angle, natural daylight. Transition: Sharp cut after smile

(0:12–0:13) — Lantern Alley Follow from behind. Lanterns warm, shadows dark. Natural low light. She glances back once. Transition: Cut on forward movement

(0:13–0:14) — Rooftop Skyline Close selfie → arm extends → skyline revealed. Wind moves hair. Natural night phone exposure. Dialogue: "이런 야경은 처음 보는 것 같아요." Transition: Hard cut on last word

东京旅行VLOG——15秒音乐剪辑 主角：与参考图像为同一女性。20岁出头的年轻韩国偶像型女性。长直黑发，柔软自然的发量，白皙瓷肌，大而有神的明亮眼睛，精致的V形脸，小巧的鼻子，自然光泽的嘴唇，清新淡妆，毫不费力地可爱且亲切的表情。休闲日系街头穿搭（白色卫衣/深色宽松卫衣/超大号夹克）。26毫米手机镜头，深景深，真实皮肤纹理，轻度HDR，中性iPhone色彩风格，未编辑的抓拍，无电影调色，无影棚灯光，无光轨，无动态模糊效果。

(0:00–0:01) — 行走镜头，东京塔亮相 自拍，低角度。东京塔在她身后，天空过曝。自然微笑。中性日光，深景深。对白：‘드디어 도쿄에 왔어요...!’（终于来到东京了...！） 转场：硬切/节奏重拍

(0:01–0:02) — 涩谷十字路口 步入人群中，中途转头。回头看向镜头。身后霓虹灯牌清晰锐利。真实夜间曝光。转场：节奏快切

(0:02–0:03) — 便利店 将饭团举到镜头前，挑起眉毛。刺眼的荧光灯室内。冷白光，真实肤色。转场：节奏快切

(0:03–0:04) — 代代木公园 坐着，视线移向别处。斑驳光影，镜头上有可见污迹。音乐停一拍——风声、鸟鸣——又迅速切回。转场：随自然动作剪切

(0:04–0:06) — 章鱼烧反应 咬下一口，瞪大眼睛，后仰大笑。温暖的实用灯笼光。琥珀色灯光下的真实肤色。对白：‘뜨거워! 진짜 맛있어!’（好烫！真的好好吃！） 转场：笑声结束时剪切

(0:06–0:07) — 自动售货机 夜晚，站在发光的自动售货机前。混合LED灯光映在脸上。略带坏笑。无发光特效。转场：单拍剪切

(0:07–0:08) — 电车窗 面孔映在车窗上。窗外城市自然模糊。她看向窗外，不看镜头。转场：快切

(0:08–0:09) — 鸟居 低角度。走向并穿过神社鸟居。鸟居填满画面上方。自然日光。转场：快切

(0:09–0:11) — 数字灯光展 ★ 标志性 缓慢抬头。蓝色、紫色、金色投影映在脸上。变焦——面部清晰，灯光虚化。仅投影在皮肤上，无光晕效果。速度：约60%慢动作 转场：在抬头动作中段柔切

(0:11–0:12) — 高达亮相 面部→镜头上摇→全身雕像入画。露出小小的惊喜笑容。广角，自然日光。转场：笑容后锐利剪切

(0:12–0:13) — 灯笼小巷 从身后跟拍。灯笼暖光，阴影深暗。自然弱光。她回头看了一眼。转场：随前进方向剪切

(0:13–0:14) — 天台天际线 近距自拍→手臂伸出→天际线展现。风吹动头发。自然夜间手机曝光。对白：‘이런 야경은 처음 보는 것 같아요.’（这样的夜景好像是第一次看到。） 转场：最后一句硬切

Subject: Same girl as the reference images. Young Korean idol-like woman in her early 20s. Long straight black hair with soft natural volume, fair porcelain skin, large bright expressive eyes, delicate V-line face, small nose, natural glossy lips, fresh minimal makeup, effortlessly cute and approachable expression. Casual Japanese streetwear (white hoodie / dark oversized hoodie / oversized jacket). 26mm phone lens, deep focus, realistic skin texture, mild HDR, neutral iPhone color science, unedited candid, no cinematic grading, no studio lighting, no light trails, no motion blur effects.

Scene: A seamless ultra-cinematic one-take shot starting from deep space and ending in an intimate café moment. The sequence emphasizes speed, scale, and immersive transition from cosmic to human scale.

Subject / Character: Final subject is @img1 — a young woman sitting in an open-air café named “LUMOS”, wearing denim shorts and a white shirt, casually eating a hamburger with a drink beside her.

Action Timeline (TOTAL: 15s):

0–4s (Space → Earth Approach):
Wide cinematic shot of Earth in deep space. Camera accelerates forward smoothly. Earth rapidly grows in frame. Subtle light streaks, atmospheric glow becomes visible. Motion builds gradually but feels grand.

4–8s (Atmospheric Entry → Fast Descent):
Camera pierces atmosphere with intense glow and motion blur. Clouds rush past. Continents and terrain sweep underneath at high speed. Strong sense of acceleration.

8–11s (City Dive → Street Flow):
Camera locks onto a city and dives sharply. Skyscrapers rise fast. Transition into street-level movement — fluid glide through streets, passing buildings, corners, and urban elements with dynamic motion.

11–12s (Café Target Lock):
Camera spots outdoor café with large “LUMOS” sign. Rapid but smooth deceleration begins. Focus tightens.

12–15s (Final Scene – Character):
Camera settles into a medium shot of @img1. She sits casually, eating a hamburger, drink on table. Natural motion (taking a bite, relaxed posture). Warm, calm contrast to previous high-speed sequence.

Camera:
One continuous shot, no cuts. Extreme speed ramping: slow → ultra-fast → controlled slowdown. Wide lens in space → natural cinematic lens at final shot. Smooth stabilization with slight handheld realism at the end.

Audio:
Cinematic rise from deep space ambience → intense whooshing during descent → city ambience → soft café sounds (light chatter, ambient noise).

Style:
Cinematic color grading: cool tones in space/descent → gradually warmer tones at street/café. High contrast, subtle film grain, volumetric lighting, atmospheric particles, ultra-detailed, 8K, photorealistic.

zh.p: 场景：一段无缝的超电影感一镜到底镜头，从深空开始，结束于一个温馨的咖啡馆时刻。整个序列强调速度、尺度，以及从宇宙到人类尺度的沉浸式过渡。主体/角色：最终主体为@img1——一位年轻女性，坐在名为“LUMOS”的露天咖啡馆中，身穿牛仔短裤和白衬衫，正随意地吃着汉堡，旁边放着一杯饮料。动作时间线（总计：15秒）：0–4秒（太空→接近地球）：地球在深空中的宽幅电影感镜头。摄影机平稳加速向前推进。地球在画面中迅速变大。细微的光痕、大气辉光逐渐可见。运动逐渐增强，但整体感觉宏大。4–8秒（进入大气层→快速下降）：摄影机以强烈的辉光和运动模糊穿过大气层。云层飞速掠过。大陆和地形在下方高速掠过。强烈的加速感。8–11秒（城市俯冲→街道滑行）：摄影机锁定一座城市并急剧俯冲。摩天大楼迅速升起。过渡到街道层面的运动——流畅地滑行穿过街道，经过建筑、街角和城市元素，动态感十足。11–12秒（咖啡馆目标锁定）：摄影机发现带有大型“LUMOS”标志的户外咖啡馆。开始快速而平稳的减速。焦点收紧。12–15秒（最终场景——角色）：摄影机稳定为@img1的中景镜头。她随意地坐着，吃着汉堡，饮料在桌上。自然动作（咬一口，放松的姿态）。温暖、平静，与之前的高速序列形成对比。摄影机：连续一镜到底，无切换。极速变速：慢→超快→受控减速。太空中使用广角镜头→最终镜头转为自然电影感镜头。平稳稳定，结尾带有轻微手持真实感。音频：从深空氛围的电影感渐起→下降时的强烈呼啸声→城市环境音→轻柔的咖啡馆声音（轻声交谈、环境杂音）。风格：电影调色：太空/下降阶段冷色调→街道/咖啡馆逐渐变暖色调。高对比度、轻微胶片颗粒、体积光、大气粒子、超精细、8K、照片级真实感。

Cinematography: First-person POV, naturalistic unconstrained human vision. Authentic head movement with organic micro-tremor, subtle wind-shake, and reactive eye-line tracking.

Lighting: surrealistic alien twilight. High-contrast natural light through a dense canopy. Underlit by vibrant bioluminescent glow from the fungal forest.

Color: 60:30:10 — dominant deep indigo and violet 60% / secondary neon magenta, cyan, toxic green 30% / accent warm amber-gold (hoverbike dashboard) 10%.

Camera: wide-angle cine lens (24mm). 180° shutter motion blur. Speed-ramping (24fps to 240fps and back). Extreme macro depth-of-field transition.

Physics: inertia and wind resistance felt through the camera. Particles and spores obey aerodynamic drag.

SUBJECTS:

pure first-person vision, no helmet, no HUD. At the bottom of the frame, the rider's hands grip the handlebars of a heavy hoverbike, fingers adjusting the throttle.

a surreal iridescent macro-insect — double-layered translucent oil-slick wings, a neon-cyan segmented body pulsing with bioluminescence, large multi-faceted magenta eyes.

LOCATION: a bizarre fantasy jungle at twilight, towering twisted mega-mushrooms pulsing with toxic green and magenta light. Glowing spores drift like ash.

ACTION — ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, NO cuts. 15 seconds.

0:00–0:04 — High-velocity real-time POV (24fps): the hoverbike flies low and fast, weaving through a narrow opening; the camera tilts into turns; spores streak past.

0:04–0:05 — The jolt: as the bike clips a glowing stalk, the alien fly flashes in from camera-left — a sudden jump-scare. The camera flinches (a micro-jerk back and right). Time violently freezes into extreme slow-motion.

0:05–0:11 — Ultra slow-motion macro (240fps): near standstill. The alien fly drifts past the lens at macro distance, centimeters from the eye — every microscopic detail visible, oil-slick wings scattering the neon light, spores parting around it, horizontal anamorphic magenta flares across the lens.

0:11–0:15 — Instant speed-ramp back (24fps): the fly snaps past camera-right and vanishes; time cracks back with a rush of wind, the engine roars, the rider corrects and accelerates deeper into the forest.

CONSTRAINTS: 16:9. ONE CONTINUOUS POV SHOT — no cuts. No screen borders or helmet graphics. Photoreal throughout.

AUDIO (NO MUSIC): heavy mechanical hum and high-RPM whine, high-speed wind. At 0:04, a caught breath. During slow-mo, wind drops into a muffled vacuum replaced by the deep thump-thump of the fly's wings and the rider's heartbeat. At 0:11, a sonic whoosh as reality snaps back.

zh.p: 摄影：第一人称视角，自然无约束的人类视觉。真实的头部运动带有有机的微颤动、轻微的风摇和反应性的视线追踪。照明：超现实主义的外星暮光。高对比度的自然光穿过茂密的树冠。下方由真菌森林发出的鲜艳生物荧光照亮。色彩：60:30:10——主色调深靛蓝和紫罗兰占60% / 次要色调霓虹洋红、青色、毒性绿占30% / 点缀暖琥珀金色（悬浮摩托车仪表盘）占10%。相机：广角电影镜头（24mm）。180°快门运动模糊。速度变速（24fps到240fps再返回）。极端微距景深过渡。物理：通过相机感受到惯性和风阻。粒子和孢子遵循空气动力学阻力。主体：纯粹第一人称视觉，无头盔，无HUD。画面底部，骑手双手紧握重型悬浮摩托车的车把，手指调节油门。一只超现实虹彩巨型昆虫——双层半透明油膜翅膀，霓虹青色的节状身体脉动生物荧光，巨大的多面洋红色复眼。地点：黄昏时分奇异奇幻丛林，高耸扭曲的巨型蘑菇脉动着毒性绿和洋红色光。发光的孢子如灰烬般飘散。动作——连续一镜到底，无剪辑。15秒。0:00–0:04——高速实时POV（24fps）：悬浮摩托车低空快速飞行，穿梭于狭窄缝隙；相机随转弯倾斜；孢子从旁掠过。0:04–0:05——冲击：当摩托车擦过一根发光的茎秆时，异星飞虫从相机左侧闪入——突发惊吓。相机微颤（向后和向右轻微猛抽）。时间剧烈冻结，进入极致慢动作。0:05–0:11——超慢动作微距（240fps）：近乎静止。异星飞虫在微距距离飘过镜头，距眼睛仅数厘米——每一处微观细节可见，油膜翅膀散射霓虹光，孢子在其周围散开，镜头上有水平变形洋红色耀斑。0:11–0:15——瞬间速度切换回（24fps）：飞虫闪过相机右侧并消失；时间伴随着一阵风声猛然恢复，引擎轰鸣，骑手修正方向加速深入森林。约束：16:9。连续一镜POV——无剪辑。无画面边框或头盔图案。全程写实。音频（无音乐）：沉重机械嗡鸣和高转速啸叫，高速风声。0:04处，一次屏息。慢动作期间，风声降为闷塞的真空，代之以飞虫翅膀的沉重扑扑声和骑手的心跳。0:11处，一声音速呼啸，现实猛然回归。

raw_p:
Cinematic psychological short film. Continuous single take, strict top-down overhead camera locked directly above a young woman matching the reference image. 24mm lens, realistic digital texture, soft haze, muted tungsten lighting mixed with green city light.

A small cramped studio apartment with a thin mattress, rumpled sheets, scattered clothes, a narrow hallway, tiny wash area with a cracked mirror, and a cluttered kitchenette.

The woman wears an oversized faded t-shirt, soft lounge shorts, and is barefoot. Slightly messy hair, faint smudged kajal under her eyes, tired expression, moving slowly like she is repeating a daily routine on autopilot.

Scene: She lies awake on the mattress staring blankly. She sits up, grabs a crumpled cigarette pack beside her pillow, takes out one cigarette, finds a lighter under the sheet, lights it, inhales, and drops the lighter.

She stands and slowly walks through the apartment while the camera perfectly tracks overhead without drifting. She enters the wash area, turns on the tap, wets her fingers, lazily splashes water on her face, and leaves water dripping.

She walks into the kitchenette, moves a plate aside, picks up a steel tumbler, then pauses completely still. She takes another drag from the cigarette.

After a few seconds, she slowly lifts her head and looks directly into the camera. She exhales smoke upward toward the lens and never breaks eye contact.

Audio: soft lighter click, distant traffic, electrical hum, running water, soft footsteps, subtle ambient tension.

en.p:
Cinematic psychological short film. Continuous single take, strict top-down overhead camera locked directly above a young woman matching the reference image. 24mm lens, realistic digital texture, soft haze, muted tungsten lighting mixed with green city light.

A small cramped studio apartment with a thin mattress, rumpled sheets, scattered clothes, a narrow hallway, tiny wash area with a cracked mirror, and a cluttered kitchenette.

The woman wears an oversized faded t-shirt, soft lounge shorts, and is barefoot. Slightly messy hair, faint smudged kajal under her eyes, tired expression, moving slowly like she is repeating a daily routine on autopilot.

Scene: She lies awake on the mattress staring blankly. She sits up, grabs a crumpled cigarette pack beside her pillow, takes out one cigarette, finds a lighter under the sheet, lights it, inhales, and drops the lighter.

She stands and slowly walks through the apartment while the camera perfectly tracks overhead without drifting. She enters the wash area, turns on the tap, wets her fingers, lazily splashes water on her face, and leaves water dripping.

She walks into the kitchenette, moves a plate aside, picks up a steel tumbler, then pauses completely still. She takes another drag from the cigarette.

After a few seconds, she slowly lifts her head and looks directly into the camera. She exhales smoke upward toward the lens and never breaks eye contact.

Audio: soft lighter click, distant traffic, electrical hum, running water, soft footsteps, subtle ambient tension.

raw_p:
WHEN SHE BECOMES THE BUTTERFLIES
30 Seconds • 16:9 
ENVIRONMENT LOCK

Open grassy hilltop at golden hour transitioning into deep indigo twilight. Rolling yellow-green grass, strong wind, no buildings or other characters.

PART 1 — THE CONFRONTATION (0:00–0:15)
P01

Both warriors stand fifteen meters apart. Low-angle 85mm. She adopts a genuine combat stance while he raises his water sword. Butterflies and water slowly gather.

P02

He lunges first with a horizontal slash. She sidesteps, parries, immediately counters with a fast slash. Sparks, water and butterflies explode at blade contact.

P03

She launches an aggressive three-hit sword combination. He blocks while retreating before creating a towering water column. She vaults over it using the momentum.

P04

Mid-air duel. Five rapid sword clashes. Butterflies and water collide with every strike. She flips away after kicking off his blade.

P05

She lands into a low slide, attacks his legs, transitions into upward and reverse slashes. He blocks with a curved wall of rushing water.

P06

Both charge directly toward each other. She thrusts forward while he delivers an overhead strike. Their weapons lock inches from the camera.

Freeze on her blazing green eyes and glowing lightsaber tip.

PART 2 — THE CLIMAX (0:15–0:30)

IMPORTANT: Begin from the exact frozen last frame of Part 1 with identical camera, pose, lighting, expressions and sword positions before motion resumes.

P07

Their blades collide violently. Close-quarters sword lock. She twists free and launches a rapid counterattack while water and butterflies burst across the frame.

P08

Fast sword exchange. She unleashes a relentless five-hit combination. He blocks and counters using rotating water currents. Every strike has realistic weight and purpose.

P09

She performs her strongest attack, creating an enormous storm of iridescent butterflies that completely engulfs the battlefield. He disappears inside the butterfly cloud.

P10

Bird's-eye view. Butterfly vortex surrounds her. He calmly finds an opening and lands one perfectly timed thrust through the vortex. Silence. She smiles peacefully.

P11

The wound glows. Her body gently dissolves from the feet upward into thousands of real iridescent butterflies. Her lightsaber transforms into butterflies. Her smiling face disappears last as soft laughter echoes across the hill.

P12

The Water Duelist stands alone beneath the indigo sky. His sword lowers. One butterfly lands on his fingertip. He smiles gently. The camera cranes upward as thousands of butterflies drift into the sky. Fade to black.

zh.p: 当她化为蝶群 30秒 • 16:9 环境锁定 开阔的草坡山顶，黄金时刻过渡至深靛蓝暮色。翻滚的黄绿草丛，强风，无建筑或其他角色。 第一部分 — 对峙（0:00–0:15） P01 两位战士相隔十五米。低角度85mm镜头。她摆出真正的战斗架势，而他举起水之剑。蝴蝶与水珠缓缓汇聚。 P02 他率先发起横斩。她侧步格挡，立即以快速斩击反击。剑刃交击处迸溅火花、水花与蝶群。 P03 她发动猛烈的三连剑击组合。他边格挡边后退，随即竖起一道冲天水柱。她借势腾跃越过水柱。 P04 空中对决。五次快速剑刃碰撞。每一次撞击都迸发蝴蝶与水花。她蹬踏他的剑刃翻身退开。 P05 她落地滑行，攻击其下盘，随即衔接上撩与逆斩。他以一道弯曲的急流壁格挡。 P06 双方迎面冲锋。她突刺向前，他则当头劈下。武器在距镜头数寸处锁停。定格于她燃烧的碧绿眼眸与发光光剑尖端。 第二部分 — 高潮（0:15–0:30） 重要：从第一部分最后一帧的完全定格状态继续，包括相同机位、姿势、光线、表情和剑的位置，然后恢复动作。 P07 双剑猛烈相撞。近距离剑刃僵持。她旋身脱出并发起快速反击，水花与蝶群在画面中爆散。 P08 快速剑刃交锋。她释放出势不可挡的五连击组合。他利用旋转水流格挡反击。每次挥击都具有真实的力度与目的性。 P09 她施展最强一击，召唤出巨大的虹彩蝶风暴，完全吞没战场。他消失在蝶云之中。 P10 鸟瞰视角。蝶之漩涡环绕着她。他冷静地找到破绽，一记精准的突刺穿过漩涡。寂静。她平静地微笑。 P11 伤口发光。她的身体从脚部开始轻柔地向上溶解，化为成千上万只真实的虹彩蝴蝶。她的光剑化作蝶群。她微笑的面容最后消失，轻灵的笑声在山丘间回荡。 P12 水之剑士独自伫立于靛蓝苍穹之下。他垂下剑锋。一只蝴蝶落于他的指尖。他温柔地微笑。镜头向上摇移，成千上万只蝴蝶飘向天空。渐隐至黑。

raw_p:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.

Inside a large underground maintenance tunnel at night, a rider on a sleek fast bike races forward as a violent surge of water floods through the tunnel behind them. The environment is industrial and clear: concrete tunnel walls, overhead pipes, support beams, service lights, metal walkways, warning lights, and wet reflective surfaces. 
The rider wears dark fitted riding gear and a full helmet with dark visor. No visible face.

Wide opening shot: the rider speeds through the maintenance tunnel at high speed. Far behind, a wall of floodwater bursts into the tunnel and begins rushing forward. Tunnel lights reflect on the wet ground.
Side tracking shot: the rider accelerates through the tunnel while water surges closer behind. The bike weaves past support pillars, pipes, and simple maintenance obstacles. The tunnel lights begin failing one by one, going dark in sequence as the rider passes.

Front three-quarter shot: the rider keeps moving fast as water rises and spreads across the floor. Spray kicks up around the tires. Warning lights flash red. 
The closing flood gate is visible far ahead at the end of the tunnel.

Final 5 seconds: the pace becomes more intense. The rider pushes to maximum speed as the floodwater closes in. More tunnel lights go dark. The rider leans low, races through the narrowing opening, and escapes just before the heavy flood gate finishes closing. The water slams into the gate from the other side.
Final moment: the rider skids to a stop in the safer corridor beyond the gate while water crashes against the sealed barrier behind.

Inside a large underground maintenance tunnel at night, a rider on a sleek fast bike races forward as a violent surge of water floods through the tunnel behind them. The environment is industrial and clear: concrete tunnel walls, overhead pipes, support beams, service lights, metal walkways, warning lights, and wet reflective surfaces. 
The rider wears dark fitted riding gear and a full helmet with dark visor. No visible face.

Wide opening shot: the rider speeds through the maintenance tunnel at high speed. Far behind, a wall of floodwater bursts into the tunnel and begins rushing forward. Tunnel lights reflect on the wet ground.
Side tracking shot: the rider accelerates through the tunnel while water surges closer behind. The bike weaves past support pillars, pipes, and simple maintenance obstacles. The tunnel lights begin failing one by one, going dark in sequence as the rider passes.

Front three-quarter shot: the rider keeps moving fast as water rises and spreads across the floor. Spray kicks up around the tires. Warning lights flash red. 
The closing flood gate is visible far ahead at the end of the tunnel.

Final 5 seconds: the pace becomes more intense. The rider pushes to maximum speed as the floodwater closes in. More tunnel lights go dark. The rider leans low, races through the narrowing opening, and escapes just before the heavy flood gate finishes closing. The water slams into the gate from the other side.
Final moment: the rider skids to a stop in the safer corridor beyond the gate while water crashes against the sealed barrier behind.

raw_p: Single continuous uninterrupted cinematic shot, no cuts, one flowing 15-second take. Shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, photorealistic live-action film, NOT animated, NOT a video game, NOT CGI render. On a private jet runway tarmac in bright daytime, a sleek private jet parked with its boarding stairs lowered. Cinematic color grading, crisp natural daylight, heat shimmer off the tarmac, clean reflective surfaces, filmic contrast, natural film grain, shallow depth of field. Photorealistic textures, real human skin, realistic materials and reflections.The single camera begins up close beside the boarding stairs where a few beautiful female flight attendants wait — elegant, professional, well-groomed women in crisp tailored white uniforms with welcoming smiles. There is no one else around, only the attendants. The man [imageReference] rides into frame on a premium futuristic motorcycle and comes to a normal, smooth, calm stop right in front of the camera — an ordinary gentle braking with no dust, no skid, no dramatic impact, just easing to a stop. He wears relaxed but refined vacation clothing — a clean fully-buttoned short-sleeve shirt, smart casual trousers, sunglasses, and clean white sneakers, looking effortlessly cool. The motorcycle is an elegant high-end design finished in deep glossy black and metallic red, premium and sophisticated.Without any cut, the same camera flows with him as he swings off the bike confidently and the female attendants greet him warmly. The camera continues unbroken, keeping him in a wider full view from a distance, as he steps beside the motorcycle and presses a button on the bike — seen naturally from afar in the same wide framing, no close-up. The button lights up and the motorcycle responds: its panels smoothly fold and retract, the frame compacting and reconfiguring with precise futuristic mechanical motion, wheels tucking in, the whole machine collapsing down and reshaping itself into a sleek premium rolling suitcase in the same matching deep black and metallic red finish, a telescopic handle rising up. The same camera orbits gently around the transformation, never cutting. The female attendants react with amazement.Still in the same continuous unbroken take, the camera follows as the man casually grabs the suitcase handle, gives it a confident look, and walks at a relaxed unhurried pace pulling the rolling suitcase behind him to the boarding stairs. The shot ends just as he steps onto the first steps and begins to ascend, the camera trailing smoothly behind and to the side — all in one single flowing continuous shot with no cuts anywhere.Photorealistic, premium, clean luxury commercial film look, one smooth steady continuous camera move, restrained cinematic color palette, filmic grain.

zh.p: 单一连续不间断的电影镜头，无剪辑，一段流畅的15秒长镜头。使用ARRI Alexa搭配变形镜头拍摄，照片级写实真人实景电影，非动画，非电子游戏，非CGI渲染。场景位于私人飞机跑道停机坪，白天明亮，一架流线型私人飞机停靠，登机梯已放下。电影级调色，清晰的自然日光，停机坪上的热浪 shimmer，洁净的反光表面，电影感对比度，自然的胶片颗粒，浅景深。照片级写实质感，真实人类皮肤，写实材质与反射。单台摄像机从登机梯旁近处开始，几位美丽的空姐在那里等候——优雅、专业、仪容整洁的女性，穿着利落的白色定制制服，面带亲切微笑。周围没有其他人，只有空姐们。男子[imageReference]骑着一辆高级未来感摩托车驶入画面，并在摄像机正前方平稳、顺畅、安静地停住——普通轻柔的刹车，无扬尘、无打滑、无戏剧性冲击，仅仅是平稳停下。他穿着休闲但精致的度假装——一件干净的扣好全部纽扣的短袖衬衫，休闲质感长裤，太阳镜，和干净的白色运动鞋，显得轻松有型。摩托车为优雅的高端设计，深光面黑色与金属红色涂装，高级精致。无任何剪辑，同一台摄像机随着他流畅运动，他自信地跨下摩托车，空姐们热情迎接。摄像机持续不间断，保持较远的全景全身画面，他走到摩托车旁，按下车上的一个按钮——在同样的远景广角画面中自然展现，无特写。按钮亮起，摩托车响应：面板平滑折叠收缩，车架紧凑重组，以精确的未来感机械动作重新配置，车轮收起，整台机器收缩变形，重塑为一款流线型高级拉杆箱，同样配以深黑与金属红色涂装，伸缩拉杆升起。同一台摄像机在变形过程中轻柔环绕运镜，从不中断。空姐们露出惊叹的表情。仍在同一连续不间断长镜头中，摄像机跟随男子自然地握住拉杆箱把手，自信地看了一眼，然后以轻松从容的步伐拖着行李箱向登机梯走去。镜头在他踏上第一级台阶并开始登梯时结束，摄像机从侧后方平稳平滑地跟随——全部为一个连续流畅的无剪辑长镜头。照片级写实、高级、洁净的奢侈商业电影风格，平稳流畅的连续镜头运动，克制的电影色彩基调，胶片颗粒感。

Maintain the exact face, identity, hairstyle, skin tone, and body proportions from @ image1 in every shot. Outfit remains the same: oversized terracotta linen shirt, dusty burgundy trousers, brown sandals, gold hoop earrings, loose wavy hair.

Authentic Indonesian woman. Late-2000s digital camcorder vlog style. Raw handheld footage with visible shake, imperfect framing, occasional focus hunting, exposure breathing, slight digital grain, warm faded tones, and spontaneous home-video energy. Never centered, never posed.

00:00–00:02 Wooden pier at sunrise. Selfie angle while smiling, talking softly to the camera, colorful boats drifting behind.

00:02–00:04 Small harbor path. Walking beside the water carrying a folded notebook, a friendly stray dog following closely.

00:04–00:06 Tiny roadside warung. Leaning on the counter, sharing a laugh with an elderly vendor while stirring a cup of tea.

00:06–00:08 Dockside scene. Sitting near the edge, reaching down to pet and feed the stray dog as sunlight reflects off the sea.

00:08–00:10 Quiet village lane beneath trees. Slowly walking, checking handwritten notes, glancing around with curiosity.

00:10–00:12 Seaside viewpoint. Standing still, enjoying the morning breeze, hair moving naturally, watching fishing boats in the distance.

00:12–00:15 Final selfie shot back at the dock. She smiles, gives a small wave, laughs naturally, and the clip ends abruptly like an old personal vlog recording.

Natural ambient sound only: waves, seabirds, distant engines, footsteps, chatter, breeze, rustling leaves, and dog sounds. No music, no cinematic styling, no fashion-commercial look.

Ultra-realistic cinematic blockbuster ocean battle. Fierce athletic female warrior, long red hair braided and whipping in the storm, black tactical armored neoprene suit with torn silver panels, skin-tight wet combat suit, battle scars and scratches across her arms, savage expression. Massive Mosasaurus with deep scars and rows of razor-sharp teeth. Raging dark ocean, massive thunderstorm, hyperdetailed water physics.

0–2s: Extreme wide shot diving fast from storm clouds toward raging ocean. Warrior stands barefoot on broken metal debris, blue glowing lines on her torn suit, blood on her hands. Massive waves crash the platform. Camera snaps to extreme close-up of her eyes as she grips an electrified spear. Lightning strikes behind her silhouette.

2–4s: Sudden underwater POV. Massive Mosasaurus rockets upward from the depths, jaws wide open. Aggressive handheld camera shake pushing into rows of teeth. Warrior executes aerial sideways flip, Mosasaurus snaps the metal platform and shreds it. Explosion of water and debris fills frame.

4–6s: 360° tracking shot spinning around her airborne body. She lands hard on Mosasaurus skull and drives spear deep into its eye. Blue electric energy pulses through flesh. Mosasaurus convulses violently, blood mist mixing with water. Camera pushes into impact point then snap-zooms out to massive crashing wave.

6–8s: Mosasaurus dives and rolls brutally. Warrior sprints along its back dragging the spear, tearing flesh and sparks. Low tracking camera behind her. She leaps upward as lightning strikes the spear — silhouette frozen against the sky. Slow dramatic push from below.

8–10s: Top-down cinematic shot. Warrior plunges downward like a missile, screaming, driving the spear through the Mosasaurus skull to the ocean floor. Massive water explosion, shockwave, blood spray, teeth scattered. Camera pulls back rapidly revealing calm sea as Mosasaurus sinks lifelessly. Warrior stands on floating debris, breathing heavy.

FX: stormy water splashes, blood mist, debris explosion, lightning strike impact, aggressive camera shake, rapid push-pull zooms, cinematic motion blur, sparks, rain storm, shockwaves.

Negative: cartoon, blurry, low quality, weak motion, bad anatomy, extra limbs, unrealistic water, text, watermark, censored frames.

zh.p: 超写实电影级海洋大战巨制。凶悍的运动型女战士，红色长发编成辫子在风暴中飞舞，黑色战术装甲氯丁橡胶紧身衣带有撕裂的银色镶片，贴身湿式战斗服，手臂上布满战斗伤疤和划痕，表情凶狠。巨型沧龙身上有深邃的伤疤和成排的利齿。狂暴的黑暗海洋，猛烈的雷暴，超精细的水体物理效果。0–2秒：极广角镜头从暴风云层急速俯冲向狂暴的海洋。战士赤脚站在破碎的金属残骸上，撕裂的战衣上泛着蓝色光纹，双手沾满鲜血。巨浪冲击平台。镜头猛然切至她眼睛的超特写，她紧握着一支带电的长矛。闪电在她身后剪影中劈落。2–4秒：突然切换水下主观视角。巨型沧龙从深处向上猛冲，巨口大张。激进的手持镜头抖动推进至成排的牙齿。战士完成空中侧翻，沧龙咬碎金属平台并将其撕成碎片。水和碎片的爆炸填满画面。4–6秒：360°环绕镜头围绕她腾空的身体旋转。她重重落在沧龙头骨上，将长矛深深刺入其眼睛。蓝色电能脉冲穿过血肉。沧龙剧烈抽搐，血雾与水混合。镜头推向撞击点，然后快速拉出至巨大的拍岸巨浪。6–8秒：沧龙猛烈下潜翻滚。战士沿其背部奔跑拖拽长矛，撕裂皮肉并迸出火花。低角度跟拍镜头在她身后。她向上跃起，闪电击中长矛——她的剪影定格在天空背景下。从下方缓慢推进的戏剧性镜头。8–10秒：俯拍电影级镜头。战士如导弹般俯冲而下，嘶吼着将长矛贯穿沧龙头骨直插海底。巨大的水爆、冲击波、血雾、散落的牙齿。镜头迅速后拉，露出平静的海面，沧龙无力地下沉。战士站在漂浮的残骸上，沉重喘息。特效：暴风雨水花、血雾、碎片爆炸、闪电击打、激进镜头抖动、快速推拉变焦、电影级动态模糊、火花、暴风雨、冲击波。负面提示：卡通、模糊、低质量、运动乏力、解剖结构错误、多余肢体、不真实的水、文字、水印、被审查的画面。
