【风格】国家地理非洲野生动物纪录片（National Geographic African Wildlife），4K超清，超长焦摄影（800mm Telephoto），高速追踪车拍摄（Tracking Vehicle 120fps），东非大草原黄金时刻光线
【时长】10秒
【场景】黄昏的东非稀树草原，金黄色的枯草齐腰高，天际线是一棵巨大的金合欢树剪影，夕阳低悬在地平线上将整个草原染成深金色，地面热浪扭曲远景
[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：草丛中的眼睛（Telephoto Close-Up 800mm, Shallow DOF）
超长焦浅景深特写：金黄色草丛占满画面，完全看不到任何动物。突然草丛缝隙中露出一双琥珀色的眼睛——一头母猎豹趴伏在草中，只有眼睛到耳尖的部分露出草尖。面部的黑色泪痕纹路从眼角延伸到嘴角，鼻头是粗糙的黑色皮革质感。瞳孔猛然收缩成一条竖线——锁定猎物。耳朵微微向后压平贴紧头骨。前景和背景的草丛虚化成金色光斑，只有猎豹的双眼锐利清晰。
[00:04-00:07] 镜头2：全速爆发（High-Speed Tracking 120fps, Side Profile）
侧面高速跟拍：猎豹从草丛中弹射而出进入全速冲刺，时速一百公里。升格慢动作下脊椎像弹簧一样极致弯曲再完全伸展——弯曲时后腿超过前腿，伸展时身体拉成一条水平线四肢全部离地腾空。每一步蹬地的瞬间爪垫下的干草和红土被踢成扇形飞散。腹部的白色短毛随奔跑节奏波浪起伏，尾巴像舵一样在高速转向时甩向一侧维持平衡。面部肌肉紧绷，嘴微张露出犬齿，鼻孔极度扩张。
[00:07-00:10] 镜头3：尘土中的结局（Super Slow-mo, Head-On Tracking）
正面超慢镜迎面跟拍：猎豹直冲镜头方向全速奔来，身后扬起一道三米高的金色尘土尾迹。它猛然侧身急转——四只爪同时在地面刨出四道土痕，身体几乎侧翻到与地面平行，尾巴甩成反方向的弧线。急转瞬间扬起的尘土形成一堵弧形的金色土墙，夕阳逆光穿透土墙将尘粒一颗颗照亮成悬浮的金色星尘。猎豹从尘墙中冲出的剪影渐渐消融在夕阳金光中。

zh.p:
【风格】国家地理非洲野生动物纪录片（National Geographic African Wildlife），4K超清，超长焦摄影（800mm Telephoto），高速追踪车拍摄（Tracking Vehicle 120fps），东非大草原黄金时刻光线
【时长】10秒
【场景】黄昏的东非稀树草原，金黄色的枯草齐腰高，天际线是一棵巨大的金合欢树剪影，夕阳低悬在地平线上将整个草原染成深金色，地面热浪扭曲远景
[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：草丛中的眼睛（Telephoto Close-Up 800mm, Shallow DOF）
超长焦浅景深特写：金黄色草丛占满画面，完全看不到任何动物。突然草丛缝隙中露出一双琥珀色的眼睛——一头母猎豹趴伏在草中，只有眼睛到耳尖的部分露出草尖。面部的黑色泪痕纹路从眼角延伸到嘴角，鼻头是粗糙的黑色皮革质感。瞳孔猛然收缩成一条竖线——锁定猎物。耳朵微微向后压平贴紧头骨。前景和背景的草丛虚化成金色光斑，只有猎豹的双眼锐利清晰。
[00:04-00:07] 镜头2：全速爆发（High-Speed Tracking 120fps, Side Profile）
侧面高速跟拍：猎豹从草丛中弹射而出进入全速冲刺，时速一百公里。升格慢动作下脊椎像弹簧一样极致弯曲再完全伸展——弯曲时后腿超过前腿，伸展时身体拉成一条水平线四肢全部离地腾空。每一步蹬地的瞬间爪垫下的干草和红土被踢成扇形飞散。腹部的白色短毛随奔跑节奏波浪起伏，尾巴像舵一样在高速转向时甩向一侧维持平衡。面部肌肉紧绷，嘴微张露出犬齿，鼻孔极度扩张。
[00:07-00:10] 镜头3：尘土中的结局（Super Slow-mo, Head-On Tracking）
正面超慢镜迎面跟拍：猎豹直冲镜头方向全速奔来，身后扬起一道三米高的金色尘土尾迹。它猛然侧身急转——四只爪同时在地面刨出四道土痕，身体几乎侧翻到与地面平行，尾巴甩成反方向的弧线。急转瞬间扬起的尘土形成一堵弧形的金色土墙，夕阳逆光穿透土墙将尘粒一颗颗照亮成悬浮的金色星尘。猎豹从尘墙中冲出的剪影渐渐消融在夕阳金光中。

en.p: [Style] National Geographic African Wildlife documentary, 4K Ultra HD, ultra-telephoto lens (800mm Telephoto), high-speed tracking vehicle (Tracking Vehicle 120fps), golden hour light on the East African savanna. [Duration] 10 seconds. [Scene] Dusk on the East African savanna, golden dry grass waist-high, a giant acacia tree silhouetted against the skyline, the sun hanging low on the horizon bathing the entire plain in deep gold, heat haze distorting the distance. [00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Eyes in the grass (Telephoto Close-Up 800mm, Shallow DOF). Ultra-telephoto shallow depth-of-field close-up: golden grass fills the entire frame, with no animal visible at all. Suddenly, through a gap in the grass, a pair of amber eyes appears—a female cheetah crouched low in the grass, only her eyes to the tips of her ears rising above the blades. The black tear marks on her face run from the inner corners of her eyes down to the corners of her mouth, her nose rough black leather in texture. Her pupils contract sharply into vertical slits—locking onto prey. Her ears press slightly back, flattening against her skull. The foreground and background grass blur into golden bokeh, leaving only the cheetah's eyes razor-sharp and clear. [00:04-00:07] Shot 2: Full burst (High-Speed Tracking 120fps, Side Profile). High-speed side tracking shot: the cheetah explodes from the grass into a full sprint, reaching 100 kilometers per hour. In slow-motion, her spine bends like a spring to its extreme then fully extends—curving so that her hind legs pass her front legs, then stretching her body into a horizontal line with all four paws airborne. With each push-off, the dry grass and red earth beneath her paw pads are kicked up in fan-shaped sprays. The white short fur on her belly ripples in waves with the rhythm of her stride, her tail swinging to one side like a rudder during high-speed turns to maintain balance. Her facial muscles are taut, her mouth slightly open revealing canines, nostrils flared wide. [00:07-00:10] Shot 3: Conclusion in dust (Super Slow-mo, Head-On Tracking). Head-on ultra-slow-motion tracking shot: the cheetah charges straight toward the camera at full speed, kicking up a three-meter-high trail of golden dust behind her. She abruptly pivots sideways—all four paws gouging four furrows in the ground, her body nearly rolling horizontal to the earth, her tail arcing in the opposite direction. In the instant of the turn, the dust she throws up forms a curved golden wall, the setting sun backlighting it, illuminating each particle as floating golden stardust. The cheetah's silhouette bursts out from the dust wall and gradually dissolves into the golden rays of the setting sun.

A cinematic early morning bedroom scene. A beautiful young woman is sleeping peacefully on a soft white bed inside a cozy modern room. The first golden rays of sunrise slowly enter through the curtains, casting warm light across her face. Dust particles gently float in the sunbeams. The camera slowly pushes in as she opens her eyes naturally and takes a calm breath.

She sits up on the bed, stretches slightly, and places her feet on the wooden floor. Wearing a light cream-colored morning outfit, she slowly walks toward a large window. The curtains move softly with the breeze. She opens the window, and fresh morning air enters the room. Outside, green trees sway gently, birds fly across the sky, and soft sunlight illuminates the surroundings.

The sound of birds singing fills the air. She closes her eyes, takes a deep breath, and smiles peacefully. Her hair moves gently in the breeze as the camera circles around her. The final shot shows her standing by the window, enjoying the quiet morning while sunlight fills the room.

Style: Ultra-realistic, cinematic lighting, realistic skin details, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movements, warm color grading, volumetric sunlight, 4K, high detail, natural emotions, movie-quality visuals.

---

Camera Shots (10 Seconds)

0–2 sec: Close-up of the sleeping girl as golden sunlight slowly reaches her face.

2–4 sec: She opens her eyes and sits up while the camera gently moves closer.

4–7 sec: She walks to the window and slowly opens it.

7–10 sec: Fresh air enters, birds sing, and she smiles peacefully while enjoying the morning.

---
Voice Over

"As the sun gently touches her face, a new day begins. The songs of the morning birds fill the air, and in this quiet moment, she finds peace."

zh.p: 一个电影般的清晨卧室场景。一位美丽的年轻女子正安详地睡在柔软的白床上，房间是现代风格，温馨舒适。晨曦的第一缕金光缓缓穿过窗帘，将温暖的光线洒在她的脸上。尘埃粒子在阳光中轻轻飘浮。镜头缓缓推进，她自然地睁开眼睛，平静地呼吸了一下。她从床上坐起，稍稍伸展身体，双脚踩在木地板上。她穿着一件浅奶油色的晨衣，慢慢走向一扇大窗户。窗帘随着微风轻轻摆动。她打开窗户，清新的晨风涌入房间。窗外，绿树轻轻摇曳，鸟儿飞过天空，柔和的阳光照亮四周。鸟鸣声弥漫在空气中。她闭上眼睛，深吸一口气，露出平静的微笑。她的发丝在微风中轻轻飘动，镜头环绕着她旋转。最后一个画面是她站在窗边，享受宁静的早晨，阳光洒满整个房间。风格：超写实，电影级光影，逼真的皮肤细节，柔和的阴影，浅景深，流畅的运镜，暖色调分级，体积光效，4K，高细节，自然情感，电影级画质。--- 镜头分镜（10秒）0-2秒：熟睡女孩的特写，金色阳光缓缓照到她的脸上。2-4秒：她睁开眼睛并坐起，镜头轻轻推近。4-7秒：她走向窗户，缓缓推开。7-10秒：清新空气涌入，鸟儿鸣唱，她平静地微笑，享受清晨。--- 旁白“当阳光轻抚她的脸庞，新的一天开始了。晨鸟的歌声回荡在空中，在这宁静的时刻，她找到了内心的平和。”

## Scene 1 (0:00 - 0:03) — "The Walk"

**Shot:** Wide establishing drone shot of the picturesque European-style town. Sunlight reflects off pastel buildings, café terraces bustle with life, flower boxes sway gently in the breeze.

**Cut to:** Medium tracking shot moving alongside the woman as she walks confidently down the cobblestone street holding the cold FANTA can.

**Camera:** Smooth gimbal tracking, shallow depth of field.

**Dialogue:** None.

**Audio:** Birds, distant café chatter, footsteps on cobblestones, soft city ambience.

---

## Scene 2 (0:03 - 0:06) — "Refreshing Moment"

**Shot:** Close-up of condensation droplets sliding down the FANTA can.

**Cut to:** Medium close-up as she raises the can and takes a sip.

**Shot:** Extreme close-up of her closing her eyes and smiling in satisfaction.

**Dialogue (soft, natural):**
**Woman:** *"That's exactly what I needed."*

**Audio:** Can opening sound, carbonation fizz, subtle refreshing sound design.

---

## Scene 3 (0:06 - 0:08) — "The Wind Arrives"

**Shot:** A few papers begin sliding across the street.

**Cut:** Her hair moves slightly as she notices the wind.

**Cut:** Hundreds of white papers suddenly burst into frame, swirling upward around her.

**Camera:** Fast whip pan transitioning into slow motion.

**Dialogue:** None.

**Audio:** Rising wind gust, fluttering paper sounds.

---

## Scene 4 (0:08 - 0:12) — "Hero Moment"

**Shot:** Dramatic low-angle shot.

She raises the bright red FANTA can high above her head while looking toward the sky.

Papers spin around her in beautiful chaotic motion.

The camera slowly circles 360 degrees around her.

Strong sunlight creates lens flares, god rays, and glowing highlights.

Several sheets fly directly past the camera lens.

**Dialogue (inspired, joyful):**
**Woman:** *"This feels amazing."*

---

## Scene 5 (0:12 - 0:15) — "Commercial Finish"

**Shot:** Extreme low-angle hero shot of the FANTA can against the blue sky.

**Cut to:** Slow-motion smile as papers continue floating around her.

**Final shot:** Freeze-frame style ending with the can remaining centered in frame while the town softly blurs behind.

**Dialogue:** None.

**Audio:** Wind slowly fades, uplifting musical swell, ambient city sounds return.

---

## Camera Cut Summary

1. Establishing aerial shot.
2. Side tracking medium shot.
3. Product close-up.
4. Drinking close-up.
5. Reaction close-up.
6. Paper gust whip-pan transition.
7. Low-angle hero shot.
8. 360° orbit shot.
9. Extreme product close-up finale.

zh.p:
## 场景1 (0:00 - 0:03) ——「漫步」
**镜头：** 航拍广角定场镜头，展现风景如画的欧式小镇。阳光映照在柔和的彩色建筑上，咖啡馆露台人来人往，花篮在微风中轻轻摇曳。
**切至：** 中景跟拍镜头，跟随手持冰镇芬达罐的女子自信地走在鹅卵石街道上。
**摄影：** 平滑稳定器跟拍，浅景深。
**对白：** 无。
**音效：** 鸟鸣、远处咖啡馆的交谈声、鹅卵石上的脚步声、柔和的城市环境音。

---

## 场景2 (0:03 - 0:06) ——「清爽时刻」
**镜头：** 特写，水珠顺着芬达罐壁滑落。
**切至：** 中近景，她举起罐子喝了一口。
**镜头：** 极近特写，她闭上双眼，露出满意的微笑。
**对白（轻柔、自然）：**
**女子：** *“这正是我需要的。”*
**音效：** 开罐声、气泡嘶嘶声、微妙的清爽音效设计。

---

## 场景3 (0:06 - 0:08) ——「风起」
**镜头：** 几张纸开始滑过街道。
**切至：** 她的发丝微微拂动，她察觉到起风了。
**切至：** 数百张白纸突然涌入画面，在她四周盘旋上升。
**摄影：** 快速甩镜头，过渡到慢动作。
**对白：** 无。
**音效：** 渐强的风声、纸张翻飞的声音。

---

## 场景4 (0:08 - 0:12) ——「英雄时刻」
**镜头：** 戏剧性的低角度镜头。她将鲜红的芬达罐高高举过头顶，仰望天空。纸张在她周围以美丽而混乱的轨迹旋转。镜头缓慢环绕她360度。强烈的阳光产生镜头光晕、上帝之光和耀眼光芒。数张纸片从镜头前飞掠而过。
**对白（充满灵感、愉悦）：**
**女子：** *“这感觉太棒了。”*

---

## 场景5 (0:12 - 0:15) ——「广告收尾」
**镜头：** 极低角度英雄镜头，芬达罐衬着蓝天。
**切至：** 慢动作微笑，纸张仍在身旁飘舞。
**最终镜头：** 定格式结尾，罐子保持在画面中央，背景中的小镇柔和虚化。
**对白：** 无。
**音效：** 风声渐弱，激昂的音乐渐起，城市环境音回归。

---

1. 航拍定场镜头。
2. 侧面跟拍中景。
3. 产品特写。
4. 饮用中近景。
5. 反应特写。
6. 纸风甩镜头过渡。
7. 低角度英雄镜头。
8. 360°环绕镜头。
9. 极近产品特写收尾。

raw_p:
コンセプト：カメラは一瞬も止まらない。常に最速・最小振幅で小刻みに動き続ける、もう1人の踊り手。
基本リズムは16分（1拍を4分割）以上の高密度で刻み、各刻みごとに必ずカメラが弾く・刻む・寄る・引くのいずれかを行う。静止フレームは作らない。決めポーズの瞬間ですら、カメラは構図を保ったまま高周波の微振動を続け、止まって見えても実際は小刻みに脈打っている。だらだらした中速の移動は一切なし。動きは常に「カクッ」と鋭い始点・終点を持つスナップ運動で、ゆっくりした補間を挟まない。
全編を通して常時走らせる微小モーション（最速・小振幅・高頻度）：
マイクロズーム連打（各刻みで数%だけ寄る／引くを高速往復、絶え間なく脈打つ）
ビートバウンス（足のステップ・膝の沈みに同期してカメラが上下に小さく弾み続ける）
ジッターパン（肩のヒット・首振りに合わせて左右へ小刻みにカクカク刻む）
マイクロシェイク（強拍で数ピクセル鋭く揺れ、即次の刻みへ）
高速リフレーミング（16分ごとに構図を微調整し続け、2人を常にベストポジションへ収め直す）
微オービット往復（中心軸まわりを小角度で左右に揺れ続ける）
身体パーツ単位の瞬間同期（鋭く・速く）：
肩のヒット → カメラがカクッと逆方向へ弾く
指先・アームライン → ズームが軌道を高速で微追従
首振り・髪のなびき → カメラも同方向へ鋭く振れて即戻る
腰のウェーブ／ボディロール → カメラが縦に小刻みにうねる
スポットターン → カメラが逆回転で小刻みに回り込む
大振りの飛び道具（決めの瞬間に最速で投入、ただし投入後も微振動は止めない）：
スナップズーム（最速で寄る／引いて瞬間到達、到達後も微ズームを継続）
ホイップパン（2人の間を最速で振り、決めの頭で微振動ホールドへ移行）
急速クレーンダイブ／クレーンアップ
高速360度オービット
ドリーズーム（背景だけ伸縮、1発）
床スレスレローアングル→急上昇
ダッチアングル（決めで大胆な斜め、斜めのまま微振動）

リズム原則：
全編：カメラは1フレームも止まらず、最速・最小振幅で刻み続ける。
強拍：微小モーションの上に大振りを重ねる（刻みは止めない）。
決め：完全静止ではなく「微振動ホールド」。構図は固定、カメラは小刻みに生き続ける。
2人がターンすればカメラも逆回転、ジャンプには跳ねて浮き、前進には弾かれて後退、すべて最速で反応。
カット割りではなく、ライブ番組らしい流れるスイッチングで全部つなぐ。

【15秒構成】
■0.0〜2.0秒 天井付近の超ワイドから、最初のビートでクレーンダイブ＋スナップズームを最速発動しツーショットのバストアップへ落下。着地と同時にマイクロズームとビートバウンスが脈打ち始め、以降一瞬も止まらない。2人同時に肩・首・腰のアイソレーション、各ヒットでカメラがカクカク逆方向へ弾く。カメラ目線の微笑みも微振動ホールドで魅せる。
■2.0〜4.0秒 2人の中心軸を高速オービットで半周しつつ、回りながら16分でマイクロズームを連打。横並び左右ステップ／片手ハート／胸元ハート／指差し（ミラー振付）、ステップごとにビートバウンスで上下。決めの頭でも止めず微振動ホールドへ移行し、髪の残像を捉え続ける。
■4.0〜6.0秒 床スレスレローアングル煽り。ボディロール／腰のウェーブにカメラが縦へ小刻みにうねる。肩のヒットごとにジッターパンで左右に刻む。足元から急速クレーンアップへ最速上昇。顎を上げた笑顔も微振動ホールド＋ダッチアングル（斜めのまま小刻みに揺れる）。
■6.0〜8.0秒 スナップズームで片方へ寄る→ホイップパンでもう片方への掛け合い。寄った先でもマイクロシェイクが鋭く微振動し続ける。それぞれ口パク、ほっぽピース／片手ハート／首傾け。指先にズームが高速追従。決めも微振動ホールドで表情を魅せる。
■8.0〜10.0秒 360度高速オービットで一周、同時に2人が高速スポットターン（左右対称）。カメラはターンと逆回転で小刻みに回り込み、回り終わりも止めず微オービット往復へ。互いに片手ハートを合わせ1つの大きなハート、その瞬間もマイクロズームを最小振幅で脈打たせる。
■10.0〜12.0秒（サビ） ワイドへ最速パンチアウト。ステージいっぱいの大きなデュエットダンス。対角線へ移動→中央集合、全ステップにビートバウンス同期。同時ジャンプにカメラも跳ねて浮く。大きなアームラインをユニゾン、軌道をズームが追う。サビ頭でドリーズームを1発、伸縮中もマイクロシェイク継続。
■12.0〜14.0秒 最速パンチアウト→パンチインの連打で距離を高速に出し入れ。2人が肩を寄せて近付く間も、カメラは16分で寄り引きを刻み続ける。アイコンタクト／指先をレンズへ、その指先にズームが小刻みに追従。柔らかい笑顔も微振動ホールド。
■14.0〜15.0秒（ラストKilling Part） 2人が一歩踏み込みぴたりと寄り添う瞬間、最速スナップズーム＋ホイップでツーショットのクローズアップに突き刺さる。到達後も完全には止めず、最小振幅・最高周波の微振動ホールドで決めポーズ・笑顔・同時ウィンクを魅せる。止まって見えて生きているフィニッシュ。

zh.p: 概念：摄影机一刻不停。始终以最快速度、最小振幅持续微动，是另一名舞者。基本节奏以十六分音符（一拍四等分）以上的高密度进行，每一拍摄影机必定执行弹动、律动、推进或拉远中的一项。不制造静止帧。即使在定点姿势的瞬间，摄影机也一边保持构图一边进行高频微振动，看似静止实则持续细微脉动。没有拖沓的中速移动。动作始终带有“咯”一声般锐利的起点与终点，不插入缓慢的补间。全篇持续运行的微动（最快、小振幅、高频率）：微缩放连击（每一拍以数%进行推近/拉远高速往复，持续脉动）；节拍弹跳（配合脚步踏步、膝盖下沉同步上下小幅弹动）；抖动平移（配合肩部撞击、甩头动作左右微幅顿挫）；微晃动（强拍时以数像素锐利摇晃，立即进入下一拍）；高速重新构图（每十六分音符持续微调构图，始终将两人收于最佳位置）；微轨道往复（绕中心轴小角度左右持续摆动）。身体部位瞬时间同步（锐利、迅速）：肩部撞击 → 摄影机“咯”地朝反方向弹开；指尖/手臂线条 → 缩放高速微幅跟随轨迹；甩头/发丝飘动 → 摄影机也朝同方向锐利摆动随即归位；腰部波浪/身体滚转 → 摄影机纵向细微起伏；定点旋转 → 摄影机逆方向细微回绕。大幅动作技（于决定性瞬间以最快速度投入，但投入后微振动亦不停歇）：快速缩放（最快速度推进/拉远瞬间到位，到位后继续微缩放）；甩拍（在两人之间以最快速度摆动，在定点头部转为微振动保持）；急速升降俯拍/仰拍；高速360度环绕；滑动变焦（仅背景伸缩，一次）；贴近地面低角度→急升；斜角镜头（定点大胆倾斜，保持斜角微振动）。节奏原则：全篇：摄影机一帧不停，以最快速度、最小振幅持续律动。强拍：在微动之上叠加大幅动作（但不停下律动）。定点：非完全静止，而是“微振动保持”——构图固定，摄影机细微持续地“活着”。两人旋转则摄影机逆旋，跳跃则弹起浮升，前进则被弹退，全以最快速度反应。非剪辑式，而以直播节目般的流畅切换贯穿衔接。【15秒构成】■0.0〜2.0秒 从天花板附近的超广角起，在第一拍发动最快速度的升降俯拍+快速缩放坠落至双人中景。落地同时微缩放与节拍弹跳开始脉动，此后一瞬不停。两人同步进行肩、颈、腰的分离律动，每一下撞击摄影机都“咯”地朝反方向弹开。朝向镜头的微笑也以微振动保持呈现。■2.0〜4.0秒 围绕两人中心轴高速环绕半圈，同时以十六分音符连击微缩放。并排左右踏步/单手爱心/胸前爱心/指向（镜面编舞），每一踏步以节拍弹跳上下起伏。定点头部也不停歇，转入微振动保持，持续捕捉发丝残影。■4.0〜6.0秒 贴近地面的低角度仰拍。随身体滚转/腰部波浪，摄影机纵向细微起伏。每一下肩部撞击以抖动平移左右顿挫。从脚边急速升降仰拍最快上升。抬下巴的笑容也以微振动保持+斜角镜头（保持斜向细微摇晃）。■6.0〜8.0秒 以快速缩放推向一方→以甩拍切向另一方进行对话式交替。即使推到目标，微晃动仍锐利持续微振。各自口型配合、比颊V字/单手爱心/歪头。指尖处缩放高速跟随。定点也以微振动保持展现表情。■8.0〜10.0秒 360度高速环绕一周，同时两人高速原地旋转（左右对称）。摄影机以与旋转相反的方向细微回绕，回转结束后也不停，转入微轨道往复。彼此单手爱心合成一个大爱心，那一瞬间也让微缩放以最小振幅脉动。■10.0〜12.0秒（副歌） 以最快速度拉出广角。满舞台的大幅双人舞。沿对角线移动→中央集合，每一步都同步节拍弹跳。同时跳起时摄影机也弹起浮升。大幅手臂线条齐舞，缩放跟随轨迹。副歌开头一次滑动变焦，伸缩期间微晃动持续。■12.0〜14.0秒 最快拉出→推入连击，快速切换距离。两人并肩靠近时，摄影机仍以十六分音符持续推拉。视线交汇/指尖朝向镜头，缩放细微跟随指尖。柔和笑容也以微振动保持。■14.0〜15.0秒（最后Killing Part） 两人踏出一步紧靠的瞬间，以最快快速缩放+甩拍切入双人特写。到位后仍不完全停止，以最小振幅、最高频率的微振动保持收束于定点姿势、笑容与同时眨眼。呈现看似静止却鲜活的收尾。

en.p: Concept: The camera never stops for a single moment. It is another dancer that constantly moves in tiny, high-speed, minimal-amplitude motions. The basic rhythm is chopped at a density of 16th notes (4 divisions per beat) or higher, and at every chop the camera must either bounce, chop, zoom in, or zoom out. No static frames are created. Even at a pose hold moment, the camera maintains the composition while continuing high-frequency micro-vibrations—even if it appears to be still, it is actually pulsating in small increments. There is no sluggish mid-speed movement. All motion is always a snap movement with sharp starts and stops, with no slow interpolation in between. Micro-motions that run continuously throughout the entire piece (fastest speed, small amplitude, high frequency): Micro-zoom rapid-fire (at each chop, zoom in/out by a few percent in high-speed reciprocation, pulsating without pause) Beat bounce (camera bounces slightly up and down in sync with foot steps and knee dips) Jitter pan (jerkily shakes left and right in small increments in time with shoulder hits and head turns) Micro-shake (sharp shake of a few pixels on the downbeat, immediately transitioning to the next chop) High-speed reframing (continuously fine-tunes the composition every 16th note, constantly repositioning both subjects to their optimal framing) Micro-orbit oscillation (continually sways left and right in small angles around the central axis) Instant synchronization per body part (sharp and fast): Shoulder hit → camera snaps in the opposite direction Fingertips/arm lines → zoom quickly and finely follows the trajectory Head turns/hair flipping → camera sharply swings in the same direction and immediately returns Waist waves/body rolls → camera undulates vertically in small increments Spot turns → camera rotates in small increments in the reverse direction Big-impact dynamic moves (deployed at peak moments at maximum speed, but micro-vibrations continue even after deployment): Snap zoom (zoom in/out at maximum speed for instantaneous arrival, then continues micro-zooming after arrival) Whip pan (swings at max speed between the two performers, transitioning to a micro-vibration hold at the downbeat of the pose) Rapid crane dive / crane up Rapid 360-degree orbit Dolly zoom (background expands/contracts only, one shot) Low-angle shot scraping the floor → rapid rise Dutch angle (bold tilt on the pose, maintaining micro-vibrations while tilted) Rhythmic principles: Throughout: camera never stops for a single frame, continuously chopping at max speed and minimal amplitude. Downbeats: large movements are layered on top of micro-motions (chopping never stops). Pose holds: not a complete freeze, but a "micro-vibration hold." Composition is fixed, but the camera remains alive with tiny movements. If the two performers turn, the camera counter-rotates; if they jump, it bounces and lifts; if they move forward, it recoils backward—all at maximum speed reaction. No cut edits; everything is connected through flowing switching typical of live programs. [15-second structure] ■ 0.0–2.0 sec From an ultra-wide shot near the ceiling, on the first beat, a crane dive + snap zoom is triggered at max speed, dropping into a two-shot bust-up. At the moment of landing, micro-zoom and beat bounce begin pulsating, and from then on, not a single moment stops. Both performers execute isolations of shoulders, neck, and waist simultaneously; on each hit, the camera snaps jerkily in the opposite direction. Even a smile looking into the lens is presented with micro-vibration hold. ■ 2.0–4.0 sec While orbiting half a circle around the two performers' central axis at high speed, micro-zoom is rapid-fired in 16th notes during the rotation. Side-by-side left-right steps / one-hand heart / chest heart / pointing (mirror choreography); on each step, beat bounce moves up and down. Even at the pose downbeat, it does not stop but transitions to a micro-vibration hold, continuing to capture the afterimage of hair. ■ 4.0–6.0 sec Low-angle shot scraping the floor, tilted up. Camera undulates vertically in small increments with body rolls/waist waves. On each shoulder hit, jitter pan chops left and right. From the feet, it rapidly cranes up at max speed. Smiles with chins raised are also held with micro-vibration + Dutch angle (oscillating in small increments while tilted). ■ 6.0–8.0 sec Snap zoom in on one side → whip pan to the other for a call-and-response. Even at the zoomed-in target, micro-shake continues sharply vibrating. Each lip-syncs, cheek peace sign / one-hand heart / head tilt. Zoom rapidly tracks fingertips. Poses also showcase expressions with micro-vibration hold. ■ 8.0–10.0 sec 360-degree high-speed orbit for one full rotation, while both performers do high-speed spot turns (symmetrical left-right). The camera counter-rotates in small increments against the turn, and even after completing the rotation, it does not stop but transitions into micro-orbit oscillation. They join one-hand hearts together to form one big heart; even at that moment, micro-zoom pulsates with minimal amplitude. ■ 10.0–12.0 sec (Chorus) Fast punch-out to wide shot. Full-stage grand duet dance. Move diagonally → gather center; every step is synchronized with beat bounce. On simultaneous jumps, the camera also bounces and lifts. Unison large arm lines, with zoom tracking their trajectory. At the start of the chorus, one dolly zoom is deployed; during the expansion/contraction, micro-shake continues. ■ 12.0–14.0 sec Rapid punch-out → punch-in rapid-fire to quickly push and pull distance. Even as the two performers draw close shoulder-to-shoulder, the camera continues to chop zoom in/out in 16th notes. Eye contact / fingertips toward the lens; zoom finely follows those fingertips. Soft smiles are also micro-vibration hold. ■ 14.0–15.0 sec (Final Killing Part) At the moment the two step forward and draw intimately close, the fastest snap zoom + whip stabs into a two-shot close-up. After arrival, it does not completely stop, but holds with minimal amplitude and highest frequency micro-vibration to present the pose, smiles, and simultaneous wink. A finish that appears still yet is alive.

raw_p:
Massive sci-fi desert world at sunset.
A convoy of armored vehicles crossing endless dunes beneath giant twin moons.
One traveler notices something impossible on the horizon: a gigantic mountain slowly moving.
At first everyone thinks it is a sandstorm illusion. Then the mountain changes direction.
The caravan begins accelerating desperately.
Visible danger escalates: dunes collapsing from distant impacts, enormous dust clouds approaching,  seismic vibrations shaking vehicles, giant footprints appearing in the desert behind them.
As night falls: the moving mountain becomes clearer.
It is a colossal walking structure crossing the desert:
part creature, part machine.
Entire villages disappear beneath its legs in the distance.
The convoy races through narrow canyons while behind them: the gigantic silhouette advances across the dunes under moonlight.
At climax, the colossal entity steps directly over the canyon ridge behind the convoy. Its massive glowing body blocks the sky.
Then suddenly, it continues walking past them into the darkness.
Ultra cinematic sci-fi epic, giant creature scale, desert atmosphere, realistic dust physics, grounded survival tension, massive environmental visuals.

zh.p: 壮观的科幻沙漠世界，日落时分。一支装甲车队在巨型双月之下穿越无垠沙丘。一位旅行者在地平线上发现了不可能存在的东西：一座巨大的山脉在缓慢移动。起初所有人都以为那是沙暴造成的幻觉。然而山脉改变了方向。车队开始拼命加速。危险显而易见地升级：远处冲击导致沙丘崩塌，巨大的尘云逼近，地震般的震动摇晃着车辆，巨大的脚印出现在他们身后的沙漠中。夜幕降临：移动的山脉变得更加清晰。那是一座横穿沙漠的巨型步行结构——半是生物，半是机器。远处，整座村庄消失在它的腿下。车队疾驰穿过狭窄的峡谷，而他们身后：那庞大的轮廓在月光下翻越沙丘。高潮时刻，庞然大物直接踏过车队后方峡谷的山脊。它巨大的发光身躯遮蔽了天空。然而突然间，它继续向前行走，消失在黑暗中。极致电影感的科幻史诗，巨兽尺度，沙漠氛围，写实的尘埃物理，扎实的生存紧张感，宏大的环境视觉。

Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.

Night. On the rooftop of a tall modern skyscraper, two anonymous operatives, one man and one woman, run side by side across the roof while a security team follows behind. Both operatives wear dark tactical clothing with full hoods or dark visors, faces mostly hidden in shadow. No clear facial close-ups, no celebrity resemblance, no famous actor look, no heroic movie-star face.

The rooftop is sleek and simple, with metal sections, vents, warning lights, and one large transparent glass section. The city glows far below with lights and light mist.
Wide opening shot: the two operatives sprint across the rooftop, staying close together. The security team is behind them and getting closer.

Tracking shot: the operatives run onto the glass section because it appears solid. Fine cracks suddenly spread under their feet. They react with surprise and try to keep balance.

Critical action beat: the glass section suddenly gives way beneath them. The floor disappears under their feet. They do not jump. They lose support unexpectedly and vanish downward through the opening as the glass breaks apart.
For a moment, it seems like they disappeared over the side of the skyscraper.

Final 5 seconds: the camera rushes toward the broken opening, reaches the edge, and looks down. It reveals that both operatives are still there, safely suspended below the roof by a maintenance line or support cable. Their bodies sway from the sudden stop as small glass fragments continue falling past them. One operative steadies the other while they hold onto the line beside the building.

Final moment: dramatic view of the two anonymous operatives suspended beside the skyscraper wall, with the glowing city below.

1. CREATION BRIEF

Generate an original 15-second dark-fantasy cinematic sequence in vertical 9:16 aspect ratio at 720p resolution. The video is a single sustained spectacle of a colossal pale bone-white frost dragon attacking a frozen mountain stronghold carved into a glacier cliff. The dragon is the unambiguous protagonist of every frame: it bursts up through a frozen lake in an explosion of shattered ice, climbs a sheer ice-clad fortress wall ripping through hanging defensive chains and frozen ballista nests, exhales a torrent of freezing breath that flash-rimes a watchtower into a brittle crystal husk, then slams its tail through that frozen tower so it shatters into glittering shards, before the camera pulls back to reveal a vast high-angle panorama of the glacial citadel cracking apart under a green aurora sky. The mood is cold, awe-inspiring, merciless, otherworldly. Pale aurora light battles deep arctic blue gloom throughout. Dense ice-fog and snow-spray roll across the frame, scattering aurora light into shimmering veils. Scale must read MASSIVE — the dragon is many times larger than any human, who appear as tiny dark fur-wrapped figures on the walls. Pacing is fast and kinetic with hard cuts on impacts, settling into a stabilized epic final reveal. Photoreal CGI, no stylization, no cartoon look. Every motion obeys heavy gravity and inertia.

2. STYLE BIBLE

Medium: realistic high-budget feature-film CGI, photoreal rendering, ray-traced lighting, physically based shading, subsurface scattering on ice and snow. Zero illustration or anime stylization, zero painterly look. Lens language: cinematic full-frame virtual cinematography, focal lengths roughly 24–50mm; wide anamorphic-feeling framing for the lake burst and climb beats, slightly longer for the breath and tail beats; shallow-to-medium depth of field with atmospheric ice-fog providing natural depth falloff and visible particulate. Color palette: a desaturated cold base of glacier blue, steel cyan, frost white, slate grey, deep teal shadow — punctuated by ethereal aurora greens and faint violets dancing overhead, with cold blue-white glow from the dragon's breath and occasional warm flickers of dying torchlight on the fortress walls (1900K) reading almost amber against the all-blue world. Lighting setup: key from a broad aurora-lit night sky (cool, roughly 7500–9000K, with animated green ribbon glow), strong cyan rim from glacier surfaces, bounce fill from snow, faint warm torch fill from defenders, brilliant cold pulse during the freeze-breath, harsh momentary highlights of refracted light when ice shatters. Texture/material rules: dragon hide is matte bone-white to pale-blue scale, dry and powdery with a frost dusting on the back plates, layered overlapping armored scutes along the spine; horns and head-crest are translucent bluish ice-crystal, internally refracting aurora light; wing membranes are pale milky leather, semi-translucent at thin edges with visible frozen vein structure backlit by the sky; thin rime crystals cling to the jaw and brow ridges and shed when it moves. Environment: glassy blue glacier ice with internal fracture lines and trapped bubbles, carved grey granite battlements, iron chains crusted with frost, frozen rope and timber ballistae, snow banks and wind-driven spindrift. Motion style: weighty deliberate wingbeats, explosive bursts on impacts, persistent realistic motion blur on fast pans, fine procedural snow-spray and ice-shard simulation, vapor of freezing breath rolling with believable turbulence.

3. CHARACTER / SUBJECT BIBLE

1. 创作概要 生成一段时长为15秒的原创黑暗奇幻电影级片段，竖屏9:16画幅，720p分辨率。视频呈现一个持续不断的宏大奇观：一只巨大的苍白骨色冰霜巨龙正在攻击一座镶嵌于冰川悬崖上的冰封山间堡垒。巨龙是每一帧中无可争议的主角——它从冰封湖面骤然破冰而出，掀起漫天碎冰，攀爬陡峭的冰覆城墙，撕裂悬挂的防御铁链与冰冻的弩炮台，吐出一股极寒吐息，将一座瞭望塔瞬间冻结成脆弱的晶体外壳，随后甩尾击穿冰塔，使其炸裂成闪烁的碎片，最后镜头拉远，展现出冰川要塞在绿色极光穹顶下崩裂的全景高空俯瞰画面。氛围寒冷、令人敬畏、冷酷无情、超凡脱俗。苍白的极光与深沉的北极蓝阴暗相互交织。浓密的冰雾与雪屑翻滚过画面，将极光散射成闪烁的薄纱。尺度必须展现“宏大”——巨龙比任何人类都大出数倍，人类在城墙上仅是裹着深色皮毛的微小身影。节奏快速而富有动感，撞击处有凌厉剪辑，最终稳定于宏大的终场揭示。照片级CGI，无风格化，无卡通感。所有运动遵循沉重的重力和惯性。

2. 风格圣经 媒介：写实高预算电影级CGI，照片级渲染，光线追踪照明，基于物理的着色，冰与雪的次表面散射。零插画或动漫风格，零绘画感。镜头语言：电影级全画幅虚拟摄影，焦距约24–50mm；湖面破冰与攀爬段落使用宽幅变形宽银幕感构图，吐息与甩尾段落稍长；浅至中景深，配合大气冰雾提供自然景深衰减与可见微粒。色调：低饱和冷色基调——冰川蓝、钢青色、霜白、石板灰、深蓝绿色阴影——点缀以空灵的极光绿与淡紫色在上空舞动，巨龙吐息散发冷蓝色辉光，城墙上偶尔闪烁的濒死火把暖光（1900K）在这片蓝色世界中几乎呈现琥珀色。照明设置：主光来自极光照亮的广阔夜空（冷色，约7500–9000K，带有动画绿色光带辉光），强青色边缘光来自冰川表面，雪地提供补光，守军提供微弱暖色火把光，冰冻吐息时爆发冷色脉冲，冰晶碎裂时产生尖锐短暂的折射光高光。纹理/材质规则：龙皮为哑光骨白至淡蓝色鳞片，干燥粉状，背部板甲覆有霜尘，沿脊柱有层叠的装甲鳞片；角与头冠为半透蓝色冰晶，内部折射极光；翼膜为苍白色乳状皮革，薄边半透，背光可见冻结的脉管结构；下颚与眉脊附着薄霜晶，移动时剥落。环境：玻璃般蓝色冰川冰，内部有断裂线与气泡，雕刻的灰色花岗岩城垛，覆霜铁链，冻绳与木质弩炮，雪堆与风驱雪屑。运动风格：沉重有力的振翅，撞击处的爆裂爆发，快速平移时持续写实的动态模糊，精细的程序化雪屑与冰晶模拟，冰冻吐息蒸汽以可信湍流翻滚。

3. 角色/主体圣经 巨龙——轮廓：巨大的四足有翼爬行动物，与其他任何野兽截然不同——比粗壮型巨龙更瘦长、更似蛇，长而蜿蜒的颈部，狭窄有角的头骨，冠以向后展开的半透冰晶角扇，深而窄的胸部，长而帆状鳍尾，宽阔的蝙蝠状翅膀，后缘覆有霜羽。比例：头部窄长如冰封狼颅，下颌长，排列玻璃状牙齿，腿长而精瘦，宽大的爪足展开以抓冰，爪尖锐如石英。从头骨后部沿颈部和脊柱延伸一条连续的低脊水晶刺，肩部最长，沿尾部展开为半透薄帆。材质/皮肤：哑光骨白至淡蓝色鳞片，永久覆有霜尘，背部有层叠装甲板，喉部与腹部较软，有鹅卵石质感，微染青色，干燥表面捕捉极光形成冷色柔光而非湿光泽。翼膜为乳白色淡皮革，以覆冰长骨支撑，边缘在背光下呈半透蓝色辉光。眼睛：淡冰蓝色，竖瞳，微微内发光，表情范围极小——只有基础爬行动物眨眼与瞳孔追踪；无人类情感。面部范围：下颌开合，鼻孔可见冷气，发力时嘴唇微掀露出玻璃状牙齿。肢体语言：蛇形、掠食性、飞行流畅、攻击爆发；翅膀振翅深沉有力，下压可见压缩空气与扬雪。重量与平衡：身体表现数吨质量——每次降落压碎冰块，每次振翅显费力，尾部平衡转弯，颈部引导运动。接触点：爪抓并刻入冰面，肩与尾帆击碎铁链与冻木，尾扫摧毁瞭望塔。人类——山地守军，身着厚重毛皮斗篷、覆霜锁甲、皮革与淡色羊毛，因尺度而显得微小且低细节，表现为城墙上攀爬的暗色剪影、坠落的身体与翻滚的人影。无需面部细节；其存在仅用于传达尺度与混乱。

4. 环境/道具 空间布局：一座夜间堡垒，镶嵌并建于高耸冰川悬崖之上，底部有冰封湖泊，梯田式花岗岩城垛，悬挂铁链串有冻结警铃，弩炮台建于冻裂木料上，一座高瘦石冰叠成的瞭望塔耸立城墙之上。背景景深：退向冰雾远处的冰川山脊与雪峰，地平线上极光带夜空。表面：玻璃状带断裂脉的冰、覆霜花岗岩、铁链、冻绳、雪堆、横跨画面的风驱雪片。道具：悬挂铁链与冻铃、冻结弩炮与弩箭、冻僵的防御旗帜、积雪木料、散落冰块与碎石。尺度参照：瞭望塔高数层，但在巨龙面前如玩具；守军如蚂蚁般大小。物理约束：冰撞击后碎裂为闪烁折射碎片与精细晶尘，铁链绷紧弹出并甩动，花岗岩破裂为硬块扬起霜雾，冻旗裂碎，冰冻吐息将表面结霜变脆，重力将所有碎片与躯体以弧形轨迹向下牵引。

5. 时间码镜头计划 00:00–00:04 —— 冰封湖面破冰而出。画面：竖构图，冰封湖面占据下方三分之二，冰川堡垒在极光下高耸于上方。设置：半秒静止开裂冰面，发丝状裂痕在表面蔓延。撞击：巨龙头颅与水晶角猛烈冲破冰面，爆裂碎冰与水花四溅，颈部向天升起，霜晶如雨。力量/重量：数吨质量上涌，冰板被抛飞划弧，水花向外铺散。面部：冰蓝色眼睛猛然睁开，鼻孔喷出蒸汽。镜头：低角度水面视角向上看，急剧上仰追随升起的头骨，爆裂时强烈晃动并在半秒内衰减。照明：冷色极光边缘光打湿白鳞，冰裂内部散发青色辉光。纹理：覆冰的骨鳞在极光下呈干冷光泽，角半透内泛微绿。镜头运动：水花与碎冰飞溅过镜头，雪花冰雾弥漫画面，尾巴拖出跟踪拍，然后快速剪切至——

raw_p: Create a 15-second 16:9 ultra-cinematic desert motorcycle chase. A masked rider on a brutal custom motorcycle charges through a post-apocalyptic desert highway at full speed. The bike is heavy, dirty, metal, aggressive, with exposed engine parts, dust-covered tires, and vibrating handlebars. The scene begins with the motorcycle exploding out of a wall of dust. Behind it, a convoy of rusted armored vehicles appears, chasing the rider. The rider dodges between wrecked cars, slides sideways through sand, jumps over broken metal debris, then lands hard as a huge explosion erupts behind him. Use powerful motion blur, dust hitting the lens, controlled handheld shake, dramatic speed ramps, sharp focus on the rider. Lighting: burning sunset, orange desert sky, harsh shadows, dust glowing in the air, gritty contrast, dirty cinematic look, realistic fire and smoke. Mood: brutal, fast, dangerous, survival chase, no comedy, no clean futuristic style. Audio: roaring engine, heavy drums, metal impacts, wind, tire skids, explosions, deep cinematic bass. Keep the same rider and same motorcycle during the whole video. Avoid random text, logos, distorted wheels, changing motorcycle shape, extra riders, floating objects, weak explosions, cartoon style, unstable chaotic camera, unreadable action, flicker, warped body, impossible physics.

Use @orgres as the clean start frame. Preserve the ogre army, the rugged hilly landscape, lighting, color, film grain, and composition from the start frame.

Use @landscape as a motion reference for camera choreography and timing. Match the timing and path of the camera move as closely as possible, specifically the smooth upward drone ascent over the terrain.

The camera acts as a drone slowly rising above the landscape. The massive ogre army marches steadily forward through the rugged, rocky hills. Heavy dust kicks up from their massive footsteps, lingering in the air. As the camera gains altitude, foreground rocks, shrubs, and dirt pass by, creating a strong sense of depth and natural parallax against the distant mountain peaks.

The horde moves relentlessly along the winding dirt path. Tattered banners and crude weapons sway with their heavy, rhythmic strides. The vanguard, riding massive armored beasts, leads the charge at the front of the column. As the camera continues to ascend, the sheer scale of the army is revealed, stretching far back into the dusty valley.

The camera maintains its smooth, majestic upward trajectory throughout the shot, keeping the focus on the sprawling landscape and the marching horde below.

Do not make the camera movement erratic or violently fast. Do not make the army move at a sprint; keep their march heavy, grounded, and rhythmic. Do not lose the epic scale of the environment or the horde. No music.

zh.p:
用@orgres作为干净的起始框架。保留食人魔军队、崎岖的丘陵地形、光影、色彩、胶片颗粒和构图。

用@landscape作为镜头编排和节奏的动作参考。尽可能匹配摄像机移动的时机和路径，特别是无人机平滑地向上爬过地形的过程。

摄像机如同无人机，缓缓升空于景观之上。庞大的食人魔军队稳步穿过崎岖的岩石丘陵。沉重的尘土从他们巨大的脚步中扬起，空气中弥漫。随着镜头高度提升，前景的岩石、灌木和泥土掠过，营造出强烈的深度感和自然视差，映衬着远处的山峰。

大军沿着蜿蜒的土路无情地前进。破旧的旗帜和粗糙的武器随着沉重而有节奏的步伐摇曳。先锋骑乘着巨大的装甲巨兽，率先冲锋。随着镜头继续上升，军队的庞大规模逐渐显现，远远延伸至尘土飞扬的山谷。

镜头始终保持着平滑而庄严的向上轨迹，聚焦于宽广的景观和下方行军的军队。

不要让摄像机运动变得不规则或剧烈快速。不要让军队以冲刺的方式移动;保持他们的行进沉重、扎实且有节奏感。不要失去环境或兽群的宏大规模。没有音乐。

Six figures crammed inside a dim cargo van at night, rain streaking the windows, shot from a low wide angle as if from the floor. Left to right: Vega, an older man in his 60s, grey stubble, weathered face, charcoal peacoat, sitting calm with hands folded; Kiko, a wiry young woman, undercut dyed teal, fingerless gloves, hunched over a glowing laptop, lit blue from below; Bruno, an enormous bald man in a tight black thermal, arms crossed, filling the frame; Lena, lean and alert, hoodie up, peering through a gap in the rear doors; Saint, sharp-jawed leader in a tailored dark jacket, standing center in a half-crouch, pointing forward; Theo, a skinny teenager in an oversized bomber, knees pulled up, eyes wide. zh.p: 一辆逃逸面包车内部，发动机怠速低，雨点敲打着车顶。维加（年长男子，沙哑嗓音，冰冷冷静，犯罪惊悚风格）低声说：“位置。”Kiko（年轻女性，快速紧张的黑客声音）喘息道：“清除。”布鲁诺（巨人，低沉的咆哮）咕哝道：“准备好了。”莉娜（紧张的低声望风）低声说：“摄像机。”圣（冷酷而有指挥感的领袖）厉声道：“现在。”西奥（颤抖的青少年初次尝试者）咽了口口水，“......走吧。”风格化的画风3D动画风格，半写实的插画、飞溅艺术美学，手绘皮肤和织物纹理，鲜明的人物轮廓，富有表情的面部表情。电影般的宽银幕、氛围透视，前景/中景/背景层次清晰，体积朦胧和漂浮的尘埃。六个人影挤在一辆昏暗的货车里，雨水划过窗户，镜头从低广角角度拍摄，仿佛从地板上拍。从左到右：维加，一位六十多岁的老人，灰白胡茬，脸上风霜斑驳，炭灰色的海军大衣，双手交叠坐着，神情平静;Kiko，一个瘦削的年轻女子，剃发后染成青绿色，戴着无指手套，弯腰伏在一台从下方发出蓝光的笔记本电脑前;布鲁诺，一个巨大的秃头男子，身穿紧身黑色保暖衣，双臂交叉，充满了画面;莉娜身形瘦削且警觉，戴着连帽衫，透过后门缝隙窥视;圣，身穿剪裁合身的深色夹克，下巴锐利，半蹲着站在中央，指向前方;西奥，一个瘦弱的少年，坐在一架超大轰炸机里，膝盖蜷缩，眼睛睁得大大的。电影感十足的犯罪惊悚灯光，透过挡风玻璃透过的单盏钠橙色路灯，深邃的阴影，青绿色和琥珀色级，35毫米变形宽银幕，浅景深，粗糙的胶片颗粒感。夜晚一辆昏暗的逃亡面包车内部，雨水打在窗户上，钠橙色的路灯透过挡风玻璃透进来。开球时六人都挤在内侧。镜头向左快拉到Vega，年长的灰胡茬男子，神情平静——“各就各位。”快速扫向基科，青绿色的剃刀，弯腰盯着发光的笔记本电脑——“清除。”快速推入布鲁诺，那个大个子秃头，双臂交叉——“准备好了。”快速对焦到戴着兜帽、从后面窥视的莉娜——“摄像机。”急切切换到圣，锐利的下颌领袖指向前方——“现在。”最后一把紧推西奥，瘦弱又害怕的少年，眼睛睁得大大的——“......走吧。”镜头锁定在他的脸上，面包车剧烈晃动。

raw_p: Seven-shot sequence, continuous energy, rain-soaked neon Tokyo at night. Cool blue-magenta grade, anamorphic lens, reflective wet asphalt, motion blur, 35mm grain. Shot 1: Extreme close-up of a gloved hand gripping the ignition key on a matte-black sport bike, neon signs reflected in the chrome. Shot 2: Low-angle on the rider's boot stamping the kickstart, engine roars to life, exhaust shimmer. Shot 3: Tight shot of the rider's visor, eyes locked forward, headlights of a pursuing car glowing in the mirror. Shot 4: Rear-wheel close-up — tire bites, the bike lurches off the line, water spray kicks up. Shot 5: Tracking shot from directly behind as the bike tears down a narrow neon alley, signs streaking past. Shot 6: Low-angle as the rider leans hard into a turn, knee near the ground, reflections smearing across the puddles. Shot 7: Wide shot — the bike whips past the camera and shrinks into the rainy distance, tail-light glowing. Ambient sound: rain on metal, engine ignition, then a rising rev, tire hiss on wet road, distant city hum.

zh.p: 七镜头连环，持续的能量，夜晚雨水浸湿的霓虹东京。冷蓝品红色，变形镜头，反光湿沥青，运动模糊，35毫米颗粒。镜头1：极近特写一只戴手套的手握着哑光黑色运动摩托车的点火钥匙，霓虹灯在镀铬中反射。镜头2：低角度拍摄骑手的靴子踩踏启动，发动机轰鸣启动，排气闪烁。镜头3：骑手护目镜的特写，目光锁定前方，后视镜中追车的车灯闪烁。镜头4：后轮特写——轮胎咬伤，摩托车猛地冲出起步，水花四溅。镜头5：从正后方跟踪镜头，摩托车冲进一条狭窄的霓虹灯小巷，路牌飞快掠过。镜头6：低角度，骑手猛地倾身转弯，膝盖贴地，倒影在水坑上晕开。镜头7：广角——摩托车从摄像机旁飞驰而过，缩小到雨中远方，尾灯闪烁。环境音：雨点在金属上，发动机点火，然后转速上升，轮胎在湿滑路面上的嘶嘶声，远处城市的嗡嗡声。

Shot 2: Low-angle on the rider's boot stamping the kickstart, engine roars to life, exhaust shimmer. Shot 3: Tight shot of the rider's visor, eyes locked forward, headlights of a pursuing car glowing in the mirror. Shot 4: Rear-wheel close-up — tire bites, the bike lurches off the line, water spray kicks up. Shot 5: Tracking shot from directly behind as the bike tears down a narrow neon alley, signs streaking past. Shot 6: Low-angle as the rider leans hard into a turn, knee near the ground, reflections smearing across the puddles. Shot 7: Wide shot — the bike whips past the camera and shrinks into the rainy distance, tail-light glowing. Ambient sound: rain on metal, engine ignition, then a rising rev, tire hiss on wet road, distant city hum.

首帧 FIRST FRAME（=上传参考图，仅作起手姿态，之后人物自然活动起来）：

宫装美人，乌发高髻、金花步摇缀长串珍珠流苏轮垂肩，眉心红花钿，

绛红描金抹胸长裙、薄纱罗披半露香肩，金线腰封系白玉环佩；

起始斜倚雕花石栏，身畔牡丹、身后宫阙、莲池落花、黄昏暖光。

人物五官妆容服饰与首帧一致，但全程肢体灵活流动，不得僵直定住。

分镜脚本（重点：人物主动表演、肢体灵动、随时与环境互动）：

SHOT 1｜0-3秒｜中近景

一片花瓣飘落，她抬手轻巧地去接，指尖一拢，

顺势把玩花瓣，唇角扬起一抹俏皮笑意，肩膀微微一晃，

身体从斜倚中轻轻坐正——动作连贯有呼吸感。

〔轻笑·气声〕"嗯？"（被花瓣逗笑的一声）

SHOT 2｜3-6秒｜眼部+面部特写

镜头随她转头推近：眼波灵动地一转，睫毛俏皮一眨，

视线追着飘飞的花瓣左右流转，鼻尖轻轻一皱，笑意盈盈。

无台词，眼神戏鲜活。

SHOT 3｜6-9秒｜半身动态

她伸手拨弄耳畔垂落的珍珠流苏，指尖一挑流苏荡开，

身子微微前倾又靠回石栏，纱披随动作滑落一截又被她随手撩起，

裙裾、流苏、碎发一起随风轻摆——满画面流动。

〔轻声·一句〕"这风，倒是会闹。"

SHOT 4｜9-12秒｜手部+披帛特写转场

切到她起身的瞬间：扶栏的手用力一撑，

纱披与裙摆扬起一道弧线，花瓣被带得旋飞，

镜头随她起身上摇——动势十足。无台词。

SHOT 5｜12-15秒｜中近景收束（动中带静）

她已轻盈起身，回眸望向镜头，发钗流苏还在余韵中轻晃，

唇瓣一动，露出明媚又略含余韵的浅笑，最后眼神柔柔一沉，

身姿仍带着方才起身的余动，自然定格——灵动而不僵。

〔气声·渐弱〕"走吧。"

声音设定：女声，明媚清灵，语速自然，气声适中；

全程仅三处极短轻语+一声轻笑，重在俏皮鲜活的情绪。

镜头 CAMERA：

多机位分镜，镜头跟随人物动作走（追接花瓣、随转头推、随起身上摇），

切换流畅，浅景深，背景牡丹宫阙虚化；整体运镜灵动不呆板。

氛围·光线：

黄昏金色侧逆光，暖调奢华；花瓣大量飘飞旋舞、莲池微漾、

珍珠流苏与纱披持续轻摆，画面始终有流动的元素，

基调明媚灵动、雍容鲜活。

CONSTRAINTS（约束）：

- 4K 超清，15秒，人物妆容服饰与首帧一致（换镜不换脸不换装）

- 重点：人物肢体全程自然流动、有呼吸有重心转移，严禁僵直定格不动

- 加入主动互动（接花瓣、拨流苏、起身、回眸）让画面灵动

- 三处台词与口型严格同步，气声质感，不假唱

- 分镜切换跟随动作、流畅自然，节奏轻快，不跳帧不卡顿

- 眼波灵动、睫毛眼神有戏；禁止眼睛发光、瞳孔异常

- 风动、落花旋飞、流苏纱披摆动符合真实物理，灵动但不夸张

- 结尾在「动中带静」的余动里自然定格，无黑屏无转场

- 无字幕、无水印、无任何标记符号、无文字

en.p:
First Frame (= upload reference image, only showing the initial pose, then the character naturally moves):

Palace-dressed beauties with black hair and high buns, golden flower hairpins adorned with long strings of pearl tassels hanging over their shoulders, red floral ornaments on their brows,

A crimson and gold-embellished strapless long dress, a thin gauze shawl half-exposing fragrant shoulders, and a white jade ring and pendant tied with gold thread at the waist;

At the beginning, leaning against the carved stone railing, peonies beside you, palaces behind, fallen flowers in the lotus pond, and the warm glow of dusk.

The facial features, makeup, and clothing of the characters are consistent with the first frame, but the body movements are flexible throughout, with no stiffness or stillness.

Storyboard script (Key points: active character performance, agile movements, interactive with the environment at any time):

SHOT 1 | 0-3 seconds | Medium to close-up

A petal drifted down, and she reached out to catch it, her fingertips gathering together,

Playing with the petals, a playful smile appeared at the corner of her lips, her shoulders swaying slightly,

The body sits up gently from a recline—the movements are smooth and breathable.

[Light laughter · breathy voice] "Hmm?" (laughing at the petals)

SHOT 2 | 3-6 seconds | Eye + Face Close-up

The camera leans in as she turns her head: her eyes shift lively, her eyelashes wink playfully,

Her gaze drifted left and right following the drifting petals, her nose wrinkled slightly, and she smiled brightly.

No dialogue, vivid eye acting.

SHOT 3 | 6-9 seconds | Half-body animation

She reached out to tease the pearl tassels hanging by her ear, her fingertips lifting the tassels as they fluttered,

She leaned forward slightly, then leaned back against the stone railing. The sheer cloak slipped off with her movement, then lifted up again,

The skirt, tassels, and stray hairs all sway gently in the wind—flowing throughout the entire image.

[Soft voice · a single line] "This wind is quite noisy." "

SHOT 4 | 9-12 seconds | Hands + shambo close-up transition

At the moment she stood up: the hand supporting the railing pushed hard,

The sheer shawl and skirt curve in an arc, petals swirling and flying,

The camera shook as she rose—full of momentum. No dialogue.

SHOT 5 | 12-15 seconds | Medium and Close Shots (Movement with Stillness)

She had already risen lightly, glanced back at the camera, her hairpin and tassels still swaying in the afterglow,

Her lips moved, revealing a bright, lingering smile, then her gaze softly darkened,

Her posture still carried the lingering movement from her earlier rise, naturally frozen — agile but not stiff.

[Breath Sound · Gradually Fading] "Let's go." "

Voice settings: female voice, bright and clear, natural speaking rate, moderate breath;

Throughout the film, there are only three very short whispers + a soft laugh, focusing on playful and lively emotions.

CAMERA:

Multi-camera storyboarding, with the camera following the characters' movements (following petals, pushing with a head, shaking as they stand up),

Smooth transitions, shallow depth, and a background of peony palaces blurring; The overall camera work is lively and not stiff.

Atmosphere & Light:

At dusk, golden side backlight creates a warm and luxurious atmosphere; Petals flutter and swirl in abundance, the lotus pond ripples gently,

Pearl tassels and sheer drapes continue to sway gently, with flowing elements always present in the composition,

The tone is bright, lively, and lively.

CONSTRAINTS:

- 4K Ultra HD, 15 seconds, character makeup and costumes match the first frame (no camera changes, no face, no costume)

- Key point: The character's body moves naturally throughout, with breathing and center of gravity shifting; rigidity and still are strictly prohibited

- Incorporate active interaction (catching petals, plucking tassels, standing up, looking back) to make the visuals lively

- Three lines are strictly synchronized with lip-sync, with breathy texture and no lip-syncing

- Storyboard transitions follow the action, smooth and natural, with a brisk rhythm and no frame skipping or lag

- Lively eye movements, eyelashes with expressive expression; Avoid glowing eyes and abnormal pupils

- Wind movement, swirling petals, and the swaying tassel drapes match real physics—lively but not exaggerated

- The ending naturally freezes in the lingering motion of "movement mixed with stillness," with no black screen or transitions

- No subtitles, no watermark, no markers, no text

raw_p:
【风格】顶级自然纪录片摄影语言，电影级自然光，高帧率升格慢动作 
【场景】日落前的高海拔群山，连绵雪峰从厚重云海中露出，天空呈金色、淡橙色与青灰色渐变。云层像缓慢起伏的海洋，阳光从云隙中穿透，形成巨大体积光柱。数条体长数公里的红白锦鲤潜游在云层内部，鳞片轮廓若隐若现。
 [00:00–00:02.5] 镜头1：云海异动 （Vertical Aerial Establishing Shot，超长焦航拍） 参考竖屏高空远景，镜头从一座覆雪山峰后方缓慢升起，前景是锋利的黑色岩壁与被风吹起的细小雪粒，中景是翻涌的金色云海，远处群山层层递进。 云层下方出现一道极其庞大的红白色轮廓，像某种远古生物正在云海深处缓慢游动。云层表面被它的身体顶起，形成长达数公里的弧形隆起。 镜头轻微推近，一片巨大的半透明鱼鳍短暂穿透云层，又迅速沉入其中。鱼鳍边缘挂着细小水珠，水珠在阳光中闪烁，随后化为漂浮的云雾粒子。
 [00:02.5–00:05.2] 镜头2：巨鲤跃出云海 （High-Speed Telephoto Tracking，240fps升格慢动作） 一条数公里长的巨型红白锦鲤突然从云海中跃出。 侧面超长焦跟拍，锦鲤身体在空中形成优雅弧线，头部率先冲破云层，厚重的云雾像海浪一样向两侧炸开。云雾沿着鱼头、鳃盖和背部快速滑落，形成巨大的白色流体瀑布。 升格慢动作清晰捕捉： 锦鲤鳃盖缓慢开合； 胸鳍在空气中柔和摆动； 腹部鳞片随着身体扭转产生细微错位； 红白相间的鳞片表面覆盖着湿润水膜； 数千颗水珠从鳍尖甩出，在逆光中变成金色光点。 锦鲤的游动姿态必须符合真实鱼类生物力学，不像飞龙，不拍打翅膀，而是通过脊柱、尾柄和尾鳍连续摆动，在云层中像在深海中游泳。
 [00:05.2–00:07.8] 镜头3：鳞片与眼睛特写 （Extreme Wildlife Close-Up，Macro Telephoto Lens） 镜头切换至贴近锦鲤头部的极端特写。参考 巨大的琥珀色眼睛占据画面上半部分，眼球表面湿润透明，清晰倒映出夕阳、雪山和摄影机所在的云层。 锦鲤缓慢转动眼球，瞳孔反射出一道锐利金色光线。 焦点从眼睛平滑转移至面部鳞片： 每一片鳞片都具有细密生长纹； 红色区域呈现深红、朱红与橙金渐变； 白色鳞片带有淡淡珍珠质感； 鳞片缝隙间残留着细小水珠与云雾； 鳃盖边缘随着呼吸轻微起伏。 一缕云雾从锦鲤脸颊前飘过，短暂遮住眼睛，又被气流卷走。浅景深下，远处雪峰与夕阳形成柔和散景。 
[00:07.8–00:10.0] 镜头4：尾鳍扫过群山 （Low-Angle Wide Tracking Shot） 镜头位于山峰上方，以仰拍视角跟随锦鲤向天空游动。参考 巨型锦鲤从摄影机上方掠过，腹部白色鳞片反射 cold 色天光，红色斑纹被夕阳勾勒出金色轮廓。 它粗壮的尾柄缓慢弯曲，巨大尾鳍横扫云层。 尾鳍扫过的瞬间，云海被推开成一个巨大的环形漩涡，数道云浪沿山谷向外扩散。细小冰晶、水珠与云雾粒子飞向镜头，形成强烈纵深感。 锦鲤逐渐潜入更高处的金色云层，只留下尾鳍末端短暂可见。云层闭合后，天空中出现一圈缓慢扩散的巨大涟漪。 最后一帧定格：锦鲤尾鳍即将完全没入云海，阳光穿过半透明鳍膜，能看到细密血管、鳍条结构和边缘水珠。 【竖屏构图要求】 画面以纵向空间为核心，突出“山峰—云海—巨型锦鲤—天空”的垂直层次。 远景镜头中，锦鲤从画面下方云层向中上部跃出；特写镜头中，眼睛位于上三分之一构图区域；结尾镜头让尾鳍由画面中央扫向顶部，增强竖屏冲击力。 主体不能始终居中，保留真实自然纪录片的追踪构图和轻微失焦修正，避免商业广告式摆拍感。 
【摄影与光影要求】 真实高海拔自然光，日落逆光，云雾具有真实体积、密度和流动惯性。锦鲤必须与环境产生真实互动，包括遮挡、投影、云层扰动、水珠飞散和玻璃般的湿润反光。 使用自然纪录片常见摄影手法：超长焦压缩空间、稳定航拍、快速追焦、局部浅景深、升格慢动作和极端生物特写。 【声音设计】 开场是高山风声、远处低沉雷鸣和细微雪粒撞击声。 锦鲤在云下游动时，加入类似深海鲸鸣的低频震动，但更轻、更神秘。 跃出云层时出现厚重的云雾破开声与低沉水流声。 特写阶段突出鳃盖呼吸、鳞片摩擦和水珠滑落的微弱声音。 尾鳍扫过云层时加入强烈但不夸张的低频空气震动，结尾恢复辽阔安静的高山风声。 
【负面提示词】 卡通锦鲤，动漫风格，游戏CG，塑料鱼，气球鱼，飞龙动作，鸟类振翅，长出翅膀，蛇形身体，错误鱼鳍，额外鱼鳍，畸形鳞片，眼睛变形，嘴部变形，锦鲤数量突然变化，主体闪烁，尺寸忽大忽小，穿过山体，云层无互动，云雾像棉花，廉价特效，霓虹发光鱼，魔法能量，闪电环绕，过度饱和，过强光晕，镜头剧烈抖动，快速随机切镜，低分辨率，模糊纹理，水印，字幕，Logo。

en.t: Giant Koi Leaping Through Golden Clouds
en.p:
[Style] Top-tier nature documentary cinematography, cinematic natural light, high frame rate upgraded to slow motion 
[Scene] High-altitude mountains before sunset, continuous snow-capped peaks emerging from the heavy sea of clouds, the sky shifting from gold, pale orange, to blue-gray gradients. The clouds resemble a slowly rising ocean, with sunlight piercing through gaps to form massive beams of light. Several red and white koi fish stretching several kilometers swim beneath the clouds, their scale outlines faintly visible.
 [00:00–00:02.5] Shot 1: Vertical Aerial Establishing Shot. Referring to a vertical aerial shot, the camera slowly rises behind a snow-capped mountain peak. In the background, sharp black rock faces and fine snowflakes blown up by the wind are in the background. In the middle is a surging golden sea of clouds, with distant mountains layered and progressive. Beneath the clouds appeared an enormous red and white silhouette, like some ancient creature slowly swimming deep within the sea of clouds. The cloud surface is lifted by its body, forming an arc-shaped bulge several kilometers long. The camera zooms in slightly, and a huge translucent fish fin briefly pierces through the clouds before quickly sinking into it. Tiny droplets of water hang from the edges of the fins, which sparkle in the sunlight and then transform into floating cloud particles.
 [00:02.5–00:05.2] Scene 2: Giant Koi Leaping Out of the Sea of Clouds (High-Speed Telephoto Tracking, 240fps Upgraded Slow Motion) A giant koi several kilometers long suddenly leaps out from the sea of clouds. From the side, the ultra-telephoto camera shows the koi's body forming an elegant arc in the air, its head breaking through the clouds first, and the thick mist bursts out like waves to both sides. Mist and clouds quickly slide down along the fish's head, gill cover, and back, forming a massive white fluid waterfall. Upgrade slow-motion clear capture: Koi gill covers slowly open and close; The pectoral fins gently sway in the air; The abdominal scales are slightly displaced as the body twists; The surface of the red and white scales is covered with a moist film of water; Thousands of droplets flicked from the tips of their fins, turning into golden glowing spots in the backlight. The koi's swimming posture must match the biomechanics of real fish. Unlike flying dragons, which do not flapping their wings, they continuously swing through their spine, tail stalk, and tail fin, swimming in clouds as if swimming in the deep sea.
 [00:05.2–00:07.8] Shot 3: Extreme Wildlife Close-Up (Macro Telephoto Lens) The camera switches to an extreme close-up close to the koi's head. Reference: The huge amber eyes occupy the upper half of the frame, with moist and transparent surfaces that clearly reflect the sunset, snowy mountains, and the clouds where the camera is located. Koi slowly turned its eyes, its pupils reflecting a sharp golden light. The focus smoothly shifts from the eyes to the facial scales: each scale has fine growth lines; The red areas show gradients of deep red, vermilion, and orange-gold; White scales with a faint pearly texture; Between the gaps between the scales, tiny droplets of water and mist remain; The edge of the gill cover rises and falls slightly with breathing. A wisp of mist drifted past the koi's cheek, briefly covering his eyes, then being swept away by the airflow. In shallow scenes and deep depths, distant snowy peaks and sunset form a soft bokeh. 
[00:07.8–00:10.0] Shot 4: Tail Fin Sweeping Over Mountains (Low-Angle Wide Tracking Shot) The camera is positioned above the mountain peaks, following the koi in a low-angle perspective as it swims toward the sky. Reference: A giant koi glides past above the camera, its white scales reflecting the cold daylight, and its red stripes outlined in golden hues by the sunset. Its thick tail stalk curves slowly, and its massive tail fin sweeps across the clouds. The moment the tail fin swept past, the sea of clouds was pushed open into a massive circular vortex, with several waves spreading outward along the valley. Fine Xiaoice crystals, water droplets, and cloud particles fly toward the lens, creating a strong sense of depth. Koi gradually dive into the golden clouds higher up, leaving only the tip of its tail fin briefly visible. After the clouds closed, a ring of slowly spreading huge ripples appeared in the sky. The final frame freezes the carp's tail fin, about to be completely swallowed by the sea of clouds. Sunlight filters through the translucent fin membrane, revealing fine blood vessels, fin strips, and water droplets at the edges. [Vertical Composition Requirements] The composition centers on vertical space, highlighting the vertical layers of "mountain peaks—sea of clouds—giant koi fish—sky." In the long shot, koi leap from the clouds below the frame toward the upper and middle sections; In the close-up, the eyes are located in the upper third of the composition; The final shot lets the tail fin sweep from the center of the frame to the top, enhancing the impact of the vertical screen. The subject cannot always be centered, retaining the tracking composition and slight out-of-focus correction of real nature documentaries, avoiding the commercial-style staging feel. 
[Photography and Light and Shadow Requirements] True high-altitude natural light, sunset backlight, clouds and mist with real volume, density, and flow inertia. Koi must interact authentically with their environment, including occlusion, projections, cloud disturbances, droplet scattering, and glassy wet reflections. Common techniques used in nature documentaries: ultra-telephoto compression of space, stable aerial shots, rapid focus tracking, local shallow depth of field, elevated slow motion, and extreme close-ups of creatures. [Sound Design] The opening features the sound of mountain wind, distant deep thunder, and the faint sound of snowflakes hitting. When koi swim beneath the clouds, they incorporate low-frequency vibrations similar to deep-sea whale calls, but they are lighter and more mysterious. When breaking through the clouds, heavy mist breaks through and the deep sound of water flows. The close-up phase highlights the faint sounds of the gill cover breathing, scales rubbing, and water droplets sliding down. When the tail fin sweeps through the clouds, it adds a strong but not exaggerated low-frequency air vibration, ending with the vast, quiet mountain wind.

**0–3 sec:**
Front three-quarter cinematic shot of both cars. The Supra driver smiles and says naturally:

The Ferrari driver smirks confidently and replies:
**"More than you can afford, pal... Ferrari."**
The girlfriend smiles confidently.

**3–5 sec:**
Inside the Supra. Both friends glance at each other with determined expressions. The passenger leans toward the driver and says:

The driver nods with a confident grin.

Rear low-angle tracking shot. Both cars launch aggressively at the same time. Front tracking camera as the **Supra pulls ahead**, overtakes the Ferrari cleanly, and crosses the finish first. The Ferrari driver looks shocked while the girlfriend is visibly surprised.

The Supra slows slightly. The driver looks across at the Ferrari with a calm smile and says:
**"Don't compare."**
End on a dramatic slow-motion hero shot of the victorious Supra driving into the sunset while the Ferrari trails behind.

zh.t: 超跑街头对决：实力打脸
zh.p:
在黄金时段，在宽阔的海岸公路上制作一段**15秒超逼真的电影街头赛车场景**。两辆**豪华敞篷跑车**并排停在同一方向。左边是一辆**红色法拉利敞篷车**，车上坐着一位自信、时尚的男子，身穿黑色西装，戴着黑色墨镜，优雅的女友坐在他旁边。右边是一辆**白色丰田Supra敞篷车**，车里坐着两个穿着随意的年轻男子。比赛前的氛围平静，配备高级电影灯光、逼真的反光、浅景深和好莱坞级别的摄影。

**0–3秒：**
两辆车的前方三分之三电影镜头。Supra司机微笑着自然地说：
**“好车......那种东西的零售价是多少？”**
法拉利车手自信地笑着回答：
**“比你能负担得起的还多，伙计......法拉利。”**
女友自信地笑了。

**3–5秒：**
在Supra内部。两位朋友都带着坚定的表情对视。乘客向司机倾身说：
**“抽烟。”**
司机自信地笑着点头。

**5–10秒：**
后方低角度跟踪镜头。两辆车同时猛烈起步。轮胎剧烈打滑，浓烟冒出，橡胶烧伤，细小的石块四散，发动机轰鸣，车辆全速加速。快速的电影剪辑展示了车轮特写、换挡、排气火焰、速度表指针上升、空中无人机镜头以及动态侧向跟踪镜头，比赛以极快的速度展开。

**10–13秒：**
前置跟踪摄像头，**Supra拉开距离**，干净利落地超越法拉利，率先冲过终点。法拉利车手看起来很震惊，而女友则明显很惊讶。

**13–15秒：**
Supra稍微减速。司机平静地看着法拉利，说道：
**“别拿来比。”**
以一段戏剧性的慢动作英雄镜头结束，胜利的Supra驾车驶向夕阳，法拉利紧随其后。

zh.p: 摄像机从原始森林潮湿、长满苔藓的地面中冲出，穿梭于浓密的巨型蕨类丛林中，发光孢子如萤火虫般在镜头周围四散飞舞。它从下层树冠中喷涌而出，洒下一阵发光的、虚幻的露珠，奔跑在刻有深邃发光符文的古老巨树高耸扭曲的树干上。翠绿与紫罗兰色的光束透过树叶，在树皮上投下耀眼的光辉，摄像机以惊人的速度旋转，向左穿过垂挂的藤蔓，最终攀升至被银色月光亲吻的无尽雄伟上层树冠。下方森林充满生机;树叶不再是黑暗，而是深翡翠、青色和靛蓝的光辉，花朵缓慢绽放，光芒如爆发般壮观。镜头再次俯冲，在月光间扭转，擦过一根巨大的发光树枝几英寸，然后切换成戏剧性的俯视角度。悬浮在苔藓悬崖边缘，站着一个孤独身影，一动不动，毫无畏惧，身影映衬着夜空中巨大的发光星云，斗篷在上升气流中飘扬，凝视着无尽的森林，仿佛守护着它的守护者。镜头越飞越高，越飞越快，展现出令人屏息的生态系统全貌：耀眼发光的植物、高耸的巨树，以及在细节上爆发的花粉。那人慢慢抬起头，向前迈步。就在那一刻，整个森林树冠齐聚一堂纯净、发光的能量爆发，月光如液态银般穿透，营造出一场史诗般、令人敬畏的电影高潮，充满古老力量与奇迹。色级：空灵银色月光，鲜艳的生物发光翡翠和青色，深邃浓郁的靛蓝色阴影，清晰明亮的高光，高动态范围，无浑浊色彩，无刺眼人工光，视觉丰富、精致、史诗般、神秘、大画幅电影级。

en.p: The camera bursts upward from the damp, mossy floor of a primordial forest, rocketing through a dense thicket of giant ferns as bioluminescent spores scatter like fireflies around the lens. It erupts through the lower canopy in a shower of glowing, ethereal dew, racing past the towering, twisted trunks of ancient colossal trees carved with deep, glowing runes. Vibrant shafts of emerald and violet light filter through the leaves, casting radiant highlights across the bark as the camera spirals with breathtaking speed, banking left through hanging vines before climbing into an endless, majestic upper canopy kissed by silver moonlight. Below, the forest breathes with immense life; instead of darkness, the foliage glows with deep jade, cyan, and indigo, flowers blooming in spectacular slow-motion bursts of light. The camera dives again, twisting between shafts of moonlight, skimming inches from a massive glowing branch, then snapping into a dramatic overhead tilt. At the edge of a suspended mossy precipice stands a lone figure, unmoving and fearless, silhouetted by a massive, glowing nebula in the night sky, their cloak billowing in the updraft as they stare into the infinite forest like they are its guardian. The camera circles higher and higher, faster and faster, revealing the full scale of the breathtaking ecosystem: radiant glowing flora, towering mega-trees, and pollen exploding in luminous detail. The figure slowly raises their head and steps forward. At that instant, the entire forest canopy surges upward in a colossal, synchronized burst of pure, glowing energy, moonlight blazing through it like liquid silver, creating an epic, awe-inspiring cinematic climax filled with ancient power and wonder. 15 seconds, 16:9. Main subject from @ image1 — lock her completely. Face, skin tone, body, outfit, everything stays identical the whole way through. She's wearing a grey faded sleeveless crop top, loose high-waist light blue jeans, black canvas sneakers, black cord necklace, black wavy hair in a messy side-swept ponytail with bangs. Korean woman, early-2000s feel.

The whole thing is shot in a quiet Korean residential neighborhood — narrow concrete alleys, low-rise houses with small terraces, a front yard with a clothesline, potted plants, parked bicycles and motorcycles, big trees, and overhead cables everywhere. No shops, no vendors, nothing commercial. Just a real neighborhood.

Camera treatment is the whole point. This needs to look like someone's friend grabbed a DV camcorder and just started recording — no plan, no setup, no nothing. Heavy handheld shake, constant reframing, subject drifting toward the edges, autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping. The image itself should look faded, low contrast, slightly washed out, with that digital noise and compression feel that early-2000s home video had. No stabilization. No modern grading. This aesthetic is non-negotiable.

She starts sitting on a concrete sidewalk fixing her ponytail, arms raised, genuine smile, wind catching her hair — camera barely holding focus. Then the camera follows her into a narrow alley where she crouches down and feeds a stray cat that comes right up to her. After that she's in her front yard hanging laundry on the clothesline, morning breeze moving everything, camera swaying and hunting. Mid-section she's on the front terrace with a coffee cup, just sitting quietly, looking out at the street — loose drifting shot from the side. Then a right-side close shot where she raises her arm, waves warmly toward someone off-frame and says "Annyeong" — camera catches it a beat late. Final shot is a slow tracking walk down the street, coffee cup in hand, she notices the lens, turns slightly and gives a real quiet smile — then the recording just cuts to black mid-motion like the camcorder got switched off.

Audio is strictly natural. Morning birds, light breeze, distant motorcycle sounds, faint neighborhood chatter, cat, coffee cup, footsteps on concrete, leaves. No music, no sound design, nothing added.

zh.p:
15秒，16：9。@ image1 的主旨——彻底锁定她。脸、肤色、身体、服装，所有细节始终保持一致。她穿着灰色褪色的无袖露脐上衣，宽松的高腰浅蓝色牛仔裤，黑色帆布运动鞋，黑色绳索项链，黑色波浪发随意地侧扫马尾，还有刘海。韩国女性，2000年代初的感觉。

整个影片在一个安静的韩国住宅区拍摄——狭窄的混凝土巷弄、带小排屋的低层住宅、带晾衣绳的前院、盆栽、停放的自行车和摩托车、大树，以及到处都是架空电缆。没有商店，没有商贩，没有商业。只是一个真正的社区。

镜头处理才是重点。这看起来就像某人的朋友拿了个DV摄像机直接开始录——没有计划，没有布置，什么都没有。手持手抖、不断重构、主体偏离边缘、自动对焦、镜头呼吸、曝光泵动。画面本身应该看起来是褪色、低对比度、略带洗白感，带有2000年代初家庭录像那种数字噪点和压缩的感觉。没有稳定。没有现代的评分。这种美学是不可妥协的。

她开始坐在水泥人行道上整理马尾，双臂高举，真诚地微笑，风吹拂着她的头发——相机几乎无法对焦。然后镜头跟随她进入一条狭窄的小巷，她蹲下身喂一只走近她的流浪猫。之后她就在前院晾衣服，晨风吹拂着一切，摄像机摇摆，猎物不断。中段她坐在前露台上，手里拿着一杯咖啡，静静地坐着，望着街道——从侧面散射着。然后是右侧特写镜头，她举起手臂，向画面外的人热情挥手，说“安宁”——镜头晚了一拍才捕捉到。最后一幕是她慢慢地跟着走在街上，手里拿着咖啡杯，她注意到镜头，微微转身，露出一个很安静的微笑——然后录像突然切换到画面中段的黑屏，就像摄像机被关掉了一样。

音频完全是自然的。清晨的鸟鸣、微风、远处摩托车的声音、隐约的邻居交谈、猫、咖啡杯、混凝土上的脚步声、落叶。没有音乐，没有音效设计，也没有任何添加。

en.p:
15 seconds, 16:9. Main subject from @ image1 — lock her completely. Face, skin tone, body, outfit, everything stays identical the whole way through. She's wearing a grey faded sleeveless crop top, loose high-waist light blue jeans, black canvas sneakers, black cord necklace, black wavy hair in a messy side-swept ponytail with bangs. Korean woman, early-2000s feel.

The whole thing is shot in a quiet Korean residential neighborhood — narrow concrete alleys, low-rise houses with small terraces, a front yard with a clothesline, potted plants, parked bicycles and motorcycles, big trees, and overhead cables everywhere. No shops, no vendors, nothing commercial. Just a real neighborhood.

Camera treatment is the whole point. This needs to look like someone's friend grabbed a DV camcorder and just started recording — no plan, no setup, no nothing. Heavy handheld shake, constant reframing, subject drifting toward the edges, autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping. The image itself should look faded, low contrast, slightly washed out, with that digital noise and compression feel that early-2000s home video had. No stabilization. No modern grading. This aesthetic is non-negotiable.

She starts sitting on a concrete sidewalk fixing her ponytail, arms raised, genuine smile, wind catching her hair — camera barely holding focus. Then the camera follows her into a narrow alley where she crouches down and feeds a stray cat that comes right up to her. After that she's in her front yard hanging laundry on the clothesline, morning breeze moving everything, camera swaying and hunting. Mid-section she's on the front terrace with a coffee cup, just sitting quietly, looking out at the street — loose drifting shot from the side. Then a right-side close shot where she raises her arm, waves warmly toward someone off-frame and says "Annyeong" — camera catches it a beat late. Final shot is a slow tracking walk down the street, coffee cup in hand, she notices the lens, turns slightly and gives a real quiet smile — then the recording just cuts to black mid-motion like the camcorder got switched off.

Audio is strictly natural. Morning birds, light breeze, distant motorcycle sounds, faint neighborhood chatter, cat, coffee cup, footsteps on concrete, leaves. No music, no sound design, nothing added.

raw_p:
首帧 FIRST FRAME（=上传参考图，100%锁定）：

宫装美人，乌发高髻、金花步摇缀长串珍珠流苏垂肩，眉心红色花钿，

绛红描金绣花抹胸长裙、薄纱罗披半露香肩，金线腰封系白玉环佩；

斜倚雕花石栏，身畔牡丹盛放、身后宫阙楼台、莲池落花、黄昏暖光。

人物五官、妆容、发饰、服饰、姿态与首帧完全一致，不得变形换脸。

分镜脚本（SHOT 切分，少台词·重微表情）：

SHOT 1｜0-3秒｜中近景（维持首帧斜倚姿态）

斜倚石栏，目光望向画面右侧远处，眼神慵懒微醺，

睫毛极轻一颤，胸口随呼吸缓缓起伏；唇角几不可察地上扬。

无台词，仅环境声（微风、落花、远处水声）。

SHOT 2｜3-6秒｜眼部特写（macro 切入）

镜头推至双眼特写：瞳孔微微转动，眼波流转，

眼尾扫向一侧，睫毛轻眨一次，眼神由慵懒转为一丝若有所思。

〔极轻气声·半句〕"……又是一年花落。"

SHOT 3｜6-9秒｜面部细节（侧脸→唇）

切侧脸特写：唇瓣轻抿，喉头微动似轻叹，

眉梢极淡地一蹙又松开；一缕碎发被风拂过脸颊。

无台词，仅一声极轻的气息叹息。

SHOT 4｜9-12秒｜手部+披帛细节

切至搭在石栏上的手：指尖轻轻摩挲冰凉石面，

腕间玉镯微晃；纱披与裙裾被风掀起一角，花瓣落于裙上。

镜头随落花极缓上摇。无台词。

SHOT 5｜12-15秒｜中近景收束（定格）

缓缓转回头，目视前方，眼神柔和微润、似笑非笑，

唇瓣极轻一动旋即收住（欲语还休）。

〔气声·渐弱〕"由它去吧。"

最终归于安静凝望，定格在雍容慵懒、略带一缕清愁。

声音设定：女声，慵懒清雅，气声偏多，语速很慢，全程仅两处极短轻语，

其余以呼吸、叹息、眼神表演为主；台词处严格贴合口型。

镜头 CAMERA：

多机位分镜——中近景／眼部 macro／侧脸特写／手部特写／回中近景；

每次切换干净利落（硬切或极短叠化），浅景深，背景牡丹宫阙虚化。

氛围·光线：

黄昏金色侧逆光，暖调奢华；花瓣随风飘落、莲池微漾，

珍珠流苏轻晃，空气中浮动金尘，基调雍容慵懒、含蓄清愁。

CONSTRAINTS（约束）：

- 4K 超清，15秒，所有分镜中人物/妆容/服饰与首帧 100% 一致（换镜不换脸不换装）

- 微表情真实细腻（眼波、睫毛、呼吸、轻叹、抿唇）为表演核心

- 两处台词与口型严格同步，气声质感，不假唱、不错位

- 分镜切换自然连贯，节奏舒缓，不跳帧、不闪烁

- 眼神有戏；禁止眼睛发光、禁止瞳孔异常

- 风动、落花、流苏、纱披、水面符合真实物理，轻柔不夸张

- 结尾无黑屏、无转场，自然定格

- 无字幕、无水印、无任何标记符号、无文字

en.p:
First Frame (= Upload reference image, 100% locked):

Palace-dressed beauties with black hair in high buns, golden flower hairpins adorned with long strings of pearl tassels hanging over their shoulders, red floral hairpins on their brows,

A crimson and gold-embroidered strapless long dress, a sheer gauze shawl half-exposing fragrant shoulders, a gold-threaded waist belt tied with white jade pendants;

Leaning against the carved stone railing, peonies bloom beside you, behind you are palace towers and towers, lotus ponds fall with petals, and the warm light of dusk.

The character's facial features, makeup, hair accessories, clothing, and posture are exactly the same as the first frame; facial changes are not allowed.

Storyboard script (SHOT, syncopation, less dialogue, heavy micro-expressions):

SHOT 1 | 0-3 seconds | Medium to Close-up (maintain the first frame tilted pose)

Leaning against the stone railing, his gaze drifted to the distant right side of the painting, his gaze lazy and slightly flushed,

Her eyelashes trembled slightly, her chest rising and falling with each breath; The corners of his lips almost slipped into a smile.

No dialogue, only ambient sounds (breeze, falling flowers, distant water sounds).

SHOT 2 | 3-6 seconds | Close-up of the eyes (macro cut)

The camera zooms in to a close-up of both eyes: pupils slightly move, eyes shifting,

The corner of his eye swept to one side, his eyelashes blinked slightly, and his gaze shifted from laziness to a hint of thoughtfulness.

[Ji Qing Sheng · Half Line] "...... Another year of flowers falling. "

SHOT 3 | 6-9 seconds | Facial Details (Profile→ Lips)

Close-up of a side profile: lips gently pressed together, a slight movement in the throat as if sighing,

Her brows furrowed faintly, then relaxed; A stray strand of hair brushed across her cheek by the wind.

No lines, only a very faint sigh.

SHOT 4 | 9-12 seconds | Hand + shabu detail

Cut to the hand resting on the stone railing: fingertips gently stroke the cool stone surface,

The jade bracelet on her wrist swayed slightly; The gauze shawl and skirt were lifted by the wind, and petals fell onto the skirt.

The camera slowly pans upward with the falling flowers. No dialogue.

SHOT 5 | 12-15 seconds | Medium Close-up (Freeze Frame)

Slowly turning his head, gazing ahead, his gaze gentle and moist, with a half-smile,

Her lips moved lightly, then immediately stopped (wanting to speak but pause).

[Breath Sound · Gradually Fading] "Let it be." "

Ultimately, it returns to quiet gaze, fixed in a dignified, lazy state with a hint of melancholy.

Voice settings: Female voice, lazy and elegant, with a heavy breathy voice, very slow speech rate, only two very brief whispers throughout,

The rest mainly focus on breathing, sighing, and eye expression; The lines strictly fit the lip movements.

CAMERA:

Multi-camera storyboard—medium and close-up / eye macro / side profile close-up / hand close-up / center close-up;

Each transition is clean and crisp (hard cut or ultra-short overlay), with shallow depth of field, and a background of peony palaces blurred.

Atmosphere & Light:

At dusk, golden side backlight creates a warm and luxurious atmosphere; Petals drift with the wind, the lotus pond ripples gently,

Pearl tassels sway gently, golden dust floats in the air, and the base tone is graceful, lazy, and reserved with a quiet melancholy.

CONSTRAINTS:

- 4K Ultra HD, 15 seconds, all characters, makeup, and costumes in the storyboard are 100% consistent with the first frame (no face changes, no costume changes)

- Micro-expressions are genuine and delicate (eye waves, eyelashes, breathing, sighs, lips pursed) as the core of performance

- Both lines are strictly synchronized with lip-sync, with breathy and textured voice, no lip-syncing or mismatching

- Storyboard transitions are natural and smooth, with a relaxed rhythm and no frame skips or flickering

- Eyes full of playful expression; Avoid glowing eyes and abnormal pupils

- Wind movement, falling petals, tassels, gauze drapes, and water surfaces match real physics, gentle and not exaggerated

- No black screen or transitions at the end, natural freeze-frame

- No subtitles, no watermark, no markers, no text

raw_p: 参照画像のキャラクターをVTuber風の実況アバターとして使用する。緑色の多角形マスク、黒い縁取り、細い目、黒い眉、紫色の大きな舌、白い頭部、黒い服の印象を維持。キャラクターは画面右下に2D/Live2D風の小さな配信者アバターとして重ね表示される。背景の料理映像には干渉しない。アバターは上半身のみ表示、軽い上下揺れ、瞬き、口パク、表情変化、ツッコミ動作、リアクションを行う。映像は青椒肉絲を作っている料理実況動画。メイン画面は実写またはシネマティックな料理映像。まな板の上でピーマン、たけのこ、牛肉または豚肉を細切りにする。包丁の音、油のはねる音、中華鍋を振る音、食材が炒められる音をリアルに入れる。料理工程は、肉に下味をつける、片栗粉をまぶす、ピーマンとたけのこを切る、強火で肉を炒める、野菜を加える、オイスターソース・醤油・酒・砂糖で味付け、最後に照りが出るまで炒めて皿に盛る流れ。画面構成はゲーム実況・料理配信風。メイン料理映像を全画面にし、右下にVTuberアバターを固定表示。左上に小さく「COOKING LIVE」風の配信UIを表示してもよいが、実在サービスのロゴは使わない。字幕やコメント欄を入れる場合は架空UIとして控えめに配置する。文字が不要な場合はUIなしでもよい。アバターの実況内容：「はいどうもー、今日は青椒肉絲を作っていきます」「まずはピーマン、細く切る。ここ雑にいくと全部終わります」「肉に下味を入れて、片栗粉でうま味を閉じ込める。ここ、地味に大事」「中華鍋、火力が命。音がもう勝ってる」「ピーマン入った瞬間、色が一気に料理になるのよ」「オイスターソース入れたら勝ち確。香りが反則」「はい完成。白ごはん、逃げてください」キャラクターのリアクション演出：包丁で細切りがきれいに決まる瞬間、アバターが目を細めてうなずく。肉を強火で炒める瞬間、アバターが少し前のめりになりテンション高めに口パク。ソースを入れて湯気が上がる瞬間、紫の舌を強調しながら「これはうまい」と驚く。完成時はアバターが画面右下で小さく拍手し、満足そうにうなずく。映像スタイル：料理映像は高品質、清潔なキッチン、自然光または暖色の照明。食材の色が鮮やかに見えるようにする。油の照り、湯気、ソースのツヤ、ピーマンの緑を強調。カメラは手元の接写、斜め上からの調理台、鍋のローアングル、盛り付けのクローズアップを切り替える。VTuberアバターは常に右下に固定し、サイズや位置が途中で変わらない。料理映像の邪魔をしない。禁止事項：キャラクターの顔やマスクのデザインを変えない。舌の色を変えない。別キャラ化しない。アバターを実写人物にしない。実在する配信サービスのロゴを使わない。料理工程を飛ばしすぎない。手元とアバターが重なって見づらくならない。食材が途中で別料理に変化しない。完成品は青椒肉絲として認識できるように、細切り肉、ピーマン、たけのこ、茶色い照りのあるソースを明確に見せる。

en.p: The character in the reference image is used as a VTuber-style commentary avatar. A green polygonal mask, black edging, narrow eyes, black eyebrows, a large purple tongue, a white head, and black clothing maintain the impression. Characters are displayed as small 2D/Live2D streamer avatars in the lower right corner of the screen. It does not interfere with the cooking footage in the background. The avatar shows only the upper body, performs light vertical movements, blinking, lip-syncing, facial expressions, straight man gestures, and reactions. The video features a cooking commentary video of making shredded pork with green peppers. The main screen features live-action or cinematic cooking scenes. On a cutting board, shred the bell pepper, bamboo shoots, beef, or pork. The sounds of knives, oil splashing, wok-shaking, and ingredients being stir-fried are captured in real life. The cooking process is: seasoning the meat, coating it with potato starch, cutting bell peppers and bamboo shoots, sautéing the meat over high heat, adding vegetables, seasoning with oyster sauce, soy sauce, sake, and sugar, and finally sautéing until glossy, then serving on a plate. The screen layout resembles game commentary and cooking streams. The main dish video is set to full screen, with a VTuber avatar pinned in the lower right corner. You may display a small "COOKING LIVE" style streaming UI in the upper left corner, but do not use the logos of real services. When adding subtitles or comment sections, they are modestly arranged as virtual UIs. If you don't need text, you don't have to leave the UI at all. Avatar's commentary: "Hello, today I'm going to make shredded pork with green pepper." "First, cut the bell pepper into thin strips. If you go too rough here, everything will be done." "Add seasoning to the meat and lock in the umami with potato starch. This part is quietly important." "Wok, heat is key. The sound is already beaten." "The moment you add green peppers, the color instantly transforms the dish." "If you add oyster sauce, you're guaranteed to win." The scent is unfair." "Yes, it's complete." "White rice, please run away." Character reaction animation: At the moment the knife cuts neatly, the avatar narrows its eyes and nods. The moment the meat is stir-fried over high heat, the avatar leans forward a bit and lip-syncs with high energy. The moment the sauce is added and steam rises, the purple tongue is emphasized, and I'm amazed, saying, "This is delicious." When finished, the avatar clapped softly at the bottom right of the screen and nodded in satisfaction. Video style: Cooking footage should be high-quality, clean kitchen, with natural or warm lighting. Make the colors of the ingredients appear vivid. Highlights the shine of oil, steam, the gloss of sauce, and the green of the bell peppers. The camera switches between close-up shots at hand, the countertop from an angle, low angles of the pot, and close-ups of the plating. The VTuber avatar is always fixed at the bottom right, with its size and position remaining unchanged midway. Do not interfere with the cooking footage. Prohibited: Do not change the character's face or mask design. Do not change the color of the tongue. No separate characters. Do not make the avatar a live-action person. Do not use the logos of real streaming services. Don't skip the cooking process too much. The overlapping hand and avatar prevent it from becoming hard to see. Ingredients do not change to other dishes midway. The finished product clearly shows shredded green pepper pork strips, green peppers, bamboo shoots, and a brown, shiny sauce so you can recognize it.

en.t: Secret Drone Shot in Luxury EV
en.p:
Presented in the style of unprocessed handheld video footage from an iPhone, with all camera settings set to auto. Referencing the natural image quality taken by real passengers inside the car using their phones, the image shows slight handheld shake and the operator's breathing sensation. Autofocus occasionally searches and delays between the female driver and the drone, and the automatic white balance naturally switches between warm light inside the car and natural light outside the window. The images present the authentic interior texture: clear luxury interior details, slight glass reflections, natural skin highlights, slight motion blur, and real noise. Only natural environment sound effects within the image are used: low wind noise from cars, faint engine noise, drone propeller hum, microphones are naturally clear. Using hidden camera angles of real passengers inside the car, the composition is occasionally imperfect, with slightly skewed edges. At 0-4 seconds, the camera slightly shifts and focuses on the cabin of the Huawei Zhijie R7, with natural afternoon light streaming through the windows onto the dark luxury interior. An elegant and mature Asian woman
Delicate heavy makeup, dressed up

Sitting in the driver's seat, he gripped the steering wheel with both hands, focusing intently on the road ahead. Inside the cockpit, a milky white DJI drone flies smoothly together, referencing the positional relationship between the aircraft and the person inside the cockpit

。 The drone's propeller spins rapidly. Between 4-7 seconds, the woman occasionally turns her head to look at the drone, a faint curious smile at the corner of her mouth, her gaze naturally following, autofocus briefly switching from her face to the drone, then pulling back again, with slight realistic reflections and motion blur appearing on the glass. At 7-10 seconds, she gently glanced at the drone again, her expression relaxed and natural. The light and shadows inside the car shifted slightly as the vehicle moved, and the camera remained genuinely handheld and gently shaken, presenting the natural lifestyle feel of passengers casually recording on their phones. The visuals present a realistic, unedited iPhone handheld video texture, with documentary-level natural imperfections and no post-production color grading or special effects. raw_p: 画像1の人物またはキャラクターを使い、15秒の高品質な縦型コスメCMを生成する。画像1を基に、そのキャラクター専用の完全オリジナルアイシャドウパレットを新規デザインし、デザインは最後まで保持する。キャラクター本人が広告モデルとして出演する限定コスメCMにする。高品質、シネマティック、美容広告、洗練、高級感、上品、少し幻想的、百貨店コスメの限定コレクション風。登場人物は画像1の1人のみ。顔立ち、髪型、髪色、体型、衣装シルエット、配色、アクセサリー、表情、雰囲気、画風を維持し、別人化・不要な実写化/アニメ化/3DCG化は禁止。商品は髪色、瞳、衣装、装飾、モチーフ、性格、世界観を落とし込んだ6〜12色の高級アイシャドウパレット。普段使い色と象徴色を両立し、マット、シマー、サテン、メタリック、グリッターなど質感差を出す。ケースは金属、ガラス、偏光パール、箔押し、彫金、宝石風装飾などでジュエリーボックスのように仕上げ、形状・装飾・中身の配色と配置は全カットで一貫させる。キャラクターはパレットを持つ、開く、見つめる、鏡越しに映る、目元に色をまとう、振り返るなど自然で上品な所作を見せる。背景は高級ドレッサー、メイクルーム、柔らかな抽象空間、花・ガラス・水・粒子を含む幻想空間など。VFXは光、粒子、ラメ、反射、色のヴェール程度に抑え、顔や商品を隠さない。1〜2秒ごとに自然に切り替え、冒頭で画像からモチーフを考えてエフェクト、スムーズなフェードで美しい瞳を写し、閉じたパレットのアップ、次に外装、続いて開いた中身、後半はキャラクターと商品を一体的に見せ、最後はキャラがコスメを持ちながらヒーローショットで余韻を残す。最後にロゴ風文字【　　　】と表示して終わる。人物追加、手足や顔の破綻、安っぽい商品、読みにくい文字、長文テキスト、不要なロゴ、過度なCG感、激しいダンスは禁止。「このキャラクターのコスメが欲しい」と思える完成度を最優先する。音質の良い音の広がりを感じさせるBGMと効果音。

raw_p: Pixar-style cinematic animated feature film, 4K vertical video, 10 seconds duration, smooth camera movement, emotional storytelling, vibrant colors, shallow depth of field, highly detailed animated textures, warm sunrise lighting in New York City. The scene begins at the base of the Statue of Liberty in New York City during a golden sunrise. A small curious child stands in the foreground holding a perfectly round FIFA World Cup soccer ball. The child looks up at the Statue of Liberty with wonder and excitement. The statue is completely static and monumental. The child gently throws the soccer ball toward the Statue of Liberty. The camera follows the ball in a smooth cinematic motion as it travels through the air. The ball approaches the statue. The Statue of Liberty slowly leans forward for the first time and her eyes subtly come to life. She carefully catches the soccer ball in one hand and examines it with fascination. Her expression feels curious and slightly magical. As she holds the ball, a glowing animated dream bubble forms above her head. Inside the bubble, a football stadium slowly appears with bright floodlights and cheering energy. The camera pushes upward into the dream bubble. The world transitions seamlessly into a surreal World Cup stadium. The Statue of Liberty is now a living football player on a pitch, with the same FIFA World Cup soccer ball at her feet. Opposing abstract football players appear ahead of her. She begins a short dribbling motion, moving forward with smooth agility, performing one clean directional change past a defender. Suddenly the dream begins to fade. The stadium dissolves into glowing particles. The camera snaps back to real New York City at the base of the Statue of Liberty. The child runs forward and gently pulls the soccer ball back from the statue. The Statue of Liberty returns to her original static monument pose. The child holds the ball and looks up. Final frame holds briefly with cinematic silence. On-screen text appears: “FIFA WORLD CUP 2026” No dialogue, no watermark, no cuts, continuous cinematic motion, seamless transitions between reality and imagination.

raw_p:
Emphasize snappy animation with lively energy, pose-to-pose, strong anticipation, overshoot, squash and stretch, quick switches in facial expressions, and follow-through on hair and sleeves. 
Give the movements a distinctive rhythm with variation in pacing: Hold still poses firmly for a split second, then transition to the next movement with a quick, bouncy snap. Make it comical and well-timed, but keep the actions easy to read. 
Movements follow: "stillness → preparatory action → sudden acceleration → large overshoot → sharp stop → hair and sleeves sway delayed." 
Facial changes are exaggerated and comical. 
Poses are clear in silhouette, with a solid hold of 0.1–0.2 seconds at the end of each action. 
Use cartoonish squash & stretch, motion blur, short afterimages, dramatic smear frames and speed lines sparingly. 
Physics are slightly exaggerated beyond reality, but the character's footing and center of gravity don't break.

zh.p:
强调活力十足的动画、姿势转换、强烈的预判、超跃、挤压拉伸、面部表情快速切换，以及发型和袖子的后续处理。
给动作一个独特的节奏，节奏可以变化：保持一瞬间的固定姿势，然后用快速弹跳的弹跳动作切换到下一个动作。要搞笑且时机恰到好处，但动作要容易读懂。
随后是动作：“静止→准备动作→突然加速→大幅超越→急停→头发和袖子摇摆延迟。”
面部变化夸张且滑稽。
动作轮廓清晰，每个动作结束时保持0.1–0.2秒。
适量使用卡通化的挤压拉伸、运动模糊、短影、戏剧性模糊画面和速度线。
物理效果略显夸张，但角色的站姿和重心并未崩溃。

0-3秒
宽角无人机镜头扫过丛林树冠。一位自信的年轻女子穿着优雅剪裁的米色狩猎风格裤装和抛光皮靴，穿行在丛林中。摄像机运动模仿专业野生动物摄影，采用长焦镜头压缩和自然手持追踪。动物们从远处平静地观察着她。

3-7秒
低角度跟踪镜头跟随她，她开始优雅地在野生动物间跳舞。慢动作的落叶在空中旋转。猴子在头顶荡来荡去，色彩斑斓的鸟儿飞过镜头，鹿群穿过前景。摄像机捕捉了真实的纪录片式焦点拉扯和自然的环境反应。

7-12秒
舞蹈过程中，一场无缝的魔法变身开始。她的面部特征逐渐演变成一只威严的老虎，同时保持着人类的优雅与真实感。先是细腻的虎眼，然后是条纹皮肤图案，强化的猫脸颊结构，以及自然显现的逼真老虎毛发。转变流畅、电影感十足且可信。她的裤装、西装外套、裤子和鞋子始终保持不变，剪裁得恰到好处。

12-15秒
史诗级野生动物英雄镜头。她现在是一个惊艳的人虎混合体，穿着同样精致的裤装和擦亮的鞋子。一只雄伟的老虎走在她身旁，她继续跳舞。镜头环绕，采用专业的野生动物纪录摄影。动物们和平地聚集在她周围。金色阳光、大气雾气、浅景深、国家地理级、超写实毛皮细节、电影级色彩分级、8K HDR、体积光、令人屏息的结尾画面。风格：野生动物纪录片摄影，国家地理质量，BBC地球风格，真实动物行为，流畅镜头过渡，电影级镜头，超细致丛林环境，自然运动，照片级真实变形效果，高级视觉特效，24fps电影动态， 杰作级。
