raw_p:
Vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, high-end Pixar/Disney-style 3D animated supermarket comedy scene. Warm glossy cinematic look, soft amber supermarket lighting, cool teal freezer glow, reflective polished floor, realistic fabric, hair, glass and ice cream textures. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks.

Characters:
A large tall bearded father, broad-shouldered, heavy build, dark hair with grey temples, thick black beard, deep navy blazer, warm grey turtleneck, charcoal trousers, black shoes, silver watch. He walks with heavy confident steps, holding a phone to his right ear and a blue shopping basket in his left hand.
A small red-haired toddler daughter with copper curly hair in two side bunches, big green eyes, freckles, bubblegum-pink dress, small pink shoulder bag, pink shoes. She moves with light bouncy steps, expressive and cute.

Scene:
Modern supermarket aisle with upright glass-door freezers glowing cool aqua, condensation on glass, shelves blurred in the background, polished reflective floor.

TIMING AND SHOTS:

0.0–1.0 sec — Low opening shot from the glossy floor. Camera tilts up from the father’s black shoes and reflection, past his trousers, blue basket, navy blazer and silver watch, to his stern bearded face. He is walking and talking on the phone.

1.0–2.5 sec — Side wide shot. The father walks through the freezer aisle. His tiny daughter follows behind, dwarfed by him and the tall freezer cases. Her hair bunches bounce as she takes quick little steps.

2.5–4.0 sec — The girl stops at a freezer door, reaches up, opens it, cool mist and teal light spill out. She happily takes one waffle ice cream cone and holds it with both hands. The freezer door closes behind her.

4.0–5.2 sec — Front medium shot. The father walks toward camera, still on the phone. The girl trots beside him holding the ice cream and looking up hopefully. The father says firmly into the phone: “No.” He is answering the call, but the girl thinks he is refusing her ice cream.

5.2–8.0 sec — Extreme close-up of the girl’s face. Her smile disappears. Her lower lip trembles, eyebrows rise into a sad inverted-V, big green eyes fill with huge glossy tears. One large tear rolls down her freckled cheek, then another. She looks devastated and adorable.

8.0–10.5 sec — Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the father. He suddenly stops. His basket swings and settles. He lowers the phone from his ear and slowly turns over his left shoulder. His stern expression softens as he notices her crying.

10.5–11.5 sec — Hold on the father’s face as he completely melts emotionally. His brow relaxes, eyes soften, mouth loosens into a tender look of surrender.

11.5–15.0 sec — Final front wide payoff. The father now pushes a huge metal shopping cart absurdly overloaded with dozens of ice cream cones: cream, pink, mint soft-serve swirls, waffle cones stacked into a wobbling mountain. The girl walks beside him beaming, laughing, arms raised in victory, taking happy bouncy

zh.p:
垂直9分16秒，15秒，高端皮克斯/迪士尼风格的3D超市动画喜剧场景。温暖光泽的电影感，柔和的琥珀色超市灯光，冷淡的青绿色冷冻灯光，反光抛光地板，逼真的面料、头发、玻璃和冰淇淋质地。没有文字，没有字幕，没有标志，没有水印。

角色：
一位高大、留着胡须的父亲，肩膀宽阔，体格健壮，黑发灰色太阳穴，浓密的黑胡须，深藏青色西装外套，温暖的灰色高领毛衣，炭灰色长裤，黑色鞋子，银色手表。他步伐沉重自信，右耳贴着手机，左手提着一个蓝色购物篮。
一个红发的小女儿，铜色卷发分成两侧，绿色大眼睛，雀斑，泡泡糖粉色裙子，小粉色单肩包，粉色鞋子。她步伐轻快弹跳，表情丰富且可爱。

场景：
现代超市货架，直立的玻璃门冷冻柜散发着凉爽的水绿色光芒，玻璃上有水汽，背景中模糊的货架，抛光的反光地板。

时间与镜头：

0.0–1.0秒——从光滑的地板下低空开场。镜头从父亲的黑色鞋子和倒影上移，越过他的裤子、蓝色篮子、藏青色西装外套和银色手表，落在他那张严肃的胡须脸上。他一边走一边打电话。

1.0–2.5秒——侧角宽角镜头。父亲走过冷冻柜的过道。他的小女儿跟在后面，被他和高大的冷冻柜比得显得渺小。她的头发随着快速的步伐弹跳。

2.5–4.0秒——女孩停在冰箱门前，伸手打开，冷雾和青绿色光芒溢出。她开心地拿起一个华夫冰淇淋甜筒，双手捧着。冷冻柜门在她身后关上。

4.0–5.2秒 — 前中速射击。父亲走向摄像头，仍在打电话。女孩小跑着走到他身边，手里拿着冰淇淋，满怀希望地抬头望着他。父亲坚定地对着电话说：“不。”他接了电话，但女孩以为他拒绝给她吃冰淇淋。

5.2–8.0秒 — 女孩面部极近特写。她的笑容消失了。她的下唇颤抖，眉毛高高扬成悲伤的倒V字，大大的绿眼睛里涌出巨大的泪水。一滴大泪水顺着她满是雀斑的脸颊滑落，接着又一滴。她看起来既心碎又可爱。

8.0–10.5秒 — 从父亲身后过肩射门。他突然停下了。他的篮子摇摆着，沉稳下来。他把手机从耳边放下，慢慢转过左肩。他严肃的表情在看到她哭泣时柔和下来。

10.5–11.5秒——看着父亲的脸，他情绪彻底融化。他的眉头放松，眼神柔和，嘴角松开，露出温柔的投降神情。

11.5–15.0秒——最终前方宽向回报。父亲现在推着一辆巨大的金属购物车，里面装满了数十个冰淇淋：奶油色、粉色、薄荷软冰淇淋漩涡、华夫饼筒堆成一座摇摇欲坠的山。女孩走在他身旁，笑得灿烂，笑着，双臂高举，欢快地跳跃着

银杏叶飘落，湿青石地面有反光。人物五官、发型、服饰、配饰、

0-2秒：微微低头垂眸，目光落在折扇上，嘴角噙含蓄淡笑。

〔轻声·气声〕"这长廊的风，又起了。"

最终归于安静凝视，定格在温柔清冷、略带忧郁。

〔最后一句气声·渐弱〕"……只盼你，安好。"

情绪克制不外放，似自语呢喃，全程贴合面部口型。

固定中近景，极缓慢推近（轻微 push-in），始终对准面部与眼神；

黄昏金色侧逆光，暖调柔和；银杏/花瓣随微风自然飘落，

固定中近景，极缓慢推近（轻微 push-in），始终对准面部与眼神；

黄昏金色侧逆光，暖调柔和；银杏/花瓣随微风自然飘落，

制作一支高端饮品广告，主角是Mah，一位25岁的西部女性，拥有及肩金色海滩波浪发、蓝绿色眼睛、自然雀斑、光泽皮肤，身穿鲜艳橙色Fanta篮球球衣，白色牛仔短裤，白色厚底运动鞋，金色圈形耳环和橙色友谊手链。明亮的夏日氛围，优质广告，鲜艳的橙色调，电影般的摄影，超现实的生活方式叙事。

视频开场，玛娜一开始就自信地对着镜头微笑，脸旁握着一罐冰凉的芬达。她调皮地转动着手中的罐头，夏日阳光下水珠闪闪发光。她对着镜头眨眼，说：“让我们让今天难忘！”“特写，芬达罐头在明亮蓝天下。细小的水滴在阳光反射下闪闪发光，映照在橙色铝质上。Mah打开罐头，发出清脆的气泡声。慢动作微距镜头捕捉到橙色气泡在她长长地喝一口清爽时涌上来。随着她享受这杯酒，笑容愈发灿烂。

她自信地走过色彩斑斓的市中心街道，街道上布满壁画、棕榈树、咖啡馆和充满夏日活力的氛围。动态的跟踪镜头跟随她，微风吹拂她的发丝。场景切换到一个热闹的夜市，橙色灯笼、串灯、音乐和美食摊位闪耀着光芒。玛娜一边拿着芬达，一边自然地在人群中跳舞，和周围的人一起笑着。

她来到一个时髦的户外小吃摊，朋友们兴奋地迎接她。他们拥抱、欢笑，一起点街头小吃。冰镇芬达罐自然地摆放在桌上，大家尽情享受这一刻。音乐渐起，玛在阳光明媚的广场里，便携音响旁跳舞。朋友们迅速加入，创造即兴而充满活力的舞蹈。手持和万向节镜头捕捉了真实的笑声和欢快的动作。

当夕阳西下时，大家一起奔向一座城市喷泉。他们在水中慢动作溅起水花，笑声不断。水珠在金色阳光下闪烁，玛举起她的芬达罐，脸上带着灿烂的笑容对准镜头。

最后的电影英雄镜头：玛站在喷泉前，周围是她的朋友们。她把冰冷的芬达蛋糕递向观众，笑着说，

玛：“这就是芬达的乐趣！”镜头缓缓拉远，展现出充满活力的夏日氛围、灿烂的夕阳、喷泉的水花声和朋友们一起庆祝。高级饮料广告、超逼真的商业摄影、动态摄像机运动、浅景深、逼真的水体物理、鲜艳的橙色和柑橘色调、欢快的叙事、4K HDR、高端品牌宣传画质、16：9宽屏、无文字叠加、无字幕。

raw_p:
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
Reference Image: @image1
アスペクト比：1:1
長さ：15秒
画風：@image1 に準拠
音声：効果音のみ。BGM、歌、セリフ、字幕なし

@image1 を唯一のビジュアルアンカーとして使用し、人物、衣装、巨大広告、作業台、補助広告、夕方の都市構造と画風を維持する。
完成済みの都市広告世界を舞台に、広告背景のペイントだけが生命を持って高速で舞い踊る。巨大広告内の人物は平面的な静止広告のまま維持し、現実空間の本人も作業台で自然に立ち、スプレー缶を下げて持つだけにする。
主役は一本の線ではなく、厚みと面積を持つ2〜3本の幅広い液体ペイントと、複数の短い筆跡。最大時には画面の4分の1〜半分を占める大胆な色面となり、液体シート、太い筆跡、扇状の面、巨大な円弧、回転する渦へ連続変形する。細い糸、ひも、コード、ワイヤー状にはしない。

[SHOT / FLOW]
0.0〜1.3秒｜即時始動
巨大広告背景の超接写. 厚いオレンジ、ネイビー、補助色のペイントが0.3秒以内に隆起し、広告面を複数方向へ爆発的に走り出す。
静かな脈動を長く見せず、カメラはペイント表面すれすれを高速滑走する。

1.3〜4.0秒｜巨大ペイント放出
2〜3本の幅広い液体ペイントと大きな色彩シートが広告面から立体的に飛び出す。
カメラは一本の後方を追い続けず、幅広いペイントの下をくぐり、二つの色面の間を突破し、横から追い越し、前景を横切る巨大な筆跡の直後に急降下する。
ペイントは画面手前と遠景を大胆に横断し、強い奥行きと速度感を作る。

4.0〜7.4秒｜低空都市ラッシュ
カメラはビルの谷間から大通り上空へ急降下し、街灯や車の少し上を高速で駆け抜ける。
幅広いペイントが左右へ激しく切り返し、左側の補助広告、ビル間空間、右奥の補助広告を順番にかすめる。
ペイントが通過した広告面では、大きなブラシストローク、色彩、光沢が瞬時に強まり、完成済み広告が再描画・再点火されたように鮮やかになる。都市の窓と街路照明も進行方向へ連鎖的に点灯する。
この区間では主役ビルへ戻らない。

7.4〜10.4秒｜垂直急上昇と渦突破
巨大なペイントシートが高層ビル壁面を、重力に逆らって一気に駆け上がる。
カメラは壁面すれすれを高速で垂直上昇し、ビル上部で約90度バンクして角を鋭く回り込む。
回り込んだ先で、オレンジ、ネイビー、補助色の幅広いペイントが、ビル間いっぱいに広がる巨大な立体渦を形成する。
カメラは減速せず、渦の外側を眺めるだけにせず、渦の中心へ正面から突入して完全に突破する。
この壁面急上昇、ビル角回り込み、巨大渦の中心突破は必須イベント。10.4秒以前に主役ビルや作業台へ戻らない。

10.4〜12.8秒｜大合流と都市再点火
渦を突破した直後、都市を巡った複数のペイントが主役ビル前方へ高速集結する。
幅広い色面が巨大な扇状に開き、立体交差し、大きな円弧を描きながらメイン広告へ収束する。
最後の大胆な筆跡がメイン広告背景を横切り、@image1の完成デザインへ鮮明に整う。同時に補助広告、ビルの窓、店舗照明、街路灯が奥から手前へ連鎖して華やかさを増す。
作業台の本人は一瞬だけ明確に見せる。本人は自然に立ったまま色彩を視線で追い、髪と衣装だけが風圧で揺れる。

12.8〜15.0秒｜高速上昇、全景、余韻
カメラは最後のペイントの上昇軌道に乗って急上昇し、そのまま高速で引く。
巨大メイン広告、作業台の本人、左右の補助広告、右奥へ続く大通り、点灯した夕方の都市全体を一画面に収める。
13.8秒以降は速度を落とし、幅広いペイントが広告背景へ静かに定着する。微細な顔料粒子と大きな色の残響だけを空中に残し、完成全景を約1秒保持して終了する。

[CAMERA / EDITING]
世界名所巡り型の立体的な移動感を、同じ都市街区の中で行う。

必須カメラ順序：
超接写滑走
→ 色面の間を突破
→ 低空急降下
→ 大通り高速ラッシュ
→ 壁面垂直急上昇
→ 90度バンクの回り込み
→ 巨大渦の中心突破
→ 高速集結
→ 上昇して全景へ引く

同じ距離、角度、速度の追跡を1.5秒以上続けない。一本のペイントを後方から長く追うだけのショットは禁止。
カメラはペイントに導かれるが、常に同じ後方位置へ固定しない。下、横、前方、渦の内側、壁面すれすれへ視点を切り替える。
流れる接続を維持しつつ、速度、方向、高度、被写体との距離を連続的に変化させる。

[SOUND]
効果音のみ。
厚い絵の具が隆起する低い流体音、重量感のあるwhoosh、色面の間を突破する風切り音、低空ラッシュ、壁面急上昇、渦内部の回転音、渦突破時の強い衝撃音、都市照明が連鎖点灯する微細な電子音、最後の顔料粒子のきらめきを使用する。

zh.t: 霓虹都市 paint 觉醒
zh.p:
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
Reference Image: @image1
アスペクト比：1:1
長さ：15秒
画風：@image1 に準拠
音声：効果音のみ。BGM、歌、セリフ、字幕なし

@image1 を唯一のビジュアルアンカーとして使用し、人物、衣装、巨大広告、作業台、補助広告、夕方の都市構造と画風を維持する。
完成済みの都市広告世界を舞台に、広告背景のペイントだけが生命を持って高速で舞い踊る。巨大広告内の人物は平面的な静止広告のまま維持し、現実空間の本人も作業台で自然に立ち、スプレー缶を下げて持つだけにする。
主役は一本の線ではなく、厚みと面積を持つ2〜3本の幅広い液体ペイントと、複数の短い筆跡。最大時には画面の4分の1〜半分を占める大胆な色面となり、液体シート、太い筆跡、扇状の面、巨大な円弧、回転する渦へ連続変形する。細い糸、ひも、コード、ワイヤー状にはしない。

[SHOT / FLOW]
0.0〜1.3秒｜即時始動
巨大広告背景の超接写. 厚いオレンジ、ネイビー、補助色のペイントが0.3秒以内に隆起し、広告面を複数方向へ爆発的に走り出す。
静かな脈動を長く見せず、カメラはペイント表面すれすれを高速滑走する。

1.3〜4.0秒｜巨大ペイント放出
2〜3本の幅広い液体ペイントと大きな色彩シートが広告面から立体的に飛び出す。
カメラは一本の後方を追い続けず、幅広いペイントの下をくぐり、二つの色面の間を突破し、横から追い越し、前景を横切る巨大な筆跡の直後に急降下する。
ペイントは画面手前と遠景を大胆に横断し、強い奥行きと速度感を作る。

4.0〜7.4秒｜低空都市ラッシュ
カメラはビルの谷間から大通り上空へ急降下し、街灯や車の少し上を高速で駆け抜ける。
幅広いペイントが左右へ激しく切り返し、左側の補助広告、ビル間空間、右奥の補助広告を順番にかすめる。
ペイントが通過した広告面では、大きなブラシストローク、色彩、光沢が瞬時に強まり、完成済み広告が再描画・再点火されたように鮮やかになる。都市の窓と街路照明も進行方向へ連鎖的に点灯する。
この区間では主役ビルへ戻らない。

7.4〜10.4秒｜垂直急上昇と渦突破
巨大なペイントシートが高層ビル壁面を、重力に逆らって一気に駆け上がる。
カメラは壁面すれすれを高速で垂直上昇し、ビル上部で約90度バンクして角を鋭く回り込む。
回り込んだ先で、オレンジ、ネイビー、補助色の幅広いペイントが、ビル間いっぱいに広がる巨大な立体渦を形成する。
カメラは減速せず、渦の外側を眺めるだけにせず、渦の中心へ正面から突入して完全に突破する。
この壁面急上昇、ビル角回り込み、巨大渦の中心突破は必須イベント。10.4秒以前に主役ビルや作業台へ戻らない。

10.4〜12.8秒｜大合流と都市再点火
渦を突破した直後、都市を巡った複数のペイントが主役ビル前方へ高速集結する。
幅広い色面が巨大な扇状に開き、立体交差し、大きな円弧を描きながらメイン広告へ収束する。
最後の大胆な筆跡がメイン広告背景を横切り、@image1の完成デザインへ鮮明に整う。同時に補助広告、ビルの窓、店舗照明、街路灯が奥から手前へ連鎖して華やかさを増す。
作業台の本人は一瞬だけ明確に見せる。本人は自然に立ったまま色彩を視線で追い、髪と衣装だけが風圧で揺れる。

12.8〜15.0秒｜高速上昇、全景、余韻
カメラは最後のペイントの上昇軌道に乗って急上昇し、そのまま高速で引く。
巨大メイン広告、作業台の本人、左右の補助広告、右奥へ続く大通り、点灯した夕方の都市全体を一画面に収める。
13.8秒以降は速度を落とし、幅広いペイントが広告背景へ静かに定着する。微細な顔料粒子と大きな色の残響だけを空中に残し、完成全景を約1秒保持して終了する。

[CAMERA / EDITING]
世界名所巡り型の立体的な移動感を、同じ都市街区の中で行う。

必須カメラ順序：
超接写滑走
→ 色面の間を突破
→ 低空急降下
→ 大通り高速ラッシュ
→ 壁面垂直急上昇
→ 90度バンクの回り込み
→ 巨大渦の中心突破
→ 高速集結
→ 上昇して全景へ引く

同じ距離、角度、速度の追跡を1.5秒以上続けない。一本のペイントを後方から長く追うだけのショットは禁止。
カメラはペイントに導かれるが、常に同じ後方位置へ固定しない。下、横、前方、渦の内側、壁面すれすれへ視点を切り替える。
流れる接続を維持しつつ、速度、方向、高度、被写体との距離を連続的に変化させる。

[SOUND]
効果音のみ。
厚い絵の具が隆起する低い流体音、重量感のあるwhoosh、色面の間を突破する風切り音、低空ラッシュ、壁面急上昇、渦内部の回転音、渦突破時の強い衝撃音、都市照明が連鎖点灯する微細な電子音、最後の顔料粒子のきらめきを使用する。

en.p:
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
Reference Image: @image1
Aspect ratio: 1:1
Length: 15 seconds
Art style: Based on @image1
Audio: Sound effects only. No BGM, vocals, dialogue, or subtitles

@image1 is used as the sole visual anchor, maintaining characters, costumes, giant advertisements, workbenches, supplementary ads, and the urban structure and style of evening.
Set in a completed urban advertising world, only the paint in the advertising background comes alive and dances at high speed. The person inside the giant advertisement remains as a flat static advertisement, and the person in the real space naturally stands on the workbench, holding the spray can by hanging it down.
The main focus is not a single line, but two to three broad liquid paints with thickness and area, along with several short strokes. At its maximum, it becomes a bold color field occupying one-quarter to half of the canvas, continuously transforming into a liquid sheet, thick brushstrokes, fan-shaped surfaces, huge arcs, and rotating vortices. Do not use thin threads, strings, cords, or wires.

[SHOT / FLOW]
0.0–1.3 seconds | Instant start
Extreme close-up of a huge advertising background. Thick orange, navy, and auxiliary paint rises within 0.3 seconds, explosively running across the ad in multiple directions.
Without showing a long quiet pulse, the camera glides rapidly just above the painted surface.

1.3–4.0 seconds | Massive paint release
Two to three broad liquid paints and large color sheets protrude three-dimensionally from the advertising surface.
The camera does not follow a single line behind it; it slips beneath a wide range of paint, breaks between two color planes, overtakes from the side, and then plunges sharply after a massive brushstroke crossing the foreground.
The paint boldly crosses the front and distant scenes, creating a strong sense of depth and speed.

4.0–7.4 seconds | Low-altitude city rush
The camera dives from the valley between buildings to above the main avenue, speeding just above streetlights and cars.
The wide paint arcs violently left and right, grazing the left side of the supplementary advertisement, the space between buildings, and the right back side in sequence.
On the advertising surfaces where the paint passes, large brushstrokes, color, and gloss instantly intensify, making the finished ad vivid as if it has been redrawn or re-lit. City windows and street lighting also turn on in a chain reaction in the direction of travel.
In this section, the main building does not return.

7.4–10.4 seconds | Vertical steep climb and vortex breakthrough
A huge paint sheet shot up the walls of high-rise buildings, defying gravity.
The camera rapidly climbs vertically just above the wall, banked about 90 degrees at the top of the building, and sharply circles around the corner.
At the edge of the circle, a wide range of paints in orange, navy, and auxiliary colors form a massive three-dimensional vortex that spreads across the building.
The camera does not slow down or just look outside the vortex; it charges head-on into the center and completely breaks through.
This wall surge around the building's corners and the breakthrough of the center of the giant vortex are essential events. It does not return to the main building or workbench before 10.4 seconds.

10.4–12.8 seconds | Great merge and city rekindled
Immediately after breaking through the vortex, multiple paints orbiting the city rapidly gather in front of the main building.
The wide color fields open into a giant fan shape, intersecting in three dimensions, and converge on the main advertisement in a large arc.
The final bold handwriting crosses the main advertising background, sharply completing the @image1's finished design. At the same time, supplementary advertisements, building windows, store lighting, and streetlights chain from the back to the front, adding to the glamour.
The person at the workbench shows it clearly for a moment. She naturally stands while following the colors with her gaze, while only her hair and costume sway in the wind.

12.8–15.0 sec | High-speed ascent, panoramic views, lingering aftertaste
The camera climbs rapidly on the final paint trajectory and then pulls at high speed.
It captures a huge main advertisement, the workbench himself, the side auxiliary ads, the main street leading to the right back, and the entire city lit up in the evening all on one screen.
After 13.8 seconds, the speed slows down and a wide range of paint quietly settles into the advertising background. Only fine pigment particles and large color echoes remain in the air, holding the completed full view for about one second before ending.

[CAMERA / EDITING]
Experience a three-dimensional sense of movement through a world famous landmark within the same urban district.

Required camera order:
Over-reach write-slide
→ Break through between color planes
→ Low-altitude plunge
→ Main Avenue highway rush
→ Vertical steep wall rise
→ Loop around the 90-degree bank
→ Breakthrough at the center of a giant vortex
→ High-speed assembly
→ Rise and pull to the full view

Do not continue tracking the same distance, angle, or speed for more than 1.5 seconds. Shots that simply follow a single paint from behind are prohibited.
The camera is guided by the paint, but it doesn't always stay fixed in the same rear position. Shift your perspective to down, sideways, forward, inside the vortex, and just past the wall.
While maintaining a flowing connection, it continuously changes speed, direction, altitude, and distance to the subject.

[SOUND]
Only sound effects.
It employs low fluid sounds of thick paint rising, heavy whoosh sounds, wind noise breaking through color planes, low-altitude rushes, sudden wall climbs, rotational sounds inside vortices, strong impact sounds when vortex breakthroughs, faint electronic sounds triggered by city lighting in chains, and the final sparkle of pigment particles.

raw_p: 15 second cinematic emotional modern-day scene, set clearly in 2026. A woman in her 30s sits alone at night in a contemporary city apartment. Modern sofa, clean minimalist interior, large window with city lights outside, smartphone on the coffee table, soft LED lamp, framed digital photo of her late husband, modern clothing, no vintage objects. She wears casual present-day clothes, a simple sweater and jeans. She holds her wedding ring and looks at a recent phone video of her husband smiling. The mood is intimate, emotional, peaceful, not horror. Start with a close-up of her hand touching the wedding ring beside the glowing smartphone screen. Cut to her face, tears in her eyes, lit by the phone and soft city light. The apartment is quiet, modern, realistic. A faint warm light appears in the reflection of the window. Her husband appears as a gentle transparent presence made of soft golden light, wearing modern clothes, calm and loving. He is not a ghost horror figure, he is a peaceful spiritual presence. Camera moves slowly behind her, revealing him standing near her reflection in the glass. She feels him and turns. He raises his hand. She raises hers. Their hands almost touch, separated by a thin glowing veil of light. A soft warm pulse fills the apartment, moving through the modern room and city reflections. For one brief moment, she smiles through tears, feeling comfort instead of loneliness. Final shot: he fades gently into golden particles reflected in the window while her phone screen shows their happy video paused. She holds the ring to her heart. Modern day only, contemporary apartment, current clothing, city night, smartphone, LED lighting, no candles, no old mansion, no antique furniture, no historical clothing, no 18th century, no Victorian style, no gothic style, no horror, no text.

Setting: Busy Moroccan souk at golden hour. Terracotta walls, hanging lanterns, spice stalls, bread vendors, copper goods, warm amber sunlight. Joyful, chaotic, heartwarming energy. Arri Alexa 35 look, shallow depth of field, dynamic handheld camera, ultra-fast cuts.

CUT 1 (0:00–0:01.5)

An elderly tea-shop owner casually rolls a football down a cobblestone alley from outside his shop.

CUT 2 (0:01.5–0:03)

A young athletic man rounds a corner, spots the ball, and runs onto it.

CUT 3 (0:03–0:04.5)

He strikes the ball cleanly down the market alley.

CUT 4 (0:04.5–0:06)

The ball crashes into a spice merchant's display, sending colorful spice clouds into the air.

CUT 5 (0:06–0:07.5)

A butcher casually flicks the bouncing ball upward with his forearm without stopping work.

CUT 6 (0:07.5–0:09)

A teenage girl on a bicycle redirects the ball with the back of her hand while riding through a narrow gap.

CUT 7 (0:09–0:10.5)

An elderly woman lowers her bread basket, plants her cane, and calmly prepares for the incoming ball. Market sounds fade.

CUT 8 (0:10.5–0:12.5)

She strikes the ball powerfully. Slow-motion tracking follows it flying through golden light.

CUT 9 (0:12.5–0:14)

The ball smashes into a giant pyramid of clay tagine pots, triggering a spectacular collapse.

CUT 10 (0:14–0:15)

The elderly woman picks up her basket, turns away, and walks off as the stunned young man watches.

Audio: Authentic market ambience, playful rhythmic music building with each pass, near silence before the final kick, triumphant finish during the clay collapse, ending on a single warm note.

CUT 1 (0:00–0:01.5)

An elderly tea-shop owner casually rolls a football down a cobblestone alley from outside his shop.

CUT 2 (0:01.5–0:03)

A young athletic man rounds a corner, spots the ball, and runs onto it.

CUT 3 (0:03–0:04.5)

He strikes the ball cleanly down the market alley.

CUT 4 (0:04.5–0:06)

The ball crashes into a spice merchant's display, sending colorful spice clouds into the air.

CUT 5 (0:06–0:07.5)

A butcher casually flicks the bouncing ball upward with his forearm without stopping work.

CUT 6 (0:07.5–0:09)

A teenage girl on a bicycle redirects the ball with the back of her hand while riding through a narrow gap.

CUT 7 (0:09–0:10.5)

An elderly woman lowers her bread basket, plants her cane, and calmly prepares for the incoming ball. Market sounds fade.

CUT 8 (0:10.5–0:12.5)

She strikes the ball powerfully. Slow-motion tracking follows it flying through golden light.

CUT 9 (0:12.5–0:14)

The ball smashes into a giant pyramid of clay tagine pots, triggering a spectacular collapse.

CUT 10 (0:14–0:15)

The elderly woman picks up her basket, turns away, and walks off as the stunned young man watches.

Audio: Authentic market ambience, playful rhythmic music building with each pass, near silence before the final kick, triumphant finish during the clay collapse, ending on a single warm note.

raw_p:
Cold green horror color palette. Woman in reference overly terrified, shaking, heavily sweating and cornered in elevator crying. Nun-like figure hold her from throat below chin.
As the lights flicker, woman skin gradually changes color. Pale gray skin becomes sickly yellow. Yellow slowly turns dark green and decayed. Veins become visible beneath the skin. Her eyes sink deeper into their sockets.
Strands of hair begin falling away from her head. More hair drops to the floor with each flicker of light. Her face rapidly deteriorates. Skin tightens over bone. Cheeks collapse inward. Nose decays away. The face transforms into a skeletal corpse-like skull. Cracks spread across the skull. Fine dust begins escaping from the fractures. The entire body slowly breaks apart into drifting gray powder and ash.
The soul (white cloud) disperses into the air and inhale by nun-like figure completely, leaving only belongings of woman at elevator door border that stops door from getting close. Cinematic supernatural horror, realistic decay transformation, unsettling atmosphere, slow terrifying progression, highly detailed, realistic lighting, psychological horror film style.

zh.p:
冷绿色恐怖色彩调。女性则是极度恐惧、颤抖、汗流浃背、被困在电梯里哭泣的女性。像修女般的身影从下巴以下的喉咙夹住她。
随着灯光闪烁，女性的皮肤逐渐变色。苍白的灰色皮肤变成病态的黄色。黄色慢慢变成深绿色并腐朽。皮肤下会出现静脉。她的眼睛更深地陷进眼眶。
头发开始从她头顶滑落。每一次光线闪烁，更多的头发掉落在地上。她的脸迅速恶化。皮肤紧贴骨头。脸颊向内塌陷。鼻子会腐烂。脸部会变成骷髅尸体状的骷髅。头骨上出现裂痕。细微的尘埃开始从裂缝中逸出。整个身体缓缓破碎，化为漂浮的灰色粉末和灰烬。
灵魂（白云）散开到空气中，被修女般的身影完全吸入，只留下电梯门口的女人的物品，阻止门靠近。电影般的超自然恐怖，逼真的腐朽变形，令人不安的氛围，缓慢恐怖的推进，高度细致、逼真的灯光，心理恐怖片风格。

10-second cinematic sci-fi action sequence, 16:9, ultra-realistic, impossible scale, vibrant visuals, realistic motion, no dialogue.
A pilot flies through a massive rotating orbital habitat.
A transparent reservoir the size of an ocean circles overhead.
Suddenly the habitat rotation fails.
Artificial gravity collapses.
The ocean breaks free.
A wall of water kilometers high begins moving through the habitat interior.
Buildings are ripped away.
Vehicles tumble through the flood.
The pilot accelerates through streets becoming rivers.
The water gains ground.
The wave fills the entire background.
The aircraft races toward a maintenance tunnel.
The ocean crashes into the city behind him.
Cut.

raw_p:
Create an intense cinematic disaster-science scene at a remote volcanic observatory during twilight. A field researcher climbs a metal platform above glowing lava rivers while the mountain trembles beneath them.

0–4s: Ultra-wide establishing shot. The observatory stands on black volcanic rock, orange lava veins glowing below, ash drifting through purple twilight. Camera performs a slow crane up.

4–9s: Medium tracking shot as the researcher moves across a shaking metal walkway, one hand gripping the rail, heat distortion warping the background. Sparks and ash pass through the foreground.

9–13s: Macro close-up of seismic equipment rattling on a metal table, needles jumping, red warning lights reflecting in protective goggles. Fast rack focus to the researcher turning toward the crater.

13–15s: Hero wide shot. The crater emits a huge vertical column of glowing ash and light while the researcher stands braced against the wind.

Style: cinematic natural-disaster realism, orange-black color contrast, anamorphic lens, heat shimmer, ash particles, practical red lights, dramatic rim lighting, grounded physics, clean audio with metal creaks, lava rumble, wind, and distant rock movement.

zh.p:
在暮光时分，在偏远火山观测站拍摄一场紧张的灾难科学电影场景。一名野外研究员攀爬着金属平台，平台位于发光的熔岩河流上方，山体在他们脚下颤抖。

0–4：超广角建立镜头。天文台建在黑色火山岩上，橙色熔岩脉在下方闪烁，灰烬在紫色暮光中飘散。摄像机缓慢起重。

4–9秒：中等跟踪镜头，研究员一手紧握栏杆，背景因热变形而穿行于摇晃的金属走道上。火花和灰烬穿过前景。

9-13：地震设备在金属桌上晃动的微距特写，针头跳动，红色警示灯在防护护目镜中反射。快速对焦转向陨石坑的研究人员。

13–15秒：英雄宽角镜头。陨石坑喷出巨大的垂直火山灰柱和光柱，研究人员站立抵御风。

风格：电影般的自然灾害现实主义，橙黑色对比，变形镜头，热闪烁，灰烬粒子，实用红光，戏剧性的边缘光，接地物理，干净的音频伴有金属吱吱声，熔岩隆隆声，风声和远处岩石运动。

Style: photoreal live-action, filmed on a spectator's handheld smartphone from a huge daytime crowd at an open-air theater (matching @Image1) — raised phones in the foreground, distant city; bright sun-drenched daytime; realistic, weighty, effective fantasy combat with GRAND black-energy VFX; stylized magic, no blood, no gore.
CAMERA: a FIXED camera position, NO zoom, NO push-in, NO dolly — only small pans and tilts to keep the fight in frame; stay wide, no face close-ups.
@Image2 = the hero archer with his giant obsidian bow; he teleports in bursts of black dust-energy to deliberate flanking positions, aiming his arrows purposefully.
@Image3 = the giant rival, about twice the hero's height, who actively FIGHTS BACK throughout — charging and hurling ripped-up stones.
ONE continuous shot, no cuts, FIXED camera, minimal pan/tilt only:
0-4s: the giant rips a slab of stone from the ground and HURLS it at the archer; the archer teleports in black dust to dodge, lands at a flanking spot to the giant's LEFT and looses an arrow that opens a swirling BLACK HOLE right there beside the giant — a deliberate mark.
4-8s: the giant tears up another stone and throws again, then swings a heavy arm; the archer teleports to dodge and repositions to the giant's RIGHT, loosing another arrow that opens a second black hole deliberately beside him — a real back-and-forth exchange.
8-11s: the giant charges and swings hard; the archer teleports behind him and looses a big obsidian arrow that strikes the GIANT square in the chest and stays embedded there, glowing.
11-15s: the two flanking black holes ignite and PULL the giant from both sides at once; he is dragged apart into great streams of black dust shot through with swirling dark-blue energy and sucked into the vortexes; the holes collapse and vanish; the crowd erupts.
Audio: roaring crowd; stone tearing and heavy thrown-rock impacts, teleport dust whooshes, taut bow draws and sharp arrow releases, vortex hums as black holes open, a heavy thunk as the arrow embeds, a building gravitational roar then a suck-and-collapse boom, scattering dust, crowd erupts on the final frame.
Preserve: ONE continuous shot, no cuts; FIXED camera, pan/tilt only, NO zoom, stay wide, no face close-ups; the hero (@Image2) with obsidian bow, the giant (@Image3) ~2x height actively fighting back with stone throws; purposeful black-hole placement beside the giant; photoreal live-action; black dust-energy, obsidian arrows, swirling black holes, dark-blue energy within the black dust; distant huge stage, crowd and city from @Image1; foreground spectators with raised phones; stylized fantasy, no blood or gore; no on-screen text.

zh.t: 黑洞弓箭手对决巨石巨人
zh.p:
风格：写实的实景拍摄，拍摄于白天露天剧场观众手持智能手机（对应@Image1）——前景中举起手机，远景城市;阳光明媚的白天;真实、厚重、有效的奇幻战斗，配以宏大的黑能量视觉特效;风格化的魔法，没有血腥，没有血腥。
摄像机：固定位置，无变焦、无推入、无推轨——仅有小幅平移和倾斜以保持战斗画面;保持宽阔，不要特写面部。
@Image2 = 拥有巨型黑曜石弓的英雄弓箭手;他以黑色尘埃能量瞬移到有意识的侧翼位置，箭矢瞄准。
@Image3 = 巨人对手，身高约是英雄的两倍，始终积极反击——冲锋并投掷撕裂的石块。
一个连续镜头，无剪辑，固定摄像机，仅最小幅度平移/倾斜：
0-4：巨人从地上撕下一块石板并投掷向弓箭手;弓箭手在黑尘中瞬移躲避，落在巨人左侧的侧翼位置，射出一支箭，在巨人旁边打开一个旋转的黑洞——这是刻意的标记。
4-8：巨人撕下一块石头再投掷一次，然后挥出重手;弓箭手瞬移到闪避位置，重新站到巨人的右侧，射出另一支箭，故意在他身旁打开第二个黑洞——一场真正的你来我往的交锋。
8-11：巨人冲锋并猛烈挥击;弓箭手瞬移到他身后，射出一支巨大的黑曜石箭，箭矢射中巨型方块的胸膛，并一直嵌入其中发光。
11-15：两侧黑洞同时点燃并从两侧拉扯巨星;他被拖入巨大的黑色尘埃流中，喷射着旋转的深蓝色能量，并被吸入漩涡;洞口坍塌消失;人群爆发出欢呼声。
音频：欢呼的人群;石块撕裂和重石撞击，传送尘埃呼啸，弓弦拉紧，箭矢锐利释放，漩涡嗡鸣，黑洞打开，箭矢嵌入时发出沉重的撞击声，重力咆哮渐起，随后是吸附坍塌的爆炸声，扬起尘埃，最后一幕人群爆发。
保存：连续一张，无剪辑;固定摄像机，仅平移/倾斜，无变焦，保持广角，无面部特写;英雄（@Image2）持黑曜弓，巨人（@Image3）~2倍身高，积极用石头反击;有目的地将黑洞放置在巨人旁边;写实真人;黑色尘埃能量，黑曜石箭矢，旋转的黑洞，黑尘中的深蓝色能量;远处巨大的舞台、人群和城市@Image1;前景观众举起电话;风格化的奇幻，没有血腥和血腥;屏幕上没有文字。

4-8s: the giant tears up another stone and throws again, then swings a heavy arm; the archer teleports to dodge and repositions to the giant's RIGHT, loosing another arrow that opens a second black hole deliberately beside him — a real back-and-forth exchange.
8-11s: the giant charges and swings hard; the archer teleports behind him and looses a big obsidian arrow that strikes the GIANT square in the chest and stays embedded there, glowing.
11-15s: the two flanking black holes ignite and PULL the giant from both sides at once; he is dragged apart into great streams of black dust shot through with swirling dark-blue energy and sucked into the vortexes; the holes collapse and vanish; the crowd erupts.
Audio: roaring crowd; stone tearing and heavy thrown-rock impacts, teleport dust whooshes, taut bow draws and sharp arrow releases, vortex hums as black holes open, a heavy thunk as the arrow embeds, a building gravitational roar then a suck-and-collapse boom, scattering dust, crowd erupts on the final frame.

raw_p:
A cinematic 10-second botanical timelapse video showing the 
complete life cycle of a squash/pumpkin plant from seed 
germination to first fruit set. NO humans, NO hands. 
Pure plant and nature footage only. Smooth seamless 
transitions between each growth interval.

SHOT BREAKDOWN (each ~1.5-2 seconds):

[0:00-0:01.5] — GERMINATION (Interval 1)
Extreme ground-level macro shot: Dark moist soil filling 
the frame, a single seed slowly cracking apart, 
tiny pale green shoot curling and pushing upward through 
the soil in timelapse motion, soil particles shifting, 
warm earthy brown tones, shallow depth of field

[0:01.5-0:03] — SEEDLING EMERGENCE (Interval 2)
Slow pull-back from close-up: Two small oval cotyledon 
leaves unfurling open from a closed position, 
fresh bright green, stem straightening upright, 
small white pot on clean surface, 
soft white studio light from above

[0:03-0:04.5] — LEAF DEVELOPMENT (Interval 3)
Gentle upward tilt shot: Plant growing taller in 
accelerated timelapse, true leaves sprouting and 
expanding outward one by one, stems thickening, 
vivid green foliage filling frame, 
clean grey background, smooth camera rise

[0:04.5-0:06] — BUD FORMATION (Interval 4)
Slow push-in macro: A tightly closed flower bud 
emerging from between large textured green leaves, 
bud slowly elongating and swelling, fuzzy green 
sepals visible, warm diffused light, 
bokeh leaf background, anticipation building

[0:06-0:08] — BLOOM (Interval 5)
Hero beauty shot: The yellow flower bud slowly 
blooming open in timelapse, petals peeling back 
one by one, revealing vibrant golden yellow interior, 
full open bloom held for a moment, 
soft natural light catching petal texture, 
slight slow-motion effect at peak bloom

[0:08-0:10] — FRUIT SET REVEAL (Interval 6)
Slow pull-back reveal shot: Camera starts tight 
on open yellow flower then slowly pulls back to 
reveal a small green fruit swelling at the base, 
flower and developing fruit in frame together, 
lush green leaves surrounding, 
cinematic final freeze-frame or slow fade to black

STYLE SPECS:
- Aspect ratio: 16:9 widescreen cinematic
- Color grade: Natural greens enhanced, 
  warm golden highlights on flower,
  rich dark soil tones, clean grey backgrounds,
  slightly boosted saturation for botanical beauty
- Camera motion: Ultra-smooth slow push-ins, 
  gentle tilts, no handheld shake
- Transitions: Organic dissolve cuts, 
  matching green-to-green color transitions
- Lighting: Soft diffused natural window light, 
  single overhead key light for studio panels
- Speed: Mix of real-time and timelapse — 
  timelapse for growth stages, 
  slow-motion for bloom opening moment
- NO humans, NO hands, NO faces at any point
- Sound suggestion: Ambient nature sounds — 
  gentle wind, soft nature ambience

zh.p:
一段电影般的10秒植物延时视频，展示了
南瓜/南瓜植株从种子开始的完整生命周期
从发芽到第一批果实。没有人类，没有手。
纯植物和自然影像。顺滑无缝
每个生长间隔之间的过渡。

快照分解（每秒~1.5-2秒）：

[0：00-0：01.5] — 萌芽（第1段）
极端地面微距照片：深色潮湿土壤填充
框架，一颗缓缓裂开的种子，
细小的淡绿色嫩芽卷曲向上伸展
土壤在延时运动中，土壤颗粒移动，
温暖的土棕色调，浅景深

[0：01.5-0：03] — 幼苗出苗（第二区间）
从特写缓慢拉回：两个小椭圆形子叶
叶子从闭合的位置展开，
新鲜明亮的绿色，茎部挺直，
干净的表面上放着一个小白盆，
柔和的白色工作室灯光从上方投射

[0：03-0：04.5] — 叶片发育（第三场）
轻柔向上倾斜的镜头：植物在
加速延时、真叶萌芽
一根根向外扩展，茎干变得粗大，
鲜艳的绿色植被填充框架，
干净的灰色背景，平滑的镜头上升

[0：04.5-0：06] — 芽形成（第四段）
缓慢推入宏观：紧闭的花苞
从大而有纹理的绿色叶子间冒出，
花苞缓缓拉长并膨胀，呈现出模糊的绿色
萼片可见，温暖的散射光，
散景叶背景，期待感的积累

[0：06-0：08] — BLOOM（第五幕）
英雄美妆照：黄色花蕾慢慢绽放
在延时摄影中绽放，花瓣剥落
一块接一块，露出鲜艳的金黄色内部，
盛开的花朵停留片刻，
柔和的自然光映照着花瓣的质地，
峰值光晕时略有慢动作效果

[0：08-0：10] — 水果集揭晓（第6幕）
缓慢拉回揭示镜头：镜头开始拉近
在开放的黄色花朵上，然后慢慢拉回去
露出一个小小的绿色果实，底部膨胀，
花朵和发育中的果实一起在框架中，
郁郁葱葱的绿叶环绕着，
电影感十足的最终定格画面或缓慢淡入黑

风格参数：
- 画面比例：16：9宽银幕电影
- 色级：自然绿色增强，
  花朵上的温暖金色光泽，
  浓郁的深色土壤，干净的灰色背景，
  植物美感的饱和度略有提升
- 摄像机运动：超平滑缓慢推入，
  轻轻倾斜，没有手持摇晃
- 过渡：有机溶解切割，
  匹配绿色到绿色的颜色过渡
- 照明：柔和的散射自然窗光，
  单顶顶灯用于演播室面板
- 速度：实时与延时摄影的混合——
  生长阶段的延时摄影，
  布鲁姆开场的慢动作
- 没有人类，没有手，没有任何面孔
- 声音暗示：环境自然声——
  温柔的风，柔和的自然氛围

raw_p:
镜头结构: 7个镜头, 15秒, 竖屏9:16。写实真人实拍 — 图生视频。

参考图:

@Image1 = 主角球员／进球者 — 每个镜头都保持他的脸、浅棕色后梳头发、白皙肤色和淡淡胡茬完全一致。忽略照片里的灰色T恤; 他穿下面描述的球队队服。

人物:

主角球员的队服(他的10名队友也穿同样队服): 黑色短袖球衣, 领口和袖口有白色内衬／滚边(露出白色), 红色球裤带黑色侧插片, 红色球袜带黑色滚边, 深色球鞋。11名对手全部穿白蓝队服; 他们的门将穿绿色长袖球衣并戴手套。

场所: 夜晚的世界杯决赛。满座的环形看台, 冷白色泛光灯照明。深绿色草皮, 湿润的草地, 上方飘着细雾, 下方有清晰的鞋钉印。

音乐: 低沉、快速的电子鼓点 and 低频体育场贝斯, 像心跳一样。

风格: 写实真人实拍画面 — 看起来像真实比赛的电视转播画面, 不是动画。真实的皮肤带毛孔、汗光和因用力而泛红的脸; 真实的布料会起皱、贴身并随动作飘动; 真实的草叶、草坑、水花和泥点; 快速摇镜时有真实的运动模糊, 近景有浅景深, 自然的泛光灯色彩。真实物理 — 动量、重量、平衡, 真实的球旋转和球网形变。不要动漫、不要卡通、不要赛璐璐着色、不要插画或数字绘画; 不要平涂色块、不要塑料感的游戏CG、不要光滑的广告渲染。

镜头1 0:00-0:02: 中近景, 28mm, 接近草地高度, 侧视角 / 他(见@Image1)带球冲进白蓝防线。他的右脚连续绕球两圈做踩单车假动作。他放低外侧肩膀; 第一名后卫跟上。他用右脚外脚背轻推, 然后用内脚背回扣。球从后卫伸出的脚旁滚过; 他压低身体, 从另一侧带球过人。鞋钉扎入湿草地, 溅起水珠。远处两队都保持完整阵型, 或回防或前压

镜头2 0:02-0:04: 脚部特写加全身中景, 50mm, 正面视角 / 第二名后卫蹲低铲球, 一条腿伸出。他用右脚尖把球挑起。球越过那条腿, 升到接近膝盖高度。他收起双腿越过后卫。左脚先落地; 右脚外脚背控住下落的球并向前送出。后卫在湿草地上滑出, 扬起雾气

镜头3 0:04-0:06: 侧面中近景, 35mm, 两人都可见 / 第三名后卫从右前方逼近。他用左脚停球并把球拖到身后。他的右肩转向后卫, 以支撑脚为轴转身。他的右脚底接球, 然后把球推到后卫身后。他结束时面向球门并继续奔跑。后卫继续前冲, 然后交叉脚步, 身体倾斜

镜头4 0:06-0:08: 全身广角, 32mm, 后侧视角 / 他追上球进入禁区, 用右脚内侧把球横拨避开追防者, 然后左脚迈到球外侧。其他后卫从两侧包夹。队友从中路和远侧插入。绿衣门将出击离开球门线。他看向球门, 收短步幅, 让球从右脚外侧滚出

镜头5 0:08-0:10: 侧面中远景, 65mm, 球员和球门都可见 / 他左脚踩在球旁, 胸和髋朝向远角, 右腿后摆。门将向左移动,压低身体, 开始扑救。在触球前, 他收回髋部, 用右脚外脚背擦过球的右下方。球被挑起, 旋转着飞向球门

镜头6 0:10-0:13: 门将视角, 18mm, 平视高度 / 球从禁区深处飞来, 黑白拼块旋转着在画面中越来越大。门将向左扑出, 双手从下往上伸。在小禁区附近, 球向右上方拐弯, 越过手套指尖和脸。他回头看着球继续飞向右上死角

镜头7 0:13-0:15: 球门内侧广角, 24mm, 草皮和球门区域都可见 / 球击中右上死角。球网向后绷起; 网结抖动回弹, 溅起水珠和草屑。门将落在对侧的湿草地上。两队仍各有11名球员。禁区内和后场的白蓝球员转身看向球门。队友从不同位置向前奔跑。射门后他直立站着, 安静地注视。全场观众一同起身; 欢呼声充满整个体育场。最后一帧: 球网仍绷紧, 球仍在旋转, 球员在远处。

注: 所有镜头按竖屏9:16构图(画面更高, 动作居中)。每个镜头的焦段、机位高度和视角都严格按上面所写保持不变。全程保持11对11全员在场; @Image1的脸在每个镜头中保持一致。

镜头4 0:06-0:08: 全身广角, 32mm, 后侧视角 / 他追上球进入禁区, 用右脚内侧把球横拨避开追防者, 然后左脚迈到球外侧。其他后卫从两侧包夹。队友从中路和远侧插入。绿衣门将出击离开球门线。他看向球门, 收短步幅, 让球从右脚外侧滚出

镜头5 0:08-0:10: 侧面中远景, 65mm, 球员和球门都可见 / 他左脚踩在球旁, 胸和髋朝向远角, 右腿后摆。门将向左移动,压低身体, 开始扑救。在触球前, 他收回髋部, 用右脚外脚背擦过球的右下方。球被挑起, 旋转着飞向球门

镜头6 0:10-0:13: 门将视角, 18mm, 平视高度 / 球从禁区深处飞来, 黑白拼块旋转着在画面中越来越大。门将向左扑出, 双手从下往上伸。在小禁区附近, 球向右上方拐弯, 越过手套指尖和脸。他回头看着球继续飞向右上死角

镜头7 0:13-0:15: 球门内侧广角, 24mm, 草皮和球门区域都可见 / 球击中右上死角。球网向后绷起; 网结抖动回弹, 溅起水珠和草屑。门将落在对侧的湿草地上。两队仍各有11名球员。禁区内和后场的白蓝球员转身看向球门。队友从不同位置向前奔跑。射门后他直立站着, 安静地注视。全场观众一同起身; 欢呼声充满整个体育场。最后一帧: 球网仍绷紧, 球仍在旋转, 球员在远处。

注: 所有镜头按竖屏9:16构图(画面更高, 动作居中)。每个镜头的焦段、机位高度和视角都严格按上面所写保持不变。全程保持11对11全员在场; @Image1的脸在每个镜头中保持一致。

en.p:
Lens structure: 7 lenses, 15 seconds, vertical 9:16. Realistic live-action shooting — image-to-video.

Reference image:

@Image1 = Main player/goal scorer — Every shot perfectly matches his face, light brown back-combed hair, fair skin, and a slight stubble. Ignore the gray T-shirt in the photo; He wears the team jersey described below.

People:

The main player's team uniform (his 10 teammates also wear the same uniform): black short-sleeved jersey with white lining/piping on the collar and cuffs (showing white), red shorts with black side clips, red socks with black piping, and dark sneakers. All 11 opponents wore white and blue jerseys; Their goalkeeper will wear a green long-sleeved jersey and gloves.

Venue: World Cup finals at night. A full circular stand illuminated by cool white floodlights. Deep green grass, moist grass, fine mist drifting above, clear shoe spike prints below.

Music: Deep, fast electronic drums and low-frequency stadium bass, like a heartbeat.

Style: Realistic live-action footage — looks like a live match TV broadcast, not animation. Real skin with pores, sweat glow, and a face flushed from exertion; Real fabric wrinkles, clings tightly, and flutters with movement; Real grass leaves, grass pits, splashes, and mud spots; When panning the mirror quickly, there is realistic motion blur; in close-ups, there is a shallow depth of field, and natural floodlight colors. Real physics — momentum, weight, balance, real ball spin, and net deformation. No anime, no cartoons, no cel coloring, no illustrations or digital drawings; No flat color blocks, no plastic-looking game CG, no smooth ad rendering.

Lens 1 0:00-0:02: Medium close-up, 28mm, close to grass height, side view / He (see @Image1) dribbles into the white-blue defensive line. His right foot circled the ball twice in a row, making a bicycle-pedaling feint. He lowers his outer shoulders; The first defender followed. He uses the right foot on the outside foot to gently push, then uses the inside foot to rebound. The ball rolled past the defender's extended foot; He lowered his body and dribbled past opponents from the other side. Shoe spikes pierce the wet grass, splashing water droplets. Both teams at a distance maintained a complete formation, either defending back or pressing forward

Shot 2 0:02-0:04: Close-up of feet with full-body medium shot, 50mm, front view / Second defender squats low to scoop the ball, one leg extended. He lifted the ball with his right toe. The ball crosses that leg and rises to nearly knee height. He tucked his legs over the defender. Left foot lands first; He controlled the falling ball with the outside foot of his right foot and sent it forward. The defenders slid out on the wet grass, raising mist

Shot 3 0:04-0:06: Side mid-close, 35mm, both visible / third defender approaching from the right front. He controlled the ball with his left foot and dragged it behind him. His right shoulder turned toward the defender, spinning around with his supporting foot as the axis. He received the ball with his right foot and pushed it behind the defender. He finished facing the goal and kept running. The defender continued to charge forward, then crossed his feet, leaning his body

Shot 4 0:06-0:08: Full-body wide-angle, 32mm, rear view / He chases the ball into the penalty area, uses the inside of his right foot to deflect the ball sideways to avoid defenders, then steps his left foot to the outside of the ball. Other defenders double-teamed from both sides. Teammates make runs from the middle and far sides. The green-clothed goalkeeper rushed out and left the goal line. He looked toward the goal, shortened his stride, and let the ball roll out from the outside of his right foot

Shot 5 0:08-0:10: Mid-long side view, 65mm, visible to both the player and the goalkeeper / His left foot is on the side of the ball, chest and hips facing the far corner, right leg swinging back. The goalkeeper moved left, lowered his body, and began the save. Before touching the ball, he pulled his hips back and brushed the ball with the outside of his right foot over the lower right side of the ball. The ball was lifted and spun toward the goal

Shot 6 0:10-0:13: Goalkeeper's perspective, 18mm, head-up height / The ball flies in from deep inside the penalty area, black and white blocks spinning and growing larger in the frame. The goalkeeper lunges to the left, his hands stretching from below to upward. Near the small penalty area, the ball curves upward to the right, passing the glove fingertips and face. He looked back and watched the ball fly toward the upper right corner of the dead corner

Shot 7 0:13-0:15: Wide angle inside the goal, 24mm, visible on both the grass and goal area / the ball hits the upper right dead corner. The net is stretched backward; The net knot shakes and bounces back, splashing water droplets and grass debris. The goalkeeper landed on the wet grass on the opposite side. Each team still has 11 players. The white-and-blue players inside the box and at the back turned to look at the goal. Teammates run forward from different positions. After the shot, he stood upright, quietly watching. The entire audience stood up together; Cheers filled the entire stadium. Final frame: The net is still taut, the ball is still spinning, and the player is far away.

Note: All shots are composed vertically in a 9:16 format (higher frame, center movement). The focal length, camera height, and angle of view for each lens are strictly maintained as described above. Maintain an 11-on-11 team presence throughout; @Image1's face remains consistent in every shot.

Multiple ultra-close-up beauty shots reveal plumper, shinier, healthier-looking lips. Slow-motion gloss movement, hydration effects, and luxury skincare-commercial aesthetics.

Final sequence shows the lip tint displayed among pink crystal gemstones on a reflective pink platform. The model appears beside the product, smiling confidently while the camera slowly circles around them.

Final hero shot: the lip tint stands centered among sparkling crystals while soft pink particles float through the air.

打造一支高端奢华美妆广告，打造光泽粉色唇彩。Vertical 9：16格式，干净的白色工作室背景，柔和的粉色美学，电影般的美妆灯光，超写实的产品摄影，高端化妆品广告。

视频开场，一位惊艳的美模在第一秒内立刻出现，她下巴靠在交叉的手臂上，旁边是一块巨大的透明粉色水晶。她直视镜头，皮肤发光，嘴唇光滑，立刻吸引所有人的目光。

水晶内，一层奢华的粉色唇彩像宝石一样被定格。一只修剪整齐的手握着一把金属美锤缓缓进入画面，敲击水晶。水晶在戏剧性的慢动作中爆发出闪烁的粉色碎片。

唇彩从破碎的水晶中浮现出来，周围环绕着漂浮的宝石、水滴和闪烁的倒影。电影般的微距镜头展现了奢华包装的每一个细节。产品开始漂浮在洁白的背景上。盖子旋转打开。一滴丝滑的粉色唇彩缓缓形成并向下拉伸，动作令人着迷。

切换到模特手持唇彩贴脸的优雅美妆照。柔和的灯光突出无瑕的肌肤、光泽的脸颊和自然美。

涂妆前极度特写嘴唇。涂抹器顺滑地涂抹在唇上，留下光泽保湿的妆效。丰富的倒影在唇面上跳跃。

多张超特写美妆照展现出丰满、光泽、健康的双唇。慢动作的唇彩运动、保湿效果和奢华护肤商业美学。

最后一幕展示了唇彩与粉色水晶宝石之间，置于反光粉色平台上。模特出现在产品旁边，自信地微笑着，镜头缓缓环绕着他们。

最后的英雄镜头：唇彩正中央，闪烁的水晶点缀着，柔和的粉色颗粒在空气中飘荡。

屏幕文字：“补水。闪耀。自信。\“你的嘴唇值得奢华。”

raw_p:
敵は生命体ではなく、黒曜石と金属で造られた無人の魔導兵。黒い多面体装甲、角のような突起、青く輝く魔力核を持つ。内部も石材、歯車、青い光だけで構成されている。

魔導兵は道路、車両周辺、左右の路地、壁面、高架上へ不規則に点在する。大きさ、向き、距離、姿勢を少しずつ変え、等間隔や左右対称に配置しない。それぞれ異なる速度とタイミングで、走る、跳躍する、蛇行する、壁を移動する、立ち止まって照準を合わせる。

Shot 1（0–4秒）：
雨の交差点。リラは画面左手前、魔導兵は画面右の中景から遠景へ自然に散らばっている。カメラは水たまりの反射を横切りながらリラへ接近し、その横を通過して、都市の各所で別々に起動する魔導兵を見せる。青い魔力核が不規則な順番で点灯する。

Shot 2（4–10秒）：
リラが水しぶきを弾いて加速。低い横移動で並走するカメラ。リラの刀が魔導兵の装甲を通過すると、斬撃線に沿って黒曜石の外殻へ青い亀裂が走る。次の瞬間、魔導兵は大小の幾何学的な石片と金属部品へ砕け、内部の青い魔力が光の粒となって上空へ消える。

リラは突進型の脚部を砕き、蛇行型を横薙ぎで粉砕。車上から跳ぶ二体の間を前転で抜け、立ち上がりながら青白い斬撃を放つ。壁面から降下する個体を空中回転斬りで破壊する。砕けた黒曜石片が路面を滑り、雨水を跳ね上げる。

Shot 3（10–15秒）：

en.p:
The enemy is not a living being, but an unmanned mage made of obsidian and metal. It has black polyhedral armor, horn-like protrusions, and a blue shining magic core. The interior is composed only of stone, gears, and blue light.

Mages are scattered irregularly along roads, around vehicles, in alleys on both sides, walls, and on elevated tracks. Gradually change the size, orientation, distance, and posture, and do not arrange them evenly spaced or symmetrically on either side. Each player runs at different speeds and timings: run, leap, weave, move along walls, and stop to aim.

Shot 1 (0–4 seconds):
Rain intersection. Lilas are naturally scattered in the front left of the screen, while mages are naturally scattered from the middle to the far right of the screen. The camera approaches Lila, passing by the reflections of puddles, then passes by to show mages activating separately throughout the city. The blue magic cores light up in an irregular order.

Shot 2 (4–10 seconds):
Lila deflects the splash and accelerates. A camera that runs parallel with low lateral movement. As Lira's sword passed through the mage's armor, blue cracks ran along the slash line onto the obsidian shell. In the next instant, the mage soldiers shattered into geometric stone fragments and metal parts of various sizes, and the blue magic within transformed into particles of light that vanished into the sky.

Lira crushes the charging legs and the serpentine form with a horizontal sweep. He slipped forward between two people jumping from the car, stood up, and unleashed a pale slash. Destroys individuals descending from walls with an aerial spinning slash. Shattered obsidian fragments slide across the road, splashing rainwater.

Shot 3 (10–15 seconds):
A large number of mages were closing in right in front of Lila. The three in the front row raised their arms within sword reach, the medium individual closed in from left and right, and the large one in the distance was also charging. Always shows Lila and an enemy approaching on the same screen.

Lila lowered her unsheathed sword in her right hand. A pale blue light focused on the blade. Just before the three front-row figures launched their attacks, Lila rotated her hips and unleashed a massive fan-shaped slashing wave 180 degrees horizontally.

From the side, a wide composition simultaneously shows the lira, sword, the mage in front of you, and the slashing wave. The slashing wave advanced from the front row to the back, carving a blue crack into the mage's obsidian armor. A beat later, they shatter in a chain reaction from nearby individuals to distant ones. Hundreds of obsidian fragments, metal fragments, and blue light particles cover the rain intersection and reflect onto the neon road surface.

When the last large individual collapsed into a massive stone fragment, the blue magic core quietly went out. Only Lila stands at the crossroads, lowering her sword and exhaling. Shattered obsidian fragments are battered by the rain, and the white dress slowly quiets down.

Important:
The enemy consisted of unmanned stone and metal structures. When destroying, only obsidian fragments, metal parts, and blue light particles are drawn. It does not depict soft physical expressions or organic internal structures.

The final massive slash is unleashed the moment multiple mages approach Lila's eyes and begin their attack. Do not use slashes after enemies disappear or toward empty roads.

Continuing this image, the characters, costumes, lighting, and depth of field are 100% consistent, naturally growing dynamic from the first frame.

Characters · Expressions · Actions — As the wind rises, strands of hair, wide sleeves, hanging beaded strings, and ginkgo leaves flutter in the air, with the ground gently reflected. Her eyelashes trembled lightly, her gaze slowly withdrew from the distant mountains, her lips parted slightly, revealing a trace of melancholy; Following the lines, the left hand gently lifts Bai Mei to her chest and lowers her head to sniff, then looks up at the sunset, while her right hand slowly closes the folding fan. His breath was visible, his chest rising and falling gently, and his eyes shimmering with moisture.

Dialogue (Ancient-style · about 10 seconds, slow and light)—

"Another year of flowers falling...... (A soft sigh) He said he would come back, but the entire corridor is golden, and I'm almost waiting until my hair turns white. "

CAMERA — From the very first frame of composition, the camera slowly zooms in (medium → medium close-up) with slight lateral shift, capturing the wind and hair as she glances back; The final section slightly rises over falling ginkgo leaves, with light spots flowing. The camera work is smooth and smooth like a movie, with no shaking.

CONSTRAINTS — 4K Ultra HD, 24fps, 21:9. Normal speed, no slow motion or deformation. 30秒垂直短劇，16:9，電影感，電影級光影，高級古風霸總，唯美悲劇張力，超現實質感。 場景： 古代恢弘宮殿與庭院，月光冷冽，燭火搖曳，煙霧繚繞，最後轉至月宮清冷廣寒殿。 角色： 后羿：英俊霸道的神射手，高大威猛，連身獸皮紅袍，氣場強勢壓迫。 嫦娥：絕美柔弱女子，白衣飄逸，眼神充滿恐懼與壓抑。 吳剛：月宮外英俊勇猛男子，身穿深色勁裝，衣袖半挽，展現強壯手臂與胸膛肌肉線條，手持巨斧砍桂樹。 風格： 電影級打光，淺景深，冷月光與暖燭光強烈對比，高級古典中國攝影質感，電影色彩分級，極致細節，悲傷粒子光效與強烈情感張力。

第一段（0-15秒）： 0-2s：旁白低沉有力：「他，就是射下九個太陽的后羿。」（蒙太奇快速剪輯：后羿拉弓射日，一個個太陽被射落，天地瞬間變暗，地上百姓跪地驚呼歡呼，史詩級震撼畫面，后羿狂笑） 2-4s：恢弘宮殿夜景，后羿高大身影緩緩走進大殿，氣勢逼人。 4-7s：畫面切回宮殿裡的床邊，嫦娥害怕地後退，后羿大步逼近。 7-10s：后羿一把用力扣住她纖細手腕，霸道低吼：「嫦娥，從今以後妳只能留在宮裡！」 10-12s：嫦娥驚恐掙扎，眼含淚光：「你別這樣，快放開我……」 12-15s：后羿冷笑將她緊緊困在懷中，強勢宣告：「老婆，我們一起修仙，長生不老！」

 第二段（15-30秒）： 15-17s：深夜，嫦娥獨自在宮殿內的窗邊徘徊，神情痛苦壓抑，抬頭望著月亮，自語：「神啊，我真的受夠了……」 17-19s：她意外發現桌上丹爐裡隱藏的長生不老藥，眼神從恐懼變為決絕，自語：「這就是...長生不老之藥?」 19-21s：嫦娥深吸一口氣，一口吞下仙藥，身體瞬間發出耀眼光芒。 21-23s：嫦娥白衣如雲衝出窗外，飛向夜空，痛苦自語：「對不起后羿……我先走了。」 23-26s：后羿猛然衝進殿內暴怒，拿起神弓連射數箭。 26-28s：后羿氣急敗壞咆哮：「嫦娥！妳竟敢背叛我！給我回來！！」 28-30s：箭矢擦過嫦娥身邊全部落空，她越飛越高，淚水在風中飛散。

30-second vertical short drama, 16:9, cinematic feel, cinematic lighting, high-end ancient-style CEO, beautiful tragic tension, surreal texture. Scene: Ancient grand palaces and courtyards, moonlight cold and cold, candlelight flickering, smoke swirling around, finally turning to the Moon Palace, the cool Guanghan Hall. Character: Hou Yi: A handsome and domineering sharpshooter, tall and imposing, dressed in a red robe with animal skin, exuding a powerful and oppressive aura. Chang'e: A stunningly beautiful and delicate woman, dressed in flowing white, her eyes filled with fear and restraint. Wu Gang: A handsome and brave man outside the Moon Palace, dressed in dark tight clothing with half-rolled sleeves, showing off his strong arms and chest muscles, wielding a giant axe to chop down osmanthus trees. Style: Cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, strong contrast between cold moonlight and warm candlelight, high-end classical Chinese cinematic texture, cinematic color grading, extreme detail, sad particle lighting effects, and intense emotional tension.

First paragraph (0-15 seconds): 0-2s: The narrator is deep and powerful: "He is Hou Yi, who shot down nine suns." (Montage quick edit: Hou Yi draws his bow and shoots at the sun, each sun is shot down, the world instantly darkens, the people kneel and cheer in shock—an epic and shocking scene, Hou Yi laughs wildly) 2-4s: Magnificent palace night scene, Hou Yi's tall figure slowly enters the grand hall, his presence overwhelming. 4-7s: The scene cuts back to the bedside in the palace. Chang'e retreats in fear, and Hou Yi strides closer. 7-10s: Hou Yi grabbed her slender wrist tightly and growled domineeringly: "Chang'e, from now on you can only stay in the palace!" 10-12s: Chang'e struggles in terror, tears in her eyes: "Don't do this, let go of me...... 12-15s: Hou Yi sneered, trapping her tightly in his arms and forcefully declared, "Honey, let's cultivate immortality together and live forever!"

Second paragraph (15-30 seconds): 15-17s: Late at night, Chang'e wanders alone by the palace window, her expression pained and suppressed, looking up at the moon and murmuring, "God, I've really had enough......" 17-19s: She accidentally discovers a hidden elixir of immortality in the alchemy furnace on the table. Her gaze shifts from fear to resolute as she mutters to herself: "This is..." The elixir of immortality?" 19-21s: Chang'e takes a deep breath and swallows the elixir in one gulp, her body instantly radiating dazzling light. 21-23s: Chang'e, dressed in white like clouds, rushes out the window, flies into the night sky, and murmurs in pain: 'I'm sorry, Hou Yi...... I'm leaving now." 23-26s: Hou Yi suddenly bursts into the hall, furious, grabs his divine bow, and fires several arrows in succession. 26-28s: Hou Yi roared in anger: "Chang'e! How dare you betray me! Come back!!" 28-30s: Arrows grazed Chang'e's side and missed all of them; she flew higher and higher, tears scattering in the wind.

Cinematic high-octane action sequence: A futuristic protagonist in sleek black tactical gear performs intense urban parkour across a modern city at dusk — leaping between rooftops, sliding down rails, wall-running, and jumping across gaps with fluid, athletic motion.

Suddenly, during a daring run across a massive suspension bridge, the bridge begins exploding dramatically behind him/her — massive fireballs, flying debris, structural collapse, sparks and smoke filling the air. In the chaos, the character triggers a high-tech biometric mecha transformation.

Biometric armor deploys in real-time: metallic plates, glowing energy lines, and heavy mechanical segments rapidly snap, unfold, and lock onto the body mid-sprint and mid-jump. The suit assembles seamlessly from limbs to torso to helmet with satisfying mechanical sounds and glowing effects. The transformation enhances power — the character leaps even farther, lands with superhuman impact, and continues the high-speed escape as the bridge fully collapses.

Dynamic camera work: fast tracking shots following the runner from behind and side angles, dramatic low-angle hero shots during transformation, orbiting camera during jumps, quick cuts on explosions. Intense slow-motion on key moments (armor snapping into place, massive leaps, debris impacts).

Style: Hyper-realistic, Hollywood blockbuster action (like Transformers meets Mirror's Edge or John Wick), cinematic lighting with golden hour/dusk tones turning to fiery oranges and dramatic shadows, volumetric smoke, particle effects, high detail on metal textures, reflections, and fabric-to-armor transition. Perfect physics, momentum, and temporal consistency. 8-12 seconds, high motion coherence.

zh.p:
电影级高能动作场面：一位身穿黑色战术装备的未来主角，在黄昏时分在现代城市中进行激烈的都市跑酷——在屋顶间跳跃、滑下铁轨、墙壁奔跑，并以流畅且富有运动感的动作跨越空隙。

突然，在一次大胆的悬索桥上奔跑时，桥在他/她身后剧烈爆炸——巨大的火球、飞散的碎片、结构坍塌、火花和烟雾弥漫空中。混乱中，角色触发了高科技生物识别机甲变形。

生物识别装甲实时展开：金属板、发光的能量线和沉重的机械部件在冲刺和跳跃中迅速展开并锁定身体。战衣无缝组装，从四肢到躯干再到头盔，伴随着令人满意的机械声和发光效果。变身增强了力量——角色跳得更远，落地以超人般的冲击力，并在桥梁完全坍塌时继续高速逃脱。

动态摄影：快速跟踪跑者背后和侧面镜头，变形时的低角度英雄镜头，跳跃时环绕镜头旋转，爆炸镜头快速剪辑。关键时刻的紧张慢动作（装甲卡住、巨大跳跃、碎片撞击）。

风格：超写实，好莱坞大片动作（类似《变形金刚》遇上《镜之边缘》或《疾速追杀》），电影般的灯光，黄金时刻/黄昏色调转为火红橙色和戏剧性阴影，体积烟雾，粒子特效，金属纹理、反射和布料到盔甲的过渡细节丰富。完美的物理、动量和时间一致性。8-12秒，高速运动相干性。

Ultra-realistic cinematic live-action, inspired by Inception. Shot on Arri Alexa Mini, 50mm lens. Natural 8 AM sunlight, shallow depth of field, organic film texture, subtle lens dispersion, photorealistic.

Character Consistency: Use the reference image as the exact protagonist. Maintain identical facial features, hairstyle, beard, body proportions, brown oversized T-shirt, black cargo pants, silver chain, and sunglasses throughout. No coffee cup.

[0:00–0:03]
The protagonist walks confidently through a busy city sidewalk. Pigeons fly in the background. He smirks and snaps his fingers.

[0:03–0:06]
A brilliant white shockwave bursts from his hand. Time freezes instantly. Pedestrians stop mid-motion, pigeons freeze mid-flight, dust and leaves hang motionless in the air. Silence.

[0:06–0:10]
Only the protagonist can move. Tracking shot as he walks through the frozen world. Light rays illuminate floating particles. He casually brushes a frozen pigeon.

[0:10–0:12]
He passes a woman in a yellow dress suspended in time. He glances at her and nods slightly.

[0:12–0:15]
He turns toward camera and snaps again. A reverse shockwave restores reality. People resume moving, pigeons scatter, city sounds return. Wide cinematic crane shot pulls away as he walks into the crowd.

Premium Hollywood VFX, realistic shockwaves, time-freeze effects, volumetric lighting, seamless transitions, natural motion blur, blockbuster quality, no AI artifacts.

他经过一位穿黄色裙子、仿佛被时间悬浮的女人。他看了她一眼，微微点头。

[0：12–0：15]
他转向镜头又拍了一张。反向冲击波恢复现实。人们重新行动，鸽子四散，城市的声音回归。宽广的电影式吊臂镜头拉远，他走进人群。

Create a cinematic sci-fi film sequence in a vast abandoned orbital megastructure above a blue planet. A lone astronaut-explorer in a sleek graphite pressure suit walks slowly across a reflective obsidian floor, helmet visor glowing faintly with interface light.

0–4s: Establishing ultra-wide shot. The explorer appears tiny beneath enormous curved alien architecture, floating debris drifting outside panoramic windows, cold starlight cutting through volumetric haze. Camera performs a slow dolly forward with subtle tilt up.

4–9s: Medium tracking shot from behind as the explorer walks toward a dormant circular gate. Floor panels illuminate one by one beneath each step, soft mechanical pulses echo through the chamber. Reflections ripple across the suit, realistic gravity and weight.

9–13s: Close-up on the helmet visor. The explorer stops, raises one gloved hand, and the visor reflects a massive star map forming in the air. Slow push-in, shallow depth of field, cinematic lens breathing.

13–15s: Hero wide shot. The circular gate opens into a blinding white-blue horizon, silhouettes of impossible structures visible beyond it. The explorer stands centered, cape-like survival fabric moving gently in artificial wind.

Style: ultra-cinematic blockbuster sci-fi, anamorphic 35mm lens, deep blue and silver color palette, practical glowing panels, volumetric fog, high contrast rim lighting, realistic metallic textures, premium VFX realism, clean spatial audio with low mechanical hums, distant atmospheric rumbles, no music.

[Duration] 10 seconds
[Scene] Rocky cliff on a snow mountain at 4,500 meters elevation, thin snow covering a gray-white gravel slope, with a backdrop of continuous bluish-gray mountain ridges, overcast sky, snow particles whipping sideways in the wind
[00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Ambush (Telephoto Close-Up, 600mm)
Super telephoto close-up: A snow leopard crouches behind a rock, revealing only half its face and front paws. The wind tousles the fluffy gray-white long fur on either side of its cheeks, with ice crystals clinging to every hair tip. Its amber iris suddenly contracts its pupil—it has locked onto its prey. The front paws silently tense, the rough texture of the paw pads clearly visible.
[00:04-00:07] Shot 2: Burst (High-Speed Tracking, 240fps Super Slow-mo)
Side high-speed tracking shot: The snow leopard launches from behind the rock, limbs fully extended into a straight line, spine arched and coiled with power. In the instant its hind legs push off the rock face,碎stone and snow dust scatter in a fan shape. Super slow-motion captures: The tail arcs through the air like a thick rope to maintain balance, while the white long fur on its belly billows in the airflow.
[00:07-00:10] Shot 3: Strike (Extreme Close-Up, Macro Lens)
Extreme close-up: The instant the snow leopard's front paw slams the ground, its five toes splay open, curved black claws piercing the thin snow layer, sending fine ice crystal particles flying across the lens (shallow depth of field blur). Freeze-frame on the moment the claw tip sinks into the snow surface, revealing the cold light glinting off the curve of the claw hook.

The camera transitions use seamless speed ramps, aggressive snap-zooms, whip-pans, and continuous motion blur, creating a flawless flow between extreme close-ups and the master composition. Lighting is atmospheric, moody, and luxurious with deep contrasts.

Timeline and Visual Direction:
- 0:00 - 0:02 | Master Composition: Starts with a slow, tense cinematic camera drift forward into the full poster layout. The atmosphere is charged and epic.
- 0:02 - 0:05 | The Text Zoom: A sudden, violent whip-pan and ultra-fast snap zoom targets the text "SAMAN AI". Instantly, a futuristic electro-luminescent HUD graphic ignites around the letters, casting a sharp neon glow with subtle digital glitch particles bursting outwards.
- 0:05 - 0:08 | The Power Boot: A rapid camera rotation tracks down to an extreme close-up of the football cleat. On impact, a kinetic shockwave ripples across the surface, emitting golden sparks and heat distortion smoke to convey immense, explosive power.
- 0:08 - 0:11 | The Heroic Face: A seamless motion-blur vertical pan tracks up to a dramatic close-up of the face. A powerful key light sweeps across the facial features, while a high-end anamorphic lens flare dramatically catches the eye, emphasizing peak determination.
- 0:11 - 0:13 | The Shield Logo: The camera Tilts and punches in on the Portugal crest logo. A luxurious, liquid-gold metallic shimmer activates, reflecting a sweeping wave of chrome light across the textured embroidery of the badge.
- 0:13 - 0:15 | The Final Out-Zoom: A powerful, ultra-smooth and fast zoom-out pulls all the way back to the full master poster. All visual elements (neon text glow, gold particles) remain active, perfectly settling into a premium, color-graded cinematic final frame.

raw_p:
SUBJECT & CONSISTENCY: An ultra-dynamic anime cinematic big-wave surfing video featuring Kai Tempest. Preserve his exact face, piercing emerald-green eyes, messy windblown white hair with vivid aqua streaks, dark-blue and white technical rash guard with a glowing neon-blue seam pattern, black board-shorts with aqua utility straps, waterproof tech-wristband tracker, and a sleek carbon-fiber metallic blue surfboard with a sharp geometric shark-tooth logo. Keep perfect character consistency the whole time. Never change his outfit, hair, or face.
STYLE: Ultra-premium anime feature-film quality, high-energy sports-anime cinematography, aggressive dynamic action animation, realistic hydrodynamics and wave physics in anime style, dramatic back-lit ocean lighting, detailed water spray, foam, and mist simulation, lively expressive facial acting. Absolutely no slow motion at any point. Constant high speed and momentum.
SETTING: A colossal, churning tropical ocean during a storm, massive 50-foot turquoise walls of water, intense sun breaking through dark storm clouds creating dramatic light rays, heavy sea spray whipping through the air, vivid adrenaline-charged atmosphere.
FORMAT: One continuous single-take shot, no cuts, no transitions, no montage, one uninterrupted aggressive camera move.
HOOK (first 2 seconds): Open EXTREMELY close on Kai’s face mid-ride inside the barrel of a massive wave, looking straight into the lens with a fierce, ecstatic grin, ocean spray and aqua-streaked hair whipping violently across his face, eyes wide and bright with excitement. He shouts a defiant challenge toward the camera. Instant speed and energy from frame one.
CAMERA: The camera rips backward off his face, pulling out of the wave's barrel and whipping into a fast 360-degree orbit around his body as he carves down the massive wall of water. In one unbroken motion, it plunges low to the water's surface, tracking just inches above the churning foam, then rockets upward to look down at him from the crest. It chases tightly, snapping between front, side, and over-the-shoulder angles, always fast, always handheld-energetic, never static, never rising into slow drifting.
ACTION FLOW: Kai snaps from a bottom turn into a vertical climb up the towering wave face, accelerating hard, a massive sheet of water spraying off his board's tail. He reaches the lip and launches into a powerful, rotating air-reverse above the crest, body and board spinning sideways against the sky. He throws a cheeky, confident wink at the camera mid-air. Then, landing cleanly back onto the churning slope with a sudden heavy impact, he sticks the landing — his board digs deep into the water, driving him forward with a hard punchy motion (fast and forceful, NOT slow). The water explodes around him, his hair flips back, and the camera shakes violently with the force of the landing.
FINAL MOMENT: Now racing safely out into th

zh.p:
主题与一致性：一部超动态动感的动漫电影级大浪冲浪视频，主角是Kai Tempest。保留他的原貌，锐利的翡翠绿眼睛，凌乱的白发带着鲜艳的水蓝色条纹，深蓝白相间的技术防磨衣，带有发光霓虹蓝缝线图案的黑色冲浪短裤，防水技术腕带追踪器，以及一块带有锐利几何鲨鱼牙标志的光滑碳纤维金属蓝色冲浪板。始终保持角色的完美一致性。永远不要更换他的服装、发型或脸部。
风格：超高端动漫电影质量，充满活力的运动动漫摄影，激进的动态动作动画，逼真的动漫流体动力学和波浪物理，戏剧性的背光海洋光影，细致的水花喷雾、泡沫和雾气模拟，生动的面部表情。绝对没有慢动作。持续高速和动力。
场景：暴风雨中巨大的热带海洋，巨大的50英尺碧绿色水墙，强烈阳光穿透黑暗的暴风云，形成强烈的光线，浓重的海浪飞扬空中，充满肾上腺素的氛围。
格式：一镜到底，无剪辑，无过渡，无蒙太奇，一次不间断的激烈摄影机移动。
HOOK（前2秒）： 极近地打开镜头，聚焦在巨浪中骑行中的凯脸，直视镜头，露出狂喜的笑容，海浪和带着水绿色的头发猛烈地飞扬，眼睛睁得大大的，充满兴奋。他对着镜头大声喊出挑衅的语气。第一帧即时的速度和能量。
镜头：镜头从他脸上向后撕裂，从浪筒中拉出，旋转成快速360度绕着他身体旋转，他沿着巨大的水墙切割。它一气呵成地俯冲到水面，距离翻滚的泡沫仅几英寸，然后迅速向上，从山顶俯视着他。它紧紧追逐，在前方、侧面和肩膀上方的角度间切换，始终快速，始终手持能量，从不静止，从不缓慢漂移。
动作流：凯从底部转跃进入垂直攀爬，攀登高耸的浪面，猛力加速，滑板尾部喷出一大片水幕。他到达边缘，在顶峰上方施展强力旋转的空中反转，身体和滑板在天空中侧旋。他在半空中对着镜头调皮又自信地眨了眨眼。然后，他重重地落回翻滚的斜坡，稳稳着陆——滑板深深插入水中，用力猛烈的动作推动他向前冲（快速有力，绝非慢）。水在他周围爆炸，头发向后甩，镜头因着陆的力量剧烈晃动。
最后时刻：现在正安全飞驰进入

raw_p:
Ultra wide cinematic aerial shot in 4K during a beautiful winter morning over a vast frozen Arctic landscape covered with endless snow fields, towering icebergs and crystal-clear frozen lakes stretching to the horizon. The camera glides smoothly above the icy terrain, weaving between massive glaciers and reflecting the soft sunlight on the snow. Gentle winds blow sparkling snow particles through the air while seals rest on the ice and flocks of birds fly across the sky. Hyper realistic snow textures, realistic reflections, atmospheric depth, cinematic lighting, volumetric fog, smooth camera movement, perfect stabilization and breathtaking photorealistic visuals.

At exactly halfway through the video, strange glowing patterns suddenly begin appearing beneath the ice. The frozen lakes illuminate from below as enormous geometric shapes emerge across the landscape. Cracks spread through the ice and gigantic sections slowly separate and rise into the sky. The camera dives closer as entire glaciers transform into colossal floating structures revealing that the Arctic is actually a hidden futuristic megacity buried beneath the ice for thousands of years. Massive neon-lit towers emerge from below, glowing energy highways activate across the frozen landscape and giant floating rings begin rotating above the city. The camera accelerates through the awakening metropolis while countless lights ignite across the horizon. Realistic ice fragmentation, dynamic particle effects, volumetric lighting, futuristic energy streams, atmospheric fog, glowing reflections, cinematic lens flares, epic scale, ultra detailed textures, smooth motion, perfect stabilization, dramatic cinematic color grading and stunning 4K photorealistic visuals.

zh.p:
超宽片4K电影航拍，拍摄于一个美丽的冬日清晨，俯瞰广袤冰封的北极景观，覆盖着无尽的雪原、高耸的冰山和清澈的冰冻湖泊，直至地平线。摄像机平稳地滑过冰冷的地形，穿梭于巨大的冰川之间，柔和的阳光映照在雪地上。微风吹起闪耀的雪粒，海豹们停在冰面上，鸟群飞翔。超逼真的雪地纹理、逼真的反射、氛围深度、电影般的光影、体积雾气、流畅的摄像机运动、完美的防抖和令人屏息的写实画面。

视频正进行到一半时，冰下突然出现奇怪的发光图案。冰冻的湖泊从下方照亮，巨大的几何图形在景观中浮现。裂缝在冰层中蔓延，巨大的冰层缓缓分离并升入天空。镜头逐渐靠近，整座冰川变成巨大的漂浮结构，揭示北极实际上是一个隐藏的未来巨型城市，埋藏在冰层下数千年。巨大的霓虹灯塔从下方显现，发光的能量高速公路在冰封的地形上启动，巨大的漂浮环开始在城市上空旋转。镜头加速穿过觉醒的大都市，地平线上无数灯光点亮。逼真的冰层破碎、动态粒子特效、体积光影、未来能量流、大气雾气、发光反射、电影般的镜头光晕、史诗级的规模、超细致的纹理、平滑的运动、完美的防抖、戏剧性的电影色彩分级以及令人惊叹的4K照片级真实视觉效果。

9:16 vertical format.

The character performs an elite-level hip-hop dance performance with irresistible charisma, confidence, musicality, and effortless swagger.

Dance style: premium commercial hip-hop, urban choreography, deep groove, musicality-driven movement, powerful chest isolations, sharp shoulder hits, controlled body waves, dynamic footwork, clean transitions, strong rhythm control, elite professional dancer quality.

The performance feels natural, relaxed, stylish, and highly skilled. Never stiff. Never robotic. Continuous micro-groove throughout the performance. Natural breathing. Natural weight shifts. Authentic rhythm. Confident presence. The character commands attention from the very first frame.

VIDEO STRUCTURE
CUT 1 (0.0s–0.8s)
Cowboy shot. The character is already moving when the video begins. Subtle groove active. At the first musical accent: sharp chest isolation, immediate shoulder hit, quick neck snap. The movement feels unexpected, precise, and highly skilled. Strong confidence. No posing. No stopping.

CUT 2 (0.8s–3.5s)
Full-body shot. The dancer explodes into groove-driven choreography. Strong bounce. Powerful rhythm. Clean footwork. Dynamic weight transfer. Large movement quality. Camera smoothly follows movement.

CUT 3 (3.5s–5.5s)
Low-angle hero shot. Large body roll. Strong directional movement. Powerful silhouette. Natural clothing movement. The dancer dominates the frame.

CUT 4 (5.5s–7.5s)
Medium cowboy shot. Focus on groove quality. Chest isolations. Shoulder grooves. Body waves. Clean musicality. Camera subtly tracks movement. Every accent feels satisfying.

CUT 5 (7.5s–11.0s)
Full-body performance section. Most impressive choreography. Traveling steps. Direction changes. Complex groove combinations. Elite dancer energy. Maximum visual impact.

CUT 6 (11.0s–13.0s)
Slow-motion sequence. Controlled body roll. Fluid body wave. Beautiful movement quality. Premium dance-film aesthetic. Elegant momentum.

CUT 7 (13.0s–15.0s)
Cowboy shot. The dancer advances toward the camera while continuing choreography. Confident swagger. Natural groove. Camera slowly pushes forward. Final musical accent. Strong finishing pose. Iconic ending frame.

CAMERA STYLE
Viral social-media dance cinematography. Fast pacing. Strong visual hooks. Character always remains dominant in frame. Alternating cowboy shots and full-body shots. Smooth tracking shots. Dynamic push-ins. Low-angle hero shots. No face close-ups.

9：16 竖版格式。

这个角色表演着顶级的嘻哈舞蹈，展现出无法抗拒的魅力、自信、音乐感和轻松自信的气场。

舞蹈风格：高端商业嘻哈、都市编舞、深沉律动、音乐性驱动的动作、强有力的胸部孤立、锐利的肩击、受控的身体波浪、动态步伐、干净的过渡、强有力的节奏控制、精英职业舞者的水准。

表演自然、轻松、时尚且技艺娴熟。从不僵硬。从不机械化。整个表演中持续的微沟槽。自然呼吸。自然的体重转移。真实的节奏感。自信的气场。角色从第一帧起就吸引了所有人的注意。

视频结构
切入1（0.0秒–0.8秒）
牛仔枪击。视频开始时，角色已经在移动了。微妙的律动激活。在第一个音乐重音处：尖锐的胸部孤立，立刻肩膀撞击，快速的脖子断裂。动作出乎意料、精准且技巧娴熟。自信满满。不准摆姿势。不能停下来。

切入2秒（0.8秒–3.5秒）
全身注射。舞者爆发出节奏感强的编舞。弹力很强。节奏有力。干净利落的脚步。动态重量转移。大动作质量。摄像机顺畅地跟随运动。

切3（3.5秒–5.5秒）
低角度英雄镜头。大体翻滚。方向性强。强有力的轮廓。自然的服装动作。舞者主导了画面。

切入4圈（5.5秒–7.5秒）
中等骑士射击。重点关注律动质量。胸部隔离。肩膀沟槽。身体波浪。纯净的音乐性。镜头微妙地跟踪着动作。每一种口音都让人感到满足。

切入5秒（7.5秒–11.0秒）
全身表演部分。最令人印象深刻的编舞。行走的台阶。方向会改变。复杂的律动组合。精英舞者的能量。视觉冲击力最大化。

CUT 6（11.0秒–13.0秒）
慢动作序列。控制身体翻滚。流体波。机芯质量优美。高端舞蹈电影美学。优雅的动力。

CUT 7（13.0秒–15秒）
牛仔枪击。舞者在继续编舞的同时向镜头前进。自信的自信。自然的律动。镜头缓缓向前推进。最后的音乐点缀。强有力的收尾姿势。标志性的结尾画面。

摄影风格
病毒式社交媒体舞蹈摄影。节奏快。视觉吸引人。角色始终在画面中占据主导地位。交替出现牛仔镜头和全身镜头。流畅的跟踪镜头。动态推入式。低角度英雄镜头。没有脸部特写。

【风格】国家地理热带雨林微距纪录片（National Geographic Macro Wildlife），4K超清，微距摄影（Laowa 24mm Macro Probe Lens），超高速升格（Phantom TMX 1000fps），电影级自然光，浅景深
【时长】10秒
【场景】马达加斯加热带雨林树冠层，一根布满地衣和湿苔藓的粗枝上，背景是层叠的深绿色叶片虚化成均匀的圆形光斑（Bokeh），几束阳光穿过树冠缝隙打在枝干上形成明暗交界
[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：完美伪装（Slow Lateral Tracking, Macro Close-Up）
微距缓慢横移，逐渐揭示隐藏在苔藓中的高冠变色龙全貌。它全身呈与苔藓近乎一致的墨绿色，一动不动。

眼部特写：两只炮塔式眼球各自独立缓慢旋转扫描——左眼向前，右眼向后。眼球外层覆盖鳞片化的圆形眼睑，只留中心一个小圆孔露出瞳孔。虹膜是精密的金棕色放射状纤维纹理，瞳孔是一个极小的漆黑针孔。

变色过程（核心4K测试点）：从尾部开始，鳞片像LED矩阵逐区点亮，颜色从墨绿向鲜黄绿波浪式推进。每一片鳞片独立变色，先是底色变浅，然后表面浮现黄色素点。变色波前经过身体中段时能看到过渡带——同一片鳞片上半绿半黄的瞬间状态。
身体微动：后脚重新抓紧枝干，趾甲在树皮上刻出弧形小划痕，几粒树皮碎屑掉落。整个身体极其缓慢地前倾5度蓄力，喉部微微鼓胀。
[00:07-00:10] 镜头3：弹射猎杀（Ultra High-Speed 1000fps, Side Profile Macro）
侧面超高速升格微距：嘴部张开露出粉白色口腔内壁，舌头根部肌肉猛然收缩——
弹射过程（升格慢动作）：粉红色的弹性舌头以体长1.5倍的距离弹射而出，舌体在空中像一根展开的弹簧逐节伸长。舌尖是一个球状黏液垫，表面密布乳突状微结构。
命中瞬间：黏液垫精准包裹蚱蜢，能看到透明的黏液丝在猎物和舌面之间拉出数根细丝，黏液在逆光下折射出微弱的彩虹色。
回弹：舌头以同等速度回缩，蚱蜢被拽入口腔。变色龙合嘴，两腮缓慢鼓动咀嚼。最后一帧：一只眼球不紧不慢地转向镜头方向，瞳孔微微放大——定格。

en.p:
[Style] National Geographic Macro Wildlife documentary, 4K ultra-high-definition, macro photography (Laowa 24mm Macro Probe Lens), ultra-high-speed upscaling (Phantom TMX 1000fps), cinematic-grade natural light, shallow depth of field
[Duration] 10 seconds
[Scene] In the tropical rainforest of Madagas, on a thick branch covered in lichens and wet moss, the background is layered dark green leaves blurring into uniform circular light spots (Bokeh). A few beams of sunlight pass through the canopy gaps, casting a light-dark boundary on the branches
[00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Perfect Camouflage (Slow Lateral Tracking, Macro Close-Up)
The macro slowly shifts horizontally, gradually revealing the full view of the tall-crowned chameleon hidden in the moss. Its entire body is a dark green almost identical to moss, completely motionless.
Skin macro details: Each tubercular scale resembles a miniature gemstone cut-off, with fine glossy highlights at the tops of the scales, and deeper dark green grooves between the scales. The bony ridges on the surface of the casque are rough and dry, resembling weathered miniature rock.
Close-up of the eyes: Two turret-shaped eyeballs independently rotate slowly to scan—left eye forward, right eye backward. The outer layer of the eyeball is covered with a scale-like, round eyelid, leaving only a small round hole in the center to expose the pupil. The iris is a finely textured golden-brown radiating fiber, and the pupil is an extremely small, pitch-black pinhole.
Front paw details: The five toes are divided into two or three groups forming pincers, gripping branches tightly. The rough pad texture and tiny curved toenails at the base are clearly distinguishable.
[00:04-00:07] Lens 2: Push-In to Head, Split Diopter Focus
The camera slowly moves to the side of the head. Both eyes suddenly turned in the same direction—30 centimeters ahead, a green grasshopper stopped on the leaf veins.
Color change process (core 4K test point): starting from the tail, scales light up in each area like an LED matrix, with the color moving from dark green to bright yellow-green in waves. Each scale changes color independently, first with a lighter base color, then yellow pigmentation spots appearing on the surface. When the color-changing wavefront passes through the midsection of the body, you can see the transition zone—the instant state where the upper part of the same scale is half green and half yellow.
Subtle body movement: The hind legs grip the branch again, toenails carving arc-shaped small scratches into the bark, and a few bark fragments fall off. His whole body slowly leaned forward 5 degrees to build strength, his throat slightly swollen.
[00:07-00:10] Shot 3: Catapult Hunt (Ultra High-Speed 1000fps, Side Profile Macro)
Side ultra-high-speed macro: mouth opens to reveal the pink white inner walls of the mouth, and the muscles at the base of the tongue contract sharply—
Ejection process (Upgrade Slow Motion): The pink elastic tongue is launched at a distance 1.5 times its body length, stretching in the air like an unfolded spring segment by segment. The tip of the tongue is a spherical mucus pad, with a surface densely covered with papillae-like microstructures.
Moment of impact: The slime pad precisely wraps around the grasshopper, allowing you to see several thin threads of transparent mucus strands stretching between the prey and the tongue, which refracts faintly in rainbow colors against the backlight.
Rebound: The tongue retracts at the same speed, pulling the grasshopper into the mouth. The chameleon closed its mouth, its cheeks slowly puffing as it chewed. Final frame: An eyeball slowly turns toward the camera, pupils slightly dilated—freeze-framed.

raw_p:
【Style】National Geographic Wildlife Documentary, IMAX-grade imaging, 4K ultra-sharp, Photorealistic, high-frame-rate slow motion
【Duration】10 seconds
【Scene】A glacial highland lake at first light, 1,200 meters elevation. The water is black and mirror-still, ringed by drifting mist; low dawn light rakes across the surface. A faint breeze carves fine ripples near the far shore, where dark pine ridges dissolve into grey fog.
[00:00-00:04] Shot 1: The Hover (Telephoto close-up, 600mm)
Super-telephoto close-up: an osprey hangs almost motionless in the air, wings beating in tight powerful strokes, head locked dead-still and angled straight down. Every feather barb is razor-sharp — chocolate-brown back, snow-white underparts trembling in its own downdraft. In the pale-yellow iris the pupil snaps to a pinpoint as it fixes on a trout finning just beneath the surface. Tiny beads of mist cling to the leading edges of the wings.
[00:04-00:07] Shot 2: The Plunge (High-speed tracking, 240fps super slow motion)
Side-tracking high-speed shot: the osprey folds its wings and drops like a thrown spear, body stretched into a single straight line, talons swung forward and wide, dawn light sliding along the wet curve of the beak. Slow motion captures the instant of impact — the bird punches through the mirror surface and a crown of water bursts outward in a perfect ring, individual droplets hanging suspended in the air, each one catching the light like a glass bead. A translucent nictitating membrane sweeps across the eye a split second before contact.
[00:07-00:10] Shot 3: The Strike (Extreme close-up, macro lens)
Extreme macro close-up: the moment the talons close on the trout — scaled yellow toes spreading apart, black hooked claws sinking through flashing silver fish-scales, a thin sheet of water peeling off the feathers. Shallow depth of field blurs the spray streaking past the lens. Freeze-frame on a single droplet rolling off the tip of a claw, the fish's gill flaring open, cold light glinting on the soaked, curved talon.

zh.p:
【风格】国家地理野生动物纪录片，IMAX级影像，4K超锐利，照片级逼真，高帧率慢动作
【时长】10秒
【场景】冰川高地湖泊，海拔1200米。水面漆黑如镜，四周环绕着漂浮的雾气;黎明的微光掠过水面。微风在远岸划出细微的涟漪，黑色松林的脊线渐渐消散成灰色雾气。
[00：00-00：04] 镜头1：悬停（长焦特写，600毫米）
超长焦特写：一只鱼鹰几乎一动不动地悬挂在空中，翅膀紧密有力地拍打，头部死定且直下。每一根羽毛的倒钩都锋利如刀——巧克力棕色的背部，雪白的腹部在自己的下沉气流中颤抖。在淡黄色虹膜中，瞳孔在锁定水面下有鳍的鳟鱼时，瞬间变成一个尖点。细小的雾珠附着在翅膀的前缘。
[00：04-00：07] 镜头2：俯冲（高速追踪，240fps超慢动作）
侧向追踪高速镜头：鱼鹰收起翅膀，像投掷的矛一样下垂，身体被拉成一条直线，爪子向前张开，黎明的光线沿着湿润的喙弧滑动。慢动作捕捉到撞击的瞬间——鸟儿穿透镜面，一顶水冠在空中喷射成完美的环，每一滴水珠悬浮空中，每一滴都像玻璃珠一样捕捉光线。一层半透明的瞬膜在接触前一瞬间掠过眼睛。
[00：07-00：10] 第三镜头：打击（极近特写，微距镜头）
极限微距离特写：爪子紧咬鳟鱼的瞬间——鳞片黄色的脚趾张开，黑色钩爪穿过闪烁的银色鱼鳞，一层薄薄的水膜剥落羽毛。浅景深模糊了镜头外的水花。定格在一滴水珠从爪尖滚落，鱼的鳃张开，冷光在湿润弯曲的爪子上闪烁。

A beautiful young South Asian woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a soft beige casual t-shirt, smiling warmly in a bright modern kitchen. Cinematic, warm natural lighting, shallow depth of field, high-end commercial style, ultra-realistic, 4K.

0-3 sec: Close-up of her hand using metal tongs to elegantly drop crystal-clear ice cubes into a stylish transparent glass on a round wooden coaster. Coffee beans scattered on the table, soft bokeh background.

3-6 sec: Smooth transition to the Golda Coffee Dolce Latte bottle (white plastic with gold cap, brown liquid, visible condensation droplets) on the table. Camera slowly circles the premium bottle showing the label clearly.

6-9 sec: Close-up of the bottle being tilted by her hand, rich creamy brown iced latte pouring smoothly into the glass filled with ice cubes in slow motion. The liquid swirls beautifully around the ice creating a tempting marbled effect.

9-12 sec: Top-down view of the glass as the creamy coffee mixes with ice, creating beautiful swirling patterns. Then medium shot: the woman gently stirs the iced latte with a golden straw, smiling softly.

12-15 sec: She lifts the glass with both hands, brings it close to her face, inhales the aroma with eyes closed in pleasure, then takes a sip. Final shot: Golda bottle and finished iced latte glass side by side on the table. Elegant text appears: "Nikmatnya Lembut, Bikin Hari Makin GOLDA!" in stylish white font.

Ultra-realistic, smooth transitions, appetizing food commercial style, warm color grading, premium product focus, 15 seconds total duration, vertical 9:16 format for social media.

zh.p:
一位美丽的年轻南亚女性，留着长长的深色波浪发，穿着柔软的米色休闲T恤，在明亮现代的厨房里温暖地微笑着。电影感十足，温暖的自然光，浅景深，高端商业风格，超写实，4K。

0-3秒：她用金属夹子优雅地将晶莹剔透的冰块放入圆形木质杯垫上的时尚透明玻璃杯中。桌上散落着咖啡豆，柔和的散景背景。

3-6秒：平滑过渡到桌上的Golda Coffee Dolce Latte瓶（白色塑料，金色盖，棕色液体，可见水珠）。镜头缓缓绕着那瓶高级酒瓶转动，清晰地显示出标签。

6-9秒：特写她手倾斜瓶子，浓郁奶油棕色冰拿铁缓缓倒入装满冰块的杯子中。液体在冰面上旋转，形成诱人的大理石纹理效果。

9-12秒：从上而下俯瞰玻璃，奶油咖啡与冰块混合，形成美丽的旋转图案。然后是中景：女人用金色吸管轻轻搅拌冰拿铁，微笑着。

12-15秒：她双手举起酒杯，靠近脸颊，闭眼吸入香气，享受着愉悦，然后啜饮一口。最后一杯：Golda瓶和喝完的冰拿铁杯并排放在桌上。优雅的文字以时尚的白色字体出现：“Nikmatnya Lembut， Bikin Hari Makin GOLDA！”。

超真实、平滑过渡、诱人食品广告风格、温暖的色彩分级、高端产品聚焦、总时长15秒、社交媒体垂直9：16格式。
