【风格】东方玄幻真人特效大片（Oriental Fantasy Live-Action Blockbuster），IMAX电影画质，8K超清，真实摄影（Photorealistic），虚幻引擎5写实渲染，达芬奇高级调色，暗黑战场氛围，无动漫感、无塑料感
【时长】15秒
【场景】末世焦土战场，龟裂的暗红色焦土，阴霾的暗灰色天空，背景千军万马的杂兵剪影（无需逐个描述）
【角色】白衣女侠（一袭白衣，手持折扇，绑带高跟鞋，长发，气质清冷孤傲，脸部毛孔与发丝清晰可见）
[00:00-00:01] 镜头1：天降神兵（Crash Landing / Speed-Ramp）
大远景：一道金色发光粒子光柱从阴霾天空极速下坠。
落地瞬间切入极致慢动作（Super Slow-mo），特写穿绑带高跟鞋的足部重重踏在龟裂焦土上，扬尘炸开、地面碎裂向四周辐射。
[00:01-00:02] 镜头2：折扇起手式（Power Burst / Wide）
全景固定机位：白衣女子在千军万马前单腿旋转，折扇横扫扫出一道巨大的金色环形冲击波，四周沙尘被掀起。暗黑战场被金光照亮。
[00:02-00:05] 镜头3：横扫千军（Tracking + Motion Blur）
中景转全景，镜头紧跟人物流畅移动，强烈动态模糊。
白衣女子如舞蹈般在敌阵中穿梭挥扇，身姿轻盈，扇影带出金色气刃轨迹。杂兵接连被气浪掀飞腾空，击飞瞬间局部切入慢动作。灰暗战场中白衣与金光是绝对视觉中心。
[00:05-00:07] 镜头4：分身压制（Bullet-time / Low-angle Push-in）
全景低角度仰拍，镜头极慢向前推进（子弹时间）。
女子单腿傲立、折扇张开，身后幻化出多个同步动作的白衣残影分身。背景大量杂兵被定格悬浮在半空，空间出现轻微扭曲感. 神明降临般的压迫感。
[00:07-00:09] 镜头5：神女法相（Epic Scale / Slow Tilt-up）
大远景轻微上摇：女子立于画面正中，背后拔地而起一尊巨大的半透明发光神女法相，双手合十后凝化出一柄巨剑。杂兵如蝼蚁冲向法相。
特效：全息半透明粒子法相，神圣的蓝白与幽蓝能量光辉。色调由金灰转为冷白幽蓝。
[00:09-00:11] 镜头6：火龙吞噬（Hollywood VFX / Handheld Shake）
远景转大远景，镜头随爆炸剧烈震动（手持碎震）。
地面炸开红色裂纹，多头烈焰火龙从地裂中喷涌而出，瞬间引发核爆级爆炸，掀起震天动地的巨大蘑菇云. 女子立于爆炸中心前，身姿渺小却岿然不动。火红与黑灰浓烟交织。
[00:11-00:14] 镜头7：废墟漫步（Slow Push-in）
大远景转中全景，平稳缓慢推镜，与前段激战形成反差。
女子手持折扇，在燃烧的废墟与漫天红黑浓烟中向镜头从容走来，空气中漂浮的火星与灰烬缓缓飘落. 胜利者的孤傲。
[00:14-00:15] 镜头8：清冷回眸（Near Shot / Subtle Breathing）
中景转近景，固定机位近乎静止，仅微风拂动。
女子直视镜头，表情平静清冷，毫无战后波澜. 逼真的衣物与发丝物理风动模拟，背景烟雾柔化. 冷灰冷蓝主导，空灵收尾。

[Style] Oriental Fantasy Live-Action Blockbuster, IMAX movie quality, 8K ultra-high-definition, photorealistic cinematography, Unreal Engine 5 realistic rendering, advanced Da Vinci color grading, dark battlefield atmosphere, no anime or plastic feel
[Duration] 15 seconds
[Scene] Post-apocalyptic scorched earth battlefield, cracked dark red scorched earth, gloomy gray sky, background of thousands of soldiers silhouetted by soldiers (no need to describe each one individually)
[Character] White-Clad Heroine (dressed in white, holding a folding fan, strapped high heels, long hair, aloof and aloof aura, facial pores and hair clearly visible)
[00:00-00:01] Scene 1: Crash Landing / Speed-Ramp
Great View: A golden glowing particle beam rapidly descended from the gloomy sky.
The moment you land, the scene switches to extreme slow-motion (Super Slow-mo), with close-ups of feet in strapped high heels stomping cracked scorched earth, dust exploding and the ground cracking and radiating outward.
[00:01-00:02] Scene 2: Folding Fan Opening Pose (Power Burst / Wide)
Panoramic fixed camera position: A woman in white spun on one leg in front of thousands of troops, her folding fan sweeping out a huge golden ring-shaped shockwave, kicking up dust and sand all around. The dark battlefield was illuminated by golden light.
[00:02-00:05] Shot 3: Sweeping Through the Masses (Tracking + Motion Blur)
The medium shot shifts to a wide shot, with the camera closely following the people as they move smoothly, with strong motion blur.
The woman in white danced through the enemy ranks, waving her fan, her figure light and graceful, her shadow trailing a golden blade. The minions were repeatedly sent flying by the shockwaves, and at the moment of being knocked up, they switched to slow-motion in a localized way. In the Dark Battlefield, the white robes and golden light are the absolute visual center.
[00:05-00:07] Scene 4: Bullet-time / Low-angle Push-in
Panoramic low-angle downward-angle shot, with the camera moving forward very slowly (bullet time).
The woman stood proudly on one leg, her folding fan spread, and behind her, several white-clad shadow clones appeared in synchronized motion. In the background, a large number of mobs are frozen suspended in midair, creating a slight distortion in space. An oppressive feeling as if a god had descended.
[00:07-00:09] Shot 5: Goddess Dharma Aspect (Epic Scale / Slow Tilt-up)
The large distant view tilted slightly: a woman stood at the center of the scene, with a huge, translucent, glowing divine goddess avatar rising from behind her. After pressing her palms together, she condensed into a giant sword. Mixed soldiers charged at Faxiang like ants.
Special effects: Holographic semi-transparent particle avatar, sacred blue-white and deep blue energy radiance. The color tone shifts from golden gray to cool white and deep blue.
[00:09-00:11] Shot 6: Dragon's Swallow (Hollywood VFX / Handheld Shake)
Zoom to wide shot, and the camera vibrates violently with the explosion (handheld shatter shaker).
Red cracks burst open in the ground, and multiple blazing fire dragons erupted from the fissure, instantly triggering a nuclear-level explosion and unleashing a massive mushroom cloud that shook the heavens and earth. The woman stood at the center of the explosion, small yet unmoving. Fiery red and black-gray thick smoke intertwined.
[00:11-00:14] Shot 7: Slow Push-in
The wide shots shift to medium panoramas, with steady and slow shot-pushing, creating a contrast with the intense earlier scenes.
A woman holding a folding fan calmly walks toward the camera amid burning ruins and thick red and black smoke, with sparks and ashes drifting slowly in the air. The pride of the victors.
[00:14-00:15] Shot 8: Near Shot / Subtle Breathing
Medium shots shift to close-ups, the fixed camera position is almost stationary, with only a gentle breeze stirring.
The woman stared directly at the camera, her expression calm and cold, showing no trace of post-war turmoil. Realistic clothing and hair simulate physical wind movements, with background smoke softening. Cold gray and cool blue dominate, ending with an ethereal finish.

Style: 3D cinematic retrofuturistic sci-fi, stylized realism, colossal floating megacity collapsing from orbit, synthwave atmosphere, dramatic volumetric clouds, impossible scale, dynamic camera movement, high-speed action, cinematic destruction, 15-second vertical video pacing 
Pilot: lone anti-gravity rider in sleek white flight armor with illuminated blue accents, aerodynamic helmet, fearless expression, riding a futuristic hoverbike Camera points upward through thick clouds. A gigantic floating city is breaking apart overhead. Entire skyscrapers drift downward like asteroids. Monorails twist through the sky. The Pilot bursts into frame on a hoverbike, diving through the falling debris field. SFX: atmospheric roar, distant structural collapse, deep synth drone. 
Tracking shot beside the Pilot racing between collapsing towers. Buildings rotate slowly in freefall. Neon signs tumble through the air. A giant transit station tears apart behind her. VFX: sparks, falling holograms, debris trails. SFX: rushing wind, metal tearing, engine scream. 
A colossal orbital defense machine awakens among the wreckage. Rotating rings spin around its glowing core. The machine locks onto the Pilot and begins pursuit through the collapsing city. VFX: targeting lasers, reactor glow, energy pulses. SFX: warning alarms, reactor hum, heavy machinery. 
The Pilot accelerates through an upside-down skyscraper drifting through the atmosphere. Windows explode outward. Debris rushes past the camera as the defense machine fires massive energy blasts through the falling city. SFX: energy cannon discharge, sonic booms, collapsing steel.

风格：3D电影式复古未来科幻，风格化现实主义，巨大的漂浮巨型城市从轨道上坍塌，合成波氛围，戏剧性的体积云层，不可能的规模，动态摄像机运动，高速动作，电影般的破坏，15秒垂直视频节奏
飞行员：一名孤独的反重力骑手，身穿流线型白色飞行装甲，配以蓝色发光点缀，戴着空气动力学头盔，神情无畏，骑着一辆未来感十足的悬浮摩托。镜头穿过厚厚的云层向上拍摄。一座巨大的漂浮城市正在头顶崩塌。整座摩天大楼像小行星一样向下漂移。单轨列车在天空中盘旋。飞行员骑着悬浮摩托冲进画面，冲进坠落的碎片场。音效：氛围轰鸣，远处结构坍塌，深沉的合成器持续音。
跟踪镜头，飞行员在倒塌的高塔间奔跑。建筑物在自由落体中缓慢旋转。霓虹灯在空中飘落。一个巨大的交通站在她身后撕裂。视觉特效：火花、坠落的全息影像、碎片轨迹。音效：呼啸的风声，金属撕裂声，发动机尖叫。
一台巨大的轨道防御机器在废墟中苏醒。旋转的环围绕着它发光的核心旋转。机器锁定驾驶员，开始在崩塌的城市中追击。视觉特效：激光、反应堆光辉、能量脉冲。音效：警告警报，反应堆嗡嗡声，重型机械。
飞行员加速穿过一栋倒置的摩天大楼，漂浮在大气层中。窗户向外爆裂。碎片飞过镜头，防御机器发射出巨大的能量弹，穿透坠落的城市。音效：能量炮发射、音爆、钢铁崩塌。
史诗级超广角镜头。飞行员逃离残骸场，整个漂浮大都市在大气层再入时点燃。成千上万燃烧的建筑如人造流星雨般划过天空。音效：管弦合成器高潮，氛围燃烧，最终的电影冲击。

A gigantic floating city is breaking apart overhead. Entire skyscrapers drift downward like asteroids. Monorails twist through the sky. The Pilot bursts into frame on a hoverbike, diving through the falling debris field. SFX: atmospheric roar, distant structural collapse, deep synth drone. 
Tracking shot beside the Pilot racing between collapsing towers. Buildings rotate slowly in freefall. Neon signs tumble through the air. A giant transit station tears apart behind her. VFX: sparks, falling holograms, debris trails. SFX: rushing wind, metal tearing, engine scream. 
A colossal orbital defense machine awakens among the wreckage. Rotating rings spin around its glowing core. The machine locks onto the Pilot and begins pursuit through the collapsing city. VFX: targeting lasers, reactor glow, energy pulses. SFX: warning alarms, reactor hum, heavy machinery. 
The Pilot accelerates through an upside-down skyscraper drifting through the atmosphere. Windows explode outward. Debris rushes past the camera as the defense machine fires massive energy blasts through the falling city. SFX: energy cannon discharge, sonic booms, collapsing steel.

巴西和阿根廷国家队从隧道进入体育场。巴西球员穿黄色球衣，阿根廷球员穿天蓝白条纹球衣。球迷挥舞旗帜，观众欢呼，戏剧性的镜头跟踪，紧张的世界杯氛围。

场景2（3-8秒）：
比赛开始。巴西与阿根廷之间节奏快速的足球比赛。巴西球员快速而精准地传递，而阿根廷后卫则积极逼抢。动态摄像机以逼真的体育转播动作跟随球穿过球场。

raw_p:
[캐릭터 고정] 이미지 1과 제작된 서핑복 캐릭터 시트를 엄격하게 참조한다. 동일한 여성 캐릭터의 정확한 얼굴, 창백하고 깨끗한 피부톤, 긴 검은 머리, 파란 눈, 신체 비율(33C-26-34), 그리고 캐릭터 시트에 정의된 플로럴 패턴의 여성용 서핑복을 그대로 유지한다. 의상, 얼굴, 체형, 헤어스타일, 색상 구성, 로고 및 디자인 요소를 변경하지 않는다. 동일한 서프보드를 유지한다. 캐릭터는 실제 프로 서퍼처럼 보이며 위험하지만 현실적으로 믿을 수 있는 세계 정상급 서핑 기술을 수행해야 한다.
[환경] 밝은 대낮의 열린 바다. 깊고 선명한 푸른 바닷물. 강한 태양광 반사. 거대한 파도. 역동적인 물보라. 강한 해풍. 전체 분위기는 빠르고, 거칠고, 스릴 넘치며, 극도로 현실적이어야 한다.
[영상 스타일] 하이퍼 시네마틱한 15초 연속 싱글테이크. 절대 컷 없음. 숨겨진 컷 없음. 전환 없음. 몽타주 없음. 하나의 완전한 연속 촬영. 하이퍼 리얼리스틱 액션. 자연스러운 모션 블러. 렌즈에 맺히는 물방울. 카메라를 덮치는 바닷물. 강한 파도 소리. 보드가 수면을 가르는 마찰음. 바람 소리. 실제 인체의 무게 이동과 균형 조절이 자연스럽게 표현되어야 한다. 전체 영상은 몰입감 있고 물리적으로 현실적이어야 한다.
[오프닝 샷] 영상 시작 시 캐릭터는 이미 거대한 파도를 타고 있다. 카메라는 그녀 바로 앞의 매우 가까운 위치에서 시작한다. 프레임은 얼굴과 상체를 중심으로 담는다. 젖은 긴 검은 머리가 바람에 흩날린다. 표정은 차분하고 두려움이 없으며 완벽하게 집중되어 있다. 강한 햇빛이 물 위에서 반사된다. 서프보드 아래에서는 바닷물이 빠르게 움직인다.
[카메라 이동] 카메라는 상체 전면에서 짧게 시작한 뒤 하나의 부드럽고 끊김 없는 움직임으로 그녀의 몸 주변을 회전하며 후방으로 이동한다. 후방에 도달하는 즉시 카메라는 서프보드 높이까지 낮아진다. 이후 영상이 끝날 때까지 카메라는 항상 수면 가까운 낮은 위치를 유지한다. 보드 꼬리(Tail) 또는 레일(Rail) 부근에서 뒤를 추적한다. 절대 높은 각도로 올라가지 않는다. 항상 서프보드를 뒤에서 쫓는 듯한 느낌을 유지한다.
[액션 흐름] 카메라가 그녀 뒤쪽의 보드 높이에 고정되자 그녀는 깊게 웅크린 자세로 강하게 가속한다. 상체를 공격적으로 앞으로 기울이며 파도 벽을 따라 질주한다. 그녀는 첫 번째 강력한 바텀 턴(Bottom Turn)을 수행한다. 서프보드 레일이 수면 깊숙이 파고들고 거대한 물보라가 뒤로 폭발한다. 이어서 파도 면을 향해 급상승하며 공격적인 카빙 턴(Carving Turn)을 수행한다. 보드 꼬리에서 강한 스프레이가 폭발하며 카메라 렌즈를 덮친다. 그녀는 즉시 한 손을 아래로 뻗어 핸드 드래그(Hand Drag)를 수행한다. 손가락 끝이 수면을 길게 스치며 물줄기가 뒤로 흩어진다. 카메라는 보드 바로 뒤에서 이를 밀착 추적한다. 그녀는 더욱 가파른 파도 구간으로 속도를 높인다.
[에어리얼 순간] 파도의 립(Lip)에 도달한 순간 그녀는 강하게 튕겨 오르며 고난도 에어리얼을 수행한다. 서프보드와 함께 공중으로 높이 솟아오른다. 시간은 극적인 슬로우 모션으로 전환된다. 카메라는 여전히 낮은 위치에서 보드 높이를 유지하며 공중 동작을 따라간다. 그녀는 상체를 카메라 방향으로 회전한다. 한 손으로 보드를 잡으며 스타일리시한 포즈를 취한다. 젖은 검은 머리카락이 공중에서 흩날린다. 수많은 물방울이 햇빛을 반사하며 떠다닌다. 서프보드 디자인이 선명하게 보인다. 그녀는 완벽한 균형을 유지하며 에어리얼을 마무리한다.
[착지 및 가속] 그녀는 자연스럽게 자세를 되돌리며 파도 위에 깨끗하게 착지한다. 착지 순간 거대한 물보라가 폭발한다. 카메라는 여전히 보드 높이에서 바로 뒤를 따라간다. 착지 직후 그녀는 연속적인 강한 펌핑(Pumping)을 수행하며 속도를 극대화한다. 무게 중심을 빠르게 앞뒤로 이동시키며 더욱 강하게 가속한다. 서프보드는 수면 위를 미끄러지듯 질주한다.
[배럴 진입] 눈앞에 거대한 중공 파도(Hollow Wave)가 형성된다. 그녀는 낮은 자세로 더욱 깊게 웅크린다. 파도 벽 안쪽 라인을 향해 진입한다. 거대한 립이 머리 위로 무너지기 시작한다. 카메라는 보드 높이를 유지한 채 그녀 바로 뒤를 따라간다. 주변 시야가 점점 어두워진다. 파도 벽이 양옆으로 솟아오른다. 거대한 물의 터널이 형성된다.
[배럴 라이딩] 그녀는 깊은 배럴(Deep Barrel) 내부를 최고 속도로 통과한다. 완벽한 균형을 유지한 채 터널 중심을 따라 질주한다. 앞손을 파도 벽 가까이 뻗어 물결을 스친다. 손끝에서 물방울이 흩어진다. 카메라는 보드 꼬리 바로 뒤에서 터널 내부를 추적한다. 머리 위에서는 거대한 물의 천장이 회전한다. 투명한 물벽을 통과한 햇빛이 푸른 빛으로 반사된다. 수많은 물 입자가 공중에 떠다닌다. 터널 출구의 강한 빛이 멀리 보인다. 파도 소리는 천둥처럼 울려 퍼진다. 모든 움직임은 하나의 연속된 싱글테이크 안에서 유지된다.
[배럴 탈출 및 마지막 장면] 그녀는 최고 속도로 터널 출구를 향해 돌진한다. 눈앞의 빛이 점점 강해진다. 거대한 물벽이 뒤에서 무너져 내린다. 마지막 순간까지 완벽한 균형을 유지한다. 터널을 빠져나오는 순간 폭발적인 물보라가 사방으로 터진다. 강렬한 햇빛이 화면을 가득 채운다. 그녀는 마지막으로 파도 립 바로 아래를 스치듯 지나가며 초고속 라인을 그린다. 양옆으로 거대한 물보라가 폭발한다. 렌즈에는 끊임없이 물방울이 튄다. 정면의 거대한 파도 벽이 점점 가까워진다. 카메라는 동일한 낮은 추적 각도를 유지한다. 그녀는 흔들림 없는 자세로 전속력 질주를 이어간다. 영상은 그녀가 거대한 파도를 향해 계속 돌진하는 순간 종료된다. 텍스트 없음. 로고 없음. 자막 없음. Ultra Realistic Water Physics. Extreme Surfing Action. Deep Barrel Ride. Inside The Tube. Heavy Hollow Wave. Aggressive Carving. Ha

[환경] 밝은 대낮의 열린 바다. 깊고 선명한 푸른 바닷물. 강한 태양광 반사. 거대한 파도. 역동적인 물보라. 강한 해풍. 전체 분위기는 빠르고, 거칠고, 스릴 넘치며, 극도로 현실적이어야 한다.

主人公と敵は常に自然な人間解剖学。腕は二本、脚は二本のみ。高速回転、蹴り、ジャンプ、着地、サマーソルト中でも余分な脚、重複した腕、分裂した足、実体化した残像を生成しない。モーションブラーは身体の外側に薄く流れるだけ。すべての攻撃は骨盤の回転、肩のひねり、踏み込み、重心移動に基づく。

[世界観]
星詠み貴族の廃宮殿。巨大な円形ホール、紫水晶の柱、金細工の階段、星座模様の大理石床、割れた天窓から差し込む月光、浮遊する粉塵、遠景に機械仕掛けの天球儀。主人公の黒紫と金の衣装に合わせ、背景は冷たい青紫の月光と金属反射で統一。

[敵]
仮面をつけた宮廷執行者たちが複数方向から連続で襲撃。長身で黒灰色の戦闘服、銀色の仮面、短剣や警棒を持つ。主人公と同じ顔・髪型・衣装に見えないよう完全に差別化。

[ムード]
最初は包囲される静かな緊張。主人公は無表情で腕を組み、眠たげな目のまま一瞬で加速する。ラストはサマーソルトキックで敵を宙へ弾き飛ばし、何事もなかったように着地する余裕の決着。

[ミュージック]
低音ドローン、鋭い和太鼓風パーカッション、金属的なクリック音。攻撃ごとに短いヒット音。最終サマーソルト直前だけ一瞬無音、蹴り抜きでストリングスが急上昇し、着地で音がすっと引く。

[カメラ・演出]
Extreme Close-Up と Wide Shot を極端に交互配置。アップでは目、口元、靴底、リボン、衝撃の瞬間を誇張。ワイドでは複数敵との位置関係と空間全体を明快に見せる。低角度、魚眼気味の誇張パース、ドリーイン、スピードランプ、マッチカットを多用。

ショット1: 0.0-1.3秒 / Wide。廃宮殿の円形ホール中央、主人公が腕を組んだまま無表情で立つ。周囲を8人の仮面執行者が半円状に包囲。天窓の月光が紫の髪と金の星飾りを縁取る。カメラは超ローアングルからゆっくり回り込み、空間の広さと包囲を見せる。

ショット2: 1.3-2.2秒 / Extreme Close-Up。主人公の半目の紫の瞳。瞳に迫る敵の影が反射する。口元がわずかに不機嫌そうに歪む。リボンの星飾りが小さく揺れ、次の瞬間だけ完全な無音。

ショット3: 2.2-3.4秒 / Wide。右前方から突っ込む敵の警棒を、主人公が最小動作で半身になって回避。小さな身体を沈め、踏み込みと同時に前蹴りを腹部へ叩き込む。敵が後方の大理石床を滑る。カメラは横移動ドリーで蹴りのラインを追う。

ショット4: 3.4-4.3秒 / Close-Up。紫の靴底が画面いっぱいに迫る。靴の金飾りが光り、命中直前に短いスピードランプ。衝撃波で敵の仮面の端が震える。モーションブラーは薄く、脚は一本だけ明確。

ショット5: 4.3-5.7秒 / Wide。左側から二人同時に斬り込む。主人公は一人目の腕を受け流し、回転しながら横蹴りで膝を崩す。続けて背後の敵へ肘打ちを入れ、さらに肩で押し込むカウンターで柱へ弾く。カメラは円形レールで360度回り込み。

ショット6: 5.7-6.8秒 / Extreme Close-Up。主人公の小さな手が敵の袖をつかむ。金の星チャームが鋭く揺れる。布のしわ、指先の力、敵の重心が崩れる瞬間を超接近で描写。背景は強い被写界深度で溶ける。

ショット7: 6.8-8.2秒 / Wide。主人公が敵の腕を引き込み、足払いで一人を転ばせる。倒れる敵を踏み台にして低く跳び、空中で半回転しながら別の敵の肩へ踵落とし。小柄な体格に反した鋭い重量感。カメラは床すれすれから見上げ、誇張されたパースで靴と敵の距離を強調。

ショット8: 8.2-9.2秒 / Close-Up。主人公の髪のツインシニヨンとリボンが回転の遠心力でふわりと遅れて流れる。半目の表情は変わらない。背後で敵の短剣が空を切り、金属音だけが鋭く響く。

ショット9: 9.2-10.7秒 / Wide。背後から迫る大柄な執行者に対し、主人公は振り向きざまの後ろ蹴りを胸部へ命中させる。さらに着地と同時に膝を抜き、低い姿勢から掌底で別の敵の顎を跳ね上げる。敵が星座模様の床上で連鎖的に崩れる。カメラは一気に引いて全体の連続処理を見せる。

ショット10: 10.7-11.8秒 / Extreme Close-Up。最後の強敵の足が床を踏み砕く。次のカットで主人公の紫の瞳、さらに靴のつま先へ高速カット。主人公が体を低く沈め、サマーソルトの予備動作に入る。音楽が一瞬止まり、髪飾りの星だけがきらりと光る。

ショット11: 11.8-13.5秒 / Dramatic Wide + Slow Motion。最終アクション。主人公が地面を蹴って後方へ宙返り、完全に美しい弧を描くサマーソルトキック。紫の靴先が下から上へ強敵の顎を正確に蹴り抜く。月光を背負った逆光シルエット、スカートとリボンが円形に広がる。敵は縦方向に吹き飛び、背後の天球儀の光と重なる。脚は左右二本のみ、回転中も人体構造を厳密に維持。

ショット12: 13.5-15.0秒 / Long Telephoto Pull Back。主人公がふわりと片足で着地し、すぐに両足を揃える。腕を組み直し、半目のまま小さく息を吐く。周囲の敵が遅れて崩れ落ち、紫水晶の粉塵が月光に舞う。カメラは望遠でゆっくり引き、廃宮殿の広大な静寂と、主人公の小さくも圧倒的な存在感を残してフェードアウト。

en.p:
[メタデータ]
Ruler: 15 seconds
Tempo: approximately 128 BPM
Composition style: Cinematic Multi-Attack Finish / Extreme Close-Up & Wide Alternation
Number of shots: 12 shots
Image quality: Theatrical anime style / Ultra high-end / 4K / Theatrical anime, highly detailed, cinematic lighting, ray tracing, artistic composition, dramatic depth of field, low-angle action cinematography, exaggerated foreshortening, controlled motion blur, clean anatomy, no duplicated limbs.

[Wardrobe - Main Character]
Completely fixed @[image1]. The protagonist wears lavender-colored twin chignon hair, purple eyes, a petite, petite figure, a dress-style coat with star decorations based on black and purple, ribbons, gold embellishments, purple-black striped socks, and purple shoes throughout every shot. Absolutely do not change facial features, hairstyle, costume, decorations, colors, or silhouettes.

[Human Body Fixation Rules]
The protagonist and antagonist are always natural human anatomy. It has only two arms and two legs. It does not generate extra legs, overlapping arms, split legs, or materialized afterimages even during high-speed spins, kicks, jumps, landings, or somersaults. Motion blur only flows thinly along the outside of the body. All attacks are based on pelvic rotation, shoulder twists, stepping forwards, and shifting the center of gravity.

[Worldview]
The abandoned palace of the Hoshiyomi aristocracy. A massive circular hall, amethyst columns, goldsmith staircases, marble floors decorated with constellations, moonlight streaming through cracked skylights, floating dust, and a mechanical celestial globe in the distance. Matching the protagonist's black-purple and gold costume, the background is unified by cold blue-purple moonlight and metallic reflections.

[Enemy]
Masked court enforcers launched a series of attacks from multiple directions. Tall with black-gray combat uniforms, silver masks, daggers, and batons. Completely differentiated so that the protagonist doesn't look the same face, hairstyle, or outfit.

[ムード]
At first, there is quiet tension surrounding you. The protagonist folds his arms expressionlessly and, still sleepy-eyed, accelerates in an instant. In the end, he sent the enemy flying with a somersault kick and landed as if nothing had happened, ending the match with ease.

[ミュージック]
Bass drones, sharp Japanese drum-style percussion, metallic clicking sounds. A short hit sound with each attack. Just before the final somersault, there was a brief silence; the strings shot up sharply with a kick, and the sound softened upon landing.

[Camera & Direction]
Extreme Close-Up and Wide Shot are alternately arranged to the extreme. In close-ups, the eyes, mouth, soles, ribbons, and moments of impact are exaggerated. In wide mode, the positions of multiple enemies and the entire space are clearly displayed. Frequently uses low-angle, exaggerated perspectives with a fisheye reaction, dream-in, speed lamps, and match cuts.

Shot 1: 0.0-1.3 seconds / wide. In the center of the circular hall of the abandoned palace, the protagonist stands expressionless, arms crossed. Eight masked enforcers surrounded the area in a semicircle. Moonlight from the skylight framed purple hair and golden star ornaments. The camera slowly circles from an ultra-low angle, showing the vastness and encirclement of the space.

Shot 2: 1.3-2.2 seconds / Extreme Close-Up. The protagonist's half-eye purple eyes. The shadow of an enemy approaching his eyes reflected off. His mouth twisted slightly in displeasure. The star decoration on the ribbon swayed slightly, and in the next moment, it fell completely silent.

Shot 3: 2.2-3.4 seconds / Wide. The protagonist dodges enemy batons charging in from the right front, turning half-body with minimal movement. He sinks his small body and, as he steps forward, delivers a front kick to his abdomen. The enemy slides down the marble floor in the rear. The camera follows the line of the kick with a sideways moving dolly.

Shot 4: 3.4-4.3 seconds / Close-Up. The purple soles fill the entire screen. The gold trim on the shoes gleamed, and just before hitting, a short speed lamp appeared. The shockwave made the edges of the enemy's masks tremble. The motion blur is thin, and only one leg is clearly visible.

Shot 5: 4.3-5.7 seconds / Wide. Both of them slashed simultaneously from the left. The protagonist deflects the first person's arm and spins while breaking his knee with a side kick. He then delivers an elbow strike to the enemy behind him, and then counters with a shoulder push to deflect the pillar. The camera rotates 360 degrees on circular rails.

Shot 6: 5.7-6.8 seconds / Extreme Close-Up. The protagonist's small hand grabs the enemy's sleeve. The golden star charm shook sharply. Scenes depicting wrinkles in fabric, finger strength, and moments when enemies' center of gravity collapses at ultra-close range. The background melts with strong depth of field.

Shot 7: 6.8-8.2 seconds / Wide. The protagonist pulls in the enemy's arm and knocks one down with a kick. Use a fallen enemy as a stepping stone to jump low, spin half in midair, and drop your heel onto another enemy's shoulder. Despite his small build, he has a sharp sense of weight. The camera looks up from just above the floor, emphasizing the distance between the shoes and the enemy in exaggerated perspective.

Shot 8: 8.2-9.2 seconds / Close-Up. The protagonist's twin chignons and ribbons float gently and slowly due to the centrifugal force of the spin. The expression on half-eye didn't change. Behind him, the enemy's dagger sliced through the air, and only the metallic sound rang out sharply.

Shot 9: 9.2-10.7 seconds / Wide. As the burly enforcer approaches from behind, the protagonist delivers a backward kick to the chest as he turns around. Then, upon landing, he pulls out his knees and, from a low position, flicks another enemy's jaw with the palm of his hand. Enemies collapse in a chain reaction on the constellation-patterned floor. The camera suddenly pulls to show the entire continuous processing.

Shot 10: 10.7-11.8 seconds / Extreme Close-Up. The final powerful enemy's foot crushes the floor. In the next cut, the protagonist's purple eyes are quickly cut to the toe of the shoe. The protagonist lowers his body and begins the somersault preparatory movement. The music paused for a moment, and only the stars on the hair ornament sparkled.

Shot 11: 11.8-13.5 seconds / Dramatic Wide + Slow Motion. Final action. The protagonist kicks off the ground and flips backward, tracing a perfectly beautiful somersault kick. The purple toe of his shoe precisely kicked the jaw of a formidable enemy from below upward. A backlit silhouette carrying moonlight, with skirts and ribbons spreading out in a circle. The enemy is blown vertically, overlapping with the light from the celestial globe behind it. It has only two legs on each side, maintaining a precise body structure even while rotating.

Shot 12: 13.5-15.0 seconds / Long Telephoto Pull Back. The protagonist gently lands on one foot and immediately brings both feet together. I folded my arms and exhaled softly while still half-eyed. The surrounding enemies collapsed late, and amethyst dust swirled in the moonlight. The camera slowly zooms in and fades out, leaving behind the vast silence of the abandoned palace and the protagonist's small yet overwhelming presence.

raw_p:
A gigantic abandoned cathedral stands in an endless black desert under a pale eclipse. The architecture is impossible: gothic arches bending inward, columns made of black marble, stained-glass windows showing moving silhouettes instead of saints. Fine ash drifts through the air like slow snow.

Opening frame: a slow dolly forward through the cathedral entrance. The floor is covered with thousands of sleeping shadows lying flat like bodies without owners.

At the 2-second mark, the eclipse light touches the floor.

The shadows begin waking.

They peel away from the stone surface, stretching upward into thin humanoid forms. Their movements are slow, fluid, and unnatural, like ink rising through water. The stained-glass windows crack from inside, releasing beams of inverted light , black rays cutting through pale dust.

The camera glides between the shadow figures as they silently turn toward the altar. Their edges flicker, sometimes solid, sometimes smoke. Every step they take leaves a ripple across the floor as if the stone were liquid.

VFX escalation: the cathedral walls begin breathing, expanding and contracting with low pressure waves. The ceiling fractures open, revealing a sky filled with rotating eclipses. The sleeping shadows fuse together into a massive winged silhouette above the altar.

Velocity ramp: a stained-glass window explodes inward ,shards suspended mid-air, each shard reflecting a different impossible sky.

Final moment: the winged shadow lowers its face toward the camera, but its face is only a doorway filled with moving stars.

Hyper-artistic gothic surrealism, slow cinematic motion, volumetric ash, inverted light beams, liquid shadow simulation, dreamlike horror atmosphere, 4K.

zh.t: 日食大教堂的阴影苏醒
zh.p:
一座巨大的废弃大教堂矗立在无尽的黑色沙漠中，沐浴在苍白的日食之下。建筑风格简直不可思议：哥特式拱门向内弯曲，黑色大理石柱子，彩色玻璃窗上展示的是移动的剪影而非圣人。细小的灰烬如缓慢的雪花飘散在空气中。

开场画面：一辆缓慢的推车穿过大教堂入口。地板上覆盖着成千上万沉睡的影子，像无主的尸体一样平躺着。

在2秒时，日食灯触地。

阴影开始苏醒。

它们从石面剥离，向上延伸成细长的人形。他们的动作缓慢、流畅且不自然，就像墨水在水中上升。彩色玻璃窗从内部裂开，释放出倒置的光束，黑色光线穿透淡淡的尘埃。

镜头在影子人物之间滑动，他们默默转向祭坛。它们的边缘闪烁，有时是实心，有时是烟雾。每走一步，地板上都泛起涟漪，仿佛石头是液体。

视觉特效升级：大教堂墙体开始呼吸，随着低压波起伏。天花板裂开，露出布满旋转日食的天空。沉睡的阴影融合成祭坛上方一个巨大的有翼剪影。

速度骤增：一扇彩色玻璃窗向内爆裂，碎片悬浮在半空中，每片碎片映照出不同的不可能天空。

最后一刻：有翼的影子低头朝向镜头，但脸只是一扇充满移动星星的门。

超艺术哥特式超现实主义、慢速电影运动、体积灰烬、倒置光束、液态阴影模拟、梦幻恐怖氛围、4K。

en.p:
A gigantic abandoned cathedral stands in an endless black desert under a pale eclipse. The architecture is impossible: gothic arches bending inward, columns made of black marble, stained-glass windows showing moving silhouettes instead of saints. Fine ash drifts through the air like slow snow.

Opening frame: a slow dolly forward through the cathedral entrance. The floor is covered with thousands of sleeping shadows lying flat like bodies without owners.

At the 2-second mark, the eclipse light touches the floor.

The shadows begin waking.

They peel away from the stone surface, stretching upward into thin humanoid forms. Their movements are slow, fluid, and unnatural, like ink rising through water. The stained-glass windows crack from inside, releasing beams of inverted light , black rays cutting through pale dust.

The camera glides between the shadow figures as they silently turn toward the altar. Their edges flicker, sometimes solid, sometimes smoke. Every step they take leaves a ripple across the floor as if the stone were liquid.

VFX escalation: the cathedral walls begin breathing, expanding and contracting with low pressure waves. The ceiling fractures open, revealing a sky filled with rotating eclipses. The sleeping shadows fuse together into a massive winged silhouette above the altar.

Velocity ramp: a stained-glass window explodes inward ,shards suspended mid-air, each shard reflecting a different impossible sky.

Final moment: the winged shadow lowers its face toward the camera, but its face is only a doorway filled with moving stars.

Hyper-artistic gothic surrealism, slow cinematic motion, volumetric ash, inverted light beams, liquid shadow simulation, dreamlike horror atmosphere, 4K.

15-second cinematic construction timelapse. The video begins with the exact stadium blueprint shown in the reference image: top-down architectural blueprint on a dark blue drafting grid, white technical linework, labeled gates, seating sections, tunnels, VIP areas, and field markings. Camera remains centered above the stadium throughout the entire sequence.

00:00–00:02
The blueprint glows softly. Technical lines brighten. Construction guides, measurement marks, and drafting details animate across the plan. The blueprint begins transforming into a three-dimensional wireframe structure.

00:02–00:04
The stadium walls rise vertically from the blueprint lines. Structural beams, support columns, concourses, tunnels, and seating bowls emerge precisely according to the blueprint. Smooth architectural growth, no destruction effects.

00:04–00:06
The wireframe evolves into a realistic unfinished stadium. Concrete foundations form. Steel frameworks expand around the perimeter. Seating sections appear layer by layer. Cranes and construction activity move rapidly in timelapse.

00:06–00:08
The stadium rapidly develops. Upper decks, VIP sections, tunnels, stairways, roof supports, entrances, and exterior facades assemble. All geometry remains perfectly consistent with the original blueprint layout.

00:08–00:10
Thousands of seats populate the stands. The pitch surface appears. Grass grows across the field in accelerated timelapse. Exterior roads, plazas, and landscaping begin taking shape.

00:10–00:12
Construction reaches completion. Roof structures lock into place. Lighting systems appear. Trees and surrounding walkways develop. The blueprint aesthetic completely disappears.

00:12–00:14
The stadium becomes fully photorealistic and matches the final reference image exactly. Crowd fills the seats. The field is pristine. The architecture, gates, tunnels, seating layout, and proportions remain perfectly faithful to the blueprint.

00:14–00:15
Final hero shot. The completed stadium stands in full daylight from the same overhead angle as the reference image. The camera slowly pushes in. Crowd atmosphere visible. The finished stadium fills the frame.

15秒的电影式建造时长。视频开头是参考图中显示的球场蓝图：深蓝色绘图网格上的俯视建筑蓝图，白色技术线条，标注的门口、座位区、隧道、贵宾区和场地标记。摄像机在整个镜头中始终位于体育场上方。

00:00–00:02
蓝图柔和地发光。技术线条变得清晰。施工指南、测量标记和绘图细节在平面图中动态显示。蓝图开始转变为三维线框结构。

00:02–00:04
体育场墙壁从蓝图线条垂直升起。结构梁、支撑柱、通道、隧道和座位区都完全按照蓝图出现。建筑结构平滑，没有破坏效果。

00:04–00:06
线框逐渐演变成一个真实的未完工体育场。混凝土地基逐渐形成。钢结构在外围扩展。座位区层层叠叠地出现。起重机和施工活动在延时中迅速展开。

00:06–00:08
体育场迅速发展。上层甲板、贵宾区、隧道、楼梯、屋顶支撑、入口和外立面均在此组装。所有几何形状都与原始蓝图布局完全一致。

00:08–00:10
数千个座位占据了看台。音高表面出现了。草地以加速的延时速度在场地上生长。外部道路、广场和景观开始成形。

00:10–00:12
施工即将竣工。屋顶结构会锁定到位。灯光系统出现了。树木和周边步道逐渐形成。蓝图美学完全消失了。

00:12–00:14
体育场变得完全写实，完全匹配最终参考图像。观众挤满了座位。田野一片崭新。建筑、大门、隧道、座位布局和比例都完全忠实于蓝图。

00:14–00:15
最后的英雄镜头。完工后的体育场从与参考图片相同的俯视角度，在全日光下矗立。镜头缓缓推进。人群气氛清晰可见。完成的体育场占据了画面。

- 摄像机保持在头顶并置中
- 平滑连续延时摄影

- 不剪辑，不换场景
- 电影灯光演变
- 高细节构造动画
- 端帧与最终球场参考图像相符

音频：
仅针对施工环境。
远处的机械声。
金属组装的声音。
人群氛围逐渐淡出，接近完成。
没有音乐。

用上传的参考图片作为身份参考，制作一段超逼真的电影视频。
身份锁定（非常重要）：年轻女性在整个视频中必须与参考图片完全一致。保留她的面部、面部结构、肤色、眼形、发型、体型比例和整体外观。没有任何身份漂移。
她穿着与参考图完全相同的服装：葡萄牙国家队官方红色球衣，带有绿色点缀，背后印有C罗7号，紧身浅蓝色牛仔裤，同样的发型、配饰和造型。
场景
在一座巨大的国际足联世界杯体育场内，葡萄牙球迷们都坐满了一场重要的葡萄牙比赛。成千上万的球迷挥舞葡萄牙国旗，唱歌、呼喊、欢呼和庆祝。明亮的泛光灯照亮了球场，巨型屏幕在头顶发光，足球场清晰可见，下面正在进行激烈的游戏。

0–3秒：
她站在座位旁，兴奋地望向球场。她微笑着扫视球场上的动作。头发在体育场的微风中自然飘动。
3–7秒：

7–11秒：
她身体前倾，紧盯着栏杆，紧张地微笑，一只手放在胸口，情绪激动地回应着这场游戏。
11–15秒：
葡萄牙创造了另一个令人兴奋的机会。她热情庆祝，鼓掌，再次跳跃，转向附近的支持者，然后挥舞着葡萄牙国旗，带着灿烂的笑容回望球场。

15秒连续镜头

动态但流畅的动作

en.p: [Style] Thriller and suspenseful atmosphere short drama, where warm yellow home light collides with cool blue mirror light, film grain, breathing in silence. [Duration] 15 seconds [Character] A woman dressing up in front of the mirror (home pajamas, bare-faced, lazy).  [00:00-00:03] Scene 1: Taking a mirror over the shoulder. A woman sits in front of a dressing mirror combing her hair, creating a warm and everyday scene. The camera moves extremely slowly—the audience notices before she does: her hand combing her hair in the mirror is backwards, and it's half a beat slower. [Hook Point] There's a hidden 'can't say what's wrong' in everyday scenes, forcing viewers to keep their eyes on it.  [00:03-00:09] Scene 2: Back-and-forth. In reality, she puts down her comb, but in the mirror, she combs again before stopping. She finally noticed and slowly looked up at the mirror. The "self" in the mirror also looked up—but the smile of the person in the mirror appeared a second before her.  [00:09-00:15] Shot 3: Close-up of both eyes. She held her breath and reached out to touch the mirror. In the instant before her fingertips touched it, the hand in the mirror took the lead, grabbing her wrist and pulling her inside. Final frame: The chair in reality is empty, and in the mirror sit two identical versions of herself, one of which is smiling. [Lip Movement Guidance] The Mirror Person (Lip Movement): "Let me come out for some fresh air." "

Audience-POV realistic smartphone video of an original fantasy outdoor stage performance. The footage is filmed vertically from inside a crowded live audience, with the phone held slightly above people’s heads. The frame has natural handheld sway, small breathing movement, brief focus hunting, mild digital noise, compressed phone microphone sound, ordinary smartphone exposure, and crowd silhouettes blocking the lower edge of the frame.
The stage is a large wooden outdoor performance platform built as a fictional mountain shrine arena: a cracked red shrine gate at the back, carved stone dragon statues on both sides, bamboo fencing, hanging cloth banners with invented calligraphy, dark wooden steps, sculpted rock formations, small ember bowls near the stage corners, and thin theatrical mist drifting behind the set. Tall trees and pale afternoon sky are visible beyond the stage. Audience members fill the foreground with dark hair silhouettes, raised phones, small cameras, and occasional hands pointing toward the stage.
Two original fantasy performers face each other on stage.
On frame-left stands the Crimson Scale Wyrm Guardian: a tall male dragon-humanoid stage performer with a strong athletic build, deep bronze skin visible around the jaw and hands, short backward-curving dark red horns, subtle cheek-scale prosthetics, amber glowing contact lenses, and layered crimson scale armor made of matte leather plates. He wears a heavy dark waist sash, black stage boots, a short thick dragon-tail costume piece attached behind the armor, and a long blackened spear with a red ember-like tip. His movement feels heavy, grounded, and ceremonial, like an ancient fire guardian entering combat.
On frame-right stands the Shadow-Reed Ninja: a lean young stage performer with quick controlled movement, ash-black layered ninja clothing, dark green cloth wraps around the forearms, a plain charcoal hood, a half-face fabric mask, soft split-toe stage boots, and two short curved matte-black blades. A narrow strip of deep green fabric trails from his back and moves with each step. His movement feels light, precise, and tactical, like a forest assassin using speed and misdirection.
0s to 4s: The phone camera rises slightly above the crowd as the audience reacts to the two performers entering their fighting marks. The Crimson Scale Wyrm Guardian steps forward from frame-left with slow weighty footwork, the spear tip dragging once across the wooden stage and creating a brief orange ember spark from a hidden stage effect. The Shadow-Reed Ninja lowers his stance on frame-right, turns one shoulder toward the dragon warrior, and shifts his blades into a crossed defensive position. The audience grows quieter for a moment, then a few people cheer as both performers begin circling toward center stage.
4s to 7s: The ninja moves first with two fast but readable diagonal blade strikes. The dragon warrior blocks the first strike with the spear shaft, turns his armored shoulder into the second strike, then answers with one broad horizontal spear sweep. The ninja ducks under the sweep, slides one foot across the stage, and lets the trailing green cloth flick behind him. Their weapons meet at center stage with a staged metallic clack. A small controlled dust burst rises from the floorboards around their boots. The phone camera jolts slightly as people in front lift their phones higher.
7s to 10s: The duel shifts into a fantasy stage illusion. The dragon warrior plants the spear into the stage with both hands, lowers his head, and the red glow inside his chest armor brightens from hidden LEDs. Thin orange smoke vents from the spear tip and curls upward. The ninja steps backward into a shadowed patch near the bamboo fence, flicks both blades outward, and two black silk ribbons snap open behind him like fast-moving shadow wings pulled by stage wires. The crowd gasps. The camera tries to keep both performers in frame, drifting slightly left then correcting back to center.
10s to 13s: Both performers charge toward the center mark in a controlled stage-combat rhythm. The dragon warrior drives the spear forward with a heavy two-handed thrust while the ninja spins aside and crosses both blades near the spear tip. At the exact contact point, a practical stage flash pops low to the floor, followed by a ring of dry leaves and dust pushed outward by a hidden air burst. The dragon warrior holds a powerful low stance, armor still glowing red. The ninja lands in a crouched side stance, one blade forward, one blade behind. The two freeze in a final dramatic face-off as the audience erupts into cheers, applause, whistles, and raised phones shaking in the foreground.
Camera behavior: continuous handheld smartphone POV from the audience, raised above shoulder level, slightly unsteady but physically grounded. The camera never becomes a professional cinematic camera. It keeps the crowd silhouettes in the lower foreground, occasionally catches nearby phone screens, and follows the performers with natural human reaction timing. The framing stays mostly medium-wide so the full stage combat remains readable, with brief focus hunting when the stage flash occurs.
Lighting: natural late-afternoon daylight from above and slightly frame-right, mixed with warm red practical stage lights hidden inside ember bowls, the dragon chest armor, and the spear tip. The ninja stays slightly cooler and darker near the bamboo-shadow side of the stage. The stage flash briefly lifts exposure on the center floorboards and nearby dust, then the image returns to ordinary phone-camera contrast.
Audio: live outdoor crowd ambience, phone microphone compression, excited audience voices close to the camera, wooden stage footwork, leather armor creaks, cloth ribbon snaps, staged metal weapon clacks, a low ember hiss from the dragon spear effect, a short smoke vent burst, one floor-level flash pop, dry leaves scattering, and loud applause at the final freeze pose.
Keep the Crimson Scale Wyrm Guardian’s horns, cheek scales, amber eyes, crimson scale armor, blackened spear, tail costume piece, heavy movement rhythm, and frame-left origin stable throughout. Keep the Shadow-Reed Ninja’s charcoal hood, half-face mask, ash-black outfit, dark green arm wraps, twin short blades, trailing green fabric, light movement rhythm, and frame-right origin stable throughout. Keep the shrine gate, stone dragon statues, bamboo fencing, ember bowls, wooden floorboards, audience silhouettes, phone POV, daylight direction, red stage glow, weapon scale, and final center-stage face-off consistent from start to finish.
Preserve original fantasy character identity, readable stage choreography, practical live-show effects, stable costume shapes, clear weapon positions, natural hand anatomy, believable body weight, consistent performer scale, grounded audience-camera movement, ordinary smartphone contrast, mild digital noise, realistic crowd reactions, and physically motivated fantasy stage spectacle.

zh.t: 幻想舞台激斗：龙与忍者
zh.p:
观众视角，真实的智能手机视频，展示了一场原创幻想户外舞台表演。画面是从拥挤的现场观众席中垂直拍摄，手机略高举在观众头顶上方。画面具有自然的手持摇晃、轻微的呼吸动作、短暂的聚焦狩猎、轻微的数字噪声、压缩的手机麦克风声音、普通的智能手机曝光，以及遮挡画面下边缘的人群剪影。
舞台是一个大型木质户外表演平台，作为虚构的山地神社竞技场建造：后方有裂开的红色神社门，两侧雕刻着石龙雕像，竹栅栏，悬挂着带有虚构书法的布横幅，深色木阶，雕刻岩石形态，舞台角落附近的小余烬碗，以及从舞台后方飘散的薄雾。舞台外可以看到高大的树木和淡淡的午后天空。观众们用深色头发的剪影、举起的手机、小型摄像机，以及偶尔指向舞台的手组成前景。
两位原创幻想表演者在舞台上对峙。
画面左侧是猩红鳞龙守护者：一位高大的男性龙形舞台表演者，体格健壮，下颌和手部可见深铜色皮肤，短而向后弯曲的深红色角，微妙的颊鳞义肢，琥珀色发光隐形眼镜，以及由哑光皮革制成的层层猩红鳞甲。他穿着厚重的深色腰带，黑色舞台靴，盔甲后方附着一件短而粗的龙尾服装，以及一根带有红色余烬状尖端的长矛。他的动作沉重、扎实且充满仪式感，就像一位古老的火焰守护者进入战斗。
画面右侧是影芦忍者：一位瘦削的年轻舞台表演者，动作迅速且受控，穿着灰黑色层叠忍者服，前臂裹着深绿色布料，戴着素色炭灰色兜帽，半面布面具，柔软的分趾舞台靴，以及两把短而弯曲的哑光黑色刀片。一条深绿色的细长布条从他背后拖下，随着每一步轻轻移动。他的动作轻盈、精准且富有战术性，就像森林刺客利用速度和误导。
0到4：手机摄像头微微抬高在人群之上，观众对两位表演者进入战斗标记做出反应。赤鳞巨龙守护者从画面左侧缓慢而沉重地步步向前，长矛尖端拖过木质舞台，制造出隐藏的舞台效果，发出短暂的橙色火星。影芦忍者在右侧框架下蹲，转过一肩朝向龙战士，双刃交叉防御。观众一度安静下来，随后几人欢呼，两位表演者开始向舞台中央环绕。
4秒到7秒：忍者先行动，先行两次快速但清晰的斜刃攻击。龙战士用长矛挡住了第一击，将铠甲肩膀转成第二击，随后以一记横扫的长矛回击。忍者钻过扫帚，一脚滑过舞台，让拖曳的绿色布料在身后轻轻飘动。他们的武器在舞台中央相遇，伴随着一声精心设计的金属碰撞声。一阵小小的受控尘土从他们靴子周围的地板上升起。前面的人把手机举得更高，手机摄像头微微晃动。
7到10：决斗转为幻想舞台幻象。龙战士双手将长矛插进舞台，低下头，胸甲内隐藏的LED灯让红色光芒更加明亮。细长的橙色烟雾从矛尖冒出，向上盘旋。忍者退后，进入竹篱附近的阴影，双刀向外一挥，两条黑色丝带在他身后啪地一声打开，像被舞台钢丝拉扯的快速影翼。观众倒吸一口气。摄像机试图保持两位演员在画面中，先稍微向左移动，然后又修正回中心。
10秒到13秒：两位表演者以受控的舞台格斗节奏冲向中心标记。龙战士用双手重力刺出长矛，忍者则侧身侧身，双刃交叉在矛尖附近。在准确的接触点，一道实用舞台闪光低垂，紧接着是一圈干叶和尘埃被隐藏的气流推动向外扩散。龙战士保持着强有力的低姿，盔甲依然泛着红光。忍者以蹲姿侧身落地，一刀向前，一刀在后。两人在最后的戏剧性对决中僵住，观众爆发出欢呼、掌声、口哨声，前景中举起的手机震动。
摄像机行为：观众持续手持智能手机视角，抬高于肩膀，略显不稳但身体稳定。摄像机从未成为专业的电影摄像机。它让观众的剪影出现在前景较低的位置，偶尔捕捉到附近的手机屏幕，并以自然的人类反应节奏跟随表演者。画面大多保持中宽，使全关战斗保持清晰可读，闪光时会短暂地进行对焦搜索。
光线：从上方自然的傍晚日光，稍微偏向画面，混合着隐藏在余烬碗内的温暖红色实用舞台灯光、龙胸甲和矛尖。忍者们在舞台的竹影侧保持稍微凉爽和暗淡。舞台闪光灯短暂提升中心地板和附近灰尘的曝光，随后画面恢复到普通手机相机对比度。
音频：现场户外观众氛围、手机麦克风压缩、观众兴奋的声音靠近镜头、木制舞台步法、皮甲吱吱作响、布质丝带扣响、金属武器碰撞声、龙矛效果的低沉火星嘶嘶声、短暂的烟雾喷发、一声地板闪光、干叶散落，以及最后定格姿势时的热烈掌声。
保持猩红鳞龙守护者的角、颊鳞、琥珀色眼睛、猩红鳞甲、黑化长矛、尾部服装、重动作节奏和左侧起始的稳定。保持影子芦苇忍者的炭灰色头罩、半面罩、灰黑色服装、深绿色护臂、双短刃、拖曳绿色布料、轻柔的移动节奏和帧右起点始终稳定。保持神社大门、石龙雕像、竹栅栏、余烬碗、木地板、观众剪影、手机视角、日光引导、红色舞台光辉、武器比例以及最终舞台中央对决，从头到尾保持一致。
保留原创奇幻角色身份、可读的舞台编排、真实的现场演出特效、稳定的服装造型、清晰的武器姿势、自然的手部结构、可信的体重、一致的表演者比例、接地气的观众镜头运动、普通智能手机对比、温和的数字噪声、逼真的观众反应以及身体驱动的奇幻舞台奇观。

raw_p:
Cinematic horror short film, 15 seconds, ultra-realistic, seamless continuous story progression, dark and suspenseful atmosphere, professional horror movie cinematography.

0s–2s

The scene opens in a dark upstairs bedroom at night. A man is sleeping peacefully in bed. Soft moonlight enters through the window, creating long shadows across the room. The camera slowly glides from the doorway toward the bed in a smooth cinematic dolly shot. The house is completely silent.

2s–4s

A faint disturbing crawling sound suddenly emerges from somewhere downstairs. The sound resembles wet claws slowly scraping across wooden floors. The sleeping man slightly reacts. The camera slowly pushes closer to his face. The sound grows louder and more unsettling. His eyes abruptly open.

4s–6s

Close-up on his frightened expression. He listens carefully. Another crawling noise echoes from below. He slowly sits upright. The camera circles around him in a slow arc while the sounds continue moving somewhere beneath the bedroom floor.

6s–8s

He cautiously gets out of bed. Tracking shot from behind as he walks toward the bedroom door. The camera follows closely over his shoulder. The hallway outside is dark. The crawling noises continue downstairs, sometimes stopping, then starting again from another location.

8s–11s

He steps into the hallway and slowly approaches the staircase. The camera switches to a low-angle shot in front of him as he descends the stairs carefully. Every step creaks. The sound below becomes clearer and more aggressive. The camera alternates smoothly between:

Over-the-shoulder tracking shots

Side profile shots

Low staircase shots looking upward

Slow handheld movements that increase tension

11s–13s

Reaching the bottom of the stairs, he stops. The camera slowly rotates around him. Horrific sounds suddenly begin coming from different rooms of the house—first the kitchen, then the living room, then directly behind him. Each sound is matched by subtle camera turns and quick pans toward the source, but nothing is visible.

13s–15s

Total silence.

The man stands frozen.

Suddenly a deep demonic laugh erupts from upstairs inside the bedroom he just left.

The camera instantly whips upward toward the staircase. At the top of the stairs, only darkness is visible. The laugh echoes through the house as the camera slowly pushes toward the darkness.

Fade to black.

Visual Style

Realistic horror movie

Psychological dread

Smooth scene-to-scene flow

No visible monster

Dynamic camera work driven by sound direction

Dark blue moonlit color grading

Volumetric lighting

Realistic shadows

Slow tension build-up

Hollywood horror cinematography

Natural character movement

Seamless transitions

High detail, photorealistic, cinematic 24fps, suspenseful and terrifying atmosphere.

zh.p:
电影级恐怖短片，15秒，超写实，无缝连贯的故事推进，黑暗悬疑氛围，专业恐怖电影摄影。

0至2

场景开场于夜晚的一间黑暗楼上卧室。一个男人安静地睡在床上。柔和的月光透过窗户洒进来，在房间里投下长长的影子。镜头缓缓从门口滑向床铺，呈现出流畅的电影推车镜头。房子里一片寂静。

2至4年制

突然，楼下某处传来一阵微弱的爬行声。那声音像湿爪慢慢刮过木地板。熟睡的男人微微反应。镜头慢慢靠近他的脸。声音变得更大，越来越令人不安。他的眼睛猛地睁开。

4至6岁

特写他害怕的表情。他仔细听着。又一声爬行的声音从下方回荡。他慢慢坐直了身子。摄像机缓缓绕着他转圈，声音在卧室地板下继续移动。

6至8岁

他小心翼翼地下床。他走向卧室门时，背后有追踪镜头。摄像机紧随他的肩膀后方。外面的走廊一片黑暗。爬行声在楼下持续，有时停止，有时又从别处响起。

8至11岁

他走进走廊，慢慢走向楼梯。镜头切换到他前方的低角度镜头，他小心翼翼地下楼。每一步都吱吱作响。下方的声音变得更清晰、更具攻击性。摄像机在以下画面间平滑切换：

肩膀上方跟踪镜头

侧面照片

俯瞰的低楼梯镜头

慢速手持动作增加紧张感

11至13岁

走到楼梯底下，他停下了脚步。摄像机缓缓围绕他旋转。恐怖的声音突然从房子的不同房间传来——先是厨房，然后是客厅，最后就在他身后。每个声音都配合细微的摄像机转向和快速平移，但什么都看不见。

13至15岁

完全的寂静。

那人僵在原地。

突然，楼上他刚离开的卧室里爆发出一声低沉的恶魔笑声。

镜头立刻向上拉向楼梯。楼梯顶端，只有黑暗可见。笑声在屋内回荡，镜头缓缓推进黑暗。

画面渐渐变黑。

视觉风格

现实恐怖电影

心理恐惧

场景间流畅

没有明显的怪物

由声音方向驱动的动态摄影

深蓝色月光调色

体积光照

逼真的阴影

缓慢的张力积累

好莱坞恐怖摄影

自然字符移动

无缝衔接

高细节、照片级真实感、电影般的24帧每秒，紧张又恐怖的氛围。

raw_p:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 
Night in a futuristic neon city. 

A courier in a sleek helmeted suit escapes between two glass skyscrapers using a real zipline cable. The courier is always physically attached to the zipline: both hands gripping a visible metal handle, the handle connected to a rolling pulley clipped around the cable, body hanging below the cable. No flying, no hovering, no standing on the cable.

Opening close shot: both gloved hands grab the metal zipline handle. The pulley locks onto the cable with sparks. The courier hangs below the line and launches forward.
Wide shot: the courier slides fast along the cable between skyscrapers, body hanging beneath the zipline, legs trailing behind from the speed. 

The city glows far below. Two drones follow behind.
Side tracking shot: the courier continues gripping the handle tightly as the pulley rolls across the cable. Wind pulls at the suit. The cable is clearly visible above the courier in every shot.

Mid-sequence: the zipline cable begins sparking and shaking. The courier still hangs from the handle as the pulley speeds toward a nearby office tower.

Final 5 seconds: the cable snaps near the end. The courier, still holding the handle, swings forward with the broken cable like a pendulum, crashes through a large glass office window, slides across the floor, gets up immediately, and runs toward the rooftop exit as drones enter behind.

Final moment: the courier bursts onto the rooftop, still holding the broken zipline handle, with shattered glass and neon city lights behind.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense, fast but readable, strong height, clear zipline mechanics, visible cable, visible handle, visible pulley, no flying person, no hovering, no standing on cable, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

zh.p:
超现实的电影动作场面，
未来霓虹城市的夜晚。

一名穿着时尚头盔服的信使利用真正的滑索缆绳从两座玻璃摩天大楼之间逃脱。快递员始终与滑索紧密相连：双手握着可见的金属手柄，手柄连接着扣在缆绳上的滚轮，身体悬挂在缆绳下方。不能飞，不能悬停，不能站在钢索上。

开场特写：双手戴手套的手抓住金属滑索把手。滑轮通过火花锁定钢索。信使悬挂在绳下，向前冲去。
广角镜头：快递员沿着摩天大楼间的缆绳快速滑行，身体悬挂在滑索下，双腿因速度拖在后面。

城市在远处闪耀着光芒。两架无人机紧随其后。
侧向跟踪镜头：快递员继续紧握手柄，滑轮滚动在缆索上。风拉扯着战衣。每张照片中，电缆清晰可见在快递员上方。

中段：滑索开始火花四溅并摇晃。快递员仍挂在把手上，滑轮高速驶向附近的办公楼。

最后5秒：电缆在快结束时断裂。信使仍握着把手，带着断裂的电缆像钟摆一样向前摆动，撞破一扇大玻璃办公室窗户，滑过地板，立刻站起，朝屋顶出口跑去，无人机紧随其后进入。

最后时刻：快递员冲上屋顶，手里还握着破损的滑索把手，身后是破碎的玻璃和霓虹灯。

风格：超写实、电影感、紧张感、快速但易读、高度清晰、滑索机制清晰、可见的缆绳、可见的把手、可见滑轮、无飞行人员、无悬停、无站立、无文字、无标志、无卡通风格、无慢动作。保持比例。保持风格和特征。宽高比为16：9。

Explosions chain across the tower as the fighter screams past it at full velocity, fireballs and sparks blasting across the canopy, the vertical red beam destabilizing, violent screen shake rattling the frame. Tracer fire and enemy fighters whip past the cockpit in flashes as the jet blazes onward.

zh.t: 赛博朋克战机极速扫射
zh.p:
重要提示：忽略叠加在参考图上的手绘红色曲线和红色箭头注释——它们不属于场景。请勿渲染、动画或以任何方式包含它们。它们仅指示战斗机的预定飞行路径。把背后的赛博朋克城市当作真正的场景来看待。

将这座赛博朋克巨城动画化为一场肾上腺素激增、高速的第一人称驾驶舱视角星际战机扫射攻击，单次连续镜头。摄像机本身就是战斗机——沉浸式的前向飞行员视角，以极高超音速在城市中飞驰，从不减速，边移动边开火。

战斗机低空快速地飞越右下角发光的滨水运河，距离水面仅数米，霓虹灯的反光在下方形成划痕。它突然切换成剧烈的左转右弯，全速穿梭于高耸的摩天大楼之间，穿过高架高速公路，净空数英寸——建筑物在画面边缘飞驰而过，光影划破画面边缘，模糊地穿过画面，重度运动模糊，径向速度线交织。加力燃烧室伴随着爆发加速。即使在穿梭中，驾驶员也已经开始开火——双激光炮连续向前猛击，撕裂建筑和掠过的敌方炮塔，火花和碎片沿途爆炸却不减速。

中央的黑色反派塔楼迅速升起，填满视野。战斗机没有减速，而是在巨大的尖塔周围划出一道高速扫射弧线，猛烈转弯，同时不断发射密集的炮火——激光火力和导弹齐射，快速斜向掠过塔楼红金相间的徽章。爆炸连锁在塔楼上蔓延，战斗机以全速尖叫着掠过，火球和火花在树冠上飞溅，垂直的红色光束使画面不稳定，剧烈的屏幕震动震动着整个画面。闪电弹和敌方战斗机在驾驶舱前方掠过，喷气机继续前进。

采用变形镜头拍摄，浅景深，光泽鲜艳的抛光大片风格，丰富的饱和霓虹色彩，明亮的高光和干净的反射，流畅的未来感光泽，深邃的黑色配以发光点缀，极度动能，激烈的运动模糊和光影，极快的摄影，流畅的电影级24fps运动，伴随突发速度爆发，轻微色差和优雅的镜头光晕。沉浸式视角，极快的速度，戏剧性的摄像机震动，体积雾霾，超细致的高预算科幻电影画面，16：9比例。

raw_p: Remote futuristic Arctic research station during polar night. Endless snowstorm. Blue floodlights illuminating giant ice fields surrounding the facility. Scientists working normally inside warm industrial corridors when distant seismic alarms suddenly activate. Outside: the massive frozen landscape begins shifting. Not cracking randomly, but moving. Entire mountains of ice slowly sliding toward the station like something enormous beneath the surface is pushing upward. A female engineer rushes through the station while outside: gigantic fractures spread across the ice for kilometers. Towering frozen walls collapse into dark water below. Communication antennas bend from tremors. Snow vehicles flip sideways. Then: a gigantic glowing shape briefly moves beneath the translucent ice sheet. raw_p: 0.0–1.5 Shot 1 — Horde reveal Quick fukan wide. Ancient ruin city filled with broken towers, cracked plazas, fallen arches, drifting dust, and swarming demon hordes. Solene stands alone on a shattered stone platform, black-and-gold coat fluttering, white curls lit by the stormy sky, Starlight Recurve Bow in hand. Establishes the battlefield, scale, and Solene as the lone center of control. Open on demon motion, then settle on Solene’s still silhouette. 1.5–3.1 Shot 2 — Vertical launch Aori angle. Solene immediately leaps upward from the platform, kicking dust and stone fragments loose. The city falls away beneath him as the dark gray cloud ceiling above slowly twists into a vortex. Starts the action instantly and sends the scene vertical. His upward movement inherits the battlefield pressure and points directly toward the sky. 3.1–4.8 Shot 3 — Skyward aim Midair hero shot. Solene steadies himself in the air and raises the bow high toward the sky, clearly aiming at the vortex before release. He draws a glowing starlight arrow while holding the bow in a strong skyward silhouette. Pale blue energy gathers along the string, limbs, and arrowhead. Makes the action intention unmistakable: he is invoking the sky. The leap peaks into a held aiming pose, creating a clean breath before release. 4.8–6.0 Shot 4 — Solene releases. The starlight arrow shoots straight upward into the center of the vortex, carving a luminous path through the cloud mass. Sparkling fractures spread across the clouds like cracks in the sky. This is the trigger event that activates the large-scale technique. Hold the raised-bow pose for a beat, then cut on release and follow the arrow upward. 6.0–7.4 Shot 5 — Street-level among the demon horde. Multiple demons look up as glittering star-like points begin appearing inside the cracked cloud vortex. Their faces are lit by pale blue light as the sky starts to shimmer. Sells enemy dread and lets the audience feel the scale from below. Match the arrow’s upward movement to the demons’ eyeline looking skyward. 7.4–8.8 Shot 6 — Tight close-up On Solene, suspended in the air. His luminous blue eyes glow; wind moves through his white curls and coat collar. He lowers the bow slightly and calmly speaks the name of his technique: “Starlight Cataclysm.” Gives the attack a signature identity and creates a final beat before the payoff. Cut from demon fear back to Solene’s calm control. 8.8–12.2 Shot 7 Explosive arrow rain One beat later, the cloud vortex tears open. Millions of luminous arrows begin raining down across the ruin city in massive layered sheets. Every arrow impact causes a massive explosion — huge bursts of starlight, expanding shockwaves, collapsing rooftops, shattered towers, flying rubble, and chained detonations ripping through demon formations and entire streets. Main payoff shot: overwhelming destruction at city scale. The spoken technique name becomes the cue for instant celestial bombardment. 12.2–15.0 Shot 8 Camera pulls far back to an extreme wide. The whole ancient ruin city is engulfed in explosive celestial impacts, demons erased in waves, plazas vanishing under light and debris, towers collapsing under chained detonations. Solene remains high beneath the vortex as a small, calm figure above the devastation. Final scale reveal and strong visual landing. Pull back from local destruction to total battlefield consequence.

zh.p: 0.0–1.5 第一击 — 部落迅速揭示 fukan 偏出。古老的废墟城市，满是破碎的高塔、裂开的广场、倒塌的拱门、飘散的尘埃和蜂拥而至的恶魔大军。索伦独自站在破碎的石台上，黑金色的外套飘扬，白色卷发被暴风雨的天空照亮，手握星光反曲弓。确立战场、规模，以及索伦作为唯一的控制中心。随着恶魔的动作打开，然后停在索琳静止的轮廓上。1.5–3.1 镜头2 — 垂直发射的青织角度。索琳立刻从平台上跃起，踢开尘土和石块碎片。城市在他脚下渐渐消失，头顶深灰色的云顶缓缓扭曲成漩涡。它能立即启动动作，并将场景垂直移动。他的上升动作继承了战场压力，直接指向天空。3.1–4.8 第三枪 — 向天空瞄准 空中英雄射击。索琳稳住身形，将弓高高举向天空，显然是瞄准旋涡后释放。他拉出一支发光的星光箭，手持弓，形成坚定的天空轮廓。淡蓝色的能量沿着弦、四肢和箭头聚集。使行动意图无误：他在呼唤天空。跳跃达到保持瞄准姿势，呼吸干净，然后释放。4.8–6.0 第四镜头 — 索伦释放。星光箭矢直直向上射入漩涡中心，在云团中开辟出一条明亮的路径。闪烁的裂缝像天空的裂缝一样蔓延在云层上。这就是激活大规模技术的触发事件。保持弓高姿一拍，放箭时停下，跟随箭向上。6.0–7.4 第五镜头 — 恶魔大军中的街头层。多个恶魔抬头望去，闪烁的星形点开始出现在破裂的云涡中。他们的脸被淡蓝色的光芒照亮，天空开始闪烁。它能传递敌人的恐惧感，让观众从下方感受到规模。将箭头向上的运动与恶魔望向天空的视线相匹配。7.4–8.8 第六镜头 — 索伦悬浮在空中的近距离特写。他那双明亮的蓝眼睛闪烁着光芒;风吹过他白色卷发和外套领口。他微微放下弓，平静地说出自己的招式名称：“星光灾变。”赋予攻击标志性身份，并在回报前创造最后的节拍。从恶魔的恐惧切回索琳的冷静控制。8.8–12.2 射击7 爆炸箭雨 一拍后，云涡撕裂。数百万支发光箭矢开始以厚重层叠的层状雨落在废墟城市上。每一支箭矢命中都引发巨大爆炸——巨大的星光爆发、扩展的冲击波、坍塌的屋顶、破碎的高塔、飞散的瓦砾，以及撕裂恶魔阵型和整条街道的锁链爆炸。主要回报：城市规模的压倒性破坏。口语技巧的名称成为瞬间天体轰击的信号。12.2–15.0 镜头8 镜头大幅拉远至极广。整个古代废墟城市被爆炸性的天体冲击吞没，恶魔被波浪抹去，广场被光芒和碎片掩盖，高塔在链条爆炸下倒塌。索伦依然高高地矗立在漩涡之下，作为一个小而平静的身影，俯瞰着毁灭之中。最终的尺度揭示和强烈的视觉冲击。从局部毁灭转向全面战场后果。

0-4s: Wide low-angle tracking shot following the hero sprinting through an ancient stone corridor. Sudden massive collapse behind him. Camera accelerates into a fast tracking shot as the floor cracks and drops away.

4-8s: Extreme dolly zoom (vertigo effect) on the hero’s face as he leaps across a widening chasm — background rushes toward camera while zooming in, creating strong disorientation. Hero twists mid-air grabbing a swinging chain.

8-12s: Dynamic orbiting camera spinning 180° around the hero while he swings across collapsing platforms. Camera tilts wildly with the falling debris, inducing vertigo. Hero runs across a tilting stone bridge that is breaking apart.

12-15s: Final desperate leap toward sunlight as the entire temple collapses into a massive sinkhole. Camera spins and drops with him in freefall, slow-motion rotation, ending with a dramatic pull-back as he lands on safe ground outside. Heavy motion blur on fast elements, coherent physics, intense energy.

Ultra-detailed stone textures, cinematic lighting, perfect motion blur, high dynamic range, stable character, movie-level stability.

0-4：宽广的低角度跟踪镜头，跟随英雄在古老的石头走廊中奔跑。突然，他身后传来巨大的坍塌。镜头加速进入快速镜头，地板裂开并下沉。

4-8：主角脸部极端的推车变焦（眩晕效果）在他跳跃越过越来越大的深渊时——背景在拉近时冲向镜头，造成强烈的迷失感。英雄在空中扭转，抓住一根摇晃的链条。

8-12：动态旋转摄像机围绕英雄旋转180度，同时他在坍塌的平台上荡来荡去。镜头随着坠落的碎片剧烈倾斜，令人头晕目眩。英雄跑过一座正在崩裂的倾斜石桥。

12-15秒：最后一次绝望的跃向阳光，整个神庙坍塌成一个巨大的天坑。镜头随着他自由落体、慢动作旋转，最终以他落在安全地面时做出戏剧性的拉回收尾。快速元素上的强烈运动模糊，连贯的物理效果，强烈的能量。

raw_p: A montage in the style of degraded 16mm archive film, warm faded colours, heavy grain, gate weave and occasional scratches. A handheld shot of children spilling out of a school gate in flared trousers and tank tops. A postman in a red Royal Mail jacket, grey trousers and a post bag walking along a terraced street at dawn. A football terrace packed with fans in matching red and white club colours, scarves held aloft above their heads, mouths open in song. A static shot of a launderette in the afternoon, sun falling through the front window, a row of machines turning, a woman folding washing on the counter. A seaside promenade where a donkey gives rides along the sand, children on its back, deckchairs and a Punch and Judy stand behind. A paperboy cycling no-handed past a row of parked Ford Cortinas. No music. No subtitles.

 ○○と ○○ は登場人物

　0:00‐0:03　画面が不規則な格子状に複数分割され、それぞれの枠内で ○○ の差し伸べる手、きらめく星の粉が激しいコマ撮り風に高速で切り替わる。
　0:03‐0:06　斜めのスプリットスクリーン。一方の枠に ○○ の星型の瞳孔、もう一方の枠に逆流する砂時計のコラージュが配置され、高速にズームインとズームアウトを繰り返す。
　0:06‐0:09　画面分割の枠線（黒い太線）が、ノイズのように激しく左右に振動（グリッチ）し始める。枠線の中に極彩色のテクスチャが明滅する。
　0:09‐0:12　画面全体の分割レイアウトが時計回りにガタガタと90度ずつ激しく回転し、それぞれの枠内の絵柄が瞬間的にフラッシュバックする。
　0:12‐0:15　○○ と ○○ のシルエットが交互に画面中央でフラッシュしながら、すべての分割枠が激しいブレ（スミア）を伴って画面中央へ吸い込まれていく。

0:00-0:03 The screen is divided into irregular grids, and within each frame, ○○'s outstretched hand and sparkling stardust rapidly switch to a fast, stop-motion style.
　0:03-0:06 Diagonal split screen. On one frame is a star-shaped pupil of ○○, and on the other, a collage of a reverse-flowing hourglass is placed, repeatedly zooming in and out at high speed.

Front-camera selfie footage mixed with back-camera stadium footage. Natural handheld movement. Micro-shakes. Motion blur. Autofocus breathing. Rolling shutter wobble. HDR processing. 24fps. 26mm lens equivalent. AUDIO (VERY IMPORTANT) The stadium atmosphere is EXTREMELY loud. Crowd chants. Drums. Whistles. Fans singing. Constant football crowd ambience. The creator must intentionally SPEAK LOUDLY and PROJECT HER VOICE like a real football vlogger trying to be heard above the crowd. Her voice must always remain louder than the background noise. Dialogue must sound energetic, clear, excited, and easy to understand. No mumbling. No whispering. No quiet speech. No narration voice. She is speaking directly into the phone microphone at close range. Scene 1 (0–3s) — Outside Stadium Front-facing selfie outside a packed New York football stadium. Thousands of Argentina fans wave flags behind her. She holds the Argentina Stanley bottle toward the camera. LOUDLY speaking into the phone: "Right guys! We're in New York for the Argentina match!" Crowd chants continue behind her. Scene 2 (3–6s) — Inside The Stadium Front-facing selfie from her seat. The pitch is visible behind her. She has to slightly raise her voice over the crowd. She says: "Listen to this atmosphere! It's unbelievable!" Scene 3 (6–9s) — Argentina Attack Back-camera footage. Argentina attack toward goal. Crowd tension rises. She shouts from behind the camera: "Come on Argentina! Keep going!" Scene 4 (9–12s) — Big Chance Back-camera follows the attack. Fans rise from their seats. Crowd volume increases dramatically. She yells: "Shoot! Shoot!" Scene 5 (12–15s) — Goal Celebration Back-camera captures Argentina scoring. The crowd explodes. Flags wave everywhere. Camera shakes from excitement. Quick cut to front-facing selfie. She is jumping, laughing, and screaming with excitement while holding the Stanley bottle. She shouts clearly: "GOAAAL! I actually go"

zh.p: 制作一段15秒的超真实电影感影响者UGC足球视频。重要的身份一致性：使用上传的图片作为准确的人物参考。在每个场景中，保持相同的面部特征、脸型、发型、体型、肤色、妆容和身份认同。角色 年轻的英国女性足球影响者。身材苗条，运动型。轮廓分明的下颌线。高颧骨。长长的黑发。全套魅力网红妆容。阿根廷支持者脸部彩绘。阿根廷支持者帽。服装：官方阿根廷主场球衣 白色短裤 白色运动鞋 阿根廷主题的斯坦利保温杯 视频风格 真实感 iPhone 14 Pro TikTok vlog。前摄像机自拍与后景体育场画面混合。自然的手持移动。微摇。运动模糊。自动对焦呼吸。快门摇晃。HDR处理。24帧每秒。相当于26mm镜头。音频（非常重要）：体育场的氛围非常吵闹。人群齐声呼喊。鼓。哨子。粉丝们在唱歌。持续不断的橄榄球观众氛围。创作者必须故意大声说话，并像真正的足球视频博主一样投射声音，试图在人群中脱颖而出。她的声音必须始终比背景噪音更大。对话必须听起来充满活力、清晰、兴奋且易于理解。别嘟囔。没有低语。没有低声的演讲。没有旁白声音。她正近距离对着电话麦克风说话。场景1（0–3秒）——体育场外 纽约橄榄球场外的正面自拍。成千上万的阿根廷球迷在她身后挥舞国旗。她把阿根廷斯坦利酒瓶举向镜头。大声对着电话说：“好了，伙计们！我们来纽约看阿根廷比赛！”身后人群的呼喊声仍在继续。第二场（3–6秒）——体育场内 她坐在座位上正面自拍。球场在她身后清晰可见。她不得不稍微提高声音，穿过人群。她说：“听听这氛围！简直难以置信！”场景3（6–9秒）——阿根廷袭击 后置镜头。阿根廷向球门进攻。观众紧张感升高。她在镜头后喊道：“加油，阿根廷！继续！”第四场（9–12秒）——大机会 后景跟踪袭击过程。球迷们从座位上站起来。观众人数大幅增加。她喊道：“开枪！开枪！”第5场（12–15秒）——进球庆祝 后摄像机捕捉阿根廷进球。人群爆发了。旗帜随处飘扬。摄像机因兴奋而晃动。快速切到正面自拍。她兴奋地跳跃、笑着、尖叫着，手里拿着斯坦利瓶。她清晰地喊道：“进球！我真的去了。”

raw_p: 精细的手绘动画，80年代复古OVA风格。场景一：在埃及皇家宫殿内，强大的胡狼神阿努比斯和强大的鳄鱼神索贝克并肩而立，共同举起一块巨石，他们神情紧绷，全神贯注地努力保持巨石在头顶上方。一位人类法老缓缓走在他们面前，双手背在身后，注视着他们，观察着谁能将巨石举得更久。法老说道：“你们之中只有一人能陪我执行下一个任务，只有最强者。”阿努比斯和索贝克相距一米，法老站在他们面前。场景二：索贝克突然灵光一闪，脸上浮现出一丝狡黠的笑容。他微微侧头看向阿努比斯，脸上带着一丝狡黠的微笑，尾巴尖伸向阿努比斯的腋窝。阿努比斯依然目视前方，全然不顾周围的一切，一心只想举起头顶的巨石。场景3：特写镜头展现索贝克的尾巴尖轻柔地、流畅地拂过阿努比斯的腋窝，背景中传来阿努比斯压抑的笑声，表明他非常怕痒。场景4：特写镜头展现阿努比斯的上半身，索贝克的尾巴尖持续轻柔地拂过阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯闭着眼睛，咧嘴大笑，发出压抑的笑声，竭尽全力地举起头顶的巨石。场景5：索贝克的尾巴尖继续挠着阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯闭着眼睛，发出响亮的笑声。腋下挠痒痒的戏码还在继续，阿努比斯哈哈大笑，然后扔掉身后的巨石，抱紧自己，挠痒痒的感觉就此消失。阿努比斯跌倒在地，仍然因为刚才的笑声而捧腹大笑，抱紧自己。索贝克头顶还举着巨石，满意地看着这一切。场景6：人类法老向索贝克点点头，说道：“看来你就是那个人。”此时阿努比斯还躺在地上，因为刚才的笑声而咯咯地笑着。索贝克和阿努比斯都肌肉发达。他们都戴着臂环。阿努比斯还戴着颈环。他们的声音都浑厚有力。语音为英文。

en.p: Finely hand-drawn animation, 1980s retro OVA style. Scene 1: Inside the Egyptian royal palace, the mighty jackal god Anubis and the mighty crocodile god Sobek stand side by side, jointly lifting a huge boulder. Their expressions tense as they focus intently to keep the boulder above their heads. A human pharaoh walked slowly before them, hands behind his back, watching them and watching who could lift the boulder longer. The Pharaoh said, "Only one of you can accompany me on the next mission, only the strongest." Anubis and Sobek were a meter apart, with the Pharaoh standing before them. Scene 2: Suddenly, Sobek had a flash of inspiration, a sly smile appearing on his face. He tilted his head slightly to look at Anubis, a sly smile on his face, his tail tip reaching toward Anubis's armpit. Anubis still stared ahead, completely ignoring everything around him, focused solely on lifting the boulder overhead. Scene 3: Close-up shows Sobek's tail tip gently and smoothly brushing Anubis's armpit, accompanied by Anubis's suppressed laughter in the background, indicating he is very sensitive to itching. Scene 4: Close-up showing Anubis's upper body, with Sobek's tail tip gently brushing Anubis's armpit. Anubis closed his eyes, grinning widely, letting out suppressed laughter, and lifting the boulder overhead with all his might. Scene 5: Sobek's tail tip continues to tickle Anubis's armpit, who closes his eyes and lets out a loud laugh. The tickling under his armpits continued. Anubis laughed heartily, then threw away the boulder behind him, hugged himself tightly, and the tickling sensation disappeared. Anubis fell to the ground, still laughing heartily at the laughter just now, hugging himself tightly. Sobek was still holding a huge stone above his head, watching everything with satisfaction. Scene 6: The human pharaoh nodded to Sobek and said, "It seems you are the one." At this moment, Anubis was still lying on the ground, giggling from the earlier laughter. Sobek and Anubis are both muscular. They all wear armbands. Anubis also wore a necklace. Their voices were deep and powerful. The audio is in English.

Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9. 

Inside an ancient temple built deep within an active volcano, glowing lava lights the stone corridors with fiery orange and red reflections. The temple is filled with massive carved pillars, narrow bridges, falling embers, smoke, heat shimmer, and collapsing stone sections. A lone explorer in rugged adventure gear carries a glowing artifact and races through the temple as the environment becomes unstable.  

Camera angle 1: wide cinematic opening shot, the explorer runs through a vast volcanic temple chamber with towering stone statues and rivers of lava below. The glowing artifact lights his hands and chest while the ground shakes and cracks begin spreading across the floor.  

Camera angle 2: dynamic tracking shot, the explorer sprints across a narrow stone bridge suspended above lava, while pieces of the bridge crumble behind him. Sparks, ash, and heat waves fill the air, and molten light reflects across the ancient carved walls.  

Camera angle 3: dramatic side shot, giant stone guardian figures begin to move in the background as the explorer races through a collapsing corridor. He ducks under falling debris, leaps over a broken section of floor, and keeps moving toward the exit.  Final action beat: the explorer reaches the temple opening just as lava surges through the chamber behind him. He jumps across one final collapsing gap and lands near the exit while firelight and smoke burst outward from the temple interior.  Final moment: the explorer emerges onto a rocky ledge outside the volcano, holding the glowing artifact, while smoke, embers, and fiery light pour from the temple entrance behind him. 

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense and fast-paced, ancient temple atmosphere, volcanic lighting, lava glow, smoke, embers, collapsing stone, dramatic scale, strong sense of danger and motion, fast but readable camera movement, high detail, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion.

镜头角度3：戏剧性的侧面镜头，巨大的石头守护者在背景中开始移动，探险者在坍塌的走廊中飞驰。他钻过坠落的碎片，跳过破碎的地板，继续朝出口前进。 最终动作节拍：探险者抵达神庙开口时，熔岩正从他身后的密室涌出。他跳过最后一个坍塌的缺口，落在出口附近，火光和烟雾从寺庙内部喷涌而出。 最后时刻：探险者走出火山外的岩石台阶，手持发光的神器，身后神庙入口处喷涌出烟雾、余烬和炽热光芒。

A lone swimmer struggles in the middle of a dark ocean. Massive waves rise and crash around them while rain lashes the water surface. Lightning flashes illuminate the endless sea.

The camera follows just above the waterline as the swimmer is repeatedly submerged beneath towering waves.

Suddenly everything becomes quiet.

The camera transitions underwater as the person slowly sinks into the deep blue darkness beneath the storm.

A strange calm surrounds them.

The transformation begins subtly. Fingers lengthen and merge. Arms become more streamlined. The ribcage expands dramatically while muscles reshape for aquatic power.

The camera circles around the body as skin gradually develops the smooth black-and-white pigmentation of an orca. Water flows naturally across the changing anatomy.

The spine lengthens. Legs merge into a powerful tail structure. The body becomes increasingly hydrodynamic while retaining realistic biological transitions throughout the transformation.

Schools of fish begin circling the transforming figure. Bubbles spiral upward through shafts of light penetrating the ocean surface far above.

The transformation accelerates. A dorsal fin emerges. Powerful tail flukes form. The figure grows rapidly in size as ocean currents respond to the awakening predator.

The newly transformed orca glides effortlessly through the water. Every movement is fluid, powerful, and graceful.

Final cinematic moment: the massive orca surges upward from the depths and breaches through a towering wave into the stormy sky. Water explodes around the body in slow motion as lightning illuminates the black-and-white silhouette against the clouds.

The camera follows the breach before the orca crashes back into the ocean and disappears beneath the dark surface.

15秒的超电影级写实水域变身戏，伴随北大西洋暴风雨的暮光。

一名孤独的游泳者在黑暗的海洋中央挣扎。巨浪在他们周围翻腾拍打，雨水拍打着水面。闪电照亮了无尽的大海。

镜头紧随水面上方，游泳者反复被高耸的波浪淹没。

突然间，一切都变得安静下来。

镜头切换到水下，那个人缓缓沉入风暴下的深蓝色黑暗中。

一种奇异的平静环绕着他们。

转变开始得很微妙。手指变长并合在一起。手臂变得更加流线型。肋骨大幅扩张，肌肉则为水力而重塑。

镜头环绕着身体，皮肤逐渐呈现出虎鲸光滑的黑白色素。水自然流经不断变化的解剖结构。

脊柱会变长。腿部融合成强壮的尾部结构。身体在保持真实的生物转变过程中，逐渐变得水动力学化。

鱼群开始围绕着变形的身影转圈。气泡通过穿透远高海面的光束螺旋上升。

水流轻柔流动，反射和光线闪烁

Scene: a large woodworking factory with three connected areas: joinery workshop, CNC machine shop with enclosed idle CNC routers and dust extraction pipes, and warehouse aisles with timber racks, pallets, plywood sheets, toolboxes and workbenches. Warm sunset beams shine through high windows, sawdust floating in the light, polished concrete floor, hand-painted industrial background.

4.4–5.7s, low 3/4 front angle beside the enclosed CNC machine shop, Yuna performs a fast kickflip, brief slow motion as the board flips under her feet.

请参考附带的角色卡，作为尤娜兔子的参考：金发扎成两个低发髻，绿色头巾绑在头顶，明亮的蓝眼睛，晒黑皮肤，合身的蓝色T恤，卡其色磨损牛仔短裤，白色运动鞋，运动型且活泼的肢体语言，自信且开朗的表情。在整个视频中保持她的脸、发型、服装和比例保持一致。通过自信、活力和动作展现她的美丽，而不是通过性化的镜头角度。

场景：一座大型木工厂，设有三个相连区域：木工车间、带封闭式空闲数控铣床和除尘管道的数控机床车间，以及仓库通道，配有木材架、托盘、胶合板、工具箱和工作台。温暖的夕阳光束透过高窗洒进来，锯末在光线中飘浮，抛光的混凝土地板，手绘的工业背景。

0.0–1.2秒，木工厂的广角景，温暖的阳光，空中飘着锯末，优奈从远处滑进画面。
1.2–2.2秒，极近距离描绘滑板轮子在抛光混凝土上滚动，她的白色运动鞋用力加速。
2.2–3.2秒，镜头转向尤娜的脸，她回头看着她，脸上带着自信而愉快的笑容，绿色头巾飘扬。
3.2–4.4秒，侧向追踪，尤娜完成干净利落的奥利跳，越过一堆低木块，顺利落地。
4.4–5.7秒，低3/4前方角度，靠近封闭的CNC机床车间，Yuna做了一个快速的kickflip，滑板在她脚下翻转时短暂慢动作。
5.7–6.9秒，前推车镜头向后穿过仓库通道，尤娜在高架和托盘之间进行长长的手动操作。
6.9–8.0秒，俯视动态镜头，她紧密地在木工工作台上切割，精准地穿梭于木材边料间。
8.0–9.3秒，先是广角镜头，然后快速特写，尤娜跳上低矮的金属安全栏杆，做了一个干净的滑板滑行，然后着陆。
9.3–10.5秒，低角度拍摄，靠近倾斜的胶合板，换成短鼻手动挡，平衡且时尚。
10.5–12.0秒，动态跟踪镜头，尤娜短暂骑上一面安全的斜木墙，然后又落回混凝土地面。
12.0–13.5秒，开放工厂车间，她完成干净的360度推踢，完美接住滑板，落地风格强劲。
13.5–15.0秒，最后一个低角度英雄镜头，优奈用一只脚停住滑板，转向镜头自信地微笑。她身后是车间、CNC区和仓库货架在夕阳光辉下闪耀。最后充满活力的音乐节拍。
视觉风格：1980年代日本OVA赛璐珞动画，粗犷的墨线轮廓，手绘角色动画，细致手绘背景，温暖的赛璐珞高光，配音

A hyper-realistic live FIFA World Cup 2026 night match broadcast, Group C: Qatar vs Switzerland. In an absurd satirical comedy scene, the entire Qatari national team in maroon kits with white accents are frantically building a massive red brick wall directly in front of their goal to block Switzerland’s attack.

Close-up shots: Qatari players #2, #15, #25 urgently laying red bricks, spreading gray mortar with trowels, intense focused expressions, sweat visible under stadium floodlights. Wide dramatic shots: multiple Qatari players (#10, #7, #6, #4, #8) on ladders and scaffolding rapidly stacking bricks across the entire goal mouth like an emergency construction crew mid-match. Bricks scatter across the grass, wheelbarrows of mortar rush in.

Foreground reaction: shocked Swiss players in white and red kits (Xhaka #10, #7) stand frozen, arms slightly raised in disbelief. Female stadium staff and women fans in Swiss jerseys react with laughter and stunned expressions, filming the scene on phones under bright lights. The referee stands confused, whistle lowered.

Broadcast style: authentic FOX Sports FIFA presentation, scoreboard overlay shows QAT 0–0 SUI, clock 37:12, “LIVE” indicator, sponsor graphics, shaky commentator cam cuts.

Commentary (live broadcast audio):
Commentator 1 (shocked): “I… I cannot believe what we are seeing—are they building a WALL?”
Commentator 2 (laughing in disbelief): “This is not defensive structure, this is full construction mode inside the box!”
Sideline reporter (urgent): “The Swiss attack has completely stopped… they’re just watching this happen!”

Crowd audio: mixed gasps, laughter, and chants turning into confused cheering.

Cinematic sports cinematography: dramatic night lighting, strong highlights on brick textures and sweat, motion blur on fast building action, dynamic cuts between tight close-ups (hands, trowels, mortar) and wide stadium shots through the goal net. Ultra-detailed jerseys, dust particles in air, realistic pitch wear.

Humorous surreal tone, meme-like absurdity, yet fully photorealistic elite broadcast quality. Satirical exaggeration of ultra-defensive “park the bus” tactics turned into literal construction.

zh.p:
一场超真实的2026年世界杯夜间比赛直播，C组：卡塔尔对阵瑞士。在一场荒诞的讽刺喜剧场景中，整个卡塔尔国家队身穿带有白色点缀的栗色球衣，正疯狂地在球门前筑起一堵巨大的红砖墙，阻挡瑞士的进攻。

特写镜头：卡塔尔球员#2、#15、#25急切地铺设红砖，用泥刀抹灰色砂浆，专注的表情，球场照明下汗水清晰可见。广阔戏剧性镜头：多名卡塔尔球员（#10、#7、#6、#4、#8）站在梯子和脚手架上，像紧急施工队一样迅速堆砌砖块覆盖整个球门口。砖块散落草地上，砂浆手推车冲进来。

前景反应：身穿白红球衣（Xhaka #10、#7）的瑞士球员震惊地站在那里，双臂微微举起，显得难以置信。女体育场工作人员和身穿瑞士球衣的女球迷们笑着，脸上露出震惊的表情，在强光下用手机拍摄这一幕。裁判一脸困惑，哨声响起。

转播风格：真实的FOX Sports FIFA呈现，记分板叠加显示QAT 0–0 SUI，计时器37分12秒，“直播”指示，赞助商图形，解说员摄像机切换。

解说（现场直播音频）：
解说员1（震惊）：“我......我简直不敢相信我们看到的——他们是在建墙吗？”
解说员2（难以置信地笑）：“这不是防守结构，这是禁区内的全面施工模式！”
场边记者（紧急）：“瑞士的袭击已经完全停止......他们只是眼睁睁看着这一切发生！”

人群声音：混合的惊呼、笑声和呼喊变成困惑的欢呼。

电影般的体育摄影：戏剧性的夜光、砖块纹理和汗水的强烈高光、快速构建动作的动态模糊、紧凑的特写镜头（手、铲子、砂浆）和球门前宽阔的体育场镜头之间的动态切换。极其细致的球衣、空气中的尘埃颗粒、逼真的球场磨损。

幽默超现实的基调，类似表情包的荒诞，却又达到了顶级广播的写实级质量。对极端防御性的“停车”战术的讽刺夸张演变成了字面上的建筑。

Create a cinematic anime short film in a unified Demon Slayer / Jujutsu Kaisen inspired art style — apply this exact same visual style consistently to ALL characters and scenes without exception.
Character Design (maintain throughout ALL scenes):
Hero: Young male swordsman, late teens, athletic build, dark hair, determined eyes, traditional Japanese warrior outfit, katana at waist
Child: Small baby girl, 2–3 years old, round face, big innocent eyes, simple village dress, same anime art style as the hero — no style deviation
Story Structure:
Opening — Close-up on hero's face receiving urgent message. Camera: low angle looking up at hero. Dramatic lighting.
Journey — Hero running through dense forest and rocky mountains. Camera: dynamic tracking shot from side, then bird's eye view. Motion blur on feet.
Village in Crisis — Wide establishing shot of burning village. Cut to medium shot of terrified villagers. Camera slowly pushes in.
Monster threatening child — Monster looms over baby girl. Camera: monster POV looking down at child, then child POV looking up at monster. High contrast lighting.
Hero Arrival — Hero leaps into frame from above. Slow motion sword strike. Camera: 360-degree rotating shot around hero.
Battle Sequence — Intense fight, multiple camera angles: close-up on clashing sword, wide shot of full battle, low angle hero power move. Fluid motion, no flickering.
Resolution — Monster defeated. Hero kneels down to baby girl's level. Soft warm lighting. Camera: gentle zoom out showing hero and child together, villagers in background.
Ending — Hero sheathes sword, walks away. Camera: back shot of hero walking into sunset, villagers watching.
Visual Rules (strict):
One unified anime art style across ALL shots — hero and baby girl must look like they belong in the same animation
Camera angle must change every scene — no repeated angles
No slideshow transitions — use cinematic cuts and motion
Warm golden lighting for resolution, cool blue for battle
Pippit watermark visible in final composition
Style: Epic fantasy anime, Demon Slayer quality, emotional storytelling, professional cinematic pacing

角色设计（贯穿所有场景）：
英雄：年轻男剑士，十几岁末期，体格健壮，黑发，眼神坚定，传统日本武士服，腰间佩刀
孩子：小女孩，2-3岁，圆脸，大而纯真的眼睛，朴素的乡村服饰，和主角一样的动漫画风——没有风格上的偏差
故事结构：
开场——英雄接受紧急信息的特写。镜头：低角度仰望英雄。戏剧性的灯光。
旅程——英雄穿越茂密森林和岩石山脉。摄像机：从侧面动态跟踪，然后是鸟瞰视角。脚部运动模糊。
危机中的村庄——燃烧村庄的广角景。画面切到惊恐的村民中景。镜头缓缓推进。
怪物威胁的孩子——怪物笼罩着婴儿女孩。镜头：怪物视角俯视孩子，然后是儿童视角抬头看怪物。高对比度灯光。
英雄到达——英雄从上方跃入画面。慢动作剑击。镜头：围绕英雄进行360度旋转镜头。
战斗场面——激烈战斗，多角度镜头：剑击特写、全场战斗全景、低角度英雄技能招式。动作流畅，没有闪烁。
决议——怪物被击败。英雄跪下，与婴儿女孩平视。柔和温暖的灯光。镜头：轻柔拉远，展示英雄和孩子在一起，背景是村民。
结局——英雄收剑，转身离开。摄影：英雄走进夕阳的背影，村民们在看。
视觉规则（严格）：
所有镜头都要统一统一的动漫美术风格——主角和小女孩必须看起来像是属于同一个动画
摄像机角度必须改变每个场景——不能重复角度
无幻灯片转场——使用电影剪辑和动态
温暖的金色灯光代表解决，冷蓝色代表战斗
最终构图中可见的皮皮特水印
风格：史诗奇幻动漫，《鬼灭之刃》的品质，情感丰富的叙事，专业的电影节奏

Hero: Young male swordsman, late teens, athletic build, dark hair, determined eyes, traditional Japanese warrior outfit, katana at waist
Child: Small baby girl, 2–3 years old, round face, big innocent eyes, simple village dress, same anime art style as the hero — no style deviation

Village in Crisis — Wide establishing shot of burning village. Cut to medium shot of terrified villagers. Camera slowly pushes in.
Monster threatening child — Monster looms over baby girl. Camera: monster POV looking down at child, then child POV looking up at monster. High contrast lighting.

【风格】韩剧校园反霸凌复仇短片（Korean School Revenge Drama），真实真人电影质感，冷白走廊灯光、冷色调（Teal & Cold Grade），手持摄影、浅景深（Shallow DOF），9:16竖屏，英文对白。所有角色均为成年演员扮演高中生，动作为电影化风格表现，无血腥无伤害结果
【时长】15秒
【场景】现代韩式高中走廊，一侧储物柜、教室门，冷白色顶灯，地砖反光
【角色】校霸（高大男性，校服外套敞开，神态傲慢）、被霸凌者（瘦弱男性，校服整齐，抱着课本）、复仇者（身穿整齐校服的男性，神情冷静，眼神坚定）

[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：走廊霸凌铺垫（35mm Handheld Push-in）
本段只有推搡和言语威胁，无任何其他肢体冲突。
中景缓慢推进：校霸把被霸凌者逼到储物柜旁，单手推搡他的肩膀，课本散落一地，被霸凌者低头忍耐不敢对视。
轻微手持晃动，配储物柜金属撞击声。
【对白口型指导】校霸（英文，居高临下嘲笑）："Nobody is coming to save you."

[00:04-00:08] 镜头2：第一记耳光（Whip Pan + Low Angle）
画面侧面突然甩入一只手，一记响亮耳光抽在校霸侧脸，快速甩镜（Whip Pan）跟随手的轨迹，清脆声响带走廊回音。
低角度：校霸旋转半圈踉跄倒地，捂着脸撑地爬起，眼眶通红抬头瞪向画面外。
【对白口型指导】校霸（英文，咬牙切齿）："Who the hell did that?"

[00:08-00:11] 镜头3：对峙揭示（Counter Shot）
反打镜头：复仇者立于走廊冷光中，俯视校霸，语气平静。
【对白口型指导】复仇者（英文，低沉冷静）："Someone here to teach you a lesson."
校霸怒吼着从地上弹起，挥拳冲向复仇者。

[00:11-00:15] 镜头4：连环耳光+俯拍终结（Rapid Cuts → Top-down → Smash Cut）
复仇者侧身避开来拳，单手揪住校霸衣领。快速剪辑（Rapid Cuts）：正反手连续扇打校霸的脸，校霸的头随之左右甩动、发丝飞舞。
最后2秒切换机位：摄像机移到两人正上方垂直向下俯拍（Top-down Overhead Shot），画面中校霸瘫坐在地面、脸朝上，复仇者揪着他的衣领。
复仇者另一只手向上高高扬起、靠近镜头（手背朝向镜头），停顿一瞬，随后这只手猛然向下扇落、远离镜头、直奔下方校霸的脸——在巴掌即将接触校霸脸部的瞬间硬切黑屏（Smash Cut to Black）并静音。
巴掌全程扇向地上的校霸，绝不朝向镜头方向挥打。

【音效设计】走廊环境声、耳光声清脆带回音、最后一掌强烈破风声后瞬间静音切黑. 无BGM或仅低沉弦乐铺底。

[Style] Korean School Revenge Drama, realistic live-action film texture, cold white corridor lighting, cool tones (Teal & Cold Grade), handheld photography, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical screen, English dialogue. All characters are adult actors playing high school students, with action expressed in a cinematic style, resulting in no bloodshed or harm
[Duration] 15 seconds
[Scene] Modern Korean high school corridor, with storage cabinets and classroom doors on one side, cool white ceiling lights, and reflective floor tiles
[Characters] School bully (tall male with his school jacket open, arrogant expression), bullied (thin male with neat uniform, holding textbooks), avenger (male in a neat school uniform, calm expression, determined gaze)

[00:00-00:04] Scene 1: Corridor Bullying Setup (35mm Handheld Push-in)
This section contains only shoving and verbal threats, with no other physical altercations.
Medium shot: Slow progression: The bully corners the bully by the locker, pushes his shoulder with one hand, textbooks scattered all over the floor, and the bully lowers his head, enduring and refusing to meet his gaze.
Slight handheld shaking accompanied by the metal impact sound of the locker.
[Lip-Sync Guidance] School bully (English, looking down at and mocking): "Nobody is coming to save you."

[00:04-00:08] Scene 2: First Slap (Whip Pan + Low Angle)
Suddenly, a hand flicks in from the side of the frame, delivering a loud slap to the bully's profile. The quick whip pan follows the path of the hand, the crisp sound echoing through the hallway.
Low angle: The school bully spins half a circle and stumbles to the ground, covers his face to support himself and gets up, eyes bloodshot as he looks up and stares off the screen.
[Lip-Sync Guidance] School Bully (English, gritting teeth): "Who the hell did that?"

[00:08-00:11] Shot 3: Counter Shot
Reverse shot: The Avenger stands in the cold light of the corridor, looking down at the school bully, his tone calm.
[Lip-Sync Guidance] Avenger (English, low and calm): "Someone here to teach you a lesson."
The school bully roared and bounced up from the ground, throwing punches at the Avengers.

[00:11-00:15] Shot 4: Rapid Cuts → Top-down → Smash Cut
The Avenger dodged the punch sideways and grabbed the bully by the collar with one hand. Rapid Cuts: Repeatedly slap the school bully's face with both hands and backhand, causing the bully's head to shake left and right and his hair to fly.
In the last 2 seconds, the camera switches: the camera moves directly above the two for a top-down overhead shot. In the frame, the bully is slumped on the ground with his face up, and the Avenger grabs his collar.
The Avenger's other hand is raised high and close to the camera (back of hand facing the camera), pauses briefly, then suddenly slaps down, away from the camera, heading straight for the bully's face below—just as the slap is about to touch the bully's face, it smashes to black and mutes.
The slap was directed at the school bully on the ground the whole time, never aimed at the camera.

[Sound Design] Corridor ambient sounds, crisp slaps with echo, and after a strong slap slash, the sound instantly mutes and blacks out. No background music or only deep string background music.

The world's first dragon airport floats high above the clouds, a breathtaking sky terminal built from glowing crystal towers, golden bridges, and colossal landing platforms suspended in the heavens. The video opens with a cinematic aerial shot of majestic dragons arriving from distant kingdoms. A massive emerald dragon glides through the clouds while an ice dragon descends from snowy mountains and a fiery crimson dragon emerges from a glowing volcanic horizon.

The camera races through the bustling airport as dragons of every size land gracefully on enormous floating runways. Dragon riders guide their creatures toward elegant sky gates while magical cargo is loaded onto giant transport dragons. Clouds drift between the terminals as sunlight reflects from shimmering crystal structures.

The action intensifies as several dragons launch from the airport in synchronized takeoffs. The camera follows them soaring between floating towers and glowing sky bridges, wings creating powerful gusts through the clouds. For the grand finale, a gigantic golden dragon departs from the main terminal and flies into a spectacular orange-and-purple sunset above an endless sea of clouds. The camera pulls back to reveal the entire dragon airport glowing magnificently in the sky, ultra-realistic, cinematic masterpiece, breathtaking scale, highly detailed dragons, fantasy realism, epic ending.

zh.p:
世界上第一个龙机场高悬云端，是一座由发光水晶塔、金色桥梁和悬浮在天上的巨大降落平台构成的壮丽空中航站楼。视频开场是一段电影般的空拍镜头，展示了雄伟的龙群从遥远王国飞来。一条巨大的翡翠绿龙滑翔于云层，一条冰龙从雪山降落，一条炽热的猩红龙从发光的火山地平线中现身。

镜头穿梭于繁忙的机场，各种大小的龙优雅地降落在巨大的漂浮跑道上。龙骑士引导他们的生物朝着优雅的天空之门前进，而魔法货物则被装载到巨型运输龙上。云朵在终端间飘荡，阳光反射在闪烁的晶体结构上。

随着几条龙同步从机场起飞，战斗愈发激烈。镜头跟随他们在漂浮的高塔和发光的天空桥之间翱翔，翅膀在云层间掀起强劲的风。压轴的壮丽时刻，一条巨大的金龙从主航站楼飞出，飞入壮观的橙紫色夕阳，落日落在无尽的云海之上。镜头拉远，展现整个龙机场在天空中辉煌发光，极为写实、电影般的杰作，规模惊人，细致入微的龙，奇幻现实主义，史诗般的结局。
