raw_p:
[0–5s]: The Canyon Plunge A blistering vertical drop down the sheer, sun-baked red rock face of a massive desert canyon. The camera plummets like a stone past jutting sandstone ledges and swirling dust devils. Intense camera shake mimics the harsh aerodynamic downdraft, with grit and loose pebbles streaking past the lens to emphasize the blinding downward speed against a harsh mid-day sun.
[5–10s]: The Apex Weave Inches before smashing into the heavily rutted dirt track, the camera aggressively pulls up, instantly stabilizing into a buttery-smooth, high-speed FPV drone glide. It threads the needle through a chaotic, high-stakes WRC rally drift corner. The camera ducks under a swinging course marker, weaves tightly between two aggressively tuned Audi R8s trading paint mid-slide, and dodges a massive, blinding spray of gravel kicked up by spinning tires.
[10–15s]: The Drift and Whip-Pan The camera executes a low, dust-spraying powerslide beneath the crest of a massive dirt jump just as a neon-wrapped rally car launches directly overhead, its roaring exhaust flames scorching the air. Using the bright orange flash of the exhaust backfire as a transition, the camera executes a vicious, motion-blurred whip-pan 180 degrees to the right—snapping perfectly onto a pit crew chief in a sponsor-heavy fire suit, capturing the exact frame she throws a checkered flag down and points a gloved finger directly at the lens.

zh.p:
[0–5秒]：峡谷坠落 一个炽热的垂直落差，沿着巨大的沙漠峡谷中被阳光晒得炽热的红色岩壁。镜头像石头一样坠落，穿过突出的砂岩岩台阶和旋转的尘埃。强烈的摄像机抖动模仿了强烈的气动下沉气流，砂砾和松散的鹅卵石从镜头边缘划过，强调了在强烈正午阳光下令人目眩的下落速度。
[5–10秒]：顶点交织英寸，在撞击崎岖泥土赛道前，摄像机猛拉，瞬间稳定，进入极其顺畅的高速FPV滑行。它穿梭于混乱且高风险的WRC拉力漂移弯道。镜头从摇摆的赛道标记下弯道，紧密穿梭在两辆经过激进调校的奥迪R8中途交替换漆，还躲避了因轮胎打滑扬起的巨大刺眼碎石。
[10–15秒]：漂移与鞭状摇移 摄像机在一个巨大的泥地跳台顶端下进行低矮喷尘的甩尾，正好一辆霓虹灯包裹的拉力赛车直接从头顶冲过，喷射的尾气火焰灼烧空气。镜头以排气回火的亮橙色闪光为过渡，向右猛烈地旋转180度，完美捕捉一位身穿赞助商消防服的维修组长，捕捉她投掷格子旗并戴手套手指对准镜头的那一帧。

Grid Animation、Mosaic Reveal、Tile Shuffle、Alpha Dissolveを使用。

---

12〜14秒

9枚を同時表示。

グリッド配置→円形配置→横一列→縦一列→ランダム配置を高速で切り替える。

各レイアウト間はFlash Cut、Glitch、Sliding Panelで接続する。

---

14〜15秒

9枚が高速シャッフルされながら一瞬ずつ全面表示。

最後に最も印象的な1枚を画面いっぱいに表示し、

White Flash
→Bloom
→Light Leak
→Freeze Frame

で締める。

使用推奨トランジション・編集効果

Flash Cut、Smash Cut、Jump Cut、Match Cut、Glitch、RGB Split、Strobe、Film Burn、White Flash、Split Screen、Grid Animation、Tile Shuffle、Mosaic Reveal、Sliding Panel、Push、Pull、Flip、Rotate、Spin、Circular Wipe、Diagonal Wipe、Checker Wipe、Random Block、Mask Reveal、Alpha Dissolve、Motion Blur、Radial Blur、Zoom Cut、Freeze Frame、Echo Frame。

同じ演出を連続使用せず、15秒間を通して画面構成が絶えず変化する、情報量と勢いのある映像として表現する。

raw_p: A cinematic, high-contrast action video in a stark minimalist white gallery space. A character wearing a traditional black samurai kimono, long flowing white hair, and a white Oni demon mask wields a massive, oversized Japanese calligraphy brush. The character dynamically spins and slashes the brush, leaving thick, fluid, three-dimensional black sumi-e ink strokes suspended in mid-air. The ink magically materializes into a ferocious, hyper-realistic tiger and twin massive Chinese dragons that swirl majestically around the character. Photorealistic 3D CGI, Unreal Engine 5 realism, ultra-sharp details, Unreal Engine 5 render, dramatic contrast between deep black ink and the brilliant white background. Single continuous uninterrupted cinematic shot, no cuts, one flowing 15-second take. Celebrity hero reveal arrival sequence, bright sunny daytime, glamorous red carpet event outside a grand building. Hyper-realistic professional film look, realistic textures, crisp natural daylight, polished surfaces, vibrant color, shallow depth of field. Absolutely no plastic CGI look.

The shot opens on an intimate close-up at ground level of a clean paved street / red carpet edge, sunlight catching the asphalt. A luxurious glossy red sports car drives forward into frame, moving ahead in a normal forward direction, and pulls up to a smooth stop. The car door opens. The camera holds low as a pair of feet in polished elegant dress shoes steps out of the car onto the ground — this is the man [IMAGE], wearing a sharp, tailored elegant suit, sophisticated movie-star style.

As he stands, the camera slowly cranes upward along his body from his shoes toward his face. During this rise, he smoothly closes the car door behind him and adjusts his suit jacket and cuffs, composed and confident. When the camera reaches his face, he removes his sunglasses with a smooth motion, revealing his charismatic, composed expression.

The camera then orbits around him, circling smoothly until it settles behind him — revealing, in front of him, a large crowd of press photographers and excited fans waiting behind barriers, cameras flashing, people cheering. The man begins to walk forward toward them.

The camera stays behind him but gradually cranes upward, rising higher until it looks down from above and behind his head in a high angle, showing him from above as he walks the carpet, waving and greeting the cheering fans, then continues forward and enters through the doors into the grand building.

STYLE: cinematic, bright glamorous natural lighting, vibrant color grade, lens flare from sunlight, realistic motion blur, shallow depth of field, blockbuster red-carpet film quality.

zh.p:
一个连续且不中断的电影镜头，没有剪辑，一遍流畅的15秒镜头。名人英雄揭晓的到场序列，阳光明媚的白天，华丽的红毯活动在一座宏伟建筑外举行。超写实的专业胶片风格，逼真的纹理，清晰的自然日光，抛光的表面，鲜艳的色彩，浅景深。绝对没有塑料CGI的效果。

镜头以地面层的亲密特写开场，画面是干净铺装的街道/红地毯边缘，阳光洒在柏油路上。一辆豪华亮红色跑车向前驶入画面，正常前进，最终平稳停下。车门打开了。镜头保持低姿态，一双穿着擦得锃亮优雅的正装鞋的脚从车里走到地面——这就是那个男人[图片]，穿着剪裁得体、优雅的西装，风格优雅，风格优雅，宛如电影明星。

他站起身时，镜头缓缓从鞋子往上移，向脸部移动。在这过程中，他顺畅地关上车门，整理西装外套和袖口，神情镇定自信。当镜头拍摄到他脸上时，他动作流畅地摘下墨镜，露出他那富有魅力且沉着的表情。

摄像机随后围绕他旋转，平稳地盘旋，直到停在他身后——映出他面前，一大群新闻摄影师和兴奋的粉丝在栏杆后等待，闪烁着闪光灯，人们欢呼着。那人开始向他们走来。

摄像机停留在他身后，但逐渐向上拉，逐渐升高，直到从上方和他头后以高角度俯视，展示他走在地毯上，挥手向欢呼的粉丝致意，然后继续前进，穿过大门进入宏伟的建筑。

风格：电影感，明亮迷人的自然光，鲜艳的色级，阳光镜头光晕，逼真的动态模糊，浅景深，红毯电影级别的巨片质量。

A peaceful sunrise garden surrounded by lush greenery, blooming flowers, and golden morning light. A young woman walks into the garden carrying a rolled yoga mat and a water bottle. Cinematic wide shots establish the tranquil environment. She finds a quiet spot on the grass, gently unrolls her mat, removes her shoes, and takes a deep refreshing breath. Soft breeze moves through the trees, birds chirp in the background, creating a calm wellness atmosphere.

The camera follows her with smooth cinematic movements as she stretches her neck, shoulders, arms, and back. Close-up shots capture mindful details—her tying her hair into a ponytail, adjusting her yoga outfit, placing her hands on the mat, and feeling the warmth of the morning sun. Natural light creates beautiful lens flares and soft highlights across the garden.

She sits cross-legged on the mat and closes her eyes. Slow push-in shots capture her calm breathing and peaceful expression. As relaxing music builds, she transitions into gentle warm-up movements and graceful yoga poses. The camera alternates between close-ups of focused expressions and wide shots showcasing her surrounded by colorful flowers, green trees, and glowing sunlight.

Cinematic drone shots reveal the entire garden as she flows effortlessly through yoga poses. Slow-motion moments emphasize balance, flexibility, and inner peace. Golden sun rays stream through the trees, creating a dreamy wellness-commercial aesthetic. Every movement feels natural, elegant, and meditative.

End with a stunning hero shot of the woman holding a beautiful yoga pose in the center of the garden, bathed in warm sunrise light. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the serene landscape, creating a feeling of harmony, mindfulness, wellness, and connection with nature. Ultra-realistic, cinematic photography, premium wellness brand commercial, shallow depth of field, soft natural colors, peaceful mood, smooth gimbal movements, photorealistic, 16:9 aspect ratio.

zh.p:
宁静的日出花园，四周环绕着郁郁葱葱的绿意、盛开的花朵和金色的晨光。一位年轻女子手里拿着卷起的瑜伽垫和水瓶走进花园。电影般的广角镜头营造出宁静的环境。她找了个安静的草地，轻轻展开垫子，脱下鞋子，深深吸了一口气，感到清新。柔和的微风穿过树梢，鸟儿在背景中啁啾，营造出宁静的养生氛围。

镜头以流畅的电影式动作跟随她，她伸展脖子、肩膀、手臂和背部。特写镜头捕捉到细致的细节——她扎起马尾，调整瑜伽服，双手放在垫子上，感受晨光的温暖。自然光在花园中创造出美丽的透镜光晕和柔和的高光。

她盘腿坐在垫子上，闭上眼睛。缓慢的推入镜头捕捉她平静的呼吸和安详的表情。随着轻松的音乐逐渐升温，她会过渡到温柔的热身动作和优雅的瑜伽动作。镜头在专注表情的特写和广角镜头之间交替出现，展现她被五彩缤纷的花朵、绿树和明亮阳光包围的景象。

电影般的无人机镜头展现了整个花园，她轻松地完成瑜伽动作。慢动作时刻强调平衡、灵活性和内心的平静。金色阳光穿过树木洒下，营造出梦幻般的健康商业美学。每一个动作都自然、优雅且冥想。

最后是一张令人惊艳的英雄照，女性在花园中央摆出美丽的瑜伽姿势，沐浴在温暖的日出光芒中。镜头缓缓拉远，展现出宁静的景色，营造出和谐、正念、健康与与自然连接的感觉。超写实、电影感十足的摄影、高端健康品牌广告、浅景深、柔和自然色彩、宁静氛围、流畅的万向节运动、照片级写实、16：9宽高比。

第一人称手机手电筒视角，夜晚推开一扇老旧公寓房门，镜头进入一间脏乱、潮湿、昏暗的卧室。房间里有一张凌乱的床，地上散落衣物、破纸箱、空水瓶和发霉的外卖盒。角落里蹲着一位明显成年的女性
hf_20260602_030359_fe9adf4d-7a5d-4c92-9517-3e9d2f2e0da1
穿着
图片_20260608230651_1029_183(1)
，看起来像被困很久。整体是写实恐怖短片质感，手持镜头轻微颤抖，呼吸声清晰，无音乐。 Shot 1 (0-3s) - THE HOOK: 第一人称慢慢推开门，门轴发出刺耳声。手电光扫过脏乱地面、凌乱床铺 and 墙上的水渍，最后停在房间角落。角落里的成年女性抬起头，眼神从害怕变成惊喜。 Shot 2 (3-6s): 她看到有人进来后非常开心，立刻站起来，朝镜头方向小跑过来。她脸上带着获救般的笑容，双手微微抬起，像是在求助和感谢。第一人称后退半步，镜头轻微晃动，画面里能听见紧张的呼吸声。 Shot 3 (6-9s): 第一人称以为救援成功，镜头稍微放低，像是准备扶她离开。女性越来越靠近，笑容仍然明亮，但房间灯光突然闪烁，床底下传来低沉的拖拽声。她停在距离镜头很近的位置，轻声说：“你终于来了。” Shot 4 (9-12s) - REVERSAL: 她的声音突然变得冰冷沙哑，表情僵住，笑容变得不自然。她缓缓歪头，眼睛在手电光里反射出异常的暗光，然后用完全不同的低哑声音说：“我等的不是救援……是替身。” Shot 5 (12-15s) - PAYOFF: 手电筒开始疯狂闪烁。她的脸在每次闪光中变得更像女恶鬼：苍白、扭曲、头发无风飘动，但不出现血腥画面。最后一次闪光时，她瞬间贴到镜头前，张开黑暗的眼睛，画面猛地失焦并切黑，只留下房门砰然关闭的声音。 Style: 第一人称手持手机录像，真实恐怖短视频质感，低光、手电筒硬光、数字噪点、轻微运动模糊、潮湿房间氛围、压抑呼吸声、门轴声、远处城市低频噪声、灯光闪烁、电流杂音。无音乐，无字幕，无水印，无额外角色，无血腥暴力，女性为明确成年角色。

en.p:
First-person phone flashlight perspective: at night, the door of an old apartment is pushed open, and the camera enters a dirty, messy, damp, and dim bedroom. The room had a messy bed, scattered clothes, torn cardboard boxes, empty water bottles, and moldy takeout boxes scattered on the floor. In the corner, a clearly adult woman squatted
hf_20260602_030359_fe9adf4d-7a5d-4c92-9517-3e9d2f2e0da1
Clothing
Image_20260608230651_1029_183(1)
, it looks like it's been trapped for a long time. Overall, it has the texture of a realistic horror short, with the handheld camera slightly shaking, clear breathing, and no music. Shot 1 (0-3s) - THE HOOK: First-person slowly pushes open the door, the door hinge makes a harsh sound. The flashlight swept over the dirty, messy floor, messy bed, and water stains on the walls, finally stopping in the corner of the room. The adult woman in the corner lifted her head, her eyes shifting from fear to surprise. Shot 2 (3-6s): She was very happy to see someone coming in, immediately stood up, and jogged toward the camera. She wore a smile as if rescued, her hands slightly raised, as if seeking help and expressing gratitude. The first-person perspective takes half a step back, the camera shakes slightly, and you can hear tense breathing on screen. Shot 3 (6-9s): First-person view assumes the rescue is successful, then lowers the camera slightly, as if preparing to help her away. The woman drew closer, her smile still bright, but the room lights suddenly flickered, and a low dragging sound came from under the bed. She stopped very close to the camera and softly said, "You finally came." " Shot 4 (9-12s) - REVERSAL: Her voice suddenly became cold and hoarse, her expression froze, and her smile became unnatural. She slowly tilted her head, her eyes reflecting an unusual dim light in the flashlight, then said in a completely different husky voice, "I'm not waiting for rescue...... A stand-in. "Shot 5 (12-15s) - PAYOFF: The flashlight started flashing wildly. Her face became more like a female demon with each flash: pale, twisted, her hair flowing without wind, but without bloody scenes. During the final flash, she instantly pressed close to the camera, opened her dark eyes, and the image suddenly lost focus and went black, leaving only the sound of the door slamming shut. Style: First-person handheld phone recording, realistic horror short video texture, low light, flashlight flashlight, digital noise, slight motion blur, damp room atmosphere, suppressed breathing, door hinge noise, distant city low-frequency noise, flickering lights, electric current noise. No music, no subtitles, no watermark, no extra characters, no bloody violence, and the female characters are clearly adult characters.

{{Image 1}} =絵コンテの参照。

添付された絵コンテ画像{{Image 1}}を基に、15秒、横型16:9の高品質な動画を作成してください。

テーマは「実写映像とエフェクトの共存」。

全体として、駅、改札、ホーム、車内、跨線橋、鉄橋、都市夜景を舞台にした、移動のリズムと、実在しない2D手描き風の妖精ドゥードルたちが共存する映像にしてください。
静止画のスライドショーにはせず、各カットの中でカメラも人も電車もエフェクトも確実に動いている、テンポのよい都市モンタージュにしてください。

映像全体の方向性：
実写ベースの駅空間。改札、駅サイン、ホーム、車両、車内、発車の瞬間、橋を渡る列車、子どもが窓を見るカット、駅構内時計、夜のホーム、屋上や高所から見る都市夜景。
その中に、2D手描き風の可愛い妖精・動物・星・惑星・軌道線・リボン線・小さな飛行体が大量に共存する。
重要なのは、駅という機能的な空間に対して、エフェクトがただ可愛いだけでなく、移動の流れ・時間の流れ・旅情を補強する存在として見えること。
全体として、軽快で都会的、少し夢があり、移動そのものが魔法に包まれている印象。

カット構成：
1カット目：改札の人波。行き交う通勤客。改札機の上や周囲に妖精ドゥードルが舞う。前進移動。
2カット目：駅サインやホーム案内の寄り。星、惑星、小さな生き物たちが周囲を流れる。素早い寄り。
3カット目：走る電車の外観。車体の上空や周囲に軌道線と妖精たち。斜め構図でスピード感。
4カット目：エスカレーター。乗客の流れに沿って、小さな妖精が上下に移動する。見上げ気味。

テンポ良く、都市の移動感を重視する。

寄り、斜め、引き、前進、横移動をバランス良く配置。

静止画のスライドショー禁止。

en.p:
{{Image 1}} = Storyboard reference.

Based on the attached storyboard image {{Image 1}}, please create a high-quality 15-second, landscape 16:9 video.

The theme is 'Coexistence of Live-Action Footage and Effects.'

Overall, create visuals that coexist with the rhythm of movement set against stations, ticket gates, platforms, inside trains, overpasses, rail bridges, and city nightscapes, alongside non-existent 2D hand-drawn fairy duddles.
Don't make it a still slideshow; make it a fast-paced urban montage where the camera, people, train, and effects all move steadily within each cut.

Overall Direction of the Footage:
A live-action station space. Ticket gates, station signs, platforms, vehicles, interiors, moments of departure, trains crossing bridges, shots of children looking out the window, station clocks, platforms at night, city night views from rooftops and high places.
Within it, a large number of cute 2D hand-drawn fairies, animals, stars, planets, orbital lines, ribbon lines, and small flying objects coexist.
What's important is that, in the functional space of a station, the effects are not just cute, but also serve as a reinforcement for the flow of movement, time, and the feeling of travel.
Overall, it feels light and urban, a bit dreamy, and the very act of moving is enveloped in magic.

Cut composition:
First shot: Crowds at the ticket gate. Commuters coming and going. Fairy Doodles dance above and around the ticket gates. Move forward.
Second cut: Station signs and platform guidance near the station. Stars, planets, and tiny creatures flow around it. Quick approach.
Third shot: The exterior of a running train. Track tracks and fairies above and around the train body. A diagonal composition gives a sense of speed.
Fourth cut: Escalator. Following the flow of passengers, the little fairy moves up and down. Looking up.
Shot 5: People waiting on the platform and a stopped train. Fairies blend into the quiet space between the train and the people. Lateral movement.
Sixth cut: Inside the car. Young people looking at their smartphones. Doodles coexist on hanging straps and windowsills. Close-up cut.
Cut 7: Station staff see off the train. Ribbon lines and stars flow in sync with the train's movement. A cuts with movement.
Cut 8: Wide view of a train crossing the bridge. Moon, planets, and fairies in the sky. A pull that feels open and open.
Cut 9: The child reaches out through the window. The effect makes it feel like a fairy is behind the window. Emotional leaning.
Cut 10: Clocks and signs inside the station. Small creatures sit on the signboard. A fast-paced insertion cut.
Eleventh cut: Home at night. The curved tracks and the depth of the platform. The fairy Doodles float in the night air. Somewhat off-putting.
Cut 12: A person viewing the city night view from a rooftop or high place. Next to it is a large rabbit-style doodle. Stars and orbital lines spread across the sky, closing the scene with a lingering impression.

Direction & Editing:
It emphasizes a fast pace and a sense of urban mobility.
Create match cuts using the direction of the train, the walking direction of the characters, and the flow of effects.
Balances are balanced with close, diagonal, pull, forward, and lateral movement.
I value the contrast between the inorganic nature of the station and the softness of the doodle.

Artwork:
High quality, cinematic, metallic feel of the station, glass, artificial lighting, city light from evening to night.
The effects are mainly pastel colors, mixed with white lines.
Although the volume is large, it does not lose visibility of station information, people, or trains.

Important Points:
Still image slideshows are prohibited.
The camera, people, train, and effects must move reliably within each cut.
Text, subtitles, logos, and watermarks are prohibited.
No deformation, unnatural proliferation, or the feeling of sticking on effects.
Please create a 15-second video of invisible fairies who live and move naturally coexist within the real-life station space.

raw_p: A 15-second anime soccer action short. Night stadium, floodlights, cheering crowd. THE SPINNING SOCCER BALL IS THE CENTRAL OBJECT OF EVERY SHOT — it must remain visible on screen at all times from start to finish. Two rivals, defined once: RIVAL A = long wild black hair, black uniform. RIVAL B = short black hair, navy uniform number 7. Full-body action shots only, wide and medium angles showing the pitch. 0–4s: Kick-off. Both players strike the ball simultaneously. The ball spins violently between their boots, then the shockwave knocks both players backward — the ball stays at center, still spinning on the grass. 4–9s: RIVAL B recovers and dribbles the spinning ball downfield at high speed. Low wide tracking shot: his feet, the ball, and the turf always in frame together. 9–12s: RIVAL A slides in from behind. RIVAL B flicks the same ball up into the air to dodge the tackle. The ball arcs upward in clear view. 12–15s: RIVAL B leaps and strikes the airborne ball with a lightning-charged mid-air volley. The ball rockets toward the goal trailing blue electricity. Final frame: the ball hitting the net. Continuity rule: one single ball exists for the entire video and never disappears between cuts. Negative: no character portrait close-ups, no sparkles or glitter effects, no standing still poses, no talking scenes, no scene without the ball. [Night stadium. Floodlights blaze. The soccer ball rests at center circle, spinning slowly on the grass. The roar of the crowd fills the air.] [RIVAL A — long wild black hair, black uniform — plants his boot. RIVAL B — short black hair, navy uniform number 7 — plants his opposite boot. Both strike the ball simultaneously. The ball spins violently between their colliding boots, a shockwave rippling outward. Both players are blasted backward. The ball stays at center, still spinning on the grass.] [RIVAL B surges upright. Low wide tracking shot — his boots, the spinning ball, and the turf locked together in one frame. He drives forward at full sprint, the ball rolling and spinning off his feet as he cuts downfield at high speed.] [RIVAL A launches into a slide tackle from behind, cleats tearing through the turf. RIVAL B catches the ball on his toe and flicks it upward in the same motion. The ball arcs high and clear above the sliding boot.] [RIVAL B leaps. The ball hangs airborne. His right leg coils and fires — a volley strike crackling with blue electricity. The ball rockets toward goal, a trail of lightning behind it. The net erupts backward as the ball hits. Crowd detonates.]

zh.p: 一部15秒的动漫足球动作短片。夜间体育场，照明灯，欢呼的观众。旋转的足球是每个射门的核心目标——必须始终在屏幕上看到它。两个对手，定义一次：对手A = 长长的狂野黑发，黑色制服。RIVAL B = 短黑发，藏青色制服7号。仅拍摄全身动作镜头，广角和中角展示球场。0–4：开球。两名球员同时击球。球在他们靴子间剧烈旋转，冲击波将两名球员击退——球仍留在中心，仍在草地上旋转。4–9：对手B抢回球权，高速运球向前推进。低景追踪镜头：他的脚、球和草皮始终同时出现在画面中。9–12岁：对手A从后面滑入。对手B将同样的球弹向空中以躲避铲球。球在清晰可见的范围内向上弧线。12–15秒：对手B跃起，用闪电般的空中截击击中空中的球。球带着蓝色电流飞向球门。最后一局：球击中网。连贯性规则：整个视频中只有一个球存在，且在切换之间永远不会消失。缺点：没有角色肖像特写，没有闪光或闪粉效果，没有站立姿势，没有对话场景，没有没有球的场景。[夜间体育场。泛光灯照亮。足球停在中心圆圈，缓缓在草地上旋转。人群的欢呼声充满了空气。][对手A——长长的黑发，黑色制服——踩下他的靴子。对手B——短黑发，藏青色7号制服——踩上了对侧靴子。两者同时击球。球在他们相撞的靴子间剧烈旋转，冲击波向外扩散。两名选手都被击退。球依然停留在中路，仍在草地上旋转。][对手B猛地站起。低景追踪镜头——他的靴子、旋转球和草皮在同一帧中紧密相连。他全速冲刺，球在他脚下滚动旋转，高速切入。][对手A从后方发起滑铲，钉鞋撕裂草皮。对手B用脚尖接球，并用同一动作向上弹球。球高高地划过滑动靴。][对手B跳跃。球悬挂在空中。他的右腿盘旋并发射——一记蓝色电流的齐射。球飞向球门，身后划出一道闪电。球击中球门时，网向后爆开。人群爆炸。]

raw_p: A fast-paced sci-fi video sequence on a high school running track under a dark, overcast sky. A blonde woman in a navy and white tracksuit walks confidently forward as students flee. A robotic spider on her wrist rapidly expands into full-body nanotech armor—featuring white, purple, and gold plating, mechanical wings, and a glowing purple helmet. A massive rock monster charges out, and she casually destroys it with a powerful purple energy blast, creating a massive explosion of smoke and debris. zh.p: 一段在高中跑道上，阴沉阴沉天空下的快节奏科幻视频片段。一位身穿藏青白运动服的金发女子自信地走上前，学生们纷纷逃离。她手腕上的机械蜘蛛迅速扩展成全身纳米科技装甲——拥有白色、紫色和金色的装甲、机械翅膀和发光的紫色头盔。一只巨大的岩石怪物冲了出来，她随意用一记强力紫色能量爆发将其摧毁，制造出巨大的烟雾和碎片爆炸。镜头拉近，她的头盔收起，露出她微笑着向镜头吹出发光的紫色吻。电影般的灯光，逼真的视觉特效，8K。

raw_p:
Pixar-quality cinematic animated short film, highly expressive 3D characters, warm golden-hour suburban neighborhood, emotional storytelling, consistent young boy character, realistic environmental continuity, seamless scene transitions, cinematic camera work.

A cheerful young boy approaches a colorful ice cream truck and excitedly buys his favorite ice cream cone. Close-up of his smiling face as he admires the perfect scoop. He happily walks away, taking a careful first step.

Suddenly the cone slips from his hand in slow motion. The ice cream falls onto the sidewalk and splatters. Close-up of the boy's shocked expression turning into disappointment. He kneels beside the melted ice cream while other children enjoy theirs nearby. The atmosphere becomes quiet and emotional.

As the boy sadly watches from a distance, the ice cream truck driver notices what happened through the service window. The driver looks concerned and smiles warmly. He steps out of the truck holding a fresh ice cream cone.

The camera follows the driver walking toward the boy. The boy looks up in surprise. The driver gently hands him a brand-new ice cream. Close-up on the boy's widening eyes and grateful smile. Warm sunlight shines across the scene, creating a magical emotional moment.

The boy happily enjoys his replacement ice cream. Nearby, a friendly stray puppy watches curiously. The boy kneels down and shares a small bite with the puppy. The puppy wags its tail excitedly, creating a heartwarming connection.

Final cinematic sequence: the ice cream truck drives away down the glowing suburban street, the boy and puppy walking side by side through golden sunlight. Wide aerial pullback revealing a peaceful neighborhood, long sunset shadows, warm emotional atmosphere, wholesome family-friendly ending, cinematic depth of field, realistic animation physics, expressive facial acting, emotional orchestral music, Pixar-inspired storytelling, theme of kindness turning disappointment into happiness.

一个开朗的小男孩走向一辆色彩斑斑的冰淇淋车，兴奋地买下了他最喜欢的冰淇淋甜筒。他微笑着欣赏完美独家的特写。他高兴地走开，小心翼翼地迈出第一步。

突然，锥形棒慢动作滑落。冰淇淋掉在人行道上溅了出来。男孩震惊表情转为失望的特写。他跪在融化的冰淇淋旁，其他孩子则在附近享用他们的冰淇淋。气氛变得安静而充满情感。

男孩悲伤地远远看着，冰淇淋车司机透过服务窗口注意到发生了什么。司机看起来很关切，温柔地微笑着。他手里拿着一个新鲜的冰淇淋筒走下卡车。

摄像机跟随司机走向男孩。男孩惊讶地抬头。司机轻轻递给他一瓶全新的冰淇淋。特写男孩睁大的眼睛和感激的微笑。温暖的阳光洒满整个场景，营造出一个神奇的情感时刻。

男孩开心地享用着替代的冰淇淋。附近，一只友善的流浪小狗好奇地注视着。男孩跪下，和小狗分享了一小口。小狗兴奋地摇着尾巴，营造出温馨的联系。

en.p:
Pixar-quality cinematic animated short film, highly expressive 3D characters, warm golden-hour suburban neighborhood, emotional storytelling, consistent young boy character, realistic environmental continuity, seamless scene transitions, cinematic camera work.

A cheerful young boy approaches a colorful ice cream truck and excitedly buys his favorite ice cream cone. Close-up of his smiling face as he admires the perfect scoop. He happily walks away, taking a careful first step.

Suddenly the cone slips from his hand in slow motion. The ice cream falls onto the sidewalk and splatters. Close-up of the boy's shocked expression turning into disappointment. He kneels beside the melted ice cream while other children enjoy theirs nearby. The atmosphere becomes quiet and emotional.

As the boy sadly watches from a distance, the ice cream truck driver notices what happened through the service window. The driver looks concerned and smiles warmly. He steps out of the truck holding a fresh ice cream cone.

The camera follows the driver walking toward the boy. The boy looks up in surprise. The driver gently hands him a brand-new ice cream. Close-up on the boy's widening eyes and grateful smile. Warm sunlight shines across the scene, creating a magical emotional moment.

The boy happily enjoys his replacement ice cream. Nearby, a friendly stray puppy watches curiously. The boy kneels down and shares a small bite with the puppy. The puppy wags its tail excitedly, creating a heartwarming connection.

Final cinematic sequence: the ice cream truck drives away down the glowing suburban street, the boy and puppy walking side by side through golden sunlight. Wide aerial pullback revealing a peaceful neighborhood, long sunset shadows, warm emotional atmosphere, wholesome family-friendly ending, cinematic depth of field, realistic animation physics, expressive facial acting, emotional orchestral music, Pixar-inspired storytelling, theme of kindness turning disappointment into happiness.

raw_p:
Create a cinematic luxury penthouse scene at sunset with eight elegant women and their cats. The camera follows a smooth continuous motion path, moving from one woman to the next. Each woman is holding, sitting beside, or petting her cat. As the camera arrives at each character, it briefly pushes into a close-up. The woman looks directly at the camera, smiles naturally, gently interacts with her cat, and introduces the cat by name.
Motion Pattern: Fly In → Close-up → Cat Name Introduction → Pull Back → Follow Red Path → Next Character
Sequence:
Luna (Australia) cuddles her Ragdoll cat and says: "This is Lilac."
Hana (South Korea) strokes her Russian Blue cat and says: "Meet Mochi."
Alexa (USA) sits behind her desk with a Maine Coon and says: "Say hello to Shadow."
Yuki (Japan) smiles beside her Scottish Fold and says: "This is Maru."
Kiara (Brazil) plays with her Bengal cat and says: "Meet Leo."
Nina (France) sits on the floor with her Ragdoll cat and says: "This is Loulou."
Sofia (Italy) gently pets her Siberian cat and says: "Meet Bella."
Maya (Thailand) sits elegantly with her Himalayan cat and says: "And this is Nala."
After the final introduction, the camera pulls back into a wide shot showing all eight women and their cats together. The cats naturally interact, play, stretch, and walk around while the women smile and laugh. Warm sunset lighting, cinematic depth of field, smooth camera transitions, luxury interior, realistic cat behavior, natural facial expressions, high-end commercial quality, Pixar-inspired realism, elegant and wholesome atmosphere, 16:9.

zh.p:
在夕阳下打造一幅电影般的豪华顶层公寓场景，八位优雅的女性和她们的猫咪。摄像机沿着平滑的连续运动路径移动，从一个女人移动到另一个女人。每位女性都抱着、坐在旁边或抚摸她的猫。当镜头接近每个角色时，会短暂地进入特写。这位女士直视镜头，自然地微笑，温柔地与猫互动，并介绍猫的名字。
动作模式：飞入→特写→猫名介绍→拉远→沿着红色路径移动→下一个角色
顺序：
Luna（澳大利亚）抱着她的布偶猫说：“这是Lilac。”
韩国的花抚摸着她的俄罗斯蓝猫说：“认识一下麻糬。”
Alexa（美国）坐在办公桌后，手里有一只缅因猫，说：“跟Shadow打个招呼。”
Yuki（日本）在她的苏格兰折叠裙旁微笑着说：“这是Maru。”
Kiara（巴西）和她的孟加拉猫玩耍，说：“认识一下Leo。”
妮娜（法兰斯饰）坐在地板上，抱着她的布偶猫说：“这是卢卢。”
索菲亚（意大利）轻轻抚摸她的西伯利亚猫，说：“认识一下贝拉。”
Maya（泰国）优雅地和她的喜马拉雅猫坐在一起，说：“这是Nala。”
在最后的介绍结束后，镜头拉远进入一个广角镜头，展示了八位女性和她们的猫咪们聚集在一起。猫咪们自然地互动、玩耍、伸展和走动，而女性则微笑着欢笑。温暖的夕阳光线、电影般的景深、流畅的镜头切换、豪华的室内、逼真的猫咪行为、自然的面部表情、高端商业品质、受皮克斯启发的现实主义、优雅健康的氛围、16：9比例。

raw_p:
幻想的な夜の水辺、バイオルミネセンスに包まれた森、青緑に発光する水面、水中を泳ぐ巨大で神秘的な水棲生物を主人公として扱ってください。 

 @画像1＝絵コンテの参照。 
 @画像1の12コマの流れ、構図、カメラアングル、光、反射、水中表現を参照してください。
ただし、絵コンテの黒枠、番号、パネル分割、文字は完成映像に絶対に出さないでください。 添付された絵コンテをもとに、15秒の横型16:9「幻想的な夜の水辺を巨大水棲生物が優雅に泳ぐ神秘的シネマティックシーン」動画を作成してください。 テーマ：映像の美しさで魅了する神作画 絵コンテのパネル順に沿って、夜のバイオルミネセンス湿地、水面、水中世界、巨大水棲生物の出現、接近、優雅な遊泳、そして静かな余韻までを、1本の流れるような美しい映像として動画化してください。 激しい戦闘やホラーではなく、圧倒的な映像美、光の反射、水の揺らぎ、水中粒子、巨大生物の優雅な動きで観客を魅了する映像にしてください。 

流れ： 0.0〜1.2秒： 水面を境に、上は青緑に発光する幻想的な森、下は深い水中世界が見えるスプリットレベルの超ワイドショット。水面には細かな波紋、蓮の葉、反射光。水中の奥には巨大水棲生物の影がゆっくり横切る。 

1.2〜2.4秒： カメラが水面ギリギリを低く滑るように前進する。発光するツタ、湿った葉、浮かぶ水草、青緑の反射が画面手前を流れていく。水面の揺れと反射を美しく見せる。 

2.4〜3.4秒： 葉先の水滴の超接写。透明な水滴の中に森の青緑の光が反射している。水滴が震え、ゆっくり落下する。背景は美しいボケ、発光粒子が漂う。 

3.4〜4.6秒： 水滴が水面に落ち、水中へ光の輪が広がる。小さな発光魚が一斉に散る。水中に泡、波紋、粒子、光の筋が広がり、静かな一滴が世界全体を動かしたように見せる。 

4.6〜5.9秒： 水中の広角ショット。巨大な水棲生物が遠くに現れる。恐怖ではなく、神秘的で優しい存在感。上から青い光芒が差し込み、周囲を小魚と発光粒子が漂う。 

5.9〜7.1秒： カメラが水中植物の間をすり抜けながら、巨大水棲生物の横を追跡する。前景には揺れる水草、奥には巨大な体.魚群がカメラ前を横切り、奥行きとスケール感を強調する。 

7.1〜8.3秒： 水中の根や巨大な樹の根元から、上方向へカメラがティルトアップする。水面の向こうに巨大な発光樹と垂れ下がるツタが見える。水中から森を見上げる、神秘的で壮大な構図。 

8.3〜9.5秒： 俯瞰ショット。水面に浮かぶ蓮の葉、円形の波紋、下を通る巨大生物の影。水面全体がゆっくり歪み、巨大な存在が近くにいることを視覚的に伝える。 

9.5〜10.7秒： 半水面ショット。画面上半分には発光する夜の森、画面下半分には水中を泳ぐ巨大水棲生物。水面の境界が美しく揺れ、上下の世界が同時に見える。カメラはゆっくり横移動する。

 10.7〜12.0秒： 巨大水棲生物の頭部または目元の超接写。体表には微細な発光模様、青緑の粒子、柔らかな水中光。目は穏やかで知性を感じる。怪物ではなく、古代から森を守っているような神秘性を出す。 

12.0〜13.7秒： クライマックス。巨大水棲生物が優雅に体をひねって泳ぎ、水中に光の軌跡、泡、粒子、波紋が広がる。上から差し込む光芒が体表をなぞり、水面にも美しい反射が生まれる。水と光のVFXは実写映画級の質感で、重さ、透明感、屈折、揺らぎをリアルに表現する。 

13.7〜15.0秒： 最後は再び広いスプリットレベルの静かな構図。上には発光する森、下には青い水中世界。巨大水棲生物は奥の深みにゆっくり消えていく。水面の波紋が落ち着き、粒子だけが漂う。観客に余韻と神秘を残して終了する。 

スタイル： 高品質アニメ映画風、神作画、シネマティック、ハイディテール、幻想的な夜の森、バイオルミネセンス、青緑の発光、深いネイビーの夜、水面反射、水中の透明感、実写映画級VFX、繊細な水しぶき、泡、粒子、光芒、屈折、コースティクス、霧、湿度感、静かな神秘性。 人物は登場させない。世界そのものと巨大水棲生物を主人公として描く。 

編集： リズム感のある美しいカット展開、ワイドショット、超接写、ローアングル、水面ギリギリの低空移動、俯瞰、水中トラッキング、斜め構図、半水面ショット、ゆっくりしたプッシュイン、滑らかなパン、気持ちのいいマッチカットを使用してください。 テンポは速すぎず、映像美を味わえる流れにしてください。ただし静止画の連続にはせず、常に水、光、魚、粒子、植物、カメラが自然に動き続ける映像にしてください。

en.p:
Treat the magical nighttime waterside, forests wrapped in bioluminescence, glowing blue water surfaces, and huge, mysterious aquatic creatures swimming underwater as your protagonists. 

@画像1 = Storyboard reference. 
 @画像1の12コマの流れ refer to composition, camera angles, lighting, reflections, and underwater expressions.
However, never display the black frames, numbers, panel divisions, or text on the storyboard in the final video. Based on the attached storyboard, create a 15-second landscape 16:9 video titled "A mysterious cinematic scene where giant aquatic creatures gracefully swim along a magical nighttime waterfront." Theme: A masterpiece captivating with the beauty of visuals. raw_p: 生成 10 秒竖屏 9:16 视频，真实手机偷拍视频风格。场景是夜晚海上的大型渔船甲板，右侧是漆黑的大海，左侧和远处是白色船体结构、栏杆、工作灯和几名船员。甲板湿滑反光，有海水、金属舱盖、绳索和船用挂钩。强烈白色船灯照亮甲板，远处海面几乎全黑，画面有低清手机压缩感、手持抖动、运动模糊和夜间噪点。 内容是几条大型金枪鱼为了躲避巨大鲨鱼追捕，慌不择路地从海里跳到渔船甲板上。整体氛围真实、混乱、荒诞、带一点黑色幽默，像船员手机突然拍到的离谱瞬间。 画面开始时，镜头站在甲板靠左位置，斜拍右侧船舷和黑色海面。几名船员穿着黄色、橙色或深色防水围裙、雨衣和手套，站在甲板后方。他们原本在看海面，突然被跳上来的鱼吓到，身体后退、抬手、惊叫。 动作节奏： 0-2 秒：第一条大型金枪鱼从右侧黑色海面突然跃过船舷，重重摔到湿滑甲板上。鱼身银白、流线型、体型很大，尾巴剧烈拍打甲板，水花四溅。船员被吓得后退。 2-4 秒：第二条、第三条金枪鱼接连从右侧海面跳上船，一条落在甲板中间，一条滑向船员脚边。它们疯狂扭动、拍尾、滑行，甲板上水花和反光更加混乱。船员惊慌地躲开，有人扶着栏杆，有人张嘴喊叫。 4-6 秒：镜头轻微后退和晃动，跟随甲板上的鱼群。几条金枪鱼在甲板上乱跳，尾巴高速拍打，身体反光明显。右侧黑色海面忽然出现巨大的水花和阴影，暗示有更大的东西正在逼近。 6-8 秒：巨大鲨鱼从右侧船舷外的黑海里猛地冲出水面，但不要跳到船上。它停留在船外，身体大部分仍在海里，只把巨大的头部和上半身冲到船舷高度。鲨鱼张开血盆大口，露出多排尖牙，嘴巴朝向甲板上的金枪鱼，像马上要咬上来。水花猛烈拍打船舷，船员被吓得猛然后退。 8-10 秒：鲨鱼的大嘴贴近船舷和镜头方向，占据画面右侧前景，张口咆哮般逼近但没有上船。甲板上的金枪鱼还在乱跳，船员在背景中惊叫、抬手、后退。镜头剧烈晃动，像拍摄者被鲨鱼张嘴吓到往后缩。最后定格在鲨鱼血盆大口、船员惊恐和湿滑甲板鱼群混乱的瞬间。 镜头语言：全程手持竖屏手机拍摄，一镜到底，不要切镜。镜头站在甲板上，始终能看到右侧黑色海面和船舷。鱼跳上船时镜头轻微跟随和后退；鲨鱼张嘴冲出水面时镜头明显惊慌抖动，但鲨鱼不能爬上甲板，不能完全落到船上。 声音：夜晚海风声、船体机械低频声、海浪拍船声、鱼摔到湿甲板上的沉重拍击声、鱼尾疯狂拍打声、水花声、船员惊叫声。鲨鱼冲出水面张嘴时有巨大水声、船员尖叫和惊呼，最后是混乱的喊叫和镜头后退的声音。 视觉重点：黑色夜海、白色渔船甲板、几条大型银白金枪鱼先后跳上船、船员惊慌后退、最后巨大鲨鱼在船舷外张开血盆大口逼近但没有上船。画面要真实、低清、离谱但可信，像突发偷拍视频。 负面要求：不要让鲨鱼跳到甲板上，不要让鲨鱼完全上船，不要卡通风，不要动画片质感，不要干净电影感，不要白天海滩，不要血腥，不要把金枪鱼变成小鱼，不要把鲨鱼变成鲸鱼或海豚，不要多只鲨鱼，不要让鲨鱼太早出现，不要切镜，不要文字，不要水印。

en.t: Tuna Jumps Boat To Escape Shark
en.p: Generates 10-second vertical 9:16 video, in the style of real phone candid videos. The scene is the deck of a large fishing boat at night at sea, with the pitch-black sea to the right, and the white hull structure, railings, work lights, and several crew members on the left and far away. The deck is slippery and reflective, with seawater, metal hatches, ropes, and boat hooks. Bright white boat lights illuminate the deck, while the distant sea is almost completely black, with low-definition phone compression, handheld shake, motion blur, and nighttime noise. The story shows several large tuna hastily jumping from the sea onto the deck of a fishing boat to evade a giant shark. The overall atmosphere is real, chaotic, absurd, and tinged with dark humor—like a ridiculous moment suddenly captured by a crew member's phone. At the start of the frame, the camera stands on the left side of the deck, obliquely filming the right side of the ship and the black sea. Several crew members wore yellow, orange, or dark waterproof aprons, raincoats, and gloves, standing behind the deck. They were originally watching the sea, but were startled by the fish that suddenly jumped up, stepping back, raising their hands, and screaming. Action rhythm: 0-2 seconds: The first large tuna suddenly leaps over the ship's rail from the black sea on the right side, crashing heavily onto the slippery deck. The fish has a silvery white, streamlined body, and a large body. Its tail slaps violently against the deck, splashing water everywhere. The crew was so frightened they retreated. 2-4 seconds: The second and third tuna jump onto the boat from the right side of the sea in succession, one landing in the middle of the deck, the other sliding toward the crew's feet. They twisted wildly, tailed their tails, and glided, making the splashes and reflections on deck even more chaotic. The crew panicked and dodged; some held onto the railing, others opened their mouths and shouted. 4-6 seconds: The camera slightly retracts and shakes, following the school of fish on the deck. Several tuna jumped wildly on the deck, their tails flapping at high speed, their bodies reflecting obviously. On the right side, a huge splash and shadows suddenly appeared on the black sea surface, suggesting that something larger was approaching. 6-8 seconds: The giant shark suddenly bursts out of the water from the Black Sea outside the right side of the ship, but do not jump onto the boat. It hovered outside the ship, most of its body still in the sea, only pushing its massive head and upper body to the ship's rail level. The shark opened its bloody mouth, revealing multiple rows of sharp teeth, its mouth pointing toward the tuna on the deck, as if about to bite. The water splashed violently against the ship's railing, and the crew was so frightened that they quickly retreated. 8-10 seconds: The shark's large mouth presses close to the ship's side and the direction of the camera, occupying the right foreground of the frame, roaring as it approaches but does not board the boat. The tuna on deck were still jumping wildly, and the crew screamed, raised their hands, and stepped back in the background. The camera shakes violently, as if the photographer is startled by the shark's mouth opening and shrinks back. The final moment was captured by sharks with bloody jaws, crew panic, and the chaos of fish on the slippery deck. Camera language: Hold a vertical screen phone throughout the shoot, take one continuous shot, no cuts. The camera stands on the deck, always showing the black sea surface and the ship's side on the right. When the fish jumps onto the boat, the camera slightly follows and retreats; When the shark opened its mouth and rushed out of the water, the camera clearly panicked and shook, but the shark couldn't climb onto the deck or fully land on the boat. Sounds: The sound of the night sea breeze, the low-frequency sound of the ship's machinery, the sound of waves crashing on the boat, the heavy crash of fish hitting the wet deck, the frantic slapping of fish tails, splashing water, and the crew's screams. When the shark bursts out of the water and opens its mouth, there is a loud splash, crew screams and screams, and finally chaotic shouts and the sound of cameras retreating. Visual highlights: Black night sea, white fishing boat deck, several large silver-white tuna jumping onto the boat one after another, crew members panicked and retreated, and finally, a giant shark opened its bloody mouth outside the ship's side but did not board. The footage should be realistic, low-definition, absurd but believable, like a sudden hidden camera. Negative requirements: Don't let sharks jump onto the deck, don't let sharks fully board the boat, don't have cartoonish air, don't have cartoon-like texture, don't look clean or cinematic, don't beach during the day, don't gore, don't turn tuna into small fish, don't turn sharks into whales or dolphins, don't have multiple sharks, don't let sharks appear too early, don't cut the mirror, don't use text, don't watermark.

raw_p:
A megalodon, whale-sized with scarred grey hide, is chasing a navy speedboat across open ocean in dramatic stormy daylight. Huge swells, a half-sunken rusted cargo ship ahead, a submarine's periscope cutting the water beyond it. Sound: screaming engines, crashing waves, sonar pings, radio chatter, shark breaching.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Aerial tracking shot. The megalodon breaches fully out of the speedboat's wake, jaws wide as a garage door, crashing back down meters behind the stern in an eruption of white water. The boat crew hangs on, soaked, the commander roaring into his radio: "IT'S RIGHT ON US! SUB, YOU READY?"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Periscope POV with crosshairs, then cut inside the submarine. The captain at the scope: "Torpedo armed. Bring it through the wreck — we'll meet it on the other side." Weapons officer slams the launch panel. Underwater shot — a torpedo bursts from the tube, screwing through dark water.

Shot 3 (6–9s): Water-level tracking shot. The speedboat races straight at the half-sunken cargo ship, threading through a torn gash in its rusted hull at full speed — sparks off the bow rail — out the other side. Behind, the megalodon doesn't turn. It accelerates.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The shark smashes THROUGH the cargo ship's hull after them — rusted steel plates exploding outward in slow motion. Bullet time — the megalodon erupts from the wreckage, jaws open, sheet metal and rivets suspended around its head — and meets the incoming torpedo nose-first. Detonation. Ship, shark, and sea vanish inside a colossal dome of fire and white water, debris frozen mid-bloom.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The blast wave overtakes the speedboat, nearly swamping it as flaming wreckage rains across the swells. The crew rises from the deck, drenched, staring at the burning ship carcass settling behind them. The commander keys his radio, grinning: "Good tag." Periscope drops below the surface.

zh.p:
一只鲸鱼大小、皮肤布满灰色疤痕的巨齿鲨，在暴风雨交加的白天追逐一艘海军快艇穿越公海。巨大的海浪，前方一艘半沉的生锈货船，潜艇的潜望镜切割着水面。声音：引擎尖叫声，海浪拍打声，声纳信号，无线电杂音，鲨鱼冲出。

第一枪（0–3秒）——THE HOOK：空中跟踪镜头。巨齿鲨完全从快艇尾迹中冲出，张大嘴巴如车库门，猛然撞击船尾后方数米处，激流如洪水般爆发。艇员们浑身湿透，紧紧抓住，指挥官在无线电里怒吼：“它就在我们身边！SUB，准备好了吗？”

镜头2（3–6秒）：潜望镜视角，带准星，然后切入潜艇内部。舰长在瞄准镜前说：“鱼雷已装填。把它带过残骸——我们会在另一边会合。”武器官猛地关上发射面板。水下镜头——一枚鱼雷从发射管中爆发，穿过黑暗水域。

第三镜头（6–9秒）：水面跟踪镜头。快艇直冲半沉的货船，全速穿过锈蚀船体上的裂口——船首栏杆溅出火花——从另一侧冲出。身后，巨齿鲨没有转身。它加速了。

镜头4（9–13秒）——子弹时间回报：鲨鱼冲破货船船体，生锈的钢板慢动作向外爆裂。子弹时间——巨齿鲨从残骸中爆发，张开大嘴，头部悬挂着金属板和铆钉——并以鱼雷头部先下撞击来袭鱼雷。爆炸。船只、鲨鱼和海洋消失在一个巨大的火焰与白水穹顶中，碎片冻结在花开中。

第5个镜头（13–15秒）：时间恢复。爆炸波席卷快艇，几乎将其淹没，燃烧的残骸如雨般洒落在波浪上。船员们从甲板上站起，浑身湿透，凝视着身后燃烧的船体残骸。指挥官按下无线电键，咧嘴笑着说：“标记得好。”潜望镜沉入水面以下。

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The blast wave overtakes the speedboat, nearly swamping it as flaming wreckage rains across the swells. The crew rises from the deck, drenched, staring at the burning ship carcass settling behind them. The commander keys his radio, grinning: "Good tag." Periscope drops below the surface.

raw_p:
日本のフルカラーアニメーション。壮大で幻想的な海底都市を舞台にした高速シネマティック映像。色鮮やかな珊瑚の高層建築、発光するクラゲ型の街灯、透明な水中道路。無数の魚、エビ、カニ、タツノオトシゴたちが人間の服を着て歩き回り、レトロフューチャーな水中飛行艇や潜水スクーターを操縦している。カメラは超高速の鞭パンショットで海底都市を駆け抜け、人々の活気あふれる生活を映し出す。

やがて巨大で古びた城壁に囲まれた区域へ到達する。苔むした汚れた石壁の中央には巨大な木製の門。門の前には無表情なタコの門番兼切符係が立っている。タコは古風な車掌・チケット係の制服を着用し、静かに巨大な木の門を押し開く。カメラはその隙間へ猛スピードで突入する。

門を通過した瞬間、世界が一変する。海水が一気に引いていき、壮大なトランジション。眩しい太陽、青い空、揺れるヤシの木。そこは活気あふれるハワイアンビーチバー。陽光に照らされた白い砂浜では、海水パンツを履いた猫たちが大歓声を上げながらビーチバレーを楽しんでいる。カラフルなカクテル、サーフボード、トロピカルな装飾、陽気なウクレレとサマー・ジャズの演奏。

すると画面右側から巨大なぽっちゃりしたオレンジ猫が勢いよくフレームインする。オレンジ猫は貝殻のネックレスを首に掛け、青いトロピカルカクテルを片手に持っている。眉をひそめ、怒った表情でカメラへ近づく。超クローズアップ。オレンジ猫は観客を睨みながら英語で叫ぶ。

"Bro, where is your ticket?"

直後、オレンジ猫が拳を振り上げ、カメラへ向かって強烈なパンチを繰り出す。衝撃で画面が大きく揺れる。映像が破損したようなデジタルノイズ、グリッチ、信号障害音。激しい電子ノイズとともに画面は完全なブラックアウト。シネマティック、ユーモラス、予測不能な異世界アドベンチャー、ダイナミックなカメラワーク、映画級アニメーション品質、豊富な環境ディテール、鮮やかな色彩、圧倒的なスピード感。

en.p:
Japanese full-color animation. High-speed cinematic visuals set in a grand and fantastical underwater city. Vividly colored coral skyscrapers, glowing jellyfish-shaped streetlights, and transparent underwater roads. Countless fish, shrimp, crabs, and seahorses roam around dressed in human costumes, piloting retro-futuristic flying boats and dive scooters. The camera races through the underwater city with ultra-fast whip-punch shots, capturing the vibrant lives of its people.

Eventually, they reach an area surrounded by huge, old castle walls. In the center of the moss-covered, dirty stone wall stands a massive wooden gate. In front of the gate stands an expressionless octopus gatekeeper who also serves as ticket attendant. The octopus, dressed in an old-fashioned conductor and ticket attendant's uniform, quietly pushes open the massive wooden gate. The camera rushes into the gap at high speed.

The moment you pass through the gate, the world changes dramatically. The seawater recedes all at once, creating a magnificent transition. The dazzling sun, blue sky, and swaying palm trees. It's a lively Hawaiian beach bar. On a sunlit white sandy beach, cats in swim trunks cheer loudly while enjoying beach volleyball. Colorful cocktails, surfboards, tropical decorations, lively ukuleles, and summer jazz performances.

Then, from the right side of the screen, a huge, chubby orange cat bursts into frame with great force. The orange cat wears a shell necklace around her neck and holds a blue tropical cocktail in one hand. He frowns and approaches the camera with an angry expression. Super close-up. The orange cat shouts in English while glaring at the audience.

"Bro, where is your ticket?"

Immediately after, the orange cat raises its fist and throws a powerful punch toward the camera. The impact causes the screen to shake violently. Digital noise, glitches, and signal interference sounds that seem to be corrupted in the video. The screen completely blacked out along with intense electronic noise. Cinematic, humorous, unpredictable otherworldly adventure, dynamic camera work, cinematic animation quality, rich environmental details, vivid colors, and overwhelming speed.

raw_p:
A giant crocodile, big as a bus, is chasing a military speedboat down a massive concrete dam spillway channel in bright stormy daylight. White water thundering, towering dam wall ahead, floodgate slowly closing. Sound: screaming outboard engines, crashing water, crocodile bellowing, klaxon alarm, radio chatter.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low rear tracking shot skimming the water. The speedboat rips down the spillway channel at full throttle, and the giant crocodile smashes through the floating boom barriers behind it, splintering them like matchsticks, jaws snapping at the engine wake. The driver glances back, yelling into his radio: "IT'S STILL ON US! IS THE GATE OPEN?"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Wide dramatic shot down the channel. Ahead, the huge steel floodgate is grinding downward, the gap beneath it shrinking, water roaring through. On the dam wall high above, a gunner with a rocket launcher sprints into position, screaming into his radio: "GATE'S CLOSING! YOU'VE GOT ONE SHOT — GO NOW!"

Shot 3 (6–9s): Side tracking shot at hull level. The boat hits maximum speed, spray exploding off the bow, the crocodile's jaws closing on the stern — its teeth clip the engine cowling — the driver throws his whole body forward as the boat threads under the descending gate with inches to spare, scraping steel.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The crocodile lunges through after it. Bullet time — the massive steel gate slams down across its back mid-lunge, pinning it, jaws thrashing wide in slow motion, white water and sparks suspended — and the rocket streaks down from the dam wall, straight into the pinned skull. Direct hit. The explosion blossoms against the dam face, fire and concrete dust blooming over the churning spillway.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The shockwave flattens the water. The speedboat skids out into the open river below, the driver looking back at the burning gate, fist raised. Above, the gunner lowers the smoking launcher and keys his radio: "Gate's closed." Cut.

zh.p:
一只巨大的鳄鱼，体型如公交车，在暴风雨交加的白天，沿着巨大的混凝土大坝溢洪道追逐一艘军用快艇。激流如雷，前方高耸的坝壁，闸门缓缓关闭。声音：外侧发动机尖叫，水流撞击声，鳄鱼吼叫，警报声，无线电杂音。

第一枪（0–3秒）——钩子：低距离后方追踪，擦水而过。快艇全速冲进溢洪道，巨型鳄鱼撞破身后的浮动栏杆，像火柴一样碎裂，嘴巴咬着引擎尾流。司机回头看了看，对着无线电喊道：“还在我们这边！门开着吗？”

第二杆（3–6秒）：沿航道远角戏剧性击球。前方，巨大的钢制防洪闸门正向下磨擦，门下的缝隙逐渐缩小，水流轰鸣而过。在高处的大坝墙上，一名持火箭筒的炮手冲到位置，对着无线电大喊：“大门正在关闭！你只有一次机会——现在就走！”

第三枪（6–9秒）：船体水平侧向跟踪射击。船速达到最大，水花从船头喷涌而出，鳄鱼的下颚咬住船尾——它的牙齿擦过发动机罩——驾驶员全身向前倾，船只在下行闸门下穿过，擦过钢铁。

第四枪（9–13秒）——子弹时间回报：鳄鱼冲过去追赶它。子弹时间——巨大的钢铁门在它背部猛然撞击，将它钉住，下颚慢动作张开，白水和火花悬浮——火箭从大坝墙上直冲，直击被钉住的头骨。直接命中。爆炸在大坝表面绽放，火和混凝土尘埃在翻滚的溢洪道上方蔓延。

第5个镜头（13–15秒）：时间恢复。冲击波使水面平坦。快艇滑入下方的开阔河面，司机回望着燃烧的门，拳头高举。上方，炮手放下冒烟的发射器，按下无线电键：“大门关闭。”停。

raw_p:
A T-rex-scale giant lizard is chasing a military cargo plane down a long runway at full takeoff speed in bright harsh daylight. Heat shimmer, dust clouds, scattered burning vehicles along the airstrip. Sound: screaming turboprops, thundering footsteps, roaring, ramp hydraulics, radio chatter.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Rear tracking shot from inside the open cargo ramp. The colossal lizard sprints down the runway behind the accelerating plane, head low, jaws snapping shut meters from the ramp where a lone soldier stands braced against the wind. Its footsteps crater the tarmac. The soldier screams into his headset: "IT'S FASTER THAN US! WE'RE NOT GONNA MAKE ROTATION!"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Cockpit shot. Pilots shoving throttles to the wall, runway end markers rushing closer in the windshield, the airframe shaking. Pilot: "Dump the load! DUMP EVERYTHING!" Behind them through the fuselage, the soldier slashes the cargo straps on a parked humvee with his knife.

Shot 3 (6–9s): Low side tracking shot at wheel height. The lizard lunges, jaws closing on the ramp edge — steel shrieks and buckles — the plane's tail dips. The soldier kicks the final strap loose and throws his whole body against the humvee as the deck tilts: "EAT THIS!"

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The humvee rolls off the ramp. Bullet time — it tumbles through the air in slow motion straight into the lizard's open mouth mid-stride. The monster bites down on three tons of steel, its sprint breaks, legs tangling — it trips at full speed, and the humvee's fuel tank detonates between its jaws. The giant body cartwheels down the runway inside a rolling fireball, tarmac chunks and flame suspended around it.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The cargo plane lifts off at the runway's last meter, climbing steeply over the burning, tumbling carcass below. The soldier hangs onto the mangled ramp, wind howling, laughing like a madman. The wreck burns down the runway behind them. Cut.

zh.p:
一只霸王龙级别的巨型蜥蜴在明亮刺眼的白天，以全速起飞追逐一架军用货机。热浪闪烁，尘土飞扬，散落在跑道上燃烧的车辆。声音：涡桨轰鸣声，雷鸣般的脚步声，轰鸣声，斜坡液压声，无线电杂音。

第一枪（0–3秒）——钩子：从敞开货舱内进行的后方跟踪射击。这只庞大的蜥蜴在加速的飞机后面飞奔跑道，低着头，嘴巴紧闭，距离停机坪只有几米远，那里一名孤独士兵正抵御风。它的脚步声在停机坪上撞击。士兵对着耳机尖叫：“它比我们快！我们轮换不了！”

镜头2（3–6秒）：驾驶舱镜头。飞行员把油门推到墙上，跑道末端的标记在挡风玻璃上飞速靠近，机体在颤抖。飞行员：“卸货！把一切都扔掉！”在他们身后，穿过机身，士兵用刀割断停放的悍马车的货带。

第三次镜头（6–9秒）：轮高处的低侧向跟踪镜头。蜥蜴猛扑，嘴巴咬住舷梯边缘——钢铁尖叫并弯曲——飞机尾部下沉。士兵踢开最后一条绑带，整个身体撞向悍马车，甲板倾斜：“吃这个！”

第四镜头（9–13秒）——子弹时间回报：悍马车从坡道滚下。子弹时间——它慢动作地在空中翻滚，直击蜥蜴张开的嘴巴。怪物咬住三吨钢铁，冲刺中断，双腿缠绕——它全速绊倒，悍马的油箱在它嘴巴间爆炸。巨人身躯在跑道上翻滚，火球中燃烧着沥青块和火焰。

第5个镜头（13–15秒）：时间恢复。货机在跑道最后一米处起飞，陡峭爬升，飞越下方燃烧翻滚的尸体。士兵紧抓着被毁的斜坡，风呼啸，像疯子一样大笑。残骸在他们身后的跑道上起火焚毁。停。

zh.p:
旅行者缓缓跑进一座破败的实验室，机械火花四溅，天花板横梁坠落，尘埃在光束中飞扬，镜头拉远，电影般的登场，浅景深。
旅行者摇动着黄铜旋钮，仪表骤然变红，手掌在炽热的金属上燃烧，琥珀色警报闪烁，电影般的特写。
极近的计时器失控旋转，齿轮发光磨擦，能量过载，微距镜头。
一圈光芒猛烈撕裂，闪电划过房间，碎片被吸向它，戏剧性的逆光，极慢动作。
传送门缓缓不稳定，旋转的能量喷射着灼烧墙壁的能量，房间震动，电影般的慢动作。
旅行者抵挡着拉扯，咬紧下巴，头发和外套在风暴中飘扬，电影般的肖像。
旅行者猛地伸手向传送门，身后一道坠落的光束撞击，指尖迸发涟漪，戏剧性的聚光灯，电影般的特写。
旅行者缓缓穿过门槛，实验室坍塌，被刺眼的光芒吞没，电影式的揭示，体积光。

Handheld mobile phone footage at night on a fishing boat deck in the open ocean. Bright boat lights illuminate the wet deck as large silver tuna suddenly leap out of the dark water and crash onto the boat. The fish flop and thrash violently while fishermen in orange and yellow rain gear react in panic, dodging and trying to grab the jumping tuna. Chaotic energy with people moving quickly and shouting. The shaky phone camera captures the wild scene with motion blur and raw handheld movement. In the final two seconds, a massive shark suddenly bursts out of the water right in front of the camera, mouth open - cut to static like the camera got damaged.

zh.p:
夜间在公海渔船甲板上拍摄的手持手机录像。明亮的船灯照亮湿润的甲板，巨大的银色金枪鱼突然从黑暗的水中跃出，撞击在船上。鱼群剧烈挣扎，而穿着橙黄雨具的渔民们惊慌失措，躲避并试图抓住跳跃的金枪鱼。混乱的能量，人们快速移动并喊叫。颤抖的手机摄像头用动态模糊和原始手持动作捕捉了狂野的场景。最后两秒，一条巨大的鲨鱼突然从水中冲出，嘴巴张开——画面切换成静态画面，好像摄像机受损了。

病毒式社交媒体风格，逼真的夜间灯光，湿润反光表面，紧张刺激，纪录片风格手持画面

en.p:
Handheld mobile phone footage at night on a fishing boat deck in the open ocean. Bright boat lights illuminate the wet deck as large silver tuna suddenly leap out of the dark water and crash onto the boat. The fish flop and thrash violently while fishermen in orange and yellow rain gear react in panic, dodging and trying to grab the jumping tuna. Chaotic energy with people moving quickly and shouting. The shaky phone camera captures the wild scene with motion blur and raw handheld movement. In the final two seconds, a massive shark suddenly bursts out of the water right in front of the camera, mouth open - cut to static like the camera got damaged. 

Viral social media style, realistic night lighting, wet reflective surfaces, high tension and excitement, documentary-style handheld footage

en.p: A realistic fixed-camera short video comedy with two storyboards, all characters are clearly adults, fully dressed. All props are plastic cartoon toys or safety comedy props. Overall, it's an absurd twist comedy, not real violence, not bloody, not bloody, not ambiguous, not explicit. [00:00-00:07] Shot 1 - Fixed Interior Lens: At night, inside the car cab, the lens is fixed at the center console and completely stationary: no push-pull, no shaking, no zoom, no recomposition. In the footage, a sloppy adult man hf_20260506_032645_e6665446-0056-40fc-b99f-8d85619f8789 is driving in a dirty white vest, with an adult woman sitting in the passenger seat. Suddenly, it felt as if someone cut in ahead. The man braked hard, his body paused forward, and he slammed the steering wheel angrily. He pulled out an exaggerated, cheap plastic cartoon toy knife from next to his seat and angrily opened the car door. The woman in the front passenger hurriedly tried to persuade him, "Don't go!" I told you it's too dangerous! The man didn't listen at all, muttering, "I'm just asking him a couple of questions!" Then he got out of the car and moved out of the camera. The car door slammed shut, leaving the woman inside, her expression devastated and helpless. [00:07-00:15] Shot 2 - Indoor Fixed Shot Reversal: Switching to a regular bedroom, the lens fixes the medium shot, completely still. The scruffy adult man from earlier lay on the bed fully clothed, his face buried in the pillow, looking both uncomfortable and enduring as if reality had just given him a harsh lesson. The woman sits behind the man (position reference: hf_20260609_173858_0a2ea93a-89fc-4376-a250-0d2e8ea60474 (1)), her expression both angry and helpless. [00:07-00:09] The woman first gave the man's buttocks a hard slap through his clothes, near his lower back, accompanied by an exaggerated comedic "smack" sound effect, then angrily said, "See, I told you, don't go, it's too dangerous!" " [00:09-00:12] She hid the prop bag behind the man's clothes from the spot on her lower back, hf_20260609_173858_0a2ea93a-89fc-4376-a250-0d2e8ea60474 (1), first pulling out that plastic cartoon toy knife, then pulling out a badminton racket. The man frowned in endurance, showing a comical expression of regret, while exaggerated baby crying sounds played in the background. [00:12-00:15] The woman continued to pull out a long string of colorful cloth strips from the same hidden prop bag, stretching longer and longer, like a failed magic trick. The man buried his face in the pillow, putting on a look of broken down and enduring endurance. At the end, the woman holds a colorful cloth strip and looks at the camera, her face full of exasperation, "I told you earlier, you wouldn't listen," and the scene stops at an absurd comedy twist. Sound: The first shot includes sudden braking, slight tire friction, steering wheel tapping, door opening and closing, a man muttering angrily, and a woman anxiously trying to stop her in Chinese. The second shot features exaggerated comedic "smack" sound effects, the rubbing of plastic toys, the soft sound of a badminton racket being pulled out, the continuous rustling of colorful cloth strips, the faint creaking of a mattress, and the comical baby crying background sound effects. No music, no real pain and screams. Style: Realistic low-budget short videos with a comedic texture. The first scene is the cool-colored streetlights inside the car at night, and the second scene is the warm ceiling lights in an ordinary bedroom. The characters' movements are down-to-earth but exaggerated, props obviously cheap and plastic-like, and the overall pacing resembles an absurd twist short drama shot from a fixed camera angle. Avoid: Prohibited are real knives, real injuries, bloodstains, sadistic content, nudity, sexual innuendo, explicit body parts, minors, extra characters, subtitles, watermarks, camera movement, camera shake, body twists, duplicate arms, prop deformation, room changes, and character flashing.

raw_p:
A gritty, realistic cinematic medium shot of a human female character with dark, naturally textured hair and heavy, low bangs obscuring her forehead, creating a brooding, composed, and introverted silhouette. She is standing in an expansive, oppressive outdoor environment under a constantly overcast, gray-blue sky. The strong wind is clearly visible, moving the tails of her heavy black leather trench coat worn over a black shirt. Around her waist is a minimalist, high-end piece of matte-finished metal utility gear housing a "alien energy core" that looks like a captured scientific specimen rather than a commercial product.
The scene begins with a slow, hypnotic camera rotation from a fixed 30-degree side profile toward the center, while gently pushing in (dolly-in). There are no cuts. The character starts with her head down, slowly lifting it to face the camera solemnly as her right hand grips the artifact on her belt.
The visual effects kick in (The Metamorphosis): As the transformation begins, heavy, low-frequency mechanical hums and a tense atmospheric score swell. Intense dark red light bleeds out, intertwined with swirling black mist and jagged black particles that erupt from the belt and surround her. As the energy engulfs her, her body performs a slight, stiff rotation and then freezes. The transformation is organic and raw; the suit manifests through the mist and particles as a biological shift, avoiding any "toy-like" mechanical assembly or clicking parts.
The final form reveals a suit composed of a fusion of black biological tissue and alien alloys, looking "living" and "growing" with pulsating textures. Faintly glowing red vascular lines or intricate circuitry trace the contours of the suit, culminating in deep, menacing red glowing eyes on the faceplate or helmet.

zh.p:
这是一幕粗犷、写实的中景镜头，描绘一位拥有深色自然发质和浓密低刘海遮住额头的人类女性角色，营造出阴郁、沉着且内向的剪影。她站在一个宽广而压抑的户外环境中，天空总是阴沉的灰蓝色。强风清晰可见，吹动着她厚重黑色皮风衣的尾巴，风衣外面是黑色衬衫。她腰间系着一件极简、高端哑光金属多功能装备，内置一个“外星能量核心”，看起来更像是捕获的科学标本，而非商业产品。
场景开始时，摄像机从固定的30度侧面向中心缓慢旋转，同时轻轻推入（推车式）。没有剪辑。角色一开始低着头，慢慢抬起头，庄重地面向镜头，右手紧握腰带上的神器。
视觉特效开始（变形记）：随着变身开始，沉重的低频机械嗡鸣和紧张的氛围配乐渐起。强烈的暗红色光芒从中流出，交织着旋转的黑雾和从腰带喷涌而出的锯齿状黑色粒子，包围着她。当能量吞没她时，她的身体做出轻微僵硬的旋转，然后僵住。这种转变是有机且原始的;战衣通过雾气和粒子表现出生物变形，避免任何“玩具式”机械组件或咔嗒声部件。
最终形态展现出一套由黑色生物组织与外星合金融合而成的战衣，看起来“活着”且“在成长”，纹理脉动。微弱发光的红色血管线或复杂的电路沿着战衣轮廓延伸，最终在面罩或头盔上呈现出深邃、威胁性的红色发光眼睛。

A diver in a blue wetsuit with yellow oxygen tank lies on the boat deck while a massive octopus jumps at him and clings to the hull, its thick tentacles wrapped around the diver’s legs and body. raw_p:
LOOK: The Bandra-Worli Sea Link at night in a raging monsoon, white cable stays lit against a black churning sea, traffic stranded on the deck; cold steel-blue grade slashed with amber sodium light, rain hammering the lens. 35mm anamorphic, heavy flare, IMAX-scale water simulation, 4K.

Shot 1 — A colossal deep-sea leviathan, barnacled and whale-vast, breaches beside the bridge and crashes through the outer cable stays mid-lunge; the cables snap taut around its body like a net and the whole span shudders, cars skidding sideways across the wet deck. Low angle from the deck craning up the breaching mass, speed-ramped at impact.

Shot 2 — Inside a hanging bus dangling half off the edge, a woman in a drenched office suit claws up the tilting aisle as the creature's eye — taller than the bus — slides past the cracked window, pupil contracting at her. Tight handheld inside the bus, Dutch-tilted, the eye filling the glass.

Shot 3 — The leviathan thrashes to tear free and only wraps itself deeper; cables shear off pylons and lash across the deck like whips, slicing a truck in half, while passengers sprint between strikes. Ground-tracking with the runners, whip-panning to each cable strike.

Shot 4 — It heaves its full weight seaward; the main pylon groans, folds — and the entire suspended span swings down over the creature's back, cables cinching as the bridge collapses onto it like a snare drawing closed. Bird's-eye directly above the folding span, geometry closing like a fist.

Shot 5 — The wreckage drags the shrieking leviathan under, one fluke hammering the surface before the cables haul it down; the woman hangs from the bus doorway on a severed stay, swinging above the boil. The bridge it attacked is what drowned it. Slow aerial pull-back: the broken Sea Link, the sinking glow, the city lights indifferent behind the rain.

zh.p:
看：夜晚猛烈季风中的班德拉-沃利海连接线，白色缆绳在黑色翻滚的海浪中亮起，船只滞留在甲板上;冰冷的钢蓝色等级被琥珀钠光切割，雨水猛烈敲打着镜头。35毫米变形宽银幕，厚重光晕，IMAX比例水面模拟，4K。

镜头1——一头巨大的深海巨兽，长满藤壶，像鲸鱼一样庞大，在桥旁破浪而入，撞断了外缆，正处于冲刺状态;钢索像网一样紧绷地缠绕着它的身体，整个桥段剧烈颤抖，汽车在湿滑的甲板上侧滑。从甲板低角度俯冲，向上攀升破口的质量，撞击时加速。

镜头2——一辆半悬在边缘的悬挂公交车内，一名穿着湿透办公服的女子攀爬倾斜的过道，生物的眼睛——比公交车还高——从破裂的窗户滑过，瞳孔收缩。车内紧握手握，荷兰式倾斜，眼睛充满了玻璃。

镜头3——巨兽挣扎着想要挣脱，却只缠得更深;钢索切断了电塔，像鞭子一样在甲板上划过，将卡车劈成两半，乘客们在攻击间隙奔跑。与跑者一起地面追踪，每次电缆击点都进行鞭状移动。

第四镜头——它将全部重量向海面抛起;主塔发出呻吟声，折叠——整个悬挂桥跨悬挂在怪物背上，缆绳紧紧收紧，桥梁像陷阱般坍塌压在它身上。鸟瞰图正上方折叠跨度，几何形状像拳头一样合拢。

镜头5——残骸将尖叫的巨兽拖入水中，一只尾鳍猛击水面，随后缆绳将其拖下;女子悬挂在公交车门口，悬挂在断绳上方，悬挂在水肿上方。它攻击的桥梁是淹死它的原因。缓慢的空中撤离：破损的海链，渐渐沉没的光芒，雨幕后无情的城市灯光。

en.p:
LOOK: The Bandra-Worli Sea Link at night in a raging monsoon, white cable stays lit against a black churning sea, traffic stranded on the deck; cold steel-blue grade slashed with amber sodium light, rain hammering the lens. 35mm anamorphic, heavy flare, IMAX-scale water simulation, 4K.

Shot 1 — A colossal deep-sea leviathan, barnacled and whale-vast, breaches beside the bridge and crashes through the outer cable stays mid-lunge; the cables snap taut around its body like a net and the whole span shudders, cars skidding sideways across the wet deck. Low angle from the deck craning up the breaching mass, speed-ramped at impact.

Shot 2 — Inside a hanging bus dangling half off the edge, a woman in a drenched office suit claws up the tilting aisle as the creature's eye — taller than the bus — slides past the cracked window, pupil contracting at her. Tight handheld inside the bus, Dutch-tilted, the eye filling the glass.

Shot 3 — The leviathan thrashes to tear free and only wraps itself deeper; cables shear off pylons and lash across the deck like whips, slicing a truck in half, while passengers sprint between strikes. Ground-tracking with the runners, whip-panning to each cable strike.

Shot 4 — It heaves its full weight seaward; the main pylon groans, folds — and the entire suspended span swings down over the creature's back, cables cinching as the bridge collapses onto it like a snare drawing closed. Bird's-eye directly above the folding span, geometry closing like a fist.

Shot 5 — The wreckage drags the shrieking leviathan under, one fluke hammering the surface before the cables haul it down; the woman hangs from the bus doorway on a severed stay, swinging above the boil. The bridge it attacked is what drowned it. Slow aerial pull-back: the broken Sea Link, the sinking glow, the city lights indifferent behind the rain.

15-second ultra-cinematic realistic transformation sequence in a dense forest during a cold rainy evening.

A lone man stands among wet pine trees while light rain falls through the forest canopy. Mist drifts between the trunks. The atmosphere is grounded and realistic.

The man suddenly freezes. His breathing becomes heavier. Muscles tense beneath soaked clothing.

The camera slowly circles around him as subtle anatomical changes begin. Fingers lengthen. Hands widen. Nails gradually become thick dark claws. Veins and tendons become more pronounced beneath the skin.

The transformation intensifies. Shoulders broaden dramatically. The spine lengthens. The rib cage expands. Legs restructure for quadrupedal movement. Clothing stretches naturally under the changing body.

Dark fur begins emerging across the arms, neck, shoulders, and face. Rainwater runs through the growing coat. Ears migrate upward and sharpen. The jaw slowly extends into a realistic wolf muzzle.

The camera stays close during the anatomical transformation, emphasizing realistic muscle movement, shifting posture, and animal locomotion emerging from the human form.

The newly transformed wolf drops onto all fours. Massive paws sink into wet earth. Breath forms dense vapor in the cold air.

Final cinematic moment: the enormous wolf lifts its head and scans the forest. Rain falls across detailed fur while yellow eyes reflect moonlight through the trees. The camera slowly pushes closer as the animal disappears into the mist.

Style: ultra realistic transformation VFX, grounded anatomy, photoreal wolf behavior, realistic fur simulation, cinematic forest atmosphere, rain interaction, nature documentary realism, AAA creature effects, no magic energy, no text, no overlays.

Audio: realistic forest ambience, rain, heavy breathing, muscle shifting sounds, fur movement, distant thunder, animal growls, atmospheric wilderness sound design.

15秒的超电影级真实变身戏，场景发生在寒冷多雨的夜晚浓密森林中。

一名男子孤独地站在湿润的松树之间，细雨穿透森林树冠。薄雾在树干间飘散。氛围扎实且真实。

那人突然僵住了。他的呼吸变得沉重。湿透的衣服下肌肉紧绷。

镜头缓缓环绕着他，细微的解剖结构变化开始显现。手指变长。双手张开。指甲逐渐变成粗壮的黑色爪子。静脉和肌腱在皮肤下变得更加明显。

转变更加强烈。肩膀大幅宽阔。脊柱会变长。肋骨会膨胀。腿部重组以适应四足行走。衣服在变化的身体下自然拉伸。

深色的毛发开始在手臂、脖子、肩膀和脸部长出。雨水会流过正在生长的毛皮。耳朵向上移动并变得尖锐。下颚缓缓延伸成逼真的狼口套。

镜头在解剖变换过程中紧贴镜头，强调逼真的肌肉运动、姿势变化以及动物从人体中出现的运动。

新变身的狼四肢着地。巨大的爪子陷入湿润的泥土中。呼气在冷空气中形成浓密的蒸汽。

最后的电影时刻：巨大的狼抬起头，扫视着森林。雨水洒落在精致的毛发上，黄色的眼睛透过树梢反射着月光。镜头缓缓靠近，动物消失在雾中。

The camera points toward a glass-clad skyscraper approximately 30 floors above the ground. Several Indian construction workers wearing dirty vests, faded trousers, paint-stained clothing, and work sandals are performing maintenance on the building exterior.

The shocking detail is slowly revealed: the workers are standing on impossibly tall stacks of colorful plastic stools balanced outside the building façade. Some are painting window frames, others are scraping old material from the glass panels. They behave casually as if this is a completely normal workday.

The filmer zooms out slightly, revealing the terrifying height. Tiny cars, buses, trees, and crowded Indian streets are visible far below. Wind blows loose plastic sheets hanging from the building. Paint drips down the glass exterior.

One worker casually reaches sideways to continue painting while standing on the top stool. Another adjusts his footing and continues working without concern.

Authentic viral phone footage, documentary realism, believable human behavior, accidental discovery, “how is this even possible?” energy, no cinematic camera moves, no safety harnesses visible, meme-worthy but completely realistic.

镜头指向地面约30层高的一座玻璃摩天大楼。几名印度建筑工人穿着脏背心、褪色的裤子、沾满油漆的衣服和工作凉鞋，正在建筑外部进行维护。

Ancient temple high in the mountains during bright daylight with waterfalls, shattered statues, dust clouds and sunlight piercing through collapsing structures

Begins with dramatic wide shot above the mountains, rapid crash zoom into combat, whip pans following impossible acrobatics and spinning staff attacks, orbit shots around giant shockwave impacts, Epic anime-style impact frames and dynamic perspective distortion, debris and sunlight flooding the frame, the monk vaulting between collapsing pillars and running across airborne boulders while trading devastating blows with multiple colossal guardians, each strike generating expanding energy rings and cracking the mountain itself, ending with the monk ascending high above the battlefield in a burst of golden light before bringing his staff down in a godlike final strike that sends a colossal shockwave across the entire temple complex, vaporizing the remaining stone guardians instantly, shattering mountainsides and freezing the world in a moment of silence, dust clouds clearing to reveal the monk standing alone at the center of a massive crater while the shattered remains of every guardian collapse around him, sunlight breaking through the clouds as the camera slowly pulls back to reveal his absolute victory and the temple restored to calm beneath the mountains

zh.p:
一位无畏的动漫武僧，长长的黑色编织头发，身上布满发光的金色纹身，手持一根散发着古老能量的巨杖
在坍塌的山中神庙内与巨大的石制守护者战斗，冲刺穿越坠落的瓦砾，用流畅的武术引导巨型攻击，释放足以裂开地面的强大冲击波
古老的寺庙矗立在高山高处，白天阳光明媚，瀑布、破碎的雕像、尘云和穿透倒塌建筑的阳光

开头是山脉上空的戏剧性广角镜头，快速撞击拉近战斗，鞭状镜头跟随不可能的杂技和旋转棍棒攻击，环绕巨大冲击波的轨道镜头，史诗动漫风格的撞击画面和动态透视扭曲，碎片和阳光充斥画面，僧侣在倒塌的柱子间翻越，奔跑空中巨石，同时与多个巨型守护者交锋。 每一击都会产生扩展的能量环，甚至裂开山体，最终僧侣在一阵金色光芒中高高升上战场上空，挥下法杖，发出神一般的终极一击，震荡整个神庙，瞬间蒸发剩余的石卫，碎裂山体，世界瞬间凝固。 尘云散去，显露出僧侣独自站在巨大陨坑中央，周围所有破碎的守护者倒塌，阳光穿透云层，镜头缓缓拉远，展现他的绝对胜利，寺庙恢复了山下的宁静

raw_p: Reggie steps off a vaporetto or onto a canal-side, adjusts monocle, delivers a “Welcome to Venice” line.  Slow push-in as he marvels at canals, calling it “London if someone forgot the roads.”  Spots a gondola and insists he needs “the cinematic entrance.”  Wide shot: he clambers into gondola, nearly tipping it, tries to stay dignified.  Cut to him seated, posing for camera, doing dramatic “influencer hand gestures.”  Gondolier starts singing; Reggie reacts with faux sophistication, then genuine awe.  Pigeons swoop overhead; quick cut of Reggie ducking, then pretending it was planned.  Passing under a bridge, he tries to deliver a serious history fact and clearly gets it wrong.  POV shot looking up at old buildings; Reggie calls it “the world’s fanciest water maze.”  Gondola brushes another gondola; brief awkward overlap, Reggie throws in a cheeky compliment or British sarcasm.  Jump cut to Reggie at a small floating café/bar, balancing espresso on the edge.  Extreme close-up: Reggie sips espresso, eyes widen at the strength, yet he pretends it’s “absolutely delightful.”  Quick montage: mini bites of cicchetti, approving nods, then one dramatic overreaction to a strong flavour.  Sunset shot on a small bridge; Reggie leans on the railing, bowler slightly askew.  Final line to camera, something like “Ten out of ten, but still no idea where the roads went,” with a jaunty waddle away.

zh.p: 雷吉从水上巴士或运河边下来，调整单片眼镜，念出一句“欢迎来到威尼斯”的台词。 缓慢推进，他惊叹于运河，称之为“如果有人忘了路，那就是伦敦”。 他发现一艘贡多拉，坚持说他需要“电影般的入口”。 广角镜头：他爬上贡多拉，差点把缆车倾倒，努力保持体面。 画面切换到他坐着，摆姿势，做出夸张的“网红手势”。 贡多利亚人开始唱歌;雷吉先是假装高明，随后是真诚的敬畏。 鸽子在头顶盘旋;雷吉低头躲避，然后假装这是计划好的快速剪辑。 他走过桥下，试图传达一个严肃的历史事实，但显然错了。 俯瞰老建筑的视角镜头;雷吉称它为“世界上最豪华的水迷宫”。 贡多拉擦过另一艘贡多拉;短暂尴尬的重叠，雷吉会插入调皮的夸奖或英式讽刺。 跳切到雷吉在一家漂浮的小咖啡馆/酒吧里，平衡着一杯浓缩咖啡。 极近特写：雷吉啜饮浓缩咖啡，眼睛因浓烈度而睁大，但他假装“绝对美味”。 快速蒙太奇：小口西凯蒂，点头致意，然后对浓烈味道的夸张反应。 《夕阳》拍摄在一座小桥上;雷吉靠在栏杆上，圆顶礼帽微微歪斜。 最后一句对镜头说的，大概是“十分满分，但还是不知道路通向哪里”，然后轻快地摇摇晃晃地走开。

raw_p:
Scene: Young man, early 20s, messy hair, plain white tee, sitting at a minimal wooden desk by a bright window. Smartphone in hand, ceramic coffee mug beside an open notebook. Bookshelf softly out of focus in background.
Style: Daylight vlog aesthetic, warm natural morning feel, muted beige and cream tones, gentle handheld rhythm.
Lighting: Soft diffused morning window light from the left, even and warm, subtle shadow on right side of face.
Audio: Soft ambient city morning sounds, espresso hiss, gentle paper rustle.

[0-3s]
Camera: Handheld wide establishing shot of the desk setup, gentle settle.
Action: He picks up his coffee with one hand while scrolling his phone with the other, relaxed and unhurried.
Lighting: Clean window light floods the desk.

[3-7s]
Camera: Slow push-in to medium chest shot.
Action: He pauses his scroll, double-taps the screen, and corners of his mouth lift into a small quiet smile.
Lighting: Soft side window light, gentle shadow shaping.

[7-11s]
Camera: Hard cut to close-up of the phone screen glowing, hand tilting slightly.
Action: His thumb scrolls slowly through a social feed, then stops on a video. The screen light shifts slightly.
Lighting: Screen glow cold against warm desk ambient.

[11-15s]
Camera: Pull back to medium, he sets the phone down and picks up his pen to write in the notebook.
Action: He writes a quick note, glances back at the phone, then exhales and leans into his work.
Lighting: Warm window light, soft and clean.
Avoid: Jitter, identity drift, staged ad feel, overexposed window.

zh.p:
场景：一名年轻男子，二十出头，头发凌乱，穿着素白T恤，坐在明亮窗边一张简约的木桌前。手里拿着智能手机，陶瓷咖啡杯放在打开的笔记本旁边。书架在背景中轻轻模糊。
风格：日光Vlog风格，温暖自然的晨间感觉，柔和的米色和奶油色调，柔和的手持节奏感。
光线：从左侧透出柔和的散射晨光，脸部右侧有均匀温暖、细腻的阴影。
音频：柔和的城市晨间环境声，浓缩咖啡嘶嘶声，轻微的纸张沙沙声。

[0-3秒]
相机：手持宽景拍摄的桌子布置，轻柔沉降。
动作：他一手拿起咖啡，一手滑动手机，神情放松，从容不迫。
照明：干净的窗户灯光充满桌面。

[3-7]
镜头：缓慢推入到中等胸部镜头。
动作：他暂停滚动，双击屏幕，嘴角扬起一抹小小的微笑。
照明：柔和的侧窗光，柔和的阴影塑造。

[7-11]
镜头：画面特写，手机屏幕发光，手微微倾斜。
动作：他的拇指慢慢滑动着社交动态，然后停在一个视频上。屏幕灯光微微变化。
灯光：屏幕在温暖的桌面环境下冷冷发光。

[11-15岁]
镜头：拉回中等，他放下手机，拿起笔在笔记本上写字。
行动：他写了条简短的便条，回头看了看手机，然后呼出一口气，投入到工作中。
照明：温暖的窗户光，柔和干净。
避免：抖动、身份漂移、广告氛围、过曝窗户。

raw_p:
現実の東京街並みの中に、ちびキャラが存在し、2Dエフェクトが現実と強く融合した世界観。エフェクトは画面に貼りついたように見えず、実写の空間・光・遠近感に完全に溶け込み、キャラクターの動きや感情に呼応して自然に発生・変化する。現実とエフェクトとちびが一体となった、爽やかで軽やか、少し魔法のような融合映像。

エフェクトは大幅に増量し、以下のものを多層的に配置：
- カラフルなリボン軌跡（ピンク・水色・黄色・白など）
- 手描き風の白い線、点線、円弧、矢印、軌道線
- 軽いスケッチ風オーバーレイと幾何学図形
- 紙吹雪・粒子・光の粒
これらは実写の奥行きに沿って前後左右に存在し、キャラクターの動きに反応して発生・変化する。

カット構成：

1カット目：眠そうに目をこすりながら歩道に出てくる。彼女の周囲にカラフルなリボン軌跡と白い手描き線が優しく舞い、足元から粒子がふわっと立ち上がる。カメラがゆっくり前進。

2カット目：のんびり歩きながら、彼女の体からリボン軌跡が何本も自然に伸びて周囲をなぞるように流れる。紙吹雪と白い軌道線が彼女の周りを優しく包み込む。カメラが横からトラッキング。

3カット目：あくびをする瞬間に、口元から優しい光の粒子と白い円弧がふわっと広がる。顔の周りに手描き風の記号線や小さな図形が軽やかに浮かぶ。カメラがゆっくり寄る。

4カット目：お店や車の横を歩く際、リボン軌跡が看板や車を優しくなぞるように通り抜ける。白い点線や矢印が彼女の歩く軌跡を強調するように出現。カメラが横移動。

5カット目：公園の桜の前で手を伸ばすと、桜の花びらとカラフルなリボン軌跡が融合して大きく舞い上がる。彼女の周囲に光の粒と手描き円弧が優しく回転。カメラが少し寄る。

6カット目：ビルを見上げながら歩く。ビルの高さに沿って長いリボン軌跡が空に向かって伸び、青空に白い軌道線と幾何学図形が浮かぶ。彼女の体から優しい光の粒子が舞う。ローアングル気味のカメラ。

7カット目：水たまりをふわっとジャンプする瞬間、周囲に水しぶき＋カラフルなリボン軌跡＋白い手描き線が大きく広がる。粒子と光の粒が跳ねて美しく舞う。カメラが少し引いて捉える。

8カット目：夕暮れのベンチに座る。彼女を中心にリボン軌跡と手描き線が優しく包み込み、夕陽の光に溶け合うように粒子がゆっくり舞う。カメラがゆっくり横移動しながら柔らかく締めくくる。

全体として、現実の東京風景・ちびきゃら・エフェクトが強く融合した世界観。エフェクトは過剰にSFっぽくせず、爽やかで軽やかで、少し詩的. エフェクトの量と動きをかなり増やし、各カットで密度高く、キャラクターの動きや感情にしっかり反応させる。カメラも各カットで確実に動いている。

en.p:
Within the real streets of Tokyo, there are chibi characters, and the world where 2D effects are strongly blended with reality. Effects do not appear glued to the screen; they blend perfectly into the live-action space, light, and perspective, naturally occurring and changing in response to the characters' movements and emotions. A refreshing, light, and slightly magical fusion video where reality, effects, and chibi come together.

The number of effects has been greatly increased, and the following are placed in multiple layers:
- Colorful ribbon trails (pink, light blue, yellow, white, etc.)
- Hand-drawn white lines, dotted lines, arcs, arrows, and track lines
- Light sketch-style overlays and geometric shapes
- Confetti, particles, and particles of light
These appear in the front, back, left, and right along the depth of the live-action film, and occur and change in response to the characters' movements.

Cut composition:

First shot: She steps out onto the sidewalk, rubbing her eyes sleepily. Around her, colorful ribbon trails and white hand-drawn lines gently dance, and particles float up from beneath her feet. The camera slowly moves forward.

Second cut: As she walks leisurely, several ribbon trails naturally extend from her body, tracing the surroundings. Confetti and white orbital lines gently envelop her. The camera tracks from the side.

Third cut: At the moment of yawning, gentle particles of light and a white arc gently spread out from the mouth. Hand-drawn symbolic lines and small shapes float lightly around the face. The camera slowly approaches.

Fourth cut: When walking past shops or cars, the ribbon trail gently traces past signs and cars. White dotted lines and arrows appear to emphasize the path she walks. The camera moves sideways.

Cut 5: When you reach out in front of the cherry blossoms in the park, the petals and colorful ribbon trails blend together and soar up in the air. Around her, particles of light and hand-drawn arcs gently rotate. The camera moved a little closer.

Cut 6: Walking while looking up at the building. A long ribbon trail stretches toward the sky along the height of the building, with white orbital lines and geometric shapes floating in the blue sky. Gentle particles of light swirl from her body. The camera is slightly low-angle.

Cut 7: The moment she gently jumps through a puddle, splashes of water + colorful ribbon trails + white hand-drawn lines spread out widely. Particles and light particles bounce and dance beautifully. The camera pulled back a little to capture the scene.

Cut 8: Sitting on a bench at dusk. Centered around her, ribbon trails and hand-drawn lines gently wrap around her, while particles slowly dance as if blending into the light of the setting sun. The camera gently closes as it slowly moves sideways.

Overall, the world is a strong fusion of real Tokyo scenery, small features, and effects. The effects are not overly sci-fi, but are fresh, light, and a bit poetic. The amount of effects and movement has been greatly increased, with dense coverage in each cut, making it a strong response to the characters' movements and emotions. The camera moves steadily in every shot.

动态镜头运动、无缝过渡、慢动作高光、富有表现力的反应、充满活力的编舞、真实的情感、高端广告美学。女性的特写交替出现，观众人数不断扩大的广角镜头，以及耳机产品细节镜头。音乐驱动的剪辑、节奏剪辑、电影化的镜头光晕、自然光、鲜艳的都市色彩、超写实的纹理。

raw_p:
A breathtaking volcanic island arena surrounded by multiple active volcanoes under a dramatic orange-red sky. Thousands of spectators watch from futuristic floating platforms suspended above rivers of molten lava. The world's most daring skateboarders prepare for the first-ever Volcano Skateboarding Championship.

The race begins. The camera follows closely behind the lead skater as athletes speed along narrow tracks carved into the sides of erupting volcanoes. Lava fountains explode into the air, sending glowing sparks and molten rocks across the course. Riders perform impossible tricks over lava rivers, including massive kickflips, spins, and aerial rotations while narrowly avoiding volcanic eruptions.

The action intensifies as competitors launch from giant ramps built on volcanic cliffs. Skaters soar hundreds of feet through the air above glowing lava lakes, executing gravity-defying tricks while smoke and fire fill the background. The camera captures dramatic slow-motion moments as lava erupts beneath them.

For the finale, the lead skater approaches a gigantic active volcano. A colossal eruption creates a natural lava-powered launch ramp. The skater performs an impossible multi-rotation aerial trick high above the crater before descending directly into the volcano. The finish line glows deep inside the crater. The athlete lands perfectly on a narrow platform at the volcano's center as lava erupts around them. Epic cinematic ending, intense energy, realistic physics, stunning volcanic visuals, ultra-detailed environment, no text, no watermark, no subtitles, movie-quality action.

zh.p:
这是一座令人屏息的火山岛竞技场，周围环绕着多座活火山，天空呈现出壮观的橙红色。成千上万的观众从悬浮在熔岩河流上方的未来感漂浮平台上观看。世界上最勇敢的滑板手们正准备迎接首届火山滑板锦标赛。

比赛开始了。镜头紧随领舞者身后，运动员们在火山喷发侧面雕刻的狭窄赛道上高速行驶。熔岩喷泉喷涌而出，溅起发光火花和熔岩。骑手们在熔岩河流上表演不可能完成的特技，包括巨大的踢翻、旋转和空中旋转，同时险些躲避火山喷发。

比赛激烈，选手们从建在火山悬崖上的巨大跳台上起飞。滑板手们在发光的熔岩湖上空飞翔数百英尺，表演违抗重力的特技，背景中烟雾和火焰弥漫。镜头捕捉到熔岩在脚下喷涌的戏剧性慢动作瞬间。

决赛中，领跑选手接近一座巨大的活火山。一场巨大的喷发形成了天然的熔岩动力发射坡道。滑冰者在火山口上方高空完成不可能的多旋转空中动作，然后直接下降进入火山。终点线在陨石坑深处发光。运动员完美落在火山中心的一个狭窄平台上，熔岩在他们周围喷涌而出。史诗般的电影结局，强烈的能量，逼真的物理效果，惊艳的火山视觉效果，极其细致的环境，无文字、无水印、无字幕，电影级动作。

raw_p: 日本のフルカラーアニメ映画、シネマティック高品質映像。BGMなし、セリフなし、字幕なし、文字なし、環境音あり。# 制約 すべてのカットで画角やアングルを変えて単調にしない。所作はゆっくり、静かに。動きは最小限。顔と手元の細かい作業は同じカットに入れない。画質が粗い場合はリファレンスとして画像を一から作り直すこと。# 登場人物 ## 執事 黒髪のやや長めの前髪を横に流した長身痩身の男性。銀縁メガネ。黒のスリーピーススーツに黒ネクタイ、白シャツ、白い手袋、胸に白いポケットチーフ。知的で落ち着いた佇まい。表情は静かで余裕があり、視線は伏し目がち。# 情景 薄暗い厨房。朝もしくは夕方。窓から柔らかい斜光が差し込む。作業台の上に銀のスプーン、赤茶色の乾いたタイティー茶葉を入れた銀のボウル、ガスコンロ、鍋、砂糖、練乳、茶こし、ガラスのピッチャー、大きな透明な丸いロックアイス、銀のトング、ミルク、透明なグラス。照明：窓からの自然光のみ。空気中に微かな埃がきらめく。# シーン 執事が薄暗い厨房で身支度を整えながら、静かな所作だけでタイティーを一杯淹れていく無言の短編。cut1: クローズアップ、ローアングル。ガスコンロの五徳まわり。執事の手がコンロのつまみをひねると、青い炎がボッと点火して輪状に広がる。薄暗い厨房に炎の青い光が灯る。カメラ固定。環境音：ガスが点火するボッという音、炎の低い燃焼音。cut2: クローズアップ、首元から喉にかけて。素手で黒いネクタイの結び目を上へ引き締める。顎をわずかに上げ、喉仏と首筋のラインがあらわになる。男性的で色気のある所作。浅い被写界深度で首元にピント。カメラ固定。環境音：ネクタイの布が擦れる微かな音。cut3: クローズアップ、手元。片手が白い手袋をもう片方の手に引き上げ、指を一本ずつ収めていく。手首までしっかり収め、手袋の表面をすっと撫でて整える。所作は丁寧で静か。カメラが手元にゆっくり寄る。環境音：手袋の生地が擦れる微かな音。cut4: エクストリームクローズアップ。白手袋の手が銀のスプーンで赤茶色の乾いた紅茶葉をすくう。細かく刻まれた乾いた茶葉で、表面はマットで粉っぽい質感。針状や繊維状ではない。白い手袋・銀のスプーン・赤茶色の茶葉のコントラストが際立つ。カメラが手元にゆっくり寄る。環境音：茶葉が触れ合う乾いた微かな音、スプーンの澄んだ金属音。cut5: クローズアップ、横顔やや前から。執事が白手袋の指先で銀縁メガネのブリッジをすっと押し上げる。レンズに窓の光が一瞬反射する。知的でクールな所作。視線は伏し目がち。カメラ固定。環境音：衣擦れの微かな音、静かな室内。cut6: クローズアップ、鍋を斜め上から見見下ろす俯瞰。コンロの火にかけた鍋の中で濃いオレンジ色の茶がゆっくり色を深め、表面から湯気が立ち上る。白手袋の手が鍋の縁にそっと添えられている。顔は映さない。カメラ固定。環境音：湯が静かに沸く音、湯気が立つ微かな音。cut7: エクストリームクローズアップ。白手袋の手がスプーンで砂糖をすくい、湯気の立つ橙色の茶へさらさらと落とす。砂糖が湯面に触れて溶けていく。カメラ固定。環境音：砂糖がさらさらと落ちる微かな音、湯が静かに揺れる音。cut8: エクストリームクローズアップ、胸元。手袋をはめた手が胸ポケットの白いチーフに指先で軽く触れて整える。所作は静かで丁寧。カメラ固定。環境音：布が擦れる微かな音、衣擦れ。cut9: エクストリームクローズアップ。濃いオレンジ色の茶へ白い練乳がとろりと落ち、ゆっくり沈んで渦を描きながら混ざり、液体全体が不透明でクリーミーなオレンジ色になっていく。カメラが液面に寄る。環境音：練乳がとろりと落ちる音、液体に沈む柔らかな音。cut10: ミディアムクローズアップ、斜め横から。執事の両手と腕が画面に入る構図。片手で鍋の持ち手を握り、もう片方の手で茶こしを支え、高い位置からガラスのピッチャーへ橙色の茶を細く注ぐ。スーツの袖と白手袋まで画面に収め、誰が注いでいるかが明確に分かるようにする。不透明なオレンジ色の液体が茶こしを通って一本の細い線になって落ちる。カメラ固定。環境音：細く注がれる液体の澄んだ音。cut11: バストショット、斜め前から。執事が白手袋の手で黒髪を後ろへゆっくり掻き上げる。前髪がさらりと流れ、額と目元があらわになる。視線は伏し目がち。注ぎ終えた後の静かなひと呼吸。背景は厨房のボケ。カメラ固定。環境音：髪が擦れる微かな音、静かな室内。cut12: クローズアップ、斜め上から。白手袋の手が銀のトングで大きな透明な丸いロックアイスを一つ掴み、透明なグラスの中へそっと置く。球形の氷がグラスの底で澄んだ音を立てる。カメラ固定。環境音：氷をトングで掴む音、氷がグラスに置かれる澄んだ音。cut13: 【スローモーション】エクストリームクローズアップ、グラスを真横から。グラスの中の大きな丸いロックアイスの上から、不透明でクリーミーなオレンジ色のタイティーが細く注がれ、氷の表面を伝ってグラスを満たしていく。液体は練乳が混ざった濃いミルクティー色で、透き通っていない。丸い氷が橙色の液体に半分沈む。逆光でなめらかに輝く。カメラ固定。環境音：液体が氷を伝って注がれる澄んだ音。cut14: 【スローモーション】エクストリームクローズアップ、グラスを真横から。グラスの中央に大きな丸いロックアイスが浮かび、不透明なオレンジ色の茶の上に、より白いミルクが静かに注がれてゆっくり広がっていく。濃いオレンジとクリーム色がくっきり二層に分かれる、この映像の一番の見せ場。逆光で輝く。環境音：ミルクが注がれる柔らかな音。cut15: バストショット、斜め前から。執事が完成したグラスを片手でそっと差し出す。
