クローズアップ、斜め上から。白手袋の手が銀のトングで大きな透明な丸いロックアイスを一つ掴み、透明なグラスの中へそっと置く。球形の氷がグラスの底で澄んだ音を立てる。カメラ固定。環境音：氷をトングで掴む音、氷がグラスに置かれる澄んだ音。cut13: 【スローモーション】エクストリームクローズアップ、グラスを真横から。グラスの中の大きな丸いロックアイスの上から、不透明でクリーミーなオレンジ色のタイティーが細く注がれ、氷の表面を伝ってグラスを満たしていく。液体は練乳が混ざった濃いミルクティー色で、透き通っていない。丸い氷が橙色の液体に半分沈む。逆光でなめらかに輝く。カメラ固定。環境音：液体が氷を伝って注がれる澄んだ音。cut14: 【スローモーション】エクストリームクローズアップ、グラスを真横から。グラスの中央に大きな丸いロックアイスが浮かび、不透明なオレンジ色の茶の上に、より白いミルクが静かに注がれてゆっくり広がっていく。濃いオレンジとクリーム色がくっきり二層に分かれる、この映像の一番の見せ場。逆光で輝く。環境音：ミルクが注がれる柔らかな音。cut15: バストショット、斜め前から。執事が完成したグラスを片手でそっと差し出す。

en.p: A Japanese full-color animated film with high-quality cinematic footage. No background music, no dialogue, no subtitles, no text, and ambient sound. # Constraint: Change the angle or angle in every cut to avoid monotony. Movements should be slow and quiet. Minimal movement. Fine work on the face and hands cannot be included in the same cut. If the image quality is rough, rebuild the image from scratch as a reference. # Characters ## Butler A tall, slender man with slightly long black bangs swept sideways. Silver-rimmed glasses. A black three-piece suit with a black tie, white shirt, white gloves, and a white pocket square on the chest. An intelligent and calm presence. His expression was calm and composed, and his gaze was often downcast. # Scene: A dimly lit kitchen. In the morning or evening. A soft slanting light streamed in from the window. On the workbench are silver spoons, silver bowls filled with dried reddish-brown Thai tea leaves, gas stoves, pots, sugar, condensed milk, tea strainers, glass pitchers, large transparent round rock ice, silver tongs, milk, and clear glasses. Lighting: Only natural light from the windows. A faint layer of dust shimmered in the air. # Scene: A silent short story where the butler prepares himself in a dimly lit kitchen, brewing a cup of Thai tea with just a quiet gesture. cut1: クローズアップ、ローアングル。 Around the kettle of the gas stove. When the butler twisted the knob on the stove, a blue flame burst into flames and spread out in a ring. A blue flame illuminated the dim kitchen. Camera fixed. Environmental sounds: the clicking sound of gas igniting, the low-burning sound of flames. cut2: Close-up, from the neck down to the throat. With bare hands, I tighten the knot of my black tie upward. Slightly lift your chin, revealing the lines of your Adam's apple and neck. Her masculine and alluring manners are sultry. Focuses on the neck with a shallow depth of field. Camera fixed. Environmental sound: The faint sound of the tie fabric rubbing. cut3: Close-up, at hand. One hand pulls up a white glove onto the other, and one finger at a time. It secures the wrists and gently smooths the surface of the gloves. Her mannerisms are polite and quiet. The camera slowly moves closer to my hand. Environmental sound: A faint sound of glove fabric rubbing. cut4: エクストリームクローズアップ。 A white-gloved hand scoops reddish-brown dried tea leaves with a silver spoon. Finely chopped dried tea leaves have a matte surface with a powdery texture. It is neither needle-like nor fibrous. The contrast between white gloves, silver spoons, and reddish-brown tea leaves stands out. The camera slowly moves closer to my hand. Environmental sounds: the dry, faint sound of tea leaves touching, the clear metallic sound of spoons. cut5: Close-up, profile slightly from the front. The butler gently pushed up the bridge of the silver-rimmed glasses with the fingertips of his white gloves. The window light briefly reflects off the lens. Intelligent and cool mannerisms. His gaze was downward. Camera fixed. Environmental sound: faint rustling of clothes, quiet indoor environment. cut6: Close-up, bird's-eye view of a pot from an angle above. In a pot heated over the stove, the deep orange tea slowly deepens in color, and steam rises from the surface. A white-gloved hand gently rests on the rim of the pot. Faces are not shown. Camera fixed. Environmental sounds: The sound of water quietly boiling, the faint sound of steam rising. cut7: エクストリームクローズアップ。 A white-gloved hand scoops up sugar with a spoon, gently dropping it onto the steaming orange tea. The sugar touches the surface of the water and melts. Camera fixed. Environmental sounds: the faint sound of sugar dripping gently, the quiet sway of hot water. cut8: Extreme close-up, chest. Her gloved hand lightly touches the white chief in her chest pocket with her fingertips to adjust it. Her manners are quiet and polite. Camera fixed. Environmental noise: faint sounds of fabric rubbing, clothes rubbing. cut9: エクストリームクローズアップ。 White condensed milk falls into a deep orange brown, slowly sinking and swirling as it mixes, turning the entire liquid into an opaque and creamy orange. The camera leans toward the liquid surface. Environmental sounds: the sound of condensed milk falling smoothly, the soft sound of sinking into liquid. cut10: Medium close-up, diagonal side. The composition shows the butler's hands and arms on screen. Hold the handle of the pot with one hand and support the tea strainer with the other, then pour orange tea thinly from a high position onto the glass pitcher. Capture the sleeves of the suit and white gloves on the screen so it's clear who is pouring. The opaque orange liquid passes through the tea strainer and falls into a thin line. Camera fixed. Environmental sound: The clear sound of a thin liquid being poured. cut11: Bust shot, from the front diagonally. The butler slowly brushed his black hair back with his white-gloved hand. Her bangs flowed smoothly, revealing her forehead and eyes. His gaze was downward. A quiet breath after pouring. The background is kitchen bokeh. Camera fixed. Environmental sounds: faint sounds like hair rubbing, quiet indoor space. cut12: Close-up, diagonally from above. Her white-gloved hand grabbed a large, clear, round rock ice cream with silver tongs and gently placed it inside a clear glass. Spherical ice makes a clear sound at the bottom of the glass. Camera fixed. Environmental sounds: the sound of ice being grabbed with tongs, the clear sound of ice being placed in a glass. cut13: [Slow Motion] Extreme close-up, glass from the side. From the large round rocked ice in the glass, thin layers of opaque, creamy orange Tai tea are poured down, flowing along the surface of the ice to fill the glass. The liquid is a dark milk tea color mixed with condensed milk and is not transparent. The round ice was half submerged in orange liquid. Shines smoothly against the light. Camera fixed. Environmental sound: The clear sound of liquid being poured along the ice. cut14: [Slow Motion] Extreme close-up, glasses held from the side. A large round rock ice floats in the center of the glass, and over the opaque orange brown, whiter milk quietly spreads and spreads. The highlight of this video, where the deep orange and cream colors are clearly divided into two layers. It shines against the backlight. Environmental sound: The soft sound of milk being poured. cut15: Bust shot, from a diagonal front. The butler gently offers the finished glass with one hand.

raw_p: 现代3D中国动画风格。场景一：在埃及宫殿中，镜头从王座厅内部开始。我们看到威武的胡狼神阿努比斯笔直地站着，双臂呈T字形。他身旁站着一位年轻的人类国王，神神情严肃地说：“我亲爱的阿努比斯，你绝不能分心。”阿努比斯坚定而严肃地回答：“遵命，主人。” 场景二：人类国王狡黠地一笑，伸手探向阿努比斯的腋窝，用手指轻轻地、流畅地挠着他的痒痒。阿努比斯的表情迅速变得灿烂起来，他努力想要忽略这种痒痒的感觉，但他实在太怕痒了。 场景3：人类国王继续用手指挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯闭着眼睛，咧嘴大笑，发出闷闷的咯咯笑声。人类国王一边挠着阿努比斯的腋窝，一边说着“咕叽咕叽咕”。 场景4：人类国王继续用手指挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯很快开始大声咯咯笑，他的手臂从T字形姿势移开，但腋窝仍然暴露在外。 场景5：人类国王继续用手指挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯开始大声咯咯笑，然后他用手臂环抱住自己，保护腋窝，这才停止了挠痒。 场景6：阿努比斯双手抱胸，发出几声余韵，随后表情再次变得严肃起来。他双手叉腰，略带恼怒地看着他的主人，说道：“主人，我们说好不挠痒痒的。”人类国王无辜地耸了耸肩，俏皮地应了一声：“哎呀。” 阿努比斯肌肉发达，手臂和脖子上都戴着环。他的声音低沉而富有磁性，极具磁性。语音为英文。

en.p: Modern 3D Chinese animation style. Scene 1: In an Egyptian palace, the camera starts from inside the Throne Hall. We see the mighty jackal god Anubis standing upright, arms forming a T-shape. Beside him stood a young human king, whose expression was solemn as he said, "My dear Anubis, you must not be distracted." Anubis replied firmly and solemnly, "Yes, Master." Scene 2: The human king grinned slyly, reached for Anubis's armpit, and gently and smoothly tickled his tickle with his fingers. Anubis's expression quickly brightened. He tried hard to ignore the itching sensation, but he was simply too afraid of it. Scene 3: The human king continues to scratch Anubis's armpits with his fingers. Anubis closes his eyes, giggles, and lets out muffled giggles. The human king tickled Anubis's armpit while murmuring "gugu gu." Scene 4: The human king continues to scratch Anubis's armpits with his fingers. Anubis soon starts giggling loudly, his arms moving away from the T-shaped pose, but his armpits remain exposed. Scene 5: The human king continues to tickle Anubis's armpits with his fingers. Anubis starts giggling loudly, then wraps his arms around himself to protect his armpits, finally stopping the tickling. Scene 6: Anubis crosses his arms, letting out a few lingering sounds, then his expression turns serious again. He put his hands on his hips, looking at his master with a hint of annoyance, and said, "Master, we agreed not to scratch you." The human king shrugged innocently and playfully replied, "Oh my." Anubis was muscular and wore rings on his arms and neck. His voice was deep and magnetic, extremely magnetic. The audio is in English.

raw_p:
A gigantic abandoned movie theater illuminated only by a single old analog projector at the back of the room. Dust floats through the beam of light crossing the darkness.

The camera slowly approaches the screen.

At the 2-second mark, the projection begins affecting reality itself.

Objects from the film emerge physically from the screen:

-rain falls into the theater
- smoke rolls across the seats
- projected actors walk into the real environment

The projected worlds become unstable and merge together:

- deserts bleeding into cities
- oceans flooding aisles
- stars appearing inside the theater ceiling

The camera passes through multiple film genres collapsing into one another.

Velocity ramp: burning film reels unravel in suspended motion while projected light fractures across floating dust.

The projector grows louder and more unstable as reality becomes entirely cinematic.

Final moment: the projector beam turns toward the camera , completely engulfing the frame in white light and analog static.

Experimental cinema surrealism, analog projection aesthetics, dreamlike transitions, practical light interaction, 4K.

zh.p:
一座巨大的废弃电影院，只有房间后方一台老式模拟投影仪照明。尘埃在穿越黑暗的光束中飘扬。

摄像机慢慢靠近屏幕。

在2秒时，投影开始影响现实本身。

影片中的物体会从银幕中实体出现：

-雨水落进剧院
- 烟雾在座椅上滚滚
- 投影演员走入真实环境

投影世界变得不稳定并合并：

- 沙漠渗入城市
- 海洋淹没通道
- 剧院天花板内出现的星星

镜头穿梭于多种电影类型，彼此融合。

速度斜坡：燃烧的胶片卷轴在悬浮运动中展开，投射的光线在漂浮的尘埃上破碎。

随着现实完全变成电影化，放映机的声音变得更大、更不稳定。

最后一刻：投影仪的光束转向摄像机，完全将画面包裹在白光和模拟静电中。

实验电影超现实主义、模拟投影美学、梦幻般的过渡、实用光影互动、4K。

raw_p:
画像1=アニメ調の主人公キャラクターシート。
画像2=フォトリアリスティックの主人公キャラクターシート。
画像3=変身シーンの絵コンテ参照。

添付された絵コンテをもとに、15秒の横型16:9変身シーン動画を作成してください。

テーマ：
超高品質で可愛さ全振りの、アニメキャラクターが虹色の魔法と大量のリボン装飾に包まれながら、フォトリアリスティックな実写風ヒロインへ変化していく変身シーン。

絵コンテのパネル順に沿って、1コマ目から12コマ目までを、連続した一本の映像として自然につなげて動画化してください。

流れ：
冒頭はアニメ調の主人公が、幻想的なピンクとパステル虹色の空間に立っている。
主人公は大きな瞳、長いダークブラウンのウェーブヘア、ふわふわ前髪、小さなピンクのリボンヘアアクセサリー、白〜生成りのオーバーサイズニット、淡いピンクのフリルスカート、白いソックス、白い厚底スニーカーを身に着けている。
1〜2コマ目では、アニメ調の可愛い顔と目元の超接写を見せ、観客が主人公の魅力をはっきり認識できるようにする。
3コマ目で手を差し出し、虹色の粒子、ハート、宝石、リボン、きらめく装飾物が指先から流れ始める。
4〜6コマ目では、主人公の周囲をピンクのリボン帯、虹色の光、ハート型のエフェクト、ジュエル、レース状の魔法陣が高速回転しながら包み込み、体の周囲に変身の渦を形成する。
5コマ目では胸元に巨大な発光リボンモチーフが現れ、可愛さと変身の中心モチーフとして強く印象づける。
6コマ目では俯瞰ショットで、主人公がリボンの螺旋と虹の円環の中心に浮かんでいる様子を見せる。
7コマ目から、顔や髪や手の質感が徐々にリアルになり始め、アニメ塗りから2.5次元的な中間質感を経て、フォトリアリスティックに移行し始める。
8コマ目ではフォトリアル寄りの顔の寄りカットを使い、瞳の反射、髪の繊維感、肌の透明感が現れてきたことを見せる。
9〜10コマ目では変身エネルギーが一気に弾け、主人公が虹色の粒子とリボンの中で回転しながら、完全にフォトリアリスティックな姿へ変化する。
11コマ目では着地または静かな決めポーズを取り、幻想的なピンクの雲、ハート、リボン、宝石の浮かぶ空間に立つ。
12コマ目ではフォトリアリスティックな主人公の可愛い決め顔の超寄りで締める。変身後も髪型、顔立ち、衣装のシルエット、色設計は画像1と画像2の整合性を保ち、一貫した同一人物として見せる。

スタイル：
高品質な劇場版アニメ映画風の導入から始まり、後半に向かって高精細なフォトリアリスティック映像へ移行する、シネマティック、ハイディテール、超高密度エフェクトの変身映像。
全体の色彩はピンク、白、ラベンダー、パステルブルー、虹色の偏光表現を基調とする。
可愛い装飾要素として、大小のリボン、虹色のリボン帯、ハート型クリスタル、ジュエル、パール、レース魔法陣、きらめく星、バブル、グリッターを大量に使用する。
前半はアニメらしい大きな瞳と可愛い誇張表現を強く出し、中盤から後半にかけて、肌・髪・布・瞳の質感だけを自然に実写寄りへ変換する。

編集：
リズム感のある高速カット、寄りカット、超接写、ローアングル、俯瞰ショット、素早いパン、気持ちのいいマッチカットを使用してください。
特に、目のアップ→手のアップ→リボンの渦→全身回転→俯瞰ショット→顔のリアル化アップ→全身着地、という流れをテンポよくつないでください。
変身途中は静止ではなく、リボンが体の周りを回り続け、髪が揺れ、スカートが翻り、粒子が流れ、主人公自身も回転・浮遊・着地まで連続して自然に動いてください。
カメラは、前半で可愛さを強調する近距離中心、中盤で回転や俯瞰を使って変身のスケールを見せ、後半でフォトリアルな美しさを強調する寄りに移行してください。

重要：
静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。
全パネルを連続した一本の変身モーションとして、自然にアニメーションさせてください。
動画全体を通して、甘く夢かわいい雰囲気と高品質シネマティック変身映像スタイルを維持してください。
文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないでください。
可愛い魔法少女的変身シーンとして、主人公がアニメからフォトリアリスティックへ進化する瞬間を演じてください。
主人公の顔、目の大きさの印象、髪型、前髪、髪色、リボン配置、衣装シルエット、色設計を全編で一貫して維持してください。

1〜2コマ目では、アニメ調の可愛い顔と目元の超接写を見せ、観客が主人公の魅力をはっきり認識できるようにする。
3コマ目で手を差し出し、虹色の粒子、ハート、宝石、リボン、きらめく装飾物が指先から流れ始める。
4〜6コマ目では、主人公の周囲をピンクのリボン帯、虹色の光、ハート型のエフェクト、ジュエル、レース状の魔法陣が高速回転しながら包み込み、体の周囲に変身の渦を形成する。
5コマ目では胸元に巨大な発光リボンモチーフが現れ、可愛さと変身の中心モチーフとして強く印象づける。
6コマ目では俯瞰ショットで、主人公がリボンの螺旋と虹の円環の中心に浮かんでいる様子を見せる。
7コマ目から、顔や髪や手の質感が徐々にリアルになり始め、アニメ塗りから2.5次元的な中間質感を経て、フォトリアリスティックに移行し始める。
8コマ目ではフォトリアル寄りの顔の寄りカットを使い、瞳の反射、髪の繊維感、肌の透明感が現れてきたことを見せる。
9〜10コマ目では変身エネルギーが一気に弾け、主人公が虹色の粒子とリボンの中で回転しながら、完全にフォトリアリスティックな姿へ変化する。
11コマ目では着地または静かな決めポーズを取り、幻想的なピンクの雲、ハート、リボン、宝石の浮かぶ空間に立つ。
12コマ目ではフォトリアリスティックな主人公の可愛い決め顔の超寄りで締める。変身後も髪型、顔立ち、衣装のシルエット、色設計は画像1と画像2の整合性を保ち、一貫した同一人物として見せる。

スタイル：
高品質な劇場版アニメ映画風の導入から始まり、後半に向かって高精細なフォトリアリスティック映像へ移行する、シネマティック、ハイディテール、超高密度エフェクトの変身映像。
全体の色彩はピンク、白、ラベンダー、パステルブルー、虹色の偏光表現を基調とする。
可愛い装飾要素として、大小のリボン、虹色のリボン帯、ハート型クリスタル、ジュエル、パール、レース魔法陣、きらめく星、バブル、グリッターを大量に使用する。
前半はアニメらしい大きな瞳と可愛い誇張表現を強く出し、中盤から後半にかけて、肌・髪・布・瞳の質感だけを自然に実写寄りへ変換する。

編集：
リズム感のある高速カット、寄りカット、超接写、ローアングル、俯瞰ショット、素早いパン、気持ちのいいマッチカットを使用してください。
特に、目のアップ→手のアップ→リボンの渦→全身回転→俯瞰ショット→顔のリアル化アップ→全身着地、という流れをテンポよくつないでください。
変身途中は静止ではなく、リボンが体の周りを回り続け、髪が揺れ、スカートが翻り、粒子が流れ、主人公自身も回転・浮遊・着地まで連続して自然に動いてください。
カメラは、前半で可愛さを強調する近距離中心、中盤で回転や俯瞰を使って変身のスケールを見せ、後半でフォトリアルな美しさを強調する寄りに移行してください。

重要：
静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。
全パネルを連続した一本の変身モーションとして、自然にアニメーションさせてください。
動画全体を通して、甘く夢かわいい雰囲気と高品質シネマティック変身映像スタイルを維持してください。
文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないでください。
可愛い魔法少女的変身シーンとして、主人公がアニメからフォトリアリスティックへ進化する瞬間を演じてください。
主人公の顔、目の大きさの印象、髪型、前髪、髪色、リボン配置、衣装シルエット、色設計を全編で一貫して維持してください。

Based on the attached storyboard, create a 15-second landscape 16:9 transformation scene video.

テーマ：
A transformation scene where an ultra-high-quality, fully cute anime character transforms into a photorealistic live-action heroine wrapped in rainbow-colored magic and numerous ribbon decorations.

Follow the panel order of the storyboards and naturally connect panels 1 to 12 as a single continuous video, then turn them into a video.

Flow:
At the beginning, the anime-style protagonist stands in a fantastical space of pink and pastel rainbow colors.
The protagonist wears large eyes, long dark brown wavy hair, fluffy bangs, a small pink ribbon hair accessory, a white to oversized knit, a pale pink frill skirt, white socks, and white platform sneakers.
In the first and second panels, close-up shots of the cute face and eyes in an anime-style style are shown, allowing the audience to clearly recognize the protagonist's charm.
In the third panel, hands are extended, and rainbow-colored particles, hearts, jewels, ribbons, and sparkling decorations begin to flow from your fingertips.
In panels 4 to 6, pink ribbons, rainbow lights, heart-shaped effects, jewels, and lace-shaped magic circles spin rapidly around the protagonist, forming a transformation vortex around the body.
In the fifth panel, a huge glowing ribbon motif appears on the chest, strongly emphasizing cuteness and transformation as the central motif.
In the sixth panel, there is an overhead shot, showing the protagonist floating at the center of a spiral ribbon and a rainbow ring.
From the seventh panel, the textures of the face, hair, and hands gradually begin to become more realistic, then transition from anime-colored to a 2.5-dimensional intermediate texture, and then transition to photorealism.
In the eighth panel, a photorealistic facial cut is used, showing the reflection of the pupils, the texture of hair fibers, and the translucency of the skin.
In panels 9 and 10, transformation energy bursts out all at once, and the protagonist spins inside rainbow-colored particles and ribbons, transforming into a completely photorealistic form.
In the 11th panel, you land or strike a quiet final pose, standing in a space filled with magical pink clouds, hearts, ribbons, and jewels.
In the 12th panel, the film closes with a photorealistic protagonist's cute and signature face. Even after transformation, the hairstyle, facial features, costume silhouette, and color design remain consistent with Images 1 and 2, presenting them as consistent and identical characters.

スタイル：
Starting with the introduction of a high-quality theatrical anime movie style, the latter half transitions to high-definition photorealistic visuals, featuring cinematic, high-detail, and ultra-high-density effects transformation visuals.
The overall color scheme is based on polarized expressions of pink, white, lavender, pastel blue, and iridescence.
As cute decorative elements, large and small ribbons, rainbow-colored ribbons, heart-shaped crystals, jewels, pearls, lace magic circles, sparkling stars, bubbles, and glitter are used in large quantities.
The first half strongly emphasized the anime-like large eyes and cute exaggerated expressions, while from the middle to the second half, only the textures of skin, hair, fabric, and eyes are naturally transformed to resemble live-action.

Edit:
Use rhythmic high-speed cuts, close-up shots, ultra-close-up shots, low angles, bird's-eye shots, quick pans, and pleasant match cuts.
In particular, keep the flow flowing smoothly with close-ups of eyes→ hands→ ribbon swirls→ full-body rotations→ bird's-eye shots→ realistic close-ups of faces→ and full-body landings.
During the transformation, the ribbon does not stand still; ribbons continuously circle around the body, hair sways, skirts flutter, particles flow, and the protagonist himself naturally moves continuously from rotation, floating, and landing.
The camera shifts to a close-up focus emphasizing cuteness in the first half, a rotation and bird's-eye view in the middle to show transformation scales, and a close-up approach in the second half to emphasize photorealistic beauty.

Important:
Do not use it as a still image slideshow.
Naturally animate all panels as a single continuous transformation motion.
Throughout the video, maintain a sweet, dreamy, and cute atmosphere along with a high-quality cinematic transformation visual style.
Do not include text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.
As a cute magical girl transformation scene, perform the moment when the protagonist evolves from anime to photorealism.
Consistently maintain the protagonist's face, eye size, hairstyle, bangs, hair color, ribbon placement, costume silhouette, and color design throughout the film.

raw_p: CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: Do NOT display, reference, or reproduce any storyboard image, panel layout, reference photo, or sketch in the video output. All scenes must be original anime-style animation generated from the text descriptions only. Ignore any visual reference frame entirely. Please turn the storyboard sequence into a fast-paced cooking video following the order of the scenes. ## Style: High-quality Japanese anime film style, cinematic lighting, ultra-detailed food animation, shallow depth of field, soft natural summer lighting, macro close-up shots, slow cinematic camera movement, refreshing and bright summer atmosphere, gourmet cooking animation style with strong emphasis on texture and moisture. ## Editing: Use fast-paced, rhythm-driven cutting as the foundation, ensuring the cooking process is intuitively easy to understand. Apply match cuts (matching shape, motion, composition, and texture) to transition smoothly between scenes. The overall video should feel like an energetic and stylish anime film, with a strong focus on sizzle, freshness, and visual appeal. ### Scene 1 — 豚ロースを叩いて下処理する Close-up of anime-style hands gripping a wooden meat mallet, firmly pounding a thick pink pork loin cutlet on a wooden cutting board. The meat flattens slightly with each strike, fibers visibly loosening. Salt and pepper are sprinkled evenly across the surface. Subtle vibration ripples through the meat on impact. Hyperrealistic anime style, sharp kitchen lighting, cinematic shallow depth of field. ### Scene 2 — パン粉をまぶす Anime-style hands methodically coating a raw pork cutlet: first pressing it into a tray of white flour, then dipping it into beaten egg wash with golden drips falling back, finally pressing it firmly into a tray of coarse white panko breadcrumbs. Each layer adheres visibly. Hyperrealistic anime style, overhead dramatic lighting, close-up food detail. ### Scene 3 — 揚げる A panko-coated pork cutlet submerged in shimmering golden oil in a deep frying pan. Vigorous bubbles erupt around the edges, gradually settling as the crust turns deep amber and crispy. Light refracts through the hot oil surface. Steam rises gently. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm golden lighting, cinematic. ### Scene 4 — 揚げたカツを切る A perfectly fried golden-brown tonkatsu rests on a wooden cutting board. Anime-style hands guide a large sharp knife, slicing the cutlet into even uniform strips. The crispy crust cracks cleanly with each cut, revealing tender white meat inside. Subtle steam escapes the cuts. Hyperrealistic anime style, dramatic top-angle kitchen lighting. ### Scene 5 — 出汁と玉ねぎを煮る Inside a wide shallow pan on a gas stove, thinly sliced onion rings simmer slowly in dashi broth. The onions gradually soften and turn translucent, gently swaying in the amber liquid. Bubbles rise steadily from the bottom. Chopsticks occasionally stir the onions. Warm steam drifts upward. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm stovetop glow, cinematic close-up. ### Scene 6 — カツを出汁の上に置く Anime-style hands use chopsticks to carefully lay sliced tonkatsu strips side by side over the gently simmering onion and dashi broth in a shallow pan. The cutlet sizzles softly as it contacts the liquid. Golden breadcrumbs begin to absorb the broth slightly at the edges. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm amber kitchen lighting, close-up cinematic framing. ### Scene 7 — 溶き卵を回しかける A slow, steady pour of beaten golden egg from a small bowl, spiraling gently over the simmering tonkatsu and onions in the pan. The egg cascades in a thin stream, spreading naturally across the surface, beginning to turn opaque at the edges where it meets heat. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm stovetop light, macro cinematic detail. ### Scene 8 — 卵がゆっくり固まる Inside the shallow pan over low heat, the poured egg slowly coagulates across the surface of the tonkatsu and onions. The edges firm into a soft golden custard while the center remains slightly runny and trembling. Gentle steam rises. No stirring — the egg sets naturally through residual heat. Hyperrealistic anime style, soft warm glow, intimate close-up framing. ### Scene 9 — どんぶり茶碗にご飯を盛る A pristine white ceramic donburi bowl placed on a stainless steel counter. A rice paddle scoops a generous mound of steaming Japanese short-grain rice, placing it carefully into the bowl. The rice grains glisten slightly, tightly packed yet fluffy. Light steam rises from the surface. Hyperrealistic anime style, clean soft kitchen lighting, close-up cinematic. ### Scene 10 — カツと卵をご飯の上に乗せる Anime-style hands use chopsticks to carefully slide the softly set egg-and-tonkatsu mixture from the pan directly onto the mound of white rice in the donburi bowl. The egg settles over the rice in a gentle wave. Broth seeps slightly into the rice at the edges. Steam rises from both layers. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm overhead lighting, close-up cinematic detail. ### Scene 11 — 卵のグレーズが自然に落ち着く The finished katsudon bowl rests still on the counter. The soft golden egg glaze slowly settles and spreads naturally over the tonkatsu strips and rice, pooling gently at the sides. The surface is lightly trembling, semi-set, glossy with broth. No hands visible — pure still life in motion. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm diffused lighting, slow cinematic push-in. ### Scene 12 — 完成したカツ丼を提示する A beautifully finished katsudon is presented in a traditional blue-and-white ceramic donburi bowl on a wooden surface. Golden soft egg drapes over crispy tonkatsu strips atop glossy white rice. A small sprig of green mitsuba garnish is placed delicately on top. Wisps of steam rise gracefully. Camera slowly orbits the bowl in a cinematic arc. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm dramatic food photography lighting, cinematic. ## Audio: Upbeat Japanese city pop melody (80s-inspired, bright and breezy) layered with light Koto plucking and chime-like percussion, evoking a cheerful summer lunch atmosphere. Title: Urban Square Giant Vision Assembly

1. [CONDITION DEFINITION]
   参照画像1枚を使用。1:1スクエア、15秒。現代的な都市広場の空きスペースに、スクエア型の巨大オーロラビジョンが高速モンタージュでゼロから組み上がる。周囲には高層ビル、都市建築、舗装された広場、街灯がすでにある。都市全体を建設するのではなく、広場の中に巨大イベントビジョンだけが新しく建設される。冒頭は明るい昼、建設が進むにつれて時間が流れ、完成時は夜。最後はライトアップされたイベント会場風になる。参照画像はスクリーン内の表示映像としてのみ使う。中盤からLEDパネルの一部に参照画像の色や輪郭が断片的に現れ、最後に全面へ美しく鮮明に表示される。参照画像の白背景はそのまま使わず、人物や主題を中心にイベントビジョン向けの洗練された表示ビジュアルとして再構成してよい。

2. [OPTIONAL PERFORMER LOOK]
   人物を主役にしない。観客がいても、夜のイベント会場の遠景シルエット程度。主役は巨大ビジョンの建設、点灯、完成表示。

3. [SHOT / FLOW]
   最初は地上目線で都市広場の空きスペースを見せる。すぐにカメラが一気に上昇して俯瞰になり、高速モンタージュ開始。土台、支柱、鉄骨フレーム、背面構造、ケーブル、LEDパネル、外装、照明機材が次々に組み上がる。中盤でLEDパネルが部分点灯し、参照画像の断片が少しずつ見え始める。後半は夕方から夜へ変化し、周辺照明とビジョンが起動。最後に参照画像がスクリーン全面に高精細で美しく表示される。ラストは少し引いて、夜の都市広場に完成した巨大ビジョン全体を見せる。

4. [CAMERA / EDITING]
   カメラは自由でダイナミック。地上目線、一気に俯瞰、斜め俯瞰、低い前進、スクリーン横通過、LEDパネルの寄り、完成後の引き全景を自然に組み合わせる。15秒内で2〜3回の自然な場面転換。高速モンタージュの気持ちよさ、パネルがはまる快感、昼から夜への時間変化、最後のライトアップ完成を重視。完成表示では参照画像を大きく、鮮明に、美しく見せる。

5. [SOUND]
   BGMなし。効果音のみ。金属フレームの組み立て音、支柱固定音、LEDパネルのクリック音、ケーブル接続音、機械駆動音、電子起動音、点灯音、ライトアップ起動音、都市広場の環境音、遠い観客のざわめき。セリフなし。ナレーションなし。no clear spoken commentary, no narration, no understandable dialogue.

6. [NEGATIVE]
   参照画像の人物や被写体をスクリーン外に実体として出さない。参照画像は巨大ビジョンの表示映像としてのみ使う。人物を主役にしない。観客をはっきり見せすぎない。都市全体をゼロから作らない。横長スクリーンにしすぎない。文字、ロゴ、透かし、ラベル、字幕、ブランドロゴ、実在イベント名、実在企業名を出さない。BGM、歌、実況、ナレーションを入れない。暗すぎる映像、くすんだ色、低コントラスト、雑なLED表示、崩れた参照画像、白背景のまま単調な表示を避ける。

en.p:
Title: Urban Square Giant Vision Assembly

1. [CONDITION DEFINITION]
   Using one reference image. 1:1 square, 15 seconds. In the vacant spaces of a modern urban plaza, a massive square-shaped aurora vision is assembled from scratch in a high-speed montage. Around it are already skyscrapers, urban architecture, paved squares, and streetlights. Instead of building the entire city, only a massive event vision is newly constructed within the square. At the beginning, it was bright daytime; as construction progressed, time passed, and by the time it was completed, it was nighttime. At the end, it looks like an event venue illuminated by lights. Reference images are used only as display images on the screen. From the middle panel, fragments of the reference image's colors and outlines appear on parts of the LED panel, and finally, they are beautifully and clearly displayed across the entire panel. The white background of the reference image is not used as-is; instead, it is acceptable to reconstruct the image focusing on people and subjects as a sophisticated display visual for event vision.

2. [OPTIONAL PERFORMER LOOK]
   Do not make people the main characters. Even with an audience, it's just a distant silhouette of a nighttime event venue. The main focus is the construction, lighting, and completion display of the giant vision.

3. [SHOT / FLOW]
   At first, the empty spaces in the city square are shown from a ground-level perspective. Soon, the camera shot up for a bird's-eye view, and the high-speed montage began. The base, pillars, steel frame, rear structure, cables, LED panels, exterior, and lighting equipment are assembled one after another. In the middle of the story, the LED panel partially lights up, and fragments of the reference image begin to become visible. In the latter half, the transition shifts from evening to night, with ambient lighting and vision activated. Finally, the reference image is displayed beautifully and in high definition across the entire screen. The ending takes a slight lap to show the entire completed giant vision of the city square at night.

4. [CAMERA / EDITING]
   The camera is free and dynamic. It naturally combines ground view, a sudden bird's-eye view, a diagonal overview, low forward view, horizontal screen passage, a close approach to the LED panel, and a panoramic view after completion. Two to three natural scene transitions within 15 seconds. We focus on the pleasure of high-speed montage, the thrill of panels fitting, the time shift from day to night, and the final illumination completion. In the finished display, the reference image appears larger, clearer, and more beautiful.

5. [SOUND]
   BGMなし。 Only sound effects. The sound of assembling metal frames, fixing pillars, clicking of LED panels, cable connections, mechanical drive, electronic start, lighting, lighting startup, urban square ambience, and the murmur of distant spectators. セリフなし。 ナレーションなし。 no clear spoken commentary, no narration, no understandable dialogue.

6. [NEGATIVE]
   Do not display people or subjects in reference images as physical objects outside the screen. Reference images are used only as display images of giant visions. Do not make people the main characters. Don't make the audience too clear. Don't build an entire city from scratch. Don't make the screen too wide. Do not include text, logos, watermarks, labels, subtitles, brand logos, real event names, or real company names. No BGM, vocals, commentary, or narration included. Avoid images that are too dark, dull colors, low contrast, sloppy LED display, distorted reference images, and monotonous displays with a white background.

raw_p: A cinematic 15-second tracking shot inside a grand gothic cathedral hall. A beautiful young witch from Beauxbatons Academy stands at the center, wearing an elegant powder-blue tailored coat, matching wide-brimmed pointed hat, and silk necktie. Dark masked figures in flowing black cloaks surround her in a threatening circle. The camera smoothly orbits around her as she performs a graceful balletic spin, unleashing a powerful vortex of glowing ethereal blue magic. Hundreds of luminous white butterflies emerge from the magical energy, swirling around her and pushing the dark figures backward. Crystal chandeliers shimmer overhead, arched windows cast moody blue and gold light, and magical particles fill the air. The camera transitions from a dramatic wide-angle view to an intimate close-up as a glowing white butterfly gently lands on her fingertips. Intense motion, dramatic low-angle perspectives, volumetric lighting, photorealistic fantasy film aesthetic, ultra-detailed textures, shallow depth of field, anamorphic cinematic composition, PBR materials, subsurface scattering, hyper-realistic, 8K, 24fps.

zh.p: 一段长达15秒的电影式跟踪镜头，场景设在宏伟的哥特式大教堂大厅内。一位来自博巴顿学院的美丽年轻女巫站在中央，身穿优雅的浅蓝色剪裁大衣，戴着配套的宽檐尖帽和丝质领带。身披飘逸黑色斗篷的黑面具人将她围成一个威胁的圈。镜头顺畅地围绕她旋转，她优雅地旋转着，释放出一股强大的发光蓝色魔法漩涡。数百只发光的白色蝴蝶从魔法能量中飞出，围绕她旋转，将黑暗的身影推开。水晶吊灯在头顶闪烁，拱形窗户投射出忧郁的蓝金光芒，魔法粒子弥漫空气。镜头从戏剧性的广角镜头切换到亲密的特写，一只发光的白蝴蝶轻轻停在她的指尖。强烈的运动、低角度的戏剧性透视、体积光、照片级写实奇幻电影美学、超细致的纹理、浅景深、变形宽银幕电影构图、PBR材质、亚表面散射、超写实、8K、24帧每秒。

Hard cuts every 0.5 seconds synced to the beat. Handheld selfie-stick camera, wide-angle lens, close selfie framing, energetic travel-vlogger style, vibrant cinematic colors, realistic lighting, dynamic motion blur, natural crowds, and clear landmarks in every shot.

Strict identity consistency across all scenes: same face, same age, same hairstyle, same body proportions, same cheerful personality. No face morphing, gender changes, hairstyle changes,watch switching wrists, or outfit blending.

zh.p:
制作一段15秒的电影级超脱离自拍视频，展示上传的女性角色<image_1><<>>2026年穿越30个世界著名目的地。每0.5秒硬切一次，与节拍同步。手持自拍杆相机、广角镜头、近距离自拍构图、充满活力的旅行视频博主风格、鲜艳的电影色彩、逼真的光影、动态动态模糊、自然人群以及每个镜头中清晰的地标。

所有场景严格的身份一致性：相同的面孔、相同的年龄、相同的发型、相同的体型比例、同样开朗的个性。没有面部变形、性别变化、发型变化、手腕切换或服装混合。

地点：巴黎埃菲尔铁塔、东京涩谷、纽约时代广场、罗马斗兽场、埃及金字塔、里约救世主教堂、伦敦大本钟、悉尼歌剧院、曼谷大皇宫、印度泰姬陵、长城中国、迪拜哈里发塔、伊斯坦布尔圣索菲亚大教堂、威尼斯大运河、秘鲁马丘、雅典卫城、巴塞罗那圣家堂、阿姆斯特丹风车、京福宫（首尔）、滨海湾金沙（新加坡） 希腊圣托里尼、约旦佩特拉、德国新天鹅堡、旧金山金门大桥、加拿大尼亚加拉瀑布、日本富士山、柬埔寨吴哥窟、瑞士阿尔卑斯山、土耳其卡帕多西亚和马尔代夫。

每个地点都有独特的时尚服装，符合当地氛围，并有有趣的表情姿势，如挥手、和平手势、合十礼、手指爱心、笑声、指向地标、竖起大拇指、惊讶反应、跳舞或玩味的观光手势。

en.p:
Unedited iPhone handheld footage is presented in authentic video style, with all camera settings automatic, with no post-processing color grading or special effects. The footage shows real handheld slight shaking and the operator's (male) breathing; the camera naturally sinks or tilts due to the subway train's movement, then quickly returns to center. Autofocus occasionally experiences search, lag, and brief out-of-focus situations, especially during body movement or hand movements. Automatic white balance naturally switches between cool and warm tones as the cabin fluorescent lights and tunnel lighting change. The overall image is flat, preserving optical imperfections such as true lens flares, slight chromatic aberration at edges, and motion blur. Simulation of CCD sensor shooting with slight vertical smear, color overflow, grain noise, and purple-green fringes with high contrast edges. Using only natural sound effects within the image, including the deep roar of subway traffic, wheel-track friction, passenger whispers, and the sound of clothes rubbing, the microphone may be slightly distorted during train acceleration or larger movements. Using a first-person POV perspective of a man inside a subway carriage (starting from a low-angle upward view while seated), the camera movements fully follow the boy's instinctive reactions (head up, body stiffness, shaking when standing up). The carriage is extremely crowded, with no empty seats; the background is packed with passengers, pull-tab seats, and blurred crowds, enhancing the sense of fullness and realism. Occasionally, the boy's own legs, knees, or hand edges are visible (to enhance the sense of position while seated). 15-second timeline (Full conception: Normal distance begins→ girl flirts and slowly approaches chest but never touches→ boy endures and pulls until finally yielding and stepping away + surprised "How are you like this" expression→ girl takes the opportunity to take the seat and mocks, finally removes mask→ boy tries to touch his shoulder, girl takes out cleaning spray to clean his hands): At 0:00, the camera shifts from a first-person, low-angle POV seated on the subway seat, slightly shifting upward to a young Asian woman standing in front of him
Clothing
Wearing a white mask, she gripped the upper strap with both hands and looked at the boy with her eyes. The carriage was crowded with no empty seats, with passengers standing in the background. The two maintain a normal distance. The boy looks up and immediately notices the girl's eyes curve playfully, and she starts to approach the camera in a suggestive rhythm (her chest gradually draws closer but always keeps a safe distance without touching). Autofocus is locked onto her upper body, the image is slightly overexposed, CCD grain noise and slight color overflow are visible (the boy's own surprised breathing is transmitted into the microphone), clearly reflecting the upward position of sitting in the seat. Between 1-4 seconds, the woman continues to approach at a slow, ambiguous pace, with the visual distance of the chest gradually closing in by about 20 centimeters, but never actually touching the camera or the man. The boy first forced himself to endure it (the POV camera slightly shakes to reflect stiffness and tight shoulders, and the low angle of the head raised while seated caused the camera to briefly drop and then lift back). Autofocus briefly searches for loss of focus in asymptote interactions and then pulls back, with the CCD showing obvious vertical trailing. The microphone captured the faint rubbing of clothes, the boy's suppressed breathing, and the low sound of a heartbeat, slightly distorted. The background is filled with passengers, with no empty seats, and the swaying train causes the image to tilt slightly. At 5-7 seconds, the boy pushes his patience to the limit and finally gives in: POV camera raises + backs up and shakes (reflecting the panicked standing up while seated), shyly shifting to the right to try to create distance. The girl relaxed her body and sat sideways in the seat left by the guy (from the POV from the guy's side behind, her sitting motion was clear—natural, smooth, and satisfied). The crowded environment of the fully loaded carriage with no empty seats makes this seat occupation even more impactful. Automatic white balance is slightly shifted due to carriage lighting, the image is slightly underexposed due to train shaking but then automatically compensates for brightness, CCD color overflow is obvious, and the lens is slightly tilted. At 8-10 seconds, the conflict reversal details: after the boy steadied himself (POV perspective), he awkwardly and quickly turned to glance at the girl (her face was bright and her eyes curved like crescent moons under the mask), then hesitantly reached out to gently touch her shoulder and said, "How did you steal my spot?" ”。 The girl sat in her seat and couldn't help but laugh, leaning back slightly with a smile, her eyes mischievously "mocking" the boy. At the same time, she took out a white spray cleaner from her bag and sprayed it twice on the boy's outstretched hand (the spray sound and fine mist were clearly visible). The autofocus movement of the woman pulling back from the side showed a noticeable delay, with the background filled with passengers clearly visible for half a second; Front passengers are briefly partially obscured in the view, the male adjusts the angle to recapture (the grip shakes intensifies), CCD tailing and particulate noise penetrate through. Between 11-13 seconds, the girl's smile becomes even more obvious, with a satisfied playful expression shaking her head slightly, continuing to sit in her seat, her gaze sweeping toward the boy (ambiguous twist: she squints slightly and smiles, with complex emotions beneath the mask). At around 12 seconds, she slowly removes her white mask, revealing a delicate face and a complete smile (full lips, straight teeth). The boy looks back for the second time in POV (the camera naturally turns his head), and the girl still wears a playful smile. The camera features realistic handheld shake and a male breathing sensation; autofocus locks onto the woman's face with slight drift, and a slight lens halo caused by fluorescent light and CCD purple-green fringes appear in the upper right corner of the frame. The girl's clear, bell-like laughter (her voice becomes clearer after removing her mask) mixed with the roar of subway tracks, the microphone's low frequency distortion (the boy's own helpless sighs mixed in). At 14-15 seconds, the girl's smile gradually fades, returning to calmness but still with a playful smile at the corner of her mouth (her full face is visible after removing the mask, with her eyes still curved), and her hands naturally rest on her knees. The boy looked shyly at the cleaned hand. The camera slowly lowers to waist height before raising (the man's center of gravity shifts). The composition is slightly imperfect, and the woman's lower body is briefly cropped at the edges, with faint fingerprint and oil stains visible at the edges of the frame. Auto white balance switches between hot and cool again, the roar of trains continues, and the overall look is presented with an unedited handheld video feel. The visuals present a realistic, unedited handheld video texture, documentary-level natural imperfections, with no post-production color grading or special effects. All camera actions match the physical characteristics of iPhone/phone automatic shooting (first-person body linkage shaking), with CCD sensor effects running throughout, perfectly recreating the ambiguous, teasing interactions and awkward tugs from a POV perspective of a guy sitting in his seat.

参考图 主角：使用角色卡人物。主角是街头足球高手，带球向前推进，身体重心低，眼神专注自信，动作灵活、有爆发力，脚法干净。主角始终是画面核心。

其他球员：场上有多名防守者，不是一个人防守。防守者从不同方向上前逼抢，有人侧面封堵，有人正面拦截，有人从后方追赶。每个防守者动作都像真实踢足球的人：伸脚抢断、转身追防、急停、失去重心、被过掉后回头追。

动作流程：
0-3 秒：主角在中前场带球启动，低身快速推进。第一名防守者从正面上来抢球，主角用脚内侧轻拨、身体假晃，从他身侧过掉。足球贴近脚下，滚动清晰。
3-6 秒：第二和第三名防守者从左右两侧夹击。主角连续做踩单车、拉球转身、脚外侧变向，足球在两脚之间快速切换，主角从夹缝中穿过。两名防守者被晃开，一个停顿失位，一个转身追赶。
6-9 秒：主角继续带球高速推进，第四名防守者从侧面伸脚抢断。主角轻巧挑球过脚，足球短暂弹起越过防守者的脚面，然后落回主角前方。主角加速追上球，场边人群开始明显惊呼。
9-11 秒：主角接近禁区或小球门前，最后一名防守者和门将同时压上。主角用脚尖把足球挑到半空，球带着清晰旋转飞到自己前上方。主角调整步伐，准备倒挂金钩。
11-14 秒：主角后仰腾空，完成完整倒挂金钩。动作要清楚、有力、真实：背部向后倾倒，双腿剪刀式摆动，一条腿精准踢中空中的足球，另一条腿保持平衡。足球被踢出后高速飞向球门，穿过防守者和门将之间，进入球门，球网明显震动。
14-15 秒：主角落地后保持酷炫姿态，场边人群爆发欢呼，防守者和门将转头看向球门，露出震惊反应。人群可以跳起、举手、喊叫，但不要冲进场内包围主角。最后画面停留在进球后的震撼瞬间。

镜头语言：手持竖屏跟拍主角推进。开头从场边中景拍主角带球，突破时镜头跟随主角横向和向前移动，有真实手抖和运动模糊。过多人时镜头保持主角和足球在画面中心。倒挂金钩时镜头自然上抬，确保能看清主角腾空、踢中足球、足球飞进球门。不要切镜，不要多机位，不要无人机，不要稳定器。

声音：足球滚动和摩擦地面的声音，球鞋快速踩踏地面声，防守者急停和追赶声，围观人群逐渐升高的惊呼声。主角连续过人时人群喊叫越来越大，倒挂金钩踢中球时有清脆有力的击球声，进球后球网震动声和全场爆发欢呼声。

视觉重点：主角连续带球过掉多名防守者，足球始终清楚可见，最后倒挂金钩进球。动作要像真实足球进攻：带球、变向、摆脱、挑球、射门。不要写成单挑，不要让所有人站着不动，不要让防守者只摆姿势。

en.p:
Reference image: Main character: Use character cards. The protagonist is a street football expert, pushing forward with the ball, keeping a low center of gravity, focused and confident eyes, agile and explosive, and clean footwork. The protagonist is always the center of the picture.

Other players: There are multiple defenders on the court, not just one defender. Defenders pressed from different directions—some blocked from the sides, some blocked head-on, and others chased from behind. Every defender's movements are like real footballers: stretching out their foot to steal, turning to chase after the defender, stopping abruptly, losing balance, and turning back after being beaten to chase after being beaten.

Action Process:
0-3 seconds: The protagonist dribbles up midfield and advances, quickly advancing with a low body. The first defender comes up head-on to snatch the ball, and the protagonist uses the inside of his foot to flick and fak, passing past him. The ball stays close to your feet, rolling clearly.
3-6 seconds: The second and third defenders pinch from both sides. The protagonist repeatedly pedals the bike, spins the ball, and changes direction with the outside of his foot; the soccer ball quickly switches between his feet, and the protagonist slips through the gaps. Two defenders were shaken off—one paused and lost position, the other turned and chased.
6-9 seconds: The protagonist continued to dribble at high speed, and the fourth defender reached out from the side to steal the ball. The protagonist skillfully flicks the ball over his foot, briefly bouncing over the defender's foot before landing back in front of him. The protagonist accelerated to catch up, and the crowd on the sidelines began to clearly exclaim.
9-11 seconds: The protagonist approaches the penalty area or in front of the small goal, with the last defender and the goalkeeper pressing in together. The protagonist uses his toes to lift the ball into the air, and the ball spins clearly as it flies above and in front of him. The protagonist adjusts his pace, preparing to hang the golden hook upside down.
11-14 seconds: The protagonist leans back and leaps into the air, completing a complete upside down. The movements should be clear, powerful, and authentic: lean your back back, swing your legs in a scissor motion, accurately kick the ball in midair with one leg, and keep your balance with the other. After being kicked out, the ball flew at high speed toward the goal, passing between defenders and the goalkeeper, entering the net, and visibly shaking the net.
14-15 seconds: Behind the corner of the main field, maintaining a cool pose, the crowd erupted in cheers on the sidelines, and defenders and goalkeepers turned their heads toward the goal, showing shocked reactions. The crowd can jump, raise their hands, and shout, but do not rush into the arena to surround the main character. The final scene stopped at the shocking moment after the goal.

Camera language: handheld vertical camera followed the protagonist as he advances. The opening starts with a mid-shot shot from the sidelines, showing the protagonist dribbling. During the breakthrough, the camera follows the protagonist as it moves sideways and forward, showing real hand shake and blurred movement. When there are too many people, the camera keeps the main character and the ball at the center of the frame. When hanging the bicycle kick, the camera naturally lifts to ensure the protagonist is flying, kicking the ball, and the ball flying into the goal. Don't switch lenses, don't multi-camera setups, don't use drones, don't use stabilizers.

Sounds: the rolling and scraping of the soccer ball, the rapid stomping of sneakers, the stops and chase of defenders, and the rising cries of the crowd. As the protagonist dribbles continuously, the crowd's cheers grow louder; when a bicycle kick hits the ball, there is a crisp and powerful hit; after the goal, the net shakes and the crowd erupts in cheers.

Visual focus: The protagonist dribbles past multiple defenders continuously, the ball is always visible, and finally scores a bicycle kick goal. The movements should resemble real football attacks: dribbling, changing direction, breaking off, lofting, shooting. Don't write it as a one-on-one, don't make everyone stand still, don't let defenders just pose.

raw_p: A whimsical handcrafted plasticine poster featuring a fisherman sitting calmly on the edge of a tiny wooden dock extending into a pastel blue lake, holding a fishing rod while staring at the water. Right beside him sits a chunky orange cat with enormous hopeful eyes, intensely focused on the fishing line and already imagining dinner. Soft rolling hills, oversized fluffy clouds and a few reeds create a clean and charming environment. Bright sky blue, mint green, cream and warm orange palette, handcrafted clay textures, stop-motion aesthetic, simple storytelling, highly readable composition with minimal details. Large playful typography reading 'THE LONGEST WAIT' occupies the upper third of the poster, balanced naturally with the clouds and open sky. The fern sways slowly. The cat's eyes move from right to left and from left to right. The fishing rod starts to bend downward as if a fish has taken the bait. The fisherman pulls the line up and catches a fish. As he lifts the fish out of the water, it slips off the hook and flies directly into the cat's mouth. The fisherman is surprised. After seeing the fish coming toward him, the cat opens its mouth and freezes in anticipation. After swallowing the fish, the cat stands up proudly and begins wagging its tail. The tail hits the letters of the title text. All of the letters start to wobble slightly and then fall into the water one after another. The letters do not change their shape or deform in any way, they simply fall into the water one by one. No camera zoom, no camera movement, no change in framing. All characters, objects and actions must remain in the same handcrafted plasticine claymation style as the original reference.

zh.p: 一张充满奇思妙想的手工塑胶海报，描绘了一位渔夫平静地坐在伸入淡蓝色湖泊的小木码头边缘，手持钓鱼竿凝视着水面。就在他旁边坐着一只胖胖的橙，眼睛充满希望，专注地盯着钓鱼线，已经开始想象晚餐。柔软起伏的山丘、巨大的蓬松云朵和几片芦苇营造出干净迷人的环境。明亮的天空蓝、薄荷绿、奶油色和暖橙色调，手工制作的粘土纹理，定格动画美学，简洁的叙事，构图极易读，细节极少。海报上三分之一处有大型俏皮字体“THE LONGEST WAIT”，与云朵和开阔天空自然平衡。蕨类植物缓缓摇曳。猫的眼睛从右向左、从左到右移动。钓鱼竿开始向下弯曲，好像鱼已经上钩了。渔夫拉起鱼线，钓到一条鱼。当他把鱼从水里提起时，鱼从钩子上滑落，直接飞进了猫的嘴里。渔夫感到惊讶。看到鱼朝他走来，猫张开嘴，屏住了期待。吞下鱼后，猫骄傲地站起身，开始摇尾巴。尾部正好碰到标题文字的字母。所有字母开始微微晃动，然后一个接一个掉进水里。字母不会改变形状或变形，只是一个接一个地落入水中。没有镜头变焦，没有移动镜头，也没有画面变化。所有角色、物品和动作都必须保持与原始参考相同的手工制作的塑料粘土动画风格。

raw_p:
A cinematic, hyper-realistic 15-second action sequence. Close-up on a female superhero wearing an intricate metallic silver filigree armor mask, with glowing neon blue eyes staring intensely. Cut to a wide shot as she hovers high above a modern city street, a massive tornado swirling behind her. She crosses her arms, then violently thrusts them outward, releasing a powerful shockwave of white smoke and kinetic energy that ripples through the surrounding buildings. 8K resolution, photorealistic, dynamic lighting, complex PBR textures, depth of field, 35mm lens, blockbuster VFX.

Cut to a high-octane cinematic sequence featuring a stealth superhero in a matte black and chrome armored suit with a matching face mask. Her long black hair streams wildly in the wind as she flies low and fast through a city street canyon. The camera dynamically orbits around her while a thick trail of white smoke follows behind. She stops mid-air, opens her arms, and faces the camera. Close-up on her face as her hair blows upward, revealing a cracked texture forming on the left side of her black metallic visor. Photorealistic, high-end CGI, cinematic lighting, sharp focus, 180mm prime lens, f/2.0 aperture.

Final battle sequence: an epic sci-fi superhero confrontation in a modern city. A warrior in intricate silver mesh armor unleashes a massive shockwave of air and smoke. Cut to a stealth warrior in a sleek black suit flying effortlessly through the billowing smoke clouds. Fast tracking shots capture flowing hair, dramatic wind physics, and highly detailed armor textures. 8K resolution, realistic motion blur, cinematic color grading, dramatic lighting, premium CGI quality.

Use the exact facial features from the reference image throughout all scenes. Maintain the same face, identity, and facial structure in every shot.

zh.p:
一段电影感十足、超写实的15秒动作戏。特写一位女性超级英雄，戴着复杂的金属银色细工盔甲面具，霓虹蓝的眼睛炯炯有神地凝视着。画面切换到远景，她悬浮在现代城市街道上方，身后有巨大的龙卷风旋转。她交叉双臂，猛地向外伸出，释放出一股强烈的白烟和动能冲击波，波纹遍及周围建筑。8K分辨率，照片级写实，动态光影，复杂的PBR纹理，景深，35mm镜头，巨型视觉特效。

画面切换到一段高能的电影序列，出现一位身穿哑光黑铬装甲、戴着相配面罩的潜行超级英雄。她那长长的黑发在风中狂野飘扬，低空飞翔，穿过城市的街道峡谷。摄像机动态地围绕她旋转，身后跟着一串浓厚的白烟。她在半空中停下，张开双臂，面对镜头。特写她的脸，头发被风吹起，露出黑色金属面罩左侧出现裂纹。照片级真实感、高端CGI、电影感光影、清晰对焦、180mm定焦镜头、f/2.0光圈。

最终战斗场面：一场现代城市史诗级的科幻超级英雄对决。一名身穿复杂银网盔甲的战士释放出巨大的空气与烟雾冲击波。画面切换到一名身穿黑色战衣的潜行战士，轻松穿梭于浓烟中。快速跟踪镜头捕捉了飘逸的头发、戏剧性的风力物理和高度细致的盔甲纹理。8K分辨率，逼真的动态模糊，电影级色彩分级，戏剧性光影，顶级CGI质量。

在所有场景中使用参考图像中的准确面部特征。每张照片都要保持相同的面部表情、身份和面部结构。

水手皮肤下隐现出淡淡的青绿色光芒。

古老的海洋能量觉醒。

水手从海底升起，巨大的水柱在他们周围盘旋。珊瑚冠、珍珠状结构和活生生的海洋护甲继续在身体上生长。

高潮时，变形后的海洋泰坦从海面喷发。一股巨大的巨浪在他们脚下升起，发光的鲸鱼和发光的海洋生物从深处浮现。

The focus shifts to a shared dining experience as friends arrive. Warm string lights, glowing charcoal embers, city lights bokeh, realistic steam, highly detailed food textures, natural human interactions, 4K quality, smooth 24fps motion, raw camera recording feel.

Environment:
Same open-air Indonesian rooftop terrace, late Saturday night. The ambient temperature has cooled, making the grill's orange glow more prominent. More seating is arranged around a low wooden table. Distant Jakarta-style skyline bokeh dominates the background with deep blues and purples, contrasting against the warm 2700K string lights.

Character Setup:
The 30-year-old Indonesian chef is joined by two close friends (a male and a female companion in casual, stylish weekend wear). They exhibit relaxed, genuine laughter, natural eye contact, and authentic body language.

Camera Setup:
Cinematic food commercial style. Fluid slider tracking shots, intimate over-the-shoulder perspectives, macro lens close-ups on food glaze, and micro-handheld stick drift to maintain a high-end gameplay/leaked cinematic look. Smooth rack focus from background laughter to foreground food sizzle.

Storyboard Breakdown (15 Seconds)
Scene 1 (0s–3.5s) — The Grand Platter
Subject: Plating and presenting the final spread.

Visuals: The chef lifts three perfectly charred, glistening ears of corn from the grill using tongs, arranging them on a large traditional banana-leaf-lined wooden platter. Beside the corn, he places grilled satay skewers and sliced limes. The camera starts with an ultra-close macro shot of the sweet soy glaze bubbling on the hot kernels, then pulls back smoothly as the chef lifts the platter.

Motion: Slow-motion steam rises vertically, catching the side-lighting from the string lights.

Scene 2 (3.5s–7.5s) — The Arrival & Toast
Subject: Handing off the food and interacting with friends.

Visuals: The chef steps over to the low wooden dining table and sets the steaming platter down. His two friends lean in, faces illuminated by the warm tabletop candles. One friend pours traditional iced tea (Teh Botol) into glasses filled with sweating ice cubes.

Motion: A dynamic push-in camera movement tracks a hand raising a glass for a casual "cheers" over the food. Real-time cloth simulation on their linen shirts as they shift weight and laugh.

Scene 3 (7.5s–11.5s) — Macro Taste Textures
Subject: Extreme close-up of a friend taking a bite.

Visuals: The female friend picks up an ear of corn. The camera cuts to an extreme close-up (macro) profile shot. As she takes a bite, the crisp texture is visible—corn juice sprays slightly, and the sweet soy glaze glistens on her lips.

Motion: Shallow depth of field blurs the background entirely into soft city bokeh. The camera has a slight, natural handheld

超写实电影视频，温馨舒适的周六夜氛围，现代印度尼西亚住宅的屋顶，高端食品广告风格。随着朋友们的到来，焦点转向共享用餐体验。温暖的串灯、发光的炭火余烬、城市灯光散景、逼真的蒸汽、极其细致的食物质感、自然的人际互动、4K画质、流畅的24fps运动、原始的摄像机拍摄手感。

环境：
同一个露天印尼屋顶露台，周六深夜。环境温度下降，烤架的橙色光芒更加明显。更多的座位围绕着一张低矮的木桌排列。远处雅加达风格的天际线散景主导背景，深蓝和紫色，与温暖的2700K串灯形成鲜明对比。

角色设定：
这位30岁的印尼厨师与两位亲密朋友（一男一女，穿着休闲时尚的周末装扮）同行。他们表现出轻松、真诚的笑声、自然的眼神交流和真实的肢体语言。

相机配置：
电影化的食品广告风格。流畅的滑块跟踪镜头、亲密的肩膀视角、微距镜头特写食物糖浆，以及微型手持摇杆漂移，保持高端玩法和电影感的流出感。从背景笑声转向前景食物滋滋声，镜头对焦流畅。

分镜解析（15秒）
第一场（0秒–3.5秒）——大盘子
主题：摆盘并呈现最终的餐盘。

视觉效果：厨师用夹子从烤架上取下三根完美焦化、闪闪发光的玉米穗，摆放在一个铺有香蕉叶的大木盘上。玉米旁边，他放上烤沙嗲串和切片青柠。镜头从超近微距镜头开始，拍摄甜豆浆在热玉米粒上起泡，然后随着厨师抬起盘子而平稳拉远。

动态：慢动作蒸汽垂直上升，捕捉着串灯的侧光。

第二场（3.5秒–7.5秒）——抵达与祝酒
主题：递食物并与朋友互动。

视觉效果：厨师走到低矮的木桌旁，放下热气腾腾的盘子。他的两个朋友凑近，脸庞被温暖的桌面蜡烛照亮。一位朋友将传统的冰茶（Teh Botol）倒入装满汗水冰块的杯子里。

动态镜头运动，追踪一只举杯的手，随意地“干杯”庆祝食物。他们在亚麻衬衫上实时模拟布料，换重心并大笑。

场景3（7.5秒–11.5秒）——宏观味觉质地
主题：朋友咬一口的极近特写。

画面：女性朋友捡起一根玉米棒。镜头切换到极近的（微距）侧面镜头。她咬了一口，酥脆的口感清晰可见——玉米汁微微喷洒，甜美的大豆釉在嘴唇上闪闪发光。

运动：浅景深完全模糊背景，形成柔和的城市散景。相机采用轻微的自然手持设计

Professional product-commercial style close-up shots show him taking one tablet and swallowing it with water. Crisp cinematic focus, detailed hand movements, smooth camera transitions.

High-end CGI, realistic biological environment, flowing particles, energy-like relief spreading through the nervous system. Dynamic camera movement follows the medicine's journey.
Transition back to reality. The tension in his face fades. His posture straightens. He takes a deep breath and smiles with visible relief. Bright natural sunlight emerges, subtle lens flare, uplifting mood. He stands up confidently and continues walking down the street. Smooth tracking shot from behind as he walks away comfortably.

头痛加剧。那人放慢了脚步，眯起眼睛，明显显得不自在。动态侧向镜头跟随他寻找座位。他坐在附近的长椅上，微微前倾，双手捧着头。特写镜头强调了他脸上的痛苦和紧张。

回归现实。他脸上的紧张感消散了。他的姿势挺直了。他深吸一口气，露出明显的释然笑容。明亮的自然阳光洒落，细微的镜头光晕，振奋人心的氛围。他自信地站起身，继续沿着街道走去。他走开时，背后有一段流畅的跟踪镜头。

Scene 1 (0–3s) “Establish + Hook”
Wide tracking shot from behind: a cartoon school boy walks alone on a quiet street, backpack bouncing slightly.
Camera slowly pushes in (dolly-in). Subtle wind + soft suspense beat starts.
Transition: quick whip pan left into next scene.

Scene 2 (3–6s)  “Threat Reveal”
Snap zoom cut-in to a girl near a parked bike being threatened by two sneaky snatchers.
One grabs her purse aggressively.
Camera angle: low-angle wide shot to make snatchers look bigger and intense.
Music intensifies sharply.
Transition: fast heartbeat zoom blur into hero reaction.

Scene 3 (6–9s) “Hero Moment Build”
Close-up on the boy’s face determined expression, eyes reflecting light.
He bends down (camera follows in slow-motion orbit shot) and picks up a small stone.
Cinematic slow-motion throw with motion blur and dramatic lighting flare.
Transition: impact cut (flash frame white)

Scene 4 (9–11s)  “Impact Chaos”
Stone hits the bike with stylized spark FX + metallic clang sound vibe.
Camera shakes slightly (handheld effect).
Purse falls in slow motion.
Snatchers react in exaggerated cartoon shock.
Transition: speed ramp + forward push-in tracking shot

Scene 5 (11–13s) “Action Resolution”
The boy runs in smooth tracking side-shot (parallax motion), grabs the purse mid-motion.
He steps in front of the girl protectively.
Snatchers retreat in exaggerated cartoon panic (blurred background motion).
Transition: soft stabilized slow fade motion

Scene 6 (13–15s)  “Hero Ending / Viral Hook Finish”
Golden warm lighting.
Medium close-up: boy returns purse gently. Girl smiles relieved.
Camera slowly rotates around them (hero orbit shot).
He puts on black sunglasses inslow-motion swag reveal.
Soft romantic outro music fades.
Final frame freezes for 0.5s (TikTok-style end lock).

背后宽景追踪镜头：一个卡通男学生独自走在安静的街道上，背包微微弹跳。

过渡：快速向左转，进入下一个场景。

快拍镜头切入，一名女孩靠近停放的摩托车，正被两个狡猾的抢劫者威胁。
其中一个用力抓了她的包。

音乐骤然增强。
过渡：快速心跳、放大、模糊，进入英雄反应。

第三场（6–9秒）“英雄时刻构建”
特写男孩坚定的表情，眼睛反射着光芒。
他弯下腰（镜头慢动作轨道跟随），捡起一块小石头。
电影般的慢动作投掷，配合动态模糊和戏剧性的光影闪耀。

Stone以风格化的火花效果+金属撞击声击中摩托。

钱包慢动作掉落。
抢夺者会以夸张的卡通震惊反应。
过渡：速度坡+前推追踪镜头

第五场（11–13秒）“行动解决”
男孩以平滑的侧射（视差运动）跑动，在移动中抓住了钱包。
他保护性地站到女孩前面。
抢夺者以夸张的卡通恐慌方式撤退（背景动作模糊）。
过渡：柔和稳定的慢淡出

第6场（13–15岁）“英雄结局 / 病毒式引子结尾”
金色温暖的灯光。
中特写：男孩轻轻地还包。女孩松了口气地笑了。
镜头慢慢围绕他们旋转（英雄轨道镜头）。
他戴上黑色太阳镜，慢动作展示周边。
柔和浪漫的结尾音乐渐渐淡出。
最终画面卡住了0.5秒（类似TikTok的终锁）。

A rookie pizza delivery boy receives an urgent order and rushes through a vibrant city on his scooter. Already running late, he is determined to deliver the pizza on time. But the day quickly turns into chaos. A sudden storm floods the streets, traffic blocks every shortcut, and an angry bulldog starts chasing him through the city.

Trying to escape, he accidentally rides into a bicycle race, gets swept into a city marathon, and then crashes into a colorful parade. Every obstacle somehow pushes him forward instead of slowing him down. The bulldog keeps chasing him, the crowds keep cheering, and the delivery boy has no idea that people now think he's competing in a major race.

The chaos grows bigger and bigger as he runs through packed streets, cheering spectators, and city landmarks. Still holding the pizza, he unknowingly takes the lead and sprints toward the finish line. Confetti cannons explode as he crosses first place. The crowd goes wild. Reporters surround him. He is handed a giant trophy and celebrated as a champion.

Proud of his victory, he rushes to complete the delivery. He finally arrives at the customer's door, exhausted but smiling, and proudly hands over the pizza.

The customer checks the receipt, looks up, and casually says:

"I ordered this yesterday."

The delivery boy freezes in shock. The bulldog finally catches up and sits happily beside him. The crowd laughs, the trophy feels meaningless, and all that chaos was for a pizza that was already a day late.

raw_p: 经典的90年代迪士尼动画风格。 场景1：一只威猛强壮的老虎正挂在树枝上，前爪紧紧抓住树枝，腋窝敞开着，它正努力保持平衡，不让自己松手掉下去。 场景2：一条蛇出现在老虎旁边，沿着老虎抓着的树枝滑行而来，带着一丝狡黠的微笑对老虎说：“哦，我的大猫，你得放松点儿。”老虎生气地回应道：“滚开，虫子。” 场景3：蛇狡黠地咯咯笑着，用尾巴尖轻轻地挠着老虎的腋窝，问老虎：“怕痒吗？” 场景4：特写镜头展现了蛇用尾巴尖轻柔地挠着老虎的腋窝，动作流畅自然。背景中传来老虎闷闷的笑声，表明它非常怕痒。 场景5：老虎上半身的特写镜头，蛇用扭动的尾巴尖不停地挠着老虎的腋窝，老虎闭着眼睛，咧嘴大笑，发出闷闷的咯咯声。 场景6：蛇继续用扭动的尾巴尖挠着老虎的腋窝，老虎闭着眼睛，大声咯咯地笑着，努力抓住树枝，但慢慢地滑了下来。 场景7：蛇继续用扭动的尾巴尖挠着老虎的腋窝，老虎闭着眼睛，大声咯咯地笑着，然后老虎松开了树枝，在半空中抱住自己，还在咯咯地笑着。然后，滑稽的是，老虎意识到自己做了什么，摔了下来，蛇则用尾巴尖顽皮地挥手告别。​​配音为英文。

en.p: Classic 90s Disney animation style. Scene 1: A powerful and powerful tiger is hanging from a tree branch, its front paws gripping tightly, armpits exposed, struggling to keep its balance and not letting go of its grip. Scene 2: A snake appears beside the tiger, sliding along the branch the tiger is grabbing, and with a sly smile, says to the tiger, "Oh, my big cat, you need to relax." The tiger angrily replied, "Get lost, bug." Scene 3: The snake cackles slyly, gently tickling the tiger's armpit with its tail tip, and asks, "Are you ticklish?" Scene 4: Close-up shows the snake gently scratching the tiger's armpit with its tail tip, the movement smooth and natural. In the background, the tiger's muffled laughter echoed, indicating it was very sensitive to itching. Scene 5: Close-up of the tiger's upper body, the snake scratches the tiger's armpit with its twisted tail tip, eyes closed, grinning and making muffled gurgling sounds. Scene 6: The snake continues to scratch the tiger's armpit with its twisting tail tip. The tiger closes its eyes, giggles loudly, and tries hard to grab the branch, but slowly slides down. Scene 7: The snake continues to scratch the tiger's armpit with its twisting tail tip. The tiger closes its eyes and giggles loudly, then the tiger releases the branch and hugs itself in midair, still giggling. Then, comically, the tiger realized what it had done and fell, while the snake playfully waved goodbye with its tail tip. The voice acting is in English.

raw_p:
Low-quality early 2010s home video footage shot on a cheap digital camcorder or old VHS camcorder, heavy film grain, visible compression artifacts, slight color bleeding, soft focus, minor tracking wobble, and that distinct nostalgic early internet era look. The entire image has a slightly washed-out color palette with warm yellow-orange undertones, low resolution feel, and subtle VHS-style noise throughout.
A cluttered bedroom or basement “man cave” from around 2010s. In the center sits an extremely overweight white man in his late 20s or early 30s with a goatee, messy medium-length hair, wearing thick glasses and a black fedora hat. He is dressed in a plain black t-shirt and is sitting in a black office chair at a messy desk. On the desk is an old beige CRT computer monitor, keyboard, mouse, scattered DVD cases, energy drink cans, papers, and random clutter. Behind him is real life 2D anime-style cheerleader girl.
The anime girl has brown hair with a yellow headband/ribbon, big expressive eyes, and is wearing a classic blue and white cheerleader outfit with a short pleated blue skirt. She holds bright yellow pom-poms and is energetically animated in smooth 2D anime style — cheering loudly, raising her arms high, shaking the pom-poms vigorously, bouncing on her feet, and opening and closing her mouth as if yelling cheers with an excited, over-the-top expression. Her movements are lively and loop naturally while the rest of the scene has realistic but heavily degraded video quality.
The man is focused on his computer screen, occasionally typing on the keyboard or moving the mouse with one hand while slightly turning his head. His facial expressions and movements feel natural but captured in low-quality home video style. The room has dim indoor lighting from a desk lamp or overhead bulb, creating soft shadows and that authentic early 2010s camcorder look. Slight handheld camera shake or static tripod shot. Overall atmosphere is nostalgic, slightly cringy, and meme-like — exactly like a video someone would have filmed and uploaded to YouTube or Reddit in 2010s if it was around. 
Ultra-detailed textures on skin, clothing, and the cluttered desk, but all filtered through heavy 2010s low-res video degradation. Cinematic yet deliberately cheap and authentic early 2010s home video aesthetic.

Girl cheers him on and he replies. Their banter is funny, wierd and creepy at the same time.

zh.p:
低质量的2010年代初家庭录像，用廉价数字摄像机或老式VHS摄像机拍摄，严重颗粒感，明显压缩伪影，轻微色彩溢出，焦暗，轻微的追踪晃动，以及那种独特的怀旧早期互联网时代风格。整张画面色调略显淡白，带有温暖的黄橙色底调，分辨率较低，且整体存在细微的VHS风格噪点。
一个杂乱的卧室或地下室“男人洞穴”，大约是2010年代的。中央坐着一位极度肥胖的白人男子，年约二十多岁末到三十出头，留着山羊胡，凌乱的中长发，戴着厚眼镜，头戴黑色软呢帽。他穿着一件普通的黑色T恤，坐在一把黑色办公椅上，坐在一张凌乱的办公桌前。桌子上有一台旧米色的CRT电脑显示器、键盘、鼠标、散落的DVD盒、能量饮料罐、文件和杂乱无章的东西。他身后是现实生活中的2D动漫风格啦啦队女孩。
动漫女孩有棕色头发，戴着黄色发带/丝带，眼睛大大的富有表情，穿着经典的蓝白啦啦队服和一条短百褶蓝色裙子。她手持鲜黄色的毛球，动作充满活力，采用流畅的2D动漫风格——大声欢呼，高举双臂，用力摇晃毛球，脚步弹跳，张合嘴巴，像是在兴奋且夸张地喊出欢呼声。她的动作生动自然循环，而其他场景则是真实但严重退化的视频质量。
那人专注于电脑屏幕，偶尔敲击键盘或单手移动鼠标，微微转头。他的面部表情和动作自然，但却以低质量的家庭录像风格捕捉。房间内有台灯或顶灯的昏暗室内灯光，营造出柔和的阴影，呈现出真实的2010年代初摄像机风格。手持相机轻微晃动或静态三脚架拍摄。整体氛围怀旧，略显尴尬，像梗一样——就像2010年代有人拍摄并上传到YouTube或Reddit的视频，如果当时有的话。
皮肤、衣物和杂乱桌面上的极细致纹理，但都经过了2010年代低分辨率视频劣化的严重滤波。电影感十足，却刻意廉价且真实，体现了2010年代初的家庭录像风格。

女孩为他欢呼，他也回应了。他们的打趣既有趣又怪异，同时令人毛骨悚然。

raw_p:
Create one continuous locked-off wide shot inside a cluttered high-rise gaming apartment at night. Keep the camera completely stationary for the entire scene: no cuts, zooms, pans, tilts, shake, reframing, or angle changes.
The seated adult man remains focused on playing a computer game. He makes natural mouse movements, taps the keyboard, leans slightly toward the monitor, and reacts subtly to tense gameplay. He stays fully clothed, never speaks, and does not turn around.
Behind him stands a clearly adult anime woman, age 22 or older, wearing modest casual gaming-themed clothing. She has a bright, friendly expression and a clean 2D cel-shaded anime appearance. Her behavior is supportive and playful, with no flirting, romance, physical contact, or suggestive movement.
[00:00–00:03]
The man begins clicking the mouse and tapping the keyboard. The anime woman bounces lightly in place and makes two small fist pumps near shoulder height. She cheers in a cheerful adult Japanese anime voice:
「がんばれ！ がんばれー！」
“Ganbare! Ganbareee!”
[00:03–00:06]
The man leans closer to the monitor as the game becomes more intense. She performs two simple side steps, claps twice, and says:
「その調子！ もう少し！」
“Sono choushi! Mou sukoshi!”
[00:06–00:09]
The man makes a quick mouse movement and presses several keys. She raises both arms in a harmless victory pose, waves once, and cheers:
「がんばって！ 負けないで！」
“Ganbatte! Makenaide!”
[00:09–00:12]
The man remains concentrated while the monitor glow flickers naturally across the desk. She alternates two small fist pumps, gives a thumbs-up, and says:
「いけるよ！ いける！」
“Ikeru yo! Ikeru!”
[00:12–00:15]
The man completes a final rapid series of clicks and relaxes slightly, suggesting success. She makes one small celebratory hop, lands naturally, claps, and finishes with both thumbs up while saying:
「やったー！ よくできました！」
“Yattaa! Yoku dekimashita!”
AUDIO:
Clear adult feminine Japanese voice with accurate lip sync. Add realistic keyboard tapping, mouse clicks, computer-fan hum, faint game sounds, quiet room tone, and distant city ambience. No music and no additional voices.
STYLE:
Photorealistic apartment combined with a crisp 2D adult anime character. Warm room lighting, cool monitor glow, red computer lighting, natural shadows, light cinematic grain, wholesome gaming-comedy atmosphere.
AVOID:
No minors, childlike appearance, romance, flirting, physical contact, sexualized clothing, suggestive dancing, camera movement, subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, watermarks, extra characters, duplicated limbs, distorted hands, facial changes, clothing changes, room changes, character flicker, or transformation into a realistic person.

zh.p:
在一栋杂乱的高层游戏公寓里，晚上拍摄一个连续锁定的广角镜头。整个场景中保持摄像机完全静止：不剪辑、缩放、平移、倾斜、抖动、重构图或角度变化。
坐着的成年男子专注于玩电脑游戏。他会自然地操作鼠标，轻敲键盘，微微倾向显示器，并对紧张的游戏进行细微反应。他穿着整齐，从不说话，也不会回头。
他身后站着一位明显成年的动漫女性，年龄在22岁以上，穿着朴素休闲的游戏主题服装。她表情明亮友好，拥有干净的2D卡通渲染动画风格。她的行为支持且充满玩心，没有调情、浪漫、肢体接触或暗示性动作。
[00:00–00:03]
那人开始点击鼠标并敲击键盘。这位动漫女郎轻轻弹跳，肩膀高度做了两个小拳头。她用一种愉快的日本成人动漫声音欢呼：
「がんばれ！ がんばれー！」
“甘巴雷！甘巴里！”
[00:03–00:06]
随着游戏变得越来越激烈，那人靠近显示器。她做了两个简单的侧步，拍了两下手，然后说：
「その調子！ もう少し！」
“园长司！“我也须越！”
[00:06–00:09]
那人快速滑鼠，按下几个键。她双臂举起，摆出无害的胜利姿势，挥了挥手，欢呼道：
「がんばって！ 負けないで！」
“甘巴特！马克奈德！”
[00:09–00:12]
那人专注地看着显示器的光芒在桌面上自然闪烁。她交替做出两个小小的拳头举动，竖起大拇指，然后说：
「いけるよ！ いける！」
“Ikeru yo！伊克留！”
[00:12–00:15]
那人完成了最后一连串快速的点击，稍稍放松，暗示成功了。她轻轻跳了一下庆祝，自然落地，拍手，最后双手竖起大拇指说：
「やったー！ よくできました！」

空气突然安静。

近景双人镜头。

少女拿出猫零食。

超动态特写。

The air suddenly went silent.
The girl stood with her hands on hips in the messy center of the room, looking down at the cat. But the cat sat upright, pretending nothing had happened. Fine dust floats in the air, and the sunset rays are soft. The camera slowly zooms in, creating a sense of comedic pressure.

Close-up duo shot.

The girl took out some cat treats.

Ultra-dynamic close-ups.
The cat lunges at the camera at an absurd speed. The snack bags shook wildly. Exaggerated stretching animation effects. The visuals are filled with sparkling stars and anime energy burst effects.

The sunset at Tiantai comes to an end.
The girl sat at the edge of the city rooftop holding a cat. In the distance, city lights lit up, and the sky was a gradient of purple-orange evening glow. A gentle breeze gently stirs the girl's coat. The cat quietly nestled in its arms, purring. The camera slowly pulls back, ending warmly.

Live IPL television broadcast. Professional cricket coverage with realistic broadcast graphics, crowd noise, stadium atmosphere, commentator audio, multiple camera angles, and authentic sports production quality.

The bowler runs in and delivers a fast ball. The batsman attempts a massive six, swinging with full power. But at the moment of impact, he completely loses grip of the bat.

The cricket ball travels only a short distance.

Meanwhile, the bat launches high into the air like a missile, spinning dramatically over the boundary rope and disappearing into the crowd.

For a moment, nobody understands what happened.

The crowd gasps, then bursts into laughter.

The batsman stands frozen at the crease, embarrassed and confused, staring at his empty hands.

Commentator: “He was trying to send the ball out of the stadium… but he’s sent the BAT out of the stadium!”

Replay immediately cuts in from multiple angles showing the bat flying farther than the ball.

The non-striker bends over laughing.

Crowd chants and cheers as the batsman awkwardly smiles and rubs the back of his neck.

Authentic live sports broadcast, realistic reactions, believable physics, meme-worthy cricket moment, accidental comedy, no slapstick, no cartoon behavior, looks like genuine viral IPL footage.

Live IPL television broadcast. Professional cricket coverage with realistic broadcast graphics, crowd noise, stadium atmosphere, commentator audio, multiple camera angles, and authentic sports production quality.

The bowler runs in and delivers a fast ball. The batsman attempts a massive six, swinging with full power. But at the moment of impact, he completely loses grip of the bat.

The cricket ball travels only a short distance.

Meanwhile, the bat launches high into the air like a missile, spinning dramatically over the boundary rope and disappearing into the crowd.

For a moment, nobody understands what happened.

The crowd gasps, then bursts into laughter.

The batsman stands frozen at the crease, embarrassed and confused, staring at his empty hands.

Commentator: “He was trying to send the ball out of the stadium… but he’s sent the BAT out of the stadium!”

Replay immediately cuts in from multiple angles showing the bat flying farther than the ball.

The non-striker bends over laughing.

Crowd chants and cheers as the batsman awkwardly smiles and rubs the back of his neck.

The boy happily walks through a sunlit street and spots a bright orange Fanta vending machine. Excited, he inserts his last coin, presses the button, and waits. The screen flashes “OUT OF STOCK.” His smile fades, shoulders drop, and he slowly walks away disappointed.

A large orange Fanta delivery truck enters the neighborhood. Suddenly a playful dog runs across the road. The driver brakes hard and swerves to avoid it. The rear cargo door bursts open and hundreds of orange soda cans explode onto the street, bouncing, spinning, and rolling everywhere in beautiful golden sunlight.

One unopened can breaks away from the chaos, rolling naturally through the neighborhood. The camera follows the can in a smooth cinematic tracking shot as it bounces over cracks, spins across the road, and gradually slows before stopping perfectly beside the boy’s sneaker.

The boy notices it, looks down in disbelief, picks it up, opens it with a loud PSHHH, and takes a refreshing sip. His face lights up with joy. 男孩愉快地走在阳光明媚的街道上，看到一台鲜橙色的Fanta自动售货机。兴奋地，他投下最后一枚硬币，按下按钮，等待。屏幕闪烁着“缺货”。他的笑容消失，肩膀垂下，慢慢失望地离开。

一辆大型橙色芬达送货卡车驶入社区。突然，一只爱玩的狗跑过马路。司机猛踩刹车并急转避开。后货舱门猛然打开，数百个橙色汽水罐在美丽的金色阳光下弹跳、旋转、滚动四处飞溅。

一罐未开封的罐子从混乱中脱离，自然地在社区中滚动。镜头以流畅的电影式跟踪镜头跟随罐子，它在裂缝上弹跳，旋转穿过马路，逐渐减速，最终完美停在男孩的运动鞋旁。

raw_p:
Gigantic futuristic city during sunset under dark storm clouds.
People suddenly begin staring upward as massive shadows move across the skyline.
Far above the city: an enormous metallic ring structure slowly descends from the clouds.
The ring is unimaginably large, wide enough to surround entire districts. Its rotating inner mechanisms glow with deep orange energy.
A man on a crowded rooftop watches in disbelief as the colossal structure lowers steadily around the city center.
The visible danger grows constantly: massive rotating machinery overhead, atmospheric shockwaves rippling through clouds, windows shattering from vibrations, emergency aircraft circling the structure, giant shadows sweeping across skyscrapers.
As the ring descends: its inner walls pass dangerously close between buildings.
Entire skyscrapers disappear into shadow beneath the rotating structure.
Crowds evacuate through packed highways while overhead: the colossal ring continues lowering toward street level.
The man runs through chaotic rooftops trying to escape the descending machinery.
The ring’s internal mechanisms spin faster: glowing energy arcs pulse between sections, debris floats upward from magnetic distortion, communication systems fail, giant holographic advertisements collapse into static.
At climax: the enormous ring surrounds the entire downtown core.
Its rotating inner surface fills the sky above the streets.
Then suddenly: the structure stops descending.
All movement ceases.
Silence.
The giant ring remains hovering motionless around the city while emergency lights flash below.
Ultra cinematic hard sci-fi thriller, gigantic scale visuals, environmental tension, realistic city panic, cinematic storm atmosphere, grounded futuristic realism.

zh.p:
巨大的未来城市，日落时分，乌云密布。
人们突然开始仰望天际线，巨大的阴影在天际线上移动。
在城市上方的遥远处：一个巨大的金属环形结构缓缓从云层中降落。
这个环形势不可想象地庞大，宽到足以包围整个区。其旋转的内部机械散发着深橙色的能量光芒。
一个坐在拥挤屋顶上的男人难以置信地看着这座庞然大物在市中心缓缓下降。
可见的危险不断增强：头顶巨大的旋转机械，云层中波浪，震动导致的窗户破碎，紧急飞机盘旋建筑，巨大的阴影扫过摩天大楼。
环形结构下降时：其内壁危险地穿过建筑间。
整座摩天大楼在旋转结构下的阴影中消失。
人群在拥挤的高速公路上方疏散：巨大的环形区域继续降低至街道水平。
那人穿梭于混乱的屋顶，试图逃离下落的机械。
环内部机制旋转加快：发光的能量弧脉冲穿过各段，碎片因磁场扭曲浮起，通信系统失效，巨大的全息广告崩塌成静电。
高潮时：巨大的环形环绕着整个市中心核心区。
其旋转的内层覆盖街道上方的天空。
然后突然：结构停止下降。
所有动作停止。
寂静。

en.p:
Gigantic futuristic city during sunset under dark storm clouds.
People suddenly begin staring upward as massive shadows move across the skyline.
Far above the city: an enormous metallic ring structure slowly descends from the clouds.
The ring is unimaginably large, wide enough to surround entire districts. Its rotating inner mechanisms glow with deep orange energy.
A man on a crowded rooftop watches in disbelief as the colossal structure lowers steadily around the city center.
The visible danger grows constantly: massive rotating machinery overhead, atmospheric shockwaves rippling through clouds, windows shattering from vibrations, emergency aircraft circling the structure, giant shadows sweeping across skyscrapers.
As the ring descends: its inner walls pass dangerously close between buildings.
Entire skyscrapers disappear into shadow beneath the rotating structure.
Crowds evacuate through packed highways while overhead: the colossal ring continues lowering toward street level.
The man runs through chaotic rooftops trying to escape the descending machinery.
The ring’s internal mechanisms spin faster: glowing energy arcs pulse between sections, debris floats upward from magnetic distortion, communication systems fail, giant holographic advertisements collapse into static.
At climax: the enormous ring surrounds the entire downtown core.
Its rotating inner surface fills the sky above the streets.
Then suddenly: the structure stops descending.
All movement ceases.
Silence.
The giant ring remains hovering motionless around the city while emergency lights flash below.
Ultra cinematic hard sci-fi thriller, gigantic scale visuals, environmental tension, realistic city panic, cinematic storm atmosphere, grounded futuristic realism.

15秒超高話題性霸總短劇，電影級敘事，豪華杜拜五星級飯店宴會廳，巨型水晶吊燈，紅毯舞台，史詩級戲劇配樂與強烈情緒起伏，專業電影運鏡，快速剪輯，淺景深，鏡頭呼吸感，超寫實人物表情，極具反差的幽默結尾。

0.0-0.8秒
空拍鏡頭高速俯衝進入豪華飯店會議廳，數百名賓客盛裝出席。舞台中央，英俊霸總身穿深藍色高級訂製西裝站在講台上演講。背後巨大LED螢幕顯示璀璨杜拜飯店夜景與巨大紅色英文字「Celebration」。史詩交響樂響起。

0.8-1.6秒
低角度英雄鏡頭環繞霸總。霸總自信演講，台下掌聲雷動，閃光燈不斷閃爍。

1.6-2.4秒
極近特寫。霸總突然皺眉，心跳聲急速放大。額頭開始冒汗。

2.4-3.2秒
鏡頭劇烈推近。呼吸變急促，耳鳴音效出現。

3.2-4.0秒
主觀視角。賓客們的臉逐漸模糊變形，畫面輕微旋轉暈眩。

4.0-4.8秒
霸總腳步踉蹌。慢動作。講稿從手中滑落。

4.8-5.6秒
身穿白色鑲鑽晚禮服的美麗女司儀立刻衝上舞台。高速跟拍鏡頭。

5.6-6.4秒
女司儀扶住即將昏倒的霸總。柔和逆光。女司儀微笑說：「你還好嗎？」

6.4-7.2秒
蒼白虛弱的霸總靠在女司儀肩上，小聲說：「我是不是心臟病發作了？」

7.2-8.0秒
女司儀神祕地向旁邊使了一個眼色。配樂突然停止。

8.0-8.8秒
一隻穿灰色道袍、手拿黃皮紙袋的橘貓從畫面外高速衝入，電影級滑軌跟拍。

8.8-9.6秒
橘貓猛然撐開黃皮紙袋，直接罩在霸總臉上。全場震驚。

9.6-10.4秒
橘貓雙手抓住紙袋，大聲喝斥：「快點給我慢慢深呼吸！」

10.4-11.2秒
霸總隔著紙袋慢慢呼吸。心跳聲逐漸恢復正常。畫面穩定下來。

11.2-12.0秒
霸總重新站上講台，精神飽滿。英雄式環繞鏡頭。

12.0-12.8秒
霸總深情看向女司儀，大聲宣布：「我要娶她當我的妻子！」

12.8-13.8秒
全場沸騰。橘貓、賓客們熱烈鼓掌歡呼。彩帶噴發。配樂進入最高潮。

13.8-15.0秒
特寫女司儀。她神祕轉身望向鏡頭，露出俏皮微笑，輕輕眨一下左眼。畫面定格。電影片尾音效。繁體中文字幕：「有時候，你只需要一個紙袋。」 超高反差喜劇收尾。

en.p:
A 15-second highly talked-about sex CEO short drama, cinematic narrative, luxurious banquet halls at a five-star Dubai hotel, giant crystal chandeliers, red carpet stage, epic dramatic soundtrack, and intense emotional ups and downs, professional cinematography, rapid editing, shallow depth of field, breathing through the camera, hyper-realistic character expressions, and a humorously contrasting ending.

0.0-0.8 seconds
Aerial cameras sped into the luxurious hotel conference hall, where hundreds of guests were dressed in their splendid attire. At center stage, the handsome CEO stood on the podium in a deep blue haute couture suit, giving his speech. A huge LED screen on the back displays a dazzling night view of Dubai Hotel and the huge red English word "Celebration." An epic symphony began.

0.8-1.6 seconds
Low-angle hero shots surrounding the CEO. The CEO spoke confidently, thundering applause from the audience, with flashing lights constantly flashing.

1.6-2.4 seconds
Extremely close-up. The CEO suddenly frowned, his heartbeat rapidly intensifying. Sweat began to form on his forehead.

2.4-3.2 seconds
The camera zoomed in fiercely. Breathing becomes rapid, tinnitus sounds appear.

3.2-4.0 seconds
Subjective perspective. The guests' faces gradually blurred and distorted, the image spinning slightly and blurring.

4.0-4.8 seconds
The CEO staggered. Slow motion. The manuscript slipped from his hand.

4.8-5.6 seconds
The beautiful female emcee, dressed in a white diamond-studded evening gown, immediately rushed onto the stage. High-speed tracking camera.

5.6-6.4 seconds
The female emcee supported the domineering CEO who was about to faint. Soft backlight. The female host smiled and said, "Are you okay?"

6.4-7.2 seconds
The pale, weak CEO leaned on the female emcee's shoulder and whispered, "Did I have a heart attack?"

7.2-8.0 seconds
The female emcee mysteriously gave a glance to the side. The music suddenly stopped.

8.0-8.8 seconds
An orange cat wearing a gray Taoist robe and holding a yellow paper bag dashed in at high speed from off-screen, followed by a movie-quality slide.

8.8-9.6 seconds
The orange cat suddenly opened a yellow paper bag and placed it directly on the CEO's face. The whole audience was shocked.

9.6-10.4 seconds
The orange cat grabbed the paper bag with both hands and shouted loudly, "Hurry up and take a slow, deep breath!"

10.4-11.2 seconds
The CEO breathed slowly through the paper bag. The heartbeat gradually returned to normal. The screen stabilized.

11.2-12.0 seconds
The CEO stood back on stage, full of energy. Heroic surround shots.

12.0-12.8 seconds
The CEO looked at the female emcee with deep affection and loudly declared, "I want to marry her and be my wife!"

12.8-13.8 seconds
The whole venue erupted. The orange cat and the guests applauded enthusiastically. The ribbons erupted. The soundtrack reaches its climax.

13.8-15.0 seconds
Close-up of the female emcee. She mysteriously turned to look at the camera, flashing a playful smile and gently blinking her left eye. The scene freezes. Movie ending sound effects. Traditional Chinese subtitle: "Sometimes, all you need is a paper bag." A dramatically contrasting comedy ending here.
