15-second ultra-cinematic fantasy transformation sequence atop a ruined cliff temple during sunrise.

A lone warrior stands at the edge of an ancient stone platform overlooking a sea of clouds. The first rays of sunlight break across the horizon while wind moves through torn banners and scattered ruins.

The camera slowly circles around the warrior as tiny golden embers begin appearing in the air. Warm light pulses beneath the skin like a second heartbeat awakening.

The embers multiply rapidly. Streams of living fire spiral around the warrior's body without causing harm. Golden-orange energy flows through glowing cracks beneath the skin.

The transformation begins. Fiery feather patterns emerge along the arms, shoulders, and face. Hair becomes strands of living flame moving gracefully in the wind.

The camera pushes closer as magnificent wings of fire start forming behind the warrior. Thousands of glowing feathers materialize from swirling embers and solar energy.

The transformation accelerates. The warrior rises slowly into the air while the surrounding ruins are illuminated by waves of radiant light. Burning feathers drift across the sky like glowing leaves.

At the climax, the body dissolves into a storm of fire feathers and solar particles. A colossal phoenix silhouette forms within the explosion of light.

The warrior is reborn as a Phoenix Avatar, surrounded by immense wings of living fire stretching across the horizon. Every wingbeat releases waves of glowing feathers into the clouds below.

Final cinematic moment: the Phoenix Avatar launches upward through the sunrise sky while a gigantic celestial phoenix made of flame briefly appears behind them, filling the heavens with golden light.

Style: ultra cinematic fantasy realism, divine phoenix transformation, living fire effects, feather particle simulation, sunrise atmosphere, mythological scale, celestial energy, dramatic aerial cinematography, AAA fantasy film quality, no text, no overlays.

Audio: epic cinematic fantasy score, celestial choir, soaring strings, powerful percussion, ember crackling, divine energy resonance, wind, and majestic phoenix calls.

zh.p:
日出时分，一座废弃悬崖神庙顶端的15秒超电影化奇幻变身序列。

一名孤独的战士站在古老的石台边缘，俯瞰着一片云海。第一缕阳光穿过地平线，风穿过破败的旗帜和散落的废墟。

镜头缓缓环绕战士，空中开始出现细小的金色余烬。温暖的光芒在皮肤下跳动，如同第二颗心跳觉醒。

余烬迅速蔓延。活火流围绕战士身体盘旋，却未造成伤害。金橙色的能量流经皮肤下发光的裂缝。

转变开始了。手臂、肩膀和脸部出现炽热的羽毛花纹。头发化作活生生的火焰，在风中优雅飘动。

镜头拉近，壮丽的火焰翅膀在战士身后开始形成。成千上万根发光羽毛从旋转的余烬和太阳能中显现出来。

转变加速。战士缓缓升空，周围的废墟被耀眼的光波照亮。燃烧的羽毛如发光的叶子飘过天空。

在高潮时，尸体化为一场火焰羽毛和太阳粒子的风暴。一只巨大的凤凰轮廓在光芒爆发中形成。

战士转世为凤凰化身，周围环绕着巨大的活火之翼，横跨地平线。每一次拍翼都会释放出一波波发光的羽毛，飞向下方的云层。

最后的电影时刻：凤凰化身冲破日出天空，身后短暂出现一只由火焰构成的巨大天凤，将天空染上金色光芒。

风格：超电影奇幻现实主义，神凤凰变身，活火效果，羽毛粒子模拟，日出大气，神话尺度，天体能量，戏剧性空中摄影，AAA级奇幻电影质量，无文字，无叠加。

音效：史诗级奇幻配乐、天体合唱、高亢的弦乐、强劲的打击乐、余烬噼啪声、神圣能量共鸣、风声和雄伟的凤凰鸣叫。

The world's first flying horse race unfolds high above the clouds among massive floating islands suspended in the sky. Thousands of spectators fill floating grandstands and airborne platforms, cheering as majestic winged horses line up at the starting gate. At the signal, the riders launch forward at incredible speed.

The camera becomes a high-speed FPV drone, flying directly behind the leading horse as it dives between towering floating cliffs and races through glowing cloud tunnels. Powerful wings beat through the air, scattering mist and sunlight. Rival riders perform breathtaking aerial maneuvers, barrel rolls, steep dives, and near-miss overtakes around ancient sky temples and giant floating waterfalls.

The race intensifies as the camera weaves between competitors at extreme speed, capturing dramatic close passes and turbulent air currents. Golden sunlight breaks through the clouds while the floating islands cast enormous shadows across the sky.

In the final seconds, two horses battle neck-and-neck above a sea of glowing clouds. The camera surges forward alongside them as they dive toward the finish line suspended between two colossal floating towers. A spectacular photo finish at sunset, golden skies, cinematic lens flares, cheering crowds, epic scale, ultra-realistic details, dynamic motion, volumetric clouds, seamless action, masterpiece fantasy cinematography.

zh.p: 世界上首场飞马大赛在云层之上、悬浮于空中的巨大岛屿间举行。成千上万的观众挤满了漂浮的看台和空中平台，为列队于起跑线的雄伟飞马欢呼雀跃。随着信号响起，骑手们以惊人的速度向前冲去。镜头化作高速FPV无人机，紧随领头马身后，记录着它在巍峨的漂浮悬崖间穿梭、在闪耀的云层隧道中疾驰的瞬间。强劲的翅膀拍打着空气，溅起阵阵雾气和阳光。竞争对手们在古老的空中神庙和巨大的漂浮瀑布周围，上演着令人叹为观止的空中特技、翻滚、俯冲和惊险的超车。随着镜头在参赛者之间高速穿梭，比赛愈发激烈，镜头捕捉到惊险的近距离交锋和湍急的气流。金色的阳光穿透云层，漂浮岛屿在天空中投下巨大的阴影。在最后的几秒钟，两匹飞马在闪耀的云海之上展开了殊死搏斗。镜头紧随其后，跟随他们奋力冲向悬于两座巨大浮塔之间的终点线。日落时分，金色的天空，电影般的镜头光晕，欢呼的人群，史诗般的规模，超逼真的细节，动感十足的运动，立体感十足的云层，流畅的动作，堪称奇幻电影摄影的杰作。

Keep the motion smooth and continuous with no cuts. Do not show guide lines, arrows, extra characters, broken broom parts, duplicate body parts, or any face reflections. raw_p:
Deep space cargo convoy: massive containers and industrial modules being transported when a single failure triggers a cascading chain reaction.  
Wide shot: convoy moving in formation, huge cargo blocks linked together. 
Failure point: one connector snaps, a container drifting slightly off-path. 
Immediate danger: another module clips it, sending both into slow but unstoppable rotation. 
Chain reaction: collisions spread across the convoy, each impact changing trajectories. 
Close tracking: a ship weaving through spinning cargo, gaps constantly closing. 
Near-crush: two massive containers slam together just behind the ship. 
Tight squeeze: pilot threads through a collapsing corridor of shifting metal blocks. 
Momentum shift: a giant module starts drifting directly into the escape path. 
Last-second dive: ship drops under it, barely clearing the edge. 
Final moment: debris field expanding, everything still moving, no stable space left.  
Heavy, readable motion, physical weight, constant “closing gaps” tension.

zh.p:
深空货运车队：当一次故障引发连锁反应时，正在运输巨大的集装箱和工业模块。 
广角镜头：车队以编队行进，巨大的货舱相连。
故障点：一个连接器断裂，容器稍微偏离路径。
紧急危险：另一个模块撞击了它，使两者进入缓慢但无法阻挡的旋转状态。
连锁反应：碰撞扩散到车队各处，每次撞击都改变了轨迹。
紧密追踪：一艘飞船穿梭于旋转的货物中，缝隙不断缩小。
近乎压碎：两个巨大的集装箱在船后面猛地撞在一起。
狭窄的挤压：飞行员穿过一条由移动金属块组成的坍塌走廊。
动量转移：一个巨大的模块开始直接漂入逃生路径。
最后一刻俯冲：飞船掉到船下，几乎没越过边缘。
最后时刻：碎片场扩展，一切仍在移动，已无稳定空间。 
沉重、清晰的动作、物理重量、持续的“缝隙缩小”张力。

en.p:
Deep space cargo convoy: massive containers and industrial modules being transported when a single failure triggers a cascading chain reaction.  
Wide shot: convoy moving in formation, huge cargo blocks linked together. 
Failure point: one connector snaps, a container drifting slightly off-path. 
Immediate danger: another module clips it, sending both into slow but unstoppable rotation. 
Chain reaction: collisions spread across the convoy, each impact changing trajectories. 
Close tracking: a ship weaving through spinning cargo, gaps constantly closing. 
Near-crush: two massive containers slam together just behind the ship. 
Tight squeeze: pilot threads through a collapsing corridor of shifting metal blocks. 
Momentum shift: a giant module starts drifting directly into the escape path. 
Last-second dive: ship drops under it, barely clearing the edge. 
Final moment: debris field expanding, everything still moving, no stable space left.  
Heavy, readable motion, physical weight, constant “closing gaps” tension.

raw_p:
SCENE: A surreal confectionery topography. Undulating hills composed of high-viscosity pink strawberry buttercream frosting with realistic subsurface scattering (0.4cm mean free path), bisected by a slow-moving river of molten golden caramel with a refractive index of 1.43. Giant semi-buried chocolate-chip cookies with cracked, matte-textured surfaces are embedded in granular crystalline sucrose sands.

SUBJECT: A juvenile ginger tabby cat. Fur is modeled with individual hair-strand physics featuring anisotropic specular reflection. Wearing a miniature 12oz indigo denim trucker cap with distinct orange double-needle chain-stitching and a pair of distressed lambskin leather driving gloves with functional brass snap closures. Eyes show distinct amber irises, radial pupillary contraction, and a wet corneal reflection of the environment.

ACTION: The subject operates a vintage 1950s green-and-yellow farm tractor. The oversized, deep-tread rubber tires rotate at 120 RPM, creating mechanical shear displacement against a cohesive substrate of moist, crumbly chocolate-brownie soil. This action ejects high-velocity particulate ejecta: cohesive dollops of viscoelastic whipped cream and granular cake crumbs. The vertical steel exhaust stack emits periodic puffs of carbon-soot particulate matter, which instantly nucleate and wrap around suspended micro-particles of dry powdered sugar in a helical vortex.

CAMERA: Dynamic low-angle tracking camera mounted on a 3-axis gyro-stabilized gimbal, running parallel to the left rear tire at a 15-degree offset. Filmed on a Panavision Panaflex Millennium XL2 with C-Series Anamorphic Prime Lenses (35mm, T1.8), creating characteristic horizontal blue flare, oval bokeh, and a razor-thin 5cm depth-of-field focused on the cat's lateral eye profile. Organic high-frequency vibration artifacts match the 15Hz diesel engine oscillation.

RENDER: Photoreal spectral ray-tracing. Volumetric participating media simulating a warm, humid atmosphere suspended with crystalline sugar dust using Mie scattering. Multi-phase fluid simulation tracking the viscous caramel splash mechanics with surface-tension adhesion to the metal chassis. Color grading mapped to a Kodak Vision3 500T 5219 profile, emphasizing deep warm undertones and rich, saturated earth tones.

MODEL OPTIMIZATION: Configured for Seedance 2's advanced physics solver. The prompt details boundary interactions between three distinct material phases (viscoelastic whipped cream, granular brownie soil, and rigid rubber tires) alongside high-frequency mechanical vibration to lock spatial coherence across sequential frames.

场景：超现实的糖果地形。起伏的丘陵由高粘度的粉色草莓奶油霜组成，具有逼真的地下散射（平均自由程0.4厘米），被一条缓慢流动的熔金焦糖河流穿过，折射率为1.43。巨大的半埋入土的巧克力碎片饼干，表面裂开哑光质地，嵌入颗粒状的结晶蔗糖砂中。

主题：一只幼年姜斑虎斑猫。毛发采用单根发丝物理建模，具有各向异性镜面反射。戴着一顶迷你12盎司靛蓝牛仔卡车司机帽，配有明显的橙色双针链条缝线，以及一双做旧的羊皮驾驶手套，手套上有实用的黄铜扣扣。眼睛呈现明显的琥珀色虹膜、桡状瞳孔收缩，以及湿润的角膜反射环境。

动作场面：主角操作着一辆1950年代的老式绿黄相间农用拖拉机。超大尺寸、深花纹橡胶轮胎以120转/分钟旋转，在湿润、易碎的巧克力布朗尼土壤中产生机械剪切排量。这种作用会喷出高速颗粒物：粘弹性鲜奶油和颗粒状蛋糕屑。垂直钢制排气管周期性喷出碳烟尘颗粒，瞬间成核并包裹悬浮的干糖粉微粒，形成螺旋漩涡。

摄像头：动态低角度跟踪摄像头，安装在三轴陀螺稳定万向节上，平行于左后轮，偏移15度。使用Panavision的Panaflex Millennium XL2镜头拍摄，使用C系列变形宽镜头（35mm，T1.8），创造出标志性的水平蓝色光晕、椭圆形散景，以及聚焦于猫侧眼轮廓的极薄5厘米景深。有机高频振动伪影与15Hz柴油机振荡相匹配。

渲染：光谱光线追踪。体积参与介质模拟以结晶糖尘悬浮的温暖潮湿大气，利用米氏散射技术。多相流体仿真，跟踪粘稠焦糖溅溅力学，并通过表面张力附着力与金属底盘进行结合。色彩分级映射到柯达Vision3 500T 5219档案，强调深暖底色和丰富饱和的土色调。

模型优化：已配置为Seedance 2的高级物理求解器。提示详细介绍了三种不同材料相（粘弹性奶油、颗粒布朗尼土和刚性橡胶轮胎）之间的边界相互作用，同时结合高频机械振动，以锁定连续帧间的空间相干性。

raw_p:
参照画像のキャラクターを主人公として使用。15秒、横16:9、24fps。日本のフルカラーアニメ。劇場版アニメのような高品質な作画。作画枚数多め。幻想的でド派手な変身シーン。主人公は参照画像のキャラクター本人。参照画像に写っている髪型、髪色、瞳、顔立ち、体格、年齢感、衣装の印象、アクセサリー、全体の雰囲気を維持する。この映像では、参照画像のキャラクターが「人間界へ行くために姿を変える」。変身後は、参照画像のキャラクター性を残したまま、人間界に自然に溶け込める学生服・制服風の姿へ変化する。変身前と変身後は同一人物。顔、髪型、髪色、瞳の印象、身長、頭身、体格、年齢感は変えない。変化するのは衣装、装飾、周囲のエフェクト、空気感のみ。

映像コンセプト：参照画像のキャラクターが、異世界的な空間から人間界へ向かうために変身する。キャラクターの周囲に浮かぶ象徴的なモチーフ、装飾、光、線、図形が、After Effectsで制作したような2Dフラットアニメーションとして動き出す。変身前の衣装や装飾が、円、三角、四角、星、リング、リボン状ライン、ハーフトーンドット、光の軌跡などへ分解される。分解された図形が、キャラクターの身体の周囲を高速で回転し、最終的に人間界用の制服姿へ再構成される。身体そのものは分解しない。衣装と装飾だけが、2D図形へ変化して再構成される。

カメラワーク方針：カメラは常に大きく動き、変身の勢いを強調する。使用するカメラワークは、極端な瞳のクローズアップ、アクセサリーや衣装装飾のマクロショット、足元から顔まで駆け上がる高速カメラ、主人公を中心にした高速360度オービット、真上からの急降下、ローアングルからの急上昇、主人公の横を高速ですり抜けるカメラ、変身後に一気に引いて全身を見せるカメラ。高速移動時は強いモーションブラーを使用する。顔、瞳、衣装、決めポーズを見せる瞬間だけ、カメラを短く止めて鮮明に見せる。

0.0〜1.5秒：参照画像のキャラクターの瞳を画面いっぱいに映す。瞳の中に、キャラクターを象徴する色、模様、光、図形が反射している。瞳が一瞬強く輝き、瞳の奥から円形リングと細い光のラインが広がる。カメラはそのリングの中心へ一気に飛び込む。

1.5〜3.5秒：リングの内部を抜けると、異世界の中央に立つ主人公が現れる。カメラは主人公の正面から急加速し、主人公の周囲を高速で360度回転する。回転中、参照画像のキャラクターに合ったモチーフが画面手前を高速で通過する。例：星、花、リボン、宝石、羽、幾何学模様、光の粒、アクセサリー状の図形など。主人公は中央に立ち、変身前の姿のまま静かに目を閉じている。360度回転の終盤、カメラは胸元やアクセサリーなど、参照画像で印象的な部分へ急接近する。

3.5〜5.5秒：0.3秒から0.5秒程度の高速な部分クローズアップを連続して見せる。瞳が開くクローズアップ。髪が揺れるクローズアップ。アクセサリーが光るマクロショット。衣装の装飾が浮かび上がるクローズアップ。指先に光が集まるクローズアップ。靴や足元へ図形が集まるクローズアップ。各ショットの切り替えには、円形リング、色面、リボン状ライン、星形、参照画像のモチーフを使ったスイッシュトランジションを使用する。

5.5〜8.0秒：カメラは主人公の足元から開始し、螺旋状に主人公の周囲を回りながら顔まで急上昇する。カメラが上昇するのと同時に、変身前の衣装や装飾が身体から浮かび上がる。浮かび上がった衣装の一部、飾り、布、金属、リボン、宝石、モチーフが、平面的な円、三角、四角、リング、星、リボン状ラインへ変化する。図形は主人公の身体の周囲を螺旋状に回転する。主人公の顔、身体、髪型、体格は変形させない。分解されるのは衣装と装飾のみ。

8.0〜10.5秒：カメラは主人公の真上へ一気に移動し、トップショットになる。主人公を中心として、円、三角、四角、星、リング、リボン状ラインが巨大な魔法陣のような円形構図を作る。図形が一斉に主人公へ集まり、人間界用の制服姿へ再構成される。上半身には清潔感のあるシャツやカーディガンが形成される。胸元にはリボンやネクタイが整う。下半身にはプリーツスカート、または参照画像の雰囲気に合った学生服の下衣が形成される。足元にはローファーや制服に合う靴が形成される。必要に応じてスクールバッグや小さなチャームが追加される。制服の色や小物は、参照画像のキャラクターの配色や雰囲気と調和させる。カメラは真上から主人公の顔へ急降下し、変身後の瞳を鮮明に映す。

10.5〜12.5秒：カメラは主人公の瞳から一気に後退する。顔、上半身、制服、全身を連続して見せる。主人公の全身が見えた瞬間、カメラは地面すれすれのローアングルへ急降下する。ローアングルのまま、主人公の周囲を高速で約270度回り込む。回転中、制服のリボン、スカート、靴、バッグ、髪飾りなどを近距離で順番に見せる。最後に、変身前の象徴的なモチーフが小さなチャームや髪飾りへ変化し、主人公の人間界での姿に自然に残る。

12.5〜15.0秒：主人公の背後に、人間界へ続く巨大な光の入口が開く。入口の向こうには、明るい学校の廊下、校庭、通学路など、人間界の学園風景が見える。カメラは主人公の背後から急接近し、主人公と一緒に入口へ突入する。円形リング、リボン状ライン、星、ハーフトーンドット、参照画像由来のモチーフが画面手前を高速で流れる。12.8秒付近で入口を抜け、人間界の学校空間へ切り替わる。ここから約2秒間、変身後の制服姿をしっかり見せる。カメラは主人公の横を高速ですり抜けたあと、急旋回して正面へ回り込み、主人公の全身を映す。制服姿の主人公は、参照画像の雰囲気を残したまま、人間界に自然に溶け込む学生服姿。髪型、髪色、瞳、顔立ち、体格、年齢感は変身前と同じ。衣装だけが制服風に変わっている。

13.2〜14.2秒、カメラは全身から上半身へゆっくり寄る。主人公の制服、リボンまたはネクタイ、スカート、ズボン、靴、バッグ、髪飾り等を短く見せる。変身前の象徴的なモチーフは、小さなチャームや髪飾りとして自然に残っている。周囲には、円、星、リボン状ライン、ハーフトーンドットが控えめに漂い、変身完了の余韻を作る。

14.2〜15.0秒、カメラが主人公のバストショットまで寄る。主人公が静かにこちらを見て、少し微笑む。瞳の中に、変身前の象徴的なモチーフが一瞬だけ浮かぶ。最後に主人公が片目を閉じて軽くウィンクする。ウィンクの瞬間、目元から小さな四芒星、リング、リボン状ラインが弾ける。エフェクトは可愛くポップな2Dフラットアニメーション。主人公の笑顔とウィンクを鮮明に見せて終了する。

AE風2Dアニメーションの演出：2Dフラットエフェクトは、カメラワークと連動させる。リングの中心をカメラが通過する。リボン状ラインがカメラの移動経路を描く。円、三角、四角、星、ハーフトーンドットが螺旋状に流れる。衣装の分解時には、装飾が平面的な図形へ変化する。

12.5〜15.0秒：主人公の背後に、人間界へ続く巨大な光の入口が開く。入口の向こうには、明るい学校の廊下、校庭、通学路など、人間界の学園風景が見える。カメラは主人公の背後から急接近し、主人公と一緒に入口へ突入する。円形リング、リボン状ライン、星、ハーフトーンドット、参照画像由来のモチーフが画面手前を高速で流れる。12.8秒付近で入口を抜け、人間界の学校空間へ切り替わる。ここから約2秒間、変身後の制服姿をしっかり見せる。カメラは主人公の横を高速ですり抜けたあと、急旋回して正面へ回り込み、主人公の全身を映す。制服姿の主人公は、参照画像の雰囲気を残したまま、人間界に自然に溶け込む学生服姿。髪型、髪色、瞳、顔立ち、体格、年齢感は変身前と同じ。衣装だけが制服風に変わっている。

13.2〜14.2秒、カメラは全身から上半身へゆっくり寄る。主人公の制服、リボンまたはネクタイ、スカート、ズボン、靴、バッグ、髪飾り等を短く見せる。変身前の象徴的なモチーフは、小さなチャームや髪飾りとして自然に残っている。周囲には、円、星、リボン状ライン、ハーフトーンドットが控えめに漂い、変身完了の余韻を作る。

14.2〜15.0秒、カメラが主人公のバストショットまで寄る。主人公が静かにこちらを見て、少し微笑む。瞳の中に、変身前の象徴的なモチーフが一瞬だけ浮かぶ。最後に主人公が片目を閉じて軽くウィンクする。ウィンクの瞬間、目元から小さな四芒星、リング、リボン状ラインが弾ける。エフェクトは可愛くポップな2Dフラットアニメーション。主人公の笑顔とウィンクを鮮明に見せて終了する。

raw_p: The camera is already racing across the back of a colossal biomechanical titan walking through an alien ocean. Its body is the size of a city, covered in forests, rivers, glowing machinery, and moving architecture. Two flight craft skim along its shoulders and spine as the giant creature strides through clouds and water, each footstep sending kilometer-wide waves across the sea below. The chase weaves through moving structures embedded in the creature's body, across rotating mechanical joints, and through gaps between enormous armored plates. Midway, the camera passes through a transparent observation chamber built into the titan's neck where a lone observer watches the world slide by beneath them. The final ascent follows the craft up the creature's towering head before revealing dozens of other giants emerging from the ocean across the horizon.

zh.p: 镜头已经在一台巨大的生物机械泰坦背后飞驰，它正穿越外星海洋。它的身体大小如一座城市，覆盖着森林、河流、发光的机械和移动的建筑。两架飞行器沿着它的肩膀和脊柱掠过，巨兽穿行于云层与水面之间，每一步都在海面掀起数公里宽的巨浪。追逐穿梭于生物体内嵌入的移动结构、旋转的机械关节以及巨大的装甲板之间的缝隙。中途，镜头穿过内置于巨人颈部的透明观察室，一名孤独的观察者注视着世界在他们脚下滑过。最后的攀登轨迹是飞船沿着那生物高耸的头顶攀升，随后露出数十个巨人从地平线对面的海洋中出现。

en.p: The camera is already racing across the back of a colossal biomechanical titan walking through an alien ocean. Its body is the size of a city, covered in forests, rivers, glowing machinery, and moving architecture. Two flight craft skim along its shoulders and spine as the giant creature strides through clouds and water, each footstep sending kilometer-wide waves across the sea below. The chase weaves through moving structures embedded in the creature's body, across rotating mechanical joints, and through gaps between enormous armored plates. Midway, the camera passes through a transparent observation chamber built into the titan's neck where a lone observer watches the world slide by beneath them. The final ascent follows the craft up the creature's towering head before revealing dozens of other giants emerging from the ocean across the horizon.

Create an ultra-realistic Japanese high school classroom scene during warm afternoon golden hour. The classroom contains wooden desks, chairs, school bags, books, notebooks, posters, a chalkboard, fluorescent ceiling lights, curtains, sliding windows, and realistic school details. Warm sunlight streams through the windows, creating natural shadows and visible dust particles.

0s–3s

The school girl sits alone at her desk studying. The three male students surround her desk, teasing her and making her uncomfortable. The camera slowly pushes toward her worried expression. Warm sunlight fills the classroom.

3s–5s

The male hero notices the situation and walks toward them. He calmly tells the boys to stop bothering her. The boys laugh at him. One suddenly kicks him. The camera whips dramatically with the impact.

5s–12s

An intense one-take martial arts sequence begins. The hero fights all three boys at once using realistic choreography. He dodges attacks between desks, vaults over tables, slides across tabletops, blocks strikes with school bags, redirects attackers into desks, and lands powerful combinations. Chairs move, papers fly, desks slide, and curtains react naturally. The camera constantly follows, circles, ducks, and moves through the classroom while staying close to the action.

12s–15s

Epic cinematic slow-motion finale. The hero lands a decisive final strike. The three attackers are knocked backward in dramatic slow motion. Papers float through golden sunlight. The camera circles around the hero standing protectively in front of the girl while the defeated boys fall behind him. Powerful cinematic ending.

Style: ultra-realistic live action, Japanese school drama, high-budget action film, realistic body physics, authentic martial arts choreography, natural lighting, grounded textures, immersive handheld cinematography, movie-quality visuals, one-take camera feel, 8K detail.

在温暖的下午黄金时段，打造超逼真的日本高中教室场景。教室内有木质课桌、椅子、书包、书籍、笔记本、海报、黑板、荧光天花板灯、窗帘、推拉窗和逼真的学校细节。温暖的阳光透过窗户洒进来，营造出自然的阴影和可见的尘埃颗粒。

0至3秒

女学生独自坐在课桌前学习。三个男学生围着她的讲桌，逗弄她，让她感到不自在。镜头缓缓移向她担忧的表情。温暖的阳光洒满教室。

3分至5分

男英雄注意到情况，走向他们。他平静地告诉男孩们别再打扰她了。男孩们嘲笑他。突然有人踢了他一脚。镜头随着冲击剧烈旋转。

5至12岁

一段紧张的一镜到底的武术序列开始了。英雄同时与三个男孩战斗，采用写实的编舞。他能在桌子间躲避攻击，翻越桌子，滑过桌面，用书包挡住攻击，将攻击者引导到桌子上，并施展强力连招。椅子移动，纸张飞散，课桌滑动，窗帘自然反应。摄像机不断跟随、绕圈、低头和穿梭于教室，同时紧贴动作现场。

12岁至15岁

史诗级慢动作结局。英雄给予决定性最后一击。三名攻击者被戏剧性的慢动作击退。纸张在金色阳光中漂浮。镜头围绕着站在女孩面前保护性的英雄展开，而被击败的男孩们则倒在他身后。强有力的电影结局。

风格：超写实真人、日本校园剧、高预算动作片、逼真的身体物理、正宗武术编排、自然光线、贴地贴图、沉浸式手持摄影、电影级视觉、一镜到底、8K细节。

负面提示：不同的面孔、身份更改、脸部互换、额外角色、卡通、动漫风格、CGI风格、虚幻引擎外观、光泽的AI表面、畸形解剖、重复肢体、薄弱的编舞、糟糕的连贯性、塑料皮肤、不真实的物理效果、色彩过饱和、过多的视觉特效、模糊的面部、低细节。

16:9 horizontal split-screen Omegle-style PC screen recording. Black background, white center divider, semi-transparent "Omegle dot com" watermark bottom-left, faint "You're now chatting with a stranger" text at top.
LEFT — South Asian male, mid-20s, plain t-shirt, clean room, warm side lighting, 4K webcam, visible pores, no beauty filter, slight off-center frame. Calmly asks "Say anything random." Slowly closes fist, 1-2 second pause, opens hand flat — white ping pong ball appears in palm. Small confident smirk. No VFX, no flash, no glow.
RIGHT — Adult female, 20s, low-bitrate phone camera, overexposed window light, compression artifacts, shaky handheld, messy bedroom background, audio crackle. Says "Ping pong ball." Watches the reveal — leans in, eyes widen, short disbelieving laugh, covers mouth briefly, says "Wait, what?" or "No way, how?" Grounded, instinctive reaction. Not theatrical.
Feel: Screen-recording compression noise, 1-2 frame call lag at reveal, autofocus drift on stranger's side, ambient room noise only, optional bold white caption after reveal. 12-15 seconds total. Cold open → question → response → fist closes → pause → reveal → reaction → hard cut.
Negative: No AI skin, no plastic faces, no VFX glow, no warped fingers, no over-acting, no studio lighting, no beauty filter, no cinematic grading, no floating ball pre-reveal, no extra fingers.

zh.p:
16：9横向分屏Omegle风格的PC屏幕录制。黑色背景，白色中心分隔线，半透明的“Omegle dot com”水印位于左下角，顶部隐约有“你现在正在与陌生人聊天”的文字。
左——南亚男性，二十多岁，素色T恤，干净的房间，侧面灯光温暖，4K摄像头，毛孔明显，无美妆滤镜，画面略微偏离中心。平静地问：“随便说点什么。”慢慢握紧拳头，停顿1-2秒，手掌平放——白乒乓球出现在掌心。自信的小笑容。没有视觉特效，没有闪光，没有光晕。
右侧——成年女性，20多岁，低码率手机摄像头，过曝窗户灯光，压缩伪影，手持设备抖动，卧室背景凌乱，音频爆裂声。上面写着“乒乓球”。看着揭晓——俯身，眼睛睁大，短促的难以置信笑，短暂捂住嘴，说：“等等，什么？”或者“不可能，怎么可能？”接地气，本能的反应。不是戏剧化的。
感觉：屏幕录制压缩噪声，揭示时1-2帧通话延迟，陌生人侧自动对焦漂移，仅有环境房间噪点，揭示后可选粗白字幕。总共12到15秒。冷开场问→→回答→拳头合上→停顿→揭示→反应→硬剪辑。
缺点：没有AI皮肤，没有塑料脸，没有视觉特效光晕，没有扭曲的手指，没有过度表演，没有影棚灯光，没有美妆滤镜，没有电影级调色，没有漂浮球的预揭示，没有额外的手指。

The room is quiet.

Suddenly the TV flickers.

Small glitches.

Static.

The television abruptly powers on by itself.

Full-screen static.

The woman steps back.

Silence.

15-second ultra-cinematic anime fantasy transformation sequence beneath an enormous cherry blossom tree during golden sunset.

A young woman stands alone beneath the ancient tree as thousands of cherry blossoms drift through warm evening light. The air is calm and filled with glowing pollen particles.

The camera slowly circles around her while soft wind moves her hair and clothing. Pink petals begin gathering around her feet and spiraling upward in delicate currents.

A faint rosy glow appears beneath her skin. Tiny blossom patterns spread across her arms and neck like living floral veins. The transformation is beautiful and peaceful rather than painful.

The camera moves closer as petals begin replacing parts of her body. Fingers dissolve into floating blossoms. Strands of hair transform into streams of petals carried by the wind.

The transformation accelerates. Cherry blossom branches briefly emerge around her silhouette while glowing pollen fills the air. Every movement leaves trails of petals behind her.

The surrounding environment responds to her awakening. Trees bloom instantly, flowers open across the landscape, and warm golden light intensifies through the drifting blossoms.

The woman rises slightly above the ground as her body becomes increasingly ethereal. Her dress flows into living petals while translucent floral energy surrounds her.

At the climax, her entire form dissolves into a magnificent vortex of thousands of glowing cherry blossoms spiraling toward the sky.

Final cinematic moment: the petals gather again above the tree and briefly form the silhouette of a radiant blossom spirit before dispersing across the sunset horizon.

Style: ultra cinematic anime fantasy, emotional transformation, cherry blossom magic, warm sunset lighting, floating petals, dreamlike atmosphere, soft wind simulation, magical realism, highly detailed anime film quality, no text, no overlays.

Audio: emotional anime orchestral soundtrack, soft piano, gentle strings, wind through blossoms, drifting petals, magical chimes, warm atmospheric ambience.

zh.p:
15秒超电影感的动漫奇幻变身场景，在金色夕阳下巨大的樱花树下。

一位年轻女子独自站在古老的树下，成千上万的樱花在温暖的傍晚光线中飘动。空气平静，充满了发光的花粉颗粒。

镜头缓缓环绕着她，柔和的风吹动她的头发和衣物。粉色花瓣开始在她脚边聚集，盘旋上升，形成细腻的水流。

皮肤下浮现出淡淡的玫瑰色光芒。细小的花朵花纹在她的手臂和脖子上蔓延，宛如活生生的花脉。这种转变是美丽而宁静的，而不是痛苦。

镜头逐渐靠近，花瓣开始取代她身体的部分。手指化作漂浮的花朵。头发变成了随风飘扬的花瓣流。

转变加速。樱花枝短暂地在她的身影周围绽放，空气中弥漫着发光的花粉。每一个动作都在她身后留下花瓣的痕迹。

周围环境对她的觉醒做出反应。树木瞬间绽放，花朵绽放，温暖的金色光线通过飘落的花朵愈发强烈。

女子微微升起，身体变得越来越虚无缥缈。她的裙子如同活生生的花瓣般飘落，半透明的花香气环绕着她。

在高潮时，她的整个身形化为成千上万朵发光樱花旋转向天空的壮丽漩涡。

最后的电影时刻：花瓣再次聚集在树上，短暂形成一个光辉的花灵剪影，随后散落在夕阳地平线上。

风格：超电影感的动漫奇幻，情感转变，樱花魔法，温暖的夕阳光影，飘动的花瓣，梦幻般的氛围，柔和的风的模拟，魔幻现实主义，高度细致的动漫电影质量，无文字，无叠加。

音效：情感动漫管弦乐配乐，柔和的钢琴，轻柔的弦乐，花间的风声，飘落的花瓣，神奇的钟声，温暖的氛围氛围。

描述：一位美丽的20岁韩国女性，拥有一头长而柔顺的黑发、富有表现力的棕色眼睛、无瑕的逼真皮肤和精致的面部特征，独自一人坐在一间现代公寓里，夜晚用一台大型平板电视观看动漫。突然，一个动漫角色转向屏幕，似乎与她对视。她僵住了，既困惑又好奇，面对这不可能的时刻。

镜头：缓慢的电影轨道围绕着女性，最后是她眼睛的极近特写，映照着动漫角色。

灯光：柔和的电视光，温暖的环境光，逼真的阴影和反射。

第二场（5-9秒）：邀请

描述：动漫角色从电视里慢慢伸出手。屏幕开始闪烁着魔法能量，闪烁的光线裂开。那女人站起身，小心翼翼地走向电视，完全被吸引住了。

镜头：顺滑地转向电视，交替切换着发光的手和女人着迷的表情。

运动：漂浮的魔法粒子，微妙的房间扭曲，闪烁的能量效果。

场景3（9-12秒）：穿越世界

描述：女子伸手触摸那只发光的手。瞬间，一道强大的魔法光芒充满了整个房间。现实破碎成发光的碎片，她化为光流，穿越令人屏息的维度隧道。

镜头：手部接触的戏剧性特写，随后是快速的FPV飞行，穿越旋转的光与魔法隧道。

视觉效果：能量爆炸、电影般的运动模糊、维度扭曲效果、闪烁的光轨。

场景4（12-15秒）：幻想王国

描述：这位20岁的韩国女子身着优雅的冒险者服饰，披着飘逸的披风，附带魔法饰品，腰间佩戴一把装饰性剑，来到一个壮丽的奇幻王国。漂浮的岛屿漂浮在天空中，巨大的发光树木照亮了大地，远处耸立着一座雄伟的魔法城堡。她慢慢转身，震惊、惊奇和兴奋交织，意识到自己已经进入了动漫世界。

镜头：史诗级的空中无人机从云层降落，环绕奇幻景观，最后以她惊叹的表情特写收尾。

Camera: Epic aerial drone reveal descending from the clouds, sweeping around the fantasy landscape before ending on a cinematic close-up of her amazed face.

raw_p:
Create a 15-second wide cinematic landscape video intro, 16:9, using Seedance 2.0 style motion. A seamless one-take digital paper collage animation inspired by classic 1950s–1960s illustrated Japan travel books, especially the charming mood of mid-century Japanese tourism posters, vintage picture books, and editorial travel illustrations, but do not copy any exact existing artwork or page.

The video combines realistic photographic magazine cutouts of Japan with hand-drawn paper illustration elements. Use stop-motion cutout animation, torn paper edges, visible paper grain, offset print texture, halftone dots, gouache color patches, pastel pencil marks, imperfect handmade shapes, and layered collage depth. The mood is nostalgic, elegant, warm, refined, optimistic, and distinctly Japanese. Keep generous off-white negative space throughout, like a sophisticated vintage travel postcard coming alive.

The camera moves continuously in one smooth tracking shot, like an animated pop-up book. Paper layers slide, fold, flip, rotate, and snap into place with rhythmic motion. Use dynamic parallax between photo cutouts and illustrated paper shapes. Fast-paced but never chaotic. Premium After Effects-style paper collage motion graphics, tactile and handmade, not glossy.

Timeline flow:

From 0 to 4 seconds, begin on a warm off-white paper background. A realistic photographic cutout of Mount Fuji emerges from the bottom of the frame. Layered paper clouds drift gently across the scene. A stylized red torii gate pops up like a vintage travel-book illustration, painted with loose gouache strokes and pastel textures. Small paper cherry blossoms, koi fish motifs, folding fans, and tiny expressive travelers appear with stop-motion snaps. Traditional rooftops unfold in the background like paper accordion structures.

From 4 to 8 seconds, the camera tracks smoothly across a Kyoto-inspired streetscape. Wooden machiya buildings are constructed from layered paper strips, combining illustrated linework with photographic architectural fragments. Decorative lantern shapes, bicycles, tea cups, and paper umbrellas briefly animate into view before sliding away. The composition remains airy with large areas of elegant off-white paper. In the distance, layered pagodas and temple silhouettes rise from textured paper cutouts.

From 8 to 12 seconds, transition seamlessly into a stylized Tokyo cityscape made from layered photographic building clippings and hand-painted paper rectangles. The city feels vibrant but translated into soft printed color blocks rather than realistic neon. A simplified Tokyo Tower rises from the center like a pop-up book structure, built from cream, vermilion red, muted navy, mustard yellow, warm gray, and soft teal paper layers. Tiny illustrated figures look upward in wonder. All signs, screens, and billboards remain abstract and completely unreadable, with no real brands, logos

zh.p:
使用Seedance 2.0风格的运动，制作一个15秒宽的电影景观视频开场，16：9。这是一部无缝的一镜到底数字纸拼贴动画，灵感来自1950至1960年代经典的日本插画旅游书籍，尤其是中世纪日本旅游海报、复古图画书和编辑旅行插画的迷人氛围，但并未完全复制任何现有的艺术作品或页面。

视频结合了日本逼真的摄影杂志剪影与手绘纸张插图元素。使用定格动画剪纸动画、撕裂的纸张边缘、可见的纸质纹理、胶印纹理、半色调点、水粉色块、粉彩色笔痕、不完美的手工形状以及层叠拼贴深度。氛围怀旧、优雅、温暖、精致、乐观，且极具日本特色。保持宽松的米白色负空间，就像一张精致的复古旅行明信片活灵活现。

镜头连续移动，像动画立体书一样流畅地跟拍。纸张层通过有节奏的运动滑动、折叠、翻转、旋转并卡入原位。在照片剪纸和插画纸张形状之间使用动态视差。节奏快但从不混乱。高端After Effects风格的纸质拼贴动态图形，触感和手工制作，而非光面。

时间线流程：

从0到4秒，从温暖的米白色纸张背景开始。画面底部出现了一块逼真的富士山照片剪影。层叠的纸云轻轻飘过场景。一个风格化的红色鸟居像复古旅行书插画一样出现，用松散的水粉笔触和柔和的质感绘制。小纸樱花、锦鲤图案、折叠扇子和富有表情的小型旅行者通过定格动画呈现。传统屋顶在背景中展开，宛如纸质手风琴结构。

镜头在4到8秒之间流畅地穿梭于京都风格的街景。木质町屋建筑由层叠的纸条构成，结合插图线条与摄影建筑碎片。装饰性的灯笼形状、自行车、茶杯和纸伞短暂地出现，随后滑开。画面整体通透，大面积优雅的米白色纸张。远处，层叠的宝塔和寺庙轮廓从有纹理的纸张剪影中升起。

8秒到12秒间无缝过渡到由层叠照片建筑剪辑和手绘纸质矩形构成的风格化东京城市景观。城市感觉生机勃勃，但更多是用柔和的彩色印刷色块呈现，而非逼真的霓虹灯。一座简化的东京铁塔从中心耸立，宛如立体书结构，由奶油色、朱红、柔和的藏青色、芥末黄、暖灰色和柔和青绿色的纸层层构成。微小的插画人物惊奇地仰望着天空。所有招牌、屏幕和广告牌都保持抽象且完全无法辨认，没有真正的品牌和标志

raw_p:
制作費30億円規模の架空アニメ映画PV。

# テーマ
黒いクルーザーバイクで高原道路を走る紫髪の女性ライダー。疾走の快感だけでなく、風を受けた一瞬の表情、停車した時の深呼吸、空へ抜ける祝福の余韻まで描く。観客が「この旅に出たい」と感じる、15秒のオリジナル・シネマティックアニメPV。

### VFX指定
路面反射、背景パララックス、風で揺れる髪、透明シールド反射、レザーの光沢、タイヤ周りの薄い砂埃、草原の波、太陽フレア、飛行機雲、白い雲文字

# 制約
- チープでB級映画のような粗雑な表現は絶対にしない。
- カメラ技法、ライティング、エフェクト、CG効果を最大限に高める。
- 登場人物やアイテムの破綻禁止。
- BGM無し
- テキスト、ロゴ、透かし、UI表示を入れない。ただし最終Cutの飛行機雲文字「Have a wonderful day to you」だけは例外。
- 女性の顔、紫髪、毛先ピンク、オッドアイ、黒レザー衣装、ブーツ、体型を維持。
- バイクは黒いロー＆ロング系クルーザーバイクを維持。
- ヘルメットは黒いジェットヘルメット、透明シールド、丸いシェル、サイドヒンジを維持。ラベルや文字は出さない。
- 走行中は透明シールドを下げる。停車時はシールドを額側へ跳ね上げる。別体ゴーグルは禁止。
- 危険運転、事故、ジャンプ、極端な蛇行は禁止。

# 情景
晴れた高原リゾート道路。やまなみハイウェイ風の緑の丘陵、遠い山並み、広い青空、白い雲。道路の白線とガードレールが奥へ伸び、草原が風で波打つ。実在看板や地名は出さない。

# 参照素材
### キャラクター
主人公の外見固定。ヘルメット装備時も顔立ち、紫髪、オッドアイを読めるようにする。

### バイク
黒いクルーザーバイク固定。

### ヘルメット

en.p:
A promotional video for a fictional anime movie with a production budget of around 3 billion yen.

# テーマ
A purple-haired female rider riding a black cruiser bike on a highland road. It depicts not only the thrill of speeding but also the fleeting expression when caught in the wind, the deep breath when stopped, and the lingering blessing that soars into the sky. A 15-second original cinematic anime PV that makes the audience feel "they want to embark on this journey."

### VFX specification
Road reflections, background parallax, hair swaying in the wind, transparent shield reflections, leather sheen, thin dust around tires, grassland waves, sun flares, contrails, white cloud characters

# Constraints
- Never use cheap or crude expressions like B-movies.
- Maximize camera techniques, lighting, effects, and CG effects.
- Prohibition of characters and items from bankruptcy.
- No background music
- Do not include text, logos, watermarks, or UI displays. However, the contrail text in the final cut, 'Have a wonderful day to you,' is an exception.
- Maintains a female face, purple hair, pink tips, odd eyes, black leather costume, boots, and body shape.
- The bike is a black low & long cruiser bike.
- Helmet: Black jet helmet, transparent shield, round shell, and side hinges remain. No labels or text are displayed.
- Lower the transparent shield while driving. When stopped, the shield is flipped up toward the forehead. Separate goggles are prohibited.
- Dangerous driving, accidents, jumping, and extreme weaving are prohibited.

# Scene
Sunny highland resort road. Green hills in the style of Yamanami Highway, distant mountain ranges, wide blue skies, and white clouds. The white lines and guardrails stretched into the distance, and the grasslands rippled in the wind. No real signs or place names are displayed.

# Reference materials
### キャラクター
The protagonist's appearance is fixed. Even when equipped with a helmet, he can read facial features, purple hair, and odd eyes.

### バイク
Black cruiser bike fixed.

### ヘルメット
Black jet helmet secured. Transparent shield, round black shell, side hinges, and black edging are maintained.

# シーン
Cut 1: -0:02.0
Camera: extreme low angle tracking shot, showing the front wheel and white stripe at high speed just above the road, and finally tilting up to the protagonist's silhouette.
Action: The protagonist rides a black cruiser bike along a highland road.
Effect: Flow of white lines, thin dust around the tires, reflections on the black body.
Detail: The face and bike shape remain intact, while the sense of speed is brought out in the background.
Mood: A sense of speed that grabs attention from the very beginning.

Cut 2: .0-0:04.5
Camera: side tracking shot から close-up へ smooth push in。
Action: The protagonist catches the wind and smiles faintly through the shield.
Effect: Blue sky reflected on the transparent shield, and the tips of purple hair swayed in the wind.
Detail: Odd eyes are visible through the shield.
Mood: Freedom, transparency, and the heroine's charm.

Cut 3: .5-0:06.6
Camera: Switched from driving to a scenic parking lot with the whip pan transition.
Action: The bike quietly stops.
Effect: The light sinking of the car, the grassland breeze, and the distant mountain range.
Detail: Do not display signs or text.
Mood: A shift from speed to tranquility.

Cut 4: .6-0:09.5
Camera: medium shot to slow orbit dolly, and finally close-up.
Action: The protagonist flicks the transparent shield toward his forehead and stretches his back, saying, "Hmm!" きもちいいー！」 he said.
Effect: Hair and costumes sway in the wind, and soft backlighting illuminates the face.
Detail: Lip-syncing. No subtitles. The shield was not in his hand but remained attached to his helmet.
Mood: Liberation, cuteness, joy of travel.

Cut 5: .5-0:12.2
Camera: rear low angle から crane up。
Action: The protagonist starts running again, shrinking into the depths of a straight road.
Effect: The engine noise fades away, and the road lines are drawn into the back of the screen.
Detail: Maintains the silhouette of a black bike and helmet.
Mood: The continuation of a journey, a lingering aftertaste.

Cut 6: .2-0:15.0
Camera: vertical tilt up, passing from the road into the blue sky.
Action: A contrail draws in the sky with the phrase "Have a wonderful day to you."
Effect: White cloud characters, clear blue sky, soft light.
Detail: The English sentence is precisely "Have a wonderful day to you." Not subtitles, but contrails.
Mood: Blessing, release, a memorable ending.

# Audio
No background music. Low engine noises, wind noises, tire noises, and high-altitude environmental sounds. Cut 4's line: "Hmm!" きもちいいー！」 Only make it sound clear.

raw_p: @image1 mage1 fights three opponents inside a Japanese high school classroom in an intense, highly dynamic one-take action sequence. The classroom is filled with wooden desks, chairs, school bags, a chalkboard, sliding windows, curtains, fluorescent ceiling lights, posters, books, and scattered papers. The fight is fast, physical, and highly interactive with the environment. The woman moves between the desks with sharp agility, dodging attacks from all three opponents at once. Papers fly through the air, chairs scrape across the floor, desks topple, curtains whip from the movement, and sunlight cuts through the windows, catching dust particles in the air. The camera is extremely dynamic and close to the action, never a static wide shot. Use a fast-moving one-take camera that constantly follows, circles, ducks, whips, and pushes through the fight. The camera moves between desks, swings around the woman as she turns, rushes backward as opponents charge, drops low near the floor during leg sweeps, rises suddenly as she jumps over a desk, and whips around quickly to reveal the next attacker. The framing should feel urgent, handheld, immersive, and physically present inside the classroom. The action should feature strong choreography, realistic body movement, believable impact, fast reaction timing, close-range combat, and continuous motion. Make the scene feel like a high-budget martial arts action sequence captured in one uninterrupted shot. Use natural classroom lighting mixed with warm afternoon sunlight through the windows, realistic shadows, practical motion blur, grounded textures, real-world imperfections, and a raw cinematic look. No glossy AI finish, no overly polished CGI, and no static long-shot framing. 15秒超电影化的神话奇幻变身场景，场景在暴烈的天体风暴中，悬于云端的神圣山峰顶。

一位孤独的古老战士站在山顶，手持仪式长矛。乌云密布在山上盘旋，金色阳光穿透天空的缝隙。

镜头缓缓环绕着这位战士，强风增强。云层开始不自然地向他旋转。闪电划过天空，照亮了刻在山顶上的古老符号。

皮肤下隐约泛起一抹金色光芒。龙鳞逐渐沿着他的手臂、脖子和胸膛浮现。光束如熔化的星光般穿过鳞片间的裂缝流淌。

转变加速。巨大的角从头顶长出，长长的天须在风中形成。他的眼睛闪耀着耀眼的金色光芒。

镜头拉近，漂浮的云带缠绕在他的身体上。风暴本身的碎片成为了转变的一部分。他的身影随着每一秒变得更大、更强大。

巨大的龙爪从他手中伸出。金色的鳞片遍布全身。周围的风暴旋转越来越快，形成了山顶周围巨大的漩涡。

高潮时，战士飞向天空。他的身体化为旋转的云朵、金色光芒和天体能量，随后重塑为由活风云、耀眼鳞片和神光构成的壮丽东龙。

龙在山顶的天空中盘旋，穿梭于雷云之间，闪电紧随其后。

最后的电影时刻：巨大的天龙从云层之上出现，展开云翼，光芒完全展开，俯瞰着下面的世界，风暴在它周围散开。

Below, a colossal monster rampages through the ruined streets while soldiers in similar armor fight it with futuristic energy weapons amid explosions and collapsing buildings. 末日后的废墟城市，白昼阴沉。超写实的专业电影画面，风化的混凝土、生锈的金属、飘散的尘埃、烟雾和雾气笼罩在倒塌的摩天大楼、破损的高速公路、远处的火光上。风会将灰烬和碎片带过空气。

角色：男性战士[图片参考]，身穿未来部落猎人盔甲——层叠皮革和战术布料，金属板，发光的蓝色装饰，绳索和多功能袋，历经风化的战斗细节;脏兮兮的汗脸，疤痕，自然的皮肤质感，绝对没有塑料CGI效果。他携带着一把未来感十足的能量长矛。

第一张（2秒）——战士站在一座高耸废弃摩天大楼边缘的特写。他举手捂住脸，把两根手指放进嘴里，吹了一声响亮而尖锐的口哨——猎人的呼唤信号。风穿过他的头发和盔甲带;镜头缓缓拉近他的脸。

照片2（1秒）——低角度拍摄的烟雾缭绕天空。一只巨大的机械有机鸟惊天冲破云层，翅膀张开，金属羽毛发出颤动声，雾气和碎片从它出现时爆发出来。

SHOT 3（2秒）——积极的手持追踪射击。战士在废墟屋顶上飞奔，靴子踩碎破裂的混凝土，强力跃出悬崖，跃入空中。巨鸟高速掠过他身下;他的手在最后一刻猛地抓住了那只鸟巨大的爪腿。强风、尘土、运动模糊。

第四张（2秒）——宽广的电影镜头。战士悬挂在巨鸟带爪的腿上，身体在风中摆动，鸟儿快速而直线地飞越战场。下方，一只巨大的怪物在废墟街道上肆虐，身穿类似盔甲的士兵们用未来能量武器与它战斗，爆炸声和倒塌的建筑不断。鸟精准地从怪物背上方飞过。烟雾和火花飞驰而过，强烈的运动模糊。

射击5（1秒）——战士放开鸟巨大爪腿的极近特写。手指从金属有机爪中松开，风呼啸而过，接触断开时感觉像慢动作一样。

第六击（2秒）——战士垂直落下，穿过烟雾弥漫的空气朝怪物飞去，双手紧握着前方的未来感长矛。矛的机械部分展开并旋转，伴随着尖锐的金属运动;强烈的蓝色能量涌入武器上的发光线条，电弧噼啪作响，随着枪尖周围空气扭曲，脉动越来越亮。他的脸庞凶猛、专注、咆哮。

第七击（2秒）——战士直接落在巨兽身上，将满蓄力的长矛深深刺入其背，刀刃深深刺入剑柄。

A lone gambler sits at a grand gaming table beneath enormous chandeliers. The atmosphere is tense. Hundreds of floating playing cards drift through the air while golden light reflects across black marble floors.

The gambler reveals his final losing hand.

Silence.

Suddenly the cards around the room begin spinning violently. Time slows. The camera circles around him as glowing cards rise from the table and orbit his body.

Golden symbols appear across his suit. The fabric transforms into ornate royal garments decorated with card suits, intricate embroidery, and luminous gold trim.

The transformation accelerates. Thousands of playing cards erupt into the air like a storm. Reality fractures into giant floating card panels showing alternate outcomes and possible futures.

His eyes glow with supernatural power. A crown made of rotating cards and gold energy materializes above his head. The casino itself begins bending and reshaping around him.

The camera pushes closer as cards fuse into elaborate armor pieces along his shoulders and arms. Gold particles and red velvet ribbons spiral around the transformation.

At the climax, a colossal throne made entirely of floating cards assembles behind him. The gambler rises from the table transformed into the Card King, ruler of fate and chance.

Final cinematic moment: the Card King sits upon the throne while an endless vortex of cards spins around him. With a subtle gesture, the entire deck freezes in midair as reality bends to his will.

高潮时，一个由漂浮卡片组成的巨大王座在他身后组装。赌徒从桌上站起，变成了命运与机遇的主宰牌王。

en.p: A 10-second vertical 9:16 live video of Hakone Station Transmission TV in Japan, with low image quality sports broadcast recording, 480p compression, strong sunlight, regular TV colors, slight sharpening and motion blur. The scene shows a wide urban road track, with clear blue skies in winter, bare trees by the roadside, spectators standing behind guardrails, and in the distance, runners and white broadcast motorcycles. In the center of the frame is a slim Japanese male long-distance runner, dressed in a dark blue sleeveless race uniform and shorts, with a white bib number on his chest that says '3', wearing white gloves, white socks, and bright red running shoes. He has short black hair, a blank and serious expression, a straight body, arms perpendicular at his sides, and feet together. He didn't look like he was running at all; instead, he looked like a real person, frozen in frame and put into the live broadcast, standing motionless in front of the camera; But the background road, the white lane line, spectators, motorcycles, and other riders were all constantly moving backward, creating the absurd illusion of him "standing and gliding across the track." The camera is a long-zoom motorcycle tracking camera for Japanese sports broadcasts. It doesn't have a cinematic feel or stabilizer feel, but rather reverses the camera from the car like a real broadcast camera, with the subject always centered and the composition a bit clumsy. The first 2 seconds show the full front, then 2 to 4 seconds suddenly switch to a low-angle close-up of the foot, red running shoes pressed together against the ground, the road moving beneath the feet but not stepping forward; Four seconds later, he switches back to his body, the camera zooms out slightly, the background becomes more empty, the motorcycle is behind him, and the timer keeps ticking. On the top left of the screen is a Japanese stage graphic with black text on a white background, a large black-and-white timer on the top right, and a blue-and-white gradient player name bar and distance information like "2.3km remaining" at the bottom. The text can be slightly inaccurate but must be like Japanese live subtitles. Overall, it should be realistic, low-definition, absurd, and dry humor—like the early Sora TV live dream scenarios: don't let the contestant run, don't let them take steps, don't exaggerate expressions, don't use movie color grading, don't use animation, don't use modern short video subtitles, don't use real TV station logos, don't use obvious CGI, don't use unnecessary body parts, don't distort faces.

Only natural sound effects within the painting (golf course wind, grass friction, slight footsteps, fabric shaking, slight tearing after a ball hit) are used, with no background music; microphones may be slightly distorted when loud. It uses a pure first-person handheld POV perspective (the subjective view of the girl lying on the ground), with camera movements fully following the operator's instinctive reactions. 30-second cinematic sports commercial, 16:9, ultra-realistic FIFA World Cup ad style.

PART 1 — THE WAIT FOR THE GOAL (0:00–0:15)

A modern living room transformed into an Argentina fan zone. Friends watch the FIFA World Cup 2026 Final on a giant screen. Argentina flags everywhere. World Cup anthem, TV commentary, crowd noise, and excited chatter fill the room.

90th minute. Scores level. Argentina launches one final attack. Everyone falls silent. Ava nervously grips a cushion. Friends begin chanting “Argentina! Argentina!”

Ava opens a special-edition World Cup Lays packet and shares it. Golden chips pour into a bowl. She takes a crunch.

CRUNCH.

The sound blends with stadium cheers. TV glow fills the frame as the living room dissolves.

PART 2 — BECOME PART OF THE GAME (0:15–0:30)

The crunch transports Ava into a packed World Cup 2026 stadium surrounded by thousands of unique Argentina supporters. No cloned faces. Real crowd behavior. Massive flags wave as the crowd roars.

2026年世界杯×广告

第一部分 — 等待进球（0：00–0：15）

现代客厅被改造成阿根廷球迷区。朋友们在巨型屏幕上观看2026年国际足联世界杯决赛。阿根廷国旗无处不在。世界杯赞歌、电视解说、观众喧嚣和兴奋的谈话声充满了整个房间。

第90分钟。分数持平。阿根廷发动最后一次攻击。所有人都安静下来。艾娃紧张地抓着一个靠垫。朋友们开始高喊“阿根廷！阿根廷！”

艾娃打开了一份特别版的世界杯Lays资料包并分享出来。金色的薯片倒进碗里。她吃了一口脆。

咔嚓。

声音与体育场的欢呼声交织在一起。电视的光芒充满画面，客厅逐渐消散。

第二部分 — 成为游戏一员（0：15–0：30）

这场起跳将阿娃带入了座无虚席的2026年世界杯体育场，周围环绕着成千上万独特的阿根廷球迷。没有克隆面孔。真正的人群行为。巨大的旗帜在人群欢呼中飘扬。

解说员：“阿根廷还有最后一次机会！”

最后进攻后采用转播式报道。粉丝们屏住呼吸。射门被击中。

进球。

体育场爆发了喧嚣。五彩纸屑落下。阿根廷是2026年世界杯冠军。艾娃与支持者庆祝，烟花点亮了体育场。

画面切回客厅。进球是在电视上发生的。朋友们爆发出庆祝，拥抱、欢呼、跳跃，动作连贯。

最后一幕英雄镜头：世界杯版 包装放在咖啡桌上。艾娃拿着一块芯片。

AVA：
“莱斯，你不仅仅是在看比赛......”
咔嚓。

“...你是其中一部分。”

超级：
2026年莱斯世界杯
一块。比赛开始。

Photorealistic first person FPV drone fly through starting from the front garden pathway of the Taj Mahal at sunrise. The camera glides rapidly forward over the Mughal garden, flying low above the symmetrical water canal with the Taj Mahal reflection shimmering beneath. Soft golden sunrise light touches the white marble dome and minarets, creating a warm glowing pink gold atmosphere. The drone smoothly dives close toward the reflecting pool, then rises upward toward the grand marble platform, passing between the garden trees and visitors from a respectful cinematic distance.

The camera circles around the Taj Mahal in a smooth orbital motion, revealing the glowing central dome, elegant minarets, intricate marble details, and the soft morning mist around the monument. It then ascends above the courtyard, capturing the full symmetrical layout of the gardens, water canal, and the Taj Mahal standing majestically under the sunrise sky. The movement should feel fast but stable, fluid and cinematic, always facing the direction of travel.

15-second ultra-cinematic dark fantasy transformation sequence in a remote forest during a thunderstorm at dusk.

A lone human stands in a clearing surrounded by towering pine trees as rain falls steadily through the forest. Thunder rumbles overhead while wind moves through the branches.

The person suddenly freezes as a powerful force surges through their body. Muscles expand visibly beneath soaked clothing. Their posture changes, becoming heavier and more animalistic. Fingers lengthen into powerful claws while hands gradually broaden into massive bear paws.

The camera circles dynamically around the transformation as fur begins spreading across the arms, shoulders, chest, and face. Bones shift beneath the skin with realistic anatomical motion. The spine lengthens, shoulders widen dramatically, and the silhouette becomes increasingly bear-like.

The transformation accelerates. Clothing stretches and tears naturally under the expanding physique. Thick dark fur grows rapidly while the face reshapes into a powerful bear muzzle. Breath becomes visible in the cold air.

Lightning illuminates the scene as the creature rises to full height. Water sprays from its fur while massive muscles flex beneath the coat. The camera pushes in close to glowing eyes filled with primal intensity.

Final cinematic moment: the fully transformed bear stands in the rain, towering above the forest floor. It lifts its head toward the stormy sky and releases a powerful roar as thunder echoes across the mountains.

Style: ultra-cinematic realism, realistic transformation VFX, detailed fur simulation, grounded anatomy changes, dramatic storm atmosphere, realistic rain interaction, powerful creature presence, dynamic camera movement, AAA fantasy film quality, no text, no overlays.

Audio: cinematic orchestral build with deep percussion and primal energy, combined with realistic rain, thunder, wind, heavy breathing, bone-shifting effects, fur movement, and forest ambience.

zh.p:
15秒的超电影级黑暗奇幻变身戏，场景发生在黄昏雷雨中的偏远森林。

一名孤独的人类站在一片被高耸松树环绕的空地上，雨水在森林中持续落下。雷声在头顶隆隆作响，风穿过树枝。

那人突然僵住，一股强大的力量穿过全身。湿透的衣服下肌肉明显扩张。他们的姿态发生变化，变得更沉重、更像动物。手指逐渐变长成强有力的爪子，而手掌则逐渐变宽成巨大的熊爪。

镜头动态地围绕着变身过程旋转，毛发开始蔓延到手臂、肩膀、胸部和脸部。骨骼在皮肤下以逼真的解剖运动移动。脊柱变长，肩膀大幅宽阔，轮廓越来越像熊。

转变加速。衣服在膨胀的身体下自然拉伸和撕裂。浓密的深色毛发迅速生长，脸部则变形成强壮的熊口部。呼吸在寒冷的空气中变得可见。

闪电照亮了场景，生物升高到最高。水从它的毛发中喷涌而出，粗壮的肌肉在毛发下紧绷。镜头靠近充满原始强度的发光眼睛。

最后的电影时刻：完全变身的熊站在雨中，高耸于森林地面之上。它抬头望向暴风雨的天空，发出震耳欲聾的咆哮，雷声在群山间回荡。

风格：极具电影感的写实，逼真的变形视觉特效，细致的毛皮模拟，贴近现实的解剖结构变化，戏剧性的暴风雨氛围，逼真的雨水互动，强大的生物存在感，动态摄像机运动，AAA级奇幻电影质量，无文字，无叠加。

Realistic shaky handheld mobile phone footage, vertical 9:16 format, grainy compressed phone camera look, digital zoom, authentic found footage style. Bright daylight on a crowded Brazilian beach.

Shot 1 (0-4s) – Third Floor Building POVHandheld shot from the third-floor balcony of a beachfront building. A massive hybrid sea creature (giant crocodile head with long powerful squid-like tentacles, dark scaly skin, glowing eyes) explodes out of the ocean and charges onto the crowded beach. People scream and run in absolute panic. The creature immediately starts grabbing victims with its tentacles, lifting them high and slamming them into the sand or throwing them into the sea. Shaky digital zoom in as it bites down on one person and flings the body across the beach.

Shot 2 (4-9s) – Cut to Ground Level ChaosFast cut to ground-level shaky handheld footage running on the beach. Complete pandemonium — people screaming and running in every direction. The massive creature rampages through the crowd, tentacles whipping wildly, smashing beach umbrellas and stalls. It grabs multiple people at once, throwing them into the air. The camera shakes violently as the person filming runs backward trying to escape while still recording.

Shot 3 (9-13s) – Final PayoffThe creature grabs a screaming man with one powerful tentacle, lifts him high, and violently slings him directly toward the camera. The man flies through the air and smashes hard into a coconut stall right behind the person filming. Coconuts explode everywhere. The camera shakes wildly from the impact, tilts, and catches a brief glimpse of the man lying bloody and broken among the smashed coconuts. The creature roars and charges forward as the person filming screams and tries to run. Hard cut to black on the sound of heavy footsteps and tentacles slamming into the sand.

Hyper-realistic creature design, realistic physics, chaotic energy, loud screaming, crashing waves, raw found footage style, high detail, bright daylight with strong contrast, extremely intense and fast-paced.

镜头1（0-4秒）——三楼大楼视角，从一栋海滨建筑三楼阳台拍摄。一只巨大的混合海洋生物（巨大的鳄鱼头部，长着强壮的鱿鱼触手，黑色鳞片皮肤，发光的眼睛）从海中爆发，冲向拥挤的海滩。人们惊慌失措地尖叫着逃跑。生物立刻用触手抓住受害者，将他们高高举起，狠狠摔进沙中或扔进海中。晃动的数字镜头放大，咬住一个人，把尸体扔到海滩另一边。

镜头2（4-9秒）——切到地面层混乱，快速切到地面地面摇晃的手持镜头，画面在海滩上奔跑。一片混乱——人们尖叫着四散奔跑。这只庞大的生物在人群中肆虐，触手疯狂挥舞，砸碎沙滩伞和摊位。它同时抓住多人，将他们抛向空中。摄像机剧烈晃动，拍摄者一边向后逃跑一边录制。

镜头3（9-13秒）——最终回报生物用一根强有力的触手抓住一名尖叫的男子，将他高高举起，猛烈地将他扔向镜头。那人飞过空中，重重撞上了拍摄者身后的椰子摊。椰子到处爆炸。镜头因撞击剧烈晃动，倾斜，短暂捕捉到那名男子躺在破碎椰子间，满身是血。怪物咆哮着冲了上去，拍摄者尖叫着试图逃跑。画面直接切黑，伴随着沉重脚步声和触手撞击沙地的声音。

超现实的生物设计，逼真的物理效果，混沌能量，响亮的尖叫声，巨浪拍打，原始伪纪录片风格，高细节，明亮的白昼对比强烈，极其紧张且节奏快速。

A high-quality Japanese anime transformation sequence with fluid sakuga animation and cinematic action.

A young shrine maiden forms mystical hand seals as golden spiritual energy flows into the ground. A massive golden magic circle expands beneath her, ancient runes glowing while debris levitates around her.

Dark jade and golden-violet spiritual mist rises from the circle as a giant Japanese salamander spirit emerges. The girl performs sacred summoning seals while chanting:

「山椒の霊、我に従え！力を授けよ！」

The salamander spirit merges with her body. Spiritual energy races across her limbs as her school uniform transforms into a sleek shrine maiden battle outfit. Her hair becomes combat-ready twin tails, water-ripple barriers form around her, and salamander markings appear near her eyes.

A magical dagger materializes from spiritual energy. She draws the blade and enters a swift, feline combat stance. The dagger glows with golden-violet and jade energy, engraved with salamander scales and sacred runes.

The sequence ends with her spinning the dagger, creating luminous water-ripple arcs while adopting a low hunting stance. The magic circle fades as her power stabilizes, leaving a tense silence before battle.

Ultra-detailed anime visuals, masterpiece character animation, dynamic camera movement, cinematic lighting, magical effects, 60 FPS, premium anniversary OAD quality, flawless sakuga transformation scene.

Cinematic realistic soccer sequence, continuous action shot. On an outdoor urban soccer field at late afternoon, a skilled soccer player runs toward a stationary ball and delivers a powerful strike. 
The instant his foot connects with the ball, the camera locks onto the ball and tracks it closely for the rest of the shot, flying alongside it in a fast, smooth, dynamic chase-camera movement. 

The ball spins rapidly through the air with realistic motion blur, passing above the field, over a low fence, and toward a nearby building. Reflections flash across the ball as it approaches a large glass window. 

In the final moment, the ball smashes directly through the window with a sharp explosive impact, sending glass shards flying inward in dramatic realistic detail. End on the ball entering the room as glittering fragments fall around it.  

Camera: begins with a low cinematic angle on the player and ball, then instantly becomes an intense ball-tracking flying camera after the kick, staying centered on the spinning ball until impact.  

Style: ultra-realistic, cinematic action, natural lighting, strong sense of speed, believable physics, detailed glass break, high tension, smooth continuous motion. 

Important controls: one soccer player only, one ball only, no cuts after the kick, camera must follow the ball continuously, ball must break the window at the end, no text, no logos, no exaggerated cartoon physics

15-second ultra-cinematic sci-fi fantasy transformation sequence inside a futuristic research facility at night.

A lone scientist stands in the center of a massive temporal chamber surrounded by floating holograms, rotating clock mechanisms, and glowing rings of advanced technology.

The camera slowly circles around the scientist as a temporal experiment activates. Blue and gold energy begins flowing through the room. The air distorts subtly as if reality itself is becoming unstable.

Suddenly multiple versions of the scientist appear simultaneously around them. Elderly, adult, teenage, and child versions flicker in and out of existence like overlapping timelines.

The transformation accelerates. Time fractures spread through the environment like cracks in glass. Floating clocks spin uncontrollably. Papers, tools, and particles become trapped between different moments in time.

The scientist's body begins shifting rapidly through different ages with every second. Wrinkles appear and disappear. Hair changes color and length. Clothing cycles through different eras and futures.

The camera moves closer as dozens of translucent timeline echoes orbit around the central figure. Past and future selves merge together in waves of temporal energy.

Reality becomes increasingly surreal. The laboratory alternates between pristine, abandoned, futuristic, and ancient versions of itself. Light bends unnaturally. Seconds seem to stretch and collapse.

The scientist rises into the air as the transformation reaches its climax. Their body dissolves into flowing streams of golden clocks, blue temporal energy, floating memories, and fragments of possible futures.

Final cinematic moment: a magnificent living Time Entity hovers above the chamber, composed of rotating rings, starlike particles, shifting ages, and luminous temporal energy. Behind them, a colossal vortex of past and future timelines spirals endlessly into infinity.

Style: ultra cinematic sci-fi fantasy, temporal distortion VFX, age-shifting transformation, reality bending effects, floating particles, cosmic technology aesthetic, golden and blue energy palette, seamless morphing, AAA visual effects quality, no text, no overlays.

15秒超电影感的科幻奇幻变身场景，场景设在一个未来研究设施的夜晚。

一名科学家站在巨大的时间舱中央，周围环绕着漂浮的全息影像、旋转的时钟机械和发光的先进科技环。

镜头缓缓环绕科学家，时间实验启动。蓝色和金色的能量开始在房间里流动。空气微妙地扭曲，仿佛现实本身也变得不稳定。

突然，多个科学家的版本同时出现在他们周围。老年人、成人、青少年和儿童版本像重叠的时间线一样时隐时现。

转变加速。时间的裂痕像玻璃裂缝一样在环境中蔓延。漂浮的钟无法控制地旋转。纸张、工具和粒子被困在不同的时间点之间。

科学家的身体每秒都在快速变换不同的年龄。皱纹出现又消失。头发颜色和长度会变化。服装会在不同时代和未来中循环。

镜头逐渐靠近，数十条半透明的时间线回声围绕着中心人物旋转。过去和未来的自我融合成一波波的时间能量。

现实变得越来越超现实。实验室在原始、废弃、未来感和古老的版本之间交替出现。光线异常地弯曲。秒钟似乎拉长又崩塌。

随着变身达到高潮，科学家升空。他们的身体化为流动的金色时钟、蓝色时间能量、漂浮的记忆和可能未来的碎片。

最后的电影时刻：一个壮丽的活生生时间实体悬浮在舱室上空，由旋转的环、星辰粒子、变换的年龄和明亮的时间能量组成。在他们身后，一个庞大的过去与未来时间线漩涡无尽地螺旋着，向无尽延伸。

风格：极具电影感的科幻奇幻，时间扭曲视觉特效，年龄转换，扭曲现实的特效，漂浮粒子，宇宙科技美学，金蓝色能量调色板，无缝变形，AAA级视觉特效质量，无文字，无叠加。

制作一部电影感十足、照片级真实的15秒海滩披萨广告，采用4K、60fps、超写实的商业风格。黄金时段的夕阳灯光、温暖的橙色调、海浪、镜头光晕、浅景深、动态镜头运动、高级美食摄影、欢乐的庆祝氛围。专注于友谊、海滩氛围、美味的披萨和共享的时刻。

0-1.5秒极近特写，一盒热气腾腾的披萨盒打开在沙滩野餐毯上。金色的阳光洒进盒子里。融化的奶酪闪闪发光。慢动作蒸汽升腾。微距食物摄影。

1.5-3秒的俯视旋转新烤披萨美景。意大利辣香肠、罗勒、橄榄和融化的奶酪在夕阳下闪闪发光。流畅的电影轨道摄像机。

3-4.5秒的朋友们坐在海滩上，像敬酒一样把披萨片举向中间。笑声，头顶的串灯，背景是海洋。切片间慢动作的奶酪拉伸。

4.5-6秒史诗级奶酪拉击球。两只手撕开一片披萨。长而有弹性的马苏里拉奶酪丝。宏观关注，戏剧化的食品商业风格。

6-7.5秒 年轻冲浪者坐在冲浪板旁，从海洋出来后咬了一口披萨。他身后闪耀着太阳焰。放松的加州风格海滩氛围。

7.5-9秒宽景电影镜头，展示朋友们弹吉他、聊天、分享披萨，在海滩布置中。镜头缓缓绕着这群人转。自然的笑声和庆祝。

9-10.5秒浪漫的日落场景。一对情侣坐在沙滩毯上，分享披萨片，看着夕阳沉入海中。柔和的金色背光。

10.5-12秒 英雄特写，一位微笑的女性正在咬一口披萨。风吹动她的头发。她身后是海洋散景。高端商业美妆照。

12-13.5秒，俯视角慢动作披萨美镜头。罗勒叶、面粉尘和香草在空气中飘荡。披萨优雅地在质朴的木板上旋转。

13.5-15秒 最后一个品牌风格的终结牌。沙滩上的披萨盒

raw_p: A tense 15 second cinematic short form video in square or vertical format for Reels/Shorts. The entire scene is viewed from a static POV camera placed inside a dryer drum, looking outward through the open circular door. The perforated metal drum is visible in the foreground, creating a claustrophobic enclosed frame. At the beginning, the view is partially blocked by green leaves, loose debris, and fluttering US dollar bills. Through the circular opening, Walter White appears leaning forward glasses, white t shirt, intense expression, exhausted but calculating. He urgently reaches both hands into the dryer and grabs cash from the drum floor. [0:00–0:02] Static inside-dryer POV. Walter leans in and reaches fast with both hands, urgently pulling cash from the bottom of the drum. Leaves and dollar bills partially obscure the view, some bills flying close to camera. [0:02–0:05] He frantically scoops up handfuls of money. Bills scatter and swirl inside the drum. His face is focused, strained, and slightly desperate. His movements are fast, repetitive, and panicked. [0:05–0:08] Tight action emphasis on the hands. One hand grabs a thick wad of bills while the other pushes aside more money and debris, searching deeper. He keeps his gaze locked downward on the cash. Heavy breathing is audible. [0:08–0:11] Walter leans in even further, almost climbing into the dryer. He grabs another large handful. Some wet, dirty bills stick to his hands and forearms. His expression hardens into determination and controlled anger. [0:11–0:13] He pulls back slightly and looks directly into the dryer, straight toward camera. In his hands are crumpled, partially wet and dirty dollar bills. His face shows relief, exhaustion, and cold calculation at the same time. [0:13–0:15] He continues staring into the dryer while holding the cash. The heavy circular dryer door slowly swings shut from the side, gradually blocking the frame until his face and the money are almost completely covered. Cut to black. Ultra-cinematic, photorealistic, gritty crime-drama mood, Breaking Bad-inspired tension, shallow depth of field, harsh practical laundry-room lighting, subtle grime, metallic texture, dynamic fluttering paper, strong tactile hand movement, static camera with intense enclosed composition. No dialogue. Sound design only: low dryer hum, rustling money, scraping hands on metal, heavy breathing, slight hinge creak, heavy closing thud at the end.

zh.p: 一段紧张的15秒电影短视频，采用方形或竖式格式，适合Reels/Shorts。整个场景通过安装在烘干机桶内的静态视角摄像机拍摄，透过敞开的圆形门向外看。前景可见穿孔金属鼓，营造出令人窒息的封闭框架。一开始，视线被绿叶、松散的碎片和飘动的美元钞票部分遮挡。透过圆形开口，沃尔特·怀特出现，身前倾斜，戴着眼镜，白色T恤，神情凝重，疲惫却算计。他急切地双手伸进烘干机，从桶地上抓起现金。[0:00–0:02]静态室内烘干机视角。沃尔特俯身，双手迅速伸出，急切地从桶底掏出现金。树叶和美元钞票部分遮挡视线，有些钞票飞得很近镜头。[0:02–0:05]他疯狂地抓起一把把钱。钞票在鼓里四散旋转。他的脸专注、紧绷，略带绝望。他的动作快速、重复且慌张。[0:05–0:08]紧密的动作强调手部。一只手抓着一大叠钞票，另一只手推开更多的钱和杂物，深入寻找。他目光始终盯着现金。沉重的呼吸声清晰可闻。[0:08–0:11]沃尔特更靠近，几乎要爬进烘干机。他又抓了一大把。一些湿漉漉、肮脏的钞票粘在他的手和前臂上。他的表情变得坚定，带着克制的愤怒。[0:11–0:13]他稍微后退，直视烘干机，直视镜头。他手中握着皱巴巴、半湿脏脏的美元钞票。他的脸上同时流露出如释重负、疲惫和冷静的算计。[0:13–0:15]他一边盯着烘干机，一边拿着现金。沉重的圆形烘干机门缓缓从侧面关上，逐渐挡住门框，直到他的脸和钱几乎完全被遮住。画面切换到黑暗。超电影感、写实、写实的犯罪剧氛围、受《绝命毒师》启发的紧张感、浅景深、强烈的实景洗衣房灯光、细腻的污垢、金属质感、动态飘动的纸张、强烈的触感手部运动、静态摄像机与强烈封闭构图。没有对话。仅有音效设计：烘干机低沉嗡鸣、钱币沙沙声、手在金属上摩擦、沉重呼吸、轻微铰链吱吱声、结尾沉重的关闭声。

The entire scene is viewed from a static POV camera placed inside a dryer drum, looking outward through the open circular door. The perforated metal drum is visible in the foreground, creating a claustrophobic enclosed frame. At the beginning, the view is partially blocked by green leaves, loose debris, and fluttering US dollar bills. Through the circular opening, Walter White appears leaning forward glasses, white t shirt, intense expression, exhausted but calculating. He urgently reaches both hands into the dryer and grabs cash from the drum floor. [0:00–0:02] Static inside-dryer POV. Walter leans in and reaches fast with both hands, urgently pulling cash from the bottom of the drum. Leaves and dollar bills partially obscure the view, some bills flying close to camera. [0:02–0:05] He frantically scoops up handfuls of money. Bills scatter and swirl inside the drum. His face is focused, strained, and slightly desperate. His movements are fast, repetitive, and panicked. [0:05–0:08] Tight action emphasis on the hands. One hand grabs a thick wad of bills while the other pushes aside more money and debris, searching deeper. He keeps his gaze locked downward on the cash. Heavy breathing is audible. [0:08–0:11] Walter leans in even further, almost climbing into the dryer. He grabs another large handful. Some wet, dirty bills stick to his hands and forearms. His expression hardens into determination and controlled anger. [0:11–0:13] He pulls back slightly and looks directly into the dryer, straight toward camera. In his hands are crumpled, partially wet and dirty dollar bills. His face shows relief, exhaustion, and cold calculation at the same time. [0:13–0:15] He continues staring into the dryer while holding the cash. The heavy circular dryer door slowly swings shut from the side, gradually blocking the frame until his face and the money are almost completely covered. Cut to black. Ultra-cinematic, photorealistic, gritty crime-drama mood, Breaking Bad-inspired tension, shallow depth of field, harsh practical laundry-room lighting, subtle grime, metallic texture, dynamic fluttering paper, strong tactile hand movement, static camera with intense enclosed composition. No dialogue. Sound design only: low dryer hum, rustling money, scraping hands on metal, heavy breathing, slight hinge creak, heavy closing thud at the end.

raw_p: 15-second ultra-cinematic anime fantasy sequence inside an infinite magical bookstore at night. The camera enters a vast bookstore illuminated by warm lantern light. Endless shelves stretch upward beyond sight, connected by floating staircases, suspended bridges, and moving ladders drifting through the air. Thousands of books glow softly on the shelves. Dust particles sparkle like tiny stars. The atmosphere feels peaceful, mysterious, and timeless. A young librarian walks slowly through the aisles carrying a glowing book. As they pass, books open by themselves and release tiny fragments of their worlds into the air. One book releases cherry blossom petals drifting across the corridor. Another opens onto a stormy ocean where miniature waves spill from the pages. Another reveals floating islands drifting among clouds. The camera follows the librarian as they climb a floating staircase toward a massive ancient book resting on a pedestal at the center of the bookstore. As the giant book opens, entire worlds emerge from its pages: mountains, forests, cities, oceans, and stars expanding into the air like living holographic landscapes. Books begin floating around the room while glowing pages orbit slowly like planets. Warm golden light fills the bookstore as countless stories come alive simultaneously. Final cinematic moment: the camera pulls back to reveal the true scale of the bookstore, an endless universe of shelves extending beyond the horizon while thousands of living worlds glow between them. Style: premium anime film quality, magical fantasy atmosphere, impossible architecture, warm golden lighting, floating particles, dreamlike wonder, highly detailed backgrounds, cinematic camera movement, emotional storytelling, breathtaking scale, no text, no overlays. Audio: emotional orchestral anime soundtrack, soft piano, gentle strings, page-turning sounds, magical ambience, floating particles, warm library atmosphere, subtle wonder-filled musical progression.

zh.p: 15秒超电影感的动漫奇幻场景，发生在夜晚无限魔法书店内。镜头进入一家被温暖灯笼照亮的巨大书店。无尽的书架向上延伸，由漂浮的楼梯、吊桥和漂浮的梯子相连。成千上万的书籍在书架上柔和地发光。尘埃颗粒闪烁如微小的星星。氛围宁静、神秘且永恒。一位年轻的图书管理员缓缓走过书架，手里拿着一本发光的书。当他们经过时，书本会自行打开，释放出他们世界的微小碎片。一本书释放了樱花瓣飘落在走廊上。另一页开启，通向暴风雨的海洋，微小的波浪从书页中倾泻而下。另一张则显示漂浮在云间的漂浮岛屿。镜头跟随图书管理员攀登悬浮楼梯，走向书店中央基座上的一本巨大的古书。当这本巨著翻开时，整个世界从书页中浮现出来：山脉、森林、城市、海洋和星辰如活生生的全息景观般向空中扩展。书本开始在房间里漂浮，发光的书页缓缓绕行，像行星一样。温暖的金色光芒充满书店，无数故事同时生动呈现。最后的电影时刻：镜头拉远，揭示书店的真实规模，一个无尽的书架宇宙延伸至地平线之外，成千上万的活生生的世界在它们之间闪耀。风格：顶级动漫电影质量，魔幻奇幻氛围，不可能的建筑，温暖的金色灯光，漂浮的粒子，梦幻般的奇迹，高度细致的背景，电影般的镜头运动，情感丰富的叙事，令人屏息的规模，无文字，无叠加。音效：情感丰富的管弦乐动漫配乐，柔和的钢琴，温柔的弦乐，令人欲罢不能的声音，神奇的氛围，漂浮的粒子，温暖的图书馆氛围，细腻且充满奇迹的音乐推进。

raw_p: Create a 15-second cinematic comedy chase inside a giant baby bedroom/playroom. ONE continuous shot, NO cuts. A tiny real adult man on a miniature skateboard has just "stolen" a giant chocolate cookie crumb from the baby's snack area and is racing away. He is a real miniature human, not a toy, doll, cartoon, or child. The room is enormous from his perspective. Camera stays ultra-low at skateboard height, tightly following behind him in one uninterrupted take. The camera accelerates, sways, tilts, and reacts naturally to every near miss while remaining on the same continuous floor path. The giant baby notices the missing cookie and becomes excited, laughing and crawling after him—not angry, just playfully curious. The chase unfolds as one connected chain reaction: Tiny skateboarder races between giant alphabet blocks while carrying the oversized cookie crumb. The baby accidentally bumps a stack of soft foam blocks, sending one tumbling into the path. He performs a dramatic skateboard powerslide underneath it. The same baby pushes a giant toy dump truck across the floor. The truck carries colorful plastic balls that spill everywhere. He zigzags between bouncing balls. One rolling ball hits a teddy bear, causing the teddy to slowly tip over across the path like a giant furry tree. He ducks and skates beneath the falling teddy's arm by inches. The baby giggles and reaches forward trying to grab the cookie, not the rider. A huge hand lands ahead. The skateboarder quickly tosses the cookie crumb into the air. The baby becomes distracted and watches the flying cookie instead. While the baby's eyes follow the cookie, the skateboarder slips through a tiny gap between giant fingers and scattered crayons. Camera follows him into a tunnel-like opening beneath the bed. Funny Ending: Just before escaping, the skateboarder looks back proudly—then a tiny cookie crumb lands directly on his head. He shrugs, grabs it, and continues skating into the darkness as the baby laughs in the background. Audio: Playful cinematic adventure music, fast comedic rhythm, light orchestral stings, toy percussion, humorous near-miss accents. Sounds of skateboard wheels on wood, rolling balls, toy crashes, baby giggles, teddy bear flops, cookie crunches, giant hand slaps, and exaggerated cartoon-style whoosh effects while keeping visuals fully realistic. Style: Photorealistic 8K realism, cinematic lighting, warm cozy bedroom atmosphere, shallow depth of field, natural motion blur, detailed textures, family-friendly comedy, realistic scale relationships, Pixar-level humor with live-action realism.

zh.p: 在一个巨大的婴儿卧室/游戏室里，创作一场15秒的喜剧追逐戏。一个连续镜头，没有剪辑。一个骑着迷你滑板的真小成年男子刚刚“偷”了婴儿零食区的一块巨大的巧克力饼干屑，正飞奔而去。他是真正的迷你人类，不是玩具、洋娃娃、卡通或儿童。从他的视角看，这个房间非常巨大。镜头保持在滑板高度极低，紧跟他身后，连续拍摄。摄像机会加速、摇摆、倾斜，并对每一次擦身而过的事故自然反应，同时保持在同一连续的地板路径上。巨婴发现饼干不见了，兴奋起来，笑着爬行——不是生气，而是玩笑着好奇。追逐就像一个连锁反应展开：小滑板手在巨大的字母块间奔跑，同时携带那块超大饼干屑。婴儿不小心撞到了一叠软泡沫块，导致其中一块掉进了小路。他在滑板下做了戏剧性的滑板漂移。同一个婴儿推着一辆巨大的玩具自卸卡车横穿地板。卡车上装着色彩斑斓的塑料球，到处都是。他在弹跳的球之间曲折穿梭。一个滚动的球击中了一只泰迪熊，使泰迪熊像一棵巨大的毛茸茸的树一样慢慢倾倒在小路上。他低头滑行，险些从掉落的泰迪熊手臂下滑过。婴儿咯咯笑着，伸手试图抓住饼干，而不是骑手。一只巨大的手落在前方。滑板手迅速把饼干屑扔到空中。婴儿分心了，转而看着飞翔的饼干。当婴儿的目光跟随着饼干时，滑板手从巨大的手指和散落的蜡笔之间滑过。镜头跟随他进入床下的隧道状开口。搞笑结局：就在逃跑前，滑板手自豪地回头看了一眼——然后一小块饼干屑直接落在他头上。他耸耸肩，抓起手机，继续滑进黑暗中，背景里婴儿的笑声。音效：俏皮的电影冒险音乐，快速的喜剧节奏，轻柔的管弦乐刺奏，玩具打击乐，幽默的差点失误口音。滑板轮子在木头上滚动的声音、滚动的球、玩具撞击声、婴儿的咯咯笑声、泰迪熊扑通声、饼干脆裂、巨大的手掌声，以及夸张的卡通风格呼啸声，同时保持画面完全真实。风格：照片级写实的8K现实主义，电影般的灯光，温暖舒适的卧室氛围，浅景深，自然运动模糊，细致的纹理，适合家庭观看的喜剧，真实比例的关系，皮克斯级别的幽默与真人现实主义。

raw_p:
SCENE: Warehouse Discovery

GEOMETRY
- Woman enters frame from left edge, 10 feet from camera
- Warehouse recedes into deep background (20+ feet)
- High windows (frame-right and frame-top) flood space

OPTICS
- Static wide shot, 35mm lens equivalent
- Hold 2 seconds
- Then: slow push-in over 6 seconds to 85mm
- Final frame: woman's face fills upper half

ILLUMINATION
- Sunlight from frame-right, 45-degree high angle
- Sharp shadow grid from window mullions across floor
- Strong contrast (5:1) — bright beam, deep shadow in corners
- Warm color (5200K)
- Volumetric light visible in air (dust particles catching beam)

ACTION & TIMING
- 0-2sec: She walks frame-left to frame-center, steady pace
- 2-5sec: She stops, head down
- 5-7sec: Head slowly raises, face enters light beam
- 7-8sec: She pauses, eyes narrow (discovery)

CONNECTION
- Her movement intersects the light geometry at moment of stopping
- Camera push completes as face enters brightest zone
- By frame-end: she is revealed by light, not hidden

zh.p:
场景：仓库发现

几何
- 女性从左侧边缘进入画面，距离摄像机10英尺
- 仓库退入深处（20+英尺）
- 高窗户（框架右侧和框架顶部）淹水空间

光学
- 静态广角镜头，35mm镜头等效镜头
- 按住2秒
- 然后：慢速推入6秒至85毫米
- 最后一帧：女性脸部占据上半身

照明
- 来自右框的阳光，45度高角
- 窗户窗框在地板上的锐利阴影网格
- 强烈对比度（5：1）——明亮光束，角落有深阴影
- 暖色（5200K）
- 空气中可见的体积光（尘埃颗粒捕捉光束）

动作与时机
- 0-2秒：她从左帧走到帧中，节奏稳定
- 2-5秒：她停下，低头
- 5-7秒：头缓缓抬起，脸部进入光束
- 7-8秒：她停顿，眼睛眯起（发现）

连接
- 她的运动在停止瞬间与光线几何相交
- 当人脸进入最亮区时，摄像机推送完成
- 帧尾：她被光线揭示，而非隐藏

15-second ultra-cinematic anime fantasy sequence at twilight.

A quiet railway station sits alone in the middle of an endless sea of clouds beneath a purple-orange sunset. The platform appears abandoned, illuminated only by old lanterns swaying gently in the wind.

A young girl wearing a school uniform stands alone holding a small suitcase. She looks down the empty tracks disappearing into the horizon.

In the distance, a mysterious train slowly emerges from glowing mist. Its windows shine with warm golden light. The train glides silently across the clouds as if floating through the sky.

As it arrives at the station, the girl steps aboard. The camera follows her through the train corridor where each window reveals a different memory instead of landscapes.

One window shows her as a child running through summer fields. Another reveals a snowy winter day. Another shows a forgotten friend waving goodbye. The memories move like living scenes beyond the glass.

Soft particles drift through the train interior while sunset light fills the carriage. The atmosphere feels nostalgic, dreamlike, and emotionally powerful.

The girl pauses beside a window showing a younger version of herself smiling. She gently places her hand against the glass.

Final cinematic moment: the train departs the station and travels into the sky among the clouds while hundreds of glowing memories float around it like lanterns in the night.

Style: premium anime film quality, emotional fantasy atmosphere, beautiful sky colors, dreamlike cinematography, nostalgic storytelling, soft lighting, floating particles, highly detailed backgrounds, magical realism, no text, no overlays.

zh.p:
暮光时段的15秒超电影感动漫奇幻片段。

一座安静的火车站孤零零地坐落在无尽云海中央，紫橙色的夕阳下。站台显得荒废，只有旧灯笼在风中轻轻摇曳。

一个穿着校服的小女孩独自站着，手里拿着一个小行李箱。她望向空荡荡的铁轨，消失在地平线上。

远处，一列神秘的火车缓缓从发光的雾气中现身。窗户散发着温暖的金色光芒。火车无声地滑过云层，仿佛漂浮在天空中。

当它抵达车站时，女孩上了车。镜头跟随她穿过火车走廊，每扇窗户展现的都是不同的记忆，而非风景。

其中一扇窗户展示了她小时候在夏日田野奔跑的样子。另一张照片显示一个下雪的冬日。另一张是被遗忘的朋友挥手告别。这些记忆如同玻璃之外的活景。

软颗粒在列车内部飘荡，夕阳的光线充满车厢。氛围充满怀旧、梦幻般且情感强烈。

女孩停在一扇窗边，窗户上露出年轻时的自己微笑着。她轻轻地把手放在玻璃上。

最后的电影时刻：火车离开车站，飞向云层中的天空，数百个发光的记忆如夜晚的灯笼般漂浮在车周围。

风格：顶级动漫电影质量，情感奇幻氛围，美丽的天空色彩，梦幻般的摄影，怀旧叙事，柔和灯光，漂浮粒子，高度细致的背景，魔幻现实主义，无文字，无叠加。

raw_p:
Alien sky above a glowing planet: two massive capital ships in a high-speed orbital duel, constantly repositioning, never stationary, supported by a small wing of elite fighters. Combat is tactical, fast, and asymmetric.  
Wide orbital shot: both ships curve along different trajectories around the planet, never aligned, trading long-range fire across distance. 
Dynamic sweep: camera arcs with one ship as it rolls to present shielded sections, deflecting incoming fire while returning calculated shots. 
Cut across space: the opposing ship accelerates laterally, changing angle, forcing shots to miss or glance off shields. 
Fighter deployment: small units launch mid-maneuver, already compensating for velocity, diving toward predicted intercept points. 
High-speed tracking: camera follows a fighter cutting diagonally across the battle, threading between long-range beams and debris. 
Near-miss moment: a capital ship’s main weapon fires slightly off-target due to motion, the beam slicing past and grazing structure instead of a direct hit. 
Tactical shift: one ship uses the planet’s curvature, dipping lower into atmosphere glow, partially obscured, forcing the other to adjust trajectory. 
Precision breach: fighters exploit a brief shield misalignment during a turn, striking a localized section without stopping the flow of battle. 
Damage response: the hit ship doesn’t stall; it rolls, vents energy, and accelerates away, stabilizing while still firing backward. 
Final escalation: both ships now on intersecting but offset paths, firing continuously while moving at high speed, the battlefield stretching across space instead of collapsing into a single point.  
No hovering, no direct standoffs, constant motion, realistic spacing, tactical positioning, momentum-driven combat, cinematic but physically grounded, high-detail sci-fi realism.

zh.p:
外星天空俯瞰着发光的星球：两艘巨大的主力舰高速轨道对决，不断调整位置，从不静止，由一支精英战斗机小队支援。战斗是战术性的、快速且不对称的。 
宽轨道射击：两艘飞船绕行星方向不同，从未对齐，远程交火。
动态扫视：一艘舰船滚动时摄像机弧线，呈现有护盾的区域，一边偏转来袭火力，一边回击精准射击。
穿越空间：对方飞船横向加速，改变角度，迫使射击失误或擦过护盾。
战斗机部署：小型单位在机动中起飞，已在补偿速度，俯冲向预测拦截点。
高速追踪：镜头跟随一架战斗机斜穿战场，穿梭于远程光束和碎片之间。
近距离命中：一艘主力舰的主武器因运动略微偏离目标，光束擦过结构而非直接命中。
战术转移：一艘飞船利用行星曲率，降低大气光芒，部分被遮挡，迫使另一艘调整航迹。
精准突破：战斗机利用回合中短暂的护盾错位，攻击局部区域而不中断战斗流。
伤害反应：被击中的飞船不会失速;它滚动、释放能量、加速远离，稳定时仍向后发射。
最终升级：两艘舰船现在走在相交但偏离的航线上，高速持续射击，战场横跨空间，而非崩塌成一点。 
没有悬停，没有直接对峙，持续移动，保持真实的间距，战术位置，以势头驱动的战斗，电影感但物理上贴近现实，高细节的科幻现实主义。

女性が操縦する白い一人乗り飛行船による、一人称視点の超高品質アニメーション映像。完成映像には赤い線・矢印・注釈・文字を一切表示しない。

白と金を基調とした壮麗な港湾都市を舞台に、カメラはFPVドローンのような一人称視点で指定ルートを超高速飛行する。

海面すれすれからスタートし、青い港を滑るように疾走。ヨットや桟橋、白い船、港湾建築の間を縫うように進みながら都市中央へ向かう。巨大な大聖堂へ加速しながら接近し、正面通過直前にメインタワー沿いを急上昇。尖塔を真下から見上げる迫力のアングルで一気に上空へ抜ける。

都市全景、港湾、遠方の山脈を見渡す壮大な俯瞰へ移行した後、塔を中心に時計回りで大きくバンクしながら旋回。白い宮殿群、青い海、橋梁、港湾施設、山並みを流れるように映し出す。

その後は都市右側上空を高速飛行しながら緩やかに下降。運河沿いの道路や広場、桟橋、金色の装飾を施した建築群の上を低空で滑空し、ガラス屋根の大型建築と港沿いの通りへ向かって駆け抜ける。

シネマティック、超高精細、圧倒的スピード感、滑らかなカメラワーク、自然なモーションブラー、リアルな空気遠近、水面反射、太陽光表現、立体的な雲、大規模ファンタジー港湾都市の壮大なスケール感を強調する。

en.p:
Ultra-high-quality first-person animated footage featuring a white single-seater airship piloted by a woman. No red lines, arrows, annotations, or text are displayed on the finished video.

Set in a magnificent port city with a white and gold theme, the camera flies at ultra-high speed along designated routes from a first-person perspective, similar to an FPV drone.

Starting just above the sea surface, you glide swiftly through the blue harbor. Winding through yachts, piers, white ships, and port architecture, you head toward the city center. It accelerates toward the massive cathedral and rapidly climbs along the main tower just before passing through directly. From a powerful angle looking up directly at the spire from below, you soar straight into the sky.

After transitioning to a magnificent overlook of the city, the harbor, and distant mountain ranges, the pagoda turns clockwise with a large bank around the tower. It reflects the flowing white palaces, blue sea, bridges, port facilities, and mountain ranges.

After that, it slowly descends while flying at high speed over the right side of the city. Glide low over canal-lined roads, squares, piers, and gold-decorated buildings, racing toward large glass-roofed buildings and the streets along the harbor.

It emphasizes cinematic, ultra-high definition, overwhelming speed, smooth camera work, natural motion blur, realistic air perspective, reflections on water surfaces, sunlight effects, three-dimensional clouds, and the grand scale of a large-scale fantasy port city.
