Title: The Woman Who Stopped Time

A vibrant city square glows beneath the warm light of golden hour, crowded with people, movement, and everyday sounds. At the center stands a captivating young street performer, dressed in a flowing dark coat, fingerless lace gloves, and a wide-brimmed hat that casts a subtle shadow over her face. Her presence is calm yet enigmatic, drawing attention without demanding it.

She slowly raises her hand, fingers extended, her gaze fixed and unwavering. With a crisp snap of her fingers, time comes to an immediate halt.

The entire square freezes in an instant. Pigeons remain suspended in midair. A man’s laughter is trapped on his face. A child hangs motionless at the peak of a jump. Coins tossed moments earlier float weightlessly like scattered fragments of light. An eerie silence settles over the scene as rose petals from a nearby flower stand linger motionless in the warm amber glow.

Moving effortlessly through the frozen world, she explores the stillness with quiet confidence. She gently straightens a woman's crooked glasses, plucks a hovering coin from the air, and gracefully spins between two motionless street vendors, a playful smile appearing on her lips. The camera glides smoothly beside her at shoulder height, drifting through the frozen city like a silent observer.

Eventually, she returns to the exact spot where it all began. She adjusts the brim of her hat, closes her eyes, and takes one slow, measured breath.

Another snap.

Time rushes back all at once. Pigeons burst into flight, conversations resume mid-sentence, laughter echoes through the square, and coins fall to the pavement with sharp metallic clinks. The crowd continues moving as though nothing unusual ever happened.

Amid the chaos, she lowers her gaze to her hand. Resting in her palm is a single gold coin she claimed from the frozen moment. A subtle, satisfied smile appears.

The camera slowly pulls away as the bustling city swallows her back into the crowd, leaving only the lingering feeling that, for a brief instant, time itself belonged to her.

zh.p:
标题：停止时间的女人

一个充满活力的城市广场在金色时分的温暖光线下熠熠生辉，人潮熙攘，日常的声音不断。中央站着一位迷人的年轻街头艺人，身穿飘逸的深色大衣，戴着无指蕾丝手套，戴着宽檐帽，帽子在脸上投下淡淡的阴影。她的气质平静却神秘，吸引着注意力却不强求。

她缓缓举起手，手指伸出，目光坚定不移。她打了个响指，时间瞬间静止。

整个广场瞬间凝固。鸽子悬浮在半空中。一个男人的笑声被困在脸上。一个孩子悬挂在跳跃的顶点一动不动。刚才投掷的硬币如散落的光片般无重漂浮。一片诡异的寂静笼罩着场景，附近花摊的玫瑰花瓣静静地停留在温暖的琥珀色光辉中。

她轻松穿行于冰封的世界，带着安静的自信探索着这片寂静。她轻轻整理一位女士歪斜的眼镜，从空中捡起一枚悬浮的硬币，优雅地在两个一动不动的街头小贩之间旋转，嘴角带着调皮的微笑。镜头在她肩高处平滑滑行，像个无声的观察者一样穿梭于冰封的城市中。

最终，她回到了一切开始的确切地点。她调整帽檐，闭上眼睛，缓缓吸了一口气。

又是一声响指。

时间一下子涌回来。鸽子飞起，谈话中断，笑声在广场回荡，硬币落地发出清脆的金属声。人群继续移动，仿佛什么异常都没发生过。

在混乱中，她低下目光看着自己的手。她掌心里放着一枚她从冰封时刻中夺取的金币。一抹微妙而满足的微笑浮现。

镜头缓缓拉开，熙攘的城市将她吞回人群，只留下那种短暂的感觉——时间本身仿佛属于她。

en.p:
Title: The Woman Who Stopped Time

A vibrant city square glows beneath the warm light of golden hour, crowded with people, movement, and everyday sounds. At the center stands a captivating young street performer, dressed in a flowing dark coat, fingerless lace gloves, and a wide-brimmed hat that casts a subtle shadow over her face. Her presence is calm yet enigmatic, drawing attention without demanding it.

She slowly raises her hand, fingers extended, her gaze fixed and unwavering. With a crisp snap of her fingers, time comes to an immediate halt.

The entire square freezes in an instant. Pigeons remain suspended in midair. A man’s laughter is trapped on his face. A child hangs motionless at the peak of a jump. Coins tossed moments earlier float weightlessly like scattered fragments of light. An eerie silence settles over the scene as rose petals from a nearby flower stand linger motionless in the warm amber glow.

Moving effortlessly through the frozen world, she explores the stillness with quiet confidence. She gently straightens a woman's crooked glasses, plucks a hovering coin from the air, and gracefully spins between two motionless street vendors, a playful smile appearing on her lips. The camera glides smoothly beside her at shoulder height, drifting through the frozen city like a silent observer.

Eventually, she returns to the exact spot where it all began. She adjusts the brim of her hat, closes her eyes, and takes one slow, measured breath.

Another snap.

Time rushes back all at once. Pigeons burst into flight, conversations resume mid-sentence, laughter echoes through the square, and coins fall to the pavement with sharp metallic clinks. The crowd continues moving as though nothing unusual ever happened.

Amid the chaos, she lowers her gaze to her hand. Resting in her palm is a single gold coin she claimed from the frozen moment. A subtle, satisfied smile appears.

The camera slowly pulls away as the bustling city swallows her back into the crowd, leaving only the lingering feeling that, for a brief instant, time itself belonged to her.

raw_p:
Ultra-realistic comedy. Modern corporate office on the 40th floor. Floor-to-ceiling glass wall overlooking a city skyline. Inspired by the viral asteroid trend. Handheld cinematic camera. Natural office audio. No background music. The asteroid event appears completely real until the twist. Fast pacing with perfect comedic timing.

⸻

0–3s — SETUP

Medium office shot.

A furious boss is standing in front of a nervous employee.

Boss points aggressively.

Boss:
“You’re useless! You’ve always been useless! Every single project—”

The employee stares silently.

Behind them, through the giant window—

A massive asteroid suddenly impacts the city in the distance.

A gigantic mushroom cloud rises.

The office trembles slightly.

⸻

3–6s — PANIC

Both men turn.

The city outside is in chaos.

Smoke.

Fire.

The shockwave begins racing toward the building.

The employee’s eyes widen.

The boss is speechless.

The glass wall starts rattling.

The shockwave is seconds away.

⸻

6–9s — THE REVENGE

The employee slowly turns toward the boss.

Years of frustration visible on his face.

Employee:
“You know what?”

WHAM.

He punches the boss directly in the face.

The boss flies backward and crashes across his desk.

Papers everywhere.

The employee straightens his shirt.

Feeling victorious.

⸻

9–12s — THE TWIST

The shockwave is almost at the building.

The employee smirks.

Accepting his fate.

The boss slowly stands up.

Holding his jaw.

Confused.

Annoyed.

He reaches onto the desk.

Picks up a remote control.

Points it at the giant “window.”

Click.

The entire city view instantly disappears.

Black screen.

The asteroid vanishes.

The mushroom cloud vanishes.

Everything was playing on a gigantic wall-sized display.

⸻

12–15s — PAYOFF

Silence.

The employee freezes.

His confidence evaporates instantly.

Employee:
“…oh no.”

He rushes over.

Falls to his knees.

Employee:
“Sir! Sir! I’m so sorry! I thought we were all dying!”

The boss slowly looks down at him.

Holding his sore jaw.

The screen behind them displays:

NO SIGNAL

Hard cut to black.

zh.p:
超现实喜剧。40层的现代企业办公室。落地玻璃墙俯瞰着城市天际线。灵感来自病毒小行星潮流。手持电影摄像机。自然的办公室音频。没有背景音乐。小行星事件看似真实，直到转折发生。节奏明快，喜剧节奏恰到好处。

⸻

0–3 — 设置

中景办公室照片。

一位愤怒的老板站在一位紧张的员工面前。

Boss咄咄逼人地指着。

老板：
“你没用！你一直都没用！每一个项目——”

员工默默地盯着。

身后，透过巨大的窗户——

一颗巨大的小行星突然撞击远处的城市。

一朵巨大的蘑菇云升起。

办公室微微颤抖。

⸻

3–6 — 恐慌

两人都转过身。

外面的城市一片混乱。

烟。

开火。

冲击波开始向建筑物飞速冲去。

员工的眼睛睁大了。

老板无言以对。

玻璃墙开始震动。

冲击波即将到来。

⸻

6–9 — 复仇

员工慢慢转向老板。

多年来的挫败写在他脸上。

员工：
“你知道吗？”

砰。

他直接打在老板脸上。

老板被撞飞，撞到了他的桌子上。

报纸到处都是。

员工整理了一下衬衫。

感到胜利。

⸻

9–12岁——扭转

冲击波快到建筑物了。

员工露出一丝得意的笑容。

接受自己的命运。

老板慢慢站了起来。

捂着下巴。

很困惑。

恼火。

他伸手去摸桌子。

拿起遥控器。

把它指向那个巨大的“窗户”。

咔嗒。

整个城市的视野瞬间消失。

黑屏。

小行星消失了。

蘑菇云消失了。

一切都在一个巨大的墙上展示。

⸻

12–15 — 回报

寂静。

员工愣住了。

他的自信瞬间消失。

员工：
“…哦不。”

他冲过去。

跪倒在地。

员工：
“先生！先生！非常抱歉！我还以为我们都快死了呢！”

老板慢慢地低头看着他。

捂着酸痛的下巴。

他们身后的屏幕显示：

无信号

画面切换到黑。

raw_p:
10-second cinematic sequence

**Camera Style:**
35mm lens look with shallow depth of field, smooth cinematic tracking shots with a subtle handheld warmth

**Lighting:**
Golden hour sunlight, warm color palette, soft natural highlights with gentle lens flare

**Environment:**
Scenic coastal highway running alongside the ocean, vintage car in motion, light sea breeze, wide open horizon

**Scene & Motion Direction:**

**0–2s:**
Wide tracking shot of a vintage car driving along a coastal road. Ocean waves roll beside the highway, sunlight shimmering on the water. Wind subtly flows through the open car windows.

**2–4s:**
Interior mid shot inside the car. A couple laughs naturally, relaxed and unposed. A cassette player is visible in frame. Their hair moves slightly with the breeze as warm sunlight softly illuminates their faces.

**4–6s:**
Cut to a roadside stop. The couple stands near a small ice cream stall, casually sharing ice cream. Their posture is relaxed, expressions soft and genuine. The ocean remains visible in the background.

**6–8s:**
Close-up shot. One of them holds a Polaroid camera and takes a quick, natural photo. The shutter moment is captured with light laughter continuing in the background.

**8–10s:**
Final shot. A Polaroid photo slowly develops in their hand, gradually revealing the image. They stand beside the vintage car with the ocean behind them, bathed in warm golden light. The camera lingers on the developing photo as the sunlight fills the frame.

**Key Realism Notes:**
Natural human interaction, no exaggerated expressions, consistent golden hour lighting throughout, realistic vehicle motion and wind behavior, and smooth, seamless transitions between shots.

zh.p:
10秒的电影片段

**相机风格：**
35mm镜头采用浅景深，镜头流畅如电影般，手持感十足

**灯光：**
金色时光，暖色调，柔和自然挑染，镜头光晕柔和

**环境：**
沿海岸公路风景优美，沿海岸线行驶，老爷车行驶，微风轻拂，辽阔地平线

**场景与动作指导：**

**0–2：**
一辆老爷车沿海岸公路行驶的广角跟踪镜头。海浪在公路旁翻滚，阳光在水面上闪烁。风微微透过敞开的车窗吹进来。

**2–4：**
车内中景。一对情侣自然地笑了，轻松自然，毫无矫揉造作。画面中可见一台磁带播放器。他们的头发随风轻轻摆动，温暖的阳光柔和地照亮了他们的脸庞。

**4–6：**
镜头切到路边的停靠点。这对情侣站在一个小冰淇淋摊旁，随意地分享着冰淇淋。他们的姿态放松，表情柔和而真诚。海洋依然隐约可见在背景中。

**6–8s：**
特写镜头。其中一个拿着宝丽来相机，快速拍了张自然的照片。快门的瞬间伴随着背景中轻笑声。

**8–10分制：**
最后一枪。一张宝丽来照片在他们手中缓缓显现，逐渐显现出图像。他们站在那辆老爷车旁，背后是海洋，沐浴在温暖的金色光芒中。镜头停留在冲洗的照片上，阳光充满画面。

**关键现实主义注意点：**
自然的人际互动，没有夸张的表情，始终如一的黄金时刻光影，车辆运动和风向行为真实，镜头间的过渡流畅无缝。

Ultra-realistic luxury skincare commercial storyboard, 12 cinematic frames arranged in a professional director's storyboard sheet. The story follows one woman throughout a full day, showing how invisible sun protection quietly supports her life without her noticing it.
Frame 1: Early morning. Woman opens curtains. Soft sunlight floods a modern apartment.
Frame 2: She waters indoor plants while sunlight hits her face naturally.
Frame 3: Close-up of sunlight passing through leaves, creating moving shadows on healthy skin.
Frame 4: Minimalist bathroom. She applies sunscreen effortlessly while checking her daily schedule.
Frame 5: Macro shot of cream disappearing instantly into skin.
Frame 6: Busy city crossing. She walks confidently among morning commuters.
Frame 7: Outdoor café meeting. Friends laugh around a table under bright daylight.
Frame 8: Rooftop lunch. Strong sunlight overhead, but she remains comfortable and confident.
Frame 9: Afternoon bicycle ride through tree-lined streets.
Frame 10: Golden-hour portrait. Natural skin texture, no makeup focus, authentic beauty.
Frame 11: Sunset reflection in a train window. Long day completed.
Frame 12: Product hero shot with tagline: “Protection So Invisible, You Forget It's There.”
Premium French pharmacy aesthetic, warm sunlight storytelling, realistic skin texture, visible pores, cinematic 35mm photography, director annotations, camera arrows, shot descriptions, luxury commercial pitch-board design, Apple advertisement quality, A24 cinematography mood, sophisticated visual narrative, ultra-realistic storyboard sheet, 8K.

超写实奢华护肤商业分镜，12帧电影画面，排列成专业导演的分镜图。故事跟随一位女性整整一天，展示了隐形防晒如何悄悄地支撑着她的生命，而她却未曾察觉。
第一帧：清晨。女人拉开窗帘。柔和的阳光洒满了现代公寓。
第二帧：她在阳光自然照射脸上时给室内植物浇水。
第3帧：阳光透过树叶，在健康皮肤上投下移动的阴影。
框架4：极简浴室。她轻松地涂抹防晒霜，同时查看每日作息。
第5帧：微距镜头，奶油瞬间消失在皮肤里。
第6帧：繁忙的城市穿越。她自信地走在早晨的通勤人群中。
第7帧：户外咖啡馆会议。朋友们在明亮的白天围坐在桌旁欢笑。
第八局：屋顶午餐。头顶阳光强烈，但她依然舒适自信。
第9帧：下午骑自行车穿过树荫街道。
第10帧：黄金时刻肖像。自然肤质，不注重妆容，纯粹的美丽。
第11帧：火车窗户上的日落倒影。漫长的一天结束了。
第12帧：产品英雄镜头，标语是：“保护如此隐形，你会忘记它的存在。”

15-second ultra-cinematic sci-fi fantasy sequence inside an infinite library orbiting a gigantic black hole in deep space.

Endless bookshelves stretch in impossible directions, curving upward and sideways under distorted gravity. Ancient books, scrolls, glowing manuscripts, and floating pages drift weightlessly between massive wooden staircases and suspended reading balconies.

The camera glides smoothly through the library as the architecture slowly rotates around the black hole visible through enormous shattered windows. The black hole bends starlight into a glowing accretion ring of gold, blue, and violet energy.

Gravity behaves strangely: books float upward, chandeliers hang sideways, dust particles spiral in slow orbit, and ink drips through the air like liquid stars.

A lone librarian figure walks calmly along a floating staircase, carrying a glowing book while pages orbit around them like tiny moons.

Mid-sequence, the black hole pulses. Shelves bend slightly, time ripples through the room, and thousands of books open by themselves, releasing luminous symbols into the air.

Final shot: the camera pulls back to reveal the entire infinite library wrapped around the black hole like a colossal ring of knowledge, glowing softly in cosmic darkness.

Style: ultra-cinematic cosmic fantasy, surreal gravity physics, impossible architecture, volumetric starlight, floating architecture, volumetric starlight, floating particles, glowing manuscripts, black hole lensing, majestic scale, no text, no overlays.

一位孤独的图书管理员平静地沿着漂浮的楼梯走着，手里拿着一本发光的书，书页像小月亮一样围绕着他们旋转。

风格与氛围: 高燃女子竞技写实主义。严酷的场馆顶光投射出强烈阴影，低饱和度色彩强化汗水与肌肉线条的对比。粗粝的手持摄影美学，突显冲击力与身体极限的张力。

 Narrative summary: In an intense MMA fight, the attackers launch a fierce attack but are ambushed. The defenders countered with a powerful low sweep, then quickly dived down to slam the opponent to the edge of the net. 

 Dynamic description: The scene cuts directly into a chaotic handheld medium shot, where fighter A launches a series of intense standing strikes, forcing fighter B to defend. The iron mesh shook violently from the violent impact.

zh.p: [条件定义]在温暖氛围的艺术家工作室里制作一段15秒的电影式延时视频。一幅空白的白色画布从一开始就站在画架上。仅将上传的1：1参考图片作为画布上最终绘画作品的主体。切勿在任何时候显示上传的参考图片本身。不要将主体作为真人、背景人物、海报、印刷图像、叠加层或现成艺术品放置在房间内。上传参考图像中的主体只能作为画布上的最终画作存在。画笔、调色刀和颜料调色板都能自主移动。色彩斑斓的颜料从调色板中升起，在空气中舞动，如烟雾、丝带、细线般的水流和活生生的笔触。最终成果应成为对上传参考图像的丰富油画诠释。[可选表演者造型]没有表演者。没有画家。没有人类的手。没有人类的手臂。没有可见的人体。所有工具都能自主移动。[射击声 / 流畅] 0-2：建立工作室。画架上的空白白色画布、调色板、画笔、颜料管、温暖的工作室灯光、微妙的创意混乱。画布完全是空的。2-5：工具开始自行移动。颜料缓缓从调色板上飘落，开始在空中舞动。5-9：快速的魔法彩绘编排。色彩轨迹在工作室中旋转、交织、旋转，如同优雅的烟雾和丝带。使用快速跳剪。画布大多保持抽象，只有部分笔触，色彩不完整，且没有可识别的主题。9-12：所有颜料的痕迹突然涌向画布。在快速的蒙太奇中，草图标记、大胆的色块、质感、高光和关键形状迅速组合起来。在本节结束前，请保持图像大多抽象且不完整。12秒内不得透露可识别的对象。12-15秒：首次清晰展示完成的画作。展示完成作品的令人满意的特写，明显基于上传的参考图片，然后是工作室中短暂的余晖。[摄影 / 剪辑]充满活力和活力。使用快速的推入镜头、轻微拉回镜头、微距特写湿颜料和刷毛、画架中景、俯视角度、侧面角度，以及每0.5到1秒快速跳切一次。中间部分应该感觉像快速的魔法蒙太奇，而不是慢速连续动作。保持画布大部分抽象，直到12秒。演播室只是场景;上传参考图像中的主体绝不能出现在画布之外。[声音]没有背景音乐。只有音效。使用令人满意的笔触、湿润的颜料移动、调色刀刮擦、颜料管挤压、柔和的呼啸声和细腻的工作室氛围。[否定]请勿将上传的参考图片作为单独的照片、屏幕、对比、海报、印刷板、叠加层或背景图像展示。请勿将上传的主体放置在画布以外的工作室内任何地方。没有上传对象的真实人版本。没有人类的手，没有人类手臂，没有画家，没有表演者焦点，没有多人，没有卡通人物，没有吉祥物，没有文字，没有字幕，没有数字，没有屏幕上的时间戳文字，没有标志，没有水印，没有签名，没有分屏，没有海报布局，没有静态单角度镜头，没有最终画作的早期全面揭示，没有未完成的结局。

她优雅地在星空间漂浮，镜头缓缓拉近红色高跟鞋。它们在宇宙背景下闪耀，成为众人瞩目的焦点。屏幕渐渐变黑。品牌标志出现，标语为：“寻找你的宝藏”。高端奢侈鞋类广告，令人难忘的广告结尾，电影般的产品英雄镜头

raw_p:
Single continuous cinematic shot on a stormy beach under heavy overcast skies, dark clouds moving fast, strong ocean wind whipping sand and loose fabric through the air, dramatic cold blue-gray color grading, realistic professional film look. The camera begins with a low tracking shot across wet beach sand filled with scattered colorful beach toys and abandoned umbrellas trembling in the wind. A small droplet of liquid aluminum suddenly glides rapidly across the sand with unnatural motion, highly reflective chrome surface, moving silently between the toys without leaving any trail behind.
The camera smoothly follows beside the metallic droplet in one uninterrupted motion as it accelerates toward a relaxed man sitting alone on a beach chair near the shoreline. Waves crash violently in the background, wind roaring loudly. The droplet instantly crawls onto his hand like living mercury. Extreme close-up as the reflective silver substance rapidly spreads across his skin. The man suddenly jolts in shock, breathing heavily, stumbling to his feet in panic while desperately trying to shake the substance off. Handheld camera movement intensifies slightly to emphasize fear and chaos.
The liquid metal continues expanding across both arms, chest, neck, and face with realistic organic motion, forming a seamless silver shell around his entire body. His movements become slower and more desperate until he freezes completely like a metallic statue standing in the middle of the windy beach. Background people begin noticing him, confused and frightened. The camera slowly circles around the motionless silver figure while wind blows sand violently across the frame and distant thunder rumbles.
Suddenly, thin glowing cracks emerge across the silver shell with faint purple light leaking from within. The camera pushes in slowly as the cracks rapidly spread louder and louder. In a violent explosive burst, the silver shell shatters outward into metallic fragments flying through the air in slow motion, revealing a terrifying monstrous creature radiating intense purple aura and smoke-like energy. The monster unleashes a massive roar directly toward camera while purple energy pulses around its body. Nearby beachgoers scream and run away in terror, some falling into the sand as umbrellas and beach objects are blown away by the wind. The camera pulls backward shakily while maintaining focus on the roaring monster standing alone against the dark stormy ocean backdrop, cinematic atmosphere, hyper realistic visual effects, dramatic lighting, intense tension, immersive film quality.

zh.p:
单一连续镜头，在暴风雨交加的海滩上，阴沉的天空，乌云飞速移动，强劲的海风吹起沙子和松散的布料，戏剧性的冷蓝灰色调色，逼真的专业电影风格。镜头从低沉的跟踪镜头开始，穿过湿润的海滩沙滩，沙滩上散落着色彩斑斓的海滩玩具和被风中摇晃的废弃伞。一小滴铝液突然以不自然的动作快速滑过沙子，高度反光的铬表面无声地穿梭于玩具间，毫无痕迹。
镜头顺畅地跟随金属水滴，一气呵成地加速，朝着一位独自坐在海岸边沙滩椅上的放松男子拍摄。背景中海浪猛烈拍打，风声呼啸。水滴立刻像活水银一样爬到他的手上。极近距离，反射的银色物质迅速蔓延到他的皮肤上。那人突然惊跳，喘着粗气，惊慌地站起身，拼命想甩掉那种物质。手持摄像机的运动稍微增强，以突出恐惧和混乱。
液态金属继续在双臂、胸部、颈部和脸部以逼真的有机运动扩散，形成一层无缝的银色外壳包裹全身。他的动作变得缓慢而绝望，直到他像一座金属雕像一样僵住，站在风吹的海滩中央。背景中的人开始注意到他，困惑且害怕。镜头缓缓环绕着那个静止的银色身影，风猛烈吹动沙粒，远处雷声隆隆作响。

Single continuous cinematic shot on a stormy beach under heavy overcast skies, dark clouds moving fast, strong ocean wind whipping sand and loose fabric through the air, dramatic cold blue-gray color grading, realistic professional film look. The camera smoothly follows beside the metallic droplet in one uninterrupted motion as it accelerates toward a relaxed man sitting alone on a beach chair near the shoreline. Waves crash violently in the background, wind roaring loudly. The droplet instantly crawls onto his hand like living mercury. Extreme close-up as the reflective silver substance rapidly spreads across his skin. The man suddenly jolts in shock, breathing heavily, stumbling to his feet in panic while desperately trying to shake the substance off. Handheld camera movement intensifies slightly to emphasize fear and chaos.
The liquid metal continues expanding across both arms, chest, neck, and face with realistic organic motion, forming a seamless silver shell around his entire body. His movements become slower and more desperate until he freezes completely like a metallic statue standing in the middle of the windy beach. Background people begin noticing him, confused and frightened. The camera slowly circles around the motionless silver figure while wind blows sand violently across the frame and distant thunder rumbles.
Suddenly, thin glowing cracks emerge across the silver shell with faint purple light leaking from within. The camera pushes in slowly as the cracks rapidly spread louder and louder. In a violent explosive burst, the silver shell shatters outward into metallic fragments flying through the air in slow motion, revealing a terrifying monstrous creature radiating intense purple aura and smoke-like energy. The monster unleashes a massive roar directly toward camera while purple energy pulses around its body. Nearby beachgoers scream and run away in terror, some falling into the sand as umbrellas and beach objects are blown away by the wind. The camera pulls backward shakily while maintaining focus on the roaring monster standing alone against the dark stormy ocean backdrop, cinematic atmosphere, hyper realistic visual effects, dramatic lighting, intense tension, immersive film quality.

Energy particles and light trails swirl around her. She stands up powerfully.

经典的90年代迪士尼动画风格。

场景一：在埃及的一座宫殿里，镜头切换到王座厅内部，我们看到：威严的胡狼神阿努比斯端坐在王座上，一群下属（士兵、顾问和一些卑微的仆人，都是人类）跪在他面前。他漫不经心地挥了挥手，轻蔑地对他们说：“现在离开。”然后便懒洋洋地靠回王座，一副百无聊赖的样子。

场景二：下属们毫不犹豫地遵从他的命令，缓缓离去，阿努比斯注视着他们。但最后一个，一个卑微的人类仆人，阿努比斯却特意吩咐道：“你，仆人，等等。”仆人转过身来，一脸困惑和惊讶，不明白威严的阿努比斯究竟想要什么。

场景三：其他下属都已离开，阿努比斯说：“过来。”仆人有些紧张，仍然一头雾水，走向阿努比斯。

场景4：阿努比斯从王座后取出一束鲜花，神情漫不经心地将花束递到一脸惊讶的仆人面前。他微微侧过头，略显尴尬，不愿直视仆人的眼睛，说道：“拿着吧。”

场景5：仆人接过花束，脸上依然带着困惑。阿努比斯仍然没有看向他，挥了挥手，说道：“你可以走了。”仆人点点头，拿着花束，一脸茫然地离开了。

场景6：阿努比斯目送仆人离去，脸上依旧是漫不经心的表情，但嘴角却浮现出一丝微笑。他手托着下巴，目送仆人离去，似乎对这位仆人颇有好感。

阿努比斯肌肉发达，手臂、脖子和脖子上都戴着环和耳环。他赤裸着上身。他的声音低沉而富有磁性。语音为英文。

en.p:
Classic 90s Disney animation style.

Scene 1: In a palace in Egypt, the camera cuts to the interior of the throne hall, where we see: the majestic jackal god Anubis sits on the throne, with a group of subordinates (soldiers, advisors, and some humble servants, all human) kneeling before him. He waved his hand nonchalantly and said to them with contempt, "Leave now." Then he lazily leaned back against the throne, looking utterly bored.

Scene 2: The subordinates obeyed his orders without hesitation and left slowly, with Anubis watching them. But the last one, a humble human servant, Anubis specifically instructed, "You, servant, wait." The servant turned around, confused and surprised, not understanding what the majestic Anubis really wanted.

Scene 3: The other subordinates have all left. Anubis says, "Come here." The servant was a bit nervous and still confused, and walked toward Anubis.

Scene 4: Anubis takes out a bouquet of flowers from behind the throne and casually hands it to a surprised servant. He turned his head slightly, looking a bit embarrassed, unwilling to meet the servant's gaze, and said, "Take it." ”

Scene 5: The servant takes the bouquet, still looking puzzled. Anubis still didn't look at him, waved his hand, and said, "You may go now." The servant nodded, took the bouquet, and left with a confused look.

Scene 6: Anubis watches the servant leave, his face still nonchalant, but a faint smile appears at the corner of his mouth. He rested his chin on his hand, watching the servant leave, seemingly quite fond of her.

Anubis is muscular, wearing rings and earrings on his arms, neck, and neck. He was bare-chested. His voice was deep and magnetic. The audio is in English.

en.p:
Character reference:

Using character reference image 1 as the bald male MMA fighter.

Using Character Reference Figure 2 as a plus-size female MMA fighter.

Overall style:

Ultra-realistic AI sports broadcast texture, professional MMA octagonal cage fight scene, UFC style but not realistically legible logo, handheld camera angle around the cage, shallow depth of field, foreground with a blurred iron cage grid, strong arena ceiling light, dark spectator seats, realistic match mat texture, slow-motion impact moments, real sweat, hair toss, glove leather texture, skin texture, and body weight sensitivity. The visuals look like MMA highlight clips on social media—no subtitles, no funny text stickers, no watermarks.

Shot 1 (0-4 seconds)

Main Body:

A bald male MMA fighter faces off against a plus-size female MMA fighter in an octagonal cage. Their clothing, faces, and body types strictly follow Character Images A and Character Images B.

Actions:

0-1 second: Both moved closer to the cage to probe, raised their hands to protect their faces, and lowered their bodies slightly, just like the start of a real MMA match.

1-2 seconds: The bald male athlete suddenly steps to the left, spinning his body to build strength, his waist and hips quickly moving his legs, with the camera quickly following his turn.

2-4 seconds: He executed a spinning side kick, landing a full-size female contestant in the abdomen. The moment of impact, she entered slight slow motion, with her abdomen and body experiencing real impact feedback, her body swaying sideways and backward, hair and sweat droplets flying under the arena lights. She still maintains a very large figure and does not lose weight.

Environment:

Black iron cage grid, octagonal cage floor, blurred spectator stands, blue and white corner post mats, strong ceiling lighting, and a realistic match atmosphere.

Lens:

Low-mounted cage mid-shot, front iron cage slightly blurred, 50mm sports lens, fast lateral following, turning and side kick, slight slow-motion at the moment of impact.

Lens 2 (4-9 seconds)

Main Body:

The same bald male contestant and the same plus-size female contestant had identical clothing, faces, and body types exactly the same. Plus-size women must maintain a super heavyweight volume, wide torso, full abdomen, and thick, strong legs.

Actions:

4-6 seconds: After being kicked, plus-size female athletes retreat to the edge of the cage, raising both hands to protect their faces, looking both annoyed and pained, trying to stand again and press back.

6-8 seconds: The bald male fighter quickly closed in, lowered his center of gravity, and delivered a short left hook to the side of her face.

8-9 seconds: At the moment of impact, slight slow-motion occurs, real compression of cheeks, hair flutters, and sweat mist spreads under the top light. She was forced to continue toward the corner pillar, her body heavily colliding with the iron cage.

Environment:

The octagonal cage corner area features an iron cage grid occupying part of the foreground, with blurred background for the audience and photographer, and the corner post mat close to the right side of the frame.

Lens:

Handheld medium and close-up, slightly shaking, like a real broadcast cameraman tracking action outside the cage. The moment of strike is a brief slow-motion effect, then returns to normal speed.

Lens 3 (9-15 seconds)

Main Body:

The same bald MMA fighter cornered the same plus-size female MMA fighter against the corner post. Plus-size women must maintain a very large super heavyweight physique, with round faces, double chins, broad torsos, full abdomens, thick legs, and a clearly visible overall sense of weight. In the footage, a male referee appears, wearing a black short-sleeved referee uniform, black pants, and black gloves, initially standing at the edge of the background to observe the game.

Actions:

9-10.5 seconds: Plus-size female athletes lean against the iron cage and corner posts, raise both hands to protect their heads, and tighten their bodies to defend. The bald male fighter pressed close to her, delivering a series of short-range punches, with the gauntlet striking her armguard, shoulder, and side of her body. The movements are fast and intimidating, but not bloody.

10.5-12 seconds: The bald male player steps back half a step, then suddenly charges forward again, delivering a powerful close-range strike. The plus-size female contestant's defense was shattered, her body lost balance, her shoulder slammed backward against the cage, and her hair and sweat were thrown up by the impact.

12-13.5 seconds: Plus-size female contestants slide down along the cage and corner posts, first bending their knees, then heavily sit down onto the octagonal cage mat. She leaned against the iron cage, her hands still half-covering her head, her expression dazed and painful, her body size and weight very obvious. The bald male fighter stopped his movement, standing half a step in front of her, his gloves still raised.

13.5-15 seconds: The referee quickly emerges from the back of the screen, enters between two competitors, gestures for the bald male contestant to stop attacking, and looks down to check the plus-size female contestant who has fallen. The camera slightly zooms in to the fallen contestant, the bald male player, and the referee all together. The final second stopped at a live MMA broadcast footage: plus-size female fighters collapsed by the cage, referees intervened, and bald male fighters stepped back.

Environment:

Black iron cage, blue-and-white corner post mats, dark spectator seats, strong arena ceiling light, blurred foreground net, and a realistic match mat texture on the ground. Keep the visuals of a professional MMA match scene, and don't suddenly switch to street fights, stage performances, or training halls.

Lens:

The cage side holds the broadcast camera, moving from medium to medium shots. At 9-12 seconds, the camera slightly shakes following the combo punch; at 12-13.5 seconds, it slides down with plus-size female contestants; at 13.5 seconds, the referee enters the frame with a slight horizontal pan, capturing the judge, downed fighter, and bald male contestant. Finally, maintain a documentary sports broadcast feel and avoid overly dramatic freeze-frame filming.

Movement Restraints:

All strikes are sporting movements—no blood, no fractures, no serious wounds. The focus is on speed, impact, imbalance, falls, body weight, referee involvement, and a real live broadcast experience. Plus-size female athletes cannot become thin when they fall, cannot become ordinary female athletes, cannot float, and must have a real sense of weight as if sitting heavily on the ground.

raw_p: 아이폰으로 촬영한 보정되지 않은 핸드헬드 영상 스타일로 제작되었으며, 모든 카메라 설정은 자동이고 색 보정이나 특수 효과는 후처리되지 않았습니다. 영상에는 실제 핸드헬드 촬영 특유의 미세한 흔들림과 촬영자의 숨소리가 담겨 있으며, 자동 초점의 탐색 및 지연 현상과 따뜻한 자연광과 주변 그림자 사이를 자연스럽게 전환하는 자동 화이트 밸런스가 특징입니다. 전체적인 이미지는 평면적이며, 사실적인 렌즈 플레어, 약간의 과다 노출, 모션 블러가 그대로 표현되어 있습니다. 바람 소리, 멀리서 들려오는 새소리, 오두막 내부 소리, 미묘한 여성의 숨소리 등 카메라에 내장된 자연스러운 주변 음향 효과만 사용되었습니다. 1인칭 시점의 핸드헬드 촬영으로 카메라 움직임은 자연스럽고 피사체의 움직임을 역동적으로 따라가며, 장면 변화에 따라 앵글이 조정됩니다. 젊은 아시아 여성의 외모는 [hf_20260531_070256_ba357bcb-4f12-41b9-8c19-c74da1eb1603]에서, 그녀의 옷과 배경은 [image_20260527072336_306_19(1)]에서 완전히 참조되었습니다. 그녀는 시골 오두막 안에 서 있었고, 검은 머리는 올려 묶은 스타일이었으며, 검은색 긴팔 크롭탑과 검은색 꽃무늬 스커트를 입고 반짝이는 하이힐을 신고 있었습니다. 배경에는 누더기 커튼, 나무 테이블, 커다란 테라코타 화분, 그리고 여러 가지 잡동사니가 있었고, 왼쪽에서 들어오는 자연광이 소박하고 따뜻한 분위기를 자아냈습니다. 0초에 카메라는 미디엄 샷으로 그녀에게 초점을 맞추었습니다. 그녀는 프레임 중앙에 서서 손을 자연스럽게 옆구리에 늘어뜨리고 있었고, 표정은 차분하면서도 약간 사색에 잠긴 듯했습니다. 부드럽고 따뜻한, 애틋한 감성이 담긴 여성의 목소리가 들려왔다. "억울한 일이 있을 때, 왜 어떤 사람들은 허공에 대고 반항하는지 아세요?" 1초 후, 그녀는 천천히 고개를 숙여 땅을 바라보았다. 눈빛은 멍했고, 몸은 무언가를 떠올리는 듯 살짝 흔들렸다. 그러다 천천히 몸을 돌려 왼쪽의 누더기 커튼 쪽으로 걸어갔다. 카메라가 옆에서 그녀를 따라갔다. 2초 후, 목소리는 더욱 부드럽고 온화해졌다. "어렸을 때, 할아버지와 함께 마당에서 채소에 물을 주곤 했어요. 할아버지는 물을 주면서 작은 소리로 욕을 중얼거렸는데, 무슨 욕이었는지는 모르겠어요." 그녀는 커튼으로 걸어가 창밖을 내다보았다. 입술은 살짝 오므리고 있었다. 카메라가 뒤에서 살짝 줌인했다. 4초 후, 그녀는 고개를 들었다. 눈에는 혼란과 슬픔이 가득했고, 몸을 돌려 천천히 나무 테이블 쪽으로 걸어갔다. 카메라가 옆에서 그녀를 따라갔다. 내레이션은 계속된다. 목소리는 여전히 부드럽다. "나중에 저는 학교를 그만두고, 일을 하고, 결혼하고, 이혼했어요. 어느 날, 음식을 배달하러 가는 길에 갑자기 허공에 대고 욕을 하기 시작했죠." 6초, 그녀는 나무 탁자로 걸어가 몸을 살짝 앞으로 기울인다. 손은 탁자 가장자리에 가볍게 얹고, 시선은 약간 흐릿해진다. 입술은 마치 허공에 속삭이듯 움직이고, 억눌린 감정이 가득한 표정을 짓는다. 카메라가 그녀의 어깨 위에서 줌인한다. 8초, 그녀는 천천히 몸을 바로 세우고, 시선은 부드러워지며, 안도감이 감도는 듯 입꼬리가 살짝 올라간다. 그녀는 몸을 돌려 커다란 토기 항아리 쪽으로 걸어가고, 카메라가 뒤에서 그녀를 따라간다. 내레이션은 계속된다. 이해심 많고 부드러운 어조로. "욕을 하는 순간, 문득 할아버지 생각이 났어요. 그 순간, 할아버지는 남에게 욕을 하는 분이 아니었다는 걸 깨달았죠." 11초, 그녀는 항아리로 걸어가 고개를 살짝 들고 카메라를 똑바로 바라보았다. 그녀의 눈빛은 차분하고 온화했으며, 이해와 안도감이 가득했다. 카메라가 천천히 옆에서 그녀의 얼굴로 이동했다. 부드럽고 진솔한 목소리로 내레이션이 마무리되었다. "그는 자신을 저주하고 있었습니다. 억울한 일을 당했지만 어떻게 맞서 싸워야 할지 몰랐던 자신을." 13초, 그녀는 몸을 살짝 이완했지만 시선은 여전히 ​​카메라에 고정되어 있었고, 입가에는 희미하고 온화한 미소가 걸려 있었다. 그녀는 천천히 화면 중앙으로 걸어왔다. 14초, 카메라가 살짝 흔들렸다. 그녀는 여전히 서 있었고, 표정은 차분하고 안도되어 있었다. 15초, 따뜻하고 자연스러운 빛 속에서 장면은 자연스럽게 끝났다. 이 영상은 아이폰으로 손으로 들고 촬영한 영상 특유의 사실적이고 보정되지 않은 모습, 다큐멘터리 수준의 자연스러운 불완전함을 보여주었으며, 후반 작업에서 색 보정이나 특수 효과를 전혀 사용하지 않았다. 모든 카메라 움직임은 실제 시골 통나무집에서 손으로 들고 촬영했을 때의 물리적 특성을 반영했다. 내레이션은 부드럽고 섬세한 감정을 담은 여성의 목소리로, 마치 그녀가 자신의 이야기를 조용히 들려주는 듯하다. 카메라 앵글은 주인공의 위치에 따라 자연스럽게 변화한다.

en.p: 아이폰으로 촬영한 보정되지 않은 핸드헬드 영상 스타일로 제작되었으며, 모든 카메라 설정은 자동이고 색 보정이나 특수 효과는 후처리되지 않았습니다. 영상에는 실제 핸드헬드 촬영 특유의 미세한 흔들림과 촬영자의 숨소리가 담겨 있으며, 자동 초점의 탐색 및 지연 현상과 따뜻한 자연광과 주변 그림자 사이를 자연스럽게 전환하는 자동 화이트 밸런스가 특징입니다. 전체적인 이미지는 평면적이며, 사실적인 렌즈 플레어, 약간의 과다 노출, 모션 블러가 그대로 표현되어 있습니다. 바람 소리, 멀리서 들려오는 새소리, 오두막 내부 소리, 미묘한 여성의 숨소리 등 카메라에 내장된 자연스러운 주변 음향 효과만 사용되었습니다. 1인칭 시점의 핸드헬드 촬영으로 카메라 움직임은 자연스럽고 피사체의 움직임을 역동적으로 따라가며, 장면 변화에 따라 앵글이 조정됩니다. 젊은 아시아 여성의 외모는 [hf_20260531_070256_ba357bcb-4f12-41b9-8c19-c74da1eb1603]에서, 그녀의 옷과 배경은 [image_20260527072336_306_19(1)]에서 완전히 참조되었습니다. 그녀는 시골 오두막 안에 서 있었고, 검은 머리는 올려 묶은 스타일이었으며, 검은색 긴팔 크롭탑과 검은색 꽃무늬 스커트를 입고 반짝이는 하이힐을 신고 있었습니다. 배경에는 누더기 커튼, 나무 테이블, 커다란 테라코타 화분, 그리고 여러 가지 잡동사니가 있었고, 왼쪽에서 들어오는 자연광이 소박하고 따뜻한 분위기를 자아냈습니다. 0초에 카메라는 미디엄 샷으로 그녀에게 초점을 맞추었습니다. 그녀는 프레임 중앙에 서서 손을 자연스럽게 옆구리에 늘어뜨리고 있었고, 표정은 차분하면서도 약간 사색에 잠긴 듯했습니다. 부드럽고 따뜻한, 애틋한 감성이 담긴 여성의 목소리가 들려왔다. "억울한 일이 있을 때, 왜 어떤 사람들은 허공에 대고 반항하는지 아세요?" 1초 후, 그녀는 천천히 고개를 숙여 땅을 바라보았다. 눈빛은 멍했고, 몸은 무언가를 떠올리는 듯 살짝 흔들렸다. 그러다 천천히 몸을 돌려 왼쪽의 누더기 커튼 쪽으로 걸어갔다. 카메라가 옆에서 그녀를 따라갔다. 2초 후, 목소리는 더욱 부드럽고 온화해졌다. "어렸을 때, 할아버지와 함께 마당에서 채소에 물을 주곤 했어요. 할아버지는 물을 주면서 작은 소리로 욕을 중얼거렸는데, 무슨 욕이었는지는 모르겠어요." 그녀는 커튼으로 걸어가 창밖을 내다보았다. 입술은 살짝 오므리고 있었다. 카메라가 뒤에서 살짝 줌인했다. 4초 후, 그녀는 고개를 들었다. 눈에는 혼란과 슬픔이 가득했고, 몸을 돌려 천천히 나무 테이블 쪽으로 걸어갔다. 카메라가 옆에서 그녀를 따라갔다. 내레이션은 계속된다. 목소리는 여전히 부드럽다. "나중에 저는 학교를 그만두고, 일을 하고, 결혼하고, 이혼했어요. 어느 날, 음식을 배달하러 가는 길에 갑자기 허공에 대고 욕을 하기 시작했죠." 6초, 그녀는 나무 탁자로 걸어가 몸을 살짝 앞으로 기울인다. 손은 탁자 가장자리에 가볍게 얹고, 시선은 약간 흐릿해진다. 입술은 마치 허공에 속삭이듯 움직이고, 억눌린 감정이 가득한 표정을 짓는다. 카메라가 그녀의 어깨 위에서 줌인한다. 8초, 그녀는 천천히 몸을 바로 세우고, 시선은 부드러워지며, 안도감이 감도는 듯 입꼬리가 살짝 올라간다. 그녀는 몸을 돌려 커다란 토기 항아리 쪽으로 걸어가고, 카메라가 뒤에서 그녀를 따라간다. 내레이션은 계속된다. 이해심 많고 부드러운 어조로. "욕을 하는 순간, 문득 할아버지 생각이 났어요. 그 순간, 할아버지는 남에게 욕을 하는 분이 아니었다는 걸 깨달았죠." 11초, 그녀는 항아리로 걸어가 고개를 살짝 들고 카메라를 똑바로 바라보았다. 그녀의 눈빛은 차분하고 온화했으며, 이해와 안도감이 가득했다. 카메라가 천천히 옆에서 그녀의 얼굴로 이동했다. 부드럽고 진솔한 목소리로 내레이션이 마무리되었다. "그는 자신을 저주하고 있었습니다. 억울한 일을 당했지만 어떻게 맞서 싸워야 할지 몰랐던 자신을." 13초, 그녀는 몸을 살짝 이완했지만 시선은 여전히 ​​카메라에 고정되어 있었고, 입가에는 희미하고 온화한 미소가 걸려 있었다. 그녀는 천천히 화면 중앙으로 걸어왔다. 14초, 카메라가 살짝 흔들렸다. 그녀는 여전히 서 있었고, 표정은 차분하고 안도되어 있었다. 15초, 따뜻하고 자연스러운 빛 속에서 장면은 자연스럽게 끝났다. 이 영상은 아이폰으로 손으로 들고 촬영한 영상 특유의 사실적이고 보정되지 않은 모습, 다큐멘터리 수준의 자연스러운 불완전함을 보여주었으며, 후반 작업에서 색 보정이나 특수 효과를 전혀 사용하지 않았다. 모든 카메라 움직임은 실제 시골 통나무집에서 손으로 들고 촬영했을 때의 물리적 특성을 반영했다. 내레이션은 부드럽고 섬세한 감정을 담은 여성의 목소리로, 마치 그녀가 자신의 이야기를 조용히 들려주는 듯하다. 카메라 앵글은 주인공의 위치에 따라 자연스럽게 변화한다.

zh.p:
一位身穿极其奢华的金色王室服饰、头戴宝石皇冠的男子，整支视频中都以自信的史努比·道格式自信摇摆说唱。
场景1：低角度慢镜头，进入一座宏伟奢华的宫殿，大理石柱子和金色吊灯，他自信地直视镜头说唱。
场景2：360度轨道拍摄，他漫步在一座盛开的花朵、金色喷泉和郁郁葱葱的皇家花园中，他用酷炫的风格轻快地说唱。
场景3：荷兰人用角度横向跟踪镜头，走过一个未来感十足的皇家市场，那里满是发光的金色摊位、异国商品和富有商贩鞠躬、带着街头风采的说唱。
场景4：广角开场镜头，随后快速戏剧性地拉近他的脸部，他走过一个巨大的皇家庭院，院子两旁排列着全副武装的皇家卫兵，立正站立。
场景5：鸟瞰缓缓俯视，露出他坐在华丽镶宝石宝座上的他，身着优雅奢华朴素皇室礼服的美丽女子站在两侧，用金色扇子扇动他，他以极致的国王能量说唱。
音乐：西海岸嘻哈节拍，重贝斯，慢滚G-funk风格，类似Snoop Dogg和Dr. Dre，深沉的808踢鼓，顺滑的合成器旋律，皇家管弦乐叠加在节拍之上，快速的说唱流畅，充满活力且有力。
角色演唱的歌词：“我是坐上王座的国王，王冠闪耀着光芒 我的王国如此富饶，一切都很美好 我的人民不乞讨，他们每天都在笑 正义与黄金，是的，我们就是这样生活 从宫殿到市场，荣耀尽显 我是这一切的国王——而且它将永远存在！”
电影般的4K、超奢华、动态的镜头运动、金色戏剧灯光、史诗般的王室氛围、与说唱节奏同步的快节奏剪辑。

を基に、15秒、横型16:9の高品質な動画を作成してください。テーマは「実写映像とエフェクトの共存」。全体として、東京の街並みを舞台にした、テンポが速く、爽快感があり、実写風景の中にカラフルな動くエフェクトが自然に溶け込む映像にしてください。静止画のスライドショーにはせず、各カットの中でカメラもエフェクトも確実に動いている、映像として気持ちの良いモンタージュにしてください。映像全体の方向性：実写ベースの東京風景。青空、電柱、電線、交差点、鳥居、路地、川沿い、電車、水辺、公園、夕景を用いた都市モンタージュ。実写の中に、2D的なカラフルなリボン軌跡、紙吹雪、図形、白い手描き風の記号線、矢印、円弧、点線、軌道線、軽いスケッチ風オーバーレイが共存する。エフェクトは画面の上に貼りついて見えるのではなく、実際の空間の遠近感や流れに沿って存在し、実写の奥行きに馴染んで見えるようにする。エフェクトはそれぞれが独立し、個性的な動きをしている。全体として、爽やかで軽やか、少し詩的で、街そのものが生きているような印象。過剰にSFやサイバーにはしない。明るい昼の透明感と、終盤の夕景の余韻を大切にする。カット構成：1カット目：東京の大通り。奥に東京スカイツリーが見える広めのストリートビュー。ローアングル気味。街並みと電線の奥行き。カラフルなリボン状エフェクトが道路に沿って流れ、紙吹雪と白い線が空気中に舞う。ゆるく前進するカメラ。2カット目：都市の中の大きな鳥居。道路標識や街の看板と鳥居が共存する不思議な構図。リボンエフェクトが鳥居をくぐるように走り抜ける。素早いパン気味のカメラ。3カット目：歩行者用信号機の超寄り。青空を背景に、信号機の緑の歩行マークが印象的に見える。周囲に道路標識。白い手描き線、円弧、粒子、図形が信号の周囲で軽やかに動く。寄りから少し煽る。4カット目：電柱と大量の電線を見上げるローアングル。空を大きく見せる。ピンク、水色、黄色、白のリボンエフェクトが電線の流れと絡み合いながら空間を横切る。紙片や小さな図形も風に流れる。カメラは見上げながらわずかに回り込む。5カット目：交差点を俯瞰気味に見下ろす。道路標識が多く、道路のラインに沿ってエフェクトが流れる。交差点の動線を強調するようにリボン軌跡が走る。テンポの良いカット。6カット目：桜の咲く川沿い。花と水辺、遊歩道、東京の街。リボン状エフェクトが遊歩道から川沿いへ自然につながる。花びら、紙吹雪、白いスケッチ線が春風のように舞う。少し穏やかな横移動。7カット目：白背景に近いスケッチ風の抽象化カット。川沿いの風景を線画化したような印象。実写から一瞬だけ2D世界へ移行したような演出。細い線、手描きの軌道線、軽い図形、音符のような記号が流れる。短く印象的に。8カット目：細い路地。赤い自販機、路地の奥行き、店先や植物。リボンエフェクトが路地を縫うように流れる。白い記号線が点在。カメラは前へ抜けるように進む。9カット目：踏切と走る電車。踏切の警報機や遮断機、車体のスピード感。リボンと紙片エフェクトが列車の通過に巻き込まれるように流れる。ダイナミックな斜め構図。10カット目：水辺の遊歩道。花壇と柵、遠くの都市景観、広い空。エフェクトは少し広がりを見せ、白いラインが空へ抜ける。ここで少し開放感を出す。11カット目：公園の池。水鳥、木々、奥に都市。穏やかで静かな空気感の中にも、細い白い線や淡い紙吹雪、やわらかなリボンの余韻が漂う。やや俯瞰からゆるく移動。12カット目：夕方の水辺と都市のシルエット。空に大きく弧を描くリボンエフェクト。夕陽の反射。ここは一番詩的で余韻のある締め。カメラは静かに前進、またはゆるく横移動して終わる。演出・編集：テンポの良い高速カット構成。各カットは短めだが、映像として繋がりが気持ちよく見えるように、リボンエフェクトや進行方向、空の色、被写体の流れでマッチカットを作る。寄り、超接写、ローアングル、俯瞰、斜め構図、前進移動、素早いパンを織り交ぜる。ただし、カメラが暴れすぎて見づらくならないよう、爽快感と視認性を両立する。実写の質感は保ちつつ、2.5次元的に、実写の中へアニメ的エフェクトが自然に入り込んでいる印象にする。画作り：高品質、シネマティック、明るい自然光、透明感のある青空、繊細な街のディテール、清潔感のある色彩設計。エフェクトはピンク、水色、黄色、白を中心に、軽やかで爽やかな色設計。エフェクト量はしっかり多めだが、被写体を見失うほどの過密にはしない。実写とエフェクトが対立せず、同じ世界に存在しているように見せること。重要事項：静止画のスライドショー禁止。各カット内で確実にカメラとエフェクトが動くこと。文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは一切入れない。過度なノイズ、ぐにゃぐにゃした形状崩れ、不自然な点滅、破綻した文字表現は禁止。実写風景の中に動くエフェクトが自然に共存する、爽快で美しい15秒映像にしてください。

en.p: {{Image 1}} = Storyboard reference. Based on the attached storyboard image {{Image 1}}, create a high-quality 15-second, landscape 16:9 video. The theme is 'Coexistence of Live-Action Footage and Effects.' Overall, create a fast-paced, exhilarating video set against the streets of Tokyo, where colorful moving effects naturally blend into the live-action scenery. Don't make it a slideshow of still images; make each montage a visually appealing montage where both the camera and effects are clearly moving. Overall direction of the video: Tokyo scenery based on live-action. An urban montage using blue skies, utility poles, power lines, intersections, torii gates, alleys, riversides, trains, waterfronts, parks, and evening views. Within the live-action, colorful 2D ribbon trails, confetti, shapes, white hand-drawn symbol lines, arrows, arcs, dotted lines, track lines, and light sketch-style overlays coexist. Effects are not visible as sticking to the screen, but rather exist along the perspective and flow of the actual space, blending seamlessly with the depth of the real shot. Each effect is independent and moves with unique characteristics. Overall, it feels refreshing, light, slightly poetic, and feels as if the city itself is alive. We won't overdo it with science fiction or cyber elements. I cherish the clarity of the bright daytime and the lingering afterglow of the evening scenery toward the end. Cut structure: First cut: A main street in Tokyo. A spacious street view with Tokyo Skytree visible in the background. Slightly low-angle. The cityscape and the depth of the power lines. Colorful ribbon-like effects flow along the road, with confetti and white lines dancing in the air. The camera moves forward slowly. Second shot: A large torii gate in the city. A strange composition where road signs, town signs, and torii gates coexist. The ribbon effect runs through the torii gate. A fast, pan-like camera. Third shot: Very close to the pedestrian traffic light. Against the blue sky, the green walking mark of the traffic light stands out strikingly. Road signs around it. White hand-drawn lines, arcs, particles, and shapes move gracefully around the signal. A bit of provocation from the sidelines. Fourth cut: Low angle looking up at utility poles and numerous power lines. Make the sky appear larger. Pink, light blue, yellow, and white ribbon effects intertwine with the flow of power lines as they cross the space. Scraps of paper and small shapes also drift in the wind. The camera looks up and slightly circles around. Shot 5: Overlooking the intersection from above. There are many road signs, and effects play along the road lines. A ribbon trail runs to emphasize the traffic flow at the intersection. A well-paced cut. Sixth cut: Along the river where cherry blossoms bloom. Flowers, watersides, promenades, and the streets of Tokyo. A ribbon-shaped effect naturally connects from the promenade to the riverside. Petals, confetti, and white sketch lines flutter like a spring breeze. A slightly gentle lateral movement. Cut 7: Sketch-style abstract cut close to a white background. It gives the impression of a riverside landscape rendered as a line drawing. The animation feels like a brief transition from live-action to a 2D world. Thin lines, hand-drawn tracks, light shapes, and symbols like musical notes flow. Short and impressive. Cut 8: Narrow alley. Red vending machines, deep alleys, storefronts, and plants. The ribbon effect flows through the alley. White symbol lines are scattered throughout. The camera moves forward, as if passing through. Shot 9: A railroad crossing and a moving train. Alarms and barriers at railroad crossings, and the sense of speed in the vehicle body. The ribbon and paper effect plays as if getting caught in the passing train. Dynamic diagonal composition. Shot 10: Waterside promenade. Flower beds and fences, distant cityscapes, and a wide sky. The effect expands slightly, with white lines reaching into the sky. Here, I create a bit of openness. Eleventh cut: The pond in the park. Waterfowl, trees, and the city in the distance. Even within the calm and quiet atmosphere, thin white lines, pale confetti, and the lingering effects of soft ribbons linger. Moving slowly from a slightly bird's-eye view. Twelfth cut: Silhouette of evening waterside and city. A ribbon effect that draws a large arc in the sky. Reflection of the setting sun. This is the most poetic and lingering ending. The camera quietly moves forward or gently moves sideways. Direction & Editing: A fast-paced high-speed cut structure. Each cut is relatively short, but to make the video feel smoothly connected, match cuts are created using ribbon effects, movement direction, sky color, and the flow of the subject. Close-up, ultra-close-up, low angle, bird's-eye view, diagonal composition, forward movement, and quick panting are interwoven. However, to prevent the camera from becoming too wild and hard to see, it balances exhilaration and visibility. While maintaining the texture of the live-action, it gives the impression that anime-like effects naturally blend into the live-action in 2.5D. Artwork: High quality, cinematic, bright natural light, transparent blue sky, delicate city details, and clean color design. The effects are mainly pink, light blue, yellow, and white, designed for a light and refreshing color scheme. The amount of effects is quite generous, but not so dense that you lose sight of your subject. It makes it appear as if the live-action and effects do not conflict and that they exist in the same world. Important note: Slideshow of still images is prohibited. Make sure the camera and effects move reliably within each cut. No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks are allowed. Excessive noise, jagged shapes, unnatural flickering, and distorted text are prohibited. Create a refreshing and beautiful 15-second video where moving effects naturally coexist within the live-action scenery.

raw_p:
【15秒動画テンプレート】

人物参照画像：＠ image1 サッカーユニフォーム
背景：サッカー場（観客多数）
サイン名：SIGN_NAME＝ぱか猫
感情表現：EMOTION＝両手ハートを作って満面の笑顔
締めポーズ：ENDING_POSE＝ウインクしながら投げキッス
────────────────────
全編を通して人物と背景は参照画像に忠実に再現する。
視聴者視点（POV）。
視聴者自身がカメラである。
人物は常に視聴者へ自然なアイコンタクトを行う。
サインを書く際、カメラ本体・レンズ・ガラス板・鏡・撮影機材は一切映さない。
サイン文字は画面前面へ自然に出現する。
サインとハートマークは動画終了まで消えない。
────────────────────
① 登場（0～3秒）
背景参照画像の環境。
人物が自然に立っている。
視聴者へ気付いて微笑む。
ゆっくりカメラへ歩き始める。
────────────────────
② 接近（3～6秒）
人物が視聴者へ近付く。
親しみやすい表情。
自然なアイコンタクト。
髪や衣装が自然に揺れる。
────────────────────
③ カメラ注視（6～9秒）
バストアップ。
人物が視聴者を見つめる。
少し身を乗り出す。
マーカーを取り出す。
サインを書く準備。
────────────────────
④ レンズへサイン（9～12秒）
POV視点。
人物が視聴者へ向かってマーカーを動かす。
カメラ本体やレンズは映さない。
「SIGN_NAME」をサインする。
続けて小さなハートマークを描く。
サインとハートは画面前面に残る。
動画終了まで消えない。
────────────────────
⑤ 感情表現（12～14秒）
サインとハートが画面前面に残った状態。
人物はサイン越しに視聴者を見る。
EMOTION を行う。
常にアイコンタクトを維持する。
サインは消えない。
────────────────────
⑥ 締めポーズ（14～15秒）
サインとハートが画面前面に残った状態。
人物はサイン越しに視聴者へ向けて ENDING_POSE を行う。
最後までサインは表示されたまま。
明るい表情で終了。
────────────────────
スタイル：
高品質
フォトリアル
自然な動作
映画的ライティング
浅い被写界深度
SNSショート動画
人物中心
高精細
滑らかなカメラワーク
────────────────────
NG：
カメラ本体が映る
レンズが映る
ガラス板が映る
鏡へサインする
撮影機材の映り込み
自撮り棒
サインが途中で消える
サインがぼやける
サインが最終フレーム前に消失する

raw_p:
纯正泰国神脑洞广告。前10秒是极度高压悬疑惊悚大片，最后5秒极其生硬地切入亮堂堂的沙雕美食家电广告。
核心创意：用最顶级的生死危机氛围，包装一个极其日常的做饭场景。利用极端的灯光突变、服装错位和演员颜艺，制造让人直呼“神经病”的爆笑落差。

时长 15秒
场景 从极度压抑、打着幽暗蓝光的废弃仓库，瞬间变为阳光明媚、温馨过头的家庭厨房。

分镜脚本

00:00-00:05 镜头1：生死倒数与极致高压
机位：极端的微距特写与面部特写交替，手持剧烈晃动，冷峻的青蓝色调。
画面：数字定时器正在疯狂倒数：00:04、00:03。豆大的汗珠从一个男人的额头滑落。他穿着极其厚重、专业的绿色防爆服，戴着战术头盔，双手颤抖着举起一把巨大的老虎钳，死死盯着眼前缠绕在一起的红蓝电线。气氛极其压抑，背景音只有沉重的呼吸声和巨大的心跳声。

00:05-00:10 镜头2：绝望剪断与窒息停顿
机位：主观视角接中景仰拍，极度紧张的慢动作。
动作：旁边同样穿着全套防爆服的女助手绝望地闭上眼睛，撕心裂肺地尖叫着摇着头。男人发出一声壮烈的怒吼，视死如归地闭上眼睛，老虎钳猛地用力，狠狠剪断了那根红色的电线。定时器刚好跳到00:00，发出一声极其尖锐、响亮的“哔——”声。画面在这个即将爆炸的瞬间凝固。

00:10-00:15 镜头3：沙雕反转与干饭狂欢
机位：毫无过渡的硬切(Smash Cut)，平视全景，灯光瞬间突变为极其明亮温暖的橙黄色日剧厨房光。
画面：根本没有炸弹。那个带有倒计时的发光物体，竟然是一台极其先进的智能电饭煲。随着“哔”声结束，电饭煲盖子“咔哒”弹开，喷涌出极其浓郁诱人的米饭蒸汽。刚才还视死如归的男女主，依然穿着那身极度违和的沉重防爆服，但表情瞬间变成了狂喜的吃货脸。男人一把掀开防爆头盔的面罩，对着镜头竖起大拇指，露出极度夸张油腻的泰式八颗牙笑容。女主手里瞬间多了一副碗筷，正对着电饭煲疯狂咽口水。屏幕四周粗暴地弹出五颜六色的泰文促销花字和搞怪音效。

en.t: Thai Ad Wild Twist Rice Cooker
en.p:
A pure Thai wild ad. The first 10 seconds are an extremely high-pressure suspense thriller, while the last 5 seconds are abruptly cut into a bold, silly food and appliance commercial.
Core idea: Wrapping an extremely everyday cooking scene with the most top-tier life-and-death crisis atmosphere. Using extreme lighting changes, costume misplacements, and actors' facial expressions, it creates a hilarious contrast that makes people exclaim "crazy."

Duration: 15 seconds
The scene transforms from an extremely oppressive, dim blue glow abandoned warehouse into a sunny, overly cozy family kitchen.

Storyboard script

00:00-00:05 Shot 1: Countdown to life and death and extreme pressure
Camera position: Alternating extreme macro close-ups and face close-ups, intense handheld shaking, cool cyan tones.
Screen: The digital timer is frantically counting down: 00:04, 00:03. Beads of sweat the size of beans slid down a man's forehead. He wore an extremely heavy, professional green explosion-proof suit and tactical helmet, his hands trembling as he raised a huge pair of pliers, staring intently at the tangled red and blue wires before him. The atmosphere was extremely oppressive, with only heavy breathing and a loud heartbeat in the background.

00:05-00:10 Shot 2: Despair cutting and suffocation pause
Camera position: subjective view with a central upward shot, extremely tense slow motion.
Action: The female assistant beside her, also dressed in a full explosion-proof suit, closed her eyes in despair, screamed in agony, and shook her head. The man let out a heroic roar, closed his eyes in fear, and with the pliers forcefully cutting through the red wire. The timer just ticked 00:00, producing an extremely sharp and loud "beep—" sound. The image froze at the moment it was about to explode.

00:10-00:15 Shot 3: Silly twists and a frenzy of eating
Camera position: No transition (Smash Cut), head-up panoramic view, the lighting instantly transforms into an extremely bright and warm orange-yellow kitchen light typical of Japanese dramas.
Footage: There are no bombs at all. That glowing object with a countdown was actually an extremely advanced smart rice cooker. As the "beep" sound ended, the rice cooker lid popped open with a "click," releasing an extremely rich and enticing steam of rice. The leads, who had just been facing death fearlessly, were still wearing that extremely mismatched heavy explosion-proof suit, but their expressions instantly turned into ecstatic foodie faces. The man suddenly lifted the mask of his explosion-proof helmet, gave a thumbs-up to the camera, and flashed an exaggerated, greasy Thai smile with eight teeth. The female lead suddenly had a set of chopsticks in her hand and was frantically swallowing saliva in front of the rice cooker. Colorful Thai promotional text and quirky sound effects pop up roughly around the screen.

raw_p: A heartwarming cinematic rescue story. A young girl walks through a misty forest at golden hour when she hears faint cries. She discovers a tiny injured baby fox trapped beneath fallen branches near a stream. Close-up shots of the frightened animal trembling as the girl gently clears the debris and carefully lifts it into her arms. Soft sunlight filters through the trees, highlighting dust particles and warm cinematic lens flares. The girl wraps the fox in her scarf and carries it through the forest. Emotional, ultra-realistic visuals, shallow depth of field, natural camera movement, detailed fur and facial expressions. The fox gradually regains strength and looks up at her with trust. Final scene: the recovered fox reunites with its family in a sunlit meadow while the girl smiles warmly. Hollywood wildlife documentary style, cinematic color grading, volumetric lighting, emotional storytelling, 4K, realistic motion, heartwarming atmosphere, Seedance 2.0.

zh.p: 一个温馨的电影救援故事。一个年轻女孩在金色时分穿过雾气弥漫的森林，忽然听到微弱的哭声。她发现一只受伤的小狐狸被困在溪流附近的倒枝下。特写镜头，看到那只惊恐的动物颤抖着，女孩轻轻清理杂物，小心翼翼地将它抱入怀中。柔和的阳光透过树木洒下，映衬出尘埃颗粒和温暖的电影镜头光晕。女孩用围巾把狐狸裹起来，带着它穿过森林。情感丰富、极其逼真的视觉效果，浅景深，自然的摄像机运动，细致的毛发和面部表情。狐狸逐渐恢复力量，信任地抬头看着她。最后一幕：康复的狐狸在阳光明媚的草地上与家人团聚，女孩温暖地微笑着。好莱坞野生动物纪录片风格，电影级色彩调色，体积光影，情感丰富的叙事，4K，逼真的动态，温馨的氛围，Seedance 2.0。

Duration: 15 seconds
Style: Pixar-quality animated short film, warm Indian village atmosphere, emotional storytelling, cinematic lighting, expressive characters, shallow depth of field, highly detailed textures, heartwarming tone.

A charming Indian village at golden sunrise. A cheerful 10-year-old village boy carries a bamboo pole across his shoulders with two clay water pots hanging from either side. One pot is perfect and full, the other has a visible crack, slowly dripping water along the dusty path. The cracked pot looks sad and ashamed while the perfect pot appears proud. As they walk, tiny flowers are revealed growing only along the cracked pot’s side of the road. The boy stops beside a colorful field of blooming flowers, gently lifts the cracked pot and smiles warmly. He points toward the trail of flowers stretching behind them. The cracked pot realizes its leaked water created the entire flower path. Its expression transforms from sadness to joy. The boy picks a small bouquet of flowers and places it beside the cracked pot. Final cinematic shot: the boy walks away down the village road carrying both pots equally, surrounded by vibrant flowers glowing in golden sunlight.

Camera: Starts with medium tracking shot behind the boy, close-up on dripping water, slow reveal of flowers along the path, emotional close-up of cracked pot, wide cinematic ending shot.
Lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight, soft volumetric rays, cozy Pixar-style color grading.
Mood: Heartwarming, hopeful, uplifting.
No text, no subtitles, no narration.

一个迷人的印度村庄，金色日出时分。一个开朗的10岁村男孩肩扛竹竿，两侧各挂着两个陶制水壶。一个花盆完美且满满，另一个有明显的裂缝，水慢慢滴落在尘土飞扬的小路上。破裂的锅看起来悲伤羞愧，而完美的锅则显得自豪。走着走着，只有裂开的花盆路边长着小花。男孩停在一片色彩斑斓的花田旁，轻轻提起破裂的花盆，温暖地微笑。他指向身后延伸的花路。裂开的花盆意识到漏水形成了整条花路。它的表情从悲伤转为喜悦。男孩摘下一小束花，放在破裂的花盆旁。最后一幕电影镜头：男孩带着两个花盆，沿着村路走开，周围是在金色阳光下闪耀的鲜花。

摄影：以男孩身后中等跟踪镜头开始，特写滴水，沿路缓缓揭示花朵，情感特写破碎的花盆，宽广的电影式结尾镜头。
光影：温暖的黄金时阳光，柔和的体积光线，舒适的皮克斯风格调色。
心情：温暖、充满希望、振奋人心。

raw_p:
“The Kite That Wouldn’t Fly”

Duration: 15 seconds

Style: Pixar-quality animated short film, colorful Indian neighborhood rooftop setting, expressive animation, cinematic storytelling, warm family-friendly atmosphere, vibrant textures, emotional visual payoff.

On a sunny afternoon in a small Indian town, an excited 10-year-old boy proudly stands on a rooftop holding a handmade kite. Beside him, his younger sister eagerly offers advice, but he confidently waves her away. The boy launches the kite. It immediately spins out of control and crashes onto a nearby rooftop. He tries again. Another crash. Frustration grows. The sister quietly picks up the kite and notices it’s missing a tail. Without saying anything, she ties a simple cloth tail to the bottom. The boy launches it one last time. This time the kite catches the wind perfectly and soars high above the town, dancing gracefully against the blue sky. The boy looks surprised, then realizes what his sister did. He smiles sheepishly and offers her the kite string reel. Together they fly the kite as it rises higher and higher. Final cinematic shot: brother and sister standing side by side on the rooftop, laughing while the colorful kite soars above the village skyline at sunset.

Camera: Dynamic rooftop tracking shots, close-ups on failed launches, focus on the sister quietly attaching the tail, dramatic upward camera tilt following the successful flight, wide cinematic ending shot above the rooftops.

Lighting: Bright afternoon sunlight transitioning into warm golden-hour glow during the final moments.

Mood: Joyful, uplifting, playful, heartwarming.

No text, no subtitles, no narration.

《不会飞的风筝》

持续时间：15秒

风格：皮克斯级动画短片，色彩斑斓的印度社区屋顶背景，富有表现力的动画，电影般的叙事，温馨且适合家庭的氛围，鲜活的质感，情感丰富的视觉回报。

在一个阳光明媚的印度小镇下午，一个兴奋的10岁男孩骄傲地站在屋顶上，手里拿着一只手工风筝。他身旁的妹妹热切地给出建议，但他自信地挥手拒绝。男孩放飞了风筝。它立刻失控旋转，撞上了附近的屋顶。他又试了一次。又是一声撞击。挫败感不断增长。妹妹悄悄捡起风筝，发现它少了一条尾巴。她没说话，只是把一条简单的布尾绑在尾巴底部。男孩最后一次发射。这次风筝完美地迎风而上，高高飞过小镇，优雅地在蓝天中舞动。男孩看起来很惊讶，随后意识到妹妹做了什么。他有些不好意思地笑了笑，把风筝线线递给她。他们一起放风筝，风筝越飞越高。最后一幕电影镜头：兄妹并肩站在屋顶上，笑着，色彩斑斓的风筝在夕阳下飞越村庄天际线。

镜头：动态屋顶跟踪镜头，失败发射的特写，聚焦姐妹机轻声连接尾部，成功飞行后戏剧性的向上倾斜镜头，屋顶上方的宽广电影式结尾镜头。

光线：明亮的午后阳光在最后时刻转为温暖的金色光辉。

心情：欢乐、振奋、俏皮、温暖。

没有文字，没有字幕，没有旁白。

raw_p:
奇幻史诗视觉奇观 (Fantasy Epic Visual Spectacle)。顶级电影特效，大场面交响乐节奏感。视觉风格核心对比：渺小的人体 vs 无垠的海洋力量，一根指挥棒掌控万顷狂涛。整体色调黄昏暖金色，大逆光，水雾体积光贯穿始终。

【场景】
黄昏时分，无边无际的深蓝色大海，天际线燃烧着橙红色晚霞，低沉的暗色云层压在海面上方，光线从云层缝隙中倾泻而下形成上帝光柱。

【角色】
年轻亚洲女性音乐指挥家：齐腰黑色长发，身穿剪裁利落的黑色拖地长裙，裙尾在风中如旗帜般翻飞。右手持一根发出淡金色光芒的指挥棒。表情专注而充满力量，如同在指挥一场命运级别的交响乐。脚下悬浮在海面上空约二十米处，下方有一圈淡淡的金色光环托举。

【分镜脚本 · 15秒】
[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：孤身凌空 · 万籁俱寂

机位：超级远景缓慢推进 (Slow Push-in from Ultra Wide)

画面：极致的大远景。无边无际的海面占据画面下方三分之二，上方是燃烧的黄昏云层。海面此刻诡异地平静如镜，倒映着天空。画面正中央，一个渺小的黑色人影悬浮在海天之间——这就是指挥家。镜头缓慢推近，逐渐能看清她飘飞的长裙和长发。她缓缓举起右手，指挥棒尖端亮起一点金色光芒。万籁俱寂，只有风声。一切蓄势待发。

[00:03-00:06] 镜头2：第一乐章 · 海浪听令

机位：中景侧面跟拍 (Medium Side Tracking)→ 快切广角俯拍 (Quick Cut to Aerial Wide)

画面（中景）：指挥家猛然挥下第一棒！指挥棒划出一道金色弧线光迹。她的头发和裙摆被自身释放的气浪猛然向后扬起。

画面（快切俯拍）：从高空俯视海面——以指挥家为圆心，一圈巨大的环形海浪从她正下方炸开向四周扩散，如同一颗石子投入平静水面但被放大了一万倍。海浪高度迅速攀升至数十米。

她开始有节奏地挥动指挥棒——向左挥，左侧海面拔起一道百米长的浪墙；向右挥，右侧海面应声升起同等高度的浪墙。两道浪墙如同交响乐的左右声道，交替起伏，韵律分明。浪尖被黄昏阳光照透，呈现出琥珀色半透明质感。

en.p:
Fantasy Epic Visual Spectacle. Top-tier movie special effects, large-scale symphonic rhythm. Core visual style contrast: a tiny human body vs. boundless oceanic power, one baton commanding vast waves. The overall color scheme is a warm golden dusk, with strong backlighting and a misty light that runs throughout.

[Scene]
At dusk, the boundless, deep blue sea burns the skyline with orange-red evening glow. Heavy, dark clouds press above the surface, and light pours down through the gaps in the clouds to form a pillar of divine light.

[Characters]
Young Asian female music conductor: waist-length black hair, wearing a sharply tailored black floor-length dress whose hem flutters like a flag in the wind. In his right hand, he held a baton glowing with a faint golden glow. His expression is focused and full of power, as if conducting a symphony of fate. Floating about twenty meters above the sea surface, a faint golden halo held up below.

[Storyboard Script · 15 seconds]
[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Alone in the Air · All sounds fell silent

Camera Position: Slow Push-in from Ultra Wide

Visual: Ultimate wide view. The boundless sea occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, with burning twilight clouds above it. At this moment, the sea surface was eerily calm as a mirror, reflecting the sky. At the very center of the painting, a tiny black figure floats between sea and sky—this is the conductor. The camera slowly zoomed in, gradually revealing her flowing long dress and long hair. She slowly raised her right hand, and a golden glow glowed at the tip of the baton. All was silent, only the sound of the wind remained. Everything is ready to strike.

[00:03-00:06] Shot 2: First Movement · Hailang obeys orders

Camera Position: Medium Side Tracking → Quick Cut to Aerial Wide

Scene (center view): The conductor suddenly swings the first bat! The baton traced a golden arc of light. Her hair and skirt were suddenly lifted backward by the shockwave she released.

Scene (quick cut from above): Looking down at the sea from high above—with the conductor as the center, a huge ring of waves bursts out from directly beneath her, spreading outward, like a stone thrown into calm water, but magnified ten thousand times. The waves quickly rose dozens of meters in height.

She began to rhythmically wave her baton—swinging left, a hundred-meter-long wall of waves rose from the left sea; Swing to the right, and a wall of waves of equal height rises on the right side of the sea. The two wave-like walls alternate like the left and right channels of a symphony, rising and falling with distinct rhythm. The crest of the wave is bathed in the evening sun, giving it an amber-colored, semi-transparent texture.

[00:06-00:10] Shot 3: Climax Movement · Wild waves dance together

Position: Rising Orbital Shot, rotating 360 degrees around the conductor while ascending

Visual: The pace suddenly picks up! The conductor's movements became intense and wild—the baton flipped up and down, each swing leaving behind golden arcs of light. Her entire body moved to the rhythm, her long dress torn and fluttered like black flames by the aura from all directions.

The sea surface was completely frenzied—dozens of giant waves rose simultaneously from different directions, soaring from dozens of meters to over a hundred meters, like massive columns of water arranged in a circular array around the conductor, rising and falling like pipe organ pipes. The sea twisted in a spiral shape in the air, mist swirling in midair, and the dusk sunlight pierced through the mist, forming countless golden beams of light. The entire sea surface transformed into a massive whirlpool centered on her, its momentum swallowing the sky.

The camera gradually rises in the circle, the perspective broadening, revealing the astonishing scale of this "ocean symphony"—she alone conducts the ocean within several kilometers.

[00:10-00:13] Shot 4: Finale · All the waves merge into one

Camera Position: Front Medium Shot → Hyper Pullback

Scene (front middle view): The conductor suddenly stops all movements. All the waves instantly froze in midair, as if time had stopped. She took a deep breath, raised the baton high above her head, and golden light radiated brilliantly all over her body.

Then—she swung the final blow down with all her strength!

Scene (Rapid Rear-Pull): The camera instantly retracts rapidly. Centered on her, all the giant waves frozen in the sky simultaneously exploded into the sky—dozens of towering water columns shot like missiles, piercing through the clouds and piercing the sky, tearing the gloomy dark clouds into a huge circular gap, revealing the magnificent sunset and starry sky above.

[00:13-00:15] Shot 5: Afterglow · Return to tranquility

Position: Static Wide Shot

Scene: The water column slowly falls, turning into a mist and fine droplets like a golden rain. The conductor hovered in the center of a torn gap in the clouds, surrounded by ring-shaped rainbow halos, countless droplets refracted like diamonds reflecting the last rays of sunlight. She slowly lowered her baton, her long hair and skirt gently fluttering in the mist. The sea returned to calm, reflecting her silhouette and the open starry sky.

raw_p:
15秒のシネマティックなファンタジー・タイムラプス短編。人物なし。文字なし、ロゴなし、透かしなし。暗い卓上に、古びて壊れた電球が置かれている。映像は、ひび割れたガラスと切れたフィラメントの極端なクローズアップから始まる。電球の中で小さな電気火花が走り、光る粉塵が素早く渦を巻き始める。カメラは電球の内部へ入っていくように素早く寄り、少し回り込む。

電球の内部で、小さな街がダイナミックなタイムラプスで形成されていく。細い道路が光の血管のように一気に伸び、小さな橋が組み上がり、建物が粒子から高速で立ち上がる。屋根が次々と形になり、狭い通りが素早く接続される。ゆっくりした幻想的な漂いではなく、見ていて気持ちのよい高速形成にする。小さな建物が伸びるマクロ寄り、曲面ガラス越しの俯瞰風構図、電球全体の中で街が広がる横からのドラマチックなアングルを切り替える。

終盤では、完成した小さな街に命が宿る。窓明かりが連鎖するように次々と灯り、街灯が点滅し、小さな光の軌跡が通りを動いて生活感を示す。電球全体が内側から暖かく輝く。最後は、壊れた電球の中に完全に灯ったミニチュア都市が入っている美しいヒーローショットで余韻を残して終わる。魔法的リアリズム、精密なミニチュア都市、暖かい琥珀色の光、ガラスの反射、強いコントラストのシネマティックライティング。BGMなし。効果音のみ。鋭い電気音、小さな組み立て音、きらめく音、ガラスの共鳴、最後の柔らかい電気のハム音。

en.p:
A 15-second cinematic fantasy time-lapse short film. No person. No text, no logo, no watermarks. On the dark table, an old, broken light bulb sits. The footage begins with an extreme close-up of cracked glass and broken filaments. Small electric sparks shot through the bulb, and glowing dust quickly began to swirl around. The camera quickly approaches as if entering the inside of the bulb, then circles around slightly.

Inside the light bulb, a small town is formed in a dynamic time-lapse. Narrow roads stretch out like veins of light, small bridges are built, and buildings rise rapidly from particles. Roofs take shape one after another, and narrow streets are quickly connected. Instead of a slow, fantastical drift, it creates a fast-paced formation that feels pleasant to watch. The dramatic side-view angle shifts between small buildings stretching out in macro mode, a bird's-eye view through curved glass, and a dramatic side angle where the city spreads out within a whole light bulb.

Towards the end, life takes root in the completed small town. The window lights flash one after another like chained lights, streetlights flicker, and small trails of light move along the street, evoking a sense of everyday life. The entire bulb glows warmly from the inside. It ends with a beautiful hero shot showing a miniature city lit up inside a broken light bulb, leaving a lingering impression. Magical realism, precise miniature cities, warm amber light, glass reflections, and cinematic lighting with strong contrast. BGMなし。 Only sound effects. Sharp electric sounds, small assembly noises, sparkling sounds, glass resonance, and final, soft electric humming.

raw_p:
Hospital Corridor Fake-Out (12 Seconds)

Scene / Setting

Night. Large abandoned Indian hospital corridor. Flickering fluorescent lights. Wheelchairs, rusted stretchers, peeling paint, long empty hallway. Everything clearly visible.

Camera

Medium shot from behind and beside an elderly Indian woman sitting in a wheelchair. Stable handheld smartphone footage. Slight shake.

Subject / Action

An elderly Indian woman sits alone in a wheelchair in the middle of an abandoned hospital corridor.

A nurse is pushing her.

A voice calls from off-screen:

“Sister, ek minute idhar aana!”

The nurse responds:

“Ek second.”

The nurse walks away, leaving the elderly woman alone.

The woman watches her disappear.

Silence.

At the far end of the corridor is a large cross-passage.

The woman stares toward it.

A massive shadow slowly appears on the wall.

Then an enormous creature walks across the distant opening.

Tall and inhuman.

Glossy black skin.

Long limbs.

Slightly wet, slimy appearance.

Its silhouette fills the entire cross-passage as it slowly walks from one side to the other.

The elderly woman freezes in terror.

The creature disappears from view.

Silence.

Nothing happens.

The woman exhales in relief.

Then she hears a faint sound above her.

A wet scraping noise.

She slowly looks upward.

Suddenly the same creature drops from the ceiling directly in front of her wheelchair.

Its face fills the frame.

It releases a violent screech.

The woman screams.

Hard cut to black.

Audio

Wheelchair sounds, distant hospital hum, flickering lights, wet scraping from above, final creature screech.

Style

Ultra-realistic horror, realistic creature movement, strong fake-out, fast escalation, high-impact jump scare, found-footage realism, no animation.

zh.p:
医院走廊假动作（12秒）

场景/场景

夜晚。大型废弃的印第安医院走廊。闪烁的荧光灯。轮椅、生锈的担架、剥落的油漆、漫长的空荡走廊。一切都清晰可见。

镜头

中景从一位坐在轮椅上的印度老妇人身后和旁边拍摄。稳定的手持智能手机录像。轻微晃动。

主题/动作

一位年长的印度妇女独自坐在废弃医院走廊中央的轮椅上。

一名护士推着她。

画外传来声音：“姐姐，我会有点时间去！”护士回复：“我也来。”

护士走开，留下老妇人独自一人。

她看着她消失。

寂静。走廊尽头有一条宽阔的交叉通道。女人凝视着它。墙上缓缓出现一个巨大的影子。然后一个巨大的生物走过远处的入口。高大非人类的皮肤光滑的黑皮肤。修长的四肢微微湿润， 黏滑的身影。

它的轮廓充满了整个交叉通道，缓缓从一边走到另一边。

老人惊恐地僵住了。

生物消失在视线中。

寂静。

什么都没发生。

她松了口气。

然后她听到头顶传来微弱的声音。

湿润的刮擦声。

她慢慢抬头。

突然，同一个生物从正前方的天花板上掉了下来她的轮椅。

它的脸充满画面。

它发出暴力尖叫。


女人尖叫。

画面变黑。

音频

轮椅声，远处医院嗡鸣，闪烁的灯光，上方湿漉漉的刮擦声，最后的怪物尖叫。

风格

超现实恐怖，逼真生物动作，强烈的假动作，快速升级，高冲击跳跃惊吓，伪纪录片式的真实感， 没有动画。

en.p:
Hospital Corridor Fake-Out (12 Seconds)

Scene / Setting

Night. Large abandoned Indian hospital corridor. Flickering fluorescent lights. Wheelchairs, rusted stretchers, peeling paint, long empty hallway. Everything clearly visible.

Camera

Medium shot from behind and beside an elderly Indian woman sitting in a wheelchair. Stable handheld smartphone footage. Slight shake.

Subject / Action

An elderly Indian woman sits alone in a wheelchair in the middle of an abandoned hospital corridor.

A nurse is pushing her.

A voice calls from off-screen:

“Sister, ek minute idhar aana!”

The nurse responds:

“Ek second.”

The nurse walks away, leaving the elderly woman alone.

The woman watches her disappear.

Silence.

At the far end of the corridor is a large cross-passage.

The woman stares toward it.

A massive shadow slowly appears on the wall.

Then an enormous creature walks across the distant opening.

Tall and inhuman.

Glossy black skin.

Long limbs.

Slightly wet, slimy appearance.

Its silhouette fills the entire cross-passage as it slowly walks from one side to the other.

The elderly woman freezes in terror.

The creature disappears from view.

Silence.

Nothing happens.

The woman exhales in relief.

Then she hears a faint sound above her.

A wet scraping noise.

She slowly looks upward.

Suddenly the same creature drops from the ceiling directly in front of her wheelchair.

Its face fills the frame.

It releases a violent screech.

The woman screams.

Hard cut to black.

Audio

Wheelchair sounds, distant hospital hum, flickering lights, wet scraping from above, final creature screech.

Style

Ultra-realistic horror, realistic creature movement, strong fake-out, fast escalation, high-impact jump scare, found-footage realism, no animation.

zh.p:
场景/场景

夜晚。大型废弃的印第安医院走廊。闪烁的荧光灯。生锈的轮椅，剥落的油漆，旧医院的招牌，漫长的空走廊延伸至黑暗。一切都清晰可见。

摄像头

手持智能手机录像。中景，从一位坐在轮椅上的印度老妇人背后和旁边拍摄。轻微的自然摇晃。

主题/动作

一位年长的印度妇女独自坐在废弃医院走廊中央的轮椅上。一名护士推着她。画外传来声音：“姐姐，等一下，别走！”护士回复：“我也来。”

护士走进侧走廊，留下老妇人独自一人。

老人目送她离开。

寂静。

走廊尽头有一条远处的交叉通道。

老人凝视着那里。

一个身影缓缓出现。一个极瘦的印度妇女，穿着破旧的病号服。皮肤白皙腐烂，静脉清晰可见。长长的黑发纠结垂落在脸上。乳白色白色的眼睛迷离。

露出锋利的大獠牙。

她慢慢走过远处的入口。

没有看向轮椅。

只是路过。她的动作感觉不对劲。太僵硬了。她太慢了。看起来很困惑。

又是抓挠声。

靠近点。

她慢慢抬头。

倒挂在轮椅正上方的也是同一个女人。

乳白色的眼睛。

皮肤腐烂。

头发垂下。

露出獠牙。

女人突然从轮椅正前方的天花板跳下，发出一声剧烈的尖叫。极近特写。音频骤然切换。

raw_p:
Scene / Setting
Night. Indian bedroom. Wardrobe closet slightly open. Room clearly visible.

Camera
Handheld smartphone. Medium shot showing woman and closet.

Subject / Action

An Indian woman is sitting on her bed.

She notices someone standing inside the slightly open closet.

Just a face visible in darkness.

The face belongs to a terrifying woman.

Extremely thin body.

Pale decaying skin with visible veins.

Long tangled black hair partially covering her face.

Milky white unfocused eyes.

Large sharp fangs.

Tattered hospital gown.

She is completely still.

The woman looks away briefly.

Looks back.

The witch is closer to the closet opening.

Still staring.

The woman becomes nervous.

Looks away again.

Looks back.

Now the witch is standing just outside the closet.

Much closer.

Still staring.

The woman backs away.

Looks down for a moment.

Looks up.

The closet is empty.

Silence.

Relief.

The woman slowly turns around—

The witch is suddenly standing inches behind her.

Milky eyes.

Fangs.

Wide unnatural smile.

She screams directly into the woman’s face.

Hard cut to black.

场景 / 背景
晚安。印度卧室。衣柜稍微敞开。房间清晰可见。

相机
手持智能手机。中景，展示女性和衣橱。

主题 / 行动

一位印度妇女坐在床上。

她注意到有人站在微微敞开的衣橱里。

只有一张脸在黑暗中清晰可见。

这张脸属于一个可怕的女人。

身体极其瘦削。

皮肤白白腐烂，血管清晰可见。

长长的黑发部分遮住了脸庞。

乳白色、无焦点的眼睛。

大而锋利的獠牙。

破旧的医院病号服。

她一动不动。

女人短暂地移开视线。

回头看。

女巫离衣橱开口更近。

还在盯着看。

那位女士变得紧张起来。

又移开视线。

回头看。

现在女巫就站在衣橱外面。

更近了。

还在盯着看。

低头片刻。

抬头看。

衣橱是空的。

寂静。

松了口气。

女人慢慢转过身——

女巫突然站在她身后几英寸处。

乳白色的眼睛。

獠牙。

那是个不自然的笑容。

她直接对着那女人的脸大喊。

画面切换到黑。

开场画面：全球城市上空的天空裂开，形成一个巨大的维度裂缝。现实闪烁，建筑物在不同状态间出现故障。

最后一个反派出现了：一个由不断变化的几何和破碎现实碎片组成的高耸虚空实体。

主角漂浮在对面，周围充满不稳定的能量。

第二档时，裂缝完全打开。

现实开始崩溃。

建筑向上延伸，街道向内折叠，重力波浪反转。

摄像机在扭曲中持续移动，穿过物体，使其在维度间相位。

第一阶段：空间战斗，双方都能弯曲空间，将整栋建筑作为武器投掷。

第二阶段：时间崩解，时间碎片，动作重叠，多个版本的动作同时出现。

第三阶段：奇点形成，裂缝开始将一切拉向内。

最终碰撞时的速度坡、碎片、光线和悬浮在完美静止中的现实碎片。

最后一刻：一切崩塌成一个点，然后寂静。

画面切换到黑暗。

然后慢慢地：城市开始改革......改变了。

色彩逻辑：深黑虚空与棱镜现实扭曲。

电影感十足的多元宇宙崩溃、最终Boss对决、4K超细致。

en.p:
Opening frame: the sky above a global city fractures open into a massive dimensional rift. Reality flickers , buildings glitch between different states.

The final antagonist emerges: a towering void entity made of shifting geometry and broken fragments of reality.

The protagonist floats opposite, surrounded by unstable energy.

At second two, the rift fully opens.

Reality begins collapsing.

Buildings stretch upward, streets fold inward, gravity reverses in waves.

The camera moves continuously through the distortion, passing through objects as they phase between dimensions.

Phase 1: spatial combat ,both entities bend space, throwing entire buildings as weapons.

Phase 2: temporal breakdown , time fragments, actions overlap, multiple versions of movements appear simultaneously.

Phase 3: singularity formation ,the rift begins pulling everything inward.

Velocity ramp during final collision ,debris, light, and fragments of reality suspended in perfect stillness.

Final moment: everything collapses into a single point , then silence.

Cut to black.

Then slowly: the city reforms… altered.

Color logic: deep black void vs prismatic reality distortion.

Cinematic multiverse collapse, final boss confrontation, 4K ultra-detail.

raw_p:
Scene / Setting

Night. Small Indian bedroom. Person lying in bed, unable to move. Ceiling fan slowly spinning overhead. Faint streetlight entering through window curtains. Everything clearly visible.

Camera

POV from the person lying in bed. Slight handheld breathing movement. Fixed from pillow height. No cinematic shots.

Subject / Action

The video begins with the person suddenly waking up in bed.

Heavy breathing.

Unable to move.

At the far end of the room stands an Indian witch-like woman.

She wears a torn,-stained hospital gown.

Her skin is pale and decayed with visible veins.

Long tangled black hair partially covers her face.

Her eyes are milky white and unfocused, not glowing.

Large sharp fangs visible.

She stands completely still.

Then her body suddenly changes shape.

For a brief moment she becomes unnaturally tall.

Then normal again.

Then her arms become too long.

Then normal again.

Then her neck stretches sideways.

Then normal again.

Each transformation lasts only a fraction of a second.

The person tries to move but cannot.

Breathing becomes frantic.

The witch slowly begins crawling toward the bed.

As she moves, her appearance continues changing:

Her jaw widens.

Her face briefly resembles a different woman.

Her limbs lengthen.

Her head twists.

Then everything snaps back.

She reaches the side of the bed.

Silence.

The witch slowly rises until her face is directly above the camera.

Her hair hangs down over the lens.

For a brief second she appears completely still.

Then her eyes suddenly lock onto the viewer.

She opens her mouth impossibly wide and releases a violent scream directly into the camera.

Extreme close-up of fangs, milky eyes, decayed skin.

Audio peaks.

Hard cut to black.

zh.p:
场景 / 背景

晚安。小印度卧室。有人躺在床上，无法动弹。天花板上的风扇缓缓旋转。透过窗帘洒进来的微弱路灯。一切都清晰可见。

相机

躺在床上的人的视角。轻微的手持呼吸动作。从枕头高度固定。没有电影镜头。

主题 / 行动

视频开始时，那个人突然在床上醒来。

沉重的呼吸声。

无法动弹。

房间的远端站着一位印度女巫般的女子。

她穿着破损、沾满污渍的医院病号服。

她的皮肤白皙且腐烂，血管清晰可见。

长长的黑发部分遮住了她的脸。

她的眼睛是乳白色的，焦点模糊，没有发光。

露出锋利的大獠牙。

她一动不动地站着。

然后她的身体突然变形。

她短暂地变得异常高大。

然后又恢复正常。

然后她的手臂变得太长了。

然后又恢复正常。

然后她的脖子侧向伸展。

然后又恢复正常。

每次变身仅持续几分之一秒。

那个人试图移动却无法移动。

呼吸变得急促。

女巫慢慢地开始爬向床边。

随着她的移动，她的外貌也在不断变化：

她的下巴张大了。

她的脸短暂地看起来像另一个女人。

她的四肢变长了。

她的头一扭。

然后一切又突然回归。

她走到床边。

寂静。

女巫缓缓站起，直到脸正好对准摄像机。

她的头发垂在镜头上。

她短暂地一动不动。

然后她的目光突然锁定了观众。

她张大嘴巴，直接对着镜头发出一声激烈的尖叫。

极近的特写，露出獠牙、乳白色的眼睛、腐烂的皮肤。

音频峰值。

画面切换到黑。

15-second absurd over-the-top Indian action movie scene, ultra-realistic, photorealistic blockbuster footage, Telugu/Tamil mass cinema energy, ridiculous dramatic camera work, extreme zooms, impossible hero worship, epic soundtrack for a completely normal situation.

0:00 - 0:03
A young man enters a family gathering.
Silence.
He looks around the room.
Slowly.
Calmly.
Then asks:
"What's the Wi-Fi password?"
Instantly, everyone's face freezes.
SFX
"DHOOOOOM!"
"BWAAAAAAH!"
Thunder strike.
Glass rattles.

0:03 - 0:06
Extreme zoom into Grandma's eyes.
Zoom into Uncle's eyes.
Zoom into Dad's eyes.
Zoom into the router.
Zoom into the blinking internet light.
Zoom back into Grandma's eyes.
Each zoom gets a dramatic impact sound.

SFX
"SHING!"
"TAK!"
"BWAAAH!"

0:06 - 0:10
Grandma slowly stands up.
The camera circles around her.
Wind suddenly appears indoors.
Curtains fly dramatically.
Her saree moves like she's entering a battlefield.
She whispers:
"Only one man knows the password..."
Massive bass drop.

0:10 - 0:13
Cut to Dad sitting silently in another room.
The camera introduces him like the final boss.
50 rapid zooms.
Slow-motion beard stroke.
Lightning flashes outside.
The router lights glow brighter.

Music
Epic Indian choir.
Heavy drums.
Electric guitar.

0:13 - 0:15
Dad slowly looks into camera.
Adjusts his glasses.
Whispers:
"Password123"
The entire house explodes into applause.
Fireworks outside.
Triumphant orchestral music.
TITLE CARD
"THE WIFI PASSWORD"
COMING SOON
Final SFX
Lion roar + thunder + jet engine + crowd cheering.

15秒荒诞夸张的印度动作电影场景，超写实、照片级的大片镜头，泰卢固/泰米尔大众电影的能量，荒谬的戏剧性摄影，极端变焦，不可能的英雄崇拜，史诗般的配乐为一个完全正常的情境配乐。

一位年轻人走进一个家庭聚会。
寂静。
他环顾房间。
慢慢来。
冷静地。
然后问：
“Wi-Fi密码是什么？”
瞬间，所有人的脸都僵住了。
音效
“嗬——！”
“哇啊啊啊！”
雷声。
玻璃碰撞声。

0:03 - 0:06
极度放大到奶奶的眼睛。
放大叔叔的眼睛。
放大爸爸的眼睛。
放大到路由器里。
放大闪烁的网络灯光。
拉近奶奶的眼睛。
每次变焦都会有戏剧性的冲击声。

音效
“成！”
“TAK！”
“哇啊啊！”

0:06 - 0:10
奶奶慢慢站了起来。
镜头围绕着她转动。
风突然出现在室内。
帷幕戏剧性地飘扬。
她的纱丽摆动时仿佛进入战场。
她低声说：
“只有一个人知道密码......”
巨大的低音下坠。

0:10 - 0:13
画面切到爸爸静静地坐在另一个房间里。
镜头像最终Boss一样介绍他。
50次快速变焦。
慢动作的胡须划过。
外面闪电划过。
路由器的灯光会更亮。

音乐
史诗印度合唱团。
沉重的鼓声。
电吉他。

0:13 - 0:15
爸爸慢慢地看向镜头。
调整了一下眼镜。
低语：
“密码123”
整个屋子爆发出掌声。
外面有烟花。
凯旋的管弦乐。
片头字幕
“WIFI密码”
敬请期待
最终音效
狮吼+雷鸣+喷气发动机+人群欢呼。

raw_p: Create a funny cinematic rally racing scene inside a sports rally car speeding through a narrow forest road. The camera is fixed inside the car, facing the cockpit in a wide dashboard/cabin shot. Three dogs are acting like a serious professional rally team, but everything feels absurd and hilarious. On the right side, a fluffy white dog is the main driver, intensely gripping the steering wheel with tiny paws, leaning forward with a dramatic serious face like a world champion racer. The dog keeps making exaggerated steering movements as the car bounces on the dirt road. On the left side, a black and white husky sits as the co driver/navigator, wearing a tiny racing headset, holding a crumpled paper map upside down, confidently barking directions even though it clearly has no idea where they are going. The husky occasionally looks shocked, points in the wrong direction, then pretends everything is under control. Behind them, a brown dog sits in the middle seat like the nervous team manager, eyes wide open, paws gripping the seat, bouncing up and down with every bump. Sometimes it looks at the driver, then at the navigator, completely confused but trying to stay brave. The car races fast through the forest. Trees blur outside the windows. Dust, leaves, and sunlight streak past the windshield. The vehicle shakes, rattles, and swerves comedically, but the dogs remain overly serious, like they are competing in the most important rally race in history. Add funny physical comedy: the map flaps in the husky’s face, the white dog accidentally honks the horn with its paw, the brown dog’s ears bounce with every bump, and all three dogs briefly freeze in dramatic slow motion when the car hits a small jump. Style: cinematic CGI realism, funny animal comedy, energetic rally racing, expressive dog faces, dynamic motion, realistic car interior, forest road background, fast speed, comedic timing, high-quality animation, warm natural lighting, playful adventure mood. Camera: fixed wide-angle dashboard/cockpit camera, slightly shaky from the car movement, realistic vibration, fast background motion through windows, no cuts, continuous shot. Mood: hilarious, adventurous, absurd, cinematic, like a serious rally race performed by completely unqualified but very confident dogs. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no human characters.

zh.p: 在一辆运动拉力赛车中，在狭窄的林间小路上创作一个有趣的电影拉力赛场景。摄像头固定在车内，面向驾驶舱，呈现宽广的仪表盘/客舱画面。三只狗表现得像一支严肃的职业集会队，但一切都显得荒诞又滑稽。右侧是一只毛茸茸的白狗，主驾驶员用小爪紧握方向盘，身体前倾，脸上带着世界冠军赛车手般的严肃表情。狗不断做出夸张的转向动作，车子在土路上颠簸。左侧坐着一只黑白相间的哈士奇，作为副驾驶兼导航员，戴着一个小小的赛车耳机，倒扣着一张揉皱的纸质地图，自信地吠叫着指路，尽管显然它根本不知道目的地。哈士奇偶尔会显得震惊，指向错误的方向，然后假装一切都在掌控之中。他们身后，一只棕色的狗坐在中间座位，就像紧张的队经理一样，眼睛睁得大大的，爪子紧抓着座椅，随着每一次颠簸上下弹跳。有时它会看向司机，然后看向导航员，完全困惑，但努力保持勇气。车子在森林中飞速疾驰。窗外树木模糊不清。尘土、树叶和阳光掠过挡风玻璃。车辆晃动、晃动、滑行，但狗狗们依然过于严肃，仿佛参加了历史上最重要的拉力赛。再加上有趣的肢体喜剧：地图在哈士奇脸上拍打，白狗不小心用爪子按喇叭，棕色狗的耳朵随着每个颠簸都弹动，三只狗在汽车跳跃时短暂地以戏剧性的慢动作僵住。风格：电影级CGI写实、搞笑动物喜剧、充满活力的拉力赛、富有表情的狗脸、动态动态、逼真的汽车内饰、森林道路背景、高速、喜剧节奏、高质量动画、温暖的自然光、俏皮的冒险氛围。摄像机：固定广角仪表盘/驾驶舱摄像机，车辆晃动略显晃动，震动逼真，背景快速透过窗户，无切换，连续拍摄。氛围：搞笑、冒险、荒诞、电影感十足，就像一场由完全不合格但非常自信的狗狗进行的严肃拉力赛。没有文字，没有字幕，没有标志，没有人类角色。

raw_p: 现代中国3D动画。威猛的豺狼神阿努比斯，臂环环绕，头戴神器，被囚禁在地牢中，背靠墙壁，双臂被锁链高举过头。一个喽啰站在他面前，逼问阿努比斯的秘密。阿努比斯漫不经心地看着他，一副百无聊赖的样子，根本没把他当回事。他只是微微移开视线，低沉的声音说道，这纯粹是浪费时间。喽啰咧嘴一笑，双手伸进阿努比斯裸露的腋窝，用手指挠他的痒痒。手指刚一触碰到阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯就咧嘴一笑，闭上眼睛，低沉的声音里传来一阵闷闷的笑声。喽啰继续挠他的腋窝，他的上半身也跟着扭动，他几乎忍不住要大笑出声，发出一阵阵闷闷的笑声，努力克制着自己，却还是忍不住笑出声来，显得有些滑稽。小喽啰不停地挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯终于大笑起来。小喽啰继续挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯笑着说他特别怕痒，已经受不了了。

en.p: Modern Chinese 3D animation. The mighty Jackal god Anubis, with arms around him and a sacred artifact on his head, is imprisoned in a dungeon, leaning against the wall, his arms raised high by chains. A henchman stood before him, demanding Anubis's secret. Anubis looked at him nonchalantly, looking utterly bored, not taking him seriously at all. He simply averted his gaze slightly, speaking in a deep voice. This was purely a waste of time. The henchman grinned, slipped his hands into Anubis's exposed armpits, and tickled him with his fingers. As soon as his fingers touched Anubis's armpit, he grinned, closed his eyes, and a muffled laugh came from his deep voice. The henchman kept scratching his armpit, his upper body twisting along with him. He almost couldn't help but burst out laughing, letting out muffled chuckles, trying hard to hold back his laughter, but still couldn't help laughing out loud, which sounded a bit comical. The minions kept tickling Anubis's armpits, and he finally burst out laughing. The little henchman continued to tickle Anubis's armpit, and Anubis laughed and said he was especially afraid of itching and couldn't stand it anymore.
