A highly realistic cinematic luxury lifestyle scene filmed like a professional Hollywood commercial.

Opening shot: captured with a stabilized drone camera during golden hour over a calm deep-blue ocean. A beautiful young woman in her mid-20s naturally drives a modern white speedboat at medium-fast speed. Her hair flows realistically in the wind, sunlight softly reflects on her skin, and the water movement looks physically accurate with natural splashes and detailed wake trails behind the boat.

Camera transitions smoothly between professional cinematic angles:
— wide aerial drone tracking shot
— side profile tracking shot close to the water
— realistic handheld close-up of her adjusting the steering wheel
— slow-motion splash shots with authentic lighting reflections
— cinematic close-up of her relaxed confident expression wearing elegant sunglasses

The boat movement feels realistic with proper wave interaction and balanced motion physics. Natural wind simulation, true-to-life ocean textures, realistic shadows, premium color grading, subtle lens flare, shallow depth of field, documentary-style realism mixed with luxury commercial aesthetics.

Final shot: drone slowly pulls away as the speedboat moves toward the glowing sunset horizon, creating a premium emotional ending.

Style: ultra photorealistic, professionally filmed, cinematic lighting, realistic camera motion, authentic human movement, luxury travel commercial, 4K HDR, smooth transitions, no CGI look, no artificial facial distortions, natural body proportions, highly detailed water simulation...

zh.p:
这是一场高度写实的奢华电影场景，拍摄得像专业好莱坞广告一样。

开场镜头：在黄金时段用稳定无人机相机拍摄，俯瞰平静的深蓝海洋。一位二十多岁的美丽年轻女子自然驾驶着一艘现代白色快艇，速度中快。她的头发在风中飘动，阳光柔和地映照在皮肤上，水流动作看起来非常贴近物理，船身后自然溅起的水花和细致的尾迹。

镜头在专业电影角度间平滑切换：
—— 广角无人机跟踪镜头
——近水侧面跟踪镜头
——她调整方向盘的真实手持特写
——慢动作溅射镜头，真实的光影反射
——她戴着优雅墨镜，表情自信放松的电影特写

船只的运动感觉真实，波浪互动和运动物理平衡。自然风模拟、逼真的海洋纹理、逼真的阴影、高级调色、细腻的镜头光晕、浅景深、纪录片风格的真实感与奢华商业美学的融合。

最后一幕：无人机缓缓拉开，快艇驶向发光的夕阳地平线，营造出极具情感的结局。

风格：超写实，专业拍摄，电影级灯光，真实的摄像机运动，真实的人体运动，奢华旅游广告，4K HDR，平滑过渡，无CGI效果，无人工面部畸形，自然身体比例，高度细致的水面模拟......

en.p:
A highly realistic cinematic luxury lifestyle scene filmed like a professional Hollywood commercial.

Opening shot: captured with a stabilized drone camera during golden hour over a calm deep-blue ocean. A beautiful young woman in her mid-20s naturally drives a modern white speedboat at medium-fast speed. Her hair flows realistically in the wind, sunlight softly reflects on her skin, and the water movement looks physically accurate with natural splashes and detailed wake trails behind the boat.

Camera transitions smoothly between professional cinematic angles:
— wide aerial drone tracking shot
— side profile tracking shot close to the water
— realistic handheld close-up of her adjusting the steering wheel
— slow-motion splash shots with authentic lighting reflections
— cinematic close-up of her relaxed confident expression wearing elegant sunglasses

The boat movement feels realistic with proper wave interaction and balanced motion physics. Natural wind simulation, true-to-life ocean textures, realistic shadows, premium color grading, subtle lens flare, shallow depth of field, documentary-style realism mixed with luxury commercial aesthetics.

Final shot: drone slowly pulls away as the speedboat moves toward the glowing sunset horizon, creating a premium emotional ending.

Style: ultra photorealistic, professionally filmed, cinematic lighting, realistic camera motion, authentic human movement, luxury travel commercial, 4K HDR, smooth transitions, no CGI look, no artificial facial distortions, natural body proportions, highly detailed water simulation...

添付された絵コンテ画像をもとに、15秒の横型16:9アニメハラハラドキドキ逃走シーン動画を作成してください。 

テーマ：盗人少女 

絵コンテのパネル順に沿って、テンポの速い颯爽シーンとして動画化してください。 流れ： 祝祭感のある巨大きのこ都市を俯瞰で見せるところから始まり、青いフードの盗人少女が人混みの熱気と装飾に紛れながら、祭りの中心にある希少な発光きのこを盗みます。 盗みの瞬間は手元の寄りや表情の寄りを交え、成功した直後は少し楽しんでいるようなスリルのある笑みを見せてください。 その後、祭り会場の高低差のある足場、屋台の上、装飾の張られた通路、ロープや布のある空間を活かして、颯爽と逃走してください。 追手や周囲の群衆が驚き、少女を追い始め、少女は人々の間をすり抜け、飛び越え、滑り込み、軽快に逃げていきます。 最後は高所の足場や橋へ抜け、祝祭の光の中を駆け抜けて終わってください。 

スタイル： 高品質なアニメ映画風、シネマティックなライティング、ハラハラドキドキの神作画、高精細、鮮やかな色彩、祝祭感のある華やかな空気感、賑やかな群衆、巨大きのこ装飾、紙吹雪や布飾りが舞うエネルギッシュな世界観。 少女は可愛さと俊敏さを両立し、楽しさと危うさが同居する雰囲気にしてください。 

編集： リズム感のある高速カット、寄りカット、超接写、ローアングル、俯瞰ショット、素早いパン、気持ちのいいマッチカットを使用してください。 盗む瞬間の手元寄り、走り出しの表情寄り、群衆をすり抜ける追従カット、足場を飛び越える俯瞰、着地の足元超接写、ロープや布を使った移動のダイナミックな斜め構図などを織り交ぜてください。 エネルギッシュでスタイリッシュな映像にしつつ、祝祭都市ならではの高低差と混雑を活かしたスリリングな逃走にしてください。 

重要： 静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。 走りや盗みなど自然にアニメーションさせてください。 動画全体を通して、同じ祭りのきのこ都市の雰囲気と高品質アニメスタイルを維持してください。 文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないでください。 颯爽シーンとしてハラハラドキドキを演じてください。 主人公の顔、青いフード、衣装、背負った籠、発光きのこの形状を全編で一貫して維持してください。

en.p:
@画像1 = Main character.
@画像2 = Refer to storyboards. 

Based on the attached storyboard images, create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 animated thrilling escape scene video. 

Theme: Thief girl 

Turn the fast-paced and lively scenes into videos following the storyboard panel order. Flow: Starting with a bird's-eye view of the festive giant mushroom city, a blue-hooded thief girl steals a rare glowing mushroom at the heart of the festival while blending into the heat and decorations of the crowd. At the moment of stealing, mix in your hands and facial expressions, and immediately after succeeding, show a thrilling smile that seems to be a bit of enjoyment. Then, make your dash away using the festival venue's uneven scaffolding, food stalls, decorated walkways, and spaces lined with ropes and cloth. The pursuers and surrounding crowd are startled and begin to chase the girl, who slips through the crowd, leaps over, slips in, and escapes nimbly. Finally, pass through high platforms or bridges, and finish by running through the festive lights. 

Style: High-quality animated film style, cinematic lighting, thrilling masterpieces, high definition, vivid colors, festive and glamorous atmosphere, lively crowds, giant mushroom decorations, and an energetic world filled with confetti and fabric ornaments. Girls should balance cuteness and agility, creating an atmosphere where fun and danger coexist. 

Edit: Use rhythmic high-speed cuts, close-up shots, ultra-close-up, low angles, bird's-eye shots, quick pans, and pleasant match cuts. Mix in close-up shots at the moment of stealing, close-up expressions at the start of a run, chase cuts weaving through the crowd, aerial views of jumping over scaffolding, ultra-close-up shots of feet when landing, and dynamic diagonal compositions of movement using ropes and fabric. Create energetic and stylish footage while making the most of the elevation differences and crowds unique to a festive city—a thrilling escape. 

Important: Do not use it as a still image slideshow. Animation naturally for running, stealing, and other activities. Throughout the video, maintain the same festival-like mushroom city atmosphere and high-quality anime style. Do not include text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks. Play out the thrilling and heart-pounding scenes as a thrilling scene. Consistently maintain the protagonist's face, blue hood, costume, basket on his back, and glowing mushroom shape throughout the film.

raw_p:
15-second cinematic dark fantasy sequence inside a frozen arctic wasteland during a violent snowstorm.

A colossal ancient titan sleeps trapped beneath a massive iceberg larger than mountains, barely visible under layers of translucent ice and deep frozen cracks. Only vague shapes of its gigantic face and body can be seen beneath the frozen surface.

The camera slowly glides across the icy landscape with heavy wind, drifting snow particles, frozen fog, and deep blue-white moonlight reflecting through the glacier.

As the camera pushes closer, subtle tremors begin beneath the ice. Tiny fractures spread slowly across the frozen surface. Deep muffled resonance echoes from below like an ancient heartbeat awakening after centuries.

The titan’s enormous eye slowly opens beneath the translucent ice. A massive glowing iris appears under the glacier, illuminating the frozen depths with cold cyan light. Snow and frost slide from the surface as the eye moves for the first time.

The surrounding iceberg creaks violently, frozen dust falling into deep cracks. The camera holds on the gigantic eye staring upward from beneath the ice while distant thunder rolls through the blizzard.

Style: ultra cinematic dark fantasy, colossal scale, ancient god atmosphere, frozen textures, realistic snow simulation, volumetric fog, moody blue lighting, atmospheric depth, glacier translucency, slow suspense pacing, photorealistic ice details.

Audio: ONLY cinematic sound effects, no music. Arctic wind, distant ice cracking, deep subsonic rumbles, frozen debris shifting, muffled titan breathing beneath the glacier, low resonance pulses.

zh.p:
一段15秒的黑暗奇幻电影，场景设定在冰冻的北极荒原，暴风雪中。

一只巨大的古代泰坦被困在一座比山脉还大的巨大冰山下沉睡，冰层层覆盖着透明的冰层和深冰裂缝，几乎看不见。冰封表面下只能隐约看到它庞大的脸庞和身体的轮廓。

镜头缓缓滑过冰冷的地形，伴随着强风、飘落的雪粒、冰雾和透过冰川反射的深蓝白色月光。

随着镜头靠近，冰下开始出现细微的震动。细小的裂缝缓缓蔓延在冰冻的表面上。深沉而闷响的共鸣从下方回响，如同古老心跳在数百年后苏醒。

巨人巨大的眼睛在半透明的冰层下缓缓睁开。冰川下出现了一个巨大的发光虹膜，冷清的青色光芒照亮了冰封的深渊。当眼睛首次移动时，雪和霜从表面滑落。

周围的冰山剧烈吱吱作响，冰冷的尘埃落入深深的裂缝中。镜头锁定了冰下那只巨大的眼睛，凝视着上方，远处雷声穿过暴风雪。

风格：极具电影感的黑暗奇幻，庞大的规模，古代神祇氛围，冰冻纹理，逼真的雪景模拟，体积雾气，阴郁的蓝色灯光，氛围深度，冰川半透明感，缓慢悬念节奏，照片级真实的冰层细节。

音频：只有电影音效，没有音乐。北极风，远处冰层破裂，低沉亚音速隆隆，冰冻碎片移动，冰川下泰坦的呼吸声，低频共振脉冲。

raw_p:
Epic Viking fantasy action set on a vast frozen lake beneath a stormy northern sky. Endless snowfields, distant mountains, harsh winds, blowing snow. High-speed chase with brutal survival energy. Sound: crunching ice, roaring wind, heavy breathing, cracking frozen surfaces, monstrous growls.

0–3s — HOOK

A Viking warrior carrying a flaming torch sprints across a frozen lake.

His boots hammer across the ice.

Behind him—

A gigantic frost-covered werewolf bursts through drifting snow.

White fur coated in ice crystals.

Blue eyes glowing.

Its massive paws crack the frozen surface beneath every step.

⸻

3–6s — ESCALATION

The warrior pushes harder.

The werewolf rapidly closes distance.

Chunks of ice break apart behind them.

The creature occasionally lunges forward, nearly catching him.

Its claws leave deep fractures spreading across the lake.

⸻

6–9s — BUILD

Ahead, a huge pressure crack cuts across the lake.

The warrior spots it.

He lowers his center of gravity and accelerates.

The werewolf roars and commits fully to the chase.

Snow and ice explode behind it.

⸻

9–12s — THE TRAP

The warrior reaches the pressure crack and dives into a controlled slide.

He skims across the narrow gap and reaches solid ice beyond.

The werewolf charges after him.

Bullet time.

Its front paws hit the weakened section.

Cracks spread outward in every direction.

⸻

12–15s — PAYOFF

The entire frozen surface collapses beneath the werewolf.

Massive sheets of ice explode upward.

The beast drops into the freezing black water below.

The warrior rolls onto the snowy shoreline and scrambles to safety.

Behind him, enormous ice slabs crash back into the lake.

Silence.

The warrior stands, breathing heavily, torch still burning.

zh.p:
史诗般的维京奇幻动作，背景设定在风暴交加的北方天空下，冰封的广阔湖泊上。无尽的雪原，远方的群山，刺骨的风，飘雪。高速追逐，充满残酷的生存能量。声音：冰块被踩碎，风声呼啸，沉重的呼吸，冰冻表面破裂，怪物般的咆哮。

0–3 — 钩球

一名维京战士手持燃烧的火把，飞奔穿越冰冻的湖面。

他的靴子在冰面上发出沉重的敲击声。

在他身后——

一只被霜覆盖的巨大狼人冲破飘雪。

白色的毛发覆盖着冰晶。

蓝色的眼睛发光。

它巨大的爪子在每一步下都咔嚓作响。

⸻

3–6 — 升级

战士更用力地推了进去。

狼人迅速拉近距离。

身后冰块碎裂。

那生物偶尔猛扑过来，差点抓住他。

它的爪子在湖面上留下深深的裂缝。

⸻

6–9 — 构建

前方，一道巨大的压力裂缝横跨湖面。

战士发现了它。

他降低重心加速。

狼人咆哮着，全力投入追逐。

雪和冰在它身后爆发。

⸻

9–12岁组 — 陷阱

战士到达压力裂缝处，俯冲进入受控滑行。

他滑过狭窄的缝隙，来到坚硬的冰层。

狼人冲了上去。

子弹时间。

它的前爪触碰到了虚弱的部位。

裂缝向四面八方蔓延。

⸻

12–15 — 回报

整个冰封的表面在狼人身下坍塌。

巨大的冰层向上爆裂。

野兽掉进冰冷的黑水中。

战士滚落在积雪的海岸线上，慌忙逃离。

他身后，巨大的冰块坠入湖中。

寂静。

战士站起，呼吸急促，火把依旧燃烧。

raw_p:
High-action medieval fantasy chase beneath a massive full moon. Ancient European city of stone towers, narrow streets, cathedral spires, smoking chimneys, fluttering banners. Silver moonlight reflects off wet rooftops from recent rain. Fast-paced, chaotic cinematography with aggressive tracking shots, speed ramps, handheld energy, and dramatic moonlit silhouettes. Sound: distant church bells, heavy breathing, tile cracking, werewolf roars, rushing wind.

0–3s — HOOK

A rogue thief in a dark leather cloak sprints across steep medieval rooftops.

He leaps a gap between buildings.

The instant he lands—

A gigantic werewolf crashes onto the roof behind him.

Eight feet tall.

Jet-black fur.

Yellow eyes glowing in the moonlight.

The roof caves beneath its weight.

Tiles explode everywhere.

⸻

3–6s — ESCALATION

The thief races along the rooftops, vaulting chimneys and sliding over wet tiles.

Behind him, the werewolf ignores every obstacle.

It smashes through chimneys instead of avoiding them.

Bricks and debris rain into the streets below.

The creature gains ground rapidly.

⸻

6–9s — BUILD

Ahead, the thief reaches a steep roof overlooking a massive cathedral square.

He slides uncontrollably down slick tiles.

The werewolf launches after him.

The gap between them shrinks to almost nothing.

The beast’s claws scrape sparks from the stone.

⸻

9–12s — THE ESCAPE

At the edge of the roof hangs a giant ceremonial banner suspended above the square.

The thief leaps and grabs it.

The banner tears loose from its mountings.

He swings across the moonlit square.

The werewolf follows without hesitation.

Bullet time.

Both suspended over open air.

⸻

12–15s — PAYOFF

The thief draws a knife and slices the banner rope.

He swings clear.

The werewolf loses its trajectory.

It crashes directly through the cathedral’s enormous stained-glass rose window.

Colored glass explodes outward.

The beast disappears into darkness inside the cathedral.

The thief lands on the opposite rooftop and turns back.

A massive crash echoes from within the cathedral.

zh.p:
高强度的中世纪奇幻追逐，在巨大的满月下展开。古老的欧洲城市，石塔、狭窄街道、大教堂尖塔、冒烟的烟囱、飘扬的旗帜。银色的月光映照在最近雨水湿润的屋顶上。节奏明快、混乱的摄影，配合激烈的跟踪镜头、加速坡、手持能量和戏剧性的月光剪影。声音：远处教堂钟声、沉重的呼吸、瓷砖裂开声、狼人咆哮、呼啸的风。

0–3 — 钩球

一名身披深色皮斗篷的流氓盗贼在陡峭的中世纪屋顶上奔跑。

他跳过建筑间的缝隙。

他一落地——

一只巨大的狼人撞上了他身后的屋顶。

八英尺高。

乌黑的毛发。

黄色的眼睛在月光下闪闪发光。

屋顶在它的重量下塌陷。

瓷砖到处爆炸。

⸻

3–6 — 升级

小偷在屋顶上奔跑，翻越烟囱，滑过湿瓦片。

身后，狼人无视所有障碍。

它撞穿烟囱，而不是躲避。

砖块和碎片纷纷落入街道。

这生物迅速追赶。

⸻

6–9 — 构建

前方，小偷来到一个陡峭的屋顶，俯瞰着巨大的大教堂广场。

他不受控制地滑过光滑的瓷砖。

狼人追了上去。

他们之间的距离几乎消失了。

野兽的爪子在石头上划出火花。

⸻

9–12年级——逃脱

屋顶边缘悬挂着一面巨大的仪式旗帜，悬挂在广场上方。

小偷跳起来抓住了它。

旗帜从挂架上撕裂。

他荡过月光下的广场。

狼人毫不犹豫地跟了上去。

子弹时间。

两者都悬挂在露天上方。

⸻

12–15 — 回报

小偷拔刀割断了横幅绳。

他摆出了一道。

狼人失去了轨迹。

它直接撞穿了大教堂巨大的彩色玻璃玫瑰窗。

彩色玻璃向外爆裂。

野兽消失在大教堂内的黑暗中。

小偷落在对面的屋顶，然后转身离开。

大教堂内传来一声巨响。

en.p:
High-action medieval fantasy chase beneath a massive full moon. Ancient European city of stone towers, narrow streets, cathedral spires, smoking chimneys, fluttering banners. Silver moonlight reflects off wet rooftops from recent rain. Fast-paced, chaotic cinematography with aggressive tracking shots, speed ramps, handheld energy, and dramatic moonlit silhouettes. Sound: distant church bells, heavy breathing, tile cracking, werewolf roars, rushing wind.

0–3s — HOOK

A rogue thief in a dark leather cloak sprints across steep medieval rooftops.

He leaps a gap between buildings.

The instant he lands—

A gigantic werewolf crashes onto the roof behind him.

Eight feet tall.

Jet-black fur.

Yellow eyes glowing in the moonlight.

The roof caves beneath its weight.

Tiles explode everywhere.

⸻

3–6s — ESCALATION

The thief races along the rooftops, vaulting chimneys and sliding over wet tiles.

Behind him, the werewolf ignores every obstacle.

It smashes through chimneys instead of avoiding them.

Bricks and debris rain into the streets below.

The creature gains ground rapidly.

⸻

6–9s — BUILD

Ahead, the thief reaches a steep roof overlooking a massive cathedral square.

He slides uncontrollably down slick tiles.

The werewolf launches after him.

The gap between them shrinks to almost nothing.

The beast’s claws scrape sparks from the stone.

⸻

9–12s — THE ESCAPE

At the edge of the roof hangs a giant ceremonial banner suspended above the square.

The thief leaps and grabs it.

The banner tears loose from its mountings.

He swings across the moonlit square.

The werewolf follows without hesitation.

Bullet time.

Both suspended over open air.

⸻

12–15s — PAYOFF

The thief draws a knife and slices the banner rope.

He swings clear.

The werewolf loses its trajectory.

It crashes directly through the cathedral’s enormous stained-glass rose window.

Colored glass explodes outward.

The beast disappears into darkness inside the cathedral.

The thief lands on the opposite rooftop and turns back.

A massive crash echoes from within the cathedral.

raw_p:
Dark fantasy action sequence. Dense moonlit forest at night. Thick fog. Silver moonlight cutting through trees. Fast handheld tracking shots. Chaotic action. Sound: heavy breathing, snapping branches, pounding hooves, werewolf growls.

0–3s — HOOK

A young warrior sprints through dense forest carrying a spear.

Branches whip past his face.

Behind him—

A colossal werewolf crashes through trees.

Massive shoulders.

Silver-gray fur.

Glowing amber eyes.

Every step sends dirt flying.

The creature is gaining fast.

3–6s — ESCALATION

The warrior vaults fallen logs and dodges tree trunks.

The werewolf tears straight through obstacles instead of avoiding them.

Entire trees snap and fall.

The forest explodes around them.

The warrior glances back.

The werewolf is only meters away.

6–9s — BUILD

The warrior bursts into a giant moonlit clearing.

Ahead—

A herd of enormous elk-like creatures stampedes across the field.

Towering antlers.

Dozens of them.

The ground shakes beneath their charge.

9–12s — CHAOS

The warrior dives into the middle of the stampede.

Bodies thunder past on both sides.

The werewolf charges directly after him.

Antlers slam into the beast.

Hooves strike.

Dirt and debris fill the air.

The clearing becomes complete chaos.

12–15s — PAYOFF

The warrior reaches a cliff edge hidden beyond the clearing.

He leaps.

The werewolf bursts through the stampede behind him and jumps too.

The warrior catches a tree growing from the cliff face.

The werewolf misses.

It sails past him and disappears into the darkness below.

The warrior hangs from the tree, breathing hard.

Cut.

zh.p:
黑暗奇幻动作场面。夜晚的密林月光照耀。浓雾弥漫。银色月光穿透树木。快速手持追踪镜头。混乱的行动。声音：沉重的呼吸声，折断树枝的声音，重重的蹄声，狼人的咆哮。

0–3 — 钩球

一名年轻战士手持长矛，穿过茂密的森林。

树枝从他脸旁呼啸而过。

在他身后——

一只巨大的狼人撞穿树木。

巨大的肩膀。

银灰色的毛发。

发光的琥珀色眼睛。

每一步都把泥土飞扬。

生物迅速逼近。

3–6 — 升级

战士们翻倒下的树干，躲避树干。

狼人直接冲破障碍物，而不是躲避。

整棵树断裂倒下。

森林在他们周围爆炸。

战士回头看了一眼。

狼人就在几米外。

6–9 — 构建

战士冲进一片巨大的月光空地。

前方——

一群巨大的麋鹿状生物在田野上奔跑。

高耸的鹿角。

几十个。

地面在他们的冲锋下震动。

9-12年级——混乱

战士冲进了人群的中心。

两侧的尸体轰鸣般地掠过。

狼人直接冲了上来。

鹿角猛地撞击那头野兽。

马蹄声。

空气中充满了泥土和杂物。

空地变成了一片混乱。

12–15 — 回报

战士来到空地后隐藏的悬崖边缘。

他跳了起来。

狼人冲破身后的狂奔，也跳了起来。

战士抓住了悬崖上长出的一棵树。

狼人没打中。

它从他身边飞过，消失在黑暗中。

战士悬挂在树上，呼吸急促。

停。

raw_p:
画像 1 = 3人のキャラクター参照。顔、髪型、服装、雰囲気を全編で一貫して維持すること。
画像 2 = 絵コンテ参照。パネル順、テンポ感、表情変化、立ち位置の奪い合い、コメディ演出の流れを参照すること。
添付された画像 1と画像 2をもとに、15秒の横型16:9のプリクラ機コメディシーン動画を作成してください。  テーマ  プリクラ機の中で、3人がシャッターのたびにセンター争奪戦を繰り広げる、ハイテンポで可愛くて騒がしいコメディシーン。

シーン設定  舞台はプリクラ機の内部。 カメラは固定されたプリクラ機のレンズ視点であり、カメラ本体や外側から見たショットは出さないこと。 画面は常に、プリクラ機の撮影画面に映る3人を中心に見せる。
3人は画像 1のキャラクターそのままで、  左の黒髪男性 中央の女の子 右の金髪男性 の関係性・見た目・表情の魅力を維持すること。 動画の基本コンセプト  3人が「自分が一番盛れる位置＝画面の中心」を奪い合う。 シャッターが切られる直前になるたびに、誰かが急に前へ出たり、横から割り込んだり、押しのけたり、顔を突っ込んだりして、センターを奪い合う。 コミカルで大げさなリアクション、可愛いポーズ、変顔寸前の焦り、嫉妬、驚き、ぶりっこ、強引な割り込みなどを盛り込み、プリクラらしい“盛れたい欲”のバトルとして描く。 最終的には3人ともフレームに収まり、仲良く可愛く決まるオチにする。

流れ（15秒構成）
0.0秒〜2.0秒  3人が最初のポーズに入る。 中央の女の子がかわいくポーズを決め、左右の2人がそれぞれ「自分も写りたい」と身を乗り出す。 まだ平和だが、すでにセンターの奪い合いの気配がある。 表情は、黒髪男性はクールに狙っている感じ、金髪男性は大げさでテンション高め、女の子は少し戸惑いながらも可愛く決めている。  2.0秒〜4.0秒  最初のシャッター直前、右の金髪男性が勢いよくセンターへ顔を突っ込む。 顔が大きく前に来て、他の2人が押しのけられそうになる。 女の子はびっくり、黒髪男性は不満げに睨む。 “誰かが急に前に出てくる”面白さを強く出す。
4.0秒〜6.0秒  次のシャッター前、今度は左の黒髪男性が素早く前へ入り、クールにキメ顔でセンターを奪う。 金髪男性は「えっ！？」というオーバーリアクション、女の子は2人に挟まれて困り顔。 顔の寄り、視線のぶつかり、微妙な押し合いで笑いを作る。
6.0秒〜8.0秒  女の子が「ちょっと！」という感じで2人を押し返し、自分でセンターを取り返す。 かわいいウインク、ほっぺを手で包むポーズ、ぶりっこポーズなど、プリクラらしい盛れる仕草を決める。 左右の2人は奥や端に追いやられて悔しがる。  8.0秒〜10.0秒  シャッター音のタイミングに合わせて、3人が一斉にセンターへ雪崩れ込む。 顔同士が近づきすぎる、肩がぶつかる、片方が顔を押し込む、もう片方が横から入り込むなど、わちゃわちゃした密度の高いコメディにする。 ここはテンポ最速。 それぞれの表情は、焦り、ムキ、驚き、笑い、必死さが入り混じる。
10.0秒〜12.5秒  一瞬バランスを崩しかけるが、3人ともなんとかフレーム内に収まろうと調整する。 押し合いから、徐々に「せーの」でまとまる空気に変化。 女の子が中央、黒髪男性が左、金髪男性が右に入り、3人の顔が綺麗に見える位置へ収束していく。
12.5秒〜15.0秒  ラストシャッター。 3人が同時にベストポーズを決める。 女の子はかわいく、黒髪男性は少しクールに微笑み、金髪男性は元気に明るく笑う。 最後は仲良し感のある、盛れたプリクラの決めカットで締める。 ラストに向かって空気が喧嘩ではなく、可愛いカオスから仲良しオチへ変わること。

スタイル  超高品質・超高精細・フォトリアル寄りの実写風映像。 ただし空気感はプリクラらしいポップで可愛い世界観。 全体として、  明るく柔らかい高キー照明 美肌感 ほんのりピンク、ラベンダー、水色系の可愛い色調 キラキラ感 ポップでラブリーな雰囲気 若者向けのテンション感 を持たせること。 平成〜令和の可愛いプリクラ文化のノリを感じる、ハイテンポで盛れるビジュアル。 演出 カメラは原則固定されたプリクラ機のレンズ視点 ただし、完成映像として気持ちよく見えるように、軽微なデジタルパンチイン、微細な揺れ、勢いを感じる前後運動感、顔の寄り引き感は可 外から見た引きショットは禁止 カメラ本体が画面に映る構図は禁止 面白さは、被写体側の動き、顔の出入り、押し合い、割り込み、表情芝居で作ること シャッターのタイミングごとに、一瞬“決めポーズ”になりそうで崩れる→誰かが割り込むという流れを明快にすること 編集  リズム感のある高速展開、寄りカット感、超接写感、勢いのある前後運動、表情の切り替えを重視してください。 実際のカメラ位置は固定でも、被写体がレンズへ近づいたり離れたり、左右から割り込んだりすることで、映像に大きな変化を作ってください。 テンポの良いシャッタータイミング、可愛い間、コミカルな詰め合い、ぴたっと決まるラストを意識してください。 静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。 3人の顔、髪、服、アクセサリー、年齢感、雰囲気を保ったまま、自然で豊かなアニメーションとして動かしてください。  感情トーン 可愛い コメディ わちゃわちゃ ちょっと恋愛っぽい空気 軽い嫉妬 全員が自分を一番可愛く／かっこよく写したい必死さ 最後は仲良し 重要 カメラ本体を画面に出さないこと ショットはプリクラ機のレンズ視点で統一すること 画像 1の3人の顔、髪型、服装、キャラクター性を全編で一貫して維持すること 画像 2の絵コンテのテンポ感、立ち位置の奪い合い、コメディ性を踏襲すること 静止画のスライドショー禁止 文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないこと 過度な人数追加禁止 別人化禁止 ラストは3人がしっかり盛れて、可愛くまとまること

スタイル  超高品質・超高精細・フォトリアル寄りの実写風映像。 ただし空気感はプリクラらしいポップで可愛い世界観。 全体として、  明るく柔らかい高キー照明 美肌感 ほんのりピンク、ラベンダー、水色系の可愛い色調 キラキラ感 ポップでラブリーな雰囲気 若者向けのテンション感 を持たせること。 平成〜令和の可愛いプリクラ文化のノリを感じる、ハイテンポで盛れるビジュアル。 演出 カメラは原則固定されたプリクラ機のレンズ視点 ただし、完成映像として気持ちよく見えるように、軽微なデジタルパンチイン、微細な揺れ、勢いを感じる前後運動感、顔の寄り引き感は可 外から見た引きショットは禁止 カメラ本体が画面に映る構図は禁止 面白さは、被写体側の動き、顔の出入り、押し合い、割り込み、表情芝居で作ること シャッターのタイミングごとに、一瞬“決めポーズ”になりそうで崩れる→誰かが割り込むという流れを明快にすること 編集  リズム感のある高速展開、寄りカット感、超接写感、勢いのある前後運動、表情の切り替えを重視してください。 実際のカメラ位置は固定でも、被写体がレンズへ近づいたり離れたり、左右から割り込んだりすることで、映像に大きな変化を作ってください。 テンポの良いシャッタータイミング、可愛い間、コミカルな詰め合い、ぴたっと決まるラストを意識してください。 静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。 3人の顔、髪、服、アクセサリー、年齢感、雰囲気を保ったまま、自然で豊かなアニメーションとして動かしてください。  感情トーン 可愛い コメディ わちゃわちゃ ちょっと恋愛っぽい空気 軽い嫉妬 全員が自分を一番可愛く／かっこよく写したい必死さ 最後は仲良し 重要 カメラ本体を画面に出さないこと ショットはプリクラ機のレンズ視点で統一すること 画像 1の3人の顔、髪型、服装、キャラクター性を全編で一貫して維持すること 画像 2の絵コンテのテンポ感、立ち位置の奪い合い、コメディ性を踏襲すること 静止画のスライドショー禁止 文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないこと 過度な人数追加禁止 別人化禁止 ラストは3人がしっかり盛れて、可愛くまとまること

en.p:
Image 1 = See the three characters. Consistently maintain your face, hairstyle, clothing, and atmosphere throughout the film.
Image 2 = See storyboard. Refer to the sequence of panels, tempo, changes in facial expressions, the battle for positions, and the flow of comedic direction.
Based on the attached images 1 and 2, create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio comedy scene video of a purikura machine.  Theme: Inside the purikura machine, the three compete for the center every time the shutter is released, creating a fast-paced, cute, and noisy comedy scene.

Scene Setting: The setting is inside the purikura machine. The camera is the fixed lens view of the purikura machine, and no shots taken from the camera itself or the outside are allowed. The screen always focuses on the three people shown in the photo booth's photo booth.
The three maintain the character's character from image 1, maintaining the charm of the relationship, appearance, and expressions: the black-haired man on the left, the girl in the center, and the blond man on the right. Basic concept of the video: The three compete for 'the position where they can stand out the most = the center of the screen.' Every time the shutter is about to be released, someone suddenly steps forward, cuts in from the side, pushes aside, or pokes their face in battle to take the center. It incorporates comical and exaggerated reactions, cute poses, impatience about to make funny faces, jealousy, surprise, cuteness, and forced interruptions, portraying it as a battle of "desire to get carried out" in the style of purikura. In the end, all three fit into the frame, and the ending ends with a cute and friendly relationship.

Flow (15-second format)
0.0 to 2.0 seconds: Three people enter the first pose. The girl in the center strikes a cute pose, and the two on either side lean forward, saying they want to be in the photo too. It's still peaceful, but there are already signs of a battle for the center. The expressions were: the black-haired man seemed to be aiming coolly, the blond guy was exaggerated and excited, and the girl, though a bit hesitant, was still cutely decided.  2.0 to 4.0 seconds: Just before the first shutter, the blond man on the right forcefully plunges his face into the center. His face was pushed forward, and the other two almost pushed him aside. The girl was surprised, and the black-haired man glared at him with dissatisfaction. Emphasize the fun of "someone suddenly stepping forward."
4.0 seconds to 6.0 seconds: Before the next shot, the black-haired man on the left quickly steps forward and takes center stage with a cool, sullen face. The blond man exclaimed, "Huh!?" With such an overreact, the girl looked troubled as she was caught between the two. Face-to-face closeness, eye contact, and subtle pushing create laughter.
6.0 to 8.0 seconds: The girl says, "Hey!" He pushed the two back and took center position himself. She strikes cute winks, poses where she cups her cheek with her hand, and cute poses—all of which are typical of purikura. The two on either side are frustrated as they are pushed to the back or edge.  8.0 to 10.0 seconds: Synchronized with the shutter sound, the three of them simultaneously plunge toward the center. The comedy is packed with chaotic pressure, with faces getting too close, shoulders bumping, one side pushing their face in, and the other squeezing in from the side. This is the fastest tempo. Each expression is a mix of anxiety, frustration, surprise, laughter, and desperation.
10.0 to 12.5 seconds: Momentarily nearly losing balance, but all three try to stay within the frame. The atmosphere gradually shifted from pushing each other to a 'set-up' approach. The girl takes the center, the black-haired man goes to the left, and the blond man goes to the right, converging into a position where the three faces look beautiful.
12.5 to 15.0 seconds: Final shutter. All three strike their best poses simultaneously. The girl is cute, the black-haired man smiles a little coolly, and the blond man smiles cheerfully and brightly. The finish is a close, lively purikura photo with a signature shot. Toward the end, the atmosphere shifts from a fight to a cute chaos that turns into a friendly punchline.

Style: Ultra-high-quality, ultra-high-definition, photorealistic live-action footage. However, the atmosphere is a pop and cute world typical of Purikura. Overall, it should provide bright, soft high-key lighting, a beautiful skin feel, cute shades of subtle pink, lavender, and light blue, sparkle, a pop and lovely atmosphere, and a sense of energy for young people. A high-tempo visuals that capture the vibe of cute purikura culture from the Heisei to Reiwa eras. Direction: The camera is basically fixed from the lens of the purikura machine. However, to make the finished video look good, slight digital punch-in, subtle shaking, forward and backward movement with momentum, and facial movements are allowed. Close-up shots viewed from outside are prohibited. Compositions showing the camera body on the screen are prohibited. Fun should be created through the subject's movements, face-to-face movements, pushing, interruptions, and facial expressions At every shutter timing, make it clear that someone will interrupt → the moment you almost fall into a "signature pose." Edit: Focus on rhythmic, high-speed development, a sharp cut, ultra-close-up feel, dynamic forward and backward movement, and facial expression transitions. Even if the actual camera position is fixed, make a big difference in the image by moving the subject closer to or farther from the lens, or cutting in from the left and right. Keep in mind the fast-paced shutter timing, cute moments, comical interactions, and a perfect finish. Do not use it as a still image slideshow. Move the three faces, hair, clothes, accessories, age, and atmosphere as natural and rich animations while maintaining their sense of age.  Emotional tone: Cute, comedy, chaotic, a slightly romantic atmosphere, a slight jealousy, everyone desperately wants to make themselves the cutest/coolest in the photo. In the end, friendship is important. Do not show the camera body on the screen. Shots must be taken from the lens of the purikura camera. raw_p:
High fantasy action sequence. Massive stone bridge spanning a bottomless canyon under stormy skies. Wind howling. Lightning in the distance. Medieval fantasy world. Fast-paced, chaotic cinematography with aggressive camera movement and speed ramps. Sound: crashing stone, werewolf growls, chain rattles, dragon roars.

0–3s — HOOK

A female huntress with braided hair, leather armor, and a bow sprints across an ancient stone bridge.

Behind her—

A gigantic armored werewolf bursts through the bridge entrance.

Seven feet tall.

Black fur.

Steel armor plates fused into its shoulders and forearms.

It charges at terrifying speed.

Stone cracks beneath every step.

3–6s — ESCALATION

The huntress races forward.

The werewolf smashes through support pillars while gaining ground.

Chunks of stone fall into the canyon.

The bridge begins collapsing section by section behind them.

The gap between them shrinks rapidly.

6–9s — BUILD

Ahead, the huntress spots a massive hanging chain descending into the canyon.

The bridge is breaking apart.

She sprints harder.

The werewolf lunges and nearly grabs her cloak.

A support tower collapses.

The entire bridge starts giving way.

9–12s — THE JUMP

The huntress leaps.

She catches the hanging chain and swings out over the canyon.

The werewolf launches after her.

Bullet time.

Chain swinging.

Stone exploding.

The werewolf suspended mid-air.

Its claws miss by inches.

12–15s — PAYOFF

A giant dragon erupts upward from beneath the canyon.

The huntress releases the chain and lands on the dragon’s back.

The dragon banks hard.

The werewolf falls past them roaring.

Disappearing into the fog below.

The huntress raises her fist.

Dragon roars.

zh.p:
高幻想动作场面。巨大的石桥横跨无底峡谷，暴风雨中。风呼啸。远处闪电。中世纪奇幻世界。快节奏、混乱的摄影，配合激烈的镜头运动和速度加速。声音：石头撞击声，狼人咆哮，锁链碰撞，龙吼。

0–3 — 钩球

一位编着辫子、身穿皮甲、手持弓箭的女猎人，正飞奔穿过一座古老的石桥。

她身后——

一只巨大的装甲狼人冲破了桥口。

七英尺高。

黑色的毛发。

钢制装甲板与其肩膀和前臂融合。

它以惊人的速度充能。

每一步下石头都裂开了。

3–6 — 升级

猎手飞奔而上。

狼人在推进时撞穿了支撑柱。

石块坠入峡谷。

桥开始在他们身后一路坍塌。

他们之间的距离迅速缩小。

6–9 — 构建

前方，猎手发现一条巨大的悬挂链条正下降到峡谷中。

桥正在断裂。

她加快了冲刺速度。

狼人猛扑过去，差点抓住她的斗篷。

一座支撑塔倒塌。

整座桥开始塌陷。

9–12岁组 — 跳跃

女猎手跃起。

她抓住了挂着的链条，荡出峡谷。

狼人追赶她。

子弹时间。

链条摆荡。

石头爆炸了。

狼人悬浮在半空中。

它的爪子差几英寸就没打中。

12–15 — 回报

一条巨大的龙从峡谷下方喷涌而出。

猎手松开锁链，落在龙背上。

龙猛地转弯。

狼人咆哮着从他们身边坠落。

消失在下面的雾中。

猎人举起拳头。

龙吼。

raw_p:
Grand luxury hotel entrance at night, wet cobblestone street, light rain, glowing city reflections in puddles.
Style: Dark crime drama film tone, deep shadows, warm amber hotel facade lights against cold blue rain, film grain texture, slow controlled pacing.
Lighting: Amber hotel awning light, cold blue rain scatter, wet reflective ground surface.
Audio: Soft rain, distant city hum, low orchestral string swell, sharp footsteps on wet stone.

[0–4s]
Camera: Slow aerial pull-down, wide establishing shot.
Action: A black luxury sedan glides to a stop in front of the hotel entrance. Rain falls steadily. Steam rises from the wet street.
Lighting: Cool blue rain light, warm amber spill from hotel facade.

[4–8s]
Camera: Low-angle static shot, then slow push-in.
Action: The rear car door swings open. A man in an elegant black suit, sunglasses and leather gloves steps out. Two bodyguards appear behind him holding umbrellas.
Lighting: Harsh amber key light from the hotel, deep shadows framing the figure.

[8–12s]
Camera: Smooth lateral tracking shot following his stride.
Action: The suited man walks steadily toward the hotel entrance. Bystanders and hotel staff step aside. Cigarette smoke drifts from his hand.
Lighting: Rim light from hotel windows, soft fill from overhead awning lamps.

[12–15s]
Camera: Slow orbit around him, low angle rising.
Action: He pauses at the entrance, adjusts his lapel, and glances back over his shoulder with a faint smirk. Text fades in: "Power doesn't ask for attention."
Lighting: Warm single-source hotel lobby glow, city lights blurred behind him.

Avoid: Identity drift, jitter, chaotic composition, temporal flicker, inconsistent features between shots.

zh.p:
夜晚豪华酒店入口，湿漉漉的鹅卵石街道，细雨，水坑中城市的倒影。
风格：黑暗犯罪剧情片基调，深邃阴影，温暖的琥珀色酒店立面灯光映衬冷蓝雨，胶片颗粒感，缓慢而有控制的节奏。
照明：琥珀色酒店遮阳篷灯，冷蓝色雨点，湿润反光地面。
音频：轻柔的雨声，远处城市的嗡鸣，低沉的管弦乐渐强，湿滑石头上的清脆脚步声。

[0–4秒]
摄影：慢速空中拉拉，广角建立镜头。
动作：一辆黑色豪华轿车滑行停在酒店入口前。雨持续下着。湿漉漉的街道冒出蒸汽。
灯光：凉蓝色雨光，酒店外墙洒出的温暖琥珀色光。

[4–8]
摄影：低角度静态镜头，然后慢速推入。
动作：后车门打开。一名身穿优雅黑色西装、戴着墨镜和皮手套的男子走了出来。两名保镖撑着伞出现在他身后。
光线：酒店刺眼的琥珀色主光，深深的阴影框住了身影。

[8–12岁]
镜头：顺畅的横向跟踪镜头，跟随他的步伐。
动作：穿西装的男子稳步走向酒店入口。旁观者和酒店员工请让开。烟雾从他手中飘出。
照明：酒店窗户的边缘光，遮阳篷灯的柔和补光。

[12–15岁]
摄像头：绕他缓慢轨道，低角度上升。
动作：他在入口处停下，整理了一下西装领口，回头带着淡淡的笑意回头看了一眼。文字渐入：“权力不要求关注。”
光线：温暖的单一光源酒店大堂光芒，身后城市灯光模糊。

避免：身份漂移、抖动、混乱构图、时间闪烁、镜头间特征不一致。

raw_p:
Live telecast of a rocket launch with no commentary. Photorealistic recreation of a space rocket catastrophic explosion during a static fire test on the launch pad at nighttime.
The massive orbital rocket stands vertically on the launch pad under dark night skies. Suddenly, a violent failure triggers an enormous explosion. A gigantic orange-red fireball erupts instantly from the base, rapidly expanding into a towering mushroom cloud of fire, thick black smoke, and flying debris. A powerful shockwave blasts outward, shaking the entire scene. The rocket structure violently disintegrates as intense flames completely consume it.
Dynamic camera work captures the raw power with realistic fire physics, glowing embers, billowing smoke, and dramatic nighttime lighting. Epic scale, terrifying yet beautiful destruction, high-detail particles, 4K quality. 24-second intense explosion sequence.

zh.p:
火箭发射现场直播，无解说。在发射台静态点火测试中进行的太空火箭灾难性爆炸的写实再现。
这枚巨大的轨道火箭垂直矗立在发射台上，夜空漆黑。突然，一次剧烈失败引发了巨大的爆炸。一团巨大的橙红色火球瞬间从基地喷涌而出，迅速扩散成一团高耸的蘑菇云，火焰、浓重的黑烟和飞散的碎片。一股强烈的冲击波向外爆发，震动了整个场景。火箭结构剧烈解体，强烈的火焰将其完全吞噬。
动态的摄影通过逼真的火焰物理、发光的余烬、袅袅的烟雾和戏剧性的夜晚灯光捕捉了原始的力量。史诗般的规模，恐怖却美丽的毁灭，高细节粒子，4K画质。24秒的强烈爆炸序列。

视频以第一人称视角开始，骑手以高速冲出云层，乘坐一条巨大、色彩斑斓、扭曲的滑梯，横跨天空。水花猛烈地溅到镜头上，溅起逼真的水花和运动模糊。骑手沿着巨大的滑梯飞速滑行，滑行着疯狂的环形、急落差、螺旋转弯和近乎垂直的路段，穿梭于高耸的摩天大楼和霓虹灯闪烁的超现实城市建筑之间。

raw_p: In a telekinetic action scene, a South Korean high school girl in a white short-sleeved shirt and gray pleated skirt stands calmly in the middle of a corridor. She is being attacked from both sides; some attackers, wearing brown school uniform jackets, wield short sticks, while others are dressed as black ninjas, creating a tense standoff in the corridor. As the enemies rush towards her, the girl unleashes a powerful telekinetic attack. Suddenly, everything around her enters a state of weightlessness and time freezes. Dozens of items—open textbooks, notebooks, a red soda can, and a wooden school chair—leave the ground, perfectly suspending themselves in mid-air. The attackers, in their lunging movements, are frozen in mid-air by an invisible force. Paper pages, scraps of paper, and dust float and swirl around her weightlessly. The camera slowly zooms in on the girl, perfectly freezing the chaotic corridor in the telekinetic-induced state of stillness and suspension. In the extreme stillness of the slowly zooming-in, frozen image, the girl's calm eyes narrow slightly. Immediately afterward, she calmly raised her right hand, her fingers loosely clenched, and then made a light yet decisive flick of her sleeve to either side of her body. In an instant, frozen time and gravity seemed to explode with this subtle gesture. A low rumble echoed in the air, and dozens of objects that had been suspended in mid-air—a heavy wooden school chair, scattered textbooks, even the red soda can—transformed into a dense projection, carrying powerful air currents, and were precisely launched towards the enemies attacking from both sides. At the same time, an invisible circular psychic shockwave violently spread out from the girl. The brown-uniformed attackers and black-clad ninjas, who had been frozen in mid-air, were instantly struck by this immense force, their bodies jolted violently, and they were sent flying backward like kites with broken strings to either end of the corridor. As gravity instantly returned, the wooden chairs shattered upon impact, textbooks scattered into a flurry of pages, and with the dull thud of heavy objects hitting the ground, the attackers collapsed onto the corridor floor, incapacitated. Silence returned to the corridor, broken only by countless tattered papers and fine dust drifting slowly in the air. The aftershocks of the shockwave ruffled the girl's bangs and hair. She remained composed, not even glancing at her fallen opponent. The girl slowly lowered her right hand, raised her slender left, and gracefully and calmly tucked a strand of black hair behind her ear, revealing her delicate and serene profile. The camera froze on this moment, the white papers falling around her like snowflakes, highlighting her still figure in a white short-sleeved shirt and gray pleated skirt. Then, the image faded out.

zh.p: 在一场心灵遥控动作戏中，一名穿着白色短袖衬衫和灰色百褶裙的韩国高中女生平静地站在走廊中央。她正遭受两面攻击;一些袭击者穿着棕色校服夹克，手持短棍，另一些则装扮成黑色忍者，在走廊中制造紧张对峙。当敌人冲向她时，女孩释放出强力的念力攻击。突然，周围的一切都进入失重状态，时间凝固。数十件物品——打开的课本、笔记本、一罐红色汽水罐和一把木制校椅——从地面上飞出，完美地悬浮在半空中。攻击者在扑击动作中被一股无形的力量冻结在半空中。纸页、纸片和尘埃在她周围无重地漂浮旋转。镜头缓缓拉近女孩，完美地将混乱的走廊定格在心灵感应带来的静止和悬浮状态中。在这张缓缓放大、定格的画面极度静止中，女孩平静的眼睛微微眯起。紧接着，她平静地举起右手，手指松松地握紧，然后轻轻而果断地甩了甩袖子，向身体两侧挥了一下。瞬间，凝固的时间和重力仿佛因这细微的动作而爆发。空气中传来低沉的隆隆声，数十个悬浮在半空中的物品——沉重的木制校椅、散落的课本，甚至红色汽水罐——都变成了一个密集的投影体，携带着强大的气流，精准地朝着从两侧攻击的敌人发射。与此同时，一道无形的圆形心灵冲击波猛烈地从女孩身上扩散开来。那些穿棕色制服的攻击者和黑衣忍者被冻在半空中，瞬间被这股巨大力量击中，身体剧烈震动，像断线的风筝一样被击飞到走廊两端。重力瞬间恢复，木椅撞击时碎裂，课本散落成一团书页，伴随着沉重物品落地的闷响，袭击者倒在走廊地板上，失去行动能力。走廊再次陷入寂静，只有无数破烂的纸张和缓缓飘散的细微尘埃打破寂静。冲击波的余波弄乱了女孩的刘海和头发。她保持镇定，甚至没有看倒地的对手一眼。女孩缓缓放下右手，抬起纤细的左手，优雅而平静地将一缕黑发别到耳后，露出她那精致而宁静的侧脸。镜头定格在这一刻，白色的纸张像雪花一样飘落在她周围，映衬出她身穿白色短袖衬衫和灰色百褶裙的静止身影。然后，画面渐渐淡出。

raw_p: A cinematic, hyper-realistic sci-fi action sequence. It begins with a close-up of a young East Asian man with long, wavy dark hair focusing intense energy, red lightning and plasma crackling between his hands. The camera cuts to dozens of sleek, futuristic metallic armor pieces flying at high speed through a dark, industrial warehouse, converging on him. Sparks fly as the high-tech, gunmetal-grey armor rapidly mechanically assembles around his body. The final shot reveals him fully suited in a powerful, glowing mecha exoskeleton with a fiery, burning plasma aura radiating from his helmet. He executes an aggressive, sweeping strike with a glowing orange laser blade, causing a massive explosion with smoke and debris in the background. High-end CGI, studio lighting, octane render, 8k resolution, intense pacing.

15-second live-action big-air skateboarding highlight continuing at the same huge outdoor ramp during deep golden sunset. Only one skateboarder and only one skateboard exist in the entire video. Do not duplicate the rider. Do not add extra skateboarders in the background.

Start with a fast low side-rear tracking shot as the rider accelerates toward the largest ramp, not only from directly behind. Use one quick close-up of the wheels, feet, and board while the rider climbs the ramp with power and control. Briefly switch to a low side angle just before takeoff to show the ramp height and speed.

The rider launches into the highest big air and performs one clean 360 aerial rotation near the peak of the jump. Keep the aerial action clear and readable. Use a brief stop-motion-style freeze effect only at the peak moment of the rotation, then continue the motion naturally. Do not make the whole aerial section slow motion. Do not create ghost trails, overlapping silhouettes, or multiple riders. The real rider remains one person, and the skateboard stays controlled under the rider’s feet.

After the peak rotation, return to normal motion for a clear descent and landing. Show the board aligning for touchdown, the wheels touching down, a short controlled slide, and a strong impact.

End with the rider gliding away into the sunset in a short cinematic silhouette from behind.

Strong sports highlight energy, dynamic but simple camera changes, low tracking shot, side-rear angle, brief side angle during takeoff and air, ground-level landing angle, clear takeoff and clear landing, dramatic height difference, readable body silhouette, realistic skateboard motion, no static sports introduction. No clear spoken commentary, no narration, no understandable dialogue. Sound effects only: fast rolling wheels, ramp rumble, wind rush, brief silence at the peak freeze, heavy landing impact, distant crowd reaction. No logo, no watermark, no readable text.

zh.p:
15秒的真人大跳台滑板精彩片段，在深邃金色的夕阳下继续在同一个巨大的户外跳台上。整个视频中只有一位滑板手和一块滑板存在。不要复制骑手。不要在背景中添加额外的滑板手。

从快速低侧尾跟踪拍摄开始，骑手加速朝最大坡道冲去，而不仅仅是从正后方。在骑手带着力量和控制力攀爬坡道时，快速特写轮子、脚和板子。起飞前短暂切换到低侧角，以显示斜坡高度和速度。

骑手跃入最高的大空中，并在跳跃顶点附近完成一次干净的360度空中旋转。保持空中动作清晰易读。只需在旋转的峰值时刻使用简短的定格动画风格定格效果，然后自然地继续动作。不要让整个航拍部分都慢动作。不要制造幽灵踪迹、重叠的剪影或多名骑手。真正的骑手依然是一个人，滑板也在骑手脚下控制。

达到峰值旋转后，恢复正常运动，实现清晰的下降和着陆。展示滑板对齐着陆、轮子着陆、短暂受控滑行以及强烈冲击。

最后，骑手从背后以短片剪影滑翔，进入夕阳。

强烈的运动突出能量、动态但简单的摄像机切换、低跟踪镜头、侧后角度、起飞和空中短暂侧角、地面着陆角度、清晰起飞和着陆、戏剧性的身高差、清晰的身体轮廓、逼真的滑板运动，无静态运动介绍。没有清晰的口头评论，没有旁白，也没有清晰的对话。仅有音效：快速滚动的轮子声、斜坡隆隆声、风力冲击、高峰冻结时短暂的寂静、沉重的着陆冲击声、远处观众反应。没有标志，没有水印，也没有可读的文字。

raw_p:
Fast-paced dystopian cyberpunk action in a ruined Indian megacity at night. Burnt cars, neon signs flickering in Hindi, sparks, smoke vents, broken flyovers, puddles reflecting pink and blue neon. Chaotic handheld cinematography, shaky tracking shots, aggressive speed ramps, dirty lens flares, practical lighting. Sound: roaring engines, metallic screeches, distorted radio chatter, distant explosions, hydraulic snake sounds.

⸻

0–2s — HOOK

A tattooed Indian cyberpunk woman with shaved punk hair tears through a dystopian street on a junkyard-built motorcycle made from welded scrap metal, exposed engine parts, and glowing wires.

Behind her—

A gigantic half-real, half-mechanical anaconda smashes through burnt cars in aggressive pursuit.

Metal jaws snapping.

Red mechanical eyes glowing.

⸻

2–4s — ESCALATION

Low shaky side tracking shot.

The snake violently crashes through parked vehicles while partially gliding over wreckage with mechanical body segments flexing unnaturally.

The woman swerves hard between wrecked taxis and burning debris.

Radio crackles in her ear.

Male voice:

“Get it in position!”

⸻

4–7s — BUILD

She accelerates harder.

Rear tire skids through puddles.

The snake lunges low behind her, smashing a car sideways into a wall.

She shouts into radio:

“I’m trying!”

Ahead—

a broken flyover ramp comes into view through smoke.

⸻

7–10s — COMMIT

The woman locks onto the ramp and speeds directly toward it.

Above on a ruined rooftop—

A man with a bazooka takes aim.

Radio:

“Just a little closer…”

The snake rapidly closes distance behind her.

⸻

10–13s — BULLET TIME PAYOFF

She hits the ramp and launches into the air.

Bullet time engages.

The cybernetic anaconda leaps upward after her, jaws opening inches from her bike.

The man fires.

Rocket streaks through frame in slow motion.

Direct hit into the snake’s mechanical skull.

Massive explosion of sparks, fire, metal fragments, and flesh.

⸻

13–15s — FINAL BEAT

Time snaps back.

The woman lands hard, bike wobbling violently—

she regains balance perfectly and keeps riding.

Behind her, the burning mechanical anaconda crashes through wrecked cars.

She laughs into the radio:

“Target down!”

The man cheers over comms.

Cut.

zh.t: 废墟中的赛博巨蟒追逐
zh.p:
夜晚在印度一座废墟大城市中，节奏快速的反乌托邦赛博朋克动作。烧毁的汽车、闪烁的印地语霓虹灯、火花、烟雾喷口、破损的高架桥、映出粉蓝色霓虹灯的水坑。混乱的手持摄影、晃动的跟踪镜头、激烈的加速坡、脏镜头光晕、实用灯光。声音：轰鸣的引擎声、金属尖叫声、扭曲的无线电杂音、远处爆炸声、液压蛇声。

⸻

0–2 — 钩球

一位纹身的印度赛博朋克女子剃光了朋克头发，骑着一辆由焊接废金属、裸露发动机零件和发光电线制成的废品场摩托车，在反乌托邦街道上疾驰。

她身后——

一只半真实半机械的巨蟒猛烈撞击着烧毁的汽车，奋力追赶。

金属颚骨咔嚓作响。

红色机械眼睛发光。

⸻

2–4 — 升级

低沉颤抖的侧向跟踪镜头。

这条蛇在部分滑翔于残骸上，暴力地撞穿停放的车辆，机械身体部分不自然地弯曲。

这名女子在报废的出租车和燃烧的废墟之间急转弯。

无线电在她耳边杂音。

男声：

“把它放好！”

⸻

4–7 — 构建

她加速得更猛。

后轮在水坑中打滑。

蛇从她身后低处猛扑，将一辆车侧向撞击墙壁。

她对着收音机喊道：

“我在努力！”

前方——

一条破损的高架桥坡道透过烟雾映入眼帘。

⸻

7–10 — 承诺

女子锁定斜坡，径直飞奔过去。

在废墟屋顶上——

一个拿火箭筒的男人瞄准了。

广播：

“再靠近一点......”

蛇迅速拉近她身后的距离。

⸻

10–13 — 子弹时间回报

她撞上斜坡，飞向空中。

子弹时间开始。

赛博巨蟒跃起追赶，嘴巴张开，距离她的摩托车只有几英寸。

那人开枪了。

火箭以慢动作穿过画面。

直接击中蛇的机械头骨。

火花、火焰、金属碎片和肉体的巨大爆炸。

⸻

13–15分 — 最后一拍

时间瞬间倒流。

女人重重摔倒，自行车剧烈摇晃——

她完美地恢复平衡，继续骑行。

在她身后，燃烧的机械水蚺撞破了被毁的汽车。

她对着收音机笑道：

“目标倒下！”

那人在通讯器里欢呼。

停。

Use Image A and Image B as the two main characters in all shots.

Image A : preserve her exact anime illustration identity, hairstyle, face, outfit, proportions, and overall design.

Image B : preserve her exact anime illustration identity, hairstyle, face, outfit, proportions, and overall design.

Both characters must remain anime-style illustrations with crisp clean line art, cel-shaded flat colors, expressive anime eyes, and zero photorealism on the characters.

All other elements — the shopping mall interior, storefronts, display windows, escalators, polished floors, shopping bags, crowd, lighting, and background architecture — are fully photorealistic.

Setting: a busy modern shopping mall on a weekend afternoon. Stylish interior, bright natural and commercial lighting, large glass storefronts, digital signage, polished floors, open atrium, many shoppers walking around. The atmosphere is lively, fashionable, and cheerful.

15-second cinematic video, 24fps, smooth motion, clear emotional flow, character consistency across all shots.

Shot 1 [MALL ENTRANCE — ARRIVAL]

Image A and Image B walk side by side into a crowded modern shopping mall, smiling and chatting. Many shoppers pass around them. The camera tracks backward in front of them as they enter the bright open atrium. They look excited for a fun day of window shopping.

Cut to Shot 2 [WINDOW SHOPPING — DISCOVERY]

The two girls stop in front of a stylish fashion storefront with a large glass display window. They lean in slightly and admire the items inside. Image A points at something cute in the display. Image B reacts with a bright smile and curious eyes. Medium shot, then close-up on their happy faces and pointing gesture.

Cut to Shot 3 [MOVING THROUGH THE MALL]

Image A and Image B continue walking through the busy mall, passing elegant shop windows, cosmetics counters, and accessory displays. They laugh together and casually gesture while talking. Camera moves alongside them. Background crowd flows naturally around them. Their mood is relaxed, lively, and playful.

Cut to Shot 4 [EXCITEMENT AT A DISPLAY]

They stop at another display window with fashionable accessories and seasonal decor. Image B notices something first and gently pulls Image A’s sleeve to show it. Image A’s expression changes into delighted surprise. Close-up on their faces, then cut to a wider shot showing both of them framed by the bright storefront and the bustling crowd behind.

Cut to Shot 5 [PURE WEEKEND JOY]

Image A and Image B continue window shopping deeper into the mall, each carrying a few small shopping bags. They smile, laugh, and enjoy the lively weekend atmosphere. Wide cinematic shot of the modern shopping mall interior, the two girls walking happily together at the center of the frame, surrounded by the photorealistic crowd and glowing storefronts. End with a gentle crane out

zh.p:
所有镜头中都用图片A和图片B作为两个主角。

图片A：保留她的动漫插画身份、发型、面部、服装、比例和整体设计。

图片B：保留她的动漫插画身份、发型、面容、服装、比例和整体设计。

两个角色都必须保持动漫风格的插画，线条清晰，采用赛璐璐渲染的平面色彩，富有表现力的动漫眼神，且角色绝无写实感。

其他所有元素——购物中心内部、店面、橱窗、扶梯、抛光地板、购物袋、人群、灯光和背景建筑——均为完全写实。

背景设定：一个繁忙的现代购物中心，周末下午。时尚的室内设计，明亮的自然和商业照明，大型玻璃店面，数字标牌，抛光地板，开放式中庭，众多购物者四处走动。氛围热闹、时尚且愉快。

15秒的电影视频，24帧，流畅的动作，清晰的情感流动，所有镜头中角色的一致性。

镜头1 [商场入口——到达]

图片A和图片B并肩走进一个拥挤的现代购物中心，微笑着聊天。许多购物者会绕过它们。镜头倒后，在他们进入明亮敞开的中庭时，从他们面前倒移。他们看起来很期待一天有趣的橱窗购物。

切换到第二镜头【橱窗购物——发现】

两个女孩停在一家时尚时尚店铺前，店里有一个大型玻璃橱窗。他们微微前倾，欣赏里面的物品。图片A指向显示屏上可爱的东西。图片B则露出灿烂的笑容和好奇的眼神。中景，然后特写他们开心的脸和指点的手势。

切换到第三镜头【穿过商场】

图像A和图像B继续穿过繁忙的商场，经过优雅的橱窗、化妆品柜台和配饰展示。他们一起笑着，边说边随意比划。镜头会跟着它们一起移动。背景人群自然地围绕着他们流动。他们的情绪轻松、活泼且充满玩乐。

切换到第四镜头【对展示的兴奋】

他们在另一扇展示橱窗前停下，展示时尚配饰和季节性装饰。图片B先注意到什么，轻轻拉了拉图片A的袖子展示出来。图片A的表情变成了惊喜的喜悦。特写他们的脸，然后切换到更广阔的镜头，展示他们被明亮的店面和熙攘人群所映衬。

切到第五镜头【纯粹的周末喜悦】

图片A和图片B继续在商场更深处逛橱窗，各自提着几个小购物袋。他们微笑、欢笑，享受热闹的周末氛围。现代购物中心内部的宽广电影镜头，两个女孩愉快地并肩走在画面中央，周围是写实的人群和发光的店面。最后用轻柔的起重机呼出

en.p:
Use Image A and Image B as the two main characters in all shots.

Image A : preserve her exact anime illustration identity, hairstyle, face, outfit, proportions, and overall design.

Image B : preserve her exact anime illustration identity, hairstyle, face, outfit, proportions, and overall design.

Both characters must remain anime-style illustrations with crisp clean line art, cel-shaded flat colors, expressive anime eyes, and zero photorealism on the characters.

All other elements — the shopping mall interior, storefronts, display windows, escalators, polished floors, shopping bags, crowd, lighting, and background architecture — are fully photorealistic.

Setting: a busy modern shopping mall on a weekend afternoon. Stylish interior, bright natural and commercial lighting, large glass storefronts, digital signage, polished floors, open atrium, many shoppers walking around. The atmosphere is lively, fashionable, and cheerful.

15-second cinematic video, 24fps, smooth motion, clear emotional flow, character consistency across all shots.

Shot 1 [MALL ENTRANCE — ARRIVAL]

Image A and Image B walk side by side into a crowded modern shopping mall, smiling and chatting. Many shoppers pass around them. The camera tracks backward in front of them as they enter the bright open atrium. They look excited for a fun day of window shopping.

Cut to Shot 2 [WINDOW SHOPPING — DISCOVERY]

The two girls stop in front of a stylish fashion storefront with a large glass display window. They lean in slightly and admire the items inside. Image A points at something cute in the display. Image B reacts with a bright smile and curious eyes. Medium shot, then close-up on their happy faces and pointing gesture.

Cut to Shot 3 [MOVING THROUGH THE MALL]

Image A and Image B continue walking through the busy mall, passing elegant shop windows, cosmetics counters, and accessory displays. They laugh together and casually gesture while talking. Camera moves alongside them. Background crowd flows naturally around them. Their mood is relaxed, lively, and playful.

Cut to Shot 4 [EXCITEMENT AT A DISPLAY]

They stop at another display window with fashionable accessories and seasonal decor. Image B notices something first and gently pulls Image A’s sleeve to show it. Image A’s expression changes into delighted surprise. Close-up on their faces, then cut to a wider shot showing both of them framed by the bright storefront and the bustling crowd behind.

Cut to Shot 5 [PURE WEEKEND JOY]

Image A and Image B continue window shopping deeper into the mall, each carrying a few small shopping bags. They smile, laugh, and enjoy the lively weekend atmosphere. Wide cinematic shot of the modern shopping mall interior, the two girls walking happily together at the center of the frame, surrounded by the photorealistic crowd and glowing storefronts. End with a gentle crane out

raw_p:
15-second ultra realistic cinematic rooftop fashion film during sunset.

Scene 1 (0–4s): A stunning fashion model steps onto a luxury rooftop overlooking a glowing city skyline at golden hour. Soft wind moves her hair and long black outfit naturally, cinematic drone shot approaching slowly, warm orange sunlight reflecting on glass buildings, ultra aesthetic atmosphere.

Scene 2 (4–8s): Slow-motion tracking shot as she confidently walks across the rooftop edge in a luxurious designer outfit with sunglasses and silver accessories. Cinematic lens flares, flowing fabric movement, rich old-money aesthetic, shallow depth of field, Vogue editorial vibe.

Scene 3 (8–12s): Dramatic side-profile close-up with sunset behind her, hair moving beautifully in wind, emotional “main character” energy, cinematic camera orbit movement, realistic skin texture, luxury perfume advertisement style.

Scene 4 (12–15s): Final powerful shot facing the city skyline while city lights begin glowing at blue hour. Camera slowly pulls back revealing the massive skyline and luxury rooftop ambiance. Text fades in: “Some people don’t follow trends… they become them.”

Ultra realistic cinematic fashion storytelling, viral Twitter/TikTok aesthetic, luxury lifestyle energy, smooth camera motion, film grain, anamorphic lens flare, highly detailed, emotional cinematic mood, 4K masterpiece.

zh.p:
15秒超写实的电影屋顶时尚电影，日落时分。

场景1（0–4秒）：一位惊艳的时尚模特在黄金时刻走上奢华屋顶，俯瞰着闪耀的城市天际线。柔和的风自然地吹动她的头发和长长的黑色服装，电影般的无人机镜头缓缓接近，温暖的橙色阳光映照在玻璃建筑上，极具美感的氛围。

第二场（4–8秒）：慢动作跟踪镜头，她自信地走过屋顶边缘，身穿豪华设计师服装，戴着墨镜和银色配饰。电影般的镜头光晕、流畅的面料运动、丰富的老钱美学、浅景深、Vogue编辑风格。

第三场（8–12分钟）：戏剧性的侧脸特写，夕阳在身后，头发随风飘动，情感丰富的“主角”能量，电影般的摄像机轨道运动，逼真的皮肤质感，奢华香水广告风格。

第四场（12–15秒）：最后一幕强劲镜头，面向城市天际线，城市灯光在蓝色时刻开始闪烁。镜头缓缓拉远，展现出宽阔的天际线和豪华屋顶氛围。文字渐入：“有些人不跟潮流......他们变成了他们。”

超写实的电影式时尚叙事，病毒式的推特/抖音美学，奢华生活方式的活力，流畅的摄像机运动，胶片颗粒感，变形镜头光晕，高度细致、情感丰富的电影氛围，4K杰作。

@画像1=主人公キャラクター。 
@画像2=絵コンテの参照。 

添付された絵コンテ画像  をもとに、15秒の横型16:9アニメハラハラドキドキ逃走シーン動画を作成してください。

テーマ：盗人少女 絵コンテ  のパネル順に沿って、テンポの速い颯爽シーンとして動画化してください。 

流れ： 水上に広がるきのこ港町市場を俯瞰で見せるところから始まり、青いフードの盗人少女が桟橋や市場の端に身を潜め、紫に発光する希少なきのこを盗みます。 盗みの瞬間は手元の寄り、少女の目の輝き、希少きのこの発光感を印象的に描写してください。 盗みが発覚すると、少女は木の桟橋、水辺の通路、船着き場、ロープ橋、水上足場を使って一気に逃走します。 追手が迫る中、少女は細い橋を駆け、足を滑らせそうになりながらも立て直し、運河を飛び越え、船の上やロープの近くをかすめながら、スピード感のある逃走を見せてください。 カモメが飛び、水しぶきや湿った木材の質感が画面に入るようにしてください。 最後は長い橋の上を光の方へ駆け抜け、港町を抜け出すように終わってください。 

スタイル： 高品質なアニメ映画風、シネマティックなライティング、ハラハラドキドキの神作画、高精細、鮮やかな色彩、水辺の透明感、湿った木の質感、港町の開放感、きのこ屋台や水上建築が並ぶ冒険感のある世界観。 少女は小さく俊敏で、悪戯っぽくも真剣、スリルを楽しみながらも本気で逃げている印象にしてください。 

編集： リズム感のある高速カット、寄りカット、超接写、ローアングル、俯瞰ショット、素早いパン、気持ちのいいマッチカットを使用してください。 市場全景の俯瞰、盗む手元の寄り、少女の顔アップ、追手から逃げる追従ショット、水面近くのローアングル、桟橋を蹴る足元超接写、運河を飛び越えるワイド、ロープ移動や高所視点などを織り交ぜてください。 エネルギッシュでスタイリッシュな映像にしつつ、水上港町ならではの水辺の危うさと橋の連続性を活かした逃走にしてください。 

重要： 静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。 走りや盗みなど自然にアニメーションさせてください。 動画全体を通して、同じ水上きのこ港町の雰囲気と高品質アニメスタイルを維持してください。 文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないでください。 颯爽シーンとしてハラハラドキドキを演じてください。 主人公の顔、青いフード、衣装、背負った籠、紫色の発光きのこを全編で一貫して維持してください。

en.p:
@画像1 = Main character. 
@画像2 = Refer to storyboards. 

Based on the attached storyboard images, create a 15-second landscape 16:9 animated thrilling escape scene video.

Theme: Thief Girl Storyboard: Please make a video of fast-paced and exciting scenes in the order of the panels. 

Flow: The event begins with a bird's-eye view of the Mushroom Port Town Market spreading over the water, followed by a blue-hooded thief girl hiding at the pier or the edge of the market to steal rare mushrooms that glow purple. At the moment of stealing, vividly depict the closeness of the hand, the sparkle in the girl's eyes, and the glow of this rare item. When the theft is discovered, the girl escapes quickly using wooden piers, waterside paths, docks, rope bridges, and water platforms. As pursuers approach, the girl runs across a narrow bridge, nearly slipping but pulling herself together, leaping over canals, and gliding past boats and near ropes, showing a speedy escape. Make sure seagulls fly and the splashes of water and the texture of wet wood appear on the screen. Finally, race across the long bridge toward the light, and finish as if you are leaving the port town. 

Style: High-quality animated film style, cinematic lighting, thrilling masterpieces, high definition, vivid colors, waterside transparency, damp wood texture, openness of a port town, and an adventurous world of mushroom stalls and water-based architecture. Make the girl appear small and agile, mischievous yet serious, enjoying the thrill while seriously escaping. 

Edit: Use rhythmic high-speed cuts, close-up shots, ultra-close-up, low angles, bird's-eye shots, quick pans, and pleasant match cuts. Mix in a bird's-eye view of the entire market, close-ups of the stolen hands, close-ups of a girl's face, chase shots fleeing from pursuers, low angles near the water's surface, ultra-close-up footsteps kicking the pier, wide shots of jumping over canals, rope movement, and high-altitude perspectives. While making the visuals energetic and stylish, make the most of the dangers of the waterfront and the continuity of bridges unique to a floating port town for an escape. 

Important: Do not use it as a still image slideshow. Animation naturally for running, stealing, and other activities. Throughout the video, maintain the same atmosphere of Mizukami Mushroom Port Town and high-quality anime style. Do not include text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks. Play out the thrilling and heart-pounding scenes as a thrilling scene. Consistently maintain the protagonist's face, blue hood, costume, basket on his back, and glowing purple mushrooms throughout.

raw_p:
Fast-paced dystopian cyberpunk action in a ruined Indian megacity at night. Burnt cars, neon Hindi signs flickering, smoke vents, broken flyovers, puddles reflecting pink and blue neon. Chaotic shaky cinematography, aggressive handheld tracking, dirty lens flares, speed ramps, practical lighting. Sound: roaring engines, distorted radio chatter, hydraulic servos, metallic growls, distant explosions.

⸻

0–2s — HOOK

A tattooed Indian cyberpunk woman with shaved punk hair races through a destroyed street on a junkyard-built motorcycle made from exposed engine parts, welded scrap, and glowing cables.

Behind her—

A gigantic half-real, half-robotic werewolf crashes through burnt cars at full speed.

Metal claws scraping asphalt.

Hydraulic limbs flexing.

One glowing red cybernetic eye.

⸻

2–4s — ESCALATION

Low shaky side-tracking shot.

The cyber-werewolf runs unnaturally fast, sometimes on all fours, sometimes launching itself over wrecked vehicles.

Its exposed mechanical spine sparks while flesh and metal shift together violently.

Radio crackles in her ear.

Male voice:

“Get it in position!”

⸻

4–7s — BUILD

She drifts hard around a pile of overturned taxis.

The werewolf slams through one car completely, sending debris flying across the road.

It gains ground fast.

The woman shouts into the radio:

“I’m trying!”

Ahead through smoke and neon haze—

a broken flyover ramp appears.

⸻

7–10s — COMMIT

She accelerates directly toward the ramp.

Cut to rooftop—

A man with a bazooka steadies his aim through heat distortion.

Radio:

“Bring it closer…”

The cyber-werewolf launches itself forward in massive leaps, nearly reaching the bike.

⸻

10–13s — BULLET TIME PAYOFF

The woman hits the ramp and flies into the air.

Bullet time engages.

The cybernetic werewolf leaps upward behind her, claws reaching inches from her back.

The bazooka fires.

Rocket streaks through frame in slow motion.

Direct impact into the werewolf’s chest.

Explosion of sparks, fire, metal fragments, fur, and smoke.

⸻

13–15s — FINAL BEAT

Time snaps back.

The woman lands hard, bike wobbling violently—

she regains control and speeds forward.

Behind her, the burning cyber-werewolf crashes through wrecked cars and explodes into debris.

She laughs into the radio:

“Got him.”

The man cheers over comms.

Cut.

zh.p:
夜晚在印度一座废墟大城市中，节奏快速的反乌托邦赛博朋克动作。烧毁的汽车，闪烁的霓虹印地语招牌，烟雾喷口，破损的高架桥，水坑反射着粉色和蓝色的霓虹光。混乱的摇晃摄影，激烈的手持追踪，脏镜头光晕，速度坡道，实用光影。声音：轰鸣的引擎声，失真的无线电杂音，液压伺服声，金属咆哮声，远处爆炸声。

⸻

0–2 — 钩球

一位纹身的印度赛博朋克女子剃了光头，骑着一辆由裸露发动机零件、焊接废料和发光电缆制成的废品场摩托车，在被毁坏的街道上飞驰。

她身后——

一只半真实半机械的巨大狼人全速冲破烧毁的汽车。

金属爪子刮擦着柏油路面。

液压肢体弯曲。

一只发光的红色赛博义眼。

⸻

2–4 — 升级

低沉摇晃的侧移射门。

这只赛博狼人奔跑异常快，有时四肢着地，有时从毁坏的车辆上方跃过。

它裸露的机械脊柱火花四溅，肉体与金属剧烈碰撞。

无线电在她耳边杂音。

男声：

“把它放好！”

⸻

4–7 — 构建

她在一堆翻倒的出租车间漂移。

狼人撞穿了一辆车，碎片四散飞溅。

它迅速取得进展。

那女人对着收音机大喊：

“我在努力！”

穿越烟雾和霓虹雾气——

出现了一个破损的高架坡道。

⸻

7–10 — 承诺

她直接加速朝坡道冲去。

切换到屋顶——

一名持火箭筒的男子通过热量扭曲稳定瞄准。

广播：

“把它拉近点......”

赛博狼人以巨大的跳跃向前，几乎撞上摩托车。

⸻

10–13 — 子弹时间回报

女子撞上斜坡，飞向空中。

子弹时间开始。

这只机械狼人从她身后跃起，爪子距离她背部只有几英寸。

火箭筒发射。

火箭以慢动作穿过画面。

直接撞击狼人胸部。

火花爆炸、火焰、金属碎片、毛发和烟雾。

⸻

13–15分 — 最后一拍

时间瞬间倒流。

女人重重摔倒，自行车剧烈摇晃——

她重新控制并加速前进。

在她身后，燃烧的赛博狼人撞破了破损的汽车，最终化为碎片。

她对着收音机笑道：

“抓住他了。”

那人在通讯器里欢呼。

停。

Scene: This is a quiet moment during a party between a handsome teen Ben  and a timid girl with glasses, Aria. They are on the balcony of the penthouse suite of an apartment.

[0:00-0:02]  Side shot of Ben and Aria. Ben is already Shaking his head. Ben speaks in an exasperated tone, "That's not how it works!" 

[Cut: -0:12] Ben's monologue with multiple cuts between the two characters as he speak continuously. Waist up shot of Ben. Ben leans back against the railing and sighs to collect himself. Then he turns to Aria and speaks in a reluctant and exasperated tone with subtle hand gestures to emphasize his points, "Kylie..is confident. Where as, you're just.." Camera cuts to Aria to see that her feelings are hurt as Ben continues his monologue out of frame,  "shy and awkward and wierd and I..I.." Camera cuts back to Ben who is still speaking his monologue, "I don't know, I want a girl who knows how to kiss, how to flirt, like Kylie," Camera cuts to Aria to catch her reaction as Ben finishes his monologue out of frame with a definitive tone, "Not some virgin."

raw_p: 采用复古动漫风格。巨龙将那个孩子举在头顶，正准备将其扔出去；然而，一只漂浮着的白色魔法手套突然凭空出现，令巨龙略感诧异——他目不转睛地盯着那只戴着手套的手，看着它缓缓伸向自己的腋下。镜头随即拉近，特写展示了那只手套如何用灵活蠕动的指尖去挠巨龙的腋窝凹陷处；其动作轻柔流畅，伴随着一阵滑稽的音效声。就在手套指尖触及腋下的那一瞬间，巨龙的表情瞬间变得滑稽可笑——他双眼紧闭，咧开大嘴傻笑不止，口中发出阵阵闷声的窃笑。手套继续挠着巨龙的腋下，巨龙也随之放声大笑；随后，他猛地松开抓着孩子的双手，转而紧紧抱住自己的身体，试图以此止住那挥之不去的痒意与笑声。随着手套凭空消失，巨龙终于从那阵狂笑中平复下来；他既对刚才发生的一切感到困惑不解，又因觉得对方“作弊”而感到恼火，遂将怒气发泄到了那个孩子身上。配音语言为日语。巨龙的声音低沉浑厚。

en.p: It adopts a retro anime style. The dragon lifted the child above its head, preparing to throw it away; However, a floating white magical glove suddenly appeared out of thin air, surprising the dragon—he stared intently at the gloved hand, watching it slowly reach for his armpit. The camera then zooms in, showing how the glove uses its agile, writhing fingertips to scratch the hollow of the dragon's armpit; Its movements are soft and smooth, accompanied by a comical sound effect. The moment his glove fingertips touched his armpit, the dragon's expression instantly turned comical and comical—his eyes were tightly shut, his mouth wide open in foolish grins, and muffled chuckles escaped from his mouth. The glove continued to tickle the dragon's armpit, and the dragon burst out laughing; Then, he suddenly released his grip on the child and instead hugged his own body tightly, trying to stop the lingering itch and laughter. As the glove vanished into thin air, the dragon finally calmed down from its wild laughter; He was confused by everything that had just happened, and also annoyed by the thought that the other party was "cheating," so he vented his anger on the child. The dubbing language is Japanese. The dragon's voice was deep and deep.

raw_p:
Create the most emotionally powerful and visually overwhelming Titanic cinematic sequence ever made — a 15-second masterpiece that feels like the ending of humanity itself. Hyperrealistic IMAX filmmaking, terrifying Atlantic storm atmosphere, colossal ocean scale, emotional devastation, award-winning Hollywood VFX, absolute stop-scrolling perfection.

0–2 SECONDS
Pitch black screen.
Only the sound of freezing wind and distant ocean waves.
Then—
a tiny warm light appears in darkness.

The camera slowly reveals the RMS Titanic emerging from endless black fog like a ghost from another world.
Every window glows gold against the freezing blue Atlantic night.
The ship feels impossibly gigantic.

2–5 SECONDS
The camera races low across violent ocean waves directly toward Titanic at breathtaking speed.
Massive water splashes hit the lens.
Passengers stand along the bow under moonlight while their clothes whip violently in the icy wind.
A woman closes her eyes peacefully.
Everything feels beautiful.
Too beautiful.

5–8 SECONDS
Without warning—
the soundtrack completely cuts.

A colossal iceberg suddenly appears beside the ship, illuminated by a single lightning strike.
For one horrifying second, the entire world becomes silent.

Then—
IMPACT.

Metal twists like paper.
Ice explodes across the deck in ultra slow motion.
The sound design becomes deafening and terrifying.

8–12 SECONDS
Rapid cinematic chaos montage:
flooding corridors,
people running in panic,
steam bursting from engine pipes,
a child crying,
lifeboats swinging above black freezing water,
the orchestra continuing to play while the ship dies around them.

Camera movement becomes frantic and unstable like real disaster footage.

12–15 SECONDS
Final god-level cinematic shot.

The Titanic stands vertically beneath the storm clouds while thousands of glowing lights reflect across the Atlantic Ocean.
The ship slowly begins disappearing beneath the freezing water as people scream in the darkness.
The camera ascends higher and higher into the sky until Titanic becomes only a tiny glowing memory swallowed by the endless black ocean.

Final frame:
complete silence.
One distant emergency flare rises into the night sky.
Cut to black.

STYLE:
Absolute cinematic perfection, James Cameron realism, Christopher Nolan tension, Denis Villeneuve atmosphere, ultra-detailed water physics, emotional orchestral soundtrack, volumetric fog, cinematic lightning, deep shadows, realistic destruction simulation, anamorphic lens flares, haunting beauty, Oscar-winning VFX, 8K IMAX masterpiece, unforgettable emotional ending.

zh.p:
打造有史以来最强烈情感、视觉冲击力最强的泰坦尼克号电影序列——一部15秒的杰作，仿佛人类的终结。超写实的IMAX电影制作，恐怖的大西洋风暴氛围，庞大的海洋规模，情感上的毁灭，获奖的好莱坞视觉特效，绝对停屏的完美。


2秒
漆黑的屏幕。
只有刺骨的风声和远处海浪的声音。
然后——\黑暗中出现了微弱的温暖光芒。

镜头缓缓揭示RMS泰坦尼克号从无尽黑雾中出现，宛如来自另一个世界的幽灵。
每扇窗户在冰冷的蓝色大西洋夜晚中都闪耀着金色光芒。
船只感觉不可思议地巨大。

2–5秒
镜头低飞越猛烈的海浪，直奔泰坦尼克号，速度惊人。
巨大的水花溅入镜头。
乘客们站在船头，月光下，衣服在冰冷的风中剧烈飘动。
一位女子安详地闭上眼睛。
一切都很美。
太美了。

5–8秒
突然——配乐完全切断。

突然出现在船旁， 被一道闪电照亮。
恐怖的一秒钟，整个世界陷入寂静。

然后——
撞击。

金属像纸一样扭曲。
冰块以极慢速度爆裂在甲板上。
音效设计变得震耳欲聋，令人恐惧。

8–12秒
快速电影般的混乱蒙太奇：
淹没走廊，\人群惊慌奔跑，\蒸汽从引擎管道爆裂，\孩子哭泣，\救生艇在黑色冰冷水面上摇摆，\乐团继续演奏，船只在他们周围沉没。

镜头运动变得疯狂不稳，像真实灾难画面。

12–15秒
最后一幕神级电影镜头。

泰坦尼克号垂直矗立在风暴云层下，成千上万的发光灯光映照在大西洋上。
船只缓缓消失在冰冷的水下，人们在黑暗中尖叫。
镜头越升越高，直到泰坦尼克号只剩下被无尽黑海吞噬的微小闪耀记忆。

最后一帧：
完全寂静。
一枚远处紧急信号弹升入夜空。
画面切换至黑。

风格：
绝对的电影完美，詹姆斯·卡梅隆的真实感，克里斯托弗·诺兰的紧张感，丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦式的氛围，极其细致的水体物理，情感丰富的管弦乐配乐， 体积雾气、电影般的光影、深邃的阴影、逼真的破坏模拟、变形镜头光晕、令人难忘的美感、奥斯卡获奖的视觉特效、8K IMAX杰作、令人难忘的情感结局。

时长：10秒
画幅比例：16:9
类型：电影感真人格斗短片，双角色动作编排，多人围观，废旧仓库地下擂台氛围

角色参考：
使用参考图1作为 Liora Vale，成年女性，24岁，纤细运动型身材，长粉色头发扎高马尾，眼神锐利，动作爆发力强。
使用参考图2作为 Veya Sable，成年女性，25岁，纤细运动型身材，银紫色齐短发，表情冷静，防守稳，抗击打能力强。
两人穿深色成人学院制服改造款：黑色修身制服外套、白衬衫、细领带、深色百褶裙或制服短裤、黑色长袜、旧皮鞋。制服带灰尘、褶皱和打斗磨损，但不性感化，不幼态化。

整体风格：
废旧仓库，水泥地，铁皮墙，生锈钢梁，破木板，堆放货架，冷白顶灯和侧面暖色工业灯混合。周围十几名围观者形成半圆，保持距离，情绪紧张。手持摄影，近身冲击感，拳脚动作清晰，带真实重量感。电影特技打斗，非致命，无血腥，无真实伤害。

SHOT 1（00:00-00:05）
Subject:
Liora 与 Veya 在仓库中央对峙，围观者围成一圈，远处有废弃木板和铁架。

Action:
-00:01：Veya 突然后手直拳刺出，拳线直奔 Liora 面门。
-00:02：Liora 眼神迅速捕捉出手路线，身体微微后撤，侧闪避开拳锋。
-00:03：Liora 顺势用横向掌板格开 Veya 手臂，身体压低，脚步横移。
-00:05：Veya 立刻双臂格挡，俯身、侧身、后仰连续切换防线，围观者因第一轮快速攻防明显惊呼后退半步。

Environment:
废旧仓库中央空地，水泥地有灰尘和脚印，周围人群形成暗色剪影。

Camera:
中景手持跟拍，24mm广角，围绕两人小幅横移；拳头靠近镜头时有短促震动。

Style:
开场试探但速度极快，动作干净，冷硬工业质感，现场压迫感强。

Constraints:
保持两名角色脸部、发色、制服一致；围观者只作为背景反应，不冲入打斗。

SHOT 2（00:05-00:10）
Subject:
Liora 抢进内线，Veya 稳住下盘准备反击。

Action:
-00:06：Liora 俯身切入，顶膝攻击 Veya 中线，动作短促有力。
-00:07：Veya 收肘下压防住膝击，同时身体向侧后方扭转卸力。
-00:08：Liora 突然下潜前抱腰，双手锁住 Veya 腰部。
-00:10：Liora 借助前冲力量将 Veya 举过头顶，做出电影特技式过肩抛摔，猛地将 Veya 控制摔向旁边破木板堆，木板炸开灰尘，但 Veya 没有受到致命伤。

Environment:
破木板堆和废弃货架在后方，摔落时扬起大量灰尘，围观者迅速让开空间。

Camera:
低机位跟随 Liora 下潜抱腰，随后镜头上仰追随举起动作，摔落瞬间快速下摇并震动。

Style:
力量型摔法，重心变化明显，强调身体重量和地面冲击。

Constraints:
摔落是受控特技动作，无骨折、无开放伤口、无真实伤害表现。

时长：10秒
画幅比例：16:9
类型：电影感真人格斗短片，双角色动作编排，多人围观，废旧仓库地下擂台氛围

角色参考：
使用参考图1作为 Liora Vale，成年女性，24岁，纤细运动型身材，长粉色头发扎高马尾，眼神锐利，动作爆发力强。
使用参考图2作为 Veya Sable，成年女性，25岁，纤细运动型身材，银紫色齐短发，表情冷静，防守稳，抗击打能力强。
两人穿深色成人学院制服改造款：黑色修身制服外套、白衬衫、细领带、深色百褶裙或制服短裤、黑色长袜、旧皮鞋。制服带灰尘、褶皱和打斗磨损，但不性感化，不幼态化。

整体风格：
废旧仓库，水泥地，铁皮墙，生锈钢梁，破木板，堆放货架，冷白顶灯和侧面暖色工业灯混合。周围十几名围观者形成半圆，保持距离，情绪紧张。手持摄影，近身冲击感，拳脚动作清晰，带真实重量感。电影特技打斗，非致命，无血腥，无真实伤害。

SHOT 1（00:00-00:05）
Subject:
Liora 与 Veya 在仓库中央对峙，围观者围成一圈，远处有废弃木板和铁架。

Action:
-00:01：Veya 突然后手直拳刺出，拳线直奔 Liora 面门。
-00:02：Liora 眼神迅速捕捉出手路线，身体微微后撤，侧闪避开拳锋。
-00:03：Liora 顺势用横向掌板格开 Veya 手臂，身体压低，脚步横移。
-00:05：Veya 立刻双臂格挡，俯身、侧身、后仰连续切换防线，围观者因第一轮快速攻防明显惊呼后退半步。

Environment:
废旧仓库中央空地，水泥地有灰尘和脚印，周围人群形成暗色剪影。

Camera:
中景手持跟拍，24mm广角，围绕两人小幅横移；拳头靠近镜头时有短促震动。

Style:
开场试探但速度极快，动作干净，冷硬工业质感，现场压迫感强。

Constraints:
保持两名角色脸部、发色、制服一致；围观者只作为背景反应，不冲入打斗。

SHOT 2（00:05-00:10）
Subject:
Liora 抢进内线，Veya 稳住下盘准备反击。

Action:
-00:06：Liora 俯身切入，顶膝攻击 Veya 中线，动作短促有力。
-00:07：Veya 收肘下压防住膝击，同时身体向侧后方扭转卸力。
-00:08：Liora 突然下潜前抱腰，双手锁住 Veya 腰部。
-00:10：Liora 借助前冲力量将 Veya 举过头顶，做出电影特技式过肩抛摔，猛地将 Veya 控制摔向旁边破木板堆，木板炸开灰尘，但 Veya 没有受到致命伤。

Environment:
破木板堆和废弃货架在后方，摔落时扬起大量灰尘，围观者迅速让开空间。

Camera:
低机位跟随 Liora 下潜抱腰，随后镜头上仰追随举起动作，摔落瞬间快速下摇并震动。

Style:
力量型摔法，重心变化明显，强调身体重量和地面冲击。

Constraints:
摔落是受控特技动作，无骨折、无开放伤口、无真实伤害表现。

en.p:
Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect ratio: 16:9
Genre: Cinematic live-action fighting short film, dual-character action choreography, crowded audience, an underground arena atmosphere set in an abandoned warehouse

Character reference:
Using reference image 1 as Liora Vale, an adult woman, 24 years old, with a slender, athletic figure, long pink hair tied in a high ponytail, sharp eyes, and explosive movements.
Use reference image 2 as Veya Sable, adult female, 25 years old, slender athletic figure, silver-purple short hair, calm expression, solid defense, strong resilience.
The two wore dark adult academy uniforms remodeled: a black slim-fit uniform jacket, white shirt, thin tie, dark pleated skirt or uniform shorts, black long socks, and old leather shoes. The uniform is dusty, wrinkled, and worn, but not sexy or juvenile.

Overall style:
Abandoned warehouses, cement floors, tin walls, rusted steel beams, broken wood boards, stacked shelves, cold white ceiling lights, and warm-colored industrial lights on the sides are mixed. A dozen or so onlookers formed a semicircle, keeping their distance, their emotions tense. Handheld photography delivers close-up impact, clear fist and foot movements, and a realistic sense of weight. The film's special effects fight are non-fatal, no blood, no real harm.

SHOT 1（00:00-00:05）
Subject:
Liora and Veya faced each other in the center of the warehouse, surrounded by onlookers with abandoned wooden boards and iron frames in the distance.

Action:
-00:01: Veya suddenly thrust a straight punch with her back hand aimed straight at Liora's face.
-00:02: Liora quickly caught the direction of her move, stepped back slightly, and dodged the punch.
-00:03: Liora then uses a horizontal palm board to block Veya's arm, lowering her body and moving her footsteps sideways.
-00:05: Veya immediately blocked with both arms, switching defenses with a lean, side, and fade. Spectators were startled by the rapid attacks and defenses of the first round, clearly stepping back half a pace.

Environment:
The central vacant lot of the abandoned warehouse was covered in dust and footprints on the cement, with the surrounding crowd forming a shadowy silhouette.

Camera:
In the middle shot, handheld follow-shoot, 24mm wide-angle, small horizontal movement around the two people; A brief vibration occurs when the fist approaches the camera.

Style:
The opening is probing but moves very quickly, the movements are clean, the cold and hard industrial texture is strong, and the atmosphere on site is strong.

Constraints:
Keep both characters' faces, hair color, and uniforms consistent; Onlookers only reacted in the background, not rushing into the fight.

SHOT 2（00:05-00:10）
Subject:
Liora rushed inside, Veya steadied herself and prepared to counterattack.

Action:
-00:06: Liora ducked in and attacked Veya midline, landing a short and powerful attack.
-00:07: Veya pulls in her elbow to block a knee strike while twisting her body to the side to the back to relieve force.
-00:08: Liora suddenly doves forward, hugging her waist and locking her waist with both hands.
-00:10: Liora uses the forward thrust to lift Veya overhead, performing a cinematic over-the-shoulder throw, and forcefully slams Veya toward a nearby pile of broken planks, which explode into dust, but Veya is not fatally injured.

Environment:
Piles of broken planks and abandoned shelves were behind them, kicking up a large amount of dust as they fell, prompting onlookers to quickly make way.

Camera:
From a low position, Liora dives down to hug her waist, then the camera tilts up to follow the lifting motion, and the moment of fall, the body quickly shakes and vibrates.

Style:
A power-type wrestling style with a noticeable shift in center of gravity, emphasizing body weight and ground impact.

Constraints:
Falling is a controlled stunt move, with no fractures, no open wounds, and no real injury effects.

raw_p: Cinematic 15-second ultra-photorealistic video, masterpiece, best quality, 8K. Exact reference to the provided image: fierce Joseon warrior with sharp intense face, battle scars, traditional topknot hairstyle secured with ornate metal hairpin, wearing flowing dark black ornate dragon robe with intricate gold patterns.  Scene sequence: 0-3 seconds: Wide dramatic establishing shot of the warrior standing powerfully on the edge of a sheer rocky cliff at twilight. Strong wind billows his robe and hair. He holds a long traditional Korean sword straight forward with both hands, eyes closed in deep concentration. Thick oppressive black aura like heavy swirling ink smoke with subtle dark violet undertones and faint crackling dark particles slowly rises from his body and intensely concentrates into the sword blade.  3-8 seconds: Camera slowly orbits 180 degrees around the warrior while the black aura grows denser, fully enveloping the sword which begins to vibrate powerfully. His eyes suddenly snap open with piercing intensity.  8-12 seconds: Extreme slow-motion (0.4x) powerful diagonal downward slash. A massive crescent-shaped black energy slash erupts from the blade, trailing thick swirling black smoke, dark particles, and shadowy energy cracks, shooting fast across the deep canyon.  12-15 seconds: The black energy slash violently slams into the opposite cliff face, causing catastrophic realistic destruction — massive explosion of shattering rocks, flying debris, thick black dust clouds, and crumbling boulders with realistic physics. Final shot cuts back to the warrior still in slashing stance, slowly lowering the sword while staring coldly at the completely destroyed opposite cliff. Volumetric fog, moody cinematic rim lighting, dark color grading, highly detailed fabric texture and metallic sword reflection, dynamic wind simulation, epic oppressive atmosphere.

zh.p: 电影级15秒超写实视频，杰作，最佳画质，8K。与所提供图片的精确对照：凶猛的朝鲜武士，锐利而严峻的面容，战痕斑驳，传统的发髻用华丽的金属发簪固定，身穿流畅的深黑色华丽龙袍，饰有复杂的金色图案。 场景序列：0-3秒：战士在黄昏时分强势站立在陡峭岩石悬崖边缘的广阔戏剧性建立镜头。强风吹动他的长袍和头发。他双手直举一把长长的传统韩剑，闭着眼睛专注地凝视着。浓重压迫的黑色气息如浓重旋转的墨烟，带着淡淡的暗紫色底色和微弱的噼啪声，缓缓从他体内升起，强烈集中在剑刃中。 3-8秒：摄像机缓缓绕战士旋转180度，黑色光环愈发浓密，完全包裹剑柄，剑开始强烈震动。他的眼睛突然猛地睁开，目光锐利。 8-12秒：极限慢动作（0.4倍）强力斜向下斩。一道巨大的新月形黑色能量斩从刀刃中爆发，拖曳着浓重的黑烟、黑暗粒子和阴影般的能量裂纹，迅速划过深邃的峡谷。 12-15秒：黑色能量斩猛烈撞击对面悬崖，造成灾难性的真实破坏——巨大的爆炸，碎石、飞散的碎片、厚重的黑色尘土和崩塌的巨石，物理效果逼真。最后一幕切回战士，仍保持斩击姿势，缓缓放下剑，冷冷地凝视着完全被摧毁的对面悬崖。体积雾气、阴郁的电影边缘光、暗色调调色、极其细致的织物纹理和金属剑反射、动态风的模拟、史诗般的压抑氛围。

15秒充满活力的印度街头美食电影蒙太奇，超写实的纪录片风格，超广角手持镜头，充满活力的路边氛围，混乱的城市活力，活跃的印度街市美学，持续不断的移动，快节奏剪辑，正宗烹饪ASMR混合欢快的印度音乐。

主要主题：
勤劳的印度街头小贩在繁忙的路边摊位里做饭，旁边是繁忙的城市交通。满脸汗水，动作敏捷，逼真的街头厨房，满锅沸腾的油，到处都是五彩缤纷的酱料和香料。

音乐：
充满活力的印度街头音乐从第一秒开始就响起——欢快的鼓点、塔布拉鼓、节日铜管乐、快速的宝莱坞风格打击乐，整个视频中持续不断的活力节奏。

钩拳。超广角自拍特写，旁边油炸站的商贩在他身旁剧烈滋滋作响。广角镜头带来的摄像机畸变营造出沉浸式的真实感。响亮的印度音乐立刻响起。

身后是车流呼啸而过。
人们大声喊着点餐。

Ultra-cinematic fantasy sequence above a colossal floating empire suspended high above endless clouds during golden sunrise.

Gigantic celestial cities drift in the sky connected by glowing bridges, towering palaces, golden temples, waterfalls flowing into clouds, and massive ring-shaped structures reflecting sunlight across the heavens.

Far above the empire, storm clouds suddenly part as an enormous angelic phoenix descends from the sky. Its wings are made of radiant molten gold feathers and blazing divine energy. Every wingbeat releases waves of glowing particles across the clouds below.

The camera flies dynamically through the floating city as citizens and guards look upward toward the celestial creature. Massive shadows sweep across the empire while golden sunlight intensifies unnaturally.

The phoenix spirals downward through the clouds, trailing long streams of burning feathers and luminous energy ribbons. Its body radiates overwhelming heat and sacred light while thunder echoes softly inside the sky.

The camera transitions into gigantic scale shots beside the phoenix as it flies between floating towers and cathedral-like structures. Reflections of the creature ripple across polished marble and golden metal architecture.

As the phoenix approaches the central palace, shockwaves push clouds outward in enormous circular formations. Bells ring across the empire while banners and cloaks whip violently in divine wind.

Final cinematic reveal: the angelic phoenix hovers above the floating empire with wings fully expanded across the sky, illuminating the entire civilization beneath a sea of golden celestial light.

zh.p:
超电影般的奇幻场景，悬浮在无尽云层之上，金色日出时分。

巨大的天城漂浮在天空中，由发光的桥梁、高耸的宫殿、金色寺庙、流入云层的瀑布和反射阳光的巨大环形建筑相连。

在帝国上方遥远处，暴风云突然散开，一只巨大的天使凤凰从天而降。它的翅膀由炽热的熔金羽毛和炽热的神圣能量构成。每一次拍翼都会释放出发光粒子波，穿过云层。

镜头动态地穿梭于漂浮的城市中，市民和守卫仰望着这名天体生物。巨大的阴影笼罩帝国，金色阳光异常地增强。

凤凰在云层中螺旋下坠，拖曳着燃烧的羽毛和发光的能量丝带。它的身体散发着压倒性的热量和神圣的光芒，雷声在天空中轻柔回响。

镜头切换到巨型镜头，飞翔于浮动的塔楼和类似大教堂的建筑之间，紧随凤凰。生物的倒影在抛光的大理石和金色金属建筑上泛起涟漪。

当凤凰接近中央宫殿时，冲击波将云层推向外方，形成巨大的圆形阵型。钟声在帝国中响起，旗帜和斗篷在神风中猛烈摇曳。

最终的电影揭示：天使凤凰悬浮在漂浮帝国上空，翅膀完全展开，照亮整个文明，笼罩在一片金色天光之海中。

风格：极具电影感的奇幻现实主义，神圣的天体氛围，宏大规模摄影，闪耀的金色能量，体积云朵，史诗般的漂浮帝国建筑，天籁般的光影，雄伟的凤凰动画，AAA级奇幻电影质量，无文字，无叠加。

raw_p:
高品質な日式アニメ（Anime）調の動画で、「作画崩壊（Sakuga）」レベルの超大迫力な空間破壊と武器顕現シーンが描かれます。

00:00–00:03（星空の亀裂・宇宙の脈動）
カメラ：少女が宙を見上げるカットから、急激にカメラが上昇し空のパースへ。
アクション：少女が頭上でパチンと指を鳴らす。その瞬間、頭上の虚空にガラスが割れるような幾何学的な「空間のひび割れ」が発生する。
エフェクト：ひび割れから星雲の紺碧と超新星の鮮烈なオレンジの光が噴き出す。周囲の重力が反転し、地面の巨大な岩が空中に吸い上げられていく。
雰囲気：圧倒的なスケール感、宇宙的恐怖と神聖さの融合。

00:03–00:06（星座の獣・星狼の降臨）
カメラ：少女を俯瞰する360度超高速回転ショット。
アクション：少女は空中で両手を大きく広げ、天空の光を胸に引き寄せるようなダイナミックなポーズを取る。
エフェクト：空間の裂け目から、純粋な星光で形成された「コズミック・ウルフ（星狼）」の半透明な巨体が咆哮しながら飛び出す。星狼の体は星座の線（星座グラフ）で繋がっており、走るたびに宇宙の塵を撒き散らす。
雰囲気：天体の覚醒、星との契約。

00:06–00:09（天体融合・コズミックアーマー）
カメラ：背後からのローアングルから、少女の横顔への超クローズアップ。
アクション：星狼が少女の背中から衝突するように融合。少女は衝撃で両腕を十字に交差させ、鋭い眼光で正面を睨みつける。
エフェクト：制服が光の粒子に分解され、星の結晶でできた重厚かつスタイリッシュな白い天体装甲（宇宙の騎士甲冑）へと一瞬で変貌する。髪は重力を無視して逆立ち、先端がネオンブルーに発光する。
雰囲気：絶対的な防御力とパワーの覚醒。

00:09–00:12（巨剣顕現・重力崩壊）
カメラ：引きの全身ショットから、武器のディテールへ超高速ズーム。
アクション：交差した両手を引き剥がすと、光の粒子が凝縮され、彼女の身長を超えるほどの巨大な「大剣（グレートソード）」が物質化する。少女は両手で大剣を握り、大振りに一閃して地面に突き立てる。
エフェクト：大剣の刀身は宇宙の星々が流れる液晶のようになっており、突き立てた瞬間、周囲の空間に重力波の歪み（黒い同心円の波紋）が広がる。
雰囲気：一撃必殺の威圧感。

00:12–00:15（戦闘開始・臨戦態勢）
カメラ：大剣の切っ先から少女の顔へと抜けるダイナミックな広角ショット。
アクション：大剣を肩に担ぎ直し、不敵な笑みを浮かべる。彼女の足元から星の光が爆発的に噴き出し、いつでも突撃できる前傾姿勢を取る。
エフェクト：背後に巨大な星座の紋様が静かに明滅し、全エネルギーがブレードに集中していく。
雰囲気：嵐の前の静けさ、圧倒的な破壊力の予感。
