Use attached LINDA VS THE COFFEE MACHINE character sheet as exact reference. Pixar-style 3D woman, late 30s, dark hair messy bun with pen, navy blazer, white blouse. Bright modern office kitchen only, no dark shots, no other people. Black/silver office coffee machine labeled “COFFEE MACHINE,” touchscreen visible throughout.

0:00–0:02: Linda enters, places paper cup, presses Americano once, waits calmly.
0:02–0:04: Close-up display: “PLEASE WAIT — BREWING.” Machine hums awkwardly.
0:04–0:07: Linda leans closer as nothing happens. Finally a thin stream of completely clear hot water drips into cup. Double beep.
0:07–0:09: Display changes to “AMERICANO COMPLETE.” Linda slowly takes cup.
0:09–0:11: Close-up: cup contains only steaming clear hot water. Silent disappointment.
0:11–0:13: Linda stares hollowly at camera, sips hot water with zero reaction.
0:13–0:15: Display changes to “READY TO BREW.” Linda looks at machine, then water, sets cup down, removes pen from bun causing it to collapse, clicks pen, walks away. Soft final beep.

Machine never moves. No coffee ever appears — only clear hot water. Cinematic Pixar realism, subtle humor, realistic office ambience, smooth camera movement, medium/wide shots plus close-ups on display and cup.

0：04–0：琳达靠近，什么都没发生。最后，一股完全清净的热水细流滴入杯中。双响。
0：07–0：显示变更为“AMERICANO COMPLETE”。琳达慢慢接过杯子。
0：09–0：11：特写：杯子里只有热气腾腾的清热水。无声的失望。
0：11–0：13：琳达空洞地盯着镜头，喝着热水却毫无反应。
0：13–0：15：显示变为“准备酿造”。琳达看了看机器，又看了看水，放下杯子，把笔从发髻里拿出来，导致它塌了，点击了一下笔，然后走开了。轻柔的最后哔声。

机器从不动。从来没有咖啡出现——只有清澈的热水。电影般的皮克斯现实主义、细腻的幽默感、逼真的办公室氛围、流畅的镜头运动、中广角镜头以及展示和杯状镜头。

en.p:
Use attached LINDA VS THE COFFEE MACHINE character sheet as exact reference. Pixar-style 3D woman, late 30s, dark hair messy bun with pen, navy blazer, white blouse. Bright modern office kitchen only, no dark shots, no other people. Black/silver office coffee machine labeled “COFFEE MACHINE,” touchscreen visible throughout.

0:00–0:02: Linda enters, places paper cup, presses Americano once, waits calmly.
0:02–0:04: Close-up display: “PLEASE WAIT — BREWING.” Machine hums awkwardly.
0:04–0:07: Linda leans closer as nothing happens. Finally a thin stream of completely clear hot water drips into cup. Double beep.
0:07–0:09: Display changes to “AMERICANO COMPLETE.” Linda slowly takes cup.
0:09–0:11: Close-up: cup contains only steaming clear hot water. Silent disappointment.
0:11–0:13: Linda stares hollowly at camera, sips hot water with zero reaction.
0:13–0:15: Display changes to “READY TO BREW.” Linda looks at machine, then water, sets cup down, removes pen from bun causing it to collapse, clicks pen, walks away. Soft final beep.

Machine never moves. No coffee ever appears — only clear hot water. Cinematic Pixar realism, subtle humor, realistic office ambience, smooth camera movement, medium/wide shots plus close-ups on display and cup.

raw_p: [0-3s] Lucifer kneels in the crater of his landing scorched earth in perfect circle around him, smoke rising. He is still, head down, both wings spread one white one black as if catching breath after the fall. Camera orbits the crater edge slowly. [3-7s] He slowly raises his head. Looks up at the sky above where he fell from. His two different eyes reflect heaven above and earth below. Expression: not anger. Grief. Slow push-in on his face. [7-11s] He stands. Black flame sword rises from the crater ground into his hand as if recognizing its master. Cold black flames erupt from blade they move wrong, burn downward. His scorched wings spread fully. Magnificent and terrible. [11-15s] He looks at camera directly, knowingly. The first time any character breaks fourth wall. He smiles slowly not evil, something far more complex. He turns and walks into darkness, wings folding. Camera holds on empty crater, then tilts up to sky a single fallen star visible. Silence.

15-second 2D fighting game cinematic between Hades and Zeus inspired by classic arcade fighters and modern anime battle games. Side-view combat arena with visible fighting game HUD, animated health bars, combo hits, impact flashes, and cinematic special attacks.

ART STYLE:
• hand-painted 2.5D
• texture painting
• 3D is only the base structure
• vibrating grease-pencil outlines
• painterly fantasy animation
• stylized arcade fighting game aesthetic
• dynamic illustrated textures
• high-end animated fantasy UI

CHARACTERS:

Hades:
• tall blue-skinned underworld king
• elegant black suit with gold-red trim
• glowing yellow eyes
• purple underworld flames
• shadow and soul magic attacks

Zeus:
• white-haired king of Olympus
• white suit with gold details
• glowing golden eyes
• lightning powers
• explosive thunder attacks

GAME UI:
• large animated HP bars at top of screen
• “HADES” and “ZEUS” character names
• combo counter
• super meter
• impact effects when attacks land
• HP decreases accurately with every hit
• dramatic “CRITICAL HIT” flashes
• stylized fantasy fighting game interface

ENVIRONMENT:
A stormy cliff arena above a raging ocean. Lightning flashes constantly in the background. Purple underworld fire burns from cracks in the rocks. Wind and rain move dramatically across the scene. Painterly clouds swirl overhead.

VIDEO FLOW:

[00:00-00:01]
Black screen. Horrifying deep narrator voice echoes:
“FIGHT.”
Massive thunder strike. Screen flashes white.

[00:01-00:03]
Instantly after the narrator says “Fight,” Zeus lunges forward aggressively with electrified punches. Side-view arcade camera. Impact flashes explode with every hit. Hades’ HP bar visibly decreases in real time.

[00:03-00:06]
Hades teleports through shadow smoke and counters with purple soul-fire blasts. Zeus gets knocked backward. Zeus’ HP rapidly drops after every strike. Combo counter rises dynamically.

[00:06-00:09]
Fast-paced back-and-forth combat. Zeus launches lightning kicks while Hades blocks and retaliates with dark magic slashes. Screen shake and hit-stop effects emphasize impacts.

[00:09-00:12]
Both fighters unleash special abilities simultaneously. Zeus summons giant lightning pillars while Hades creates skeletal shadow arms erupting from the ground. Massive painterly effects fill the arena.

[00:12-00:15]
Final cinematic clash. Hades and Zeus collide mid-screen with a gigantic explosion of gold lightning and purple flames. HP bars nearly empty. Freeze-frame impact shot with vibrating grease-pencil outlines and dramatic arcade-style “FINAL STRIKE” text.

VISUAL DETAILS:
• arcade fighting game camera
• responsive hit reactions
• accurate fighting physics
• painterly animated effects
• stylized combo flashes
• dynamic health bar reduction
• exaggerated anime-style impacts
• cinematic screen shake
• hand-painted particle effects
• fantasy UI animations
• no realistic rendering

zh.p:
15秒的2D格斗游戏，哈迪斯与宙斯之间的电影感，灵感来自经典街机格斗游戏和现代动漫战斗游戏。侧视格斗竞技场，配有可见的格斗游戏HUD、动画血条、连击、冲击闪光和电影级特殊攻击。

艺术风格：
• 手绘2.5D
• 纹理绘画
• 3D仅是基础结构
• 振动的油脂笔轮廓
• 画风奇幻动画
• 风格化街机格斗游戏美学
• 动态插图纹理
• 高端动画奇幻界面

角色：

哈迪斯：
• 高大蓝皮肤的黑帮国王
• 优雅的黑色西装，饰以金红色边饰
• 发光的黄色眼睛
• 紫色黑帮火焰
• 暗影与灵魂魔法攻击

宙斯：
• 奥林匹斯白发国王
• 白色西装，配金色细节
• 发光的金色眼睛
• 闪电能力
• 爆炸性雷击

游戏界面：
• 屏幕顶部大面积动画生命值条
• “哈迪斯”和“宙斯”角色名称
• 连击计数器
• 超级节拍
• 攻击命中时的冲击效果
• 每次命中HP都会准确减少
• 戏剧性的“致命一击”闪光
• 风格化的奇幻格斗游戏界面

环境：
一个暴风雨的悬崖竞技场，俯瞰着汹涌的海洋。闪电在背景中不断闪烁。紫色的冥界火焰从岩石裂缝中燃烧。风雨在场景中戏剧性地移动。如画般的云朵在头顶盘旋。

视频流畅：

[00:00-00:01]
黑屏。令人毛骨悚然的低沉旁白声音回响：
“战斗。”
巨大的雷击。屏幕闪烁着白光。

[00:01-00:03]
叙述者刚说“开战”，宙斯便猛烈冲刺，挥出带电的拳头。侧视街机摄像头。冲击闪光会在每次攻击中爆炸。哈迪斯的生命值条会实时明显下降。

[00:03-00:06]
哈迪斯穿过阴影烟雾瞬移，并用紫色灵魂火焰反击。宙斯被击退。宙斯每次攻击后生命值迅速下降。连击反击会动态上升。

[00:06-00:09]
快节奏的你来我往的战斗。宙斯发射闪电踢，哈迪斯格挡并反击黑暗魔法斩击。屏幕震动和击停效果强调了冲击感。

[00:09-00:12]
两位战士同时释放特殊能力。宙斯召唤出巨大的闪电柱，哈迪斯则制造出从地面爆发的骷髅影臂。巨大的绘画效果充满了整个竞技场。

[00:12-00:15]
最终的电影式对决。哈迪斯和宙斯在画面中段碰撞，伴随着巨大的金色闪电和紫色火焰爆炸。生命值条几乎用尽。定格冲击镜头，配有震动的油笔轮廓和戏剧性的街机风格“FINAL STRIKE”文字。

视觉细节：
• 街机格斗游戏摄像机
• 响应式击中反应
• 精准的格斗物理
• 如画般动画化的特效
• 风格化的连招闪光
• 动态血条减少
• 夸张的动漫风格冲击
• 电影级屏幕震动
• 手绘粒子特效
• 奇幻界面动画
• 无真实渲染

史诗级格斗游戏原声带，h

raw_p:
Ultra-realistic cinematic 15-second video of a beautiful young woman waking up in a luxury modern home surrounded by nature and mountains. The scene opens in a softly lit elegant bedroom with morning sunlight gently passing through large glass windows. The camera slowly pans across the room showing minimal luxury interior design, soft white bedding, and natural textures.
The girl wakes up naturally, looking calm and fresh, with realistic human skin texture and natural morning expression. She sits up from bed and walks slowly toward the bathroom in a relaxed, everyday motion. The bathroom is modern, clean, and luxurious with soft lighting and high-end finishes.
She brushes her teeth in a realistic way with natural hand movement and subtle reflections in the mirror. No exaggerated gestures, fully grounded human behavior.
After finishing, the camera slowly transitions and moves past her toward a large glass window. The focus shifts outside, revealing a breathtaking view of green mountains, misty air, and peaceful natural scenery surrounding the house.
Cinematic lighting, handheld realistic camera movement, shallow depth of field, soft natural color grading, highly detailed textures, 4K ultra-realism, emotional calm morning mood, no stylization, no anime, no artificial look, pure realistic human footage style.

zh.p:
超写实的15秒电影视频，讲述一位美丽年轻女子醒来时身处一栋被大自然和群山环绕的豪华现代住宅。场景开场于一间柔和光线优雅的卧室，晨光透过大玻璃窗轻柔洒入。镜头缓缓扫过房间，展现极简奢华的室内设计、柔软的白色床品和自然的质感。
女孩自然醒来，看起来平静而清新，拥有逼真的人类皮肤质感和自然的晨间表情。她从床上坐起，慢慢走向浴室，动作轻松自然，像日常的样子。浴室现代、干净且豪华，灯光柔和，装潢高端。
她刷牙时动作自然，镜中反射出细微的倒影，动作逼真。没有夸张的动作，完全接地气的人性行为。
结束后，镜头缓缓切换，越过她，朝一扇大玻璃窗移动。视线转向户外，展现出令人屏息的绿色山脉、雾气弥漫的空气和环绕房屋的宁静自然景观。
电影般的灯光，手持真实的摄像机运动，浅景深，柔和自然的色彩调色，高度细致的纹理，4K超写实，情感平静的晨间氛围，无风格化，无动漫，无人工效果，纯粹写实的人类画面风格。

Ultra cinematic story-driven premium advertisement of a KitKat chocolate bar, film-grade realism, emotional storytelling transitioning into luxury macro product visuals, dark moody lighting evolving into warm cinematic tones

Scene 1: A young man sitting at a desk late at night, dim blue lighting from laptop screen, tired eyes, messy workspace, subtle background blur, slow handheld camera movement, realistic stress atmosphere

Scene 2: Fast chaotic cuts -typing aggressively, phone notifications lighting up, clock ticking, close-up on eyes, tension building, slightly shaky camera, cool tones

Scene 3: Sudden pause - silence moment, he leans back, notices a KitKat on the table, a soft warm spotlight gently hits the chocolate, camera slowly pushes in, mood shift begins

Scene 4: Extreme macro shot -hand picks up KitKat and snaps it in ultra slow motion, crisp break sound, chocolate crumbs and particles floating, dramatic cinematic lighting, everything 
transitions into calm slow motion

Scene 5: The man takes a bite of the KitKat, close-up on face, eyes gently closing, expression relaxing, stress melting away, lighting shifts from cool blue to warm golden tones, subtle smile appears, peaceful atmosphere

Scene 6: Melted chocolate flowing over KitKat in macro detail, rich glossy texture, warm highlights, smooth fluid motion, shallow depth of field, luxurious feel
Scene 7: Kitkat pieces floating and rotating in mid-air, suspended crumbs, volumetric light rays passing through particles, deep contrast, premium product ad aesthetic

Scene 8: Final hero shot - full KitKat centered on glossy black reflective surface, soft rim lighting, warm glow, slight mist in background, slow cinematic zoom-in

Audio: soft ambient music transitioning from tense to calm, satisfying chocolate snap sound,

zh.p:
极具电影感的奇巧巧克力棒高级广告，电影级的真实感，情感叙事过渡到奢华宏观产品视觉，阴郁阴郁的灯光逐渐演变为温暖的电影色调

场景1：一名年轻男子深夜坐在办公桌前，笔记本电脑屏幕发出昏暗的蓝色灯光，疲惫的眼睛，凌乱的工作环境，细微的背景模糊，手持摄像机移动缓慢，真实的紧张氛围

场景2：快速混乱的剪辑——激烈敲击键盘，手机通知亮起，钟表滴答，眼睛特写，紧张气氛渐浓，镜头微微抖动，冷淡的基调

场景3：突然停顿——沉默时刻，他靠回椅背，注意到桌上有个KitKat巧克力，柔和温暖的聚光灯轻轻照在巧克力上，镜头缓缓拉近，情绪开始转变

场景4：极限微距镜头——手拿起KitKat拍了一张超慢动作，清脆的断裂声，巧克力屑和颗粒漂浮，戏剧性的电影灯光，一切
过渡到平静慢动作

场景5：男子咬了一口奇巧巧克力，特写脸部，眼睛轻轻闭上，表情放松，压力消散，灯光从冷蓝色转为温暖的金色，微妙的微笑浮现，宁静的氛围

场景6：融化的巧克力在奇巧巧克力上流淌，细节丰富，质地光滑，温暖的高光，流畅的运动，浅景深，奢华的感觉

raw_p:
Ultra-cinematic dark fantasy survival sequence deep inside a frozen pine forest during a violent snowstorm at night.

Thick snow fog drifts between towering trees while icy wind howls through the forest. Visibility is extremely limited. Snow falls heavily across frozen ground illuminated only by pale moonlight and faint blue bioluminescent glows moving in the distance.

A pack of massive wolves slowly emerges from the fog. Their eyes burn with cold blue light while glowing patterns pulse faintly beneath frost-covered fur. Their breath forms dense vapor clouds in the freezing air.

The camera tracks low through deep snow beside the wolves as they move silently and intelligently between trees. Snow scatters beneath their paws while glowing particles drift from their fur like frozen embers.

The pack suddenly accelerates into a coordinated hunt. The camera races dynamically through the blizzard alongside them, weaving between pine trees, broken branches, and frozen rocks at extreme speed.

Moonlight flashes intermittently through the fog revealing glimpses of giant silhouettes sprinting through the storm. The wolves communicate silently through synchronized movement while their glowing eyes cut through the darkness.

One wolf leaps across a fallen frozen tree in slow motion, snow exploding outward beneath its body. Another disappears completely into the fog before reappearing closer to the camera like a ghost.

The storm intensifies violently. Wind bends the forest while visibility collapses into white chaos. The glowing wolves become streaks of blue light moving through the blizzard.

Final cinematic reveal: the entire pack stands motionless atop a snowy ridge overlooking the frozen forest below while moonlight pierces through the storm behind them.

Style: ultra cinematic dark fantasy realism, atmospheric snow simulation, glowing bioluminescent creatures, realistic wolf movement physics, volumetric fog, freezing winter atmosphere, dynamic tracking cinematography, high-end particle VFX, survival horror tension, AAA fantasy film quality, no text, no overlays.

zh.p:
超电影感的黑暗奇幻生存场景，发生在夜晚暴风雪中冰冷松林深处。

浓厚的雪雾在高耸的树木间飘荡，冰冷的风在森林中呼啸。能见度极其有限。雪花厚重地落在冰冻的地面上，只有淡淡的月光和远处微弱的蓝色生物发光光芒照亮。

一群庞大的狼慢慢从雾中出现。它们的眼睛燃烧着冷蓝色的光芒，霜覆盖的毛发下隐约跳动着发光的图案。它们的呼吸在冰冷的空气中形成浓密的蒸气云。

镜头低空穿过深雪，伴随着狼群在树间无声而聪明地移动。雪花在他们爪下四散，发光的颗粒如冰冻的余烬从毛发中飘落。

狼群突然加速，展开协调的狩猎。摄像机在暴风雪中动态穿梭，穿梭于松树、断枝和冰冻岩石之间，速度极快。

月光穿透雾气，隐约照亮巨型身影在风暴中奔跑。狼群通过同步动作无声交流，发光的眼睛划破黑暗。

一只狼慢动作跳过倒下的冰冻树，雪花在它身下爆开。另一个完全消失在雾中，然后像幽灵一样靠近镜头出现。

风暴猛烈加剧。风吹动森林，能见度崩塌成一片白色混沌。发光的狼变成了穿梭于暴风雪中的蓝光轨迹。

最终的电影揭示：整个狼群静静地站在雪山脊上，俯瞰着冰封的森林，月光穿透风暴。

风格：极具电影感的黑暗奇幻现实主义，氛围雪地模拟，发光生物，逼真的狼运动物理，体积雾气，冰冷的冬季氛围，动态追踪摄影，高端粒子视觉特效，生存恐怖紧张感，AAA级奇幻电影质量，无文字，无叠加。

raw_p:
暗く湿った森の中。映画のクリーチャーのような質感。濡れた傘、ぬめる皮膚、深いシワ、虚ろな目。シネマティックなホラー演出。

キノコは萎れた老人のような男性の声で、低くかすれた声で喋る。
「……久しぶりに人間を見たな」
話した直後、表情が急に苦しそうに歪む。
「うっ……」
続けて呼吸困難のように、喉を詰まらせながら、
「うっ、うっ、うっ……！」
と苦しそうな声を漏らす。顔が痙攣し、目が見開かれ、体全体が小刻みに震え始める。震えは激しくなり、湿った裂ける音とともに、キノコの傘が中央から縦にビリビリと裂ける。

その内部から、少し小さい、まったく同じ顔をした新しいキノコがゆっくりと現れる。古い外皮はしおれて崩れ落ちる。
新しいキノコは深呼吸して、少し元気な声で、
「ふ〜、わかがえったわい」
と言う。

最後は新しいキノコの不気味な笑顔のクローズアップ。

en.p:
In the dark, damp forest. It has a texture reminiscent of movie creatures. Wet umbrellas, slimy skin, deep wrinkles, vacant eyes. A cinematic horror scene.

Mushroom spoke in a low, hoarse voice like a withered old man.
「…… It's been a while since I've seen a human."
Right after speaking, his expression suddenly twisted in pain.
「うっ……」
Then, as if struggling to breathe, her throat tightened,
「うっ、うっ、うっ……！」
She let out a voice of distress. Her face twitched, her eyes widened, and her whole body began to tremble slightly. The tremors grew more intense, and with a wet cracking sound, the mushroom's cap cracked vertically from the center.

From inside, a slightly smaller, identical new mushroom slowly emerges. The old outer skin wilts and crumbles.
The new mushroom took a deep breath and, in a slightly energetic voice,
「ふ〜、わかがえったわい」
he said.

Finally, a close-up of the creepy smile of a new mushroom.
Ultra-realistic, dark fantasy, body horror, movie quality, humidity, detailed rendering, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, cinematic lighting, horror movie style, 9:16 vertical video.

raw_p: A cinematic psychological sci-fi sequence where an ordinary office day slowly breaks reality. 0–3s: Morning office routine. A young woman scans into a modern corporate building, coffee in hand, elevator rising smoothly. Everything feels normal, sterile, and repetitive under cold fluorescent lighting. 3–6s: Subtle distortions begin — computer screens flicker with unreadable code-like symbols, hallway lights blink in an unnatural rhythm, and coworkers repeat the same movements in looping patterns without noticing. 6–9s: The office environment shifts. Glass walls briefly show an endless void outside instead of the city. Printers output black pages of shifting text. Time feels fragmented as clocks on the wall spin erratically. 9–12s: Full surreal escalation — elevators open into identical floors repeating infinitely, voices become distorted, and the woman realizes she is the only one aware as reality behaves like a broken simulation. 12–15s: Final cinematic shot. zh.p: 一段电影感十足的心理科幻片段，讲述了一个普通的办公室日慢慢打破现实。0–3：早晨办公室例行公事。一位年轻女子手捧咖啡，扫视着一栋现代化企业大楼，电梯平稳上升。在冷冷的荧光灯下，一切都显得正常、冷漠且重复。3–6：细微的失真开始——电脑屏幕闪烁着难以辨认的代码符号，走廊灯以不自然的节奏闪烁，同事们不自觉地重复同样的动作，形成循环模式。6点到9点：办公室环境发生变化。玻璃墙短暂地显示出外面是无尽的虚空，而非城市。打印机输出的是动态的黑色文字页面。时间仿佛支离破碎，墙上的时钟不规则地转动着。9–12区：完全超现实的升级——电梯打开，进入无数重复的同一楼层，声音变得扭曲，女性意识到自己是唯一清醒的人，现实如同破碎的模拟。12–15秒：最后一个电影镜头。她独自站在一片无边无际的空旷办公网格中。灯光一盏盏熄灭，陷入黑暗，只剩下她的显示器发出一条信息：“模拟结束。”风格：极度电影般的现实主义、反乌托邦科幻恐怖、故障失真视觉特效、企业边缘空间氛围、冷冷荧光灯、递归环境设计、心理紧张感、胶片级色彩分级、诡异极简音效设计感觉。

en.p: A cinematic psychological sci-fi sequence where an ordinary office day slowly breaks reality. 0–3s: Morning office routine. A young woman scans into a modern corporate building, coffee in hand, elevator rising smoothly. Everything feels normal, sterile, and repetitive under cold fluorescent lighting. 3–6s: Subtle distortions begin — computer screens flicker with unreadable code-like symbols, hallway lights blink in an unnatural rhythm, and coworkers repeat the same movements in looping patterns without noticing. 6–9s: The office environment shifts. Glass walls briefly show an endless void outside instead of the city. Printers output black pages of shifting text. Time feels fragmented as clocks on the wall spin erratically. 9–12s: Full surreal escalation — elevators open into identical floors repeating infinitely, voices become distorted, and the woman realizes she is the only one aware as reality behaves like a broken simulation. 12–15s: Final cinematic shot. She stands alone in a vast empty office grid stretching endlessly in all directions. The lights shut off one by one into darkness, leaving only her monitor glowing with a single message: “END OF SIMULATION.” Style: ultra cinematic realism, dystopian sci-fi horror, glitch distortion VFX, corporate liminal space atmosphere, cold fluorescent lighting, recursive environment design, psychological tension, film-grade color grading, eerie minimal sound design feel.

raw_p:
15秒前後、2〜3場面で構成されたシネマティックな歴史アクション短編動画。舞台は戦国時代、日本の険しい山の上に築かれた山城。映像の中心は、山城へ押し寄せる攻城軍と、それを迎え撃つ城側の守備兵による大規模な攻防全体。巨大な攻城塔や破城槌などの攻城兵器は画面内に登場してよいが、映像の主役にしない。攻城兵器だけを大写しにし続けず、山城全景、押し寄せる軍勢、城壁を登る兵、守備兵の迎撃、火矢、投石、城門周辺の混乱をバランスよく見せる。

Scene 1: 明るくはっきりした昼光の中、まず俯瞰で山城の全景を見せる。険しい山の斜面、石垣、城門、櫓、城壁、その下から押し寄せる攻城軍が一目で分かる。山の斜面を登る兵、盾を持って前進する兵、はしごを運ぶ兵、攻城軍の中に見える大型の攻城塔や破城槌、城壁の上で迎撃準備をする守備兵を同時に見せる。最初の数秒で「山城をめぐる大規模な攻城戦」が明確に伝わる強い導入にする。

Scene 2: 攻防が一気に激しくなる。攻め手は山の斜面を駆け上がり、はしごを石垣や城壁にかけ、兵士たちが城壁を登り始める。城側の守備兵は高所から火矢、投石、槍、叫び声で迎え撃つ。火矢が飛び交い、石が落下し、盾に衝撃が走り、煙と土埃が立ち上がる。攻城兵器は戦場の一部として見えるが、主役ではなく、軍勢全体の中の迫力要素として扱う。俯瞰、横移動、急接近、引きの全景を切り替え、攻めと守りの関係を分かりやすく保つ。

Scene 3: クライマックスでは、城門周辺と城壁上で攻め手と守備側の力が同時にぶつかる。兵士が城壁を登り、守備兵が押し返し、火矢と投石が交錯し、城門付近では衝撃と木片、煙、火花が広がる。巨大攻城兵器を主役にせず、あくまで山城全体の攻防、城壁を登る兵、迎撃する守備兵、城門周辺の混乱を中心に描く。最後は煙と火の向こうにそびえる山城と、まだ続く攻防を感じさせる引きの全景で締める。1〜2秒の短い余韻を残す。

色調は明るくはっきりしたシネマティックな昼光にする。画面全体を灰色や茶色に沈ませず、山城、攻め手、守備兵、火矢、煙、旗の色が明確に分かれるようにする。暖かい自然光、くっきりした輪郭、強めのコントラスト、火矢の鮮やかなオレンジ、旗の赤や白、石垣と木材と鎧の質感差を強調する。曇天すぎる空、低コントラスト、くすんだ灰色、濁った色、全体がぼやけた映像は避ける。

カメラワークはダイナミックにする。冒頭は必ず俯瞰で山城全景と攻城軍を見せる。ローアングルで攻め手の迫力を見せ、横移動で前進する軍勢を追い、急接近で火矢や城壁を登る兵の緊迫感を見せ、最後は引きの全景で攻城戦全体の余韻を残す。映像は重厚でアクティブ、戦場全体が動いていること。BGMなし、効果音のみ。足音、盾の衝撃、火矢、石の落下、木材のきしみ、叫び声、風、戦場のざわめきを強調する。文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、分割画面、コラージュは出さない。

色調は明るくはっきりしたシネマティックな昼光にする。画面全体を灰色や茶色に沈ませず、山城、攻め手、守備兵、火矢、煙、旗の色が明確に分かれるようにする。暖かい自然光、くっきりした輪郭、強めのコントラスト、火矢の鮮やかなオレンジ、旗の赤や白、石垣と木材と鎧の質感差を強調する。曇天すぎる空、低コントラスト、くすんだ灰色、濁った色、全体がぼやけた映像は避ける。

カメラワークはダイナミックにする。冒頭は必ず俯瞰で山城全景と攻城軍を見せる。ローアングルで攻め手の迫力を見せ、横移動で前進する軍勢を追い、急接近で火矢や城壁を登る兵の緊迫感を見せ、最後は引きの全景で攻城戦全体の余韻を残す。映像は重厚でアクティブ、戦場全体が動いていること。BGMなし、効果音のみ。足音、盾の衝撃、火矢、石の落下、木材のきしみ、叫び声、風、戦場のざわめきを強調する。文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、分割画面、コラージュは出さない。

en.p:
A cinematic historical action short film about 15 seconds long and composed of 2 to 3 scenes. The setting is a mountain castle built atop rugged mountains in Japan, during the Sengoku period. The focus of the footage is the large-scale battle between the assault forces advancing toward the mountain castle and the castle defenders who are resisting them. Giant siege towers and battering rams may appear on screen, but they should not be the main focus of the video. Rather than focusing solely on siege weapons, the film balances the full view of the mountain castle, the invading troops, soldiers climbing the walls, the defenders' defenses, firing arrows, stone-throwing, and the chaos around the gates.

Scene 1: In the bright and clear daylight, first show the entire mountain castle from above. You can instantly spot the steep mountain slopes, stone walls, gates, turrets, walls, and the assault army pressing in from below. Soldiers climbing mountain slopes, soldiers advancing with shields, soldiers carrying ladders, large siege towers and battering rams visible within the siege army, and defenders preparing to intercept atop the walls are all shown simultaneously. In the first few seconds, the introduction is strong, clearly conveying the 'large-scale siege battle over the mountain castle.'

Scene 2: The battle intensifies all at once. Attackers would run up the mountain slopes, climb ladders over stone walls and city walls, and soldiers would begin to climb the walls. The castle defenders met from high ground with flaming arrows, stones, spears, and shouts. Arrows flew everywhere, stones fell, shields struck with impact, and smoke and dust rose up. Siege weapons appear as part of the battlefield, but they are not the main characters; rather, they are treated as the powerful elements within the entire army. It switches between bird's-eye view, lateral movement, rapid close-up, and pull-back panoramic views to keep the relationship between offense and defense easy to understand.

Scene 3: In the climax, attackers and defenders clash simultaneously around the gates and on the walls. Soldiers climbed the walls, defenders pushed back, and firebolts and stones flew in a flurry, with shocks, wood fragments, smoke, and sparks spreading near the gates. It does not focus on massive siege weapons as the main focus, but rather focuses on the overall siege of the mountain castle, the soldiers climbing the walls, the defenders intercepting them, and the chaos around the gates. The tour ends with a panoramic view of the mountain castle towering beyond smoke and fire, evoking the ongoing battle and battle. Leaves a brief lingering aftertaste of 1–2 seconds.

The color tone is bright and distinct, with cinematic daylight. Do not make the entire canvas sink to gray or brown; instead, clearly distinguish the colors of the mountain castle, attackers, defenders, fire arrows, smoke, and flags. Warm natural light, sharp outlines, strong contrast, vivid orange arrows, red or white flags, and the contrast in texture between stone walls and wood and armor are emphasized. Avoid overcast skies, low contrast, dull grays, muddy colors, and images that are completely blurry.

カメラワークはダイナミックにする。 At the beginning, the castle is always shown from an overhead view of the entire mountain castle and the siege army. The low angle showcases the power of attackers, chasing advancing troops with lateral movement, and the tension of fire arrows and soldiers climbing walls at close range, ending with a panoramic retreat that leaves the entire siege battle feeling alive. The visuals are heavy and dynamic, with the entire battlefield moving. No background music, only sound effects. It emphasizes footsteps, the impact of shields, flaming arrows, falling stones, the creaking of wood, shouts, wind, and the murmur of the battlefield. No text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, split-screen, or collages are included.

abstract art animation, hand-drawn, emotional kinetic transformation. {{Image 1}} through {{Image 5}} are five cyberpunk and glitch-art compositions featuring neon pink, cyan, magenta, electric blue color palettes, digital glitch artifacts, pixelated distortions, heterochromatic glowing eyes, data-moshing effects, and claustrophobic intensity. Extract every form, motif, color, line quality, texture, rhythm, and emotional tension from the references.

The animation must feel fast, alive, unstable, and emotionally charged. Every transformation seamless and continuous. No hard cuts. No static pauses except single-frame impact holds. Entire composition including background constantly transforms. All elements behave as if pulled by memory, gravity, heat, sound, and emotion simultaneously.

[0-1.5s] A central abstract figure appears as if already in motion. Its inner color pulses outward in uneven emotional waves, while its outline tears away in multiple directions. The background bends around the figure like soft paper under pressure. Fine hand-drawn textures crawl across the surface faster than the main form moves, creating tension between body and skin.

[1.5-3s] The detached outlines accelerate and become nervous thread-like forms. The figure's color core stretches into sharp ribbons and liquid stains simultaneously. Some ribbons snap back, others whip forward, each leaving a trembling residue. Empty spaces between moving parts ignite into new shapes, as if the composition is creating forms to fill its own emotional gaps.

[3-4.5s] All forms suddenly surge diagonally across the frame. One large shape folds over itself like fabric, but the fold reveals a completely different texture beneath: grain, chalk, wet ink, and scraped paint all visible at once. The background follows the fold, twisting into a new color field. Smaller forms are dragged behind the motion, stretching into speed lines that remain alive and continue transforming.

[4.5-6s] The composition fractures into several emotional forces: one calm, one violent, one fragile, one ecstatic. Each force pulls color from the others. Shadows appear before the objects that cast them, moving ahead like predictions. Original forms chase their own shadows, but the shadows mutate faster, becoming brighter, thicker, and more dominant than the objects.

[6-7.5s] A rapid chain reaction begins. Every collision between forms produces a new motif taken from the references: fragments, symbols, textures, silhouettes, stains, lines, and color fields. These new motifs immediately accelerate in different directions. Trails do not simply fade — they harden into new bodies, then melt again, then split into smaller emotional echoes.

[7.5-9s] The entire frame compresses toward a single invisible point near the lower center. All lines, colors, textures, shadows, and background layers squeeze inward at different speeds. Hold maximum compression for one single frame. Then everything explodes upward and outward with vertical smears, wobbling contours, and overshooting motion. Each element lands in a new position but continues vibrating from impact.

[9-10.5s] Textures begin migrating between forms like exchanged emotions. A rough dry texture enters a fluid form, making it move in broken angular steps. A liquid texture enters a rigid form, causing it to sag, drip, and breathe. A glowing color texture passes into the background, making the entire environment pulse. Every form changes behavior based on the texture it receives.

[10.5-12s] A cascade of rotations crosses the frame. Each form flips, twists, or turns inside out, revealing a hidden back face with a dramatically different color and emotional quality. Revealed faces reach toward neighboring forms like hands, hooks, flames, or waves. When touched, the next form rotates immediately, continuing the cascade faster and faster until the entire frame has transformed into a new emotional world.

[12-13.5s] Boundaries dissolve everywhere at once. Forms merge, reject each other, separate, then merge again. New hybrid shapes inherit colors, textures, and motion behaviors from their parents but never become identical to them. The background no longer sits behind the forms — it becomes one of the forms, pushing forward, swallowing edges, and releasing new figures from within itself.

[13.5-15s] Every previous process returns simultaneously at maximum speed: outlines detach, colors seep and drip, textures migrate, shadows lead, forms chase, trails solidify, hidden faces rotate, boundaries dissolve, backgrounds fold, and hybrid shapes multiply. Each element performs multiple transformations at once. Final second feels emotionally overloaded but visually intentional — a fast, hand-drawn abstract storm where every reference has been fully absorbed and transformed until the last frame.

抽象艺术动画，手绘的情感动感转化。{{图片1}}到{{Image 5}}是五件赛博朋克和故障艺术构图，特色包括霓虹粉色、青色、品红色、电蓝色调色板、数字故障伪影、像素化失真、异色发光眼睛、数据冲击效果和幽闭紧张感。从参考中提取出每一种形式、主题、色彩、线条质量、质感、节奏和情感张力。

动画必须感觉快速、生动、不稳定且情感充沛。每一次转变都无缝且持续。没有硬性切割。除了单帧冲击保持外，没有静态暂停。整个构图包括背景都会不断变化。所有元素似乎同时被记忆、重力、热量、声音和情感牵引。

[0-1.5秒] 一个中央抽象人物仿佛已经在移动。它的内在色彩以不均匀的情感波浪向外扩散，而轮廓则向多个方向撕裂。背景像受压的软纸一样弯曲。细腻的手绘纹理在表面上爬行的速度比主体移动更快，制造了身体与皮肤之间的张力。

[1.5-3s] 脱离的轮廓加速，变成紧张的线状形态。人物的色核同时拉伸成锋利的丝带和液态污渍。有些丝带弹回去，有些向前甩动，每一条都留下颤抖的痕迹。运动部件之间的空白点燃成新的形状，仿佛构图在创造形态以填补自身的情感空白。

[3-4.5秒] 所有形态突然斜向横扫画面。一个大形状像布料一样折叠，但折叠后却展现出完全不同的质感：木纹、粉笔、湿墨和刮过的油漆同时显现。背景随着折叠轨迹旋转，形成新的色域。较小的形态被拖拽在运动后面，拉伸成保持生命并持续变形的速度线。

[4.5-6秒] 这部作品分裂成几种情感力量：一种平静，一种激烈，一种脆弱，一种狂喜。每种力都从彼此中吸取颜色。影子出现在投射它们的物体前方，像预言一样向前移动。原始形态追逐自身的影子，但影子变异更快，变得比物体更明亮、更浓密、更占主导地位。

[6-7.5秒] 快速连锁反应开始。形式间的每一次碰撞都会产生新的主题：碎片、符号、质感、剪影、污渍、线条和色域。这些新主题立刻加速到不同方向。痕迹不会简单地消逝——它们会硬化成新的身体，然后再次融化，最终分裂成更小的情感回声。

[7.5-9秒] 整个画面压缩向靠近下方中心的一个隐形点。所有线条、颜色、纹理、阴影和背景图层以不同速度向内挤压。保持最大压缩一帧。然后一切都会向上和向外爆发，伴随着垂直的涂抹、摇晃的轮廓和过度的运动。每个元素落在新位置，但撞击时仍会震动。

[9-10.5秒] 纹理开始像情感交换一样在形态间迁移。粗糙干燥的纹理转变为流动形态，使其以破碎的角度步进移动。液态质地进入僵硬形态，使其下垂、滴落并呼吸。发光的色彩纹理进入背景，使整个环境脉动。每个形态都会根据收到的纹理发生变化。

[10.5-12秒] 一连串旋转穿过画面。每个形态都会翻转、扭转或翻转，露出隐藏的背面，颜色和情感质感截然不同。露出的面孔向邻近的形态伸延，如手、钩子、火焰或波浪。当被触碰时，下一个形态会立即旋转，不断加快连锁反应，直到整个画面转变为新的情感世界。

[12-13.5秒] 界限在各处瞬间消融。形态合并、相互拒绝、分离，然后再次合并。新的混合形态继承了父本的颜色、质感和运动行为，但从未完全相同。背景不再位于形体背后——它成为形态中的一个，向前推进，吞噬边缘，释放出自身的新形象。

[13.5-15秒] 所有之前的过程以最大速度同时返回：轮廓脱离，颜色渗出滴落，纹理迁移，阴影引领，形态追逐，轨迹固定，隐藏面旋转，边界消散，背景折叠，混合形状倍增。每个元素同时执行多个变换。《最后一秒》情感过载，但视觉上是有意为之——一场快速的手绘抽象风暴，所有参考都被完全吸收和转化，直到最后一帧。

en.p:
abstract art animation, hand-drawn, emotional kinetic transformation. {{Image 1}} through {{Image 5}} are five cyberpunk and glitch-art compositions featuring neon pink, cyan, magenta, electric blue color palettes, digital glitch artifacts, pixelated distortions, heterochromatic glowing eyes, data-moshing effects, and claustrophobic intensity. Extract every form, motif, color, line quality, texture, rhythm, and emotional tension from the references.

The animation must feel fast, alive, unstable, and emotionally charged. Every transformation seamless and continuous. No hard cuts. No static pauses except single-frame impact holds. Entire composition including background constantly transforms. All elements behave as if pulled by memory, gravity, heat, sound, and emotion simultaneously.

[0-1.5s] A central abstract figure appears as if already in motion. Its inner color pulses outward in uneven emotional waves, while its outline tears away in multiple directions. The background bends around the figure like soft paper under pressure. Fine hand-drawn textures crawl across the surface faster than the main form moves, creating tension between body and skin.

[1.5-3s] The detached outlines accelerate and become nervous thread-like forms. The figure's color core stretches into sharp ribbons and liquid stains simultaneously. Some ribbons snap back, others whip forward, each leaving a trembling residue. Empty spaces between moving parts ignite into new shapes, as if the composition is creating forms to fill its own emotional gaps.

[3-4.5s] All forms suddenly surge diagonally across the frame. One large shape folds over itself like fabric, but the fold reveals a completely different texture beneath: grain, chalk, wet ink, and scraped paint all visible at once. The background follows the fold, twisting into a new color field. Smaller forms are dragged behind the motion, stretching into speed lines that remain alive and continue transforming.

[4.5-6s] The composition fractures into several emotional forces: one calm, one violent, one fragile, one ecstatic. Each force pulls color from the others. Shadows appear before the objects that cast them, moving ahead like predictions. Original forms chase their own shadows, but the shadows mutate faster, becoming brighter, thicker, and more dominant than the objects.

[6-7.5s] A rapid chain reaction begins. Every collision between forms produces a new motif taken from the references: fragments, symbols, textures, silhouettes, stains, lines, and color fields. These new motifs immediately accelerate in different directions. Trails do not simply fade — they harden into new bodies, then melt again, then split into smaller emotional echoes.

[7.5-9s] The entire frame compresses toward a single invisible point near the lower center. All lines, colors, textures, shadows, and background layers squeeze inward at different speeds. Hold maximum compression for one single frame. Then everything explodes upward and outward with vertical smears, wobbling contours, and overshooting motion. Each element lands in a new position but continues vibrating from impact.

[9-10.5s] Textures begin migrating between forms like exchanged emotions. A rough dry texture enters a fluid form, making it move in broken angular steps. A liquid texture enters a rigid form, causing it to sag, drip, and breathe. A glowing color texture passes into the background, making the entire environment pulse. Every form changes behavior based on the texture it receives.

[10.5-12s] A cascade of rotations crosses the frame. Each form flips, twists, or turns inside out, revealing a hidden back face with a dramatically different color and emotional quality. Revealed faces reach toward neighboring forms like hands, hooks, flames, or waves. When touched, the next form rotates immediately, continuing the cascade faster and faster until the entire frame has transformed into a new emotional world.

[12-13.5s] Boundaries dissolve everywhere at once. Forms merge, reject each other, separate, then merge again. New hybrid shapes inherit colors, textures, and motion behaviors from their parents but never become identical to them. The background no longer sits behind the forms — it becomes one of the forms, pushing forward, swallowing edges, and releasing new figures from within itself.

[13.5-15s] Every previous process returns simultaneously at maximum speed: outlines detach, colors seep and drip, textures migrate, shadows lead, forms chase, trails solidify, hidden faces rotate, boundaries dissolve, backgrounds fold, and hybrid shapes multiply. Each element performs multiple transformations at once. Final second feels emotionally overloaded but visually intentional — a fast, hand-drawn abstract storm where every reference has been fully absorbed and transformed until the last frame.

raw_p: A first-person POV video of a player piloting a medieval-style hang glider over a breathtaking fantasy landscape. The player's leather-gloved hands are visible, gripping the wooden control bar. Below, a pristine blue river winds through a deep valley, reflecting the bright, sunny sky. In the distance, massive floating islands hover in the air, and a giant medieval stone castle with tall towers and yellow banners sits on a cliffside. A large red dragon flies dynamically through the sky. The video includes gaming elements like a heads-up display (HUD) showing speed, altitude, a mini-map, and a quest log titled 'The Lost Crown' in the corner. The camera rolls and dives, capturing the exhilarating motion of flight with cinematic sunlight and a wide-angle field of view.

raw_p: 16:9のアニメ絵コンテシートを作成してください。8つのシネマティックなコマで構成し、黒いコマ枠を入れてください。文字、テキスト、キャプションは入れないでください。テーマ：居心地のよい深夜のキッチンで、ひとつのシンプルな卵が魔法のように黄金のオムライスへと変化していく。スタイル：オリジナルの現代的な日本アニメ風。シネマティックなライティング、暖かみのある色彩、料理を高密度に描き込んだ美しいフードイラスト、やわらかい発光ハイライト、表情豊かなモーションライン、美味しそうで満足感のある調理ビジュアル。1コマ目：木製のキッチンカウンターの上に置かれた1個の卵のクローズアップ。暖かな深夜の光に照らされ、静かで落ち着いた居心地のよい雰囲気。2コマ目：若い料理人が卵を割る。卵の中から魔法のような黄金の光が弾ける。3コマ目：フライパンの中でご飯とケチャップが渦を巻く。湯気が立ち上り、ダイナミックな円運動を描く。4コマ目：フライパンの中でバターが溶け、きらめく黄金の泡が弾ける。極端なクローズアップで、とても気持ちのよい描写。5コマ目：ふわふわのオムレツがスローモーションのように形作られていく。縁がほのかに光り、柔らかな質感が伝わる。6コマ目：オムレツがケチャップライスの上に完璧に着地する。アニメらしいドラマチックなインパクトの瞬間。7コマ目：ナイフでオムレツをやさしく開くと、中のとろとろの卵が黄金の溶岩のようにご飯の上へ流れ出す。8コマ目：皿に盛られた完成したオムライスのビューティーショット。湯気が立ち上り、ソースは艶やかに輝き、魔法のようなきらめきがあり、ループの終わりにもつなげやすい構図。カメラ表現：クローズアップ中心、ダイナミックなアングル、なめらかなアニメ料理CMのような映像感。ライティング：暖かく、居心地がよく、黄金色に包まれた深夜のキッチンの雰囲気。品質：クリーンな線画、丁寧な陰影表現、高級感のあるアニメ料理CMの仕上がり、食欲をそそる、SNSでバズりそうなビジュアル。ネガティブプロンプト：文字、テキスト、キャプション、ウォーターマーク、ロゴ、ぼやけ、手の崩れ、指の本数異常、構図の散らかり、リアル写真風、ホラー表現、暗くて汚れたキッチン。16:9の横動画で、15秒のアニメ料理動画を作成してください。テーマ：居心地のよい深夜のキッチンで、ひとつのシンプルな卵が魔法のように黄金色のふわとろオムライスへと変化していく。スタイル：オリジナルの現代的な日本アニメ風。シネマティックな料理CMのような映像、暖かな黄金色のライティング、居心地のよい深夜のムード、精密で美味しそうな料理アニメーション、なめらかなカメラワーク、魔法のようなきらめき、やわらかな湯気、艶やかなソース、満足感のある料理クローズアップ。動画は、SNSでバズりやすいテンポの良い料理シーケンスとして構成してください。0:00-0:01 木のカウンターの上で光る卵のフックショット。0:01-0:03 卵を割ると黄金の魔法の光があふれ出す。0:03-0:05 フライパンの中でケチャップライスが渦を巻く。0:05-0:07 極端なクローズアップでバターが溶ける。0:07-0:09 フライパンの中でふわふわのオムレツが形作られていく。0:09-0:11 オムレツがケチャップライスの上に着地する。0:11-0:13 ナイフでオムレツを開くと、とろとろの中身がご飯の上へ流れ出す。0:13-0:15 完成したオムライスのビューティーショット。湯気が立ち上り、黄金のきらめきがあり、自然にループできる締め。カメラ：シネマティックな横構図、浅い被写界深度、なめらかなプッシュイン、料理のクローズアップ、ダイナミックなパン移動、ドラマチックなアニメ的アングル。雰囲気：居心地がよい、魔法のよう、美味しそう、満足感がある、暖かい、深夜のキッチン。セリフなし、文字なし、キャプションなし、字幕なし、ロゴなし。料理はとにかく美味しそうに見せ、アニメーションはなめらかにしてください。

en.p: Please create a 16:9 anime storyboard sheet. Consist of eight cinematic panels, with black frames included. Do not include text, text, or captions. Theme: In a cozy late-night kitchen, a single simple egg magically transforms into golden omurice. Style: Original, modern Japanese anime style. Cinematic lighting, warm colors, beautiful food illustrations densely depicting dishes, soft glowing highlights, expressive motion lines, and delicious-looking and satisfying cooking visuals. Panel 1: Close-up of an egg placed on a wooden kitchen counter. Bathed in warm midnight light, it creates a quiet, calm, and cozy atmosphere. Second panel: A young chef cracks an egg. A magical golden light bursts forth from inside the egg. Panel 3: Rice and ketchup swirl in the frying pan. Steam rises, drawing a dynamic circular movement. Panel 4: Butter melts in the pan, and sparkling golden bubbles burst. Extreme close-up, very pleasurable depiction. Panel 5: The fluffy omelet is shaped in slow motion. The edges glow faintly, conveying a soft texture. Panel 6: The omelet lands perfectly on top of the ketchup rice. A dramatic moment typical of anime. Panel 7: When you gently open the omelet with a knife, the melty egg inside flows onto the rice like golden lava. Frame 8: Beauty shot of the finished omelet rice served on a plate. Steam rises, the sauce shines glossy, with a magical sparkle, creating a composition that easily connects to the end of the loop. Camera Expression: Focused on close-ups, dynamic angles, and a smooth visualization reminiscent of an anime cooking commercial. Lighting: A warm, cozy, and golden kitchen atmosphere at midnight. Quality: Clean line art, careful shading, luxurious finishing from an anime cuisine commercial, appetizing visuals that could go viral on social media. Negative prompts: text, text, captions, watermarks, logos, blur, clumsy hands, abnormal finger counts, messy composition, realistic photo style, horror expressions, dark and dirty kitchens. raw_p:
Ultra realistic mass celebrity entry scene. Single continuous shot. Handheld camera from crowd perspective. Natural micro-shake. No cuts. Documentary realism.
Audio:
Only natural environment sound — loud crowd cheering, people shouting, rapid camera shutter clicks, phones recording audio, airport announcements echoing, footsteps, fabric movement, distant engine idle and rev.
Lighting:
Natural daylight through airport glass panels. Mixed reflections. Realistic shadows. Slight haze for depth.
Main Character:
A 24-year-old Indian male celebrity with a sharp jawline, styled brown hair, and light stubble. Calm, confident presence with a subtle controlled smile. Face must remain consistent.
Outfit (STRICT LOCK):
Black zip-up jacket with soft fleece/matte texture worn open, clean light grey/white t-shirt inside, beige/cream tailored pants.
Accessories: transparent beige square-frame luxury sunglasses with gradient lenses (Tom Ford style).
No changes.
SCENE
0–3s:
Handheld camera starts from inside the crowd behind barricades. Slight natural shake. People in front partially block the view. Phones raised high, some screens visible recording. Crowd is loud and restless. Camera tries to find a clear view toward the arrival gate.
3–6s:
Camera lifts slightly above shoulder level, shaky but controlled. Focus shifts between heads, waving hands, and glimpses of the arrival gate. Media cameras flash. Anticipation builds as people lean forward.
6–10s:
Security suddenly steps in, pushing the crowd slightly back. Camera reacts naturally with a small shake. Through the gaps, the celebrity becomes visible in the distance, slightly blurred at first, then gradually clearer as he walks forward with bodyguards.
10–13s:
Camera zooms slightly (natural handheld push-in feel). Celebrity now clearly visible, walking confidently in center. Security clears the path. He raises his hand and gives a calm wave with a slight smile. Camera struggles slightly to keep him in frame as people move.
13–15s:
Camera tilts and shifts trying to follow him as he reaches his convoy. Partial view of Lamborghini Aventador, with Mercedes G63 and Innova behind. A bodyguard opens the scissor door. The celebrity enters quickly. Engine revs. Vehicles begin moving. Camera lifts slightly as people jump to see. Fade to black.

zh.p:
超写实的大众名人入场场景。单镜头连续。手持摄像机从观众视角看。天然微摇。没有割伤。纪录现实主义。
音频：
只有自然环境的声音——人群的欢呼声、人们的喊叫声、快速的快门声、手机录音声、机场广播回响、脚步声、布料移动声、远处发动机怠速和轰鸣声。
灯光：
通过机场玻璃窗透进的自然光。各种想法。逼真的阴影。略带迷雾以增强深度。
主角：
一位24岁的印度男明星，拥有锐利的下颌线、梳理过的棕色头发和浅色胡茬。冷静自信的气质，带着微妙而克制的微笑。面子必须保持一致。
服装（严格锁定）：
黑色拉链夹克，柔软抓绒/哑光质地敞开，内穿干净的浅灰白色T恤，米色/奶油色剪裁裤子。
配件：透明米色方框奢华太阳镜，带有渐变镜片（汤姆·福特风格）。
没有变化。
场景
0–3：
手持摄像机从路障后方的人群中开始拍摄。轻微的自然抖动。前面的人部分挡住了视线。手机高举，有些屏幕还在录像。人群喧闹且躁动不安。摄像机试图找到通往到达登机口的清晰视角。
3–6岁：
镜头略高于肩膀，晃动但控制得很好。注意力在头脑、挥手和抵达登机口间切换。媒体摄像机闪光灯。随着人们向前倾身，期待感逐渐升高。
6至10岁：
保安突然介入，将人群稍微推开。相机自然地做出轻微震动。通过缝隙，名人在远处隐约可见，起初略显模糊，随后随着他带着保镖向前走来，逐渐清晰起来。
10–13岁：
相机会稍微变焦（自然的手持推入感）。名人现在清晰可见，自信地走在中央。安保清理通道。他举起手，带着淡淡的微笑平静地挥了挥手。随着人物移动，镜头在保持他进入画面时略显吃力。
13–15岁：
镜头倾斜移动，试图跟随他抵达车队。兰博基尼Aventador的部分视图，梅赛德斯G63和Innova紧随其后。一名保镖打开了剪刀门。名人迅速进入。发动机转速。车辆开始移动。镜头微微上扬，人们跳起来观看。画面渐渐变黑。

zh.p:
日落时分的巨大沙漠巨型城市。
橙色的尘暴穿过无尽的公路。
人们照常过日常生活。
远方地平线上：一堵巨大的黑墙，无尽地延伸。起初看起来像是天气。
然后人们意识到：墙在移动。慢慢来。直接朝城市方向。
一名男子在拥挤的街道上开车，注意到恐慌逐渐蔓延。
紧急广播开始。军用车辆在路口飞驰。
墙壁每分钟都在变大：比摩天大楼还高，光滑无瑕，完全寂静，吞噬着背后的阳光。
随着它逼近：阴影异常拉伸，温度骤降，电子设备故障，鸟儿在头顶飞翔。
那名男子弃车，穿过混乱的疏散人群。
天际线后：巨大的移动墙壁现在主宰着地平线。沙尘暴盘旋上升。
高潮处：巨大的黑墙延伸至城市的外围区域。整个天际线在它身后消失在黑暗中。
那人转身，墙壁直立在市中心上方。
然后突然：墙停止了移动。寂静。
几秒钟后，建筑物慢慢化为雾气并消失。
超电影感的科幻悬疑惊悚片，巨型视觉效果，环境紧张感，逼真的恐慌，沙漠赛博朋克氛围，电影般的灯光，接地气的现实主义。

raw_p:
Ultra-cinematic surreal art sequence inside an endless black void filled with reflective liquid mercury. A lone contemporary dancer stands barefoot on the mirror-like metallic surface beneath soft silver light.

As the dancer begins moving slowly, the mercury reacts unnaturally to every gesture. Ripples travel outward like liquid mirrors while reflections distort independently from reality. The dancer’s body moves with elegant fluid choreography, long flowing fabric trailing through metallic waves.

The camera circles continuously around the performance in one uninterrupted cinematic movement. Every step creates suspended droplets of reflective mercury floating weightlessly in the air. Hands and feet leave temporary silver trails that dissolve slowly into liquid smoke.

The dancer spins gracefully while the mercury rises around the body like living sculpture. Metallic waves twist upward into giant reflective ribbons and mirrored humanoid shapes that mimic the choreography with slight delay.

Mid-sequence, gravity appears to collapse. The dancer floats briefly above the mercury surface while thousands of liquid silver droplets orbit around the body like a frozen galaxy. Reflections fracture infinitely beneath the surface.

Soft white light pulses through the liquid environment while the dancer performs increasingly surreal movements impossible under normal physics. The mercury stretches, bends, and folds reality around the choreography.

Final cinematic reveal: the dancer freezes in a final pose while the entire mercury ocean rises upward into a gigantic reflective vortex surrounding the silhouette in complete darkness.

Style: ultra cinematic surrealism, liquid mercury physics simulation, reflective metallic surfaces, elegant contemporary dance movement, floating particles, dreamlike atmosphere, impossible fluid behavior, high-fashion art film aesthetic, smooth cinematic camera motion, monochrome silver palette, AAA visual effects quality, no text, no overlays.

zh.p:
超电影般的超现实艺术序列，置身于无尽黑暗虚空中，充满反光液态汞。一位当代舞者赤脚站在镜面般的金属表面上，沐浴在柔和的银光下。

当舞者开始缓慢移动时，汞对每个动作都异常反应。涟漪像液态镜子一样向外扩散，而反射则独立于现实扭曲。舞者的身体动作优雅流畅，长长的布料在金属波浪中拖曳。

镜头以一个不间断的电影式运动不断环绕表演。每一步都会形成悬浮的反光水银水滴，无重地漂浮在空中。手和脚会留下暂时的银色轨迹，慢慢溶解成液态烟雾。

舞者优雅地旋转，水银如活雕塑般环绕身体上升。金属波浪向上扭转成巨大的反光丝带和镜面类人形，模仿编舞，略有延迟。

在中段，重力似乎坍缩了。舞者短暂漂浮在水银表面之上，成千上万的液态银滴如冰封的银河般环绕着身体旋转。反射在表面下无限破裂。

柔和的白光在液态环境中脉动，舞者做出越来越超现实的动作，这些动作在正常物理学下是不可能的。水银在编舞周围拉伸、弯曲并折叠现实。

最终电影揭示：舞者定格在最后的姿势中，整个水银海洋升起，形成一个巨大的反光漩涡，将剪影包围在完全黑暗中。

风格：超电影超现实主义、液态汞物理模拟、反光金属表面、优雅的当代舞蹈动作、漂浮粒子、梦幻氛围、不可能流畅的行为、高端艺术电影美学、流畅的电影摄影机运动、单色银色调色板、AAA级视觉特效质量、无文字、无叠加。

zh.p: 制作写实电影风格的视频 角色：IMG_12是主角。在每一次比例变化中，保持准确的身份、比例、服装、材料、轮廓、面部/眼睛设计以及可识别的特征。不要重新设计、赋予人性或改变角色。风格：照片级真实的电影现实主义，结合超现实的博物馆魔法和未来科幻氛围。手持相机，轻微的自然抖动，浅景深，柔和的运动模糊，逼真的曝光变化，细腻的胶片颗粒感，逼真的身体物理效果。无屏幕文字、字幕、说明、标志或对话 场景：内景 安静博物馆展厅 – 白天。一个大型玻璃展示柜里陈列着一个未来主义城市立体模型：微型霓虹灯塔、微型悬浮车、磁铁轨道、全息桥、机器人雕像、发光的街道网格、天线结构、能量护盾，以及涂绘的赛博朋克天际线背景。冷蓝色和紫色的博物馆灯光与温暖的聚光灯交织在一起。博物馆感觉真实，但立体模型变成了一个活生生的科幻世界，单镜头，没有硬剪接。镜头动态跟随0–2秒：IMG_12站在玻璃柜旁，研究未来城市立体模型。霓虹灯的倒影在玻璃上滑动。模型内部，一辆微型悬浮车突然亮起并自行移动。IMG_12靠近了2–4秒：玻璃像液态铬一样泛起涟漪。IMG_12伸手去触碰，突然被拉向前，强行穿过却没有断开。比例快照：IMG_12变成微缩模型，现在站在立体模型内，周围是巨大的发光道路线、微型塔楼、天线和机器人雕像。4到6：进入立体模型世界。这座微型城市焕发生机。霓虹网格在脚下脉动，悬浮车在塔楼间漂移，全息桥梁闪烁，机器人雕像如无声守护者般静止不动。IMG_12跑过一条发光的磁性道路，镜头低空跟随角色6–8：一辆小型悬浮摩托启动并飞过。IMG_12一气呵成地跳上去。比例捕捉：角色会与悬浮摩托成比例。摩托车在城市中加速穿梭，穿梭于摩天大楼、机器人雕像、发光的车道和漂浮的车流之间。镜头以运动模糊和电光条状轨道运行8–10秒：悬浮摩托飞越闪烁的全息桥。桥在他们脚下出现故障，瞬间变得透明。IMG_12紧紧抓住，看着城市像博物馆模型变成真正的未来都市一样不自然地倾斜。绘制的天际线短暂地变得深邃，云层移动10至12秒：悬浮摩托飞速冲向展示柜的弧形玻璃墙。IMG_12从摩托上跳向玻璃，穿过波纹的镀铬表面。比例快照：IMG_12恢复正常大小，冲回博物馆展厅 12至14秒：IMG_12重重地落在光滑的博物馆地板上。

Create a hyper-realistic cinematic 15-second commercial for a modern energy-protein snack brand called “Billy’s Power Protein Bar.” The video should feel like a high-end fitness + lifestyle advertisement with fast emotional transformation storytelling.

🎞️ STYLE

Ultra-realistic, cinematic lighting, smooth handheld iPhone + DSLR hybrid look, shallow depth of field, soft glow energy effects during transformation moments, dynamic speed ramps.
CUT SCENES (TOTAL 15 SECONDS)
⏱️ 0–3s | “Low Energy Start”

Close-up of the main character sitting slightly tired at a desk / home setting.
She looks unfocused, slow hand movements.
Camera slowly pushes in.

🎙️ VOICEOVER (calm, slightly low tone):
“Some days… your energy just doesn’t show up.”

⏱️ 3–6s | “The Bite”

Close-up of hands opening Billy’s Power Protein Bar.
She takes a bite. Subtle cinematic glow begins around her face.

🎙️ VOICEOVER (slightly rising tone):
“Then one bite changes everything…”

⏱️ 6–9s | “Energy Shift”
Her eyes sharpen, posture straightens.
Quick flash cuts of energy surge effect.
Lighting becomes brighter and more vibrant.

🎙️ VOICEOVER (confident tone):
“This is not just chocolate… this is power fuel.”

⏱️ 9–12s | “Power Montage”

Fast cut montage:

Working intensely at desk
Running / gym movement
Confident walking in supermarket aisle
All movements are sharp, powerful, focused.

🎙️ VOICEOVER (strong commercial tone):
“Billy’s Power Protein Bar fuels focus, strength, and unstoppable drive.”

⏱️ 12–15s | “Final Hero Shot”
Slow-motion close-up of the bar in hand.
She smiles confidently, city/light background glow.
Logo appears.

🎙️ VOICEOVER (final impactful line):
“Billy’s Power Protein Bar — unlock your energy.”

Background music: high-energy cinematic beat with rising intensity throughout the entire 15 seconds
Keep continuity: same main character, same face, same identity throughout all scenes
Emphasize smooth transformation from tired → powerful
Use subtle glow/energy visual effects during bite moment
Maintain premium commercial aesthetic (Nike-style + luxury food ad feel)

为一个名为“比利的力量蛋白棒”的现代能量蛋白零食品牌制作一支超现实的15秒电影广告。视频应当像高端健身+生活方式广告，带有快速情感转变的故事讲述。

🎞️ 风格

超写实、电影感的光影、顺滑的手持iPhone+单反混合风格、浅景深、变身时柔和的发光能量效果、动态速度提升。
过场动画（全长15秒）
⏱️ 0–3 |“低能量启动”

主角坐在书桌前/家庭场景的特写。
她看起来有些恍惚，手势缓慢。
镜头缓缓推进。

🎙️ 旁白（平静，略显低沉）：
“有些日子......你的精力就是没有表现出来。”

⏱️ 3–6 |《咬伤》

手部特写打开比利的能量蛋白棒。
她咬了一口。她脸周围开始泛起微妙的电影光晕。

🎙️ 画外音（略微升高的音调）：
“那一口就改变一切了......”

⏱️ 6–9 |“能量转移”
她的眼神变得锐利，姿态挺直。
快速切换能量激增效果。
光线变得更加明亮和鲜艳。

🎙️ 旁白（自信语气）：
“这不仅仅是巧克力......这就是能量燃料。”

⏱️ 9–12岁 |“力量蒙太奇”

快速剪辑蒙太奇：

在办公桌前拼命工作
跑步/健身房活动
自信地走在超市货架上
所有动作都锐利、有力、专注。

🎙️ 旁白（强烈商业语气）：
“比利的力量蛋白棒能提升专注力、力量和不可阻挡的动力。”

⏱️ 12–15 |“最终英雄镜头”
手里拿着吧台的慢动作特写。
她自信地微笑，城市/光线背景闪烁着光芒。
标志出现了。

🎙️ 画外音（最后一句有力的台词）：
“比利的力量蛋白棒——释放你的能量。”

🔊 重要导演说明
背景音乐：充满活力的电影节拍，贯穿整整15秒，强度逐渐增强
保持连贯性：同一主角、同一张面孔、同一身份贯穿所有场景
强调从疲惫→强大转变的顺畅
在咬合时刻使用微妙的光晕/能量视觉效果
保持高端商业美学（耐克风格+奢侈食品广告的感觉）

入力画像のキャラクターを完全基準として、顔立ち・目の形・髪型・髪色・体型・衣装ディテールを全シーンで厳密に統一。同一人物固定。  
日本のフルカラー劇場版アニメ。  
アニメらしい大きめの瞳、綺麗な線画、柔らかなアニメ塗り。  
リアル寄りではなく、自然で高品質なアニメ作画。  
繊細なグラデーションと透明感のある色彩。  
滑らかなアニメーション。  
自然な髪の揺れ、布の動き、感情表現。  
結婚式当日の朝。静かな結婚式場のブライズルーム。  
白いカーテン、大型鏡、化粧台、ドレスラック、アクセサリー、小物、ブーケが綺麗に配置されている。  
柔らかな朝日と暖色照明が混ざる落ち着いた空間。  
劇場版アニメのような静かな空気感と没入感。  
キャラクター作画は全シーンで安定。  
シーンごとに顔や頭身を変化させない。  

―― Scene 1 : 控室で待つ ――  
キャラクターは薄手のルームウェア姿で鏡前に座っている。  
少し緊張した穏やかな表情。  
髪は自然に下ろしている。  
朝日が頬と髪を柔らかく照らす。  
机にはメイク道具とアクセサリー。  
肩を軽く動かし、小さく深呼吸する。  
カメラは肩越しからゆっくり引き、室内全体を映す。  

―― Scene 2 : ドレスを準備する ――  
スタッフが純白のウェディングドレスを丁寧に広げる。  
レース、リボン、刺繍、フリルを綺麗に描写。  
ドレス裾が柔らかく床へ広がる。  
キャラクターは鏡越しに静かに見つめる。  
柔らかな逆光でドレス輪郭を際立たせる。  

―― Scene 3 : ブライダルインナー着付け ――  
スタッフがブライダルインナーを整える。  
肩紐や背中部分を順番に固定。  
キャラクターは静かに姿勢を整える。  
着付け途中の変化を自然に描写。  
上品で落ち着いた演出。  

―― Scene 4 : ドレスへ足を通す ――  
スタッフがドレス裾を持ち上げる。  
キャラクターが慎重に足を通す。  
ドレス生地が柔らかく揺れる。  
腰や肩位置を丁寧に整える。  
ドレスが身体へ自然に馴染んでいく。  

―― Scene 5 : 背面固定 ――  
背中のファスナーをゆっくり閉める。  
リボンやコルセット紐を整える。  
背面レースを丁寧に調整。  
キャラクターの表情が少しずつ引き締まる。  

―― Scene 6 : ヘアセットとベール ――  
髪を後ろでまとめる。  
前髪や後れ毛を細かく整える。  
ヘアアクセサリーを固定。  
純白のベールを装着。  
半透明のベールが肩へ柔らかく落ちる。  
鏡越しに完成へ近づく姿を映す。  

―― Scene 7 : アクセサリー装着 ――  
イヤリング、ネックレス、グローブを順番に装着。  
スタッフがドレス裾を整える。  
キャラクターがブーケを受け取る。  
鏡前で静かに全身を確認。  
緊張と幸福感が混ざった自然な微笑み。  

―― Scene 8 : 出発前 ――  
控室の扉前に立つ。  
スタッフが最後にベールと裾を整える。  
キャラクターがゆっくり前を見る。  
呼吸を整え、小さく頷く。  
静かな空気の中、扉がゆっくり開く。  
劇場版アニメのラストシーンのような余韻で締める。

Using the character in the input image as the complete standard, facial features, eye shape, hairstyle, hair color, body shape, and costume details are strictly unified across all scenes. The same person is fixed.  
A full-color theatrical anime from Japan.  
Anime-like large eyes, beautiful line art, and soft anime coloring.  
Rather than focusing on realism, the animation is natural and high-quality.  
Delicate gradients and transparent colors.  
Smooth animation.  
Natural hair swaying, fabric movement, emotional expression.  
The morning of the wedding day. A quiet bridal room in a wedding venue.  
White curtains, a large mirror, a dressing table, dress racks, accessories, small items, and bouquets are neatly arranged.  
A calm space where soft morning sunlight and warm lighting blend together.  
A quiet atmosphere and immersive atmosphere like a theatrical anime.  
Character animation is consistent across all scenes.  
Do not change your face or body shape for each scene.  

―― Scene 1: Waiting in the Waiting Room ――  
The character is sitting in front of a mirror wearing thin loungewear.  
A slightly nervous, calm expression.  
Her hair is naturally down.  
The morning sun gently illuminates her cheeks and hair.  
On the desk are makeup tools and accessories.  
Gently move your shoulders and take a small, deep breath.  
The camera slowly pulls over your shoulder, showing the entire room.  

―― Scene 2: Preparing the Dress ――  
Staff carefully unfold the pure white wedding dress.  
Lace, ribbons, embroidery, and frills are beautifully rendered.  
The hem of the dress is soft and spreads across the floor.  
The character quietly gazes through the mirror.  
Soft backlighting accentuates the dress's silhouette.  

―― Scene 3: Bridal Innerwear Dressing ――  
Staff help arrange bridal innerwear.  
Secure the shoulder straps and back parts in order.  
The character quietly adjusts her posture.  
Naturally depicts changes during kimono dressing.  
An elegant and calm presentation.  

―― Scene 4: Stepping into the Dress ――  
Staff lift the hem of the dress.  
The character carefully steps through.  
The dress fabric sways softly.  
Carefully align your waist and shoulders.  
The dress naturally blends into your body.  

―― Scene 5: Back Fixing ――  
Slowly zip the zipper on your back.  
Arrange the ribbons and corset strings.  
The back lace is carefully adjusted.  
The characters' expressions gradually tighten.  

―― Scene 6 : ヘアセットとベール ――  
Gathering the hair at the back.  
Finely trim bangs and stray hair.  
Secure hair accessories.  
Wearing a pure white veil.  
A translucent veil gently falls onto my shoulders.  
Images of the figure approaching completion through the mirror.  

―― Scene 7: Accessory Attachment ――  
Earrings, necklace, and gloves are put on in order.  
The staff adjusted the hem of the dress.  
The character receives the bouquet.  
Quietly check your whole body in front of the mirror.  
A natural smile mixed with tension and happiness.  

―― Scene 8: Before Departure――  
I stand in front of the waiting room door.  
The staff finally adjust the veil and hem.  
The character slowly looks ahead.  
I steadied my breathing and nodded slightly.  
In the quiet air, the door slowly opened.  
It ends with a lingering feeling reminiscent of the final scene of a theatrical anime.

Epic fantasy adventure, cinematic storytelling, dramatic visual effects, photorealistic, ultra detailed, 4K.

raw_p: A highly detailed realistic character design sheet for "ZEPHYR" an ancient storm sorcerer. Front, side, back view. Age appears 60 but immortal. Long white flowing robes with silver storm cloud embroidery, tattered at edges from centuries of magic. Long silver beard braided with lightning rune charms. Staff: twisted driftwood topped with crackling storm crystal. Skin: faint blue veins glowing under pale skin. Eyes: solid white with storm clouds visible inside. Color palette: storm grey, electric white, deep navy, silver, pale ice blue. Character stats panel. White background. Realistic 3D render style. [0-3s] Zephyr stands on edge of floating sky island above storm clouds, robes billowing violently in wind. Lightning strikes around him constantly. Camera wide low angle sky filled with apocalyptic storm. [3-7s] He raises staff slowly. Storm responds — clouds spiral inward toward him like a vortex. His white eyes begin glowing intensely. Camera push-in on face as wind reaches hurricane force around him. [7-11s] He slams staff down — CRACK. Massive lightning bolt strikes down from sky through his body and into the earth below. Slow motion captures the bolt frozen mid-strike. Thunder shockwave ripples visibly through clouds. [11-15s] Storm clears instantly. He stands in perfect calm, staff planted, surrounded by drifting storm clouds below his feet like a god above weather. Camera pulls back into massive aerial reveal. Absolute silence after chaos.

zh.p: 一张高度详细且逼真的角色设计表，专为“ZEPHYR”设计，一位古老的风暴巫师。正面、侧面、背面。年龄看似60岁，但不朽。长长的白色长袍，绣有银色风暴云图案，边缘因数百年的魔法而破损。长长的银色胡须，编着闪电符文的护符。法杖：扭曲的漂流木，顶部覆盖着噼啪作响的风暴水晶。皮肤：淡蓝色的血管在苍白的皮肤下发光。眼睛：纯白，内部可见暴风云。配色方案：风暴灰、电光白、深藏青、银色、浅冰蓝色。角色属性面板。白色背景。逼真的3D渲染风格。[0-3秒] 西风站在风暴云上方漂浮的天空岛边缘，长袍在风中剧烈飘扬。闪电不断在他周围劈下。镜头宽广的低角度天空，充满末日风暴。[3-7s] 他慢慢地召集法杖。暴风雨回应——云层像漩涡般向他螺旋蔓延。他的白眼开始强烈地发光。镜头对准脸部，风力在他周围达到飓风级别。[7-11s] 他猛地摔下法杖——啪。一道巨大的闪电从天空穿过他的身体，直击地面。慢动作捕捉到箭矢在击中时被冻结。雷电冲击波在云层中清晰地波动。[11-15秒] 风暴立刻散去。他站得一丝不苟，法杖插在手中，脚下被飘荡的暴风云包围，宛如天神般凌驾于天。镜头拉远，展开大规模的空中特写。混乱之后的绝对寂静。

Wide aerial shot of an endless frozen kingdom buried under a violent magical snowstorm, gigantic ice castles and shattered frozen bridges disappearing into fog, blue glowing runes beneath the ice, snow whipping across the screen, cinematic drone movement

The princess raises the crystal lantern and releases a blinding wave of ancient magic across the frozen kingdom, snow freezes midair, giant creatures pause, glowing runes ignite across the glaciers

Cut to black.

zh.p:
🎬 概念：
《冰雪奇缘王国生存》

持续时间：15秒
风格：超电影级黑暗奇幻，Netflix原创剧氛围，照片级写实，4K，戏剧性体积光影，逼真的雪地物理，慢动作时刻，管弦乐紧张感，宏大场景

🎥 场景解析
0–3秒

广阔航拍镜头，描绘一个被狂暴魔法暴风雪掩埋的无尽冰封王国，巨大的冰城堡和破碎的冰桥消失在雾中，冰下蓝色发光的符文，雪花在屏幕上飞舞，电影般的无人机移动

摄像机：缓慢下降的空中推入
心情：神秘、古老、危险

3–6秒

一位身披厚重毛皮银色斗篷的公主，手持一盏发光的水晶灯笼，穿行于暴风雪中，冰粒漂浮在她脸颊周围，风猛烈地拉扯着她的披风，脚印在深雪中形成

王国感觉被遗弃了。

摄影：侧向跟踪镜头，浅景深，电影特写

6–9秒

冰川下的地面开始裂开，伴随着深沉的雷鸣声，巨大的蓝色发光眼睛在透明冰层下缓缓睁开，冰川表面下巨大的冰冻生物苏醒

暴风雪加剧。

摄像机：低角度，微微晃动以冲击
声音氛围：深沉的低音隆隆作响，远处怪兽回声

9–12秒

巨大的冰巨人部分穿透她身后的冰川，冰冻碎片慢动作爆炸，公主惊恐地转身，魔法蓝光映入她的眼中

摄影：围绕公主旋转的戏剧性轨道
视觉效果：电影级碎片，高细节冰层破坏

12–15秒

公主举起水晶灯笼，释放出耀眼的古老魔法浪潮，冰雪在半空中结冰，巨兽停顿，发光符文在冰川上点燃

画面切换到黑暗。

文字出现：
“冬之最后的继承人”

*   **Cut 1 (0–2s):** Low-angle wide shot. Gunner moves laterally with high-speed lightning steps, firing three black-and-white energy bolts. Handheld camera follows with exaggerated perspective and ground-level parallax.
*   **Cut 2 (2–4s):** Blader enters with a low-to-the-ground slide, easily deflecting the bolts with the energy blade. Sparks and air pressure rings diffuse outward. Fast whip-pan follows the projectile trajectory without jump-cutting.
*   **Cut 3 (4–6s):** High-to-low tilting shot. Gunner spirals through the air while firing precision shots with electric arc trails. Blader wall-runs up a pillar and leaps over a broken railing, creating strong depth between foreground and background.
*   **Cut 4 (6–8s):** Brief bullet-time (slow motion) as an energy bolt grazes a mask; immediately returns to full speed. Blader uses the blade tip to parry a bolt, creating a clear reflection trajectory.
*   **Cut 5 (8–10.5s):** Blader performs a zigzag teleport dash with trailing afterimages, falling from above for a heavy downward slash. Gunner retreats while adjusting their stance.
*   **Cut 6 (10.5–13s):** Gunner deploys a translucent arc energy shield with their free hand to block the heavy slash. The two clash in mid-air over the escalator void with high-speed exchanges of bolts and blades. A final heavy impact creates a ring-shaped shockwave of dust and debris as both land and separate.

**Effects and Motion:**
Energy bolts feature black cores, white lightning textures, crackling arcs, and air pressure cones. The blade features orange glowing edge + mechanical structure.

电影感十足的手绘2.5D混合动画（3D基础模型+2D笔触上色），24帧每秒，13秒。能量枪使用者指的是image1。刀片用户指的是image2，使用的是image3中的刀片设计。该设定指的是image4。

**摄影：**
多镜头剪辑，包含6个剪辑。18–35mm超广角镜头，具有强烈透视和明显的视差。动态手持追踪，带有自然的微抖动和轻微的脚步移动（没有平滑的万向节运动）;偶尔出现荷兰天使;快速但清晰的动作轨迹和构图。角色稳定性高，没有闪烁、遗物或额外肢体。没有文字、标志或水印。

**环境：**
在一个赛博朋克废弃的购物中心里。画面有破碎的玻璃穹顶、倒塌的建筑、蓝色尘雾和霓虹品红/粉色的光线泄漏。包括受损的自动扶梯、大型开放式中庭、悬挂的电缆、散落的碎片、闪烁的标志、体积光束和漂浮的尘埃。

**角色设定：**
* **炮手：** 全脸面罩，黑色服装，白色闪电装饰。发射带有“黑核+白色闪电”纹理的能量弹。
* **陀螺手：** 使用橙色能量刀刃（橙色发光刃+机械结构）。敏捷的移动，擅长墙壁奔跑、空中闪避和闪电般的瞬移/残影冲刺。

**动作场面（13秒，6次切换）:**
* **切入1（0–2秒）:** 低角度广角镜头。炮手以高速闪电步伐横向移动，发射三道黑白能量弹。手持摄像机以夸张的透视和地面视差呈现。
* **斩击2（2–4秒）:** 陀螺手以贴地滑行进入，轻松用能量刀偏转箭矢。火花和气压环向外扩散。快速鞭击动作沿弹道移动，无需跳剪。
* **切3（4–6秒）:** 高低倾斜射门。炮手在空中盘旋飞行，同时用电弧轨迹精准射击。陀螺手攀爬柱子，跳过破损的栏杆，营造出前景与背景之间的强烈深度。
* **Cut 4（6–8秒）:** 能量弹擦过面罩时的短暂子弹时间（慢动作）;立刻恢复全速。陀螺手用刀尖格挡箭矢，形成清晰的反射轨迹。
* **斩击5（8–10.5秒）:** 陀螺手施展锯齿形瞬移冲刺，后面留下残影，从上方坠落，施展重重的向下斩击。炮手撤退，调整姿势。
* **斩击6秒（10.5–13秒）:** 枪手用空闲的手布置半透明弧能量护盾，挡住重击。两人在自动扶梯虚空中高速交锋，雷电和刀刃交锋。最后一次强烈的撞击产生环状的尘埃和碎片冲击波，既落地又分离。

**特效与动作：**
能量箭具有黑色核心、白色闪电纹理、噼啪作响的电弧和气压锥。刀刃具有橙色发光边缘+机械结构。

raw_p:
Futuristic coastal city at night beside the ocean.
Crowds gathered outside watching the sky nervously.
High above Earth: a gigantic orbital ring structure burning in the atmosphere.
The structure is enormous: thousands of kilometers wide, glowing with fire and debris trails.
A young engineer runs through evacuation crowds while overhead: massive fragments begin descending slowly through clouds.
Visible danger everywhere: burning debris crossing the sky, shockwaves rattling windows, emergency sirens,  collapsing communication towers, panicked traffic jams.
One gigantic section of the orbital ring becomes visible descending directly toward downtown. Its glowing structure fills the clouds overhead.
The engineer races through streets illuminated by burning debris trails.
As tension escalates: ocean tides pull backward unnaturally, sonic booms shake skyscrapers, clouds ignite orange, power grids fail.
At climax: the colossal orbital fragment emerges fully through clouds above the city. Its burning metallic surface covers the sky.
Then suddenly: its descent stabilizes. Thrusters ignite across the structure.
The orbital ring slows and stops high above the ocean.
Silence.
The burning sky slowly dims.
Ultra cinematic hard sci-fi disaster atmosphere, gigantic scale visuals, realistic environmental panic, cinematic clouds, grounded sci-fi realism, intense sky visuals.

zh.p:
未来感十足的海滨城市，夜晚靠海。
外面聚集着紧张的人群，注视着天空。
在地球上空：一个巨大的轨道环结构正在大气中燃烧。
这座建筑巨大无比：宽达数千公里，燃烧着火焰和碎片的痕迹。
一名年轻工程师在头顶上空穿过疏散人群：巨大的碎片开始缓慢穿透云层坠落。
到处都是可见的危险：燃烧的碎片横扫天空，震波震动着窗户，紧急警报声，倒塌的通信塔，惊慌失措的交通堵塞。
轨道环的一个巨大区域开始显现，正直接下降向市中心。它发光的结构充满了头顶的云层。
工程师在燃烧的残骸小径照亮的街道上飞驰。
随着紧张局势升级：海潮异常地向后拉，音爆震动摩天大楼，云层燃起橙色，电网瘫痪。
高潮处：巨大的轨道碎片完全穿透城市上空的云层。它燃烧的金属表面覆盖了天空。
然后突然：它的下降稳定了下来。推进器在结构上点燃。
轨道环减速并停在高空。
寂静。
燃烧的天空慢慢暗淡下来。
超电影感硬科幻灾难氛围，宏大画面，逼真的环境恐慌，电影化的云朵，接地气的科幻现实主义，强烈的天空视觉效果。

raw_p:
Ultra-cinematic fantasy desert sequence during a colossal sandstorm at dusk, endless dunes illuminated by deep orange storm light and violent lightning inside the clouds.

A lone desert nomad stands atop a massive dune wearing flowing layered robes, face partially hidden beneath weathered cloth and bronze ornaments. Wind tears through the fabric while glowing ancient symbols pulse faintly across his staff and hands.

The camera circles slowly around the nomad as enormous sand dragons begin emerging from beneath the dunes. Their bodies are made of shifting sand, stone armor, glowing amber eyes, and swirling dust vortexes. Entire dunes collapse as the creatures rise into the storm sky.

The nomad raises his arm calmly and the dragons respond instantly, spiraling through the desert like living tornadoes. Their gigantic bodies carve through the sandstorm while lightning flashes illuminate their scales and jaws.

The camera follows dynamically through the storm as the dragons fly around the nomad in massive circular patterns, creating giant pressure waves that ripple across the dunes. Sand particles explode through the air while visibility shifts constantly between darkness and glowing storm light.

One colossal dragon dives directly beneath the desert surface before erupting upward behind the nomad in a gigantic explosion of sand and debris. The storm intensifies violently around them.

Final cinematic reveal: the nomad stands motionless at the center of the storm while multiple giant sand dragons circle the sky above like ancient gods controlling the desert itself.

Style: ultra cinematic fantasy realism, colossal creature scale, realistic sand simulation, volumetric storm atmosphere, desert lightning, flowing cloth physics, mythical ancient power aesthetic, cinematic aerial camera movement, high-end VFX particles, AAA fantasy film quality, no text, no overlays.

zh.p:
极具电影感的奇幻沙漠场景，在黄昏时分巨大的沙尘暴中，无尽的沙丘被深橙色的风暴光芒照亮，云层中闪电猛烈交织。

一名孤独的沙漠游牧者站在巨大的沙丘顶端，身穿飘逸的层叠长袍，脸部分被风化的布料和青铜饰品遮住。风撕裂布料，古老的发光符号在他的法杖和手上微微跳动。

镜头缓缓环绕游牧者，巨大的沙龙开始从沙丘下出现。他们的身体由流动的沙子、石甲、发光的琥珀色眼睛和旋转的尘埃漩涡组成。整个沙丘坍塌，生物升入风暴天空。

游牧者平静地举起手臂，龙群立刻做出反应，像活生生的龙卷风般在沙漠中盘旋。它们庞大的身躯划破沙尘暴，闪电照亮了它们的鳞片和下颚。

镜头动态地跟随风暴，龙们以巨大的圆形图案绕着游牧者飞行，制造出巨大的压力波，在沙丘上荡漾。沙粒在空气中爆炸，能见度不断在黑暗与发光的风暴光芒之间切换。

一条巨龙直接潜入沙漠表面之下，随后在游牧者身后爆发出巨大的沙尘和碎片爆炸。风暴在他们周围猛烈加剧。

最终的电影揭示：游牧者静静地站在风暴中心，而多条巨大的沙龙在天空中盘旋，宛如古老的神明，掌控着整个沙漠。

风格：极具电影感的奇幻现实主义，巨型生物的比例，逼真的沙尘模拟，体积风暴氛围，沙漠闪电，流动的布料物理，神话般的古代力量美学，电影感十足的空中摄像机运动，高端视觉特效粒子，AAA级奇幻电影质量，无文字，无叠加。

raw_p:
Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic movie-style video.

CHARACTER:
IMG_39 is the main character. Preserve the exact character identity, proportions, wardrobe, materials, silhouette, face/eye design, and recognizable features throughout every scale change. Do not redesign, humanize, or change the character.

STYLE:
Photoreal cinematic realism with surreal museum magic. Handheld camera, slight natural shake, shallow depth of field, soft motion blur, realistic exposure shifts, subtle film grain, believable body physics. No on-screen text, subtitles, captions, logos, or dialogue.

SETTING:
INT. QUIET MUSEUM GALLERY – DAY. A large glass display case holds a detailed underwater ruins diorama: miniature coral reefs, broken ancient columns, a tiny shipwreck, seaweed, pearl-like stones, diver statues, small fish sculptures, sand, shells, and a painted deep-ocean backdrop. Cool blue museum lighting mixes with warm spotlights. Dust floats in the gallery air. The museum feels real, but the diorama becomes a living underwater world.

SINGLE CONTINUOUS SHOT, no hard cuts. Camera follows dynamically.

0–2s:
IMG_39 stands beside the glass display case, looking into the miniature underwater ruins diorama. Soft blue light reflects on the glass. Inside the diorama, a tiny seaweed strand suddenly sways as if moved by water. IMG_39 leans closer.

2–4s:
The glass surface ripples like liquid. IMG_39 reaches toward it and is suddenly pulled forward. The body presses through the glass without breaking it. Scale snap: IMG_39 becomes miniature, now standing inside the underwater ruins diorama among giant coral branches, sand grains, shells, and broken stone columns.

4–6s:
INSIDE THE DIORAMA WORLD. The underwater scene comes alive. Sand drifts slowly like fog, coral glows faintly, seaweed waves, and tiny fish sculptures begin moving like real fish. IMG_39 runs across the sandy terrain as if gravity is lighter, footsteps kicking up soft clouds of sand. Camera tracks low beside the character.

6–8s:
A small seahorse statue cracks to life and swims past. IMG_39 jumps onto its back in one fast motion. Scale snap: the character becomes proportional to the seahorse. The seahorse darts through coral arches, around broken columns, and past frozen diver statues. Camera orbits with motion blur, bubbles, and shimmering museum spotlight flashes.

8–10s:
The seahorse dives through the broken shipwreck. Wooden beams and ropes pass close like huge obstacles. A burst of glowing bubbles lifts IMG_39 upward. The painted ocean backdrop briefly becomes endless deep water, with faint light rays moving above.

10–12s:
The seahorse races toward the curved glass wall of the display case. IMG_39 jumps from its back toward the glass. The character passes through the rippling surface mid-air. Scale snap: IMG_39 returns to normal size, bursting back into the museum gallery.

ファーストフレームに添付の画像を使わない

セリフは全て日本語、環境音あり。

# スタイル
日本のフルカラーアニメ、映画のような重厚なカラーグレーディング

# 制約
すべてのカットで画角やアングルを変えて単調にしない。

# 情景
場所：深い針葉樹の森の中。日中。木漏れ日が地面に斑に差し込む。
太い切り株の上に腰を下ろしている。
足元に小型ガスバーナーと金属製マグカップ。
カップ麺は赤いカップに白い文字で「NIPPON」のロゴ。

# シーン
ひとり森の中でNIPPONのカップ麺を作って食べるまでの一連の所作。
細かい手元の動きをテンポよく見せる。

cut1:
マクロショット、真横から。
地面にNIPPONカップだけが置かれている。
木漏れ日が斑にカップを照らす。
環境音：風、鳥の声。

cut2:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
親指の爪がカップの蓋の端に引っかかり、ペリペリと剥がし始める。
環境音：蓋を剥がす音。

cut3:
マクロショット。
手が小型ガスバーナーを地面に展開する。
環境音：金属の展開音。

cut4:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
親指がライターを擦る。一度空振り。
環境音：シャッという空振り音。

cut5:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
二度目で青い炎が点く。
【スピードランプ：スロー→着火で加速】
環境音：着火音、炎のボッという音。

cut6:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
青い炎がゆっくりゆらめく。
環境音：炎の音。

cut7:
マクロショット。
金属マグカップをバーナーの上に乗せる。
環境音：金属が置かれる音。

cut8:
エクストリームクローズアップ、真上から俯瞰。
水面に最初の気泡が現れ、ゆっくりと沸騰が始まる。
環境音：水が沸騰していく音。

cut9:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
指先がマグカップの縁に一瞬触れ、熱さで素早く引っ込む。
環境音：指が触れる微かな音。

cut10:
ワイドショット。
木漏れ日が地面をゆっくり動いている。誰もいない静かな森。
環境音：風が木の葉を揺らす音、鳥の声。長い間。

cut11:
マクロショット、斜め横から。
両手がマグカップからNIPPONカップへ湯をゆっくり注ぐ。
白い湯気が木漏れ日をキラキラと照らしながら立ち上る。
環境音：注ぐ音、湯気が立つ音。

cut12:
マクロショット。
手が蓋を折り曲げて閉じ、マグカップを蓋の上に重りとして置く。
環境音：蓋を折る音。

cut13:
マクロショット。
湯気がNIPPONカップの隙間から立ち上り、風でふわっと消える。
環境音：風。静寂。

cut14:
マクロショット。
両手が割り箸を袋から取り出し、パキッと割る。
環境音：パキッという音。

cut15:
マクロショット、真上から俯瞰。
手がNIPPONカップの蓋を開け、箸でかき混ぜる。
湯気が一気に広がる。
環境音：箸がカップに当たる音、湯気の音。

cut16:
マクロショット、斜め横から。
横顔。箸でラーメンを一口すする。
環境音：すする音。

cut17:
バストショット、斜め横から。
ふうっと息を吐いて遠くの木立をぼんやり見る。
目が細くなる。カメラがゆっくり横顔に寄っていく。
環境音：息を吐く音、風。シーン終わりへ向けて環境音がゆっくりフェードアウト。

en.t: Making Cup Ramen In The Forest
en.p:
A video of the person in the attached image making cup ramen
Do not use the images attached to the first frame

All dialogue is in Japanese, with ambient sounds.

# スタイル
Full-color Japanese anime and film-like rich color grading

# Constraints
Change the angle and angle in every cut to avoid monotony.

# Scene
Location: deep in a coniferous forest. At midday. Sunlight filtering through the trees casts mottled patterns on the ground.
It sits atop a thick tree stump.
At your feet, you have a small gas burner and a metal mug.
The cup noodles are red cups with white letters and the "NIPPON" logo.

# シーン
The whole process of making and eating NIPPON's cup noodles alone in the forest.
Makes the subtle movements of the hands appear at a good pace.

cut1:
Macro shot, from the side.
Only the NIPPON cup is placed on the ground.
Sunlight filtering through the trees illuminates the cup in a mottled pattern.
Environmental sounds: wind, bird sounds.

cut2:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
My thumbnail gets caught on the edge of the cup lid and starts peeling it off with a crunchy sound.
Environmental sound: The sound of the lid being removed.

cut3:
マクロショット。
The hand deploys a small gas burner on the ground.
Environmental sounds: the sound of metal unfolding.

cut4:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
My thumb rubs the lighter. Once a missed swing.
Environmental sound: A swinging sound with a sharp thud.

cut5:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
On the second try, blue flames lit up.
[Speed Lamp: Slow → Ignition for Acceleration]
Environmental sounds: ignition sounds, the crackling of flames.

cut6:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
Blue flames slowly flicker.
Environmental sound: Sounds of flames.

cut7:
マクロショット。
Place the metal mug on top of the burner.
Environmental sound: The sound of metal being placed.

cut8:
Extreme close-up, bird's-eye view from straight above.
The first bubbles appear on the water surface, and the boiling slowly begins.
Environmental sound: The sound of water boiling.

cut9:
エクストリームクローズアップ。
My fingertips briefly touch the rim of the mug, then quickly pull in with the heat.
Environmental sound: a faint sound when fingers touch.

cut10:
ワイドショット。
Sunlight filtering through the trees slowly moves across the ground. A quiet forest with no one around.
Environmental sounds: the wind rustling leaves, birdsong. For a long time.

cut11:
Macro shot, diagonal side.
Both hands slowly pour hot water from the mug into the NIPPON cup.
White steam sparkled as it rose, illuminating the sunlight filtering through the trees.
Environmental sounds: Pouring sounds, steaming noises.

cut12:
マクロショット。
Fold the lid with your hand and close it, placing the mug cup on top as a weight.
Environmental sound: The sound of the lid being folded.

cut13:
マクロショット。
Steam rises from the gaps in the NIPPON cup and gently disappears with the wind.
Ambient sound: Wind. Silence.

cut14:
マクロショット。
Both hands took the chopsticks out of the bag and snapped them open.
Environmental sound: cracking sound.

cut15:
Macro shot, bird's-eye view from above.
Your hand opens the lid of the NIPPON cup and stirs it with chopsticks.
Steam spreads all at once.
Environmental sounds: chopsticks hitting cups, steam noise.

cut16:
Macro shot, diagonal side.
Profile. I took a bite of ramen with my chopsticks.
Environmental sound: The sound of sipping.

cut17:
Bust shot, diagonally sideways.
I let out a deep breath and gazed absentmindedly at the distant grove.
My eyes narrow. The camera slowly moves closer to her profile.
Environmental sounds: exhaling sounds, wind. As the scene nears its end, the ambient sounds slowly fade away.

raw_p:
A person sits alone in a quiet room, thinking intensely. Subtle flickers of light begin forming around their head.

At the 2-second mark, their thoughts materialize — glowing objects emerging into the air: memories as floating photographs, ideas as abstract shapes, fears as shadowy distortions.

The room fills with physicalized thoughts drifting in layers.

The camera moves through these objects — each reacting differently to light and gravity.

Velocity ramp: a memory shatters into fragments mid-air.

Final moment: everything collapses back into the person’s mind in a single pulse of light.

zh.p:
一个人独自坐在安静的房间里，专注地思考。头周围开始出现细微的光芒闪烁。

在两秒钟时，他们的思绪显现——发光的物体浮现于空中：记忆如漂浮的照片，思想如抽象形状，恐惧如阴影扭曲。

房间里充满了层层漂浮的实体思绪。

摄像机穿梭于这些物体之间——每个物体对光线和重力的反应都不同。

速度坡：一段记忆在空中破碎成碎片。

最后一刻：一切在一道光脉冲中回归那个人的意识。

raw_p:
Create a video based on Image 1

Opening scene: the girl walks to school and suddenly notices an injured orange kitten beside a
cardboard box in a small alley. The camera slowly pushes in as the kitten weakly looks up and softly
meows.

Close-up shots of the girl gently cleaning and bandaging the kitten’s paw with a handkerchief.
The girl carefully hides the kitten inside her backpack, only its fluffy head peeking out as she continues walking toward school.

Inside the classroom, the teacher writes on the whiteboard while the girl nervously glances down at
her moving backpack.

The zipper slowly opens by itself and the kitten pops its head out. Nearby students begin gathering
around in surprise and excitement.
The kitten lets out one adorable “meow,” instantly melting the entire classroom. Everyone smiles, laughs softly, eyes sparkling with joy.

Final cinematic shot: the girl sits beside the sunny classroom window holding the kitten while classmates surround them happily petting it.

根据图片1制作视频

开场场景：女孩走去学校，突然注意到一只受伤的橙色小猫站在
小巷里的纸箱。镜头缓缓靠近，小猫虚弱地抬头，轻声
喵。

特写镜头，女孩用手帕轻轻清理并包扎小猫的爪子。
女孩小心地把小猫藏进背包里，只有它蓬松的头部露出来，继续朝学校走去。

教室里，老师在白板上写字，女孩紧张地低头看着
她的搬家背包。

拉链慢慢自己打开，小猫探出头来。附近的学生们开始聚集

最后的电影镜头：女孩坐在阳光明媚的教室窗边抱着小猫，同学们围着他们开心地抚摸着它。

raw_p:
Ultra-realistic cinematic travel video shot on an iPhone 15 Pro wide-angle lens (4K, 60fps). Scene opens with a slow handheld approach toward a stylish young woman standing on a wooden mountain viewpoint deck. She is overlooking dramatic lush green tropical mountains covered in mist and layers of depth.
She wears an all-red drop shoulder t-shirt and baggy black pants, paired with black sunglasses. Her natural dark hair flows gently in the mountain breeze. She stands in a relaxed, confident pose with both hands resting on the wooden railing, looking calmly to the left side of the horizon.
Camera begins with a soft focus foreground of wooden textures, then smoothly shifts focus to her face and outfit details. Subtle lens breathing and natural motion blur enhance realism. Cinematic sunlight rays break through massive fluffy clouds, creating golden highlights across her silhouette and soft rim lighting on her hair and shoulders.
Mid-sequence shows a slow orbit from slightly behind her right side, revealing the vast tropical valley and layered mountain depth. Leaves and light mist subtly move with wind, adding natural motion.
Final shot pulls back slowly, framing her as a small figure against the grand landscape, emphasizing scale, freedom, and travel serenity. Vibrant natural colors, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, and candid luxury lifestyle aesthetic throughout. Slow cinematic pacing, emotional calm tone, immersive travel atmosphere.

zh.p:
用iPhone 15 Pro广角镜头拍摄的超写实电影旅行视频（4K，60fps）。场景开场是手持缓慢接近一位站在木制山景台上的时尚年轻女子。她俯瞰着被薄雾覆盖、层层叠叠的翠绿热带山脉。
她穿着一件全红色的低肩T恤和宽松的黑色裤子，配戴黑色太阳镜。她那自然的黑发在山风中轻轻飘动。她站在放松自信的姿势上，双手搭在木栏杆上，平静地望向地平线的左侧。
镜头先以柔焦的木质质感前景开始，随后平滑地切换到她的脸部和服装细节。细腻的镜头呼吸和自然的运动模糊增强了真实感。电影般的阳光穿透厚重蓬松的云层，为她的轮廓和头发和肩膀上柔和的边缘灯光点亮。
中段画面显示了从她右侧稍后方缓慢轨道飞行，展现出广阔的热带山谷和层叠的山脉深度。树叶和轻雾随风微微移动，增添了自然的运动感。
最后一幕缓缓拉远，将她塑造成一个小人物，映衬于宏伟的景观，强调规模、自由和旅途的宁静。鲜艳的自然色彩、浅景深、逼真的肤质，以及坦率的奢华生活方式美学。缓慢的电影节奏，情感平静的基调，沉浸式的旅行氛围。

raw_p:
Create a hyper-realistic cinematic short commercial titled:

“JUST ONE MORE.”

FORMAT:
Vertical 9:16 premium commercial.
Length: 15 seconds.
Cute, funny, emotionally warm and instantly replayable.

The commercial should feel:
like a perfect mix of Pixar-level charm,
luxury commercial cinematography,
and relatable childhood chaos.

MAIN CHARACTER:

A tiny adorable 4-year-old child with:

- messy fluffy hair,
- oversized hoodie,
- expressive eyes,
- tiny sneakers,
- slightly dramatic personality,
- emotionally exaggerated reactions.

The child should feel:
genuinely human and naturally cute —
not “TikTok kid actor” energy.

SCENE:

A warm cozy living room during rainy evening weather.

Soft lamp lighting.
Cartoons playing quietly.
Blankets,
snacks,
toys scattered everywhere.

The atmosphere feels:
safe,
nostalgic and deeply comforting.

OPENING — 0:00–0:03

The child sits extremely focused watching cartoons while eating popcorn dramatically.

Completely emotionally invested.

Suddenly:

The TV turns off.

Silence.

The child freezes in disbelief.

0:03–0:06

Slow zoom on the child’s face.

Processing betrayal.

Tiny blinking.
Mouth slightly open.
Holding popcorn midair.

In the background:
a parent stands holding the remote calmly.

电视关了。

寂静。

寂静。

家长把电视重新打开一秒钟。

孩子立刻恢复了纯粹的幸福。

灿烂的笑容。

卡通的倒影在眼中发光。

定格。

极简的排版：

“只是。一。更多。”

结束。

按照下面12格分镜序列，制作一部电影感极强的乐高足球短片。不要添加、删除或更改任何场景——严格按照分镜顺序和描述操作。

风格：极度电影般的乐高真实感，逼真的乐高纹理，戏剧性的夜场灯光，湿润反光草地，浅景深，强烈的电影散景，体积神射线，FIFA转播能量与好莱坞体育电影情感混合。

法国对英格兰的对决，法国队穿蓝色球衣，英格兰队穿白色球衣。

故事板顺序严格遵循：

1. 史诗级的夜空巨景，巨大的乐高世界杯体育场，烟花绽放。
2. 乐高粉丝疯狂欢呼，法国和英格兰的国旗飘扬，金色五彩纸屑纷纷飘落。
3. 戏剧性的低角度球员从烟雾弥漫的隧道走出球场。
4. 法国队长身穿蓝色球衣的特写镜头，配有戏剧性的边缘灯光。
5. 法国队长（蓝球衣）与英国队长（白球衣）紧张面对面对峙。
6. 快速低速追踪镜头，展示身穿白色球衣的英格兰球员在湿润反光草地上运球。
7. 极近距离的乐高脚完美控制球，水珠飞溅。
8. 法国前锋身穿蓝色球衣，带球射门的强力射门。
9. 戏剧性的慢动作球门摄像机角度——球击中球门，守门员迟扑。
10. 爆发性的团队庆祝——身穿蓝色球衣的法国球员跳跃拥抱，金色彩纸纷纷落下。
11. 情感缓慢的电影镜头，描绘这位身穿白色球衣的悲伤英国上尉独自站立，四周飘落着五彩纸屑。
12. 法国队在烟花和观众欢呼声中举起世界杯奖杯的最后一幕，英勇的低角度镜头。

摄影风格：动态好莱坞体育摄影——使用低角度、流畅的跟踪镜头、适当时的戏剧性慢动作、情感特写和宽广的动作。始终保持一致的写实乐高风格。
