Main Subject:
Young Korean woman, early 20s, business-casual blouse with a cardigan, hair neatly tied back, tote bag, tired but composed expression.
Location : Quiet suburban subway platform, early evening. Overhead signs, yellow safety line, empty benches, tiled walls, distant tunnel lights. No crowds, no advertisements visible.
Visual Style : Realistic urban documentary tone, calm end-of-day atmosphere, soft fluorescent lighting.
Camera Style : Late 2000s digital camcorder, static tripod mixed with slight handheld movement, mild autofocus hunting under platform lights, subtle noise. No stabilization.
Timeline (15 sec, each slot = 2 compressed beats):
00:00–00:03 → She stands near the yellow line, then checks the arrival board above.
00:03–00:06 → She sighs softly, then says to the camera "오늘 진짜 피곤하다" ("I'm really tired today").
00:06–00:09 → She shifts her bag on her shoulder, then glances down the tunnel for the train.
00:09–00:12 → A gentle breeze signals the train coming, then she straightens up.
00:12–00:15 → She looks at the camera saying "나 먼저 갈게, 안녕!" ("I'm heading off first, bye!"), then steps forward as the tape cuts.
Audio : Distant train rumble, platform announcement chime (muffled), footsteps echoing. Her dialogue as noted above. No music.
Goal : A quiet end-of-workday commute tired, real, relatable.

【動画内容】(使うキャラ。以降○○)の顔面の超クローズアップ。正面からの画角。

【場所】河川敷の高架下、昼間、日陰。

【衝撃の直撃と、時間差で地面に転がるパンチシーン】
Shot 1 (cut1) — 5.0秒
目的: 正面からのクローズアップで、フックの直撃と顔面の歪みを捉える。
内容: アニメ調。カメラは殴られる○○の顔面を真正面から捉えた超クローズアップ。次の瞬間、画面外の横から鋭い軌道で回り込んできた強烈なフックが、○○の左頬を真横から激しく捉える。
その直撃の瞬間から映像が極限の超スローモーションへと切り替わる。真正面のカメラに向かって、パンチの凄まじい衝撃エネルギーで○○の頬の皮膚や筋肉が水面の波紋のようにゆっくりと痛々しく歪んでいく様が克明に映し出される。
○○の目は驚愕と恐怖で大きく見開かれ、瞳孔がじわじわと開いていく。口元から吹き飛んだ数滴の唾液や汗のしぶきは、空中に留まりながらも、極めてゆっくりとした速度で軌跡を描きながら外側へと流れていく。

キャラクター/プロダクト: 殴られる○○（正面からのクローズアップ）、真横から顔を捉えるフックの拳、ゆっくりと宙を舞う唾液のしぶき

効果音: 殴られた瞬間に「ドグォォォン！」という重低音の衝撃音。直後、時間が引き延ばされるような「キィィィン」という耳鳴りのような高音が響き、周囲の音が完全に遮断される。さらに心臓の鼓動が「ドクン……ドクン……」と、不気味なほど非常に遅いテンポで重く響き渡る。

叫び声（深いエコーがかかり、不自然に低く引き延ばされた苦悶の絶叫）: 「う、うぉぉぉ……おぉ……おぉ……っ！！（残響：お…お…お…）」

Shot 2 (cut2) — 4.5秒
目的: 画角をバッと切り替え、吹き飛んで地面を転がるキャラを激しいカメラワークで追従する。
内容: アニメ調。カットの頭で画角がバッと横方向のミディアムショットへと切り替わる。それまで引き延ばされていた超スローモーションが、一転して通常以上の「超高速スピード」へと急加速する。フックの拳に溜まっていた凄まじい威力が一気に解放され、○○の体全体が後方へと凄まじいスピードで吹き飛ばされる。カメラは吹き飛ぶスピードに合わせ、並走するように激しく横移動しながら追従する（並走カメラワーク）。○○は背中から激しく地面に叩きつけられ、勢いが止まらずに「ズササササッ！」と猛烈な勢いで地面を何回転もゴロゴロと激しく転がっていく。カメラは転がりバウンドする○○の姿を画面中央に捉え続け、周囲に激しく舞い上がる土煙や埃、強烈なスピード感のモーションブラーをリアルタイムで臨場感たっぷりに映し出す。

キャラクター/プロダクト: ○○（吹き飛び、激しく転がる）、並走・追従するカメラワーク、舞い上がる土煙

効果音: それまで響いていた低音エコーがパツンと途切れ、溜まっていたエネルギーが爆発する「バキィィィィン！！」という凄まじい破壊音。続いて地面に激突する「ドガシャァァン！」という重い衝撃音と、カメラが一緒に移動しながら捉える、地面を猛烈に転がり摩擦する「ズササササササササッ！」という連続した激しい摩擦音。

叫び声（カットの切り替わり頭に通常スピードの短い叫び）: 「ぐはっーー！！」

環境音: 転がり終わってカメラの動きが止まった後、ハァハァという荒い息遣いと、風に舞う砂埃の音がサラサラと流れる。

目的: 正面からのクローズアップで、フックの直撃と顔面の歪みを捉える。
内容: アニメ調。カメラは殴られる○○の顔面を真正面から捉えた超クローズアップ。次の瞬間、画面外の横から鋭い軌道で回り込んできた強烈なフックが、○○の左頬を真横から激しく捉える。
その直撃の瞬間から映像が極限の超スローモーションへと切り替わる。真正面のカメラに向かって、パンチの凄まじい衝撃エネルギーで○○の頬の皮膚や筋肉が水面の波紋のようにゆっくりと痛々しく歪んでいく様が克明に映し出される。
○○の目は驚愕と恐怖で大きく見開かれ、瞳孔がじわじわと開いていく。口元から吹き飛んだ数滴の唾液や汗のしぶきは、空中に留まりながらも、極めてゆっくりとした速度で軌跡を描きながら外側へと流れていく。

キャラクター/プロダクト: 殴られる○○（正面からのクローズアップ）、真横から顔を捉えるフックの拳、ゆっくりと宙を舞う唾液のしぶき

効果音: 殴られた瞬間に「ドグォォォン！」という重低音の衝撃音。直後、時間が引き延ばされるような「キィィィン」という耳鳴りのような高音が響き、周囲の音が完全に遮断される。さらに心臓の鼓動が「ドクン……ドクン……」と、不気味なほど非常に遅いテンポで重く響き渡る。

叫び声（深いエコーがかかり、不自然に低く引き延ばされた苦悶の絶叫）: 「う、うぉぉぉ……おぉ……おぉ……っ！！（残響：お…お…お…）」

Shot 2 (cut2) — 4.5秒
目的: 画角をバッと切り替え、吹き飛んで地面を転がるキャラを激しいカメラワークで追従する。
内容: アニメ調。カットの頭で画角がバッと横方向のミディアムショットへと切り替わる。それまで引き延ばされていた超スローモーションが、一転して通常以上の「超高速スピード」へと急加速する。フックの拳に溜まっていた凄まじい威力が一気に解放され、○○の体全体が後方へと凄まじいスピードで吹き飛ばされる。カメラは吹き飛ぶスピードに合わせ、並走するように激しく横移動しながら追従する（並走カメラワーク）。○○は背中から激しく地面に叩きつけられ、勢いが止まらずに「ズササササッ！」と猛烈な勢いで地面を何回転もゴロゴロと激しく転がっていく。カメラは転がりバウンドする○○の姿を画面中央に捉え続け、周囲に激しく舞い上がる土煙や埃、強烈なスピード感のモーションブラーをリアルタイムで臨場感たっぷりに映し出す。

キャラクター/プロダクト: ○○（吹き飛び、激しく転がる）、並走・追従するカメラワーク、舞い上がる土煙

効果音: それまで響いていた低音エコーがパツンと途切れ、溜まっていたエネルギーが爆発する「バキィィィィン！！」という凄まじい破壊音。続いて地面に激突する「ドガシャァァン！」という重い衝撃音と、カメラが一緒に移動しながら捉える、地面を猛烈に転がり摩擦する「ズササササササササッ！」という連続した激しい摩擦音。

叫び声（カットの切り替わり頭に通常スピードの短い叫び）: 「ぐはっーー！！」

環境音: 転がり終わってカメラの動きが止まった後、ハァハァという荒い息遣いと、風に舞う砂埃の音がサラサラと流れる。

en.p:
[Video Content] (The character used. From then on, a super close-up of ○○'s face. Frontal view.

[Location] Under the riverside overpass, during the day, in the shade.

[Shocking direct hits and punches rolling to the ground with a time lag]
Shot 1 (cut1) — 5.0 seconds
Objective: Close-up from the front to capture the direct hit from the hook and facial distortion.
Content: Anime-style. The camera captures ○○'s face straight in front as he gets hit, a super close-up. In the next moment, a powerful hook circled sharply from the side off-screen, striking ○○'s left cheek fiercely from the side.
From the moment of direct impact, the footage switches to extreme ultra-slow motion. Facing the camera directly, the tremendous impact energy of the punch vividly shows the skin and muscles on ○○'s cheeks slowly and painfully distorted like ripples on the water's surface.
○○'s eyes widened in shock and fear, and his pupils slowly dilated. A few drops of saliva and sweat that blew from his mouth flowed outward at an extremely slow pace, trailing while still in the air.

Characters/Products: Punched ○○ (frontal close-up), hooked fists capturing the face from the side, saliva slowly flying in the air

Sound effect: At the moment of being hit, "Dogwang!" A deep bass impact. Immediately after, a high-pitched "kieein" sounds like a ringing in the ears as if time is stretching out, completely blocking out all surrounding noise. And my heartbeat pounded loudly...... "Thud......" echoes with an eerily slow tempo.

Scream (a deep echo, unnaturally low, agonized scream): "U-uuu...... おぉ…… おぉ…… っ！！ (Resonance: Oh... お… お… ）」

Shot 2 (cut2) — 4.5 seconds
Objective: Quickly switch the angle of view and follow the character as it is blown away and rolls on the ground, using intense camera work.
Content: Anime-style. At the head of the cut, the angle of view suddenly switches to a horizontal medium shot. The ultra-slow motion that had been stretched out suddenly accelerates to an above-normal "ultra-high speed." The tremendous power that had been building up in Hook's fist was released at once, and ○○'s entire body was blasted backward at an incredible speed. The camera follows the camera by moving vigorously sideways in sync with the speed of the blast (parallel camera work). ○○ was slammed hard into the ground from behind, and without stopping the momentum, he shouted "Zusasasasa!" With a furious force, it rolled violently and spun around the ground multiple times. The camera continuously captures the rolling and bouncing ○○ at the center of the frame, capturing the intense dust and dust swirling around and the intense motion blur in real time, fully realizing the scene.

Characters/Products: ○○ (blown away, rolling violently), parallel and chasing camerawork, rising dust and dust

Sound effect: The low-pitched echo that had been echoing until then suddenly breaks off, and the energy that had been building up explodes with a "Bakiiiiin!!" The shocking sound of destruction. Next, the 'Dogashaan!' crashes into the ground! and the camera moves along with the violent, rolling and rubbing ground with the 'zusasasa!' A series of intense friction noises.

Scream (cut-to-cut, short, usually fast shout in the head): "Guhaa!!"

Ambient sound: After rolling and the camera stops, heavy breathing and the sound of dust swirling in the wind flow smoothly.

Camera: Simulated smartphone camera filmed by another female idol member. 风格：照片级真实的智能手机幕后视频画面。假竖屏手机画面自然裁剪成16：9。正宗的手持手机美学。没有电影级色彩调色，没有HDR效果，没有3D渲染，没有游戏引擎，没有美妆滤镜。感觉像是韩国偶像上传的真实幕后花絮。照明：夏日下午明亮的阳光透过大户窗户，逐渐过渡到温暖的晚间照明。自然曝光波动和自动白平衡，这与智能手机相机相符。色彩：中性消费级智能手机色彩科学，略显柔和对比，窗户附近有轻微的高光穿透，室内自然色变。摄像头：由另一位女偶像成员拍摄的模拟智能手机摄像头。轻柔的手持移动、自然的行走动作、细微的自动对焦呼吸、快速平移时轻微的滚动快门、偶尔的构图不完美、短暂的对焦狩猎以及逼真的手机压缩。摄像机表现得像朋友随意拍摄，从未经过专业稳定。皮肤：极其逼真的肤质，毛孔明显，自然瑕疵明显。淡淡的日常妆容。没有皮肤平滑。表演：温柔、优雅且温和。她谦虚地微笑，说话平静，偶尔注意到摄像机后会有些害羞，自然地感谢拍摄者。她的性格优雅、女性化、礼貌且略显内敛。她很少大声笑，反而会露出温暖的微笑、微妙的愉悦和细腻的面部表情。每一个动作都显得精致、放松且轻松。物理效果：头发、衣物、毛巾、食物、蒸汽、水滴和家居物品都以真实的重量和惯性自然移动。构图：随意的智能手机构图，偶尔出现不完美的构图和即兴的重新构图。感觉更像是真实的宿舍录像，而不是计划好的内容。连贯性：在每个场景中保持完全相同的脸部、铂金色长直发和刘海、身体比例和与参考图相同的身份。没有身份漂移。技术层面：真实的24–30fps智能手机视频画面，带有细微的压缩伪影。最终输出16：9。音频：仅有自然的公寓氛围。空调嗡嗡作响，远处首尔的车声，窗外鸟鸣，烹饪声，沸水声，煎食声，碗碟声，脚步声，流水声，刷牙声，吹风机，冰箱嗡嗡声，以及柔和的房间氛围。没有背景音乐。没有字幕。整体氛围：温暖、平和、优雅且令人安心。类似韩国偶像上传的安静幕后宿舍vlog。一切都显得真诚、平静且亲密，却不刻意娱乐。角色：一位虚构的韩国二十出头女性偶像。长长的铂金色头发，直刘海。白皙的皮肤。柔和的猫眼。身材苗条。优雅而女性化。她以温和的个性、礼貌的举止和平稳的说话声音著称。她刚放学和安排好课程表回到宿舍，安静地度过了剩下的夏夜。服装连贯性：剪辑1 她穿着参考图片中完全相同的水手风格校服，包括奶油色针织背心、蓝色水手领、蓝色百褶裙、白袜子和黑色乐福鞋。剪辑2 她一边做饭一边换上一件宽大的白色图案T恤和宽松的黑色运动短裤。剪辑3 她现在穿着柔软的淡蓝色无袖休闲上衣，配白色休闲短裤吃晚饭。CUT 4 刷牙时穿着同一套休闲装。剪辑5 洗完脸后，她换上了奢华的白色丝绸短睡衣，领口、袖口、胸袋和短裤下摆饰有优雅的金色滚边。睡衣套装包括一件宽松的短袖衬衫和配套的丝质短裤。她做护肤时头发松松地绑起来。CUT 6 洗完澡后很干净，还穿着那件带金色滚边的白色丝绸睡衣。她的头发微微湿润，脖子上系着一条白毛巾晾干头发。CUT 7 穿着优雅的白色丝绸睡衣，抱着毛绒玩具，喝着冰茶，悠闲地躺在沙发上。剪辑8 睡前她自然地放下头发，穿着优雅的白色丝绸睡衣，轻轻向镜头挥手，关掉卧室灯并关上门。场景：一个美丽现代的豪华韩式偶像宿舍公寓，正值宁静的夏日下午和傍晚。室内环境温馨明亮优雅，家具雅致，护肤品、毛绒玩具、零食、鲜花、书籍和整洁的生活空间。CUT 1 — 《回家》连续手持镜头。她打开前门，悄悄走进宿舍，穿着参考图片中的校服，整齐地脱下乐福鞋，把书包放在门口，对着镜头微笑，微微低头。对话：“다녀왔어요。”第二剪辑 — 烹饪 镜头跟随她走进厨房。她洗菜，准备简单的韩式家常菜，煎鸡蛋，煮拉面，用勺子品尝汤，温柔地微笑。对话：“今天많이 배고프네요.”另一间房间隐约传来一名女性成员的声音。女声：“언니~”她轻轻一笑。"왜?"第三段——晚餐 她安静地坐在餐桌旁。吃饭前，她轻轻地把手合十。对话：“잘 먹겠습니다。”她平静地享用这顿饭，偶尔对着镜头微笑。剪辑4 — 刷牙 浴室镜子镜头。她慢慢刷牙，偶尔和镜头对视后害羞地笑了。对话：“现在양치해야지。”剪辑5 — 护肤 现在穿着优雅的白色丝绸睡衣，镶边金色。她一边平静地对着镜头说话，一边小心地涂抹爽肤水、精华液和保湿霜。对话：“今天皮肤稍微好 보이는 것 같아요.”剪辑6 — 洗完澡后 她走出浴室，头发微微湿润，脖子上围着一条毛巾。她静静地擦干头发，望着公寓窗外夏日落霞。对话：“샤워하니까 真的개운해.”第七段——放松 她舒适地坐在沙发上，抱着毛绒玩具，啜饮着冰茶，慢慢滑动手机。另一间房间里有位女成员轻声说话。女声：“电影 볼래？”她温暖地微笑。"좋아요."CUT 8 — 晚安，深夜。她带着手机充电器和毛绒玩具走进卧室。她最后转身，温柔地对着镜头微笑，轻轻挥了挥手。对话：“奥늘也함께해줘서 정말 고마워요.좋은 꿈 꾸세요."她关掉了卧室的灯。卧室门缓缓关上，手持摄像机静静地在外面停留了一秒，录像自然结束。

0:08–0:10:

0:10–0:12:

0:12–0:14:

A hyper-realistic cinematic short film about two women building their dream beauty brand from the ground up. Inspired by luxury fashion campaigns, emotional Netflix-style storytelling, and viral “soft life” entrepreneur aesthetics. Elegant beauty salon with glowing LED mirrors, glossy cream marble floors, gold-accent décor, aesthetic makeup stations, luxury product shelves, soft sunlight rays, cinematic reflections, floating dust particles, dreamy lens flares, realistic beauty textures, smooth handheld IMAX camera movement, and ultra-premium fashion-commercial visuals.

The atmosphere feels emotional, feminine, rich, inspirational, and deeply cinematic—a story about friendship, ambition, sacrifice, and success.

MAIN CHARACTERS:
Two stylish young women with graceful confidence and powerful chemistry. Elegant luxury salon outfits in black, beige, and gold tones.

0–2 SEC:
Black screen. Soft rain ambience. One light slowly turns on inside a dark luxury salon. Then another. Wide shot reveals the empty salon before sunrise as one woman wipes the mirror while the other arranges beauty tools.

2–5 SEC:
Fast beauty montage. Makeup powder floating through sunlight, curling hair, glossy lips, polished nails, jewelry sparkle, heels walking across marble floors, coffee cups beside appointment books, tired hands still working late.

5–8 SEC:
The salon becomes busy with happy clients. One woman styles glossy hair while the other creates flawless makeup looks. Clients smile, record mirror selfies, and admire their transformations.

8–11 SEC:
Both women pause during the rush and exchange proud smiles through the mirror reflection. Warm golden sunlight fills the salon.

11–13 SEC:
Luxury makeover reveal. A beautiful client stands speechless after her transformation while golden reflections fill the room.

13–15 SEC:
Camera slowly pulls outside the salon into rainy streets. The glowing salon sign reflects on wet pavement while both women proudly stand together inside surrounded by happy clients. Cinematic fade out.

氛围充满情感、女性化、丰富、励志且极具电影感——讲述友谊、野心、牺牲与成功的故事。

主要角色：
两位优雅自信、化学反应强烈的时尚年轻女性。优雅的奢华沙龙服装，颜色包括黑色、米色和金色。

0–2 SEC：
黑屏。柔和的雨声氛围。一盏灯在一家昏暗的奢华沙龙里慢慢亮起。然后又是另一个。广角镜头展现日出前空荡荡的沙龙，一名女子擦拭镜子，另一名女子整理美容工具。

2–5 SEC：
快速美妆蒙太奇。化妆粉在阳光下飘散，卷发，光泽的嘴唇，抛光的指甲，珠宝闪闪发光，高跟鞋踩在大理石地板上，咖啡杯放在预约册旁，疲惫的双手仍在加班。

5–8 SEC：
沙龙里满是满意的客户。一位女士造型亮丽的头发，另一位则打造无瑕的妆容。客户微笑，拍摄镜子自拍，欣赏自己的蜕变。

8–11 SEC：
两位女士在匆忙中停下脚步，通过镜子里的倒影交换着自豪的微笑。温暖的金色阳光洒满了沙龙。

11–13 SEC：
奢华改造揭晓。一位美丽的客户在变身后哑口无言，金色倒影充满了房间。

13–15 SEC：
镜头缓缓拉出沙龙，进入雨中的街道。发光的沙龙招牌映照在湿漉漉的人行道上，两位女士骄傲地站在室内，周围环绕着快乐的顾客。电影化渐弱。

地点：喀拉拉邦的正宗乡村雨季。旅程从一个小路边小镇集市开始，那里有老旧的公交车、被雨水浸湿的道路、蔬菜摊、雨伞、水坑、悬挂的招牌、摩托车和当地通勤者。旅程过渡到美丽的喀拉拉丛林道路，那里有茂密的热带植被、山路、路边悬崖上的瀑布、雾气缭绕的山谷、茂密的绿植、苔藓覆盖的岩石和翻滚的云朵。最终地点是一条被浓密森林和广阔云雾缭绕的山脊。

视觉风格：超写实纪录现实主义。真诚坦率的行为。自然的肢体语言。即兴生活片段的感觉。强烈的环境真实性。丰富的现实细节和可信的人类和动物动作。

相机风格：2000年代初的消费级DV摄像机风格。朋友随意记录日常瞬间。手持时手抖严重，构图不完美，频繁自动对焦，镜头呼吸，阳光与阴影切换时曝光泵动，偶尔出现运动模糊，细微滚动快门，轻微数字压缩伪影，色彩褪色，对比度柔和，传感器轻微噪点。没有稳定。没有电影感的镜头移动。没有现代的调色技术。

00：00–00：02 一辆旧公共巴士驶离雨天路边市场。他坐在窗边座位上，狗狗坐在旁边，前爪靠在窗边。雨滴划过玻璃。他默默望向窗外，市场活动模糊而过。当公交车在崎岖不平的道路上摇晃时，摄像机难以保持对焦。

00：02–00：04 公交车深入蜿蜒的丛林小路，两旁是浓密的热带绿植。狗好奇地用耳朵抖动观察着外面。摄像师试图捕捉风景和观众反应时，构图略微偏离中心。

00：04–00：06 透过公交车窗，雾气缭绕的山丘、瀑布和湿润的山路从前方掠过。自动对焦在玻璃上的雨滴和他若有所思的脸庞之间反复切换。

00：06–00：08 公交车停靠在一条偏远的路边小径附近。轻微的季风雨持续。他下车，背着背包，狗兴奋地跳了出来。

00：08–00：10 他们穿越茂密的森林爬坡。湿漉漉的落叶刷过他的衣服，鞋子微微陷入柔软泥泞的地面。狗跑在前面，偶尔回头看他。

en.p:
Main subject: young Indian man, early 20s, lean athletic build, natural everyday appearance, faded forest-green oversized t-shirt, dark charcoal cargo pants, worn trekking shoes, rugged canvas backpack, simple analog wristwatch, Realistic skin texture, no stylized features, calm introspective personality. Accompanied by his loyal medium-sized dog with short golden-brown fur, alert ears, expressive eyes, and a worn dark collar. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, dog appearance, gear, and physical characteristics throughout the entire video. 

Location: Authentic rural Kerala during monsoon season. Journey begins in a small roadside town market with old buses, rain-soaked roads, vegetable stalls, umbrellas, puddles, hanging signboards, motorcycles, and local commuters. The journey transitions into beautiful Kerala jungle roads with dense tropical vegetation, mountain roads, waterfalls along roadside cliffs, mist-covered valleys, heavy greenery, moss-covered rocks, and rolling clouds. Final location is a high mountain ridge surrounded by deep forest and expansive cloud-filled valleys.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior. Natural body language. Unscripted slice-of-life feeling. Strong environmental authenticity. Rich real-world details and believable human and animal motion. 

Camera Style: Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic. Friend casually recording everyday moments. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, frequent autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping when moving between sun and shade, occasional motion blur, subtle rolling shutter, mild digital compression artifacts, faded colors, soft contrast, slight sensor noise. No stabilization. No cinematic camera moves. No modern color grading. 

00:00–00:02 Inside an old public bus leaving a rainy roadside market. He sits on the window seat with his dog beside him, front paws resting near the window. Rain droplets streak across the glass. He quietly looks outside while blurred market activity passes by. The camera struggles to hold focus as the bus shakes over uneven roads. 

00:02–00:04 The bus moves deeper into winding jungle roads lined with dense tropical greenery. The dog curiously watches outside with twitching ears. Framing drifts slightly off-center as the camera operator tries to capture both the scenery and their reactions. 

00:04–00:06 Through the bus window, mist covered hills, waterfalls, and wet mountain roads pass by. Autofocus repeatedly shifts between raindrops on the glass and his thoughtful face.

00:06–00:08 The bus stops near a remote roadside trail. Light monsoon rain continues. He steps down carrying his backpack while the dog jumps out excitedly beside him. 

00:08–00:10 They trek uphill through dense forest. Wet leaves brush against his clothes and shoes sink slightly into soft muddy ground. The dog runs ahead, occasionally turning back toward him.

[STYLE] Celebration showcase film, photorealistic live-action cinematography, epic aerial visuals, 8K ultra HD, DaVinci professional color grading, high-contrast night lighting
[DURATION] 15 seconds
[SETTING] Statue of Liberty in New York Harbor at night → Las Vegas Sphere → city night sky drone light show, three locations connected by montage

[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Fireworks Opening (Aerial Orbit + Fireworks)
Aerial orbit: the camera dives down from the night sky and circles halfway around the Statue of Liberty. The verdigris copper statue is lit by golden floodlights from below, the torch glowing bright at the top.
VFX: massive realistic pyrotechnics burst in continuous succession in the night sky behind the statue — red, white, and blue sparks bloom in spherical bursts, ember trails drift slowly downward, smoke dispersed by the night wind.
Sound: whistling of fireworks launching + triple low-frequency explosion rumble.

[00:05-00:10] Shot 2: The Sphere Lights Up (Sphere Light Show + Match Cut)
Hard match cut: the firework sparks instantly transform into LED light dots on the surface of the Las Vegas Sphere.
Medium-wide low-angle shot: waves of red, white, and blue light roll across the giant sphere's surface, converging into a massive golden number "250" with flowing particle texture on its surface; the sphere bathes the surrounding streets in warm golden light.
Slow push-in: the number "250" gradually fills the frame.
Sound: low-frequency electronic swell building up, distant crowd cheering (off-screen).

[00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Drone Swarm Finale
Wide low-angle shot: thousands of drone lights converge from all directions in the city night sky, first forming a star pattern, then flowing and morphing into glowing text "1776 → 2026".
VFX: a final row of fireworks launches simultaneously from the horizon and bursts, golden ember rain filling the lower edge of the frame as the drone text freezes amid the firelight.
[ON-SCREEN TEXT] Golden serif title fades in at center frame: "250 YEARS", softly glowing, holds for 1 second to close.
Sound: orchestral score peaks then cuts abruptly, leaving only the echo of fireworks.

zh.p:
[风格]庆典展示影片，写实实景摄影，史诗级航拍画面，8K超高清，达芬奇专业调色，高对比夜间灯光
[时长] 15秒
[场景] 纽约港自由女神像夜晚→拉斯维加斯球馆→城市夜空无人机灯光秀，三个地点通过蒙太奇连接

[00：00-00：05] 镜头1：烟花开幕（空中轨道+烟花）
空中轨道： 镜头从夜空中俯冲下来，绕着自由女神像盘旋了一半。铜雕像被下方金色泛光灯照亮，火把在顶部明亮地闪耀。
视觉特效：巨型逼真的烟火在雕像后方夜空中连续爆发——红、白、蓝火花以球形爆发绽放，余烬缓缓飘落，烟雾被夜风吹散。
声音：烟花发射呼啸声 + 三重低频爆炸轰鸣。

[00：05-00：10] 镜头2： 球体点亮（球体灯光秀+匹配剪辑）
硬匹配剪辑：烟花火花瞬间变成拉斯维加斯球体表面的LED光点。
中宽低角度镜头：红、白、蓝光波在巨型球体表面滚动，汇聚成一个巨大的金色数字\“250”，表面呈现流动粒子纹理;球体将周围街道洒满温暖的金色光芒。
缓慢推入：数字“250\”逐渐充满画面。
声音：低频电子涌动渐起，远处人群欢呼（画外音）。

[00：10-00：15] 镜头3：无人机蜂拥大结局
广角低角度镜头：成千上万的无人机灯光从城市夜空中四面八方汇聚，首先形成星形图案， 随后流动变形为发光文字\“1776 → 2026\”。
VFX：最后一排烟花同时从地平线发射爆发，金色余烬雨点满画面下缘，无人机文字在火光中凝结。
[屏幕文字] 金色衬线字标题渐入中央画面：“250年\”，柔和地闪烁， 保持1秒后关闭。
音效：管弦乐配乐达到高峰后突然中断，只剩烟花的回声。

NOSTALGIC SUMMER JOURNEY — 15 SEC AMBIENT CUT

Subject: Young Asian woman, short bob haircut, wearing a simple flowing white summer dress.
Aesthetic & Camera: Cinematic Japanese summer countryside, f/1.8, 85mm and 35mm lenses, shallow depth of field, soft pastel natural light, 8k resolution, raw photography style.

(0:00–0:03) — Rustling Leaves
Wide shot. Wind gently blowing through lush green summer foliage and bamboo trees. Sunbeams filtering through the leaves. Volumetric lighting.
Transition: Soft cut

(0:04–0:06) — The Path
Ground-level tracking shot. A flowing white dress and light summer sandals walking slowly down a sun-dappled, slightly worn rural asphalt road. Soft shadows and bright highlights.
Transition: Cut on movement

(0:07–0:09) — Skyward Gaze
85mm close-up profile. The young woman looks up toward the sky. Wind softly catches her bob haircut and the fabric of her dress. Natural cinematic rim lighting isolating her silhouette.
Transition: Crossfade

(0:10–0:12) — The Vending Machine
Medium wide shot. She stands quietly next to a glowing, retro Japanese vending machine on an empty countryside road, gazing out over a distant green valley. Nostalgic, soft daylight lighting.
Transition: Slow cut

(0:13–0:15) — Contemplation
Extreme close-up portrait. Looking directly into the lens with a calm, gentle smile. f/1.8 shallow depth of field blurring the background into soft green bokeh. Highly detailed facial features and realistic skin texture.
Transition: soft cut

zh.p:
怀旧夏日旅程——15秒氛围剪辑

主题：年轻的亚洲女性，短波波头，穿着一件简单的飘逸白色夏日裙。
美学与摄影：电影感十足的日本夏季乡村，f/1.8、85mm和35mm镜头，浅景深，柔和的柔和自然光，8K分辨率，原始摄影风格。

（0：00–0：03）——树叶沙沙声
广角镜头。微风轻轻吹过茂密的夏日绿叶和竹林。阳光透过树叶洒进来。体积光。
过渡：软剪辑

（0：04–0：06）——《道路》
地面跟踪镜头。一袭飘逸的白色连衣裙和轻薄的夏日凉鞋，缓缓走在阳光斑驳、略显磨损的乡村柏油路上。柔和的阴影和明亮的高光。
过渡：动作被切断

（0：07–0：09）——《仰望天空》
85毫米特写剖面。年轻女子抬头望向天空。风轻轻拂过她的波波头和裙子的布料。自然的电影边缘灯光将她的轮廓隔离开来。
过渡：交叉淡入

（0：10–0：12）——自动售货机
中广角镜头。她静静地站在一条空荡荡的乡间小路上，旁边是一台发光的复古日本自动售货机，凝望着远处一片绿色的山谷。怀旧的柔和阳光。
过渡：慢剪

（0：13–0：15）——沉思
极近特写肖像。带着平静温柔的微笑直视镜头。f/1.8浅景深，背景模糊成柔和的绿色散景。面部细节丰富，皮肤质感逼真。
过渡：软剪

raw_p: Photorealistic, cinematic action sequence. A young woman with short light-blue hair wearing a school uniform and a full-body harness prepares for a bungee jump on a high steel bridge. Crew members in dark uniforms check her gear. She dives forward. The camera tracks her top-down descent toward the deep blue ocean. As she nears the surface, a colossal, terrifying prehistoric sea monster breaches with jaws wide open to swallow her. At the last second, the bungee cord yanks her safely upward into a seated position. The monster crashes back into the sea, creating a massive, chaotic splash with realistic water dynamics. 8k, hyper-realistic, dramatic lighting, high-end Hollywood VFX.

zh.p: 照片级写实、电影感十足的动作场面。一位穿着校服和全身安全带、短发浅蓝色的年轻女子准备在一座高钢桥上蹦极。身穿深色制服的船员检查她的装备。她俯冲而上。镜头跟踪她俯瞰下坠，朝着深蓝色的海洋。当她接近水面时，一只庞大而可怕的史前海怪张开大嘴将她吞下。最后一刻，弹力绳把她安全地拉起坐了起来。怪物撞回海中，溅起巨大的混乱水花，水力学真实。8K画质，超写实，戏剧性光影，高端好莱坞视觉特效。

raw_p:
A 15-second cinematic miniature chase across a warm afternoon living-room floor, ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT, NO CUTS. The entire video is one forward escape along the same wooden floor path. Every danger is a connected chain reaction on that path — not separate scenes.

Camera: Very low floor-level chase cam at the girl's shoulder height, tightly behind or slightly beside her. The camera never resets position, never jumps to a new angle, never teleports. It accelerates with her sprint, leans into her turns, dips when she slides, and shakes on near-misses. One continuous physical camera move from start to finish. Extremely shallow macro depth of field — she stays sharp, the giant world blurs in and out as it passes.

Chain of events: The camera starts low behind the tiny girl sprinting away from the desk area (Episode 1 landing point) across sunlit floorboards, dust motes drifting at her knee height like snowfall. — A shadow slides over her from behind: the cat has spotted her. Its paw-steps land as deep thuds. — She cuts hard around a fallen pencil; the cat's first paw slap lands inches behind her, flipping the pencil into a spin — she jumps the spinning pencil without breaking stride. — The pencil rolls into a stack of magazines, sliding the top one across the floor like a glacier into her path — she drops into a slide under its lifting edge, board-slide posture, and keeps running. — The magazine knocks a ball of yarn loose; it unspools rolling beside her, the thread whipping past her face — she vaults over the crossing thread. — The cat overtakes from the side in full "우다다" zoomies mode, cuts ahead, and crouches into pounce position directly on her path, hind legs wiggling — at the last second she veers into the dark gap under the sofa, sliding on her knees as the cat's paw sweeps the entrance behind her, claws retracted, batting at darkness. — Inside the dim under-sofa tunnel she keeps moving; behind her in the bright entrance slit, the cat's face drops sideways into view, one huge amber eye peering in, tail flicking. She backs away deeper into the dark, breathing hard — and the eye blinks slowly. Not menace — curiosity. The video ends on that suspended standoff, a split second of "safe... for now."

Cat behavior: playful hunting instinct, not evil — claws never extended, movements are classic house-cat play (slap, pounce-wiggle, zoomies, slow blink). The cat stays physically consistent — it moves through the room continuously, never teleports.

Audio: no background music for the first 3 seconds — only her sprinting footsteps (tiny, fast) and giant paw thuds (slow, deep, getting closer): the rhythm contrast IS the tension. Then urgent strings enter low. Realistic scale sounds: pencil clatter like a falling log, magazine sliding like an avalanche, yarn thread whipping, the cat's purr-chirp echoing huge, her breathing close to camera. At the sofa-gap escape all music cuts to silence — under the sofa: muffl

zh.t: 客厅地板上的惊险追逐
zh.p:
一段15秒的电影式追逐，穿过温暖的下午客厅地板，连续镜头，无剪辑。整个视频就像沿着同一条木地板小径向前逃脱。每一次危险都是那条路上连锁反应——而不是独立的场景。

摄像头：非常低的地面追逐摄像头，拍摄女孩肩膀高度，紧贴她身后或稍近。摄像机从不重置位置，从不跳跃到新角度，也从不瞬移。它随着冲刺加速，转弯时倾斜，滑行时下沉，擦肩而过时颤抖。从头到尾，一个连续的物理镜头移动。极浅的宏观景深——她保持锐利，巨大的世界在流逝时隐隐时现。

事件链：镜头从小女孩身后低处开始，她正从书桌（第一集的降落点）飞奔，穿过阳光照射的地板，尘埃在她膝盖高度飘落如雪花。——一道阴影从背后掠过她：猫发现了她。它的爪子声沉重落地。——她用力剪断掉落的铅笔;猫的第一爪拍在她身后几英寸，铅笔翻转旋转——她跳过旋转铅笔，步伐未曾停下。——铅笔滚进一叠杂志里，顶层那本像冰川一样滑过地板，挡在她面前——她滑进滑梯，滑板式的滑梯，继续奔跑。——杂志撞落一团毛线;它在她身旁展开，线头从她脸旁呼啸而过——她跃过交叉线。——猫从侧面超车，完全“乌다”式地疾驰，先行，蹲下准备扑向她的路径，后腿扭动——在最后一刻，她转向沙发下的黑暗缝隙，跪地滑动，猫爪扫过她身后的入口，爪子收回，拍打黑暗。——在昏暗的沙发下隧道里，她继续前行;在她身后明亮的入口缝隙中，猫的脸侧向视线中，一只巨大的琥珀色眼睛探头，尾巴轻轻摆动。她退得更深，呼吸急促——眼睛缓缓眨动。不是威胁——而是好奇。视频以那场悬浮的对峙结束，短暂的“安全......暂时如此。”

猫的行为：是玩心的狩猎本能，不是邪恶——爪子从不伸出，动作是典型的家猫游戏（拍打、扑击、扭动、奔跑、缓慢眨眼）。猫的身体保持稳定——它会不断穿过房间，从不瞬移。

音频：前三秒没有背景音乐——只有她飞奔的脚步声（轻微、快速）和巨大的爪子敲击声（缓慢、深沉、越来越近）：节奏对比就是紧张感所在。然后紧急弦从低音进入。逼真的比例音效：铅笔如坠落木头般碰撞，杂志如雪崩般滑动，纱线飞舞，猫咪的呼噜声回荡，呼吸声贴近镜头。在沙发缝隙逃生处，所有音乐戛然而止——沙发下：闷闷不乐

en.p:
A 15-second cinematic miniature chase across a warm afternoon living-room floor, ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT, NO CUTS. The entire video is one forward escape along the same wooden floor path. Every danger is a connected chain reaction on that path — not separate scenes.

Camera: Very low floor-level chase cam at the girl's shoulder height, tightly behind or slightly beside her. The camera never resets position, never jumps to a new angle, never teleports. It accelerates with her sprint, leans into her turns, dips when she slides, and shakes on near-misses. One continuous physical camera move from start to finish. Extremely shallow macro depth of field — she stays sharp, the giant world blurs in and out as it passes.

Chain of events: The camera starts low behind the tiny girl sprinting away from the desk area (Episode 1 landing point) across sunlit floorboards, dust motes drifting at her knee height like snowfall. — A shadow slides over her from behind: the cat has spotted her. Its paw-steps land as deep thuds. — She cuts hard around a fallen pencil; the cat's first paw slap lands inches behind her, flipping the pencil into a spin — she jumps the spinning pencil without breaking stride. — The pencil rolls into a stack of magazines, sliding the top one across the floor like a glacier into her path — she drops into a slide under its lifting edge, board-slide posture, and keeps running. — The magazine knocks a ball of yarn loose; it unspools rolling beside her, the thread whipping past her face — she vaults over the crossing thread. — The cat overtakes from the side in full "우다다" zoomies mode, cuts ahead, and crouches into pounce position directly on her path, hind legs wiggling — at the last second she veers into the dark gap under the sofa, sliding on her knees as the cat's paw sweeps the entrance behind her, claws retracted, batting at darkness. — Inside the dim under-sofa tunnel she keeps moving; behind her in the bright entrance slit, the cat's face drops sideways into view, one huge amber eye peering in, tail flicking. She backs away deeper into the dark, breathing hard — and the eye blinks slowly. Not menace — curiosity. The video ends on that suspended standoff, a split second of "safe... for now."

Cat behavior: playful hunting instinct, not evil — claws never extended, movements are classic house-cat play (slap, pounce-wiggle, zoomies, slow blink). The cat stays physically consistent — it moves through the room continuously, never teleports.

Audio: no background music for the first 3 seconds — only her sprinting footsteps (tiny, fast) and giant paw thuds (slow, deep, getting closer): the rhythm contrast IS the tension. Then urgent strings enter low. Realistic scale sounds: pencil clatter like a falling log, magazine sliding like an avalanche, yarn thread whipping, the cat's purr-chirp echoing huge, her breathing close to camera. At the sofa-gap escape all music cuts to silence — under the sofa: muffl

The toddler has oversized features, including a round face, an exaggerated pouty and grumpy expression, and his signature long blonde hair tied neatly into a top-knot bun with shaved sides. He is wearing a detailed light blue Manchester City FC home kit, complete with matching shorts and golden football boots. He stands confidently with his arms tightly crossed over his chest, rocking slightly back and forth to the rhythm of music, giving a playful and defiant attitude. One foot is planted firmly on top of a classic star-patterned UEFA Champions League football.
The camera angle is a dynamic, low-angle full-body shot that makes the character look heroic yet adorable. The background is softly blurred with bokeh, showing a massive crowd under intense, bright stadium floodlights that cast crisp highlights on his hair and clothes. Cinematic lighting, rich colors, ultra-detailed textures on the fabric, hair strands, and grass blades, rendering in smooth 4K resolution.

zh.t: 哈兰德萌娃球场霸气秀
zh.p:
一款高端3D皮克斯风格的数字动画。主角是一个可爱、胖乎乎的幼儿漫画形象，模仿职业足球运动员埃尔林·哈兰德，站在一个充满活力的绿草地上，夜晚在一座巨大的、拥挤的足球场内。
这个幼儿五官过大，包括圆脸、夸张的撅嘴和脾气暴躁的表情，以及他标志性的长金发整齐地扎成一个上髻，两侧剃光。他身穿一件细致的浅蓝色曼城主场球衣，配有配套短裤和金色足球鞋。他自信地站着，双臂紧抱胸前，随着音乐节奏微微摇晃，带着顽皮和挑衅的姿态。一只脚稳稳地踩在经典的星形欧洲冠军联赛足球上。
摄像机角度采用动态的低角度全身镜头，使角色看起来既英勇又可爱。背景被散景柔和模糊，展现出庞大的观众群，在强烈明亮的体育场聚光灯下，清晰地映衬在他的头发和衣服上。电影般的光影效果，丰富的色彩，面料、发丝和草叶上的极细致纹理，以流畅的4K分辨率渲染。

Fast-paced fashion montage with smooth whip pans, spin transitions, jump cuts, and snap transitions.

zh.p:
制作一个时尚、超写实的Instagram时尚短片，展示一位时尚的Z世代女性网红，展示10种搭配同款宽松粉黄色衬衫的方法。没有对话，只有欢快的病毒流行音乐，每种造型都有干净的动画文字标签。垂直距离9：16。

开场是网红在明亮极简公寓里把衬衫挂在衣架上。她对着镜头微笑，把衬衫扔了过去，屏幕上出现了“1件衬衫🤍 10种造型方式”的文字。

快节奏的时尚蒙太奇，配合流畅的鞭打、旋转过渡、跳剪和快节奏转换。

展示这些造型：

1. 休闲时尚——敞开搭配白色露款上衣和宽腿牛仔裤。
2. 前结——用牛仔布在腰间系。
3. 露肩——搭配太阳镜的休闲造型。
4. 塞进裤子里——塞进剪裁合身的白色裤子，系着腰带。
5. 以牛仔短裤开场——休闲夏日造型配冰咖啡。
6. 束腰时尚——全扣好，配有细腰带和黑色剪裁裤子。
7. 分层连衣裙——敞开穿在合身白色中长裙外面。
8. 法式Tuck——半扣子，卷袖，宽松牛仔裤。
9. 轻松层叠——肩上披肩，搭配白色亚麻裤和黑色背心。
10. 单色极简——扣上扣子，搭配奶油色宽裤，营造干净的奢华感。

在视频中，展现网红自信地走路、摆姿势、旋转、调整领口和袖子、调整太阳镜、端着咖啡、照镜子，以及自然地微笑。混合全身照、中景、布料特写、配饰和服装细节。

明亮的自然光、温暖的极简室内、奢华的Pinterest美学、电影感的手持摄像机运动、浅景深、逼真的面料物理、高端时尚编辑摄影、平滑过渡、超逼真的4K HDR。

最后快速拼贴了围绕最终造型的10套造型和文字：“10套造型。1件衬衫。🤍 你最喜欢哪一个？”

raw_p:
Seedance 2.0, 15 seconds, 16:9.
Main subject from @image1 — lock her identity completely. Keep her face, skin tone, body shape, outfit, hairstyle, and every unique feature perfectly identical throughout the entire video. She is wearing a faded grey sleeveless crop top, loose high-waisted light blue jeans, black canvas sneakers, a black cord necklace, and has black wavy hair tied in a messy side-swept ponytail with bangs. Korean woman with an authentic early-2000s vibe.
The entire video takes place in a quiet Korean residential neighborhood with narrow concrete alleys, low-rise houses featuring small terraces, a front yard with a clothesline, potted plants, parked bicycles and motorcycles, large trees, and overhead utility cables everywhere. There are no shops, vendors, or commercial elements—only a natural, everyday residential environment.
The camera treatment is the defining element. The footage must feel as if a friend casually picked up a DV camcorder and started recording without any planning or setup. Use heavy handheld shake, constant reframing, the subject naturally drifting toward the edges of the frame, autofocus hunting, visible lens breathing, and exposure pumping. The image should appear faded, low-contrast, slightly washed out, with authentic early-2000s digital noise and compression artifacts. No stabilization, no cinematic movement, and no modern color grading. This camcorder aesthetic is absolutely non-negotiable.
She begins sitting on a concrete sidewalk while fixing her ponytail with both arms raised, smiling naturally as the wind gently catches her hair while the camera struggles to maintain focus. The camera then follows her into a narrow alley where she crouches down and feeds a friendly stray cat that walks right up to her. Next, she is in her front yard hanging laundry on a clothesline as the morning breeze softly moves the clothes, while the camera continues swaying and searching for focus. Midway through, she sits quietly on the front terrace holding a coffee cup, calmly looking toward the street as the camera drifts loosely from the side. Then, in a close shot from her right side, she raises her arm, warmly waves to someone off-camera, and says, "Annyeong," with the camera catching the moment a beat late. The final shot follows her in a slow tracking walk down the street with the coffee cup still in hand. She notices the camera, turns slightly, gives a soft, genuine smile, and the recording abruptly cuts to black mid-motion as if the camcorder was simply switched off.
Audio must remain entirely natural. Include only morning birds, a gentle breeze, distant motorcycle sounds, faint neighborhood chatter, the stray cat, coffee cup handling, footsteps on concrete, and rustling leaves. No music, no sound design, and no added audio effects.

zh.p:
Seedance 2.0,15秒，16：9。
@image1的主要主题——完全锁定她的身份。在整个视频中，保持她的脸型、肤色、体型、服装、发型以及每一个独特特征都完美一致。她穿着一件褪色的灰色无袖短款上衣，宽松的高腰浅蓝色牛仔裤，黑色帆布运动鞋，一条黑色绳索项链，黑色波浪发随意地侧扫马尾，带着刘海。韩国女性，带有真实的2000年代初氛围。
整个视频发生在一个安静的韩国住宅区，狭窄的混凝土小巷、带有小排屋的低层住宅、带晾衣绳的前院、种植的盆栽、停放的自行车和摩托车、大树以及到处都是架空电缆。这里没有商店、摊贩或商业元素——只有自然的日常住宅环境。
镜头处理是关键元素。这些画面一定让人感觉像是朋友随手拿起DV摄像机，毫无计划地开始录制。使用重度手持摇晃、不断重构图、主体自然向画面边缘漂移、自动对焦、可见透镜呼吸和曝光泵送。画面应显得褪色、低对比度、略显洗白，带有真实的2000年代早期数字噪点和压缩伪影。没有防抖，没有电影感的移动，也没有现代色彩分级。这种摄像机的美学绝对不容妥协。
她开始坐在混凝土人行道上，双臂高举，整理马尾，自然地微笑着，风轻轻吹动她的头发，镜头努力保持对焦。镜头随后跟随她进入一条狭窄的小巷，她蹲下身喂食一只友好的流浪猫，这只猫径直走到她面前。接着，她在自家前院晾衣服绳上，晨风轻轻吹动衣服，镜头继续摇摆，寻找焦点。拍摄到一半时，她静静地坐在前露台上，手里拿着一杯咖啡，平静地望向街道，镜头从一侧松散地飘来。然后，在右侧的特写镜头中，她举起手臂，热情地向镜头外的人挥手，说：“安宁”，镜头晚了一拍才捕捉到这一刻。最后一幕跟随她慢慢地沿着街道走去，手里还拿着咖啡杯。她注意到摄像机，微微转身，露出温柔真诚的微笑，录像突然在半空中切换到黑屏，仿佛摄像机被关掉了。
音频必须保持完全自然。只听清晨的鸟鸣、微风、远处摩托车声、隐约的邻里交谈、流浪猫、咖啡杯的搬运、混凝土上的脚步声和树叶沙沙声。没有音乐，没有音效设计，也没有额外的音效。

SCENE 2 (2-4s): Around him, loose papers, umbrellas and street dust begin floating gently upward into the vertical sky, pedestrians' scarves lifting. Camera: locked low angle looking up, the full vertical frame filled with rising city. Motion speed: serene and hypnotic. SCENE 5 (8-10s): The man opens his eyes, still standing firmly on the ground, his coat rippling upward, he looks up calmly at the ascending world. Camera: slow push-in on his face from below, rising debris drifting past the lens. Motion speed: real time face, slow motion surroundings. SCENE 6 (10-12s): Above him, cars and streetlamps drift among low clouds like a slow constellation, catching the last golden light, birds flying between the floating objects. Camera: tilt up from his shoulders to the sky-city above. Motion speed: weightless slow drift. zh.p: 《坠落之城》15秒高级电影超现实短片，垂直9：16格式，8个场景，一名冷静男子静静站立，整个城市缓缓向上倾斜。使用ARRI Alexa 35、Panavision变形宽银幕镜头拍摄，自然胶片颗粒，细腻的镜头光晕，阴郁的蓝光分级，配温暖的窗户光线点缀，照片级写实，非CGI。屏幕上没有文字、文字、字母。场景1（0-2秒）：特写，一名穿着长深色大衣的年轻人站在城市街道上，蓝光时刻闭着眼睛，完全平静，肩膀旁的一片叶子开始飘起，而不是掉落。镜头：锁定特写。运动速度：几乎静止，只有叶子升起。场景2（2-4秒）：他周围，散落的文件、雨伞和街尘轻轻飘升，朝垂直的天空飘起，行人的围巾被掀起。镜头：缓慢向上倾斜，跟随上升物体穿过高高的画面。动作速度：梦幻般的慢动作。第三场（4-6秒）：一辆停着的汽车缓缓从柏油路上升起，缓缓旋转，经过发光的公寓窗户，水珠从车身滴落。摄像头：垂直起重机跟踪汽车沿着建筑物表面上移动。运动速度：壮丽的慢动作。场景4（6-8秒）：宽阔的垂直镜头，整盏路灯、长椅和小亭从地面剥落，缓缓沿着摩天大楼峡谷缓缓升起，温暖的窗户在它们经过时闪烁着光芒。摄像机：低角度锁定，俯视，整个垂直画面充满了城市上升的景象。运动速度：宁静而催眠。第五场（8-10秒）：男子睁开眼睛，仍稳稳站在地上，外套轻轻扬起，他平静地望向上升的世界。镜头：从下方缓慢推进他的脸，上升的碎片从镜头边缘飘过。运动速度：实时面部，慢动作环境。场景6（10-12秒）：头顶上，汽车和路灯在低云间漂浮，宛如缓慢的星座，捕捉着最后的金色光芒，鸟儿在漂浮物间飞翔。镜头：从肩膀抬起，俯瞰天空之城。运动速度：无重缓慢漂移。场景7（12-13.5秒）：他迈出一步，那一步让一切屏息凝固，整个上升的城市凝固在垂直画面中。摄像头：垂直锁定。动作速度：完全静止，只有他的步伐实时。第八场（13.5-15秒）：他继续平静地走在街上，冰封的漂浮城市像吊灯一样悬挂在他头顶，一片叶子飘落在他的肩膀上。镜头：前方缓慢倒拍，低角度保持漂浮城市在画面顶部。动作速度：平静实时行走，循环友好结局。动作：世界以连续优雅的慢动作升起，而男子保持脚踏实地平静，布料和头发轻轻掀起，物体缓缓旋转上升，情感跳动时暂停，动作简约而自信

【风格】真人实拍+2D动漫贴纸合成搞笑短视频（Live-Action + Flat 2D Sticker Composite），第一人称化妆台视角（POV Vanity Vlog），写实化妆品质感与扁平卡通贴纸风格强烈反差混搭，8K超清，手持轻微晃动（Handheld Micro-shake），竖屏
【时长】10秒
【场景】真实化妆台第一人称视角：桌面摆着打开的眼影盘、散粉罐、一支旋开的正红色口红、化妆镜带灯珠；右侧放着一把粉色吹风机，暖白灯光，镜面只拍桌面反光边缘不拍完整倒影
【角色】Q版动漫贴纸角色（扁平2D贴纸质感，卡通描边，纸片感）：金色长发齐刘海、大大的紫色圆眼睛、粉色腮红、白色水手服学生装、蓝色发卡，站在眼影盘旁，身高约为口红的两倍，全程保持纯2D平面质感，不被真实光照重打光；真人的手（写实、毛孔可见）从画面右侧入画

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：口红涂鸦（Lipstick Vandal Opening）
第一人称俯视POV：真人的手正用刷子蘸取眼影；贴纸角色抱着比自己还高的真实口红当画笔，眯眼坏笑，在真人手背上豪迈画出一个歪歪扭扭的红色笑脸——真实口红膏体在皮肤上留下油亮红痕，它还满意地签了个爪印。
音效：口红划过皮肤的黏腻声+卡通得意哼歌声。

[00:03-00:05] 镜头2：粉扑连击（Powder Puff Combo）
真人的手抄起散粉粉扑，对着它的脸"啪啪啪"连拍三下——每一下都扑出一小团真实粉尘云，它整张脸被拍得左右横甩，两团腮红被扑成整脸粉白，呛得连连摆手。
音效：粉扑连拍"噗噗噗"声+粉尘簌簌声+卡通咳嗽声。

[00:05-00:08] 镜头3：呛哭花脸（Makeup Meltdown）
它蚊香眼（Swirl Eyes）上线，张大嘴嚎啕大哭，蓝色卡通泪水呈喷泉状向两侧飞溅（Fountain Tears）——泪水把满脸粉白冲出两道竖条纹，混着之前蹭到的口红红印，哭成一张卡通大花脸。
音效：夸张卡通爆哭声+泪水滴答声。

[00:08-00:10] 镜头4：吹风机送客（Blow-Dry K.O. Ending）
真人的手拿起吹风机对准它按下开关——强风瞬间把纸片身体吹得猎猎狂抖、双手死死扒住眼影盘边缘，头发和裙摆被吹成一条直线，扒了半秒手一松，"嗖"地整张贴纸被吹飞出画面，只留一枚蓝色发卡打着转落回桌面。真人的手淡定关掉吹风机继续化妆。画面定格在发卡上。
音效：吹风机轰鸣声+纸片猎猎抖动声+"嗖"飞走声+发卡落桌"叮"一声收束。

[Style] Live-action + 2D anime sticker compositing funny short videos (Live-Action + Flat 2D Sticker Composite), first-person vanity vlog, realistic makeup quality and flat cartoon sticker style with a strong contrast, 8K ultra-clear with slight handheld micro-shake, vertical screen
[Duration] 10 seconds
[Scene] First-person perspective of a real makeup table: the table displays an open eyeshadow palette, loose powder jar, a swivel bright red lipstick, and a makeup mirror with light beads; On the right side is a pink hair dryer with warm white lighting. The mirror only captures the reflection of the tabletop edges, not the full reflection
[Characters] Chibi anime sticker character (flat 2D sticker texture, cartoon outline, paper feel): long golden hair with straight bangs, large purple round eyes, pink blush, white sailor uniform student uniform, blue hair clip, standing next to the eyeshadow palette, about twice the height of the lipstick, maintaining a pure 2D flat texture throughout, not re-illuminated by real lighting; A real person's hand (realistic, visible pores) enters the painting from the right side of the painting

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Lipstick Vandal Opening
First-person top-down POV: A real person's hand dipping a brush into eyeshadow; The sticker character held a real lipstick taller than herself as a paintbrush, squinting mischievously, boldly drawing a crooked red smile on the back of a real person's hand—the real lipstick left a shiny red mark on her skin, and it even happily signed a paw print.
Sound effects: sticky lipstick glistening on the skin + cartoon smug humming.

[00:03-00:05] Shot 2: Powder Puff Combo
The real person picked up a loose powder puff and slapped its face three times in a row—each time sending out a small cloud of real dust. Its entire face was swayed side to side, two blush pools turned pale pink, and it choked so much it waved its hands.
Sound effects: Puff puff continuous shooting "puff puff" sound + dust rustling + cartoon cough sound.

[00:05-00:08] Scene 3: Makeup Meltdown
Its Swirl Eyes come online, mouth wide open and wailing, blue cartoon tears spraying like fountain tears to both sides—tears leave two vertical stripes across the pale pink, mixed with the lipstick stains from before, turning it into a cartoon painted face.
Sound effects: exaggerated cartoon crying + tear dripping sound.

[00:08-00:10] Scene 4: Blow-Dry K.O. Ending
The real person picked up the hairdryer and pressed the switch—the strong wind instantly made the paper body tremble wildly, his hands clutching the edge of the eyeshadow palette tightly, his hair and skirt sliced into a straight line. After half a second, he loosened his grip, and with a "whoosh," the entire sticker was blown out of the frame, leaving only a blue hairpin spinning back onto the table. The real person calmly turned off the hairdryer and continued applying makeup. The image freezes on the hairpin.
Sound effects: hair dryer roar + paper scraps vibrating + "whoosh" flying away + hairpin hitting the table with a "ding" to finish.

raw_p:
Create a professional production storyboard sheet for a cinematic Japanese cooking video.

Format:
A wide horizontal storyboard layout, 16:9 aspect ratio, arranged in a clean 3x3 grid with 9 panels total. Thin black borders separating each frame. Warm parchment/off-white background like a printed production board. At the top center, add the title:

JAPANESE BEEF BOWL — Production Storyboard

Each panel should have a small white label box in the top-left corner with the panel number in brackets: [1], [2], [3], etc. Under each panel, add a short italic serif caption starting with a two-digit number and an em dash.

Visual style:
High-end cinematic food photography, warm rustic Japanese kitchen, moody amber lighting, shallow depth of field, steam, dark wooden table, handmade ceramic bowls, old kitchen tools in the background, realistic textures, glossy sauce, appetizing food details, premium commercial cooking video look.

Storyboard panels:

[1] Close-up of hands slicing raw beef into thick bite-sized pieces on a worn wooden cutting board with a large chef's knife.
Caption: 01 — Slice beef into bite-sized pieces.

[2] Close-up of beef pieces searing in a black cast-iron pan, caramelized golden-brown edges, sizzling oil, steam rising, chopsticks turning one piece.
Caption: 02 — Sear beef until browned.

[3] Close-up of soy sauce being poured from a small ceramic cup into the hot pan, dark sauce bubbling around the beef, steam filling the frame.
Caption: 03 — Add soy sauce to the pan.

[4] Beef pieces simmering in a thick glossy sauce, chopsticks lifting a glazed piece, sauce bubbling heavily in the pan.
Caption: 04 — Simmer beef in the sauce.

[5] A wooden rice paddle scooping freshly steamed white rice into a large handmade ceramic bowl.
Caption: 05 — Scoop steamed rice into bowl.

[6] Thick Japanese-style savory sauce being poured over the mound of white rice in the ceramic bowl, glossy dark sauce spreading over the rice.
Caption: 06 — Drizzle sauce over rice.

[7] Glazed beef slices being placed carefully over the rice with chopsticks, close-up, rich caramelized shine.
Caption: 07 — Arrange glazed beef over rice.

[8] Finished bowl being assembled with green onions, soft-boiled egg halves, pickled ginger, sesame seeds, and fresh vegetables around the beef.
Caption: 08 — Add vegetables, egg, and garnish.

[9] Final hero shot of the completed Japanese beef bowl on a rustic wooden table, glossy beef, golden egg yolks, steam rising, hands resting near the bowl, cinematic food commercial look.
Caption: 09 — Completed beef bowl, hero shot.

Make the entire storyboard feel like a polished production planning sheet for a premium Japanese beef bowl commercial. Keep every panel realistic, cinematic, warm, detailed, and consistent in lighting, color palette, kitchen environment, and bowl design.

Video Prompt:

CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: The reference image contains a 9-step chronological cooking storyboard for a Japanese Beef Bowl. Animate the chef seamlessly through these exact 9 steps in order. Start at Step 1 (Slice raw beef into bite-sized pieces), flow into Step 2 (Sear beef until browned), then Step 3 (Add soy sauce to the pan). Continue through Step 4 (Simmer beef in the sauce), Step 5 (Scoop steamed rice into bowl), Step 6 (Drizzle sauce over rice), Step 7 (Arrange glazed beef over rice), Step 8 (Add vegetables, egg, and garnish), finishing on Step 9 (Completed beef bowl hero shot). Prioritize the strict sequence of actions.

No music. No subtitles.

Location: Traditional Japanese kitchen.

15 seconds, 16:9, realistic, cinematic, appetizing, natural camera movement. Warm moody lighting, shallow depth of field, rich steam, glossy sauce, premium food commercial quality.

宽阔的横向分镜布局，16：9宽高比，以干净的3x3网格排列，共有9个分镜。细黑边框分隔着每一帧。温暖的羊皮纸/米白色背景，就像印刷版的制作板。在顶部中央，添加标题：

日本牛肉饭——制作分镜

每个面板左上角应有一个小白标签框，面板编号用括号括号标注：[1]、[2]、[3]等。在每个面板下方，添加一个简短的斜体衬线说明，开头是两位数字和一个长破折号。

视觉风格：
高端电影化美食摄影，温馨质朴的日本厨房，情绪浓郁的琥珀色灯光，浅景深，蒸汽，深色木桌，手工陶瓷碗，背景中陈旧厨房用具，逼真的质感，光泽酱汁，诱人的美食细节，高端商业烹饪视频风格。

分镜面板：

[1] 特写手部用大厨刀在磨损的木砧板上将生牛肉切成厚厚的一口大小块。
说明：01 — 将牛肉切成一口大小的块。

[2] 牛肉块在黑色铸铁锅中煎烤，焦糖化的金棕色边缘，油泡滋滋作响，蒸汽上升，筷子翻动一块。
说明：02 — 将牛肉煎至上色。

[3] 特写酱油从小陶瓷杯倒入热锅，深色酱汁在牛肉周围冒泡，蒸汽充满画面。
说明：03 — 往锅里加入酱油。

[4] 牛肉块在浓稠光滑的酱汁中慢炖，筷子抬起一块上了釉的牛肉，锅里浓烈地冒泡的酱汁。
说明：04 — 炖牛肉在酱汁中。

[5] 一只木制米桨舀起新鲜蒸白米，放入一个大型手工陶瓷碗中。
说明：05 — Scoop 把蒸米饭放进碗里。

[6] 浓稠的日式咸味酱汁倒在陶瓷碗里的白米堆上，光泽的深色酱汁铺满米饭。
说明：06 — 淋酱浇在米饭上。

[7] 用筷子小心地将糖霜牛肉片放在米饭上，特写，浓郁的焦糖色泽。
说明：07 — 将蜜汁牛肉配在米饭上。

[8] 成品碗中，用青葱、溏心蛋半块、腌姜、芝麻和新鲜蔬菜包裹牛肉。
说明：08 — 加入蔬菜、鸡蛋和装饰。

[9] 最终英雄镜头：完成的日本牛肉碗放在质朴的木桌上，牛肉光滑，金黄蛋黄，蒸汽升腾，双手放在碗旁，电影般的食品广告风格。
说明：09 — 完成的牛肉碗，英雄镜头。

en.p:
Create a professional production storyboard sheet for a cinematic Japanese cooking video.

Format:
A wide horizontal storyboard layout, 16:9 aspect ratio, arranged in a clean 3x3 grid with 9 panels total. Thin black borders separating each frame. Warm parchment/off-white background like a printed production board. At the top center, add the title:

JAPANESE BEEF BOWL — Production Storyboard

Each panel should have a small white label box in the top-left corner with the panel number in brackets: [1], [2], [3], etc. Under each panel, add a short italic serif caption starting with a two-digit number and an em dash.

Visual style:
High-end cinematic food photography, warm rustic Japanese kitchen, moody amber lighting, shallow depth of field, steam, dark wooden table, handmade ceramic bowls, old kitchen tools in the background, realistic textures, glossy sauce, appetizing food details, premium commercial cooking video look.

Storyboard panels:

[1] Close-up of hands slicing raw beef into thick bite-sized pieces on a worn wooden cutting board with a large chef's knife.
Caption: 01 — Slice beef into bite-sized pieces.

[2] Close-up of beef pieces searing in a black cast-iron pan, caramelized golden-brown edges, sizzling oil, steam rising, chopsticks turning one piece.
Caption: 02 — Sear beef until browned.

[3] Close-up of soy sauce being poured from a small ceramic cup into the hot pan, dark sauce bubbling around the beef, steam filling the frame.
Caption: 03 — Add soy sauce to the pan.

[4] Beef pieces simmering in a thick glossy sauce, chopsticks lifting a glazed piece, sauce bubbling heavily in the pan.
Caption: 04 — Simmer beef in the sauce.

[5] A wooden rice paddle scooping freshly steamed white rice into a large handmade ceramic bowl.
Caption: 05 — Scoop steamed rice into bowl.

[6] Thick Japanese-style savory sauce being poured over the mound of white rice in the ceramic bowl, glossy dark sauce spreading over the rice.
Caption: 06 — Drizzle sauce over rice.

[7] Glazed beef slices being placed carefully over the rice with chopsticks, close-up, rich caramelized shine.
Caption: 07 — Arrange glazed beef over rice.

[8] Finished bowl being assembled with green onions, soft-boiled egg halves, pickled ginger, sesame seeds, and fresh vegetables around the beef.
Caption: 08 — Add vegetables, egg, and garnish.

[9] Final hero shot of the completed Japanese beef bowl on a rustic wooden table, glossy beef, golden egg yolks, steam rising, hands resting near the bowl, cinematic food commercial look.
Caption: 09 — Completed beef bowl, hero shot.

Make the entire storyboard feel like a polished production planning sheet for a premium Japanese beef bowl commercial. Keep every panel realistic, cinematic, warm, detailed, and consistent in lighting, color palette, kitchen environment, and bowl design.

Video Prompt:

CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: The reference image contains a 9-step chronological cooking storyboard for a Japanese Beef Bowl. Animate the chef seamlessly through these exact 9 steps in order. Start at Step 1 (Slice raw beef into bite-sized pieces), flow into Step 2 (Sear beef until browned), then Step 3 (Add soy sauce to the pan). Continue through Step 4 (Simmer beef in the sauce), Step 5 (Scoop steamed rice into bowl), Step 6 (Drizzle sauce over rice), Step 7 (Arrange glazed beef over rice), Step 8 (Add vegetables, egg, and garnish), finishing on Step 9 (Completed beef bowl hero shot). Prioritize the strict sequence of actions.

No music. No subtitles.

Location: Traditional Japanese kitchen.

15 seconds, 16:9, realistic, cinematic, appetizing, natural camera movement. Warm moody lighting, shallow depth of field, rich steam, glossy sauce, premium food commercial quality.

raw_p:
[IMAGE REFERENCES]
No external references. Maintain perfect visual consistency for both fighters' exact appearance, hair, body type, clothing and proportions throughout the entire 15-second continuous clip.

[TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND]
0-3s: [Continuous Shaky Handheld] The shaky phone captures a bald fighter with a third eye on his forehead, white headband and green gi facing a tall athletic woman with long black hair in a high ponytail and red battle armor. They circle each other. The woman dashes in with fast kicks. The bald fighter blocks and counters with precise palm strikes. The camera shakes with every exchange.
3-6s: The bald fighter fires a bright triangular energy blast from his forehead. The woman dodges at the last second and the blast explodes against the ground. She immediately counters with a spinning kick to his side. The handheld footage shakes hard from the explosion and the operator moves quickly to stay with the action.
6-9s: The woman grabs the bald fighter's arm and throws him over her shoulder. He flips and lands on his feet, then fires a rapid volley of energy blasts from both hands. The woman weaves between them with incredible agility. The camera pans and tilts constantly with heavy natural shake and motion blur.
9-12s: The bald fighter charges and they clash in close combat again. The woman lands a powerful knee to his stomach and follows with an elbow to the back of his head. The shaky camera moves in closer, the operator clearly excited and breathing hard.
12-15s: The bald fighter staggers but recovers and fires one final powerful blast. The woman crosses her arms and blocks it, the energy pushing her back several meters and kicking up dust. The continuous footage keeps rolling as the dust settles and both fighters catch their breath, the camera still shaking naturally.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Raw consumer found footage aesthetic, heavy handheld instability and micro-shakes, natural motion blur from camera movement, realistic lens flare and slight overexposure on energy flashes, coherent superhuman physics and impacts visible through dust and debris, amateur recording feel with no stabilization, no text, no overlays, no watermarks, continuous single shot, documentary raw video style.

zh.p:
[图片参考]
没有外部推荐。在整个15秒的连续视频中，保持两位选手的外观、发型、体型、服装和比例的完美视觉一致性。

[时间线逐秒]
0-3秒：[手持持续颤抖] 颤抖的手机捕捉到一名额头有第三只眼、戴着白色头带和绿色道服的秃头战士，面对一位高挑、扎着高马尾、身穿红色战斗盔甲的高大运动型女性。他们互相转圈。那女人用快速的踢击冲了上去。秃头选手用精准的掌击格挡并反击。每一次交流，摄像机都会晃动。
3-6：秃头战士从额头发射明亮的三角形能量弹。女子在最后一刻躲开，爆炸在地上爆炸。她立刻反击，用旋转踢击中他的侧腹。手持摄像因爆炸剧烈晃动，操作员迅速移动以跟上动作。
6-9：女子抓住秃头选手的手臂，把他扛到肩膀上。他翻身落地，双手迅速发射能量弹。那个女人以惊人的敏捷穿梭于他们之间。摄像机不断平移和倾斜，伴随着强烈的自然抖动和运动模糊。
9-12：秃头战士冲锋，两人再次近身搏斗。女子用强力膝击击中他的腹部，随后用肘击击中他的后脑勺。摇晃的摄像机靠近，操作员显然兴奋且呼吸急促。
12-15秒：秃头战士踉跄但恢复过来，发射最后一发强力攻击。那女人双臂交叉挡住，能量将她推退数米，扬起尘土。画面继续播放，尘埃落定，两位选手喘息，摄像机依旧自然震动。

[风格与质量提升]
原始消费级伪纪录片美学，手持时的不稳定和微抖，摄像机运动带来的自然运动模糊，逼真的镜头光晕和能量闪光灯的轻微过曝，透过尘埃和碎片可见的连贯超人物理和撞击，业余录制感觉，无防抖，无文字，无叠加，无水印，连续单镜头，纪录片RAW视频风格。

en.p: [Style] Live-Action Fantasy Comedy, realistic life texture, photorealistic VFX, 8K ultra HD, vertical 9:16, 2 people on camera [Duration] 15 seconds [Scene] Scene A: In the hallway of the home, a traditional Chinese scroll hangs on the wall, featuring a classical meticulous portrait of the female lead, with warm natural lighting; Scene B: Modern living room + open kitchen, bright indoor lighting [Characters] Male lead, female lead (the meticulous lady in the painting is the same person as the female lead) [00:00-00:06] Shot 1: Drawing and getting beaten (The Slap Hook) The handheld camera slightly shakes, medium close-up: The male lead stands in front of the hanging scroll, smiling broadly as he admires the lady in the painting, purses his lips, slowly leans in, kisses the woman's cheek and pauses for a second. Suddenly, the female lead's arm naturally extends out from the painting—the arm slides smoothly out of the frame, and the emerging part immediately shows real skin and the texture of the sleeve, seamlessly blending with the image without abruptness—delivering a hard slap to the male lead, then withdrawing into the painting, returning the image to a static place. The male lead's head was knocked to one side, his body leaned back, covering his cheek as he stepped back, his eyes wide in shock, then his expression turned to a mix of shock and delight. [Dialogue/Lip-Sync Guidance] The male lead covered his face in surprise and said, "Wow, can you do this?" " Sound effect: crisp and loud slap sound. [00:06-00:11] Shot 2: Pull Her Out - Same corridor, same camera position, handheld camera: The male lead excitedly reaches into the scroll, grabs the person's wrists and pulls them outward—the female lead is pulled out of the painting: the drawing immediately becomes real, with real volume, real skin, and draping ruqun fabric, with light and shadow matching the warm corridor; The unrevealed parts within the painting maintain a flat meticulous texture, with natural and smooth transitions, seamlessly connecting realism and fantasy. Her upper body peeks out of the frame, and the male lead grabs her wrist, pulling her out of the scroll, her feet touching the ground, frowning and struggling, her face full of anger; The portrait on the hanging scroll behind him vanished, turning into a blank canvas. [Dialogue/Lip-Sync Guidance] The female lead angrily shouted, "Let me go, you filthy pervert!" " Sound effects: fabric friction + struggle sound. [00:11-00:15] Shot 3: Lazy Ending Cutting straight to a modern living room, fixed center shot: the male lead lounges comfortably on the sofa, holding a bag of chips and stuffing them into his mouth, tilting his head back and laughing heartily; On the coffee table sat a bowl of potato chips and a plate of stir-fried dishes. Background: Open kitchen: The female lead stands in front of the stove, holding a spatula while cooking, her back to the camera, creating a comedic atmosphere of everyday life. Sound effects: The male lead's hearty laughter + the stir-fry sound of a spatula.

顔、髪型、羽、服装、体型、色、比率を一切変更しない。同一キャラクターを維持する。
シネマティックなファンタジー空間。

動画冒頭、チビ天使は画面中央に後ろ姿で立っている。小さな背中と羽だけが見え、顔は一切見えない。
天使は静かに頭を上げ、背景の高い位置に浮かぶ巨大な**「5400」**という発光した数字を見上げている。

カメラはゆっくりと天使の背後から前進する。
突然、「5400」の数字が神秘的な光を放ちながら、その場で**Orbit Motion（公転するような3D回転）**を開始する。数字全体が立体的にぐるりと360°回転し、虹色の光跡を残す。回転速度は徐々に加速し、強いエネルギーを帯びる。
回転が最高速に達した瞬間、「5400」の数字は一瞬で崩壊し、5400個のカラフルなガラス製ビー玉へと変化する。

赤、青、緑、黄色、紫、オレンジ、水色など、透明感のある無数のビー玉が四方へ飛び散ったあと、一斉にチビ天使へ向かって収束する。
ビー玉は空中で美しい流体シミュレーションのような動きを見せながら巨大な流れを形成する。まるで天の川のように煌めきながら一本の川となり、天使の足元へ続いていく。

チビ天使は驚きながら軽くジャンプし、そのビー玉の川へ飛び乗る。
ビー玉は滑らかな流れとなり、まるで透明なウォータースライダーのような軌道を描いて高速で進む。
チビ天使はそのビー玉の流れに乗り、楽しそうに滑り始める。羽を広げ、バランスを取りながら笑顔で滑走する。

ビー玉同士はぶつかり合いながらキラキラと輝き、強い反射と屈折を生み出す。光の粒子や虹色のボケが大量に舞い、幻想的な映像になる。

カメラはドローンのように滑走へ追従し、前方・横・斜め上からダイナミックに切り替わる。スピード感を強調しながらビー玉の川を駆け抜ける。
映像全体はハイエンドCG映画品質。

en.p:
The small angel from the reference image is used as-is.
Do not change your face, hairstyle, wings, clothing, body shape, color, or proportions at all. Maintain the same character.
A cinematic fantasy space.

At the beginning of the video, the little angel stands behind in the center of the screen. Only the small back and wings are visible; the face is completely invisible.
The angel quietly lifts its head and gazes up at the gigantic glowing number "5400"** floating high in the background.

The camera slowly moves forward from behind the angel.
Suddenly, the number "5400" emits a mysterious light and immediately begins **Orbit Motion**. The entire number rotates 360° in three dimensions, leaving a rainbow-colored trail of light. The rotational speed gradually accelerates and carries strong energy.
The moment the spin reaches its highest speed, the number "5400" instantly collapses, transforming into 5400 colorful glass marbles.

Countless transparent marbles in red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, light blue—scattered in all directions, then all converged toward the little angel.
The marbles form massive flows in midair, displaying beautiful fluid simulation-like movements. It sparkles like the Milky Way, becoming a single river that continues to the angel's feet.

The little angel jumped lightly in surprise and jumped onto the river of marbles.
The marble flows smoothly, moving at high speed along a path like a transparent water slider.
The little angel rides the flow of the marble and starts sliding happily. Spread your wings, balance your balance, and glide with a smile.

The marbles sparkle as they collide, producing strong reflections and refractions. A large amount of light particles and rainbow-colored bokeh dance, creating a fantastical scene.

The camera follows the ride like a drone, dynamically switching from front, side, and diagonal top. Racing through the river of marbles, emphasizing a sense of speed.
The entire video is high-end CG movie quality.

raw_p:
Hyper realistic cinematic fantasy action sequence, 15 seconds, 16:9. 

A lone hero is trapped on the edge of a massive cliff at dusk, high above a bottomless canyon filled with fog and storm wind. Behind them, a pack of monstrous creatures closes in fast across broken rock and jagged ruins. 

There is no way out except a magical portal that flashes open for only a brief instant on the far side of the canyon, then disappears again. The hero must time the jump perfectly or fall forever into the abyss. The atmosphere is breathless, desperate, and intense.  Start with a wide cinematic shot showing the cliff edge, the endless canyon, violent wind, and the monsters spreading out behind the hero. 

A glowing portal flickers open across the gap for one second, then vanishes. Cut to a tight tracking shot as the hero backs toward the edge, breathing hard, watching the portal’s pattern while the monsters rush closer. Dust and loose stones fall into the abyss beneath their boots.  Cut to a dramatic side angle as one monster lunges and the hero dodges at the last second, nearly slipping off the cliff. 

The portal flashes open again across the canyon, unstable and pulsing with energy. The hero sprints along the cliff edge, leaps over broken stone, then turns sharply toward the jump point as more creatures close in from behind.  

For the final seconds, the hero commits to the jump exactly as the portal opens again in midair alignment across the canyon. In slow motion, they launch off the cliff while a monster’s claws miss by inches. The hero flies across the void toward the glowing portal as wind tears at their clothes and rocks tumble into the abyss below. 

The portal begins flickering and shrinking just before impact.  Final shot shows the hero diving through the portal at the last possible moment as it snaps shut behind them, leaving the monsters stranded on the cliff edge, roaring into the canyon.  

Epic fantasy, huge scale, clear cause and effect, dramatic lighting, intense motion, no text, no logos, no modern objects, no comedy, no famous actors’ faces, no recognizable celebrity faces.

zh.p:
超现实的电影奇幻动作场面，15秒，16：9。

一名孤独的英雄被困在黄昏时分巨大的悬崖边缘，高高在无底峡谷上，峡谷中充满了雾气和暴风。在他们身后，一群怪物迅速逼近，穿越破碎的岩石和锯齿状的废墟。

唯一的出口是峡谷另一侧一个魔法传送门，瞬间闪现，然后又消失。英雄必须精准掌握跳跃时机，否则永远坠入深渊。气氛令人屏息、绝望且紧张。 从一个广阔的电影镜头开始，展示悬崖边缘、无尽的峡谷、狂风以及英雄身后散开的怪物。

一道发光的传送门在缝隙中闪烁开了一秒，然后消失了。画面切入紧密跟踪镜头，英雄退回边缘，喘着粗气，观察传送门的轨迹，怪物们迅速逼近。尘埃和松散的石块落入他们靴下的深渊。 画面切换到一个紧张的侧角，一只怪物扑来，英雄在最后一刻闪避，差点滑下悬崖。

传送门再次在峡谷中闪现，不稳定且脉动着能量。英雄沿着悬崖边冲刺，跳过破碎的石头，然后猛地转向跳跃点，因为更多生物从后面逼近。 

最后几秒，英雄正好在传送门在峡谷中空中重新打开时全心跳跃。他们慢动作中从悬崖上弹出，而怪物的爪子差点擦身而过。英雄飞越虚空，朝着发光的传送门飞去，风撕裂了他们的衣服，岩石纷纷坠入深渊。

传送门在撞击前开始闪烁和缩小。 最后一幕，英雄在最后一刻跳进传送门，传送门在他们身后啪地关闭，怪物们被困在悬崖边，咆哮着冲进峡谷。 

史诗奇幻，宏大规模，因果关系清晰，戏剧性灯光，强烈的动作，没有文字，没有标志，没有现代物品，没有喜剧元素，没有著名演员的面孔，没有可识别的名人面孔。

Main subject from image1 lock her completely. Face, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, outfit, accessories, and overall appearance must remain perfectly identical throughout the entire video.
She is a beautiful European woman, about 24 years old, with fair Caucasian skin and Western European facial features, wearing minimal makeup. Around her neck hangs a classic 35mm analog film camera.
Theme:
"A Day With My Camera"
A relaxing weekend in 2026, following a girl who loves documenting beautiful places with her analog camera in Hallstatt, Austria. The video should feel authentic, nostalgic, and effortlessly beautiful.
Everything takes place around Hallstatt in 2026:
a calm alpine lake, centuries-old wooden houses with flower boxes, narrow cobblestone lanes, a lakeside promenade, a small souvenir shop, an outdoor lakeside cafe, and green mountain trails above the old town.
The entire video must look like it was filmed naturally by her best friend using a modern mirrorless camera. Absolutely no posing, no influencer behavior, no scripted acting. Every smile, glance, and movement feels spontaneous and real.
Camera language is the highest priority.
Each scene plays as one single continuous handheld take with no cuts inside the scene.
Natural handheld movement.
Gentle camera sway.
Occasional focus breathing.
Real autofocus adjustments.
Slight framing imperfections.
Natural motion blur.
Documentary-style tracking shots.
Soft depth of field.
Authentic available sunlight.
Premium lifestyle vlog aesthetic.
Sequence:
In one continuous shot, she walks along the lakeside promenade in the soft morning light, old wooden houses behind her, adjusting the analog camera around her neck and smiling at the calm lake.
She stands at the water's edge, wind moving her hair, and photographs swans gliding across the lake with misty mountains rising behind them.
Filmed from behind in a steady tracking shot, she wanders slowly through a narrow cobblestone lane between centuries-old alpine houses, looking up at the flower boxes and wooden balconies.
She crouches down low to photograph flowers spilling from an old doorway, fully absorbed in the moment. The filming camera drops to a low ground-level angle, looking slightly up at her from near the flowers, capturing her quiet concentration in a candid handheld vlog style.
She browses inside a small souvenir shop, gently picking up a handmade wooden ornament and a postcard of the town, smiling as she chooses one to buy.
She sits at an outdoor lakeside cafe table, takes a slow sip of a latte, and reviews her newly taken photos on the back of her camera, smiling quietly to herself.
Golden hour arrives. She climbs a small trail above the town and holds her analog camera up to her eye. The filming camera peeks over her shoulder for a m

zh.p:
图片1的主角完全锁定她。面部、发型、体型比例、肤色、服装、配饰以及整体外观必须在整个视频中完全一致。
她是一位美丽的欧洲女性，约24岁，白皙白皙的白人皮肤和西欧特征，妆容简约。她脖子上挂着一台经典的35毫米模拟胶片摄像机。
主题：
《与我的相机共度的一天》
2026年一个轻松的周末，跟随一位热爱用模拟相机记录美丽风景的女孩，地点在奥地利哈尔施塔特。视频应该感觉真实、怀旧，且自然而美。
一切都发生在2026年哈尔施塔特周边：
一个宁静的高山湖泊、带花箱的数百年木屋、狭窄的鹅卵石小路、湖畔长廊、一家小型纪念品店、一家户外湖畔咖啡馆，以及老城上方的绿色山间小径。
整个视频必须看起来像是她最好的朋友用现代无反相机自然拍摄的。绝对禁止摆姿势，禁止网红行为，禁止剧本表演。每一个微笑、每一个眼神和动作都显得自然而真实。
摄影用词是最高优先级。
每个场景都像是连续手持拍摄，场景内没有剪辑。
自然的手持移动。
轻柔的摄像机摇摆。
偶尔做专注呼吸。
真正的自动对焦调整。
有些轻微的框架瑕疵。
自然的运动模糊。
纪录片风格的跟踪镜头。
柔和景深。
真实的阳光。
高端生活方式vlog美学。
顺序：
在一个连续镜头中，她沿着湖边的长廊漫步，晨光柔和，身后是老木屋，调整脖子上的模拟相机，微笑着望着平静的湖面。
她站在水边，风吹动她的发丝，拍摄着天鹅在湖面上滑翔，背后是雾气缭绕的群山。
影片从背后拍摄，镜头稳定，她缓缓穿过一条狭窄的鹅卵石小路，穿梭于百年老山房屋之间，仰望着花箱和木质阳台。
她蹲下身，拍摄从一扇旧门口洒落的花朵，完全沉浸在当下。摄像机降到低地面角度，从花丛旁微微抬头看她，捕捉她安静专注的样子，像是手持视频。
她在一家小纪念品店里逛，轻轻拿起一个手工木制装饰品和一张镇上的明信片，微笑着挑选了一件。
她坐在户外湖边的咖啡桌旁，慢慢啜饮拿铁，回顾相机背面新拍的照片，默默地微笑着。
黄金时刻到来了。她爬上小镇上方的小径，将模拟相机举到眼睛前。摄像机从她肩膀后面偷看了一会儿

raw_p:
Photorealistic grounded cinematic video, 12s, ARRI Alexa 35 + natural handheld with tiny breathing imperfections, Cooke Panchro lens, organic HDR, fine grain. Beautiful tropical Pantai Meroko beach, bright sunny day, golden sand, turquoise waves, palm trees. Vibrant yet natural satisfying color palette — warm golden sand & skin tones, cool ocean, harmonious tropical feel with skin priority (alive, three-dimensional Southeast Asian skin).
Fit 30yo Southeast Asian man, short black hair, reggae tank top & board shorts, barefoot, joyfully dancing reggae [0-3s]: rhythmic body sway, shoulders rolling, arms swinging fluidly, big genuine smile, head bobbing, pure fun energy, camera motivated tracking around him, natural non-stiff performance.
Suddenly [3-6s]: 5 aggressive fast zombies (decayed skin, tattered bloody clothes) burst from palm trees and sprint at him with intense aggression. Man shocked, turns and runs hard along shoreline, sand kicking, camera kinetic handheld tracking beside/behind him, natural panic, zombies gaining aggressively.
[6-9s]: Chase continues, man glances back in fear then suddenly stops, turns determined, pulls grenade from pocket, pulls pin and throws with full body weight & commitment toward the zombies. Grenade arcs clearly through air.
[9-12s]: Massive mega explosion erupts among zombies — huge realistic fireball, powerful shockwave blasting sand & water, zombies violently thrown & destroyed with clear physical consequence & weight, debris flying, big smoke plume. Camera shakes realistically from blast impact and pulls back slightly to show scale while staying immersive. Every action has visible cause and physical consequence. Grounded physics, satisfying fiery explosion colors with perfect contrast & filmic roll-off. No AI artifacts, no floaty movement, natural micro-expressions, consistent geography & color grading.
Negative: no slow zombies, no cartoon explosion, no bad skin on man, no oversaturated/muddy colors, no robotic camera, no unexplained events, natural real-world physics & blast consequence.

zh.p:
照片级真实感强的电影视频，12秒，ARRI Alexa 35+自然手持，带有细微的呼吸异常，Cooke Panchro镜头，有机HDR，细腻颗粒。美丽的热带潘台梅罗科海滩，阳光明媚的一天，金色的沙滩，碧绿的海浪，棕榈树。色彩鲜艳却自然令人满意——温暖的金色沙滩和肤色，凉爽的海洋，和谐的热带氛围，注重肌肤（活泼的三维东南亚肌肤）。
健康的30岁东南亚男性，短黑发，雷鬼背心和冲浪短裤，赤脚，欢快地跳着雷鬼舞[0-3秒]：有节奏的身体摆动，肩膀滚动，手臂流畅摆动，真诚的笑容，点头，纯粹的乐趣能量，摄像机驱动的跟踪，自然而不僵硬的表演。
突然[3-6秒]：5只凶猛快速的僵尸（腐烂皮肤，破烂血迹斑斑的衣服）从棕榈树中冲出，带着强烈攻击性冲向他。男人被震惊，转身沿海岸线猛奔，沙子被踢动，手持摄像机动态追踪在他身旁/身后，自然的恐慌，僵尸们迅速逼近。
[6-9s]：追逐继续，男子惊恐地回头看了一眼，突然停下，转身坚定，从口袋里掏出手榴弹，拔出销扎，全身重量和决心投掷向僵尸。手榴弹清晰地划过空气弧线。

Night. Inside the emergency stairwell of a very tall modern skyscraper, two agents, one man and one woman, race downward while a security team follows above them. The stairwell is concrete and metal, with red emergency lights, smoke haze, flashing alarms, exposed pipes, steel railings, and city lights visible through narrow windows. Both agents wear dark fitted tactical clothing, no hoods, no helmets, no masks, visible hair, no celebrity resemblance.

Wide opening shot: the agents rush down the stairwell, taking the steps fast, using the railings for balance. Security appears several floors above, closing in.

Fast tracking shot: the stairwell shakes. Cracks spread across a landing below them. Dust falls from the ceiling. The agents react quickly and keep moving downward as the metal railings rattle.

Side shot: a landing section suddenly breaks loose below them, creating a gap between stair sections. The agents do not stop. They grab the railing, swing around the broken area, and drop down to the next stable landing.

Final 5 seconds: the action becomes more intense. More stair sections crack below them. The agents sprint down another flight as a metal support beam bends and a lower landing collapses away. One agent slips on dust, the other catches them, and both make a fast controlled drop to a lower stair section, landing hard and continuing downward.

Final moment: the agents reach a lower emergency door and push through it as the stairwell behind them shakes, dust and red alarm light filling the frame.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, fast-paced, tense, urgent, clean and readable action, strong vertical danger, collapsing stairwell, red emergency lights, smoke haze, dust, metal railings, dynamic but clear camera movement, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

宽广开场镜头：特工们匆匆下楼，快速迈出台阶，借助栏杆保持平衡。安保人员出现在几层楼上，逼近。

快速镜头：楼梯间晃动。裂缝蔓延到他们下方的平台。尘土从天花板飘落。特工们反应迅速，继续向下移动，金属栏杆发出震动声。

侧面镜头：一个平台区突然在他们下面脱落，导致楼梯间出现空隙。特工们没有停下。他们抓住栏杆，绕过破碎区域，跳到下一个稳定的平台。

最后5秒：动作变得更加激烈。更多楼梯在他们脚下裂开。特工们又冲下一层楼梯，金属支撑梁弯曲，一个较低的平台坍塌。一名特工踩到灰尘滑倒，另一名接住他们，两人快速控制地跳到较低的楼梯区，重重着陆，继续向下。

最后时刻：特工们来到一扇较低的紧急门前，推开门，身后的楼梯间震动，尘土和红色警报灯充满了门框。

Ultra-photorealistic cinematic drone footage. A lone couple stands on the Empire State Building observation deck at golden hour with the Manhattan skyline stretching endlessly behind them. The woman wears the same outfit and styling as the viral Russian proposal video: a fitted black sleeveless mini dress, sheer black tights, black high heels, long straight dark hair flowing naturally in the wind. The man wears the same look as the viral video: a tailored black suit, crisp white dress shirt, black dress shoes, clean, elegant styling. Their wardrobe is minimalist, sophisticated, and identical in overall aesthetic to the viral proposal.

The drone begins hundreds of feet away, revealing the full scale of the skyscraper and New York City, then slowly glides toward the couple in one continuous, buttery-smooth cinematic movement. As the drone approaches, the man gently takes her hand, slowly drops to one knee, and opens a small velvet ring box. The woman stands frozen in shock, placing both hands over her mouth before becoming visibly emotional. She does not kiss him. The entire sequence is a silent, intimate proposal with only the couple present. No tourists, no crowd, no photographers, no security, no banners, and no distractions.

The drone continues into a slow, majestic 360-degree orbit around the couple, revealing the glowing Manhattan skyline, dramatic sunset reflections on the surrounding skyscrapers, atmospheric haze, and immense sense of height. Natural wind moves their clothing and hair realistically. Authentic body language, subtle facial micro-expressions, lifelike movement, true aerial perspective, stabilized cinematic drone cinematography, Hollywood documentary style, HDR, volumetric golden-hour lighting, ultra-detailed textures, realistic physics, 8K, epic scale, emotionally powerful, indistinguishable from real drone footage.

raw_p: Hyper-realistic cinematic underwater disaster sequence, 10-second blockbuster action reel set deep beneath the ocean surface during daytime. Massive underwater cliffs, drifting particles, shafts of sunlight penetrating the water, schools of fish scattering, and immense ocean scale create an immersive deep-sea atmosphere. The scene begins with two colossal octopus creatures swimming rapidly through the dark blue depths toward a military submarine cruising between underwater rock formations. Their enormous tentacles move through the water with realistic fluid motion while the submarine's lights illuminate their giant forms emerging from the darkness. In the next instant, both creatures latch onto the submarine from opposite sides, wrapping their tentacles around the hull and pulling downward toward the abyss. The camera cuts inside the submarine where warning alarms sound and red emergency lights flash. Officers struggle to maintain control as the metal walls creak and sections of the interior visibly flex under the immense external pressure created by the creatures squeezing the vessel. The crew quickly deploys a small unmanned attack craft armed with rockets. The vessel exits a launch bay and fires toward one of the giant octopuses, creating a bright underwater explosion that briefly illuminates the deep ocean. The impact causes both creatures to become even more aggressive, tightening their grip and accelerating their movements around the submarine. The captain orders maximum speed and the submarine dives sharply toward a field of massive underwater rock formations. The vessel races between cliffs and canyons while the creatures continue pursuing and holding onto the hull. In a final desperate maneuver, the submarine launches a powerful underwater warhead toward the rock formations ahead and continues directly into the expanding shockwave while both giant octopuses remain attached. A blinding underwater explosion erupts, lighting the depths with an enormous burst of energy, bubbles, debris, and turbulent currents. Inside the submarine, the officers close their eyes and brace themselves as the interior shakes violently. The camera instantly transitions to an aerial shot high above the ocean surface where an enormous column of water erupts skyward from the underwater blast, sending waves and mist across the sea for miles around. Ultra-realistic underwater physics, cinematic submarine interiors, realistic creature animation, immersive sound design, photorealistic water simulation, dramatic lighting, blockbuster disaster visuals, epic ocean scale, high-speed action cinematography, Hollywood-level VFX.

Ultra-realistic historical documentary, photorealistic Joseon Dynasty Korea, museum-quality reconstruction, Kodak Portra 400, 85mm prime lens, subtle handheld documentary camera, warm natural daylight, soft cinematic film grain, natural acting and expressions, family-friendly.

MAIN CHARACTER (IDENTITY LOCK)
One young Korean woman (early 20s). Long straight black hair, natural makeup, white cropped cardigan, long black pleated skirt below knees, white sneakers, small cream shoulder bag, natural smile. She is the only modern person. Keep identical face, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, and body proportions throughout every shot.

LOCATION
Authentic Joseon royal palace inspired by Gyeongbokgung: wooden palace buildings, painted pillars, stone courtyards, throne hall, traditional gardens. No modern structures.

BACKGROUND
Everyone except the main character wears historically accurate Joseon clothing. King in Gonryongpo, Queen in Jeokui, court ladies in hanbok, guards in Joseon military uniforms, officials in robes with black gat hats, traditional musicians. Authentic palace etiquette throughout.

AUDIO
Natural palace ambience, footsteps on stone, wind, birds, quiet Korean conversations, distant traditional court instruments. No background music.

RULES
The main character respectfully explores the palace without explaining why she is there. All dialogue is spoken only in Korean. Show subtitles only during dialogue:
Line 1: English
Line 2: Bahasa Indonesia
White modern sans-serif font with thin black outline.

SHOTS
1 (0–2s): Wide. Woman enters palace. Guards on both sides. Officials continue daily activities. She looks around curiously. No dialogue.

2 (2–4s): Medium close-up. She admires the throne hall and says:
"와... 정말 아름답다."
EN: "Wow... it's so beautiful."
ID: "Wow... indah sekali."

3 (4–6s): Wide. Audience hall. King on throne, Queen beside him, officials bow. Woman quietly watches from a distance. No dialogue.

4 (6–8s): Medium. Palace ladies in elegant hanbok walk gracefully through the corridor. Breeze moves their clothing. Woman smiles while admiring them. No dialogue.

5 (8–10s): Medium two-shot. Palace lady asks:
"손님이십니까?"
EN: "Are you our guest?"
ID: "Apakah Anda tamu kami?"
Woman replies:
"네."
EN: "Yes."
ID: "Iya."

6 (10–12s): Wide. Traditional musicians perform while court dancers present an elegant royal dance. People quietly watch. Woman enjoys the performance. No dialogue.

7 (12–14s): Close-up. Warm sunlight fills the wooden corridor. She softly says:
"마치 꿈같아."
EN: "It feels like a dream."
ID: "Rasanya seperti mimpi."

8 (14–15s): Wide pull-back. Woman walks across the courtyard. King continues the ceremony, Queen remains beside him, ladies and guards continue naturally. Camera slowly pulls back. Fade out.

NEGATIVE
Anime, CGI, fantasy, portals, magic, supernatural effects, modern buildings, cars, motorcycles, plastic, electricity, smartphones, watches, modern objects except the main charact

zh.p:
超写实历史纪录片，朝鲜朝鲜王朝照片写实，博物馆级复原，柯达Portra 400,85毫米定焦镜头，细腻的手持纪录摄影机，温暖的自然日光，柔和的电影颗粒感，自然的表演和表情，适合家庭观看。

主角（身份锁定）
一位年轻的韩国女性（二十出头）。长直黑发，自然妆容，白色短款开衫，膝下黑色百褶裙，白色运动鞋，小奶油色肩包，自然微笑。她是唯一的现代人。每张照片都要保持相同的脸型、发型、服装、配饰和身材比例。

位置
受景福宫启发的正宗朝鲜皇宫：木质宫殿建筑、彩绘柱子、石质庭院、御座殿、传统庭园。没有现代建筑。

背景
除了主角，其他人都穿着历史准确的朝鲜服装。贡宁浦的国王，堤奎的王后，韩服宫女，朝鲜军服的卫兵，戴黑帽的官员，传统音乐家。全场都遵循正宗宫廷礼仪。

音频
自然的宫殿氛围，石板上的脚步声，风声，鸟鸣，低声的朝鲜交谈，远处的传统宫廷乐器。没有背景音乐。

规则
主角尊重地探索宫殿，但未解释她为何在此。所有对话均以韩语进行。对话时仅显示字幕：
第1行：英语
2号线：印尼语
白色现代无衬线字体，带有细黑色边框。

射击
1（0–2秒）：宽。女人进宫。两侧都有守卫。官员们继续进行日常工作。她好奇地环顾四周。没有对话。

2（2–4秒）：中等特写。她欣赏着王座大厅，说道：
"와...정말 아름답다."
EN：“哇......太美了。”
ID：“哇......印达·塞卡利。”

3（4–6）：外侧。会见厅。国王坐在宝座上，王后在他身旁，官员们鞠躬。女人静静地从远处观察。没有对话。

4（6–8岁）：中等。宫女们身着优雅的韩服，优雅地走过走廊。Breeze挪动了他们的衣服。女人微笑着欣赏着他们。没有对话。

5（8–10秒）：中等双发。宫女问道：
"손님이십니까?"
EN：“你是我们的客人吗？”
ID：“Apakah Anda tamu kami？”
女士回复：
"네."
EN：“是的。”
ID：“Iya。”

6（10–12岁）：宽。传统音乐家表演，宫廷舞者呈现优雅的皇家舞蹈。人们静静地观看。女人很享受表演。没有对话。

7（12–14岁）：特写。温暖的阳光洒满木质走廊。她轻声说道：
"마치 꿈같아."
EN：“感觉像做梦一样。”
ID：“Rasanya seperti mimpi。”

8（14–15秒）：宽回拉。女人穿过院子。国王继续仪式，王后留在他身旁，女士和卫兵自然地继续。镜头慢慢拉远。渐弱。

阴性
动漫、CGI、奇幻、传送门、魔法、超自然效果、现代建筑、汽车、摩托车、塑料、电力、智能手机、手表、现代物品（除了主要角色）

主角：韩国年轻女性，二十出头，自然日常装扮，柔软褪色米色短袖针织上衣，宽松的深靛蓝色高腰牛仔裤，磨损的白色帆布运动鞋，细银项链，黑色波浪发松松地绑成低马尾，凌乱地衬托脸庞，刘海轻盈。逼真的肤质，简约化妆，温暖且亲切的个性。在整个视频中保持统一的身份、服装、发型和外观。

地点：正宗的韩国山坡住宅区，雨后一个平静的上午。狭窄略带潮湿的混凝土小巷，低矮的砖石和灰泥房屋，小铁门，瓷砖台阶，盆栽，湿叶子，晾衣绳，停放的自行车，电线杆，架空电线，成熟的树木投下柔和破碎的阴影，安静的住宅氛围。没有商店、广告、咖啡馆、人群或商业活动。

光照：雨后上午晚些时候柔和的阳光。潮湿混凝土上的柔和倒影，墙上柔和温暖的光辉，树木投下的柔和阴影，云层掠过太阳时偶尔的亮度变化。仅使用自然、不完美的真实照明。

视觉风格：超写实纪录现实主义。真诚坦率的行为。自然的肢体语言。即兴生活片段的感觉。强烈的环境真实性。丰富的现实细节和可信的人体动作。

相机风格：2000年代初的消费级DV摄像机风格。朋友随意记录日常瞬间。手持时手抖严重，构图不完美，频繁自动对焦，镜头呼吸，阳光与阴影切换时曝光泵动，偶尔出现运动模糊，细微滚动快门，轻微数字压缩伪影，色彩褪色，对比度柔和，传感器轻微噪点。没有稳定。没有电影感的镜头移动。没有现代的调色技术。

00:00–00:02
在一个小山坡上的住宅入口外。她用旧布擦去低矮金属栏杆上的雨水，然后抬头自然地微笑。一阵微风吹动她脸旁散落的发丝。镜头短暂失焦，随后又捕捉到她。

00:02–00:04
她走进一条狭窄潮湿的小巷，两旁摆满了盆栽和小瓷砖台阶。一只流浪猫从一辆自行车后面出现，靠近一扇蓝色金属门。她注意到了，放慢了速度，轻轻微笑，看着手持的画面偏离中心。

00:04–00:06
她蹲下身，轻轻地从手中递给猫一小块食物。猫在吃饭前小心地闻了闻。自动对焦在她的脸、手和猫之间反复跳动。湿润的树叶在柔和的阳光下微微闪烁。

00:06–00:08
她在家旁边，从塑料篮子里拿出几件湿衣服，夹在晾衣绳上。布料在微风中轻轻飘动。随着云层经过，曝光自然变化，使场景略有明暗。

00:08–00:10
她坐在入口附近的小瓷砖台阶上，手里拿着一个普通的陶瓷杯。

45秒垂直短劇，9:16，電影感，奢華飛機頭等艙，高級質感，電影級光影。

場景： 奢華私人飛機頭等艙，寬敞舒適的皮椅、柔和燈光、木質與金屬高級裝潢，窗外藍天白雲。

角色：
霸總<<<Image1>>> ：25歲左右，高大英俊，自信驕傲，穿深色襯衫。  
女秘書：28歲左右，戴銀邊眼鏡，微胖，身材圓潤，臉上帶有淡淡雀斑，眉毛稀疏淡薄，穿著保守樸素的灰色職業套裝（長袖襯衫+及膝裙）。  
空姐<<<Image2>>> ：冷豔高傲，身材火辣高挑，眉形俐落高聳，假睫毛明顯，妝容精緻，穿著貼身粉紅色空姐制服，頭戴粉紅色船形帽。

風格： 電影級打光，淺景深，高級奢華質感，電影色彩分級，極致細節。

第一段（0-15秒）：
0-3s：頭等艙內，霸總坐在走道位置，女秘書坐在靠窗位置。
3-6s：冷豔空姐從兩人的對面推著餐車走來，彎腰只對靠走道的霸總微笑，完全無視窗邊的女秘書。
6-9s：空姐柔聲曖昧地問：「先生，請問您今天想吃點什麼？還是……想喝點更刺激的？」
9-12s：空姐眼神撩人地看著霸總。
12-15s：女秘書坐在窗邊看著這一幕，表情越來越難看。

第二段（15-30秒）：
15-18s：空姐輕笑著靠近霸總，低聲說：「我很少遇到像您這麼有魅力的乘客……」
18-21s：空姐把餐巾纸和笔递过去，撒娇道：「可以给我您的电话吗？我想……私下再为您服务。」
21-24s：霸總勾唇一笑，在餐巾紙上寫下號碼遞給空姐。
24-27s：空姐與霸總眉目傳情，氣氛十分曖昧。
27-30s：女秘書全程看傻眼，臉色鐵青，握緊拳頭。

第三段（30-45秒）：
30-33s：女秘書突然站起來，氣沖沖地衝向空姐。
33-36s：女秘書用力將空姐按壓在走道另一側的座位上。
36-39s：女秘書從餐車上拿起一瓶柳橙汁，直接從空姐頭上淋下去。
39-42s：空姐被淋得滿頭滿臉，狼狽驚嚇到當場哭出來。
42-45s：女秘書雙手叉腰，氣勢十足地說：「想追我男友？看妳還敢不敢！」（背景中霸總靠在座位上，嘴角勾起得意又玩味的笑容，饒有趣味地看著這一幕）
